reviews.text: Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious — perfectly prepared with just the right crunch and flavor. I highly recommend this restaurant — and try the lasagna bites! The decor is also lovely, with a cute Victorian French theme, and the menu offers a little bit of everything.

reviews.author: Naughty OFW
reviews.text: A Delightful Morning at Cafe Lilou, Bahrain My recent breakfast experience at Cafe Lilou in Bahrain was nothing short of delightful. From the moment I stepped inside, I was enveloped in an atmosphere of elegant charm. The decor was sophisticated and inviting, creating a truly lovely ambiance to start the day. My order consisted of a classic Eggs Benedict, a side of perfectly toasted bread, and their tempting hotcakes accompanied by a generous array of fresh berries and their signature buttery spread. To complete the meal, I opted for a simple black coffee. I'm pleased to report that every element of my breakfast was delicious. The Eggs Benedict were executed flawlessly, with perfectly poached eggs and a rich, velvety hollandaise sauce. The toasted bread was crisp and provided a satisfying contrast in texture. However, the real star of the show might have been the hotcakes. They were light and fluffy, and the combination of the sweet berries and the incredibly moreish signature buttery spread was simply divine. Even the black coffee was well-brewed and robust, providing the perfect caffeine kick. Beyond the exceptional food, what truly elevated my experience was the attentiveness of the staff. From the moment I was seated until I left, they were consistently friendly, efficient, and readily available without being intrusive. This level of service was undoubtedly a major plus for Cafe Lilou and significantly contributed to the overall positive impression.

reviews.author: Zakkry Walls
reviews.text: If you’re hungry, this is definitely the place to go! The food is rich, delicious, and tasty and the breakfast is always fantastic! Coffees and desserts and unique and elegant. Great location, and if you’re going during the week you shouldn’t have any issues with finding parking. Weekends are busy and recommend taking an uber or using the parking garage.

reviews.author: sumesh surendran
reviews.text: Happened to step in for lunch and was impressed by the attention to detail and the high level of service displayed by the staff. The service was top notch as they made sure to give us their recommendations and explained the dishes with no trace of frustration whatsoever. Kudos! The portion was ample and the quality of the food was impeccable. The variety of drinks offered is also worth mentioning. The ambiance is so lively and the vibes is certainly lit. Highly recommend this spot if you are looking for breakfast, brunch, lunch or dinner.

reviews.text: Very nice French café. They serve breakfast until late. Beautiful Parisian-style decorations with French music. I will come back if I come back to Bahrain. Situated in a very beautiful and popular area Block 338.

reviews.text: The Street Shawarma. ohh I guess this is one of the best shawarma we had so far. No joke! The green ranch sauce that one, ooohhh hit us direct to our heart. It’s our first time to try this shop and we made a good choice to have their Green Ranch Arabic Shawarma box😎 Their Shawarma will make you feel full. reviews.text: They don't care about their customers. I bought a necklace that broke the first time it was worn, took it back to get fixed and then it broke again from the same spot... took it back a total of 4 times, mind you out it hasn't been worn once. When i asked for a refund or exchange because clearly there is a manufacturing defect, they wouldnt take it back. Save ur money and buy something from more reputable places in gold city.

reviews.text: I went there because of the offer they had discount 10% on using imtiaz for her card, while I was paying turned out they are liars .. They end up by saying no discount on this item because its already on offer while its not. Their gold designs are neutral too, nothing interesting

reviews.author: Bartosz Jarmolowicz
reviews.text: Good offer of jewellery for ladies, helpful staff who and fast order to measure processing time.

reviews.author: MAZHAR SAIFI
reviews.text: The owner of Alsafa Jewellery is wow.....

reviews.author: Ahlam Falamarzi
reviews.text: Nice collection

reviews.author: Mritunjay Kumar
reviews.text: I visited Al Wadi because it’s one of the highest-rated restaurants in the Petra area, but unfortunately, my experience didn’t live up to the hype. While the location is convenient, especially for tourists visiting Petra, I felt the food and service were underwhelming. The dishes lacked the freshness and flavor I expected, especially given the strong reviews. Service was rushed but attentive. It seems like the high ratings might be more about the location and limited local options rather than the overall quality. If you’re looking for an exceptional dining experience, you might want to explore other spots or manage your expectations.

reviews.author: Sruthi Madabushi
reviews.text: This restaurant was rated as one of the best in Petra, hence we were curious to try this place. The food was really good and authentic. The atmosphere was also good, and while the town and nearby area was busy it added to the vibe of the restaurant. It’s very centrally located to the Wadi Musa town and was closely located to Petra.

reviews.author: Fahd Batayneh فهد بطاينة
reviews.text: An excellent restaurant in Petra in the downtown area with a decent menu of soups, salads, starters, local traditional and international dishes, drinks, and desserts. The restaurant is an old building that is very well designed with paintings and antiques, making it look and feel nostalgic. Food portions are enough for one person, and dishes are very tasty. The bake traditional Jordanian bread. Staff are very friendly, and can speak several main languages. They accept cash and card payment. Parking can be slightly challenging though one can park almost anywhere.

reviews.author: Anca Enache
reviews.text: Great food and atmosphere! Jeff was an amazing server that made sure that everything is perfect. The food was delicious and quick to arrive. He also show us the traditional making of tannur(local bread) as seen in the video.

reviews.author: HECTOR RAMIREZ
reviews.text: Fantastic service! Jeff took great care of us—super friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect. The food was delicious and came out quickly. Highly recommend this place, especially if you get Jeff as your server!

reviews.author: Mr.Sailor
reviews.text: Great food, the atmosphere is fabulous, a lot food choices, and the staff is great, you will enjoy yourself.

reviews.author: Ali AlMoosa
reviews.text: Al Waha at the Gulf Hotel consistently delivers top quality food with impeccable service. Seafood Night is a true highlight rich in flavors, fresh selections, and expertly prepared dishes. The attentive staff and elegant setting make it a standout dining experience every time.

reviews.author: Ngolobe Nelson
reviews.text: We had a family dinner on the Monday BBQ night, it was fantastic, the food was tasty and plenty with a lot of options, salad and fruits all available, the ambience is amazing, my wife liked everything and the kids enjoyed too. Lisa was an exception lady as she gave our table much attention, Ahmed the concierge is a fantastic guy and so welcoming, we shall be back soon for sure.

reviews.author: Mohammad Shabbir Khan
reviews.text: Sea food and sweet variety very limited as compared to the sea food @Wyndham grand. I think it can improve

reviews.author: M H
reviews.text: Had the BBQ American Buffet and it was amazing. So many choices from appetizers, salads, choices of meats, and a lot more. Great staff very friendly and helpful. Price was a little high but that’s normal theses days everywhere. Can’t wait until next Monday..

reviews.author: Aloha Mike's Neighborhood
reviews.text: My favorite breakfast place to visit while in Bahrain 🇧🇭 Girly is the most polite and attentive server. Always greets me with a smile and is a pleasure to be around. They serve pork bacon and sausage. On weekends, they have a bogo promotion featuring three menu items, but one get one free before 12:00 noon.

reviews.author: Siyan Nay
reviews.text: I love it! The drinks are nice with reasonable prices. Food is good. And The band on the weekend is such an amazing. They made our days last time. So we're gonna go back again Updated They have band on the weekday too

reviews.author: Pamela cox
reviews.text: This is a super chill place for breakfast. I have been looking for an American style breakfast and I finally found one everything on the dish was good although it is quite pricey for a breakfast I did enjoy it. The place is nice and quiet and they also play good music.

reviews.author: Heather Palma
reviews.text: Great experience. We went in for lunch and had a great time.

reviews.text: Good solid food selection, the team make it worth the visit. The decor is incredibly dark and could do with a rethink as it's a very moody choice of colour scheme

reviews.text: Juffair mourning hall is considered a unique mourning hall in every sense of the word. It is a light, a beacon and a guide in an area filled with hotels and discos. The mourning hall is the true face of Juffair. May God enlighten the hearts of those in charge of the mourning hall.

reviews.author: ameer ameer
reviews.text: Peace be upon Hussein, the children of Hussein, and the companions of Hussein, peace be upon them all

reviews.author: latif al hayki
reviews.text: Places of worship are held on religious occasions, and the place for condolences and weddings serves as a hall where people gather

reviews.author: BRO
reviews.text: I give him a star, they are all Shiites

reviews.author: BB L
reviews.text: Bahrain Bay Kitchen is the main restaurant located on the ground floor of the Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay. The restaurant is very spacious, with a refined and elegant interior. We visited for the Christmas dinner buffet, which offered an impressive variety of dishes, most of them were delicious. The seafood, in particular, was very fresh, and the ice cream was also excellent. Although it was quite crowded due to the holiday, the food was constantly replenished, and the staff provided great service throughout. It's been a while since our visit, so things may have changed, but personally, it was a very satisfying dinner buffet experience.

reviews.author: Andre Haydar
reviews.text: Amazing experience for a great quality food , vibes and gathering. We have enjoyed alot as a family , whereby kids spent time in kids club for the Friday brunch and we enjoyed our food. Buffet is not that big yet super perfect with good quality choices. The music is lovely with a beautiful band on board. The place is very nice and have outdoor seating as well. Better to reserve here.

reviews.author: Tariq Daoud
reviews.text: We came to this restaurant expecting a top-tier dining experience, but what we got was loud, chaotic, and frankly, unacceptable for any establishment – let alone one claiming to be 5-star. One table of guests was drinking heavily, singing loudly, and making obnoxious noises that echoed through the entire dining area. It felt more like a bar gone wild than a fine dining restaurant. The worst part? The staff did absolutely nothing to calm the situation. In fact, they seemed to find it amusing and even encouraged the group by laughing along and lingering near their table. Many guests, including us, were visibly uncomfortable. We couldn't enjoy our food, conversation was impossible, and the whole atmosphere was ruined. After complaining, we expected at least some form of action, but there was none. Not even an apology. Eventually, we had to leave early. For the price we paid and the reputation this place tries to uphold, the experience was a total letdown. I hope management seriously reconsiders how they handle disruptive customers and how their staff contributes to the experience. Until then, I won’t be recommending this place to anyone looking for a peaceful or refined evening out.

reviews.author: J.V.Madrid
reviews.text: Outstanding, what an experience. The food is amazing, and the variety.... You can not imagine. There are dishesh from all around the world. Service is so amable and attent. The live music is perfect. The place is really beautiful, and the sights are worthy.

reviews.author: Tyrone
reviews.text: Incredible brunch experience. The food variety/choices is almost too much but I can’t complain because there’s something for everyone. Prices are high but if you love to eat, you can eat your moneys worth with sushi, prime rib, and lamb. Hit up the high value items first and never look back!

reviews.author: Princess
reviews.text: If i could give them 10 stars I would, I am very impressed by the delicious taste of their food. I ordered clams and seabream I was enjoying every bit. The lemon butter sauce is exceptional yummy yummy. If you're seafood lover you must go there and thank me later! I would definitely go again and again any time I visit Bahrain. Thank you for the warm welcome by the staff and lovely hosts who served me ☺️🙌

reviews.author: Alexei Moiseyev
reviews.text: It's an absolutely delightful experience. The service is exceptional. The views from the terrace that envelopes the restaurant are splendid. The menu and the wine list are perfectly designed. Fresh seafood can be selected from the ice-lined display to be prepared in various ways. I've gone for a butterfly hamour simply grilled. ...an absolute delight!

reviews.author: Saud Al-Subaie
reviews.text: At the fish market resturant, you choose your seafood fish, shrimps, crabs, and seashell and how you want them to be cooked. Variety of recipes available with extra appetisers of your choice. The views around by the sea are beautiful. The service is good. But this resturant is unbelievably overpriced!

reviews.author: Zaid Al-Asa'd
reviews.text: The Fish Market restaurant offers an unforgettable dining experience that I highly recommend. From the moment you step in, the ambiance is charming, with an open and fresh design that enhances the experience. The highlight, of course, is the seafood, which is not only fresh but prepared with incredible skill. Every dish I tried was bursting with flavor, from the perfectly grilled shrimp to the deliciously fresh sea mussels. The variety on the menu caters to all preferences, ensuring that everyone finds something they love. What really sets the Fish Market apart is its exceptional service. The staff is attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable, making excellent recommendations without being overbearing. You can tell they take pride in what they do, which makes the meal that much more enjoyable. And then there’s the view – simply breathtaking. The restaurant overlooks a serene waterfront, making it the perfect spot for a romantic evening or a relaxing lunch. Whether you're a seafood lover or just looking for a unique dining experience, the Fish Market delivers on all fronts. It’s a place I can’t wait to visit again.

reviews.author: Karim Mouawad
reviews.text: We really enjoyed having lunch there. The food was delicious. Great to be able to enjoy their food as we usually enjoyed at their original branch in Al Bander Resort. It gave us the opportunity to enjoy it in downtown Bahrain Bay. Had the salad, shrimps, crab, silous and sea bream which were all delissssssh!! Thank you! ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Lilith
reviews.text: The ambience and view were beautiful. The decoration has been tastefully done, and there is a nice view of the city, sea and Fort. Unfortunately, though I was not very impressed with the food. The seafood was not seasoned, and the rice was extremely plain.

reviews.author: Ara Jherielle
reviews.text: This is a must-visit restaurant. Amazing place. You can enjoy the variety of seafood within your budget. 👍🏻 And a relaxing view of the sea. 🌊

reviews.author: DMK
reviews.text: Popular waterfront eatery at which you could either take your time and choose your catch on display to be prepared for you, or rely on expert chefs to deliver house specials at a quicker turnaround. We like seafood so we really enjoyed this place. This restaurant is frequented equally by both international tourists and local clientele who value the quality offerings of this unique venue.

reviews.author: sky Forhad
reviews.text: It's a seafood Fish Market Marina in Alexander The fish soup was different from what we're used to, as it had shrimp in it. It was a delicious soup with plenty of ingredients. Afterwards, we ordered grilled fish. It came with fried calamari and rice, but the fish was undercooked. At first, I thought this might be how Egyptians prepare fish, but then I realized it was just mine that was like that. When I asked for it to be changed, they sent a new plate. The taste was quite good. There were 4-5 different kinds of mezes, and the ones with garlic and eggplant were my favorites. Warm mini pitas were also served with the dishes. The staff were served at a normal pace. The place was large but noisy. However, the view was amazing. You could watch the calm waters of the Mediterranean from anywhere in the restaurant.

reviews.author: I. Morgan
reviews.text: The Mina District Fish Market is unlike any fish market you’ve ever seen — it’s more like stepping into the luxury food halls at Harrods. The building itself is a work of art, with intricate mosaics, clean marble interiors, and beautiful ironwork that gives the whole space a sense of calm elegance. Even if you’re not here to buy, it’s absolutely worth a visit just to admire the design and experience the atmosphere. The selection of seafood is vast, fresh, and beautifully displayed — from local catches to more exotic varieties. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, it’s the perfect stop if you’re exploring the Mina District or Old Doha Port. Stylish, spotless, and full of character — a must-see spot in the city!

reviews.author: Muna Hawwa
reviews.text: offers a unique blend of culinary excellence and architectural beauty 🩷🩷🩷 Many visitors highlight the quality of the seafood and the unique dining experience. Some patrons have noted longer waiting times during peak hours and suggest arriving early to avoid delays. Despite its upscale ambiance, the market offers competitive pricing, often more affordable than high end seafood restaurants in Doha.

reviews.author: Isuru Dissanayake
reviews.text: This is one of the iconic fish market in Mina District, Doha. This fish market is located in a building that doesn't really look like a fish market. Fish market interior is like an art gallery. The ceiling is doctorated with colorful glass panels and it looks amazing. Also they maintain the fish market with a pleasant vibe. Highly recommended to visit and have a look.

reviews.author: Света Косенко
reviews.text: Thank you for a good experience and tasty food in your restaurant. And thank you for an amazing hospitality from Khalid. Everything was 5 star, my biggest recommendation!

reviews.author: Isidre Marco Tuset
reviews.text: This is a new area on the old city harbour with nice restorants & cafeterías. The fish market is young stile and you can bay the fish that they cook for you.

reviews.text: One of the best Chinese restaurants in Bahrain

reviews.author: H M (Wanderlust)
reviews.text: This place hasn't changed in over 18 years, still serving the same dishes... So familiar too your taste buds. The Chinese dishes offered are prepared with local spices and tastes in mind. Gotta try the shrimp balls, fried rice, Mongolian beef and grilled hamour all for a reasonable price

reviews.author: Aamir Usmani
reviews.text: It is an old Chinese restaurant with some of the very good Chinese dishes. I like the most is beef strips specially cooked, forget the name. Chicken Manchuria is not that great. You can order American chowpsy, if you like sour and sweet sauce. Parking is an issue. Some time you can find near the restaurant and some times little far.

reviews.author: Ahmed Zainal
reviews.text: Another great product of the original Hong Kong restaurant chefs. If you want great Chinese food at affordable prices, this is the place to go. Parking is the only issue I have. The manager Jo really takes care of you when he's around. Try the Chili Beef or Chicken Cashew Nut.

reviews.author: ahmed zainal
reviews.text: My favorite Chinese restaurant in Bahrain. Outstanding service, excellent food, cozy atmosphere. You can ask for half portions and literally everything is good.

reviews.text: A traditional establishment, running through generations. Great authentic setting, delicious food, and good prices. Thanks to the Haji family who kept it original over the years. A must for a visitor who is looking to try local food.

reviews.author: Michael Nofal
reviews.text: Haji’s serves authentic food that’s full of flavor. They have set times for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, so it’s good to plan ahead. I tried the breakfast and was impressed by the big variety of options. You can choose to sit inside or outside. Highly recommended if you’re looking to try something traditional and authentic.

reviews.author: jaffar pathan
reviews.text: Tried mixed grill skewers….it was okay-okay. The beef skewers were slightly overcooked (burnt look). The bread was big and fresh. The ambience too was ok-ok as we were sitting outside. Good price for quantity served. Next time will try some other dish.

reviews.author: Magdalena Grudzien
reviews.text: We went to the place for lunch to try some traditional Bahraini dishes, but not much of the items on the menu were available. We took chicken curry, chicken Machboos and fish curry. All of them were fine. The portions are quite generous. What we liked the most was the traditional interior and a very good tea. There is no toilet (just a sink to wash hands). Staff is friendly and helpful. We got everything served really fast.

reviews.author: Danah Alshuaib
reviews.text: Overall, everything was great. Wonderful hospitality and great owners. They took good care of us and we were seated quickly. I personally enjoyed the white cheese, beans and beef stew.

name: Street Stall - Bab Al Bahrain
address: Street Stall - Bab Al Bahrain, Manama, Bahrain

reviews.author: Halima Alrashed
reviews.text: I had a lovely experience at The Orangery Tearoom. The atmosphere is calm, elegant, and perfect for a relaxing tea break. I ordered tea and a slice of strawberry gateau — it was light, super fluffy, and absolutely delicious! The staff were friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. Service was smooth, and everything was brought to the table with care. The tearoom itself is beautifully set up, making it a great spot to unwind and enjoy a treat. Overall, it was a wonderful visit. I’d definitely come back again and recommend it to anyone looking for a cozy place with great desserts and warm service.

reviews.author: Isha Al-Maghrabi
reviews.text: This was a great place to try! The setting is beautiful, with friendly service, and the food was delicious. I tried the egg nachos, which is something I’ve never tried before anywhere. It's definitely worth a try!

reviews.author: Amr
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of dining at The Orangery in Bahrain, and I can confidently say it was one of the most delightful restaurant experiences I’ve had in a long time. From the moment I walked in, the ambiance transported me—elegant, calming, and beautifully designed, with attention to every detail. The atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between cozy and refined, making it ideal for both casual meetups and special occasions. What truly elevated the experience, however, was the outstanding service. I want to specifically mention Hassania, who was incredibly warm, attentive, and professional throughout the visit. Her friendly demeanor and thoughtful approach made me feel genuinely welcomed. She managed everything with grace and ensured everything ran smoothly, always with a smile. It’s rare to encounter someone who so naturally enhances the dining experience. The Orangery’s culinary offerings are clearly crafted with care, and the presentation is just as impressive as the flavors. Every element—from the decor to the tea selection—shows the team’s commitment to excellence. I didn’t feel rushed at any point, and the relaxed yet sophisticated vibe made it easy to unwind and enjoy every moment.

reviews.author: Arwa Al Saber
reviews.text: The Orangery Tearoom & Patisserie in Bahrain offers a delightful dining experience with delicious food, a classy and elegant ambiance, and exceptional service. The menu features a blend of European and Middle Eastern flavors, with standout pastries and beautifully presented dishes. The salad 🥗 is a bless, mini steak 🥩😋😋, and the chocolate melt cake is from heaven 😋😋.The atmosphere is refined yet welcoming, making it a perfect spot for breakfast, afternoon tea, or a relaxed meal. My visit was a suhoor this night during Ramadan and it was an awesome evening 👌🏼👌🏼The staff are highly professional, attentive, and ensure a pleasant visit. Whether you’re looking for a sophisticated dining experience or a cozy spot to unwind, The Orangery is a top choice in Bahrain.

reviews.author: Ehdaa Ibrahim
reviews.text: I finally visited this cafe after hearing so many recommendations, and I can see why it's so popular. The food was absolutely yummy, the coffee was fantastic, and the staff were all very friendly. We were hoping to sit outside, but it was completely full, so if you're set on outdoor seating, I'd suggest getting there early.

reviews.author: Christy
reviews.text: Good price, interesting place, good food but it arrived cold because they forgot, two employees to serve all the tables and they looked tired, I don't recommend this place on the holiday due to the service, maybe going on a weekday is better.

reviews.author: Madelyn Ponce
reviews.text: This is a lovely restaurant with delicious food and attentive service. It’s an ideal place to enjoy lunch or dinner, whether you’re with family or friends. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the overall experience is consistently satisfying. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Zack Simpson
reviews.text: Has to be my favourite restaurant in Bahrain no doubt! Food is always cooked to perfection and always tastes the same, very high standards, great variety as well. My go to order will always be hummus, mutabbal, cheese fingers, golden fried shrimp, mix fried rice, mix grill, juje kebab, and crème caramel. They have excellent selection of fresh juice, pomegranate juice being my favourite!

reviews.author: Anita Davis
reviews.text: Have always been a fan of Al Abraj. Been to their Mamama branch a few times. This is my first time visiting the Muharraq branch, absolutely lovely! Stunning interiors and excellent food!

reviews.author: Majid Admani
reviews.text: We had a family dinner this Friday and all of us were spell bound by the experience in totality that we had visiting this arabic cuisine venture... Al Abraaj has everything that one wishes for on an ideal dineout with family.. delicious food + courteous hospitality + elegant interiors + the vibes... it was awesome experience.. food was so juicy and tender that we couldn't resist but had to repeat our ordered portions.. Definitely on our "to go" list and expecting same experience going forward as well

reviews.author: Praveen Mk
reviews.text: Awesome food and drinks with a wide variety of shisha flavours. The new Alwanees is unique with its own professional service and very polite and attentive staffs. Great thanks to the team Alwanees for a wonderful family dining experience. All the very best👍

reviews.author: Jadala Ranjith
reviews.text: This is one of best family dining place in Bahrain. The new Alwanees is awesome with good ambience and multicusine food with a very reasonable price. All the very best to the team Alwanees!!!

reviews.author: Āršhād Ilyas
reviews.text: The great place for wonderful family dining experience . The new Alwanees offers a variety of food choices from a multicusine menu and a collection of refreshing beverage . The shisha is awesome with a good ambience to sit and enjoy the smoke. Very well professional staffs are unique with their own polite behavior .

reviews.author: Viktoryia Bahryna
reviews.text: Delicious food, excellent service and very reasonable price! Iftar costs only 6 BD with 3 cold and hot appetizers, 3 main courses, Arabic sweets and a fresh fruits. Plus dates, vimto, laban, water and Arabic coffee ! It’s a lovely place! We will be back soon!

reviews.author: karthik reddy pilli
reviews.text: Specially recommended fried hammour one of the best dish and good atmosphere, polite staff,well maintaing cleanliness and hygiene

reviews.author: Reem Mohamed
reviews.text: Great hang out café for friends and family. Sheesha and a good menu of delicious and beautifully presented food. Not my first of course, but it has been a long time since I visited Al Bandira and I can see how much effort has been put into improving the menu and the service. Love the food and drinks and the service was great.

reviews.author: Rafat Rizq Youssef
reviews.text: One of my favorite cafes to lay back, have a good meal, and enjoy the shisha. It's got indoor and outdoor seating areas, and is family friendly. It's been open a while and the wear is showing on the furniture so it could do with a revamp. As for the food, I recommend the Arayes Nachos and Cheese Zaatar. The hummus platter wasn't the best and the spicy potatoes were too greasy. Shisha is the best though!

reviews.author: Abdullah Baqami
reviews.text: Very slow service. Bad attitude from the staff. Ordered a cup of tea and it was half full The manager was supportive of customers and understood our complaints. His attitude and graciousness solved the issue.

reviews.author: Attallah
reviews.text: Nice place for really good Shishah. The staff were helpful and welcoming. There is only indoor tables. We did not try their food so we can’t judge. You can also watch sports as they have many TV screens.

reviews.author: Jeremiah Stanley
reviews.text: Fabulous. We had a private party for 25 people at Bindaira Cafe. Oh boy! Glad we chose this place. Mr.Isa was professional and addressed all our requirements perfectly. The chef showed his class with the full goat ghoozi. The salads, the shisha and the desserts were top notch. We had a great ambience and a quality group time at the exclusive party hall. Highly recommend Cafe Bindaira. 10 stars!

reviews.author: Ermano Geuer
reviews.text: Extraordinary good coffee and great and modern atmosphere in the old town. You wouldn't expect a cafe like this with such a great style. Very cool menu offering breakfast all day and a good variety of tea and coffee. Quiet and relaxing place where you can take a rest from sightseeing. Can only be recommended!

reviews.author: Vik Paw
reviews.text: Fantastic coffee shop and restaurant, hidden away in the cultural district. Definitely make your way here for a drink and bite to eat. Freshly made in-house breads and other local delicacies. Recommend the breakfasts, mezze items and fresh juice - and coffee of course! Manakeesh, Nutella bread, grilled halloumi, falafel, kibbeh 🤤

reviews.author: William Kloth
reviews.text: Wonderful space along the Pearling Path. Great breakfast which is served all day. Excellent coffee and Karak Tea. The space is beautiful and staff was very accommodating. Highly recommended if you want a beautiful spot to grab something to eat and drink. Particularly good if you want a stop on the Pearling Path.

reviews.author: Tyrone
reviews.text: Good stop along the Pearling Path. They have everything from dessert to full meals. Swing by if you’re thirsty or hungry! Refer to the photos for what the entrance looks like!

reviews.author: Amanda Miley
reviews.text: We came here for lunch with our tour group. Not sure if this is what they would normally have...or if it was special for the tour. Food was delicious. Chocolate Date cake. Rose hip drink.

reviews.author: Sam Mef
reviews.text: Matam for use on occasions

reviews.author: Amer Bin Rajab
reviews.text: Islamic place

reviews.author: Omar Hashim
reviews.text: Clean and good

reviews.author: Amir 457
reviews.text: The Saqiyya funeral is intended for religious occasions and birthday parties for the people of the House of Prophethood and the source of the message. The Qur’an is also read to the souls of the deceased for the people of the region to receive condolences.

reviews.author: Mohammed Alkhabbaz
reviews.text: Peace be upon you, Abu Abdullah

reviews.author: Shayne Haridas
reviews.text: Lovely full Bahraini breakfast and Saffron Karak, but a lil pricey compared to the other local bahraini breakfast joints. The tea could have been hotter though. Great location and ambience but parking is hard to come by.

reviews.author: Ahmad Helmy
reviews.text: Best ethnic bahraini breakfast in Muharraq 👌 The Atmosphere is amazing & service as well is very nice..✅ Try the royal breakfast...it will give u a bits and pieces from the whole menu 💯🌟 Cheese platter is not only cheese ... it has jam, honey, labneh, olive and 3 types of cheese 🧀 Don't follow Google map to the point if u want to reach out ... better to park your car 200m away & get this distance by walk.

reviews.author: Ala Al-Mubarak
reviews.text: This place is a true hidden gem of a restaurant in Muharraq, if you can find it 😉 You won’t get to it by car, I suggest you park your car in the parking lot opposite the post office and walking the rest of the way, google maps will lead you there. The food place has a very authentic charm, and the breakfast is delicious. Best of all, the price is well worth the trip. A must visit if you are looking for something delicious, affordable and authentic.

reviews.author: Life story
reviews.text: Nice traditional local food. Service was good too. This restaurant is opposite to Mohammed Ben Fares musical hall where local classical music show are played every Thursday night.

reviews.author: Nassar Munaz
reviews.text: Traditional ambiance , in an old street. They have got some traditional arabic food but less options . Had tried their breakfast it consisted of many small portions and it was good enough for 2 people . No parking around the area , little difficult to navigate and reach , not very spacious Good try especially for breakfast 👍

reviews.text: Good price, interesting place, good food but it arrived cold because they forgot, two employees to serve all the tables and they looked tired, I don't recommend this place on the holiday due to the service, maybe going on a weekday is better.

reviews.author: Madelyn Ponce
reviews.text: This is a lovely restaurant with delicious food and attentive service. It’s an ideal place to enjoy lunch or dinner, whether you’re with family or friends. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the overall experience is consistently satisfying. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Zack Simpson
reviews.text: Has to be my favourite restaurant in Bahrain no doubt! Food is always cooked to perfection and always tastes the same, very high standards, great variety as well. My go to order will always be hummus, mutabbal, cheese fingers, golden fried shrimp, mix fried rice, mix grill, juje kebab, and crème caramel. They have excellent selection of fresh juice, pomegranate juice being my favourite!

reviews.author: Anita Davis
reviews.text: Have always been a fan of Al Abraj. Been to their Mamama branch a few times. This is my first time visiting the Muharraq branch, absolutely lovely! Stunning interiors and excellent food!

reviews.author: Majid Admani
reviews.text: We had a family dinner this Friday and all of us were spell bound by the experience in totality that we had visiting this arabic cuisine venture... Al Abraaj has everything that one wishes for on an ideal dineout with family.. delicious food + courteous hospitality + elegant interiors + the vibes... it was awesome experience.. food was so juicy and tender that we couldn't resist but had to repeat our ordered portions.. Definitely on our "to go" list and expecting same experience going forward as well

reviews.author: Praveen Mk
reviews.text: Awesome food and drinks with a wide variety of shisha flavours. The new Alwanees is unique with its own professional service and very polite and attentive staffs. Great thanks to the team Alwanees for a wonderful family dining experience. All the very best👍

reviews.author: Jadala Ranjith
reviews.text: This is one of best family dining place in Bahrain. The new Alwanees is awesome with good ambience and multicusine food with a very reasonable price. All the very best to the team Alwanees!!!

reviews.author: Āršhād Ilyas
reviews.text: The great place for wonderful family dining experience . The new Alwanees offers a variety of food choices from a multicusine menu and a collection of refreshing beverage . The shisha is awesome with a good ambience to sit and enjoy the smoke. Very well professional staffs are unique with their own polite behavior .

reviews.author: Viktoryia Bahryna
reviews.text: Delicious food, excellent service and very reasonable price! Iftar costs only 6 BD with 3 cold and hot appetizers, 3 main courses, Arabic sweets and a fresh fruits. Plus dates, vimto, laban, water and Arabic coffee ! It’s a lovely place! We will be back soon!

I really have to say that the security guard that was on duty was totally and extremely RUDE. This is not the first time that he speak to us in a very rude way, this is actually the third time. Him and the small indian guy was completely obnoxious. I hope you guys will consider educating these kind of people about manners and some decency on treating other people..

reviews.author: samar AlQadri
reviews.text: Wonderful location with access to good food and many other attractions

reviews.author: Didi HS
reviews.text: This place in Tyr is wonderful, the staff are nice, but the prices are not acceptable, they're triple the prices in other restaurants or maybe more, the food was acceptable but definitely not worth the money we paid. However, the qr code menu was not working, and we didn't know about the prices before we ordered, but we never expected it to be this much expensive. 240$ for 4 adults!!

reviews.author: D
reviews.text: The best part about this place is the outside, sea-side decking. A lovely place to enjoy the sunset or watch the waves break on a sunny day with a beer.

reviews.author: Mazen Tannous
reviews.text: Amazing place to finish your trip in Tyre, with a lovely dinner by the sea. Tasty food, a bit expensive the fish but at least it’s fished locally. The staff is super welcoming and pet friendly !!

reviews.author: Anna Bella
reviews.text: This place is over hyped if you ask me. The food is okay. The place is quite and has a nice view and has an old feeling tonight giving its charm thats it. Not very accessible because no taxis around and the host are not very accommodating. Outdoors dining ruined by cats not a problem if you like them but we are alergic so that’s a bummer. Not alot options for seafood either.

reviews.author: Charishma T
reviews.text: The store is great and you get amazing international products there. However, the female Bahraini staff person at the cash counter is useless, incompetent, and racist. I asked her if there was anyone to help me and she outrightly refused. I had to go around looking for another staff, whom I found and helped me very well. This woman at the cash counter was also busy video calling and couldn't be bothered with putting my items into the carry bag. But her attitude was compleltely the opposite towards Bahraini customers, whom she greeted with a smile. Pathetic service. Recommend the management to take strong action and change such shameful staff.

reviews.author: Ahmed Khamis (Vezo)
reviews.text: It was a very bad experience for my best market in Bahrain. They offer 50% of all fruit and vegetables... I found that they add around 45%more on price! Even after visit budaiaa branch they say in refaaa , i went there ... What is that ALAOSRA ! I will not visit you more ....

reviews.author: louise ahmadi
reviews.text: There is no longer fresh bread, vegetables, fruit. Cat food and many more essentials. The staff saying no customer that's why all empty shelves, of course customers won't come if nothing to buy! Please either stock the shelves or close so another brand can serve the customers.

reviews.text: Nice new place .. spacious.. neat .. helpful staff .. loved it..

reviews.author: RomanRoman99 k
reviews.text: A traditional establishment, running through generations. Great authentic setting, delicious food, and good prices. Thanks to the Haji family who kept it original over the years. A must for a visitor who is looking to try local food.

reviews.author: Michael Nofal
reviews.text: Haji’s serves authentic food that’s full of flavor. They have set times for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, so it’s good to plan ahead. I tried the breakfast and was impressed by the big variety of options. You can choose to sit inside or outside. Highly recommended if you’re looking to try something traditional and authentic.

reviews.author: jaffar pathan
reviews.text: Tried mixed grill skewers….it was okay-okay. The beef skewers were slightly overcooked (burnt look). The bread was big and fresh. The ambience too was ok-ok as we were sitting outside. Good price for quantity served. Next time will try some other dish.

reviews.author: Magdalena Grudzien
reviews.text: We went to the place for lunch to try some traditional Bahraini dishes, but not much of the items on the menu were available. We took chicken curry, chicken Machboos and fish curry. All of them were fine. The portions are quite generous. What we liked the most was the traditional interior and a very good tea. There is no toilet (just a sink to wash hands). Staff is friendly and helpful. We got everything served really fast.

reviews.author: Danah Alshuaib
reviews.text: Overall, everything was great. Wonderful hospitality and great owners. They took good care of us and we were seated quickly. I personally enjoyed the white cheese, beans and beef stew.

reviews.text: Its a beautiful placed to hangout But very silent and hardly notice people roaming around Peaceful for people who don’t like city life Beaches are clean and small Every island got a small play area, sport ground There is a supermarket and few shops as well Like Al Osra and Baskin robins and few more There are masjid as well in the island

reviews.author: Alya Altareef
reviews.text: So nice to have a skatepark, nice energy. However the park itself doesn't flow well and sometimes feels intimidating for beginners. There's a public beach near it, small but so nice! The private beaches are amazing for snorkeling. Only issue is, to get access, you need to know someone living in durra, which sucks. Skatepark not accessible to all.

reviews.author: Ammar Alnajem
reviews.text: One of the best relaxing 😎 Urban Living Island style place for families. Durrat Al Bahrain is the third largest artificial island in Bahrain. Houses there are private, but the management have future plans for building apartments for rents, hotel and more small shops. All needed facilities are there including restaurants, supermarket, salon 💇, cafes, ice cream shop 🍦 , bicycle and golf carts rental.

reviews.text: First time ordering from them the food was good loved the different taste and the packing and service was really good will definitely order from them again and the Arabic box is just BD 1.5 and Chipotle box 2.5

reviews.text: One of my favorite shawarma restaurants in bahrain. I always order through talabat and the experience always good and food is so tasty. Today is the first time I visited the restaurant myself and I wish I didn’t. The staff are very rude, I asked for special request for my order however they didn’t make it the way I asked. When I told them that It’s not as I order they told me take and we can’t adjust it for you. After several attempts they replaced my order and treated me as it’s charity or abase. I hope this massage be read by restaurant management, you have a good restaurant please work on customer service to reach perfection

reviews.text: First time tried, and its delicious 🤤 Its a small place No place to dine in. Its take away only And the rush is on every time So its better to call 📞 and order The price is reasonable around 650 fills for chicken and beef is 750 I guess. Worth trying! Deliver is available via talabat.

reviews.author: theweekendguide bh
reviews.text: The Street Shawarma. ohh I guess this is one of the best shawarma we had so far. No joke! The green ranch sauce that one, ooohhh hit us direct to our heart. It’s our first time to try this shop and we made a good choice to have their Green Ranch Arabic Shawarma box😎 Their Shawarma will make you feel full. Their shawarma box is good for two with freshly cook fries on the side. I hope they will have some coolers too which compliments their shawarma. The place is just a shop for take away, Inshallah they expand to bigger place. They open from 6pm until 12am daily, call them for deliver or pick up. So whenever you’ll be around Riffa, try to pass by and experience this really good Shawarma. Where to go? Where to eat? Check our page @theweekendguide.bh

reviews.author: AA
reviews.text: Always a pleasure to have the crispy pomegranate shawarma box with extra crispy onion. This combo is very unique in Bahrain. Very saucy and the pomegranate gives a sour crunch. I love that the fries are always fresh and fried properly. The portions are generous and more than fulfilling for the average appetite.

reviews.author: SUSANA BLANCO
reviews.text: A perfect spot to get lost and connect with Bahraini culture. It features a café, a small shop with original gifts from local artists, and a lovely garden.

reviews.author: Melike Eda Taşkit Elgohary
reviews.text: I discovered this place recently. It was truly a more beautiful place than I expected. I thought it was a single building, but I saw that there were other buildings as well. When you enter, there is a cafe on your right, an exhibition in the building on your left, and a library on the upper floor. If you wish, you can grab your coffee, read your book in the library, study, or sit outside in the garden. I found myself discovering new places every time I went to closely examine each section one by one. I saw that some places were still under renovation. It is quiet on weekdays and crowded on weekends. It is located in the mosque on the upper floor of the exhibition building. Prayer mat and prayer clothes are also available. I found myself outside, on the balcony of my house, experiencing a peaceful and calm feeling among the sounds of birds and nature. When ordering coffee, the credit card device is faulty, so they take payment in cash or cash. There are also sections selling souvenirs at the entrance and inside the cafe. I saw sockets in some places. You can bring your computer with you and find a socket to charge it. Being a nature lover, I was very happy to find Water Garden in Bahrain before. Now this place has almost become a Water Garden for me. Also, this place is very close to Water Garden.

reviews.author: Ala Al-Mubarak
reviews.text: Beautiful art gallery and event space. They also have a lovely cozy coffee shop there. A hidden gem in the heart of Manama.

reviews.author: fawaz bucheeri
reviews.text: Great coffee with great ambiance, the place is perfect for a break from reality. The place isn’t packed like most good coffee shops in Bahrain, were you could just take an hour off your day and sit somewhere. The layout of the place is very welcoming because of the natural sunlight which greatly effects the experience of the time spent indoors.

reviews.author: William Kloth
reviews.text: Fun little art space with a few exhibits from local artists. Beautiful outdoor space and there is a small library upstairs.

reviews.text: Normal, just large and full of lighting. They choose good lecturers and the people of the city are always present.. Many chairs and seating options are available. Relaxing and the atmosphere is nice, but their entrance and exit and space allocation for somethings needs to be considered

reviews.author: Lyala rn
reviews.text: It was extremely hot here, but there are some places where you can refresh yourself. If you want to cool down yourself, they have this sprinkling water or you can just stay at the entry area where they scan the ticket code. It was air conditioned although it was on an open area. And they also have open water refilling station. Just bring your own water bottle. Do not bring any plastic bottle because they won't allow it inside. And on this picture, we were sitting at Block J.

reviews.author: Emilio Venuti
reviews.text: The Bahrain International Circuit has become an essential date on my Formula 1 calendar. This world-class venue hosts not only F1 races but also thrilling competitions for Porsche Cup, Formula 2, and Formula 3. What truly stands out is the festive atmosphere during F1 race weekends. The circuit transforms into an exciting entertainment hub with activities for adults, teenagers, and children of all ages. The concerts that are part of the F1 experience add another dimension to the event, creating unforgettable memories for attendees. Throughout the year, the circuit maintains a diverse calendar of motorsport events and activities. I recommend checking their official website for the annual program to plan your visit accordingly. If you're traveling through Bahrain, the circuit's visitor shop is worth a stop. You can purchase souvenirs or official merchandise from your favorite racing team to commemorate your experience. The facilities are impressive, with excellent viewing positions around the track allowing spectators to witness the high-speed action up close. Racing experts frequently praise the circuit's layout for producing exciting overtaking opportunities, particularly into Turn 1 after the main straight. So if you find yourself in Bahrain or are planning a trip to the Middle East, make sure to swing by the Bahrain International Circuit. Whether it's race day or not, there's always something interesting happening at this premier motorsport destination.

reviews.author: ANSON AN THOMAS
reviews.text: For me personally.wvery time i go there i feels like im living my best life. Its such an amazing place For a free motor enthusiast to have a very good time of their life really wish I would have a full-time job there so that I can enjoy Enter every minute n BI c it's such a amazing place and I would recommend everybody Everybody to check out their activities and experience every single one of them.

reviews.author: Tariq Daoud
reviews.text: We came to this restaurant expecting a top-tier dining experience, but what we got was loud, chaotic, and frankly, unacceptable for any establishment – let alone one claiming to be 5-star. One table of guests was drinking heavily, singing loudly, and making obnoxious noises that echoed through the entire dining area. It felt more like a bar gone wild than a fine dining restaurant. The worst part? The staff did absolutely nothing to calm the situation. In fact, they seemed to find it amusing and even encouraged the group by laughing along and lingering near their table. Many guests, including us, were visibly uncomfortable. We couldn't enjoy our food, conversation was impossible, and the whole atmosphere was ruined. After complaining, we expected at least some form of action, but there was none. Not even an apology. Eventually, we had to leave early. For the price we paid and the reputation this place tries to uphold, the experience was a total letdown. I hope management seriously reconsiders how they handle disruptive customers and how their staff contributes to the experience. Until then, I won’t be recommending this place to anyone looking for a peaceful or refined evening out.

reviews.author: RAMI ALSARAWI
reviews.text: Restaurant Review: Maki Brunch – A Refined Yet Relaxed Culinary Experience in Bahrain If the term elevated casual ever needed a definition, Maki Bahrain would be its perfect embodiment. This restaurant masterfully blends fine cuisine, attentive service, and refined ambience—all while allowing guests the comfort of dressing down without facing judgment. Think high-end dining without the pretense: fine food, excellent service, a tasteful setting, and not a single “gestapo” waiter to scold you for wearing sandals and a T-shirt. The menu is extensive, with a wide range of options—some outstanding, others less memorable—but the guidance of a knowledgeable waiter made all the difference. His recommendations were spot on and greatly enhanced the experience. Starters An absolute must-try is their sashimi. The salmon with za’atar is an inventive fusion that works beautifully, while the spicy tuna tataki was perfectly seared and flavorful. Even the miso soup—often an overlooked staple—was excellent, though I’ll touch on pricing later. I also sampled the beef rolls as a hot starter. While the concept was unique, the execution fell short for me, as the beef was slightly overcooked. A one-time experience, but not one I’d revisit. Sushi The sushi sampler was an artistic presentation of flavors and textures, with standout freshness. The salmon sushi in particular (please refer to the menu for the specific name) was a highlight. Each bite was a harmonious blend of visual appeal and taste—a testament to thoughtful curation. Main Course & Beverage The Wagyu Kobe beef cubes were the centerpiece of the meal. Ordered medium rare, the beef was melt-in-your-mouth tender—this is no exaggeration. Unfortunately, the dish arrived cold, which detracted from what could have been a flawless experience. Steak should not rest for more than 3–5 minutes before serving. Thankfully, the accompanying fried rice was served piping hot, and when combined with the beef, it elevated the flavor profile, creating a balanced, multi-dimensional dish. The Chardonnay, served perfectly chilled, was aromatic and complemented the meal wonderfully. Ambience & Service The service and ambience go hand in hand—both refined yet relaxed. The atmosphere invites calm, and the background music contributes to an overall sense of serenity. The staff strike a fine balance between attentiveness and discretion. Final Thoughts Maki Bahrain is a must-visit culinary destination. I would easily add it to any Bahrain travel checklist. While the pricing is undoubtedly on the higher end, the quality of food and the overall experience make it worth considering for a return visit. A few tweaks, especially around temperature control for hot dishes, could elevate it from excellent to unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: A J Bashha
reviews.text: The Dragon's Blood Tree (Dracaena cinnabari) is a remarkable species endemic to Socotra Island, Yemen, where it grows in large densities of woodland. Its distinctive umbrella-like mushroom shape is entirely natural. These trees can live up to 600 years and reach a height of 10 meters. The tree's deep red resin, resembling blood, has been highly valued since the Roman era for its uses in dye, violin varnish, medicine, makeup, and rituals. Socotra, located in the Indian Ocean near the coasts of Yemen and Somalia, is politically part of Yemen, though it has historical and cultural connections to Somalia. The island features spectacular scenery and is home to numerous endemic species of plants, birds, and other fauna, such as the Dragon's Blood Tree. Its unique landscape includes rugged mountains, canyons, wadis, caves, and picturesque beaches. The calm, shallow sea and the warm climate make it an attractive destination for nature lovers, scientists, and adventurers. Tourists often engage in snorkeling, fishing, hiking, and sightseeing, making the most of the island's natural beauty. However, Socotra lacks proper tourist infrastructure, such as hotels or guesthouses, and camping remains the only accommodation option. Transportation and facilities are underdeveloped, which preserves its untouched appeal. The island's population is relatively low and includes indigenous Socotri people, along with residents from other parts of Asia and Africa. The Socotri are known for their generosity and hospitality toward visitors. Despite its natural wonders, Socotra faces challenges, including illegal flights from the UAE that are not approved by Yemen’s government. These activities, tied to the UAE's broader role in Yemen, raise concerns about the island’s sovereignty. Nonetheless, Socotra remains a remote and captivating destination for those willing to embrace its rustic charm and unspoiled environment.

reviews.author: Міша Кобута
reviews.text: Socotra is the most alien-looking place on Earth — wild, untouched, and absolutely mesmerizing. Located off the coast of Yemen, this island is home to trees and landscapes that exist nowhere else in the world. The iconic Dragon Blood Trees look like giant mushrooms from another galaxy, and the island is full of bizarre plant life, white-sand beaches, and crystal-clear lagoons. It’s a paradise for adventurers, photographers, and nature lovers. No big hotels, no crowds — just raw beauty and complete disconnection. Sunsets on Socotra feel sacred. Nights are filled with stars. And the silence? Unreal. It’s not the easiest place to reach, but maybe that’s what keeps it pure. If you want to see Earth before it was touched — go to Socotra.

The hotel itself is stunning—luxurious rooms, great food, and a peaceful beachside location that makes it perfect for a relaxing getaway. One person who really stood out during my stay was Ghady at the reception. He was friendly, welcoming, and made the check-in process smooth and easy. His warm attitude added a personal touch that made me feel right at home. Great service all around!

reviews.author: hadeel alq
reviews.text: I stayed at a beautiful and spacious hotel in Bahrain. The property is large with a variety of restaurants to choose from, which is perfect if you enjoy exploring different cuisines. My room was big and came with a balcony, and the furniture was nice and comfortable. However, I did experience a few issues. There were mosquitoes in the room, even though I only briefly opened the balcony door once. I also requested a dental kit (toothbrush and toothpaste), but the service was very slow and the staff didn’t handle it professionally. On the positive side, the breakfast was absolutely delicious with a wide variety of options. I tried the sushi restaurant, but unfortunately, I didn’t enjoy the food there—it didn’t meet my expectations. On the other hand, I also visited the spa, and it was amazing! The massage experience was incredibly relaxing and professional. Overall, the hotel has a lot of potential, but I hope they improve their room service and attention to detail in the future

reviews.author: Kevin Grubi
reviews.text: Le Jardin offers a beautiful setting right in the heart of the Medina—an oasis of calm with a charming atmosphere and a lovely view. The décor and ambiance are definitely highlights, and the staff were extremely friendly and welcoming throughout our visit. As for the food, it was of good quality and tasted great, but leaned heavily toward a Western/European style rather than offering something authentically Moroccan. That in itself isn’t a problem, but it’s important to note if you’re hoping for local flavors. The main issue was the price. While the food was enjoyable, it felt overpriced—comparable to what you’d pay in many parts of Europe, even Switzerland. Considering we’re in Marrakech, where quality food is usually more affordable, it didn’t feel justified. It almost felt like we were paying more for the ambiance than the cuisine. In summary: a lovely place, nice staff, and good food, but the price-to-value ratio just isn’t there. If you’re visiting Marrakech for its authentic and affordable culinary experiences, Le Jardin might not be the best choice. I wouldn’t recommend it overall.

reviews.text: We had been recommended to come here as it was close to our Riad. The food was ok, but I expected so much more than just ok to justify the high price. My wife had Bolognese pasta which should have had cheese or garnish but was just a bowl of adequate pasta with an ok sauce. Hot chocolate was warm and again tasty but not very hot. I left feeling that we paid a premium for an adequate meal. Service was fairly slow,I had to ask the chatting waiters for drinks and desserts rather than them noticing we had finished. Certainly an ok meal with a busy feel, but more cafe than top restaurant.

I was really looking forward to the trip, and based on the excellent planning and support, I’m sure I would have felt very comfortable at the hotel. I hope to visit in the future!

reviews.author: Cymbie Lumbao
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Moheli Laka Lodge! Hans is the owner and helped us out with our travel package. He is a pleasant, honest and helpful man to deal with. They booked and included our Royal Air flight round trip from Moroni - Moheli, which takes away the stress of dealing with it on our end. Chris was one of his deputy manager that took care of us in the island, kudos to all the team at Laka Lodge GROUNDS: Very lush and beautiful, it has that relaxing feel to it. Our favorite thing was at around 4pm when snacks are being served the lemurs will be hanging out by the trees near the parking spots. If the Lemurs are not there just asked one of the restaurant staff for help, they know how to call them. It is such a cool experience, they are so gentle whenthey take the bananas. Rooms: We had the beach bungalow, we can watch the sunset from our bed. Bathrooms are decent and clean. They provide filtered water instead of bottled water which is very ecofriendly and hand made soap ☺️ Activities: They have plenty to offer and prices are fair and affordable. The highlight for us was watching the turtle at night laying eggs and got lucky to see the babies hatching, so Amazing. We hope to be back here again. * the drive from the airport to the lodge is 1hr, one of the most beautiful one hour drive you’ll take you see the water the coastline and the very lush forest! Worth the trip to get here.

reviews.author: Cat Flavored Soda
reviews.text: It's such a beautiful island that should definitely be travelled to!!! But don't let this hotel spoil the wonderful landscape. It's dirty (especially the dining tables and dishes are disgusting), the staff are unfriendly and unprofessional and the owner is constantly trying to scam people (and openly threatening them if it doesn't work). And to top it all off, the hotel is simply exorbitantly overpriced. The service is about the same as what you get in the guesthouses in the neighbourhood for €20. The only really great activity they offer is the tour to the turtles in Itsamia (1.5 hours away). My advice would be to look for accommodation in Itsamia straight away and save yourself all the fuss here. Laka Lodge ruined my holiday.

reviews.author: Ossi Koskinen
reviews.text: Spend 8 days here on september and it was the nicest place on they country. they keep the area clean and it has a private beach. 50m from the beach you can snorkel with sea turtles and 150m from the beach there is healthy corals. Food is good and they offer food without fish as well. They help you with everything you might need. wifi works fell in common areas but is quite limited on rooms (you dont really miss the internet here). they organize a lot of activities. its truly a hidden paradise. even its a safe country to stay they have guards 24/7

reviews.author: Mathijs van de Ven
reviews.text: We stayed a week in Moheli and would like to explain a little bit more about this place. We think it is way too expensive and not in proportion to the rest of the island(s). Laka lodge is absolutely a stunning place (beach view), but for sure the most expensive place from the Comores! There a cheaper options (rooms 25-30 Euro’s a night) around this village. They claimed the beach, so foreigners have to pay 20 Euro entrance fee and a minimum spend of 10 euro per person. There are several similar free beaches around, for example in Ouallah. We think this price is ridiculous. They offer great services for Western tourists, making it much more convenient to travel in a place that is not easy to travel around. Yet it creates a certain monopoly. We found the owner a grumpy guy who only seems to be interested in $$$. Old staff members told us that the staff recieve a very limited salary. We cannot verify this of course. I would therefore not recommend this place and would stay with local small-scale hotels/guesthouses.

reviews.author: Michel Cloutier
reviews.text: Super lucky to have had the chance to taste the Pekka because someone else cancelled their order. Need to order ahead of time though - takes 3 hours to make. It’s amazingly tasty, juicy, tender. Tried the mixed pork and lamb. And Marco took us to the kitchen to show us how it’s made. Got to try.

reviews.author: Nawras AI
reviews.text: Konoba Dubrava is an absolutely amazing restaurant — top-quality, truly next-level! The whole place has this authentic, rustic charm but delivers a high-end dining experience. If you want to enjoy something special and traditional, this is the spot. 💥 Pro tip: You must order the famous Peka when you make your reservation! It’s a traditional Croatian dish that takes a few hours to cook, but trust me — it’s completely worth the wait. Tender, flavorful, and unforgettable. The atmosphere, the service, the food — all of it is just fantastic. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a proper local experience with some fancy vibes. A must-visit when in Dubrovnik!

reviews.author: Danielle Schmergel
reviews.text: A MUST in your stay! Wow! This restaurant was authentic and what an experience it was, absolutely exceptional. Our server Bojan made our experience even better, even our hostess who greeted us with complimentary shots! Just wow! I recommend ordering the food ahead of time so you can get to try something in the iron Bell, we had the octopus and mixed meats and fried donuts and tres leches! Just everything was perfect from the potatoes to the donuts! Thank you Konba Dubrava and Bojan for the experience and the meal!

reviews.author: Jen Thrasher
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant that feels like you’re in someone’s home. Family style servings of delicious meats potatoes veggie options too. Perched above Dubrovnik wonderful sunset views. Highly recommend. The staff was courteous and kind and would definitely return.

reviews.author: Amanda van Baarsen
reviews.text: Order 3 hours early to get the peka (under the bell). The veal will blow your mind. Greek salad is an excellent accompaniment. We ordered two meals under the bell and could have saved ourselves some money and wasted less food if we'd just ordered one. The staff here are delightful. We highly enjoyed our experience.
