reviews.author: Joelle Jbeily
reviews.text: We had a lovely dinner at Restaurant Kopun in Dubrovnik. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive. We ordered these two delicious dishes: Capon - pasticada Both plates were generous, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. The food arrived quickly, and the prices were very affordable considering the quality and quantity. Highly recommended if you’re looking for authentic Croatian cuisine in a charming setting. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Jermaine Lim
reviews.text: We were looking for a dinner spot for our first night in the Old Town, and chanced upon this restaurant right up a tall flight of stairs. The server was very hospitable and introduced us the 3 course set meal (1 soup, 1 main and 1 dessert) for €38. We got a meat set meal and a fish set meal, and it was the best decision! The soup dishes warmed us up very quickly in the cold, and the beef + octopus was very soft and delicious. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Quynh Phuong Luu
reviews.text: Quite pricey for small portion. Tiny shrimp, wonder if they were frozen shrimps, not fresh one. We also ordered fries but they were little bit overcooked.

reviews.author: Camila Hurtado
reviews.text: The food was amazing, I highly recommend the black risotto and the pašticada. I don’t remember the name of the dessert but it was also really good. Everyone at the restaurant was really nice. Lovely place

reviews.author: Alma Felix
reviews.text: Very well located and spacious but their dishes lack flavor. They are not well seasoned. We had the Dubrovnik Copun, one of their specialties and it was average, but the traditional beef pasta was even worse. I wouldn’t recommend getting dinner here.

reviews.author: Amanda van Baarsen
reviews.text: We dined at Nautika with high expectations, drawn in by its Michelin star reputation, stunning seaside location, and glowing reviews. And in many ways, the experience delivered. The food was truly excellent - each dish beautifully composed and full of flavour. The view alone is worth noting: a cinematic backdrop of a wooden sailboat gliding across the water, alpine swifts darting overhead, and a front-row seat to one of the most picturesque vistas in Dubrovnik. We were fortunate to enjoy our table for a leisurely three hours, which allowed us to truly settle in and soak up the setting. The staff were warm, gracious, and professional throughout, and we appreciated the thoughtful touches like the complimentary dessert bites and a sweet pomegranate liqueur to end the meal. That said, a few service details fell short of the fine dining standard one might expect at this price point. Our very kind sommelier seemed somewhat flustered - two of the wine pairings arrived mistimed, one after the dish and one well before. Our water glasses were left empty for long stretches early in the meal, and our napkins weren’t refolded when we left the table. Small things, perhaps, but they add up in a place that markets itself on perfection. In the end, we had a memorable evening, and the food was without fault. But with such a lofty reputation, I was hoping for just a bit more polish. Still, if you’re looking for an unforgettable setting and exquisite flavours, Nautika offers both - just know that your expectations may need a touch of calibration.

reviews.author: Rajen Parekh
reviews.text: Memorable experience!! Fantastic views of the Adriatic sea with nice cool breeze.👌 Made advanced reservation. Ordered Veg Creamy Risotto with Asparagus and Tortellini with mushroom, cheese, and black truffle flakes. Delicious.👌 Appetizers were tasty and cretively served!! Great collection of wine.🍷 Had Manhattan. 🥃 Very well done. At dawn with lights on, it was the most beautiful ambiance you can wish for the most romantic dinner. Hazelnut Carmel dessert cake was also delicious. Tried local dessert wine. Great service and very courteous staff. Highly highly recommended.

reviews.author: Guy Johnston
reviews.text: This place is amazing. Best place we’ve been after 4 weeks along the Adriatic. Henry, our main server was incredible. So pleasant and welcoming, thoughtful and knowledgeable. Food is amazing and view is the best in Dubrovnik. 100% must visit.

reviews.author: Harrison Holt
reviews.text: Phenomenal Dinner with a Stunning View! We had an incredible meal at Nautika in Dubrovnik. The zucchini, veal cheek, and shrimp dish were all absolutely phenomenal each one expertly prepared and full of flavor. The service was top-notch throughout, and the setting couldn’t have been more beautiful. They even moved us to a table with an even better view for dessert, which was such a thoughtful touch. A truly unforgettable dining experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Michael Haidinger
reviews.text: Mario was our server for the night and need to call out, he was an all star. So much on our experience was due to his great service. We sat on the first row on the upper terrace and it was such an amazing experience. Everything was so tasty and all of the cocktails had such a fun presentation to them. Everyone did everything they could to make our night as pleasant as possible. Truly worth the money if you want a great dinner. There are a few fine dining places but I am so glad I went with this spot.

reviews.author: Bozhidar Stambolov
reviews.text: We visited the restaurant by the recommendation of our host. The setting is very contemporary, quiet and warm. Our waitress was super welcoming. She explained more details about the different dishes which helped my parents decide what to get. Each meal had unique flavors and a great presentation. Loved it!

reviews.author: Nicolaas Mays
reviews.text: We were visiting from Australia, met a local who recommended Pantarul restaurant. So we booked a table, The food was exceptional, My wife and I loved it that much we ate there again the following night. Ordered two different meals and once again the meals were outstanding. Highly recommend. Thank you to all the staff at Pantarul. Nick & Catherine

reviews.author: Plate Cleaner Club
reviews.text: Pantarul was a peaceful escape just outside Dubrovnik 🍷✨ I came on a weekday evening with a reservation but noticed they had room for walk-ins too. The space was quiet, clean, and welcoming. The fish tartare came out on a warm plate, which was such a thoughtful touch 🐟🔥—fresh and full of flavor. The beef tagliata was tender and paired beautifully with the pepper jam 🥩🌶️. I tried the octopus special too, which was super fresh, though the cheese on top was a bit too much for me 🐙🧀. Ended on a high note with the whipped caramel almond brittle—so light and fluffy with the perfect crunchy sweet topping 🍮✨ While everything was tasty, the prices made it a bit hard to justify overall. Still, worth a visit if you’re looking for a calm, elevated meal outside the city!

reviews.author: PATRICK SHIPPELT
reviews.text: Service was amazing. The arancini appetizer was absolutely amazing tasty start to our Gourmet burgers which were also superb! Definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Mafalda Aleixo
reviews.text: Overrated restaurant. The score on Google did not correspond to (our) reality. The food was nothing special. We ate grilled sea bass with sautéed vegetables (tasteless, disappointing) and fettuccine with a tomato sauce (one of those industrial ones, not homemade), octopus (not tender at all), olives and sun-dried tomatoes. Everything is very regular, without any magic, soul or anything that make us want to come back. Comparing the quality-price ratio, it is a very expensive restaurant for what it is.

reviews.author: Maureen Durand
reviews.text: A truly memorable lunch in the heart of Dubrovnik’s Old Town! The setting is elegant and peaceful, the service attentive and professional, and the food… simply outstanding. The baked octopus was incredibly fresh, perfectly tender, and beautifully presented with refined sides. We also really appreciated the staff’s recommendations for both wine and dishes. A big thank you to the entire team for such a high-quality experience — a must-visit for seafood lovers and anyone looking for an exceptional Mediterranean lunch in Dubrovnik! Follow for more tips on Instagram @teslamag_travel

reviews.author: Pei
reviews.text: Visited in early spring (low season - April). A few tables of patrons. We were served dearly & simply the best dinner in Dubrovnik. Every dish was served with utmost delicacy & our favourite was the foie gras, smooth, buttery and literally melted in the mouth. Secondly was the mushroom & truffle pasta, creamy and mushroomy. Last but not least, the octopus tentacles were chewy & cooked to perfection. Sparkling wine was the greatest touch of all. All in all, we had a pleasant meal in Proto fish restaurant!

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.text: One of the best restaurants we’ve dined at in Dubrovnik, highly recommend coming here if you’re in town. The service was excellent and our server was very helpful in giving us recommendations on what to try. We ordered oysters and beef carpaccio to start. Then had Grilled Sea Bass, Fettuccine with Scampi and Black Truffles, and Oven Roasted Octopus Tentacles. All the main dishes were wonderful but the octopus tentacles was some of the best I’ve ever had in my life, I didn’t even know you can make octopus that tender! Finished off with a couple of desserts, one that was kinda like a lava cake but filled with a pistachio sauce and then a serving of chocolate mousse. Great ambiance especially with the terrace seating.

reviews.author: Yuta Kurimoto
reviews.text: Michelin star seafood restaurant. Food was okay but price was high for what it was in my opinion. We had scallop, grilled octopus and 1.2kg sea bass grilled with veg and potatoes (150€!!).

reviews.author: Matt Hogan
reviews.text: Was recommended to this place by a friend of mine. At first the atmosphere felt lovely and the drinks seemed pleasant but very slowly things went down hill. Our waiter for one was as thick as a brush. He forgot to mention the meal we ordered (that he himself recommended) had bone, head and tail. I chose not to have this and instead went for the monk fish as I was informed it did not have head, bone or tail. Our waiter advised against it but accepted my decision. When my family massive fish had arrived it had been a 20 minute wait and we were all taken aback by the head and tail of this meal. I was glad to be getting the monk fish as I am scream-ish when it comes to full on dead fish. Only for the waiter to forget my meal all together, leaving me to tuck into something that I found uncomfortable. He then came out with my monk fish only to call it a lamb chop. Lamp chops are red meat and this was a pale white, it was a fish. Then my brother who was sitting next to me began to choke on a fish bone, he was coughing for a good 3 minutes and our waiter wasn’t even concerned in fact none of the staff battered an eyelid when my brother was struggling to breathe. He was fine in the end but still you’d expect a discount for forgetting my food and nearly killing my brother. But nope, the waiter charged us a whopping €464 and when asked about discount he just said “No, no all is fine” , he then asked for a tip. Seriously a tip after all that!!!!!! Unless you’re looking for a rubbish meal and poor service, never ever come here.

reviews.author: Cintami Sunjana
reviews.text: The place was recommended by our Airbnb host and it did not disappoint! We went on a Saturday night without a reservation. Everything was perfect starting from the service to the food itself. The waiters were very kind, we even received complimentary dishes and local drinks and they explained how and from what was it made of. We had the beef tartar for the starter, the chateaubriand as a main and a chocolate cake to end the experience. We will definitely come back when visiting Hvar again!

reviews.author: Abigail Fernandes
reviews.text: This has to be one of our best meals in Croatia. The service is so great, they make you feel so welcome and the food was absolutely outstanding. Definitely coming here again while we’re in Hvar! We had the Istria Truffle Gnocchi and Octopus Carpaccio with the chocolate cake for dessert. Dalmatian food is 🤩🤩 and it was perfectly executed at Dalmatino. Highly highly recommend! Don’t skip this if you’re in Hvar!

reviews.author: Stephanie Casler
reviews.text: Excellent!! Really cute interior and exterior, food was creative and flavorful. We got the Carpaccio Eros (zucchini) and I got the Filet Rossini, which came topped with seared foie gras and shaved truffle 🤤 Very good wines and friendly service. We also had these polenta sticks that were so good we asked for more - definitely recommend!

reviews.author: John Le
reviews.text: So good that we had to come back twice during our time in the old town. The service here was exceptional and the restaurant runs like a well-oiled machine. The tuna tartare, gnocchi and desserts were phenomenal. The steak was a bit undercooked and under seasoned to my liking. The meal would’ve been better with mashed potatoes instead of french fries in my opinion, but they seem to serve french fries with everything here in Croatia. I recommend getting the steak cooked one level higher than what you normally get if you live in North America (they tend to undercook steaks in Europe compared to Canada).

reviews.author: wabisabi wabisabi
reviews.text: Good simple food and service but I’d expect better the prices. It’s more elevated home cooking. The tuna was good but cooked in too much oil in and the salad it came with was underwhelming. The highlight was the icecream next to the granma cake. The cake itself was simply okay. The service was fast and friendly. They bring some liquors in between on the house which is interesting. Overall good experience but not sure if the food is worth coming back for.

reviews.author: vic NY (Vic NY)
reviews.text: Pretty good food, wish they had a bigger selection. Most restaurants offer the same few dishes, at least you can find a few creative ones that are a bit different here

reviews.author: A
reviews.text: We went here on our last night in Hvar, it was the best meal we’ve had during our trip. Martin was great, attentive, and had amazing recommendations!

reviews.author: Oliver Carsten
reviews.text: The whole experience was wonderful. All the courses from the initial amuse-bouche were excellent. We shared 2 starters: ravioli with truffles and shrimp risotto. Both were superb and alone worth coming for. Then we had the lamb stew with homemade gnocchi. Also excellent. We finished with a dessert of basil ice-cream with marinated strawberries. Light and very tasty. All accompanied with a fruity local red wine. A thoroughly enjoyable experience. Great food, good service, beautiful surroundings. What more could you want?

reviews.author: Jessica Xie
reviews.text: Overall a 4 star experience mainly because we were charged for 2 portions of the bread. We did not ask for seconds but the waiter insisted on bringing us more so we agreed. The mandatory “cover charge” is for the bread, olives, and gazpacho, which we knew about from the menu and these reviews. However, insisting me have more of a dish that I did not ask for then charging me for it doesn’t seem right to me? The food was good but I would not come back here for this reason. It’s not about the money, but the principle/restaurant ethics.

reviews.author: Paula Gordillo Rodríguez
reviews.text: We were looking for a nice place to dine at for our last night in Hvar and Giaxa did not disappoint. To start they brought us some homemade bread and olives (which were incredibly delicious) and some homemade “pie”. We tried the local white wine which was very smooth and lightweight. As an appetizer we wanted something light so we ordered the monkfish carpaccio which was very delicate and refreshing. To eat we had the tuna fish which was my favorite, grilled to perfection paired with baked potatoes and also the saffron prawn risotto. Everything was delicious and the service was top!

reviews.author: Lee Mason
reviews.text: This is an excellent family owned restaurant with exceptional food. The restaurant has a nice ambiance and excellent service. My wife and I each ordered the octopus salad, and we shared the Fisherman's Plate for 2. Everything was beautifully presented, and the food was excellent.

reviews.author: Nikhil Nemade
reviews.text: My wife and I stopped here for lunch on our dya trip to Hvar. It also happened to be their first day of opening for the season. The restaurant is a cozy, lovely place and is part of the owner's home. The owner and his family were lovely people to interact with. They only serve Croatian food and wine and do it damn well. The food was fresh and tasty. There were vegetarian options for my wife which she loved. The wines and food were fairly priced and we had a great overall experience. We wish this restaurant great success and would happily recommend this to others.

reviews.author: Jakub Szary
reviews.text: Very cute, home style restaurant that serves delicious food. Staff were great and had a joking personality, which we enjoyed 😂. Food was fantastic and fresh, and the atmosphere was cozy. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jun zhang
reviews.text: The restaurant is so cute and the food is fantastic. Best meal I have had so far in Croatia. We had The Tuna, Octopus salad and home made lemonade and brandy fig for dessert.

reviews.author: Tim Sellars
reviews.text: We had a traditional Croatian dinner here for the most reasonable prices anywhere in Hvar. Family owned and run restaurant.

reviews.author: Miroslav Majer
reviews.text: Our experience at Passarola restaurant was wonderful. The atmosphere was pleasant, and the dishes were tasty and nicely presented. We greatly appreciate sommelier Sabina, who professionally recommended excellent wines. Her expertise significantly contributed to our enjoyable evening. Thank you, Sabina, and the entire Passarola team. We look forward to returning. Best regards, The Sailing Team from Slovakia

reviews.author: J Sloan
reviews.text: The highlight of this restaurant is the service. Between Kristian, (our waiter) and his love of music references (my wife was Amy “ Winehouse” and I was Jim “Morrison”) and the sommelier with her great recommendations and love of local wine we had a great evening. Food was good, not great but portions were large so think about splitting if you have a starter. The house sushi roll was very good, although the salmon and tempura shrimp were all cooked. The salad was pretty pedestrian, just lettuce, cucumber and tomatoes. The fish in parchment was very good and tender.

reviews.author: Jackie Goggins
reviews.text: Cristian was our server and he really made our experience 10/10. He was attentive, very kind and professional. We stumbled upon this place looking for dinner and were very impressed with the ambiance, the food, and service. For starters we had the burrata salad and salmon sashimi which were both very fresh and tastey. The sensay roll was delicious!! Highly recommend sitting on the second floor terrace and having dinner at sunset.

reviews.author: Ron de Wit
reviews.text: The food was great and they had amazing wines. The sommelier knew everything about wines and told about it with so much passion, really great!

reviews.author: Tharmika Tharmabala
reviews.text: My group of 4 had experienced the wine tasting with our host Sabina. She made the experience unforgettable!! She is extremely passionate about wine and makes you truly understand each flavor with each sip. The wine itself was delicious! My favorite would definitely be the perch white wine. Sabina does a phenomenal job at explaining each wine and sharing fun stories about each bottle. Truly one of the most recommended things to do on this island! They also just added sushi to their menu and let’s just say, BEST sushi we ever had in our lives!!! 10/10!!! Thank you again the staff and service was outstanding.

reviews.author: Tharmika Tharmabala
reviews.text: My group of 4 had experienced the wine tasting with our host Sabina. She made the experience unforgettable!! She is extremely passionate about wine and makes you truly understand each flavor with each sip. The wine itself was delicious! My favorite would definitely be the perch white wine. Sabina does a phenomenal job at explaining each wine and sharing fun stories about each bottle. Truly one of the most recommended things to do on this island! They also just added sushi to their menu and let’s just say, BEST sushi we ever had in our lives!!! 10/10!!! Thank you again the staff and service was outstanding.

reviews.author: hello there
reviews.text: Their jam doughnut is so soft, airy, and not oily. Their cheese twist pastry is super crispy and flavorful with the seeds on top.

reviews.author: Thomas Vermeulen
reviews.text: Tasty pastry with cream cheese here. They're only open in the morning. Ideal while waiting for the bus to Stari Grad or walking around on the nearby square. Service is a bit so so, but baked goods are value

reviews.author: Rosie cable
reviews.text: Very good ham and cheese bakes and croissants! Cheap and delicious! Accept cash and card :)

reviews.author: Alice Wu
reviews.text: Wonderful bakery. Corn baguette, custard donut, meat burek. All fresh and warm from the oven. Sometimes cash only though I heard the woman before me pay with card. So your mileage may vary. But he prices are so cheap, recommend you just bring cash. Come early as they close by afternoon. Also adjacent to an excellent farmer's market

reviews.author: Megan Bamberger
reviews.text: Best pastries on Hvar! They all are made fresh and are still warm in the morning. Cash only and worth every cent!

reviews.author: Vladi B
reviews.text: We stumbled upon this gem while walking through Korcula old town. Having been impressed by it’s beautiful terrace we were even more impressed by the quality of food and service. Everything was impeccable!!! Astonishingly good food, very attentive and swift service, beautiful setting overlooking rooftops it was very magical. Ante reserved exceptional table for us and we didn’t get the name of our server but he was very knowledgeable and phenomenally attentive and polite and with the restaurant for past 12 years . Chef made lobster to perfection and everything else too. Looking forward to coming back.

reviews.author: Gareth Underwood
reviews.text: If you are lucky enough to get a reservation, then this is the best seafood restaurant. The service was attentive. Our server Adrian was on point. The atmosphere was relaxed, and this was also in part due to the service being present for any request. The food was excellent. After eating out every night for two weeks, this was one of our favourites. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Michael Matthews
reviews.text: A lovely meal in a very lovely setting. Excellent service, fantastic quality seafood. Would definitely return. The mixed seafood plate gave a taste of all the appetisers and every element was superb. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Mark Burgess
reviews.text: Walked up without a booking around 6pm Immediately seated on a picturesque terrace with amazing views of the old town. Bread and tuna pate a surprise addition and very tasty whilst we waited for our main courses. Grilled squid 🐙 was excellent. Tender and meaty. Lamb chops were spot on 😋 Fries really tasty. Cheesecake dessert a sweet end. Family owned run and it shows. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Courtney Shadd
reviews.text: I stumbled on this place accidentally and I’m so glad I did! The food was absolutely amazing. The Fish samosas were highly recommended by my server, Christian from Zagreb, and I’m so glad I listened. He also recommended the GRK wine and the macaroni with shrimp and he could not be more right! It was so good! If I had more time on the island I would be here everyday. As for the service, Christian was literally the sweetest person and gave amazing recommendations. He was so helpful and his service was wonderful. He was so knowledgeable about all of the foods and he made my experience here great! I will be back for the food of course but mostly because of his amazing service! When you’re here ask for him as your server!

reviews.author: Peter Ashworth
reviews.text: One of the best restaurant finds in Korcula, Croatia 🇭🇷 . The food was spectacular (Michelin Starred), the service excellent, the table out on the edge of the promenade under the trees, and the experience highly personal. We met the Chef owner (Filip) and the most amazing waiter who guided us through great menu choices ( I highly recommend you try the duck!!). You should find and try.

reviews.author: Toni Luci
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a dinner that goes beyond the ordinary and turns into a memorable experience – Filippi in Korčula is the place to be. An 8-course dinner that was flawless from start to finish – a perfect blend of fine cuisine, professional service, and a beautiful seaside setting. I won’t spoil the surprise by revealing the dishes, but know this – each course is a revelation, and the journey is worth every cent. This is not just a meal – it’s an experience. Let the photos speak for themselves, and I’ll leave it to you to discover the magic that Filippi has to offer.

reviews.author: Katrine Gisselø Lauridsen
reviews.text: Honestly very very disappointing. The food did not live up to the price or the Michelin recommendation. Most of the dishes lacked salt and acidity. The price was way too high compared with the quality (104€ each for 3 small dishes). The service was good but I would still not recommend going.

reviews.author: Marina Garmes
reviews.text: We left the restaurant feeling frustrated. We paid €104 per person for a tasting menu — a price well above the local standard — so we expected at least satisfying quality and portions. Unfortunately, that wasn’t the case. My starter, a shrimp tartare, was excellent. My husband’s veal was good, but the portion was shockingly small. At that point, the waiter offered us some focaccia — which, considering it was a tasting menu, we naturally assumed was included. But no: we were charged extra for it, which felt misleading. The main courses were underwhelming. Mine lacked flavor and creativity, and included a grape that tasted overwhelmingly like vinegar. My husband’s lamb was just okay, but again, served in a disappointingly tiny portion. As for dessert, my white chocolate option was very good, but his strawberry sorbet was basically just frozen strawberry juice. Nothing more. For the price we paid, we left hungry — and with the sense that the experience didn’t live up to the price point, in terms of flavor, care, or transparency. We do not recommend it.

reviews.author: Meg
reviews.text: When in Korčula, you need to book a table here, not only for the incredible food made with best ingredients and much love, passion, talent and creativity, the perfect service, but also for the incredible view. It deserves every Michelin star they received. One of the best Croatian dinings ❤️

reviews.author: Tom Balaban
reviews.text: This was one the most well-rounded dining experiences in my life, and at 77 I've had a few. EVERYTHING, from food to wines to service to atmosphere, was extraordinary. This authentic Croatian cooking at its very best

reviews.author: Kyle Larkin
reviews.text: Konoba Maha is a hidden gem on the island of Korcula. Situated in a rural and remote area, you’re welcomed by a small Konoba surrounded by nature. For those booking, I would highly recommend pre ordering the chicken peka which is a traditional dish that takes 4+ hours to prepare in a historic style. The service, and the white wine that was recommended to us, was also excellent. A great culinary experience!

reviews.author: Martin Stenderup-Larsen
reviews.text: A beautiful restaurant in the countryside a short drive from Korcula city. I had “the octupus” … grilled octopus with Black beans and potato. Best dish on our trip. For Dessert an excellent cheesecake… normally I don’t order cheesecake but this I would certainly order again…👍😁

reviews.author: Adriane King
reviews.text: My friend and I went for dinner and it was one of the best meals we have ever had. The zucchini soup was to die for! We didn’t know about ordering the peka in advance so ordered off the menu and it was wonderful. The service and atmosphere are top notch. We wished we found it earlier so we could go back again before we left Korcula. Thanks for an unbelievably great meal!

reviews.author: Jason Crerar
reviews.text: Lovely authentic family owned Croatian restaurant. Well priced compared to some of the other restaurants we tried.

reviews.author: Daniel Kusy
reviews.text: Our visit to Konoba Mate in Pupnat was a memorable part of our trip to Korčula. Upon arrival, we appreciated the pleasant outdoor patio with its rustic stone walls, which created a nice atmosphere. The food was excellent. We had the traditional Pasticada with macaroni, which was very delicious and a dish we will remember. The ravioli with goat cheese was also very good. As someone from Poland, a country known for its dumplings, I can say these ravioli were well-prepared and satisfying. To complement our meal, we enjoyed the local Plavac wine, which was excellent and paired well with the dishes. The dessert, a white chocolate mousse with bay leaf, was a pleasant surprise. It was delicious, and it was interesting to discover how well bay leaf worked in a dessert. It provided a delightful end to our meal. The staff were very nice and attentive. Our dog was welcome, and the staff even provided water and a cheese snack, which was a thoughtful gesture. Konoba Mate offers a very good dining experience with excellent food, good wine, a pleasant setting, and hospitable service. We highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Maciej Polaczek
reviews.text: Delicious, beautifully presented and varied food. Excellent service – kind, unobtrusive, yet always there when you need them. A charming, intimate garden. A wonderful shop with homemade products. We’ll be back in a few days!

reviews.author: Kyle Larkin
reviews.text: It’s not surprising that Konoba Mate is on the Michelin list as their food is excellent and their family service continues. We were served by the owners daughter and really enjoyed our experience. The almond pesto pasta was delicious as was their traditional meat dish. The restaurant, in a small town, also feels like a great find outside of the hustle and bustle.

reviews.author: Chiara Sackellares
reviews.text: Konoba Mate offers a cozy and beautiful outdoor dining experience, perfect for a summer night out with your family or a romantic date night. Each dish is presented beautifully and tastes even better than it looks. The service is top notch, warm, friendly, and inviting. The pasticada with macaroni features their homemade pasta with tender and perfectly seasoned meat and my personally favorite, the prawns with macaroni has a creamy, savory sauce with perfectly cooked prawns. The bread is fresh and pairs perfectly with the salted and marinated sardines, fresh cheeses, and kumquat jam. Save room for dessert!

reviews.author: Zorana Jagodic
reviews.text: Dining at Konoba Mate was an unforgettable experience. We started with a hearty legume soup, followed by their phenomenal tortellini filled with goat cheese and sage – simply divine. The slow-cooked beef cheeks were melt-in-your-mouth delicious, and both desserts we tried were outstanding. We also enjoyed excellent wine that perfectly complemented the meal. To top it all off, we were lucky enough to be joined by dida Mate himself, who shared stories about Korčula and the history of the konoba. It was a truly special and authentic experience. Everything – from the food to the atmosphere – deserves the highest praise. Don’t miss this place if you’re on the island!

reviews.author: Irina Ideas
reviews.text: The most mysterious and wholesome place of entire Croatia. It holds something very special and if you are near make an effort experience it

reviews.author: John Denny
reviews.text: Viewed from our cruise ship, Marella explorer ii in 2019, on our way to Venice, a stunning island.

reviews.author: Deborah Chapple
reviews.text: What an AMAZING Island to visit. Perfect place to go after the hustle and bustle of Dubrovnik. Great restaurants, clear water surrounds the island and plenty of little stores to find a treat.

reviews.author: stjop ex
reviews.text: One of the islands that is still going under the radar. Absolutely breathtaking, it's the greenest of all islands in Croatia with a rich cultural heritage and fantastic beaches. Since the land there is fertile, the locals grow pretty much everything and the taste of fruit and vegetable is amazing. Let's not forget two sorts of wines; pošip and grk which are brilliant. If you have a chance to go there don't hesitate, immerse yourself into the real mediterranean.

reviews.author: Ivana Magdić
reviews.text: A beautiful Mediterranean island, with excellent beaches, vineyards and breathtaking architecture. The traditional dance "Moreška" should definitely be seen. The birthplace of Marco Pollo is preserved in the town of Korčula.

reviews.author: Irina Ideas
reviews.text: The most mysterious and wholesome place of entire Croatia. It holds something very special and if you are near make an effort experience it

reviews.author: Charlie Joe
reviews.text: We tried the domestic dish Pašticada, it was so delicious. The staff were very friendly. Portions were great sizes and very affordable! Will definitely eat here again when we come back :)

reviews.author: najmedeniji
reviews.text: After one hour waiting time, we got crispy-to-the-point-of-death sausages and blackened fries. Other plates were fine, but this really ruined our lunch. Also no apologies from the staff. I rember this reataurant as a great place to eat from a few years ago. Pitty.

reviews.author: Nickolaos Skampagiannis
reviews.text: The best Tavern and food in our 7days roadtrip through Dalmatian coast. We tried black risotto and a mix of grilled seafood, caught the same morning!! Everything was excellent, especially the atmosphere and the local hospitality was fulfilled with kindness and warmth. Not touristic at all!! With very low prices. The best of the best . Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Alexander Dzhanibekyan
reviews.text: We have been there twice this week and both of the times were amazing. The food was delicious, they definitely can cook a tasty steak, it was a perfect medium rare. The service was very friendly. The servant explained everything very well and all his suggestions very on point. It’s also important to mention that meat as well as fish are fresh there. The interior at this restaurant is very lovely too (see the pictures). A great place to visit, recommended.

reviews.author: Marek Lenčucha
reviews.text: Great local food, great service.

reviews.author: Dominik Bibko
reviews.text: Nice small bakery! 5 stars for having even vegan options!

reviews.author: Gospah karlsson
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Tomek Wis
reviews.text: The best bakery in the world!!!!

reviews.author: Luis Gomes
reviews.text: Fantastic seafood restaurant in Makarska! We ordered the house fish platter, which came with a generous and tasty selection of freshly grilled and perfectly cooked fish – everything was flavorful and well-seasoned. The mussels we had as a starter were some of the best we’ve tried: fresh, tender, and full of flavor. The staff were incredibly friendly, helpful, and attentive throughout the meal, which really made us feel welcome. The outdoor terrace is charming, with a relaxing vibe and a lovely view – a perfect setting to enjoy a great meal. Highly recommended for seafood lovers!

reviews.author: Nermina Jovic
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of dining at this remarkable restaurant, and I must say—everything about the experience was top-notch. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warm, attentive service that set the tone for the evening. Our waiter Dragan was knowledgeable, friendly, and genuinely cared about making our visit special. The food was nothing short of outstanding. Every dish we tried was expertly prepared, beautifully presented, and bursting with flavor. You can tell the chefs use high-quality ingredients and put thought into every element of the menu. The atmosphere was another highlight—elegant yet cozy, with tasteful decor and just the right lighting to make the space feel both intimate and vibrant. Whether you're on a date, with family, or out with friends, it's the kind of place that elevates the occasion. Despite the high quality of both service and cuisine, the prices were surprisingly reasonable. It’s rare to find a spot that delivers such a complete dining experience without breaking the bank. Highly recommended—I’ll definitely be returning soon!

reviews.author: Lucas Vítor Assini
reviews.text: Very nice place, beautiful decorations with a lot of tables. The food was great and the staff were very friendly! Prices were good.

reviews.author: Vootele Voikar
reviews.text: Excellent service with professional advice - listen to the waiters, they really know! Dishes good for sharing too, Pavlova, and Fish carpaccio were delicious and tasty experience!

reviews.author: Patrik Kisucky
reviews.text: Do yourself a favor when visiting Makarska Riviera and make sure you visit Riva restaurant. The place is amazing. Great vibes, amazing food and the service is top-notch. Our server was Milan and he did an excellent job.

reviews.author: Phil Drayton
reviews.text: Wonderfull place to eat fantastic food and people watch. So good, we went back for our 25th anniversary meal, staff are brilliant and the amazing Gorka is a superb hostess. Also check out her beautiful art.

reviews.author: Agnes Pethes
reviews.text: We had a very special evening at Gordana's. As there's off season, the restaurant was totally empty. We only stumbled upon the gem, called Stari Mlin. The seabass filet and the mussles were extremely good. All the ingredients were fresh. Gordana made us feel home. And her artistic and uplifting spirit, kind hospitality made our rainy evening very special. She was very friendly, but let us having our own space. Our dinner was a beautiful experience. As we're staying longer, we'll definitely visit her again. (Sorry about the quality of my photos, my phone is barely working. :) )

reviews.author: Skywalker Feng
reviews.text: This restaurant has a beautiful environment, and provides good service. Unfortunately the quality of the food really suck. I first tried the "Thai-style" rice with seafood - this is not traditional Thai food, in fact this is not even Asian fusion. From the wrong rice, to the wrong sauce, and the wrong way it is cooked, it is a complete mess at so many level. When I complained about it to the waitress she was quick to admit this is not real Thai food, and offered a free exchange for other food. Then I ordered the grilled seabass fillet with fried potatoes, and thought this could not go wrong, since it is traditional Croatian food. Unfortunately the disaster happened twice - the seabass fillet was over-grilled, overly salty, and the potatoes are air-fried and tasteless. I had to throw most of the food away.

reviews.author: Tarpit Grover
reviews.text: An absolutely lovely evening. Our host was really kind and made us feel really comfortable. The food was top notch and the fish was really fresh. Grilled potatoes were lush! House white wine was second to none. All in all an event well spent with a family who’s passionate about cooking and art.

reviews.author: Radka Kovarovičová
reviews.text: AMAZING! The food, the stuff & the setting of the restaurant are simply stunning! We came back twice, both visits were food heaven. Me and my family recommend this place when you want to enjoy fresh and super tasty sea-food. Thank so much for this experience! You are doing amazing job.

reviews.author: Rajen Parekh
reviews.text: Had dinner at the restaurent Bevanda. Made pre reservation. Got seated on time. Excellent views of the bay. Ordered basil gnocchi pasta. So soft and delicious. Had glass of red wine. Good service. Good dessert - had Lava cake with icecream. Slight obstruction of view on one side due to temporary construction. Recommended.

reviews.author: denise burns
reviews.text: Stunning hotel and location. Staff are super friendly and helpful. Breakfast is first class, and we had a delicious evening meal there 😊

reviews.author: Ricard Guasch
reviews.text: I am writing to express my concern and disappointment regarding the recent dining experience at the hotel restaurant. After having a meal at the restaurant, I began experiencing severe food intoxication symptoms, including nausea, stomach cramps, and vomiting. This was incredibly distressing, especially since it occurred shortly after finishing my meal. While I understand that these situations can sometimes be unavoidable, it is crucial that the restaurant adheres to high standards of food safety and hygiene to ensure guest wellbeing. I would like to urge you to investigate this incident thoroughly and review the quality and handling of the ingredients used. The overall ambiance and service were pleasant, but unfortunately, the food safety issue significantly impacted my stay. I hope you take this feedback seriously and make necessary improvements so that future guests don’t have a similar experience.

reviews.author: Pascal Jean Guy Renard
reviews.text: I live in Zagreb but I am from Belgium and I must say that I am quite critical about hotels and restaurants especially if they are quite expensive. I must say that if it's about the hotel part or the restaurant, I really don't have nothing to say !!! All the simple details are there and really in the end this all place is really not expansive compared to what you get... Really just an amazing place !!!

reviews.author: Adele G
reviews.text: I had high hopes for this restaurant with its beautiful terrace and sea view, but my experience was incredibly disappointing. The waitress we encountered was rude and unhelpful. When we asked if we could order a pizza, she snapped that she was too busy and she didn't know when we could come back to eat. Even though the terrace was not full at all, half of the seats were empty and no people inside in a restaurant, didn’t understand it. In fact, she rudely suggested we might as well not come at all since she had 'too much work' to deal with. What surprised us even more was the contrast with another waiter, who politely informed us that they start preparing food at 1 PM and that we could already place our orders. If you can't handle working with people, why become a waitress and ruin the experience at a nice place? At the end the rude waitress asked for tips, she explicitly pointed that we have to leave a tip for her(as soon as she brought the bill). I’ve attached the photo of the waitress who was extremely rude. Wanted to point we were the only foreigners that place(low season), we felt like we are not welcomed there at all. As for the food and drinks. Dont order cappuccino there, quite low quality. But pizza was really good for that i am giving 1 star. But all in all after treating us this way we will never come back and would not recommend to anyone. No matter which nationality you are you always have to be treated with respect.

reviews.author: Damir
reviews.text: Restaurant Tramerka located in the streets of picturesque Volosko is a real discovery. The peaceful surroundings of the seaside town give a special charm to everything. The waiter is very polite and funny and just right as he deserves all the praise. The food is a little more expensive compared to the rest and the portions are really small as if you are eating a cold appetizer. The choice of food on the menu is quite enough for everyone. The house wine is too expensive. The interior is very nicely decorated but the terrace is a real recommendation.

reviews.author: Eva Lipnik
reviews.text: Tramerka is hidden on a narrow street between buildings in Volosko, but just a minute from the coast. The food was absolutely delicious - the two of us started with 3 starters (we were really hungry) and all three were great, but tuna tartare really stood out. The bread was warm, freshly baked. For main course, we had grilled octopus and a white fish (grdobina), which were also really tasty. The staff was very friendly. I recommend reserving a table up-front, especially if you wish to sit outside. Would recommend 10/10.

reviews.author: Rebekah Berkovic
reviews.text: Update June 2025 Simply one of the best restaurants overall. They are doing everything right - excellent dishes, quaint and comfortable location, top notch service and friendliness. We already can't wait to go back! Update June 2024 Still amazing, if not better than last year. Lovely service, amazing flavour profiles, great vibes. Best place in and around Opatija. We ended up going here two nighs in a row and loved it both times. It's small and unassuming with a very chill atmosphere. The owner/server is friendly, helpful and clearly understands good food and service. They have some fresh offers each day that are not on the menu. We had a tuna tartare, both the octopus and cuttlefish salads, the marinated white fish and anchovies, the mussels, the prosciutto and had a chance to eat the lamb ispod peke. Every dish was wonderful. The house wine (both red and white) we're also very good. We'd highly recommend this place and can't wait to be back.

reviews.author: Vid Janša
reviews.text: Very positively impressed by both the atmosphere and the food. The prices are also reasonable for the food - not cheap but also not expensive.

reviews.author: C K
reviews.text: Impeccable service, amazing food, quiet spot away from the main street and crowd. Intimate. Love the vibe.

reviews.author: Walter Schärer
reviews.text: Gourmet style restaurant, tasty fish dishes, good wine selection, impeccable service, picturesque location. Well done!

reviews.author: Lu La
reviews.text: We were looking forward to a special dinner at Plavi Podrum, but unfortunately, it didn’t live up to expectations. The waiter was unfriendly and insisted we order more than we wanted, which made us uncomfortable. While the food looked great and my boyfriend enjoyed his meal, my dish, supposedly with truffles, had no truffle flavor at all. The atmosphere was chaotic, with children playing just half a meter away and even a dog barking inside the restaurant. Not what you’d expect from a place claiming to offer exclusive dining.

reviews.author: Max Myklagard
reviews.text: We came to finish our business meeting with our Croatian colleagues during the dinner. The place is very unique - running by the family in 3rd generation. Very special dishes prepared with passion and enthusiasm. The staff is service oriented, always kind and asking when necessary. Selection of drinks is also amazing.

reviews.author: Adrien OLLIER
reviews.text: Disappointing – not a premium experience and very very very expensive for what it is really. This restaurant needs to come back down to earth. I’m Parisian and used to dining in premium restaurants. Plavi Podrum claims to be one — it absolutely isn’t. The service was so arrogant and no smiling at all. No advice, no suggestions, just constant upselling. We waited far too long, even though the place was only 1/3 full. The cappelletti was a disaster — tasteless and served sinking into water. The rest was decent, but not enough to save the experience. Dogs were barking non-stop inside the restaurant and no one cared. Some guests were clearly treated mutch more better than others. This place is clearly resting on its laurels. Promise not kept.

reviews.author: Marko Ilicic
reviews.text: Amazing restaurant, definitely top 5 in Opatijska riviera. Great take on fine dining, plus traditional specialties. For example there is octopus made more towards fine dining and black squid risotto made in traditional way. I loved the amazing selection of the olive oils including best of 2020. Great dessert as well.

reviews.author: petru mihai
reviews.text: 4 stars because, the waiter English wasn't so good. Other wise, very nice location. A nice old style restaurant. Waiter was kind and helpful. Food didn't come as fast as expected, compared that there were just 2 tables, but OK. Food was delicious. I do recommend this place. Enjoy. 😊

reviews.author: Rez Phillips
reviews.text: This is an outstanding place to eat. Great service. And great food. My wife's pork loin with gnou was to die for. Definitely would recommend eating here if you are in Osijek

reviews.author: Viera Bodnarova
reviews.text: Oh my gosh! Heavenly experience 😇 The food was just wow! I couldn't put the fork down, I definitely ate too much 😆 Everything from grill was delicious, we had soup in bread, rich and big salads and grilled vegetables. They've got English menu and you can pay with card (ATM is next door, too). And the interior is just fabulous. The pictures are from the garden... We will come back again and I recommend the restaurant to all fellow travelers 😉 and thanks to the Google Maps community for answering my question so quickly 😍

reviews.author: Hanna Ollos
reviews.text: An absolutely wonderful restaurant with a fantastic menu and a super vegetarian variety. I cannot judge how the meaty stuff tasted, but my companions seemed very satisfied as well. Moreover, homemade bread and delicious spreads helped us to survive the waiting times. Dessert was also really yummy. I could also only say super nice things about the service..so... Best restaurant in Osijek, without a doubt!

reviews.author: martin b
reviews.text: Great place for local cuisine & vine, had the game stew with game from the National Park across the river, local Merlot from Belje. Super is the delicious homemade bread with a self made spread 👌💕

reviews.author: Mackers
reviews.text: Still one of the best places to eat in Osijek, with quite reasonable prices for high quality food and wine, I try to come here every year now because of their great consistency. Staff is also friendly and their wifi is good. I went with colleagues, and everything we ordered was tasty - pljukanci with black truffles, venison, gnocchi, I had tuna steak with curry sauce. Their desserts were also inspired - like a modern twist on local traditions (krempita, chocolate cake). With a glass of wine or soda, you could get a very decent meal for under 20 euros.

reviews.author: Lucian Urcan
reviews.text: One of the best restaurants I have visited in Croatia and also in Europe. It could as well be located on the French riviera :) It offers you a true fine dining experience. I will return there each time when I am visiting Osijek.

reviews.author: Marko Štavt
reviews.text: Very nice food, also the salad was great. Not the cheapest but worth it. Potatoes were fair. Meat and sauce were very nice. Attentive staff.

reviews.author: Adelina Pang
reviews.text: If you're looking for a place where exceptional food meets a charming environment, Lumiere Bistro is the perfect choice.

reviews.author: Dino Marosicevic
reviews.text: Fantastic food. The Wien schnitzel is an authentic size. The gorgonzola steak was absolutely delicious and cooked to perfection. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Vesna Šeremet
reviews.text: Untidy, horrible plastic cakes! Average cakes, bad bread.

reviews.text: The bakery is closed

reviews.text: nan

reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Dusko ILIC
reviews.text: Nestled along the picturesque river Drava, Osijek is enveloped by sprawling vineyards that stretch as far as the eye can see. For lunch, the ideal choice is to indulge in delectable dishes crafted from river fish paired with local wines. Savor dishes like smoked carp pâté with a side of roasted pepper tartare, complemented by a vibrant tomato salad. For the main course, feast on a tender perch fillet served with a medley of cooked vegetables and drizzled with a velvety white butter sauce. The star of the meal was the 2022 harvest of grasevina from the renowned Papak vineyard, a white wine that boasts a fruity, fresh, and slightly aromatic profile. The service was impeccable, with the waiter Ivan graciously offering tastings of grasevina from various vineyards, though Papak's stood out as the clear favorite. The flavors harmonized beautifully, promising a culinary experience to remember. With such exceptional quality, it's only a matter of time before the restaurant earns its well-deserved first Michelin star in the region. It's a recognition that is truly earned.

reviews.author: noavali daddress
reviews.text: Best restaurant for me in city! Perfect service, nice and tasty food! Good wine choice. Recommended all dishes. we ordered several starters and mains, everything was outstanding! And the service was at very high level!

reviews.author: 이빨부자 Leebbal
reviews.text: A reasonably priced find dining restaurant in Croatia. beef cheek dish is so tender. Lava cake was quite dry

reviews.author: Marija Janeva
reviews.text: Service was impeccable, the food was great and we didn't struggle to find a spot without a reservation. The interior is really nice and pleasant to sit in.

reviews.author: Ruža Peček-Guillot
reviews.text: It's been a long time since I've eaten so divinely. Relaxing atmosphere and excellent staff. Chapeau

reviews.author: Lanokota Phoenix
reviews.text: I recommend making a reservation. When I arrived at around 730pm, and didn't have a reservation, they didn't seem to want to accept me...despite it not being full, even by the time I left. In the end the owner\manager grudgingly said I could eat, but only if I accepted the mixed grill. He allowed me no other food choice. I found this a bit odd, especially as when other local people arrived, they seemed to have a choice to freely order from the menu. Despite it not being what I wanted to eat, I tried it anyway, and the meat was quite good. Sausage, chevapi, chicken, pork all of which were cooked deliciously, and beef pattie which was so so. I might have rated the food higher had I been allowed to choose food I wanted. Ambience was nice, a bit quiet early on until the tables started to fill. There was some kind of band bringing in gear by the time I finished my meal, so I didn't get a chance to hear that. Despite the not so welcoming owner, the waitress was super nice, so I added stars for her service, or it would have been rated lower for the unwelcoming feel.

reviews.author: Zach Pierce
reviews.text: A great Croatian experience! It's located in the old town part of Osijek, the food is tasty and is well priced.As an American I just happened to be walking towards the music I heard in the distance of Osijek, and what did I find, and entire fish cooking festival right out front of the restaurant. I was greeted by some very friendly Croatian, and from that moment on I was their guest. I was fortunate enough to enjoy a luscious meat platter and fish platter while tasting local wine and sparkling water. Croatian folk music was playing and all I could do was move to the beat, sit back, and take it all in.

reviews.author: Vojtěch Šanca
reviews.text: Restoran Slavonska Kuća offers absolutely fantastic food in huuuge portions and very professional service. It feels like one of these restaurants where you would take your family for a celebration dinner but it doesn't cost a fortune (but, honestly, it could be cheaper). Also I have to mention the amazing waiter who was extremely nice and friendly. The food itself represents the typical cuisine from Slavonia which is very specific itself as it is a merge between Hungarian and Balkan (at least from my perspective) and is definitely worth trying. The menu isn't very long but I think that's a good sign. They cook only few dishes of each kind but they do it very well.

reviews.author: Kateryna Kravchenko
reviews.text: Traditional Croatian food, amazing dishes and very friendly staff

reviews.author: Mauro Iannuzzi
reviews.text: Traditional restaurant in the old Osijek. People very kind. Good food.

reviews.author: Katherine Hauptmann
reviews.text: I LOVE this place , so accommodating with my gluten allergy and my kids , incredible food and beautiful setting and the waiter was a darling

reviews.author: Martin Cemez
reviews.text: Pleasant service, atmosphere, excellent food. Fried calamari with chips and beer.

reviews.author: Kiara Kiara
reviews.text: OMG! What a hidden gem 💎... We had the fish sharing platter and the fish wasn't fresh...it was still alive!!!! Simply divine! Service extremely professional and friendly. Super recommend.

reviews.author: Ritchie Pettauer
reviews.text: Almost too good to be true. The friendly, knowlegeable and attentive service, the attention the chef is paying to all the little details, the fantastic Croatian wine menu ... Every single dish we had here was cooked to perfection: Seafood, local lamb, pasta, the delicious sweets - WOW! Of course we visited the "crook" ("Farabuto" in Italian) more than once. So happy I could celebrate my birthday here - looking forward to our next visit. Definitely on my all-time top ten list.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Franzoni
reviews.text: Very good experience. The place is extremely quiet and cozy, the atmosphere is very relaxed elegant and informal at the same time. The menu is short enough to ensure high quality food, but wide enough to allow the customers to choose between a solid variety of dishes. Our waiter spoke both in English and Italian, we appreciated it. She also explained perfectly the dishes when brought to the table. Home made bread was a nice surprise too. We came here to eat fish, we ate fish and we were happy about it. 85€ in three people, amazing price-quality ratio. We also ordered the cheesecake, honestly it wasn't great, but that does not ruin an amazing dinner.

reviews.author: Asia
reviews.text: We visited this place in Pula today and it was absolutely amazing! The food was incredibly delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. On top of that, the portions were huge – we honestly couldn’t finish everything, even though we really wanted to because it tasted so good! The service was also outstanding – friendly, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome. You can tell there’s real passion behind this place. Highly recommended – we’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Maciej Grabowski
reviews.text: Great choice of pizza and pasta. We had gnocchi with goulash, sea food pasta and few others. Great place for dinner or drink on your way to or from the castle! The staff is welcoming and really helpful, too!

reviews.author: Sava V. Franke
reviews.text: This place isn’t fancy — it has that classic Balkan vibe, and I loved it. I had the ćevapi and they were top! Juicy, flavorful, and served just right. Exactly what you hope for when you’re craving real Balkan food. The staff were kind and welcoming, and the atmosphere was warm and relaxed.

reviews.author: Julia Tischenko
reviews.text: We had the turkey steak with cheese and Parma ham in mushroom sauce, and the truffle pasta — and both dishes were absolutely amazing. The truffle pasta was especially impressive: generous chunks of black truffle throughout, and the portion size was just right satisfying without being too much. The flavor was rich and perfectly balanced. The turkey steak really surprised us the portion was huge! We had to take some of it to go, but it was so tender and flavorful that we just couldn’t leave any behind. Highly recommended! Great food, generous portions, and wonderful flavors.

reviews.author: eye
reviews.text: Easily my favourite restaurant in Pula, we dined here 4 times during our week-long stay in Istria and loved it every single time. The restaurant has a great variety of meals ranging from pasta and pizza to ćevapčići and calamari. It gets quite busy and you might need to queue (especially in the evenings) but the ambiance is pretty relaxed nonetheless. The staff is very kind and welcoming, service is pretty fast even during rush hour. Amazing quality for the price.

reviews.author: Bojana Drača
reviews.text: It's been years since my last visit to Batelina. The quality and the mood are still the same. I loved the cold starters plate. We were also lucky to come in the crab season! Definitely recommended!

reviews.author: zeljkog74
reviews.text: We were planning to visit David's place for a while now. As great fans od his culinary philosophy we enjoyed lovely selection of cold seafood starters, followed by fish of choice (daily catch) and great cannoli for desert. The atmosphere was great and the staff was excellent. If you like good quality seafood prepared with care this is a place to go.

reviews.author: Amalia S
reviews.text: I’ve been so excited to try this restaurant and all I can say is that I can’t wait to go back! The food is all homemade and so incredibly fresh! The selection is what was caught that day and there is so much to choose from. Drinks are great and priced well. The staff is amazing, attentive, nice and friendly but also so knowledgeable. The terrace where we sat was so lovely, the view of the gardens and flowers around makes you feel at home. Desserts were mind-blowing (I don’t usually care too much). This might now be my #1 fish restaurant in Croatia! I didn’t even mind that it was cash only. And the value for money was really good!

reviews.author: J K
reviews.text: If you like (raw) seafood starters and pasta, this is a must visit. Most likely one of the best food experiences which I can only recommend. Have in mind that the place gets busy and you need to reserve well in advance. Kudos to the Chef!

reviews.author: Jennifer Chan
reviews.text: Cozy restaurant with great service n fresh seafood. V impressed w the food quality. Better half is not a fan of fish and he liked the grilled flounder and red mullet carpaccio. Highly recommended if u visit pula. Wont disappoint. Pricing is reasonable for quality. Reservations required. We walked in n were lucky to get a table. No menu. Fresh catch of the day.

reviews.text: Tourist trap...I usually don't post reviews but...We stopped by to buy some baked goods, everything was ok, saleswoman spoke english well, until I asked her for the check that she printed out. She lost her speech and suddenly she was able to speak only croatian and used google translate. She tried to explain it with phrases like "no papier"... that she doesn't have paper? That she has just printed out? Funny.... I wouldn't ask for it, if she didn't want hide it so badly. Also it's not easy to know, how much you'll pay as the price tags are everywhere and you don't know what belongs to what. This is not a good way, how to make more money from your bussiness. You can simply start with improving your baking recipes as everything tastes like donut (whether it's salty or sweety)

reviews.author: Mario D. Zmaj
reviews.text: If Google is the big brother of our future, I am not afraid of it. It keeps thinking I have been to places I have never been to, and this is one of those places. 5 stars no doubt!

reviews.text: Very nice ambience full of plants and super sweet crew. We ate 3 fish dishes and everything was very fresh and nicely prepared. The dessert was specially good and seasonal. The house wine very good. Looking forward to going back!

reviews.author: Nenad Trifunovic
reviews.text: Reliable place, just not very inspiring. Sure, you'll get very decent food at restaurant experience price and there will be no mistakes and it's deffinitely no scam, but no thrill either. Routinely boring. I wish I could go back in time to visit Vodnjanka again.

reviews.author: aida spahic
reviews.text: Very good wines, delicious homemade Food, the owner is very polite and available men, everything was great and we Will come back for sure again

reviews.author: Michael Prionas
reviews.text: Highly recommend this restaurant if you want fresh Croatian seafood. I had the brodet (seafood stew) which was incredibly flavourful and a good portion too. The staff were also very friendly and the restaurant had a beautiful ambience.

reviews.author: Jo von MUC
reviews.text: Nice location. Really tasteful food - I believe they are aiming for a star. Good service. You have the choice between three different menues (meat, fish, veg). Can recommend it to everyone. You have to reserve a few days ahead.

reviews.author: Gianni
reviews.text: Visited some time ago. From the outside the restaurant seems almost anonymous, but the warm internal atmosphere, combined with the simple furnishings and the kindness of the waiters immediately give an idea of ​​what a Konoba should be. I had lunch with a mixed tartare which I found very good and definitely very well presented. Finally I had a homemade pasta with truffle and shrimp. This dish didn't completely convince me: a little too watery and bitter in flavour.

reviews.author: Vilko Pintar
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: CHOLE Tang
reviews.text: Great place with food worth the price and has a really nice fisherman village atmosphere. We had a reservation, so we didn't have to wait, but it was particularly crowded in here, so we recommend coming early or reserving a seat. Highly recommend the tiramisu. It was creamy and had a smooth sift base and lots of flavor. It would have been better with a stronger chocolate flavour but it was good for the price. The pesto pasta was delicious, it had a unique taste, fresh tomato's and the pasta wasn't dry, tough or hard, but rather just nice The fish soup was definitely a must try as it had the fresh taste of the fish and the soup was relatively clear without a fishy smell. It had bits or rice and for a soup, it was very filling. The calamari was recommend to us by the waiter and it was served on a huge plate with fries that are warm soft and crispy. This was the star dish for our lunch and it cannot be passed.

reviews.author: Rad S
reviews.text: Very central location at the Marina. Food here is very delicious. I loved the fish and stuffed calamari dish. The restaurant can be a bit loud at the outside seating area and if it is a hot summer evening but they make it up for that with food. It is a little more expensive than other places nearby around. But overall it was good. Reservation ahead is highly recommended.

reviews.author: Celest Tang
reviews.text: My local guide recommended this place !!! I loved all the dishes I tried here (the fish soup, calamari, pesto, mussels and fish soup). I didn't take a pic of the fish soup but it was really fresh and taste super delicious 😋😋 The food came out really quick too

reviews.author: Kristjan Kušar
reviews.text: Great food and service. The portions are very big (we had the fish plate for 2 and extra mussels). Very tasty 👌🏼 will come again

reviews.author: Clara Piñol
reviews.text: The service is exceptional, the waiters are very kind and pleasant. The mussels are to absolutely die for. Also had the best coffee I ever had from this restaurant. I will come back

reviews.author: S. T. NEUBERT
