reviews.author: Judy A
reviews.text: Beautiful food and nicely presented. Service is very fast. Love how the wine and Parmesan is presented! Highly recommend for great food at very reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Ana Isabella Martinez Brito
reviews.text: We didn’t come in on our first night at Rijeka because it was empty, but we decided to give it a try on the second night. The food was incredible, but moreover our waiter Antonio made the experience way better. He brought parmesan with a grader to our disposition, answered all our questions, checked constantly on us, and made amazing recommendations. A must visit when you visit Rijeka!

reviews.author: Jaro Games
reviews.text: Ordered food, it was inedible and disgusting. When I complained, the waiter SUGGESTED A REPLACEMENT, which I accepted. I WAS CHARGED FOR BOTH dishes. The manager is hiding like a coward... and does not respond. I suggest avoiding this place altogether, there are MANY better restaurants nearby with better food and lower prices. EDIT: PART 2. Today, one of the employees contacted MY FRIEND, and offered HIM (probably free) dinner. All that in effort for ME to delete this post. So me having a bad experience does not mean amything to restaurant? And trying to silence me then??? If you want to talk, talk to me directly not through someone else.

reviews.author: Alan Nikolovski
reviews.text: I had the carbonara here and it was amazing—creamy, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. You can really taste the quality ingredients. The staff were friendly and the atmosphere was great. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Alicja
reviews.text: lovely restaurant with great choice of pasta with seafood gives the italian cuisine a local vibe. the food was excellent together with croatian wine and beautiful liqueur Teranino (must try after meal). all served by lovely Anita which hosted us so friendly. definitely a place worth to visit!

reviews.author: Timo Reymann
reviews.text: Can not recommend this place enough. Excellent location, near the castle. A lot of cafés and restaurants nearby. Next bus stop is a few hundred meters away. Apartment itself is charming with a balcony and small, but well equiped kitchen. Also the prices are really reasonable.

reviews.author: Lyudmyla Smyrnova
reviews.text: The apartment is very nice, small, but nice. You can go to the city on foot. Very close is the castle, which is beautiful day and night. The owner of the house is very kind. Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Terezija Cimperšek
reviews.text: Good location, comfortably furnished and equipped apartment, and extremely friendly owner.

reviews.author: Monika w-1
reviews.text: Przytulny, gustownie urządzony apartament z dużym tarasem.

reviews.author: Alvin Bolic
reviews.text: Immaculate cleanliness.

reviews.author: Victor Sjölin
reviews.text: Best mussels I ever had, and I order it a lot. Gnocchi ragu was also great. Best meal during a one week round trip in Croatia, Slovenia and Trieste.

reviews.author: Nicola Ernesto Rinaldi
reviews.text: Tourist trap! We decided to follow trip advisor and time out and booked a table for two. Food is apolling, mixed grilled meat is bland and tasteless. The cod pate was nothing special and served with a miserable presentation. Disappointed and frustrated with the low level of this experience

reviews.author: Patrick Morgan
reviews.text: We got the seafood platter for 2, a salad and potatoes. It was overpriced and a little overrated, fish was good, potatoes tasteless and salad was four slices of cheese and four slices of tomatoes. Sorry guys for a premium restaurant in old town Rovinj the food was quite poor. Nice ambiance though

reviews.author: Katherine Sheridan
reviews.text: Mixed mussels were great, anchovies were fine, oysters were pretty bad - tiny and full of shell chunks. Overall the food was fine but quite overpriced. Waiter forgot part of the order but then charged us for it.

reviews.author: Vieran Hodko
reviews.text: Amazing find! The restaurant we were originally looking for only opened later. Cozy decor, warm staff and the food was quite tasty for the most part. The mussels came in a delicious white wine, butter and very garlic-ky sauce! The blitva ( swiss chard with patatoes, olive oil, lots of garlic and some magic seasoning) . The seafood was nice and several options are from the region. In a placd full of tourist traps , I can recommend and the prices were mostly quite reasonable

reviews.author: Yelena
reviews.text: We chose this restaurant based on the great reviews—and we definitely weren’t disappointed! The service was perfect, and the food was absolutely delicious. We had the Istrian-style goulash, and it was truly tasty—mildly spiced, yet rich in flavor. You can pay by card, which is convenient, but unfortunately, tips cannot be added to the card payment.

reviews.author: Bad-i (Bad-i)
reviews.text: Wow what a place!!!! Its not a restaurant, its a family garden with great atmosphere and tremendous food. Our last evening at Rovinj and we finally went with appartment owner recommendation. We chose the first from the list, instead of google maps rankings. That was the latest but best choice ever. Not sure why this place is only 4.6*. In my opinion they deserve 6. We went for sheep cheese with truffles (dont take pitta bread, its simply too much), and fuzi with truffles. Best meal whole week in Croatia. When you are in Rovinj you need to visit this place. Seriously, do not waste time on map search. Go there !!!

reviews.author: UD
reviews.text: Service was amazing. My server (Maria?) was very kind. Plenty of seats for lunch time. Bathroom was modern and clean too! The gnocchi with mushroom and spinach was only 10,50 euros. Place also had free WiFi . Relaxing music and ambience. Thank you!

reviews.author: Terry C
reviews.text: I loved the truffle pasta and the steak. The margarita pizza was good. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: SQ Ong
reviews.text: Very authentic Croatian Coastal Family run restaurant serving great pasta! We had a comfort foods there on our last day🥰

reviews.author: Alicia Fuente Juarez
reviews.text: Monte is a fantastic restaurant and a real highlight of Rovinj. The food is creative, beautifully presented, and full of amazing flavors. Every dish felt special and thoughtfully made. The staff were friendly and professional, making the whole evening a lovely one. The sommelier gave us great wine recommendations that matched the food perfectly and introduced us to some excellent local wines. It was a unique experience worth every moment.

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.text: "The first Michelin-starred restaurant in Croatia, and it is well-deserved.” If I could give this restaurant 6 stars, I would. It offers an absolutely amazing culinary experience. The food is simply out of this world—a true form of art. The presentation is beautiful as well. Without exaggeration, I wish I could dine here every day. My partner and I chose the 3-course menu, and we were extremely full by the end. The service was wonderful and professional, although one lady forgot which dish belonged to whom, and one gentleman didn't notice I was running out of water. However, I can overlook those minor issues given the overall positive experience. A MUST-visit when in Rovinj. Experience this yourself and make sure to make a reservation. (Visited June 2nd, 2024)

reviews.author: Dany Ros
reviews.text: Fabulous food in a wonderful setting. Excellent attention to detail in how the food is arranged in your place. Some dishes are bursting in color. Tjitske was superb and made us very welcome.

reviews.author: Slobodan Radosavljevic
reviews.text: My second time here. Let's start with the good - the atmosphere is magical, we were sat down for nearly 4 hours, yet the time flew by. The staff are exceptionally attentive, as you would expect (though maybe a little too surprised at there being a teetotaler at the table). RE food, I had the meat&fish menu, my companion the veggie. The verdict on the veggie menu is that while it looks exquisite, it tastes merely "nice" - we have definitely had mind-blowing set menus before, and I think this one just needs to mature/evolve a little. For the carnivores, the plates were exceptional, but just a little on the small side - I ended up leaving hungry, which is never good. They could have remedied this with regular bread service (the oil, salt and butter were left on the table throughout), but there was only one slice of bread given at the start. All in all, falling a little short of expectations at this level. Would I come again? Possibly, the atmosphere is that good - but I'd sure to have a decent, late lunch first.

reviews.author: joga4i0
reviews.text: Great Family owned restaurant with a very creative and passionate menu of seafood. If you are in for an experience full of taste this is the right place.

reviews.author: JÁNOS SZLAMA
reviews.text: Quit busy the shop, you can find sweet and salty baked goods

reviews.author: Desid Trep
reviews.text: The size and weight of burek is so small that it is not normal. And the price is slowly going up. I thought you had improved, but no. I will never come again. May it be done to you as you do to others!

reviews.author: Sandra Rosner
reviews.text: I can definitely recommend it, it's very tasty and the price is ok.

reviews.author: Honky Tonk
reviews.text: Doughs that are under-leavened and chewy like we are used to eating in Italy. Krapfen and croissants with little filling. Pizza by the slice was acceptable but the small round pizza was really rubbery and the dough was sweet.

reviews.author: Josua Pachoinig
reviews.text: Great selection of pastries and very cheap too

reviews.author: Suresh Kumili
reviews.text: Lovely restaurant at the edge of Rovinj old town. Has seating at different levels. I preferred to sit down at the bottom level, which is pretty much between rocks with cushions to make seating comfortable. The view of Adriatic from that edge is phenomenal :) The staff is warm and was very helpful in selecting the wine based on my taste preference. Do go here if you are looking for a great view. Dinner around sunset would be the best :)

reviews.author: Mika Kociolkiewicz
reviews.text: Romantic spot! Excellent food, one of the pricier places but they do have the perfect view so it’s understandable. The details of the design is very cute. We got a bit surprised about the service fee, the waitress didn’t mention anything about it. We were splitting the bill between us friends and it got just a bit awkward situation as we didn’t get informed and it looked like we were going without paying

reviews.author: Andreas
reviews.text: We had outdoor seating with good view. Beef carpaccio was good. Beef was cold. Truffle pasta was a big disappointment. Pasta was not al dente and the pasta taste is very off. Not sure why the pasta did not taste good. I think Barilla tastes better. Ribeye steak has grill Leak and I don’t think it goes well with steak. There is €4/person cover charge

reviews.author: Bojana Simic
reviews.text: Huge disappointment. Service was ok. Young girl that came first to serve us didn’t know anything about the food on the menu (what is included in two most popular dishes that she/restaurants recommend). We had to repeat several times what we want to eat, cause she wasn’t listening. But when food started to come, it was a different waiter. Soup was delicious. But then came my main dish - Squid served Rovinj way, with hair in it. Which I noticed when half of portion was eaten. Long hair white or gold (cause of sauce wasn’t that sure). Waiter offered different dish, I didn’t want any. He apologized, removed dish from the recipe, but restaurant didn’t offered anything else. Completely understand that they are understaffed, but don’t understand that there’s no management that will come and apologize in any way due to discussing situation. Was my favorite place in Rovinj, for years, but not anymore. Wish them luck and hope they’ll go back to their quality. Cause those prices (15€ for daily soup, cheapest dish on the menu) and this quality of service and food are perfect reasons to avoid this place.

reviews.author: Katarína Gažová
reviews.text: We came here for lunch. We were seated on the lower terrace right by the sea, a beautiful place but it was quite windy but they had no problem moving us to the other side. We had a fish fillet, meat and our daughter had spaghetti which was not in the menu but they offered us some. Everything was excellent, wonderfully seasoned, very tasty. The service was amazing, the table was ready, we also got a delicious starter. The prices were higher, but the food and the view were worth it!

reviews.author: Suresh Kumili
reviews.text: Lovely restaurant at the edge of Rovinj old town. Has seating at different levels. I preferred to sit down at the bottom level, which is pretty much between rocks with cushions to make seating comfortable. The view of Adriatic from that edge is phenomenal :) The staff is warm and was very helpful in selecting the wine based on my taste preference. Do go here if you are looking for a great view. Dinner around sunset would be the best :)

name: Street Stall - Marsala Tita
address: Street Stall - Marsala Tita, Rovinj, Croatia

reviews.author: Ivan Milić
reviews.text: The lamb was very delicious, but maybe too salty. The side dish (grilled vegetables) was also very salty. There was literally a layer of fine salt on the vegetables. This is the only bad thing. The texture and freshness of the food was extraordinary. They also have an extensive wine list. The parking is located right in front of the restaurant. It is advisable to make a reservation beforehand, maybe even 2-3 days in advance.

reviews.author: Milan Lomic
reviews.text: Truly amazing experience! Food is out of this world. We had famous risotto and roasted pork and both were the best I ever had. Service was super fast. We even had a small chat with the owner who wanted to make sure that we were satisfied. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: baqir hassan
reviews.text: TLDR: food poisoning, sub par meal for Michelin star Expected a great meal given the reviews and Michelin star. Received cold and dry pork, which per other reviews is the specialty. Risotto was good. We both got food poisoning after eating here, major gastrointestinal symptoms that caused us both to be stuck in the bathroom for about 16 hours. Wife had mild stomach cramps after leaving the restaurant. About 4 hours after our meal, wife developed major GI symptoms consistent with food poisoning. I developed symptoms about 8 hours after eating here, both of us felt perfectly fine before our meal and did not have food in the interim. This was the only meal where we both ate all of the same food and were feeling fine up until eating here. As a physician who has worked in the emergency room and treated food poisoning, it is clear that our meal at this restaurant was the cause. First Michelin star restaurant we had been to and it was dismal.

reviews.author: Sanan Phutrakul
reviews.text: Excellent traditional Croatian fare with friendly service and a homely atmosphere. The lamb liver and heart stew was like something a grandma would make.

reviews.author: Marie-Eve Giguère
reviews.text: At Konoba Vinko, a traditional Croatian tavern, we had a delightful meal featuring regional cuisine and wine. The focus on simple, locally sourced ingredients, expertly prepared, was a true highlight. • The veal risotto was rich, savory and well-balanced, while the capon was flavorful and juicy. Konoba Vinko showcased culinary excellence through simplicity. Another great recommendation from the MICHELIN Guide. • We greatly appreciated the wonderful meal and their ability to accommodate us on such short notice. Thank you!

reviews.author: Marija Škorić
reviews.text: The products are excellent. Always fresh and delicious. The only complaint is that it can only be paid in cash. They would be for 10 stars, in my opinion, if you introduced that you can also pay by card.

reviews.author: Roko Periš
reviews.text: A fat yellow scowling grandmother closed the door in my face 5 minutes before closing time. She is always scowling and always serving over something!

reviews.author: Ljuta Guja
reviews.text: The lady with blond short hair, who works in the bakery, is very rude and scowling every day!!

reviews.author: Josip Bralic
reviews.text: Always fresh, a large selection of products, friendly staff, all praise....

reviews.author: Jens Mueller
reviews.text: Everything was great, there was even dark bread. There were only a few parking spaces

reviews.author: Betsy Anderson
reviews.text: Peligrini may have been one of the best dining experiences of our lives. The service was so friendly and professional, the food was too good to be described adequately, and the setting was beautiful. I don’t know how the chef came up with those dishes but it was pure magic with the blending of flavors. If you have the chance to dine here, definitely take advantage of it!

reviews.author: James Dooms
reviews.text: We came here for dinner while staying in the area after our wedding and it was a treat for us. They may only have 1 Michelin star but they definitely should have more. The food was delicious and local, each with a story of origin. The wine was great too. The service was as what you would expect in a place like this with very friendly staff. The only comment I have is that during the summer, the court yard can get quite hot even in the evening so there isn’t much of a breeze that flows through. There are also mosquitos which will get you if you don’t spray. The heat mainly was an issue which didn’t allow for the full enjoyment of the meal but the food and service itself was amazing. Definitely recommended..

reviews.author: Linda` Ferguson
reviews.text: Sarah and her team created the most magical evening for us Canadians visiting Croatia. Thank you so much for the incredible memories❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviews.author: Dario J
reviews.text: A Memorable Experience at Pelegrini Today I had the pleasure to try out the sea food at Pelegrini restaurant in Šibenik. This was a true pleasure and I enjoyed it a lot. The food was fantastic, offering a variety of new and exciting flavors. Each dish was beautifully presented and tasted incredible. The staff were incredibly friendly and professional which enhanced the overall experience. They are mostly serving sea food but have some meat as well.

reviews.author: David Bear
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant. Wonderful creative and delicious food. The Tasting menu provides a dinner to remember. Fantastic service. Makes a visit to Sibenik that much more special

reviews.author: Betsy Anderson
reviews.text: Peligrini may have been one of the best dining experiences of our lives. The service was so friendly and professional, the food was too good to be described adequately, and the setting was beautiful. I don’t know how the chef came up with those dishes but it was pure magic with the blending of flavors. If you have the chance to dine here, definitely take advantage of it!

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant. Wonderful creative and delicious food. The Tasting menu provides a dinner to remember. Fantastic service. Makes a visit to Sibenik that much more special

reviews.author: Emina Hukic
reviews.text: We came in for a late dinner and had the octopus ispod peke and seafood risotto (rižoto sa morskim plodovima) and it was absolutely delicious! Perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and great service. 10/10, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Gemma Legrand
reviews.text: This Restaurant was booked and selected on our behalf by our tour operator. They made a fantastic choice. We were greeted by Krešimir who immediately gave us a warm welcome and set the tone for our experience. He was warm, professional and guided us through the menu and wine list. His suggestions and recommendations were spot on and he thanked us for trusting him, the gratitude was all ours! We had the cold fish platter and tuna capacious to start, followed by the octopus main and fish fillet. All the fish was fresh and perfectly cooked. The portions were substantial and the foccacia bread was a delicious addition. We would highly recommend this establishment. Krešimir is an asset as is the chef. Bravo

reviews.author: Maks Bednarz
reviews.text: What can I say, great place for an evening dinner, pleasant atmosphere, the restaurant is gently tucked away, making it seem more private. Quality food, service incredibly professional and friendly. A bit pricey but worth it.

reviews.author: Andra Schaz
reviews.text: We are so happy, we found this rather hidden restaurant by accident and were lucky to secure a reservation for a party of seven for the same evening. Our table was located on the small upstairs terrace (if I recall correctly there were merely 4 tables incl ours), from which you enjoy a nice view and benefit from a pleasant, light breeze (depending on the weather, of course). Our waiter was very friendly and attentive, gave us very good wine recommendations and on top had a nice way with the kids. During our two weeks stay in Croatia and various restaurant visits, I have to say the dining experience at this place was by far the best! The carpaccio of tuna and beef were deliciously seasoned and of superb quality. As a main course we enjoyed a grilled sea bass, which the waiter professionally filleted for us, tasty vegetables as a side dish, grilled octopus and the kids had grilled salmon with baked potatoes, which was delicious as well. The accompaying wines as recommended by the waiter were lovely as well. We had a wonderful time and would definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Damir Franusic
reviews.text: Best cheesecake and apple pie ever, excellent tuna carpaccio and mussel shells brought directly from the sea. Apart from the food, the staff was very friendly and well mannered.

reviews.author: Darya N.
reviews.text: A very stylish and great looking restaurant in Sibenik. Location is super cool: in the middle of an old city there is a small square with a huge tree and an elevated section, where all tables are. This you have nice shade in hot weather. The choice is good with fish, meat and veggie dishes. Soup as an appetizer fitted very good. As the main I chose homemade gnocchi. They were more dough than potatoes, but still very nice. Can highly recommend this place, was a great atmosphere and ambient.

reviews.author: Nikhil Roy
reviews.text: Everything about this place is amazing! This was my second time dining here—after having a fabulous meal last year, I knew I had to come back. The memory of that delicious food had been lingering in my mind ever since, and it did not disappoint the second time around. I’d highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Šibenik. The food is fantastic, the service is professional, and the whole experience is just top-notch. You definitely won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Martin Sikyta
reviews.text: Very nice food and atmposphere in the center of the city. Food was really delicious and well spiced!

reviews.author: Marko Zivaljic
reviews.text: We were two families with kids. The dalmatian Pašticada was fantastic, also the octopus salad and the fish dish was excelllent. The terrace creates a nice atmosphere with enough shadow for sun protection! Overall great lunch!

reviews.author: Alexander Rose
reviews.text: We're still sitting here as I write this. The actual place is just gorgeous, you're surrounded by old walls and trees. Service is friendly, cheerful and definitely competent. The food was ridiculously good, both meat and fish. Tinel is absolutely worth a visit.

reviews.author: P K
reviews.text: It's very good hotel.in Sisak, Croatia Centre of sisak and near in bank, garden and school near. It's looks good and service also Very good. Cleaning hygiene it's also here. Enjoy coffee with friends here.

reviews.author: Natko Duvnjak
reviews.text: Back to the 80's feeling,sink in the bathroom broken,broken electrical socket above the bed, breakfast lacks several things, no water, few fruit juices, on the other hand restaurant service personel is nice and kind, one of the recepcionists during departure rude and unpolite... states that he doesn't care if the guests forget their IDs because "it's their job to ask them back..." , but the lady from the accountancy office was unbelievable, yelling and being rude in a phone call because we didn't provide her number of the order form, no matter the service was paid in advance. Pitty it's the only hotel in Sisak...

reviews.author: Anita Krskó
reviews.text: The smoking area is at the entrance which means that you arrive in cigarette smoke and literally the whole hotel smells like you’re in an ashtray. If you aren’t a smoker it’s really disturbing. Poor cleaning, wet walls, bad smell.

reviews.author: Miroslaw Michalczyk
reviews.text: The location of the hotel is ok. They have good coffee and cakes. Breakfast the same every day. The inside looks like a communist era. There are traces of the earthquake in some rooms. Service at its best.

reviews.author: Svjetlana Miodrag
reviews.text: This is a hotel with long tradition, lately modernized. Many cultural events and celebrations of joyful life moments are being held within. Very tasty food and different kinds of cakes I would definitely recommend. If course, you can just stop by and drink your coffee in peace or use one of their rooms if you need to stay overnight. Prices are moderate, in line with quality, staff members are approachable, willing to help with information. As I said, I would recommend it 😃🌹

reviews.author: Misel Bakula
reviews.text: Excellent food, probably the best fish in the wider area. Great staff, very reasonable prices. Any recommendation.

reviews.author: Vladimir Novalić
reviews.text: Friendly staff, fast service and great food. Be sure to visit and enjoy the excellent food and pleasant atmosphere.

reviews.author: Pavla Mackic
reviews.text: The food is excellent, the fish platter for two is finger-licking good. The waiters are friendly and professional, unobtrusive. All recommendations.

reviews.author: Ivan Habeković
reviews.text: The renovation is ongoing, and you gentlemen who are responsible for this application, better go home. Again you don't post pictures and information you get for free. There are people who want work, leave it to them because you don't want to work, but you take the money 💰 in a hurry. Any further comment is redundant! 😈😬😭😈😈😈😬😈😬😭

reviews.author: Nada Conjar
reviews.text: All five for the cult restaurant in Sisak. The best ambience, the staff, the service, everything..

reviews.author: Kelly Robbins
reviews.text: We did not just have a meal here but really a full on experience. Marco, our waiter, was friendly, knowledgeable, and perfectly attentive. Each bite of food was delicious and Marco’s Croatian wine recommendation paired incredibly. The atmosphere in the small streets of Split cannot be beat. This place is a must try! We started with the burrata and then enjoyed the pasta and the lamb shank for our mains. Would recommend all three!

reviews.author: Hannah Broyer
reviews.text: My friend and I decided to treat ourselves to a nice meal, and this restaurant exceeded all of our expectations! We had the best and prompt server, Andre💗, he was knowledgeable on the menu and helped us make great food and wine choices. I highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Caleigh Haber-Takayama
reviews.text: We sat in the window and enjoyed the view / people watching while we ate some small bites. Our server was super kind, even recommended some dishes which we chose. They did not disappoint. I hope to come back some day

reviews.author: Julia Petrachkova
reviews.text: This restaurant charmed us completely! The historic setting with its gorgeous interior made dinner feel special. Food was delicious - modern takes on Dalmatian classics with perfect execution. Their wine list impressed us with excellent local options we wouldn't find elsewhere.

reviews.author: Elisa Chan
reviews.text: I asked the waiter for local dish. He recommended the black ink risotto and the flat bread with stuffing inside. It was divine! Especially to the black ink risotto. Even the pasta was equally delicious. The waiter himself was very helpful with the recommendation and great service! We paid 98 eur for our bill. Though it was a little pricey, it was worth it.

reviews.author: Светлана К
reviews.text: A magical place! Today we visited this seafood restaurant for the first time — and we were absolutely delighted. We ordered the shrimp cream soup, and it was simply incredible! The flavor was exquisite, delicate, and rich, with a perfect balance of sea aromas and spices. Every spoonful felt like a little journey to gourmet paradise. The atmosphere is truly enchanting: cozy, beautiful, and full of thoughtful details. We enjoyed it very, very much — so much that we just had to thank the staff and the chef personally. Thank you for such a wonderful culinary experience! We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Victoria So
reviews.text: Due to traffic we got to Split later than intended and were severely late for our booking, but the staff worked their magic with a table. The chef’s fish selection was a hearty plate of 4 different types of fresh fish, meant for 2 but could easily feed 3, and the wine selection paired very well with the fish we had. A very good start to our stay in the city!

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.text: One of the best restaurants we’ve been to in Split (it is Michelin guided!). The service was wonderful and everything came out quickly. Everything we ordered was very good especially the risotto and grilled flounder. The flounder was grilled to perfection and was probably one of the best grilled fish I’ve had in my life. Highly recommend eating here if you’re near Old Town Split!

reviews.author: okkaung
reviews.text: Michelin star restaurant for 2023 and 2024. The fish is cooked to perfection. The monk fish is the best I have ever eaten in my life! Talk about perfection in cooking. Just simple grill with salt and olive oil and it produces the world's freshest and softest fish! The cuttlefish black risotto is also the best I have eaten. The cuttlefish is so tender. I have never eaten such a tender cuttlefish! Price is also very reasonable and portion is huge.

reviews.author: Daria Snarskaya
reviews.text: Amazing food! Amazing service. Our family really enjoyed the early dinner there. All the food was on point and the service was excellent. If you are traveling 🧭 in Split definitely must to dine in.

reviews.author: Yousef A. Almubarak
reviews.text: Varsity of tasty pastries at very reasonable prices. The lady working here is really nice but she doesn’t speak English. The items are limited but overall good.

reviews.author: Suzanne K
reviews.text: Small bakery but big choice of bread and rolls, including loaves freshly baked to local recipes ,sweet pastries and hot slices of pizza and burek( you must try these in Croatia,-flaky, filo pastry spirals filled with either minced meat, cheese, spinach & cheese and sometimes sweet filling), hrenova ( hotdog rolls) and other baked delights. Always helpful ladies and local prices

reviews.author: Nathan Haseldine
reviews.text: They don’t accept cards :/ but everything looked good and the woman was nice

reviews.author: Ivan Jaric
reviews.text: Working time not updated. They not work sunday

reviews.author: Marton Kurucz
reviews.text: all fresh and looks good. every day of the week

name: Street Food Stall - Pazar
address: Street Food Stall - Pazar, Split, Croatia

reviews.author: Varsha Ramgopal
reviews.text: Get the fresh fruits, orange juice and local grilled meat. Also souvenirs are affordable here compared to everywhere else.

reviews.author: Nicci Haywood
reviews.text: Mixed feelings. Paid over the odds, small punnet of cherries and 1 flat peach €7, then €3.50 for 1 beef tomato and 1 small garlic - both were male sellers. The woman seemed more fair , homemade olive oil €4 and 2 peaches €1.50. The fish market was good, €12 for 1 kilo of fresh bought prawns which were insanely delicious.

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.text: Very vibrant market, lots of fresh fruit and veg with the added meat stores on the side. Everything tasted amazing!

reviews.author: Enoki N Daisy
reviews.text: Cute local market. Love coming here to see how the local lives and see all the fresh produce. They also have deli and butchers. Not selling seafood as they have a particular market in the old town selling only seafood. Highly recommended for just walking around and see what Croatian fresh market like.

reviews.author: harri frams
reviews.text: Fantastic market. Full of fresh fruit and veg. Other markets are nearby clothes and fish. Great little place, I didn't buy anything as I didn't need any fresh ingredients, but seeing fresh food in its finest bursting with colour and smells always intrigues me. Lots of locals there too buying there fruit that's always a good sign.

reviews.author: C C
reviews.text: My friend and I had a delicious dinner here. The food was so fresh, flavourful, and piping hot when it came out. Menu recommendations from the staff were perfect. Well priced food and wine. Great vibes with people singing along to the music, a cute baby getting passed around while parents ate, and the neighbour’s dog asleep on the floor. Authentic Croatian food with a completely welcoming local experience. Absolute gem and I’ll definitely go back.

reviews.author: MR APARIS
reviews.text: We sat in by the bar on stools (there is a dining room across the street). It’s off season so we were alone. Husband had shrimp and pasta. I had sardines for lunch. Both delicious. Bread fresh and hearty. Service terrific. In bar area you watch the food being cooked. Great experience.

reviews.author: Lucy Chen
reviews.text: One of the best meals of our lives! We are going back two nights in a row. We got the anchovy pasta and grilled sea bass. The grilled sea bass was one of the best fresh fish I’ve ever had. The potato and Swiss chard sides were surprisingly good. Anchovy pasta was super savory and tasty. Simple flavors but done really well.

reviews.author: Britney Wang
reviews.text: We came during peak hours and waited around 30 minutes for a table. The wait did not disappoint at all as the food was delicious. Ordered the slow cooked beef cheeks, tuna steak and veal chop. Beef cheeks were definitely the star of the show. We also got both desserts tiramisu and chocolate ganache but they weren't anything to write home to.

reviews.author: Walter Wollny
reviews.text: Talk about a treat. I would definitely come back here. Please enjoy my photos. Super great service fantastic food super reasonably priced! So my second time in two days is still just amazing!

reviews.author: C C
reviews.text: My friend and I had a delicious dinner here. The food was so fresh, flavourful, and piping hot when it came out. Menu recommendations from the staff were perfect. reviews.author: Robert Kern
reviews.text: Stellar view out over the harbour. Incredible food, we had a variety of cold appetizers that ranged from very good to absolutely outstanding, followed by a grilled John dory fish, cut and served table side. Strongly recommended.

reviews.author: Juan Uribe
reviews.text: Overall, this is a great place to have a fine dinner. The service was great. The server was very attentive and knew the menu very well, he also had great recommendations to make for our dinner. He was knowledgeable when we mentioned that there were food restrictions in our party. The food was fantastic. We had the best of the best of the Adriatic, we also had the fish soup which was delicious. It was a broth soup with a good chunk of white fish and capers. We also tried the super greens starter. It was fantastic. The place is not great for Winter dining since it is in the port and relatively separated from the heart of the city. But you could tell that during the summer months when the boating season is live the terrace is very active and the view of the port of Split is fantastic. We didn’t have dessert, but the options looked really attractive. Overall, you can tell that this place is Michelin guide restaurant and it’s well deserved.

reviews.author: Tina Curkovic
reviews.text: Everything was absolutely perfect – the food, the service, and the ambiance. Zrno Soli is without a doubt the best restaurant in the city of Split. Every dish was delicious and beautifully presented, and the staff was professional, friendly, and attentive throughout the entire evening. The atmosphere was elegant yet relaxed, making it an ideal place for a memorable dining experience. One highlight of the evening was the dessert called Honey and Milk – it was simply outstanding! A perfect ending to a perfect meal. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ithinai Yingsiri
reviews.text: Top best restaurant on all our trip for 3 weeks in Europe. Very good in sea food n cooking skill. Great seafood n fishes dishes. Sea bass in salt n risotto in crab sauces cooking w great skill. Restaurant locate in marina w great location, a bit away from city but worth the walk.

reviews.author: Boris Kremenovic
reviews.text: Awesome restaurant with a high quality service and food!

reviews.author: Lily Zhang
reviews.text: We’ve spent a week in Trogir, and we’ve been to this restaurant 4 times cuz it was THAT good amongst other restaurants in town. My friend ordered chicken Milanese 3 times!!! And our last meal was also in this restaurant. My fav part is that the waiter there actually recognise us. Shout out to Damien (I might have misspelt his name but he’s the one with the crazy moustache!).

reviews.author: Audun Adsen
reviews.text: Fish platter for two, mmm. Apple crumble and vanilla ice cream, yummy! We sat in the garden/back yard, quiet and great atmosphere. Prices not too high.

reviews.author: jm leseche
reviews.text: Well served and presented meals. Fish foods and risotto are very tasty but a little salty. Book in high season and enjoy.

reviews.author: Jeff Burton
reviews.text: Sema is the best. Great guy! The food is also wonderful. Six people and we all enjoyed everything so much.

reviews.author: Marija Glišić
reviews.text: Food was great, ordered pasta with steak, zucchini and tomato sauce. Friend eat grilled fish it was great. Service was little bit slow. But it was great experience after all.

reviews.author: Vedran Divkovć
reviews.text: In the old town center in the heart of Trogir is located this small family restaurant. They gave us a real gastronomic experience. The wine selection is more than good. The waiters are true experts and feel free to take recommendations for dishes with wine pairings. we took a couple of appetizers we couldn't decide on a favorite all the flavors were so well balanced. The main courses are just a real paradise for our palate. The risotto was cooked to perfection, the fish was very fresh the steaks melted in the mouth. what can I say but thank you and see you again.

reviews.author: Annika Hepo-oja
reviews.text: The food was really amazing. The taste and the structure, beautiful portions, everything was so well planned! We took menus, the price was 33€ and it was totally worth every cent. We shared the food to get a taste of meat and fish dishes. Dessert was surprising and do good. I totally recommend this restaurant if you visit Trogir!

reviews.author: Martina Rochová
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience at Konoba Trs. The food was absolutely delicious – full of flavor and beautifully presented. What made the visit even more special was the friendly and attentive staff. They took the time to explain all the ingredients in our dishes. If you're looking for a place with authentic atmosphere, outstanding food, Konoba Trs is a must-visit. We’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Lorena Grabovac
reviews.text: An unforgettable experience from the moment we walked into the restaurant—we immediately felt truly welcome. The food was exceptionally delicious and beautifully presented, and the entire experience was elevated by the wonderful service: professional, friendly, and always ready to offer great recommendations. I’ll definitely be back! 😊

reviews.author: Vy Nguyen
reviews.text: We had lunch at Konoba Trs in Trogir and it was such a good find. I got the set menu with cod pralines and salsa—super tasty with decent price. The risotto was okay, though the rice could’ve been more al dente. Surprisingly the steak was soft and really delicious. What stole the show was that mille-feuille-style potato—so good. Another highlight was the natural lemonade—actually freshly squeezed with zero sugar, which is rare and refreshing. The staff were really attentive and the place wasn’t busy at all during lunch. Highly recommend this spot if you’re in Trogir and want a nice meal.

reviews.author: Mei Chi Siu
reviews.text: A must try! We walked by and were attracted by the quaint, quiet, side street restaurant. We ordered a small salad, garlic bread, grilled octopus (tentacles), and grilled lamb chops. Bread was fluffy, and both entrées were fresh and juicy. The lamb chops were a tad salty but full of spices; really delicious. Server was courteous and attentive. Overall, the meal was reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Genelle Pea
reviews.text: We ordered grilled octopus & squid ink risotto. The food is good and delicious. Service is very good and highly recommended this restaurant for everyone. If you are chilli lover, don’t forget to ask for their chilli . It is a super chilli 😀

reviews.author: Dom Skeele
reviews.text: I got the beef stew with gnocchi. The meat was incredibly tough and salty. My girlfriend got the "local cheese platter", which was just 4 slices of ok cheese---not even different cheeses, just four slices of the same cheese. The food took forever to come out, and our waitress straight up upside down dumped an entire beer into a glass for me so that it was ~75% foam. Very bad experience overall, and kind of soured us on Trogir dining. The portions were also incredibly tiny, and I left hungry. I got a way better meal at a fast food place for 5€ afterwards.

reviews.author: Beverley Gomes
reviews.text: A fantastic find! What a special experience. The Lamb Peka is amazing. This is a Croatian specialty for feast days. Service was excellent and we felt very special.

reviews.author: Olga Kovalenko
reviews.text: Delicious food, good service, charming atmosphere

reviews.author: Shalki Nagpal
reviews.text: Their pistachio croissants 🥐 are accidentally vegan and delish too!! Recommend to anyone looking for vegan options in Trogir. There’s always a long queue over the weekend.

reviews.author: Nick N.
reviews.text: Five stars,the best in Trogir, the employees are very kind and friendly.

reviews.author: Irish Dawn
reviews.text: I am not satisfied with the service just now. We just bought our bread August 7, 2023 20:00 hrs, and the younger staff (lady) ,was rude and she was not happy that we have to pay separately, inspite of the paymenr in cash.. It will be the same if there 5 people going in the bakery in one time. We are tourist here, and we didn't expect to be treated this way..

reviews.author: Caz B
reviews.text: Friendly and patient staff - probably the friendliest we have experienced in a Croatian bakery on our holiday. Very nice products, big choice and moderate prices.

reviews.author: Iulia Ciocan
reviews.text: We are in 2024 and this people still wants me to pay in cash…and they don’t have an ATM! I don’t recomand,it’s not a good place if you are hungry and you don’t have cash.

reviews.author: Amalia S
reviews.text: Mixed feelings about this place. Good wine, good (but too expensive) pasta. Excellent and fresh tuna tartare. But served without toast or bread which was very disappointing (and in my opinion it should be served!). Felt like they wanted us to pay for bread additionally (tuna tartare in most places comes with toast). Oysters were not great. I had two and did not enjoy them as I usually do. Service was fine but not good enough for this type of a restaurant. Nice patio and atmosphere. Overall a fine but not great enough experience for the price.

reviews.author: Andrew Streams
reviews.text: Trogir being a tourist Mecca is loaded with restaurants of all kinds so we felt lucky to stumble on Don Dino. The service was great and the food was even better. We had a chicken dish and the steak & gnocchi - delicious! They had fans going and a water must which was appreciated as it was a warm day.

reviews.author: Alysia Hutchinson
reviews.text: We were looking for somewhere for dinner on our first night in Trogir and this was one place that our host recommended. We took advantage of the Experience Menu which was a 3 course set meal for 2 people and the food was incredible. Nikola was our server and he was so attentive, he even brought us a free aperitif after we’d finished. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a fancy atmosphere for dinner that doesn’t break the bank.

reviews.author: Ismael Romero
reviews.text: It was a really good place to have a lunch. Ivan was the waiter who served us and he was really kind and also he told us about how it is prepared the local food in the Dalmatian area. On top of that, the food was extremely good. I have more than 10 years of experience in gastronomy and is too much difficult to find an excellent price that can offer excellent food, excellent quality and excellent presentation. All of this with a combination of an excellent service is a great opportunity to enjoy the local gastronomy. I will recommend this place for my entire life.

reviews.author: Philip Beswick
reviews.text: Wonderful restaurant. Perfect spot in the centre of the old town - really beautiful. And they back it up - the service was pro and super friendly and helpful. And then the food..! The Don Dino risotto (prawn and sea urchin) was genuinely TOP notch. Couldn’t recommend more highly.

reviews.author: Aljoša Graovac
reviews.text: Great pizza and the staff. The location is easy to find and the pizza is very tasty. The prices are ok, about 10-15€ per person.

reviews.author: Uros Groselj
reviews.text: Good food, friendly staff. Recommend.

reviews.author: Nicole Spoljar
reviews.text: Beautiful outdoor seating. Food was great, we were a table of seven and and a variaty of things. Our server was great as well!

reviews.author: Michel Hamelink
reviews.text: Good pizza and beer for great prices. My waiter was really friendly and everything arrived super quick. Menu available in English.

reviews.author: Roman Sodar
reviews.text: Awesom mood, kind service and excelent pizza. Have to go back next time I am in Varaždin and try other meals.

reviews.author: Velimir Kramarić
reviews.text: Ok

reviews.author: Siniša Kaštelan
reviews.text: Super!

reviews.author: Vedran Trogrlic
reviews.text: Ok

reviews.author: Nikola Habulan
reviews.text: Super

reviews.author: Igor Rešetar
reviews.text: Ok

reviews.author: Javanti BP
reviews.text: Tasty food, proper portion sizes, nice wine list, friendly staff. Value for money excellent.

reviews.author: Kalina Mileva
reviews.text: Exceptional Culinary Experience at Bedem Restaurant, Varaždin During my visit to Varaždin, I had the pleasure of dining at Bedem Restaurant, and I can confidently say it was an unforgettable experience. Located next to the historic town walls, the restaurant offers a charming ambiance that perfectly complements its exquisite cuisine. From the moment I arrived, the service was impeccable—attentive, professional, and genuinely welcoming. The menu showcases a perfect blend of traditional Croatian flavors with modern culinary techniques, highlighting local, seasonal ingredients in every dish. Each plate was presented with artistry and attention to detail, making the dining experience both visually stunning and incredibly flavorful. One of the standout aspects of Bedem is its well-deserved Michelin recognition, which is reflected in the quality of the food and the creativity of the dishes. The chefs, Anđelko Levanić and Zlatko Novak, bring their expertise to every meal, transforming simple, locally inspired ingredients into gastronomic masterpieces. The ambiance is equally impressive—whether you choose to dine in the cozy indoor space, with its elegant decor and warm atmosphere, or on the beautiful terrace, which offers a spectacular view of the Varaždin castle. If you are looking for a top-tier fine dining experience in northern Croatia, Bedem Restaurant is an absolute must-visit. I highly recommend it to anyone who appreciates exceptional cuisine, world-class service, and a truly memorable atmosphere.

reviews.author: Annette Hollingsworth
reviews.text: Cold cheese plate was phenomenal along with the glass of wine. However Apricot Chicken with risotto was sub-par. Both were on chewy side and lackluster in taste. Sat outside on patio. Enjoyed the cooler weather and view of hillside.

reviews.author: Przemysław Adamski
reviews.text: I have been twice. Day after day. A wonderful combination of tradition and modernity. Elegant and original serving of dishes, with portion sizes and fair prices. Nice atmosphere, nicely arranged interiors. Very good price of wines, great service. Congratulations to the owners and chefs for such a unique place. Certainly, when I return to Varaždin I will visit this place again.

reviews.author: Tomislav Prizmic
reviews.text: Great food and very reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Fernando Betancourt
reviews.text: Dining at Lola Konoba was truly a highlight of our trip to Vis. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was perfect, laid-back yet elegant, with a gorgeous garden setting and a vibe that captures the magic of the island. What really made the evening unforgettable was Daniela, our incredible host. She went above and beyond, offering thoughtful recommendations for drinks and dishes that turned out to be absolute hits. Every bite was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. On top of that, Daniela shared wonderful suggestions for places to explore around the island, including beaches (Silver Beach) and wine tours, helping us make the most of our time here. The central location made it easy to stop in during a walk around town, and we’re so glad we did. If you're visiting Vis, Lola Konoba is a must. A perfect combination of great food, warm hospitality, and island charm.

reviews.author: Tsu Nami
reviews.text: This restaurant is excellent, particularly the ambience and staff. We shared a few of the starters: the cuttlefish croquettes, the gnudi with ricotta and truffle and the roast pumpkin with spicy tahini mayo. All were amazing, but the pumpkin took the cake. The spice was just perfect. For the mains, I got the beef cheek. This was really tender and overall excellent, only issue was that some of the almonds were very bitter. Finally for dessert, we tried all of them: the carob cake, deconstructed lemon tart and the chocolate truffles. I wasn’t a fan of these to be honest - not worth the price!

reviews.author: Yasmin S
reviews.text: This restaurant is so beautiful. The waitstaff were really friendly and accommodating. It’s so hard to find vegan food in Croatia so I was grateful they had options for me that were also delicious.

reviews.author: Paul Ts
reviews.text: Very cool and beautiful place. Picturesque court, pleasant music, great service. We had there a couple of glasses of wine. And the chef cooked especially for us shrimps carpaccio- that was really tasty.

reviews.author: Arne Dalos
reviews.text: Wow! Amazing place and outstanding staff in every way made our evening excellent. You just have to visit this place. Food was so tasty. I gave our waiter (Spanish guy) the possibility to create my menu and I don’t regret a bit. He knew what he was talking about. Whatever he would choose I reckon all would be fantastic. It feels you sitting in someones beautiful garden. So cosy!

reviews.author: Peter Vukovics
reviews.text: They just opened today and most probably I was the very first customer. Credit card is accepted! Very friendly staff, as one would expect from a traditional family run business. I loved the burek - same taste as it used to be in 2021 when I visited first Kut-Vis.

reviews.author: Giorgio Mattucci
reviews.text: The evaluation is the average between the quality of the products and the cleaning, that are good, and the attitude of the staff/behavior towards the customer that is poor. For a krapfen and a pan brioche i paid almost 8€. All the bakery of the island offer almost the same products at the same prices. In other places these were sold at 2/3€. Obviously no receipt.

reviews.author: Aiste Meidute
reviews.text: Do not go here! Rude cashier, no prices listed (probably to trick travelers into paying more), no cards accepted, we weren't given a check after so definitely not a transparent bussiness. Everything costs minimum 2 EUR, so don't know if the prices are high or not in comparison to other bakeries.

reviews.author: Andrea Miskovic
reviews.text: Nice bakery, friendly staff also speaking English. We tried bread which was a good quality and stayed fresh for multiple days. Also sweet pies were very good. A bit more expensive but you receive a good quality. Only possible to pay in cash.

reviews.author: TFO TFO
reviews.text: The cinnamon rolls were just amazing! The bread is also some of the better bread that we have had in the last 2 weeks.

reviews.author: Sebastian de Angelis
reviews.text: What a fantastic restaurant. There were seven of us and we let the waiter just feed us. We had a grilled scorpion fish for the main and it was hands down the best fish we had. That day not only did we have lunch there but we came back for dinner and had the same meal again!

reviews.author: Buyisiwe Shongwe - Varenzakis
reviews.text: Traditional Croatian cuisine which gave us a real sense of the taste palette here. We initially had a very rude reception by one of the waiters who shooed us away from the waiting area… but it improved as the night progressed.

reviews.author: Miro Mayer
reviews.text: One of the best local restaurants on Vis. Interesting food combinations based on traditional cousine. Good selection of local wine. Long enough wine list for the type of the restaurant. Excellent service.

reviews.author: Brittany Fisher
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful restaurant. Best Tuna Tartare I have ever had… and I eat this a lot! Excellent service, excellent everything! Recommend getting a bottle of local wine, it pairs perfectly with the seafood.

reviews.author: Bozo Pavicin
reviews.text: excellent fish restaurant. the employees are all locals so you have the charm and real atmosphere of a local restaurant but with top quality food. it is always busy so you have to book a table. large selection of fish and lobster. good selection of wine. Ee aet “skarpina” fish.

reviews.author: Mark Perry
reviews.text: We arrived very early evening and got seated right next to the water. We had a very friendly waitress who made sure we had everything we needed. My wife had scampi buzara and I had black cuttlefish risotto. We both really enjoyed our food. After our meal we were shown around inside the restaurant which looked very cosy and interesting. We really enjoyed our evening in this restaurant.

reviews.author: Sven Vojnović
reviews.text: We’ve been visiting Vis for almost 10 years now and having dinner at Konoba BAKO atleast 2 times during our stay has become a tradition. The staff is lovely, location is wonderful and food is expertly prepared while keeping it simple because the fresh ingredients speak for themselves. If you’re not in the mood for seafood, I highly recommend ordering a steak. 10/10 overall!

reviews.author: Lovro Vojnović
reviews.text: Highly recommended if you’re looking for a high-quality and delicious meal. The ingredients are fresh, and the dishes are fantastic and authentic, accompanied by phenomenal service that consistently maintains a high standard. The location is right by the sea, making the whole experience even more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Noah Lindberg
reviews.text: A lovely seaside dinner – we sat outside, just steps from the waves. The octopus in wine was excellent, and the waitress was very cheerful and attentive, which made the experience even better. The interior is impressive, with amphorae and a lobster pool. One of the best spots in Komiža. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Y G
reviews.text: Food was mediocre at best, which was really disappointing. Not much taste to any of it - fish, risotto, pasta. We were a group of 8 and no one really enjoyed their food. The location was nice and the service was good but I wouldn’t recommend this place.

reviews.author: Jiaqi Z.
reviews.text: We really wanted to love the food, as the garden seating is so beautiful. Our calimari was big and impressive looking but extremely rubbery. Our lamb was well seasoned but thin and a bit dry. Our bread basket was just toast slices, and ants got into the basket. The only saving grace was the squid ink risotto, which was delicious with a side of roasted vegetables. We unfortunately liked the food the least out of the places we tried so far in Zagreb, Split, and Vis, although we do try to avoid touristy places and have generally been quite successful 🌝

reviews.author: Roland Hillion
reviews.text: Great restaurant. Family-owned and -managed with a traditional approach to cooking. 100% recommended if you wanna try out some traditional Croatian recipes. We had the stuffed peppers, the octopus salad and marinated sardines - everything was fresh and tasty. The location is equally pleasing, the garden is very peaceful and the tables are quite apart from one another.

reviews.author: Hye Kim
reviews.text: Gorgeous lunch with gentle and nice owners. Octopus salad is stunning. Chef gave us a fresh lemon which is proper to make a cup of tea.

reviews.author: Jakub Nosowski
reviews.text: Had an amazing time and feest in Villa Rustica! Delicious food and kind waiter with helping attitude made our evening. Yes, there are few ants on trees, but hey, aren’t we guests in their world;)

reviews.author: bostjan bajc
reviews.text: It was a fair dinner. Lamb on grill was unfortunately not evenly grilled, two pieces were very good but other two overgrilled and totaly dry. Black risotto was OK, rice maybe a bit overcooked. A little more attention to details and would be really good. Open Vugava vine was light and tasty.

reviews.author: Dragana Ruzic
reviews.text: Great food and views. Loads of space in the restaurant and outside. Usually busy though all the time. Only downside is it took about 40 minutes for us to get our food. The wedges were a bit dry and they didn’t give you any condiments on the table like ketchup. A bit pricey, but other than that, it is worth it for the views.

reviews.author: Rajko Keravica
reviews.text: Super spot! Good food good views good service. Nothing else to ask for. You will not be disappointed that is for sure. And its just 2 minutes walk from the center, and has a parking area. Simply put, if you want to give yourself a feel that you are secluded and still be literally in the center of Vukovar, this is a place to be!

reviews.author: Nenad Turicanin
reviews.text: I came here after two years, first time round was very nice and pleasant, very affordable, great food. Today, I have no words to describe, starting from service that was appalling, very unpleasant to meal prices and size of portions. They now charge separate for main dish’s and sides, so for ćevapi and chips you end up paying €12 while other dishes are ~€16 - €20 comparing to similar places this is -40-50% more. Size of portions is very disappointing, we ordered a fish soup for two, size had barely enough for one, I recently been in Citadela in Baranja, size for two is equal to size for 4. Miješano meso is for a laugh, I mean some dry pork loin, small bacon, tiny sausage and 5 small ćevapi and tiny burger. Very disappointing and food is not worth the money!!!

reviews.author: AL 222
reviews.text: We were there on a stop with our river cruise. I researched beforehand on Google where to have a bite to eat and decided to go with Vreske. Some of the reviews were really bad but my gut instinct told me that some of the reviews might be written by not so genuine people. We were greeted with a big welcome and shown to our table. The setting is lovely with views over the Danube. The gentleman who saw to us was very attentive and he recommended the catfish soup. He said immediately that it would take about 40 minutes to prepare which is gold to my ears as I know then it is prepared fresh. We enjoyed the wine (very good!) and had a lovely and relaxed time until the soup came. The soup is served with pasta and it was just simply delicious. We can only recommend this restaurant and please don't listen to these bad reviews. As with all restaurants, if it is busy it will always take longer, but the hospitality and friendliness of the people is wonderful. Many thanks for having us.

reviews.author: Nataša Vuković Mikinac
reviews.text: Nice restaurant with domestic meni, located nearby river Dunav.

reviews.author: IAM*DAM
reviews.text: So good bakery with nice and kind personal.

reviews.author: Teardrop Raindrop
reviews.text: gr8

reviews.author: Oliver14
reviews.text: Super

reviews.author: Miro Lovric
reviews.text: One of the worse bakeries I've been to. As if she was behind from 30 years ago. Everything needs to be changed. And in the display case, pastries and other products are disorderly arranged

reviews.author: Željko Filipović
reviews.text: One of the best and my favorite bakery in Vukovar and the wider area with a very large selection of various pastries, breads, pizza, burec and much more at reasonable prices. The staff is extremely friendly and quick to serve.

reviews.author: Dean Willaredt
reviews.text: Food was ok, nothing special, very average. Service was a bit slow. The first lady we talked to was not friendly or helpful but our waiter was fine. Pizza was good but we’ve had better many other places. Caprese Salad was disappointing. Prices were fine. Not sure why this has 4.6 stars but it should not. 4-stars at most.

reviews.author: Maya Turner
reviews.text: I got the hamburger and it tasted like soy meat or something that had filers- I am American so perhaps that is the way beef texture is in Croatia …. My husband had seafood spaghetti and it too was not very good- little flavor- the restaurant is on the walkway by the water and the sunset was beautiful and the servers were nice - food is not the best

reviews.author: Lolita Tsyttser
reviews.text: It was one of the worst lunch we ever had. Food was absolutely tasteless, pleskovica is very basic. Restaurant is full of flies, which were always staying or on our food or drinks. Waitress Sandra with a red hair very unfriendly, we asked her if there is any place outside to stay? She said “You don’t see, that there are no tables available?”, then we asked her to bring “extra tomatoes”, she said “this is not fast food”. We ordered Pleskavica, she forgot to bring Ajvar which was on the menu together with a meal. After we reminded her, she finally brought that. In general, recommended to avoid this place.

reviews.author: Evelyn Rivera
reviews.text: Great place for small town, many options in the menu! I had the pizza cuatro fromagio and was delicious also we order some bread with cheese, omg was so good. And nice light local beer.

reviews.author: Lawrence
reviews.text: Best restaurant in Vukovar! I don't know what to say about this place... the service was great and the food was outstanding. You need to try the mixed meat as it was the best I've had. We got the big meat platter which was good for 5 (it says 5 but 7 can eat it) some salads, a pasta, grilled vegetables, risotto, and calamari. Everything was excellent. The value for money was outstanding and unfortunately we couldn't finish all the food since the portions were large. All in all we spent less money here with alcohol for 6 people than we did in Zadar for 4 people with coffee and the food here was 100000X better. Total bill with many beers was 116 Euro 😍. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone. The grilled meat was superb!

reviews.author: D J
reviews.text: Amazing stay will return definitely this was last minute arrangements. Protip give them a straight call and see what can be done. The main thing why everyone should stay here is that the breakfast section has a unique rakija section with many different ones to choose from.

reviews.author: Jagoda Basic
reviews.text: Absolutely fabulous stay at Villa Martini. Spacious clean room with excellent air conditioning and super wifi. Spacious clean bathroom and generally very clean place all around. Now breakfast😀Vesna the owner treats you like a family and makes eggs as you like. On offer is continental or cereal breakfast and included is a French toast. Not to mention that you are in the CBD and close to everywhere. Definitely a place to stay when you come to this City of Heroes 😊❤️

reviews.author: mary kljajic
reviews.text: We spent one night at Villa Martini we were pleasntly suprised, wish were able to spend more time. The owner was extremely pleasant. Highly recommended. Will be returning👍👍

reviews.author: radu tudor orzata
reviews.text: One of the best villa with a very nice and kind staff (owner with his wife)!!!

reviews.author: grgazg1
reviews.text: Great hospitality and clean rooms and excellent breakfast.

reviews.author: Claus Holm
reviews.text: A magnificent location with a stunning view to the ocean is the absolute recent to visit this restaurant. We both had the tasting menu, which was good (not outstanding) and they were out of oyster with some excuse that it was Sunday (then tell us upfront or take it off the menu. The with pairing was very interesting and good with Croatian wine. However on the chilling evening, you would expect blankets or some level of heating and the service was more directed to tables ordering a la carte serving and getting the waiters attention was almost impossible.

reviews.author: Anna Kaletkina
reviews.text: 10/10!! Last time I came to Foša it was back in 2019 and I remember the absolutely stunning view and amazing food. Came back 4 years later and tried the tasting menu (5 courses) which they didn’t have back then. Absolutely outstanding! Can’t imagine fish being prepared better! The atmosphere is so romantic and calm, restaurant is open very late which is great for summer heat. Only the last course (panna cotta) wasn’t up to my liking as I like it more liquid, however my partner enjoyed it a lot. If in Zadar- must visit!

reviews.author: Kemal S
reviews.text: İ dont know why this amazing restaurant had only 4,2 points. This was one of the best lunches i ever had in my life. İ am from Mediterranean and this food is 100% genuine. Chef must be given full credit for cooking everything just perfect. Rare cooked and delicious. Cant tell enough !!

reviews.author: Kelly Adanir
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience at Fosa considering the hype and great reviews. We made a reservation via the website a month before our visit and it was confirmed with Martina Furcic but the reservation was not registered. There was no apology for their mistake but they reluctantly found us a table. We had to ask for menus. We had to wait for long periods of time before being asked if we’d like a drink and to order food. It felt like we were an inconvenience. The food was good but nothing exceptional.

reviews.author: Laurel Ellis
reviews.text: It’s Michelin star for a reason. Every dish was wonderful, the staff were excellent. Fabulous views of the sea. I would recommend the fish soup, the best I have had in Croatia. As my partner said ‘the whole shibang was fantastic.’

The with pairing was very interesting and good with Croatian wine. However on the chilling evening, you would expect blankets or some level of heating and the service was more directed to tables ordering a la carte serving and getting the waiters attention was almost impossible.

Came back 4 years later and tried the tasting menu (5 courses) which they didn’t have back then. Absolutely outstanding! Can’t imagine fish being prepared better! The atmosphere is so romantic and calm, restaurant is open very late which is great for summer heat. Only the last course (panna cotta) wasn’t up to my liking as I like it more liquid, however my partner enjoyed it a lot. If in Zadar- must visit!

reviews.author: Kemal S
reviews.text: İ dont know why this amazing restaurant had only 4,2 points. This was one of the best lunches i ever had in my life. İ am from Mediterranean and this food is 100% genuine. Chef must be given full credit for cooking everything just perfect. Rare cooked and delicious. Cant tell enough !!

reviews.author: Kelly Adanir
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience at Fosa considering the hype and great reviews. We made a reservation via the website a month before our visit and it was confirmed with Martina Furcic but the reservation was not registered. There was no apology for their mistake but they reluctantly found us a table. We had to ask for menus. We had to wait for long periods of time before being asked if we’d like a drink and to order food. It felt like we were an inconvenience. The food was good but nothing exceptional.

reviews.author: Laurel Ellis
reviews.text: It’s Michelin star for a reason. Every dish was wonderful, the staff were excellent. Fabulous views of the sea. I would recommend the fish soup, the best I have had in Croatia. As my partner said ‘the whole shibang was fantastic.’

reviews.author: Marga Paramita
reviews.text: It was raining heavily when we reached Zadar that we took shelter from the rain and ate lunch in the restaurant. Thought it would be expensive and touristy but the food was alright. The fish was fresh and the steak was done well. The service was great and friendly. Saw some neighborhood people having lovely chats while drinking at the restaurant. The cozy ambiance and such a laid back place make people feel welcomed.

reviews.author: Jolynn Toh
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing. We wiped everything clean from the plates - the fish soup was rich and the fish cooked to the right texture, the sauce from scampi was well balanced and we had perfectly grilled sea bream. We would return here for sure, for our best seafood meal in Croatia.

reviews.author: Rosa Gutierrez
reviews.text: Nice spot for authentic Dalmatian dishes. Beautiful location, good quality of food, friendly servers. Sometimes service can be a little slow specially when they are busy so be patient. I recommend Konoba Skoblar.

reviews.author: Rebecca Rovai
reviews.text: Authentic Dalmatian food. The fish dishes were delicious, specially the risotto al nero di seppia (very traditional of this area). We ordered raw tuna and langoustine and they literally melted in the mouth. Service was excellent, as well as the quiet location. Definitely we will go back again!

reviews.author: Lika SONE
reviews.text: We had our last dinner in Zadar here on our vacation and it was quite good. The atmosphere was nice and the food as well. Just wished the shrimps had smth on the side and maybe the side dishes of a chicken would be more. But overall it was great! 👍🏽

reviews.author: Hermosa Moda
reviews.text: Best burek with cheese!

reviews.author: Miss K
reviews.text: Fresh tasty pastries. Great burek!

reviews.author: Naklockowani
reviews.text: Very tasty burek, but payment only in cash

reviews.author: Roko
reviews.text: There is no better burek.

reviews.author: NenoN
reviews.text: The bakery has changed hands. The best burek without cheese in town 😂🤣

reviews.author: Michael Kao
reviews.text: Vegan is good.

reviews.author: Andro Lončar
reviews.text: A complete disaster of a dinner. Extremely bad food in every way. Too expensive!!!!

reviews.author: Bobo
reviews.text: Everything great!

reviews.author: Maria Jurić
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Naeun Kim
reviews.text: Where to begin… food was divine, fried doughnut balls are a must and our grandma’s and grandpa’s pans were so hearty and fresh. The konoba is tucked away in a quiet street near some attractions but away from the riff raff. But service was most memorable, Rok was super and truly made us feel at home! He is a legend and took great care of us. Six stars if I could 👌

reviews.author: Benjamin Watson
reviews.text: Good classic and traditional Croatian food in a very “grandma’s kitchen” (in a good way) feeling setting. Good variety and options. Service was attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: Nada Boto
reviews.text: Nice restaurant. The location is quite peaceful since it is not situated in the bustling streets, or surrounded by many other establishments like other restaurants in Zagreb are. Unfortunately I must say that despite the waiter being friendly and kind, this place is very clearly understaffed. My kind recommendation to whoever is running the spot, is have at least two waiters, and try to get the food out quicker. We waited over an hour to eat (and we had a reservation....) Very few people will return to a restaurant after experiencing such wait times, regardless of the food. It is a lot of time to waste for someone who is visiting Zagreb and would like to just stop and have lunch. The place has a bit of an old, Croatian rustic style- it is quite cute. The dishes are even served on old-fashioned pots and pans and cutting boards. The food is great. It tastes like your Croatian grandparents' cooking- hence the name "Grandpa's dream" 😄. It is simple, and the portion sizes are on the larger size. The food is of high quality however, it is clear they are not using low grade oils or meats. For dessert there are great options like Imotski- style cake, crêpes, and ice cream.

reviews.author: Tricia Dime
reviews.text: The food was generally good — the punjene vješalice stood out as really well done. The black risotto, though, was a bit bland. Service was fine; the staff did the job with a touch of friendliness.

reviews.author: Литературен гид
reviews.text: Great place! Strongly recommend! Hobotuce pod Peka ( Octopus in traditional Croatian style) is absolutely perfect! You must try!

reviews.author: Алиса Дубровская
reviews.text: I love this place! One of my favorites in Zagreb! If I'm in town, I'll definitely stop by and order my favorite truffle struk. It's also delicious with spicy paprika! The pros are that they have a terrace. Great service and atmosphere! I recommend this place in the center of Zagreb! I'll definitely come back again.

reviews.author: Shaf
reviews.text: This dishes was unbelievable. I tried it for the first time and I loved it right away. It has a little bit similar texture with Lasagna, but smoother. I ordered the original one (salted cheese). This restaurant is the famous strukla place in Zagreb, hence in some cases it has long queue. So you better have a reservation before coming. My friends and I were lucky because we came early before everyone having dinner, so we got our place on the spot. I really recommend this place if you want to try the typical food of Zagreb.

reviews.author: Jon Jags Nee
reviews.text: TL;DR: Tried La Štruk in Zagreb and had the roasted pepper štrukli. Super creamy, kind of like a lasagna without the meat—glad I tried it, but probably wouldn’t order it again. I think the sweet versions would hit harder, especially in winter. Amazing service and cozy garden vibe though—worth a visit for the experience. More below. So, I usually eat a very Asian-style diet—lots of ginger, garlic, soy sauce—so I rarely go for anything heavy in dairy. It’s not that I don’t like dairy, I’ve just never really explored dishes centered around it. So trying štrukli at La Štruk was definitely stepping outside my comfort zone. I ordered the roasted pepper štrukli, and I’ll be honest—it was really good. The flavor reminded me a bit of lasagna, but it leaned more cream-forward rather than meat- or filling-forward. It was soft, rich, and definitely filling. But here’s the edit, just to be completely honest: As someone who cooks and enjoys layers of flavor and texture, I don’t think I’d order this again. I found myself wishing for more contrast—some crunch, acidity, or spice. The texture was very soft throughout, and while the roasted pepper helped add a bit more dimension, the overall experience was still very one-note and dairy-heavy for my personal taste. That said, I’m really glad I tried it. It’s clearly a local staple and a great example of traditional Croatian comfort food. If you’re in Zagreb and want something authentic and cozy, this is a solid option to experience what locals love. Honestly, I bet the sweet versions would shine more here—I can totally imagine this being an amazing winter dessert, hot and creamy in the cold weather. Now for the vibe—10/10. All the servers spoke English, which made it easy for me as a solo tourist to feel welcome. The restaurant is tucked away in an alley, and they offered me a seat in the garden out back—which was peaceful, charming, and full of birdsong. Super relaxing. Overall: • Food: 6.5/10 (great to try once, but not my usual jam) • Service: 10/10 • Ambience: 10/10 Give it a shot if you’re curious—especially if you love creamy, comforting dishes or are visiting in colder months.

reviews.author: Kilian
reviews.text: The restaurant was recommended to me by a local of the city. The staff was super friendly and even allowed to enter with a dog and provided it with snacks. The restaurants atmosphere is very comfortable and warm. The menu is almost exclusively štrukli, which is a sign of quality and you noticed that they simply mastered their specialty. Overall, la Štruk didn't just warm you with the Štrukli but also the warm atmosphere and service.

reviews.author: Andreja
reviews.text: Tasty strukli, but disappointing service La Štruk is a super touristy spot if you want to try the famous traditional štrukli — and it’s the only dish they serve here. Our first encounter was disappointing — a waitress rudely turned us away, saying there were no available tables, even though we clearly saw empty ones. We came back 10 minutes later, and a different, much nicer waitress seated us. The garden is lovely, with lots of trees and a cozy vibe. I tried the truffle štrukli — tasty, rich, and very filling. My friend had the original cheese štrukli, which was also good. The food is nice and worth trying if you’re curious about štrukli, but the staff could definitely work on their kindness and hospitality.

reviews.author: Алиса Дубровская
reviews.text: I love this place! One of my favorites in Zagreb! If I'm in town, I'll definitely stop by and order my favorite truffle struk. It's also delicious with spicy paprika! The pros are that they have a terrace. Great service and atmosphere! I recommend this place in the center of Zagreb! I'll definitely come back again.
