reviews.author: Rusdi Budiman
reviews.text: A beautifully curated tasting menu and a truly memorable way to end my time in Croatia. Noel offers an experience that stays with you. From the complimentary kombucha to the thoughtfully printed menu and gift at the end — both marked with the date of my visit on 19/6/25— every detail showed care and generosity. The quiet dining room, complemented by soft, calming music, created a zen-like atmosphere that made the evening feel intimate and special. Service was warm, professional, and never overbearing — a hospitality style that lets the food speak for itself. A refined and heartfelt final meal in Croatia — one I’ll remember for a long time.

reviews.author: Y Liu
reviews.text: We made a reservation at Noel to celebrate one of our friends’ birthday during our visit in Zagreb. We were all looking forward to the experience since it is the first restaurant received the Michelin Star in Zagreb. However, we were utterly disappointed and unimpressed. We had their spring tasting menu and added on one of their classic dishes, the trouts for our dinner. Most of the dishes were uninspired, and the taste was either overall sour or salty. I couldn’t even finish one of the dishes since it was extremely salty. I told the host in person and over the phone when I made the reservation that we were here for a birthday celebration and would like to have surprise for our birthday girl during dessert time. They ended up just putting a candle on the chocolate, which left us speechless. On top of it, one of our friends tripped on the step while on the way to the restroom and literally fell on his knees in front of everyone in the restaurant. The host and the restaurant staffs didn’t really show any care after it happened and only gave us a bag of ice after we asked for it. As a Michelin star rated restaurant, you would think that both food and services would be apart from others, but somehow Noel failed to deliver it. We have had great meals during our short stay in Zagreb and was hoping that Noel would top it; However, sometimes things don’t turn out the same as you wished for and that’s the case for Noel.

reviews.author: Karlo Tadić
reviews.text: From the lovely staff to the wonderful food, it's hard to highlight what we loved the most. We took the cocktail pairings and they were really great. In hindsight, we enjoyed the rooster and the amuse bouches the most.

reviews.author: Antonia Jagodić
reviews.text: Unreal gastronomic experience. Dinner in 6 fantastic courses. The interior is simple, the staff is very friendly and accommodating. They deservedly have a Michelin star. Prices are justified considering the status of this restaurant. I recommend it to everyone who wants a real gastronomic journey and pleasure.

reviews.author: Miriam Oehme
reviews.text: We recently dined at Restaurant Noel in Zagreb and had a very enjoyable experience. The restaurant’s Michelin star is really well deserved! l The setting is modern yet comfortable, with wooden tables, comfortable chairs, and an open kitchen pass that adds a touch of interaction to the atmosphere. The decor features works by local artists, which gives the space a distinct character. We started with cocktails at the bar, which were well-crafted and a nice introduction to the evening. The set menu consisted of around 10 courses, and instead of opting for wine pairing, we tried the tea pairing. Each course was matched with a cold-brew tea, an interesting and innovative choice that complemented the dishes very well. The food focused on local and seasonal ingredients, including truffles, seafood, mushrooms, and pumpkin. The dishes were packed with bold flavors and ,a well-balanced interplay of sweetness, acidity, and savory notes. Service was attentive and friendly, making us feel comfortable throughout the evening. The overall atmosphere was casual but polished. Restaurant Noel offers a thoughtful and well-executed fine dining experience with a focus on Croatian ingredients. It’s a good choice for those looking for a refined meal in Zagreb.

reviews.author: Jonathan Mui
reviews.text: Tried the apple strudel pastry and cherry pastry and it was really good. The flavour of the fruits really shines through and the filling isn’t that sweet. We struggled to figure out what each pastry was at the beginning and the staff were also trying their best to explain them to us but we can also kinda tell their patience is wearing thin so we just picked the easiest 2 pastries to identify and they tasted good

reviews.author: Travis Larrat
reviews.text: Mini triangle Pizza 2.50€?! It's not worth nearly that much. I waited about 2 minutes inside while the employee talked to her friend, only when I answered did she speak to me, I don't recommend it.

reviews.author: Cyclops Grey
reviews.text: The Best Croissant I've ever have before. So delicious and rich with taste. Try their Choco Croissant, awesome taste.

reviews.author: Infernus 25
reviews.text: Idk what's with all the negative comments about the customer service cause everyone in there was very friendly and welcoming

reviews.author: Natali Krpan
reviews.text: There are so many bakeries in Zagreb but this one is really wonderful. The choice is incredible and it is all delicious. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Henry Yam
reviews.text: A group of us went yesterday on a Sunday. Made reservation and would suggest this as I can see this restaurant being busy during regular week. Ordered the baked sea cream fish and tried the lamb too. Both were made. Fish as suspected was very fresh. The server was very friendly as we requested separate bills with no issues. Would recommend and the ambience was very nice.

reviews.author: Yu Chen Lin
reviews.text: I’d recommend making a reservation in advance—the indoor seating area is much nicer in terms of decor. The downside of sitting outside is the strong smell of smoke (which I personally don’t like 🤣). Even though there’s a glass door that seems to block it, the smoke still drifts in anyway. A big thank you to the staff for patiently introducing and recommending dishes to my family and me. I didn’t catch your name, but your service was truly excellent and attentive. This was our first meal in Croatia, and we were eager to try traditional local dishes. This place turned out to be a wonderful choice! 😋

reviews.author: Lukas Felipe Furlan Trentin
reviews.text: The restaurant has an amazing atmosphere, is very elegant, and offers exceptional service. The food is absolutely delicious. I have never had such good slow-cooked boar gnocchi. It has so much flavour that I'm unable to describe how good it was. 10 out of 10!

reviews.author: Nancy S
reviews.text: I had a wonderful visit to Vinodol in Zagreb. The food was absolutely delicious, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. The ambiance added a touch of elegance to the experience. I started with a small appetizer—bread with spinach and cheese—which was delightful. For the main courses, I chose seabeam fish and Zagreb cutlet (veal), both prepared to perfection. To complement the meal, I enjoyed a glass of local red wine. Overall, the ambiance and culinary offerings made for a truly memorable experience.

reviews.author: Alie Jones
reviews.text: Great atmosphere and food, but our server was not available and he was impolite all throughout, even asking me if I hated my food when I asked for a to-go box (!). He also kept mentioning a tip when we received our bill. We I had the beef soup with homemade semolina dumplings, veal roast with with krumpirusa potato pie and traditional Balkan vegetable stew duvec, Traditional Dalmatian soparnik chard pie house-special, and Warm molten chocolate cake with homemade bourbon vanilla ice cream

reviews.author: Grazyna K
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience at this restaurant, which truly celebrates traditional Cypriot cuisine. The fish mezze was one of the best we’ve ever had – fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The shrimp in white sauce were especially delicious and cooked to perfection. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the service stood out – our waiter was incredibly friendly and made us feel right at home. Our kids were thrilled to be treated to ice creams, while we enjoyed traditional Cypriot sweets for dessert, a perfect way to end the meal. It’s absolutely worth the 15-minute walk from the port. A great spot for anyone wanting to taste authentic Cypriot flavors. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sebastian B (Seby Basti)
reviews.text: As we arrived early than our booking time slot, we received a table in a few minutes! The restaurant looks so amazing, authentic and traditional outside and inside! There’s plenty of dishes to choose from, but I suggest to ask the stuff for recommendations! They are so helpful and attentive! The food was delicious, compliments to the chef! Overall was the best food experience that we had in Ayia Napa! Totally recommend it!

reviews.author: Carbkilla
reviews.text: We had the fish mezze, the hummus and the other starters were a bit off so not such a great start but eventually the other dishes got better and we enjoyed our meal. The service was fast, a little too fast, we felt rushed. We recommend this restaurant but we had better fish mezze at other places.

reviews.author: Wakizashi Yoshikawa
reviews.text: We had beef stifado and it was delicious. The meat was was tender and juicy and the sauce was great. The portions are large enough and sits just as it should. Atmosphere was nice and the staff was helpful and polite. There was no long waiting for the food to arrive either. Great place overall

reviews.author: Luca Negrini
reviews.text: If you stay in Aya Napa, I would recommend this place to have a nice dinner. We ate fish meze and were very excited. The food is amazing and typical cipriota! I suggest to booking because in the night there was line of people to eat in.

name: Isaac’s Fish Tavern
address: Isaac’s Fish Tavern, Ayia Napa, Cyprus

reviews.author: Anna Shvetsova
reviews.text: It was amazing! We ordered a platter for two — two adults and our four-year-old — and had a delicious lunch. The food was absolutely tasty. We also tried the signature Cypriot beer and enjoyed our time chatting and relaxing. The service was excellent, the staff was friendly, and the atmosphere was very comfortable. We were so happy with our experience that we’ll definitely come back and recommend this place to our friends!

reviews.author: A L
reviews.text: Firstly, as someone who grew up in SA, I feel a sense of stakeholder ownership over Ocean Basket and I did wonder if this one in Cyprus would stand up to the high standards and great value of SA. I was not disappointed. What a lovely team of people, fantastic food and good wine at amazing value. This is the place for amazing seafood. Even the pudding was a massive win. As my children said when we left: why did we eat anywhere else this holiday? I cannot recommend this restaurant and this chain enough.

reviews.author: Nino Akhalbedashvili
reviews.text: Love to visit Ocean Basket every time when i’m in Ayia napa. Menu is diverse, service is fast, staff is friendly and always ready to help with the choice. What to say about food? It’s just perfect. This year they had a sushi menu as well, tasted it and was delicious. Also wand to mention Zohaib, who was very helpful and served us really well.

reviews.author: Anda Rotariu
reviews.text: Super good experience. We ate Fish&Chips and Cod&Calamari (both with half fries and half rice - which we considered a great option to have both). You can choose how you want the seafood prepared (grilled/fried). Big portions. For dessert we had portokalopita which was amazing! The serving was also great.

reviews.author: Anastasiia Kotiuzhynska
reviews.text: The best restaurant in Ayia Napa! It looks simple but the food and service are impeccable. Fish plate is big and tasty, sea bream was fresh and mouthwatering. We didn’t have space for desserts. And there are always queues to eat there so it speaks for itself. Definitely recommended.

reviews.author: Anna Shvetsova
reviews.text: It was amazing! We ordered a platter for two — two adults and our four-year-old — and had a delicious lunch. The food was absolutely tasty. We also tried the signature Cypriot beer and enjoyed our time chatting and relaxing. The service was excellent, the staff was friendly, and the atmosphere was very comfortable. We were so happy with our experience that we’ll definitely come back and recommend this place to our friends!

name: Street Gyro Stand
address: Street Gyro Stand, Ayia Napa, Cyprus

name: Street Stall - Harbor
address: Street Stall - Harbor, Ayia Napa, Cyprus

reviews.author: George Marius
reviews.text: Ayia Napa Harbour is a beautiful and peaceful place that’s perfect for a relaxing walk or enjoying a meal by the sea. The harbor is well-kept, with colorful fishing boats, crystal-clear water, and a lovely promenade lined with restaurants and cafes. It’s especially charming in the evening when the lights reflect on the water and the atmosphere becomes calm and romantic. You can take a boat trip from here, which is a great way to explore the coastline and see the sea caves or even go snorkeling. It’s a nice contrast to the party vibe of Ayia Napa — here you get to slow down, enjoy the sea breeze, and take in the scenery. Highly recommend stopping by, whether for a seafood lunch, a sunset stroll, or just to sit and relax by the water.

reviews.author: Haroulla Johnston
reviews.text: Fantastic, beautiful, Amazing holiday so much to do and the food is fresh and absolutely delicious. Loads of boat trips a great shopping area. Clubs bars and restaurants fantastic beaches and the sun never stops shining .

reviews.author: Kyriacos Kythreotis
reviews.text: Great spot for a walk or holiday pics. Look out for the Turtle Cruise on the ScubaCat boat for a great day out and BBQ lunch that departs most days and afternoons from the harbour.

reviews.author: Harry R.
reviews.text: Aya Napa is a good organized touristic place. You find a lot of shops, taverns, bars and a long nice beach-walk. The sea is clear and the rent for sunbed and umbrella very cheap. Be aware it's overcrowded and not very special compared to the golden beaches in Greece. Aya is much better than Larnaka. So take your sunscreen and enjoy your stay!

reviews.author: Alex Walker
reviews.text: Lovely little spot Ayia Napa Harbour has a great atmosphere with plenty of places to eat, drink, and take in the view. It’s a shame I didn’t get to spend more time there, but it’s definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area.

reviews.author: Lily Khachatryan
reviews.text: Loved this place from my first visit and have already returned five times. The food is perfect — I’ve tried many dishes from the seafood menu, and everything was excellent. A big advantage is that the staff allow you to change the side dishes that come with the fish if you prefer something else. The Greek salad is truly perfect. The atmosphere is very inviting, the staff are extremely friendly, and there’s lovely Greek music playing in the background. I’ll definitely be coming back again.

reviews.author: ROMAN OCTAVIAN
reviews.text: In 10 days staying in Ayia Napa we choose to eat 3 times durring dinner at Taverna Napa est.1976. From the first evening i had the feeling that i am more than just a simple client. Mario the owner is going above and beyond with the service and all the employees are very professional. Talking about food , taste , quality i have only goood words. Everything is Poli kalo , poli poli nostimo. Thank you for an amaizing culinary experience and most problably next year on your 50th anniversary we will have at least a dinner here

reviews.author: Carbkilla
reviews.text: Excellent location and vibe, food is tasty and the staff very polite and hard working. Portions are large and no fancy plating, just good homemade food. We will definitely come back on our next visit!

reviews.author: Tomáš Jurkovič
reviews.text: We have been here twice and I would come back anytime again. I felt very welcomed and the food was just fabulous. They serve multiplex vegan & gluten-free meals, just ask ask I did and they will arrange everything according to your needs. I recommend doing an online reservation before, restaurant was nearly full when we arrived. Waiting time is bit longer, especially for some meals, but mezes came after few minutes. Better park your car in a parking lot near the roundabout above the restaurant.

reviews.author: Dario Gros
reviews.text: From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is elegant, welcoming, and absolutely flawless. The service is exceptional,thoughtful, attentive, and genuinely passionate about creating a memorable experience. Every dish is a masterpiece, blending top-quality ingredients with bold, unforgettable flavors and stunning presentation. This isn’t just a meal—it’s a world-class culinary experience that stays with you long after the last bite. Nothing left on the plate. Only happens at extraordinary places.

reviews.author: Maria Talley
reviews.text: This is one of the local go-to spots in Famagusta. A family-style restaurant that won't leave you hungry. For $65 my mom and I shared an awesome 3 course dinner with desserts and even took a bunch of meet home with us for the next day. One thing to know is that there isn't a menu to choose from, only prix fixe, so come hungry!

reviews.author: Kirill Yerofeyev
reviews.text: Delicious and diverse food, convenient location in the heart of Famagusta, very invested and attentive staff. Who seems to be the restaurant manager was constantly checking up on us to ensure we had a great experience. Next time I’m in Cyprus I’ll make sure to visit again. We had meze and meats platter (never tasted chicken this soft), and came here for drinks the week before. Everything was top-notch

reviews.author: ABGAR GARIS
reviews.text: We went there with friends, two families midday and it was really busy but the waiters and waitresses were quick and helpful. The menu was great and the prices were reasonable. The food quality and price was great. The restaurant is by the sea and has great atmosphere. We didn't have to wait long for the food and the side dishes were also satisfying.

reviews.author: gl umz
reviews.text: We have been coming to Apsava for many years. The food and service is excellent. We couldn't finish the meat and had to take them home. The meat portion for 2 people is huge after all that meze as well. Forgot to take photos of the desserts snd fruits. The restaurant has a very cosy interior and well decorated with trees lining one side of the restaurant.

reviews.author: Jean-Marc Nginn
reviews.text: Nice place, nice restaurant located in the old town. the staff is welcoming, helpful and smiling. There are lots of tables and apparently they serve at all hours. The dishes ordered were excellent and in quantity. Fortunately, it is possible to take leftovers from your meal in doggybags. it was a nice surprise and I will definitely come back.

reviews.author: bahar dehghani
reviews.text: We ordered the Pide and the Kebab with eggplant, and both were really delicious! The portions were generous —just one of those dishes were perfect for two people. They also offered free and unlimited appetisers like salad, two types of French fries, and some super tasty Çiğ köfte. When we were finished they charged them again 😅 The staff were really friendly, even though we spoke English. Mohamad, the Arab guy, was especially kind and welcoming. After we finished our meal, they surprised us with a free tea service, which included tea, ice cream, and Knafeh. It was the perfect sweet ending after such a heavy meal! Overall, I totally recommend this place if you're looking for good food and a great experience.

reviews.author: Faleh Alrammah
reviews.text: Certainly! How about this succinct yet enticing review: --- Visited here and was utterly charmed by the authentic Turkish ambiance. The complimentary dish served upon arrival was a delightful teaser of the flavors to come. Ordered the Eskender, and it was a revelation—perfectly cooked, with flavors that transported me straight to Turkey. A must-visit for anyone craving genuine Turkish cuisine. 5 stars

reviews.author: Dr. Murat Çinici
reviews.text: I had a meal at Aspava in Kızılay. The place is clean and has a pleasant atmosphere. I ordered the “PTT” menu, which includes 4 pieces of lavash-wrapped döner, salad, fries, çiğ köfte, ezme, tea, and two desserts. The taste was average, but the portions were generous. The price was 540 TL — not cheap, not expensive, just reasonable for what you get. There were plenty of complimentary side dishes, and when I asked for an extra plate of fries, they brought it quickly, which was nice. However, the service could be better. The waiter gave off a bit of a “eat quickly and leave” vibe. Maybe it’s because I was dining alone, but a more welcoming and professional attitude would have improved the experience. Overall, it’s a decent spot with rich offerings. Would I go again? Yes. But there’s room for improvement when it comes to customer service.

reviews.author: Angus Wong
reviews.text: Even though the staff did not speak English, we could communicate with what little Turkish words I have learnt and the help of Google Translate. We ordered two mains and two drinks, but we ended up with a big feast. The starters literally filled our four seat table, and the manager was offering free refills while we were waiting for our mains. The serving size of the şiş kebap was huge, we got 5 kebaps for that one dish alone. As we finished our mains, we were served two more courses of dessert and a pot of çay. This all ended up only costing us 1045TL which is around $30 USD at the time. This is the best value meal we have ever had! Throughout our meal the wait staff and manager were friendly and helpful, and didn't rush us even though they were quite busy and had almost full capacity. Despite the language barrier, we felt welcomed.

reviews.author: Siarinho 28
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly and accommodating. There is a lot of space in the restaurant. Besides the food, many different side dishes are served. But the main course was unfortunately just average. The meat was tough and not well done. It was heavy in the stomach. Prices for the food were moderate.

reviews.author: Maria Talley

reviews.author: Ekaterina Kyriacou
reviews.text: We went for dinner. Food tasted OK, nothing special. The traditional decor is beautiful. We ordered kebab and lamb chops. It seemed to me that the price was a bit high for the portion. Packed with people and. all windows closed. I asked to open the windows, they said they would open the Ac instead. stuffy atmosphere, like a cave. The only 2 waiters trying their best, but ofcourse service was a bit slow.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: Superb location, traditional rooms and value for money. Nice little breakfast too! Loved the decoration inside the restaurant. Will def visit again.

reviews.author: Max Williams
reviews.text: They tell us that the rooms are 60 euros per person and when we come to pay they tell us its 80 per person, the staff at the reception was being rude that we are wrong and we don’t have right to talk, the rooms are dirty and smelly. We came to check in and the housekeepers were still cleaning our rooms and we came later that our check in time.By the way full of dust and broken glasses not safe for kids. And the power stations don’t work and the one that work burned our hair straightener . And the air conditioner doesn’t work in any room

reviews.author: Jiri Neoral
reviews.text: Group of 5 for dinner. All good and huge portions. I had to take mix grill for takeaway

reviews.author: Ariel Albert
reviews.text: We eat at the resternt cakes and drink cofe, we love the ornge cake.

reviews.author: Teri Allerton
reviews.text: Definitely 💯 worth a visit! Took me a while to find it as in my map it says Roof Top Bar not Ais Giwrkis but it was worth the walk, perched on top of a hill you can gain entry by car or by climbing up a few stairs from the village. Tables outside and inside and great welcome and service! The menu was a brilliant fusion of Cypriot and Cretan food and if there were a few of you then the Meze would be a great option! We decided on a delicious starter of Saganaki which did not disappoint and then shared the Mixed Grill and still did not manage to finish it!!! Followed by a complimentary portion of tasty orange cake Mr Andrea’s and his team delivered everything we were looking for on our trip to Kakopetria. Thank you to our hotel Thymises for recommending selflessly that we must eat out of the hotel at least once!!! We thank you and again Mr Andrea’s who bless him went to open his restaurant in the morning as I had ‘lost’ my sunglasses only for me to find them in my handbag 🫣if you eat no where else then please eat here and Mr Andrea’s next time you come to Pomos we will show you our selection of fabulous eateries!

reviews.author: Daniella
reviews.text: Went for Valentines as they had a last min cancellation and they could accommodate us. The service has been stellar every time I’ve been there and the staff super polite and approachable, always with a smile on their face. The food never disappoints )i recommend the meze) tasty fusion of Crete and Cyprus cuisine 😊

reviews.author: Aleksey Komissarov
reviews.text: We came from pretty far thinking it was a nice local spot, but turns out they only serve meze — €25 per person, no menu, no other options. That wasn’t mentioned anywhere. Might be fine if you're nearby and want a full meze meal, but definitely not worth the trip if you're coming from far away. Just a heads-up for others.

reviews.author: Kalmer Kaljuste
reviews.text: Out of the 2-3 highest rated restaurants in Kakopetria this was the best. Due to the low season there were not many people having dinner at the restaurant, so the chef served us food and made us feel quite homely. The food itself was very juicy/moist and cooked just perfectly. On top of our main dishes we ate the local orange cake which was probably one of the best cakes we've had in years. Everything about this restaurant was top level. Note: there is also air conditioning inside.

reviews.author: Sea Sun And Chilies M
reviews.text: Wonderful Hospitality tasty food amazing desert portokalo pitta well done Bravo !!

reviews.author: Tatiana Minaeva
reviews.text: Came to the hotel’s restaurant to try the trout with butter sauce and it was above expectations. The fish was off the bone and served with a delicious souse of butter, parsley, garlic, and lemon. I had it with mashed potatoes – so tasty together. We also had the grilled halloumi, honestly one of the best I’ve ever had. Service was super friendly, the view over the terracotta rooftops was amazing, and the prices were very reasonable – a bonus to an already great experience. Highly recommend – definitely go for the trout!

reviews.author: Jenny Schauroth
reviews.text: We visited the famous Milos restaurant after having heard so much about it and it is shockingly bad! 16€ for a village salad, 14 € for a ready bought Augustino burger with the cheapest bread and nothing else on it, no sauce, no salad, no onions. If the food had at least been the tiniest bit worth it, but it wasn't. Honestly don't go here, it's a waste of your money.

reviews.author: Georgia St
reviews.text: Stayed at the hotel and ate at the restaurant too. The hotel for its prices, I was expecting more “luxury” in the rooms and at the welcome. The rooms have a lot of character and tradition but bathroom could have been renovated to support the prices. (€170 for one night and the jacuzzi bath tab has extreme damage). The room overall was clean and tidy. Staff has trapped us to trying the hotels restaurant by asking us to reserve our spot as the restaurant is fully booked. Again, felt very awkward when walking in the restaurant. We got the menu aaannnddd €16.50 for a SALAD. Just a salad!!!! Overpriced restaurant for only OK food. Breakfast was very minimal without many options.

reviews.author: M Vslk
reviews.text: Great room, amazing breakfast and the village is beautiful but the path in the river next to the hotel had rubbish all over(so sad).

reviews.author: Eleni Kyriacou
reviews.text: Everything here is magical and outstanding. Perfectly appointed and maintained hotel, spotlessly clean, ample breakfast, spacious rooms and bathrooms and the most idyllic location imaginable. A glorious balcony to dine on, day and night. One cannot recommend The Mill enough.

reviews.author: Lars haha
reviews.text: Had a wonderful Time. Great people and great food great hotel ! We will visit again ! Thank you for your service!!

reviews.author: Kristina Timotheou
reviews.text: The overall experience was good. The location and the view was great! The service wasn’t what we expected for the price to be honest. When we arrived we said that we will stay just for the drinks, but then changed our mind and stayed also for the food. The waiters were very cold and distant and we were the last to serve even though we came first. The food quality was not something we expected for the price. Seafood salad was a disaster) out of 3 shells i had in my salad only 2 of them were properly cooked and opened! And the rest of the seafood was not fresh at all, it was obvious, even though we were at the cost of the Mediterranean Sea! The mussels were not properly cleaned and overcooked! It was the same story with my husband’s Frutto di Mari pasta! If you came there just for drinks to enjoy the view and you have no expectations for the price than this place is for you!

reviews.author: Thomas Loebert
reviews.text: Place to be in North Cyprus. Fantastic sea views at the foot of the historic monastery. Be sure to make a reservation as the restaurant is always very busy. Facts: friendly service, very good cuisine, wide selection of wines and reasonable price-performance ratio

reviews.author: israa nasser
reviews.text: The location is truly outstanding, and the hotel's vibe and aesthetic are incredibly pleasing to the eye. Unfortunately, we couldn't secure a reservation because it was fully booked, so make sure to book in advance to avoid disappointment.

reviews.author: boris schaefer
reviews.text: Hotel: We had a deluxe double room with balcony and sea view. The location directly below the abbey allows a great view from the garden area / pool to the monastery and on the other side to the sea. The whole complex is very lovingly maintained and the water in the pool is incredibly soft. The location is great for excursions in the whole area of Northern Cyprus. We had booked two nights and spontaneously extended our stay by one day. One of the most beautiful resorts we have ever been to. We really enjoyed our time out in this little piece of "Eden" on earth and recharged our batteries. Restaurant: The breakfast buffet is very extensive, egg dishes are all freshly prepared, the cappuchino is incredible. The dinner leaves nothing to be desired, I have rarely eaten such good meat prepared so well. The whole staff is very friendly and attentive. The owner summed it all up in one sentence: This is a peacefull place. You can't say it better than that.

reviews.author: Esma Y.
reviews.text: One of the best restaurants in Girne! The food was w-o-w delicious!! The portions were very big and tasty. The price is reasonable and atmosphere and interior design is fantastic. We differently recommend this place!

reviews.author: James Andrew
reviews.text: We visited for dinner. We only speak English, staff found an English speaking waiter for us. I am ceoliac, gluten free. The staff made sure to help me find dishes I could eat. The food was excellent, the service was excellent and the view is wonderful, we were there for sunset and I highly recommend. Coming from East Coast of Australia, it was quite special to see a sunset over the water.

reviews.author: Veronika Cs
reviews.text: We came here on a Saturday evening with friends, had to wait a bit for a table with sea-view but it worth it. As the restaurant was full the service was a bit slow, we order beef in creamy mushroom sauce the with chicken, fish and chips and a vegetarian option. The beef was tender and tasty so was the chicken, the fish and chips though was too oily and not too tasty except for the sauce they brought with it, the veg option was good as well. Overall the food was ok but not exceptional.

reviews.author: Eleoni Kurza
reviews.text: We enjoyed this restaurant so much that we came twice during our time in Cyprus. The restaurant has such a stunnung view and peaceful setting inside. I can recommend the prawns, sweet & sour chicken and their traditional dessert. The previous day I had the kebab. They serve generous portions.

reviews.author: DaVinciFX Group
reviews.text: Excellent restaurant after renovation, in the best traditions of Ezic. Very respectful staff. Excellent dishes, prices slightly above average.

reviews.author: Jimmy Goldfinger
reviews.text: The head waiters look like they've been turned into zombies, and are being forced to work there. My chicken kebab was just overcooked, I was scared that the chef was going to keel over the grill while cooking the food for the customers and myself. The commis waiters were very helpful and more customer oriented. I don't think I'll be going again, it used to be a constant regular of mine every time I came to the island, disappointing unfortunately.

reviews.author: Prénom Nom
reviews.text: The best Steaks, T-Bone Steaks, Entrecôte in Girne! All other food also very excellent !

reviews.author: Jason A
reviews.text: We were recommended this restaurant from a store owner. The meal was absolutely delicious and filling. The bread was constantly flowing to our table. The chicken was tender and well seasoned. The tea was piping hot and delicious. I highly recommend this place. Cypriot potatoes are the best in the world IMO.

reviews.author: Joshua Cook
reviews.text: Best food in Cyprus, everything full of flavour and extremely authentic, we had to go again and went twice on our trip to Cyprus. Beautiful, had nothing like it. The garlic mushroom starter is a must try and the sauce is amazing. Perfectly cooked meat and amazing experience.

reviews.author: Suheyla kishi
reviews.text: we had the full kebab menu and it was amazing. Very fresh and served hot. you do get full by the end of your meal, however my only complaint would be the size of portion of serves is very little. You only get 1 of everything. eg 1 kofte, 1 tiny bit of shish ect... but because it's spaced out you do get relatively full. if your a bigger eater than it might not be as filling or enough. overall it was a nice dining experience and everyone enjoyed the food including the buffet dessert bar.

reviews.author: Alena Altmann
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful place to drink and eat. On the bottom is an amazing bar, on top a restaurant. The walls are filled with artwork, the food is amazing and the staff is just lovely. If you like art, good music and food come here.

reviews.author: Jurate Saveikis
reviews.text: Very good choice of drinks and like home made food.Very Irish pub atmosphere

reviews.author: Dmitry S
reviews.text: Liked everything. Delicious food, excellent service, amazing wall decorations and fair prices. There is a bar on the ground floor, the restaurant is on the next floor.

reviews.author: Monika Sinušaitė
reviews.text: Highly recommended! Came here according to Lonely Planet suggestion and it was really lovely experience. Very nice staff, good food, plenty (really plenty) kinds of the beer and cozy atmosphere :)

reviews.author: Алексей Гуз
reviews.text: Wow !!! Very original and authentic atmosphere, huge (impressive and worthy of any gourmet) selection of alcohol, regular special menu Attentive waiters And the "cherry on the cake", in winter on the second floor they light a fireplace, which adds warmth to the atmosphere (we were there when it was +4c and windy outside) and coziness. I recommend visiting every day!)

reviews.author: David Hovsepyan
reviews.text: We had a great time — the atmosphere was pleasant and the service was good. The food was overall good: the meat was well-cooked and the salad fresh and tasty. However, I’m taking one star off because the meat was only warm, and once it cooled down, it became too oily and lost its appeal. I hope the owner or manager sees this and shares the feedback with the kitchen team — properly heating the food would make a big difference.

reviews.author: Nasma Shwahde
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the oven-baked lamb – it was incredibly tender and full of flavor. The service was warm and attentive, and the atmosphere made for a lovely dining experience. I wasn’t a fan of the wine I tried by the glass, and the selection was a bit limited, but overall, it was a great meal and with very nice open atmosphere and space next to the sea. Very reasonable prices

reviews.author: George Moise
reviews.text: Can't say I was impressed. The pork meat was veeery hard to eat, chewed until my mouth was hurting. The stifado was amazing, but I woudn't recommend coming here again. The waiters didn't clean our table until we left, so we had all the plates sitting dirty on our table.

reviews.author: Zaddy Maxwin
reviews.text: We had dinner reservations for a group of 5, we were greeted nicely with the staff. It was our first time here and when we asked the waiter about his recommendations, he was not very helpful and simply referred to ‘different people have different taste’ thank you captain obvious! The service was not on par of what i was expecting, maybe its supposed to be like this culturally i dont know The bread is very big and probably not gluten free, the village salad is mid (the lettuce is very basic), the tahini and tziki is also mid. In the main course, we had both lamb and beef kleftico and isteffado, vegetarian Mousakka, What i would recommend the most is the veg mousakka, lamb kleftico & stefado

reviews.author: Loui Stavrou
reviews.text: What an amazing Greek restaurant! So happy we decided to come for our last meal of our holiday here. Traditional Greek food, so tasty & excellent service. Amazing value for money. We ordered the village salad, haloumi, bread and dips to start and they were all so good, then onto the mains - 1 pork souvla ( big chunks of meat ) & 1 chicken souvla. Both were very nice however the pork was out of this world! Our bill came to €63 and we even had the militzis bottle of white wine ( only €15!). Our waiter was very friendly and helpful, he recommended the pork and it was our favourite. Do not hesitate to go here, we will be back!

reviews.author: Tatjana G
reviews.text: Excellent restaurant with authentic homemade food and warm hospitality This restaurant truly impressed us in every way. The food is authentic and homemade, full of rich, well-balanced flavors. We had a mix of meze, which was absolutely delicious – every dish was carefully prepared and full of character. A special mention goes to the pickled caper shoots, which were a real highlight. The lamb chops were perfectly grilled – tender, juicy, and full of flavor. The owner and the staff were extremely friendly and professional, creating a welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. At the end of the meal, we were treated to fresh watermelon and a homemade cake – a thoughtful gesture that really stood out. You truly get great value for money here. After a meal like this, you leave happy and already thinking about coming back.

reviews.author: Yasmin Raveh
reviews.text: We came here in 2017 and i knew i had to be back now in 2025. It's still an amazing place!! Service is wonderful, especially Pavlos. Cant wait to return here on our next visit! The atmosphere is so pleasant, there is live music on Friday and Saturday. We had Grilled veggies, steak, fries, salad - all fantastic.

reviews.author: Adrian Razvan
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at this restaurant and it was one of the most authentic culinary experiences I’ve ever had. I tried the Meze, and it was absolutely delicious, offering a true taste of traditional flavors. The restaurant itself has an amazing atmosphere, full of life, with vibrant live music that enhances the dining experience. It’s a family-run business, and you can really feel the warmth and care in both the service and the food. Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for a memorable meal!

reviews.author: George Timotheou
reviews.text: This is my first stop every time I visit Cyprus. The souvlaki was so tender, like steak! It’s a family run business with a sister that takes the bookings and sings at the weekend with live music, 3 brothers that serve the food and make sure every customer feels welcome. The father is in the kitchen ensuring all the food meets their highest standards. This restaurant is one of the wonders of Cyprus situated in my home village of Aradippou.

reviews.author: AC
reviews.text: World class flavours. The dips are insanely good and the grilled flavours in the meats is truly special. As well as the vibes and good atmosphere. If you’re a tourist and seeing this review, look no further and just come you will not regret it.

reviews.author: Tatjana G
reviews.text: Excellent restaurant with authentic homemade food and warm hospitality This restaurant truly impressed us in every way. I tried the Meze, and it was absolutely delicious, offering a true taste of traditional flavors. The restaurant itself has an amazing atmosphere, full of life, with vibrant live music that enhances the dining experience. It’s a family-run business, and you can really feel the warmth and care in both the service and the food. Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for a memorable meal!

reviews.author: George Timotheou
reviews.text: This is my first stop every time I visit Cyprus. The souvlaki was so tender, like steak! It’s a family run business with a sister that takes the bookings and sings at the weekend with live music, 3 brothers that serve the food and make sure every customer feels welcome. The father is in the kitchen ensuring all the food meets their highest standards. This restaurant is one of the wonders of Cyprus situated in my home village of Aradippou.

reviews.author: AC
reviews.text: World class flavours. The dips are insanely good and the grilled flavours in the meats is truly special. As well as the vibes and good atmosphere. If you’re a tourist and seeing this review, look no further and just come you will not regret it.

reviews.author: serene
reviews.text: Meze is such a great way to taste a large variety of fish. It requires 2 people minimum to order but the food is enough to feed 3. The cooking is simple without excessive seasoning to bring out the freshness of the ingredient. The squid can be cleaned a bit more to remove the excess ink and interior but all other dishes are wonderful. Our waiter was also very attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: Loui Stavrou
reviews.text: My favorite restaurant in Larnaca! You have to get the fish meze. At 24 euros per person it is excellent value for money. From the salad / pitta breads and dips to start, to the 8 fish courses that come out one after the other, it’s delicious. Most of the fish comes plain, so don’t expect lots of seasoning, however you add fresh lemon & salt and it’s amazing. We come here 2 or 3 times every time we visit Cyprus. Service was excellent also. The octopus and baby squid are our favorite. We also loved the sea bream at the end with olive oil. So fresh!

reviews.author: Szonja Balogh
reviews.text: This is a very nice restaurant located at the city’s pier, very close to the airport. It’s a busy spot with fast service and very fresh food. The venue is wheelchair accessible. The food was excellent, especially the larger fish dishes from the charcoal grill — incredibly flavorful. The mezza selection is average, not exceptional, but still enjoyable, particularly with fish and octopus options. The grilled fish on its own is remarkably tasty. Note that they don’t use much spice or salt, so the flavors are clean and simple. The atmosphere can be quite loud during peak hours. If you’re looking for fast, high-quality food — especially fresh fish — I can definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: martin cvetkov
reviews.text: Food was amazing - fresh and flavorsome. We ordered a dish with 8 different types of fish. Service was quick. The place is super busy, loud and chaotic - depending on what are you looking for that could be both a downside and a part of the authentic experience. It is advertised as a local fish restaurant - decor is very basic but the quality of the food and fast service make it up for that.

reviews.author: ベナクリス
reviews.text: The restaurant we ate lunch at in the city center recommended this place for seafood. We had the fish meze and the octopus platter, and all in all, they were good. The fish meze was mostly fried seafood, but the flavor was good. It wasn't overly salted like most fried food, so you did get to taste the seafood itself. The octopus was good as well, just a bit too chewy. Needless to say, it was a lot of food for a great price.
