reviews.author: Giorgos Patsali
reviews.text: My favourite Steak House in Cyprus by far. The quality of everything is amazing but what keeps me going every time there is the service. I’ve never seen such an amazing welcome and service from the staff. Truly amazing! I visited the place the first time in 2021 and ever since I have been a customer. I didn’t get a good photo of the steaks since I dived in and pretty much ate everything before considering of taking a photo, but, I will keep going.

reviews.author: Viktorija
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a fantastic steak in Limassol, Columbia Steak House is a great choice. When we arrived, the restaurant was nearly empty, creating a calm and cozy atmosphere, perfect for an enjoyable evening. The staff were attentive and professional, adding to the overall experience. We started with a Greek salad that was fresh and flavorful—a perfect beginning to the meal. For our mains, we tried fillet steaks—American beef cooked medium-rare and Australian beef cooked medium-well. Both were tender, juicy, and perfectly cooked, with generous 250-gram portions. The side dishes were equally impressive, especially the truffle mashed potatoes, which I absolutely loved. We paired the steaks with peppercorn sauce (my favorite) and creamy mushroom sauce, both of which complemented the meat beautifully. To finish, we lingered over a cup of espresso and a scoop of ice cream, still enjoying the peaceful atmosphere. The only downside was that the toilets didn’t match the elegance of the restaurant, but everything else was exceptional. From the moment you walk in to the moment you leave, Columbia Steak House delivers a great dining experience. Bravo 👏🏼

reviews.author: Kyriacos Costa
reviews.text: Amazing dinner at Columbia Steak House. All of the dishes were very well executed and full of flavours. Steak was also really good, even though the cooking was slightly more cooked from what we ordered (we ordered medium, came medium to well). Desserts were also really good, we especially liked the pecan pie. Service was fast and efficient.

reviews.author: Nickolas Fisher
reviews.text: The place is very atmospheric. The design inside is arranged in the best traditions of American or British steakhouses. The staff are very friendly and polite. The steaks themselves are perfect, and they truly are among the best you can find in Cyprus. On the other hand, the rest of the food is extremely plain. The grilled vegetables proved to be half raw, the Ceasar salad has no relation to its original. But the steaks are really tasty indeed

reviews.author: C Raftis
reviews.text: A fantastic steakhouse with a fabulous atmosphere and well-thought-out layout and design. The spacious smoking and non-smoking sections ensure a comfortable dining experience for all guests, with the smoking area featuring excellent ventilation. The menu offers well-prepared and carefully selected dishes, with the steaks being particularly outstanding.

reviews.author: Andria Elia Photography
reviews.text: Excellent food, taste and textures. As a vegetarian I believe this is the only place in cyprus that gives so many tasty vegetarian options on their menu. I've ordered vegetarian musakka and it was DELICIOUS. Everything we've ordered had a home made flavor and was tasty Highly recommend

reviews.author: Polina Karakostova
reviews.text: We had a nice meal at Karatelo Tavern! The food was fresh, flavorful, and offered a creative twist on traditional Cypriot dishes without losing their authentic soul. The staff were warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere had that perfect mix of cozy and lively. With nice view of the castle. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in Limassol

reviews.author: Naiké Colombo
reviews.text: Excellent service and food. Really friendly atmosphere, and very tasty food. The lucomades are a must, amazing light and delicious! I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Amit Hayile
reviews.text: Super nice tavern with Cypriot and some Greek dishes. We had the mazze, huge variety, everything fresh and well prepared. Highly recommended if you would like to get the local experience.

reviews.author: Yaniv Levy
reviews.text: Great restorant. The food is amazing and the service was great. Great atmosphere and the price is fine.

reviews.author: Andria Elia Photography
reviews.text: Excellent food, taste and textures. As a vegetarian I believe this is the only place in cyprus that gives so many tasty vegetarian options on their menu. I've ordered vegetarian musakka and it was DELICIOUS. Everything we've ordered had a home made flavor and was tasty Highly recommend

reviews.author: Polina Karakostova
reviews.text: We had a nice meal at Karatelo Tavern! The food was fresh, flavorful, and offered a creative twist on traditional Cypriot dishes without losing their authentic soul. The staff were warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere had that perfect mix of cozy and lively. With nice view of the castle. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in Limassol

reviews.author: Naiké Colombo
reviews.text: Excellent service and food. Really friendly atmosphere, and very tasty food. The lucomades are a must, amazing light and delicious! I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Amit Hayile
reviews.text: Super nice tavern with Cypriot and some Greek dishes. We had the mazze, huge variety, everything fresh and well prepared. Highly recommended if you would like to get the local experience.

reviews.author: Yaniv Levy
reviews.text: Great restorant. The food is amazing and the service was great. Great atmosphere and the price is fine.

reviews.author: Anna V.
reviews.text: We loved this tavern. We went with fish meze and it didn’t disappoint. We ordered meze for two and it was more than enough food for two adults and a teen. The starters were great, the sea food even better, it is a great concept that gives a chance to try multiple dishes. The service was great too and felt very personal. Thank you!

reviews.author: Samuel Najac
reviews.text: I've been traveling to Cyprus for business for the last 2 years. This was my first time to this restaurant and it was amazing. The food is honestly the best food I've ever had here in Cyprus. The meat Meze was my favorite dish but every dish was so flavorful. The atmosphere is perfect. Very nice, comfortable, and welcoming. The staff was very kind, and welcoming. It felt as if you were having a meal with friends you knew. This was a great experience overall. I am looking forward to my next trip to come here again. You must experience this restaurant.

reviews.author: Veronika Ratner
reviews.text: Thank you very much for the delicious food! The people working there are super positive! The wine was delicious and the ladyfingers dessert will forever be in my heart. ❤️🌈☀️ We will definitely come again. ☀️🫶☺️

reviews.author: Kostia Bilich
reviews.text: We came to this place from a blog recommendation. We came around 18:30 and it was really busy. Vut fortune smiled upon us and we managed to get the last available table outside. It is recommended to book in advance. I ordered the tomato soup which was divine. Also a small shrimp appetizer that was wonderful as well. For the main I chose the mixed grill which was really good. Service was great. Can't recommend enough

reviews.author: Olivia Farah
reviews.text: Great restaurant, clearly family run and very successful. I would recommend booking as they were very busy all night. We had the meze and I was so stuffed, we struggled to finish it all, at only 23€ each it was excellent value. All the dishes were homemade, my favourite part was all the different dips they offered. Would definitely return.

reviews.author: Joanna T
reviews.text: If you're looking for one of the most worthy places to eat in Limassol, this restaurant absolutely deserves a spot at the top of your list. The food is consistently delicious, packed with great flavour, and the portion sizes are generous without being overpriced. What really stands out is the variety on the menu, there’s something for every taste, from rich and hearty dishes to lighter, more refreshing options. Whether you're in the mood for meat, seafood, or vegetarian dishes, you’ll find something that hits the spot. The service is another major highlight. The staff are always welcoming, attentive, and genuinely friendly, which adds to the warm, inviting atmosphere of the place. Another thoughtful touch that deserves mention is how family-friendly the restaurant is. For those dining with little ones, they’ve got a baby changing table and even a child-sized toilet seat, which makes a big difference for parents trying to enjoy a meal out without stress. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Faidra Antoniadou
reviews.text: This rating would have been a 10/10 if our waiter didn’t act like he didn’t want to be serving us. All other staff were super nice and the food was amazing. Lovely atmosphere overall with many food and wine options. Generally great.

reviews.author: Christopher Thomas
reviews.text: We had a fantastic meal here. All dishes were very tasty and freshly made. The meat was succulent and fell off the bone in the lamb dish. Dipping sauces exceeded expectations. The service was prompt and attentive. Heaters on the patio made outdoor dining an option. Would recommend and return!

reviews.author: Alexander Latishenok
reviews.text: We had a great lunch at this place and I can say that it was amazing experience! The portions are big, the meals were tasty and fresh. You can se that all the ingredients are high quality and the restaurant cares about it. Pavlova is one of our favorite desserts and we found it here. My wife said that cherry in Pavlova is a rare case. Personal thanks from her :) I would highlight that service is at a very good level, polite and friendly personnel. Planning to come back again ☺️

reviews.author: Данко Вълков
reviews.text: We have been there with friends, had an amazing time. The food was great as we have had some variety of sea food, and other dishes that he had tried. The drinks were wine and beer, as you could see the beer was even happier to see us again in the same restaurant 13 years later. We are even able to feed the "gato" and "cats" with some fish and chicken, so they were going after us right after we left the place. We will go there again definitely when we are in thst area.

name: Street Stall - Old Port
address: Street Stall - Old Port, Limassol, Cyprus

reviews.author: Michael Soanes
reviews.text: I must admit all along the seafront is worth seeing from Cafe Nero down to the Marina.A lovely walk finishing at one of the cosey bars ,chilling out and people watching.You can't beat watching the colourful fishing boats and the expensive yachts in the marina,it's so relaxing.

reviews.author: John Tucker
reviews.text: What a great place for a walk on a beautiful day! Enjoyed seeing the fisherman in the morning. Continued walking the waterfront for a few miles. We had a great lunch at Kipriakon back at the Old Port after our walk along the water.

reviews.author: Dimitris Tsatsaronis
reviews.text: British-inspired old port of the 1950s that has been renovated covering cultural and commercial use. Modern, beautiful, clean, covering all tastes. It is an ornament for the city. It's worth a guided tour.

reviews.author: Zaryab Hassan
reviews.text: the place is Quite nice you can see different people's and the sea view is awesome from there also there's so nice yachts 🚢

reviews.author: Eduardo Pereira
reviews.text: Very nice spot to hangout with friends, to go during the night, to have a coffee during the day, to grab an ice cream, to take pictures, to eat (fancy!) or just to walk around. There is a bit of everything there. Great vibes, busy, beautiful, clean and attractive!

reviews.author: Evanthia Christodoulou
reviews.text: I was there for a stand up comedy followed by live music and both were amazing. However, food was too expensive and not adequate in terms of quantity. Service was also bad.

reviews.author: Nikolas Konstantinou
reviews.text: I was here for a stand up comedy. One of the best night i had in Limassol.

reviews.author: Dora Christofi
reviews.text: Nice place for Greek rock music. They also serve food but I would not recommend it. They often host live music event with famous Greek singers. Drinks after 11 are more expensive (because of live music).

reviews.author: marinos achilleos
reviews.text: Too expensive. When there's a live the prices goes double for every drink (this is written on menu) and the outdoors area does not communicate with indoors. If you want to smoke with your 12 euro glass of whiskey you have to go outside, or ask them for an ashtray and they provide you a plastic glass. So basically you break the law, and they are fine with it

reviews.author: Margarita Shamugiya
reviews.text: Shisha guy doesn’t care at all. I asked if the flavor is strong, he said no. And it was very strong, i had headache from the 1 minute….. when i said that its actually very strong, he said “i dont think so” and didnt fix or offer smth……. awful!!! Shishas served from Shishakings!!👎👎👎👎👎👎👎

reviews.author: Giorgi Chikhladze
reviews.text: One of the best places to enjoy a generous meal in Nicosia. It has a great interior with an outdoor seating area. I must highlight the exceptional hospitality of the staff. Natia,Lika and Mzia,who work there, were incredibly helpful in choosing the food, especially since I’m not very familiar with the local cuisine. The prices are quite reasonable—nothing is overpriced, and you never feel like you’re being ripped off. Every time I return, I will definitely visit this place again. Highly recommended to everyone.

reviews.author: Anna M
reviews.text: Delicious food, fresh, well seasoned. Excellent price to quality ratio. Huge portions, plate for 2 can easily feed 3 😁 nice staff and great location.

reviews.author: Rares Vitelariu
reviews.text: Great food, the portions are really big.We ordered a chicken platter for 2 and could not finish it so we had to take it for take-away.The meat and the fries were delicious.Definetly recommend this place.

reviews.author: mateusz nierodzik
reviews.text: Oh my god, this place is one of the best we were in Cyprus! The meat plate for 2 persons was more than enough, dessert was perfect and service very helpful and polite. Prices are good. A lot of seats so u won't have to wait in queue!

reviews.author: Monica Ioannou
reviews.text: Great service, lovely atmosphere, and amazing food. You definitely get more than what you pay for! Big portions with delicious food 😋 will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: Giorgi Chikhladze
reviews.text: Excellent service and incredibly delicious food. I highly recommend visiting this place. The waiting time passed quickly, especially thanks to the beautiful outdoor seating area. I received my tasty meal within 12 minutes, and the prices were quite reasonable. I definitely recommend it to everyone!

reviews.author: Miloš Metlar
reviews.text: I had a lunch here with couple of friends. Restaurant is easy to find, as it is located in the busy street that leads to Turkish part of Nicosia. We were welcomed by the manager who was really outgoing person. Staff was friendly and service super fast. We got our meals in about 10-15 minutes.

reviews.author: bogdan alexandru bola
reviews.text: Extremely good food, everything was fresh and delicious, all from local producers. The staff was very friendly and helpfull and they tried their best to make us feel welcomed. The music played was live, but not too loud, so that we could talk without problems. The scenery was also like a fairytale and the local wine was just perfect. The prices aren.t as high as other places, the portions really big. So just perfect!

reviews.author: Zuzi
reviews.text: Such a lovely friendly place, we were greeted by the owner himself. We were walking down Ledra Street and wondering where to go have lunch as we were craving traditional Cypriot food and I have to say that it exceeded our expectations. The food was amazing, fresh and delicious. They also cater for vegetarians. We started with a Greek village salad and courgettes balls that came piping hot, then moved on to a mixed souvlaki dish that was scrumptious and came with fries, tzatziki and bread. Our waitress Tatia was very friendly and efficient. We were also given complimentary panna cotta for dessert and a shot of mastic liquor 😋.. We sat in the beautiful back garden which is a bonus and there was a also a singer on the Sunday who serenaded everyone with beautiful soft songs. We can't recommend this lovely restaurant enough and will definitely be back soon! Thank you Anamma!

reviews.author: Always Andri Wedding Design
reviews.text: We had an absolutely delicious light late lunch here. Had the Greek salad and mixed platter for 2, all the meats were fresh and really tasty. We sat in their back garden which was lovely too with lots of fresh plants and flowers and air conditioning. A real hidden gem.

reviews.author: Alex Siamantas
reviews.text: Zanettos is one of the oldest traditional taverns in nicosia. They serve only mest meze, which is practically everything. The quantity of food is insane, but the taste is even better! Every time i visit this place, i can't wait to come back! 5/5 from me!

reviews.author: Doc Moc
reviews.text: Mezze overkill here, ha, ha! No menue, only Mezze with >20 components. Delicious and very diverse. Definitely worth its money. As it is clearly just too much for a single person, they also feed the poor with whatever you cannot manage yourself. Support!

reviews.author: יניב דוד לוי
reviews.text: We wanted to taste traditional food. We found this place, it's a mezze taverns. Not a classic tavern but the atmosphere was great. They proposed us to take mezze menu (to be honest, i don't think they have another option of service... hahaha). The food is good and arrived in very big quantities!! 22 different mezze! The meat arrived at the end...so wait for it. We took a Rose wine, beers, soda ext... and paid 38€ each. Not the best food in town but definitely worth the experience and your money. Excellent service.

reviews.author: CAPATINA ROXANA
reviews.text: An interesting experience of Cypriot meze with a little bit of everything: salads, fresh french fries, zucchini fries, pork and chicken meat, two types of sausages, halloumi cheese, bulgur, a type of rice with spinach, olives and a good dessert. A little bit too much for two people in my opinion. I enjoyed the cozy atmosphere of their green garden terrace during our dinner time, surrounded with jasmine and trees. The food is good and fresh, and I couldn't help but notice that the terrace got crowded immediately after 7 pm, and more than half of the customers seemed to be locals, spending quality time with family on a Sunday evening, enjoying this location and the meze meals.

reviews.author: Martha Gerolemou
reviews.text: Visited this place in 2016 and was pleasantly surprised how amazing the food was. Fast forward to my next visit to Cyprus and this was on the top of my list to revisit. Let me tell you, it didn't dissapoint. Food was plentiful but all very traditional with amazing flavours. Service was great. Do your taste buds a favour and visit this place, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Jelena Nikolic
reviews.text: My favorite landmark of the city! Loved it so much. Such a nice architecture, historical gem. Lovely for taking photos and just chilling as well. There is a paid toilet, restaurants and souvenir shops.

reviews.author: Marcel Bohunský
reviews.text: Büyük Han is the largest and best-preserved caravanserai in Cyprus, located in the old city of Nicosia (Lefkoşa). Built in 1572 by the Ottomans, it once served as an inn for merchants and travelers. The building features a beautiful courtyard, surrounded by two-story stone arches and a unique central mosque with a fountain. Today, Büyük Han is a lively cultural center, home to art galleries, craft shops, and cozy cafes. It’s the perfect place to experience authentic Cypriot atmosphere, enjoy local food, and discover handmade souvenirs. A must-visit for anyone exploring the heart of Nicosia.

reviews.author: İsmail Güngör
reviews.text: Büyük Han: A peaceful historic stop in the heart of Nicosia Located in the center of Nicosia, Büyük Han is a beautifully preserved Ottoman-era inn that strongly resembles the famous Koza Han in Bursa. With its two-story arched structure, central courtyard, and small domed prayer room, it offers a perfect mix of history and charm. Inside the han, you’ll find small shops selling handmade crafts, ceramics, jewelry, and traditional gifts. You can browse, shop, or just watch the artisans at work. There are also cafés in the courtyard where you can sit, relax and enjoy a cold drink or Turkish coffee. It’s an ideal place to take a break, especially during the warmer months. Tips for visitors: Great spot for buying local, authentic souvenirs Take a seat in the courtyard and enjoy a refreshing drink Go upstairs for a nice view of the entire space Visit in the morning for the best light and fewer crowds

reviews.author: bogdan alexandru bola
reviews.text: This is the largest caravansarai on the island of Cyprus and is considered to be one of the finest buildings on the island. Built by the Ottomans in 1572, the structure has an open courtyard, where there is a mosque with a fountain. This Han actually became the first city prison under British administration. A nice place to visit and have something to eat and drink.

reviews.author: Nikola Srdanov
reviews.text: A wonderful place that you must visit in the Turkish part of Nicosia. There, you will find a quality restaurant where you can try Turkish specialties. However, I must emphasize that the restaurant feels somewhat commercialized and not very authentic, so I doubt that locals regularly dine there. In any case, Büyük Han is a beautiful spot where you should definitely spend some time enjoying Turkish coffee, tea, or freshly squeezed pomegranate juice.

reviews.author: Meme Z
reviews.text: Food was good but not amazing. Not sure about the hype. Went there around 9pm all other restaurants seemed to be quiet but this one has heaps of customers. Had a salad and an entry and a drink as i wanted sth light. Total bill 805tl. Fair. Nothing too special Nothing bad either

reviews.author: Michaela J.
reviews.text: I can recommend this restaurant, the service was great and portions huge. All served meals were freshly prepared and very tasty. The location is nice, outside and inside, with clean rest rooms and friendly staff. We sat outside and enjoyed the natural shade from blooming bougainvillea. The only downside was the (temporary) noise from the near building site. The biggest mosque next to the restaurant is being renovated, can’t tell for how long.

reviews.author: Sam Sung
reviews.text: Good restaurant, but noodles and salads are not rich in flavour and dressing. The quality of the vegetables is very good. Coffees are also very good. Service is friendly and fast. Due to many diners at lunch time, the floors were dirty (not a staff fault). Toilets not clean.

reviews.author: goyourownway
reviews.text: Good value of money Italian and Spanish restaurant with intrusive cats N35°10.606' E33°21.904' Sabor or El Sabor Latino is a locally popular restaurant serving Italian and Spanish cuisine next to the Selimiye Mosque or Selimiye Camii, historically known as Cathedral of Saint Sophia or Ayasofya Mosque in the Turkish-Cypriot part of Nicosia. It offers seating inside, on the covered and heated terrace and on Selimiye square. If you had enough of kebabs, it offers tapas, pasta, chicken, meat dishes and surprisingly Asian noodles, but no pizzas. In November 2021, we ordered Parmiggiano salad with mixed greens, arugula, shaved Parmesan cheese and sun-dried tomatoes (tl 39), vegan spaghetti with onions, fresh tomatoes, capers and kidney beans (₺ 40) and linguine sabor with fried prawns, calamari and tomato sauce (₺ 82). The kitchen cooked quickly and soon large bowls of steamy Italian pasta were on our table. The pasta dishes were well-prepared, tasty and nutritious. The Italians do much better when it comes to taste, but these dishes were nothing to be ashamed. The same goes for the white Pasqua Pinot Grigio (₺ 135) Italian wine. Good, but nothing to be remembered. However, our culinary hearts were racing at the desserts: Incirli pasta (₺ 25) and mosaic chocolate cake (₺ 25). Much more locally infused baking produced light figs and chocolate cake, accompanied by a well-brewed cappuccino. Very good ending to a good local dinner. Service was friendly in English with an English menu. Beware of the resident cat population: this free-spirited army of cats has overstepped the line of begging, jumping on chairs and tables to demand food while you are eating. They know every trick in the book. One trick El Sabor knows is to offer payment in euros at unfavourable rates: pay in Turkish lira. The food of El Sabor cannot be compared to original Italian or Spanish food, but they do a good job in a nice atmosphere with friendly and quick service. Recommended.

reviews.author: Eden Morris
reviews.text: Our favourite restaurant in Cyprus! The food is amazing (and such good value) and the staff are an asset to the restaurant. This is best place to get a cold Effes and you must order the garlic mushrooms and chocolate soufflé. Such good vibes all round

reviews.author: bogdan alexandru bola
reviews.text: Good food in an amazing location. The prices are a bit higher than other places, but the location is worth it. Remember that we are talking about the largest caravanserai on the island and one of the finest structures on the island. The staff was very nice and helpfull all the way.

reviews.author: Jelena Nikolic
reviews.text: The service was amazing, the waiters are so genuinely nice and friendly. Food was 10/10 - so so delicious. The place has no toilet of their own, but you can use the building's paid toilet (50cents). We paid in euros, so the conversion rate was very high.

reviews.author: Paul Ciprian
reviews.text: In fact is a real restaurant, not just a cafe. We had lunch here, they serve mostly traditional Turkish dishes. It was OK, though I can't say I'm a fan of this kind of food. Good service, it's possible to pay by card.

reviews.author: Kalmer Kaljuste
reviews.text: Tasty and traditional food in a very unique place. We really enjoyed the flat bread with fillings (sorry, I'm not exactly sure what the name of the food is). We ordered half with spinach and half with grounded beef (which was similar to Russian chebureki). The hummus came with a very nicely baked bread.

reviews.author: Marina
reviews.text: Quite a nice location. Staff was friendly and the food was good and a surpisingly big portion for the price. The Manti were really good. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Paul Renner
reviews.text: Good fish and seafood in this casual cool restaurant with friendly staff. Next to Old GSP Stadium and near to sights such as St. Paul's Anglican Cathedral and the Leventis Art Gallery.

reviews.author: 1984mazzie
reviews.text: The quality of food is very good and the dishes have very nice ingredients and are quite unique for Nicosia. However my experience with the service was not so great. I was waiting for some time until I had to go to tell someone I had a reservation. Even though I was asked if I wanted something to drink, they didn't bring me a menu (a girl from table behind me who came 10 mins after me got a menu long before I did). I specifically asked 3 times for ice cubes and they did not bring. They also mixed up 1 order and didn't bring 1 plate but that was not a big deal in my opinion. All in all even though the quality of food was great I wouldn't go again because the service was terrible.

reviews.author: Anna Kurylo
reviews.text: A nice place with delicious food. Waiters speak English, the food is good. The indoors were fully booked when we came (12pm), but they have air conditioning even outside. Loved it.

reviews.author: Elektra Kypridemou
reviews.text: Delicious Greek food, really nice and helpful staff, cosy and warm environment. Don't hesitate to try 'portokalokrema' as a dessert. It's a unique, unforgettable experience. There is also free parking right next to the restaurant. Tip: book in advance (if possible a day before) because it's usually full. Totally recommended!!!!! I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Edy Aziz
reviews.text: Fine dining Greek taverna mix What is immediately noticeable is the casual yet sophisticated, unintrusive style of the well mannered staff, who upon receiving you start laying a few tidbits of olives and hot peppers and excellent village bread on the table (just as in a traditional taverna), and continue explaining the unusual but novel dishes (no printed menu, everything is chalked on the main wall, serving both as a giant blackboard and a design feature. Frequent changes in the choices guarantee all fresh seasonal produce, but limit quantity so be prepared to go earlier than later). The place itself doesn't boast loud decor or fancy tables and chairs, but sticks to an atmosphere that is reminiscent of old day tavernas, only it's freshly coated in white contrasting to the dark black and warm grays of floor and shelving. In general it's a cosy taverna setting. Wines are few and decent enough, the food exceptionally well prepared if you like and know Greek cuisine. Overall, an excellent choice between kitchen, ambience and price. I have been already several times, always on the spur of the moment and without having reserved beforehand (but early enough, before the night rush) and noticed the standard always remained high.

reviews.author: Giorgi Chikhladze
reviews.text: Excellent service and incredibly delicious food. I highly recommend visiting this place. The waiting time passed quickly, especially thanks to the beautiful outdoor seating area. I received my tasty meal within 12 minutes, and the prices were quite reasonable. I definitely recommend it to everyone!

reviews.author: Miloš Metlar
reviews.text: I had a lunch here with couple of friends. Restaurant is easy to find, as it is located in the busy street that leads to Turkish part of Nicosia. We were welcomed by the manager who was really outgoing person. Staff was friendly and service super fast. We got our meals in about 10-15 minutes.

reviews.author: bogdan alexandru bola
reviews.text: Extremely good food, everything was fresh and delicious, all from local producers. The staff was very friendly and helpfull and they tried their best to make us feel welcomed. The music played was live, but not too loud, so that we could talk without problems. The scenery was also like a fairytale and the local wine was just perfect. The prices aren.t as high as other places, the portions really big. So just perfect!

reviews.author: Zuzi
reviews.text: Such a lovely friendly place, we were greeted by the owner himself. We were walking down Ledra Street and wondering where to go have lunch as we were craving traditional Cypriot food and I have to say that it exceeded our expectations. The food was amazing, fresh and delicious. They also cater for vegetarians. We started with a Greek village salad and courgettes balls that came piping hot, then moved on to a mixed souvlaki dish that was scrumptious and came with fries, tzatziki and bread. Our waitress Tatia was very friendly and efficient. We were also given complimentary panna cotta for dessert and a shot of mastic liquor 😋.. We sat in the beautiful back garden which is a bonus and there was a also a singer on the Sunday who serenaded everyone with beautiful soft songs. We can't recommend this lovely restaurant enough and will definitely be back soon! Thank you Anamma!

reviews.author: Always Andri Wedding Design
reviews.text: We had an absolutely delicious light late lunch here. Had the Greek salad and mixed platter for 2, all the meats were fresh and really tasty. We sat in their back garden which was lovely too with lots of fresh plants and flowers and air conditioning. A real hidden gem.

reviews.author: Alex Siamantas
reviews.text: Zanettos is one of the oldest traditional taverns in nicosia. They serve only mest meze, which is practically everything. The quantity of food is insane, but the taste is even better! Every time i visit this place, i can't wait to come back! 5/5 from me!

reviews.author: Doc Moc
reviews.text: Mezze overkill here, ha, ha! No menue, only Mezze with >20 components. Delicious and very diverse. Definitely worth its money. As it is clearly just too much for a single person, they also feed the poor with whatever you cannot manage yourself. Support!

reviews.author: יניב דוד לוי
reviews.text: We wanted to taste traditional food. We found this place, it's a mezze taverns. Not a classic tavern but the atmosphere was great. They proposed us to take mezze menu (to be honest, i don't think they have another option of service... hahaha). The food is good and arrived in very big quantities!! 22 different mezze! The meat arrived at the end...so wait for it. We took a Rose wine, beers, soda ext... and paid 38€ each. Not the best food in town but definitely worth the experience and your money. Excellent service.

reviews.author: CAPATINA ROXANA
reviews.text: An interesting experience of Cypriot meze with a little bit of everything: salads, fresh french fries, zucchini fries, pork and chicken meat, two types of sausages, halloumi cheese, bulgur, a type of rice with spinach, olives and a good dessert. A little bit too much for two people in my opinion. I enjoyed the cozy atmosphere of their green garden terrace during our dinner time, surrounded with jasmine and trees. The food is good and fresh, and I couldn't help but notice that the terrace got crowded immediately after 7 pm, and more than half of the customers seemed to be locals, spending quality time with family on a Sunday evening, enjoying this location and the meze meals.

reviews.author: Martha Gerolemou
reviews.text: Visited this place in 2016 and was pleasantly surprised how amazing the food was. Fast forward to my next visit to Cyprus and this was on the top of my list to revisit. Let me tell you, it didn't dissapoint. Food was plentiful but all very traditional with amazing flavours. Service was great. Do your taste buds a favour and visit this place, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: paul morphew
reviews.text: Had the most amazing Meza here last night, we were a party of 4 and wanted to try proper Greek food at an original Taverna and we were not disappointed 😁 The whole meal including 2 bottles of wine was €103, talk about value for money! The owner and staff were super friendly and we thoroughly enjoyed our evening. Wish we had come here on our first day, not our last evening. Highly recommended! 👍

reviews.author: Marta Vanni
reviews.text: I would say, probably the best food we had in Paphos! the place is very cosy and very central. I really recommend :))

reviews.author: Nigel Cohen
reviews.text: What a wonderful restaurant! It is the real deal in terms of authentic Cyrpus. The setting is rustic, the owners are almost stereotypically Cypriots, slightly gruff exterior but fully accommodating to everything we asked them for. But here, food is the star. We liked it so much, we went twice. In the two meals, had greek salad, roasted sea bass (cooked to perfection), Kleftico (sublime), chicken kebab (succulent and packed with flavour) and vegetarian mousaka (out of this world). See the photos we took. Even the complimentary toast they provided had lashings of herb infused butter. Everything they served was cooked to perfection, using clearly local produce that tasted as good as food gets. Very highly recommended.

reviews.author: L H
reviews.text: A true gem in Paphos – Argo Taverna If you’re visiting Paphos and looking for a truly traditional dining experience, Argo Taverna is an absolute must. The food was simply delightful – fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully prepared. The service was just as impressive: friendly, genuine, and welcoming without being overbearing. You can tell the staff truly care about their guests and are proud of what they offer. It’s this combination of authentic service and outstanding food that makes Argo stand out. It’s the best traditional place we’ve eaten at in Paphos – a place you’ll want to return to again and again. We had Stifado, The Ribs, Calamari and Octopus, with sweet ending of baklava and pancakes. A Must visit!!

reviews.author: Bar Abergel
reviews.text: Best of the best! Super fresh, kind and professional service. Thank you for the great time❤️❤️🙏

reviews.author: iole gravina
reviews.text: THE REAL AND AUTHENTIC GREEK CUSINE. we arrived here our first night in Paphos for hazard and it was an incredible surprise. A warm welcome from the owner and the staff. We tried some of the best zucchini balls ever and also the meze was super good. Also the fish was fresh and tasty. We went back also another day. Highly recommended, the atmosphere was nice as well. Thank you for make us feeling home

reviews.author: fede rico
reviews.text: Meze in paphos very good.i've take the meze menu with meat ( 26 €) and my wife veg meze (19€).Abundant dishes in the center of old town paphos,maybe not the cheaper but a lot of small tastings very delicious.service was ok( it was tuesday evening ). I approved, pay attention at the drinks( 6 € beer,3€ water)

reviews.author: James Lambert
reviews.text: We asked the staff at the hotel to recommend a local place that is not geared up for tourist and they recommended this place. We had the meat meze and it was lovely, the food just keeps on coming. All seating was outside and there is a nice area away from the road for kids to run around and play so you can keep an eye on them. Nice water feature and greenery to look at whilst eating. The couple next to us was complaining that the service was bad because they didn't keep coming over and asking if everything was ok or if they wanted more drinks. I explained to them that's not how it works, they are people that like to leave you to enjoy your meal without being pestered every 5 mins but if you want or need something just ask. Would highly recommend this place to others.

reviews.author: Thomas Maple
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful restaurant in the middle of Pafos town. Recommended by the Rough Guide and a taxi driver, this place is divine. Fresh food and ingredients, numerous courses as part of the Meze and not a bad dish amongst them. Don't settle for the numerous genetic restaurants catering for tourists. Go get some proper authentic Cypriot food. And make Fettas your first stop. I've given 4 stars for service and atmosphere not 5 as we were tucked away on the edge of the terrace and got forgotten at the beginning. But they soon made up for it! Oh and minus points for not knowing George Michael, or that he was half Cypriot!

reviews.author: Al C (alcoh.h)
reviews.text: Recommended to us by our local taxi driver for the meze, he said it’s where all the locals in the old town go, himself included. There was live music, helpful staff, plenty of food and drink and a really nice atmosphere. There is no menu here for food or drink, or at least there wasn’t when we went, but there is the choice of vegetarian or meat meze, a variety of beers and wine, as well as desserts. The plates just keep coming, so we didn’t have any room for dessert, but the mains were brilliant. I wouldn’t say the baked feta with honey was worth paying extra for, but only because there is so much choice already. At the end of the evening, the owner ordered a taxi for us, and whilst people were waiting for a table, we were never rushed off of ours, even when we just had drinks left.

reviews.author: Liudmila L
reviews.text: Went there recently with my family and absolutely loved it! The dishes were super original with really cool flavor combos – everything tasted amazing. The truffle oil was a nice touch and made the food even more special. Great vibes, friendly staff, and just an all-around awesome experience. Would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Khalid Al-Ghanim
reviews.text: The best dining experience we had in Paphos. A beautiful restaurant that feels like you are in a movie set or a painting. Lovely building surrounded by trees and and cats! The food was tender and delicious. Can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Marina S
reviews.text: An absolute gem. Every dish we tried was outstanding — from the vibrant green salad and baked halloumi with honey to the perfectly cooked fish, tender calamari, and flavorful fava. We especially loved the cauliflower dish — a real standout. The atmosphere is warm and unique in terms of decor, and the staff are welcoming and attentive. Booking is essential — and well worth it.

reviews.author: tessa varnava
reviews.text: A personal favourite! Every dish is simply exquisite! Im always amazed every time we go. Well done to the chef! and service staff are always incredibly warm and super professional - not seen much in Cyprus!

reviews.author: Sandra Björg
reviews.text: I had the most amazing night at this restaurant! I honestly had no idea what to expect—I just saw the great reviews and decided to give it a shot. And wow, it completely exceeded every expectation. After 10 days of traveling around the island, this was hands down the best meal I’ve had. The food, the atmosphere, the service—everything was spot on. If you’re in Paphos, do not miss this place. In fact, it’s worth traveling to Paphos just to eat here. It won’t let you down!

reviews.author: Khalid Al-Ghanim
reviews.text: The vibe is very cool. The view of Paphos was beautiful. The food is good, nothing special, but good. The beef souvlaki was cooked to my liking and the portion was generous considering the price!

reviews.author: Angel T
reviews.text: Muse was the last place in Paphos we visited before flying back home. I wish we had gone sooner! The food was so good. The stars of the show are the Green tagliatelle Scallops and the Apple Pie(one of the best I’ve ever had)

reviews.author: Mark Harrop
reviews.text: Gorgeous sunset setting. Food well priced and great sized portions. A must go for an evening sunset. Recommend making a reservation for the best tables which look to the sea.

reviews.author: Monika Lasic
reviews.text: stumbled upon this restaurant recently while visiting upper town Paphos, very pleasantly greeted by friendly staff,the food was outrageously delicious, and the view was something! we ate simple Greek food,but with a slight modern take,just a few tweaks elevated the simple chicken souvlaki with chips into a lunch to remember. Chic and modern,white,bright and refreshingly laid back and casual...must try if you are there!

reviews.author: Tal German
reviews.text: The food isn't great, the quality of the ingredients is ok at best, but the dishes weren't made thoughtfully and the preparation doesn't make up for it either. We ate 4 dishes- Salmon tartar - the salmon comes with avocado and caviar - both of them fishy and fatty like the salmon which led to y unbalanced dish (why not add something fresh, crispy, sweet, hot/spicy or nutty? Nuts, herbs, fruits, chives). Scallop pasta - the pasta was good with a nice bite and had ok sauce, unfortunately, the scallops were big and had potential but missed any sear at all and a little bit undercooked, generally the dish needed salt. Sear the scallop. Both of the dishes were served with the same tasteless foam. Chicken with cheese sauce- somehow this was the best dish- the chicken breast was juicy and tasteful, in itself, the sauce was delicious. The vegetables it was served with, had no unique features and were boring with no connection with one other. Sometimes less is more - maybe use asparagus, leaks, or spring peas. Beef fillet - the beef was ok quality but very pricey, it was tender but tasteless with the same boring eclectic vegetables. A fatty tangy sauce would have been in use here. All and all the experience wasn't great. No one gave a shit if we liked our food or needed anything, sometimes waiting a couple of minutes without being noticed. I recommend changing some cooking methods and ingredients to be a really good restaurant because it is a nice place to sit down and it appears like somebody is trying to give you a good food experience but doesn't know how to.

name: Street Food - Harbour Kiosk
address: Street Food - Harbour Kiosk, Paphos, Cyprus

reviews.author: Ian Ager
reviews.text: Friendly service. I bought gallons of mineral water here on my holiday.

reviews.author: Jeremiah poole
reviews.text: Booked a wavedancer boat trip here whilst on my travels It was special I ate most of the BBQ meat on offer Has a pee in the sea Special 🐻🚣🏼🍗

reviews.author: Michael Sch
reviews.text: Fraud. They hate customers. Absurd prices

reviews.author: Patrik Černohorský
reviews.text: It has great escape routes

reviews.author: Muhsin Khan
reviews.text: Nice products

reviews.author: Khalid Al-Ghanim
reviews.text: The vibe is very cool. The view of Paphos was beautiful. The food is good, nothing special, but good. The beef souvlaki was cooked to my liking and the portion was generous considering the price!

reviews.author: V T
reviews.text: Really nice interior and decor, quick service, and the staff always looked out for you. Ribeye steak was alright, really nice garlic prawns, and the veg platter had a few different options, which was a nice change from generic veg platters elsewhere. Run out of kids' burgers, so we had to order nuggets instead, plastic plates, and cutlery for the shared starters for the little ones, which is a nice touch. Really busy and lively atmosphere.Some things on the menu may be a bit overpriced for what they are.

reviews.author: Simina Mihuta
reviews.text: Listen, this might be the best restaurant in Paphos. My husband and I ate here twice during our vacation in the summer of 2025. The first time, we had fish and seafood: the Wild Coast Whole Fish (sea bream stuffed with herbs and grilled) and the Cape Seafood Platter (a mix of tiger prawns, squid, mussels, and a piece of Nile perch—this dish could easily feed two people). The second time, we decided to try “the meats” and ordered the Lodge African Mezze, which includes a variety of salads and meats served one after another (check their menu for details). Although it’s listed as a meal for two, the portions are so generous that four people could be satisfied. If it’s just the two of you, don’t order anything extra. We made that mistake by also ordering the bone marrow (which was excellent, by the way), but it was simply too much food. Also, if you enjoy great wines, The Lodge won’t disappoint. We only tried the local house wines by the glass, but they were absolutely amazing.

reviews.author: Jacob Addis
reviews.text: What a find! Brilliant food, great service! Don’t be put off by the name, the monkey gland sauce is great - hard to explain, almost similar to a Jack Daniel’s sauce if you’re from the UK. Steak was slightly overdone for both but still plenty tender and didn’t have any effect on the meal, it tasted great! Still the best meal we have had on our trip! I’m gonna have to try squeeze in one more trip here before we leave in a few days! There is a car park to the side/rear of the restaurant however it is small so you may struggle (we took the last space when we went) - however there is on street parking etc so I don’t think you’d struggle. If you’re thinking of going, go!

reviews.author: Philip Belshaw
reviews.text: Went on the reviews of others and wasn't disappointed, we hadn't booked and it was a Friday night the receptionist was very helpful and managed to get us in but had to leave at a certain time so we missed the starters. Pictures posted are a 400g and 500g ribeye cooked to perfection but be aware listen to your waiter or waitress as they cook them slightly different. The staff were excellent and very helpful if you are in Paphos give it a try. The downside is it's not the cheapest but worth it for the ambience and friendliness of the staff.

reviews.author: Rachel Carr
reviews.text: My partner and I had an absolutely lovely meal here while on our holiday. The food was absolutely delicious, the service was excellent, and the restaurant was spotlessly clean. I had the half rack of ribs which as you can see from the photo was a hefty portion and my partner had the burger which he said was one of the best he’d had. The meat was clearly very high quality, cared about, and was all very reasonably priced. We also shared the wings and the boerewor sausage to start which were again excellent, really well seasoned. Washed down with some lovely wine, it was a great meal. If we’re ever back in Cyprus this restaurant will definitely be top of our list to return to!

reviews.author: Deborah A S
reviews.text: Good choice of food. Most of the service was good. However, some of the waiters would lean over other people's food at our table to serve the others in the group. When asked not to do that, another member of staff said it was OK. Staff need to be trained on how to serve food correctly. The fish attracted lots of flies. As this place is in the tourist area, it is expensive for what you get.

reviews.author: D. Dr. G.
reviews.text: Our entire family absolutely loved Kara’s Dish Tavern in Kapparis, Paralimni. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, creating the perfect setting for a relaxing and enjoyable meal. The food was truly excellent – fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. We would easily give it five stars! What made our visit even more special was the incredibly friendly and welcoming staff, who made us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. We can wholeheartedly and unreservedly recommend this taverna to anyone looking for a fantastic dining experience. We will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Darya Popova
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience at this seafood restaurant in Cyprus! Everything was incredibly fresh and delicious — from the appetizers to the main dishes. The service was absolutely wonderful, and we were especially touched by our waiter, Christos, who was exceptionally warm, caring, and attentive. He made us feel truly welcome and added a very special touch to our evening. The interior of the restaurant is beautifully designed, creating a cozy and elegant atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-quality seafood and heartfelt hospitality!

reviews.author: chris chalkley
reviews.text: A really lovely restaurant, the food was amazing and the atmosphere was great. Staff were very friendly and attentive, helping members of my group who couldn't decide what they wanted. Plenty to eat for non fish eaters but the seafood is what this place is really about.

reviews.author: Fran Taylor
reviews.text: Christopher was phenomenal! His knowledge and recommendations truly elevated our experience. He was not only charming but also incredibly attentive, making us feel genuinely cared for throughout the evening. The service was exceptional, and the entire night was simply delightful. We'll absolutely be returning!

reviews.author: G N
reviews.text: Nice traditional tavern with traditional deco, very welcoming owner and his family, and lots of lovely kittens and cats! Food is very delicious, some dishes are made with home grown products! Worth a try!

reviews.author: Kev in
reviews.text: An unforgettable experience If hospitality had an address, it would be the Ploumin Tavern in Sotira. This wonderful restaurant is more than just a place to eat - it is a piece of living tradition, a home away from home. From the moment we stepped inside, we were not only warmly welcomed, but greeted with a warmth and openness that you only find in a true family business. The owner, a true passionate host, made our evening an unforgettable experience. The food? A feast for the senses! The traditional dishes, prepared with love and perfection, not only tasted delicious, but also told stories about Cypriot culture and cuisine. Every ingredient, every spice was perfectly balanced and reflected the dedication with which people cook here. It was an honor to eat in the family's room. Thank you for everything. Luna & Kevin Germany

reviews.author: Alice Luker
reviews.text: Disappointing service, ok food. They didn’t seem to have the service under control. Lots of dishes flittering around the tables, many of which were wrong- not just for our table but others too. There were errors in our starters and mains, 1 in the starters and almost all of them in mains, despite the waiter writing them down from our phone when we initially ordered. It felt poorly managed and disorganised, which is a shame as it’s a lovely venue. Very atmospheric, nice music, layout etc. None of the dishes were standout delicious, they were mostly good. The chicken dish was disappointing. Lots of room for improvement. If I’m honest. 40 euros for two sharing a customised mezze, 2 mini bottles of wine and coffee.

reviews.author: Georgia Georgiou
reviews.text: As a Cypriot Aussie visiting Cyprus, this was hands down one of the best dining experiences I’ve had! A truly traditional Cypriot taverna — the food was absolutely excellent, authentically Cypriot, and cooked to perfection. Portions were generous and every dish felt like it was made with real care. But what really stood out was the genuine filoxenia — the hospitality here is second to none. The staff were so welcoming, happy to have a chat, and you could tell they genuinely cared about their customers having a good experience. The atmosphere was warm, lively, and full of heart. If you’re looking for a place that offers not just great food, but a real taste of Cyprus with all the warmth that comes with it, this is it. Can’t recommend it highly enough!

reviews.author: Jessica Robinson
reviews.text: Hidden gem found about a 20 minute drive from Protaras! Definitely worth a car, or taxi ride to this beautiful traditional Greek tavern! The food was delicious and authentic and hospitality was flawless! We enjoyed it so much, we came back on the second night! Everytime was fresh and grilled to perfection! A lovely find on our holiday - thank you very much for our two lovely evenings! We left very full and happy! Will definitely visit again!

reviews.author: Panayiotis JT
reviews.text: Parking was hard to find but as you can see in the picture by the time we finished it started to empty. The restaurant is situated along a river which they use to farm their own fresh Trout. My wife had the Trout and chips and I had the Lamb Kleftiko but unfortunately by the time we got there the roast potatoes had run out so they brought the dish with chips which was slightly disappointing. Chairs uncomfortable and service very slow so if you plan to eat here make sure to arrive early and to be patient with the service. Overall the food was nice and the fresh air even better.

reviews.author: Gazza Meg
reviews.text: Went with my family for the first time it's an old place in the forest next to a river they r welcoming and the food was actually really good. I had the lamb souvla which was delicious. Generous amount of fries with it. The eggplant and tzatziki dip were also very good so I believe they were made by the chef and not out of a tub. Recommended

reviews.author: Katrina D
reviews.text: The restaurant has a chill vibe. As part of our tour, they provided halloumi and grapes on the house which were very good. We also got spicy chicken wings as starters and fresh chicken with chips. The starter was good, however the fresh chicken with chips wasn’t the best. Servings are, however generous.

reviews.author: George L
reviews.text: I recently dined at Psilo Dentro restaurant and found it to be in an idyllic location, nestled close to the serene Caledonia waterfall. The calming atmosphere added to the dining experience. The service was relatively efficient, considering the crowd. The fish was skillfully cooked and delicious, though the presence of bones was a minor inconvenience. However, the restaurant's biggest drawback was its evident state of disrepair. The outdated premises, which haven't seen updates since its opening years ago, were a noticeable downside. A score of three out of five seems fair, with potential for improvement through much-needed upkeep and modernization.

reviews.author: Natasa B.
reviews.text: A nice place, under the forest trees, to enjoy a fresh grilled trout for 18.50. Served with fries or boiled potatoes... Nice village salad also.

reviews.author: Nandia Christophi
reviews.text: The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. The food is high quality and absolutely delicious. As someone who doesn’t usually enjoy meat, I was surprised by how much I loved it here everything was cooked to perfection!🤌🏽

reviews.author: Panayiotis JT
reviews.text: I asked the local lotto shop owner were do you eat and he referred us to this place. Parking there is a lot and easy. Service was very slow which you got the feeling that they couldn't be bothered to serve you. For starters we ordered the garlic mushrooms which was nice. We ordered the Koubebia (dolmades) and a lasagna for main dishes. The Koubebia and the lasagna meat inside both tasted off so we did not eat the dishes paid and left. Will not be visiting here again.

reviews.author: Kyriakos Kyriakides
reviews.text: We phoned them beforehand to inquire if there was space for our group. They reassured us there was. When we arrived they very rudely told us there was no space so we ended up waiting. When we sat down we weren't acknowledged until we asked to be with the response "just wait" said with an aggressive tone. When it was time to order they just told us "Mezes" was not an option. We had to ask multiple times for them to list what was actually available. We ended up leaving.

reviews.author: רחל מלבסקי
reviews.text: Beautiful authentic place with friendly owners, effective and fast service, and food is another thing… I rarely compliment restaurants in Cyprus but this one is ten out of five. The produce is fresh, well seasoned and masterfully cooked, huge portions. Our second time here and the restaurant doesn’t leave place for doubt that it is one of the best in Cyprus.

reviews.author: Elena HadjiAntoniou
reviews.text: Review update July 2022. Staff was very unfriendly and impolite and prices were dear and didn’t respond to the menu’s price list and not in a good way. We ended up paying more of course because of that. Ticket attached for price range.

reviews.author: Kimberly Victoria Vaglio
reviews.text: The food was fresh and delicious. All the flavours and doses were well-balanced and of quality. The service is great, being a family business you can tell the owners love their restaurant and the atmosphere also reflects that, as it is very cozy and classily put together. The music is also very pleasant. Side note: have the pourekias as they are crunchy, not too sweet and well-filled! My compliments to the chef and owners :) *Added photos are half-eaten as it was very yummy

reviews.author: Dr.Illusion
reviews.text: The location and the view was great but unfortunately they basically had not alot of grilled food options on the day we went. We asked for a couple of them but they only had sausages that day. Overall it was a nice experience but we didn’t end up ordering what we wanted.

reviews.author: Marianna Panayi
reviews.text: Service and food was great. 4,5/5 because in my opinion the pork chops and the kotsi were overcooked. It was a meat meze, so we didn’t get any mushrooms, potatoes, or halloumi. However, the food was more than enough and perfect in general. Must visit!!!

reviews.author: Roberto De Gennaro
reviews.text: Very traditional cypriot cuisine with reasonable price and beautiful atmosphere. I would highly recommend this place, especially the "stifado," which is like a beef stew cooked in red wine and vinegar. We ordered 3 mains, a salad for 2 (village salad) and 2 drinks and we only paid 50 euros. (You can check the bill in my pictures) Around the area, there are also nice hiking trails and plenty of free street car parking

reviews.author: Angélika Lessani
reviews.text: Very cute traditional and familial restaurant, the service was fast, very decent price, nice view on the mountains! Highly recommended !

reviews.author: Anna Maria Bla
reviews.text: This is certainly a gem of the town! We enjoyed two dinners here and everything was perfect. The restaurant opens at 7 pm and is quickly full on weekend. We ordered grilled octopus and squid the first time, and chose to go with starters (octopus, mussels, fried squid and salad) the next day. The portions are big and so yummy, food is fresh, the staff is nice and kind and the atmosphere is great!

reviews.author: Bob Spence
reviews.text: Excellent restaurant for fish. The muscles were very good and the swordfish steak was delicious, melt in your mouth. Chunky chips were the biggest I've seen very tasty. Will be returning very soon. Highly recommended. Great service by friendly staff.

reviews.author: Panagiotis Oikonomopoulos
reviews.text: Best fish on the island! Fresh fish and seafood every day. The owner is such an amazingly friendly person! Food is excellent, fresh, delicious. English spoken staff, quick service and fair prices; this is what somebody needs :) high recommended

reviews.author: Jemma Chamberlain-Webber
reviews.text: A must go the area! Amazingly fresh fish that you can pick out yourself. Delicious sides and huge portions. Great service and family run authentic vibes!

reviews.author: Julie Oakeley
reviews.text: Good food cooked well, we opted for a whole snapper accompanied by village salad , dips, cous cous and chips! The snapper was delicious, simply cooked , so fresh no more than a splash of oil and a squeeze of lemon were needed to enhance its flavour !

reviews.author: Craig Snowling
reviews.text: The reviews about this restaurant are spot on, simply delightful place to dine. The food was exceptional, we were made to feel really welcome, I don’t say this lightly but if you are able to then dine here. Absolutely no complaints. The meat meze my son and I shared was delicious and the dishes simply kept on coming. I look at reviews when deciding where to dine and we were all impressed. Miss this place and it’s your loss.

reviews.author: Dr Jamie Smith
reviews.text: Moustakallis Tavern is an essential visit for anyone in the area who wants to experience authentic local food cooked in a traditional way. The menu is great and the quality of the food is excellent, fresh and well presented. The restaurant is stylish in design and spacious and the staff are super helpful and welcoming. Highly recommend a visit.

reviews.author: Hemi J
reviews.text: Fantastic!! Once of my favorite restaurants I’ve visited in Cyprus! 🇨🇾 Andreas and family are super friendly and welcoming, the food is quick, super fresh and tasty. I have visited on numerous occasions and would certainly be back!

reviews.author: Zlatin Mladenski
reviews.text: A nice Cypriot atmosphere with both seats inside and outside. The old owner of the place is all the time around and attracts the attention. The Souvlaki was a bit dry and you need sauces to be able to eat it. The french fries and the sea food were good. The place seems to be more convenient for groups of at least 4-5 people because of the spacious terrace and the big tables.

reviews.author: Bernd Kluth
reviews.text: How can you make a guest 100% happy ?! Of course first with an aperitif called “Ouzo Special”, then a delicious appetizer of various kinds, a main course such as “Octopus”, for dessert of course a delicious juicy sweet orange, and all this framed in a romantic place right next to the fireplace and looked after by a courteous friendly team and their Bosses. We were guests there 4 times and can only report positive things and will definitely stop there again on our next Cyprus vacation.

reviews.author: Anna Maria Bla
reviews.text: This is certainly a gem of the town! We enjoyed two dinners here and everything was perfect. The restaurant opens at 7 pm and is quickly full on weekend. The portions are big and so yummy, food is fresh, the staff is nice and kind and the atmosphere is great!

reviews.author: Marcin Wiewióra
reviews.text: Today we spent nice evening there. The Sea Bream was delicious. The Staff fullfilled Pie needs. Recommend to everyone !

reviews.author: George Mallouppas
reviews.text: Poor quality. Slow service. Ordered very expensive fish and fried squid. We were reassured that the fish and squid were fresh, but was not. Probably cooked the day before. Unacceptable for the price you pay. Shame about the view.

reviews.author: tigrul carpatin
reviews.text: Everything is fresh. They are wonderful host and they keep the kitchen doors always open to see how the food is cooked if you want. Until the food is served they give you butter and toasted bread and after you finish the lunch, you receive some sweet specialities on the house.

reviews.author: Evgeniy Bolbot
reviews.text: One of the best fish menu in Protaras. Finally found the place in Protaras which I will visit again. The food was fresh and tasty.

reviews.author: Emma Martin
reviews.text: I found this restaurant via the Daxi Holiday Guide and was glad I did. Great food and friendly staff in a lovely location right on the Protaras to Pernera boardwalk.

reviews.author: Alexander Latishenok
reviews.text: We had a very nice meal at Vangelis. We were very hungry and ordered two meals mix grill and sea food plater. First was brought home made bread with salty butter. Perfect to start your stomach working and after those delicious sets came. All was fresh, tasty and tender. We were fully satisfied. The only point I would say to me the sea food set could be a bit more salty but it’s a matter is taste. Will come again to try something else. The personnel were friendly and polite 🙏👍

reviews.author: Balazs Szabo
reviews.text: We had a lovely lunch here, the stifado and the moussaka were fantastic, the portions were huge. The staff were very friendly and very polite. The restaurant is right on the busy Main Street of Protaras, easy to find. It also has tables in the back, facing the sea (much better view than the street). I highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Mia Fitzpatrick
reviews.text: Incredible food, lovely service and great value! We went here 3 times on the week we stayed all the food was incredible and the dips come with the best freshly baked bread I’ve ever had!

reviews.author: Zsofia Barocsi
reviews.text: It was our first time at Vangelis Tavern. I think I had the best moussaka ever here. We all enjoyed our food. I also tried some of the mixed meze that my friends ordered, and they were all excellent. If only your chairs were a bit more comfortable.

reviews.author: Širín Ježková
reviews.text: We had such a great time at this restaurant! The lamb Kleftiko and chicken souvlaki were amazing—so tender and full of flavor. The staff were super friendly and welcoming, and it was really nice to hear how much the owners care about them and create a good atmosphere. The place was clean, cozy, and had a great vibe. And the best part? They even made us a special dessert just because! Definitely a spot we’ll come back to.

reviews.author: V Y
reviews.text: Fantastic outdoor meze dining, everything you could ask for. We had an amazing evening that this local restaurant. Ordered the meze for 3 and the food was plentiful and absolutely delicious. Amazing value for money. Staff was really good and attentive with us. I would highly recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Emmanouela K
reviews.text: The best food ever, we loved the halloumi (homemade!), the Kleftiko and everything we ordered. Best service, great quality and professionalism! Well done! You are an amazing team! We will definitely come back soon!

reviews.author: Suzana Kedron
reviews.text: An out of the way local gem. They serve up all the local favorites on a charming outdoor setting. Pave yourself you will certainly not leave hungry.

reviews.author: Petros R.
reviews.text: GOOD TAVERNA We visited on a Friday night as a party of 6. The place was packed. Service was fast and attentive and food didn’t take long to arrive. The place is full of huge fans that give a nice breeze. All of the food items are good, however there are no “wow” dishes. Vibes could be better if there was live music. Good prices

reviews.author: Maroun Younan
reviews.text: A must try when in Cyprus. The restaurant is an old house. The chef helped us to avoid over ordering. The mezze was amazing. The food was so good and good quantities. The service was not the best, maybe because they were full. Like they never refilled our glasses of wine. They even got fewer glasses. They didn't clean the table until we were standing and leaving. But still a must visit

reviews.author: Sea Sun And Chilies M
reviews.text: 2.9 review and still seat here because I didn't want to belive it well I'm believe now ... Check that amazing sandwich for 6 euro ?? Cmon people is that for real ??

reviews.author: Potato Chucks
reviews.text: Quick stop here after a long drive from Paphos to the highest point of mount olympos. Service was quick, food options average. Ordered ham sandwich, burger also ordered but chips need to be ordered separately. Ham sandwich lovely, but very dry. Just meat and bread, no sauce. Ham tasted nice. Good views of mountains. Overall, the restaurant is a bit outdated, with average food. Could do with some love on both areas.

reviews.author: ülosoft hd
reviews.text: I can honestly say this place certainly isn’t worth just 2.9 stars out of 5. The food was delicious. Nothing was bad. The service was pretty nice, foods arrived in a very reasonable time. None of the items we ordered were forgot. The atmosphere was ideal for me. The snowy view outside the window was gorgeous. Beef stew was a solid 10/10. The menu was local and the salad was very fresh. Recommended by me.

reviews.author: Tim Katsapas
reviews.text: Terrible food. Do not eat here. We ordered the pork souvlakia and it was horrible. I couldn't even eat one piece. It literally tasted like nothing. The hotdogs we ordered were horrible quality, they just fell apart. Lastly we ordered a cappuccino, and I think bath water would taste better. Highly disappointed and would never return. The view was good, and the service was decent - he was friendly enough

reviews.author: Andreas Santis
reviews.text: A perfect location of the restaurant but unfortunately the people who serves in the restaurant don’t know anything about service at all. It is not an issue to have Chinese or Bangladeshi servers but at least teach them how they should take the food order from the clients and how they should serve the food. I am really wondering if the owner is Cypriot.

reviews.author: Richard Webster
reviews.text: This place is a must if you have access to a car to drive up. The roads are very good although you do sometimes feel like your driving through someone's back yard at times but the views and the lovely little towns that you stumble across and don't be afraid to stop and grab a coffee and cake they are always welcoming.

reviews.author: Nada Khaled
reviews.text: A must do experience if you’re visiting Cyprus, it took us 2 hrs from protaras but road up and down is perfectly safe with lots of shops and restaurants in the way , amazing waterfalls stops in the way up ad well, free parking slots as well

reviews.author: Anna I
reviews.text: No visit to Cyprus is complete without at least one visit to the Troodos region. Lots of Monasteries, Churches, historic/cultural sites, picnic areas, wineries, hiking areas, tavernas, etc. The weather is cooler (and sometimes cold), and the vibe is completely different from that of the beaches. In the beach areas, only a small percentage of the people one encounters are actually Cypriot, but the mountains attract a lot of internal tourism, so one encounters a lot more locals. If you ask a Cypriot where they personally prefer to visit on a day trip, Troodos is likely to top the list.

reviews.author: Yanni
reviews.text: The Troodos Mountains in Cyprus offer a refreshing escape with their cool climate, picturesque villages, and rich history. Here’s a review based on visitor experiences: Troodos Mountains: A natural wonderland, the Troodos range is the largest mountain range in Cyprus and is renowned for its biodiversity and geology. It’s a perfect destination for nature lovers, hikers, and those interested in geotourism. The area is dotted with charming villages, Byzantine monasteries, and churches that are part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Activities: Visitors can enjoy a range of activities from skiing in the winter at Mount Olympus, the highest peak, to exploring nature trails, waterfalls, and the local flora and fauna in the summer. The region is also known for its wine routes, offering a taste of the local viticulture. The Troodos Mountains are highly appreciated for their natural beauty and cultural significance. A day to remember, brilliant views and natural waterfalls. Accessibility: The mountains are accessible by car, and there are accommodations and restaurants catering to various tastes and budgets. Whether you’re seeking adventure, relaxation, or cultural enrichment, the Troodos Mountains provide a memorable experience for all who visit. Enjoy your trip to this enchanting part of Cyprus! 🌲🏔️

reviews.author: R J
reviews.text: A very long and bendy road slowly gets you to the mountains. They're very high, and the views are excellent. There are several view points, waterfalls and stops on the way. These include toilets. Walking boots are advised. It's not always snowy at the top, but its decidedly colder, so bring warmer clothes. Some places get very busy, so plan your route. You can do many walks, or simply stop and view, the road is a loop, so its easy to find. Sadly many cats in the mountains.
