reviews.author: Sema Arslan
reviews.text: That’s one of the best restaurants in Alexandria to taste all special Egyptian food I think, their small dishes as appetizers were really tasteful and the bread comes like balloon right away from oven feels so warm. The waitresses are always helpful, the only thing should be improved about the areas with smoking or not smoking I know generally smoking is allowed in Egypt inside but specially as tourists with kids we are not used to this and children at least could be kept away from the smoke and the lady in restrooms who holds the toilet paper, please just put the toilet papers inside no need for holding a lady inside to give me the toilet paper this feels awkward for 2025 and about hygiene. Other than this about the food everything was perfect. We visited one time for fish and another time for beef side both experience was really valuable 💐

reviews.author: Dr.Ahmed Farhoud
reviews.text: One of the best places where you can have grilled meat and traditional dishes, the resturant is newly opened in this new location that is why GPS can mislead your direction . The place is clean ,tidy ,well organized and the owner is present and supervise the servers as well as greet the customers ,Food was delicious as well as salad ,Servers were fast and helpfull and smiling .value over money is very good.

reviews.author: Omar Karaa
reviews.text: It’s just that it was too expensive for the huge unnecessary quantity I believe. Although I feel like the meal in Egypt is bigger than the usual for me.

reviews.author: Aisha Alyaarobi
reviews.text: One of the most spacious restaurants I’ve ever been to, place is so huge and busy, but still the service on point and timely. Before ordering, we chose the types of fish we would like to eat, and after it was measured and all, we were seated, and everything was served in order. Starting with soup and appetizers followed by fried shrimps, the grilled shrimps we chose, and last the main fish dish and later we ordered mint tea and everything was perfect, delicious, and fresh. Recommended. The place is whole experience on its own, and prices are reasonable looking at service and quality of food.

reviews.author: Αχμάντ σε όλο τον κόσμο
reviews.text: One of the best restaurants in Alexandria! The food is delicious, and the service is excellent. I will definitely come back again.

reviews.author: Mohamed Raafat
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Ernesto Santibanez
reviews.text: Great seafood restaurant with lots of seafood options. You will be asked to select the seafood before sitting down, seafood is then weighted and either grilled or pan-fried. The place is popular among tourists. Food was fresh, staff spike English and they accepted cards.

reviews.author: Nader Malek
reviews.text: It would be easy to walk past this restaurant but that would be a mistake. The staff will help select a fresh fish which they will expertly season and bbq. The result is a delicious meal and a wonderful memory. We had the barbecued sea bass with tombe. Absolutely delightful. Thank you.

reviews.author: Ines
reviews.text: It's was DELICIOUS ! I loved and enjoyed every bite yummy I'll definitely come back

reviews.author: Joanna McLaughlin
reviews.text: One of our favourite meals in Egypt! In comparison to a lot of the seafood restaurants in Alexandria, we found this restaurant to offer fantastic value for money. The owner had excellent English and explained all the options to us, weighing up and pricing each of our picks in turn. We particularly loved the grilled sea bass and prawns but also really enjoyed all the sides that came with the meal including a really yummy aubergine dish. We visited twice during the three nights we spent in Alexandria and we would highly recommend.

reviews.author: shee
reviews.text: Had a delightful experience at this seafood restaurant! The fresh seafood selection is impressive, and the grilled seabass was delicious, and the butter prawn was also fresh and flavorful. The seafood creme soup was rich and flavorful with fresh seafood treasures inside. Prices are in the middle range, making it a reasonable choice. Despite the language barrier, the staff was friendly and accommodating. This restaurant is definitely worth a visit!

reviews.author: Princess
reviews.text: If i could give them 10 stars I would, I am very impressed by the delicious taste of their food. I ordered clams and seabream I was enjoying every bit. The lemon butter sauce is exceptional yummy yummy. If you're seafood lover you must go there and thank me later! I would definitely go again and again any time I visit Bahrain. Thank you for the warm welcome by the staff and lovely hosts who served me ☺️🙌

reviews.author: Alexei Moiseyev
reviews.text: It's an absolutely delightful experience. The service is exceptional. The views from the terrace that envelopes the restaurant are splendid. The menu and the wine list are perfectly designed. Fresh seafood can be selected from the ice-lined display to be prepared in various ways. I've gone for a butterfly hamour simply grilled. ...an absolute delight!

reviews.author: Saud Al-Subaie
reviews.text: At the fish market resturant, you choose your seafood fish, shrimps, crabs, and seashell and how you want them to be cooked. Variety of recipes available with extra appetisers of your choice. The views around by the sea are beautiful. The service is good. But this resturant is unbelievably overpriced!

reviews.author: Zaid Al-Asa'd
reviews.text: The Fish Market restaurant offers an unforgettable dining experience that I highly recommend. From the moment you step in, the ambiance is charming, with an open and fresh design that enhances the experience. The highlight, of course, is the seafood, which is not only fresh but prepared with incredible skill. Every dish I tried was bursting with flavor, from the perfectly grilled shrimp to the deliciously fresh sea mussels. The variety on the menu caters to all preferences, ensuring that everyone finds something they love. What really sets the Fish Market apart is its exceptional service. The staff is attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable, making excellent recommendations without being overbearing. You can tell they take pride in what they do, which makes the meal that much more enjoyable. And then there’s the view – simply breathtaking. The restaurant overlooks a serene waterfront, making it the perfect spot for a romantic evening or a relaxing lunch. Whether you're a seafood lover or just looking for a unique dining experience, the Fish Market delivers on all fronts. It’s a place I can’t wait to visit again.

reviews.author: Karim Mouawad
reviews.text: We really enjoyed having lunch there. The food was delicious. Great to be able to enjoy their food as we usually enjoyed at their original branch in Al Bander Resort. It gave us the opportunity to enjoy it in downtown Bahrain Bay. Had the salad, shrimps, crab, silous and sea bream which were all delissssssh!! Thank you! ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Lilith
reviews.text: The ambience and view were beautiful. The decoration has been tastefully done, and there is a nice view of the city, sea and Fort. Unfortunately, though I was not very impressed with the food. The seafood was not seasoned, and the rice was extremely plain.

reviews.author: Ara Jherielle
reviews.text: This is a must-visit restaurant. Amazing place. You can enjoy the variety of seafood within your budget. 👍🏻 And a relaxing view of the sea. 🌊

reviews.author: DMK
reviews.text: Popular waterfront eatery at which you could either take your time and choose your catch on display to be prepared for you, or rely on expert chefs to deliver house specials at a quicker turnaround. We like seafood so we really enjoyed this place. This restaurant is frequented equally by both international tourists and local clientele who value the quality offerings of this unique venue.

reviews.author: sky Forhad
reviews.text: It's a seafood Fish Market Marina in Alexander The fish soup was different from what we're used to, as it had shrimp in it. It was a delicious soup with plenty of ingredients. Afterwards, we ordered grilled fish. It came with fried calamari and rice, but the fish was undercooked. At first, I thought this might be how Egyptians prepare fish, but then I realized it was just mine that was like that. When I asked for it to be changed, they sent a new plate. The taste was quite good. There were 4-5 different kinds of mezes, and the ones with garlic and eggplant were my favorites. Warm mini pitas were also served with the dishes. The staff were served at a normal pace. The place was large but noisy. However, the view was amazing. You could watch the calm waters of the Mediterranean from anywhere in the restaurant.

reviews.author: I. Morgan
reviews.text: The Mina District Fish Market is unlike any fish market you’ve ever seen — it’s more like stepping into the luxury food halls at Harrods. The building itself is a work of art, with intricate mosaics, clean marble interiors, and beautiful ironwork that gives the whole space a sense of calm elegance. Even if you’re not here to buy, it’s absolutely worth a visit just to admire the design and experience the atmosphere. The selection of seafood is vast, fresh, and beautifully displayed — from local catches to more exotic varieties. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, it’s the perfect stop if you’re exploring the Mina District or Old Doha Port. Stylish, spotless, and full of character — a must-see spot in the city!

reviews.author: Muna Hawwa
reviews.text: offers a unique blend of culinary excellence and architectural beauty 🩷🩷🩷 Many visitors highlight the quality of the seafood and the unique dining experience. Some patrons have noted longer waiting times during peak hours and suggest arriving early to avoid delays. Despite its upscale ambiance, the market offers competitive pricing, often more affordable than high end seafood restaurants in Doha.

reviews.author: Isuru Dissanayake
reviews.text: This is one of the iconic fish market in Mina District, Doha. This fish market is located in a building that doesn't really look like a fish market. Fish market interior is like an art gallery. The ceiling is doctorated with colorful glass panels and it looks amazing. Also they maintain the fish market with a pleasant vibe. Highly recommended to visit and have a look.

reviews.author: Света Косенко
reviews.text: Thank you for a good experience and tasty food in your restaurant. And thank you for an amazing hospitality from Khalid. Everything was 5 star, my biggest recommendation!

reviews.author: Isidre Marco Tuset
reviews.text: This is a new area on the old city harbour with nice restorants & cafeterías. The fish market is young stile and you can bay the fish that they cook for you.

reviews.author: Djoko Tjioman
reviews.text: Enjoying our dinner here, we order rise, grilled beef and lamb, and couple drinks, everything were great. Recommended!

reviews.author: Salsabila Hatim
reviews.text: Ordered delivery for half kilo mixed grill and Alexandrian liver ; what I received was completely disappointing: very small portions! Nothing like the pictures on Talabat. It was embarrassing! Don’t waste your money on this restaurant. Will never order from you again.

reviews.author: MKBC
reviews.text: Great selection of mezze (small dishes served with bread), and tasty Egyptian dishes. Fish can be chosen fresh right outside the restaurant. Nice atmosphere.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text: I got food poisoning and was sick for weeks from eating here. I had continuous ishal and vomiting and my stomach was in so much pain that I had to go to the hospital. It was the worst sickness i ever had. They are not clean and I do not recommend at all.

reviews.author: Mohamed Samy
reviews.text: Good food! The only downsides are long delivery time and is a bit expensive.

reviews.author: Riad Ghanma
reviews.text: They could do better, the fish is under cooked, and the shrimps tasted boiled, not grilled. the young waters were great and nice and helpfull, the fushman was helpful too the cost is not much

reviews.author: Tonni
reviews.text: Great experience! Loved the food, well cooked & really delicious! The waiting time for your order to be served is fairly not so long, but it’s fish, it takes time to be prepared and then cooked. But you can order in advance if you know what you want, by the time you get to the restaurant, it’ll be ready to served. You’ve missed out a great taste, if you go Alexandria and didn’t go to Kadoura Restaurant! I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: JessFa_Channel
reviews.text: Food was so Amazing! Kullu laziiz geddan! If you are in Alexandria don't miss this Place, fish Is very fresh and they cook It perfectly, also baba ganush was very good. Can't wait to be back. Alf shukr 🙏

reviews.author: Indira Blažič
reviews.text: The restaurant is very nice. It is hidden between houses. Lots of fish to choose from. They have fresh fish every day. You choose a fish, and they tell you how they recommend to prepare it. Toilets nearby, no toilet paper as they don't practice that. Prices are cheap, and the food is excellent.

reviews.author: Adrian Chlebowski
reviews.text: Legendary place. Picking fresh seafood that lies on ice, has its own charm. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: Shady Soliman
reviews.text: This is such an amazing place! The food is delicious and the atmosphere is so unique with amazing views of the sea. The place has a lot of character. They have lots of antiques, as well as some wild animals (deer, monkeys, parrots, pelicans, etc), so it's a pretty unique place. Not your average seafood place 😂. Totally recommend.

reviews.author: Anwar Abdel-Karim
reviews.text: Best seafood restaurant in Egypt. Great location. Overlooking the Mediterranean sea and the port of Alexandria. Excellent people and services.

reviews.author: Randa Effat
reviews.text: The most excellent place to eat fish. Choose your favorite fresh fish, have it cooked the way you like. At the table there are a variety of salads and dips to choose from. Served with freshly baked hot bread. The seagull restaurant is a very old restaurant built like a fort. Located on the sea. A beautiful breeze whether you are sitting inside or outside. It had many antiques. It underwent a terrible fire which destroyed it completely. Happy to see it is back like the old days

reviews.author: Amir Sobh
reviews.text: This restaurant surpassed all expectations and stands as the epitome of culinary excellence. Without a doubt, it is the best restaurant I have ever had the pleasure of dining at, special thanks to Mahdy

reviews.author: Ahmed Abuelmagd
reviews.text: very very impressed, this was my first visit to seagull reasturant ( definitely not the last) and I have to say it didn't disappoint, the food was exceptional the ambiunce of the place , service and attention to details was really something to appreciate, I would highly recommend it for anyone looking for authentic Alexandrian seafood dishes and a lovely dining experience.

reviews.author: Tyler Lovatt
reviews.text: Beautiful view and place for a walk, but be prepared to get a lot of people coming upto you for taxis or selling things as there is a lot.

reviews.author: A Flou
reviews.text: The corniche is a nice place to walk in it the only thing you wont like is someone who pass by and throw some word to you…

reviews.author: Putri Ve Mohamed
reviews.text: I love Alexandria Egypt 🇪🇬

reviews.author: juzar kachwala
reviews.text: Great views

reviews.author: DT /Ahmed Adel
reviews.text: wonderful place you can relaxe

reviews.author: Abdul Hazeeb
reviews.text: I really loved this place calm and serene spend time leisurely with economic bus fares from SAPTCO at just 3.45SAR which made the commute so easy

reviews.author: NiNiShu
reviews.text: Good space to walk around. Near the bay. Crossing roads is difficult, you need to reach here with Cab. Mosque nearby Hotel Dana by Rayhaan Rotana is nearby. Starbucks nearby

reviews.author: MARYAM
reviews.text: Sunrise at Dammam Corniche is pure magic! Soft waves, golden skies, and a peaceful breeze to start your day right. It’s the perfect spot for an early morning walk, a quiet coffee by the sea, or watching the kids play as the sun comes up. Whether you’re alone or with family, sunrise here feels like a gentle reset.

reviews.author: asif Theace
reviews.text: Dammam, corniche is a place where you can spend time with family and friends. You can sit on grass in the park, plenty of area for sitting. Wide area for car parking. Local food and tea, coffee vendors are available, restaurants and al baik is also there. For kids, there are rented cars and swings to enjoy. But it needs more cleaning due to a lot of crowd and repair because the steps area which connects the sea is not clean and street lights are broken. You can find here people enjoying finish also.

reviews.author: Mohammed Omar
reviews.text: The main beach in Dammam. Perfect for weekends or just for cruising in your car on late nights. The smooth toads and what not. A HOT SPOT for real!!

reviews.author: MOHAMMED AHMED MOHAMMED
reviews.text: Wonderful view

reviews.author: mohamed alhosani
reviews.text: Nice place but more attractive

reviews.author: a m
reviews.text: This place is wonderful with nice blue beaches I hope you visit it and you will see how much this city is beautiful

reviews.author: Space Love
reviews.text: Cool place to relax and enjoy nature

reviews.author: Ehsan
reviews.text: Calm and nice with good landscape.

name: Street Stall - Raml Station
address: Street Stall - Raml Station, Alexandria, Egypt

reviews.author: Susanta Neogi
reviews.text: In Alexanderia we arrived on a Friday in month of Ramadan and afternoon roads were difficult to go through as crowds occupied the roads for their prayers As we were waiting patiently saw the trams go by and posted on pictures arevtje trams all blue line.The guide told us that the tramway network was operating from 1863 and only few tram systems operating double deck and we managed to see one and photograph is included .The tram system was electrified in 1902 in addition to AL Raml line there are also lines to central and western Alexanderia.Koltata in india has a tram line which commenced in 1863 with horse drawn trams which were replaced by steam in 1883 and finally electric locomotion and this is reason why I wish I could have taken a ride in double decker train which we saw and understand Alexanderia has only 6 coaches in its fleet..A very unique institution in Alexanderia and it is now 163 years old another record for Egypt to be proud of..

reviews.author: Doaa abdelfatah
reviews.text: The beautiful place ever Alexandria has a lot of civilizations

reviews.author: Maha Elsayed Hamed
reviews.text: My happy place ❤️

reviews.author: Dr. Abdalla Ibrahim
reviews.text: The heart of Alexandria. Very good view for the old area of Alexandria. Lots of shops for gifts and souvenirs and local restaurants to taste the famous food especially the take away ones. Approachable by all means of transportation. Very crowded area but nice to visit to enjoy the seaside and a good walk at the walkway. Recommended visit for people from outside Alexandria.

reviews.author: Ahmed Hassab
reviews.text: Historical and old area in alexandria egypt. Famous by all.this is the old area in alexandria since ages the most alexandria people going there for ether shopping or sightseeing. Most of the good restaurants are there as well as the shopping area. You can find lots of hotels near to the area as well as good cafes. Lots of very old cinemas and theatres can be found in the area. You really will be enjoyed.

reviews.author: Sara Gaber
reviews.text: My first time here and it won’t be the last, the atmosphere is amazing. The food was between average and high, the grilled shrimp was perfect, singari aros was also good, the seafood soup wasn’t good, fried calamari was average. But the prices were a little high. Overall the experience was good.

reviews.author: Mahmoud Hassan (Mody6172)
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at this establishment, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The ambiance was inviting, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere that made me feel right at home. The staff were attentive and friendly, ensuring that every aspect of the meal was to my satisfaction. The menu offered a diverse selection of dishes, each prepared with the utmost care and presented beautifully. The flavors were outstanding, showcasing the chef's expertise and commitment to quality. It's rare to find a place that consistently delivers on all fronts—service, ambiance, and cuisine—but this restaurant does just that. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience.

reviews.author: Mavis Barba
reviews.text: The food was very fresh and delicious. The waiters did all the possible to explain us the menu in English and to make us feel special. And the location is perfect to see the sunset while you eat.

reviews.author: ehab hammam
reviews.text: One of the unique seafood restaurants in Alexandria at Abou qear

reviews.author: Eman sheta
reviews.text: Very classy 🤩🤩a seaside elegant fish restaurant There is a small safe parking area.. the decorations and atmosphere are really stunning The outdoor hall is looking over the beach. The service is a little bit slow. You should wait a little till you pick your fish and weigh them. We asked to order directly from the menu but they refuses. You must pick your fish The waiters are so helpful. Cutlery is really elegant 😊. The dishes are well prepared and cooked. Salads varieties are limited but green salad was fresh and delicious. You can drink a fresh juice after your meal on the sand Highly recommended 👌👌

reviews.author: Christine Eskandary
reviews.text: Outstanding! Beautiful location and large rooms. Delicious food. Everything was perfect apart from the packed breakfast when we were leaving. The previous hotel was also excellent but both provided a packed breakfast on departure that that was inedible. The last memory of what was a very lovely hotel. Nobody could drink the coffee ( to which most of us were looking forward) from the machine and apart from the pieces of fruit which we put in our bags, the rest of the breakfast and big plastic tubs were immediately discarded. We left feeling quite let down, and in need of breakfast. A decent tea or coffee and a FRESH bread roll with an apple in a paper bag, would have done! The one-off use of plastic was pretty wide-spread and I think most tourists would be happy to see a more sensible approach. It was a beautiful hotel.

reviews.author: ka hang leung
reviews.text: Of all the years I’ve been traveling around the world and studying aboard, I’ve never had one hotel that would refuse to provide water because I chose not to have the room clean for the day which led to them not being able to refill the complimentary water. I called the room service hotline tried to explain to the guy that I didn’t get my room clean and if by any chance I can get the complimentary water for the day so I could take my wife can take her meds. Explaining didn’t work, the guy insisted me to pay 20 Egyptian pound for it with an attitude. I’d rather pay more for a store that wouldn’t give me an attitude.

reviews.author: Gin Sch
reviews.text: Great hotel for Egyptian ambiance. Food excellent for breakfast and other meals. Great location just across from Nubian Museum, and up the hill from main drag. Can walk down to main St and get tuk tuk back up. Every room has gorgeous view of Nile and islands. Aswan is a nice place to spend some time.

reviews.author: Dick Gaasbeek
reviews.text: Excellent hotel and nicely located, on top of a hill with a view of the Nile and the city. Spacious, clean rooms with good beds. And very attentive and cooperative ladies at the reception: in particular Maria, Marian and their third colleague whose name I have unfortunately forgotten. Many thanks for your hospitality!

reviews.author: David Riad
reviews.text: Couldn’t have asked for a better stay in Aswan. The location is perfect, the room views are absolutely stunning, and the staff were some of the friendliest I’ve ever met. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Polaris N
reviews.text: I asked twice from them when I visited Aswan Their food is clean and good and reasonable prices I recommend

reviews.author: M M
reviews.text: Pizza Biti at Aswan, Egypt is very close to the railway station. They have decent pizza and very reasonably priced. Vegetarian options also was available like 3 cheese pizza, Margarita Pizza and Vegetable pizza. Taste was ok but you can’t expect much in a place like Aswan for a vegetarian.

reviews.author: J B
reviews.text: I really appreciated this place. The service was excellent. The price is incredibly cheap. Loved it! Possibility to eat “Italian” or Egyptian pizzas

reviews.author: Amatullah Robles
reviews.text: We asked for the menu in Arabic and we ordered the Egyptian vegetarian Pizza, it was very big and delicious and they were very fast. We also could watch how they prepare the pizza and we made videos of it. They have a small toilet (not very nice or clean, but a toilet).

reviews.author: Harold Franken
reviews.text: Good Pizza! Good place to sit. My eyes were bigger than my appetite. I had the big one😂

reviews.author: Sony S
reviews.text: This place was recommend for lunch by our tour guide and it was worth the recommendation. The food was very good in quality and flavour, the ambience is well set with a good view of the nile and it's tributaries. Very good service too, based on your taste or need, they do suggest from the menu what suits the best. Worth a try while you are in Aswan. One can also enjoy the locally brewed coffee that's fresh and refreshing.

reviews.author: sharad bishnoi
reviews.text: Beautiful place on an island 🏝️ in river Nile. Almost at the end of Nile river towards Aswan Dam and close to Nubian village, the Dokka restaurant is known for excellent Nubian Cuisine. We tried their chicken recipe with Tahini & Humus, and also Fish and rice made in Nubian style. Very spacious restaurant offering breathtaking view of great Nile and villages nearby. You have to take a boat to reach the restaurant since the place is on an island.

reviews.author: Alexander Gee
reviews.text: Recommend a visit to this restaurant on a little island next to Elephantine Island. Getting to the restaurant is easy via a free boat service run by the restaurant accessed from a small dedicated pier opposite the Egypt Air office in central Aswan. Good view of the temple on the island across one of the channels. Very welcoming staff and would really recommend the koftas, they were superb. The Baba Ganouj was very tasty.

reviews.author: Tarek Raslan
reviews.text: It is located in the middle of the Nile with an amazing view and premium location 👌. The welcome is very warm and the service is very friendly, they also have good menu. The food was so 🫣 disappointing in terms of taste and quality, maybe because the place was empty. Overall experience is below average.

reviews.author: Jack Papaya
reviews.text: I went with mango juice, lentil soup and grilled chicken with fries, the mango juice was good, the lentil soup was good, when the chicken arrived, I found a hair in my fries, the chicken was well cooked but not seasoned very well, the fries were ok. I then went to pay, and they charged me 800 Egyptian pounds, not sure if service charge was included but it was more than I thought it was. Friendly staff and a welcoming place but let down my the food and hair in the food, and a possible over charging.

reviews.author: Tarja
reviews.text: This restaurant presented a bit of a puzzle. Based on the very casual decor – think plastic tablecloths and water in plastic cups – I was expecting budget-friendly prices. However, the menu was surprisingly expensive, placing it in the same range as much nicer establishments in Egypt. The food itself was actually quite tasty for a budget-friendly meal, and if it had been priced appropriately, that would be the end of the story. The service was friendly and attentive. However, the final bill was significantly higher than anticipated, roughly a third more than the total I calculated from the menu prices. I'm still unsure how they arrived at that total, as there was no clear breakdown of the service charges. This underhanded tactic completely negated any positive impression from the friendly service and decent food, and ultimately left a really bitter taste. Please be aware that they don't accept card payments, and locating a nearby ATM proved to be quite a challenge.

reviews.author: javad mashreghi
reviews.text: I usually don’t write negative reviews, but I feel it’s my responsibility to share this experience for the comfort and safety of others. We visited this restaurant based on a recommendation. The food was actually quite decent, and the ambiance pleasant. However, our entire experience was deeply ruined by the unprofessional and shockingly inappropriate behavior of one of the young male staff members. This individual made unsolicited, intrusive, and even vulgar comments—crossing every possible line of respectful interaction. His jokes were offensive, his remarks disturbingly personal, and his overall behavior completely unacceptable in a space that should be safe and welcoming to all guests. We chose not to confront him at the time, as we were the only guests there and didn’t want to escalate things. But we left the restaurant feeling upset, uncomfortable, and frankly, disrespected. This wasn’t a simple case of poor service—it was a violation of personal boundaries and a failure in basic human decency. As long as individuals like this are part of the staff, I cannot recommend this restaurant as a safe or respectful environment. I truly hope the management takes this seriously. No customer should have to feel unsafe or demeaned simply for choosing to dine out.

reviews.author: Jack Papaya
reviews.text: I tried this place for dinner. Had the stuffed pigeon, each dish comes with many side dishes . Food was mostly good. Quite a lot of food for 1 person. The atmosphere was quiet and calm. Overall it was a decent experience with friendly quick service. Wouldn't come back though as i prefer cheaper places to eat.

reviews.author: Mohamed Aslam
reviews.text: We had dinner here on the first day of our stay in Aswan after reading the Google reviews, but it was a deeply disappointing experience. The menu is heavily overpriced for tourists, with a 10% service charge added. However, let’s assume the pricing is acceptable—was there any service to begin with? Absolutely not. The service was poor, the food portions were shockingly small (see the photo for reference), and they charged 555 EGP for what can only be described as a kid-sized portion, plus service charge and tax. The food was bland, the hygiene standards were unacceptable, and there wasn’t a single positive aspect about this restaurant. This was, without a doubt, the worst dining experience we had in Egypt. Avoid this place at all costs.

reviews.author: Nina Lauterbach
reviews.text: We came here upon recommendation of our hotel. Overall the food was nice, with starters and many side dishes. It was not as cheap as you would normally expect in Egypt (and they included quite a big service charge), but at least it was well prepared so you do not have to be afraid of getting ill. The owner was very attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: Hari Shiyani
reviews.text: Located within the historic Old Cataract Hotel, this spot is both convenient and a must-visit. We chose to dine outdoors, and the view of the Nile was absolutely stunning. We ordered the lentil soup, fattoush salad, falafel, potato harra, and koshary. Every dish was delicious—the falafel were perfectly crispy and warm, the koshary was flavorful with just the right amount of spice, the vegetables in the fattoush were fresh and juicy, and the potato harra had a wonderful texture. The portions were generous and more than enough to satisfy the hearty appetites of the two of us. We didn’t even have room for dessert! The staff was incredibly accommodating, and the service was excellent. Highly recommend - both the restaurant, and the hotel!

reviews.author: Pauline Yoong
reviews.text: This is one of the best restaurants in Aswan, IMHO, given that we didn't have much time spent in Aswan and the food in our hotel was not good at all. We came to the Old Cataract hotel restaurant over two nights. The price is higher than the usual restaurants in Aswan but the food quality was really good. This is an Egyptian restaurant and reservations are required to get a table. They have live performance of Egyptian music which some of them is quite pleasing as we dine. There is outdoor and indoor seating. The outdoor is really nice if the weather is less windy. Indoor is a little cold with the air condition but it beats having sand blown into the food as we sit in the windy weather. We ordered the oxtail tajine and hot mezzas and their dessert platter. They were delicious and we ate very comfortably.

reviews.author: Inkyoo Lee
reviews.text: Fantastic grilled meat and shrimp in a surreal atmosphere. Mariam was an amazing host.

reviews.author: Dylan H
reviews.text: We were staying at the Old Cataract hotel and this was definitely the best food we had there! The atmosphere is lovely, right on the river and though it doesn't have the WOW factor of the 1902 Restaurant, the food here was much better for less money. Service is also fantastic. We loved this restaurant!

reviews.author: Leopold Mpoyi
reviews.text: Authentic oriental cuisine, the atmospher of the restaurant is very pleasant with Egyptians musicians playing live. Special mention to Mohamed our waiter for his kindness and devotion.

reviews.author: Constant Koopman
reviews.text: Great location and food, but complete rip off and scammers. Agreed on total price of 400 (about €12) for two meals, which is a normal price. Charged 1000 (€33), took our last money so had a hard time getting home.

reviews.author: Z A
reviews.text: This place is cozy, impeccably clean and with great ambiance. The atmosphere is laid back but the staff is very helpful and eager to please. They are very proud of their beautiful place and take good care of it and their guests. You must eat at their restaurant!! The food is divine! Simple but exquisite. I reccomend it very highly!

reviews.author: Safira Tai
reviews.text: Don't trust the host, he is dishonest. Eat here if there is no other choice. Food isn't tasty and healthy, but vegetables and bread are ok. The view and the location are nice. Overall, don't recommend.

reviews.author: human_exe
reviews.text: i heard the owner is bad but i am not sure sense our egyptian guide payed for the food from my experience i think the food is wonderful and view is very good

reviews.author: Niccolò Pozzi
reviews.text: DO NOT BOOK HERE BAD EXPERIENCE GOOD FOOD AND LOCATION ONLY

reviews.author: Leyi Su
reviews.text: The most friendly and comfortable dinning experience I have ever had in Egypt. Perfect location with good view of the river. Cheap price for good food. We are happy about our mango juice, mint tea, stuffed Pigeon and aubergine tagime. The staff is very helpful and no one will come to bother you.

reviews.author: Kevin Burela
reviews.text: The food is here amazing! It’s a spot that isn’t crowded by typical tourist traps so we were pleasantly surprised to see such good service, great food and ambience. We recommend the bbq beef, the tamarind and hibiscus and the Nubian desert - these were our favourite on the trip to Egypt!

reviews.author: Rushan
reviews.text: Service was very friendly. The food was okay. Drinks are good. Credit cards are accepted. They also have shisha. It is really cheap, but doesn't last long. Like 15 minutes and it's dead.

reviews.author: Ali Wali
reviews.text: This is one of the best restaurants in Aswan and my favorite one. You can reach there by using the public ferry in front of KFC just 20E£ to cross it's next to King Jamaica. The vibe here is very very home like you can relax and the owner is a great man. The food tasted great and he also gives you tips and calls good priced boats. I will always eat here when I am in Aswan

reviews.author: Johnny
reviews.text: Such a great place! With such nice people! You can have delicious food, for example nubian tajines and awesome juices for very fair prices. My girlfriend fell in love with breakfast. And don‘t forget the perfect view. We hope to come back soon! All the best from Jonathan and Isa

reviews.author: Tab Knr
reviews.text: An extraordinary place in Aswan! Located on the Elephantine island, where you can discover traditional Nubian life in the village, with a beautiful terrace and view on the Nile. The room is comfortable and clean and the service is perfect. We got served a delicious breakfast (bread, eggs, jam, cheese, juice, coffee...) every morning. Lunch and dinner is available on request. The owner can organise other tours for you as well. Our highlight was a falouka (sailing boat) ride in the sunset. I can only recommend staying here. You will spend the most relaxing time, no noise or cars around, fresh air and the most friendly people. The hosts Said and Hamed will be there for you to give you a memorable time you'll never forget!

reviews.author: Flora Vafea
reviews.text: I was ready to cancel my reservation because I had read some bad reviews for this house. I am glad that I didn't do it. The best of the place is the exceptional view! It is a really Nubian house, so if you are looking for luxury, this is not the place. If you would like to experience to live within a Nubian village, this is a good place to stay. There is also a small beach nearby, you may swim in the Nile. There is a kitchen, where I could make a coffee and store my fruits in the refrigerator.

reviews.author: Théophane Couderc
reviews.text: We were very seduced by Said's warm welcome. The house is located on the western part of Elephantine Island, it is very easy to reach by taking the ferry (5EGP) and crossing the width of the island. We were 20 minutes away from the center of Aswan. Said gave us lots of good advice and prepared a Nubian village excursion for us. The accommodation is lovely and peaceful. The view over the Nile is exceptional. Excellent value for money. We witnessed beautiful sunsets. The room is clean and very pleasant. A superb Nubian parenthesis and a guaranteed change of scenery surrounded by nature on the banks of the African river. I highly recommend to anyone wishing to discover Aswan and its surroundings.

reviews.author: Claudio Bosgraaf
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay very much. The welcoming is very friendly and welcoming and they are more than willing to help you with all kinds of information to organise your trips and visits in the area. Nice breakfast, simple but clean air conditioned rooms. The roof terrace with shaded and unshaded places to sit, is a nice place to relax. The roof terrace has a kitchen, that every guest can use to make something to drink or eat. The guest house offers free Wi-fi with 2 different access points, which provides good coverage on the roof and the rooms. For us it is definitely a place to return to, the next time we are again in Aswan.

reviews.author: Frida Tugnoli
reviews.text: Place was dirty. No bathroom in the bedrooms. Common bathroom didn’t even have a shower just toilet and basin. There is a discharge behind the hotel. The view from the top roof is beautiful but couches are dusty and uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Alonso Esteban
reviews.text: We went for an evening drink at The Bar. The view is incredible and the service is the best you can get. Our host Sondos was the nicest person, she gave us explanations about the history of the hotel and let us visit a suite. She was amazing! Will definitely recommend and come back!

reviews.author: Zheqi Zhao (Alex)
reviews.text: Must stay here when you are in Aswan. For the stay experience: Environment: in a non-peak month, the whole front and back yard gardens are super private and exclusive. Pool side seat under a mango tree cannot be more relaxing. Room: Luxury room with Nile view. I literally wowed when i see the view in the room for the first time. The room is spacious with living area and bedroom and closet room. Service: Marvel and Moo (sorry if i do not spell it correctly), they are great concierges. The room call is always answered immediately. The staff are always ready to help. Dinning: only tried the terrace bar. The Agatha’s high tea: you definitely should have it in the afternoon. I had it in the afternoon in June. The month is not a peak season so i can have a great private time in the Nile view seat and enjoy Agatha’s book with AC. The Agatha’s cocktail: great cocktail with gin as the base served with sandwiches and nuts. I drank it as a sundowner. That is really an enchanting experience. For the Agatha Christie’s and Winston Churchill’s suites tour: Great tour, great tour guide!

reviews.author: Anita Chirde
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Old Cataract Hotel and our stay couldn’t have been more magical. Our room was elegantly decorated and had the most breathtaking view. The many restaurants gave us ample choice for dining. All excellent. The hotel is truly grand and the grounds are spectacularly maintained. The staff is just delightful and so welcoming and helpful. One of the best hotel experiences I’ve ever had.

reviews.author: Yinan Li
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience during our recent stay. The hotel environment is lovely – well-maintained, quiet, and offers a relaxing atmosphere. Our room was excellent: spacious, impeccably clean, with great amenities and a very comfortable bed. The real highlight, though, was the exceptional staff. We were particularly impressed by **Marvel and Agnes**. From the moment we arrived, they provided truly outstanding service.

reviews.author: Robin Giles
reviews.text: The hotel is absolutely beautiful!! You can’t get a better view of the Nile, and the pool is incredible. The tour taking you to Agatha Christie and Winston Churchill’s rooms was very informational and fun (our guide, Marvel, was very impressive- she knew everything we wanted to know and spoke many languages). Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ana M
reviews.text: The restaurant is so beautiful (we went during luch) and the food is sooo delicious. We ordered some drinks and boneless chicken (comes with fries). First we sat inside but after 15min they offered us another table with an amazing view, it was very kind of them. The chicken was soooooo good, it tasted like butter and garlic and it was so juicy, really really nice. The prices were also okay, not expensive. I recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Marta Querol, escritora
reviews.text: Very nice place with a simple but good menu. We asked for samoussas, excellent, and unboned chicken with fries and salad very good, accompanied of an Egipcien Red wine, tastefull and strong. The ambience, envolving but quite cold a that time. They had heaters. Service a little slow. We asked them to call for an uber to go back to the hotel and it costed double than the way to.

reviews.author: Oliver Maclean
reviews.text: One of the best meals of my life. The location is very random and a bit sus as you drive up but all is forgiven when I saw the view from the patio. All the staff were very friendly with us (westerners, no Arabic) and we were able to get up close in the kitchen and bake our own bread. The chicken was incredibly juicy and well seasoned. Mezze was great too. Another standout was the vine leaves, didn’t know so much flavour could be in such a small bite. Seriously fantastic meal!

reviews.author: Amr Kamal
reviews.text: We were a group of 4 adults and 3 children. If you ever visited the old original restaurant, you will be very disappointed with this new venue. We used to visit the old restaurant once a week where we were welcomed with a smile from the door until we left. There were plenty of parking spaces that belonged to the restaurant itself, not just parking somewhere in the street. Waiters were very friendly and cheerful, which made us wanna order more. Nowadays, they just stall you for 30 minutes until they come to you with a stranger behavior and unfriendly attitude as if you were to eat for free. I can't imagine also that in 2025, we are still having a sign where you enter that identifies a minimum charge for what you should pay per person. What if I am on a diet and would like to eat only a grilled chicken that costs half the price!!! Humiliating. Food was very humble compared to the gorgeous tasty meals offered in the old one. Friendliness for children cannot be even compared. In the old restaurant, we had animals to ride, play with, and feed. Here, you have just a magnificent view which is not also provided for all tables including ours. I don't see myself visiting this restaurant again as it will ruin the great impressions and memories I had in mind for the old one.

reviews.author: Moataz Ibrahim
reviews.text: We had a stop by lunch and order their rotisserie half chicken, unfortunately was very dry mean specially breast and the over paste of Rosemarie made it more more dry, herring and mixed salad were good.

reviews.author: Levi
reviews.text: The staff were all very friendly. The coffee was top-notch. The building is stunningly beautiful.

reviews.author: Suliman Ahmed
reviews.text: It's classy, the staff are nice and welcoming, and the food is great, but it is pricey as it seems, with no minimum charges. However, the atmosphere is good to finalize some work on your computer, but not that quiet for phone calls! I ordered the frequently ordered sandwich as per the chief-(club sandwich) & it was good, orange juice, pasty dessert, and a hot latte; ended up paying 530 EGP.

reviews.author: howaida shahin
reviews.text: One of my favorite spots in Cairo. Expensive; small portions; sometimes, u feel the difference in service towards locals vs foreigners. However, it is still a nice spot to get a coffee and a pastry and have a nice talk.

reviews.author: هدوي هدوي
reviews.text: I would like to extend a special greeting to Coffee Corniche and a special thank you to the employee (Sama) for her good treatment and reception. The food was very delicious.

reviews.author: Amar Al-Sbayi
reviews.text: The staff are pleasant and polite… very traditional loving Egyptian hospitality. However, the prices rob your wallet! 75 Egyptian pounds for a soda… plus VAT and house charge… 96 Egyptian pounds! 75% markup!!!

reviews.author: Lujeyn Alayed
reviews.text: I’ve been there twice, and it’s a nice place to enjoy a classic aesthetic. However, they don’t have a menu or fixed prices, so you might get charged differently each time. Also, avoid talking to anyone who tries to approach you. If you don’t see staff wearing the brand’s red and blue logo, it’s best not to go in

reviews.author: Halide Vera
reviews.text: The atmosphere was great! We went there in the night after dinner for some local beverage. Unfortunately couldn’t try the famous coffee instead local tea we had as it was late in the night. There was live music and service was good. Staff were very friendly. Definitely you should visit this place if you are in Khan El Khalili

reviews.author: Zakaria BOUTAIB
reviews.text: Nice and crowded place, great for enjoying some traditional Egyptian tea, fresh juice, or shisha in an authentic atmosphere. But there are two main downsides: First, it’s hard to relax because many people constantly approach you to sell things or ask for money. Second, there’s no official bill — at the end, they just tell you a price, and often it includes things you didn’t ask for or thought were complimentary. Still worth the visit for the experience, but stay alert.

Still, it’s a lovely place to enjoy a cup of tea and soak in the vibrant hustle and bustle of the market.

reviews.author: Munib C
reviews.text: It's a very simple place overlooking a busy road. We're in a small space converted into a cafe. It's simple, but the place has charm. It's a far cry from American coffee chains. For a change of scenery and authenticity, this is it. I ordered a Turkish coffee. They also give you a bottle of water. Men and women are mixed here. It's a good place for tourists looking for a taste of modest Egypt.

reviews.text: A historic café and restaurant that is beautiful in its presentation and variety

reviews.text: Excellent services, delicious juices, and a beautiful outdoor sitting area surrounded by flowers and plants bring joy. Great for inviting friends and family.

reviews.author: Jinky Crevillo
reviews.text: Café Riche is a true gem in the heart of Cairo, blending history, charm, and culture in a way that few places can. From the moment you step inside, you’re transported back in time — the vintage decor and historic ambiance make it feel like a place where stories were made (and they were!). The service is warm and attentive, and the menu offers a solid mix of Egyptian and international dishes. I especially enjoyed the coffee — simple yet flavorful. Whether you’re looking for a quiet place to read, chat with friends, or soak up some Cairo history, Café Riche delivers. Highly recommend for locals and tourists alike.🤎

reviews.author: Patricia Presser
reviews.text: Went to visit this historical café tucked away on a busy city street. Tried to order anise Tea and they told me they didn’t have any hot drinks available because their machine wasn’t working. Was able to get Turkish coffee… Confused?!?

reviews.author: Fine Fuhgg
reviews.text: Unfortunately, it's overrated. It seems popular, but there's nothing special about it. The atmosphere was a little spooky: dark, old and smelling of cigarettes. We got the menu and decided what to order, but after wasting so much time, the waiter came to take our order, only to inform us that they accept CASH only. So we had to leave to withdraw some cash, but on the way, we found a better restaurant with a much more welcoming atmosphere and tasty food!

reviews.author: Pedro Almeida
reviews.text: Probably the best coffee I had in a long time. The atmosphere, the untouched deco… It’s a time capsule. Smoking indoors allowed and alcohol is served too.

reviews.author: Sarah J
reviews.text: We came to see a historic cafe but were surprised to see an unfriendly, super rude blonde woman managing the place. It is a shame honestly to have someone like her manage the cafe. She did not allow us to sit inside where the intellectuals and revolutionaries used to meet. She allowed only outside, on the renovated modern section. No greetings whatsoever. The staff is terrified by her and thus didn’t get our order right. I don’t recommend visiting the cafe, it’s not worth it.

reviews.author: Youssef Bacoura
reviews.text: An exceptional dining experience from start to finish. The cuisine is absolutely top notch fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Whether you’re here for a relaxing breakfast or a romantic dinner, the ambiance is unmatched, especially on the terrace overlooking the Nile. The view is stunning at any time of day, and the atmosphere is both elegant and welcoming. Service was attentive, professional, and warm without being intrusive. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy great food in one of the most iconic settings Zamalek has to offer. A true gem by the river.

reviews.author: Lee Al Qassab
reviews.text: Wow this restaurant served the best food and wine. The staff were so friendly and funny. They made sure we had everything we needed. The view is great directly in front of the Nile. It was a lovely fine dine experience without the extra formalities. They gave us recommendations that did not disappoint. The steaks were my favourite. The elevator broke down tho and we had no other option of going down and the manager refused to give me a free glass of wine which was sad. Would definitely recommend the restaurant and definitely planning on coming again in my next trip to Egypt.

reviews.author: madhumita kulkarni
reviews.text: It’s a fancy rooftop restaurant with a amazing view of the Nile. The ambience and service is great. We visited the place to experience their Egyptian breakfast which was beautifully served. The taste was really good and would definitely visit again. Generally for breakfast, prior reservation is not required but for dinner it’s recommend.

reviews.author: Kamran Nobari
reviews.text: Amazing food. This restaurant was a suggestion by our friends who visited a month ago and it didn’t disappoint. We tried salmon tartar as starter and also some amazing bread and butter. This followed by chatauebriand for two. Amazing food. We washed all this food down with some pineapple brûlée . Service was great and ambiance was nice and romantic

reviews.text: It is certainly one of the cleanest and best grill restaurants in Egypt. Its food is clean and well-served, and its prices in relation to its quality are acceptable (or a little high, of course, in comparison).

reviews.text: I have been eating at Al-Dahan for forty years and it is considered one of the best kebab shops. As for Al-Neefa, they are unique

reviews.author: Ihar Beliauski
reviews.text: Our guide brought us to El Dar Darak during our tour of the pyramids, and it turned out to be a great spot for a meal. The food provided was very good - fresh, flavorful, and a nice introduction to local cuisine. However, drinks were not included and were slightly overpriced compared to what you’d expect. The restaurant also has a washroom, which is convenient during a long day of sightseeing. Overall, it was a good place to relax and enjoy a meal, but be prepared for additional charges for drinks.

reviews.author: Danny Leibrandt
reviews.text: Great restaurant! We had an absolutely huge meal for about $30, not bad. They give you a ton of sides to have with bread, like a middle eastern version of Korean BBQ. A nice staff member explained the different dishes for us too.

reviews.author: Deborah Coelho
reviews.text: Very good experience!! They offer different options and staff is very friendly and polite. We had one big menu, it comes with different egipcian options, everything was tasty. We has the okra tajine, it was very good too!! Manager is friendly, it came to ask if we liked, I said I loved one sauce and he gave it a little bit to me taking, it was lovely!! I advice you to try this place!! Really worth!!!

reviews.author: Casandra Nicola
reviews.text: The food was average, a mix of traditional food, but made for tourists maybe? A bit blunt. We didn't dine in, we got take away, and the portions were smaller than those inside (I got a chance to see while we were waiting for our order). Also, they first forgot the soup of the day, which was part of the menu we ordered, so we had to come back for it.

reviews.author: Nicholas Marine
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The variety of appetizers was impressive — each one full of flavor and beautifully presented. The duck was absolutely exceptional: tender, perfectly cooked, and bursting with rich taste. And the dessert… unforgettable! A perfect sweet ending to an amazing meal. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Tarja
reviews.text: This restaurant presented a bit of a puzzle. Based on the very casual decor – think plastic tablecloths and water in plastic cups – I was expecting budget-friendly prices. However, the menu was surprisingly expensive, placing it in the same range as much nicer establishments in Egypt. The food itself was actually quite tasty for a budget-friendly meal, and if it had been priced appropriately, that would be the end of the story. The service was friendly and attentive. However, the final bill was significantly higher than anticipated, roughly a third more than the total I calculated from the menu prices. I'm still unsure how they arrived at that total, as there was no clear breakdown of the service charges. This underhanded tactic completely negated any positive impression from the friendly service and decent food, and ultimately left a really bitter taste. Please be aware that they don't accept card payments, and locating a nearby ATM proved to be quite a challenge.

reviews.author: javad mashreghi
reviews.text: I usually don’t write negative reviews, but I feel it’s my responsibility to share this experience for the comfort and safety of others. We visited this restaurant based on a recommendation. The food was actually quite decent, and the ambiance pleasant. However, our entire experience was deeply ruined by the unprofessional and shockingly inappropriate behavior of one of the young male staff members. This individual made unsolicited, intrusive, and even vulgar comments—crossing every possible line of respectful interaction. His jokes were offensive, his remarks disturbingly personal, and his overall behavior completely unacceptable in a space that should be safe and welcoming to all guests. We chose not to confront him at the time, as we were the only guests there and didn’t want to escalate things. But we left the restaurant feeling upset, uncomfortable, and frankly, disrespected. This wasn’t a simple case of poor service—it was a violation of personal boundaries and a failure in basic human decency. As long as individuals like this are part of the staff, I cannot recommend this restaurant as a safe or respectful environment. I truly hope the management takes this seriously. No customer should have to feel unsafe or demeaned simply for choosing to dine out.

reviews.author: Jack Papaya
reviews.text: I tried this place for dinner. Had the stuffed pigeon, each dish comes with many side dishes . Food was mostly good. Quite a lot of food for 1 person. The atmosphere was quiet and calm. Overall it was a decent experience with friendly quick service. Wouldn't come back though as i prefer cheaper places to eat.

reviews.author: Mohamed Aslam
reviews.text: We had dinner here on the first day of our stay in Aswan after reading the Google reviews, but it was a deeply disappointing experience. The menu is heavily overpriced for tourists, with a 10% service charge added. However, let’s assume the pricing is acceptable—was there any service to begin with? Absolutely not. The service was poor, the food portions were shockingly small (see the photo for reference), and they charged 555 EGP for what can only be described as a kid-sized portion, plus service charge and tax. The food was bland, the hygiene standards were unacceptable, and there wasn’t a single positive aspect about this restaurant. This was, without a doubt, the worst dining experience we had in Egypt. Avoid this place at all costs.

reviews.author: Nina Lauterbach
reviews.text: We came here upon recommendation of our hotel. Overall the food was nice, with starters and many side dishes. It was not as cheap as you would normally expect in Egypt (and they included quite a big service charge), but at least it was well prepared so you do not have to be afraid of getting ill. The owner was very attentive and friendly.

reviews.text: A very good place with low prices and high quality drinks

name: El Tabei El Domyati
address: El Tabei El Domyati, Cairo, Egypt

reviews.author: Amr Darwish
reviews.text: Very cozy restaurant, tourist friendly, authentic homemade egyptian food. Only opens for 2 hours from 5-7pm with a daily delicious set-menu, so make sure to queue up at least 10 mins ahead! Food is served once ordered since it is already prepared. As an Egyptian, I have to say this is one of the best authentic homemade Egyptian experiences.

reviews.author: Gummy
reviews.text: we cleared our plates. only open for a few hours here so come early cause the food runs out. i could not recommend enough. such a beautiful homey family vibe cooking… missed out on dessert so will come back again earlier to try to get. menu also changes everyday!

reviews.author: Hussa AlJuraifani
reviews.text: A quaint and adorable place! The decor is so cute. Super cozy and inviting, Soumaya herself is very sweet! The waiters were friendly and attentive. The food was delicious and tastes homemade, and made with love! Absolutely no notes. Especially loved the molokhiya.

reviews.author: Sichun Wang
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a dinner in Cairo, this Fasahet Somaya in Downtown is THE PLACE TO BE! The wholesome tastes of Egyptian home cooking attracts loads of locals waiting up for its exclusive 2-hour opening. You’ll find the folks among the most genuine and friendly around there, eating with you across the room with delightful decorations. Absolutely inouï experience! STRONGLY RECOMMENDED!!!

reviews.author: Christine Labeste
reviews.text: Home cooked market fresh meals! You won’t be disappointed. Skip places like Felfela (for the tourists) and spend your money here instead. Go early at 17h because when the food is gone, the restaurant closes. Absolutely worth it. We got everything that was on the menu and it was delicious.

reviews.author: Klaudia L
reviews.text: This place converted me to a falafel fan or as the Egyptians call it Ta’ameya, recipe being also a bit different and in my novice opinion the best I have tasted. It was super crunchy on the outside, bright with ground spices and soft on the inside. Perfectly spiced and packed full of flavor. The other stand out were the Veal chops. Food overall really tasty. Fit out a bit eclectic, with fish tanks, bird houses, murals and eclectic lamps. All a little dusty, mysterious and giving off just the Cairo vibes a tourist is after. Where the place falls done is Service. Friendly faces standing around, forgetting items, missing cutlery and taking forever to bring a drink.

reviews.author: Sude Naz Tekbaş
reviews.text: Everything was good except service. I waited 5 mins for menu and 15 mins fot dessert. It came from fridge but it feels like they are doing it again. They accept only cash and i didnt know that. I told the waiter who is in suit and he came to atm with me after i got the cash he told me you must give 100egp it is not written on the receipt. And i told him of course i know that is not written there. He kept asking me while im keeping to say no. If he didnt say anything i’ll give some but after that big no

reviews.author: Ernesto Santibanez
reviews.text: Beautifully decorated restaurant serving Egyptian food. The place is popular with tourists and it is overpriced, food is OK. They only accept cash and charge a "right to use the cutlery" and service on top. They also expect a tip on top of all of that.

reviews.author: Ed Clarke
reviews.text: Very good food in an amazing building. Tourist vibe does not take away from the experience. Falafel was excellent although lacked seasoning. Tourists should be aware that credit cards are not accepted and the service charge does not include a tip. Typical Egypt…

reviews.author: Hassan Ghaffar
reviews.text: While in #cairo went to a restaurant that I had seen on social media many times @felfelaeg, first off the ambiance is amazing, great decor. we ordered multiple breakfast items, Falafel, Foul, Shakshuka, and Lentil Soup. the food was delicious, Egyptian Falafel are a little different then the rest of the Arab world, they are made from Fava beans, which was good, and honestly you can't go wrong with Foul, with fresh bread. definitely a great place 👌

reviews.text: Very good food

reviews.author: Abeer
reviews.text: Nice

reviews.author: Mostafa Hassan
reviews.text: Epic

reviews.author: Yasser Mohammed
reviews.text: Very normal food and not as they say Perhaps my most popular thing is liver, not sheep, and its taste is different, and molokhiya, there are tastier ones. Bananas are boiled and browned in the oven and taste burnt. Soup for trotters is veal. I do not have extensive experience, but it may be acceptable. The restaurant in general is not good, but there is the best in terms of decoration and quality of food, as well as the price...

name: Khan El Khalili Restaurant
address: Khan El Khalili Restaurant, Cairo, Egypt

reviews.author: Anastasia Travkina
reviews.text: I recently visited Naguib Mahfouz Restaurant at Khan El Khalili and had a pretty great experience! The food was really good, but there’s a minimum charge of 600 pounds. The highlight for me was the live music, especially the electric violin—I'm not usually into Arabic music, but it was really enjoyable. The waiters were traditionally dressed and super friendly, adding to the authentic vibe. There are two main areas: one for dining, which isn’t too loud, and another perfect for grabbing a drink and soaking in the music. It’s definitely a place to visit, with such a historical feel. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Stiliyan Stoyanov
reviews.text: A hidden gem in the middle of Khan El Khalili bazar. The atmosphere is very authentic and the staff adds that extra notch to really make you feel welcomed. The food is traditional Egyptian food. The service is fast and efficient. They will always try and accommodate and changes to the meal, in case there is something you do not like. In our case they replaced the rabbit for chicken and changed the green sauce to a nice traditional tomato dish. I would highly recommend a visit if you are in the area.

reviews.author: Mohamed Hafez
reviews.text: The atmosphere at Naguib Mahfouz Restaurant is truly charming — rich with traditional Egyptian decor and a warm, nostalgic vibe that makes you feel like you’ve stepped into history. The staff are friendly and attentive, adding to the welcoming experience. However, the food itself is average Portions are decent, but the flavors felt a bit underwhelming for the price. Oriental desserts are not good at all, kofta seem to be pre-cooked and stored on the fridge and then coocked. Overall, it’s a nice spot to visit for the ambiance, but don’t set your expectations too high on the food.

reviews.author: Hadil mahfoudhi
reviews.text: It was my first time giving Egyptian food a try and luckily it was in this restaurant. I had a great experience here, the food was amazing and i loved the live Egyptian music in the background. The waiter was so friendly and funny tho and my friends and i had a real moment of joy!

reviews.author: Elle Rens
reviews.text: My husband and I are world travelers and were taken there for iftar by a local friend (who we were meeting there for the first time - referred by her brother in another country). We had lunch there earlier while we waited to meet her and then again a set dinner at 6 pm when the fast ended. The food just kept coming, and it was phenomenal! The management and staff were incredibly friendly and helpful. Our new friend (and management) refused to take money from us as they said we were their guests - even though we invited our new friend for a meal. It was actually embarrassing for us but in a very humble, good way. I can only say good things about this restaurant and about Egyptians (particularly our new friend) and their incredible hospitality and friendliness and desire to please and assist/help. This was an evening that we will remember and treasure for ever!

reviews.author: Dee Avi
reviews.text: A nice experience from the restaurant itself to the excellent service and somewhat the food. Everything was great and food was good. I felt there is more pasta that lentils therefore if you like lentils dont shy off asking for more. Highly recommend local restaurant

reviews.author: Viktor Kovács
reviews.text: Amazing food, and amazing service. They don't overcharge you because you are a foreigner. They only have kosheri, but this is the go-to place for it. It was crowded, we had to walk up several floors. This was the first dish we had in Egypt. We had no stomach bug after it. It tastes AMAZING.

reviews.author: Randa Khalid
reviews.text: I've been here to try the traditional Egyptian dish "koshary." It was pretty good, and you can adjust the sauces according to your preferences . This restaurant has its own festive song that kept being played all along. We sat outside, and it was lovely seeing the people walking while enjoying the meal.

reviews.author: Gonçalo Carmo
reviews.text: A true Egyptian food experience. Only one dish is served here and therefore the food arrives quickly. Also ask for a dessert. Good value for money

reviews.author: Senad Gashi
reviews.text: Koshary Abou Tarek is a must-visit when you’re in Cairo! The atmosphere is lively and welcoming, and the service is truly outstanding. Every single waiter was extremely friendly, helpful, and full of good energy. The staff made the experience really fun and memorable. You don’t just come here for the food – which is also great – but for the great mood and warm hospitality. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: John Shenoda
reviews.text: Piccolo mondo , you get in and find some italian decorations and names of people carved on the walls all around you , you get seated by helpful staff (but you need to have a reservation) , the menu has a wide selection of drinks and Italian cuisine dishes. I ordered seafood pasta and salmon fettuccine and both were very tasty , the best thing about this place is the view by the nile which makes the whole experience blends in together nicely. If you want a break from the city lights this place is highly recommended .

reviews.author: Faatimah Soonnoo
reviews.text: Le Pacha is an absolute gem in Cairo! The food was delicious — every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was elegant yet relaxed, perfect for a memorable evening. But what really made the experience unforgettable was the stunning view of the Nile! This place is a must-try. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Michael Yanni
reviews.text: Amir was a great host. We had so much fun. The food was great. Drinks are beyond amazing. Great vibes all around.

reviews.author: Salam Gabran
reviews.text: Disappointing experience. Le Pacha group is recognized for upscale dining, specialy, Carlos. However, piccolo mondo was a disappointment. In a basic Italian themed restaurant, you are served high quality EVOO and a fine balsamic vinegar, paired with good quality bread, while waiting for the meal. That was not provided until we asked for it. We received a bowl of stale olive oil, and low quality balsamic vinegar. Compared to other lower caliber Italian themed restaurants in heliopolis, piccolo mondo failed. Pizza ingredients were good, the expected quality, but the dough was more of chewy bread. In the end, that was not the anticipated quality while dining in le pacha

reviews.author: Marwan Ragheb
reviews.text: Piccolo Mondo, nestled in the basement of Le Pasha boat, offers a cozy setting with pseudo "Italian specialties". The ambiance is charming and the service is decent, making it a pleasant spot for a casual meal. The food itself is middle-of-the-road — nothing extraordinary but passable. The biggest letdown was the bread buns, which tasted like they were defrosted in the microwave and lacked freshness. Overall, it's an acceptable choice if you're not seeking culinary perfection but just a relaxed meal by the Nile.

name: Mat’am El 6th of October
address: Mat’am El 6th of October, Cairo, Egypt

reviews.author: D Tas
reviews.text: The place may not look nice to you, but it is a really nice place. This is a local place and hawawshi should really be eaten here. I had the hawawshi with cheese and it was really good. It was just a bit too greasy. If I come to Cairo again, I will come here again.

reviews.author: Eissa Al Remeithi
reviews.text: Not bad

reviews.author: Egyptian Backpacker
reviews.text: It's an amazing restaurant The food is very delicious 😋 Very cheap, the price start from ( 20 - 30) egp.

reviews.author: Tamer M. Awad
reviews.text: The inventor of the Hawawshi. It is the origin of it and the developer of new options. The atmosphere there is very friendly, cozy, warm and welcoming. There are other varieties available to choose from besides this main target of visitors. The outside is a different experience to have as well, it is worth trying.

reviews.author: Rafeik Said
reviews.text: The best ever hawawshy since more than 35 years i m using to eat at them, they are the most experienced in this field , i totally recommend them

name: Mat’am El Nasr City
address: Mat’am El Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt

name: Mat’am El Sayeda Zeinab
address: Mat’am El Sayeda Zeinab, Cairo, Egypt

reviews.author: Khaled Salah
reviews.text: The wonderful collection of games in one building with 3 levels As well as the children's area and its distinctive games

reviews.author: Jesse Lee
reviews.text: This is a very nice and elegant restaurant, the staff were very friendly and professional. The food was good but not exceptional for the price.

reviews.author: Juergen Cannes
reviews.text: This Turkish Restaurant belongs to the Hotel Kempinski NILE. We got invited for a meal from the Restaurant Manager, Mr. Ahmed Ragab, whom I have informed about some negative experiences in the Lounge and Blue Restaurant. The ambiance of the Restaurant is nice but not luxury, what I have expected from a 5 Star Hotel. We were sitting in a separate room. Fast we got the Menu. We ordered Mezze ( 6 different were served), the Jumbo Prawns and mixed Seafood baked in the oven. The presentation could have done better. All of the fresh fish was swimming in the deep sauce on a small fish plate. It was difficult to find the fish due to be covered and swimming in the brown sauce. The taste of the mixed fish ( white fish and Salmon, Prawns and Mussels was good except the two Mussels. It was difficult to eat from this plate. If I wouldn't have done it slowly and carefully all would have landed on the table cloth. Opposite the Mezze was perfectly prepared and of an unbeatable good taste. What a pity that nobody has cared about us sitting in a separate room. In general I can recommend this Restaurant.

reviews.author: Sally Scrivener
reviews.text: The best jumbo prawns and halloumi I have ever had and superb service too.

reviews.author: Nexuser
reviews.text: Excellently served by Ahmad and Adam. Quick and efficient service for a delicious cuisine. I was amazed by the french fries not too much fried in appearance but well cooked. It deserves me crossing the whole earth to come to Cairo.

reviews.author: Diana PHILIP
reviews.text: This is a lovely restaurant by the Nile. This was a last-minute stop as another place we looked at was closed. The menu is more than comprehensive and it would be very hard to decide on the things you want to eat. Definitely get one of the starters and a main, if there is room left a dessert will do it just right. We had a few different things and we loved it all. We loved the experience from the start to the end and will repeat it on our next stay. Our waiter Oman was very kind, and friendly and this experience was special.

reviews.author: Mohamed Sultan
reviews.text: That is one of the best places ever in Cairo. It has lovely scenes and views. It is in the middle of the river Nile in Zamalek. They have a very good quality food. They have also a very good and quick service. It is expensive but it deserves. Once you are there for once, you will be there for several times.

reviews.author: Kenny Vb
reviews.text: This place was recommended to us via locals and I must say it is something. Situated on a riverbank in the middle of Cairo it is an exceptional place. Somewhat upper scale, but certainly accessible for everyone. The vue is unique, but it's not something you will easily found as a regular tourist. We had an Iftar dinner, so I can not tell you how the menu looks like normaly, but this time it was a pretty damn good buffet. I hidden gem. To discover for certain!

reviews.author: أبو العز
reviews.text: In the area of ​​Zamalek, the view of the Nile is wonderful with breath of fresh air .. Speed ​​in service .. Food providers are professional and respectful .. The taste of food is good, very expensive Its location on the Nile is good. Entry is by appointment. Sequoia restaurant has been closed and opened in Beeja restaurant.

reviews.author: Thavyness
reviews.text: What a gorgeous place...loved the tent style restaurant with gorgeous views of the Nile. Place is cosy with relaxed sofa seating, shisha, cocktails, and delicious food!! There was even a large round table for big groups who want to celebrate a special occasion. We watched fresh bread being baked in brick-oven in back of the restaurant. We came here for a business dinner and would highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Cindy Tsai
reviews.text: So lovely and airy with the best Nile view in the city! Food was good but not out of this world. Nice drinks and international crowd

reviews.author: Ahmed Ehab
reviews.text: So little portions when it comes to Nutella pie, and the savory has good portions but low quality ingredients. I totally don't recommend it, especially with the high price.

reviews.author: Ulkar Eldarqizi
reviews.text: For the first time trying fateer i like the taste. They have both savory and sweet one. Also a rare masheltek one. I like savour rolls with smoked mixed however it had waay too much cheese so u can’t taste meat at all. The other one was big enough, although my husband (local) says it is supposed to have more butter and buttery smell. As a foreigner to me it was delicious as it is. Prices are a bit high maybe because it locates in Zamalek? I believe it deserves 25% cheaper compared to local prices here. Service was great and Ahmad was very nice and helpful. Even though they didn’t have tea on their menu he ordered from outside for us. One more note side dips are pretty big and expensive, especially if u wanna try few things it will ho to waste. My suggestion is it can be cheaper and less amount instead to not waste leftovers. I recommend to try it 😍they have different branches all over Cairo

reviews.author: Areeb Jawed
reviews.text: As a tourist, this place is gold! We got a Hawawshi (meat in bread which is then baked or fried), a fateera with vegetables like mushrooms, olives and cheese, and also a roll with garlic cream and white cheese. Although the roll was too heavy for us to finish (gave it to a nearby homeless person), we couldn't stop eating the fateera and Hawawshi. They were spot on and delicious. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Hos “Hos” A
reviews.text: I tried it 3 years ago and 2 weeks ago. It was great and it became terrible. The fetir unfortunately was thrown at the end because it can't be eaten. Tasteless, not fresh, not as it used to be at all. Avoid.

reviews.author: Zeyad Ahmed
reviews.text: Okay lets rate everything i tried on a scale from (1-10) Fries (0) Hot dog feteera (8) Alfredo chicken feteera (7) Coulslow (-10) Nuttela banana 🍌 (8.5) To sum it up you will taste the best feteer ever specially that its made very light nearly no oil Any thing else the screwed it up unfortunately They have to put some effort in side dishes It is calm with low light good for a date not so good for a group You will enjoy the taste of feteer and just feteer dont waste your time tasting
