reviews.text: So little portions when it comes to Nutella pie, and the savory has good portions but low quality ingredients. I totally don't recommend it, especially with the high price.

reviews.author: Ulkar Eldarqizi
reviews.text: For the first time trying fateer i like the taste. They have both savory and sweet one. Also a rare masheltek one. I like savour rolls with smoked mixed however it had waay too much cheese so u can’t taste meat at all. The other one was big enough, although my husband (local) says it is supposed to have more butter and buttery smell. As a foreigner to me it was delicious as it is. Prices are a bit high maybe because it locates in Zamalek? I believe it deserves 25% cheaper compared to local prices here. Service was great and Ahmad was very nice and helpful. Even though they didn’t have tea on their menu he ordered from outside for us. One more note side dips are pretty big and expensive, especially if u wanna try few things it will ho to waste. My suggestion is it can be cheaper and less amount instead to not waste leftovers. I recommend to try it 😍they have different branches all over Cairo

reviews.author: Areeb Jawed
reviews.text: As a tourist, this place is gold! We got a Hawawshi (meat in bread which is then baked or fried), a fateera with vegetables like mushrooms, olives and cheese, and also a roll with garlic cream and white cheese. Although the roll was too heavy for us to finish (gave it to a nearby homeless person), we couldn't stop eating the fateera and Hawawshi. They were spot on and delicious. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Hos “Hos” A
reviews.text: I tried it 3 years ago and 2 weeks ago. It was great and it became terrible. The fetir unfortunately was thrown at the end because it can't be eaten. Tasteless, not fresh, not as it used to be at all. Avoid.

reviews.author: Zeyad Ahmed
reviews.text: Okay lets rate everything i tried on a scale from (1-10) Fries (0) Hot dog feteera (8) Alfredo chicken feteera (7) Coulslow (-10) Nuttela banana 🍌 (8.5) To sum it up you will taste the best feteer ever specially that its made very light nearly no oil Any thing else the screwed it up unfortunately They have to put some effort in side dishes It is calm with low light good for a date not so good for a group You will enjoy the taste of feteer and just feteer dont waste your time tasting

reviews.author: Su Xiao
reviews.text: Socotra island has all of the spectacular and wonderful things that they are rarely to be seen in the other places over the world - beautiful caves, white sand beaches, sand dunes, cliff and oceanfront, bottle tree and desert roses, dragon blood trees, Egyptian vultures, to name a few.

reviews.author: Rugile Gile
reviews.text: Incredibly versatile landscape across a small area. Gorgeous trees and even more fascinating sea life 🤩 You will have a time of your life. I definitely had!

reviews.author: A J Bashha
reviews.text: The Dragon's Blood Tree (Dracaena cinnabari) is a remarkable species endemic to Socotra Island, Yemen, where it grows in large densities of woodland. Its distinctive umbrella-like mushroom shape is entirely natural. These trees can live up to 600 years and reach a height of 10 meters. The tree's deep red resin, resembling blood, has been highly valued since the Roman era for its uses in dye, violin varnish, medicine, makeup, and rituals. Socotra, located in the Indian Ocean near the coasts of Yemen and Somalia, is politically part of Yemen, though it has historical and cultural connections to Somalia. The island features spectacular scenery and is home to numerous endemic species of plants, birds, and other fauna, such as the Dragon's Blood Tree. Its unique landscape includes rugged mountains, canyons, wadis, caves, and picturesque beaches. The calm, shallow sea and the warm climate make it an attractive destination for nature lovers, scientists, and adventurers. Tourists often engage in snorkeling, fishing, hiking, and sightseeing, making the most of the island's natural beauty. However, Socotra lacks proper tourist infrastructure, such as hotels or guesthouses, and camping remains the only accommodation option. Transportation and facilities are underdeveloped, which preserves its untouched appeal. The island's population is relatively low and includes indigenous Socotri people, along with residents from other parts of Asia and Africa. The Socotri are known for their generosity and hospitality toward visitors. Despite its natural wonders, Socotra faces challenges, including illegal flights from the UAE that are not approved by Yemen’s government. These activities, tied to the UAE's broader role in Yemen, raise concerns about the island’s sovereignty. Nonetheless, Socotra remains a remote and captivating destination for those willing to embrace its rustic charm and unspoiled environment.

reviews.author: Міша Кобута
reviews.text: Socotra is the most alien-looking place on Earth — wild, untouched, and absolutely mesmerizing. Located off the coast of Yemen, this island is home to trees and landscapes that exist nowhere else in the world. The iconic Dragon Blood Trees look like giant mushrooms from another galaxy, and the island is full of bizarre plant life, white-sand beaches, and crystal-clear lagoons. It’s a paradise for adventurers, photographers, and nature lovers. No big hotels, no crowds — just raw beauty and complete disconnection. Sunsets on Socotra feel sacred. Nights are filled with stars. And the silence? Unreal. It’s not the easiest place to reach, but maybe that’s what keeps it pure. If you want to see Earth before it was touched — go to Socotra.

reviews.author: Benjamin Barakat
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful islands and places I have ever been! The landscape is unreal, and the people here very very welcoming and friendly! If your interested in visiting be sure to check out my website to find out more about the tours I host here yearly!

name: Street Stall - Khan El Khalili
address: Street Stall - Khan El Khalili, Cairo, Egypt

reviews.author: Arthur Krzycki
reviews.text: Great place. A true bazaar in the best traditions of the Middle East. Yes, plenty of tourists, but quite a few locals having fun, listening to music and drinking tea as well.

reviews.author: Legends l
reviews.text: Huge huge market with hundreds of vendors. The upper part is more geared towards tourists and from here you can buy souvenirs and many more. You can easily get lost. I found the vendors to be okay. They all have their own techniques. After all, they have to sell to survive! If you are uncomfortable with prices, always try another stall. Prices can be inflated so do negotiate or shop around. There are eateries as well. Beware of scammers who hang around the main road. They will befriend you and lead you to shops you don’t want to visit. I loved this market and was glad to come away with a fair bit of purchase supporting locals whilst not being ripped off.

reviews.author: Halide Vera
reviews.text: It was a hugeee bazaar! The city Cairo never sleeps. The whole night bazaar was open. You can find here many local products like essences, spices, nuts, gift shops. Nice to visit place.

reviews.author: Katarina Petrinec
reviews.text: This bazar was great if you’re looking for deals, once you enter the upper part of the bazar it’s for tourist nicer quality, better fabrics, maybe more money but quality is there. I bought two scarves, three pyramids and a table cloth. The market itself very busy crowded so remember where you are it’s so easy to get lost! As a tourist it’s important to barter because they will lower their price walk away if you have to! They will drop the prices you don’t have to buy right away. Just learn to walk away! I got some great deals today. Very happy with my purchases I walked away came back to negotiate they dropped the prices but it’s important to note that they still have to make a living but not taking advantage of tourist either! The further you go into the bazar the quality drops rapidly. You can find food venues which are awesome! Lots of places to eat drink and find anything. Keep yourself alert as you can easily lose things.

reviews.author: Neil Horchover
reviews.text: Noisy and very busy, but we went at 7pm… You get the feel of a vibrant life here, everyone is friendly to you, but also it is an Egyptian place not tourists so you see women buying their spices, families having meals and old men sitting drinking coffee marvelling why a western bloke is amazed at what he calls home

name: Street Stall - Tahrir Sq
address: Street Stall - Tahrir Sq, Cairo, Egypt

reviews.author: Aya Becker
reviews.text: We visited Taboula twice. The first time, the service was impeccable — very welcoming and friendly. The second visit, however, was quite the opposite, which was a bit disappointing. That said, the food was great on both occasions. We ordered a variety of mezes, and every single one was delicious. The only dish I didn’t enjoy was the tabbouleh–fattoush combo. It felt more like a basic salad with iceberg lettuce, tomatoes, and a hint of honey. The only element that resembled fattoush was the fried bread pieces. The real highlight of the meal was the bread — absolutely amazing. Because of how filling it is, I’d recommend either enjoying it with the mezes or skipping straight to a main dish. Otherwise, you might find yourself too full to truly enjoy everything. Despite the inconsistent service, we loved the food enough to come back again. Taboula is definitely one of the nicest spots in the area.

reviews.author: Roger
reviews.text: Very French/Lebanese style restaurant for tourists but tasteful. A little pricey but food was good, staff speak good English and French - they allow smoking at tables which is disappointing these days. Nice cosy atmosphere though in Garden City area.

reviews.author: Marwan
reviews.text: Overall, the place is pretty decent. The food is really good, but I was a bit annoyed by the indoor smoking. The prices are also pretty reasonable.

reviews.author: Kaitlyn McMillan
reviews.text: Best food I’ve had in Cairo and the service was impeccable. I went with the waiter’s recommendation, shish taouk motafe. It is chicken served with mushroom and lemon sauce. Soooo amazing. They also brought me free bread, yogurt sauce, and hummus. Maybe because I’m eating alone, or maybe it’s included. The restaurant is adorable and has dark mood lighting. I will definitely be back here.

reviews.author: Mikha'el Abdul
reviews.text: This restaurant is located in a very dark street/area. Quite a task to get there. We made a reservation in advance. The place was surprisingly packed despite the hidden location. We ordered a good bottle of French Wine for a decent price but was told that it was an Egyptian wine. The food wasn't the best. The Orzo soup was OK. The Shawarma plate was chipped as you see in the picture. The taste was very bland with a lack of spices. Overall, the ambience felt good and lively with the crowd but not for us. The noises overshadowed the music.

reviews.author: Andrea Iriarte
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Nile Ritz-Carlton. The service was wonderful. As we walked in, we were taken to the elevator so we could check in at the Club level, where we could eat dinner? Lunch? We were so jet lagged I had no idea what meal it was, but I really appreciated being able to eat and go to sleep. The food was delicious. The views of the Nile were incredible! The shops on the first floor were good. We did not use the pool, but it was really nice as well. You can walk straight into the most wonderful museum, avoiding lines and everything! Location is perfect! The only thing I would caution is that this hotel is a party central. Ask for a room on the Nile side, as the wedding parties can be LOUD!

reviews.author: Amy Re
reviews.text: We had the best stay ant the Ritz Carlton Cairo! Zeinab and Mohammed Hossem were so helpful and professional during our stay. The restaurant food was incredible with so many options to choose from. The rooms were comfortable and clean and overall hospitality at the hotel was the best ever!! We were also greeted by Menna in the lobby who took extra care of us while at the hotel. She even brought up a special book with history on Cairo. Our overall stay was outstanding! I highly recommend this hotel :)

reviews.author: Los ojos del pelícano 2010
reviews.text: My favorite hotel in Cairo. The breakfast is the best I never have before. Fantastic room and views. I am very grateful with Zeinab Elrayes and Mohamed Hussein, they were very kind and supporting. They take care of me. I really recommend this hotel and the food because the chef is a number one.

reviews.author: Ryan Kim
reviews.text: The Nile Ritz-Carlton in Cairo has a prestigious name and a prime location along the Nile, but the experience doesn’t fully live up to the brand’s usual standards. The hotel feels noticeably dated, with furnishings and decor that could use a refresh. While the service is polite and the views of the Nile are beautiful, the overall atmosphere lacks the modern luxury and refinement expected from a Ritz-Carlton property. For the price, you might expect a more updated and polished experience. Still, it's conveniently located near many key attractions, which is a plus. But in terms of value and condition, it falls short — a 3-star experience at best.

reviews.author: Waheed Kahtani
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at The Ritz-Carlton, Cairo from May 1–5, 2025. The room had a stunning Nile view and luxurious furnishings—absolutely beautiful and relaxing. The Front Desk and Guest Relations teams were very professional and warm welcome. Their kind and thoughtful attitude reflected true Egyptian hospitality and Arab generosity. Special thanks to them for making my experience smooth and memorable. The food was outstanding! I dined twice at Bab El-Sharq—both evenings were delightful. The ambiance, delicious food, and friendly staff made it a highlight of my visit.

reviews.author: Abdullah E Alshatti
reviews.text: Definitely one of the best breakfasts I’ve ever had in Egypt.. specially that I’m on a high protein diet, their eggs shakshoka with cheese, chicken shawarma dish were so delicious and clean.. it’s definitely gonna be my routine to visit Zooba and recommend it for my friends.

reviews.author: J. S.
reviews.text: The best place in Kairo Zamalek for breakfast - service & people are amazing. The service is excellent, the waiters welcome you with open arms and you feel completely at ease here. The location is small and doesn't invite you to linger for long, but that doesn't detract from the excellent quality of the food. If you are in Cairo, you absolutely have to eat here. Thanks to the Zööba team

reviews.author: Avery “AveryCloseCall” Alix
reviews.text: Overall, it was inexpensive and OK. The staff were surly but the atmosphere was OK if cold enough you need to wear a jacket. The rice pudding was great, otherwise the food wasn't noteworthy. Solid, inexpensive street food, served slowly. On the downside, they made no effort to shake spice around the fries, the shawarma was OK. We got in before it was busy but the wait staff just sat around instead of taking orders. Still, it was cheap! Unfortunately, there is a hidden 12% charge for service so I have to remove a star. If you want to charge more, just include it in the price... The food isn't expensive anyways!

reviews.author: Ihar Beliauski
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the style and vibe of Zööba Cafe in Cairo. The atmosphere is very cozy and authentic, and the fact that the waiter spoke English made the experience even more comfortable. It was my first time trying the traditional Egyptian dish, koshary. Honestly, when they brought it, I thought I wouldn’t like it, but to my surprise, it was actually very tasty! I also tried karkade juice, which was perfectly refreshing and not overly sweet.

reviews.author: LordPuppy RD
reviews.text: Pretty good food and it was our first meal in Egypt and we tried as much as we could. Our experience was good and I'd say it was the best rice pudding I ever had. Now that I had time to compare the quality, the only difference I can really tell is the Hawashi is not as good as other places. But service and price point is great!

reviews.text: I have been staying in this hotel for yearsssss every time I am in Dahab . The friendly staff , the biiiiiig rooms, the rooom and the perfect location 💜

reviews.author: Nouran Reda
reviews.text: In all honesty, the location is close to everything, sea front… the staff is beyond supportive and helpful. Very reasonable prices 100% recommend

reviews.author: Ahmad Salem
reviews.text: The location is excellent in the centre of Masbat Bay. The side view is a good option looking over souvenir shops, side-seaview, and side- mountainview. Breakfast is nice, and the chef is very helpful. Staff are helpful and honest. Suitable for families. The only problem comes out off the hotel; Surrounded by the crowded area of the market, the problem lies especially with the other kitchen of the Ali Baba restaurant, which doesn't belong to the hotel, making a lot of noise with tools and yelling at each other. N.B. The dining area of the hotel on the roof offers a magnificent view 👌🏻

reviews.author: Tarek Anwar
reviews.text: Good price, great location. Old school egyptian room style. A bit unclean though. Service a tad lacking although everyone is very friendly. Highlight is the roof where you can Egyptian breakfast.

reviews.author: Hala El-atr
reviews.text: Friendly stuff🙏🏼, and Great location👌, but room’s furniture is old, dusty☹️, and they not provide minibar service inside the room😠, however when I asked for, they provided me a kettle to assure my satisfaction. My point is don’t expect lavish service, but the stuff here really are amazing 👌and will do their best to make you comfortable and happy.🥰😀😀

reviews.author: Mahmoud Al-Wreikat (JY5HL)
reviews.text: The best fish restaurant ever in Aqaba. The food is very delicious, the service is very excellent, and the service is also very fast. The owner, management and staff are excellent and very friendly. Prices are reasonable and affordable. I highly recommend going there for lunch and/or dinner.

reviews.author: Alia Barahmeh
reviews.text: Great lunch experience at Alibaba in Aqaba! Tried various seafood dishes, ribs, biryani, and appetizers - all delicious. Outdoor seating is cool, centrally located in downtown. Easy taxi access from hotels. Prices fair for quality. Staff very friendly. Loved it!

reviews.author: AL Hanadi
reviews.text: I don’t if they are good at or not, We tried grilled meet mashawi, tabbouleh and chilli potato and yalanji, it was not good at all Sour tabbouleh, very dry and hard rice inside the yalanji Chilli potato was nice Rice was nice. Staff is perfect 👌🏽 very friendly and welcoming. Atmosphere is vintage and awesome.

reviews.author: Laura Carr
reviews.text: The fish was beautiful and fresh, cooked to perfection. The service was impeccable, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Rhys Travel
reviews.text: Delicious food especially fish sayadiyah, grilled shrimps and mixed grilled meat were all great. We had to wait maybe 15-20 mins for the food as they're very busy. It's probably a touristy place and it's comfortable and clean. We also had three drinks and kunafa and baklavas. The bill came to about 55JD for three of us with service and tax included.

reviews.author: Becca Rice
reviews.text: Tucked away in a side street, this quaint spot is a true gem of a restaurant. It looks modest from the outside, but from the moment you enter it's a quality experience all the way. Everything is prepared with care and fantastic quality. The staff are attentive, friendly and ready to offer guidance with the menu. We had several small dishes to be able to try a variety of flavors and from the first savory dish down to the dessert, it was all incredible. We didn't even think to take photos because we were so absorbed in the dishes presented to us! We will definitely be back! A big thank you to this wonderful place for such a great culinary experience ❤️

reviews.author: Ale K
reviews.text: I have been going to this restaurant for years and it has consistently been excellent. It's a small and intimate restaurant, so making a reservation is highly recommended. The food is truly delicious, offering a wonderful selection of hot and cold meze. The main courses are superb, and to finish, they have delicious desserts and excellent domestic coffee.

reviews.author: Ajay Parekh
reviews.text: 5 stars well deserved! Service with a smile and attention, food was tasty and plentiful. We were a group of six on our last night in Malta. Two of us had the vegetarian mezze items, the other four had the main meat dishes also ( no vegetarian options for main course), although too full to have any dessert. Oh and the wine list is extensive and we chose well with our red.

reviews.author: Mafalda Pedro
reviews.text: AMAZING!! We found this place on google when looking for a place for dinner last minute that was close to where we were staying in Gzira, and omg we were impressed!! Between the 2 of us we got a range of plates to share and we were so impressed by everything. We really recommend the lamb, it was so tender and juicy and probably the best lamb we've ever had! Everything else was equally amazing. We had some Lebanese wine that was so good as well. We were being constantly impressed whenever everything came out. The service was amazing and the restaurant didn't disappoint.

reviews.author: David Fenech
reviews.text: We have been before but it’s been a while, so we were looking forward to enjoying some very good Mediterranean/ Middle Eastern food. The serving staff as smart and attentive as always - they deserve the best accolades as much as the cooking staff for their amazing food. We asked for our Albanian server to choose the food for us and he made some great choices. The starter hummus dips and lamb/harissa dip were so nice with the fresh bread. We felt the felafal had a very hard / burnt exterior shell, but all the meat based dishes were simply divine, including the lamb tongue. The wine is on the expensive side and the servers tried to sell more of it - doing their job. But the biggest hang up we had was the heat in the restaurant- we really couldn’t imagine eating there in summer. Having said that, I’m in love with this place - recommended

reviews.author: Jonas Bürgi
reviews.text: Some of the best food I have ever eaten in my life. There is only one dish - but this dish is perfect. There is one waiter who can speak english very well.

reviews.author: Sara Ahmed Fouad
reviews.text: The meat taste is really different. I was advised to try it, but I didn't give a big importance for the advice. Now I know, it deserves 😊

reviews.author: Safae Kherbouche
reviews.text: This place deserves 100 stars, if you ever come to Konya this place is a must try

reviews.author: Amin Memari
reviews.text: The best Turkish firing kabab you can find here, the pure taste of lamb with fresh bread takes you to the extreme of enjoyment. We ordered some Turkish sweets with tea, a great combination 👍 strongly recommend it.

reviews.author: Lennart Garritsen
reviews.text: This place is a true scam. I went here because of the reviews. They specialised in lamb with onions and bread (nothing else on offer). Food is good but fatty and service is friendly. But: very high price - 150gr plus water was 425TL… price quality is insanely bad. Other places charge way less despite owners claims. Will never return here…

reviews.author: Alexander Leonidas
reviews.text: We started with the seafood soup and the Egyptian bread with dips. The soup was good, it lacked saltiness however. The dips were very good and so was the bread. For main we had a grilled fish with vegetables. This had a tomato based vegetable medley which paired well with the fish. Overall this is good bang for your buck.

reviews.author: Shahd Elbadry
reviews.text: The treatment was so friendly, the service was excellent, the quality and the taste of the food was brilliant. Note: the mixed seafood dish is small but worth it

reviews.author: Mohamed ELFishawy
reviews.text: We tried it two times in 2023 and 2024 2023 was amazing, and this year was even better ( and I am not even a sea food fan ) Fried Calamari and butterfly shrimps were delicious, but my favourite item was the Mussels ( with butter, mozzarella, and vegetables) Very friendly staff, great view and of course you can't forget the tea . الاكل ممتاز والكمية مناسبة وسعر مناسب Delicious - good portion and good price

reviews.author: Cyriac Edappully
reviews.text: Had a really good experience here. The fish was very nicely prepared and quite delicious. The decor isn't as lovely as some of the other higher-end places. But the service is still very good. Also it's more reasonably priced. Really enjoyed my visit here.

reviews.author: Theresa Klose
reviews.text: Vistit in 12/2023: Very nice and friendly restaurant. We came twice during our holidays and had some food, tea and a shisha. The food was very tasty and the menu was quite big. The staff is extraordinary friendly - they really live their slogan. It is very nice to sit close to the sea and enjoy the view on the bay. Unfortunately there was a bit smell from cats there (well Dahab has a lot of cats, so its not the only restaurant with that issue and its not their fault). Update after next visti in 12/2024: the restaurant is still good and the staff is friendly.

reviews.author: Bassel Sherif
reviews.text: Great place for fried chicken. Just what you would expect with the street atmosphere and the good food. Good service but sauce wasn't the best though. Would definitely go again.

reviews.author: Peter Hanna
reviews.text: Looks not good .. and prices are not real . and then you know it's wonderful taste of food .. and the price very very less than the quality of the food and taste .. Sure every time in dahab I will be there for sure ..

reviews.author: G maze
reviews.text: Amazing in terms of quality and money worthy. Best one in Dahab tbh. Deep flavor and very quickly in serving and amazing portions. Just surrounded by so many cats and dogs which might be annoying sometimes

reviews.author: Ahmed A. Hosny
reviews.text: I went to King Chicken in Dahab and ordered 3 rice-stuffed pigeons — it was really good! The meal came with generous sides: 3 servings of molokhia, rice, tahina, and salad. Everything was flavorful, fresh, and very affordable. The total was just 600 EGP for all of it. Definitely a great spot for a hearty, traditional Egyptian meal at a good price

reviews.author: David Attia
reviews.text: I try the Mix grill and it was fabulass and reasonobale prices

reviews.author: Elena Fedorchenko
reviews.text: Great seafood restaurant. Not cheap by Sinai standards, but very tasty.

reviews.author: Yomna Elfar
reviews.text: We ordered the blueberry pretzel — it was really nice! The sandwiches were good; the bacon was definitely better than the turkey. I wouldn’t recommend the tiramisu though — it was below average. But overall, it’s a great spot for breakfast and bakeries, with reasonable prices.

reviews.author: leen faqiat
reviews.text: I always wondered why the restaurant was always so crowded—until I visited it myself. I tried several items from the menu, and all of them were great (except for the pretzels). I highly recommend the sandwiches—they’re delicious, filling, and freshly made. The prices are also very reasonable, making it a great value for the quality. It’s definitely a top spot for breakfast, and I’ll be coming back for more!

reviews.author: Minerva Sadek
reviews.text: Good breakfast spot, has healthy and loaded options. We had the Vitamin breakfast (fruits, yogurt, honey and muesli) which was so good and refreshing, we also ordered eggs and the honey cake. Coffee was fine and the food is very worth it

reviews.author: Alena Milashchenko
reviews.text: Time:9:30 AM Date:19.04.25 Delicious pastries, but the service ruins everything. We had breakfast at the restaurant and afterwards asked to take the remaining bun to go. The cashier gave us a dirty bag for the pastry. We had to ask a different waiter to pack the food properly. Overall, the food was tasty, but the service was terrible. The only positive impression was from one waiter — an older gentleman who did his job with dignity and professionalism.

reviews.author: Dana Alshashani
reviews.text: Disgusting attitudes from staff especially the cashier was very rude and was being sarcastic about me ordering pancakes!! How should i know you only serve them in cairo!! disgusting service the waiter got us the wrong coffee then when i explained to him that i knew it was the next table’s coffee because i tasted it ((I told him in arabic so he definitely understood what i was saying القهوة للطاولة التانية، عرفت انها مش قهوتي لاني شربت منها he still gave my cup to that table!!)) i had to warn them not to drink it cause i’ve already had a sip!!! + food was less than basic + quite expensive considering how terrible the experience was

reviews.author: dear winni
reviews.text: very good food and we have been dahab for 3 days and we have come for 2 meals here already probably we will come back at the last day the aubergine is really sooooooo nice the price is reasonable

reviews.author: Ahmed Gharieb
reviews.text: Good but over rated Value for money you get very good food for what you are paying Not the excellent but still good experience but it is a common Egyptian restaurant providing Egyptian local traditional food for very good prices. It is a bit busy because of that, so show up early if you are looking to dine in. You can also order takeaway sandwiches which looks good.

reviews.author: Mark Rezkalla
reviews.text: The place has good vibes for eating in, and the value for money is good. Foul was not that tasty, falafel was mediocre. On the other hand french fries was good it had a very delicious spices on it. Recommended for breakfast but don’t raise your expectations!

reviews.author: Deborah Dalla Nora
reviews.text: Really nice and friendly service as well as delicious food 🤤 gets everyone happy- vegans, vegetarians and non! Also, the quality-price is totally worth it. I highly recommend it and we’ll surely come back ;)

reviews.author: Rasha Elsaadany
reviews.text: Very tasty breakfast... 😋 😋 😋 Helpful staff and very good location.. Nearst to everything.. Best place for oriental breakfast in Dahab.

reviews.author: Lauren Johnson
reviews.text: We had an excellent stay for a short family trip. The hotel is well-situated with great views of the lake. The suite was spacious, comfortable, and clean. The service staff is amazing and made sure we felt accommodated. The two restaurants both have tasty food and the breakfasts were lovely. The pools and grounds are super well-maintained. This is a great place for family, couples, or single visitors to have a relaxing stay!

reviews.author: S Ghani
reviews.text: Gorgeous spot, great trip with partner or family. Food is really delicious. Beautiful views and everything is close by. Very calm and chilled, adult only pools. Rooms were stunning. Breakfast was huge and delicious

reviews.author: Nader Raafat
reviews.text: Incredible place to stay! Very relaxing and luxurious, you won't want to leave. All the staff went above and beyond in every way, from waiters to housekeeping to reception staff. Everyone was always friendly and had a big smile on their face when helping you and it makes such a difference, they took pride in their work. Rooms are very comfortable and the pool with a lake view is excellent. Great escape from the city noise and bustle

reviews.author: Michiel Buitelaar
reviews.text: Luxurious but relaxed, friendly, cosy. Friendly staff. Not much to see or do in the vicinity - too bad the lake is not swimmable. Rooms are spacious and well designed.

reviews.author: Theofilos SHIN
reviews.text: You can be surprised at this hotel before the desert area. I can say this is a kind of design boutique hotel. There is a good restaurant and you can enjoy something unique and different scenery within and from the hotel to outside.

reviews.author: Christian Naroz
reviews.text: ✨ A Breakfast to Remember at 9 Pyramids Lounge! ✨ This place truly took my breath away — starting with the incredible view of the pyramids, which made for the most unforgettable breakfast experience. The service was top-notch from the moment we walked in, and the food… wow. Absolutely delicious! We enjoyed a classic oriental spread with perfectly seasoned foul, crispy falafel, and warm, flaky feteer that melted in our mouths. I also tried el3asal and te7ena for the very first time — and let me tell you, it was one of the best things I’ve ever tasted in my life. A flavor I’ll never forget! A special shoutout to Essam, our amazing waiter. He was incredibly polite, attentive, and professional — his service was truly phenomenal and made our experience even more special. If you’re in Cairo, do yourself a favor and make this your breakfast stop. You won’t regret it! 🌅🍽️🇪🇬

reviews.author: Piotrek P
reviews.text: An amazing place right in front of the Pyramids. The food was really fresh and tasty (went for oriental breakfast option). I recommend booking this place month in advance as it's hard to get a table. The access is easy but need to allow time to buy tickets to access the plateau and wait for the shuttle bus. Highly recommend this beautiful place. Will definitely come back

reviews.author: Jack Watson
reviews.text: Incredible service! Essam was such an amazing server. He made sure we were always taken care of and even went the extra mile to make sure we had fresh hot bread. If you come here I would advise to ask for him as it really made our experience here fantastic. Omar in the front was also great.

reviews.author: Laila Elbaddaly
reviews.text: The view of the Pyramids makes the whole experience special. The food was really good, flavorful and well-made. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the service was fast. A great spot to enjoy a meal with a view of the Great Pyramids. Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Mohammed Altamimi T
reviews.text: I’d heard a lot about 9 Pyramids Lounge and all the fuss around it, but honestly, the service was below average and the Egyptian food wasn’t the best. The only thing that stood out was the amazing view while having breakfast. I think the place could do much better by improving food quality and service adding some entertainment would definitely enhance the vibe for tourists.”

reviews.author: Ana M
reviews.text: The restaurant is so beautiful (we went during luch) and the food is sooo delicious. We ordered some drinks and boneless chicken (comes with fries). First we sat inside but after 15min they offered us another table with an amazing view, it was very kind of them. The chicken was soooooo good, it tasted like butter and garlic and it was so juicy, really really nice. The prices were also okay, not expensive. I recommend this restaurant.

reviews.author: Marta Querol, escritora
reviews.text: Very nice place with a simple but good menu. We asked for samoussas, excellent, and unboned chicken with fries and salad very good, accompanied of an Egipcien Red wine, tastefull and strong. The ambience, envolving but quite cold a that time. They had heaters. Service a little slow. We asked them to call for an uber to go back to the hotel and it costed double than the way to.

reviews.author: Oliver Maclean
reviews.text: One of the best meals of my life. The location is very random and a bit sus as you drive up but all is forgiven when I saw the view from the patio. All the staff were very friendly with us (westerners, no Arabic) and we were able to get up close in the kitchen and bake our own bread. The chicken was incredibly juicy and well seasoned. Mezze was great too. Another standout was the vine leaves, didn’t know so much flavour could be in such a small bite. Seriously fantastic meal!

reviews.author: Amr Kamal
reviews.text: We were a group of 4 adults and 3 children. If you ever visited the old original restaurant, you will be very disappointed with this new venue. We used to visit the old restaurant once a week where we were welcomed with a smile from the door until we left. There were plenty of parking spaces that belonged to the restaurant itself, not just parking somewhere in the street. Waiters were very friendly and cheerful, which made us wanna order more. Nowadays, they just stall you for 30 minutes until they come to you with a stranger behavior and unfriendly attitude as if you were to eat for free. I can't imagine also that in 2025, we are still having a sign where you enter that identifies a minimum charge for what you should pay per person. What if I am on a diet and would like to eat only a grilled chicken that costs half the price!!! Humiliating. Food was very humble compared to the gorgeous tasty meals offered in the old one. Friendliness for children cannot be even compared. In the old restaurant, we had animals to ride, play with, and feed. Here, you have just a magnificent view which is not also provided for all tables including ours. I don't see myself visiting this restaurant again as it will ruin the great impressions and memories I had in mind for the old one.

reviews.author: Moataz Ibrahim
reviews.text: We had a stop by lunch and order their rotisserie half chicken, unfortunately was very dry mean specially breast and the over paste of Rosemarie made it more more dry, herring and mixed salad were good.

reviews.author: Kevin B
reviews.text: This is a review based on my experience tonight. I am a British solo traveller and I have been in Cairo four nights. This is by FAR the best place i have eaten at. Firstly I want to say the food is amazing and is cooked fresh. Be prepared to wait, why rush, escape from the chaos of Giza/Cairo. Secondly this is a local restaurant and as such do not expect many tourists and respect the local traditions, embrace it. As such don't expect alcohol. The views here are amazing at night (and I image in the day too) with the ability to clearly here the audio from the light show at the pyramids as well as seeing them obviously. The staff here are so well mannered which can be rare for a tourist in a local restaurant, they don't obsess over you but do provide a top service. I took the time to thank the chef downstairs as well as his culinary skills were divine. A shame I have to move on tomorrow from Cairo otherwise I would definitely be here again! 😍🙏🏻

reviews.author: Laura Matthys
reviews.text: If you are staying on this area of Giza this is the best option to have lunch/dinner or even breakfast. We went there for 3 days straight to have dinner and the personal was very nice, food really delicious and they have really good juices. They have 2 terraces where you can sit and watch the pyramids, even get to see the lights and sound show from there. Prices were good, there is not a lot of luxury inside but I can assure the food is the best!

reviews.author: Samar Ammar
reviews.text: They have the best view on Pyramids with very reasonable prices. I have spent the whole day there and tried their food, dessert and drinks and liked them all ❤️ .. but I didn't like the type of songs they play it very very loud and ruins the atmosphere at night.

reviews.author: GABRIEL PEDRO GONZALEZ CONNIO
reviews.text: The view is amazing. You can see the three pyramids together at the same time in a short distance. The food is really good tasting 👍👍

reviews.author: EsRaa Hamza
reviews.text: I have visited the place twice, they have a very beautiful roof with an amazing view to pyramids and sphinx , prices are reasonable and stuff is friendly. very near to the pyramids gate. A Highly recommended place❤️

reviews.author: Almaith
reviews.text: They have many branches, so I’m not exactly sure which one I was at. They offer a ‘Pyramid’ dessert that’s really rich and large. I tried the Umm Ali and rice pudding—total rating: 8/10

reviews.author: Aly Madbouly
reviews.text: Good place but too small to sit and eat.. Prefer to get the food as take away

reviews.author: mohammed Hamad
reviews.text: Not like before, very expensive prices

reviews.author: Ahmed Amer
reviews.text: You pay a lot for average quality. The dine in place isn't well equipped or furnished.

reviews.author: Hameed Hamada
reviews.text: a collection of ice cream with its different tastes , fruit salads and other nice things

reviews.author: Waleed Khaleel
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Alaa Shakar
reviews.text: A beautiful place that lacks some attention in treatment

reviews.author: AHMED ALMASAABI
reviews.text: Very nice and good place

reviews.author: محمد سلطان
reviews.text: Food is average

reviews.author: علي عماد
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: عبدالله العناني
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: HuiChing
reviews.text: The legendary Khan al-Khalili Bazaar Traveled to Egypt in early 2013. According to rumors, the Khalili Market, which is very large, easy to shop, easy to buy, and very Egyptian, is scheduled for the afternoon of January 25, the last day of the trip. At that time, the destination is back to the starting point, Cairo. I have been waiting for this moment to take action ~ I want to bring back some very Arabian souvenirs! By the way, during this trip to Egypt, security checks were tight everywhere - museums, restaurants, hotels, trains... entering any tourist attractions required X-ray and metal detector inspections, because I had just experienced the incident in Egypt on January 25, 2011. Launch the Jasmine Revolution. A fire next to Tahrir Square burned down the political party building to which former Prime Minister Mubarak belonged. The location was right next to the Cairo Museum we visited, and the traces of the burned walls were still clearly visible. According to reports, the anger that reflects the Egyptians' desire for freedom, democracy and economic development will spread again. The time is the second anniversary. In the afternoon of January 25, 2013, one of the gathering places for 80,000 anti-government demonstrators was in Kazakhstan. Mosque Square in Lili Bazaar…. The calm local tour guide, in order to avoid our unnecessary worries and not being able to fully experience the splendor of ancient civilization, did not calmly inform us of its seriousness until the last moment, and respect the show of hands of the whole group whether to give up the attraction... In order to avoid the radicals and being trapped in the siege and unable to catch the flight on time, the whole group ended up visiting the ‘Carrefour Market’ at the airport. After entering the Egyptian airport customs, the TV screen was constantly showing horrific images of riots, smoke, casualties... across Cairo. Of course, that also includes the places around Khalili that we were going to... Watching the military and police use tear gas and rubber bullets against the demonstrators, tense clashes broke out... At this time, we were about to get on the plane and leave here. The Khalili Market, the largest in the Middle East where ancient Egyptian camel caravans gathered, as well as the yellow sand camel bells and thousand-year-old Egypt, we are destined to see you again! As for photos of Khalili, they are missing.

reviews.author: Faisal Hegazy
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Jad Boulos
reviews.text: A great place to try authentic Egyptian koshary affordable, filling, and packed with carbs (pasta, rice, and lentils). The place is always crowded, which speaks to its popularity. The taste is good, not exceptional, but definitely worth trying. Just keep in mind that it's a heavy meal and can be a bit tough on digestion

reviews.author: Piotrek P
reviews.text: This is a chain restaurant with very efficient service and tasty food:-) it's fast and filling - good place to experience traditional meal called Koshary. They provide four different sizes of the same meal. I usually go for medium which is large enough. The dish costed 1 Euro including a drink.

reviews.author: Mohamed “Egypt Tour Guide” Ashmawy Ashy
reviews.text: Koshary is a truly delicious and satisfying Egyptian dish that's loved by many, and the chain of koshary El Taharit restaurants is one of the famous chains in Cairo services Koshary. Koshary's ingredients are, Rice: A base for the dish. Lentils: Provide a hearty texture and protein. Tomato sauce: Adds a tangy flavor. Koshary sauce: A unique sauce specific to koshari, often made with vinegar and spices. Beans: Chickpeas are commonly used. Dental: This might be a typo or a local term. Perhaps you meant " lentils"? Fried onions: Add a crispy texture and savory flavor. #Ashy_Egypt

reviews.author: eezee48
reviews.text: Excellent value. Good, healthy food with rice, noodles, lentils, special tomato sauce and chicken peas. Friendly service.

reviews.author: Shammes Al Shamsi
reviews.text: Amazing koshary + excellent service

reviews.author: Mehmet Dilşeker
reviews.text: The restaurant offers a rich and diverse menu with options to suit every palate. The portions, especially for non-seafood dishes, are generously sized and satisfying. The establishment also stands out with its impeccable cleanliness and well-presented service. Every dish is served with great attention to detail, ensuring a pleasant and hygienic dining experience. Moreover, the attentive and friendly staff make guests feel truly valued, and the reasonable pricing further enhances this delightful experience.

reviews.author: Jonathan Cohen
reviews.text: Last night in Egypt and we wanted an authentic Seafood dinner, and that is what we got. Many locals here and everything was tasty and since I am waiting for the check, I'm not sure of the price but they seem very reasonable (I ordered market price items so the actual price is not known yet). Also the fresh mango juice was just that - just juiced mangos.

reviews.author: Maksymilian Szymczyk
reviews.text: The restaurant was great with super delicious and cheap food. It’s great for all countries because the menu is in a lot of different languages. The food was marvelous and so delicious. It was so many great things and I would highly recommend it especially if you are on a budget and are looking for some really delicious food. So to summarize this is an amazing restaurant almost perfect in every way and i highly recommend it. Super cheap as well.

reviews.author: Gledhow 2023
reviews.text: Absolutely blown away by this place! I honestly can’t understand why it’s only rated 4.3, this restaurant is a true gem. As a Mediterranean who loves fish, I can say this was one of the best fish meals I’ve ever had, especially at such an incredible price! The fish soup was to die for: rich, flavourful, and comforting. The homemade lemon juice was hands down one of the best I’ve ever tried. Our children had the tagliatelle with salmon and devoured every bite. We definitely over-ordered, but everything was just too tempting: the calamari, shrimps, mussels, each dish was absolutely delicious. I had the seabass, and although I couldn’t finish it, it was perfectly cooked and full of flavor. This place was such a great surprise. I genuinely can’t fault it. Thank you for making my day!

reviews.author: Inna Stateva
reviews.text: The service is excellent- they would guide you through the options of fresh seafood and recommend ways for it to be prepared. The food arrives really quickly - while you wait for it, you can enjoy the local bread and dips (you have to order them though). The red fish and the soups are a must try.

reviews.author: Paul Emslie
reviews.text: BE WARNED AND BEWARE. Place looked neat and tidy, had the football on the TV, so I went in and ordered a plain coffee. With it comes a small bottle of water. After finishing I was sort of pressured into buying another drink so I had a tea. As soon as I had finished I was asked to get another drink so I had a small can of pineapple soda. No food was offered so I went to pay the bill. Handed over £50 and he said I needed £100 more. I am used to being ripped off as a tourist but this was a scam. When I refused they got real angry. Not a very nice experience. Be warned and beware.

reviews.author: Fares El Shoura
reviews.text: they brought me sugar with antis in it so i told them to give me another and they did but it also had ants in it🙂🙂

reviews.author: Mad Had
reviews.text: It’s so bad I will never come back again

reviews.author: ESLAM ELFAITOURY
reviews.text: Ok for a fast break..good price

reviews.author: Adham Kandel
reviews.text: Not fool happy

reviews.author: Елизавета Авдонина
reviews.text: Such a great place! We had a nice dinner, seafood Is fresh and very tasty, the restaurant is clean and service is excellent, prices are not high and very friendly staff. Definitely recommend for visiting!

reviews.author: Joanne Kelly RTT therapy practitioner
reviews.text: My only criticism is that the tables and chairs could do with a revamp. They're a bit old and shabby. Apart from that we enjoyed a lovely meal.

reviews.author: Louise Serrant
reviews.text: My husband and I come here all the time. I love the quality of the food and the excellent service from the staff. I've eaten in a few fish restaurants, but this is far the best. I would highly recommend El Mina fish restaurant.

reviews.author: Joe Nabil
reviews.text: I enjoyed eating seafood here. It was my first time and I heard it's the best in town. The quality of cooking fried or grilled was good. Beautiful interior! Prices were decent. Service can be better by having a smile in their face and offering better hospitality when welcoming people coming in.

reviews.author: Nini Azzam
reviews.text: Very bad. The only good thing was the waiter who worked with us. He was very polit and helpful. Our fish took more than 45 min to come. Then it came wrong. One fish was prepared in a different way than what we ordered, the grilled fish one was raw from the inside, and 2 were dry. They brought us a totally different thing that we did not order to start eating as it was taking too long. Would not recommend it!

reviews.author: Joshua Stoia
reviews.text: Had a wonderful seafood dinner here. Quality fish caught the same day, cooked with charcoal, wonderful soup and shrimp too. Just next to the sea with beautiful views. And a special thank you to all the staff, from the waiters to the chefs, they made it a wonderful experience, and they offered service with kindness and generosity. Thank you all so much!

reviews.author: Stephan von Keitz
reviews.text: We had a grandious dinner for two. The five course fishmenu was really excellent and the service was so lovingly. This all with an intoxicating Ambience..... look over the red sea!

reviews.author: K. B.
reviews.text: We had diner here last night. Service as everywhere in the hotel is excellent with special attention for the kids We had the tuna tartare which was very tasty. My husband had then catch of the day, again excellent and my beef was perfectly cooked as medium rare. All as well for very affordable prices. Very happy to have this restaurant on the hotel premises so we can alter the buffet diner of the hotel were the food is ofcourse less, the location as well and it is overcrowded

reviews.author: Amr Sherif
reviews.text: Relaxing place with great ambiance. Shrimps and calamari were fresh and nicely cooked. Would have loved a bit more variety like tajins. But great place nonetheless

reviews.author: John Nessim
reviews.text: Greek mediterranean vibes that chills your body and lifts your spirit Thats the atmosphere i love to have my dinner in These people broke all rules to give you the treatment you deserve from the welcoming entrance to the fish tent where the chef guides you to have the perfect sea food experience to the hall workers who tend to serve you with a smile The food is exquisite, the fish seasoning and recipes are so well made , the catering was well made and even the bowls used are sea creatures look alike It’s an experience you could never forget

reviews.author: Mehmet Dilşeker
reviews.text: We went as three families, a total of 8 people. Since the children weren’t hungry, we only wanted to order for 5 people. However, we were shocked when we saw the price list because the prices were kinda expensive. So, we decided to try the cheapest item on the menu, a falafel dish for 22 Egyptian Pounds. After a while, the waiter seemed upset because we chose the cheapest option and told us that if we ordered it, they would charge a 15% tax and a 15% service fee for everyone. We were furious that they wanted to charge tax even for those who didn’t eat and decided to leave. The waiter mocked us as we left. Because of this, we couldn’t eat anything at all.

reviews.author: Eve
reviews.text: I was end of last year at Gad an loved the food. But now in may when I visited again the food was not good after multiple visits. The food took so long to come even when the restaurant was almost empty.. and even if you request for something they don’t do it. We are very unhappy.. This is what got delivered…

reviews.author: Katrine InDA
reviews.text: We ordered a veggie dish but got one with chicken. It was a good food though and the variety of choices is really good. Got this as a recommendation from a local guide, wasn't super touristy. Paid 8€ incl tips

reviews.author: Heithem Moumni
reviews.text: I recently visited and had a highly disappointing experience. The service was extremely poor, with the waitstaff showing a clear lack of communication skills. They were not only inattentive but also used inappropriate language, which made the experience uncomfortable. The restaurant had a mix of different cuisines, but unfortunately, none of the dishes stood out. The food was not only poorly prepared but also seemed unhygienic. The cleanliness standards were far below what one would expect, and this raised concerns about the overall food safety. Additionally, the atmosphere was unpleasant. The ambiance was poorly maintained, and the environment felt unwelcoming. Overall, my visit was very unsatisfactory, and I would not recommend it to anyone.

reviews.author: Robbie
reviews.text: 🇬🇧English review🇬🇧 We stopped here for some food on a recommendation from our taxi driver. The food was excellent, we had pizza and burgers, nothing too fancy as just fancied as it was a quick lunch. It was very fresh, nicely presented and good sized portions for a very reasonable price on the menu. There is a service charge included in the bill. A word of warning please be observant when settling the bill make sure you have cash and have a currency converter to hand if paying on other currencies. The bill was reasonably priced at 1435EGP, they only take cash and as we didn’t have enough EGP we asked for the price to converted to GBP. They tried to overcharge us by £14GBP stating the price was £36 whereas the conversion was nearer £23 at the time. Other than this small issue the restaurant is definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: Hazem Bakr
reviews.text: While I enjoy exploring the diverse culinary scene, Star Fish Restaurant is the one place I find myself returning to without hesitation every time I visit Hurghada – and that's usually at least twice per trip! For anyone seeking an authentic Egyptian seafood experience, look no further. Star Fish offers an impressive variety of seafood, and what truly noticed is the consistent freshness of their offerings. You can taste the quality in every bite. The portion sizes are also excellent, ensuring you leave feeling truly satisfied. The taste, however, is where Star Fish truly shines. They expertly prepare the local Red Sea fish, and I particularly recommend trying the Nagel and Sheoor – the flavors are simply outstanding. It's clear they understand and appreciate the local catch. Beyond the exceptional food, Star Fish is also a great choice for groups and families. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the staff are friendly, It's a genuine, unpretentious Egyptian seafood restaurant that focuses on delivering delicious food and a pleasant dining experience. If you're in Hurghada and craving fresh, authentic seafood in a friendly setting, Star Fish Restaurant is a must-visit. It's become my go-to, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and delicious seafood meal. The photos of yesterday visit Today's visit has 2 Dishes of sham El Nesim Renga

reviews.author: 夏召汉
reviews.text: We ordered starfish meal 395 EGP each, the portion is big actually, making us very full, even though with only 4 shrimps in total, and we cannot finish the meal. But honestly the flavor is very normal, cannot compare to the shrimp in family seafood at all! Even though here is more famous and the ambience looks more high class, with a lot of living fish in the tank. They provide different fresh fish from the sea, and more diverse dishes, with affordable prices.

reviews.author: Monkey Dj Music (Box Sound)
reviews.text: The fish at Star Fish Restaurant is excellent—fresh and well-prepared. The shrimp was good, but a bit hard to peel. The mussels had a honey mustard dressing, which was an interesting twist. The rice with shrimp was also enjoyable. The restaurant is not very fancy, and the decor could be improved to enhance the dining experience. Cleanliness is quite good, around 90%, but there’s still some room for improvement. If you’re looking for a high-end seafood restaurant, this isn’t the place. But if you want great fish at a casual spot, Star Fish is a solid choice!

reviews.author: Alina P.
reviews.text: The atmosphere of the place left us with much to desire — it’s not very clean, old and not taken care of. The fish and shrimp were tasty. Everything else was mediocre at best — rice was bland, and the shrimp tajin was made to look like it’s a lot of food, but in reality it’s mainly potato and sauce. Service was ok, but a bit slow.

reviews.author: Gâza Lucian
reviews.text: 5 Stars A wonderful experience with delicious fish! I've tried both the Starfish restaurants in Hurgada and Sharm El Sheikh — the food is excellent at both. However, if I had to choose, I'd go with the Sharm location because of its stunning view that perfectly complements the meal. Highly recommended!
