name: Street Stall - Sheraton Rd
address: Street Stall - Sheraton Rd, Hurghada, Egypt

reviews.author: Liz Armstrong
reviews.text: Overlooking the beautiful yachts on Hurghada Marina. Beautiful bar/ restaurant serving the most amazing menu at really good prices. Delicious wines, sea food and various dishes from around the world. Our waiter, Tito was attentive, pleasant and professional. It was a great lunch with friends. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Nessma Youssef
reviews.text: The ambiance, music, and overall atmosphere were very nice, it's a nice setting but the food was disappointing. I ordered the escalope pané, and my husband had their signature salmon. Both were below average. The food didn’t match the ambiance. Glad to have checked this place off my list, but I wouldn't return.

reviews.author: Declan Doherty
reviews.text: Fantastic restaurant the quality of the food is excellent and oh my God the prices are so good. The staff are so lovely and friendly. We will be back in the future

reviews.author: ingo reimann
reviews.text: Thanks for that great evening in a nice atmosphere with delicious food. I had the juicy camel steak with rice. Thanks also for Tito's extraordinary service! I can absolutely recommend visiting the Heaven to dine like in Heaven!

reviews.author: Vinh H Nguyen
reviews.text: We were recommended this place by a dive guide. The food was fairly as expected but not tremendous. On a Friday evening mid December, it was chilly sitting outside. They didn’t have enough heater for everybody. Seemed to be one of the popular restaurants in the marina.

reviews.author: F Z
reviews.text: 5 stars for the service and ambiance, but only 2 stars for the food. I stayed at this historic hotel for a few nights and thoroughly enjoyed my stay. However, the restaurant didn’t live up to the hotel’s standards. Despite branding itself as a French restaurant, with dress code requirements, the food fell disappointingly short of even a basic international standard. In my opinion, the beautifully crafted tableware was wasted on such uninspired dishes.

reviews.author: Taline V.Fermanian
reviews.text: I would like to express my extreme dissatisfaction with the service and treatment my companion and I received during our visit to your hotel. As a well-known French hotel chain, we expected the highest standards of hospitality, but unfortunately, our experience was far from what we anticipated. Upon arrival at the hotel, we were greeted by a receptionist who displayed extremely rude and unprofessional behavior. Before even acknowledging our “good evening,” he looked us up and down and immediately told my companion that he could not enter to 1886 because he wasn’t wearing a blazer. I understand and respect a dress code, but the way he spoke to us was disrespectful and condescending. When I inquired if there was a formal dress code, he told me, "You’re good, but he can’t get in like this!" His tone and attitude made us feel unwelcome and disrespected, which is completely unacceptable in a hotel of your reputation. We then decided to have dinner at *La Corniche*, since we had already paid an entrance participation fee. However, on our way there, we passed by *1886* and wanted to take a quick look. To our surprise, the same receptionist stopped us again and, with an arrogant tone, said, “Wait here, I need to check if there’s no one at the restaurant before you can enter.” He made us feel as if we were begging to be allowed inside, which was utterly humiliating and insulting. I do understand the need for dress codes and restaurant policies, but the manner in which we were treated was far below the standard expected of a luxury hotel. The staff’s behavior was not only unprofessional but also deeply disrespectful, which greatly impacted our perception of Sofitel’s brand and reputation. I believe that no guest should be made to feel this way, and I hope that this feedback will be taken seriously to ensure that no other guests experience similar treatment in the future. I would appreciate it if you could investigate this matter and take appropriate action to address the behavior of the staff involved. Thank you for taking the time to consider my concerns.

reviews.author: Dylan H
reviews.text: We had a fun time here in this historic restaurant. The ambience is nice, though stuffy - the food was just okay and didn't merit the price, but we still enjoyed ourselves and the experience.

reviews.author: Alexey Koulakov
reviews.text: We were cheated in this restaurant - they tried to charge 3 000 dollars instead 3000 local pounds by our card. It was a scandal we mentioned this. Food is average for these prices. Interiors are great, but this thanks to historical french people, not to current management.

reviews.author: Swapnnali Jadhav
reviews.text: Best food experience in egypt. Especially when you are served vegan with love...

reviews.author: M Martin
reviews.text: Went in a bus with a group of 52 and wanted an alternative to McDonald's. The manager greeted us warmly and answered our questions. I picked the chicken shawarma wrap, and my wife chose the falafel wrap. Both came with fries that were excellent. On the side, I also tried the sausage stuffed with rice, interesting. Bottled water. For desert, we got the kunafa, topped with Nutella to go, yummy. All for 500 pounds. Everything was low salt the way I prefer, and my wife added salt to everything. We liked it all ok? Not great, but it was all good. The views of Luxor temple were amazing. Great location.

reviews.author: Maria Dolores Espiño
reviews.text: Good prices! Fee wifi- internet service it is not bad. You need to ask the password Non alcohol drinks Pizza, chicken, pasta, onion rings, ice cream In front of luxor temple. Great view. Place to charge batteries Friendly waiters. They speak in english Kids playground Tip not included. In the menu it says 10% but it is not added to the price.

reviews.author: Stella Fung
reviews.text: We had breakfast here and the food and drink are delicious. The price is affordable and the service is really good. You can have a nice view of Luxor Temple and Nile River. It will be nice to see sunset from this restaurant.

reviews.author: Nazia
reviews.text: The food was ok, but I think the highlight here is the beautiful temple and river view! Really beautiful! The service staff is also very good👍

reviews.author: Dave Riat
reviews.text: Best view ever. You see the temple the nile the square!!! Food is local and western. Not so bad. Prices ok. Service is good. Staff friendly.

reviews.author: Irka Aliyeva
reviews.text: A perfect 10 out of 10! I was hesitant at first, wondering if the photos would match reality, and I’m glad to say my expectations were fully met. The hotel looks just like in the pictures. It feels as if time has stood still here since the early 20th century: antique interiors, books available for reading, grand high arches, and spacious halls – truly an oasis in the midst of bustling, crowded Egypt. The rooms are cleaned regularly, and all bathroom fixtures are spotless—almost as if they were just installed. There is no intrusive music, neither in the restaurants nor by the pool—this place is designed for escaping the hustle and bustle of the world and giving your mind a break from constant thoughts. It makes you want to lounge by the pool all day, reading books. The hotel grounds invite you to take peaceful walks through the inner garden and the herb garden, where various plants are grown. The staff is incredibly attentive and courteous. The attention to detail from the hotel's designer is truly impressive—it feels like every little thing has been carefully thought out. This hotel is worth every penny. I will definitely return.

reviews.author: Sam Horine
reviews.text: I want to live at this hotel - everything is special and thoughtfully placed. Wish I’d had more time - don’t sleep on the food here either, this one probably the best meal I had in Egypt. Everything was so fresh and flavorful and good - amazing place.

reviews.author: Sina von Ketelhodt
reviews.text: A Tale of Elegance and Luxury From the moment I stepped through the grand entrance of this magnificent 5-star oasis, I felt transported to a realm straight out of 1001 Nights. The exquisite blend of traditional Arabian opulence and modern luxury creates an atmosphere of pure magic. The attention to detail in every aspect of the hotel’s design is nothing short of breathtaking. Ornate arches, intricate mosaics, and lush courtyards evoke the splendor of a royal palace. The villa was a sanctuary of comfort, featuring sumptuous furnishings, fine textiles, and a beautiful garden with stunning views of the desert sunset. The service was impeccable, with every member of the staff embodying warmth and professionalism. From personalized greetings to anticipating my every need, their dedication to excellence was evident. The dining experience was equally extraordinary. Each meal was a culinary journey, showcasing the finest local and international cuisine, served with Arabic flair. For those seeking a luxurious escape steeped in romance and tradition, this hotel is an unparalleled gem. I cannot wait to return. Rating: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Neerav Doshi
reviews.text: A boutique hotel in the true sense of the word. You will have an unforgettable stay with a pinch on the pocket. The attention to detail in the decor, and regarding the quality of food is brilliant. Their rooms are unique. The only drawback (or not) is the fact that it is a bit far from the city, and takes an effort to get here if you don't have cabs handy.

reviews.author: Wolker K
reviews.text: The Hotel is a gem. Fabulous food with ingredients from their own farm. Amazing garden as a true hide away. Architecture like a private estate with lot of history. Service very personal and not the usual top hotel speech. The different sizes of the villas are perfect for either families or groups with necessity for more privacy. I really enjoyed the stay.

reviews.author: Joel Gratte
reviews.text: Food is amazing, a big menu, well priced, with smaller options starting at 100 pounds or around $2. Nice outdoor setting with fans and views of the nearby Avenue of Sphinxes + Nile River. Thank you to Sadiek for the drink and friendly service!

reviews.author: Ruby Pritchard
reviews.text: We loved this restaurant. We were staying in the hotel below and we ate here several times. Each time, the service was great and the food was delicious. Beautiful rooftop views of the Nile, avenue of sphinxes and sunset! We ate a lot of the mezze foods but our favourite dish was the spinach feteerah and spiced cauliflower . We had a great last dinner and our waiter, saidick was fantastic and gave us a complimentary hibiscus tea. Highly recommend. Really nice vibe and the restaurant is very cute!

reviews.author: o tkasch
reviews.text: Wonderful place, I truly couldn't expect such a great atmosphere, tasty Egyptian food and breathtaking view. Prices are also fair, I had lattice soup, camel pot, mango and banana milkshakes(they're very tasty), highly recommend all of them. Also they serve cold karkadeh, just order it

reviews.author: phuong tieu
reviews.text: During our visit, we were so impressed by this restaurant that we ended up dining here twice in one day! The food was absolutely delicious, with rich flavors and fresh ingredients that truly captured the essence of Egyptian cuisine. Each dish was well-prepared and satisfying, making it a memorable culinary experience. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, providing excellent service with warm hospitality. They made sure we felt comfortable and attended to our needs with genuine kindness. One of the highlights of this place is the rooftop seating, which offers a beautiful view—perfect for enjoying a meal while taking in the surroundings. Whether you’re here for lunch or dinner, the atmosphere is both relaxing and charming. Overall, this restaurant is a must-visit if you’re looking for great food, friendly service, and a scenic dining experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Yao Wang
reviews.text: We were checking into Nefertiti Hotel when reception mentioned there is a rooftop restaurant. After a hectic day at Valley of the kings and Karnak, we wanted somewhere close and chose to go upstairs from our room to check it out. Views were stunning and food/prices was not bad considering we were paying for the view. Hubby had chicken shawarma wrap and I had Lebanese chicken. Oreo shake was lovely, so I do recommend that. Since we were starving it's hard to judge if their food was good or we just needed to be fed. Either way the first waiter was cranky and wouldn't come to take our order but second one, Bebo was nice to us throughout the meal and our stay. Bonus Tip: their free buffet breakfast was sub par, so not sure why other reviews said their breakfasts was good. I would only come for either lunch or dinner and enjoy the view.

reviews.author: Luke Liu
reviews.text: Mohammed Sarah recommend us delicious and authentic Egyptian dishes. Very good taste and we had to come back again for dinner. Good service too.

reviews.author: Lansong Yang
reviews.text: The food is delicious and the environment is clean. The service staff is very warm and thoughtful. The dining environment is comfortable and hygienic. I highly recommend tourists to come to this restaurant for dinner, you will have a good experience.

reviews.author: Veronica Monedero
reviews.text: This was the best meal we had in Luxor! After trying different 5 star hotels restaurants (very disappointed) we tried this one before heading out! They had a great vegetarian option and the bread was the best thing I had! Paired with the salads were delish! The service was excellent and the staff very friendly. Prices are not on the menu, but you can ask for all the prices ahead of time. The price was very fair for the portions.

reviews.author: Yu Lang
reviews.text: The food here is delicious, especially the soup! The owner is very nice and friendly and he gives us salad and dessert for hospitality. Also, I really like the atmosphere here. However, there is no price listed on the menu, I need to ask servers for the price, which I think can be improved. But the price is reasonable, for about 500 pounds per person. Generally speaking, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Patricio O'Gorman
reviews.text: Very good taste of local Luxor food. A Lentil soup to start with, then a main course of meat and chicken with rice and fries. Pita bread kept coming and was OUT OF THIS WORLD. Dessert was nice and the coffee was good. Recommended! Lots of tourists around, server was fun, fast and did a small magic trick on us (flower out of a napkin).

reviews.author: junguk wi
reviews.text: Delicious food with a perfect Nile view! Had an amazing dinner at El-Kababgy Restaurant in Luxor on June 10. The grilled lamb chops were tender and full of flavor, and the soup was rich and comforting. The riverside view during sunset was absolutely beautiful. Big thanks to the manager Hamada for the warm and friendly service. Highly recommend this place if you're in Luxor!

reviews.author: Jeje moon
reviews.text: This restaurant has great food , nice view and sweet service with staff! I was really happy in this restaurant. I ordered lamb, which is little salty but juicy and yummy. I already came back to Korea but couldn't forget food and memories here so I'm writing review. They like Korean customers and very sweet. I will come back next time when I visit Luxor.

reviews.author: Julian Sakarai
reviews.text: Decent food, amazing location. We dined at El Kababgy on a very hot summer evening, and had the roasted pigeon, baba ghanoush, tahini, white cheese dip, mesa’ka, and vegetable tagine. Given the restaurant’s excellent location, I assumed the food wouldn’t be that great, but it was actually pretty decent. If you’re staying anywhere near Luxor Temple, as we were, you could do worse than coming to this place for a meal.

reviews.author: T G
reviews.text: Great spot to enjoy a sunset dinner on the Nile River in Luxor. Local recommendation. Great Kofta and kebab. Everything tasted fresh. A little pricier than most places, but you’re paying for the view.

reviews.author: Shelby Stover
reviews.text: El-Kababgy was our favorite restaurant during our trip to Egypt! We loved the staff (who were welcoming and generous). We loved the food. And we loved the view—both beautiful and chaotic. This is a lovely place to eat a hearty Egyptian meal—try the Tajin Kofta!

reviews.author: KF Yoon
reviews.text: Came here just to try their famous koushry. Didn't know what exactly it is, but have to try since it is Egyptian national dish. As I already has lunch earlier, just ordered the mesium size. Already quite large portion for just 24 EGP. Looks like a mixture of pasta, rice, chickpeas, lentils with tomoto paste and some chilli oil. The blended taste just came together wonderfully. So appetising. Completely finished it despite being full. Service is friendly and fast. The dining area could do with a bit more brightness though. BTW, Google Map for walking directed me to wrong back instead of front of the shop. Can't enter from the back.

reviews.author: Welison Floriano
reviews.text: The food was great, the service was great, the prices were great. Cash only.

reviews.author: Elsa Chung
reviews.text: Sunday, Nov, 2017 - we got our money exchanged close to the tourist souk by the Luxor Temple, and then walked south through the train station and past some wonderful eateries, but this restaurant we wanted to try (it had some good reviews so we decided to give it a shot). When we walked closer we noticed a lot of locals. We were then passed along to cashier (thinking we are buying takeouts), who passed us along upstairs dining area. We were provided with the English menu (not sure if it is the same price as the Arabic menu) and we ordered a small Koushry, falafel, baba gonush dish, and a chicken pie at 6:07pm (the hubs was hungry). We received everything except the chicken pie by 6:15pm as they are still cooking it. We received the pie at 6:13pm. The taste is pretty good. The 'pie' looks more like quesadilla, and the 'crust' is like those Chinese green onion pancake, except without the green onions here. Unfortunately, I find the chicken content to be lacking. The staff are friendly and water from a jug is provided (they actually treat us like one of them here, which is awesome!) The only little wrinkle is we said small Koushry and apparently they gave us a medium - difference of 4LE. Not a big deal, but we both remembered pointing to the 'small' on the menu to the waiter. Overall, happy experience. And yes, we can't finish the pie and took it home.

reviews.author: Jan Fordjour
reviews.text: This Is a nice restaurant, good menu not many drink options however. The manager was amazing and friendly. Nice to explore if your in Luxor especially if you want to go into the town not just the tourist parts.

reviews.author: Subham Banerjee
reviews.text: We had Kochari and Chicken Platter. Loved the Kochari, it was nutritious and tasty. The foreigner bill is higher than the one for locals, even if on the menu card the rates are the same. We paid 255 EGP for the food, which was more by quite a margin than the card rate. Anyways, we didn't mind it as it is the same across Egypt now and 255 EGP really isn't that high for the meal. The place is clean and the service is fast.

name: Jewel of the Nile
address: Jewel of the Nile, Luxor, Egypt

reviews.author: Rainer Gruen
reviews.text: Little restaurant on a side street near some fancy hotels. The food was good but took a while to come. It was an absolute bargain !!! With friendly service. The decor is neat and I enjoyed the Rolling Stones background music. Not pristine Egyptian but a nice change.

reviews.author: Pano Nikitopoulos
reviews.text: I had a really nice dinner here, the shrimp was spiced up just a bit, and the Egyptian meatballs were delicious. The plate was xlso garnished with taste with finely sliced salad. I could not leave without a desert which also turned out just as expected with two crepes of medium size, honey and some finely sliced exotic fruits. The guava juice is also recommended.

reviews.author: Gilad Rom
reviews.text: Fantastic food - lots of clearly marked vegan options!

reviews.author: Congzai Da
reviews.text: Good service, nice people and cute plating

reviews.author: Rebecca Godwin
reviews.text: We had an excellent meal here last night.. delicious food excellent attentive and polite service great value. Please support this newly reopened restaurant

reviews.author: Cécile COLLET-ROBIC
reviews.text: A truly memorable experience! The setting is absolutely stunning, and the food was exquisite — each dish full of flavor and beautifully presented. The service was warm and attentive throughout. Prices are higher than average, but the experience is well worth it. Thank you for your hospitality!

reviews.author: zhanjie song
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed here for three days. Generally speaking, it was good. The hotel environment was very natural and the decorations in the room were very interesting. The food was presented very elegantly. We could enjoy a wonderful view from the rooftop.

reviews.author: Viktoria Andreeva
reviews.text: The best restaurant in Luxor! Oh my God, this is honestly the best restaurant I’ve ever been to. The hospitality is beyond amazing — the staff are kind, attentive, and genuinely care about your experience. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming; it truly feels like home. The food is absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. What makes it even more special is that everything is organic and grown locally right here. There are options for everyone — vegetarian and non-vegetarian — and every dish we tried was incredibly tasty. We came as a group, and the service was super quick and smooth. Everything was easy and stress-free. Highly, highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality food, great people, and an unforgettable experience in Luxor!

reviews.author: FEMALESAXOPHONIST
reviews.text: We are renting a villa locally and been doing the rounds of restaurants. This place is incredible. Moustafa welcomed us and was an excellent member of staff. It’s relaxed and fun and the food really is the best. You can get a good meal locally for 400 Egyptian per person but it’s not the same standard. Here you will spend about £20 if you have some alcohol per person. There are more expensive and exclusive hotel restaurants that do not live up to the standard of Marsam. If this is your budget or for a treat you must come here: Set beautifully overlooking the fields , you can dine inside or out. The food is excellent and I’m hard to please liking tasty healthy food. We’ve booked for dinner tonight and will probably be coming often before we leave. Amazing place!

reviews.author: Marissa Abisai Ceja
reviews.text: Wow! What a hidden gem in Luxor!!!! I would return to Egypt for this quaint and beautiful hotel. The best lunch I've had in all of Egypt. The gift shop is beautifully curated, and Maria is a genius—such a remarkable woman. The cardamom coffee is superb, and the farm-to-table experience is one of a kind. It truly is a gem!

reviews.author: Steph Wartmä
reviews.text: Wonderful antique hotel, very much style from old times, established in the year 1886. Historical heritage well kept, inclusive old fashioned service. Very much appreciated! Great garden, big pool, our children liked very much! Food a little bit expensive, but excellent. Large breakfast buffet. Wonderful views to the Nil river.

reviews.author: Anna Mayer
reviews.text: My friends and I (all females) loved, LOVED our stay at the Winter Palace! My friend and I lost our luggage, and the Winter Palace concierges followed up with the airline on behalf until they delivered our luggage. The process was much easier and smoother than it would have been if we had tried to do it ourselves. Also, the excursions we booked through the hotel were fantastic! Our tour guide through the temples and Valley of the Kings and Queens — Jackie — was so smart and kind. We really enjoyed our experience. Overall, the staff at the hotel are so kind and amazing. Everything felt personalized and by the end, we didn’t want to leave.

reviews.author: J K
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful hotel experience! Every staff member—from the front desk to housekeeping to the bar and restaurant team—was genuinely friendly and welcoming. The front desk always greeted me with a smile, housekeeping kept everything spotless, and room service was fast, efficient, and delicious. Even the poolside service was on point! The breakfast bar and buffet were fantastic—fresh, delicious, and with a great variety each morning. The location was perfect—within walking distance to restaurants, banks, and Luxor Temple. I always felt safe and found it easy to get around quickly. This was hands-down my best hotel stay in Egypt. The only small note is that some of the furniture in the pavilion/common areas is a bit dated, but it didn’t take away from the overall five-star experience. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Ds Ds
reviews.text: As the name suggests the hotel is truly a Palace. From the beautifully manicured grounds at the the back to the Nile facing rooms at the front you are in for a treat.The staff were engaging and the breakfast menu is nice and varied. Would thoroughly recommend tacking on a couple of nights after your cruise from Aswan at this hotel😊

reviews.author: Brent Allan Black
reviews.text: Staying at the Winter Palace was like stepping into a bygone era of luxury and charm. The rooms are spacious and beautifully maintained, blending old-world character with modern comfort. Service throughout the hotel was warm, attentive, and genuinely thoughtful. The lush gardens offer a serene escape from the bustle outside, perfect for a quiet morning stroll or an afternoon drink. The hotel’s rich history is felt in every detail—from the grand architecture to the storied halls—and brings a deep sense of nostalgia. A truly special place that captures the magic of Luxor in every way.

reviews.author: Alexandre Raphael Wery
reviews.text: By far the best Egyptian food restaurant we’ve tried during our 2 weeks trip to Egypt. Everything is super fresh, tasteful and authentic. The atmosphere is relaxing and the decoration is giving milles et une nuits vibes which makes your experience even better. The prices are totally ok. Big +1 for the amazing collection of fresh fruit juices. The staff was not always super friendly, that could be a way of improving. We’ve been 3 times and will definitely be back. 100% recommend when in Luxor.

reviews.author: Enrique Hernandez
reviews.text: This restaurant was a recommendation and ended up losing my time and money. I ordered the Duck with Vegetables and my wife Lamb and rice. What could it be wrong in a country famous for their cooking? Well to make short avoid at all cost and go to better place. I recommended another restaurant that was far better than Sofra. The duck and veal were not fresh and was poorly cooked. Please beware

reviews.author: Ryan Kim
reviews.text: Sofra Restaurant & Cafe in Luxor offers a warm and authentic dining experience with traditional Egyptian dishes served in a beautifully decorated setting. The rooftop terrace has a lovely, relaxed vibe — perfect for enjoying dinner while soaking in the atmosphere. The food is flavorful and well-portioned, with a variety of options that highlight local ingredients and spices. While not every dish was mind-blowing, the overall quality was satisfying. Service was friendly and attentive, adding to the charm of the place. If you're in Luxor and want to try local cuisine in a cozy, traditional space, Sofra is definitely worth a visit. A solid 4-star experience.

reviews.author: Daria Gavriouchkina
reviews.text: We came here several times during our stay in Luxor. The service is sometimes a bit slow but otherwise quite good. The food on considerably tastier and cheaper than at hotel we were staying at.

reviews.author: Meg In The World
reviews.text: Atmosphere was nice, but service was pretty bad. They didn’t bring soup and rice until I asked after 20 min after they brought the main dish. The rabbit was hardly eat and wasn’t tasty. Wonder how they got the high reviews for the poor service and the food. I would recommend to go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Simona Koukalová
reviews.text: I would love to return to this hotel resort. The hotel resort is beautifully maintained, beautiful gardens full of greenery and blooming bushes. I was very satisfied with everything. As with the tours, with pleasant and smiling service, I have to pick up the lifeguard Rambo (nickname). He is a very nice guy in the right place. He is always smiling, helpful and pleasant. He was always helpful in everything. Just a great vacation.

reviews.author: Vivien Ivánkovits
reviews.text: The Hotel is located in a huge (!) area, in the middle of nowhere, in the company of Emerald and Dream Lagoon. At the same time, more hotels are being built around it. There is also a doctor, a pharmacy and a bazaar in the hotel area. We originally booked accommodation in the Dream Lagoon, then as it turned out afterwards we got a room in the Blue. Anyway... We didn't change, because the next day we found (we booked the room after midnight) that the garden here is the most beautiful. 🕌 Speaking of the garden... Beautiful, fantastic, amazing, fairytale-like, wonderful. Seeing the pictures, my 9-year-old nephew was amazed that such a thing exists in reality?! 🌵🌴🌼 I also liked the Blue Lagoon because the buildings here are the most authentic. The rooms are clean, of course I could get involved in things (I cleaned a mirror on the first day), but I don't want to, because they didn't interfere with our daily life. On two occasions we also encountered geckos in the room, which we were not so happy about (fear...), but then they left us alone and did not return to us during our stay. 🦎 The workers are very nice, they even got close to us... and it was hard to separate from them. (Cancer zodiac sign) I noticed that the workers here are happy to accept the baksis, but not as much as last year in Waterworld in Hurghada. I think this is because of the Italians, i.e. the Italians are a grateful people, they are certainly happy to hand out the euro here as well. Speaking of... Italians. There are plenty. The locals said it was a "mini Italy". As in their home country, they do not speak any language other than their own. The locals adapted and learned to speak Italian (supposedly an easy language - according to a local). So they are in the majority in the place, then the Czechs and Poles, and finally the Hungarians represent their country. So this is not Hurghada... 👦👦🏽🫂 Italians are said to come here because the sea is wonderful. Which is true. I am attaching pictures to the report and I state that there is no editing on them. That's the color of the water! There is a daily walk if you want to swim, because the water is very shallow (up to your ankles at low tide), and you have to walk several hundred meters if you just want to take a dip in it. However, the wildlife does not even come close to Hurghada. (Makadi Bay) We didn't go deep, so we only saw a few fish and, as an extra, a blue-spotted spiny shoal. 🏝🏖🏊‍♂️🚶‍♀️ About the food... I'm a picky eater, but I survived the week. Those who are not, can eat fruit, beef, fish, chicken, local dishes... There were always 3 types of pasta, as well as pizza. During the day, the bars prepared hamburgers, fries, pizza and hot dogs. 🍇🍉🍕🍟🍔🧇🥞 We did not participate in the optional program, because last year we tried many things, "only" Cairo was left behind. We wanted to see it this year, but we charged 700 euros/2 people from the travel agency (Carthage). That would have been enough for them to take me to Hurghada by bus and from there by small plane. Internet in the rooms, just like in the fairy tales... where it was, where it wasn't... but you could have bought an internet card on the bus and at the airport as well. 🌐 Animators entertain the holidaymakers with various sports in the afternoon and a mini disco for the children in the evening. 🎊 We also took part in a couple's massage (105 euros/4 times), a cosmetic treatment... If you missed Cairo... and on the last night we did not eat at the hotel, but at a fish restaurant on the beach. It was a bit sad that at 8:00 p.m. the table was set for just the two of us and they were cooking just for the two of us... even though the food was delicious and the place cozy. Of course, many people do not want to spend extra money if they have already paid for all-inclusive care. So I understand, but - obviously - they don't serve fish and scallops like here in the hotel's restaurant.

reviews.author: Mohamed alsharif
reviews.text: It never gets boring! As the way you kitesurf will hugely depend on the winds and the weather conditions, you will find that your technique changes constantly, which ensures that things never get boring. The sport provides a never-ending learning curve, which gives different mental sensations, all at once, like, fear, nervousness, excitement, adrenaline rush, etc.

reviews.author: Hamza Sherif
reviews.text: Its not a bad place if you're staying over for a business related trip/layover, but not for an actual summer vacation. Overall the staff is really kind, but chef Osama keeps flirting with tourists in Arabic. Other tyan that, its ok.

reviews.author: Abdelrahman Atwa
reviews.text: Good brake fast, and amazing view, all activities available inside

reviews.author: Mohab Hussein
reviews.text: The best seafood in Sinai by far , owner is the chef and he is super friendly. Chef Ayman is very welcoming , he showed us first the kitchen and how neat and clean it is , we ordered several dishes and none of them were disappointing! The shrimp was done butter fly style and that sauce was incredible ❤️ Truly worth every penny, highly recommend it for groups .

reviews.author: Dan C
reviews.text: Amazing, fresh and absolutely delicious Large group - good service Soooo tasty It's VERY quiet in the area atm but very welcoming and food was incredible Deffo reccomend Great prices

reviews.author: George Galal
reviews.text: Chef Ayman, who is also the owner & has another branch by same name “Cleopatra” in Saint Catherine, is a gentleman offering 30+ years of culinary experience & the friendliest hospitality. The food is so GOOD! The Seafood soup was loaded & the grilled chicken was tasty. Cleopatra’s design is a sight for the eye & Mr Ayman invited me to the open kitchen to see how clean it is & to watch him prepare the food. Prices are reasonable & portions are decent. Mr Ayman has 2 playful pet dogs which is a huge plus while waiting. The restaurant is very close to the sea.

reviews.author: Israa Alaa
reviews.text: A must try! Super fresh seafood! Would recommend it to everyone! The only downside is that the food takes too long to be prepared, we waited for 1.5 hours, other people waited for 2 hours. But it was the holidays and it was crowded so maybe the wait time is less on normal days. But the overall experience was wonderful and would definitely go there again.

reviews.author: Erskine May
reviews.text: We turned up here out of the blue as a group of 14 at a time when tourism in the area was suffering due to regional conflict. The proprietor (and chef) was working with a skeleton staff of only 1 other person (seemingly the sous-chef). We weren’t sure what to expect or whether they could handle such a large group. Further, many of us had ordered complicated dishes and we had a diversity of dietary requirements in our group. We waited a little while but when the food came out, it was simply outstanding. Namely, the fresh fish was all cooked to perfection and handsomely seasoned/sauced. A seafood gem.

name: Rommel’s Beach Café
address: Rommel’s Beach Café, Marsa Matrouh, Egypt

reviews.author: Princess
reviews.text: If i could give them 10 stars I would, I am very impressed by the delicious taste of their food. I ordered clams and seabream I was enjoying every bit. The lemon butter sauce is exceptional yummy yummy. If you're seafood lover you must go there and thank me later! I would definitely go again and again any time I visit Bahrain. Thank you for the warm welcome by the staff and lovely hosts who served me ☺️🙌

reviews.author: Alexei Moiseyev
reviews.text: It's an absolutely delightful experience. The service is exceptional. The views from the terrace that envelopes the restaurant are splendid. The menu and the wine list are perfectly designed. Fresh seafood can be selected from the ice-lined display to be prepared in various ways. I've gone for a butterfly hamour simply grilled. ...an absolute delight!

reviews.author: Saud Al-Subaie
reviews.text: At the fish market resturant, you choose your seafood fish, shrimps, crabs, and seashell and how you want them to be cooked. Variety of recipes available with extra appetisers of your choice. The views around by the sea are beautiful. The service is good. But this resturant is unbelievably overpriced!

reviews.author: Zaid Al-Asa'd
reviews.text: The Fish Market restaurant offers an unforgettable dining experience that I highly recommend. From the moment you step in, the ambiance is charming, with an open and fresh design that enhances the experience. The highlight, of course, is the seafood, which is not only fresh but prepared with incredible skill. Every dish I tried was bursting with flavor, from the perfectly grilled shrimp to the deliciously fresh sea mussels. The variety on the menu caters to all preferences, ensuring that everyone finds something they love. What really sets the Fish Market apart is its exceptional service. The staff is attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable, making excellent recommendations without being overbearing. You can tell they take pride in what they do, which makes the meal that much more enjoyable. And then there’s the view – simply breathtaking. The restaurant overlooks a serene waterfront, making it the perfect spot for a romantic evening or a relaxing lunch. Whether you're a seafood lover or just looking for a unique dining experience, the Fish Market delivers on all fronts. It’s a place I can’t wait to visit again.

reviews.author: Karim Mouawad
reviews.text: We really enjoyed having lunch there. The food was delicious. Great to be able to enjoy their food as we usually enjoyed at their original branch in Al Bander Resort. It gave us the opportunity to enjoy it in downtown Bahrain Bay. Had the salad, shrimps, crab, silous and sea bream which were all delissssssh!! Thank you! ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Lilith
reviews.text: The ambience and view were beautiful. The decoration has been tastefully done, and there is a nice view of the city, sea and Fort. Unfortunately, though I was not very impressed with the food. The seafood was not seasoned, and the rice was extremely plain.

reviews.author: Ara Jherielle
reviews.text: This is a must-visit restaurant. Amazing place. You can enjoy the variety of seafood within your budget. 👍🏻 And a relaxing view of the sea. 🌊

reviews.author: DMK
reviews.text: Popular waterfront eatery at which you could either take your time and choose your catch on display to be prepared for you, or rely on expert chefs to deliver house specials at a quicker turnaround. We like seafood so we really enjoyed this place. This restaurant is frequented equally by both international tourists and local clientele who value the quality offerings of this unique venue.

reviews.author: sky Forhad
reviews.text: It's a seafood Fish Market Marina in Alexander The fish soup was different from what we're used to, as it had shrimp in it. It was a delicious soup with plenty of ingredients. Afterwards, we ordered grilled fish. It came with fried calamari and rice, but the fish was undercooked. At first, I thought this might be how Egyptians prepare fish, but then I realized it was just mine that was like that. When I asked for it to be changed, they sent a new plate. The taste was quite good. There were 4-5 different kinds of mezes, and the ones with garlic and eggplant were my favorites. Warm mini pitas were also served with the dishes. The staff were served at a normal pace. The place was large but noisy. However, the view was amazing. You could watch the calm waters of the Mediterranean from anywhere in the restaurant.

reviews.author: I. Morgan
reviews.text: The Mina District Fish Market is unlike any fish market you’ve ever seen — it’s more like stepping into the luxury food halls at Harrods. The building itself is a work of art, with intricate mosaics, clean marble interiors, and beautiful ironwork that gives the whole space a sense of calm elegance. Even if you’re not here to buy, it’s absolutely worth a visit just to admire the design and experience the atmosphere. The selection of seafood is vast, fresh, and beautifully displayed — from local catches to more exotic varieties. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, it’s the perfect stop if you’re exploring the Mina District or Old Doha Port. Stylish, spotless, and full of character — a must-see spot in the city!

reviews.author: Muna Hawwa
reviews.text: offers a unique blend of culinary excellence and architectural beauty 🩷🩷🩷 Many visitors highlight the quality of the seafood and the unique dining experience. Some patrons have noted longer waiting times during peak hours and suggest arriving early to avoid delays. Despite its upscale ambiance, the market offers competitive pricing, often more affordable than high end seafood restaurants in Doha.

reviews.author: Isuru Dissanayake
reviews.text: This is one of the iconic fish market in Mina District, Doha. This fish market is located in a building that doesn't really look like a fish market. Fish market interior is like an art gallery. The ceiling is doctorated with colorful glass panels and it looks amazing. Also they maintain the fish market with a pleasant vibe. Highly recommended to visit and have a look.

reviews.author: Света Косенко
reviews.text: Thank you for a good experience and tasty food in your restaurant. And thank you for an amazing hospitality from Khalid. Everything was 5 star, my biggest recommendation!

reviews.author: Isidre Marco Tuset
reviews.text: This is a new area on the old city harbour with nice restorants & cafeterías. The fish market is young stile and you can bay the fish that they cook for you.

reviews.author: Katharyn Gadient-Elkheshen
reviews.text: This is a really nice outdoor market in the north coast. It has a blend of upscale and shaabi places. The grocery store is especially good, with lots of snacks and other important items like batteries, diapers, etc. 10/10

reviews.author: Jean-François Baltas
reviews.text: Nice and convenient small mall. Food court needs a refresh though and prices in the supermarket are a bit high compares to Cairo but you’re happy to find one knowing that it’s seasonal.

reviews.author: Dr. Neveen Sabra
reviews.text: It is very big and full of products. I think if u need anything u will find it in this supermarket. It is always crowded during summer. I used my voucher which was very convenient for me but the watermelon was not good and I throw it

reviews.author: Mohamed Khairat
reviews.text: The super market has all your needs. The restaurants have a variety to choose from. Also if you are missing a beach towel or slippers you should find good options here. Yet bare in mind if you're coming here, it is super busy. With tight parking spaces.

reviews.text: Anything u want to buy u will find there , they have nice food court , too much restaurants, but too crowded so its not easy to find tables and chairs, also they have summer cinema

reviews.text: Karim, his parents, brother and family are legendary in Nuweiba . Trailblazers in the world of sustainability ( don’t there without a tour of their sustainable farm and children’s center to give back to the Bedhouin women and children) & their hospitality and beach lodge cannot be beaten in Sinai. I have never and would never stay anywhere else in Nuweiba.

reviews.author: Adam Shield of the feather
reviews.text: Such an amazing place, with an amazing vision for farming and sustainable living. It's worth a stop and stay, as the owners are beautiful people and the staff is very helpful!

reviews.author: Dana Hooshmand
reviews.text: Beautiful place to chill for a few hours, or to stay at for a few weeks. Owners speak Arabic, Italian, French and English. And probably more languages...

reviews.author: Bron Solla
reviews.text: A wonderful day trip from Dahab or staylonger at the nearby Habiba Beach Lodge. Look around while you're there. It's amazing how they grow the vegetables in the fertile soil. And such a large variety of plants growing there.

reviews.author: Ahmed Hussien
reviews.text: I recently visited El Borg for a seafood meal, and I must say the food was quite good. The seafood was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared, making it a solid choice for seafood lovers. However, while the food was satisfying, the atmosphere of the restaurant left something to be desired. The ambiance didn’t quite match the quality of the dishes, and the space could use a bit of an update. The chairs and tables felt outdated, which gave the overall setting a less-than-ideal vibe. If you’re looking for a place with excellent seafood but don’t mind a more casual or older environment, El Borg is worth a visit. Still, a little investment in updating the decor could elevate the experience significantly.

reviews.author: Athanasios Tryfonidis
reviews.text: Great Restaurant! English menu available, some of the staff speaks English. Delicious food! The red sauce of the Seafood spaghetti is out of this world. They have also fresh fish, you can choose your own. Card payment possible. Culinary to be recommended without hesitation. They even bring you the cutlery in a pot of hot water for desinfection, much appreciated.

reviews.author: Phuoc Huyen Anh Nguyen
reviews.text: Beautiful view on the beach, good food (seafood, desserts) & drinks (mint lemon juice) at a reasonable price. We really enjoyed our lunch.

reviews.text: I loved it so much. Food tastes great and place is nice. Staff is also nice

reviews.text: The place is overrated and overpriced. It’s good but not the best. Food is tasty but not special. They need to care more about cleanliness. The bathroom was disgusting. I mean you can eat the same delicious fish way cheaper somewhere else.

reviews.author: Tarja
reviews.text: This restaurant presented a bit of a puzzle. Based on the very casual decor – think plastic tablecloths and water in plastic cups – I was expecting budget-friendly prices. However, the menu was surprisingly expensive, placing it in the same range as much nicer establishments in Egypt. The food itself was actually quite tasty for a budget-friendly meal, and if it had been priced appropriately, that would be the end of the story. The service was friendly and attentive. However, the final bill was significantly higher than anticipated, roughly a third more than the total I calculated from the menu prices. I'm still unsure how they arrived at that total, as there was no clear breakdown of the service charges. This underhanded tactic completely negated any positive impression from the friendly service and decent food, and ultimately left a really bitter taste. Please be aware that they don't accept card payments, and locating a nearby ATM proved to be quite a challenge.

reviews.author: javad mashreghi
reviews.text: I usually don’t write negative reviews, but I feel it’s my responsibility to share this experience for the comfort and safety of others. We visited this restaurant based on a recommendation. The food was actually quite decent, and the ambiance pleasant. However, our entire experience was deeply ruined by the unprofessional and shockingly inappropriate behavior of one of the young male staff members. This individual made unsolicited, intrusive, and even vulgar comments—crossing every possible line of respectful interaction. His jokes were offensive, his remarks disturbingly personal, and his overall behavior completely unacceptable in a space that should be safe and welcoming to all guests. We chose not to confront him at the time, as we were the only guests there and didn’t want to escalate things. But we left the restaurant feeling upset, uncomfortable, and frankly, disrespected. This wasn’t a simple case of poor service—it was a violation of personal boundaries and a failure in basic human decency. As long as individuals like this are part of the staff, I cannot recommend this restaurant as a safe or respectful environment. I truly hope the management takes this seriously. No customer should have to feel unsafe or demeaned simply for choosing to dine out.

reviews.author: Jack Papaya
reviews.text: I tried this place for dinner. Had the stuffed pigeon, each dish comes with many side dishes . Food was mostly good. Quite a lot of food for 1 person. The atmosphere was quiet and calm. Overall it was a decent experience with friendly quick service. Wouldn't come back though as i prefer cheaper places to eat.

reviews.author: Mohamed Aslam
reviews.text: We had dinner here on the first day of our stay in Aswan after reading the Google reviews, but it was a deeply disappointing experience. The menu is heavily overpriced for tourists, with a 10% service charge added. However, let’s assume the pricing is acceptable—was there any service to begin with? Absolutely not. The service was poor, the food portions were shockingly small (see the photo for reference), and they charged 555 EGP for what can only be described as a kid-sized portion, plus service charge and tax. The food was bland, the hygiene standards were unacceptable, and there wasn’t a single positive aspect about this restaurant. This was, without a doubt, the worst dining experience we had in Egypt. Avoid this place at all costs.

reviews.author: Nina Lauterbach
reviews.text: We came here upon recommendation of our hotel. Overall the food was nice, with starters and many side dishes. It was not as cheap as you would normally expect in Egypt (and they included quite a big service charge), but at least it was well prepared so you do not have to be afraid of getting ill. The owner was very attentive and friendly.

The location is very central, and the food is ready in just about 2 minutes. They also offer to add hummus inside, which I definitely recommend!

reviews.text: I think this is the place we liked the most in terms of price performance in the Namaa Bay area. The meat is very tasty, odorless, non-spicy, nicely grilled, the kebabs are also delicious, the price is reasonable both for TL and for this region, the appetizers and salads were also very good, we recommend it to everyone.
