reviews.author: Ananya Borah
reviews.text: Farsha cafe comes with its own set of pros and cons. Pros: It is very well decorated with all refurbished items everywhere Food and drinks are too good They play music from every country so when they played one punjabi song, I got excited and danced. The strawberry with tequila is just too good The ambience when the lights go off is to die for us. Awestruck view Definitely the best cafe I have been to. Decent price list. Cons: We were there in June-July. It was off season for Egypt but not in Sharm perhaps so we waited for almost an hour to get a seat There are shops in the upper deck so you ought to buy stuff while you wait. Endless stairs to climb up if you get drunk. You rather sleep off on the beach which is also lots of stairs Cramped seating: there are people everywhere. So you will have to squeeze in. We sat there for 3-4 hours and my legs were numb Not enough items on the food menu. What if I want to eat something else other than a pizza. Hookah recommendations can be better. Overall if you are in Sharm or rather in Egypt - you must visit Farsha for the experience. Definitely doable once in a lifetime!! 🤍🤍🤍

reviews.author: Rozie
reviews.text: This spot offers a truly stunning view of the beach—absolutely picture-perfect and definitely worth seeing. The atmosphere had a lot of potential, with great energy and a vibrant vibe that many people would enjoy. However, it was extremely crowded during our visit, which made it a bit difficult for us to fully relax and enjoy the experience. The seating arrangement was quite packed, with many guests being placed at shared tables with people they didn’t know. While that can be fun and social for some, it wasn’t really our style, and we found it hard to get comfortable. We were hoping to stay longer and enjoy the ambiance as the night lights came on, but the crowding made us decide to head out earlier than planned. It’s a beautiful concept with a great location and lively atmosphere—just a little too packed for our taste. It might be perfect for those who love a bustling, social scene!

reviews.author: Uriel Polito
reviews.text: You must be there really early o wait couple hours after they turn the lights on, We wait 2 hours and it was well worth it. We got couple drinks before and once we were inside, the atmosphere is amazing, we have couple more drinks and then we move to a dancing area. We did not get any food, but we only see pizzas.

reviews.author: Jay Patel
reviews.text: Stunning sunset. Please note to all other parents they do not let children in down in the seating in the rock cliffs. You can sit with children at the top cafe which you get a great view over the bay and sea but you won’t get to experience the full atmosphere with children. Definitely recommend this place for adults without children as the lighting is on point when it gets dark. Amazing concept. Prices aren’t overly expensive either and they aren’t pushy for you to order drinks either.

reviews.author: Robert Vlas
reviews.text: Farsha Cafe is undeniably a visually stunning place. The decor, ambiance, and views are absolutely breathtaking—it’s one of those spots that instantly makes you feel like you’ve stepped into a dream. The design is unique, the seating areas are cozy and picturesque, and there’s a magical vibe that makes it easy to see why so many people are drawn to it. However, the experience of actually getting in and enjoying the place is a completely different story. Be prepared to wait in a long, chaotic line for hours, especially during peak hours. There’s little to no crowd control, and once you finally manage to get inside, you’re packed in with so many people that it’s hard to even move around freely, let alone relax. If you’re someone who enjoys loud music, big crowds, and a party-like atmosphere, you might still enjoy it. But if you’re coming for a peaceful coffee or to soak in the views, it’s just not worth the hassle. The hype sadly doesn’t match the experience for anyone looking for comfort, calm, or quality service. Farsha has incredible potential, but unless they improve how they manage crowds and reservations, it’s more stress than it’s worth.

reviews.author: Anthony Ibrahim
reviews.text: The food is very bad and compared to the price it's even worse Not recommended at all

reviews.author: Abdulrahman A
reviews.text: food not tasty

reviews.author: Mishary
reviews.text: I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. Their prices are very high compared to other restaurants, but they don't deserve the prices. On top of that, the menu is expensive, and they add a 14% tax and 12% service charge. They also ask for a tip. Our food didn't arrive until after a 40-minute wait, and this was despite the restaurant being literally empty, with only our table available. So, if there were more tables, when would they deliver it? After the food arrived, it was cold and not hot at all. The food wasn't hot or tasty. It was acceptable, but frankly, it wasn't anything special, and this wasn't what we expected.

reviews.author: Esraa Esraa
reviews.text: A really wonderful experience. The food was very good, and even though we came late, they received us with the best reception and the best food.

reviews.author: Essam Sayed
reviews.text: Safsafa Fish Restaurant is located in the Old Market area in Sharm El Sheikh. It serves fish meals at moderate and economical prices. It serves fresh seafood with rice and salads. It has a branch in the city of Suez, near the Suez Stadium wall.

name: Sinai Star
address: Sinai Star, Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt

reviews.author: Mohamed Hani
reviews.text: Short review JUST DO NOT GO THERE I went with my Italian friends last night. At first, terrible service, Asked for the menu for a few times before I finally got one. I’m ready to order but no one is coming to take my order. They don’t write my order down and they just left while I’m making my order before I even finish ordering. Somehow we manage to get our order served and that’s what we got Raw bread Tahine and baba ghanoush was good, fillet fish was ok but too oily, the rice was too oily and way too much tomatoes, calamari was very very oily, shrimps was raw and taste horrible, my friend actually has to spit it after putting it in her mouth. We refuse to eat and return our food Not just a bad experience but also they brought me the full cheque of what we order. Very rude staff. Very bad food. The worst fish/seafood experience in Sharm el Sheikh. DON’T GO!

reviews.author: Antoine ADAM
reviews.text: We had diner last night with the family, Nice ambiance outside, fishes well cooked on demand and as per your preference. I strongly recommend but you need to bring your own alcool should you want to have some ;-)

reviews.author: Thomas Li
reviews.text: It’s a scam…. Super rude service and bad hospitality. The boss ignored our requests for the whole night, he even didn’t give us the menu unless we required for more than 10 times….. and the boss overcharged us a lot (our bill was 2000 but the boss charged us for 3200 without a receipt) Don’t go to this restaurant please

reviews.author: esmael mohamed
reviews.text: Good food, good people i’ll give them 7 stars

reviews.author: Kel Emmison
reviews.text: Very tasty food and first time we haven’t felt ripped off 😝😍 We are going back tonight

reviews.author: Alexandre Raphael Wery
reviews.text: By far the best Egyptian food restaurant we’ve tried during our 2 weeks trip to Egypt. Everything is super fresh, tasteful and authentic. The atmosphere is relaxing and the decoration is giving milles et une nuits vibes which makes your experience even better. The prices are totally ok. Big +1 for the amazing collection of fresh fruit juices. The staff was not always super friendly, that could be a way of improving. We’ve been 3 times and will definitely be back. 100% recommend when in Luxor.

reviews.author: Enrique Hernandez
reviews.text: This restaurant was a recommendation and ended up losing my time and money. I ordered the Duck with Vegetables and my wife Lamb and rice. What could it be wrong in a country famous for their cooking? Well to make short avoid at all cost and go to better place. I recommended another restaurant that was far better than Sofra. The duck and veal were not fresh and was poorly cooked. Please beware

reviews.author: Ryan Kim
reviews.text: Sofra Restaurant & Cafe in Luxor offers a warm and authentic dining experience with traditional Egyptian dishes served in a beautifully decorated setting. The rooftop terrace has a lovely, relaxed vibe — perfect for enjoying dinner while soaking in the atmosphere. The food is flavorful and well-portioned, with a variety of options that highlight local ingredients and spices. While not every dish was mind-blowing, the overall quality was satisfying. Service was friendly and attentive, adding to the charm of the place. If you're in Luxor and want to try local cuisine in a cozy, traditional space, Sofra is definitely worth a visit. A solid 4-star experience.

reviews.author: Daria Gavriouchkina
reviews.text: We came here several times during our stay in Luxor. The service is sometimes a bit slow but otherwise quite good. The food on considerably tastier and cheaper than at hotel we were staying at.

reviews.author: Meg In The World
reviews.text: Atmosphere was nice, but service was pretty bad. They didn’t bring soup and rice until I asked after 20 min after they brought the main dish. The rabbit was hardly eat and wasn’t tasty. Wonder how they got the high reviews for the poor service and the food. I would recommend to go somewhere else.

name: Taj Mahal
address: Taj Mahal, Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt

reviews.author: Paddy McManus
reviews.text: Absolutely awful place ! Drinks are stupid expensive and a dead wet fish has a better atmosphere to it. Overall I'd not recomend ever again ! One to avoid .Moto is don't go ever ! Hotel staff promise a amazing party 🤣🤣 . English traveler BTW. Pacha all the way !!

reviews.author: Yousef bin yousef
reviews.text: I think he's the best in Sharm el-Sheikh, there's never been anything like him, and the soap party was nicer than expected. Pay attention to the entry prices. Every hotel or company gives prices that differ from the Hereafter. I always advise you to ask more than one person and take the best price because everyone can find lower prices in certain places, not everyone.

reviews.author: Evgenii Mangushev
reviews.text: Beautiful Russian hostess. That’s about it for the pros. Entrance fee 30$ - the highest I’ve seen in Egypt. A cocktail - 18$! Is it Monaco? (In hurghada entrance is 10$, cocktail is 6-8$). Here they don’t even have Jin and no juice! Shit! All night freaking techno! Getting tired in 30 minutes after coming. And their WiFi is never working!

reviews.author: Marshall Connelly
reviews.text: Not a bad club- however it is a £22 entry fee (1,400 Egyptian pounds) which comes with a “free drink”. It is a tiny cup and they do not put much alcohol in. The drinks you pay for cost around £12/£14 each ( 900/950 Egyptian) and they also tiny. The music was ok but seemed like they were playing very similar songs by the end of it. The decor is really nice, with the taj mahal theme, with elephants around the club. All in all, it’s an ok club- but the prices are wayyyyyy too much.

reviews.author: Mohame Amr
reviews.text: very bad one ' someone his name is shehab is awfully behaving with me in verybad manner . but WHO care 🙈🙉🙊

reviews.author: Hana Alaa
reviews.text: Lovely spot with lots of delicious food options! We went there around 4 or 5 times and everytime the food was great! We recommend for breakfast Alexandrian foul, falafel, and clotted cream with honey. We also loved their Chicken Schnitzel (فراخ بانيه), and the sweet custard sugar pie. The current pasta (مكرونة جارية) was pretty good but needed more spice for sure In the salad options, definitely try the potato salad, the yogurt salad was also great.. and green salad with onions is solid! Try the Siwa juice as well, it's a date smoothie and I suspect it has banana in it? Not sure, but very delicious!

reviews.author: Cyril St Barth
reviews.text: Good below average . Couscous disappointing full of water . Bread disgusting. Lentils soups just ok. Service no smiling and slow. We never receive olives that we ordered . Dirty and noisy

reviews.author: Elise Vv
reviews.text: The food in the restaurant is not awful. The rice is very salty. The pie added an extra large dose of sugar, which is too sweet to eat. The juice is also so sweet that I can't drink it. And the waiter lied to people that there was a service fee, liar! The others didn't pay the service fee at all.

reviews.author: Max Krijthe
reviews.text: Really nice place to eat. I loved the chicken curry! The staff is really kind an everything is made quit fast. The service is good.

reviews.author: Suheir Mahmud
reviews.text: Amazing fresh food, fast service satisfy all tastes... Must visit.. Staff friendly and professional Great experience to taste Egyptian and North African dishes

reviews.author: Nga Pham Bich
reviews.text: Excellent! We had 2 days at the hotel. It was right at the fotress. The owner and all staff were fantastic, friendly and responsive. They provide us goo advises. We used the cart service provided by 1 staff there to visit around Oasis with fixed price. Recommend you stay here

reviews.author: Monika Varga
reviews.text: This hotel was a thing in the past, but seems they stopped caring about it. Dust and dirt EVERYWHERE. Wherever you sit down you get dirty (dusty, sandy). The wool blanket they have on the beds is full of stony sand that of course falls from the ceiling. But guess they NEVER washed it. Cleanliness not existing. Of course rooms don't get cleaned upon your stay, not even when you stay 10 nights. The manager Mr. Salama sits infront of the entrance for 16 hours a day and does absolutely nothing except shouting around and giving orders to staff. He cannot handle the VISA machine, kitchen stuff has to do it. Kitchen is uncleaned, every surface full of oil and dirt, not fresh one of course. Garbage everywhere. Mohammad Ali from the breakfast staff asked me and another guest if we wanna join him to the wedding of HIS relative. It was in Abu Shourouf village, 30km one way. He drove the old minibus of Mr. Salama and upon return he asked us for 800 LE gas money for this short trip to HIS FAMILY'S WEDDING!!!! Upon check in they don't ask for ID. At check out no payment receipt nor any other proof of payment. Cash i paid 1200 LE per night (i am resident in Egypt). They claim by card payment it would cost 1400 LE. So i paid cash 12000 LE for my 10 nights without any proof of payment. Waiting 3 days for a fresh towel, they claim they have none anymore. So i brought the old one myself to a laundry. Had twice a mouse in my room. They put up a sticky surfaced trap, each time it took 2 days til the mouse was caught! They just put the trap and zero effort to just catch it manually or however. Mr. Salama offered me to change room but i stayed because in every room this can happen since the mice enter from under the doors. In booking.com they claim to have A/C, a kitchenette (i think they don't know what kitchenette means) and being a non-smoking place throughout. All this is not the reality. At all. I edited this review and made it less "harsh" and removed real details due to pressure to remove review from someone working for them.

reviews.author: Samah Gayed
reviews.text: I always had a beautiful experience in Albabenshal guest house and in the restaurant where you can have a delicious meal with a great view. The rooms are confortable and you fell that you have space. I love the natural material that are made from and the traditional decoration is art and simplicity combined. The guest house is in the heart of the ancient fortes and in the center. Mr. Salama is very friendly and helpful, he is a wise and calm person. He can arrange and advice you for unforgettable tours in the desert or in other attractions of Siwa. At Albabenshal I always met fantastic people, during the winter time around the fire or in summer on the roof at the restaurant or just at the entrance. If you want to feel the authentic traditional Siwa, that is the place for you.

reviews.author: FROZE
reviews.text: The people were so nice and the rooms were giving the Siwa vibes i really recommend it

reviews.author: luke mercieca
reviews.text: Couldn’t have chosen a better accommodation during my trip to Siwa. Right in the centre of the city at the entrance of the Shali Fortress. It was clean and comfortable and the service was great, very helpful and nice with us!

reviews.author: Miguel Pérez
reviews.text: I cannot recommend this hotel. The location is very far from the city center, breakfast is poor and it gets very cold at night as they only provided a thin blanket.

reviews.author: Mahmod El,snosi
reviews.text: I recommend trying it, great place.

reviews.author: y m
reviews.text: Very friendly staff and delicious food. It was a fun experience.

reviews.author: Lior Algranati
reviews.text: A complex of rooms built in local style with a swimming pool that looks unused. There is charm in this place with the plants around and the simple design. But the room is not that clean, especially the bathroom, simple breakfast, Siwa style. The place is a bit far from the center. Not suitable for the average tourist.

reviews.author: Ana Beatriz
reviews.text: Good experience: super cute place, cozy rooms for a fair price. The staff is really super gently. The shower is not the greatest, maybe a curtain would make big difference. The breakfast is really good and well made. Good place, specially If you consider where you are.

name: Fatnas Island Café
address: Fatnas Island Café, Siwa Oasis, Egypt

reviews.author: Fatma Helmy
reviews.text: If you have a low budget, then this hotel is for you! The hotel was not as I expected. The staff are polite, but unprofessional and usually absent. I arrived in Siwa at 9:30 am on a Friday, but I found it very dusty and empty. No one was available at the reception. Were they asleep? On holiday? I called the receptionist, and the young man told me to take the room key from the counter. Upon entering the room, it was extremely dusty, dirty and the AC was broken. I complained and changed rooms, but it was equally dirty and very dusty. I asked him to clean the room and change the bed sheets. The bathroom was completely lacking in toilet paper and soap. When I requested these items, he said when the owner comes, he would take money from him to buy the toiletries—Two or three reminders later, we finally received one very small toilet paper roll for two adult guests. Were they afraid that we would poop too much? I asked for the internet, but it seems that they hadn’t paid the bill. I reminded him, but still no internet. The hotel entrance was still very dusty and dirty, and no one was on duty to receive guests or answer guest questions. One night, I woke up to very loud voices from a fight. Male guests in the next room were fighting and smoking. I didn’t bother to complain because neither the owner nor the worker was present to shut them up. That made me really mad. I didn’t get enough sleep that day. On the last day, I finally found the owner and the worker cleaning the hotel entrance and stairs! If only they had done this BEFORE our arrival!!! The hotel itself has the potential to always be full of guests, but the hotel managers don’t fully understand the basics of what is required to keep guests happy. The hotel rooftop offers a lovely view of the town square. The Siwi people themselves are nice and very polite. The room is cluttered and small with a over sized closet and a mini fridge. It is better to remove the closet, especially since hangers are nowhere to be found inside. Instead, you will see heavy blankets. The location is perfect, but Siwa is not the quiet place it used to be. So, I don’t recommend to stay in the town center. The street noise will wake you up daily. In a nutshell, this place is for a super low budget traveler who is used to Cairo’s cacophony, but is patient and wants to be able to buy things easily from nearby shops. I don’t think i will return again, but I would recommend the hotel for other travelers who have these aforementioned criteria. Best of luck to the hotel and to fellow travelers!

reviews.author: Abdelkhalek Helal
reviews.text: Great money value with enough comfort after a long Safari day. Staff are helpful (Mina)

reviews.author: Ahmed Fathi (HomesteadY Siwa)
reviews.text: Great affordable experience in Siwa. They also help with all your logistics and whereabouts in Siwa.

reviews.author: Willy's
reviews.text: Normal hotel, very cheap, beside all shops and the restaurant but I didn't recommend it for foreigners

reviews.author: Usama Khalil (‫أسامة خليل‬‎)
reviews.text: Not the best place, but it is very clean, helpful staff, medium fees. Bot expensive and not cheap.

reviews.author: Mohamed El-Haddad
reviews.text: Even though the menu isn't that big, the plates are all wonderful. The chicken with olives (in the pic) is so delicious and the one with the pomegranate syrup is just the same. The vegetable kouskous was so good too. Super friendly host. The candlelight moonlight roof dinner was a nice experience and a must for anyone visiting Siwa.

reviews.author: Ahmed Fathi (HomesteadY Siwa)
reviews.text: Lovely restaurant and lovelier hotel (aka Shali Lodge Hotel).

reviews.author: Malaka Ashour
reviews.text: My second time here, clean, nice oriental breakfast and near downtown

reviews.author: B AlRash
reviews.text: I liked the outdoor area. Wanted to have lunch but had to order it ahead of time. Ended up hanging out for some tea. The spot is nice.

reviews.author: Mahmoud Akram
reviews.text: We tried following Google maps to this restaurant and the destination was a deserted place and we couldnt find the restaurant and had to drive in a big circle and found ourselves at the matrouh road entering siwa again so ask for directions to the place instead of following Google on this one

reviews.author: mohamed raouf
reviews.text: they know nothing about room service, they don't clean the room ever, i had to ask to change my towels and they changed it after the second time, also i asked to clean the toilet basket but they didn't, the electrical plugs most of them were not working, their food has no taste and they have no fixed price menu as i got two different prices for the same coffee in two different days

reviews.author: Zsuzsa Méhész
reviews.text: I love this place. My favourite in Siwa. Can’t wait to visit and stay here again!

reviews.author: Ahmed Fathi (HomesteadY Siwa)
reviews.text: Great location, architecture and views.. Aka Kenooz.

reviews.author: Mia Belgica
reviews.text: Very unique room I love the ambiance.Thank you to Mr.Khalid for helping us through out our tour in siwa.Very accommodating staff. Great room,hot and cold shower and clean….

reviews.author: Rania Saeed
reviews.text: The rooms are very authentic. However, the breakfast was awful. The food was served cold and never together. There was never any cleaning during 4 day stay to the rooms or the common areas. There are no trash bins in the common areas so trash piled up and was never cleaned. Also, the workers in general weren't friendly or helpful l. I wouldn't return to this place again.

reviews.author: Ahmed Hosny Zidan
reviews.text: Staff is super helpful very dedicated to their work especially Mr. Mohamed ( reception) excellent smiling staff willing to helping you in any situation.

reviews.author: Nano Jed
reviews.text: Spacious resort Good breakfast Friendly atmosphere Good service Electric & WiFi available Modern bathrooms with hot water and efficient drainage! Some nights might be noisy ( dog’s parking). Good stay for short period only . Thank you

reviews.author: Rania Hegazi
reviews.text: Everything is super. Dinner is amazing but breakfast is not so good. Tap water smell is not good

reviews.author: J K
reviews.text: Very nice resort super staff excellent food just a bite to far from the center but I will go back again

reviews.author: Betsy York
reviews.text: This is a perfect resort hotel in the western border town of Siwa, Egypt. It experiences power outages periodically but makes up for uncontrollable circumstances with excellent services and support. I really loved the beautiful use of palm tree woods and a very restful, comfortable bed after extensive travel times.

reviews.author: Shishira Thomas
reviews.text: The food is enough to make you want to go back to this place. It's mostly Moroccan, and damn, the chef can COOK!! Every night, we had a 5 course meal with a salad, a bastilla, chicken, beef, and rice, every day being a different preparation of these. And dessert, of course. Exceptional! The rooms were clean and comfortable. Candles are provided. The bathroom had an automatic light, which was convenient. There's hot water at the property as well. The pool wasn't very inviting because it was dark and murky, but this could also be because they don't use chemicals. Service was top-notch. The manager was always around to give you assistance if you need it. There's a charger at the reception to charge your devices. The location is beautiful. It's a 20 min drive from the main town, and most of the route is tarred. The last bit, which is not, prepared you for the remote feeling you want when you book this place. The view from Taziry is also spectacular. We loved it!

reviews.author: Piotrek P
reviews.text: We went there for dinner, which was really good. It was a Moroccan buffet in an outdoor setting. Will definitely come back

reviews.author: Salah Hetata
reviews.text: Well if you in love with living in natural environment this is the place I lived it and living under candrl lights and the food was amazing and such a nice quite place I love it no electricity there except one plug to charge and one small bed light and there is a light on the bathroom but other then this it's candels I really loved it and staff are amazing and so friendly and so helpful

reviews.author: marla hany
reviews.text: Very calm, good view, clean air, goid hospitality from staff, Best food in Siwa if not one of the best in Egypt! Very attentive to details Chef.

reviews.author: Mohamed Roushdy
reviews.text: rooms are constructed with natural materials while conserving a private and pampered comfort. The quality of the air, the absence of noise and light pollution, all make the back-to-nature experience so immediate. You will find yourself absorbed by the perfectly clear night sky, gazing at the shooting stars, or immersed in a spiritual osmosis.

reviews.author: Lubna Hassan
reviews.text: In February, I had the pleasure of staying at Strand Taba Heights Hotel as part of the organizing team for the Taba Liberation Day event. As a Guest Relation working in the hospitality field, this visit was both inspiring and relaxing. From the moment I arrived, I felt the calm, peaceful energy of the place. The location is breathtaking, surrounded by mountains and the magical Red Sea view. The staff were kind and attentive, always smiling and ready to assist. The rooms were spacious, clean, and elegantly decorated — a perfect place to rest after a busy day. The food was fresh and tasty, with a variety that satisfied every taste. What made the experience truly special was the peaceful atmosphere and the natural beauty surrounding the hotel. It was a perfect mix of professional hospitality and warm, authentic Egyptian charm. I would definitely love to visit again.

reviews.author: Tala Qtaishat
reviews.text: My stay at the hotel was truly exceptional! The staff were incredibly friendly and professional — always smiling and ready to help. They made me feel right at home. The facilities were clean, well-maintained, and relaxing, especially the pool and spa area. The food was delicious and offered a good variety, especially at breakfast and dinner. You can tell there’s a lot of care put into the quality and taste. The massage experience was amazing — the therapists were highly skilled, and the atmosphere at the spa was calming and soothing. I highly recommend this hotel and would definitely love to come back again!

reviews.author: ahmed raafat
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience during my stay at this hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff was welcoming, professional, and always ready to help. The check-in process was smooth, and the room was clean, spacious, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The housekeeping was consistent and thorough, and the amenities – including the restaurant, gym, and lounge areas – were top quality. The breakfast buffet offered a great variety and was delicious every morning. What really stood out was the warm hospitality and attention to detail. It made me feel at home away from home. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking for comfort, cleanliness, and excellent service. The restaurant staff was attentive and friendly, always making sure I was satisfied.

reviews.author: Areej Awad
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of staying at Strand Hotels in Taba, and the experience was truly unforgettable. From the moment I arrived, the staff greeted me with warm smiles and genuine hospitality, ensuring my stay was comfortable and memorable. Their professionalism and attentiveness were evident in every interaction. A special shoutout goes to the animation team, who brought so much energy and joy to the experience. Their creativity and enthusiasm were contagious, making every activity and event engaging and fun. Whether it was the morning exercises, evening shows, or kids' entertainment, they went above and beyond to create a lively and welcoming atmosphere. The hotel's serene location, nestled between the mountains and the sea, added to the charm of the stay. The breathtaking views and tranquil atmosphere made it the perfect getaway for relaxation and rejuvenation. I would highly recommend Strand Hotels in Taba to anyone seeking a luxurious and welcoming retreat. The staff, service, and animation team truly set this hotel apart, and I look forward to returning in the future.

reviews.author: Mohamed Ahmad
reviews.text: A wonderful resort with stunning architecture, excellent service, and a wide variety of delicious food. Everything was well-organized and comfortable, with great attention to detail. It was my first visit, but definitely not the last! I will not forget to mention the amazing Menna from the guest relations! She was very helpful and cheerful. Thank you for making my stay better

reviews.author: Devi Bajaj
reviews.text: Heard a lot about this place and we were in the area so decided to try it as as every review and blog said it’s an institution for authentic Greek food in Athens - but not much flavor so we didn’t love it. Cool place though, you go down the stairs and sit at a shared table if there isn’t an empty table available. They come and tell you the dishes and you choose. We had the fish which was great, but the chickpea soup was pretty bland. There was a fava bean thick stew like dish which was decent, dipped there homemade bread in it.

reviews.author: Matias Infeld Caballier
reviews.text: This place is a must visit in Athens, the food is superb. The neighbourhood is a bit like Berlin-styled under mood. You sit at the table and the service will bring you the food, no choices, no doubts. Everything was delicious, and extremely cost-effective.

reviews.author: Gard Karlsen
reviews.text: We stopped by here for lunch as the rumour is that this is one of the oldest taverns. The way in is actually down a staircase into a basement and we got a table - and as it was big we just shared it with another couple. The guy serving was in a no fuzz mood so we just got a jug of white wine and food was served - so we did not get a chance to look at a menu or choose anything. We got bread, vegetable soup, chickpea soup and some grilled fish. The food was not bad and it was a fun experience but it would have been great to choose food from the menu. It was 25 Euros for the two of us.

reviews.author: Noé DUARTE
reviews.text: Amazing restaurant if you want a true traditional and authentic (rustic) restaurant in Athens. You don’t have any menu. The waiter just tell you what they have for the day. Then, the chef writes the prices on your paper napkin on the table. This place only accepts cash. I definitely recommend going !!

reviews.author: Olivia Carroll
reviews.text: Basement restaurant that serves whatever they’re cooking that day. No menus, no ordering, just food and wine brought to the table. The food was delicious. Traditional dishes of fava beans, white beans, chickpeas, sardines, and potatoes served with a load of bread. This cost our family of four €41. Wouldn’t recommend using the bathroom here, but otherwise the atmosphere is cozy.

reviews.author: T'Andre White
reviews.text: Incredible dining experience. Don’t let the haters scare you away. This place is going in my wife’s top 3 meals EVER. Service was incredibly fast (even after receiving apologies for being so busy). Everything we ordered was delicious, warm, seasoned, and quality. There wasn’t a bite that wasn’t enjoyed. Very accommodating for American tourists. Plenty of free water and accepting credit card, no questions asked. Do yourself a favor and make it in for a snack. The house white wine was delicious and everything was quite affordable! Additionally they served delicious/juicy watermelon for free after we asked for the bill. 😎

reviews.author: Rachael Sapphire
reviews.text: Overall a pleasant experience, although I have some reservations: 1. While I do appreciate the music, keep in mind of the 3 euro charge per person for the live music which may not guaranteed to be your taste and can be extremely loud. 2. Food is not bad, but nothing I would shout about as well. It's good, can be seen as pricier to some but still nice. 3. Very crammed, many many people and your table may be back to back with someone else. The restaurant has a pleasant charm to it, but not somewhere I would revisit.

reviews.author: Al Baris
reviews.text: The vegetarian food was okay, nothing special – a bit mediocre for the price. The staff was friendly and attentive, which we appreciated. It was very busy on a Saturday evening, and unfortunately, we only had our table from 7:30 to 9:00 pm. There was no live music during that time, which was a bit disappointing since we were hoping to enjoy that part of the experience.

reviews.author: Anissa Colaco Souza
reviews.text: The food here was incredible, to start with we had the greek salad which was super fresh and yummy and the grilled oyster mushrooms, a delicious surprise! As a main we had the pork knuckle and potatoes, the meat just fell off the bone! the potatoes we super tasty as well. The service was great and I love the interiors! This was my favourite meal in Athens!

reviews.author: Eniko Rabe
reviews.text: Feels like you have joined a big Greek family for dinner - food is great, the service too even though it's super busy all the time. If you want to have dinner after 9, make a reservation well in advance, some nights are fully booked because of the live music.

reviews.author: Ozge Ustundag
reviews.text: We visited on a weekday around 11 AM and it was already quite busy — a good sign! The prices were very reasonable, and the gyro was flavorful and satisfying. The pita bread stood out — fresh, warm, and delicious. A great quick bite in the heart of the city.

reviews.author: Dickran Khodanian
reviews.text: Hands down, best gyro spot in Athens. For being in the dead city center, its prices are impressively cheap and its food is very delicious. The founder has been there for several decades and he was there when we went. We just asked him to make us something he recommended and thought we would like. He made us a beef gyro with a tomato sauce that I haven’t tried anywhere else. The beer is also $1.50 and well worth it. During lunch and dinner time, there will definitely be a line. The food comes out very fast.

reviews.author: VoudouLounge
reviews.text: It was really good so it does live up to the hype I would say by the lineup and wait gets pretty lengthy at times which is unfortunate. Food is fresh and the prices are fair so if you have the patience to wait or if you ever pass by and there’s no line I’d definitely recommend to give it a try.

reviews.author: Omri Ashkenazi
reviews.text: I came here to grab something small on the go. I ordered a pita with meat and a pita with pork. The dishes were simply excellent and cheap!! I recommend coming early before their food runs out! I will definitely come back here

reviews.author: Hector A. Lopez
reviews.text: I read everywhere that this was THE PLACE to eat gyros, and honestly, they were very good! But I also had really good ones in several other places… if you see there’s a long line, just move on — it’s not something unique. They’re good, but that’s it… you can find great gyros in many places around Athens.

reviews.author: Istvan Borsos
reviews.text: One of the best places we were during our stay in Athens. We arrived here without a reservation. The place is nice and the waiters/waitresses are lovely. Most importantly, the food was fabulous. We'll definitely come back again.

reviews.author: Marc-Antoine Plourde
reviews.text: Very good restaurant with kind, attentive staff and beautifully prepared dishes. The flavors were excellent across the board — the mushroom fricassee was rich and earthy, the Greek salad was fresh and unique, and the couscous main dish was truly delightful. If I may offer one small suggestion: the portion sizes, especially for the starters, could easily be scaled down a bit. Even with a good appetite (and having fasted 11 hours before the meal!), I found the quantities a little too much, which can take away from fully appreciating the progression of the meal. The setting is relaxed and unpretentious — not fancy, but welcoming. Overall, no regrets at all. A very good experience, tasty and thoughtful cuisine. A few small adjustments on portioning would make it even better.

reviews.author: S CHEUNG
reviews.text: **A Culinary Journey to Remember: Our Greek Dining Experience in Athens** Nestled in the heart of Athens, we stumbled upon a gem of a Greek restaurant that left an indelible mark on our taste buds and hearts. From the moment we stepped through the door, we were enveloped in a warm embrace of hospitality that set the tone for an unforgettable dining experience. The cozy and chic decor transported us to a world where tradition meets modern elegance. The ambiance was perfect for an early dinner, with soft lighting and tasteful decorations that created an intimate yet lively atmosphere. Our server, with a smile as bright as the Mediterranean sun, guided us through the menu with such enthusiasm and knowledge that we felt like we were dining with a dear friend. Their recommendations were spot-on, reflecting a deep understanding of the dishes and a genuine desire to ensure we had the best experience possible. The dishes arrived beautifully presented, each one a work of art that showcased the freshness and quality of the local ingredients. The simplicity of the preparations allowed the natural flavors to shine, with each bite revealing a symphony of tastes that were both surprising and delightful. The balance of herbs, spices, and fresh ingredients was nothing short of magical, transporting us to the sun-drenched hillsides and bustling markets of Greece. What made the experience even more remarkable was the affordability of the meal. The quality and portion sizes far exceeded the price, making it an exceptional value that we would happily recommend to anyone visiting Athens. Our evening at this charming Greek restaurant was more than just a meal; it was a culinary journey that celebrated the best of Greek cuisine and hospitality. We left with full hearts and bellies, already planning our next visit. If you find yourself in Athens, do not miss the opportunity to dine at this hidden gem—your taste buds will thank

reviews.author: Veronika Cs
reviews.text: We found this restaurant by accident on our first day in Athens, we wanted to have a nice lunch but weren’t prepared for fine dining, hence we didn’t not try the whole menu. We had Greek salad that was truly refreshing with the frozen cucumber slushie, nice touch, we also had squid with fresh courgettes and couscous with lots of lime and some mint, was a taste bomb on palates and we had cod with parsnip puree and fried polenta with feta, which was also excellent. I wish we came for dinner and tasted everything on the menu, I recommend the place to fellow foodies. The only negative was that the tables are too close to each other.

reviews.author: Orgasm Atron
reviews.text: A really nice place, feels like a chefs restaurant but much more relaxing and cormftable. The cousin is rather traditional bit with a relatively modern and edgy touch to it. The mushrooms were outstanding and the prices are reasonable.

reviews.author: Buyisiwe Shongwe - Varenzakis
reviews.text: The most incredible, juiciest, tender and well made souvlakis you will EVER have!! Not sure how they get them right but this is undoubtedly the gold standard!! Everything on the menu is great! The peppers, salads, etc. all are off the charts!! The service is very good and besides it being a super busy restaurant, the toilers are clean!!

reviews.author: Marlon
reviews.text: Spent 5 days in Athens and ate here everyday! Sometimes, twice a day. Easy to find and great food. There wasn’t much tourist when we went, mostly locals which is always a good sign in a touristy place. Food - Easy 5 Stars! I love grilled meat so this was like heaven! Salad was amazing too! Service - our waiters were always kind and helpful, offering good service and advice when asked. Atmosphere - I would have given it more than 3 but people just came there to eat. In fact, I loved the fact that people kept to themselves. But wouldn’t have minded to have seen it more lively. I can’t complain and I always look back to the photos with longing and massive cravings

reviews.author: Cass
reviews.text: I'll be thinking about the yogurt kebab for a long time. It was incredible but quite large. If you get it, it's enough for 2 people. The staff was very nice to me, and made sure i was taken care of the whole time. It's in a very busy area right by Montaseraki Square, but they have tons of seating and service was still great.

reviews.author: Silvia Martišová
reviews.text: Amazing spot in city cente with affordable prices. Restaurant is always almost full but staff is quick and attentive. I ordered white wine for 4,8€ and expected small glass and they brought me 500ml of wine which was tasting amazing. Their yogurt kebab is amazing as everyone else said. Chicken kebab is also very good meal. If you visit you will be very happy with your choice :)

reviews.author: Ratul Das
reviews.text: The well know O Thanasis didn’t disappoint, it was busy and bustling for dinner, the food took some time to arrive but it was worth the wait. The meats were perfect cooked, the kebab and the pork souvlaki were the best. The yogurt kebab is a must, we skipped it this time. The prices are moderate and portions are huge, don’t order too much.

reviews.author: Buyisiwe Shongwe - Varenzakis
reviews.text: The most incredible, juiciest, tender and well made souvlakis you will EVER have!! Not sure how they get them right but this is undoubtedly the gold standard!! reviews.author: Ian Rae
reviews.text: Getting here is a real experience, there’s a cable car but the walk up to the cable car, composed mainly of stairs is pretty steep to begin with. We arrived around sunset and it was quite busy on the hill and the cable car was running pretty continuously. We’d a reservation and got a great table next to the window. First the positives, the view is awesome. Service I thought was pretty decent certainly friendly and we were made to feel welcome. I’m afraid I was a little disappointed with the food, I ordered the fish of the day (sea bream) and the dish just felt a little over-complicated to me. My wife had lobster which was a much better choice. It wasn’t cheap either. Overall it’s probably worth going for the view and the experience but not as a food destination.

reviews.author: Walton Eleanor
reviews.text: The views are incredible, even though it was cloudy was well worth the trip, very special spot! Definitely book in advance- we were on the waitlist as booked last minute and were very lucky to get outside table. It was so beautiful. The food was really good too!

reviews.author: Jennifer Bernal
reviews.text: Breath taking views!!! Be aware you have to take a sort of tramway— which i thought was very cool. The food was so good, to start we had greek salad and grilled shrimp then for main course lamb and pork. The staff was friendly and attentive. A hidden gem!

reviews.author: Helena Sisková
reviews.text: I would say you pay the the views, not the quality of food. I was glad that we did not have to pay a deposit or be a large party to get a reservation, as many Athens restaurants with the view/rooftops require this. The food was good, but nothing special and the prices were quite high. Also as the time went by and the place got busier (around sunset time) it was a bit hard to get a server to come to us, we ended up waiting for the bill for about half an hour, just looking at each other :) But the views are unmatched. Also the restaurant is a grat way to avoid crowds visiting the top of the hill.

reviews.author: John McAfee
reviews.text: Oh My! Top 10 dinner without a doubt. Such an amazing view. Great food. Great cocktails. Great wine. Great views. Wow

name: Ta Karamanlidika tou Fani
address: Ta Karamanlidika tou Fani, Athens, Greece

reviews.author: Carissa Tong
reviews.text: Must try the Kasseri cheese and Pastirma!

reviews.author: Idan
reviews.text: Really like this charcuterie place, Very tasty and the owner is really nice and helpful

reviews.author: Ioannis Papadopoulos
reviews.text: Excellent products from carefully selected suppliers. Friendly service.

reviews.author: Georgia Lalou
reviews.text: When great taste is combined with impeccable service, the result is magical! Excellent roe, aged cheeses and delicious cold cuts - the pasturmas is simply divine and the pastrami is the best I have ever tasted. A big thumbs up for the high quality of the products that has been maintained over the years but also for the constant kindness and willingness of the people who work there and always ensure the best!

reviews.author: Mixalis Galanopoulos
reviews.text: Excellent shop with fantastic products from small producers Here one can find excellent cold cuts and cheeses from the past and remember the flavors from their childhood The staff is very helpful and specialized

reviews.author: Guy Russell
reviews.text: We arrived in Athens and went for a stroll. We found this restaurant off the beaten path in Plaka (is that possible?). It is located on a small quiet square and has more seating outdoors under cover than inside. It is a great setting. Good food, good service and good value. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: D Clover41
reviews.text: I ordered a beef stew. Nobody asked me for any options, because my mistake, there were and I hadn't said what option I wanted. I got a plate dripping with orange grease, a bowl shaped meat, some white rice and some fries. I asked where are the aubergines and the sauce? The waiter informed me that the orange bubbles were supposed to be tomato sauce. He did return with a plate covered with more grease, meat, and aubergines. So no stew, and no beef either. It was dry pork. I pointed this out to another waiter but he wouldn't hear any of it. Too bad.

reviews.author: Marc “MarcPFlanders”
reviews.text: A nice restaurant located at a side of Mnisikleous, the stair street. The restaurant is on a quiet square with no traffic. You forget that you’re in Athens and you get the feeling that you’re eating in a small Greek village. It’s one of my favourite restaurants in Athens since a long time.

reviews.author: Dan Peacefield
reviews.text: What an exceptional restaurant! Lovely to sit under the vines and be served by such professionals. The beef skewer I ordered was perfectly cooked and my wife's octopus was bang on. We have already recommended this restaurant to two other couples. Best one we found in Athens.

reviews.author: Vakhtang Khabazi
reviews.text: Really nice Greek restaurant near Acropolis. It’s in sorta secluded and calm area. Outside space is like a little square/yard which brings out very classy, film scenery vibes. I believe it actually served as a movie scene location for some film. Very delicious food, quite lovely service and super super cat friendly. They even had their own restaurant stray cat with a sign and everything :) I’d totally recommend.

reviews.author: Meika Goode
reviews.text: When traveling, I love stopping by mom-and-pop restaurants. They usually have the best homemade food, and this restaurant did not disappoint. In the window, there was a leg of lamb on a roasting pan, and I just had to try it. Boy, was it delicious. It was freshly cut, so moist, and perfectly seasoned. I will be back.

reviews.author: Allison Yan
reviews.text: My mom and I had a wonderful experience and delicious meal! This place is a cozy, no-frills family run restaurant. The staff are friendly and helpful in explaining the menu. We shared the moussaka, another eggplant dish, and the pork belly - all were amazing. And the entire meal was under 30 euro! What a steal. Give this Rick Steves-approved spot a visit; you won’t regret it!

reviews.author: Ann Zh
reviews.text: A charming family-run restaurant. The atmosphere was incredibly pleasant, making us feel right at home. Every dish we tried was delicious, truly authentic Greek cuisine, and the prices were surprisingly affordable. This spot is a real gem for a delightful Greek meal

reviews.author: YB
reviews.text: You know you’re at the right place when you walk into a restaurant that is full for lunch at 2.15pm and the waiter tells you that “the service is bad but the food is good”. The food here tastes like what you would expect a Greek mother to cook for you in her home, unpretentious, full of flavour and leaving you satisfied. Their eggplant, mousaka and lamb are standouts and the prices are very reasonable to boot. So come swing by after you visit the Acropolis and pair that dose of Greek history with some authentic Greek fare

reviews.author: Elena Akivenson
reviews.text: The staff is very friendy an the food is delicious. My daughter never ate moussaka in her life because she tried it once and she found it disgusting but the moment she tried the moussaka here she was amazed and so was I, the moussaka is amazing. We where there already two times this week! The food portions are big enough but the restaurant is very basic.

reviews.author: Yarys
reviews.text: En Plo Restaurant was an unforgettable dining experience! The proximity to the water and the refreshing sea breeze made it the perfect escape on a hot day. The food was incredibly fresh and absolutely delicious, with every dish bursting with authentic flavors. Despite the restaurant being quite busy, the staff handled everything with professionalism and kindness, serving us promptly and with a smile. The atmosphere, combined with the fantastic service and mouthwatering food, made it a highlight of our time in Corfu. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: G&S Travels
reviews.text: What an amazing experience looking over the old fort. The restaurant has modern decor and very friendly and helpful staff. The food quality is excellent. Affordable wine and drinks makes a very pleasant experience. Will be back for sure

reviews.author: Vincent Aun
reviews.text: Dining right next to the sea with breath taking scenery. The sea water is so clear you could swim in it. Sunset was so beautiful. The foods were excellent, there were eleven of us, we totally enjoyed our meal. The waiter was very friendly, took care of us very well.

reviews.author: Catherine Bragg
reviews.text: Can't give it any more stars and I would if I could. Absolutely our favorite ocean side Cafe in Old Town Corfu. You can have a sparkling water while jumping into the ocean to cool off. Not to mention the food, lots of grilled options and the salads so fresh. Mangiare!

reviews.author: AC ZPB
reviews.text: The Staff is very accommodating! They have the best “Orange pie” I personally have ever tasted! We went 2 times to have dinner! amAll Amazing!

reviews.author: Leon L
reviews.text: We were looking for a restaurant that would offer a taste different from traditional Greek cuisine while still maintaining its charm, and we found just the place. The chef turned simple dishes into masterpieces—sardines, a typical fish dish, but he adds something that completely transforms their flavor. The approach to another dish, the stuffed rabbit, was equally impressive—a very interesting combination of stuffing and presentation. The wine selection, which was recommended to us based on our preferences, was outstanding. It was absolutely delicious. We are delighted that such restaurants exist. Of course, it must be acknowledged that this experience does not come cheap.

reviews.author: James
reviews.text: Great dining experience! We were greeted gracefully by the knowledgeable staff which set the tone to continue throughout the evening. The food was unique and complex which provided great conversation points trying to figure out where the exciting and unknown flavours were coming from. The courtyard is lovely and quiet, away from the hustle and bustle of the main streets in the old town, but super easy to find. The swordfish main dish was out of this world! Wine was excellent too. The only thing that didn’t hit to the same level was the dessert which looked lovely but perhaps lacked the explosiveness of flavour of the other dishes in comparison. Thanks to the lovely team for the great evening.

reviews.author: Bryn McKay
reviews.text: This is by far one of the best restaurants I’ve ever been to in the world. The food is innovative and imaginative. Form the Artichoke heart/ morel mushroom starter into the Shrimp/ pumpkin puree Ravioli into the Slow cooked Beef.. my taste buds were on a wild yet calming journey. The desserts were divine, and the salmon. Monet suggested some of the most incredible pairings. Isabella was our waitress and she took the upmost care. Would not miss this! What a Treat.

reviews.author: Georges Sarantos
reviews.text: Everything there was brilliant . Food wise was mesmerised by the complexity of aromas my mouth was receiving through out the whole experience there. A list of great wines. we went there without reservation (that none should do in the future) but the manager was able to provide a table so we can dine me and my wife. The only thing I would love to see in that restaurant ( I know is hard but that will make it even more special) was the luck of a degustation menu cause if your are visiting Corfu once or even twice your life its hard to get to try all the menu. (that I wanted to do) cause you will end up with a great bill. Food for thought Otherwise I amazed and thank you.

reviews.author: Aoife Spence
reviews.text: Experienced some amazing fine dining and food at this lovely restaurant. The chef is absolutely amazing at what he does. The food was outstanding, so tasty whilst also learning some amazing ways in which the food was cooked and prepared. I also tried some amazing wine and rose. I would definitely recommend it if you are looking for high-quality food and an amazing fine dining service.

reviews.author: David Weber
reviews.text: A lovely way to end our visit to Corfu. We had many wonderful meals on the island, but this one combined great food, great service and a relaxed yet dramatic atmosphere. Great for people-watching!

reviews.author: Henry B
reviews.text: Amazing food - Greek classics with amazing flavours. Fantastic service and location. Portion sizes are copious and starters could easily be shared between the two of us. We had the spinach millefeuille and the savoury doughnuts to start - both very original. Then the lamb with lovely lemony potatoes in a meaty sauce, and moussaka which didn’t have potatoes in so was lighter than the classic I’ve had before. We were absolutely stuffed but still managed to share the kafayifi pudding which was lighter than it sounds and a great way to finish. Washed down with a bottle of Klima Kotsifali (Crete). No notes! It was busy so would recommend booking if you want an outside table.

reviews.author: Bella B
reviews.text: Truly impeccable dinner and service! Absolute professionalism, godly food, and a good disposition of the tables. The clients’ needs and wishes are handled very professionally, discreetly, and with no frills. Every client is treated equally and with no assumptions of any kind. The serving is done at a perfect temp; every dish is served right on time and without overcrowding the table. It is a nice feeling knowing that you can just relax and be taken care of in the best way possible. The food is absolutely finger-licking! Every dish tastes exactly as it’s supposed to, with a touch of a nice surprise and an explosion of flavors. The ingredients are of high quality, combined thoughtfully, and they complement each other beautifully. All the flavors dance in sync on your taste buds! When visiting the coast in the summer, I always tend to order octopus from the different places we dine in. This one is by far the best I have ever had! I wholeheartedly recommend Rex restaurant and will definitely come back again! Thank you for being the perfect choice to finish off a special day with a special meal and service. We had: Greek salad, spinach pie, grilled octopus with potatoes and artichoke, calamari with quinoa and spinach, a glass of white wine, ginger beer, lemonade, and an orange pie.

reviews.author: Jakub Jagodzinski
reviews.text: Food was amazing. We tried the Hummus & Avocado and it was one of the nicest foods I had in a while. The main was also amazing. Nothing else to add just try it, you will not be disappointed. A+++

reviews.author: Franciele Machado
reviews.text: Excellent food. The octopus was the softest one I ever ate in life.

name: Street Stall - Old Fortress
address: Street Stall - Old Fortress, Corfu, Greece

reviews.author: Andreea Tau
reviews.text: Entry is free for visitors under 25, and €10 for those over 25. It’s definitely worth a visit! You can climb all the way to the top, where you’ll be rewarded with a panoramic view of the city 🏞️🌆. I recommend bringing a bottle of water with you — the walk can be a bit demanding, especially in the heat 💦🥵.

reviews.author: mark stewart
reviews.text: Stunning experience! Very well kept, and fascinating to walk around. A small museum, and a museum shop are a must, they are located near the entrance. The walk up to the lighthouse isn't too hard, but can be a bit slippy under foot on some of the stones. Don't think a wheelchair would get up there. The views from the top are well worth the effort of the walk. Look for the English cookhouse hidden in the corner.

reviews.author: Lauren Higgins
reviews.text: Great views when climbing to the top. Advise to do it early as it can be tough climbing up in the heat. €10 entry per person. Nice cafe with great views to rest after climbing up.

reviews.author: Dahi Yazılım
reviews.text: Corfu is one of the most authentic islands of Greece and offers a lot. Old Fortress is the main tourist attraction. Entrance is 10 Euro and cash only. Site is well preserved. There is a music conservatory (no visit) and sail club restaurant inside. Other than militaristic and historical significance, gives a very nice view of Adriatic Sea.

reviews.author: James Yarwood
reviews.text: Amazing historical site that is definitely worth a visit. You can walk all the way to the top of the hill/mount above the central fortress too - It's worth it. The views are incredible! There is a cafe and restaurant located within the fortress grounds, so a good place to stop for a break before ascending to the top.

reviews.author: Will Neal
reviews.text: First time to grease, and Corfu was great. Lots of local shops and a nice park. We even took a dip in the sea.

reviews.author: Dan Shelley
reviews.text: If you enjoy historical visits I highly recommend Spianada Square. There's a walk up to the lighthouse with spectacular views!

reviews.author: Gautam Nayak
reviews.text: Nice place to spend a few hours in heart of Old Corfu Town - usually quite crowded. Plenty of restaurants around with seating on the pavements. Many shops for clothes, jewellery, souvenirs, etc

reviews.author: Beatrice Pitea
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of visiting Spianada Square in Corfu, and it was an amazing experience. Located right in the heart of the city, next to the fortress, it offers a perfect blend of history and lively atmosphere. There’s also a large parking lot nearby, which is very convenient for visitors. The narrow, pedestrian streets filled with historical charm give you a unique and pleasant feeling as you explore. The area is bustling with shops and tavernas, and the atmosphere is vibrant both during the day and in the evening. It’s a must-visit spot in Corfu for anyone who loves history, culture, and a lively setting.

reviews.author: Joseph Andrews
reviews.text: Spectacular view of Greece from the top of the stairs. Nice place to grab coffee and a snack and then move on to the old fort. It’s got a patio decor, beautiful sunshine slight breeze almost all the time.

reviews.author: Chris Tilson
reviews.text: Went here in the afternoon and was half full, alot of people coming and going in boats which was joyful to see. Especially when you see 3 or 4 nice sized ones. The food was really nice, not sure if it was worth the cost as its an expensive place to eat given other places near by with just as nice a view. If going for a date night or somewhere you want that little extra from your night its worth a visit, they also do water taxis from local areas, that's a nice touch. The service was a little slow and forgot things which they apologised for. Overall a nice experience but having done it once I cant see us going back.

reviews.author: Zita LEITNER
reviews.text: We were recommended Taverna Agni by the lovely team at Spiro’s Boat Hire and arrived by boat. The staff at the taverna kindly helped us dock and immediately offered sunbeds to relax on until the restaurant opened – a thoughtful touch that set the tone for the whole experience. Although we didn’t have a reservation and couldn’t sit right at the beachfront, the service, food, and atmosphere more than made up for it. Everything – from the drinks to the dishes and the attentive staff – was impeccable. The prices are on the higher end, but they absolutely match the quality. We highly recommend booking in advance for a front-row seat to the sea, and without a doubt, this place is worth the visit!

reviews.author: Georgina Hibbert
reviews.text: The restaurant was quite empty when we went and had it been busier the atmosphere may have been nicer. As it was, the staff were so attentive it almost felt like they were hovering around us. They were friendly but over attentive. The two meat dishes were too well done for out liking.

reviews.author: Cezar Hotnogu
reviews.text: I had an exceptional culinary experience at Taverna Agni! Without a doubt, I ate the best fish I’ve ever had – fresh, tender, and perfectly cooked. The food is traditional, authentic Greek cuisine, full of flavor and prepared with care.

reviews.author: Susan Webb
reviews.text: Our party of 5 arrived by boat to this beautiful bay and decided to have lunch here. Great vegetarian options, such as the Briam, grilled vegetables, giant Greek beans, etc, all very delicious. An enjoyable occasion with top-notch food at a sublime location. There is also someone to help with mooring the boat, which is moored just out the front, so you can keep an eye on it.

reviews.author: Andreea Tau
reviews.text: An excellent gyros at an excellent price — just €5 for a portion full of delicious, high-quality ingredients 🥙👏. It’s a true family-run business, and you can tell they put a lot of heart and effort into everything they do. I really appreciated that even the potatoes are peeled and cut by hand — no frozen shortcuts here! 🥔✨ The Corfu map tablecloths were also a nice touch — charming and unique 🗺️. Wishing you continued success! 🍀❤️

reviews.author: Bilge Yıldırım
reviews.text: Definitely must-go place. The food, the place, the atmosphere, the staff… such an amazing. Prices are fine and the food is just DELICIOUS. If you go there around 6pm you can find a table but later is impossible. Always crowded and totally understandable! :)

reviews.author: Anne
reviews.text: Best gyros so far! Everything was fresh and hot. The lady behind the counter was rushed off her feet, so don't expect smiles or service (she was a little abrupt to be honest). The male waiter who attended to us was nicer and we were just happy with the gyros that we were happy to overlook everything else!

reviews.author: Rose Hart
reviews.text: Seems like a locals place. We went on an evening boat trip to Kerkyra and we saw our captain here getting his own dinner. He said it was the best in Corfu town. - amazing food, great price, fast service. If you want some authentic Greek food go here!

reviews.author: Julia Rakowska
reviews.text: We waited for a while but got seated very fast. Amazing prices for the amount of food and drinka. My boyfriend had the steak and he loved it! Go here!

reviews.author: Shane Egan
reviews.text: Had a really nice lunch here. I recommend the Soutzoukakia. The chips/french fries seem to be homemade and are great!

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: Very nice... had sea bass.. Make sure to come at lunch as they close at 6pm

reviews.author: Rich B
reviews.text: Our favourite place to eat in Corfu Town. Visited twice on our last trip and it will be on our list of "must dos" on our next visit. Fresh fish, good portions and freshly cooked. Excellent staff and mainly locals eating there. Always a good indicator. Many people just popped in to collect their lunch as takeaways. Love this place and always try to find restaurants like this on all the islands we visit.

reviews.author: Дамир Бикмухаметов
reviews.text: This is a nice diner with an assortment of freshly cooked traditional dishes. To my taste the food was heavenly delicious. The service was friendly and helpful. Nice ambience and not the least, air conditioned room.

reviews.author: Guy Hamilton
reviews.text: Great food when we visited to this restaurant. Highly recommended

reviews.author: michal ramon
reviews.text: The tavern is in the middle of the village. No parking- you have to look for a spot in the narrow roads.the food is very simple- salami, carpacio, fetta cheese and salad. A lot of meat and french fries. For dessert fresh fruits and local yougurt with honey. The was live music and 3 nice dancers. The menu is fixed- 45 per person

reviews.author: Lorelei Petcu
reviews.text: A really great way to spend a traditional evening!! The set menu (45€) includes so much food, all local with a real homemade feel. The music and dancers are great entertainment and everyone was so nice and accommodating.

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.text: Fun local eatery on Corfu with a little Greek background music and dancing entertainment. We visited as part of a small group tour. The food was probably the most authentic local food we've experienced so far.

reviews.author: Patrick Kleman
reviews.text: Great place. Food was amaizing. Entertainment was enjoyable. The tavern itself is beautiful.

reviews.author: Madalina stratulat
reviews.text: Great food (too much even), traditional appetizers, simple but very tasty,pork, veal and lamb- so, so good!!! The service was excellent, singers and dancers were so much fun! Do not eat before you go! Village is small and picturesque, it’s worth to walk through the small streets

reviews.author: gzmbsl
reviews.text: We’ve been coming to The Venetian Well every year — it’s always been one of our favorite spots in Corfu for the atmosphere, the beautiful square, and what used to be an elegant, gourmet dining experience. Sadly, this time was very different. We made our reservation a week in advance and were asked to prepay €80, which we found unusual, but we trusted the experience would be worth it. Unfortunately, it wasn’t. The staff were very kind, but the service was extremely slow. There was a fixed Easter menu, and no one asked about our dietary preferences. Out of five courses, two included mageiritsa (Greek Easter soup made from lamb intestines) — something neither of us can eat or enjoy. In the end, it was our dog who helped finish the plate. We paid €85 per person for a set menu where we genuinely disliked almost half the dishes. To top it off, the card machine wasn’t working, and we had to pay in cash, which caused further delay. It breaks my heart to say this, but something has changed here. What used to be a refined, special dining spot now feels like a forced set-menu place with none of the finesse we loved. After many visits over the years, this was, unfortunately, our last.

reviews.author: South Arl
reviews.text: This is the best restaurant on Corfu. Delicious food (anything seafood is a win) from a local celebrity chef, extremely professional service, beautiful setting overlooking a charming plaza with a centuries old Venetian well. This is a must for a unique romantic meal in Corfu town.

reviews.author: Efthymia Drakou
reviews.text: The best gastronomical experience ever. Huge thanks to Panagiotis for his recommendation skills and his ambience. Thank you so much Panagiotis.

reviews.author: Vlad Mtar
reviews.text: Beautiful location, amazing service and food. Dishes are delicious. Very big wine menu.

reviews.author: Martyna Kopel
reviews.text: My husband and I had the absolute pleasure of celebrating our anniversary at this beautiful Greek restaurant, and it truly exceeded all our expectations. The food was nothing short of exceptional – fresh, full of flavor, and perfectly seasoned. Every dish was a masterpiece, transporting us straight to the heart of Greece with its rich aromas and authentic taste. The service was outstanding – warm, welcoming, and incredibly attentive without being intrusive. It’s rare to experience such genuine hospitality these days, and it made the evening even more special. The interior of the restaurant is simply stunning – elegant yet cozy, with careful attention to every detail. Soft lighting, tasteful decor, and gentle Greek music created the perfect romantic atmosphere. This place truly has soul. It's ideal for special occasions or simply for anyone wanting to escape into a little Mediterranean paradise for the evening. We’ll absolutely be back – highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sameer Barakat
reviews.text: From the setting to the food this place was outstanding. Nice open evening vibe. Farm to plate concept came through immediately - starters were the best we’ve had at ANY restaurant, unmatched flavours that kept us reordering again and again. Mains were lovely, but somewhat paled in comparison to the starters, though the pork gyros was incredible: jumpy, juicy flavours with the charcoal and sage smoke. Great service and would 100% recommend a specific trip here if you’re in Crete. Parking can be a bit tough so come by bus if possible, or park in a nearby car park (some independent ones shut at 10/11pm though so take care, otherwise your car will get locked inside overnight)

reviews.author: Thijs Devooght
reviews.text: This restaurant is truly next level. It’s not just about the delicious food or the outstanding service. It’s about the full experience. From the moment you walk in, you’re immersed in a world of taste and aroma. Every dish is thoughtfully crafted, not only to satisfy your hunger but to delight your senses. The flavors are bold, the presentation is artistic, and the atmosphere completes the magic. If you’re looking for more than just a meal, this place delivers an unforgettable culinary journey.

reviews.author: vera zheung
reviews.text: This restaurant is without a doubt one of the most unique Greek dining experiences I’ve had. The atmosphere and dishes stood out with creative twists on traditional flavors, all made from fresh local ingredients. It’s a memorable place that truly highlights the artistry of Greek cuisine.

reviews.author: Mihaela Dimitrova
reviews.text: Firstly we wanted to walk in spontaneously but it was booked for a couple of nights upfront. It turned out there was a table for our last night on Crete we could not have spent it better! A very atmospheric culinary experience! The lights, smells, decorations of the interior and exterior are a beautiful setting for the delicious food. Everything is made with so much thought and love.

reviews.author: Charlotte Watkin
reviews.text: Beautiful food, great atmosphere. The service is a little slow but that is common in Greece. We were given a starter and dessert for free for our whole tenable of 5. The food portions were very good value for the money, and everyone really loved all the food. The flavours and aromas were delicious.

reviews.author: Andy Fitzjohn
reviews.text: Very nice experience. Food was excellent, Highly recommend. We had stuffed vine leaves, homemade pies, aubergine dip and Dakos as starters they were all excellent with all offering something different. Portions are generous so we then had just two mains and that was enough for four people. They bring you a free desert and alcohol shots.

reviews.author: A
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience dining at Tamam during our trip. The service was outstanding — friendly, attentive, and welcoming from start to finish. The food was absolutely incredible, with fresh ingredients, authentic flavors, and beautifully prepared dishes that truly showcased the best of Greek cuisine. The atmosphere was warm, relaxed, and lively, making it a perfect spot whether you’re out for a casual meal or something special. One of the highlights was how dog-friendly the restaurant was — they welcomed our furry friend with open arms, which made the experience even more enjoyable. Overall, everything from the setting to the service to the food exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

reviews.author: Nathan Collins
reviews.text: Had a lovely lunch with my family we all tried lovely and different food options ranging from squids, goat and calamari and all food options were excellent. Washed down with nice beers and a delicious house white I totally recommend lunch here. The restaurant is located just behind the touristy port location surrounded by cool art and craft shops that are worth a view in their own right. A lovely setting to eat in the street and watch the world go by.

reviews.author: Lydia Hazel
reviews.text: One of the best restaurants I’ve been to. We got the roasted vegetables and a meat pie and combining the pie with the cheese sauce and the veggies was one of my favorite food experiences I’ve had. Every bite was delicious. The staff were wonderful and half of the restaurant is in a building that was a Turkish bath hundreds of years ago. This is exactly the kind of experience I want when I travel. Prices were good too, we spent about €50 for a bottle of wine, vegetable dish, and the meat pie, which was plenty of food for us both. They brought us raki and baklava complimentary at the end of the meal as well.

reviews.author: Darlene
reviews.text: Make a reservation! A table outside is much cozier than inside, especially when it's hot. Tamam is always busy so we reserved ahead and it was lovely. Must-go if you want to taste some authentic Cretan food. We were glad we went here on our first day of vacation because it was a great introduction. It's a bit of a noisy location since there are people queuing outside and lots of tables inside

reviews.author: Vass Dean
reviews.text: Food was amazing fresh fish on our choice urchin salad and seasonal greens. The staff all of them very polite and engaged with all the customers. They all seemed they love their job and their customers. Loo review 8/10. Would hit 9 if there more than one cubical. Treat at the end raki drink brownie with central yogurt with cherries and watermelon. Very generous appreciations for their customers.

reviews.author: Yannick Gnann
reviews.text: Very Nice place for seafood. We Had the seafood platter for two, which was amazing. The Service was good. Good size of the meals and directly at the sea. Prices are very good. Housewine 1 litre for 12 Euro!

reviews.author: Hien Nguyen
reviews.text: This place is a gem . The eggplant is so good, you can cry . The seafood was fresh as well. We came back twice! Ordered so much, we took the leftovers and fed the cats

reviews.author: Yannah
reviews.text: Visiting the restaurant for the second time, the previous one was 4 years ago. Back then we were really happy with the atmosphere and the food that's why we came back. Well, something has changed, we didn't feel welcomed and treated the same way, the food was also too average, not bad, but also not great. The location is still very beautiful, I recommend visiting for the sunset, it's amazing.

reviews.author: JIHYE Kim
reviews.text: I was the beautiful sunset with delicious food I ordered fried squid, fisherman pasta, mussels, and salad.. Every dish was amazing... I highly recommend this restaurant!

name: Street Stall - Venetian Harbor
address: Street Stall - Venetian Harbor, Crete (Chania), Greece

reviews.author: Marvin Chung
reviews.text: Nice walk along the harbour towards the lighthouse where you have a very nice view of the old town harbour on one side and the sea on the other side.

reviews.author: Honest Travel Reviews
reviews.text: Such a lovely place to walk and take in the view of both the harbour and the ocean. Please note the the breakwater is currently closed. If your looking at walking to the lighthouse you can’t Cheers M

reviews.author: Brandon Zoras
reviews.text: Cool structure. Stairs are uneven and lots of people in the way in the narrow opening to get up. Not much shade in the area so pack water if you are going to the light house as it was really hot.

reviews.author: dawn jarvis
reviews.text: Great place to visit to watch sun go down. Lots of bars & restaurants

reviews.author: Dawn Abbey
reviews.text: Pretty harbour. Lovely views of the ocean and of the harbour. Could t get in the lighthouse though.
