reviews.author: Darlene
reviews.text: This place was a bit disappointing since the reviews looked great but the food was very mid. The starters were quite basic, and before we knew it our main dishes were served. We barely got time and could not even ask for them to wait. Our tiny table was full. Both of our main dishes tasted bland, the swordfish was tough and the sides tasted old and quickly thrown on a plate. My pasta was just okay.

reviews.author: Denise Corsi
reviews.text: An amazing experience. We were craving some seafood for dinner and they definitely delivered it. Nothing to say except from WOW! Waitresses also very nice and polite, also found one of them that spoke Italian to me, to let me understand better the fish available that evening. We also received a complimentary strawberry sorbet. Prices are more than fair for the portion and quality

reviews.author: Suhaya Bhandary
reviews.text: An unassuming place, if you don’t want the frills and just good food. I ate the grilled Sea Bream and loved it. It was a nice light meal served with some grilled veggies on the side. Perfect for a warm summer afternoon with a site of chilled Charma. Did I mention that they give you a lovely strawberry sorbet on the house?

reviews.author: Sarah Wang
reviews.text: Shrimp pasta very tasty!! They were very busy, we were put upstairs and it was quite hot up there. Ingredients were very fresh! Even got a free strawberry sorbet at the end which was the highlight.

reviews.author: E L
reviews.text: An unassuming restaurant on a plain street away from the tourist traps. Exceptional food, friendly service and fair prices. We had the FISH FILLET (with spinach, raisins & pine nuts) & FRESH TUNA WITH VEGETABLES (in orange-honey sauce) and both were exceptional. An as everyone says the complimentary strawberry sorbet is divine. We’ll be back…

reviews.author: Derek Tsai
reviews.text: It was a busy Sunday night and this restaurant was recommended to us. I thought it’ll take a while to get our food, however it came quickly. We had Greek salad, mussels, fish and squid. All were nice, however the mussels were my favourite. We also got free dessert and some ouzo which was very generous. Staff were very nice too.

reviews.author: Halima Averill
reviews.text: We had an incredible meal at Ippokampos in Crete. The seafood linguine, fish linguine, fish with potato salad, and octopus were all absolutely delicious. Every dish was packed with flavor and cooked perfectly. To top it off, we were treated to a free dessert, which was such a lovely touch. The staff were warm, welcoming, and made the whole experience even more special. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ratul Das
reviews.text: The view itself makes the restaurant worth it, put that together with true immaculately prepared food, whether it’s the cold Cretan salad and the ceviche or the hot dishes, they will mention that none of the seafood is fresh except the mussels, however believe me they don’t taste of something frozen, we had the fried squid and the grilled octopus, the grilled sea bream with the lemon butter sauce was delicious. Save some space though, they will bring you free dessert and raki to top the meal of, you will leave the restaurant with a full stomach and heart and a tipsy head 🙂‍↔️

reviews.author: Mel Hill
reviews.text: Sea bass, fried anchovies, greek salad & stuffed vine leaves. Best meal we've had since we arrived. Beautiful view of the harbour too. Highly recommended, especially as they are right next to the fresh fish market, so the fish is lovely & fresh. Lots of outside seating, good access, stairs to get inside though. Unsure if they have a disabled ramp.

reviews.author: Selina Zhang
reviews.text: Nice seafood spot with variety of places to sit. Inside, inside/outside terrace, and fully outside. The service was pretty good, the food was okay. Dakos and fried calamari was great but was let down by the seafood moussaka that we were recommended. Lacked flavour and was put off by it not being heated up enough, was just slightly warm inside.

name: Street Stall - Lion Square
address: Street Stall - Lion Square, Crete (Heraklion), Greece

reviews.author: Raven Sunkiller
reviews.text: Avli was hands down our favorite restaurant on our 3 week trip across Greece for ambiance. It’s a stunning and unique restaurant experience. We sat in the open courtyard full of fruit trees and plants - so beautiful and relaxing, it’s a perfect place to spend time with friends and good food. We walked through the inside seating and the interior is beautiful as well. The service was impeccable, drinks were delicious, and the salad & entrees are high quality.

reviews.author: Philipp Estreich
reviews.text: We chose this restaurant because it was highly recommended in our guidebook. The recommendation turned out to be very accurate, as our visit was a thoroughly positive experience. We arrived without a reservation and were fortunate to be seated immediately, which was a pleasant surprise. The restaurant is located in a charming courtyard. The decor is inspired by a hippie and garden theme, which is perfect for a laid-back evening. The food was delicious, and the portion sizes were well-sized, making the price reasonable. The presentation of the dishes was also appealing and added to the overall dining experience. (Look at the photos) The waitstaff were friendly and made us feel welcome.

reviews.author: Brian Hubbard
reviews.text: The location, the courtyard, the food and service were all wonderful. Our first table was partly in full sun but as soon as a shady table became free the waitress kindly and efficiently moved us. I enjoyed the most amazing slab of melt-in-the-mouth lamb perfectly cooked and presented. My wife had a beautiful salad which was also very good We’d eaten here 5 years previously and were nervous about going back in case the excellent experience last time proved unrepeatable. No worries there! We were not disappointed

reviews.author: Estelle H.
reviews.text: We had lunch on the very cute courtyard. The service is good and the food as well! We recommend the fresh fish fillet and the lamb : the meat cooking is PERFECT!

reviews.author: Poul Foged Nielsen
reviews.text: Be aware that Avli seems to be multiple things; the courtyard and outside. We got a fantastic table in the courtyard and ordered a grilled fish (Grouper?) and the rooster. Arrangement of the food was top notch, the fish was served in a soup with with local vegetables which wasn't my favourite. The rooster was nice but contained a little cartilage. I'm sure I'll come back again and find something that is more to my taste.

reviews.author: Milla Jimenez
reviews.text: A beautiful restaurant with amazing food! We booked this for a birthday meal, and it was absolutely perfect. The view, atmosphere, service, and quality of the food all came together to make it a truly memorable experience. If I’m ever in the area again, I would absolutely come back.

reviews.author: T CH
reviews.text: Delicious fresh seafood in a picture-perfect setting! We ordered the fresh-caught grouper and were not disappointed! Loved the added touch of a complimentary dessert and Raki! There was an added charge of 4EURO for a water we didn’t order…but luckily we caught it, and our waiter easily removed it before paying the final bill.

reviews.author: Anne Gryllakis Roberts
reviews.text: Prima Plora is a stand out establishment. Visited recently with a large group and was impressed by their creativity and care they put into their foods. The Rainbow Roll, Dragon Roll and Eel Roll were superb. Skip the usual Greek fare and try their signature dishes. The wines list was excellent as were the desserts. Located in a beautiful setting on the ocean. I highly recommend Prima Plora in Rethymno.

reviews.author: George N
reviews.text: Do NOT miss this place. It may seem a little out of the way but it’s SO worth it. All dishes were excellent. The space and setting are sublime and the service is super friendly and attentive.

reviews.author: Aimee Marysia
reviews.text: Food and service was AMAZING. The sushi was unreal, and the freshly caught fish was so flakey and delicious. The recommendation of wine for the table by the server was 100% on point and the aray of desserts were classical desserts with a twist. Would 100% come back.

reviews.author: Alison Parish
reviews.text: We heard really good things about the restaurant and we were excited to try, but ended up pretty disappointed. We ordered « a puff pastry » with feta cheese, lemon, rose, and fig. However, it was three different pastries with fig, rose jam, and lemon jam. It wasn’t quite our taste. For main dishes, we ordered the lamb/pork burger and rigatoni with pesto and pork tenderloin. The burger was delicious, but the accompanied fries were a bit hard to eat. The pesto dish was quite oily and not as flavorful. We didn’t finish the dish. We were given complementary cake and raki which was nice and tasted great though. The servers were friendly and everything was given within a good time. Unfortunately, we didn’t enjoy the rest of the food much.

reviews.author: Vojtěch Brožek
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely fantastic – traditional cuisine prepared with great care and attention to detail. The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming, making us feel right at home from the moment we walked in. The atmosphere and setting of the restaurant were simply magical – cozy, charming, and full of character. I recommend this place to anyone looking for an authentic and memorable dining experience!

reviews.author: Valérian Francart
reviews.text: For the first time in my life, I’ve felt emotions during my diner. Everything was PERFECT, including the service. Made with local products, the food makes me understand the worldwide reputation of the island.

reviews.author: James Findlay
reviews.text: The absolute BEST meals we had on the island. The lamb was an absolute standout. The squid was also great. The house white was also a winner, and you can't leave without some of the ouzo! Fabulous service from the woman with the dreadlocks too! Sorry we forgot your name!! Would ABSOLUTELY go here again.

reviews.author: Sogi B
reviews.text: Everything was very good. We liked our food (sfakiani and grilled calamari). Also, we tried green salad which was very delicious. Staff were really friendly. Totally recommend this place.

reviews.author: Paweł Pr
reviews.text: Nice and historical place, with a great view of the sea and town. You can spend around one hour there walking along the old walls and admiring picturesque views. The cost of the entrance is 5 euros per person. Unfortunately, ruins seem to be not well maintained and preserved, so you have to be careful during the sightseeing.

reviews.author: Eric Christopher
reviews.text: A beautiful spot with stunning sea and town views. Explore rich historical ruins for just €5 entry. While not a curated site, it's a great way to spend an hour. The top offers the best views of the old town and marinas. Parking can be tricky, even during off-season. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.author: Manfred Pretz
reviews.text: The fortress is absolutely amazing and the view from the walls is great. Tickets are 5 €. There is a small kiosk with really decent prices (50 ct for water) and a tasty iced coffee (2,20 €). The explanation boards are completely weathered, though and it is impossible to learn anything about the history of this place. I used Wikipedia instead.

reviews.author: Itay Hofri
reviews.text: Very cool experience, it’s very large and not a lot of places where closed off, like you would find in some other touristic ruins. The fort is pretty high up and has some very interesting buildings on it, but it is very accessible. The cost for the average person is 5 euros which is pretty great.

reviews.author: R T
reviews.text: Wish we had gone a little bit earlier in the day. But we managed to finish the ground tour. Beautifully preserved. Would have liked to know what the different bunkers were for, as we left guessing. The lady at the gates was also fluent in English. I sadly dropped my leaflet in the toilets as we were leaving the grounds, maybe there was more information there?

name: Street Stall - Old Town
address: Street Stall - Old Town, Crete (Rethymno), Greece

reviews.author: Sarah Lazzari
reviews.text: Rhodes is such a beautiful city. Would definitely recommend visiting!

reviews.author: Isac Dos Santos Junior
reviews.text: One place everyone should have a chance to visit. Beautiful, iconic, historical.

reviews.author: terike
reviews.text: The Old Town and tip of the peninsula is where all the amazing sites and history are, incredible place.

reviews.author: taylan acar
reviews.text: The trees and cafes are amazing. Historical sites are great. The beaches are top notch. Find a ticket if Possible and visit.

reviews.author: Greg D
reviews.text: A magical and varied island, full of deep historical architecture and rich welcoming culture. The food and wine was excellent, whether we ate simple local food or went high end. I had very little idea how liveable it would feel, as the old town has everything one could need to be comfortable. A slower simpler pace of living is possible here, and we were lucky to have stayed with a wonderful warm family that shared home cooked delights with us. We also found it easy to travel around and go to other islands. The weather is perfect for me as it’s hot yet breezy so I would recommend it to those who also enjoy that kind of feel.

reviews.author: MJ Bold
reviews.text: We visited Old town bazaar clothes shop yesterday, a truly amazing shopping experience; not only did they pay for myself and my families free taxi transport to and from our hotel. The customer service was second to none. The shop has everything you would ever want, the best clothes, footwear, designer bags, and loads more. An enormous range of the latest styles and fashions, at reasonable prices. We were made to feel really welcome by all the staff, and even given free refreshing cooling drinks. Had our every need met, by Mehmet and his excellent very friendly, polite and professional team. There were so many highlights, during our shopping trip, the adorable cats, and the astonishing clothes choices. One of the best things is after we brought lots of clothes, we were able to leave them in the trusted hands of the shop and go off sightseeing, returning later, where the taxi driver Ali who was amazing, one of the most helpful and kind person we've ever met. Delivery them and us back to our hotel. Great value for money, we would definitely comeback again. The old town shop location itself is breathtaking and a stone throw away from the famous historical Roman Hadrian's Gate and the stunning marina.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: Was recommended by family, and boy they did not disappoint, went above and beyond, fantastic people, fantastic products, fantastic quality, can't recommend enough, buy with confidence

reviews.author: Adegoke Enirayetan
reviews.text: Oscar is a nice guy, he showed me good deals that makes sense. I will definitely come back with my friends for more amazing deals

reviews.author: Tracey CHAPPELL
reviews.text: Picked up by driver and taken to old bazaar. Beautiful shopping experience, staff very helpful and quality of goods superb... They even gave free transfer back to hotel after I'd had a look around other stores. great day

reviews.author: Brad Ingber
reviews.text: The service was absolutely amazing friendly, helpful, I was greated with a beverage of my choice! I was picked up from my hotel and drop back off, free of charge. The clothes were top quality. I was really impressed with how affordable everything was for such great material and style. It’s not often you find that perfect mix of price and quality. Thank you!

reviews.author: Julie Rideout
reviews.text: A superb taverna in a beautiful setting. The food, service and location are all beyond expectation. Thank you Maria and team. A seafood restaurant run by the third generation of wonderful women. We were initially a party of 4 then later joined by another 4. Nothing was too much, we were welcomed by the owner and embraced as friends. We had calamari, octopus and bread and dips, all were excellent. Avoid all the large flashy places and look for the blue balcony and tables and chairs.

reviews.author: Maaike Migchelbrink
reviews.text: We had an amazing meals. It is the only place we found that wasn’t touristy and didn’t have people outside trying to pull you in. The fish dishes were excellent, and the staff was incredibly kind and welcoming. It’s a good idea to make a reservation, although they’ll do their best to find you a spot even without one.

reviews.author: Davide F
reviews.text: We had an amazing night at this taverna: the food and wine were excellent, the staff were friendly and always smiling, the owner was a lovely lady, and the atmosphere was authentically Greek! We had fresh fish and some meze — everything was perfect. The only downside was that everyone else seemed to receive a complimentary taste of ouzo and a sweet, but we didn't. Considering the relatively high (but absolutely fair) bill, we ended up not leaving the generous tip we had planned — just bad luck. Still, highly recommended — one of the best places in town!

reviews.author: Zoe Lenagh-Glue
reviews.text: We had an amazing meal at Knossos - from the minute we walked in, we were greeted by Maria like we were family, and then to our surprise we were shown to the balcony upstairs where we had the best view in the house and a private dining experience! The food was wonderful - a special mention to the taramasalata - Maria’s family recipe. All in all, amazing food, the best service and the loveliest host.

reviews.author: Jamie Clark
reviews.text: Perfect food, service and spot! Do yourself a favor and try it if you can. Everything was fresh, served with a warm smile and with a beautiful backdrop. Will def be back

reviews.author: Spiros Gounaris
reviews.text: Excellent atmosphere and service. Magnificent tastes. BUT! NO dish is worth waiting for two hours. This is how long it took for the mains to arrive. Huge problem in the kitchen operations. Hence the four stars. If you are patient give it a try.

reviews.author: Dafna Spruijt-Peled
reviews.text: The food was delicious. Came once for lunch and dinner, both very good, servings are big enough. Dessert very good too. Homemade limonade sooo good. Service Excellent, across is old building, at night there are lights

reviews.author: Donna McRoberts
reviews.text: We have just returned from a wonderful evening at Platanos! A gorgeous spot for dinner. The food and service were wonderful! The wine delicious! And the ambience and music superb! A beautiful summers evening that we will cherish. Thank you 💙

reviews.author: Kirk Tree
reviews.text: I’m a strong believer in leaving 5 star reviews for restaurants providing the majority of boxes are ticked, then every now and then we stumble upon something exceptional like Platanus and it makes me wonder why google don’t offer the ability to give some additional kind of rewards for the exceptional. Firstly the location is just amazing, the restaurant is situated directly opposite the historical Plane tree of Hippocrates (featured in the book remarkable trees of the world) so for a tree lover the location alone definitely ticks the box. I can’t be certain on this but I also believe that there is some kind of live music played each night, trust me when I say if you are seeking the ideal romantic restaurant you really must visit Platanus as the setting and the music combined is delightful. If truthful no matter the food served up at this point the 5 stars have already been given, then we have the most wonderful pleasant waiter and the food that arrives is some of the best I have been fortunate enough to experience. The starter of veal souvlaki and Greek salad was followed by beef skirt and veal cheek cooked for 36 hours. OMG !!!! Fine dining at its best, it’s clear the chef knows how to impress, we followed with pistachio crème brûlée and a pavlova which also did not disappoint in any way. To finish the evening off we both had flambéed coffee, had Irish coffees and liqueur coffees but these are something a little different and special. Truly one of the greatest food experiences I have ever had and I really cannot fault in any way whatsoever, do not miss out on the experience.

reviews.author: Barry Westby
reviews.text: A beautiful place to eat. The service was excellent, efficient, polite, but not stuffy. The menu was different to anything we had seen elsewhere in the town. We ordered two starters to share, and they were delicious, particularly the gyoza. We tried the Lamb and Beef cheek mains and they were so tasty, the meat cooked to perfection. The house wine was good, as was the coffee afterwards.

reviews.author: lucas child
reviews.text: Completely worth the hype, and it was without a doubt the best restaurant on the Island of Milo’s. The service was very good too. We couldn’t stop bugging the two servers who were brothers, and we were chatting up a storm with them, and we were enjoying their company so much. The owner was so cool, and the staff was all so nice and congratulatory towards my wife who is pregnant. Such a positive food and people experience!

reviews.author: Haleemah Alaydi
reviews.text: Medusa may get a lot of hype, but unfortunately, the experience didn’t live up to any of it. We waited over an hour for a table, initially requesting to sit by the water. While we were flexible and eventually offered to take any available table, we watched as the owner continuously seated other guests ahead of us, including a group of two that took a large table after claiming more people were coming (they showed up an hour later). When we politely asked again about being seated, the owner responded with hostility, raising his voice and creating an unwelcoming atmosphere. This brash and arrogant attitude completely soured the experience. As for the food: while some dishes were decent, nothing justified the high prices or the hype. The portions were too small. The octopus was slightly burned on the bottom and lacked flavor. The swordfish souvlaki, priced at a ridiculous €17.50, was a tiny portion served without bread with a spoon of rice; just a skewer on a plate. For Milos, that price is far from reasonable. The place might look picturesque, but the chaotic management, blatant favoritism and lack of respect for guests ruin the experience. There are many better options on the island that serve great food without the attitude or the wait.

reviews.author: Sean Henderson
reviews.text: The shrimp and the calamari are delicious they have a nice smoky fire flavour and minimalistic preparation. The zucchini fritters are the best I have had. Top that off with a tasty Greek salad and you're sorted. The view is nice and you can take a dip in the water after you put your name down for a table.

reviews.author: lali vachiberadze
reviews.text: The best restaurant in all of Milos! We had to wait in line for 30 minutes to get in, but it was absolutely worth it! The atmosphere is amazing you’ll be mesmerized by the views even before you step inside, and they only get better from the restaurant itself. The view is breathtaking, the staff is incredibly sweet and professional, and every dish is outstanding. Especially the octopus — I highly recommend trying it, you won’t regret it!

reviews.author: Claude Hemphill
reviews.text: This place is popular for a reason. Great fish and just a really cool vibe. When we walked up, there was a bit of a line, but the host was just so friendly that he made the wait and finding a table part of the pleasant experience. The food is just top notch classic seafood. We had the calamari and the swordfish souvlaki along with a couple of Aperol spritzes. just perfect.

reviews.author: Jaileez Campos
reviews.text: One of my favorite restaurants in Mykonos, especially if you are looking for something more fusion/contemporary Mediterranean cuisine and amazing cocktails! The service is just as great as the food. If you are a seafood lover, I highly recommend getting the calamari spaghetti and octopus carpaccio! Please take a look at the pictures—can we please give them an applause for the amazing presentation!?

reviews.author: Jeffrey Fox
reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff. We had a reservation for 7pm and the place was empty. Drinks were great and food was overall great. This is not a place that locals eat, we asked hotel staff and cab drivers and none had heard about this place. The salad was the only food option that was not good, tasted like it wasn’t fresh.

reviews.author: Peter Corfitsen
reviews.text: Definitely worth a visit. Genuine Greek dishes with a twist (upwards…..). Lovely presentation of the food (the photos don’t quite give justice) and a great engaged crew of waiters. Funky Kitchen is off the beaten track of Mykonos Town and that provides a nice, cozy and quiet atmosphere- in this otherwise very bustling place. Thanks to our waiter for attentive service always accompanied by a story or two from Greece or Mykonos.

reviews.author: Trish Miller
reviews.text: This place is amazing!!!! Great and funny waitstaff. The presentation is beautiful. We had the lamb chops, chicken, and rib eye. All were delicious, but the sous vide chicken stole the show, probably the best chicken I have ever had! Also their house red wine was yummy. Great ambiance and off the main street. Definitely GO!!!!

reviews.author: Frank Haralson
reviews.text: Just finished eating in little Venice in Mykonos at the Funky Kitchen. It just so happens that my guide for the tour I had today is co-owner (with her husband) of a little restaurant in little Venice on Mykonos. I was lucky enough to find it and was rewarded by a meal that is unrivaled in recent memory. Every course has been thoroughly thought through and is more delicious than it looks. Why this isn’t a Michelin starred restaurant is beyond me. Probably simply because it hasn’t been discovered yet! The bread is homemade. The appetizer was a calamari that is cut and prepared fettuccine style with a sweet chorizo that is a perfect combination for the dish. The main course was beef cheeks cooked for 14 hrs. (So tender that you could eat it with a spoon) with wild picked greens and potatoes. The dessert was a Mexican key lime tart with chocolate earth (a light crunchy brown crust) on top and bottom! I’m stuffed and sublimely happy! I can’t wait to come back! 😜😍

reviews.author: Hajer Badri
reviews.text: This taverna is amazing, the staff are very friendly!! The food was amazing, and super fresh. But you should take into consideration that the waiting time is more than an hour and you can’t make any reservations! In the waiting time you can go swim in their private cove which is a very nice beach. You also have free drinks because of the waiting time. Try their chocolate cake!!

reviews.author: Tracey O'Shea
reviews.text: Don't miss out on this. So good! We arrived early and the restaurant was full,we got the last table so no long wait for us, but if you do have to wait you will a view and Rose in hand. The staff werw so nice and welcoming and the food was worth the hype. We had fish and pork and baked potatoes, and the salads are so fresh and amazing.

reviews.author: Dorothy C
reviews.text: Kiki’s is worth the hype! We went twice during our week long trip to Mykonos! It is located right by the beach which is amazing. You can also sea the sea from certain seating areas! Amazing food and very friendly service. While waiting for a table, they offer you free wine. They also have a salad bar that is amazing and worth trying! You can pick two salads with each salad order and the sweet lady will tell you what’s in each salad. Definitely recommend coming here!

reviews.author: Jonny
reviews.text: Hidden gem away from the main tourist hustle and bustle. The “authentic” Greece. Service and welcome were great. Got seated straight away. Only a small place so I can imagine in peak season it gets very busy but we were here in low season. And a secluded beach further down for after dinner swims.

reviews.author: GR
reviews.text: Kiki Tavern is an amazing spot and an absolute must-visit! It’s not crowded, and the view along with the beach is simply stunning. The standout dish is definitely the pork chop—highly recommended! The stuffed chicken was a little dry and tough, but I appreciated the creative touch of sun-dried tomatoes inside. The octopus was also quite decent. The salad was surprisingly good too. Don’t miss out on their homemade wine—it’s served in a charming little tin cup, which adds a unique and fun touch to the experience. Overall, we had a wonderfully relaxing and enjoyable time there!

reviews.author: Hajer Badri
reviews.text: This taverna is amazing, the staff are very friendly!! The food was amazing, and super fresh. But you should take into consideration that the waiting time is more than an hour and you can’t make any reservations! In the waiting time you can go swim in their private cove which is a very nice beach. You also have free drinks because of the waiting time. Try their chocolate cake!!

reviews.author: Victoria Olmos
reviews.text: The carbonara was HORRIBLE, i didn’t even finished it, they don’t even use guanciale… i make a better carbonara at home🥲 this didn’t even had taste and not even PEPPER which is literally one of the MAIN ingredientes. U can see by the pictures how bad it looks.

reviews.author: Wilmar Kaiser
reviews.text: The swordfish I ordered was okay, but it didn’t stand out in terms of flavor. It was cooked well, but there wasn’t anything particularly special about it.

reviews.author: Sorina Popa
reviews.text: Good tasty food especially the mussels saganaki. Overpriced gyros. Typical plain greek service but good place for a quick tasty dinner.

reviews.author: JEFFERY COMER
reviews.text: While we were there, we decided to stop here to have lunch. We agree it kindly and sat down in the shaded area outside. They brought us a bottle of cold water, which is fantastic on the hot humid day and then we ate lunch which was quite delicious. It does not have the views at some places that some other places in Mykonos have but they a very nice atmosphere. I would go back at either again if I was ever in the area.

reviews.author: David Greve
reviews.text: We have visited Kostas taverna for 30+ years … the food is simple classic Greek … excellent! The servers are all very prompt and polite…the owners son is now in charge … the most kind, considerate ( not to Mention extremely handsome ) young man who greets all his guests. He truly cares about your visit. We highly recommend, Vicki and David Greve Pittsburgh USA

reviews.author: Sarah Chou
reviews.text: Had a lovely dinner here with my boyfriend and it was the fanciest restaurant we ate at in Mykonos. My boyfriend has Celiac’s and the chef came out to our table to personally let us know his son also has it and they would do their best to avoid any cross contamination. The waitress also pointed out everything on the menu he could have or what could be modified. We enjoyed a delicious meal outside where we were able to people watch and enjoy the nice weather and the wait staff was very kind and timely with the food which I appreciated. Everything was scrumptious and I’d recommend checking this place out for a nice meal. We were able to make a reservation a day before. After the meal they gave us this delicious chocolate hazelnut candy that they make in house and don’t sell but I’d go back for that!!

reviews.author: sophie kan
reviews.text: Nice Resturant with outdoor seating. Service was quick and friendly. Got the focaccia to start, which was warm and fluffy - but was missing the salt and rosemary usually found on focaccia. We ordered the steak which was cooked well, but we found that the smoky flavour overpowered the actual flavour of the steak. The fish fillet however, was very nice, and was accompanied with a lovely sauce.

reviews.author: Antoinette van Heerden
reviews.text: We had a fantastic evening! Great food, great wine and a beautiful setting! What more can one ask for..Thank you very much to Konstantina and her team for making it even more special with their thoughtful service. I would highly recommend M-Eating Restaurant!

reviews.author: Hannah Fleming
reviews.text: Literally the best meal of our trip. So good I wish we could have eaten there twice. The ambiance, service and cadence of the meal was perfection. We started with the focaccia and dips, moved into the braised pear salad (omg), then the small meatballs in potato cream (the best bite I’ve eaten all trip), the scallops (with beautiful presentation and perfect balance) and the carbonara orzo. We finished off with the literal perfection that was the hazelnut chocolate pralines. The house rose was also one of the best I’ve ever had. So grateful for the meal and experience here in Mykonos! If we have time you can be sure we will try to go again! Thank you m-eating!

reviews.author: fady mkawam
reviews.text: One of the best spots for authentic Greek cuisine. Everything was spot on — delicious food and a fantastic atmosphere. Truly a great local experience!

reviews.author: Sumol
reviews.text: This seafood restaurant is located right in Little Venice, accessible only by foot. It's a local favorite, serving up delicious seafood in a European style, like whole grilled or fried fish, shrimp, and octopus. They also have pasta dishes with tomato or cream sauces. Eating here is so much fun because of the lively atmosphere with people walking by – it makes the meal even more enjoyable! Perfect for anyone looking for tasty seafood that's quick and doesn't take too long.

reviews.author: Cory Beal
reviews.text: Unpopular opinion maybe but I was underwhelmed. I had it in my head I would go to Nice n Easy on the coast since it had better reviews. A local artist swore by Niko’s so we decided to try it. Located close to the water shuttle in Little Venice it was centrally located around most of the shopping areas. We were met by mostly grunts and scowls to sit down. As with most European restaurants there is no urgency and you must wave down a waiter. Which is fine, but there were no pleasantries or cultural exchanges. The seating area is all outside on a slanted road with very small tables. It is in a busy walking path among the shops so while busy it wasn’t completely distracting. The noise level was moderate but could easily hold a conversation. The bathrooms were inside next to the kitchen and going could see minimal indoor seating. The sourdough was really good along with the olive oil which I have to believe was fresh. We REALLY wanted grilled octopus so we ordered that and a pasta of grilled octopus, along with a fried cheese. The grilled octopus was great and seasoned well. The pasta was eggshell and less impressive. The red sauce was watery and bland mostly but a great deal of octopus chunks in every bite. At the End of the Day - Nikos was bland and underwhelming and unwelcoming to tourists. It’s fine I’ll only go there once and I got my seafood I wanted. Skip this place despite the locals and try Nice N Easy and tell me if your experience was better than mine!

reviews.author: Pascal Abukhalil
reviews.text: Food is very touristic. Flavors are weird. The artichoke salad had curry and mayo!! I was expecting Mediterranean olive oil… mushroom has Gorgonzola not Roquefort at all. The saganaki cheese has batter !!! Wine totally watered down. Ice cream is supermarket ice cream and had ice in it. However the waiters were very nice. Nice seating area. Nice vibe.

reviews.author: Wilmar Kaiser
reviews.text: The food here was okay, but the flavors weren’t anything particularly special. They accommodated us quickly, which was great. However, one downside was the bread they served, it seemed like an appetizer or complimentary, but we were surprised to find out we were charged extra for it. It would have been better if they clarified that beforehand, as it wasn’t something we had ordered. Overall, the experience was fine, but a bit more transparency would improve it.

reviews.author: Julia Smith-Vidal
reviews.text: This Greek taverna was ok, the service was good, we were seated quickly and had no issues that weren’t sorted quickly. The food was ok but the presentation was lacking a bit and the quality wasn’t exceptional. There is a good selection of things to choose from, it was nice to try the Mykonion pie.

reviews.author: Jules Berkan
reviews.text: Delicious! I saw the reviews for this place and wanted to try it. Super cute place! We were greeted by a very handsome man, who recommended the chicken leg on a spit- so good! We also recommend the Aegean signature cocktail, Greek sausage plate, grilled feta and gluten free pita. Everything we had was great! Thank you, Stefano for the recommendation and excellent service!

reviews.author: stephen mcbride
reviews.text: Dropped in here because we were searching for some halloumi and was very glad we did. Found space for 6 upon walking in and met the nicest staff (they even helped take some elaborate photos for us!). We got a few different cheese order - halloumi and spicy feta amongst them - and they did not disappoint. We saw other food and it looked just as good. They also had a good selection of beer from Mykonos that was definitely worth it. Prices were reasonable, too!

reviews.author: Sydney Morris
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing!! My mom has celiac and they knew all about and were able to accommodate her! Both the regular food and the gluten free was delicious! And the service was amazing! Our server was very sweet and even helped us speak some Greek terms!

reviews.author: Praveen G
reviews.text: Pepper Souvlaki & More is a great spot in Mykonos for a quick, delicious bite. The ambience is fun and lively, and the souvlakis are on point, whether you go for chicken, pork, or the veggie option, they’re all super tasty. Perfect for a casual meal while exploring the island.

reviews.author: Ekanki G
reviews.text: The food was absolutely amazing! We ordered chicken souvlaki and it is one of the best in the Mykonos that we have tasted. Pepper Grill Eatery is hidden gem in a little Venice. Great price! Definitely recommend this place!

name: Street Stall - Ano Mera
address: Street Stall - Ano Mera, Mykonos, Greece

reviews.author: April Williams
reviews.text: We visited one day off of our cruise ship. There was a shuttle from the port to the town or a 30 minute walk. We really enjoyed walking around the town seeing the beautiful architecture. Buildings are all white but very colorful doors, windows, and/or balconies. We enjoyed seeing the windmills, churches, shops and restaurants, flowers, and cats. We found the people very friendly. The streets are busy so watch for motorcycles especially. There are 2 public beaches. There is a public restroom at the shuttle drop off and somewhere in the middle that are free to use. Maybe you will be lucky and see Petros the Pelican.

reviews.author: Tarek Raslan
reviews.text: We booked 3 nights coming with ferry from Athens, the first sight of the island 🏝️ is breathtaking and so romantic 🥰, since we had a 🚗 so we went touring the island which all streets are very narrow maximum two small cars and some times on car only can pass with no traffic lights 🚥 at junctions so take care , little Venice part is so nice but expensive the beach all over choose according to your budget Overall we had great time and enjoyed the trip

reviews.author: Melani García Ponce
reviews.text: This place felt like home, you must no skip this island, beautiful people And cute cats around

reviews.author: THE EXPLORER
reviews.text: We visited the island in June on a cruise. This was the second visit to Mykonos. So picturesque in every direction. The houses, the sea, the windmills, the food! We just loved it and hope to get back there as soon as we can.

reviews.author: Denisse Moreno
reviews.text: Such a beautiful island!!!! Been there 3 years in a row now, can’t wait to come back 🇬🇷🤌🏽✨

name: Street Stall - Little Venice
address: Street Stall - Little Venice, Mykonos, Greece

reviews.author: Rico Sumadia
reviews.text: Matogianni Street is more than just a destination; it's an experience. It encapsulates the very essence of Mykonos – stylish, vibrant, and utterly enchanting. Whether you're there to shop, dine, people-watch, or kick off your night, Matogianni is the beating heart of Mykonos Town and an absolute must-visit for any traveler to the island.

reviews.author: Devildman
reviews.text: Beautiful street, classic Greek cobblestone and architecture, breathtaking scenery, blue doors on white buildings, and plenty and plenty of shopping. Some tourist traps for sure, be Mindful. But everything was such a great experience walking through the town on this shopping road.

reviews.author: Philippe B.
reviews.text: Not the most interesting place in Mykonos The street is lovely, as many others in Mykonos. This one is famous because of its numerous shops offering luxury items from premium international brands. International expensive products for international jet setters. Nothing special, nor typical.

reviews.author: Jamila Satani
reviews.text: Nice street. Very busy after 10am.

reviews.author: Carlos Rangel
reviews.text: Nestled within the heart of Mykonos town, Matogianni Alley is a hidden gem that captures the essence of this enchanting island. My wife and I had the pleasure of wandering through this picturesque alley early one morning, when the streets were blissfully empty. The absence of crowds, a rare luxury given the popularity of the location, allowed us to enjoy our walk at a leisurely pace, savouring every moment. Matogianni Alley is steeped in history, its narrow, winding paths a testament to the island’s rich past. Originally a hub for local artisans and traders, the alley has retained much of its old-world charm while seamlessly blending with contemporary elegance. The whitewashed buildings, adorned with vibrant bougainvillaea, create a stunning contrast against the clear blue sky, offering a feast for the eyes at every turn. As we strolled along the cobblestone pathway, we couldn’t help but marvel at the array of boutique shops, each offering unique treasures. From handcrafted jewellery to exquisite textiles, the alley is a shopper’s paradise, inviting visitors to take home a piece of Mykonos. The quaint cafes, with their inviting aromas of freshly brewed coffee and traditional Greek pastries, beckoned us to pause and indulge. Nearby, the iconic Mykonos windmills stand as proud sentinels overlooking the Aegean Sea. These historic structures, dating back to the 16th century, were once vital to the island’s economy, grinding grain for local consumption and export. Today, they serve as a picturesque reminder of the island’s agricultural heritage and provide a perfect backdrop for photography enthusiasts. A short stroll from Matogianni Alley brings you to the Mykonos Folklore Museum, housed in a charming 18th-century mansion. Here, visitors can delve into the island’s cultural history, exploring exhibits that range from antique furniture and historic photographs to traditional costumes and nautical artefacts. It’s a must-visit for anyone eager to understand the heritage that has shaped Mykonos. As the morning light bathed the alley in a golden glow, we reluctantly concluded our peaceful walk. Matogianni Alley, with its blend of history, charm, and contemporary vibrancy, had offered us a precious window into the soul of Mykonos. It is not merely a path to tread but a journey to experience, where every corner holds a story, and every step invites discovery. For those seeking a true taste of Mykonos, away from the hustle and bustle, an early morning stroll through Matogianni Alley is an experience to cherish. It’s a place where time seems to stand still, and the beauty of the moment is all that matters.

reviews.author: vahe99
reviews.text: Had the best time partying here! Our host Kristi was awesome!! We made daybed reservations (would HIGHLY recommend reservations) and just hung out all day. The music was on point. Food and drinks were great. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Elena
reviews.text: We had an absolutely amazing time at the beach club! Costas and Ervist provided outstanding service – they were incredibly attentive, kind, and always there when we needed something, without ever being intrusive. We didn’t miss a thing and felt completely taken care of the entire time. The relaxed atmosphere, excellent service, and beautiful setting made our experience unforgettable. If you’re planning to visit, definitely ask for Costas and Ervist – they’ll make sure you have the best time! Highly recommended – we’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Name Surname
reviews.text: Good location in a bay, almost no wind, parking costs €10 for the whole day, and very reasonable prices for sunbeds (€25 in June for a sunbed in the back rows). Comfortable beds with towels. Good restaurant, but pretty expensive for lunch. Compared to other beach clubs, this one is definitely the best. Others charge 2-4 times more for much worse service.

reviews.author: Daniel Mole
reviews.text: Super Paradise Beach Club offers an incredible experience – the music, entertainment, food, and cocktails were all top-notch. The atmosphere was lively but not overcrowded, which made for a really enjoyable day. Valet parking was a great touch, and everything was spotlessly clean. The location is stunning too. The only downside is the price – it's definitely on the more expensive side compared to other beach clubs on the island. Still, if you're looking for quality and a vibrant vibe, it's worth the visit.

reviews.author: Robyn Cunliffe
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach bar! We popped down on a little quad bike trip round the island. I felt a bit underdressed but the staff were still very welcoming which was nice. A little bit expensive but the food looked incredibly fresh and tasty and the drinks were ice cold. Worth the visit!

reviews.author: Gisela Fontelles
reviews.text: Generous portions and great quality food! Every dish was flavorful and freshly made. We were pleasantly surprised to receive complimentary yogurt at the end – a nice touch that made the experience even better. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: Ashley Bruce
reviews.text: Restaurant conveniently right by the port, we came for lunch to kill time while waiting for the ferry. We ordered: • The usual Fava and Saganaki Naxian Graviera with Orange marmalade (It came with 2 slices of cheese as opposed to the usual single, however the marmalade was a little too sweet for my liking.) • Octopus croquette: On the salty side, the tartar sauce balances it out though. • Naxian meatballs were delicious, perfectly cooked and the explosion of flavours was amazing! Server was really nice and attentive. Brought us complimentary dessert: naxian yogurt with sweetened carrot on top. I must say, I’m loving their yogurt desserts. So simple, yet so delicious! Everything, with the 2 cans of coke, came up to €42!

reviews.author: Min Lee
reviews.text: It was odd we ordered 2 seafood dishes. The seafood orzo came well, felt fresh. While the seafood saganaki felt like it was reheated of microwaved. We were recommended here by a local so I was confused at the difference of quality of the dishes here. The food quality maybe be different based on who is coming?

reviews.author: Tasha Y
reviews.text: They serve Salatouri, which is quite special—easily the best Greek dish I’ve ever had. The service is friendly, and you can enjoy a beautiful sunset from the terrace. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Pam Spelker
reviews.text: Ohhhhh .the food! ❤️ Wonderful seafood, prepared very well. Definitely one of the more popular restaurants on the strip. Worth dining here if you can get in during crowded times.

reviews.author: Hazal Irmak
reviews.text: Giagko’s Pantheon is a must-visit in Chora! Everything I tried was absolutely delicious. The restaurant is beautifully located in the heart of Chora, with charming views of the street outside Chora itself is stunning. If you’d like to sit outside, be sure to make a reservation.Try not to miss the sunset here it’s truly magical.Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ozgur Cagri
reviews.text: Very good and delicous greek food and local atmosphere. Try fava! Service is quite nice and kind. We prefer veal steak for main course. It would have been better but it was nice.

reviews.author: Melissa Ernst
reviews.text: We stopped by and we’re delighted by the food! We stopped by for a late lunch after visiting the nearby church. The lamb rib special was some of the best lamb I’ve had. My husband enjoyed the souvlaki.

reviews.author: RAM IMAGERY
reviews.text: I can't get enough of their calamari. The best in town without a doubt ! This family owned restaurant, hast that grandma taste in all of their dishes. True traditional greek/patmean dishes. The staff is great & very friendly. There's always room for improvement when it comes to service but let's be real, it's island service & a Greek one. The location is perfect and either inside or outside, you'll feel like home. Give a chance for lunch or dinner & you won't be dissapointed.

reviews.author: Jill Hodges
reviews.text: Best meal so far after 12 days of vacation. The vegetarian grape leaves and beet salad were amazing. Everything was delicious and the view was incredible.

reviews.text: One of my favorite spots in Patras. It has nice cafes around to drink coffee or eat something. The atmosphere here is amazing, especially at the sunset

reviews.author: Alireza Biglari
reviews.text: Marina Patras is a beautiful and relaxing spot by the sea! The view is stunning, especially at sunset, creating a perfect atmosphere for a walk or a meal by the water. The area is well-maintained, with plenty of cafes and restaurants offering delicious food and drinks. The vibe is peaceful yet lively, making it a great place to unwind or enjoy time with friends. Whether you're a visitor or a local, it's definitely a must-visit destination in Patras. Highly recommend for a refreshing and scenic experience

reviews.author: Marie j Melidis
reviews.text: A favorite destination within our city's limits ! A well-known, well maintained, and well managed concept for all times! Bravo! 👏

reviews.author: Maria Anna Karaoulani
reviews.text: Beautiful place to drink a coffee and watch the sunset. It should have been kept in a better state though because a lof of things are ruined and never get replaced.

reviews.author: Dimitris Georgakopoulos
reviews.text: Nice view, not so grounded but trendy. Free parking available.

reviews.author: Andrew Watts
reviews.text: Tucked away in the backstreets, this place has a beautiful garden area which is so well decorated that it would make a good calendar! (See photos). I cannot comment on the rooms as we did not actually stay here.

reviews.author: Lenore Rowntree
reviews.text: A beautiful and very comfortable place to stay. Quiet and away from the bustle of Old Town. Delicious food at the restaurant and engaging, friendly and helpful hosts. Everything beautifully appointed.

reviews.author: Kelly Harding
reviews.text: Beautiful, historical building, amazing food. Run by the nicest people. The best place to be in Rhodes.

reviews.author: Mia Modaro
reviews.text: We had the most beautiful dinner here, the restaurant is so lovely and the atmosphere is great! The waiters were amazing, they gave us great recommendations and even though they were slightly understaffed still provided us with a wonderful experience - all whilst dealing with a rude American couple near us so we really appreciated their effort! If I ever come back to Rhodes I’m making a booking straight away - PS if they have lavender cream brûlée or the deconstructed baklava on the menu definitely order it!

reviews.author: Alex E
reviews.text: Our family had the most enchanting experience at the Marco Polo Mansion in Rhodes Old Town this past June. Traveling as a group of six adults and two small children, we were welcomed by Efi and Spiro with open arms and treated like family from the moment we arrived. We split our stay between the main mansion and the apartment-style lodging next door—both were absolutely perfect, offering everything we could have asked for. The design of the hotel is nothing short of inspiring, with beautiful decor, colors, and an atmosphere that transports you to another time. Every morning, we were greeted with the freshest and most delicious breakfast, a perfect start to each day. The location is ideal—tucked away from the busy main streets but just a short walk to all the must-see sights in Rhodes Old Town. The charm of Rhodes captivated us, and staying at the Marco Polo Mansion made it even more unforgettable. Efi and Spiro’s hospitality was above and beyond, and we can't wait to return. And the restaurant? Truly the best dining experience we had on the island. We dined there three times in our five-night stay—the food is a masterclass in innovative Greek cuisine, delicious and beautifully presented. Thank you, Efi and Spiro, for creating such a jewel in the heart of one of Greece's most magical islands. We can’t wait to visit again!

reviews.text: Beautifully decorated restaurant - inside is also super cute work some seats and sofas under archways. Great quiet but cosy and friendly vibes. The food was exceptional - best fish I've ever tasted. The staff were very kind to the kids as well as us. We really loved it, will try to come back before leaving Rhodes and would highly recommend anyone visiting Old Town Rhodes to come here for food!

reviews.author: Hugo Andres Peña Lagos
reviews.text: A beautiful place with excellent service, friendly and smiling. We enjoyed the dinner very much, exquisite flavours and at a very convenient price.

reviews.author: Em Peneau
reviews.text: We arrived there quite late and only a few tables were left. However, we weren't rushed and left to enjoy our wine. The food is good and the portion are massive. We asked about sizes and were told otherwise. We would have probably ordered less had we known... Overall a very good experience with friendly service for a 1st meal in Rhodes.

reviews.author: Ege Aynur
reviews.text: Delicious tavern foods with modern touch. Atmosphere is pretty.

reviews.author: Teja Tomšič
reviews.text: The food was great and staff was so nice and helpful!

reviews.author: Richard Becker
reviews.text: Magnificent view and great area. It would have been possible to drive all the way up, but we chickened out and parked halfway. The hike up was demanding in the 37C heat, but it was all worth it.

reviews.author: Emma Hingley
reviews.text: I loved this I have limited mobility but you can drive right to the top to park the views are amazing and you can hear the peacocks calling below. There’s an old house that’s empty you can explore with underground rooms it’s oddly magical

reviews.author: antony jones
reviews.text: Amazing views long walk up but can drive well worth it

reviews.author: Imre Gönczi
reviews.text: Highly recommended! Experienced drivers can go until the way point, but there is also a lot of spot where you can leave your car and walk 5 minutes.

reviews.author: Oleg Rjumin
reviews.text: Best viewpoint on Rhodos. A lot of butterflies (probably vanessa cardui) in the end of May. Wedding photographers spot. Easy to reach by car.

reviews.author: Andrew Watts
reviews.text: If you want to eat, drink and watch the world go by then this is the place. Beautiful harbour and the 'alleged' location of the Colossus of Rhodes. Plenty of places to eat with a great view and if you fancy a cake or slice of gateau look no further. The gateway to the old town is only a short walk away.

reviews.author: Kay Bunsell
reviews.text: Beautiful views definitely go visit while your on your hoilday. Some markets stall in old town. Lovely walk along the port and through the castle. Got a shuttle bus from our hotel there and back 24€

reviews.author: Andreia Vieira
reviews.text: Amazing experience, amazing crew and amazing views. We went in the Wind catamaran (it was the best one of the 3, in our option). The crew was super friendly and helpful, but Andreas was the super star of them all, he was chatting with us most of the trip, he is super nice and extremely kind. We loved it. Thank you so much for you all ❤️

reviews.author: Neil Rhodes
reviews.text: The hotel is very good. A lovely facility overlooking the Aegean Sea. The staff are helpful, friendly and excellent at their job. The only thing that lets it down is the food. Very average. Salads are good but it’s processed mushrooms and cold plates for lukewarm food. If the standard of the food could be improved then it would be excellent. But we had a great week, going on excursions and relaxing by the pool.

reviews.author: Clare
reviews.text: Lovely port very close to the Old Town in Rhodes. Plenty of boat trips leaving daily.

name: Street Stall - Old Town
address: Street Stall - Old Town, Rhodes, Greece

reviews.author: Sarah Lazzari
reviews.text: Rhodes is such a beautiful city. Would definitely recommend visiting!

reviews.author: Isac Dos Santos Junior
reviews.text: One place everyone should have a chance to visit. Beautiful, iconic, historical.

reviews.author: terike
reviews.text: The Old Town and tip of the peninsula is where all the amazing sites and history are, incredible place.

reviews.author: taylan acar
reviews.text: The trees and cafes are amazing. Historical sites are great. The beaches are top notch. Find a ticket if Possible and visit.

reviews.author: Greg D
reviews.text: A magical and varied island, full of deep historical architecture and rich welcoming culture. The food and wine was excellent, whether we ate simple local food or went high end. I had very little idea how liveable it would feel, as the old town has everything one could need to be comfortable. A slower simpler pace of living is possible here, and we were lucky to have stayed with a wonderful warm family that shared home cooked delights with us. We also found it easy to travel around and go to other islands. The weather is perfect for me as it’s hot yet breezy so I would recommend it to those who also enjoy that kind of feel.

reviews.author: MJ Bold
reviews.text: We visited Old town bazaar clothes shop yesterday, a truly amazing shopping experience; not only did they pay for myself and my families free taxi transport to and from our hotel. The customer service was second to none. The shop has everything you would ever want, the best clothes, footwear, designer bags, and loads more. An enormous range of the latest styles and fashions, at reasonable prices. We were made to feel really welcome by all the staff, and even given free refreshing cooling drinks. Had our every need met, by Mehmet and his excellent very friendly, polite and professional team. There were so many highlights, during our shopping trip, the adorable cats, and the astonishing clothes choices. One of the best things is after we brought lots of clothes, we were able to leave them in the trusted hands of the shop and go off sightseeing, returning later, where the taxi driver Ali who was amazing, one of the most helpful and kind person we've ever met. Delivery them and us back to our hotel. Great value for money, we would definitely comeback again. The old town shop location itself is breathtaking and a stone throw away from the famous historical Roman Hadrian's Gate and the stunning marina.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: Was recommended by family, and boy they did not disappoint, went above and beyond, fantastic people, fantastic products, fantastic quality, can't recommend enough, buy with confidence

reviews.author: Adegoke Enirayetan
reviews.text: Oscar is a nice guy, he showed me good deals that makes sense. I will definitely come back with my friends for more amazing deals

reviews.author: Tracey CHAPPELL
reviews.text: Picked up by driver and taken to old bazaar. Beautiful shopping experience, staff very helpful and quality of goods superb... They even gave free transfer back to hotel after I'd had a look around other stores. great day

reviews.author: Brad Ingber
reviews.text: The service was absolutely amazing friendly, helpful, I was greated with a beverage of my choice! I was picked up from my hotel and drop back off, free of charge. The clothes were top quality. I was really impressed with how affordable everything was for such great material and style. It’s not often you find that perfect mix of price and quality. Thank you!

reviews.author: Hannah May (HannahMay93)
reviews.text: Enjoyed a nice lunch today during a walk through Old Town. We were prompted seated and served. Food was very tasty, however not entirely sure it was worth the price compared to other restaurants I have been, but still a very and welcoming nice. Great spot to relax and people watch as you enjoy your food 👍🏻

reviews.author: Drew Lunn
reviews.text: We'd been craving some oysters and had heard that Alexis Tavern was the place to go. We managed to visit on the first day of it opening for the season, and sitting there on our own in the middle of Rhodes Old Town, being waited on by some brilliant waiters was an experience that people would pay some serious money to experience, and one that will live long in our memories. A really romantic, special end to our night. Thank you guys! And thanks for the complimentary dessert!

reviews.author: Odette Bodo
reviews.text: Super cozy atmosphere, great wine and the food was amazing!! We opted for the fish of the day and it was delicious!! For dessert recomment the pannacotta, it‘s something… Will come back definitely!!

reviews.author: Sanne Spaan
reviews.text: I was seated by Sebastian. Who is a friendly host with a big smile to make you feel welcome. I chose the prosecco that goes perfect with the Greek salad. The Greek salad was very good it was fresh and you can taste that that have good quality ingredients. I also got the crispy feta bites which I have never seen befor and was a good combination between sweet and salty. I got a dessert with pannacotta and raspberry with ice cream of pistachio. Het pannacotta is nice and simpel. The raspberry at more sour to it which I like. I fell in love with the pistachio ice cream and Carmel. So everything was good in my experience amazing even the cook knows what he is doing

reviews.author: Victor Capo
reviews.text: Excellent lunch and atmosphere! Best meal far in Greece. Sebastian was the best he is in our photo!

reviews.author: Daria M
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the place and the whole experience I had. I dined just after 5pm and I was the only one in restaurant food nice and fresh and real taste of Greece. The owner was amazing recommended the house wine locally made in Rhodes and recommended few traditional dishes worth trying as a first time visitor in Greece. The atmosphere was amazing everyone so carrying the owner the waiter and the cooks whole staff was soo kind and sweet I did get a heartwarming birthday wishes followed by a piece of cake and a birthday song. Great place I do recommend to everyone🥰

reviews.author: Christopher Gallacher
reviews.text: The food was delicious, fresh and such a generous portion. The service was second to none. It was great atmosphere and the music was at the right level all in amazing time. Would highly recommend and I’ll be going back

reviews.author: Kristina Kalonomos
reviews.text: Taverna Kostas is an authentic restaurant serving delicious traditional Greek food. When visiting Rhodes I gave this restaurant a try and was so impressed that I came back a second time. The atmosphere is warm and makes you feel like you’re in someone’s home as opposed to a restaurant. The staff are beyond friendly, and the service was very quick. In terms of food, my group ordered a number of things off the menu and were consistently blown away by each one. The chicken souvlaki dinner was extremely juicy and came with a healthy portion of salad, rice, fries, and tzatziki. The lamb over mashed potatoes was super tender and very flavorful. The fried feta in phyllo pastry with sesame and honey was an amazing starter. The calamari was crispy and fresh. My favourite mains were the moussaka the pardisia salad. The moussaka was very tasty and extremely authentic, reminding me of my own Γιαγιά’s cooking. The pardisia salad was a fresh blend of mango, green apple, tangy vinaigrette, and grilled manouri cheese over mixed greens which absolutely blew me away. Despite the restaurant not having a cocktail or wine list, we tried the house red and white wines and were extremely satisfied with both. The red wine was a perfect dry while the white was flavourful and more full-bodied. The freshness of the food paired with the promptness of the service and overall environment will make Taverna Kostas a repeat choice for me when coming back to Rhodes!!

reviews.author: Sebastian Gramlich
reviews.text: Beautiful family owned traditional Greek cuisine restaurant, with great, lovely and friendly hospitality and service. Really can't complain anything. Can only recommend to check it out and enjoy a great food experience.

reviews.author: Christian Ellwood
reviews.text: Authentic Hidden Gem in Rhodes This charming spot was recommended by one of the local shops in Rhodes, and it did not disappoint. Tucked slightly off the beaten path, it offers a more traditional, authentic Greek experience with truly homemade food. The service was warm and welcoming. While the waiter’s English was limited—and my Greek even more so—we still managed just fine, and it only added to the local charm. The food was absolutely superb—fresh, hot, and clearly made with care. If you’re looking for something genuine and a little different from the typical tourist fare, take the plunge and give this place a try. You won’t regret it.
