reviews.author: Oliver Bailey
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the food and the sea view. But most of all i was impressed by the service staff, very friendly and accommodating. The food was served promtly and presented very well. The only comment i would make here is that it was a bot more expensive than I would expect. Keep in mind that you can also have a swim as the restaurant is next to a beach ⛱️ with sunbeds and beach chairs. For lunch for 2 people expect to pay around 30€ per person.

reviews.author: Donald Phipps
reviews.text: Called in for a very late lunch. I had read very favourable reviews so thought we would give it a try. Slightly off the main tourist streets of Rhodes Old Town but well worth seeking out. Beautiful restaurant setting under the trees. Efficient service and lovely food. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Łukasz Mich
reviews.text: I was disappointed with our visit. The service was quite inattentive. We ordered the Fish Mixed Platter and didn’t receive any pita, fries, or even a small side salad. The staff didn’t mention that the side dishes needed to be ordered separately. They also forgot the drinks for one of our friends. The food itself was average at best. After asking for the bill, I ended up going to the counter to pay myself after waiting 15 minutes. The place itself has a nice atmosphere, but unfortunately, the overall experience was underwhelming. I do not recommend it.

reviews.author: Loïs Sandkuijl
reviews.text: We stumbled upon this little restaurant by chance and decided to give it a try. What a fantastic evening we had! The food was delicious, and the desserts and limoncello are highly recommended: they’re homemade! Theo made sure we had an unforgettable evening, and we will definitely be coming back. We recommend it to everyone!

reviews.author: Meja Jonsson
reviews.text: Super good food but also a little expensive. The staff was really nice and the atmosphere too. If you don’t know what to get I really recommend the seafood pasta 🍝!!! It was delicious 😋

reviews.author: Utku Ören
reviews.text: No regrets. An absolutely positive taste experience for us. We had the privilege to taste all these food in a serene environment on a relatively hot summer evening but it was well worth it. You think two people cannot manage all this food, you're wrong my friend. It is amazing what the human body is capable of when things are right. Dolmadakia was excellent, maybe dare I say better than my grandma's (she is turning in her gave now... 🥹). Lamb shoulder was how it should be, a.k.a. AMAZING!, crispy outside tender inside with lots of fat. Wow! It never disappoints to climb the mountains of Greek islands for a dinner whichever island we go in Greece. Thank you!

reviews.author: Lisa Mc Creery
reviews.text: Incredible taverna up in the mountains. I had found this reading some articles before my holiday and then had it recommended to us in Pefkos. Well worth the beautiful drive. Very simple menu but done incredibly. They squeezed us in before the kitchen closed and we were incredibly grateful. Food was incredible and the staff were so friendly too.

reviews.author: Lisa W
reviews.text: We visited this restaurant for lunch and were warmly welcomed by the owner with a big smile. To start, we had the aubergine dip and zucchini fritters—both were absolutely delightful. For the main course, we shared the lamb for two, though the generous portion could easily have served four. Everything was incredibly delicious!

reviews.author: Jamila Mallat
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious every dish was full of flavor and cooked to perfection. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great dining experience! Typically Greek!

reviews.author: Giannis Tsambalieros
reviews.text: Expert Review: Mageirotechneio Taverna Paraga (Paraga) – A Feast of Rhodian Tradition in Apollona Tucked in the serene village of Apollona, Rhodes, Mageirotechneio Taverna Paraga (affectionately known as Paraga) is a culinary love letter to Rhodian heritage. This family-friendly gem, brimming with local charm, delivers an unabashedly authentic experience where every dish feels like a warm embrace from the island itself. Atmosphere: Rustic Warmth Meets Village Soul Paraga’s unpretentious setting is quintessentially Greek taverna: checkered tablecloths, weathered wooden chairs, and walls adorned with faded photos of Apollona’s past. The air buzzes with lively chatter from tables packed with local farmers, families, and in-the-know travelers—a testament to its status as a community pillar. Located just steps from the village square, the taverna feels like a hidden slice of Rhodian life, untouched by tourist gloss. Service: Heartfelt Hospitality The staff here exudes genuine warmth, treating guests like extended family. Service is relaxed yet attentive, with servers eagerly guiding diners through the menu or sharing stories about the village. The pride they take in their food and wine is palpable, especially when they pour a glass of their famed house semi-sweet red with a knowing smile. The Food: A Celebration of Rhodian Flavors Paraga’s menu is a masterclass in rustic simplicity, letting high-quality ingredients shine. During your feast, standout dishes likely included: - Rodian Salads: Bursting with sun-ripened figs, crispy greens, and tangy local cheese, drenched in golden olive oil. - Appetizers: Think creamy *tzatziki*, smoky tyrosalata (cheese dip), and delicious *dolmades* (stuffed vine leaves) that set the tone for the meal. - Mixed Grill: A carnivore’s dream—juicy thick cut bacon, tender lamb chops, and lamb (Cypriot-style sausages) sizzling off the charcoal, served with lemon-drenched potatoes. - Kolokithokeftedes: Zuccini fritters, a Rhodian specialty, crispy on the outside and fluffy within. But the true star? The **house semi-sweet red wine**. This velvety, fruit-forward blend is dangerously drinkable—ideal for pairing with grilled meats or sipping solo as the sun dips behind the village hills. ### **Why It Shines** - **Local Vibe**: This is where Rhodians eat, ensuring authenticity in every bite. - **Generous Portions**: Dishes are hearty and shareable, perfect for family-style dining. - **Unbeatable Value**: Quality ingredients and modest prices make it a steal. ### **The Verdict** Paraga isn’t just a meal—it’s an immersion into Rhodian culture. While it won’t dazzle with avant-garde plating or fusion twists, it doesn’t need to. This taverna thrives on tradition, heart, and flavors that have been perfected over generations. Whether you’re a family craving a feast, a traveler seeking authenticity, or a wine lover hunting for hidden gems, Paraga delivers. **Rating**: 5/5 – A flawless example of Greek taverna magic. *Pro tip*: Let the staff guide your order, and don’t leave without a carafe (or three) of that semi-sweet red. Arrive early to snag a table under the vines, and save room for homemade deserts if it’s on offer!

reviews.author: Şule Demir
reviews.text: I loved the atmosphere: It was the most authentic Greek vibe restaurant we experienced in Rhodes. The service was excellent, and the staff were truly kind and friendly. We really appreciated the complimentary dessert; it was so refreshing and delicious! The fried zucchini flowers were absolutely on point; crispy, flavorful, and a definite highlight. Even though the food was okay for the price overall, I felt like something was missing. Still, our overall experience was very satisfying.

reviews.author: Icewitty Ice
reviews.text: Fed up with the bull tourist restaurants and especially their prices, we finally found a secretly hidden authentic Greek place. We loved the hospitality and the food was simply amazing. Order several small dishes, put them centrally on the table and eat whatever you like most. That's the greek way!

reviews.author: Jess Glez
reviews.text: Rhodes is extremely touristy and I believe I would struggle to find authentic places, luckily enough I found this place! Cosma (I hope I'm spelling his name correctly) was a super host. Very welcoming from the minute I stepped in the restaurant, made me feel like a family member. This is a family run restaurant and it has an authentic and local feel. The menu is mezze style which means they don't have main dishes, you order different small plates and share. The food was really tasty and enjoyable. These kinds of places warm my heart and my stomach, 😂 I'll definitely come back and if you find yourself in Rhodes wanting to escape the crowd and find a real Greek restaurant, this is the place for you!

reviews.author: Maja Jonsson
reviews.text: Food was delicious!! Especially the cheese balls and Greek salad! It took some time for all the food to arrive, but that’s ok. And they gave us some kind of dessert at the end which was kind and delicious!! 🤌🏽🤌🏽

reviews.author: Meja Jonsson
reviews.text: Super nice place! Food was delicious and the atmosphere was nice 👍 the staff was very friendly but seemed like they forgot one thing we ordered ( we had to remind them). Still very nice, just recommend maybe reminding the staff if the food takes some time :)

reviews.author: antonis pagonis
reviews.text: Excellent Experience A small but elegant restaurant with outstanding service and delicious food. Every dish was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. The staff was attentive and professional, making the whole evening smooth and enjoyable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality dining in a relaxed atmosphere.

reviews.author: Joey D'Ortenzio
reviews.text: Our last night in Oia and we took a chance finding a place to dine without reservations. By luck we found Floga. Very cozy and romantic spot that served the BEST local dishes on the island! I can confidently say this was the best meal in Greece so far. The service and views are outstanding to boot. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Σέφη Παναγοπούλου
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience! I honestly don’t understand some of the negative reviews — our experience was completely the opposite! The staff were incredibly polite and professional. everything was handled with class. The food was fantastic, full of flavor and clearly made with care. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming. This place and its team are truly top level! Highly recommended — we’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Thomas Dobernig
reviews.text: Fantastic... The presentation and view are beautiful, not to be outdone by the service. Just a great experience.

reviews.author: Elena Kasparis
reviews.text: 1 800 Floga is an elegant and intimate restaurant that provides a wonderful dining experience for a special evening out in Santorini. The setting of the restaurant is beautiful and the establishment is tastefully designed, with eye-catching table settings. We had the salad with salmon to start and it was very refreshing and flavorful! We also had the stuffed calamari, which was very unique and tasty. For our main, we had both risottos (the pistachio and seafood) to share and were blown away. Incredible flavors and gorgeous presentation. For my seafood risotto, I requested a claw cracker to eat the prawn, which they were happy to give me along with a wet wipe to clean up after. All the dishes were beautifully plated and well-executed. We had the flaming creme brûlée for dessert, which was a fun experience and very tasty. Value for quality is there - while some dishes may not be huge, the portion is a reasonable size and dishes have high-quality ingredients that make it well worth the cost. Phillips provided exceptional service - very personable and helpful. Very knowledgeable to answer all our questions and provided great recommendations.

reviews.author: Vu Thanh Long NGUYEN
reviews.text: The view from this restaurant towards the plain and the distant sea is exceptional. The air is well controlled by the natural wind, making it not too hot even when dining at noon. The restaurant is beautifully decorated with many small trees, fish tanks, a swimming pool, and more. The food here is very delicious. Giaprakia (a traditional Greek recipe with minced meat, rice, and mint, wrapped in cabbage and served with French fries and yogurt sauce) as well as stuffed calamari (with feta cheese, sundried tomatoes, onions, and peppers) are excellent. The waiters are nice and very friendly.

reviews.author: Adrian
reviews.text: The restaurant was a very amazing experience. As you can see in the photos, you walk into a blue stone looking building, and are greeted with beautiful gardens, greenhouses, real ducks / chickens, man-made waterfalls, ponds and other amazing decorations. From the start of the restaurant to where you dine in, it takes about 30 seconds to walk through all these amazing decorations. I’m not complaining! You are then greeted by what feels like every waiter in the restaurant, which was a very pleasant greeting and are shown to your table of choice. I chose the scenic view which was spectacular. The menu was very modern and easy to read. I opted for the Shrimp Saganaki as a starter, which had a very sweet taste, and I really enjoyed this. For the main course, I had Salmon, however, it was slightly above average. It felt a bit overcooked & too grilled. I prefer it a little on the raw side in the middle and they probably should’ve asked how I wanted it cooked. I honestly have made better Salmon at home. To finish on a high, they were playing really good deep house music.👌🏻 Overall, it was a really great experience, except the main meal, which should be the heart of the dinner.

reviews.author: Armin
reviews.text: A brilliant restaurant. I’ll try to categorize my review. The restaurant is by a cliff so you have excellent views. Some seats might not have the excellent view but you could always see the sea. The service was great, waiters and waitresses are very professional and they treated us in a very friendly manner. The food was great. Very tasty, great portions and the quality of everything is top notch. We ordered a glass of white wine for 4.5 euro and they brought a glass of I think around 250 ml of white wine. Great stuff. I have to say a must try restaurant. I would give this restaurant a plus as well making it a 5⭐️➕

reviews.author: Martina Fitzgerald
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience at Argos. We were sold to come over here when we read such excellent reviews. Argos definitely did not disappoint. We entered from the back door by mistake, but were told during our meal to exit through the front as this takes us to an underground cave - a very interesting experience (pictures below). We opted for the rose house wine, the Casablanca shisha (very well suggested by one of the staff members), Greek platter to share and lobster pasta to share (pictured). If I could, I would give 10 starts to the staff, everyone is so nice, welcoming and well informed. They have a cute cat too… but that’s just a bonus. 💗

reviews.author: Amanda Rozea
reviews.text: This place was really interesting. I would advise getting seafood because it seemed to be their thing. The entrance leading up to it was interesting and different. Our favorite was dessert which we had the orange soufflé with chocolate ice cream. The overall atmosphere was very inviting, they had live music and the service was very good.

reviews.author: Salman Soleimani-Dashtaki
reviews.text: We drove by this place just before the sunset, felt a good vibe, a bit away from the crowd, calm and cozy, so we decided to stop for dinner. It is a 25 years old family owned restaurant, 3 generations, all from Santorini. Unlike many “touristic places”, not many temporary/seasonal workers; most people are local. The two brothers who now own and run the place are both born in Santorini and live here year long. Very authentic food. Most of the ingredients are harvested locally, from their own farm here, or around the island. Many Santorini unique/local dishes, which you cannot find in typical restaurants here. Staff are very friendly. Service was great. We highly recommend trying out their restaurant. You feel a bit of a history here with great authentic local foods. 😊

reviews.author: Alex Tham
reviews.text: Drove 30 mins from my hotel to get here. But well worth the time and effort. The grilled pork steak is the best I have tried in my life! Big portions and very reasonable price. The panorama adds to the whole dining experience.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text: Such a gem! On way to lighthouse the waiter outside the restaurant waved and smiled…we didn’t forget and on way back we called in like others say food was incredible, the best home cooked and best value for money in our experience in Santorini. We were given a taster of four wines along with appetisers, a lovely gesture, food is local to restaurant from owners farm. Fabulous views. Very friendly staff. Would highly recommend a visit…oh toilets are super clean and lots car parking space.

reviews.author: george kamakaris
reviews.text: Amazing restaurant outside the tourist spots. We had our classic Greek Salad and my slave has the calamari and I had what was the most amazing shrimp Saganaki. Juicy to the food. Loved it and fully recommend it

reviews.author: Bernadetta G
reviews.text: Great service and even better food! The staff was friendly and attentive, and every dish was fresh and full of flavor. A wonderful spot for a delicious meal and warm hospitality. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ray van Giessen
reviews.text: Love this place! Great view and the food is wonderful. Had the tzatziki and baked feta as starters, then a Greek vegetable risotto with feta mousse and a lamb shanks that was cooked to perfection!

reviews.author: Nikita Wu
reviews.text: Every dish here is absolutely delicious! That’s why my family came back twice during our trip to Santorini. The portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable. The pork shank and lamb shank were both amazing—but just a heads-up, the pork shank takes about 30 minutes to be served. Totally worth the wait!

reviews.author: Ice Cold
reviews.text: We had a great experience at this restaurant. From the warm and friendly staff to the layout of the bar kitchen and tables and where the restaurant was located. The starterers were amazing and so was the main course and dessert. No visit to Santorini would be complete without dinner at Kokkalo.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Yeo
reviews.text: By far, the best food I had in Greece! Salad was phenomenal, the tomahawk pork was excellent! Tender and juicy.. unbelievable! The food was michelin standard. Will come back again!

reviews.author: randa kirkman
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this restaurant's food. They were busy so I didn't have much expirence with the server however they were polite and very helpful getting me a small dessert after being stuff with their amazing lamb shank. My favorite meal I have experienced in Greece. A great view as well!!

reviews.author: Joyce Gardner
reviews.text: We were celebrating our 35th wedding anniversary and chose Lauda to celebrate. The seating looking over the Caldera is incredible! It is hard to describe how special it is. Be prepared to walk down many steps to get to the restaurant level below. The service was impeccable. We had a six or seven course testing menu with wine pairing. They start with an on the house plating before moving on to your courses. (They prepared a gluten free menu for me showing my courses to highlight how they modified dishes that contained gluten. The food is presented looking like works of art. Each bite is a culinary experience.

reviews.author: Mark Held
reviews.text: Amazing views. We had the Discovery tasting with with pairing. Make sure you have 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Top notch ingredients, best wine pairing we had in Greece, excellent service. Scorpion fish and Croaker fish amazing. Alex our host was outstanding. Pricy but worth every Euro. Only opportunity was timing on dish delivery, it was off at times but minor.

reviews.author: Max Carroll
reviews.text: One of the best experiences of my life, the view of the caldera was absolutely breathtaking. The menu had info about the history of the restaurant on Oia and about the chefs which was a really nice touch. The food was excellent, we did the 3 course tasting menu and a bottle of wine. Definitely not a cheap meal but if you’re willing to ball out one night it’s worth it

reviews.author: Allyson Love (Allyson Wonderland)
reviews.text: Overlooking the caldera became no joke - you sit on an outcropping over the sea, the winds occasionally bustling through. We opted for the tasting menu, complete with unusual and tasty bits - most were surprising. We each had our favorites, of course. :) Warning: beauty and taste costs dearly. Yes, it is crazy expensive, and also, it is hard on your knees. There are NO lifts going up or coming down. If you choose the wine pairings and now need to make your way back to your hotel, it may take you a hot minute. Also, the pricing is what we call a "TV dinner" : for the same price, you could get a new flat screen.

reviews.author: Asmae M'nebhi
reviews.text: Excellent experience! The food is innovative and delicious. The staff is kind and welcoming. Breathtaking views of the water from your seat. If you get the 10 course menu , come hungry and make sure to have 3-4 hours allocated for it.

reviews.author: Zihui Luo
reviews.text: The food, views, and service were all top-notch! We ordered the Lamb with fried potatoes, chicken leg, and salad with strawberries as per the suggestion of the staff! It was all really flavourful and tender. Staff were also really friendly and patient with telling us the special menu of the day. We were given free aperitifs, cheesecake, and wine to wait when the cashier system wasn’t working.

reviews.author: Alessandra De Giorgio
reviews.text: Amazing experience. The view is outstanding, the ambiance relaxing and the food is spectacular. Frankly one of the best experiences ever done and probably the best restaurant in Santorini.

reviews.author: Rian O'Neill
reviews.text: We had heard nothing but good things about this restaurant and were not disappointed. Delicious food in generous portions, friendly service and really lively atmosphere. Also reasonable prices for such high quality Complimentary ouzo shots before the meal and cheesecake for dessert on the house were a really nice touch. We went for dinner on Saturday night (26 April) and both inside and outside areas were absolutely packed the entire time, so definitely book in advance!! Not to be missed

reviews.author: David P
reviews.text: Great food, poor service. Excited to try this place as had heard good things. Managed to get a booking a few days before for later sitting at 9pm. The restaurant itself has a nice terrace overlooking the airport-side of the island. Staff on arrival were welcoming and when taking the order, but sadly the service went downhill from there. The starters, drinks and mains drinks were all delivered to our table but no empty plates removed so we had to stack our empty ones ourselves on the nearby edge of the terrace. And, after being served our mains - we were basically forgetten about. We were left with our finished plates and empty glasses for over 45 minutes. Eventually I went to the service desk and someone finally appeared to help and I requested if we could pay. I was rudely informed to wait by our table. Shortly after another waitress came to charge our card. When we asked if they had a desert menu she said no but that they usually serve a complimentary cheesecake. She then charged our card and we did get the cheesecake but by the end we felt like we were in the way and just wanted to leave. The food itself was great, especially the starters we had including the special salad, boar sausage and local aubergines with tomato and feta (would get all again). Sadly due to the late sitting, the local lamb dishes were all sold out so we didn't get to try them. We instead had moussaka and the pork with feta sauce (both okay but wouldn't get again). I'd recommend trying to book earlier so they don't run out of dishes and maybe the staff are less busy and tired so they won't forget about you or at least appear to be more friendly and attentive.

reviews.author: Irene Zadonska
reviews.text: Perfect food, ambience and service. We ordered dolmadaki, beet salad, roasted lamb and some pork. Everything came out really delicious. They manage to have many guests Nd manage them smoothly. Free desert and rakia were delicious and appreciated.

reviews.author: Mateo Braho
reviews.text: Amazing dinner at Roka! The food was delicious and the atmosphere perfect, but what truly made the night special was the incredible service from George and Isaac warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Thank you both!

reviews.author: Kal Patel
reviews.text: FOOD OVERHYPED AND NOT WORTH THE PRICE!!! We had a group of 4 in our party. We also had reservations. Ambiance is fantastic, views are breathtaking and that’s about all we can say. FOOD Food was not up to our standards. We ordered two chickens which were not cooked properly, the chicken was pink from the inside, we informed the waiter and they took both back to the kitchen. When they came back they just recooked the chicken we sent back so now it was burnt. The chicken didn’t have flavor was very bland. The manager came and apologized and said they would COMP us the two chicken entrees. When the check came they charged us for the two chicken entrees 32 euros a piece so a total of 64 euros. We questioned the bill with the waiter he said we took two back and we charged you for the two new chickens, even though they recooked the two the took. So their meaning of COMP is different then the ENTIRE WORLDS MEANING OF COMP!! SERVICE Initially the waiter was good but once he found out we were not ordering drinks he checked out from the service. OVERALL I would NOT recommend this location to anyone. They need to get their language straightened out about COMP. If we are still going to pay for the chicken then they shouldn’t say it was COMPED, it defeats the purpose of the word being used.

reviews.author: Anas khalaf
reviews.text: Issac and mohammed gave us an amazing experience 10/10. Amazing vibes amazing food amazing service. Beats nubu all day long. The iceberg lettuce is a must try and the yellow tail

reviews.author: Shideh S
reviews.text: Had the best experience, the Gyoza was the best I’ve had, the sushi, watermelon spritz, and the views were out of this world.

reviews.author: Sahar
reviews.text: We were a couple at the restaurant celebrating a birthday. The restaurant is very high-end, with fresh and high-quality food, an excellent atmosphere, and a stunning view. The waiters were very courteous, polite, and patient. The manager was very attentive and caring. We also received a complimentary dessert from the restaurant. Highly recommended, a must-visit place.

reviews.author: Seán Wallace-Cotter
reviews.text: Selene is such an experience - don’t miss it if you’re in Santorini! We have been twice now and both times the service and food were outstanding. Their team even gave us a lovely gift as part of our honeymoon celebration.

reviews.author: Bir Luno
reviews.text: The most romantic dinner of my life because of the rooftop sunset! The staffs were nice but everything takes forever.Food’s decent, they can do better.We dined here in May 2019.

reviews.author: Seif W
reviews.text: 10/10, we did the small taster menu (~1.5 hour experience) and it was worth every euro. We booked to celebrate our honeymoon, and everything was excellent. The setting of the restaurant is beautiful, the plating was wonderful, the flavors were outstanding and by the end of the meal we were very full. The wait staff were also top notch, caring for every detail and considerate of our needs. I would definitely recommend this place for a true fine dining experience in Santorini for any special occasion.

reviews.author: Serena Bowen
reviews.text: This dining experience was absolutely amazing. It embodied everything from great service, great food and great ambience. The staff go above and beyond to ensure you have an unforgettable experience. If you enjoy wine they have a great selection and the sommelier is passionate and knowledgeable. Highlights have to be the lamb main and pistachio dessert. We even got to meet the head chef at the end, will definitely be visiting again! Thank you

reviews.author: dimitris chamzas
reviews.text: Wow, what an unforgettable dining experience! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Our waitress was absolutely wonderful—friendly, attentive, and made sure we were well taken care of the entire night. But the real star of the evening was Chef Giannis. The dishes were not only visually stunning but bursting with flavor! You can tell he puts his heart and soul into every plate. Every bite was a culinary masterpiece. If you’re looking for an extraordinary dining experience, this is the place. Highly recommend, and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Seán Wallace-Cotter
reviews.text: Selene is such an experience - don’t miss it if you’re in Santorini! We have been twice now and both times the service and food were outstanding. Their team even gave us a lovely gift as part of our honeymoon celebration.

reviews.author: dimitris chamzas
reviews.text: Wow, what an unforgettable dining experience! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Our waitress was absolutely wonderful—friendly, attentive, and made sure we were well taken care of the entire night. But the real star of the evening was Chef Giannis. The dishes were not only visually stunning but bursting with flavor! You can tell he puts his heart and soul into every plate. Every bite was a culinary masterpiece. If you’re looking for an extraordinary dining experience, this is the place. Highly recommend, and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Melissa Denise
reviews.text: There is a path that takes you here but it can get confusing because some of the path is covered by rocks. You will have to carefully climb around or over. Then you have to carefully balance yourself and walk along a rock wall! It is totally doable as long as you are careful! The area here is small so it can get crowded. I would bring good sandals or even water shoes. The water is so clean and blue and my boyfriend who swam said the water felt warmer since its protected by that big rock. It's disheartening though to see trash left behind by people. Any human that litters is trash themselves!!!

reviews.author: Chelsea K
reviews.text: One of the only spots to swim in Oia but very rocky and no sand. Only for good swimmers !

reviews.author: Kealan O'Ver
reviews.text: Great little swimming spot with a fun place to run and jump (or dive if you’re confident enough) from about 15 feet up.

reviews.author: Angela Petridou
reviews.text: A small harbour just below Oia , Santorini

reviews.author: Edmark Policarpio Pineda
reviews.text: Nice bay with plenty of restaurants

reviews.author: Cuddles Hugs
reviews.text: We found the beach 4 days into our holiday. I'm so glad we did. It made our holiday the remainder of the beaches. Are rocky a bit uncomfortable on the feet? You definitely need beach shoes to go into the water but not here.

reviews.author: Tom Ma
reviews.text: Nice beach, parking along the coast, tiny stones not sand but don't hurt the foot.

reviews.author: o f
reviews.text: I visited about 10 Beach in Greece in one month this beach fall at the bottom of my list. The beach was too busy, lots of people. I like my beaches quite. This beach is littered with beach bed stores and noise . It was sti nice to swim. I went as far as possible from the crowd. The waves and curent were just right to float and swim.

reviews.author: Sy
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Water is clear and cool. Free benches available, and bathroom not far.

reviews.author: Jillien C
reviews.text: What a day on this beach. The water felt so great. The scenery is unforgettable. We realized too late that wherever you eat, you can sit on the beach without purchasing an umbrella. We stayed on the beach for nearly 8 hours. Hopefully we will return tomorrow. Many restaurants along the water. Photos do not do it justice.

reviews.author: Fisnik Abdulai
reviews.text: Ergon Agora East is one of the best places in Thessaloniki for families and food lovers. The venue combines a high-end supermarket with a fine dining restaurant serving delicious Greek cuisine made from fresh, local ingredients. The large outdoor area offers an amazing view and a relaxing atmosphere, perfect for any time of day. A big plus is the well-designed playground, making it ideal for families with kids. Whether you’re shopping, dining, or just enjoying a coffee, the experience is exceptional. Highly recommended for both locals and tourists!

reviews.author: Al El
reviews.text: The place is an indoor market where you can buy a variety of groceries, including stalls featuring products from Japan, the USA, Australia, and other regions. You can also grab a tasty meal, though the menu selection is somewhat limited. We visited on a Sunday, and it was quite crowded, so we had to wait a bit to get a table and place our order. Overall, we liked the experience. Prices are slightly above average. One downside was that the doors to the street were left open, causing a strong draft. It was quite uncomfortable given the cold weather. Other than that, everything was good. The service was fairly quick despite the large number of visitors.

reviews.author: George “NeverLucky” Goud
reviews.text: A great place, combining both a beautiful market with local and fresh products, as well as a restaurant using these products for its dishes. Quality wise was very good, with emphasis on the local market and flavor from there. Atmosphere was also excellent with view to the sea side and sitting both outside and in. The only thing that could be better is the pricing, which I believe was a bit over the top for the specific dishes. Overall a great experience!

reviews.author: Silvana Vojkan
reviews.text: Love this place. Everything is so perfect. We have been here more than 5 times and coming back for more each time we are in Greece.

reviews.author: Can Cetin
reviews.text: Amazing experience near the sea. Stunning foodmarket in the entrance, must visit. We had lunch there and tried chicken breast and beef together with Greek salad. The taste was above average but considering the atmosphere, the taste was not that fascinating, but it was OK. Service was a bit slow, we had to wait for more than 20-25 minutes after we ordered. Overall, it was a great experience.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.text: Nice place with good service and food. We arrived around 23:00 when the kitchen was already to close about and we were still able to order the food. Thanks guys! The only one thing that I didn’t like and was disappointed that a lot of people were smoking inside which is normally no go in the restaurants of that level and very uncomfortable for those who are not smoking but have to be passive smoker in that case especially while eating! That’s actually very common in Greece while in the most European countries is forbidden to smoke in the restaurants inside and allowed only if it’s an open air area.

reviews.author: Lars Holmqvist
reviews.text: I was too hungry to take pictures! We had grilled octopus, greek salad, chili balls, a very large fish I don't know what it was, and very good white wine. I got quite full because my colleagues didn't eat like men should but I was quite content! Finished off with Ouzo and all in all this is a very good restaurant with attentive personnel.

reviews.author: Dr.Arafat Mansur
reviews.text: An Unforgettable Dining Experience at Mavri Thalassa Mavri Thalassa in Thessaloniki is a seafood lover’s paradise! The grilled fish was cooked to absolute perfection, bursting with fresh, rich flavors that transported me straight to the Aegean. The octopus was tender and beautifully seasoned, a true delight with every bite. But the star of the night for me was the baby calamari—crispy on the outside and so wonderfully soft inside. The service was fantastic, and the ambiance made the whole experience even more special. If you’re in Thessaloniki, this is a must-visit!

reviews.author: Barbara Venetikidou
reviews.text: Visiting “Mavri Thalassa” was been an amazing culinary trip! We received the highest level of food quality together with an absolutely amazing treatment by both the staff as well as the owner, Mr Tokidis! This restaurant is a piece of jewelry in Thessaloniki, just 20’ by car/taxi from Thessaloniki city center. I highly recommend it for its innovative Greek cuisine!

reviews.author: Tedi Chiavalon
reviews.text: A wonderful seafood restaurant with a long tradition. Excellent selection of fresh fish, shellfish, mollusks, and crustaceans. An outstanding wine list. We truly enjoyed the beautiful ambiance. Be sure to book in advance, as the restaurant is constantly full.

reviews.author: Xhulia Plaku
reviews.text: A very elegant market in the heart of Thessaloniki. Unfortunately, some of the shops were closed, and those that were open only offered tea, sweets and there were also a few small cafes. Anyway, the exterior architecture was very beautiful, and the interior decoration for Easter was also lovely.

reviews.author: CW
reviews.text: Nice place to visit, although we came on Whit Monday so a lot of stalls were closed. Quite fancy so not the typical market but more of an organic, artisan market. Some nice stores, handmade items and good quality purchases to be made here. Lovely architecture on the outside. Not somewhere you can buy things on a whim, but still worth visiting.

reviews.author: Ngân Nguyễn
reviews.text: It seems as a bazaar, which often implies a bustling, open-air environment with a diverse range of vendors. There are more delicious choices for lunch with fresh fish, seafood, or meat.

reviews.author: Kostis
reviews.text: I visit this little diamond every time I go to Thessaloniki. It's a historic market with tiny shops with local products. A must-see for every visitor who is nearby.

reviews.author: Deepblue Sky
reviews.text: I came there on a Sunday evening. It was open, though many of the shops were closed. A fancy and comfortable place to shop.

reviews.author: George “NeverLucky” Goud
reviews.text: A truly beautiful restaurant, hidden just aside of the city center, with excellent tastes and exquisite Mediterranean dishes. Everything was well made, each dish had its own twist and was truly special. Atmosphere it's easygoing with nice music, pretty helpful and friendly staff. Price wise it's a bit pricey, but the quality and quantity of the food absolutely justifies the price. I would suggest you to visit at least once, the menu is rotating and it's an experience worth tying! A hidden gem.

reviews.author: Evgeniya Dimitrova
reviews.text: We came in with high hopes and really wanted to like this place, especially since the concept and menu sounded intriguing. In fairness, we didn’t try the full menu, so this review is based on a limited selection of dishes. We ordered a salad, two starters, a main, and the two types of bread. Let’s start with the bread — unfortunately, both options were extremely underwhelming. Very small (apricot-sized) and quite possibly the worst bread I’ve ever had. 0/10. The tomato, strawberry, and peach salad had a lovely idea behind it, but lacked basic seasoning and overall flavor. It felt like a missed opportunity. 3/10. Service-wise, we weren’t informed in advance that dishes would come out one at a time. That would’ve been helpful to know, especially since we were hoping for a quick lunch (we had our puppy with us and I’m currently pregnant, plus it was very hot both inside and out). The zucchini dish was another letdown — I eat zucchini regularly and these were by far the most bland I’ve ever had. Again, no seasoning, no flavor. 0/10. The shrimp starter was the highlight of our meal. Tasty, well-prepared, and nicely balanced. 7/10. The squid dish, sadly, had a strange bitter aftertaste and little else going on flavor-wise. 6/10. Finally, the Mahi Mahi, recommended by our server (and the priciest item we ordered), was cooked well according to my husband, but not to my personal taste. 5/10. One thing worth noting: the staff were very polite and welcoming, and the restaurant was empty when we arrived, so service was attentive throughout. However, the entire experience took almost two hours and we only managed to finish the salad and shrimp. While we appreciated the ideas behind the dishes, the execution really didn’t land for us. Sadly, we won’t be returning or recommending it — but perhaps others might have better luck with different menu choices.

reviews.author: Ayhan İrem
reviews.text: We had one of the best experiences, food wise in Thessaloniki! 100% recommended!!! I leave here photos of a few dishes we tried, I forgot to take pictures of all the dishes we tried because I was in a trance! 😍💯💯💯

reviews.author: Dr. Nantia Iakovidou
reviews.text: We liked the langoustine dish and the fish soup very much. The rest of the food we tried was also very good and beautifully served. I definitely recommend this place and I would definitely go again to taste more dishes.

reviews.author: Carlos Gómez
reviews.text: Lovely fish place. All the food we taste was delicious. The wine they recommended us was great. Excellent service

reviews.author: Daniela Friedrich
reviews.text: Fantastic food, not so expensive and really nice and friendly waiter. The atmosphere is romantic, more French than Greek in a cute backyard. Many Ouzo, wine and beer. Great food, everything was so delicious and in a great quality. Very clean WC.

reviews.author: Goose on the Loose Travels
reviews.text: Start to finish it was all great. We had pureed yellow lentils and muscle risoto to start, both were fantastic. For main courses we had the sea bream and the sea bass and they were both perfect. Even the side of french fries were delicious. I highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: William Oliver
reviews.text: Perfect location and great terrace. We ordered many different dishes that were super tasty and prepared on the spot. Totally recommend it!

reviews.author: Guntram Kueper
reviews.text: The entrance didn't look friendly, so we had doubts whether we should get in. Get in! ;-) We had phantastic meal from the starters to the fish and were amazed by some wonderful desserts. Very good variety on the cards and only fresh fish if available will be offered. Also the seafood was fine (cuttlefish with onions) and very special - I can only fully recommend that restaurant!!!

reviews.author: Sofia P.
reviews.text: Beautiful little tavern right at the center of Thessaloniki,with a small yard with lots of plants and a fountain that makes you feel like your in a small plaza. Very tasty food,mostly the seafood,which I've tried repeatedly. There is also a wide range of starters and salads to choose from to accompany the food and drink. Polite stuff and good service.

reviews.author: I
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at this Greek taverna. We ordered a variety of dishes, and every single one was fresh, flavorful, and authentically prepared. You can really taste the quality in each bite. The service was friendly and attentive, making us feel welcome from the start. The location itself is warm and cozy, with a relaxed, traditional vibe that adds to the overall charm. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy delicious Greek food in a comfortable setting!

reviews.author: Φαίη Aβέρη
reviews.text: If you are passing by Thessaloniki you must eat here. The value for money ratio is literally insane. I could have never imagined eating a pork tenderloin this good and for the price of 7,5€. It was cooked to perfection making it juicy on the inside and grilly on the outside. The rice that it came with (it also had fried potatoes as an option) was also very tasty and not moist in a bad way like it usually is. We also ordered fried zucchini that came with tzatziki- it was crispy and perfectly seasoned. To continue with, the grilled pleurotus mushrooms were impeccable, so tender and delicious. We also ordered fried cheeseballs that were handmade and not frozen (something very rare) and an a la crème chicken that was also delicious. All portions were big and very well taken care of. Lastly they offered as some revani and sokolatopita (traditional greek desserts) for free. The service was also very fast and the waiters were so kind & friendly. As you can see the place is also beautiful and it wasn’t too warm even now in late June. We 100% recommend this place.

reviews.author: Nir Feldblum
reviews.text: Spontaneously passed by this place and decided to walk in. Got all local faces and no tourists around. The place had the Greek atmosphere with 3 elderly women in the kitchen preparing the food. It was so simple and tasty and got smiling face walking out of there. I even forgot to take photos of the food. After a long climb it is worth going in at lunch time. Enjoy

reviews.author: Monika Rajchlova
reviews.text: Wonderful Greek restaurant with delicious food and great ambience. We enjoyed our lunch so much we came back for dinner the next day and we will definitely come back again when in Thessaloniki in future 😍

reviews.author: Jane Marsh
reviews.text: Visited twice on our five night stay in the area. There is indoor and outside seating, we sat indoors on both occasions. The waiters were different both nights but all were superb moving in perpetual motion and taking orders in strict order of arrival. There were only two clearing and laying tables, serving food and drinks, taking orders and payment. The food was also very good. Would particularly recommend the aubergine and feta dish, lamb chops, fried squid and bekri meze. With water, a litre of wine and bread the bills came to around 35 euros. Highly recommended. They don't take bookings.

name: Street Stall - Aristotelous Sq
address: Street Stall - Aristotelous Sq, Thessaloniki, Greece

name: Street Stall - Kapani Market
address: Street Stall - Kapani Market, Thessaloniki, Greece

reviews.author: M
reviews.text: We love the sights and sounds of the market 🙂 You can get souvenirs like olives, cheeses, olive oil, sweets, olive oil soap, Greek delight in different flavours, Greek cookies & biscuits, herbs and spices - pre packed with a wooden spoon, in a test tube bottle or "smell before you buy" and much, much more. There is something for everyone in this market but it pays to shop around. The olive oil soap I saw in the 2nd and subsequent stalls cost only 75% of what I paid for.

reviews.author: Susan Blazek
reviews.text: Authentic open air market is one of the most interesting parts of the city. Fresh fruit & vegetables, nuts, spices & teas, just-butchered meat, religious articles, tavernas and bric-a-brac live side by side. Some great bargains to be found, and a feast for all the senses. (Can be smelly due to fish & meat!) Great for colorful, interesting photos.

reviews.author: Hana Pospíšilová
reviews.text: Interesting experience. The sellers offer different kinds of products (spices, candy, meat, seafood, vegetables, fruit…). However, it is challenging to park your car near the Kapani Market as most parking spots are full even in April, I can’t imagine how it looks in summer. You can smell seafood throughout the whole market so be prepared.

reviews.author: Miloš Mišić
reviews.text: I love this market and its location in the very center of the city. A lot of different products in one place and a lot of olives!

reviews.author: Gustav
reviews.text: Excellent local market that’s a must-do for photography lovers, and people who love people-watching. It’s colourful and vibrant and full of locals. Visit in the morning when it’s bustling. Beautiful olives, herbs & spices, and everything locals need to prepare traditional local dishes. Open from 8am , we visited around 11am and it was perfect.

name: Street Stall - Modiano Market
address: Street Stall - Modiano Market, Thessaloniki, Greece

reviews.author: Xhulia Plaku
reviews.text: A very elegant market in the heart of Thessaloniki. reviews.text: I came there on a Sunday evening. It was open, though many of the shops were closed. A fancy and comfortable place to shop.

reviews.author: Sue Vogt-Skard
reviews.text: After seeing some of the photos and comments about paying to enter we didn’t go inside as we were short of time but they were plenty of folks paying to enter but it was worth popping along en-route to see other places. Impressive outside. We did read up about it and got a feel of the place that way.

reviews.author: Matěj Kunc
reviews.text: What a building! A crowning achievement of late Roman architectural engineering. The building is monumental and massive, inspiring awe and wonder. The early Byzantine mosaics, although not that well preserved are still a sight to behold. And of course, who could forget the cats? The Roman Empire did not end, it was just transferred to the cats of the Mediterranean, who now run it :)

reviews.author: Cristiana Cioflec
reviews.text: The entrance costs 10€. It's quite an impressive construction, found in the middle of the buildings. It was usually a church, and became a mosque during the otoman occupation between 1520-1921. We didn't visit the inside of it, for us it wasn't interesting enough

reviews.author: Diane Huebner
reviews.text: This ancient church from 300 AD likely reflects the style of pre-christian houses of worship. The interior mosaics are sublime. The minaret was added later under Ottoman rule when it was used as a mosque.

reviews.author: Stefania Cocos
reviews.text: It's nice, but if you're not a fan of empty walls then don't pay 10e for nothing. Inside there are just a few remaining frescoes and that's about it. Just the walls, everything else you can see from outside.

reviews.author: Chrystalla Georgiou
reviews.text: Such a clean beautiful street, full of amazing boutiques cafes restaurants, buskers playing and singing Greek music. Just beautiful

reviews.author: Kaan Aslan
reviews.text: The city seems like starting here. Many cafes, restaurants, bars, and stores are located between this street and the coastline.

reviews.author: Nikola Miljkovic
reviews.text: Big boulevard with famous brands

reviews.author: Vuk Majstorovic
reviews.text: Famous shopping street with Greek atmosphere, lots of restaurants and local bars. You can find it all here, cheap and expensive.

reviews.author: Srđan Đorđević (Gumeni)
reviews.text: Great place

reviews.author: J. Mitchel
reviews.text: Historical tavern from the beginning of 10 century!!! In the hart of old town surrounded from historic monuments & churches !!! Food was nice, meat oriented & special salads!!! Don’t miss smoked eggplants, Batzos cheese, zucchini salad & kritamos salad!! Enjoy

reviews.author: Walter van Praag
reviews.text: We stayed in the airbnb on the square and came here for dinner by default. What a great surprise. Traditional local delicacies and a little glass of Mastiha at the end. Friendly service and nice food in a great hidden location away from the traffic.

reviews.author: Pea Jay
reviews.text: Discovered this place by accident on a Sunday evening. Old timey tavern in Thessaloniki. The cook might look like he’s distant, but a very warm and cool person. Music is played through a vinyl player. Delicious food, all prepared by the cook himself. We were very satisfied in the end. I’m not sure why there are people leaving negative reviews. Tip: don’t feed the cats, the cook himself feeds them by the end of the shift. 5/5 from me.

reviews.author: Alexandra Adamidou
reviews.text: Everything was perfect. Food is insane and the people who work there are so kind

reviews.author: Yiannis Chrysostomidis
reviews.text: Interesting dishes but nothing superb here. It’s near old Thessaloniki in a picturesque alley under the city’s old walls. Two people in the kitchen and one waiter that makes it difficult to service the place in peak times. Patience is needed to eat here at such times and could be welcomed if the food was spectacular but it wasn’t.

name: To Full tou Meze
address: To Full tou Meze, Thessaloniki, Greece

reviews.author: M
reviews.text: The restaurant was busy and we waited a few minutes to be seated. The waiting staff seem to have different roles as some were unwilling to take orders or bring the bill. The fried zucchini sticks were crispy and not at all greasy. The risotto was creamy & al dente and would have been perfect but the addition of cheese made it much too savoury. The warm beetroot salad was quite plain but some lemon juice & salt made it all better. We were stuffed and declined the complementary dessert.

reviews.author: Anastasiya Puchkouskaya
reviews.text: It was a really good tavern for dinner. Nice atmosphere, authentic design and polite stuff. Portions were big, prices on the average and food was delicious. Definitely recommended!

reviews.author: T. Tran
reviews.text: I visited this restaurant, Full tou Meze, for dinner, and despite the crowd, the service was prompt. Our dishes were served shortly after ordering. The portions were generous and delicious. The salad and grilled octopus are highly recommended—they were exceptional. As a delightful gesture, the restaurant treated us to complimentary ice cream at the end of our meal. This restaurant is definitely a great option for dinner.

reviews.author: michal weintraub
reviews.text: Very good greek food. Everything we ordered was delicious and there is a good atmosphere right in Ladadika st. Prices are fair also. The restaurant is very busy if you come late evening.

reviews.author: Danijela Fezer
reviews.text: The food is absolutely delicious, fresh and well presented. We had saganaki with mussels and mixed barbecue meet. Also, Greek salad was divine. The restaurant was full and all the staff was busy. House wine is on the menu, we chose Rose and we enjoyed it very much. The only thing that kind of wasn't excellent is we waited a bit too long to pay. But, it didn't matter as it rained a lot outside 😎. At the end, we got complimentary vanilla ice cream which was great. I recommend this place with my whole heart!!!

reviews.author: Chang Allen
reviews.text: Watch this before you go please! This restaurant is a trick, a lie! Michelin guide please notice this. It’s about the reputation of Michelin guide. I expected this restaurant pretty much. It’s famous for its history and traditional Campanian cuisine and Michelin gave them one star for “High quality cooking” which is totally not real. I skipped to judge the service part. The only thing you need to know is that they didn’t smile at all until you pay for the meal and that’s the end of all experience. When we sit, they didn’t even introduce their menu for today. It was a 7 courses menu. 150 euro per person. Firstly, the bread was so dry. I only ate a few because it cannot trigger my appetite at all. I tried many bread in Europe, this was the lowest quality bread. The starter they called Sushi style but I didn’t see any sushi at all. It was just raw fish without any cooking technics. It was cultural misappropriation. I felt insulted by this dish. (We are Asian.) Then, few dishes were using the same plain croutons, bad chopped, no-cooked tomato dice. If this was how Michelin called “High quality cooking”. I would rather spend 10 euro buy a bread, tomato, olive oil from any supermarket and chop them roughly. And throw the rest of 140 euro into the sea of Amalfi. Almost all the dishes were plain but the scialatielli in their menu was too salty. They had bad taste on their own seasoning. In conclusion, La Carevella has bad service, bad cooking quality, and their 7 courses menu was plain without any sincerity. But the Campanian wine was distinctive I couldn’t deny it. But it definitely doesn’t deserve a Michelin one star. This is a shame I follow Michelin guide and end up a bad experience like this. Let’s see how many people will spend more than 100 euro to eat “this”.

reviews.author: Jacob Thomas
reviews.text: The first thing to say about this place is that the service is exceptional. You are greeted at the door and from the moment you are shown to your table it already feels like an experience. We opted for the seasonal taster menu, which was the perfect amount of food for an evening dinner. The menu had a heavy emphasis on fresh, locally sourced produce of fish and vegetables. Each dish was nicely balanced and allowed the amazing quality of the produce to speak for itself. I also really enjoyed the decor, the artwork was unique and interesting, and the plates, cutlery, and wine glasses gave the place a feel of elegance but comfort. If you’re in Amalfi and are looking for an amazing experience combining excellent service and a varied taste of local cuisine and produce La Caravella is definitely worth visiting.

reviews.author: Paul Levatino
reviews.text: Fine dining at its best. Great price for the quality experience. Don't miss it if you're in Amalfi.

reviews.author: Janice Chu
reviews.text: The idea of this restaurant is supposed to be like dining in a museum - an art museum! To start this review, the food here is great and imaginative! The service is also attentive. You leave here feeling full to the brim. The one thing that deducts points from this overall experience may be the vibe and atmosphere of the restaurant. It is cold, awkward and uneasy to dine in a “museum”. The silence is deafening! Other than that, the food and presentation is delicious and beautiful which activates all senses. It is quite the expensive dining experience as well - we did the tasting menu for reference. There were not many tables ongoing as well likely due to the price point.

reviews.author: Vicki
reviews.text: My dinner at @lacaravellaamalfi is one of the highlights of the trip. The dining experience of a traditional but creative tasting menu and the artistic environment is one of a kind! When I found out about this restaurant gallery I was so excited to visit - and it did not disappoint! I can only post 10 photos here, but the decor and art pieces they have on display were so nice as well. My favorites were the lemon leaves with shredded fish, shrimp with ricotta cheese, and the “sun in the dish” aka giant lemon soufflé. Loved the local and fresh ingredients. I was so full and satisfied after the meal! Highly recommend to people visiting Amalfi who are looking for a nice fancy dinner to enjoy!

reviews.author: hollie dow
reviews.text: If I could give a 10 for the service I would! Everyone was so lovely- But the tall gentleman who seemed to be a head waiter, was incredibly lovely and welcoming, we didn’t have a booking for lunch but allowed us to wait for 20 minutes to find us a table, in that time we sat outside and enjoyed a lovely sparking wine that he recommended and a snack. When we got our table we sat down, waiters offered to take our coats and bags. We wanted everything from the menu, so enlisted our great waiter to recommend something for us- he did not disappoint! You MUST get the lardo to start. The pasta with artichoke and cured meat was probably the best plate of food I’ve ever eaten. The first day we had the poached pear - simple and divine. The second day we had the milk pudding - incredible and annoyed that I didn’t pack some in my suitcase home. We both left here feeling like we were being hugged by our stomachs! We proceeded to book a table for lunch the next day. I’ve eaten at around 8/9 of the well known restaurants in Bologna - this was the top. I did also say to my partner that it may be my new favourite restaurant and that I may have cheated on him with my pasta. I will be back!!!! @michelin - Bib Gourmand at least?

reviews.author: Gur Ozbelge
reviews.text: food is.. why we traveled here and it didn’t disappoint. I do LOVE tortellini in brodo and that’s what I wanted to try if I had a single meal in bologna. It was amazing. Mortadella was amazing, I wish it was this good in LA. Service was exceptional as well. I still remember the server’s face when I asked for a little red pepper for my brodo, he was baffled and tried to out it in kind words why red pepper would be overpowering but he would bring it if I wanted. I do love the passion & commitment to food, so I just switched to black pepper instead. I would be there in a heartbeat if I’m ever back in Bologna.

reviews.author: Martin Rosenthal
reviews.text: All' Osteria Bottega is a traditional restaurant in a quiet part of Bologna; a 10 or 15 minute walk away from the tourist flood. For lunch, my partner started with a salad while I had an eggplant parmigiana. For secondis, my partner had a pasta and I had lamb shank. Nothing astounding but all well executed. Make a reservation in advance. We called several days in advance and could not get a dinner reservation. We were able to get a 2:00 lunch reservation.

reviews.author: T. Voster
reviews.text: What an experience, classic bolognese cuisine with a service that was just perfect. Having arrived for lunch we’d hat to first sit outside a bit but within 15 minutes we got a spot. The essence of slow food is being presented by the kitchen & the servers. A wine collection that has been closely prepared made it even better. An amazing atmosphere for a saterday lunch, sitting inbetween friends & families. You can feel the culture & love of food.

reviews.author: Bartholomew Tan
reviews.text: One of the best meals we had in Italy - where tradition meets precision in the heart of Emilia-Romagna, the home of Italian cuisine. We expected high standards, but the level of refinement here was beyond what we imagined. The presence of solo diners who had travelled just to eat here speaks volumes. The tagliatelle al ragù was among the best pasta dishes we’ve ever had - the texture of the pasta was perfectly cooked, soaking up every bit of the rich, deeply flavoured ragù. But the real star? The pigeon - prepared to perfection, tender, and unbelievably juicy. The atmosphere strikes the perfect balance between elegant and homey, with attentive service that makes you feel truly welcomed. The owner personally greets each guest, adding to the warmth of the experience. An absolute must-visit - just be sure to book ahead.

reviews.author: JohnTsikoudakis
reviews.text: The second oldest trattoria in the history of Italy! Just that is a reason to come by and have a glass of Lambrusco! Apart from that, this place really made me feel like home! From rich to poor this place accommodates literally anyone and thats something really special, because you feel instantly a friend with anybody near you. Its about the energy. You have to experience this yourself! Feel free to take your snack and enjoy it for free there!! Loved it really!! Thank you! Keep the history alive!

reviews.author: HSE Surveys
reviews.text: This is a great place to visit if you are in Bologna, the wine and beer service, atmosphere are outstanding, the food is down to the individuals who want to use the establishment. You may struggle to find somewhere to sit, if that's the case go around the market place return and there will be somewhere. Well worth a visit and don't be put off if you don't speak Italian, the language of food and wine is universal 😉

reviews.author: Andrew Kanouse
reviews.text: Stopped in as part of a food tour, so the experience was probably different than it would be if we had just popped in. Ultimately, it's a vibe. It seems exclusively at this point to service food tours, which they seem to do well. We walked to the back by many other tables reserved for other groups. It's somewhat divey, which I think they lean into. The wines were pretty good and curated well for the tour. You're allowed to bring your own food, which is seemingly the thing to do. Would I venture here outside the tour? Probably not. But definitely serves the purpose for the tours.

reviews.author: nayana cariappa
reviews.text: We went here on our first night in Bologna and we're so glad we did! The vibe is electric andir feels like everyone and everything is alive! The bar is old school, homely and no nonsense. You get your own food from outside and share a table with strangers and just soak in the goodness of life. Absolute must do in Bologna! We had the spritz, a glass of the pignoletto and the valpolichella rosso- excellent.

reviews.author: Julie Kempen
reviews.text: This hostelry only sells wine or beer. Customers are encouraged to bring their own picnics. Very friendly service. There is no sign outside, so it is necessary to research and/or ask to find its location. We bought our picnic from the small market in a parallel street and enjoyed eating it in the outside courtyard of Sole along with one of the five varieties of prosecco on offer.

reviews.author: Diana Fusco
reviews.text: I was a bit skeptical about this place cause I had the feeling it was too touristy, but had a lot of recommendations about it and I had to try myself. I wasn’t totally wrong, but I had a pleasant dinner anyway. Firstly, the staff is very friendly, young and available. I came alone on Sunday night (it was also Easter) but they managed to fit me even if they were closing the line. They don’t take reservations. I sat on a table next to a family: since I travel alone, sharing the table is something that I personally like, even if others may don’t. The service is very fast. I ordered tagliatelle alla bolognese, nice portion but I’ve definitely had better ones in Bologna. Then I had mascarpone with berries, and it was delicious. I didn’t order anything to drink, and my total was 14€. Definitely a good price.

reviews.author: Filipchrd
reviews.text: Amazing food. They serve 1L jug of beer which I enjoyed. After the first plate of tortellini I was already filled enough to not need a second dish, however got it anyways. The staff is amazing and so kind, loved all of their tattoos as well especially the girl.

reviews.author: Boat K.
reviews.text: Food is delicious. Bologense is very excellent. The vibe is very low key with canteen style table. Its very crowded so make sure you go early before the big crowd hits. Its a must visit place in Bologna.

reviews.author: Hang
reviews.text: We visited this restaurant in the heart of Bologna that I had been to about five years ago. I remembered the food being a bit on the salty side back then, but this time everything was just right. We started with a pasta soup that I believe was beef-based — rich, comforting, and full of flavor. It was actually my first time having this type of soup in Italy, and I really enjoyed it. The pork steak topped with ham and melted cheese was indulgent (definitely high in calories!) but tasty and satisfying. And of course, the panna cotta was as good as I remembered — smooth, creamy, and the perfect way to end the meal. All in all, a great first meal to kick off our Italy trip before heading down to Tuscany. Would definitely recommend it for a hearty local experience in Bologna!

reviews.author: Aurelia Ghenuche
reviews.text: I've read that people queue here before the opening. Well... it's true. We were there at 12:03, and there were like 15 people queueing already, with over 30° outside. The place is small and it was quite hot inside. BUT. The staff is lovely, and the food is simply delicious. I must have had the best ravioli in the world. At least for me they were.
