reviews.author: Alex Heinrich
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of dining at Anna Maria Trattoria in Bologna for lunch. The food was good, with dishes that were both enjoyable and satisfying. While I found lunch to be adequate overall, the atmosphere truly captured the essence of a typical Bologna afternoon. The restaurant offers a selection of wines, including the unique option of "wines on tap," which is quite common in Italy. The service was very good, contributing to a pleasant and relaxed dining experience. If you're looking for a nice spot to enjoy a casual meal in Bologna, this is a solid choice.

reviews.author: GameXSergiuY
reviews.text: The bolognese pasta sauce is amazing and the fresh pasta is really good. I recommend choosing this restaurant if you want to eat some good bolognese

reviews.author: Hakan Uçan
reviews.text: I ordered lasagna and liver . simply delicious and perfect. cosy atmosphere and wonderful staff .

reviews.author: Monika Garbala
reviews.text: I'm from Poland and honestly... I'm confused by some of the reviews from my fellow Poles. This was one of the very few places that didn’t scream “tourist trap” – and I say that after a deep dive through Google reviews. The focaccia? UNFORGETTABLE. Just olive oil and salt – simple, perfect. Meanwhile, other places were serving something closer to cardboard. The pasta here was actually cooked right (yes, it’s possible!) and full of flavor. And the waitress? An angel in human form. Highly recommended for anyone who actually wants to eat well and not end up with soggy noodles that taste like packet pasta from a sad Polish supermarket.

reviews.author: Brenda Miller
reviews.text: We almost didn't end up in Bologna. What an unexpected delight! A to Z we spent a memorable. We hadn't made lunch reservations and lucked upon Anna Maria Trattoria! How lucky were we???? We'd spent a long day on Vespas touring the hills of Bologna and wound up seeing a great Rick Steves review for Anna Maria. Our server was attentive and helpful. The meal was tasty and fresh, AND dessert was literally (and figuratively) icing on the cake! If you find yourself in Bologna for a day, do yourself a favor and grab a meal here.

reviews.author: Ken Morton Jr
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my meal here. The staff is friendly and fun, and the food is excellent. It’s classic Bolognese cooking - high-quality local ingredients, simple, humble, and full of flavor. I had a great time bantering with the waiter, and the food arrived quickly without ever feeling rushed.

reviews.author: ros anchors
reviews.text: Absolutely delicious food and fantastic friendly service. We wanted to return but they are taking most of August as a well earned holiday which we totally understand. They even gave us recommendations for other restaurants. Well worth travelling from the centre of town to visit. The best food I have had since arriving in Italy. We would return when we are here again.

reviews.author: CY Lim
reviews.text: Had dinner here on a friend’s recommendation. Food was excellent. I enjoyed the primi dishes most. We also had a few of the daily specials e.g white truffle on egg which had a lovely delicate flavor. The restaurant also had a great selection of wines. Service was warm and friendly. The staff were young but were very knowledgeable about the dishes and wines. They added that very welcoming touch to dining at Bertozzi.

reviews.author: Tobias Gehrig
reviews.text: The food was okay, the service was a huge disappointment. After getting the first course, the waitresses went really every minute to the table to look if we finished eating (we ate at a normal pace). Once I finished my plate it was removed without any comment while my girlfriend still was eating. When she finished her plate they also removed it without asking or comment. After getting the second dish the procedure with showing up at a uncomfortable pace to clear the table one waitress stopped directly at our table, looked at us with a face of total boredom, disinterest and lack of any respect for distance and people eating at your establishment. This whole experience killed any kind of athmosphere and made an evening supposed to be relaxed uncomfortable and made us felt unwelcome and a necessity for the people working. I myself work at a fine dining restaurant and I get that sometimes you are looking if you can move forward in the menu at a table, but this was far from okay. There were only five occupied tables in the whole restaurant and we were obviously not blocking a table for others waiting (even this shouldn’t have been our concern). For this price you get at dozens places in Bologna comparable food. Do it, better get going!

reviews.author: Andrew Kanouse
reviews.text: Somewhat far from our hotel but with great reviews so we ventured out. And it's not a bad walk so we didn't really even mind it. Started with the mortadella mouse/potato souffle, which were a few interesting bites. We didn't think either of the pastas were standouts: gramigna & tortellini in brodo. The latter was particularly disappointing because it's one of the main dishes to try in the area, but it's just a bit boring (but maybe this is just what this dish is). We got a side of spinach that we probably didn't need but it was nicely done. Ended with the lamb chop, which was well cooked and the potato it was served with was perfectly lightly seared.

reviews.author: El Patron
reviews.text: The perfect location to grab some excellent traditional food in Bologna. Everything we had was beyond perfect. The tagliatelle al ragu and the raviolini Bologna ai pistacchi were really delicious but the simplicity and flavors of the tagliatelle ai funghi porcini were the icing on the cake. Also the best panna cotta (had a wonderful creaminess to it) I ever had. Truly a wonderful spot!

reviews.author: Yecheng Shen
reviews.text: For dinner, the prices here were a bit higher compared to nearby restaurants, but the portions were also noticeably larger. The lasagne was honestly the best I've ever had in my life – absolutely incredible! The tortellini was also very good. However, the cotoletta Bolognese was quite salty. This place seems to be very popular, as we had to wait a while for our food.

reviews.author: Eylul
reviews.text: Everything we ate was delicious. The carpaccio and the tagliatelle with porcini mushrooms were especially great. For dessert, the panna cotta was a perfect way to finish. It’s a high-end place in terms of price and quality, but don’t forget to make a reservation!

reviews.author: noa levy
reviews.text: Excellent hand made pasta, excellent service, traditional food with good products and an accessible menu. The opening hours are a bit more flexible than other places - which makes it the best choice when everything else is closed.

reviews.author: kristina lavin
reviews.text: Such a good idea to have the trio of Bologna’s famous dishes! Each one was so delicious. The dessert wine options were also incredible.

reviews.author: Kartik Sharma
reviews.text: Absolutely great food and ambience. Carefully selected ingredients, homely cooking. While it’s not hard to get good food in bologna this place will hit the spot for most if not all. We got the lasagna verde rich bechamel and ragu (on point), chicory salad and the artichoke salads both delectable. Recommend the brodo. Very much echo the other reviewers.

reviews.author: Sim Birgin
reviews.text: A very enjoyable place. The menu is simple and everything is delicious. We took Garisenda as a starter and continued with Lasagme. The main course was beef cheek with red wine and a bottle of wine as an accompaniment. We closed with tiramisu. All were very good. The recommendations of the waiter who took care of us were also satisfactory and sufficient. A true price-performance place. Definitely try it!

reviews.author: Dan Cere
reviews.text: Generous authentic food, rich, indulgent and earthy home comforts. The cotolleta bolognese with chicory was exceptional, pasta dishes excellent, great atmosphere and decor. Really great value for money. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: teresa fong
reviews.text: We had a day tour in Bologna and reserved a table for lunch after did some search online. We ordered insalata funghi, 2 tortellini, faraona (chicken with cream), cicoria (side dish veggies), 2 deserts (tenerina con mascarpone and zuppa inglese) plus a bottle of water with gas. The food is just right and we had an enjoyable lunch there.

reviews.author: Mademoiselle Adriana
reviews.text: HORRIFIC CUSTOMER SERVICE! They actually make an effort to be rude… My Regret Is Ever Bringing Business Here This was my fourth—and definitely last—time eating at this restaurant. I’ve regularly brought my team here during our trips to Bologna because of the beautiful view and the quality of the traditional food. The service was never impressive, but we tolerated it for the scenery and cuisine. We asked to split the bill—something that had already been agreed upon with our lovely waitress Maddy. She was excellent. Then another male waiter came over, ignored one of the girls who politely said she’d only had a drink, and without hesitation charged the entire bill to her card. He said “grazie” and walked off. No confirmation, no clarification—just blatant disregard. Despite being the first to arrive, we were the only table that didn’t receive bread, even though we paid the coperto. When we went to the till to address the issue, the man there didn’t offer an apology. He didn’t refund the coperto, either. He simply refunded the entire bill charged to the wrong person, so we could re-pay individually for what we each had. That’s the bare minimum—not service recovery. To make matters worse, while we were still at the till discussing the situation, another waitress shoved past us without a single “excuse me,” clearly irritated by our presence. It was unnecessarily spiteful and perfectly summed up the hostile energy we received throughout the meal. My biggest regret is having brought so much business to a place that, frankly, doesn’t deserve it. Bologna is full of fantastic restaurants with incredible food. What sets any establishment apart is how it treats its guests—and here, it’s clear they just don’t care. Lose the waitstaff with attitude and hire people who understand what customer service actually means. Good food isn’t enough if your customers leave feeling disrespected and angry. Cheers!

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.text: Disappointing. The pasta was luke warm, the pork was tasty and the sangioviese wine was good. The service was generally lacking. My husband ordered the panna cotta 'dessert of the day' yet was given creme caramel, see photo. When we asked the waiter told us it was panna cotta! Even Google said it was a caramel dessert!!! Unfortunately it was our only disappointing meal of our holiday. Whilst friends are visiting places we recommended elsewhere they won't be visiting Trattoria Serghei plus we will give the same feedback to our Airbnb host who recommended this restaurant.

reviews.author: Damian Bożewicz
reviews.text: First experience with bolognese cuisine and it was great. Portions were not very big but quality was amazing. I never had that good pasta before. The restaurant is open for just few hours and it might be full, so you might get lucky to get it. But also we've been served food within 10 minutes. Very fast. Very friendly small Trattoria

reviews.author: T C
reviews.text: Mama Mia! So good. I had Gramigna alla salsiccia. I will be back to this restaurant if I ever visit Bologna again.

reviews.author: Julien Mombet
reviews.text: Deceptive! Read a lot of good reviews and hoped to have a go at their highly-praised lasagnas. They were not available, therefore I went for the tagliatelle al ragù. Of course they were OK but not great, and compared to other places I already went to quantity was a bit “scarce”. Dessert was the same despite asking for a large chunk of the dessert of the day. Staff merely friendly, not offering any bread with my meal. Price OK but I’ll definitely won’t go back here or recommend to try it compared to other places I already tried.

reviews.author: Odette Yazbeck
reviews.text: While they were kind enough to fit us in between reservations, we had an hour, but felt very rushed. The pork chops were thin, bland and dry- no sauce, literally nothing else on the plate. While the two small stuffed zuchinni with meatballs were tasty, the portion was very small. Would not go back, nor would we recommend.

reviews.author: Natália
reviews.text: We had our dinner here, it was quite busy as it was one day before the new years eve so the serivce was quite slow but very nice. The menu had interesting options and everything was super tasty

reviews.author: Basma Loussaif
reviews.text: I had a good experience in this restaurant. We ordered a salad and a steak. Both were very delicious. The lady was very helpful to answer our questions specifically that we have some food restrictions (no alcohol and no porc). We finished with a mascarpone and a tiramisu and also were so good. Thank you.

reviews.author: Max
reviews.text: Friendly staff, plenty space in and outside and quick on order. Ordered the gramigna alla salsiccia for €10 and the next time ordered beef Ragu tagliatelle for again €10 and complementary slices of bread with order. Food was amazing and we even returned when we went back into Bologna for the last day of our stay

reviews.author: Viorica Wildes
reviews.text: It was a combination of bad service and bad food. It was still fairly early and they had only a couple other tables besides us, but we did not feel welcome from the very beginning. The waitress kept saying no to any question/request we had (ex. According to her they couldn’t even make pasta with butter or without anything on it for the kids) until the point where we said that we’re probably going to leave and she suddenly changed her mind. It was weird. Then the food came but not all as she forgot to order my husband’s food. And my lasagna was cold inside. To end, the waitress also put my leftovers in the same box with another person in the party that was sick at the moment. I cant think of anything positive about that dinner.

reviews.author: Olivier A.
reviews.text: 🍝 Don’t be deceived by the appearance of Restaurant Trattoria Tony – it’s a hidden gem! We were warmly welcomed and offered a lovely table on the terrace. The atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable, making you feel right at home. The dishes? The tartare was delicious and well-seasoned, the Cotoletta al tartufo was to die for, and the tiramisu was magnificent. Overall, it’s an excellent spot for a delightful dinner in Bologna. Highly recommended! 👏🇮🇹🍷

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.text: Incredibly delicious and fresh sandwiches genuinely the best I've ever had and I'm not usually a fan of sandwiches. The pistachio one was divine, the pistachio pesto was amazing and if I had time would have gone back to try more as there are so many options to choose from!! The bread is also so fresh you can see the staff carrying it to the shop and it's also warm!!! This is clearly a very popular place for good reason and they have very cleverly opened 3 stores so that wait times are very short. We also ordered one of the truffle ones and it is definitely very potent..

reviews.author: Roy Akiki
reviews.text: We tried All’Antico Vinaio and were really impressed by how fresh everything was. The portions are extremely generous—definitely come hungry. We ordered on the self-service machine, and since there was no queue, the service was super fast. One tip: I’d recommend asking to have your sandwich cut in half. While it’s delicious and packed with flavor, the size can make it a bit overwhelming and repetitive by the end. Still, absolutely worth trying!

reviews.author: Theo Koenen
reviews.text: What a sandwich!! So many flavour combinations that they have. Try something different, you won't regret it. The lines can be long, and it's worth the wait. Don't wanna wait too long, skip breakfast, they open at ten! People making the sandwiches are having fun. We couldn't finish it all at once, a great snack before dinner. Recommended!!

reviews.author: Benjamin Dibble
reviews.text: If you're looking for an amazing sandwich in Florence, then this is the place. With constant cues all day long, it's good to get there early. But don't worry it's worth the wait! The bread and ingredients are all fresh and they really do give you a huge portion. You'll see people all over the place sitting eating these sandwiches as you have to stop what you are doing to appreciate the taste. .. I will go out on a limb and say the best in Florence by far!.

reviews.author: Vlad Ivancu
reviews.text: Tried the famous sandwich here – it was good, with fresh ingredients and generous portions. But honestly, it felt a bit overrated. With all the hype, I expected something extraordinary, and while it was tasty, it’s not the best sandwich in the world. Worth trying if you're nearby, but be ready for long lines and high expectations.

reviews.author: Ben Vance
reviews.text: Exceptional Italian steakhouse. My wife was recommended this place by 2 separate people who’ve been to Florence before. The pear ravioli lives up to the hype and the steak was cooked excellently. Outstanding dining experience with good service. Highly suggest booking a reservation for lunch/dinner.

reviews.author: Fearless 1973
reviews.text: Outstanding experience!! Reservations are sometimes tough to get & worth the effort. I had the privilege of speaking to the owner before departure and found him extraordinarily humble & gracious. The restaurant has a warm, inviting atmosphere with candlelit tables & fine linens. Decadent, high quality olive oil & balsamic was a treat for me personally! Our waiter was professional & went above and beyond. I cannot say enough about my meal! I ordered the filet prepared in a rich, thick balsamic glaze. The steak was at least 3” thick, a healthy 8-12oz & a perfect medium rare!! 👏 👏 La Giostra was my absolute favorite dining experience in Firenze!! Someday I’ll return to their beautiful city & will probably make a reservation here for each night of my visit. Thank you for a beautiful dining memory. We really had a wonderful time at your establishment!

reviews.author: Max Krzyzaniak
reviews.text: A fabulous all around experience visiting La Giostra on our recent trip to Tuscany. We had arrived late to our reservation, so we started at the bar for cocktails in their cozy atmosphere. Drinks were great! As we got seated for our table, you understand how popular, maybe touristy, this restaurant has become. We were presented with handheld complimentary bites for the table, common around here, which were also delicious. Through our dinner service, our favorite entrees included the Pear Ravioli and a Lemon Chicken dish. These were truly incredible. The owner came by to wish my mother Happy Birthday many times and even came to sing with dessert. Such a warm, welcoming restaurant with true Tuscan nature.

reviews.author: Robert Burkett
reviews.text: Dining at La Giostra was an unforgettable experience that transported me straight to the heart of Tuscany. The moment I stepped under the stunning 16th-century brick vaults, I was enveloped by the warm, inviting atmosphere enhanced by twinkling amber lights. The authentic Tuscan flavors exploded in every dish, particularly the Florentine T-bone steak, which was cooked to perfection. Each bite was a celebration of rich, traditional cuisine that left my taste buds dancing with delight. The extensive wine list paired beautifully with the meal, showcasing the restaurant’s commitment to offering a genuine Italian dining experience. The hospitality at La Giostra was equally remarkable. The staff treated us like cherished guests, ensuring that our every need was met with a smile. It’s no wonder this cozy gem is a favorite among world-famous celebrities; the combination of incredible food and attentive service makes it feel like a home away from home. I can’t stop raving about the noodles, which truly were to die for! For anyone looking to indulge in remarkable Tuscan and Lorraine cuisine, La Giostra is an absolute must-visit. The smart-casual dress code adds a touch of elegance, making it perfect for a romantic evening or a gathering with family and friends.

reviews.author: Jerome Buisson
reviews.text: We spotted the place before travelling to Florence and it looked lovely. The atmosphere is certainly romantic and the menu is staggeringly, mouth-wateringly delicious! The food is flavourful, the service is great, the drink menu is extensive... what more to say than to recommend you to go there!

reviews.author: Yecheng Shen
reviews.text: I had the chance to visit this restaurant twice, first for lunch and then for dinner. My main takeaway is that there's a noticeable quality gap between the two experiences. The €12 lunch special was a real bargain, coming with drinks and no hidden cover charge. While the flavors were just okay, it was incredibly good value. Dinner, however, was a different story – the quality was significantly higher. The ragu was solid, and the T-bone steak was particularly impressive with its great texture. What's more, the dinner prices were quite reasonable.

reviews.author: Sameh Mina
reviews.text: We loved this place so much we came back twice during our trip! The steak was perfectly cooked, and the seafood pasta was fresh and full of flavor. The staff were super friendly and made us feel very welcome. Highly recommended if you’re in Florence!

reviews.author: Bevi Chris Cheung
reviews.text: Fantastic restaurant, fast & attentive service, wide variety of food selections, absolute delicious food from start to finish and super reasonable price. Their menu online and in restaurant are the same so you can see in advance. Cannot compliment this restaurant enough. Highly recommend anyone who is looking for a semi budget friendly, amazing resturant.

reviews.author: Isabel Tiger
reviews.text: One of our favorite restaurants in Florence! We were there several times last summer. It feels a bit more crowded and known this time. It feels authentic, has a great atmosphere, very friendly staff and great food. You can be a part of their WhatsApp group and get the daily lunch menu on the phone. The tiramisù is absolutely wonderful! The prices are great. We went there several times during our week in Florence recently, both for lunch and dinner (twice) and also only for the tiramisù. Cannot wait to go back. 😊 We never waited for Dinner since we made reservations.

reviews.author: Deborah Hatchell
reviews.text: We had been in Florence for 3 days before we discovered this little gem on our last night. It was a 50 minute wait on a Sunday night to get a table for 2 without reservations. I highly recommend calling ahead! The service was on point and the kind server spoke English. Food was delicious...my husband ordered a pepperoni pizza (predictably American) but, I'm a food adventurer, AND I love anchovies. I got a solid nod of approval from our server when I ordered the 3rd pizza option on their menu: Anchovies and Capers. It did not disappoint. The Peroni beers were cold and the server offered us to try an after dinner digestive liquor. Being a food adventurer, I said YES! I thought it was Amaretto from the label, but instead it was a very strong medicine flavored liquor that cured me of any sickness I might've had before the shot. HAHA! It was an incredible value: 2 big Peroni beers + 2 pizzas + 1 Tiramisu and 2 liquor shots = 33 Euros/$39 USD So glad we found this place and I hope others do, too.

name: Osteria Il Gatto e La Volpe
address: Osteria Il Gatto e La Volpe, Florence, Italy

reviews.author: Matt Baker
reviews.text: Eating dinner here was a fantastic experience. The staff were friendly and helpful, the restaurant itself had a truly unique atmosphere and ambiance, and the food... Well the food was bloody fantastic. It was our first dinner in Florence and I suspect it will be the best. Side note: Definitely take them up on their shaved truffle addition if they offer. Worth every (reasonable) cent.

reviews.author: Akınalp Fidan
reviews.text: We tried their pasta and gnocchi and both were good, I cant say they were best but considering interior design it was a decent experience. The wine was also good. Prices were not cheap but not expensive too. I can recommend it if you are looking for pasta or gnocchi.

reviews.author: Sofia Ilona Salzer
reviews.text: We walked in with a reservation for 3 while the place was fairly empty and were sat right next to the host stand area. We ordered the chef’s special Florentine steak with a side of the mixed veggies. The server asked how we wanted it cooked and said “medium? well?” and we said “no, rare” to which she replied “well?” to which I said “rare”. We went back in forth until she finally acted as though she understood “rare”. When they brought the steak out I confirmed by asking if it was going to be cooked rare and she said yes. We waited over half an hour wondering why would a rare steak take so long. It was because they were cooking the shit out of it. The steak was medium at best. And the veggies were incredibly bland as if not seasoned at all, and quite skimpy for €7, 4 thin slices of zucchini and eggplant and 2 slices of bell pepper. It was objectively a very good steak, but seeing the photos of the traditional rare Florentine steak in the reviews of the restaurant we left very disappointed. It is okay to have servers who are not fluent in English but it is not okay to have them pretend to understand when they do not. Also, the acoustic covers of English pop songs playing were quite insufferable. Unfortunately, this kind of music is present in many shops/restaurants. Just ask to be seated away from the speaker.

reviews.author: Riccardo Telesca
reviews.text: perfect place to eat typical and characteristic Florentine dishes, particular and very relaxing environment, ideal for resting after visiting Florence, very prepared and very friendly staff, very low prices for what is offered to the customer, absolutely recommended!!!

reviews.author: chariseeu
reviews.text: We had an amazing dining experience at this restaurant! For starters, we ordered the DOCA, which was absolutely delicious and set the tone for the meal. For our mains, we tried the PICI IN CARBONARA DI MARE and PICI SUL CINGHIALE —both dishes were packed with flavor and perfectly cooked. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making us feel welcome throughout the meal. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for fantastic food and great service.

name: Osteria Vini e Vecchi Sapori
address: Osteria Vini e Vecchi Sapori, Florence, Italy

reviews.author: Faryal S
reviews.text: Best meal I had in Florence, best service, best vibes. Stopped by on a Monday at noon and got a 2:30pm reservation straight from the owner who was trying to accommodate us. Ordered beef carpaccio (which I normally don’t like, but I loved this one), the pici with meat sauce (phenomenal), and the duck ragú (lighter, also great). Finished off with a fluffy, light tiramisu. The entire time, we were waited on with gusto and they were nice enough to cancel our main dish since we we got too full. I’d recommend you solidify a reservation via your hotel as this place is small and popular. But I’d eat here at any possible time it’s available. 10/10!!! They deserve all their fanfare.

reviews.author: Uyen Dang
reviews.text: A perfect last dinner in Florence. We made a reservation two weeks in advance and when we arrived about 20 minutes earlier, we were lucky to be seated right away. All of the food we ordered was amazing. The chicken liver pate was creamy and rich. The duck ragout pasta was perfectly cooked and the sauce has an amazing depth to it. I am usually not a fan of lamb because of the strong taste but this one was perfectly done, nicely charred the flavor was so good. I also recommend the ice cream cake dessert, it was extremely refreshing after a heavy meal. We also got free limoncello. The waiters were very attentive and the pacing of the food was extremely good. It was so busy but the service was top notch!

reviews.author: Jodi Parks
reviews.text: Our best meal in Florence!! From start to finish the meal was excellent!! We had a reservation (it’s a small place so make one if you can. we did see them accommodate as many as they could without them too) and they were right on time. Service was impeccable. Food was incredible. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!

reviews.author: Michael Chan
reviews.text: Small, cozy restaurant in the heart of Florence that severs authentic, delicious Italian food with even better service. Do yourself favor and book a reservation immediately when you arrive in Florence or via phone (1 week out). We were fortunate to dine here twice this week (yes, it was that good). Tomas and his staff are wonderful. They cater to both locals and tourists. Make sure you try the fried artichokes if they offer it. Yum! Butter and anchovies are also amazing and same with the ice cream cake. Definitely try to come here next time you visit Firenze.

reviews.author: irvin dominguez
reviews.text: Found this amazing restaurant in the heart of Florence. From arrival to end of our meal we had nothing but the best service from the staff there. They make everyone feel very welcome and went with their recommendations. All the dishes we had were fenomenal. Not a big fan of duck but everyone kept mentioning “Duck Raggu” and let me tell you the flavors are amazing! Definitely will recommend this dish, I don’t think any of our dishes were bad. All of them had amazing taste and quality ingredients. Definitely try to make a reservation since is a small place but full of life! We got lucky and were able to get a table for 3. But if you’re visiting Florence, try this dishes and let me know what you think!

name: Street Stall - Mercato Centrale
address: Street Stall - Mercato Centrale, Florence, Italy

name: Street Stall - Ponte Vecchio
address: Street Stall - Ponte Vecchio, Florence, Italy

reviews.author: Nancy Evans
reviews.text: What a blessing to visit and pray in the presence of the precious blood and unburnt eucharistic miracles. Thank you, Fr. Daniel!

reviews.author: DAVID SNYDER
reviews.text: Overlooked jewel well worth the visit, especially since the restoration work.

reviews.author: Amy Rock
reviews.text: The hours say open, but it is not. Updated hours would be helpful, so to not walk across the city for no reason.

reviews.author: Gianmarco Cantafio
reviews.text: Beautiful church but with some less comprehensible interventions during its interesting life. Here was undertaked Simone del Pollaiolo the architect who designed Palazzo Strozzi and the Loggia dei Tessitori

reviews.author: Steve P
reviews.text: Open hours posted by the entrance. A beautiful church. Certainly worth a visit. No photos or video is allowed inside.

reviews.author: Nicholas Ong
reviews.text: The food was good but it’s like other touristy Florentine restaurants, nothing special. We came because of various reviews but found them exaggerated and unreliable. Price is reasonable though. Reservation recommended as there is a line of tourists like us who probably read the same reviews!

reviews.author: S. S.
reviews.text: I don't know where to start. I would simply recommend this place with "Just Visit!" Reasonable pricing, down to earth and genuinely tuscan menus, attentive staff with no excessive fake kindness (it's my best compliment - might not be others cuppa) Artichoke cream gnocchi was the best. I'm just so sad I was too full to try more.

reviews.author: Andrej Halaszi
reviews.text: Sometimes when you're traveling, it can be really difficult to find the right place — somewhere you can truly enjoy a meal in a homely atmosphere. I'm not a fan of touristy spots or flashy restaurants. I prefer home-style cooking, something in the spirit of alla nonna. When I arrived in Florence, I asked my friends to take me to exactly that kind of place. And this restaurant was exactly what I was hoping for — a place where the food feels homemade and the atmosphere makes you feel like part of the family. From the warm, attentive, and genuinely heartfelt service to the cozy interior and, most importantly, the simple, delicious, and traditional food — everything here made me feel like I had suddenly acquired an Italian grandmother who just cooked me a real dinner with love and years of experience behind it. I highly recommend visiting this restaurant. Go for the traditional dishes. They might not be overly sophisticated or artistic in presentation, but what you'll get is that warm, comforting feeling of a homemade meal — even if you're miles away from home.

reviews.author: Jordan Putt
reviews.text: To say our meal was perfect almost feels like an understatement. Not only was the food delicious and fresh, but the service from our waiter Gabriele was so personal, warm and friendly. We appreciated his recommendations and humor, it took an already excellent experience one step better. Whatever they pay him isn’t enough! We also noticed that he brought the same level of service and personality to each one of the tables around us as well. All in all, a beautiful culinary experience combined with excellent service. Would come back here any time!

reviews.author: Lari Claudia Lungu
reviews.text: This restaurant is a must-visit! The food is absolutely amazing, bursting with flavor and quality. The staff are not only friendly but also incredibly efficient, working seamlessly to ensure a smooth dining experience. Service is impressively fast and well-organized. Due to its popularity, booking is highly recommended—it fills up right from opening!

reviews.author: kai wang
reviews.text: Warning!!! Do not go here!! Very sad that I chose this as my first pasta meal I had in Italy. Came here due to all the good reviews and talks about how this is a very authentic place Was extremely pumped to try Ordered Florentine steak and marinara pasta ….soon greatly disappointed Two other people next to us also ordered the steak One of which we struck up a conversation with because he saw us picking at our steak and told us he was also very underwhelmed with the food The other group next to us didn’t even bother to finish Marinara Pasta 2/5 Nothing special, pasta noodles way too soft and very underwhelming. Definitely had way better pasta. We were recommended by the person sitting next to us to go to Trattoria Sabatino instead. Glad we went for dinner! Way better! Florentine steak 55euro/kg and minimum purchase of 600grams. Expensive compared to other places. Nothing else to say besides…. 🤢 bad. Might be rated at the top of one the worst steaks I have ever eaten. I had 1/3 of my steak and stopped wasting my stomach on bad food.

reviews.author: Jay Wilson
reviews.text: Incredible hole-in-the-wall with authentic food and experience. We had the bolognese and Florentine steak. The pasta sauce was incredible - such a rich flavor. The steak was perfectly seasoned, if a bit on the rare side. We were lucky to get in for lunch without a reservation. It's not a big place, and the waiter said they are always full. We would definitely come back the next time we're here.

reviews.author: nicole lo
reviews.text: Truly amazing service by Mario’s familia! They were so sweet and friendly and the steak here was soft. Thought the steak would be too rare and tough but it tasted perfectly cooked and delicious. Had a nice hard sear and well seasoned. The tomato beans were also so comforting and tender. The place is quaint but bustling, felt like the real florentine deal!!

reviews.author: Andrew Rose
reviews.text: I'm a bit of a steak snob and stopped ordering it out as it's usually disappointing. The T-Bone here is amazing! Super soft inside, wasn't asked how I wanted it cooked which to me should be how every steak restaurant is. Came out rare. Very friendly and accommodating, managed to squeeze us in for an hour but would recommend pre booking a spot. Wish I'd come here earlier in our trip as I've only eaten the steak an hour ago and already want more. Various size steaks so if you want a bigger one ask for it, ours was 700g. Also had the meat pasta which was also delicious and the best one of our trip. Paid around 51 euros for the steak and pasta dish which I think is excellent value

reviews.author: Jakob Laukeland
reviews.text: Came in with a reservation and was luckily seated in the basement. Upstairs was way more crowded, and way warmer. Service was nothing special while we ordered and received our food. However there was more energy when we entered and left the restaurant. The biggest caveat was the wait. We waited well over 30 minutes for our food, probably closer to 40. The italians who came in after us got their food first, so there was maybe some bias there. Actually, 3 other tables that ordered after us got their foof way before us. Luckily, the food was amazing.
