reviews.author: Ben Corby
reviews.text: Amazing soulful food, couldn’t recommend it more. From starters to dessert, everything was delicious. From the minute you walk in you feel like you walked into your Italian grandparents home. Did not feel rushed at all even though there was a big queue outside, make it so much more enjoyable and welcoming. The staff were also very friendly and accommodating! We cannot wait to come back when we are next in Florence!

reviews.author: Gizem Agca
reviews.text: We waited for about 45 minutes to get in, and it was totally worth it. Amazing roast beef and excellent red wine. It became our favorite restaurant during our trip to Florence. We even went back one more time before leaving. Everything from the salad to the dessert was absolutely delicious. The staff are also very friendly and welcoming. Prices are also very reasonable. Thank you for everything!🤗

reviews.author: Casey Duncan
reviews.text: Come early and expect to stand in line, but it is worth it! If you want to feel like your eating dinner at your Italian Grandparents family get-together, then this is the place. We waited in line about 30 minuets, and then was seated at a table with other diners already there. Even with the language barrier, the others were friendly and made you feel at ease. The servers were to the point but patient with us foreigners. The food was outstanding. Nothing over the top "Touristy" like the rest of Florence. Just good, authentic Italian food. If you want to experience Italy, then you need to experience Trattoria Sabatino.

reviews.author: Sarit Shah
reviews.text: Found this restaurant by chance, came here for an evening meal. The queues begin before the restaurant is open. We came at 8:30 in the evening and got seated at 9:40. The queue is long but it moves fast as people eat then leave. It serves homemade food with a first, second course with sides and dessert, the quality of food is good for a traditional Italian trattoria. For a family run business the service is very good, the staff are attentive. Prices are reasonable and affordable. Recommend to come here as early as possible and try the food here. You will be satisfied.

reviews.author: O T
reviews.text: Ever seen a restaraunt that has the best food in town and lowest prices too? THIS IS IT!!! $5 for pasta and 6/7$ for main courses. It’s not a Michelin institution, more like coming to your grandparents for dinner. Best millefolie I ever had. I don’t know how they do it as all eateries around are twice the price. Not a very long menu - pasta only comes with tomato or meat sauce, but it’s super good. Be prepared to be seated with other people too - if you are a party of 2/3 you may end up sharing a bigger table with other folks. They open at 7:15 on weekdays , we came at 7:15 and the line was about half an hour, but totally absolutely worth it. Lunch is 12-2pm, no line. Very fast and very friendly servers. Highly highly recommend.

reviews.author: Benny CHAN
reviews.text: First time there. We had reservation but had to wait a bit which is alright given its popularity. We were politely led to our table with menu introduced. We ordered steak, Los lobster spaghetti, mashed potato and clam soup. All of them are impeccably cooked. The lobster is fresh with a huge portion of pasta. The steak is perfectly timed and cooked with a nice grilled taste by charcoal. The clam soup is thick, lovely flavoured with very fresh clams. The staff are polite, helpful and responsive. The atmosphere is very good. They deserve 5-star at all fronts.

reviews.author: 游逸雯（Evelyn）
reviews.text: When visiting Florence, Italy, a friend highly recommended Zara Restaurant, and it absolutely lived up to the hype! Since my friend and I don’t have big appetites, we decided to share a T-bone steak cooked medium-rare. The outside was beautifully charred, while the inside remained incredibly tender and juicy — simply mouthwatering! The complimentary bread on the table can be refilled endlessly, and we loved pairing it with olive oil and red wine vinegar, which the staff gladly provided. It was so delicious that we ended up coming back every day during our 5-day stay in Florence! We even reserved our table for the next four days right then and there. The interior decor is stylish and distinctive, creating a cozy yet elegant atmosphere. With such a pleasant overall dining experience, it’s no surprise that the place is often packed — advance reservations are highly recommended. We had a truly memorable time and will definitely be coming back next time we’re in town!

reviews.author: Cheryl Lye
reviews.text: We went for lunch around 1:30 p.m. without a reservation. There was a queue, but we only waited about 15 minutes before getting a table. The restaurant is quite spacious and lively, with a great atmosphere. We ordered the lobster pasta, sea bass, sangria, and a smoothie—and everything was absolutely delicious. The lobster was incredibly fresh, and the pasta was full of flavor. Prices were very reasonable too—my lobster pasta was only around €22, which is great value for the quality. Despite how busy it was, the staff were friendly and welcoming. You may need to get their attention during peak times, but they always served us with a smile. I also appreciated that there was no pressure to tip and they let you enjoy your meal at your own pace. Overall, a fantastic experience from start to finish. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ольга Берещук
reviews.text: The restaurant is just great, all the dishes and even cocktails are super tasty. The service is really very fast though there are many people there all the time. We didn’t have reservation so we had to stand in a queue, it was very fast about 15 minutes though it was long. I do recommend this restaurant if you are looking for a vibrant place to eat, delicious dishes of Italian cuisine plus nice design and good music

reviews.author: Nandini B.
reviews.text: Super tasty and fresh pasta! I especially loved the tomato and basil gnocchi. Ambiance is nice, I recommend sitting outside! Be sure to get a reservation ahead of time for dinner! 4 stars because the food was great but the service was pretty mediocre.

reviews.author: Joshua Fields
reviews.text: Some of the best Value you can get out of a tasting menu. The Mare menu 5 course was excellent, the dry aged fish, Bottoni Molluscs, Risotto, and Monk Fish were all wonderful. Portions were nice and Breads were plenty.

reviews.author: Andrea P.
reviews.text: Great first experience in a starred restaurant. Food was unbelievable! We had the classic menu, 5 courses picked by the chef (the last one is always a dessert). Amouse bouche really appreciated and some of them super tasty - my favorite was the pickled fennel! Focaccia was super soft and truly an helpful tool to do ‘scarpetta’. Tortellini with pesto was mind blowing too! A wonderful experience, the service was very attentive and explained every dish with all the details. My only side note is that the service was extremely slow, about 30 min in between courses, a bit too long in my opinion, considering the restaurant was almost empty. Also a backhoe music would be appreciated as it was super quiet inside and almost felt awkward to talk! Price is right for the experience- definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Francisco Martucci
reviews.text: By far the best culinary experience I have had in Italy. The place was beautiful, right next to a window with a great view on the top floor. The staff could not be better, they were friendly and even though there was some limitations on the language it was still a great experience. The prices were not high for the quantity and quality. No doubt that I would come back here. If you are a tourist or local you must come and visit this place. I still cannot believe a paid 30eur for all these dishes.

reviews.author: Cam Pinkney
reviews.text: Beautiful 5 course dinner with many options to choose from. Great wait staff as well!

reviews.author: Jor Bee
reviews.text: Good food, great service, nice view. Fun to do a bit of food shopping after dinner. Very upscale market. Fine dinning restaurant. More so than Eataly or the restaurant on the ground floor. My second visit and I'd come back for a third.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: I know you are looking through reviews to make sure you find a place you’ll like. Go here, trust me, it is amazing. Had the best pasta we’ve ever had. Absolute perfection! Best pasta in Italy. Can’t say enough. Get anything local and you will be impressed. I am sure the rest is just as amazing but we only had local dishes when we wen’t. The service was top notch, smiles all around. Every staff member smiled and made me feel more than welcomed. Me and my wife, Emily, are fairly critical when it comes to going out to eat and we were hands down impressed with this restaurant. Worth it a million times over. Thanks you so much for a fantastic experience. You are the best and hard work deserves recognition. I hope we get to come back one day.

reviews.author: Peter Huang
reviews.text: Is Le Rune the best restaurant in Genoa? I wouldn’t know, I didn’t eat anywhere else. After the first bite of my “poker” mixed seafood, I knew I would be back the next day. The food was top notch, every bite richly flavourful. Genoa is famous for its pesto? After their trofie pesto I now know why! Not just taste, but texture was well considered. The fish in their local stockfish stew was “tough”, not an attribute I usually like in fish, but it worked marvellously with the soft potatoes! Similarly their stuffed squid was exactly the right texture (important for squid). If the food wasn’t reason enough to come back, I would have probably came back for their warm and welcoming service and smiles. I ate both my dinner in Genoa here and had I stayed another day would have eaten there again! With any luck I hope to have the opportunity to eat at Le Rune again!!

reviews.author: Guillaume Pourtalet
reviews.text: Superb !!! Friendly staff, delicious food and excellent wine selecion. We had a great time. Thank you.

reviews.author: Yan Leng Vuong
reviews.text: Good Michelin recommended restaurant. We were lucky enough to get a dinner reservation on the same day. The restaurant is very cute and cozy, we had a table in the backyard, it was very hot as the wind doesn't flow. Food review incoming. The cod spread was amazing, actually the best dish from our dinner. We had the signature Genoa pesto pasta. The grilled octopus was well seasoned and also well cooked. Finally the rabbit was delicious, most and tasty.

reviews.author: EmiLem
reviews.text: The food and wine was amazing! Definitely try the focaccia and trofie. The owners were lovely and welcoming, great evening, thank you!

reviews.author: Jakub Jastrzębski
reviews.text: This is a restaurant with a higher price but the food you are getting is really worth it. We went there on Friday evening without reservation but if you're trying to go there on Saturday, make a reservation before. One of the best in Genova

reviews.author: Paul d B
reviews.text: Came here because of a recommendation from a good Italian friend and it did not disappoint. The portions are big, fresh and very tasty. A must eat is the fried seafood and the lasagne with pesto, a signature dish. Order a bottle of white local wine and you are set for enjoyment.

reviews.author: Josh “Focus”
reviews.text: Delicious seafood. Good sized wine list. Wine by the glass is not a thing here.

reviews.author: Kevin Kay
reviews.text: We made the reservation a month in advance, based on searching the Michelin site. WOW! The food was incredible. In our 10 days in Italy, the lasagne pesto here was the best thing we found!

reviews.author: Emma Voysey
reviews.text: Wonderful higher end Italian restaurant offering delicious homemade foods including their own freshly baked breads & pastas. We ate a light dinner sitting outside as the darkness fell, overlooking the amazing ancient centre. Set back far enough from the “Porto Antic” for it not to be thronged with a gazillion tourists. The waiting staff were charming & brought a bowl of water for @JackRussellMikey. The shrimp linguine with carbonara sauce was was DIVINE. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Kasper B-A
reviews.text: A lovely restaurant with tradition, decent prices and wonderful staff. Particulary the staff who goes above and beyond. The restaurant was opened in 1939 and has passed down three generations. The visitors include both popes, Frank Sinatra, Madonna and Pavarotti. The staff are friendly, know their craft and have good humor. This is a must place visit in Genoa

reviews.author: Alexey Astafurov
reviews.text: Just had the most incredible experience at this restaurant 😍✨ **Zeffirino Genova** is a renowned Italian restaurant located in the city of Genova, Italy. Known for its exquisite Italian cuisine, it typically features a menu that emphasizes fresh seafood, homemade pasta, and traditional Ligurian dishes. The restaurant seeks to provide an exceptional dining experience, blending culinary tradition with contemporary techniques. Zeffirino is particularly famous for its beautiful waterfront views, making it a popular choice for both locals and tourists. The restaurant often garners praise for its ambience, attentive service, and high-quality ingredients. If you are interested in specific dishes, wine pairings, or reservations, I can provide more detailed information.

reviews.author: Andy Huang
reviews.text: Super awesome restaurant in Genoa. Highly recommended. It has a lot of history and the team that is running the restaurant is third generation. The food is amazing and very high-quality. I love the vibe and their service is super fantastic. The restaurant is very well decorated in the team is lovely. very Italian.

reviews.author: Juan Ovalle
reviews.text: We had lunch as a group of four and, while the experience wasn't bad overall, it's not a place we'd choose to return to. We started with the eggplant with Parmigiano, which was decent but not particularly memorable. For the main course, I had the filetto di manzo with red wine sauce. Despite its €50 price tag, the meat didn't seem properly aged and the sauce lacked depth. The other dishes we tried - carbonara pasta and chicken with peppers - were also just average. Perhaps we probably didn't make the best choices from the menu, but at a total of €270, we expected a consistent level of quality across all dishes. There are definitely places that offer similar quality for at least €80 - €100 less. That said, the service was excellent - the staff was professional, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcomed.

reviews.author: Gheorghe Sonia
reviews.text: We got there late around 10 pm, but the stuff was great serving us food and drinks. We got the focaccia for starter, from the home, it came perfectly because we were hungry. The recomandations were exactly as they said. We had different kinds of fish, and pasta sea food, the pasta delicious, like all of them. We got the dessert also and it was perfect. Thanks a lot.

name: Street Stall - Piazza Caricamento
address: Street Stall - Piazza Caricamento, Genoa, Italy

name: Street Stall - Porto Antico
address: Street Stall - Porto Antico, Genoa, Italy

reviews.author: Marco Candela
reviews.text: Tipical "porticato all'italiana" where you can find all sorts of food and goods, from the genoese fry fish to south american dishes, from modern fish burgers to 80's style cafes.

reviews.author: Zoe Giordano
reviews.text: A covered street near the old harbour of Genova. You can find fresh fish, street food, shops and bars.

reviews.author: Luigi Crosetti
reviews.text: Historical place in Genova heart of the Old medieval commercial site

reviews.author: Abubakar Livingstone
reviews.text: A nice place to go for shipping and the stuff working there are kind

reviews.author: Gsmcrazy
reviews.text: This is nice place to visit , it's historical place ..

name: Street Stall - Via Garibaldi
address: Street Stall - Via Garibaldi, Genoa, Italy

name: Street Stall - Via XX Settembre
address: Street Stall - Via XX Settembre, Genoa, Italy

name: Trattoria alle Due Torri
address: Trattoria alle Due Torri, Genoa, Italy

reviews.author: Katherine Schutte
reviews.text: Coeliac heaven! They have a seperate gluten free 'senza glutine' menu with lots of choice. I asked for gluten free bread when they brought out gluten bread for my family and they happily provided a soft white roll. For my main, I went for the Pansotti with Walnut Sauce because I am vegetarian, and it was mind-blowing! I have never had gluten free ravioli so it was an absolute treat to experience this! The walnut sauce was so delicious, a cheesy, nutty, creamy flavour and the pasta tasted amazing with a great texture. The portion size was generous - I was full but I couldn't leave with ordering a gluten free dessert haha! There were about 5 different gluten free dessert options, including gluten free tiramisu! I was SO happy! And it lived up to my hopes and expectations - a fantastic taste and texture. Can't recommend this restaraunt more to anyone looking for great gluten free food in Genoa. Excellent service, friendly and helpful staff, and a lovely setting.

reviews.author: Erin King
reviews.text: We stumbled upon this place after our planned restaurant was closed for Labor Day, and we were not disappointed! The care put into identifying allergens in the meals was so appreciated, as we were travelling with a family member who can’t eat gluten. We all thoroughly enjoyed our meal and are now so sad our visit into Genoa was only one day, as we’d love to return to try something else! Would highly recommend for both deliciousness and ambiance. 10 stars.

reviews.author: Barbara Flanigan
reviews.text: What a wonderful, beautiful place. My husband is celiac, vegetarian,and they have handmade pasta, gluten free with walnut sauce. He even received a gluten free bun. I had a steak, cooked perfectly with homemade chips. The staff was very kind and helpful. This was a great find. The history of the building made it even more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Sapna H
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the food here! Everything was so flavourful and perfectly prepared; I have no feedback on what they can improve upon. My Italian is very limited, but the server was very patient and kind. The restaurant itself is nice and cozy, making a great spot for a dinner date. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.text: What a charming little Italian experience. We were so impressed, not only with the food, atmosphere and experience, but the lengths at which this little restaurant went to highlight and outline all of the common allergens in the dishes In our group, we had 2 people with food intolerances and had no problem choosing meals that were safe and delicious without having to ask a single question! Perfecto!

reviews.author: Peggy Hankins
reviews.text: Walking around Genoa, looking for a place to eat lunch and it looked like nothing opens before noon! We spotted this place in a narrow back street and made our way back there just in time to beat the crowds that had already made reservations. This was our best meal of our trip so far, and the best steak I have tasted in years! If you can get a table, we highly recommend it

reviews.author: Azadeh Hosseini
reviews.text: Great place to spend your dinner date; lovely and helpful staff. The food was gorgeous. We had first dish which is pasta with green fresh pesto (Genoese) then had beef fillet steak with peppercorn sauce & my husband had fish basket. Reasonable prices. They close at ten so make sure you get there early.

reviews.author: Gianmaria Griglio
reviews.text: Good local trattoria (not fine dining obviously): the decor is fairly charming in this small restaurant close to the old port of Genoa. The trenette and the trofiette, both hand made, deliver on what they promise and the pesto is creamy, tasty, with just a hint of garlic, definitely one of the best I've tasted. The fritto was ok: very well cooked (no gummy calamari) but the batter was too thick and somewhat lumpy. Most likely it suffered a bit of heat in the kitchen which caused the batter to thicken. Good quality-price ratio.

reviews.author: Ewelina Majcherczak
reviews.text: My experience with this restaurant was great. Food was tasty (I don't remember when I ate that good) , service busy but kind. I can truly recommend it.

reviews.author: M J
reviews.text: This is a very good and authentic Italian restaurant. We suggest eating the local and famous dishes such as the Pesto Genovese. Note: there is an extra sitting fee for each one who eats, as custom in Italy

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.text: The dishes are great, well balanced and very tasty. However, the overall experience is diminished by a very hasty service, crowded seating, little attention from the staff and a alcohol free drinks menu consisting of water, fanta and cola. This last fact was also noticed by a pregnant lady next to us and she did not appreciate it. How can you have 20 wines but only 3 alcohol free options in 2025?

reviews.author: Melody Ma
reviews.text: Food was good - enjoyed the lasagne and the fish and potato salad starter but service was way too fast, which is great for hungry souls who just want to eat and go. For those who want to have a proper socialising meal, I feel the pace is too rush and tables are too closed together - can overhear conversations and wine got knocked off the table as someone was passing by the table.

reviews.author: Zennure Danisman
reviews.text: We had dinner at the place and of course we had pasta with pesto the iconic one 👌🏻💚 It was delicious, the pesto was so fresh that you can really understand the difference. We didn’t have the reservation, since we prefer to sit outside to feel the ambiance of Piazza De Ferrari. By considering it’s a favorite and wellknown restaurant with also Michelin recommended the prices were quite reasonable too! We started with beef tartare and had a local red wine 🍷 In brief, it’s highly recommended 🙂

reviews.author: Erin Call
reviews.text: A beautiful place that gets full very quickly! Make a reservation and get three courses for sure! Loved it. The waiters were so kind, the atmosphere was lovely, and of course delicious food!

reviews.author: Elysabeth Chaitoglou
reviews.text: Good food and fast service. Thank you for the no reservation table , we didn’t wait at all !!! The view is good and the wine perfect. We had the pasta and a Genova cheesecake . I recommend you.

reviews.author: Roman Hans
reviews.text: Just loved it. Like the best Italian grandma would make, and you can taste the love in every bite. We were just about fighting over our favorites. You are safe ordering literally anything, but don't miss the pasta with pesto. The wonderful waitstaff made even these clueless tourists feel welcome. Don't miss.

reviews.author: Edina Szabó
reviews.text: We arrived at 7:30 PM without a reservation, and the staff seated us, informing us that we could stay until 8:45 PM, which was acceptable. The staff was average, and when we asked for help with the menu, they refused to speak English. Since we were hungry, we stayed and ordered. The food was average; the meat was chewy, the pasta tasteless, and the mixed seafood was the only dish we enjoyed. It would have been better to leave. The place dont deserve the hype.

reviews.author: Boris Mateev
reviews.text: If in Genoa, you must eat try Ugo! Great local food, amazing atmosphere in the center of town on a charming small side street. Outstanding experience, thank you!

reviews.author: Ercan A.
reviews.text: Good location combined with tasty food. The atmosphere is very warm with lots of tables and chairs. Those people who want relaxed seating and quiet ambiance may not find this restaurant comfortable.

reviews.author: Jake Higgins
reviews.text: The freshness of the ingredients is they key here. Came for their pesto pasta but was not totally convinced. It's not a knock you off your seat meal by any means and the flavours are very simple. Well worth a try while in Genoa but not sure this is the one I would recommend.

reviews.author: Amine Fahel
reviews.text: Stopped by Luini near the Duomo for a quick snack and tried their famous panzerotti. Opted for the classic fried one with tomato and mozzarella—absolutely delicious! The dough was perfectly crispy on the outside and soft inside, with gooey cheese and flavorful tomato sauce. There was a line, but it moved quickly, and the staff handled orders efficiently. At around €2.50 each, it’s an affordable and tasty treat. Definitely worth a visit when in Milan!

reviews.author: Chao-Yang Fu
reviews.text: Since it is not expensive, you can combine several tastes for a meal. The staff is very kind as well. It is recommended to have top few salty option because the layer is crispy. Others' layer taste like a pizza bread.

reviews.author: ugurcan arbaz
reviews.text: Luini Panzerotti is an iconic spot that everyone looking for a quick bite in Milan must visit! Located right in the city center, just a few steps from the Duomo, you’ll almost always find a line in front — but don’t worry, it moves quickly and is absolutely worth the wait. Their panzerotti are freshly made, served hot, and perfectly textured. The classic tomato and mozzarella filling is a must-try: the outside is slightly crispy, while the inside is soft and filled with deliciously melty cheese — truly an unforgettable taste. They also offer sweet and alternative savory options to suit every preference. Prices are very reasonable, making it an ideal choice for a quick meal or a perfect street snack. Since the place is quite small and there’s almost no seating inside, be prepared to enjoy your panzerotti on the go. In short, visiting Milan without tasting a panzerotti from Luini would be a real miss! Great flavors, fair prices, and an unbeatable central location make it a must-stop!

reviews.author: Nii NII
reviews.text: Nice location. The queue went extremely fast. Friendly staff. I tried the mozzarella panzerotti. Affordable snack, flavour was extremely simple tomatoes and cheese. I enjoyed the Nutella tarts with nuts on top and a shortbread type pastry. Would return if in Milan.

reviews.author: Maricris Guevarra
reviews.text: A must-try! The food tastes incredibly fresh and delicious 😍 absolutely worth the money. We loved it so much that we went back on Sunday, but sadly they were closed. It’s just a short walk from the Duomo, tucked away on the left side. 🥖🥐🥯

reviews.author: Özgün Uçankale
reviews.text: I really loved the atmosphere of this place. Everyone is hanging out in front of the restaurant with a glass of wine, chatting and enjoying themselves; and the crowd is great. The restaurant uses high; quality drinks, and I’ll definitely come back every time I visit Milan!

reviews.author: melisa solakoglu
reviews.text: What a lovely place to spend a cold winter evening! Me and my friend enjoyed this place so much. We ordered a bottle of wine and a cheese board which was very good. And my friend loved the peeled almonds I took a pic just to see if I can find it somewhere else :))

reviews.author: Gyuna Bak
reviews.text: One of my absolute favorite spots in Milano! The wine selection is great and there’s non-alcohol option too! Amazing atmosphere and great place to have friends and chat. Live music was going on too! Miss this place sm

reviews.author: Gizem O
reviews.text: This place is a good choice for a date, a special celebration or even for casual night out. You can sit outside or go downstairs which has more warmness and a special athmosphere. They have plenty wine options and the waiter helped us pick by letting us taste some of them. They give olives and almonds as side which were very tasty. We didn’t order but their dishes looked delicious as well. A little pricy but worth it.

reviews.author: Valerie
reviews.text: A must-visit when in Milano! The Aperitivo is amazing however I recommend reservations

reviews.author: Peter Nidetzky
reviews.text: Very good classical dishes in the restaurant of the first floor. On our visit in Milano, we found no restaurant with such quality dishes & also very good service! Give it a try!

reviews.author: Hassan Zebib
reviews.text: Travel back to 1883 at Milan's Peck, a paradise for food lovers. Savor legendary cured meats, artisan cheeses & a vibrant display of seasonal fruits & dried treasures. Unearth fragrant truffles, the crown jewel, and pair them with expertly curated wines. Don't miss the incredible breads, especially the black magic! Peck's a central Milan gem overflowing with gourmet delights, waiting to be explored.

reviews.author: Roy Steinberg
reviews.text: Amazing variety, impeccable service, top notch quality. Antonio & Sylvia - You are great ! Grazie mille

reviews.author: C M. B.
reviews.text: Great limoncello

reviews.author: William Wallace
reviews.text: I'm dismayed to have to share this review. However, the rudeness I witnessed brought me to this point. It's embarrassing to watch two young clerks at the checkout behave so disgustingly with an elderly lady (with the right to ask for explanations) but not only that, to also see the clerk behind the counter not sparing himself and treating ANOTHER lady badly. Having seen this, I have decided not to buy anything from Peck anymore, at least not from guesto store.

reviews.author: annieruth
reviews.text: Holy moly. I don’t even know where to start with this outrageously amazing food. We decided to go with the tasting menu. It offers the perfect amount of food to have you leaving not overly full, but enough to have you sleep well tonight. Next the service. We had a reservation at opening, but as the night packed up, the service stayed amazing. With every dish, they brought it out and described everything in the plate. They gave you enough time to eat then let the food settle before bringing out the next dish. They give amazing recommendations and never let us down. The atmosphere was beautiful outside. Even though there is a park behind you, I found it quite peaceful listening to the little water running, the people around us, and the families at the park play around. Truthfully an amazing Italian restaurant!!

reviews.author: Maurizio Muratore
reviews.text: We recently dined at Ratanà and had a very enjoyable experience. The atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between modern elegance and relaxed comfort, making it an ideal setting for a refined yet informal meal. We started with a selection of antipasti that were beautifully presented and full of flavor—each bite showcasing the kitchen’s attention to seasonal ingredients and careful preparation. For the main course, we all chose risottos, which did not disappoint. Creamy, well-executed, and rich in taste, they reflected a deep respect for Milanese culinary tradition with a subtle contemporary twist. Service was courteous and professional throughout. Overall, Ratanà is a solid choice for anyone looking to experience high-quality Milanese cuisine in a welcoming and well-curated environment.

reviews.author: Cathy Chen
reviews.text: We had dinner at Ratanà last Friday and overall it was a great experience. The beef carpaccio was absolutely delicious — fresh, tender, and perfectly seasoned. The saffron risotto with bone marrow was rich and flavourful, though a bit too heavy for my taste. The veal with tuna sauce was also very tasty, but the creamy tuna sauce made it slightly rich as well. A beautifully presented meal with a nice balance of tradition and creativity.

reviews.author: Michael Kelley
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing, we did a lunch tasting menu with wine pairing as that was the best way to get a sense of the restaurant. The staff was great and the food was amazing. I would recommend making a reservation but this was one if our favorites on Italy.

reviews.author: Simon Weiner
reviews.text: Great Atmosphere & Quality Ingredients, But Our Choices Missed the Mark We were really looking forward to dining at Ratana, especially since it’s a bit out of the way when staying in central Milan. The restaurant itself has a fantastic ambiance, but as we didn’t have a reservation, we had to sit on the terrace as it was fully booked inside. There’s no doubt about the high quality of the ingredients and the excellent service, but unfortunately, our choices didn’t quite hit the mark. The dishes we selected felt either too traditional or too modern for our tastes—though the dessert was absolutely delicious! It’s a shame, as the restaurant looks wonderful, and the quality is undeniable. Perhaps with different choices next time, we’d have a better experience!

reviews.author: shaam chakawri
reviews.text: The location truly speaks for itself: situated in the iconic Galleria Vittorio Emanuele, this spot exudes class and charm. While I didn’t come for lunch or dinner, I specifically stopped by for a classic breakfast – and it did not disappoint. The ambiance is elegant and timeless, with décor that perfectly complements the grandeur of the Galleria. Service was friendly and professional, striking a nice balance between attentive and relaxed. What stood out most was the quality of the coffee and the freshness of the brioche. The flavors were simple yet authentic – no unnecessary frills. What pleasantly surprised me were the prices. Compared to similar establishments in other major cities, both in Italy and abroad, this is a very affordable choice for a refined breakfast experience. In short: this is more than just a place to eat or drink – it’s somewhere to pause, appreciate your surroundings, and enjoy the quality of something simple done well. Perfect for a calm start to the day or a quick break while exploring Milan.

reviews.author: Georgiana Raluca
reviews.text: We had dinner at Cracco and chose to sit upstairs, inside – the location is beautiful, with a very classic and peaceful ambiance. It’s an elegant setting, no doubt, and you can feel the prestige of the place, especially with its Michelin star. However, the food didn’t quite meet the expectations that come with that reputation. I ordered the lobster for two, which looked more impressive in the photo than it did on the plate. The taste was fine, but nothing that really stood out or made me want to come back. I skipped dessert because nothing on the menu really appealed to me, and the cheese selection was surprisingly small – just one thin slice of each type, which felt a bit underwhelming. Overall, it’s a nice spot if you’re looking for a quiet, refined atmosphere, but from a culinary perspective, I wouldn’t return for a second visit.

reviews.author: Lo Kerry
reviews.text: It is one of a kind dining experience. Service was no doubt exceptional. I enjoyed the sweetness from the starter. The risotto was very nice. A personal greetings by the chef was something I didn't expect on the night.

reviews.author: H
reviews.text: It was okay, it felt very awkward and impersonal customer service. The menu is misleading as we thought the food from the below cafe would be available and it was not clear. Staff are way to formal and difficult to relax with. The atmosphere is dull and boring. I would not recommend really. We also had a couple who came after us who were given menus before us which felt a bit odd.

reviews.author: Marcella Reynaga
reviews.text: As soon as we walked in we were greeted with look at our menu the prices are higher and you each need to order something. That was so odd . Food was tasty, it we were hungry. Service was decent. First restaurant in Italy that gave us the bill fast and processed fast. Atmosphere is nice . Very busy area table had nice view of the galleria .

reviews.author: Mike Arens
reviews.text: Natürlich! Hier ist eine sehr positive Google-Rezension für Da Giacomo mit Schwerpunkt auf Seafood, Hundefreundlichkeit, Weinauswahl und dem besonderen italienischen Flair: ⸻ An unforgettable taste of Italy! Da Giacomo is a true gem for anyone who loves seafood and authentic Italian elegance. The menu is a celebration of the sea – from perfectly grilled fish to delicate crudo and rich pasta dishes with fresh seafood, every bite is a reminder of why Italian cuisine is so beloved. What makes it even more special is the warm, welcoming atmosphere – not only for guests, but also for our furry companions. It’s rare to find a place so beautifully designed and still genuinely dog-friendly. The service is attentive and knowledgeable, especially when it comes to wine. Their selection is superb, with excellent Italian labels that perfectly complement the dishes. With its classic interior, vintage charm, and a crowd that feels effortlessly chic, Da Giacomo captures that unique Italian flair – refined but relaxed, stylish yet soulful. A perfect evening every time.

reviews.author: Louise Descampe
reviews.text: I absolutely loved my experience dining at this restaurant. Not only was the food fantastic, every dish was flavorful, and beautifully presented, but the service truly made the evening unforgettable. The staff was incredibly kind and attentive from start to finish. A special thank you to Teo, our wonderful waiter, who went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and taken care of. His warmth and genuine hospitality made our night. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Linnea S.
reviews.text: Always a scene, always fun. A matter of the best heart to recommend this restaurant, my all time calssic spot in Milano, great for fish! Recommend to go with friends during fashion/design week!

reviews.author: KIM Danny
reviews.text: The staff's service is good. In particular, the sommelier's handling was excellent. The food is a mixture of delicious and not so delicious. I do not recommend the calamari. It is too salty. The problem was that I ate over 2kg of blue lobster and got sick, but overall, it is a satisfactory restaurant.

reviews.author: Matthew West
reviews.text: The entire experience was fantastic from start to finish. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, setting the perfect tone for the meal. It started with a delicious amuse-bouche, followed by the lobster linguini, which was well-balanced, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The seafood stew was as impressive, with a rich broth and fresh, tender seafood. The service was excellent--attentive, friendly, and well-paced. Every detail was thoughtfully handled, making the evening even more enjoyable. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: beauty tantivongsakij
reviews.text: Had a great time here with my friend, portions are not very big (ours looks extra small because we asked to share) but overall taste is great. I especially loved their sourdough bread, warm and crispy on the outside whilst soft and chewy on the inside. I’d recommend to book a table before hand so you can get one by the window with a nice view of the Duomo. Ambience and service were both amazing, I’d recommend this as a fun and interesting place.

reviews.author: Erik Nilsson
reviews.text: Wow what a place, had an excellent dinner here. The service was one of the best I've had, everything from the wine pairing to what dishes to choose and just the overall friendly attitude from everyone that works there. It's not a place for just one dish since they are small, but very well thought trough and delicious. And really not that expensive for that kind of experience. Highly recommend a visit if you feel like trying fine dining in Milan

reviews.author: Marik Hermann
reviews.text: This Restaurant is really outstanding. They not only have stunning views (make sure to get a table looking at the duomo) but also a really great, vegetarian menu. On top the wine selection is very recommendable. Go here for a nice dinner. PS: you have to take the public elevator to the 4th floor.

reviews.author: Dorota Pluta
reviews.text: After arriving we not given the table that we had reserved, the lady who sat us down was extremely unhelpful and rude. The waitors are tired or simply dont want to work even when we arrived at opening time. I am here for the 4th time and am extremely disappointed for the first time, the food was almost inedible. The prices are high, portions are tiny. It seems as if the waitors are cooking the food. The waiting time was super long. The dishes are either too salty, too soapy or lake any flavour. Overall, I will not be coming back again, apart from the view (if you are lucky enough to see it) there is nothing to come here for. There are far far better places to eat at in milan.

reviews.author: Katerina Mpouronikou
reviews.text: The location is amazing and the view. Very good service and wine. However the food was not nice. Personally I believe that most of the combination on the products doesn't make sense. For example there is a dessert which is with passion fruit and salted caramel, and the flavour was bad. Most of the meals were tasteless unfortunately. For the food that offers the prices are very high.

reviews.author: Filipchrd
reviews.text: Amazing church. One of the most beautiful I’ve seen in my life. There are 52 pillars inside this church which is a must see. On top of the church is also stunning, with very nice towers and statues. On the roof of the church there is no cover although that’s expected. Unfortunately at the time of my visit the church was in renovation.

reviews.author: Deni Oli
reviews.text: A Must-See in Milan! The Duomo is absolutely stunning & an unforgettable experience! I highly recommend booking at least two months ahead, especially if you want the rooftop access. Be sure to choose the ticket that includes the lift, to avoid walking up hundreds of steps! Dress code is strict: no tank tops or shorts/skirts above the knees. It’s a cathedral, so dressing respectfully is a must to avoid the risk of being turned away or being forced to purchase a scarf (which can cost at least €20). I came prepared, but unfortunately saw several people turned away or scrambling to cover up. Be punctual. Show up on time. Being late isn’t just inconsiderate, it may mean missing your time slot altogether. Knowing that this magnificent structure took nearly six centuries to build made the experience even more humbling. I’m so grateful I had the chance to witness this iconic piece of history up close.

reviews.author: Arman Tajarrod
reviews.text: INCREDIBLE experience. As if the countless statues inside and outside the cathedral weren’t enough, there’s also an entire museum packed with stunning sculptures—and the best part is, it’s included with your general main floor ticket. Truly awe-inspiring. I’d recommend setting aside at least one hour for the cathedral and another hour for the museum to really take it all in. It’s a must-see for anyone who appreciates art, history, or architecture.

reviews.author: Ankitha Chapte
reviews.text: Even though I didn’t go inside, the Duomo di Milano completely blew me away. The moment you step into the square and see it in front of you, it almost doesn’t feel real. The size, the detail, the sheer presence of the cathedral, it’s unlike anything I’ve ever seen. Every corner is filled with carvings, spires, and statues that make you want to pause and take a closer look. I found myself just slowly walking around it, circling it like it was a museum from the outside. It look 600 years to construct after all. It’s the kind of architecture that reminds you why people travel. Even if you’ve seen photos before, nothing compares to standing in front of it. I probably took a hundred photos, and none of them fully captured how massive and intricate it is. The surrounding square adds to the experience, it’s full of people, music, street artists, and that classic European buzz. The Duomo stands right at the heart of it all, completely owning the scene. It makes you feel like you’re witnessing something timeless. Next time I’ll definitely go inside and up to the rooftop, but honestly, just being there outside was an experience in itself. If you’re ever in Milan, don’t miss it, even if you don’t have time for a full tour. It’s one of those places that stays with you.

reviews.author: Yuval K
reviews.text: Super impressive cathedral. We added the terrace tour, and it was nice.. good views from above. It's short, maybe 20 minutes. The cathedral inside is amazing. Super high with beautiful windows and sculptures.

reviews.author: Dmitry
reviews.text: A big and fancy historic shopping mall, with plenty of high-end brand boutiques and restaurants. The building is beautiful, especially its glass dome. I did not buy anything (it was not the purpose of my visit), but just walking around is fun.

reviews.author: Stav Tzabari
reviews.text: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II is absolutely stunning — a true architectural gem in the heart of Milan 💎. The glass ceiling and intricate mosaics make it feel like you’re walking through a palace rather than a shopping mall 😍. It’s the perfect blend of history, elegance, and high fashion 👜✨. As an interior designer it was so stunning to be there! There are plenty of luxury shops, charming cafés, and restaurants to enjoy, and just being there feels special. Don’t forget to spin on the bull mosaic for good luck! 🐂🍀

reviews.author: James Leithart
reviews.text: For basically being a shopping mall, this place has some absolutely impeccable architecture. I’ve never seen a shopping center with age-old art painted on the walls and statues lining the walls. Not even to mention the gorgeous glass dome allowing for incredible lighting shining down onto the walkways below.

reviews.author: Tadeusz Godlewski
reviews.text: Wow this place is beautiful, but also really crowded. Architecturally it’s stunning, but there is also so many crowds of people trying to take photos here. It’s a cool place to check out

reviews.author: M E Lesteri
reviews.text: An absolute must-visit when in Milan — the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II is not just a shopping arcade, it’s a masterpiece of architecture. The stunning glass dome, intricate mosaics, and elegant design make it feel more like a palace than a mall. You’ll find high-end luxury brands, charming cafés, and historic restaurants — perfect whether you’re looking to shop, people-watch, or just soak in the atmosphere. Even if you’re not buying anything, just walking through is a beautiful experience. Don’t forget to spin on the bull mosaic for good luck — it’s a quirky little tradition and fun to see others doing it too! Perfect spot for photos, especially in the early morning or late evening when it’s quieter. A great place to start or end your Milan sightseeing.

name: Street Stall - Piazza Santo Stefano
address: Street Stall - Piazza Santo Stefano, Milan, Italy

name: Street Stall - Porta Ticinese
address: Street Stall - Porta Ticinese, Milan, Italy

reviews.author: Ryosuke KITAOKA
reviews.text: Fantastic cuisine and atmosphere! I visited there at lunch time in sunny April day and had Milanese risotto. You’ll regret the opportunity if you don’t visit.

reviews.author: Carlo Scibilia
reviews.text: Very good typical restaurant, not large but with very peculiar and original decorations and furnishings. Given the size of the place, it is highly recommended to place a reservation in advance. They make traditional Milanese food, and other traditional dishes. The quality of the food and of ingredients is good, and they have a huge choice of wines from overall Italy and beyond. The service is very nice and the accommodations are comfortable. Somewhat expensive.

reviews.author: Marc-Andre Perret
reviews.text: If you’re seeking an authentic Milanese dining experience, Trattoria Arlati is a true hidden gem that perfectly blends tradition and charm. Tucked away from the tourist hotspots, this cozy establishment feels like a well-kept secret among those who truly appreciate Milan’s culinary heritage. The menu is filled with time-honored regional dishes, prepared with love and a deep respect for tradition, from risotto alla Milanese to osso buco that melts in your mouth. What sets this place apart is its selection of exquisite wines, carefully curated to complement the flavors of each dish. The sommelier’s recommendations are spot on, featuring both local Lombardian labels and a few surprising, lesser-known treasures from Italy’s best vineyards. The ambiance is intimate yet unpretentious, making it the perfect spot for food connoisseurs who enjoy discovering Milan’s gastronomic heart away from the crowds. For a dining experience that’s both authentic and refined, Trattoria Arlati is a must-visit.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Lorris Ritter
reviews.text: We came here at the recommendation of a friend-of-a-friend and wow are we glad we did! The food was outstanding — we had fava beans & salame to start, followed by ricotta+spinach tortelloni, and then by slow-cooked veal dishes (osso bucco & the daily special) one of which was accompanied by the crispy saffron rice which was a delight of both flavor and texture. One of us also had the classic tomato+basil spaghetti and two days later we are still wondering how something so simple can be so good. We had an excellent bottle of local red that was quite moderately priced. For dessert three of us shared a nice tiramisu and the house specialty: a warm slice of panettone (which they make year ‘round, not just at Christmastime) topped with the same custard they use in their tiramisu. 🤩😇🥰 Atmosphere is intimate and charming; decor is eclectic. This restaurant is off-the-beaten-path but absolutely worth going out of your way for.

reviews.author: Sab
reviews.text: Amazing food! The waiters are also super professional and kind!

reviews.author: Itsuki
reviews.text: I didn’t reserve a table at the restaurant, so I expected to wait behind those with reservations. However, the extended wait at the entrance felt awkward, though a stunning seafood display provided some distraction. Once seated, I scanned the QR-code menu and wine list, ordering the “Raw Prawn and Langoustine” appetizer and “Spaghetti alle Vongole” as my main course. The appetizer—three raw prawns and three langoustines—was fresh, flavorful, and well-priced at EUR 18. The extra virgin olive oil drizzle offered a refreshing twist compared to the usual Asian soy sauce and wasabi pairing. My only complaint was one langoustine with an uncleaned vein. The Spaghetti alle Vongole was tasty, though not the best I’ve had. The pasta felt slightly undercooked, but the combination of extra virgin olive oil, clam juice and white wine was delightful. Initially, the waiter seemed distant, barely acknowledging my “grazie” with the customary “prego.” Surprisingly, he later offered complimentary pecorino cheese and a small glass of liqueur, elevating the service from a potential two-star rating. The lack of air conditioning made the dining experience uncomfortably warm. I was sweating during the vongole course, as were other diners, who shed their jackets to cope.

reviews.author: Kyoung Hong Kim
reviews.text: It is one of the best food in Milan. You should try to get lobster with tomato. There is special source with that. Also should book before going there. Always full.

reviews.author: Hakan Murat Ünsal
reviews.text: Disappointment and Disrespect! I had made a reservation weeks in advance for my birthday at this restaurant, which is right next to my old home. Just because we were around 20 minutes late, they didn’t bother to call, show any effort, or even look us in the eye when we arrived — they simply turned us away without any explanation. It was a complete lack of respect and ruined what was supposed to be a special day for me. To make matters worse, my boyfriend had flown in from Amsterdam just for this occasion. The fact that they disregarded all this effort and treated us with such indifference shows how this place only cares about money. I will never forget this disrespect, and I definitely do not recommend this place. You could easily experience the same treatment. By the way, it’s not even that great of a place to begin with. Just so you know.

reviews.author: 김명선
reviews.text: Strongly recommend this restaurant. Food was exceptional and the service was even more excellent. Price was also reasonable. Best experience in Milan without doubt.

reviews.author: Ronald Asher
reviews.text: Wow what an amazing lunch we had. Started with and Fried Calamari and Prawn then the Pistaccio Scallop and main was the Lobster, tomatoes and red onion. And for dessert their flan which was like eating a creamy custard filling to a donut. We WILL BE BACK. The son who works the front of the house was so so so amazing. He made us feel like we were regulars and there were a Lot of regulars there for lunch. A must go to if you can get in and make the journey. Gratzi Mile'

reviews.author: teresa marchione
reviews.text: A classic Milanese trattoria offering a menu that stays true to traditional local dishes, such as the iconic veal cutlet fried in butter. The staff is friendly, courteous, and well-informed about the menu, making it easy to choose the right dish. Service is quick, and the atmosphere is warm and informal—perfect for a relaxed and authentic dining experience.

reviews.author: JH Ryu
reviews.text: If you want to eat traditional style of Milanese cuisine such as Rissoto e Ossobuco, Costoletta Milanese, Trattoria Milanese is one of best choices. All foods are authentic Lombardian style and great. (Polenta is a polenta. I understand why it is. Not recommended) They also have a good wine list (there is a good half bottle wine Brancaia 👍). Service was very good. Server was kind and humorous, so enjoy time for dine. It deserves to have their famous name. Thank you for excellent time.

reviews.author: Dean M
reviews.text: A great place to experience traditional Milanese food. The osso bucca was especially fantastic. The affagato was an incredible way to end the meal and pick up some energy for after lunch activities. It was the best ever. Good array of well priced local wines too. It is true that some of the staff is not particularly welcoming to those without a reservation or the whit to decode a very simple Italian menu, but I'm not sure that is all bad if it keeps out some of the more obnoxious tourists. Seemed to be mostly Italians when we visited.

reviews.author: MILANUNO
reviews.text: A restaurant established in 1933, where you can taste all the most authentic and Milanese dishes imaginable. We do not give up their pumpkin tortellini and the Milanese schnitzel that comes on a bone and is huge. When you come to most authentic local restaurants and say that you are sharing the dish, then the kitchen divides the dish into two plates and we really like it. So we shared all the dishes and each person received their own plate, but the dessert is shared like in Israel, in the center of the table, so of course you cannot miss their famous tiramisu. We were able to enjoy a traditional local dessert called Zabionna, which is a warm cream that comes with the famous Pantone cake of the holiday.

reviews.author: Chanya Phanitchawan
reviews.text: I had a great meal here. Everything was authentic Milanese food which tastes amazing. The food was also served almost immediately after I ordered like it was made with magic. Plus all the uncles who work there are very kind and attentive.

reviews.author: Jasmin Tiwari
reviews.text: Loved by the locals, so expect some wait time. One of the best pizzas I’ve ever had- sadly we weren’t that hungry at the time and couldn’t enjoy multiple items on the menu. But the yellow tomato pizza and suppli were the best ever. A bunch of friendly faces to welcome you too.

reviews.author: Sean Stephenson
reviews.text: Excellent experience and the pizzas were fabulous 👌 by far the best we've had on holiday. My only comment would be we did struggle with the menu since there was no English version so we had to spend extra time to use our phones to translate but still was well worth it. The restaurant is always full with a que of people wanting to get in. Fast service and the pizzas came out in no time. Can see why the locals love the place. Great price is well, could never get a great pizza like this at this price in the UK.

reviews.author: Eric Feazel
reviews.text: This place never disappoints. Just a short walk from the Lungomare, 50 Kalò offers quick, efficient service and a relaxed atmosphere. You can sit indoors or outside, but on a beautiful day like today, the outdoor seating is ideal. I ordered the Diavola pizza and it arrived within minutes—perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and absolutely delicious. Prices are very reasonable for the quality you get. Highly recommend if you're in the area!

reviews.author: Monika Kucharska
reviews.text: Absolutely the best pizza we’ve had the chance to try in Italy. Out of many places with similarly high ratings, this one truly stands out for several reasons. During our short stay, we ended up eating here twice - something we NEVER do, as we aim to explore new spots everyday. But this time, we just had to come back. First and foremost: the pizza itself. Perfectly balanced in flavor, wonderfully aromatic, with an ideal texture. Remarkably, it was also incredibly easy to digest, even for someone with a very sensitive stomach, which is almost unheard of. The Buffalo Margherita especially caught our attention - the cheese was outstanding, and the tomatoes… out of this world, unlike anything we’ve ever tasted before. The tuna and onion pizza turned out to be an unexpected but surprisingly delicious combo too. We also tried the zucchini and mint frittella which was full of flavor and perfectly seasoned. The service was warm and efficient - we waited no more than five minutes for our pizzas. In short: an absolute gem. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.text: Really amazing pizza - dare I say the best in Naples? It’s definitely the best pizza I’ve ever had. We ordered the pizza with Salsiccia & also the Antica Margherita (Slowfood). What’s special about them? Salsiccia pizza: the red onions gave it that perfect spice, while the Salsiccia gave it the perfect body for the pizza. Antica Margherita pizza: the saltiness of the pecorino (aged) with the tanginess of the tomatoes *chefs kiss* only thing I’d add is perhaps some spice! IMPORTANT: Call in advance to make a reservation as there is a massive queue. We were there eating at 10PM and there was still a queue of people waiting to be seated. Also can order it as takeaway if you prefer!

reviews.author: Natasha Bell
reviews.text: We went at 6:30 and we got a table straight away! The menu is limited but it keeps things moving quickly. I had high expectations for the pizza and was worried it wouldn’t live up to them… but it was one of the best pizzas I have had! The flavours were incredible and it was cooked perfectly. Both pizzas were €6, then they ask for a tip which we were happy to provide as the meal was so cheap! Would recommend

reviews.author: Floww
reviews.text: You know a place is iconic when it has a crowd outside before it even opens—and yes, Da Michele absolutely lives up to its legendary status. We rolled in late, fully expecting to get the “kitchen’s closing” glare, but nope—pizza came out fast like they knew we needed that doughy salvation. And wow, was it worth it. Yes, it’s saucier than your average Neapolitan pizza (prepare for a little delicious mess), but it totally works. The sauce is rich, vibrant, and practically dances on the dough. And that dough? Chewy, pillowy, and full of flavor—like it took a nap in olive oil and came back enlightened. Only two options on the menu (marinara or margherita), and honestly, that’s all you need. They’ve mastered simplicity and nailed the execution. Final verdict: Legendary for a reason. Fast, flavorful, and comforting in the best way. Come for the history, stay for the chew. Bonus: it’s so saucy, your shirt gets a free souvenir.

reviews.author: Astrid LI
reviews.text: We pre-ordered pizza through the delivery app for Sunday night. The line wasn’t too bad, but we still waited about 10-15 minutes—maybe dining in would’ve been quicker. Anyway, the pizza was absolutely worth it! Fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Highly recommend trying their signature toppings. Will definitely order again! 🍕🔥

reviews.author: Abbigale Nguyen
reviews.text: This place was awesome because of how affordable and massive the pizzas were! Like for a HUGE famous pizza, they’re charging 6€. Like in this economy? When they have a line around the block? They’re still charging so little for their pizzas and I think that is this place’s strength. The pizzas were great, but the overall dining experience was a treat. Definitely wanna come back next time I’m in Naples.

reviews.author: T L
reviews.text: I like it) of course it’s get huge marketing hit after the movie , however pizza is great, place is historical, price are super Cheap and it is what you expect from Good pizzeria. Only 2 pizza choose basically which is perfect. I got lucky and on Sunday morning around 10:45 I enterrés without any queue! Which was top

name: L’Antica Pizzeria da Sorbillo
address: L’Antica Pizzeria da Sorbillo, Naples, Italy

reviews.author: Carrie Conelli
reviews.text: As passionate home pizzaiolos with our own pizza oven, we thought we had a solid handle on Neapolitan pizza – until our first trip to Naples and our visit to Sorbillo. This legendary spot had long been at the top of our list. Since they don’t take reservations, we came prepared to wait – but even with a long line, we were seated in just 30 minutes. And every minute was worth it. We ordered two pizzas for three people, given their generous size – but after the first bite, we were genuinely moved. No exaggeration: happy tears were shed. The pizza was that good. Naturally, we ended up ordering a third one. The service was warm, attentive, and impressively efficient given the constant rush. Prices are more than fair for the quality and experience. Only one downside: drinks were served in plastic cups. Team Sorbillo – this pizza planet deserves better. Please consider switching to sustainable tableware. A place serving pizza of this caliber should care just as much about the planet as it does about perfection on a plate. Bottom line: Hands down the best Neapolitan pizza we've ever had. We’ll be back – no question.

reviews.author: Stefanos Michalis
reviews.text: In my opinion better pizza than Da Michele but that's different for each person I guess. Huge selection of pizzas and they also have one with pineapple but I didn't feel like "risking" it in this trip. Amazing craft beer as well. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Eric Taylor
reviews.text: Solid pizza but not the best we’ve had in Italy. The Margherita was our favorite of the four we ordered. We waited about 30 minutes for our party of five to be seated, arriving around 4:30 pm. Staff was mixed on friendliness towards us. Definitely a good pizza and worth a visit but I wouldn’t wait an overly long time for it.

reviews.author: Polina Osipova
reviews.text: This place lives up to the hype, I don't agree with the negative reviews. We've been fortunate to be spoiled by really good pizzas, so it's not the easiest task to satisfy our expectations. The pizza here is delicious. Long line to get in but it's worth the wait. Friendly staff, pleasant atmosphere. Fair prices.

reviews.author: Diana B.
reviews.text: Best of the best - bravissimo. Real NEAPOLITANO- real PIZZA. Thin crust amazing local ingredients used! Anchovy pizza is without any cheese and fish is pretty intense. But bcs I love anchovy fish- was excellent. Meat pizza with stratochella was bit spicy and mindblowing - new taste in LIFE. must try! Drinks - best prices. House wine & beer avaliable. Peroni 0.5l was also there at excellent temperature. Ps. We will come again and again 🤗🍕🍕🍕

name: Pizzeria Concettina ai Tre Santi
address: Pizzeria Concettina ai Tre Santi, Naples, Italy

reviews.author: Melisa Şerifaki
reviews.text: Amazing pizza, prices are of course high for naples but for Michelin star restaurants it is cheap. They forgot one of our order. Atmosphere is amazing, reserve for terrace for sure!

reviews.author: teresa marchione
reviews.text: We were here for lunch….the food is good with different presentation from others. We tried the tasting menu: few appetizers, 3 different pizza slides and 1 dessert. Since it was tasting menu and since they have more than one dessert I was disappointed to get only one, so when I paid I gave my feedback and promptly they offered to us Torta Caprese(very good). I do not give 5 stars because there are few things that I did not like: the music was not appropriate for a typical Napoletano Restaurant since it was more for a launch bar. Personally, I find the use of latex gloves by waiters when serving food to be unhygienic. It often makes me think that they might not wash their hands as frequently, since the gloves can give a misleading sense of hygiene. Moreover, I was concerned by the lack of a tablecloth or even paper napkins on the marble table, and by the fact that the cutlery rested on a metal stand. It raised doubts about whether these stands are sanitized or replaced between customers, which made me feel somewhat nervous and not entirely at ease.

reviews.author: arielyomtov
reviews.text: The dough and the cheese are excellent, my pizza was with no sauce so I can't comment on it, the tomatoes were fresh and sweet. The server was fast efficient and kind, all I could ask for. Overall 10/10, will fly to Italy again to taste the pizza in the near future

reviews.author: Jennifer Erwing
reviews.text: We have been in Napoli 6 days and this is the first restaurant that we have been compelled to write a review about. "WOW!!" 😍 We have tried other touristy restaurants and we were ok with the flavor but this restaurant is something very different. The flavor and uniqueness of the food makes this restaurant outstanding. Don't get me wrong. The food is good at the other restaurants that we tried with great ratings but it's nothing that we thought was worthy of telling the world. This place is truly different. We tried the San Gennaro pizza. It is something completely different from any other pizza that we've tried. Delicious! Bonisimo!! We hope to come back and pay a visit to try another one that their unique pizzas! 🍕 Beware at the prices are a bit high. We got one pizza one bottle of water and one glass and the price was 49 Euro.

reviews.author: Mustafa Khalil
reviews.text: Authentic Neapolitan pizza with a perfectly blistered crust and rich, fresh flavors—just like in Naples. Sitting outside adds to the vibe, making you feel like you’re right in the heart of italy !

reviews.author: Natasha Bell
reviews.text: We went at 6:30 and we got a table straight away! The menu is limited but it keeps things moving quickly. I had high expectations for the pizza and was worried it wouldn’t live up to them… but it was one of the best pizzas I have had! The flavours were incredible and it was cooked perfectly. Both pizzas were €6, then they ask for a tip which we were happy to provide as the meal was so cheap! Would recommend
