reviews.author: robert barnsley
reviews.text: Beautiful street with a bit of everything. Culture lovers and bargain hunters as well as some beautiful dining options.

reviews.author: Moti M
reviews.text: Awesome old area of Torino

reviews.author: SARA maryam
reviews.text: Beautiful place in Turin

reviews.author: Georges Younes
reviews.text: Via Po offers one of Turin's memorable and seemingly never-ending perspectives. The perfectly aligned buildings on either side of the street direct your eyes to focus as far away as you can see, which happens to be on the other side of the Po river at the Chiesa Parrocchiale della Gran Madre di Dio.

reviews.author: Sharify Mohammad Hosein
reviews.text: Lovely place to have a walk around and have some relaxation with river sound

reviews.author: Nicholas Ong
reviews.text: The food was good but it’s like other touristy Florentine restaurants, nothing special. We came because of various reviews but found them exaggerated and unreliable. Price is reasonable though. Reservation recommended as there is a line of tourists like us who probably read the same reviews!

reviews.author: S. S.
reviews.text: I don't know where to start. I would simply recommend this place with "Just Visit!" Reasonable pricing, down to earth and genuinely tuscan menus, attentive staff with no excessive fake kindness (it's my best compliment - might not be others cuppa) Artichoke cream gnocchi was the best. I'm just so sad I was too full to try more.

reviews.author: Andrej Halaszi
reviews.text: Sometimes when you're traveling, it can be really difficult to find the right place — somewhere you can truly enjoy a meal in a homely atmosphere. I'm not a fan of touristy spots or flashy restaurants. I prefer home-style cooking, something in the spirit of alla nonna. When I arrived in Florence, I asked my friends to take me to exactly that kind of place. And this restaurant was exactly what I was hoping for — a place where the food feels homemade and the atmosphere makes you feel like part of the family. From the warm, attentive, and genuinely heartfelt service to the cozy interior and, most importantly, the simple, delicious, and traditional food — everything here made me feel like I had suddenly acquired an Italian grandmother who just cooked me a real dinner with love and years of experience behind it. I highly recommend visiting this restaurant. Go for the traditional dishes. They might not be overly sophisticated or artistic in presentation, but what you'll get is that warm, comforting feeling of a homemade meal — even if you're miles away from home.

reviews.author: Jordan Putt
reviews.text: To say our meal was perfect almost feels like an understatement. Not only was the food delicious and fresh, but the service from our waiter Gabriele was so personal, warm and friendly. We appreciated his recommendations and humor, it took an already excellent experience one step better. Whatever they pay him isn’t enough! We also noticed that he brought the same level of service and personality to each one of the tables around us as well. All in all, a beautiful culinary experience combined with excellent service. Would come back here any time!

reviews.author: Lari Claudia Lungu
reviews.text: This restaurant is a must-visit! The food is absolutely amazing, bursting with flavor and quality. The staff are not only friendly but also incredibly efficient, working seamlessly to ensure a smooth dining experience. Service is impressively fast and well-organized. Due to its popularity, booking is highly recommended—it fills up right from opening!

reviews.author: The Roberts Family
reviews.text: Visiting the beautiful city of Venice is amazing. The history, architecture and plenty of restaurants to choose from. That said, I am thrilled that I did my research as we dined for my husband’s birthday at Al Covo, and I will say it did not disappoint. Our whole experience was delightful. It began with amazing service from everyone we were in contact with. The meal was delicious from start to finish. Our server Richard was a particular stand out with helpful suggestions, kindness and wit. Beautiful food, amazing staff and a lovely atmosphere made this the trifecta. Grazie mille!

reviews.author: Stephanie DeDecker
reviews.text: Lived up to the recommendations! The food is soo fresh and creative, I enjoyed all of it! I booked this a two weeks in advance and could only get a lunch time so book early! I had the beetroot ravioli - it was perfect summer lunch dish. It was fresh with the poppy seeds and light. I also got the hummus with local vegetables, also good, I was surprised the vegetables were still hot but good nonetheless

reviews.author: Orestes Hadjistamoulou
reviews.text: Venice has a reputation for expansive food that isn’t very good; though chances are the people who say that aren’t doing the research they need to in order to find great spots like these. We had a wonderful meal filled with fresh seafood and beautifully prepared dishes. We had seasonal crab as well as a medley of fried seafood. Do not skip the desert their cheesecake is incredible!

reviews.author: Darren Reuben
reviews.text: Just eaten at Al Covo. We had a fantastic meal. Delightful location not far from St Marks Square. A good choice of food, especially if you like fish. I opted for sole and my wife chose a beautiful pasta dish. A great choice of wine from the local regions. Topped off with a cheesecake to die for. The recommendations for Al Covo are well deserved

reviews.author: V. J.D.
reviews.text: Perfection! It’s probably one of the best restaurants in Venice. Their “only reservations” policy assures an exceptional kitchen as they don’t “double” the tables for a second round. The produce is fresh and the combinations are made with great interest and food taste. The staff is lovely and very familiar, the water jugs are the perfect murano glass style of my dreams, the deco is traditional and the restrooms are pristine. That review down saying the seafood wasn’t great and like worms in the mouth might have never ate real-well cooked seafood: in Al Covo you will get low cooked, fresh seafood. We come back from Spain here every year and it’s always amazing. Please, if you are only ready to eat overcooked dry shrimps, go to a picture menu style restaurant. Leave a table to those who appreciate the good food.

reviews.author: A Mok
reviews.text: Love this restaurant. Booked for lunch, was seated outdoors in a quiet and breezy alley. Food was spectacular, seafood was so fresh. Loved their glasswares too! Highly recommend and do book in advance.

reviews.author: Michael Hickey
reviews.text: One of the best meals we had in Venice! We are foodies from Brooklyn and we’ve had our fair share of delicious dinners. Don’t miss the grilled octopus, and the rest of the meal was very well prepared. It was a very full and somewhat noisy restaurant, and service could be a bit slow, but in our opinion worth it and overall highly enjoyable.

reviews.author: QC
reviews.text: Came for dinner and it was delicious. We received a welcome fried ball that was delicious. We ordered the grilled octopus (very good), fried shrimp and calamari (the wasabi mayo was yum), and a pasta dish in crab sauce. The restaurant is cozy. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Matt Martinez
reviews.text: Definitely a touristy place; especially at the first seating the servers are going to rush you into ordering and you’re definitely not going to get any help from them ordering a wine. But if you know what you’re doing you can find some good bottles for sure and the food we tried was almost all excellent (I would actually skip the spider crab tagliatelle and go for the spaghetti instead and don’t get me started on that sad little arancino they brought as an amuse bouche). Maybe not going to win any Michelin stars anytime soon but you could definitely do a lot worse in Venice.

reviews.author: Irmak
reviews.text: This place was an absolute gem and highlight of our Italy trip. Food, deserts, wine, everything was amazing. The ambiance was amazing as well - both outside and inside. I don’t know how well known this place is, but in a sea of touristy average restaurants, this place was the savior.

reviews.author: A Mok
reviews.text: Love this restaurant. Booked for lunch, was seated outdoors in a quiet and breezy alley. Food was spectacular, seafood was so fresh. Loved their glasswares too! Highly recommend and do book in advance.

reviews.author: Michael Hickey
reviews.text: One of the best meals we had in Venice! We are foodies from Brooklyn and we’ve had our fair share of delicious dinners. Don’t miss the grilled octopus, and the rest of the meal was very well prepared. It was a very full and somewhat noisy restaurant, and service could be a bit slow, but in our opinion worth it and overall highly enjoyable.

reviews.author: QC
reviews.text: Came for dinner and it was delicious. We received a welcome fried ball that was delicious. We ordered the grilled octopus (very good), fried shrimp and calamari (the wasabi mayo was yum), and a pasta dish in crab sauce. The restaurant is cozy. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Matt Martinez
reviews.text: Definitely a touristy place; especially at the first seating the servers are going to rush you into ordering and you’re definitely not going to get any help from them ordering a wine. But if you know what you’re doing you can find some good bottles for sure and the food we tried was almost all excellent (I would actually skip the spider crab tagliatelle and go for the spaghetti instead and don’t get me started on that sad little arancino they brought as an amuse bouche). Maybe not going to win any Michelin stars anytime soon but you could definitely do a lot worse in Venice.

reviews.author: Irmak
reviews.text: This place was an absolute gem and highlight of our Italy trip. Food, deserts, wine, everything was amazing. The ambiance was amazing as well - both outside and inside. I don’t know how well known this place is, but in a sea of touristy average restaurants, this place was the savior.

reviews.author: Braulio A.
reviews.text: Al Squero is our go-to for experiencing one of Venice’s most beloved traditions—cicchetti! This cozy, bustling spot is a hidden gem where locals, students, and workers gather for incredible small bites and perfectly poured drinks. Arrive early to snag a seat inside and be ready when the trays of fresh cicchetti emerge—you won’t want to miss out! With affordable prices, delicious snacks, and refreshing Aperol spritzes, it’s the perfect stop for a pre-dinner bite. And the best part? You can savor your food while watching skilled artisans craft gondolas right before your eyes—a true Venetian experience like no other!

reviews.author: cando2008au Compton
reviews.text: Here has a great buzz going on. Opposite the gondola repair shop there is something to watch while you enjoy an excellent food experience. The aparol spritz is also a perfect mix. Be careful of the seagulls as they have learnt how good the food is also and will steal it straight off you plate if given the opportunity

reviews.author: Lingual Tan
reviews.text: Best place for cichetti! And spritzers were only £3! Found this place on Google Maps and arrived before 12pm, there was a long queue behind us right after. So much variety and everything was yummy! First meal in Venice and so worth it! The restaurant overlooks an old boat building workshop so you can kill two birds with one stone by coming here!

reviews.author: Siena Palakumar
reviews.text: I’ve got to say that we had the best cicchetti we’ve had so far. Our favourite ones were the shrimp and tuna with onion on top. We had to go back for more! There’s not too much seating inside, but you can sit outside the restaurant by the canal, just watch out for the seagulls

reviews.author: Charlotte Robinson
reviews.text: Really cheap and tasty cicchetti, about €2.50 each plus very cheap wine (€3.50) and good soft drink options. Plus, the staff are super friendly! Theres a small amount of seating inside but it’s really better to sit outside on the wall for the beautiful setting!

reviews.author: Emma B
reviews.text: We were recommended Osteria alle Testiere by friends who visit often, and it was the highlight of our trip to Venice & Verona. The food was outstanding and the hospitality from Luca and his team was warm and welcoming. We enjoyed a leisurely lunch trying lots of local seafood (including oysters, clams, scallops, fish, pasta alongside exceptional veg) with excellent wine, followed by a tiramisu and coffee. Their menu changes daily based on the best ingredients available and so they say that because of this, all of their dishes are recommended - we’d have to agree! This is a gem of a restaurant. To ensure you don’t miss out, we’d highly recommend booking well in advance due to the small restaurant size.

reviews.author: Arash Shaeri
reviews.text: We booked a table for lunch a couple of months before our trip to Venice. The food here is amazing. Delicious and fresh. You can't go wrong with any of the items on the menu. Tuna tataki was wonderful as were all of our mains. It's a small place which is why it's booked out well in advance. If you like your seafood, then definitely come here. It's not cheap but it's worth it.

reviews.author: Yevgen Gusovskyy
reviews.text: A very popular and rather famous Osteria that used to not even have an electronic reservation system. Alas, times have changed )) The food is quite expensive but if you are into very fresh seafood, it is one of the better places to go enjoy the catch of the day. The scallops were nice with a bit of citrus and micro green fanciness. The razor clams were impeccable and I love ordering them here. Bo hole was very nice and classy. The gnocchi had a bit too much cinnamon for me but very tasty nonetheless. The St Jacques fresh and simple. The pistachio cake excellent and homey, the way I prefer it. It’s a tiny place and you should not plan to easily get a table here. I would come here with a partner and never with kids but I’m sure kids will feel fine here as well. Centrally located, beautiful and honest place that I quite enjoy year after year.

reviews.author: Stefan Funk
reviews.text: Absolute cracking restaurant. For me one of the best - if not THE BEST in Venice 2 Months later and we are here again ! As always a really great experience. Oyster from the lagoon- small but soooo good. Best spaghetti vongole that I had EVER. We will come back every time when we visit Venice. Reservation absolutely necessary

reviews.author: Taylor Bowman
reviews.text: Hands down our favorite meal in Venice, and maybe even Italy as a whole. My husband and I ended up here our first night in Venice and naively did not make reservations. We were lucky to get their only open table. The meal was absolutely incredible. We had our favorite wine of the whole trip was here, and their spaghetti alle vongole and pistachio cake were DIVINE. Make reservations ahead of time so you are sure to get a table, you do not want to miss this restaurant on your trip to Venice.

reviews.author: The Roberts Family
reviews.text: Visiting the beautiful city of Venice is amazing. The history, architecture and plenty of restaurants to choose from. That said, I am thrilled that I did my research as we dined for my husband’s birthday at Al Covo, and I will say it did not disappoint. Our whole experience was delightful. It began with amazing service from everyone we were in contact with. The meal was delicious from start to finish. Our server Richard was a particular stand out with helpful suggestions, kindness and wit. Beautiful food, amazing staff and a lovely atmosphere made this the trifecta. Grazie mille!

reviews.author: Stephanie DeDecker
reviews.text: Lived up to the recommendations! The food is soo fresh and creative, I enjoyed all of it! I booked this a two weeks in advance and could only get a lunch time so book early! I had the beetroot ravioli - it was perfect summer lunch dish. It was fresh with the poppy seeds and light. I also got the hummus with local vegetables, also good, I was surprised the vegetables were still hot but good nonetheless

reviews.author: Orestes Hadjistamoulou
reviews.text: Venice has a reputation for expansive food that isn’t very good; though chances are the people who say that aren’t doing the research they need to in order to find great spots like these. We had a wonderful meal filled with fresh seafood and beautifully prepared dishes. We had seasonal crab as well as a medley of fried seafood. Do not skip the desert their cheesecake is incredible!

reviews.author: Darren Reuben
reviews.text: Just eaten at Al Covo. We had a fantastic meal. Delightful location not far from St Marks Square. A good choice of food, especially if you like fish. I opted for sole and my wife chose a beautiful pasta dish. A great choice of wine from the local regions. Topped off with a cheesecake to die for. The recommendations for Al Covo are well deserved

reviews.author: V. J.D.
reviews.text: Perfection! It’s probably one of the best restaurants in Venice. Their “only reservations” policy assures an exceptional kitchen as they don’t “double” the tables for a second round. The produce is fresh and the combinations are made with great interest and food taste. The staff is lovely and very familiar, the water jugs are the perfect murano glass style of my dreams, the deco is traditional and the restrooms are pristine. That review down saying the seafood wasn’t great and like worms in the mouth might have never ate real-well cooked seafood: in Al Covo you will get low cooked, fresh seafood. We come back from Spain here every year and it’s always amazing. Please, if you are only ready to eat overcooked dry shrimps, go to a picture menu style restaurant. Leave a table to those who appreciate the good food.

reviews.author: Lynette Million
reviews.text: My husband reserved this place for our anniversary dinner before we went to the opera. It was perfect because it was next door to the opera house. The staff was amazing and so welcoming! The food was so good and drinks were delicious. Prices were fair. Would definitely come back here!

reviews.author: Liz H
reviews.text: Had a great dinner here. No reservations but we got a table on the edge of their covered patio. The filet steak all tartufo was amazing. Pricey but totally worth it. We spent €150 for two entrees, a dessert, water and 3 glasses of wine. Wine reasonable - good pour for €10.

reviews.author: Charlotte Piel
reviews.text: We went there for dinner and it was amazing! The black truffle pasta was to die for, and the parma and melon was delicious! The bread was still warm and the butter (salted) was great! Both of our fruit salad were very good! The servers were attentive and really nice! We even had free biscuits at the end! The setting next to the Fenice is gorgeous! I would definitely recommend this address!

reviews.author: Amy Moore Brown
reviews.text: We stopped in for a quick, light bite before touring the opera house. Being right next to the Opera House, we had little to no expectations for this place but were blown away by amazing food! We split the Scampi spaghetti “bursara” style and each had a glass of wine / Prosecco. The food and the wine were some of the best we have had in Italy! Highly recommend a visit and both the spaghetti scampi and the wine/prosecco!

reviews.author: Dovile K.
reviews.text: Most amazing experience! 5 stars is not enough to rate this amazing restaurant - both food and service

reviews.author: EK
reviews.text: Our 5 th time since 2021 … We love the service, food, ambiance of this great Italian restaurant. Many Thanks for the excellent experience … its great as always never less always more…especially many thanks to our wait staff Mr. Rashid and all the Da Ivo team for a memorable night…

reviews.author: Phillip Strickland
reviews.text: Great atmosphere and great food! Small dining room so make a reservation. Nice specials also. If you can, arrive by boat/gondola for the full experience

reviews.author: Loy Garcia
reviews.text: I made my reservation way in advance. As I started reading reviews, I was nervous about keeping it. I decided we should keep it as the good reviews and return visit reviews were more compelling than the negative. Let me just say we had an excellent experience!! The service by everyone was excellent and attentive! The food was very good and the experience was as advertised. The menu was pricey, but I felt that for the experience, it was worth it. I would recommend this place for anyone who asks. If you are on a budget, this is not the place for you.

reviews.author: Constanza Company
reviews.text: We spent New Years Eve, and to be honest it was a big disappointment. When you pay 150€ per person, you expect the food to be extraordinarily delicious. Why George Clooney or other artists go there I do not understand. I’m very sorry because the team was very nice and kind… but this wasn’t worth the money!!! The special menu was “grande carte” and also “grande robbery”! The starters - min 45/50€ - lacked flavour, the pasta -min 50€ the plate - was “nice”, but nothing compared to the other mouth melting experiences we had at other restaurants in Venice - for literally half the price. If you want to waste your money just to see the pictures of the famous people hanging on the wall, be my guest. Maybe we should have ordered the 120€ truffle pasta?

reviews.author: Sean K
reviews.text: This spot in Venice is everything you want in an authentic Italian dining experience. It’s cozy, tucked away, and full of charm. The food is incredible—think fresh pasta, perfectly cooked seafood, and rich, flavorful sauces. The service is warm and makes you feel like part of the family. Whether you’re celebrating something special or just enjoying a meal in one of the most beautiful cities in the world, this place hits all the right notes. A true Venetian gem.

reviews.author: A Mok
reviews.text: The best dining experience I had in Venice. Booked online the day before for a table of 4. Every dish was fine and delicious. Fish was very fresh and the tiramisu was so special. View was perfect. It’s a bit further from our hotel but we enjoyed spending the evening away from the crowd. General Manager was super friendly and chatty, we felt very welcomed and we enjoyed his company very much. He was also very knowledgeable when we asked for wine recommendations. Highly recommended and I will come back when I return to Venice.

reviews.author: K RV
reviews.text: While in Venice, we tried this restaurant which was close to our hotel. It has relatively small space inside but very large are for outside seating next to the canal, The menu had enough choices for adults and children. The service was friendly but slow. Good was delicious.

reviews.author: Vivian Lim
reviews.text: The staff is so friendly. You can eat outside while looking out over the canal. The atmosphere is sooo nice indoors. We sat down to eat outside and went indoors because it was so cold, and the staff kindly moved us around. The oil pasta is so delicious!!

reviews.author: bella cha
reviews.text: It was the best experience on my trip to Italy. Nine members of my family arrived in the evening, but there was no river seat for a large number of people. A seat was created by waiting for an hour, and the staff quickly organized the seats. Both the meal and wine were perfect, and above all, the atmosphere was full of Venice's atmosphere.The staff was handsome and kind, and the whole family counted as the best experience in Italy. Please remember that nine families from Korea were impressed by your kindness and hospitality.

reviews.author: Denny Cha
reviews.text: Came here for dinner with my family. I would say foods here are luxuriously tasty! (Definitely not cheap but i didnt feel i was overpaying the foods) So far the best quality restaurant i have been to in Italy. I have been traveling throughout Italy for past 2 weeks and the place here was even better than seafoods i had in Cinque Terre. My recommendation is grilled shrimp, seafood pasta, and ricotta and pear cake. Portion is on smaller side but the quality makes up for it. Ricotta and pear cake has a great balance between refreshing and sweet. I really fell in love with this dessert! If i visit Venice again in the future, i would love to come back here. If you want some nice dinner with family in quiet place, i recommend this place. Outdoor seating also looked great with nice overview.

name: Street Stall - Campo Santa Margherita
address: Street Stall - Campo Santa Margherita, Venice, Italy

reviews.author: Spencer Hawken
reviews.text: One of Venices quietest islands, while also being pretty built up. This is where the workers live and the Americans like to stay, probably due to the Hilton hotel. It has good accessibility via a number of stops to the main island.

reviews.author: Connor James
reviews.text: Love this part of Venice. You can find things much cheaper here so I recommend staying on this island. There isn’t a lot to do as far as tourist stuff is concerned but you’ll have plenty of options in terms of food and shopping.

reviews.author: Bhavna Narula
reviews.text: Beautiful island at the down south. Chilled and more local than St. Marco. It was amazing to be a part of their annual special FIESTA dela Redentore, fire works, celebrations with free music concerts and happy people everywhere !

reviews.author: Mahesh Kumar
reviews.text: Away from the touristy Venice. Reach here by Vaporetto's (Venetian Water Bus). Best time to be here is during the dusk. Take a stroll along the walkway on the edge of the island, experiencing the sea breeze and sunset with different cloud colours. Restaurants & cafes are spread out throughout the walkway.

reviews.author: Anna Krasteva
reviews.text: It’s a really small part of Venice that you can see in a day. Not much to it but the view of the other side

name: Street Stall - Rialto Market
address: Street Stall - Rialto Market, Venice, Italy

reviews.author: hila
reviews.text: A nice market in the heart of Venice. There are some amazing and unique fish on display, along with food stalls, fresh vegetables, souvenirs, and more. Prices are on the expensive side.

reviews.author: Chiara
reviews.text: Rialto Market is a true gem in Venice! The vibrant atmosphere, the freshest seafood, and the colorful local produce make it an unforgettable experience. It’s the perfect place to soak in the city’s culinary culture and see where Venetians shop for their ingredients. Whether you’re looking for the best seasonal fruits or just want to enjoy the lively market scene, this is the place to be. Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic food and local traditions!

reviews.author: Lucy
reviews.text: Clearly past it's glory days, but still has an atmosphere and uniqueness that makes it worth a visit. A noticeable number of 'tourist tat' stalls amid the fresh fruit & veg and fish stalls. You can still imagine what it would have been like to visit and do your shop when it was thriving though. Great people watching!

reviews.author: Lau Eva
reviews.text: We stayed in Venice for 3 nights, we visited the market twice. They have wonderful seafood selection, we brought some back and cooked in our beautiful Airbnb.

reviews.author: CityScrolls
reviews.text: The market is a feast for the senses. You will delight in vibrant fruit and vegetable colors, immerse yourself in an array of intoxicating smells (good and bad) and listen to the lively banter of stallholders speaking in Venetian dialect. The vibrant bustle is at its peak during the early hours. You don't have to buy anything if you don't wish to - just enjoy the spectacle. In my opinion, the Pescaria (fish market) is the most fascinating. Inside the Neo-Gothic market hall, you'll find massive swordfish, squirming eels, soft-shelled crabs, and other fresh catches. Seagulls constantly attempt to steal, hovering just beyond reach as they scavenge for scraps.

name: Street Stall - San Polo
address: Street Stall - San Polo, Venice, Italy

reviews.author: CityScrolls
reviews.text: My review concerns the Zattere promenade, not the waterbus station. Once a landing dock for timber carrying rafts ('zattere'), essential for building Venetian ships and structures, the quay is now a favorite local spot for strolling. Especially on sunny afternoons, locals promenade the nearly 2 km stretch, sharing laughs, exchanging news and gossip and enjoying gelato. You may feel more like an observer than a participant, but that's all part of the experience. Sunsets from the Zattere are spectacular! As sunset approaches, find the perfect spot by the water to enjoy an aperitivo, relaxed by the gentle flow of boats along the Giudecca Canal.

reviews.author: MrRomanfly
reviews.text: One of the most ancient area of Venice. In the past, river boats used this quay to offloads coal, wood, salt and other goods and in the recent years was used by small cruise vessel and super yachts while calling Venice.

reviews.author: Mark Mishaev
reviews.text: This is one of the special parts in Venice

reviews.author: Nick Davies
reviews.text: Decent canal side bars cafe and restaurants.... Nice and not too busy

reviews.author: Joerij Terletskij
reviews.text: BEST ART TEAM RESTAWRATOR in VENEZIA

name: Trattoria al Gatto Nero
address: Trattoria al Gatto Nero, Venice, Italy

reviews.author: Grace Li
reviews.text: The BEST clam pasta we’ve ever had. The razor clam and scallop appetizer was delicious. Our server recommended the risotto to us which is only made a certain way on Bruno islands. A lot of menu items have a minimum 2 person order so the risotto was 60€ 😳 which was good but nothing of wow factor like the clam pasta was. If we could go back, we’d get the clam pasta and another pasta dish instead. You must make a reservation in advance or get lucky like us and go right off the water taxi to see if any reservations are left. Luckily we got one of the last walk-ins for lunch at 2pm. Total for an appetizer, the risotto for 2 and 1 clam pasta dish which we split was 170€.

reviews.author: Ruth Smoother
reviews.text: The best eating experience in all ways I had in Italy. From the kind personalized service, to the atmosphere, the crockery, cutlery, all give an amazing vibe before even the food arrives. The food was just delectable. I had the spider crab tortellini. And it was divine. The paired wine suggested complimented it. It was extremely reasonable in cost also! I cannot recommend this treasure more - just make a reservation so you don’t miss out on this once in a lifetime experience.

reviews.author: Ush K
reviews.text: It’s a bit pricey, but absolutely worth it - this was the best restaurant we visited during our trip to Venice. In fact, it was because of this meal that Burano became our favorite island. We had lunch here without a reservation, but the staff were incredibly kind and offered us a table in 40 minutes. The bread with balsamic vinegar and olive oil was delicious. We’re still wondering where I can find the same vinegar they use! The seafood appetizer was fresh and flavorful, and the pasta we ordered was rich and perfectly cooked. While waiting, we chatted with a lovely older couple (in their 60s/70s) next to us, who told us it was their sixth time coming back to the island just for this restaurant. I hope that one day, when we’re their age, we can return to this little island and enjoy another meal here.:)

reviews.author: Karlyn Armstrong
reviews.text: We had an incredible family lunch in the back garden. It was utterly charming and the service was excellent - even with unruly children. All of the food was great but especially the crab tagliolini. They also catered to my gluten free needs perfectly. 5 star experience all around.

reviews.author: Natalie Kennedy
reviews.text: This was probably the most enjoyable dining experience I’ve ever had. The environment and ambience of the restaurant are lovely and the service was warm and very attentive. We had our very young children with us which had me a bit nervous but they were beautifully welcomed and made to feel right at home by the staff! The seafood risotto (the reason we had wanted to come) was delicious, and the grilled seafood was so fresh and perfectly cooked. Even the small side of vegetables we ordered was outstanding and excellently seasoned. We can’t stop talking about what a lovely time we had!

reviews.author: Adalyn
reviews.text: DO NOT LISTEN TO BAD REVIEWS! This place has a beautiful view, sat us right away, and the owner was charismatic. The food was nothing special, but decent for the price and atmosphere (and no wait time.) I can’t speak for the meat reviews, but the carbonara and pesto pasta was yummy. If you stumble upon this place, it’s definitely worth the try!

reviews.author: Adam Stewart
reviews.text: Delicious food, reasonable prices, great service. Loved the Carbonara and Spaghetti Alle Vonge (with clams). Bruschette and Caprese were perfect starters.

reviews.author: Sue Indrigo
reviews.text: The food was fine. The prices were similar to other restaurants (expensive). It was raining outside so they left us alone with no rush. However when it came time to pay, the bill was presented quickly. I didn't have much time to review it before it was taken away. I did notice an 11 euro service charge. For 3 people I'm not sure how they came up with that number. They then proceeded to tell us that a tip was not included and that it should only be cash.They hovered while we gathered our things. I assume to see what tip we left. This is Italy. No tip required. And what about that 11 euros?? I thought it was a bit shady.

reviews.author: michael hensey
reviews.text: We should have read the review before we entered the restaurant Da Bepi with high expectations. Patrons seemed happy dining outside. The inside decor was pleasant, and a number of customers seemed to be enjoying their food. We sat down, and before we ordered, a group of ants 🐜 joined us. We asked the waiter to move us. He did, and we ordered our food, I had the T-bone medium rare, and my wife had mixed grilled seafood. Both meals were terrible. Too salty. And the meat was fatty. We couldn't wait to go. Don't go near this place.

reviews.author: Chris Cheung
reviews.text: The service is great. The view is nice. But the food sucks. We ordered a grilled beef steak in medium. It comes out in a well-done steak. The steak is very thin as you can see in the photo (sorry that I forgot to take a photo for the cross section). It also has too much sinew in the steak. It totally tastes like a home made steak, but not up to a restaurant standard. And it cost for €18. Others are fine.

reviews.author: WenHua 文華 Chao
reviews.text: Super excellent Italian traditional cuisine! Excellent baked bread, simple cooked spaghetti, excellent cooked seafood risotto, all dishes are delicacy, Italian red wine tasted super good! Waiters are very skillful and friendly so everyone enjoyed the meal very pleasantly.

reviews.author: kit headley
reviews.text: I’m almost hesitant to give this place such a great review because it feels so local and delicious and I want it all to myself next time I’m in Venice. But I loved everything about it. Best plate of pasta I had the whole trip. I know that pasta’s not really the top thing to get in Venice, but I love it. The place was filled with local workers and the spaghetti with peppers was fantastic. The menus are hand written (so no promises on what will be on offer when you visit) and I got to chat with two different local gentleman at the table next to mine. Definite must go for me any time I return to Venice.

reviews.author: MF
reviews.text: Simple, homely and fresh pasta (pesto was so good) and so so delicious aperol spiritz ✨

reviews.author: Petros R.
reviews.text: Excellent, authentic restaurant - value for money! Two course lunch special was €14! Pasta with clams was ok, fish was perfect! Friendly staff, gets crazy busy around 1PM, so it’s a good idea to call ahead!

reviews.author: Gabriela Pîrvulescu
reviews.text: Atmosphere was great, thanks to the waiters who made us feel very cozy and relaxed. The food was great, we had pizza, pasta, fish plates and also dessert. Recommend it 100%

reviews.author: Eddie Samuel
reviews.text: Absolutely marvelous, taste great, size is amazing, light on your stomach and having it in a French bread makes it out of norm. People are amazing, truly enjoyed it. Did I say it costs almost 1 USD only, yes it does

reviews.author: Heba Daoud
reviews.text: I tried falafel sandwiches here for the first time ever it’s so good . I highly recommend everyone to come and grab one fresh and tasty sandwich

reviews.author: Lee Warburton
reviews.text: At 0.60 dinars for a falafel sandwich (its all they sell) its still one of the best meals on our trip

reviews.author: Robert M
reviews.text: Real cheap street food, nice taste better hot, and quick. Nice sandwich but not something I'd eat everyday. If you are on rainbow street and never had a falafel stop by and try it.

reviews.author: Moh'd Kayyali
reviews.text: Have been regular customer more than 30 years… lately falafel spices not like the past… taste is different from last years… but still nice .. quick service friendly staff standard price…

reviews.author: David Lan
reviews.text: A very interesting concept for a cafe bar. I really enjoyed the rooftop. The view was incredible but the food was somewhat bland and uninspiring. However, the atmosphere was quite good. I was visiting a friend that I haven't seen in 25 years since college. So that just added to the special atmosphere and we were speaking loudly and it didn't bother anyone. So if you're looking for a place to get together with friends, this is not a bad one at all. And when you get a chance on your way out, check out all those interesting art books.

reviews.author: Jennifer Killpack
reviews.text: Beautiful place to sit and enjoy the sunshine and cool of the morning. Great breakfast deals include coffee and fresh juice. Also the cheese manaeesh is handmade and to die for!

reviews.author: Mohammad S.S. Almaani, Ph.D.
reviews.text: A good, clean restaurant serving hamburgers and nachos (in addition to a long list of delicious food)is a gem for any food lover. Freshly grilled burgers, made with high-quality beef, perfectly toasted buns, and a variety of flavorful toppings, are always satisfying. Pair that with nachos piled high with gooey melted cheese, fresh guacamole, zesty salsa, and seasoned beef or chicken for the ultimate treat. A clean environment, friendly staff, and attention to detail make the experience even better, ensuring every bite is both delicious and enjoyable.

reviews.author: Öykü
reviews.text: Driest kebab I’ve ever had… they better remove it from the menu. The waiter was also weird, asking me “why are you angry” while I was just looking at my wallet (?) …Atmosphere was meh. High bpm pop / electronic is obviously not the best choice for a book cafe

reviews.author: Eric Miller
reviews.text: **The Vibe Is Back—and Better Than Ever!** Books @ Café has made a triumphant return! I stopped by for dinner last night, and I was thrilled to see the place buzzing with life once again. The restaurant was full, radiating the lively, welcoming atmosphere that made it such a beloved spot in the first place. It’s clear there’s been a fresh wave of energy—new management, new staff, and an impressively attentive team. I counted at least six or seven servers, all professional and friendly, along with a new manager who was actively ensuring everything ran smoothly. As for the food? Absolutely delicious, just as I remembered. Every bite was a reminder of why this place holds such a special place in the hearts of so many. Thank you, Books, for a truly wonderful evening. You’ve recaptured the magic, and I can’t wait to return again very soon!

reviews.author: deem_life
reviews.text: Beautiful

reviews.author: MohdEmad Hijazi
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Andy D
reviews.text: What a pleasant surprise this place was. We went in for a quick drink and a shared appetizer with 4 people and got a bottle of wine and shrimp. The food was fantastic!! Service fairly quick, with a great server. The atmosphere was fine, little oddly decorated for my taist. But all told this was a great stop, one I would do again without hesitation. Our server also spoke nearly perfect English.

reviews.author: yasmeen shanti
reviews.text: I went to this restaurant for the second time for the sushi buffet. They offer a miso soup which was sooo yummy a tad salty. And a crab salad which was amazing and really good. The sushi buffet has so many kinds and it is really yummy and delicious. From cooked to raw, nigiri to maki. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Mary Hantash
reviews.text: The food very delicious and the service is perfect specially hisham

reviews.author: Sara Rojas
reviews.text: I walked in for a quick bite but stayed for hours. Decor is beautiful and suhi rolls looked like art. Flavors popped and team was attentive. Honestly, this was one of my fave discoveries.

reviews.author: Anastasia
reviews.text: I was very hungry and ordered French onion soup and lasagna. And for dessert creme brulee. As a result, I overate. Everything was delicious. Good big portions. Interesting presentation. Large and varied menu. I was also pleased with the generous portion of wine

reviews.author: Ellis Duncan
reviews.text: Great people working there, and awesome food. The Koshary is great, and the Macarona Bechamel and Curly with Cheese are both delicious.

reviews.author: Lim
reviews.text: Not the same shop at downtown! The photos in the reviews are misleading! The staffs in the shop told me is the same! Obviously this shop is Habibeh! Not Habibah!

reviews.author: Mary Jones
reviews.text: I will never go. Ask to this place. The owner disrespectfully said that I wasn’t allowed back because I was American. He started sticking his things out and cursing in Arabic. The owner has no manners a and doesn’t deserve people’s business. I have never seen someone that hates their life as much as that man. He is very jealous and hates his life. And the sweets are always missing something. They want to you beg for something you payed for. The owner is trash. Now we know what kind of family he comes from.

reviews.author: Ramy Hallak
reviews.text: Average and the best one located in dt

reviews.author: Wassim Saad
reviews.text: A very delicious plate of oriental sweet ( Konafa) an extraordinary taste, you have to stand in a very long queue specially in the weekends because the shop is located in the the heart of the old market in East Amman, the beautiful organized calm clean city.

reviews.author: Fahd Batayneh فهد بطاينة
reviews.text: One of the finest and oldest restaurants in Amman Downtown opposite the old Downtown Postoffice. The restaurant serves a diverse menu of soups, salads, starters, main dishes, drinks and desserts. Their main menu items are local traditional dishes and international. Food portions are generous, and are very tasty. They accept cash and card. Staff are very friendly, and service is quick. The restaurant is very well decorated as it has a lot of antiques on display. They have an indoor seating and a veranda seating that overseas the downtown area. There are car parking lots within walking distance. Getting into the restaurant involves climbing stairs to an upper floor.

reviews.author: Koko
reviews.text: Absolutely loved the experience! The food was beyond delicious — fresh, flavorful, and super clean. We tried the creamy freekeh, fruits tabbouleh, and lamb neck… every dish was spot on! Big shoutout to Roshdi for the outstanding service — so welcoming and professional. Highly recommended. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Dr. mo Sammour
reviews.text: Good and and service were below average. We ordered two beef burgers with french fries. I think the burgers were frozen and not fresh. I couldn’t finish my plate. I feel let down by such a well known famous restaurant. We waited twenty minutes before our orders arrived! Disappointing.

reviews.author: J L
reviews.text: My husband and I had a great meal in downtown Jafra sitting on the balcony. The neck lamb was fork tender served on a bed of delicious Arabic rice. It could've fed 2 or 3 persons. My husband had the mixed grill and that was good too. The grillled whole tomato was sweet andctasty as was the grilled charred whole onion. We shared a big bowl of fresh rocca/arugula with cherry tomatoes and pomegranateseeds. Service was friendly and helpful, with beaming smiles. I am glad I decided to ignore the bad reviews. I did wish we had another friend or two to share our meal as we ate too much and had to leave food behind. Two thumbs up. The ladies toilet could be cleaner is my only complaint.

reviews.author: S54D1E H K
reviews.text: After visiting Rainbow street a few times we were recommended this place that became our favourite place to visit for our vacation. Warm and attentive staff. It was a pleasure to visit.

reviews.author: Germán Fernández
reviews.text: Nice restaurant placed in Amman area, 30 minutes by car. Good service, clean and fashion facilities. Awesome tipical food. English speaking personal. There is an open grill inside the restaurant, smoking is allowed, wide wines selection. The menu has different traditional local plates and some international.

reviews.author: Kevin Walters
reviews.text: Great place. Food was delicious, Atmosphere was fun, and service was good. Prices are not bad for what is offered. Was going to order dessert, but they have us a free one (actually 3). Less than 50 for two of us (apps, mains, tea).

reviews.author: Μαρία Ηλιάδου
reviews.text: Stunning place for lunch or/and dinner with great food options and wide variety! Entertaining and amusing music, some times even live! We really enjoyed our dinner there! We also appreciate our desert, Kanafeh, being prepared in front of us!

reviews.author: Ihsan Zumot
reviews.text: Lovely place, history is in every corner , very rustically designed and decorated.

reviews.author: Amir Riaz
reviews.text: Traditional Arabic Resturant located a bit away from main city but place is quite with nice city view. Decor & seating is good. Most unique thing is presence of grilled food cooking area in centre of restaurant with a huge chimney vent above it so no smoke or smell is felt inside the hall. Food menu is traditional Jordanian Cusine with grilled food as main course. Aroma & taste is excellant with quick & good service. Place is good for all.

reviews.author: Sara Feras Jarrah
reviews.text: The best restaurant in Amman to serve BBQ and Mansaf! we ordered a bbq set with lamb chops and Mansaf, and I give it 8.5/10 for the taste and quality of the food. The place is spacious and suits everyone from adults to kids and its divided to smokers and nonsmokers area. The staff are very professional and respectful with excellent service presented. I always love to see the old woman who bakes the Arabian Taboon bread however she is only available from 12 pm to 3:30 Pm (Lunch time) , also there is a kid area for games and arcades which my little brother always enjoyed! Thank you for your service and your kindness each time

reviews.author: Zaina Mahseen Zamiruddin
reviews.text: Tried this mashawi place and honestly, it was just okay. The food wasn’t bad, but for the price, you can definitely get better Arabic grills elsewhere. It feels like an old spot that hasn’t been refreshed in a while, the menus were dirty and falling apart. The vibe was pretty meh overall, nothing that made me want to stay longer. That said, the service was actually really good, which helped, but not enough to make me want to come back.

reviews.author: Dr. mo Sammour
reviews.text: Pure excellence! The food, the service and ambience were all great. We had the traditional Jordanian dish called “Mansaf”. It tasted truly delicious. The meat was locally sourced and of course lean and tender. The rice and sauce were cooked to perfection. We ordered one starter and that was fried Kobbeh, which also tased very good. We were served by genuinely customer focused waiter by the name Ibrahim AlSadiq (إبراهيم الصادق) a lovely Egyptian guy. We felt truly welcomed and the food was truly yummy. We had lovely Egyptian (kosheri) tea and muhallabiyya sweet, complement of the restaurant. The charge per person very much depends on the type and quantities of order.

reviews.author: Jonathan Avner
reviews.text: Had a fantastic evening here. Food was wonderful and service was helpful and friendly!

reviews.author: Hadeel
reviews.text: The food was good. The only complaint was that the "mashaw"" was less portion that we needed to order again. Otherwise, everything was good. The appetizers were really good with good amounts, the gave watermelon and pudding as dessert for free. Fast Service and the were nice. Valet available for 2jd.

reviews.author: Israa AlBargoothy
reviews.text: I dined at Ren Chai in Amman during Ramadan, and it was an unforgettable experience. The ambiance was elegant yet cozy, making it the perfect spot for an Iftar meal. The food was absolutely delicious—every dish was bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. I tried the shrimp balls, noodles, and a variety of sushi, and everything was fresh, perfectly seasoned, and full of rich, authentic taste. Each bite was a treat! The service was also very attentive and welcoming, adding to the overall great experience. Ren Chai is definitely one of the best spots in Amman for high-quality Asian cuisine. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Farah Hattar
reviews.text: Update: After sharing my honest feedback, I was pleasantly surprised by how genuinely the team reached out to me. They showed great care and professionalism, and the woman who contacted me was incredibly kind and attentive. I truly appreciate businesses that listen to their customers and are committed to building real connections and improving their service. It’s rare to see this kind of dedication, and it definitely left a positive impression on me. Looking forward to visiting again soon with a fresh perspective!

reviews.author: Mazhar Tello
reviews.text: I had a wonderful dining experience at Renshai, a restaurant specializing in Chinese cuisine and Japanese sushi. The menu offers a wide variety of options, from classic Chinese dishes to fresh, well-prepared sushi rolls. I tried several items including the spicy noodles and salmon sushi, and everything was flavorful and beautifully presented. The ambiance of the restaurant is cozy, clean, and elegantly designed with an Asian-inspired decor. The lighting and seating arrangement create a comfortable environment perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit. They made sure we were satisfied with our orders and provided helpful recommendations from the menu. Overall, Renshai is an excellent spot for anyone craving authentic Chinese and Japanese flavors. I highly recommend it for sushi lovers and fans of Asian cuisine in general. I’ll definitely be visiting again soon.

reviews.author: Wj Discovery
reviews.text: Good food not my go to asian place but it is delicious. The Rangoon was perfect the crispy beef wasn’t crispy yet tasted very good siblings where good 👍🏽 You can walk in but we usually book if there is a big group

reviews.author: Mohammad S.S. Almaani, Ph.D.
reviews.text: The serene ambiance and delicious cuisine make this establishment worthy of return visits. This restaurant offers an exceptional dining experience, starting with its delicious and diverse menu. There is a wide variety of dishes to choose from, ensuring that every guest finds something to satisfy their taste buds. The food is not only flavorful but also beautifully presented, making each dish a delight for the senses. Cleanliness is a top priority here, as the restaurant is always spotless and well-maintained, ensuring a comfortable and hygienic dining environment. The atmosphere is calm and serene, providing the perfect setting for a relaxing meal. Whether you're dining with family, friends, or enjoying a quiet solo meal, the quiet ambiance enhances the overall experience, allowing for easy conversation or peaceful solitude. From the food to the setting, this restaurant is a perfect choice for anyone looking for a memorable and enjoyable meal.

address: Street Stall - Jabal Amman, Amman, Jordan

name: Street Stall - Rainbow St
address: Street Stall - Rainbow St, Amman, Jordan

reviews.author: naim joubran
reviews.text: A nice street in Amman full of old shops and restaurants. We went there for a walk and spent almost 2 hours jumping from one store to the other. Lots of shops who sell authentic stuff and many restaurants also serving all kinds of food

reviews.author: Rafeeque M. Ali
reviews.text: Most happening place in Amman... a street full of cafes, restaurants and art shops etc... a stroll around this street during the evenings are the best time pass while in Amman...

reviews.author: Ahmed Al-Akki
reviews.text: This is a must see landmark when visiting Amman. This street has so many interesting stores, amazing restaurants and cool cafes. The vibe is very hip and refreshing.

reviews.author: Dip
reviews.text: It may have been good. The old picture looked nice, it's nothing like it anymore, total waste of time, don't waste your time going to Rainbow Street.

reviews.author: Mariam Ossama
reviews.text: Had heard a lot about it, but honestly a bit overrated. It's a nice walk with some shops and restaurants. Bought some nice souvenirs from the shops there. It is definitely better to walk there than the city center

reviews.author: Raluca Dumitrescu
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience at Sufra. A very nice place, traditional decoration, very authentic design. The food was incredible good. The portions are huge, so be careful how much you order. The lamb is very good , no matter the plate you choose. The mint lemonade also good.

reviews.author: Lawrence Hon
reviews.text: A truly delightful place to dine around a gushing fountain and beautifully lit surroundings, while people are bustling and cooking around you. The atmosphere is lively and convivial. Besides that, the menu is a delight to behold; there are many options for any person, even the pickiest. However, the prices tend to be on the higher side considering Jordan. They have a not-often-seen liquor menu with excellent Jordanian wine, lots of appetizers (I ordered two and both were delicious), and a comprehensive selection of entrees. My entree was average in taste, I felt the chicken was a bit overcooked to my liking, but maybe that's just their style. But the atmosphere is inviting and you can easily linger here over conversation and a few drinks for hours.

reviews.author: Frankie Montanez
reviews.text: Incredible experience at Supra! The food was absolutely fresh and delicious — the hummus, tabbouleh, falafel, and chicken dish were all outstanding. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and you could truly taste the quality in every bite. We were especially grateful that the owner kindly welcomed us even though the kitchen was about to close — such genuine hospitality. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an authentic and memorable meal in Amman!

reviews.author: Laith Abuabdu
reviews.text: Sufra is hands down one of the best dining experiences in Amman! The food is absolutely incredible—from the traditional Mansaf to the perfectly grilled meats, fresh salads, and refreshing juices, every dish is full of flavor and beautifully presented. The service is warm and professional, and the atmosphere is just perfect—authentic, welcoming, and full of charm. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy real Jordanian hospitality and cuisine at its finest!

reviews.author: Bo
reviews.text: Sufra Restaurant offers a relaxed and authentic Jordanian dining experience in a charming setting. The cozy villa, with its garden seating and traditional decor, creates a comfortable atmosphere that feels both inviting and rooted in local culture. We enjoyed a variety of mezze dishes, all of which were fresh and flavorful. The hummus was creamy and well-seasoned, the falafel had a satisfying crunch with a soft, herb-packed center. Service was friendly and attentive. The staff provided clear recommendations in English. Prices felt reasonable for the quality and ambiance.

reviews.author: Jonathan
reviews.text: After an amazing day at Jerash, we stopped for dinner at Trader Vic’s, which offers a taste of tropical paradise in the heart of Amman. It provided a relaxing and quiet escape from the bustling city streets. Stepping inside the timbered interior, adorned with colorful masks and bamboo decor, feels like entering an island oasis. The menu features their signature drinks and dishes and didn’t disappoint! Great service and upbeat music added to the atmosphere. With its fun vibe, great food and drinks, and great location, Trader Vic's is a one-of-a-kind dining gem in Amman, for a memorable night out.

reviews.author: Elie Khalil (branguider)
reviews.text: Enjoyed our 1st visit in Amman to our favorite place worldwide🤩 tasty food & great service special thanks to (Mahdi) for the great hospitality. Its Sunday & guess what!? Its Ladies night!! (2drinks on the house)🥂 lovely atmosphere will visit it again for sure👌& we got coconut ice cream on the house as well🍦

reviews.author: Brian Bontenbal
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere, the concept really works. Food is surprisingly good! Combinations of flavours that work well together. Large list of cocktails, also bigger ones for groups. Tasty!!! 😊 Final point worth mentioning is the service. We were taken extremely well care of by all the team. Fadi, my new friend, you get a special mention and a big thumbs up 👍👍👍 You've made our night memorable and because of you we will return tomorrow for drinks on our last night in Jordan. To all the team: congratulations! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gary Moon
reviews.text: Our evening at Trader Vic’s was like finding an amazing Oasis. The food was fantastic, cooked perfectly and with great flavor. The best part was the relaxing atmosphere and attentive service. Hussein our water is a Rock Star with the best recommendations! The restaurant is a perfect representation of Ohana.. which is Hawaiian for family.

reviews.author: Arnab Ghosh
reviews.text: A nice, quiet outlet with all the usual Trader Vic's favourites. The local special is a drink called Amman Aku Aku — a lovely refresher at the end of a hard day's work!

reviews.author: Eslam Ghazzawi
reviews.text: A Hidden Gem with Stunning Views and Exceptional Flavors! 🤩✨🌟 Vinaigrette never disappoints. 🍣🥳 The rooftop setting offers breathtaking views of Amman, creating the perfect ambiance for a relaxed and elegant dining experience. 🌃💫 The menu is a beautiful blend of international and Asian-fusion cuisine—each dish is crafted with care, especially their sushi and signature mains. 🥢🍱 The service is warm and attentive, and the atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between upscale and welcoming. 🧑‍🍳😊💯 Highly recommended for family dinners or special occasions! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦🎉🎈

reviews.author: Dr Charbel Chedrawy
reviews.text: A beautiful Japanese restaurant in the heart of Amman with an exquisite view. Located inside Al Qasr Metropole Hotel, this rooftop is the place to be. Very quite with excellent food and service, with a wonderful atmosphere. The dessert are perfect. Enjoy...

reviews.author: Abdallah Abu Ghalyoun
reviews.text: I visited this restaurant today in Amman, and I must say it was a delightful experience. The food was delicious, and the service was excellent. The view from the restaurant was amazing, offering a panoramic vista of most of Amman. The atmosphere was youthful, pleasant, and friendly. I highly recommend it, especially for young people.

reviews.author: Hosam Wajeeh
reviews.text: The sushi was great. Other appetizers, drinks & service were below average. The atmosphere is great at night.

reviews.author: Ève Tabi
reviews.text: Vinaigrette is all right, but I would rather go to the Garden since they are in the same building. The sushi are fine but far from exceptional. I stayed at the AlQasr Hotel for more than a month, so I went a few times, and the sushi was always quite dry. For the price, I would imagine they would be better. The view is nice, and the service is also good :)

reviews.author: Qasim Radaideh
reviews.text: One of the unique experiences I had in Jordan, I gave a try to their food at an eco-friendly restaurant. I had a nice view to the old part of the city of Amman, and that was nice. Service was great, nice and professional friendly staff. Food was great in quality and taste, no mistake at all, and I saw what others are ordering all looked so delicious and presented and served nicely. The ambience of whole place is calm and amazing. Smoke and noise free is very nice experience. Did not stay in the rooms, but maybe it could be nice experience from the way it’s over looking the city with great view. I wish there are more places like this in town. Great respect to the management of the restaurant, looking forward to more visits. I advise you give it a try, you will enjoy it.

reviews.author: dana shadid
reviews.text: I had a great experience at this place! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was excellent. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. What truly stood out was the breathtaking view—overlooking the old city of Amman, it created a magical atmosphere that made the experience unforgettable. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a great meal with a stunning view!

reviews.author: Omar Bazrawi
reviews.text: One of the unique experiences in Amman where you can try their organic food at an eco-friendly restaurant. View to the old part of the city is stunning, don't miss it. Prices are within the range.

reviews.author: Hadeel Abu ktaish
reviews.text: spent a brief but lovely time at this scenic center. the gift shop features unique, local products. the food was very fresh as well.

reviews.author: Yazan Al-Saif
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Wild Jordan Center. The location is easy to find, parking is available if you're booking your stay there or you can just park on the street in front of the center. The staff members are friendly and always ready to help. The views are nice as you can see Amman Castle Mount, huge flag pole, and downtown area. Food options are wide and diverse especially for vegans and vegetarians. Ingredients are local and influenced by Jordanian culture.

reviews.text: It may not look fancy but you can still have nice plats to eat. The waiter was nice and welcoming. Large choice of plats. Terraces (ground and 1st floors) to enjoy your meal outside.

reviews.author: Niamhfromglen
reviews.text: I had the most beautiful and tasty meal at this restaurant 🌻 I can’t wait to come back to try the dish with the peppers. Does anyone know what it’s called I would love to try make it but it will never be as good as this place 🥺

reviews.author: Georgi Ivanov
reviews.text: Nothing special as kitchen or as atmosphere - it is more a street quick bite restaurant at the Market and after you have finished your meal nothing can keep you there. Prices seem reasonable, but they put on them sales tax, service charge etc., so you better read the menu carefully before to leave them a tip, too. .

reviews.author: Bahaa Mba
reviews.text: it was the best mostly in aqaba if you want the real taste specially by the sea food ,, and all this staff clean well cooked and also the good service for a local resturant ,, but somedays now the service is changing bad and good

reviews.author: Jean-Noël JOFFROY
reviews.text: restaurant to flee, we ordered grilled local fish fillets and after a long wait we had fried pang fillet (origin Vietnam) they also served us something not ordered and to finish applied 10% + 7% of tax

reviews.author: Nadine
reviews.text: Amazing place, cheerful staff, generous portions and everything was really delicious, food came very quickly

reviews.author: Filippo Bertetto
reviews.text: Delicious, quick and honest. The best food we had in Jordan so far. All the plates were delicious, incredibly tasty and light at the same time. We ate so much but didn't feel heavy afterwards. The people are so polite, welcoming and honest (same prices for everybody). Very kind with tourists to let couples together at the ground floor and patience with the ordering and everything really. You have to have a meal here if you are in Aqaba. Do not skip the falafel.

reviews.author: Tom Ford
reviews.text: Wow what can I say? This place is a must go to place in Aqaba if you are there. The food is so tasty and is so cheap! You really do get good value for your buck here! It cost us £5 equivalent for two of us to eat lunch here. The food was so tasty and prepared for us there and then whilst we were there. If you’re in Aqaba then give this place a visit!

reviews.author: A .Z A
reviews.text: it actually is delicious and have a lot of options to see the arabian hummus and falafel, along with other things such as salad, one note that i mightve sensed is the lack of instructions as i ordered the food and i had to go to outiside to the window to get my order, i believe instructions are needed

reviews.author: Annalisa Bonacini
reviews.text: Typical restaurant with a room for family upstairs. Many local families were there for lunch. Nice staff. Very low prices and good food: we had lunch for five people (2 big sandwiches with falafel, 3 meat + hummus and salad, 2 french fries, 12 falafel and 2 water bottles) for only 10 JOD. We strongly recommend it !

reviews.author: Laura Mesa Abad
reviews.text: 10/10 Me and my friend had dinner for 10JOD total. The food was delicious - we had the kofta with tomato, baba ganoush, garlic yogurt and the Arabian salad. The service was impeccable - the waiter was very kind and offered us tea and sweets for dessert (for free!🥹). This is a lovely restaurant I would really recommend eating at if you’re ever in Aqaba!

reviews.author: Mohga Tawfik
reviews.text: I saw good reviews on this place so suggested it to my friends to try it. We were fasting so we had our iftar. I wanted to try the traditional food (mansaf) but the chicken version. The milky soup that comes with the dish is being served separately which is very useful in case you didn’t like it so you can manage whether to add it to the dish or not. It wasn’t light and salty, this is not my preference when it comes to food so I ate the rice with the chicken only 😁 but they tasted very nice. Portion was very good. Prices were good too. It was crowded Masha2allah. I’d eat there again.

reviews.author: Um Suleiman
reviews.text: Service was excellent food was amazing will visit again the kabab was tasty juicy well spiced but the shrimp I’ve never had shrimp like this my entire life yousif was amazingly friendly and pleasant I’ll definitely recommend it to family and friends

reviews.author: Lavinia Wang
reviews.text: I was recommended this restaurant by a local friend. The place was small but really clean. I ordered hummus with meat and lamb with rice. Both were super tasty. The portion sizes were huge! Yusef was very friendly, making the experience even better. Thank you Yusef, I’ll see you next time!

reviews.author: Lucile Ané
reviews.text: Delicious restaurant, best meal we had in Jordan ! Service is exceptional. We especially recommend trying the lemon mint drink and the Berouti hummus.

reviews.author: syruk
reviews.text: I visited Al Bait Al Shami today for the third time in three years, and I’m happy to say that the quality of the service, hospitality, and food has remained consistently excellent. The place has a charming atmosphere, with beautifully decorated interiors that reflect the authentic Syrian spirit. The food is delicious, with true Syrian flavours, presented in an appealing way. Portions are generous and reasonably priced. The drinks are tasty, and the overall ambience is cosy and enjoyable. The staff are polite, welcoming, and attentive. They’re more than happy to accommodate special requests or modify dishes to suit your taste. The restrooms are clean and well-maintained, which is always a plus. We also enjoyed the shisha, which was quite pleasant. As a lovely gesture, the restaurant offered us complimentary traditional Middle Eastern sweets. There are separate seating areas for smokers and those who prefer fresh air, but note that children are not allowed in the smoking section — something to keep in mind when visiting with family. I’ll definitely be coming back here on my next trip to Doha!

reviews.author: Wajdy Shalghin
reviews.text: Syrian cuisine, the food is good, we had mixed grill the chicken tawook, meat cubes, lamb chops and kebab are good, tender and tasty. We had also meat with tomato which was also good. In addition to cheese burek which was amazing, hummus, mutabal, fatoush and rocca salad. The sweet was OK. The service was good and the staff were nice. I recommend

reviews.author: Ajeet Keshari
reviews.text: Very Disappointing I tried the Umm Ali at Al-Shami Home Restaurant last night, and unfortunately, it was a huge letdown. As someone who truly enjoys this classic dessert, I was shocked at how poorly it was made. It felt like the chef either had no idea how Umm Ali is supposed to taste or simply didn’t put any care into preparing it. The texture was off, the flavor was bland, and overall, it was a far cry from what Umm Ali should be. Honestly, it was so bad that I genuinely believe they should reconsider offering it on their menu until they learn how to make it properly. If you're craving Umm Ali, this is definitely not the place for it.

reviews.author: Parth Soni
reviews.text: Me along with my friends went to have Umm ali late in the evening but little did we knew about the disappointment we were going to face. Certainly, Chef don't know how its made. We barely had 2-3 spoon out of guilt towards paying for it. I'd highly advise to revisit the recipe as it's a famous dessert. ------- To be considered as constructive feedback and not otherwise, A disappointed Visitor.

reviews.author: Samer Kharsa
reviews.text: If you miss homemade-style meals, Al-Shami Home Restaurant is the place to go. Their food is consistently flavorful, with standout dishes like the thinly sliced rocca with beetroot salad and the boneless chicken breast platter (my favorites); in addition to their standard daily meals. The service is fast and friendly, making each visit enjoyable. Plus, the reasonable prices make it a great value. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Laura Mesa Abad
reviews.text: 10/10 Me and my friend had dinner for 10JOD total. The food was delicious - we had the kofta with tomato, baba ganoush, garlic yogurt and the Arabian salad. The service was impeccable - the waiter was very kind and offered us tea and sweets for dessert (for free!🥹). This is a lovely restaurant I would really recommend eating at if you’re ever in Aqaba!

reviews.author: Mohga Tawfik
reviews.text: I saw good reviews on this place so suggested it to my friends to try it. We were fasting so we had our iftar. I wanted to try the traditional food (mansaf) but the chicken version. The milky soup that comes with the dish is being served separately which is very useful in case you didn’t like it so you can manage whether to add it to the dish or not. It wasn’t light and salty, this is not my preference when it comes to food so I ate the rice with the chicken only 😁 but they tasted very nice. Portion was very good. Prices were good too. It was crowded Masha2allah. I’d eat there again.

reviews.author: Um Suleiman
reviews.text: Service was excellent food was amazing will visit again the kabab was tasty juicy well spiced but the shrimp I’ve never had shrimp like this my entire life yousif was amazingly friendly and pleasant I’ll definitely recommend it to family and friends

reviews.author: Lavinia Wang
reviews.text: I was recommended this restaurant by a local friend. The place was small but really clean. I ordered hummus with meat and lamb with rice. Both were super tasty. The portion sizes were huge! Yusef was very friendly, making the experience even better. Thank you Yusef, I’ll see you next time!

reviews.author: Lucile Ané
reviews.text: Delicious restaurant, best meal we had in Jordan ! Service is exceptional. We especially recommend trying the lemon mint drink and the Berouti hummus.

reviews.author: syruk
reviews.text: I visited Al Bait Al Shami today for the third time in three years, and I’m happy to say that the quality of the service, hospitality, and food has remained consistently excellent. The place has a charming atmosphere, with beautifully decorated interiors that reflect the authentic Syrian spirit. The food is delicious, with true Syrian flavours, presented in an appealing way. Portions are generous and reasonably priced. The drinks are tasty, and the overall ambience is cosy and enjoyable. The staff are polite, welcoming, and attentive. They’re more than happy to accommodate special requests or modify dishes to suit your taste. The restrooms are clean and well-maintained, which is always a plus. We also enjoyed the shisha, which was quite pleasant. As a lovely gesture, the restaurant offered us complimentary traditional Middle Eastern sweets. There are separate seating areas for smokers and those who prefer fresh air, but note that children are not allowed in the smoking section — something to keep in mind when visiting with family. I’ll definitely be coming back here on my next trip to Doha!
