reviews.author: Angle Meme
reviews.text: One of the local pastry shops in AlAqaba..really delicious and freshly backed pastries..

reviews.author: Qusai AlHonati
reviews.text: Evertime am visiting home, altarboosh is a vital station for me, highly recommeded for traditional pastries, quality/price is high.

reviews.author: Maddalena Davoli
reviews.text: Nice stuffed pastries for a Quick lunch

reviews.author: Ing. Tomas Dvoracek
reviews.text: Delicious little "pizzas".

reviews.author: Bora Arasan
reviews.text: This was the place where we could feed ourselves in the most affordable way in Aqaba.

reviews.author: Salma Murad
reviews.text: I have been staying in this hotel for yearsssss every time I am in Dahab . The friendly staff , the biiiiiig rooms, the rooom and the perfect location 💜

reviews.author: Nouran Reda
reviews.text: In all honesty, the location is close to everything, sea front… the staff is beyond supportive and helpful. Very reasonable prices 100% recommend

reviews.author: Ahmad Salem
reviews.text: The location is excellent in the centre of Masbat Bay. The side view is a good option looking over souvenir shops, side-seaview, and side- mountainview. Breakfast is nice, and the chef is very helpful. Staff are helpful and honest. Suitable for families. The only problem comes out off the hotel; Surrounded by the crowded area of the market, the problem lies especially with the other kitchen of the Ali Baba restaurant, which doesn't belong to the hotel, making a lot of noise with tools and yelling at each other. N.B. The dining area of the hotel on the roof offers a magnificent view 👌🏻

reviews.author: Tarek Anwar
reviews.text: Good price, great location. Old school egyptian room style. A bit unclean though. Service a tad lacking although everyone is very friendly. Highlight is the roof where you can Egyptian breakfast.

reviews.author: Hala El-atr
reviews.text: Friendly stuff🙏🏼, and Great location👌, but room’s furniture is old, dusty☹️, and they not provide minibar service inside the room😠, however when I asked for, they provided me a kettle to assure my satisfaction. My point is don’t expect lavish service, but the stuff here really are amazing 👌and will do their best to make you comfortable and happy.🥰😀😀

reviews.author: Mahmoud Al-Wreikat (JY5HL)
reviews.text: The best fish restaurant ever in Aqaba. The food is very delicious, the service is very excellent, and the service is also very fast. The owner, management and staff are excellent and very friendly. Prices are reasonable and affordable. I highly recommend going there for lunch and/or dinner.

reviews.author: Alia Barahmeh
reviews.text: Great lunch experience at Alibaba in Aqaba! Tried various seafood dishes, ribs, biryani, and appetizers - all delicious. Outdoor seating is cool, centrally located in downtown. Easy taxi access from hotels. Prices fair for quality. Staff very friendly. Loved it!

reviews.author: AL Hanadi
reviews.text: I don’t if they are good at or not, We tried grilled meet mashawi, tabbouleh and chilli potato and yalanji, it was not good at all Sour tabbouleh, very dry and hard rice inside the yalanji Chilli potato was nice Rice was nice. Staff is perfect 👌🏽 very friendly and welcoming. Atmosphere is vintage and awesome.

reviews.author: Laura Carr
reviews.text: The fish was beautiful and fresh, cooked to perfection. The service was impeccable, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Rhys Travel
reviews.text: Delicious food especially fish sayadiyah, grilled shrimps and mixed grilled meat were all great. We had to wait maybe 15-20 mins for the food as they're very busy. It's probably a touristy place and it's comfortable and clean. We also had three drinks and kunafa and baklavas. The bill came to about 55JD for three of us with service and tax included.

reviews.author: Becca Rice
reviews.text: Tucked away in a side street, this quaint spot is a true gem of a restaurant. It looks modest from the outside, but from the moment you enter it's a quality experience all the way. Everything is prepared with care and fantastic quality. The staff are attentive, friendly and ready to offer guidance with the menu. We had several small dishes to be able to try a variety of flavors and from the first savory dish down to the dessert, it was all incredible. We didn't even think to take photos because we were so absorbed in the dishes presented to us! We will definitely be back! A big thank you to this wonderful place for such a great culinary experience ❤️

reviews.author: Ale K
reviews.text: I have been going to this restaurant for years and it has consistently been excellent. It's a small and intimate restaurant, so making a reservation is highly recommended. The food is truly delicious, offering a wonderful selection of hot and cold meze. The main courses are superb, and to finish, they have delicious desserts and excellent domestic coffee.

reviews.author: Ajay Parekh
reviews.text: 5 stars well deserved! Service with a smile and attention, food was tasty and plentiful. We were a group of six on our last night in Malta. Two of us had the vegetarian mezze items, the other four had the main meat dishes also ( no vegetarian options for main course), although too full to have any dessert. Oh and the wine list is extensive and we chose well with our red.

reviews.author: Mafalda Pedro
reviews.text: AMAZING!! We found this place on google when looking for a place for dinner last minute that was close to where we were staying in Gzira, and omg we were impressed!! Between the 2 of us we got a range of plates to share and we were so impressed by everything. We really recommend the lamb, it was so tender and juicy and probably the best lamb we've ever had! Everything else was equally amazing. We had some Lebanese wine that was so good as well. We were being constantly impressed whenever everything came out. The service was amazing and the restaurant didn't disappoint.

reviews.author: David Fenech
reviews.text: We have been before but it’s been a while, so we were looking forward to enjoying some very good Mediterranean/ Middle Eastern food. The serving staff as smart and attentive as always - they deserve the best accolades as much as the cooking staff for their amazing food. We asked for our Albanian server to choose the food for us and he made some great choices. The starter hummus dips and lamb/harissa dip were so nice with the fresh bread. We felt the felafal had a very hard / burnt exterior shell, but all the meat based dishes were simply divine, including the lamb tongue. The wine is on the expensive side and the servers tried to sell more of it - doing their job. But the biggest hang up we had was the heat in the restaurant- we really couldn’t imagine eating there in summer. Having said that, I’m in love with this place - recommended

reviews.author: Jonas Bürgi
reviews.text: Some of the best food I have ever eaten in my life. There is only one dish - but this dish is perfect. There is one waiter who can speak english very well.

reviews.author: Sara Ahmed Fouad
reviews.text: The meat taste is really different. I was advised to try it, but I didn't give a big importance for the advice. Now I know, it deserves 😊

reviews.author: Safae Kherbouche
reviews.text: This place deserves 100 stars, if you ever come to Konya this place is a must try

reviews.author: Amin Memari
reviews.text: The best Turkish firing kabab you can find here, the pure taste of lamb with fresh bread takes you to the extreme of enjoyment. We ordered some Turkish sweets with tea, a great combination 👍 strongly recommend it.

reviews.author: Lennart Garritsen
reviews.text: This place is a true scam. I went here because of the reviews. They specialised in lamb with onions and bread (nothing else on offer). Food is good but fatty and service is friendly. But: very high price - 150gr plus water was 425TL… price quality is insanely bad. Other places charge way less despite owners claims. Will never return here…

reviews.text: Great and authentic Lebanese food, generous platters and great taste. You can eat the raw dishes without any fear of food poisoning. Keep in mind the cost though for budget conscious people.

reviews.author: Karim Sirgi
reviews.text: Used to be my FAVORITE restaurant in Lebanon; they recently underwent renovation (very nice) but it seems the quality of the food also got renovated downward ... I tried it in late January 2019 and it was a huge disappointment. I kindly informed our waiter about it and begged him to let management know and do something about it in the near future ... Best of luck for a very much needed come back to previous glory! I won't come back unless I hear great reviews again from friends and family living there

reviews.author: Elham Nakadi
reviews.text: Excellent traditionnel Lebanese Food, very good service. Family oriented, an address not to miss if your a foodie....👍😁

reviews.author: Koko Koko
reviews.text: Food is amazing but I didn't like the fish the kind was( BIZRI ) I think not well fried .the kafta nayyé and all the raw meat was excellent .

reviews.author: Samia Elzyrkassouf
reviews.text: It's a Lebanese restaurant ..mezze and grilled meat chicken sausages...very tasty and generous portions

reviews.author: Marina S
reviews.text: The seafood menu is extensive—grilled jumbo shrimps, fried calamari, whole fish, you name it. Portions are generous and staff are polite (they kindly swapped a sugary coleslaw for a plain salad when we asked). The space has a cozy, nautical feel, which adds charm. However, a few things threw us off. Many seafood dishes are deep-fried or borderline overcooked—even grilled shrimps were tough to peel. The coleslaw? Packed with sugar—literally crunching between the teeth. Also, if you order a dish grilled at your table, beware: the ventilation isn’t strong enough — be prepared to smell like smoke afterward. Good service, but the food and setup need fine-tuning.

reviews.author: Bo
reviews.text: We had a lovely lunch at Captain’s Restaurant during our time in Aqaba. The highlight was definitely the seafood bucket—both fresh and flavorful. It’s a great choice if you’re in the mood for a hearty and satisfying seafood feast. The service was warm and friendly. The setting is casual and comfortable, making it a nice spot to relax. Overall, a solid choice for seafood lovers in Aqaba. Would happily come back!

reviews.author: Shaakirah F
reviews.text: Overall we enjoyed the place - food was good, fish was cooked really well however the sides and the tartar sauce could have done with more flavour. Service was great, very welcoming! Nice place to visit in Aqaba if you like seafood.

reviews.author: aseel emran
reviews.text: Wow, It was a lovely experience. Everything was so good the food, the staff and the atmosphere 👌 The staff was quick witted since we were 14 people they added up the tables for us to sit together and the food was super deli Ten out of ten

reviews.author: Marta Silva
reviews.text: Amazing meal. We asked seafood tablieyh and seafood spaghetti and it was tasteful and delicious. The bread is the best we have tried! Habib and Yahea are part of the staff and they gave us a warm welcoming and a funny and nice vibe for a dinner.

reviews.author: Mohammad Eid
reviews.text: I went to this place along with my cousin and our wives based on the [great] recommendations of many locals in Aqaba - and to my surprise there was only one bad [google] review and one customer sitting having lunch (it was around 1 PM on a Saturday at the time). The server who came to us was very helpful and gave us some good recommendations as we were browsing through the long menu. My wife had the spicy fish, and I had the mixed seafood grill, which were both absolutely delicious! For appetizers we had the mtabel, fried calamri, and a rocca salad - the rocca salad was not good but the other items were really good. The place was a little expensive but then again most seafood is a bit pricey. In conclusion I am glad we tried this place and I too will highly recommend it to anyone visiting Aqaba.

reviews.author: Sobhi Dweik
reviews.text: they are serving a good food and wine ,its cozy and recommended for couple dinner 👌

reviews.author: Maamoun S
reviews.text: Overrated, prices are high compared to food quality: Prawns were overcooked, grilled fish was chewy...

reviews.author: Majd Hawari
reviews.text: Ok

reviews.text: Excellent seafood, but a little expensive. Wine is served. There is Wi-Fi. The card payment did not go through, I had to go to the ATM opposite.

reviews.author: Areen Arabiat
reviews.text: It’s a really nice hotel, highly recommend if you’ve got the money

reviews.author: khalid azzam
reviews.text: Everything is poor, AC is not working, and there is no signal in the room nor WiFi, It is a very cheap but shitty hotel?

reviews.author: karja lol
reviews.text: The worst hotel the room wasn't clean the AC doesn't work and room is hot and you can't even breath and the inside room every now and then some of the employees look at us from the window like what the hell is going on and the place doesn't match with the place

reviews.author: Euphoria Dz
reviews.text: I really liked the vibe of it very simple and cozy

reviews.author: Naji Abufara
reviews.text: When we reached , the front desk wasn't helpful at all, so disrespectful when we asked to see the room before we made a check in , also when we saw the room, it wasn't like the photos and the rating, looks dirty, Thier is a bad heavy smell in the lobby. We were very disappointed after a long trip , Be Carful! DON'T lose your money on it , not worth it!

reviews.author: Victor Wang
reviews.text: We picked a less crowded timing and just took pictures for fun. Still the food was amazing. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ellice Antonelli
reviews.text: Best meal we had in Jordan! We had the set menu which was super tasty and varied, and the service was excellent. Incredibly reasonably priced too 😁

reviews.author: Quynhnhu N
reviews.text: Amazing lunch in Aqaba! Decor was beautiful, the staff and service were excellent - very welcoming and friendly and the food was just delicious. Possibly our favourite or top 2 meals in Aqaba. The guava juice was lovely, refreshing, while the seafood tajine and mansaf meat were simply divine. To top it off, we ordered dessert, which was also excellent (very big portion for 1, so glad we shared it). All round great restaurant, we were concerned as we'd seen mixed reviews expressing a decline in food quality, but we thought it was great. Portions were also generous, we were still full at dinner! Would definitely come back here.

reviews.author: Saed Salaimeh
reviews.text: The seating area is amazingly organized and decorated.. Suitable for pictures and Instagram stories.. But food was not as it used to be.. It was too greasy.. Small portions.. And in general does not compare value of money.. Toilets were very dirty and I was disappointed as i used to love this place.. In general.. I would recommend it for coffee or a drink.. But not for food.

reviews.author: Gregory Harris
reviews.text: While the food and drink may be a bit overpriced, the food is generally tasty. A large variety of authentic Jordanian food is on the menu. The real reason people come, however, is the unique vibe - the seats are stuffed chairs or loveseats and the tables are made of tree trunks. Likewise, the dishes are carved wood. Live music weekends. reviews.text: This is an absolutely fantastic place a bit of a labyrinth but so enjoyable with winding streets and multiple marketplaces and plenty of cafes and eating spots. Great atmosphere and one of the streets will take you down to the beach. We spent hours just wandering around and it’s up there with any marketplace in Morocco.

reviews.author: mmm a
reviews.text: This has got to be the best souk in Morocco! I’ve been to many, but Essaouira’s felt so special. I spent about five hours there and still didn’t want to leave. Each shop has its own unique vibe, and the shopkeepers were incredibly kind and helpful. Every time I asked where to find something, they wouldn’t just point me in the direction—they’d actually walk me there and leave without the other shopkeepers noticing. It was such a genuine experience. You’ll find everything from handmade Moroccan teapots and beautiful tea glasses to breathtaking paintings and handmade rugs, linen clothing, genuine leather goods, and the most fragrant spices. If you’re looking for authentic treasures, this is the place!

reviews.author: SONICK THUKKANI
reviews.text: Floating in the Dead Sea is like nothing else in the world! Thanks to the high salt density, your body naturally floats with zero effort — it’s surreal, relaxing, and absolutely unforgettable. To make the most of your visit, choosing the right spot along the coast is key. We stayed at the Grand East Hotel, and it made a big difference. The beach access was smooth, the mud was plentiful (perfect for a natural spa treatment!), and the food and facilities were spot on. A few tips for first-timers: Apply the Dead Sea mud before entering — it’s not just great for your skin, it also enhances the whole experience. Protect your eyes, nose, and mouth from the water — the high salinity can be quite harsh if it gets into sensitive areas. Splashing is a big no-no! Enter slowly, float gently, and enjoy the calm and buoyant sensation. It’s truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience and a natural wonder you’ll remember forever.

reviews.author: Abu Suzan
reviews.text: I had the privilege of visiting the Dead Sea during my recent trip to Jordan, and I must say, it was an awe-inspiring experience like no other! The Dead Sea is truly a mesmerizing natural wonder that left me in complete awe of its unique beauty and healing properties. The first thing that struck me was the otherworldly landscape surrounding the sea. The vast expanse of shimmering water contrasted against the arid desert landscape created a sight that I won't soon forget. The vibrant hues of the water and the salt-crusted shores made for a surreal and picturesque scene. Floating in the buoyant waters of the Dead Sea was an absolute delight! It's true what they say - you effortlessly float on the surface due to the extremely high salt concentration. It's an unusual sensation that made me feel like I was weightless, and the feeling was truly therapeutic. I couldn't resist taking a dip and experiencing this unique phenomenon for myself. Moreover, the mineral-rich mud found along the shores is known for its healing properties. I couldn't pass up the chance to slather myself with this renowned mud, and it left my skin feeling incredibly rejuvenated and smooth. The surrounding resorts and facilities cater to tourists, making it a comfortable and enjoyable experience for all visitors. There are showers available to rinse off after floating, and the option to relax in the on-site spas, where I indulged in a refreshing mud wrap treatment. The stunning sunset over the Dead Sea is not to be missed. As the sun dipped below the horizon, the sky was painted in hues of orange, pink, and purple, casting a magical glow over the entire area. My visit to the Dead Sea was an unforgettable experience, and I would highly recommend it to anyone seeking a unique and rejuvenating adventure. Whether you're a nature enthusiast, an adventure seeker, or simply looking for relaxation, the Dead Sea has something to offer everyone. Just remember to bring your camera to capture the beauty of this enchanting place! Tips: Stay hydrated as the climate can be quite dry. Don't forget to pack sunscreen, as the sun can be intense. Bring water shoes to protect your feet from the salt crystals along the shoreline. Try to catch the sunset - it's a sight you'll cherish forever. Overall, the Dead Sea is a must-visit destination that will leave you with unforgettable memories. I'm already dreaming of the day I can return to this enchanting natural wonder!

reviews.text: The hotel was absolutely wonderful, extremely clean, with excellent service. Everything was great, from the food to the friendliness of the staff at the reception. Everyone was welcoming and professional. The only minor issue was that the bed wasn’t as comfortable as expected, but that does not take away from the overall quality of the stay and how enjoyable the experience was. Thank you for such a lovely stay.

reviews.author: Eman Dabbas
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived, our experience at the Kempinski Hotel was nothing short of amazing. The booking process was seamless, and the service was outstanding, special thanks to Mr. Yazan Al Ahmad for his help in every step of the process. The staff were warm, welcoming, and attentive, making us feel right at home throughout our stay. Our room was spotless, beautifully decorated, and incredibly comfortable. Every detail, from the cozy bed to the delicious breakfast, reflected a high level of care and hospitality. I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team. The service exceeded all my expectations, and every member of the staff contributed to making our stay so enjoyable. A special thanks to Mr. Ivan for the exceptional kindness and thoughtful attention shown to us during our stay. His warm and genuine personality made us feel welcomed as he truly went above and beyond to assist us with anything we needed. We are already looking forward to our next visit. Thank you for a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Suehila Elkateb
reviews.text: My husband and I travelled to the Kempinski Hotel Ishtar Dead Sea Resort in March for 5 nights and we stayed in the Resense Spa area. It is hard to describe succinctly our experience. The staff, from the Lady in Red to Mohamad T our concierge, the restaurant staff, the drivers, the spa staff and last but not least at all our cleaner Mohamad treated us with the utmost care. We were treated kindly by everyone who were always available to see if we needed anything and never overbearing - kind, friendly and professional. The location was stunning, the view from our room was serene and peaceful, and the spa experience was so relaxing especially the hydrotherapy and the indoor Dead Sea pool and saunas. We went everyday and went down to the Dead Sea almost everyday to float and receive Dead Sea mud massages from the staff. The room was very large and more than comfortable. We had everything we needed including a daily stocked fridge with cold drinks and water, and daily fresh fruit and nuts. The breakfast was fantastic- so fresh and so many choices, we felt we didn’t need to eat until dinner. The Lebanese restaurant in the hotel is a real treat, the food is fantastic and offers a lot of choices, the Lebanese chef is very particular in offering the best of Lebanese cuisine ( I am Lebanese so I am very particular about my Lebanese food!) and he may even treat you to some music ! It was exactly what we needed, a break that offered quiet comfort, rest and detaching from the stresses of every day life in a luxurious setting. Thank you Kempinski Ishtar! What a beautiful place!

reviews.author: Bayan Qabouq
reviews.text: I had a one-night stay with my family on June 26, 2025. The hotel is generally nice, but it’s clear that some maintenance and renovation are needed. The staff could also be more welcoming and courteous. Although I paid in advance for a suite with specific features, we were given a different room upon arrival with the excuse that the hotel was fully booked. No effort was made to provide what we had originally booked and paid for, which was disappointing.

reviews.author: Tünde Lovestyán
reviews.text: Beautiful garden, room and facility, our buggy driver Mohamed was extremely kind. Same time unfortunately cannot tell the same regarding the reception. We had some challenges with our booking and we didn’t feel that much welcome or experienced help. The room and gardens are beautiful. We upgraded our room to a villa for 65JOD, which is a good deal but in front of our villa there is construction side, which was not mentioned and next to the infinity pool they are drilling which is not exactly the sound we wanted to chill on. Pretty impressed and disappointed at the same time. On top of all they the balcony door was broken. Couldn’t close the room. Called reception, noting for 10 mins and I needed to call again to send someone to come and check. And turned out it was broken. Not the experience at all expected from a 5 star Kempinski hotel in a country where services are top notch. In Amman and Petra lower star hotels are way more pleasant when it comes to service and guest centricity… sad to say that.

reviews.author: SONICK THUKKANI
reviews.text: Floating in the Dead Sea is like nothing else in the world! Thanks to the high salt density, your body naturally floats with zero effort — it’s surreal, relaxing, and absolutely unforgettable. To make the most of your visit, choosing the right spot along the coast is key. We stayed at the Grand East Hotel, and it made a big difference. The beach access was smooth, the mud was plentiful (perfect for a natural spa treatment!), and the food and facilities were spot on. A few tips for first-timers: Apply the Dead Sea mud before entering — it’s not just great for your skin, it also enhances the whole experience. Protect your eyes, nose, and mouth from the water — the high salinity can be quite harsh if it gets into sensitive areas. Splashing is a big no-no! Enter slowly, float gently, and enjoy the calm and buoyant sensation. It’s truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience and a natural wonder you’ll remember forever.

reviews.author: Abu Suzan
reviews.text: I had the privilege of visiting the Dead Sea during my recent trip to Jordan, and I must say, it was an awe-inspiring experience like no other! The Dead Sea is truly a mesmerizing natural wonder that left me in complete awe of its unique beauty and healing properties. The first thing that struck me was the otherworldly landscape surrounding the sea. The vast expanse of shimmering water contrasted against the arid desert landscape created a sight that I won't soon forget. The vibrant hues of the water and the salt-crusted shores made for a surreal and picturesque scene. Floating in the buoyant waters of the Dead Sea was an absolute delight! It's true what they say - you effortlessly float on the surface due to the extremely high salt concentration. It's an unusual sensation that made me feel like I was weightless, and the feeling was truly therapeutic. I couldn't resist taking a dip and experiencing this unique phenomenon for myself. Moreover, the mineral-rich mud found along the shores is known for its healing properties. I couldn't pass up the chance to slather myself with this renowned mud, and it left my skin feeling incredibly rejuvenated and smooth. The surrounding resorts and facilities cater to tourists, making it a comfortable and enjoyable experience for all visitors. There are showers available to rinse off after floating, and the option to relax in the on-site spas, where I indulged in a refreshing mud wrap treatment. The stunning sunset over the Dead Sea is not to be missed. As the sun dipped below the horizon, the sky was painted in hues of orange, pink, and purple, casting a magical glow over the entire area. My visit to the Dead Sea was an unforgettable experience, and I would highly recommend it to anyone seeking a unique and rejuvenating adventure. Whether you're a nature enthusiast, an adventure seeker, or simply looking for relaxation, the Dead Sea has something to offer everyone. Just remember to bring your camera to capture the beauty of this enchanting place! Tips: Stay hydrated as the climate can be quite dry. Don't forget to pack sunscreen, as the sun can be intense. Bring water shoes to protect your feet from the salt crystals along the shoreline. Try to catch the sunset - it's a sight you'll cherish forever. Overall, the Dead Sea is a must-visit destination that will leave you with unforgettable memories. I'm already dreaming of the day I can return to this enchanting natural wonder!

reviews.text: I had an absolutely wonderful stay! From the moment I arrived until check-out, everything was perfect. The entire staff was incredibly kind, helpful, and professional. A big thank you to the managers and every team member — your warm hospitality truly made me feel at home. The service was outstanding, the room was spotless and comfortable, and every detail was well taken care of. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I highly recommend this hotel and will definitely be coming back. Thank you all again for making my stay so special!

reviews.author: Leylah Murad
reviews.text: I have been staying here since i was young and i still love it! Now is a great time to go and they have entertainment almost every night. Relaxing, quiet & great opportunity to reap the benefits of the dead sea. The breakfast buffet was my favorite part! The staff is extremely friendly and always willing to give you a ride around. :) 10/10!

reviews.author: Wesam Najjar
reviews.text: From the moment I stepped into my room, I was blown away by the impeccable cleanliness. Every detail was thoughtfully maintained, making my stay feel truly luxurious. The service was just as outstanding—every staff member was professional, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. One of the highlights of my stay was visiting the Valley Cafe. The ambience was fantastic, and the service was top-notch. A special mention goes to Mohammad Alsamman, who was incredibly friendly and helpful throughout. What truly made my experience unforgettable was how the staff went above and beyond to celebrate my birthday. They surprised me with a delicious cake and even arranged for the band to sing for me—it was a heartfelt and touching gesture that I’ll always remember. It was my first time at this hotel here in the Dead Sea, and it really exceeded all my expectations with its perfect blend of comfort, hospitality, and those special moments that make a stay truly remarkable!

reviews.author: Kim Krug
reviews.text: We have been coming here every year for the past 22 years, and each time we feel completely at home. The hotel is designed like a traditional Arabic village, creating a romantic and authentic atmosphere – it doesn’t feel like a typical hotel at all. It’s the perfect place for a relaxing escape at the lowest point on Earth. Abed and Ayoub took excellent care of our room – everything was spotless. They anticipated our needs and fulfilled them even before we asked, such as providing extra small towels. The cleaning was always quick and thorough while we enjoyed our breakfast. The rooms are spacious, with a large bathroom featuring both a shower and a bathtub. The amenities leave nothing to be desired, and if there’s ever anything you need, it’s taken care of right away. Highly recommended for anyone looking for comfort, peace, and a special atmosphere that keeps you coming back.

reviews.author: Rawan Soussou
reviews.text: We had a wonderful one-night stay at the Movenpick Dead Sea Hotel. Everything was excellent from start to finish. The staff were incredibly helpful and welcoming — special thanks to Omar Owais for making the reservation process smooth, Rawan Fakhouri for the warm check-in and help with the rooms also explaining for us the hotel map, dining options, and hotel facilities , and Ahmad from customer service for his help with the late check out. The food was amazing, the rooms were clean and comfortable, and the pool staff were efficient and friendly — quick to respond to our requests. We also attended the evening show: the belly dancing performance was beautiful and engaging, though we felt the band could have been more energetic. Overall, it was a truly pleasant and relaxing experience. We would definitely love to come back!

reviews.author: michael enns
reviews.text: There was no available pool, none, there is no note about this. We tried to cancel when we got here as it was 40 degrees, but as we had just booked it booking would have charged us a full room penalty this was by far the worse part of being at a Dead Sea resort, we should have been instantly refunded, very very disappointed. They said the pool was down for 2 days, not a chance it has water in the last year The property was entirely in disarray Fell down marble stairs that had left clean soap on them thankfully not too badly injured Coffee mug exploded when we poured hot water into it There were open electrical sockets in the room There was only one available restaurant Garbage all over the site Absolutely run down

reviews.author: Seyyare Qurbanli
reviews.text: We arrived at the hotel very late, but we received a very nice welcome. they even gave us a sea view room. there was plenty of variety at breakfast, and there was both indoor and outdoor seating. in general, breakfast in jordan was of poor quality, but nevertheless it was relatively better in this hotel. The hotel has direct access to the Dead Sea, and free mud baths were also offered here.

reviews.author: Zaid Alidi
reviews.text: Very quiet and relaxed in the weekdays, The pool is big and clean with great overview of the dead sea, we went for day use though i believe they also have rooms if you want to stay overnight.

reviews.author: Anthony Napolitano
reviews.text: Couldn't have had a better experience with our day pass here It was a long way over to Aqaba so we decided to check out the Dead Sea our driver took us to this resort. While tourism is down in the area they treated us like royalty. They rolled out the red carpet for us let us use all the facility and then we had to leave before lunch was going to be ready so the head chef Salah Al Turk prepared My wife and I a custom meal so that we were fed before our flight. He went out of his way to make sure that we enjoyed our food and drinks. Couldn't have asked for better service. If you plan on going to the Dead Sea come here they will take care of you.

reviews.author: Rahmah Ramli
reviews.text: We stopped here for a sumptuous, delicious lunch, right after we went through the immigration procedures at the King Hussein Border Crossing as we left Palestine and back to Jordan. This place is beautiful and well designed. We took the opportunity to dip our feet in the Dead Sea, at the same time tested the saltiness of the water. Great, relaxing place indeed.

reviews.author: Jelena Stefanović
reviews.text: An unforgettable experience! The Dead Sea is a must-visit destination near Amman, offering breathtaking views, unique natural beauty, and the famous floating experience. The high salt concentration makes swimming effortless, and the mineral-rich mud is great for the skin. There are several resorts and public beaches with facilities like showers, changing rooms, and spa treatments. Sunsets here are absolutely stunning, creating a peaceful and magical atmosphere. A truly one-of-a-kind place that combines relaxation, adventure, and natural wonders. Highly recommended! 🌊✨

name: Street Stall - Sowayma
address: Street Stall - Sowayma, Dead Sea, Jordan

name: Zara Spa Dining
address: Zara Spa Dining, Dead Sea, Jordan

reviews.author: Mariam Ossama
reviews.text: Great spa. Enjoyed it very much. Staff and therapist are great and super friendly. You can buy dead sea products there as well from the shop. Must try the dead sea treatment: salt scrub, mud wrap ending with a massage. Have 3 different pools that you can use and access. Dead sea pool is amazing and so is the infinity pool. Offers free of charge lemon and orange water with nuts and dates and tea. Lockers are clean. Mini restaurant at the infinity pool, recommend the bree burger. Thank you for pampering us.

reviews.author: Froilan Antonio Bacungan
reviews.text: A must have experience! Me and my wife booked the At the Dead Sea couples treatment that gets you a salt scrub, mudding, and 50min massage. Plan at least 1-2 hours before and after your treatment to enjoy the spa facilities and you can also make the most of the spa’s own infinity pool to watch the sunset. Make sure to visit their shop too as they sell good products at same or cheaper prices than at the airport and nearby stores.

reviews.author: Yanal Fakhoury
reviews.text: Zara Spa at the Dead Sea is hands down one of the most incredible spa experiences I’ve ever had! From the moment you step in, you’re greeted by the warm and professional staff who make you feel at home. A special shoutout to Ahmad Salem, whose hospitality and attentiveness took the experience to a whole new level. He went above and beyond to ensure every detail was perfect! The facilities are nothing short of luxurious. The infinity pool offers breathtaking views of the Dead Sea, making it the perfect spot to unwind. The Dead Sea water float pool is a unique and soothing experience that leaves your skin feeling rejuvenated and refreshed. Their experienced massagers truly know their craft. I left feeling completely relaxed and re-energized. On top of it all, they offer complimentary beverages throughout your visit, adding to the pampering experience. If you’re considering a visit, stop thinking and just go! Zara Spa is the epitome of relaxation, luxury, and exceptional service. It’s a must-visit destination that will leave you planning your next visit before you even leave.

reviews.author: Rasha Mortada
reviews.text: The service is Zara wasn’t like any other! The staff are so friendly and so attentive to you. They keep the place full of harmony and clean! The warm pool is very good in the winter - like now in Feb. I also went for a message Gaita was very good with it !! So grateful for the kindness and professionalism. Bravo 🤍

reviews.author: John Carolan
reviews.text: Had a lovely day at Zara spa. Ahmad was very welcoming, the facilities were superb. I had a really good deep tissue massage and loved chilling at the infinity pool which is private to the spa and has an exceptional view. I look forward to my next visit!

reviews.author: ICONIX 21
reviews.text: It was super good, I recommend the mixed grill and the staff is super friendly!

reviews.author: Sandy Hazan
reviews.text: Well located location with valet, the food was good and the portions were big enough and the staff were very nice

reviews.author: mustafa afeef
reviews.text: A distinctive and comfortable location and reasonable prices

reviews.author: يزن زريقات
reviews.text: Youth like a rose and exceptional service

reviews.author: Radi Qaraman
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Ivan Chucx
reviews.text: With a capacity to serve over 1000 guests within one hour, this restaurant is a remarkable place to visit. The first thing you notice is adequate space for parking and then the friendly staff who are on hand to receive the guests. The food is good, served warm, and it's mostly an all-you-can-eat setup. I recommend this place to all visitors. In the short time I was there I met people from Poland, France, and Germany who were on a tour to Jordan.

reviews.author: Hi I Am
reviews.text: Our private tour driver brought us here. First thing we noticed was a big tour bus parked right in front and we all know what that means. We were first made to watch a staff member baking flat bread in the oven. There is a tip jar right in front but we were not forced to tip here. The restaurant dining space is huge and they would have to be to accommodate tourists. We had the option to dine inside or outside. It was a rainy day but it was dry and warm in their outdoor but covered seating area. The price of the buffet is 12 JD per person, drinks were not included. Or 14 JD per person to add a mixed bbq plate. We opted out of that. We also shared a Petra beer at 5 JD. We over heard another table ordering red wine and that was 25 JD for a bottle. The food offered were 3 kinds of dips, various salads, pastas, egg plant, yellow rice, green beans, beef patties in white sauce, chicken and for desserts consisted of tangerines, mini fried dough balls in syrup and a rice milk type pudding cake. Plus the flat bread that was seen being made. Of the items offered, we enjoyed the 3 dips, green salad, eggplants and the tangerines. We found the pastas to be unappetizing and the green beans to be salty. At 12 JD I don’t think it was worth it. When requesting the bill the staff member went over it to ensure there were no extra charges and mentioned a few times that tips were not included. My total was 29 JD and I handed over a 50 JD bill. I suggested a 4 JD tip, which was a 14% tip but the staff member suggested 6 JD instead. I disagreed and eventually he agreed.

reviews.author: Asia Turman
reviews.text: We spend 10 days in Jordan and Artemis was by far one of our favorite dining experiences. The restaurant had excellent service and provided great food recommendations for our table. Everything our waiter selected was super delicious! Price came out to 80JOD for 4 of us which considering the quality of food and amount, we thought that was perfect. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Klara Ljubi
reviews.text: We did not have much to choose from. Hence, it was an okay lunch but would prefer something more gourmet. The price was great - 14JD for two as a waiter gave us a discount in order not to go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Hala Al Jukka
reviews.text: Staff are super friendly, the views are great and it's always fun to end a road trip at Artemis. My favourite part is their freshly baked bread, it's the best I ever had. Make sure to ask for extra before you leave.

reviews.author: Khalid Odeh
reviews.text: Very good

reviews.author: Omar mohmmad Ali ayasrah
reviews.text: good shop i

reviews.author: 511 Super market
reviews.text: Super market

reviews.author: Orange Rani
reviews.text: There is nothing wrong with it. It can help you if you are looking for a way to go. Not all goods are available and their prices are normal or slightly more expensive

reviews.author: Ali smadi
reviews.text: A good place, good prices, and has all the household supplies

reviews.author: Fahad Alkhamis
reviews.text: Good Food, But Service Needs Improvement. The food quality and taste were excellent, and the prices were reasonable for what you get. However, the service needs improvement—it was slow and not very organized. Also, you need to watch the bill cause they may add dishes to your bill. If you’re looking for a better dining experience and don’t want to wait, I recommend making a reservation in advance. Otherwise, you might have to wait for a table. Overall, it is a good place for food in Jarash, but the service could be better.

reviews.author: Fahd Batayneh فهد بطاينة
reviews.text: One of the finest Lebanese restaurants in Jerash with a very diverse menu of soups, salads, mezzas, barbecues, main dishes, desserts, and drinks. They have ample indoor and outdoor seating. The outdoor seating is on an upper floor. They offer shesha, thus offering smoking and non-smoking dining areas. Food is extremely tasty, and portions are generous. Extra food can be packed for takeaway. They accept cash and card. They have ample self and valet parking. During the weekend and holidays, the place can get over-booked. Thus, a reservation can come handy. They have a branch in Amman under the name “Lebanese Um Khalil”.

reviews.author: layth Rabab'ah
reviews.text: The food was really delicious, and the staff were very helpful. The service was perfect. After the meal, they gave us dessert and Turkish coffee as a thoughtful and unexpected gesture, which we really appreciated. The Kibbeh Nayeh from the appetizers menu was very tasty – highly recommended! We also tried the beef slices, they were very juicy and tasty. I didn’t like the seating and the hall very much, but overall, the experience was excellent.

reviews.author: SIA LEE
reviews.text: It was a fantastic experience. All the staff were very friendly. If I have the chance, I would love to visit again.

reviews.author: giada annarumma
reviews.text: We had dinner on a saturday night without reservation. We didn't have to wait, the service was quick, waiters extremely professional. The prices were honest, the food amazing. I tried the fried frogs and was not disappointed. At the end they offered us the best muhalabieh I've eaten. Best restaurant of Jerash!

reviews.author: Mohammad K. AlHejin
reviews.text: beautiful location with great view, rooms need renovation desperately ... breakfast is home made and awesome.

reviews.author: Roni Haddad
reviews.text: Definitely not kids friendly. Every item in the outdoor gaming area is broken. No security measures for children especially that the hotel is in an open area. Kids can easily fall into the pool. This is a run down place. ACs are not working properly in the rooms, fridges and TVs don’t work, rooms are not cleaned well. The only good thing about this place is the food. The chef is great at his job doing great Jordanian dishes.

reviews.author: MC Spahr
reviews.text: Stayed on a rainy day December 2019. Very friendly and helpful staff. Rooms are dated and need some attention but are comfortable. Only three guests on a Sunday night but a full menu was available and the food was very good. I would like to go back on a sunny day for the views.

reviews.author: Karina Wakefield
reviews.text: Avoid this hotel. Extremely run down, water was pouring down the stairwell, paint peeling off walls, taps rotate in sink with little water pressure, games room has external door missing and is in disrepair, gardens are overgrown with weeds, loose wires coming out of walls, playground equipment broken and weeds have taken over the area. Restaurant also totally disorganised and reception staff provided inaccurate information regarding meal times. Wifi poor and non existent in rooms. TV didn't work and furniture in relaxation area dirty and broken.

reviews.author: Peter Silie
reviews.text: First of all I think that this hotel would be a good place to stay for summer. It's located on top of a mountain near by Gerasa and the view is really enjoyable. BUT ... I have been here in winter. Three degrees outside and unfortunately in the rooms it wasn't much warmer. I called in the morning and was promised a heated room. As I arrived I was shown the room and you can guess - it was freezing. They didn't turn on the heating but even if they had it would probably just have made a slight difference as the heating didn't work properly. On their website they promised dinner next to a warm and cozy fireplace. Guess what was missing when I had dinner... A warm and cozy fire (to be fair - the fireplace at least existed). Last I'd like to give some information about costumer service. They always smiled and said yes but nothing really happened. I asked for an additional electric heater for the room. They said they would bring one but didn't (to be fair - they gave me an additional blanket). When ordering lunch I asked if they could heat up the dining room. They agreed but didn't do anything (There where 3 patio heaters in the room they didn't use). All in all. Don't stay here in winter. In summer it could be a good shot.

name: Street Stall - Hadrian’s Arch
address: Street Stall - Hadrian’s Arch, Jerash, Jordan

reviews.author: Chris W
reviews.text: A wonderful family running this hotel. Very kind, if you want them to make a delicious dinner for you just make sure to ask ahead of time. Warm water and heating. Convenient location to get to the archeological site's parking to the south. Be mindful of the tight parking.

reviews.author: latif farooqi (LEO)
reviews.text: Nice accommodation for the night. We got I. Bed room in a 3 Bed apartment, comfortably bedding & quiet room. Well worth the price.

reviews.author: Daan Quittner
reviews.text: The kind family of Hadrian's Arch will do everything to make you feel at home. There is plenty parking pace around the perimeter, the breakfast is really good and includes delicious tomato's, olives, eggs, herbs and other local treats. They gave some great tips on where to have diner and we could leave our luggage in a separate room on travel day while visiting Jerash. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: asta sirich
reviews.text: The local people/children around the neighbourhood is not friendly, we had kids throwing rocks at us and screaming F your mom and sister at us, it did not feel safe to go around. The hosts is friendly, the food is really good(just remember to ask for the price, we found it a bit expensive), the room was very clean and the bed was good. Location was in walking distance to the ruins, but due to the behaviour of the locals I would not recommend doing that if you look like a white turist...

reviews.author: Debby P
reviews.text: Very good hostel. Runned by a really nice family. You get a warm welcome. Here you can eat very good home cooke dinner!! I was stunned by the kindness they will give you. The rooms are big and clean!!!

name: Street Stall - Jerash Rest House
address: Street Stall - Jerash Rest House, Jerash, Jordan

reviews.author: Bo
reviews.text: The best thing about this place is its convenient location right outside the Jerash Visitor Center—perfect for a break after exploring the ruins. The drinks were refreshing, and the outdoor seating area was pleasant. However, the food was just average and felt overpriced for the quality. It's fine if you're looking for a quick bite nearby, but not a place I’d go out of my way to dine at. Overall, it’s a decent spot for the location and a drink, but don’t expect too much from the food.

reviews.author: A Zahin
reviews.text: After touring the Temple of Zeus and the Temple of Artemis including the Roman city, this is a great place for a snack or a full Buffett. They also have Turkish coffee and lots of juices. Food on the Buffett was great I strongly recommend you give it a try. As I’m typing this I can feel the Turkish coffee kicking in (hahaha). Great place to stop and enjoy this part of the world

reviews.author: Phyllis T
reviews.text: 10 JD for the buffet, which was surprisingly good given the restaurant is inside a major tourist site. Good for vegetarians, lots of salad options. The crispy fried pita chips were amazing! Relaxed outdoor seating and friendly service.

reviews.author: Vincent
reviews.text: Food was good, not that expensive for the location. We took the buffet, lots of options but most of the food is served cold.

reviews.author: Claudia Landolfo
reviews.text: This is a cheap solution: the buffet is only 10JOD pp. The buffet was rich and with plenty of choices. the restaurant is huge so it has several seating options plus a nice outside terrace. After walking all day we didn't feel like adventuring into the city to find a place to eat. This place is right next to the visitor center, basically inside the Jerash ruins. The baba ghanoush was great. Complimentary tea. The bar also makes western coffee! Bathrooms need improvements but they were kinda clean.

name: Street Stall - Roman Ruins
address: Street Stall - Roman Ruins, Jerash, Jordan

reviews.author: Ben_glt 34
reviews.text: Many shops without salespeople harassing you to buy

reviews.author: Hanna M
reviews.text: A souk as you'd imagine it. A lot of chatter and little substance. But despite everything, the people are very nice and friendly!

reviews.author: TheYvanbreizh
reviews.text: Souk not interesting.

reviews.author: Gratien pub (gpnam)
reviews.text: Just one place, tourist bus stopped, everything else being closed.

reviews.author: Ross Daniels
reviews.text: This is an absolutely fantastic place a bit of a labyrinth but so enjoyable with winding streets and multiple marketplaces and plenty of cafes and eating spots. Great atmosphere and one of the streets will take you down to the beach. We spent hours just wandering around and it’s up there with any marketplace in Morocco.

reviews.author: mmm a
reviews.text: This has got to be the best souk in Morocco! I’ve been to many, but Essaouira’s felt so special. I spent about five hours there and still didn’t want to leave. Each shop has its own unique vibe, and the shopkeepers were incredibly kind and helpful. Every time I asked where to find something, they wouldn’t just point me in the direction—they’d actually walk me there and leave without the other shopkeepers noticing. It was such a genuine experience. You’ll find everything from handmade Moroccan teapots and beautiful tea glasses to breathtaking paintings and handmade rugs, linen clothing, genuine leather goods, and the most fragrant spices. If you’re looking for authentic treasures, this is the place!

reviews.author: Mohammed nurul Islam
reviews.text: Best place to shop in all city

reviews.author: Federica Preda
reviews.text: Beautiful and quaint! The shops are full of local souvenirs and for all budgets! Exceptional fish and real Argan oil! We will definitely return. A quiet city where you can reach everything on foot.

reviews.author: World Trip
reviews.text: A favorite ❤️ A truly delightful souk in the port city of Essaouira ✅ The climate is pleasant and the people are truly friendly!

reviews.author: Khedira Ghazi
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: ida russo
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Ahmad Yousef
reviews.text: It was an acceptable experience. We were four people and ordered Mansaf, grilled chicken, beef Stroganoff, and veal steak. The food was very average and not special. I don’t think I would visit again. The atmosphere was pleasant, the place is spacious, and the service was excellent — but the food lacked uniqueness.

reviews.author: Sadeen B
reviews.text: This place is always a must for me whenever I’m in Amman. The fried fish was super good—no fishy taste at all, which I really appreciated since I’m super picky with seafood. The meat is always cooked just right, never dry. The atmosphere is really nice, and the service is honestly amazing. Our waiters were so kind and patient, even though we were a big group. Definitely recommend

reviews.author: Jakub Kozak
reviews.text: Very good food, awesome mansaf thst you need to try. Service is fast and efficient! Highly recommended! PLEASE STOP SMOKING IN THE RESTAURANT

reviews.author: Yavuz Selim Elmas
reviews.text: Ambiance is great, service is great, nice and comfy seating available. You can smoke sisha while having your meal, if that’s your thing. Overall the food I tried was really tasty, and the prices a tiny bit high.

reviews.author: Ibrahim Alzayed
reviews.text: I’ve been visiting this restaurant for 20 years. It still maintains its cleanliness, quality, and the delicious taste of its dishes.

reviews.author: Mazhar Tello
reviews.text: We visited Ayola Restaurant in Madaba for breakfast, and it was a lovely experience worth sharing. The restaurant is located in the heart of the city, making it easily accessible and ideal for those who appreciate traditional atmospheres. The décor is beautifully heritage-inspired, reflecting authentic Jordanian culture and creating a warm, welcoming ambiance. The setting was calm and pleasant, and the cleanliness was excellent, which made us feel comfortable throughout our visit. As for the food, it was good in both taste and quality. However, as a constructive suggestion, we found the bread to be a bit too thick, and it would be better if it were lighter and easier to eat. Overall, I recommend visiting this restaurant for a traditional-style breakfast in a beautifully designed space, especially for those who enjoy cultural and aesthetic details.

reviews.author: A J
reviews.text: We had our first meal in Jordan here, following our host’s recommendation and we did not regret it! It turned out to be one of the best meals of our trip. The fukhara and shawarma were absolutely delicious, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The staff was incredibly kind and welcoming. The traditional decor is also stunning and really adds to the experience. A great start to our Jordanian journey!

reviews.author: Mritunjay Kumar
reviews.text: Ayola in Madaba is a gem! Fresh and tasty food, a fantastic vibe, and a unique retro design that gives the place real character. It’s easily one of the best spots not just in Madaba, but in all of Jordan. Definitely a must-visit if you’re in the area.

reviews.author: Michaela Pľutová
reviews.text: Very nice place full of tasty food. Best falafel I had in Jordan, very good cheese pirogi, and we also tried the chicken alyo fokhara, very delicious. For two people we ordered two apetizers and one main dish and it was more than enough, but we could try more dishes this way. Good prices, good portion. Thank you :)

reviews.author: Sruthi Madabushi
reviews.text: We found this place in downtown madaba, and we were really starving. The food was good, and the service was nice as well. We had a halloumi based wrap and an iced drink. This place is very well located and was quite busy!

reviews.author: Tsholo Tiro
reviews.text: I wish I could give more than 5 stars because this place was just amazing. The food, the service and the setting, all were top notch. The salad was simple but mouthwatering. When it came to mains, I wanted the lamb cutlets but sadly they were out of them, instead I had the lamb cubes, and I was blown away. Without a doubt the best lamb I have ever had. The flat bread and the chips were equally delicious. Bisho, my waiter, was the icing on the cake. So sweet. I would highly recommend this place. I wish I had more time in Madaba so I could eat here again.

reviews.author: Adrian Rodrigues
reviews.text: Amazing place to come and have some local dishes. We had a buffet here and it was amazing. Everything on the menu was tasty and well done. The service and staff are very friendly and helpful. There is no parking available here as it's located on a narrow street.

reviews.author: Elmer Cartoneros
reviews.text: We appreciate Amed and the Manager and Hazan they are from Egypt. They are so kind and accomocadating they extended their generousity towards us which we didnt expect it. The food is super good that’s💯% i can recommend we ordered chicken steak thats superb🙌🏻🙌🏻 and the ambiance is cool and warm very cozy feeling. You wont regret coming here!

reviews.author: Cherine H
reviews.text: Amazing tasty food from salads to frappe even links fried and glazed with pomegranate molasses. Salad dressing was tasty and grilled 🍆 eggplant's were properly prepped.breaf was fresh and warm, reserves in plastic bags and cut in halves. I didn't care much for the ambience is it for like sitting in at someone's balcony, not that much decoration but the group with me insisted on being there since we didn't have reservations tomorrow but the food was perfect and the service was friendly and hospitable. The place serves and sells JR wine. As well as some local beer brands that might be worth trying. Turkish coffee was well prepped, aromatic, served warm with perfect with perfect foam for

reviews.author: mohammed Irshaed (The king of taste)
reviews.text: في اعتقادي الشخصي افضل مطعم في مادبا من ناحية الموقع وجوده الطعام والخدمات المقدمة فيه If you in Madaba, searching for a place to dine in , you should not think twice and go to Bawabet Madaba restaurant. The food are awesome and the provide hookah in their beautiful terrass or if you would like a glass of local beer or wine , this is your place. I always take my tourists to this restaurant and I've never ever received a bad comment from them about the food or the service. The serving crew are amazing always happy and fun dealing with them.

reviews.author: Arwa AbuKashef
reviews.text: Excellent service, delicious dishes i had during my trip to mount nebo and ma'in... i loved the noodles, i ordered a coffee after lunch , yet simply desserts , i prefer Cheesecake or cakes, they offered arabic sweets ,which am not into ... There seems a bar for night life, which is well known in Madaba

reviews.author: Krisztina Erdei
reviews.text: Very kind owner and staff, the food is delicious, salads, hummus, soups are a must try.

reviews.author: Mike Jumah
reviews.text: Great place to dine and the food is delicious

reviews.author: Joanna Barańska
reviews.text: We ended up here by accident, the first restaurant we encountered on the way from the Dead Sea. A very positive surprise. The decor is not to our taste, perhaps not very atmospheric, but the food is excellent, friendly service. For my husband, who is a vegetarian, a dish off the menu was prepared. Prices very reasonable. At the end we were treated to a free dessert.

reviews.author: Twal Majdi
reviews.text: It's amazing tourest restaurant really have delishes food and good service strong and perfect team

reviews.author: Andy D
reviews.text: What a pleasant surprise this place was. We went in for a quick drink and a shared appetizer with 4 people and got a bottle of wine and shrimp. The food was fantastic!! Service fairly quick, with a great server. The atmosphere was fine, little oddly decorated for my taist. But all told this was a great stop, one I would do again without hesitation. Our server also spoke nearly perfect English.

reviews.author: yasmeen shanti
reviews.text: I went to this restaurant for the second time for the sushi buffet. They offer a miso soup which was sooo yummy a tad salty. And a crab salad which was amazing and really good. The sushi buffet has so many kinds and it is really yummy and delicious. From cooked to raw, nigiri to maki. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Mary Hantash
reviews.text: The food very delicious and the service is perfect specially hisham

reviews.author: Sara Rojas
reviews.text: I walked in for a quick bite but stayed for hours. Decor is beautiful and suhi rolls looked like art. Flavors popped and team was attentive. Honestly, this was one of my fave discoveries.

reviews.author: Anastasia
reviews.text: I was very hungry and ordered French onion soup and lasagna. And for dessert creme brulee. As a result, I overate. Everything was delicious. Good big portions. Interesting presentation. Large and varied menu. I was also pleased with the generous portion of wine

reviews.author: Jameel CARE
reviews.text: The atmosphere at Haret Jdoudna is undeniably beautiful, with its vintage charm and relaxing setting — easily the highlight of the experience. However, everything beyond the ambiance was disappointing. The food quality fell short of expectations, with very small portions that were heavily overpriced. Even more frustrating was the poor service: staff were slow to respond, inattentive, and lacked the basic level of hospitality one would expect from a restaurant of this reputation. Sadly, Haret Jdoudna would not be my first or second choice when visiting Madaba. If you are only looking for a nice place to sit and enjoy the surroundings — and are willing to tolerate slow service and expensive, underwhelming food — it might still be worth a brief visit. Otherwise, I would recommend exploring other options.

reviews.author: Omar Alhosani
reviews.text: The food was good and the Atmosphere is great. However, we were the first people to arrive to the restaurant and we saw the manager arguing with a lady staff. He obviously treats the staff (calling them while pointing fingers in a very aggressive and rude manner.. Unfortunately it was an unpleasant experience.

reviews.author: Mohammad EL TURK
reviews.text: I truly love it! If you want to have a special experience just visit it. Last time I visited it was like 2010, two days I had my lunch there and it's still magical

reviews.author: Basel Daoud
reviews.text: Food: The food is very delicious! The menu offers a big variety of options, mainly Lebanese and Mediterranean mezze. There are many vegan and vegetarian options to choose from aswell. Their mix grill bbq is delicious specially with their home made garlic sauce. The restaurant does offer Alcoholic beverages, spirits, wine, and Shisha. Service: I am utterly disappointed with the service, we reserved a table for 3:00 o'clock, however we got sat down at 3:45. What makes it worse is that the lady responsible for seating and welcoming guests had a bad attitude and was rude. However, manager was extremely friendly and was able to fix the issue and ensure the service to be top notch for the rest of our stay. Atmosphere: Amazing atmosphere! Authentic historical way of decorations and seating. I recommend reserving in advance and requesting the outdoor area as its nicer. Prices: Prices are slightly on the high side, however for the overall experience I do recommend giving the place a visit.

reviews.author: Mark Smit
reviews.text: For 28JD for 2 nights the price point is really good. Definitely a dated hotel, but beds are comfy. It can be noisy outside, but would recommend for anyone on a lower budget. Owner is a nice guy!

reviews.author: Leo Fay
reviews.text: Yes the owner is nice. But we do not ask him to be nice, but to offer an accommodation service. But first all the hotel smells the cigarette. Also the place where you will have breakfast. So we took it outside. Then our bed sheets smelt someone smell and there were hairs on them. I thought it was hazard, that it wouldn’t be possible that they didn’t clean it. But we stayed 3 nights and I could see the owner make the bed of the room beside the day after. WITHOUT changing bed sheets nor cleaning the room. It was disgusting !!! And the day after I saw a maid cleaning. So I got it : the weekend there is no maid, so the bedsheets are not being washed and the room will be unclean. And you will sleep in the bed of somebody else. Buuurk. At least but not less, the room is in front of the street, so it is very very noisy. An unbelievable experience…

reviews.author: Trikke Peeters
reviews.text: Well, you do get what you pay for, so if you want a 5 star hotel look some place else. But this place is nice and basic for traveling on a budget! The host is a friendly dude that makes sure you got everything sorted out. We got hot water in the shower and the beds were good! Breakfast is nice, basic and local.

reviews.author: Antoine M
reviews.text: Nice hotel in the center of Madaba, the manager is an old gentleman who is very kind and accommodating. He knows a lot about the city and Jordan in general so don't hesitate to ask him for some info. The room was fine, nothing extraordinary and a bit old looking but the beds were comfy, the water pressure strong and there was Wi-Fi. The breakfast included was typical of what you can find in Jordan and there was more than enough to feel full with it. Careful as there is no hotel parking but you can park in the street in front of it or you can go around and you should find a parking in the street behind. I recommend it for anyone who would like to stay in Madaba for a few days!

reviews.author: Aline P.
reviews.text: Good value for money. The hotel is a bit run down, but definitely good enough for a short stay. Great location near the important sights. The owner was very kind and helpful and provided us with information about our next stops. Would come back.
