reviews.author: Algérie Algerino
reviews.text: During our visit to Makkah, my family and I had planned to dine at the Raffles Hotel. We decided to sample different hotels each night to gauge both quality and pricing. When I inquired about the cost, the staff informed me it was 160 SAR per person. Considering we were a family of four – my wife, two children, and myself – I asked if we could pay only for myself and my wife. Upon returning later, I found a same staff member at the counter. I attempted to pay and requested payment for only two people, as other hotels had accommodated. Initially, the staff member refused and called the manager. Despite my insistence, the manager declined. Undeterred, I requested to speak directly with the manager. After a conversation with the manager, they finally agreed to accept payment for two people. However, to my surprise, the price had escalated to 590 SAR for just two individuals. This unexpected increase left me in a difficult situation, especially considering my children's presence and their inquiries about the escalating cost. Even though the hotel is great and fabulous, I dream to have an opportunity to spend 10 days there all-inclusive, Inchallah, experiencing every luxury and amenity it has to offer.

I need to apologise for this as I’ve forgotten the name of the chef but he was the chef that was always at the lamb and arab rice section and serving me. The food here tasted amazing as well and the chef was extremely friendly as well. Everyone whom attended for the lunch buffet needs to try their pasta as their carbonara as well as the neopolitan spaghetti are the best dish I ever had, especially when the specific chef cooked for me. I hope someone could let me know what’s the name of the chef as I honestly forgotten. I apologised for giving such a late review as I promised them to give a review back then but totally forgotten. Nevertheless, the whole experience I had here was a perfect 10/10 and I would definitely be dining here when I’m back in the holy land.

reviews.text: Very tasty food.. fusion of traditional and modern I think.. place is grand and often with lots of people during the afternoon time when we went there.. our host paid but I could imagine the place to be very expensive.. recommended

reviews.author: Davis Ron
reviews.text: Classy place. One of the best dining experience in Kuwait. Definitely visiting again. Must try the date pudding with saffron tea

reviews.author: Azzam Aziz
reviews.text: Excellent service, food, theme. It represents someone's home cooked food pretty well.

reviews.author: Yasmine ElSharkawy
reviews.text: Amgad service was super 👌 and he really made it an amazing experience He recommended me super lovely dishes that made my experience in Dar hammad super positive & planning to be back

reviews.author: Vijoy Venu
reviews.text: Famous for their Kuwaiti traditional cuisine we decided to try this as tourists. The meat was tender and juicy. The soups were served in carved out bread and was an experience. Their rice is slightly sweet however I felt it very oily for me. Good portion size and usually crowded place. They have seating outdoor and upstairS too.

reviews.author: Qaasim Illi
reviews.text: They offer traditional Kuwaiti cuisine, but I’m not into meat. I opted for salads and vegetarian entrees with Tannour bread. The taste was good across the board. The ambiance is warm and inviting, with Arabic coffee served alongside the recitation of a poem. Nice.

reviews.author: Azin Safa
reviews.text: My friends and I went here for breakfast. The place had a nice and pleasant atmosphere, and the service was relatively good. The food was very delicious but came in small portions—except for the liver dish, which had a sufficient serving size. After the meal, we were served Arabic coffee and dates, but the portions were quite small, and there weren’t even enough dates for everyone at the table.

reviews.author: Tasneem Alothman (Taz)
reviews.text: I’ve been to Fareej Swaileh (فريج صويلح) twice now in Kuwait, and both times the experience has been consistently great which says a lot. The food is tasty and hits the spot, but what really stood out was how fast everything came out; I honestly don’t think we waited more than five minutes. It’s perfect when you’re hungry and don’t feel like waiting forever. Another thing I love is the لقيمات (sweet dumplings) they serve for free before and after the meal. It’s such a thoughtful touch that makes the whole experience feel warm and welcoming. Definitely a spot I’ll keep coming back to.

reviews.author: Sally Chung
reviews.text: I found this place on Google while looking for local cuisine, and it didn’t disappoint! During the Gulf Cup, it was super crowded, even at 4 PM, but the 20-minute wait was totally worth it. The chicken was tender, the rice perfectly cooked and seasoned. Despite the crowd, the service was excellent and English-friendly. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to try authentic Kuwaiti cuisine!

reviews.author: Doct0r B
reviews.text: I went to them many times in different timing and occupations. Their set of menu is good to go and the test is amazing. The breakfast, launch and dinner each have unique flavors. Usually they serve the soup in a bread but you can ask them to be served in a regular bowel. I recommend the chicken soup. For the breakfast they have separate dishes or as a packages ( Freej Swaileh BK and Emirati BK - as I attached) For lunch and dinner, they have variety from rice to stew, I prefers beef stew (Saloonat Latham) with whit rice. For salads try Chefs special which is Arabic slaw with cheese served in a nice crispy bread and sour sauce. For dessert you can try different types, but I recommend LUQAIMAT with cheese (fried dough with cheese) and Karak tea (TEA with MILK). They have inside sitting and in the winter they do a lovey decoration outside, so you can have great time with your family and enjoying the nice weather too.

reviews.author: Oofy X
reviews.text: One of my favorite places to have traditional food in, I always ordered for delivery but this time decided to dine in. Unfortunately the atmosphere of the place is dead, it doesn’t give the same vibes as the branch in Kuwait at all, and there’s barely any atmosphere in the place. The food was great as always and the staff were so friendly!

reviews.author: Shaikh Annie
reviews.text: Love the restaurant with beautiful ambiance and the lovely staff. Even love the way they welcome people. 💗 I couldn’t add more pictures but love their welcome saffron drink and last lebanese tea and all food was really tasty fresh and MOUTHWATERIN. Must try these all items . You gonna love it! 🤩😍

reviews.author: Doyle Lee
reviews.text: A splendid Kuwaiti restauran super friendly staff! We had great food such as hummus, mumawash prawn rice and delicious leguimat. Their samosa is so worthy for a mention too. Don't miss the supermarket opposite for your hotel needs. Highly recommended for a complete enjoyable outing!

reviews.author: adnan ahmad
reviews.text: The ambiance was so cozy and welcoming. The soft lighting made it perfect for a relaxed iftar with family.Every dish was hit in the buffet. The elegant decor and peaceful vibe made our iftar even more memorable.

name: Layali Al Khaleej
address: Layali Al Khaleej, Kuwait City, Kuwait

reviews.author: Maha Alabduljalil
reviews.text: I used to be lucky with my orders but this time it’s a 4/5 in general • complementary bread basket with Lebnah dip 👍🏼 • Rocco salad: 5/5 👍🏼 • Parmigiana chicken pasta: was very hot that it didn’t had a taste I would give it 3/5

reviews.author: Ivan Molina
reviews.text: Best pizza I have ever tried, with the taste of wood oven, the pasta was great

reviews.author: Latifa Alawadhi
reviews.text: Located in Alhamra Tower, 1st floor. 📍 The food is amazing!!🔝 We had: - Arancino Palla. - Formaggi Oregano Fries. - Corn & Avo. - Crispy Short Ribs. - Short Ribs Risotto. - Short Ribs Brioche. - Burrata Pizza. All good and beverages were delicious!!💯

reviews.author: Tynayko Melendez (Tye)
reviews.text: Highly recommend this for Italian food in Kuwait. I had the best person taking my order too! Thank you so much for everything. The food was phenomenal and extremely delicious. My experience was further influenced by Nikhil. That was my waiter/server. He was awesome! Nikhil was very attentive and always there whenever I needed him. If you're from the United States, definitely stop by here and ask for Nikhil if you can. The presentation of the food is not something I usually care about but it was definitely something that caught my eye. The food both looked good and tasted even better. Well, what are you waiting on? Enough reading. Go get your Italian food!! I hope you enjoy it like I did.

reviews.author: zouheir Bitar
reviews.text: The staff is attentive and personable. They exhibit a genuine passion for service, effortlessly balancing professionalism and friendliness. Prompt service is a hallmark here. Each phase of dining, from seating to ordering to serving, is executed with impressive efficiency, ensuring a smooth and Each dish is expertly crafted, bursting with fresh, vibrant flavors. The restaurant sets itself apart with unrivaled dining experiences in every aspect—ambiance, service, and culinary excellence, making it a destination worth revisiting and recommending. We had a birthday event for my daughter and everyone was there for help

address: Souk Al-Mubarakiya Stall, Kuwait City, Kuwait

reviews.author: Abbas Hussain
reviews.text: If you want to visit the old market and bazar of kuwait 🇰🇼 that is revamped and renovated with modern looks, then you must visit Al Mubarakiya. Everything there is well managed and cleaned. Old houses and structures, that was once the homes of people, now turned into shops. The market structure and shops make me feel like the old architectural design from a story from Alladin. Street with warm lighting ambience in style of old lantern, structure, small ventilation windows, old retro door of houses with chain buckles, still used to lock doors of shop, Adobe looks of houses now transformed into shops, made you time travel into time. All the shops are well organised and you can find a lot of clothing, restaurants, tea shops, sweet shops, perfume shop there. I simply love visiting this area. As many people were there, I was not comfortable taking pictures of the vicinity but somehow managed to get a few shots. Barbecue of the one of the restaurant 😋 is delicious with a good serving size but expensive.

reviews.author: Alik Must
reviews.text: Very strange market. One benefit and a drawback is that most of the traders are arranged in sections. All exchange offices are on one street, so you can compare the rates quickly. But on the other hand, it is difficult to find an exchange elsewhere. Goods are all the same in many shops: perfumes, rolls of fabrics. Barely anything for the tourists. Heritage street with mostly closed shops. All the sellers are sitting in the shops talking to somebody on the phones. Nobody's interested in the customers. Most of the shops are very small. How did you survive the covid?

reviews.author: Taylor Deni
reviews.text: Such a beautiful atmosphere and setting early evening. Big and nice to browse. Having said this, most vendors sold the same items. There wasn't much variety and it wasn't cheap. This isn't the place to bargain. Most were selling perfumes. I came out smelling very nice! I would however definitely recommend going as the traditional architecture and atmosphere takes you back to another era. Worth a browse for sure. Get lost in the various alleys and explore!

reviews.author: NIHAD
reviews.text: Abu halifa cooperative society (Jammiya) having vast area of shopping and all sectors of items available here. Cleanly and neatly arranged. Reasonable rates.

Walking through its alleys feels like stepping back in time." > "Old vibes, rich culture, endless charm — the soul of Kuwait lives in its old market."

reviews.text: Has a good, hardworking team and coordinates all the work in Safely Manner.. Excellent team to manage civil and MEP jobs.

reviews.text: Good team with technician and quality work.

reviews.author: Mritunjay Kumar
reviews.text: I visited Al Wadi because it’s one of the highest-rated restaurants in the Petra area, but unfortunately, my experience didn’t live up to the hype. While the location is convenient, especially for tourists visiting Petra, I felt the food and service were underwhelming. The dishes lacked the freshness and flavor I expected, especially given the strong reviews. Service was rushed but attentive. It seems like the high ratings might be more about the location and limited local options rather than the overall quality. If you’re looking for an exceptional dining experience, you might want to explore other spots or manage your expectations.

reviews.author: Sruthi Madabushi
reviews.text: This restaurant was rated as one of the best in Petra, hence we were curious to try this place. The food was really good and authentic. The atmosphere was also good, and while the town and nearby area was busy it added to the vibe of the restaurant. It’s very centrally located to the Wadi Musa town and was closely located to Petra.

reviews.author: Fahd Batayneh فهد بطاينة
reviews.text: An excellent restaurant in Petra in the downtown area with a decent menu of soups, salads, starters, local traditional and international dishes, drinks, and desserts. The restaurant is an old building that is very well designed with paintings and antiques, making it look and feel nostalgic. Food portions are enough for one person, and dishes are very tasty. The bake traditional Jordanian bread. Staff are very friendly, and can speak several main languages. They accept cash and card payment. Parking can be slightly challenging though one can park almost anywhere.

reviews.author: Anca Enache
reviews.text: Great food and atmosphere! Jeff was an amazing server that made sure that everything is perfect. The food was delicious and quick to arrive. He also show us the traditional making of tannur(local bread) as seen in the video.

reviews.author: HECTOR RAMIREZ
reviews.text: Fantastic service! Jeff took great care of us—super friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect. The food was delicious and came out quickly. Highly recommend this place, especially if you get Jeff as your server!

reviews.author: Aung Aung
reviews.text: Good Experience surfing at there Durrat Beach. place is nice with beautiful view.

reviews.author: Zuhair Shehab
reviews.text: Nice place to take your family to

reviews.author: Abdullah Mohammed
reviews.text: Its a beautiful placed to hangout But very silent and hardly notice people roaming around Peaceful for people who don’t like city life Beaches are clean and small Every island got a small play area, sport ground There is a supermarket and few shops as well Like Al Osra and Baskin robins and few more There are masjid as well in the island

reviews.author: Alya Altareef
reviews.text: So nice to have a skatepark, nice energy. However the park itself doesn't flow well and sometimes feels intimidating for beginners. There's a public beach near it, small but so nice! The private beaches are amazing for snorkeling. Only issue is, to get access, you need to know someone living in durra, which sucks. Skatepark not accessible to all.

reviews.author: Ammar Alnajem
reviews.text: One of the best relaxing 😎 Urban Living Island style place for families. Durrat Al Bahrain is the third largest artificial island in Bahrain. Houses there are private, but the management have future plans for building apartments for rents, hotel and more small shops. All needed facilities are there including restaurants, supermarket, salon 💇, cafes, ice cream shop 🍦 , bicycle and golf carts rental.

reviews.author: Hamad Naim
reviews.text: First time ordering from them the food was good loved the different taste and the packing and service was really good will definitely order from them again and the Arabic box is just BD 1.5 and Chipotle box 2.5

reviews.author: himens1
reviews.text: One of my favorite shawarma restaurants in bahrain. I always order through talabat and the experience always good and food is so tasty. Today is the first time I visited the restaurant myself and I wish I didn’t. The staff are very rude, I asked for special request for my order however they didn’t make it the way I asked. When I told them that It’s not as I order they told me take and we can’t adjust it for you. After several attempts they replaced my order and treated me as it’s charity or abase. I hope this massage be read by restaurant management, you have a good restaurant please work on customer service to reach perfection

reviews.author: Abdullah Mohammed
reviews.text: First time tried, and its delicious 🤤 Its a small place No place to dine in. Its take away only And the rush is on every time So its better to call 📞 and order The price is reasonable around 650 fills for chicken and beef is 750 I guess. Worth trying! Deliver is available via talabat.

reviews.author: theweekendguide bh
reviews.text: The Street Shawarma. ohh I guess this is one of the best shawarma we had so far. No joke! The green ranch sauce that one, ooohhh hit us direct to our heart. It’s our first time to try this shop and we made a good choice to have their Green Ranch Arabic Shawarma box😎 Their Shawarma will make you feel full. Their shawarma box is good for two with freshly cook fries on the side. I hope they will have some coolers too which compliments their shawarma. The place is just a shop for take away, Inshallah they expand to bigger place. They open from 6pm until 12am daily, call them for deliver or pick up. So whenever you’ll be around Riffa, try to pass by and experience this really good Shawarma. Where to go? Where to eat? Check our page @theweekendguide.bh

reviews.author: AA
reviews.text: Always a pleasure to have the crispy pomegranate shawarma box with extra crispy onion. This combo is very unique in Bahrain. Very saucy and the pomegranate gives a sour crunch. I love that the fries are always fresh and fried properly. The portions are generous and more than fulfilling for the average appetite.

reviews.text: Friendly staff and the food was delicious. Place is clean and the food came quickly and hot. They also gave complimentary sweets and a fruit basket! We will come back again.

reviews.author: Rafeeque M. Ali
reviews.text: One of the best lebanese restaurant in town.... with traditional ambiance and nice seating arrangements.... Food was amazing - especially the cold apatizers, chicken liver and mixed grill... finally the complimentary deserts were too good as well...

reviews.author: irfan syed
reviews.text: Location and atmosphere is outstanding.

reviews.author: Deepal Melvo
reviews.text: I had an incredible dining experience at Assaha Restaurant. The authenticity of the Arabic cuisine is truly exceptional—each dish was bursting with rich flavors. The atmosphere was amazing, with a warm and inviting ambiance that perfectly complemented the food.

reviews.author: Hummings by Humera
reviews.text: It's a beautiful and cozy place to dine at. It is conveniently located at the Gulf Road. The restaurant entrance is grand and the decor is scenic. However, I found the food very average in taste. I ordered chicken corn soup. It was tasteless and full of starch. The basic dishes like Fatoush, Hummus and Mixed grill were bland and ordinary in taste. The service was not good at all. The waiters are careless and unconcerned.

reviews.author: Risha Duttry
reviews.text: I love coming to Salt. It’s got a great vibe on the beach, plus has really good burgers and fries. Absolutely love their ice creams as well! Definitely recommend to everyone. I also appreciate that they allow you to get your ice cream after you finish eating, so it doesn’t melt. Also, I don’t have kids, but I think it’s cool that they put on science shows throughout the day to keep children engaged.

reviews.author: JOHANA SANGKIGAY
reviews.text: Chef, I’m giving you a chance to redeem yourself. Next time, I’ll be expecting a fresh chicken burger, not one that’s been through the microwave too many times. 2/10. Sweet potato fries? Solid—7/10. Flat white? Nailed it 8/10. The ambiance? Perfect for coffee lovers. Clean, quiet, and a peaceful space to unwind. Will I come back? Yes, for the coffee and the vibe. As for the burger? I’m waiting for its redemption.

reviews.author: bashar mraish
reviews.text: Here's a sample review for Salt Restaurant in Kuwait: Salt Restaurant - Kuwait Salt offers a unique dining experience with a focus on fresh, flavorful dishes. It's a self-service restaurant, allowing you to explore the menu and customize your meal. Pros: * Delicious Food: The menu features a variety of options, from salads and wraps to grilled meats and seafood. Everything we tried was incredibly tasty and well-seasoned. * Fresh Ingredients: The emphasis on fresh, high-quality ingredients really shines through in the flavor of the food. * Casual and Relaxed Atmosphere: The self-service style creates a casual and relaxed dining experience. * Parking Available: Convenient parking is available on-site, making it easy to access the restaurant. Cons: * Can get busy: During peak hours, the restaurant can get quite crowded, which may require some patience at the food stations. Overall: Salt is a fantastic option for a casual and delicious meal in Kuwait. The quality of the food is excellent, and the self-service model makes it a convenient and enjoyable dining experience. Recommendation: I highly recommend Salt Restaurant to anyone looking for a tasty and casual meal in Kuwait.

reviews.author: N Alduwaisan
reviews.text: Right away from Dubai the famous slider burger shop now in Kuwait. Fantastic location facing the Gulf Coast. Super service with an outdoor and indoor seating. My order was chicken Cheetos slider and was very good. The fries was super yummy and fresh.They should restudy their prices list though.

reviews.author: Befikre
reviews.text: The location of Salt in Salmiya is absolutely fantastic! Nestled in a lively spot, the weather in November adds to the charm with a cool breeze and great vibes. It’s spacious and perfect for families, with lots of fun activities for kids, making it a great spot for a casual outing. As for the food, I have to admit that it didn’t live up to the hype. While the quality is decent, I found the prices a bit steep, especially for a simple slider that tasted like a basic burger. The fries, salted caramel softie, and coffee were also underwhelming. While the food was fine, it didn’t justify the price. However, the overall experience is pleasant. The self-service concept means you pick up your order at the counter, which works for a casual, fast-food vibe. The large space is great for hanging out, and there are fun activities like ping pong and foosball to keep you entertained while you wait. The atmosphere is further enhanced by good music, creating a relaxing place to chill with friends or family. In the end, Salt offers a cool location and a fun environment, but if you're looking for food that matches the hype, it's a bit lacking. Overall, the experience was just average.

reviews.author: Me So
reviews.text: Vegetables are NOT fresh. Most of the times, the required groceries not available. Worst baklava. Rude people at counter, keeps changing prices as he wishes...

reviews.author: Prem Kumar
reviews.text: A petty shop serves the nearby community. The basic needs for the kitchen are available. Prices are little more than the market prices and options are limited. However, the shop takes care of the basic needs of the nearby people and serves them well.

reviews.author: Clifford Fernandes
reviews.text: Good general stores. Only the man who is there at the cashier at 9pm doesnt know the price of products or intensionally pricing things higher at checkout...

reviews.author: Ali Bai
reviews.text: Best bakala very good service and people . Also srilanka vegetables also available. Low price for vegetables than daily fresh

reviews.author: Najibuddeen kunhahamed
reviews.text: Good grocery and good customer service ànd home delivery available hear good prices good location last night open .

reviews.author: Princess
reviews.text: If i could give them 10 stars I would, I am very impressed by the delicious taste of their food. I ordered clams and seabream I was enjoying every bit. The lemon butter sauce is exceptional yummy yummy. If you're seafood lover you must go there and thank me later! I would definitely go again and again any time I visit Bahrain. Thank you for the warm welcome by the staff and lovely hosts who served me ☺️🙌

reviews.author: Alexei Moiseyev
reviews.text: It's an absolutely delightful experience. The service is exceptional. The views from the terrace that envelopes the restaurant are splendid. The menu and the wine list are perfectly designed. Fresh seafood can be selected from the ice-lined display to be prepared in various ways. I've gone for a butterfly hamour simply grilled. ...an absolute delight!

reviews.author: Saud Al-Subaie
reviews.text: At the fish market resturant, you choose your seafood fish, shrimps, crabs, and seashell and how you want them to be cooked. Variety of recipes available with extra appetisers of your choice. The views around by the sea are beautiful. The service is good. But this resturant is unbelievably overpriced!

reviews.author: Zaid Al-Asa'd
reviews.text: The Fish Market restaurant offers an unforgettable dining experience that I highly recommend. From the moment you step in, the ambiance is charming, with an open and fresh design that enhances the experience. The highlight, of course, is the seafood, which is not only fresh but prepared with incredible skill. Every dish I tried was bursting with flavor, from the perfectly grilled shrimp to the deliciously fresh sea mussels. The variety on the menu caters to all preferences, ensuring that everyone finds something they love. What really sets the Fish Market apart is its exceptional service. The staff is attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable, making excellent recommendations without being overbearing. You can tell they take pride in what they do, which makes the meal that much more enjoyable. And then there’s the view – simply breathtaking. The restaurant overlooks a serene waterfront, making it the perfect spot for a romantic evening or a relaxing lunch. Whether you're a seafood lover or just looking for a unique dining experience, the Fish Market delivers on all fronts. It’s a place I can’t wait to visit again.

reviews.author: Karim Mouawad
reviews.text: We really enjoyed having lunch there. The food was delicious. Great to be able to enjoy their food as we usually enjoyed at their original branch in Al Bander Resort. It gave us the opportunity to enjoy it in downtown Bahrain Bay. Had the salad, shrimps, crab, silous and sea bream which were all delissssssh!! Thank you! ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Lilith
reviews.text: The ambience and view were beautiful. The decoration has been tastefully done, and there is a nice view of the city, sea and Fort. Unfortunately, though I was not very impressed with the food. The seafood was not seasoned, and the rice was extremely plain.

reviews.author: Ara Jherielle
reviews.text: This is a must-visit restaurant. Amazing place. You can enjoy the variety of seafood within your budget. 👍🏻 And a relaxing view of the sea. 🌊

reviews.author: DMK
reviews.text: Popular waterfront eatery at which you could either take your time and choose your catch on display to be prepared for you, or rely on expert chefs to deliver house specials at a quicker turnaround. We like seafood so we really enjoyed this place. This restaurant is frequented equally by both international tourists and local clientele who value the quality offerings of this unique venue.

reviews.author: sky Forhad
reviews.text: It's a seafood Fish Market Marina in Alexander The fish soup was different from what we're used to, as it had shrimp in it. It was a delicious soup with plenty of ingredients. Afterwards, we ordered grilled fish. It came with fried calamari and rice, but the fish was undercooked. At first, I thought this might be how Egyptians prepare fish, but then I realized it was just mine that was like that. When I asked for it to be changed, they sent a new plate. The taste was quite good. There were 4-5 different kinds of mezes, and the ones with garlic and eggplant were my favorites. Warm mini pitas were also served with the dishes. The staff were served at a normal pace. The place was large but noisy. However, the view was amazing. You could watch the calm waters of the Mediterranean from anywhere in the restaurant.

reviews.author: I. Morgan
reviews.text: The Mina District Fish Market is unlike any fish market you’ve ever seen — it’s more like stepping into the luxury food halls at Harrods. The building itself is a work of art, with intricate mosaics, clean marble interiors, and beautiful ironwork that gives the whole space a sense of calm elegance. Even if you’re not here to buy, it’s absolutely worth a visit just to admire the design and experience the atmosphere. The selection of seafood is vast, fresh, and beautifully displayed — from local catches to more exotic varieties. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, it’s the perfect stop if you’re exploring the Mina District or Old Doha Port. Stylish, spotless, and full of character — a must-see spot in the city!

reviews.author: Muna Hawwa
reviews.text: offers a unique blend of culinary excellence and architectural beauty 🩷🩷🩷 Many visitors highlight the quality of the seafood and the unique dining experience. Some patrons have noted longer waiting times during peak hours and suggest arriving early to avoid delays. Despite its upscale ambiance, the market offers competitive pricing, often more affordable than high end seafood restaurants in Doha.

Highly recommended to visit and have a look.

reviews.text: So nice to have a skatepark, nice energy. However the park itself doesn't flow well and sometimes feels intimidating for beginners. There's a public beach near it, small but so nice! reviews.author: Ammar Alnajem
reviews.text: One of the best relaxing 😎 Urban Living Island style place for families. Durrat Al Bahrain is the third largest artificial island in Bahrain. Houses there are private, but the management have future plans for building apartments for rents, hotel and more small shops. All needed facilities are there including restaurants, supermarket, salon 💇, cafes, ice cream shop 🍦 , bicycle and golf carts rental.

Today is the first time I visited the restaurant myself and I wish I didn’t. The staff are very rude, I asked for special request for my order however they didn’t make it the way I asked. When I told them that It’s not as I order they told me take and we can’t adjust it for you. After several attempts they replaced my order and treated me as it’s charity or abase. I hope this massage be read by restaurant management, you have a good restaurant please work on customer service to reach perfection

Deliver is available via talabat.

reviews.author: theweekendguide bh
reviews.text: The Street Shawarma. ohh I guess this is one of the best shawarma we had so far. No joke! The green ranch sauce that one, ooohhh hit us direct to our heart. It’s our first time to try this shop and we made a good choice to have their Green Ranch Arabic Shawarma box😎 Their Shawarma will make you feel full. Their shawarma box is good for two with freshly cook fries on the side. I hope they will have some coolers too which compliments their shawarma. The place is just a shop for take away, Inshallah they expand to bigger place. They open from 6pm until 12am daily, call them for deliver or pick up. So whenever you’ll be around Riffa, try to pass by and experience this really good Shawarma. Where to go? Where to eat? Check our page @theweekendguide.bh

reviews.author: AA
reviews.text: Always a pleasure to have the crispy pomegranate shawarma box with extra crispy onion. This combo is very unique in Bahrain. Very saucy and the pomegranate gives a sour crunch. I love that the fries are always fresh and fried properly. The portions are generous and more than fulfilling for the average appetite.

reviews.author: Muneera alq
reviews.text: Always enjoy the quiet in the mall you can find almost everything you want there and the Sea view is amazing

reviews.author: Befikre
reviews.text: During our recent vacation in Kuwait, I had the pleasure of visiting Souk Sharq Mall with my parents, and it was a delightful experience that offered a perfect blend of shopping, entertainment, and cultural attractions. From the moment we walked in, we knew it would be a memorable visit. Stunning Architecture and Atmosphere Souk Sharq Mall is beautifully designed, combining modern shopping experiences with traditional elements. The architecture is striking, with large open spaces, elegant decorations, and stunning views of the marina. The water clock near the entrance truly stood out during our visit. My parents were absolutely fascinated by this piece – its mechanical movements and the way it tells time are captivating. It’s definitely one of the highlights of the mall and a must-see for anyone visiting. Shopping Experience The mall offers a wide variety of stores, from high-end fashion boutiques to popular international brands. There’s something for everyone, whether you’re looking for luxury items or more casual everyday wear. The shopping experience is comfortable, with spacious aisles and plenty of seating areas if you need a break. The layout of the mall is easy to navigate, so you can comfortably shop and explore without feeling overwhelmed. Entertainment and Activities One of the best parts of our visit was being able to watch the Gulf Football match between Kuwait and UAE. The mall has a great screening area where people gather to watch major sporting events, and it was the perfect place to enjoy the game. The atmosphere was lively, with other fans cheering and engaging with the match. It was an exciting and fun way to spend time together, and my parents really enjoyed the experience as much as I did. Dining Options After exploring the shops and enjoying the football match, we took a break at one of the many cafes and restaurants within the mall. There’s a great selection of dining options, ranging from casual eateries to more upscale restaurants, so you can find something to suit your tastes. The mall’s waterfront location also means you can enjoy a pleasant dining experience with views of the marina. Family-Friendly Atmosphere Souk Sharq Mall is incredibly family-friendly, with plenty of activities and spaces for all ages. It’s a great place for families to spend time together, whether you’re shopping, dining, or just exploring the mall’s various attractions. My parents and I felt very comfortable throughout our visit, and it’s a perfect place to relax and enjoy some time together. Conclusion Overall, Souk Sharq Mall is a wonderful destination in Kuwait that offers much more than just shopping. From the stunning water clock to the exciting football match experience, there’s something for everyone. The combination of great shopping, entertainment, dining, and cultural attractions makes it an ideal place to spend a day with family. If you’re visiting Kuwait, I highly recommend adding Souk Sharq Mall to your itinerary for a memorable and enjoyable experience.

The price is 600K Lebanese Pound, Equal to US $7, affordable. Free Parking available, but sometimes crowded.

reviews.author: Anderson England
reviews.text: Good food and huge portions. The restaurant is spotless and well lit. The waiters and staff are friendly and an English menu is available. The waiter had good recommendations and the food came out quickly. The restaurant was full of locals and had a decent take away business. This was a great first meal in Baalbek. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Alain Francis
reviews.text: A 150 year old historic hotel, full of stories, memories and famous guests. Once you set your foot in this hotel, a beautiful journey begins, starting from the old authentic items, artifacts to the famous guests' portrait/photos. The view from the second floor is mesmerizing straight into the Roman Temples. However, the rooms are not equipped with a TV and need some maintenance, yet wifi and hot water are available. The stay includes breakfast, which was generous and delicious.

reviews.author: Mano EID
reviews.text: Great location facing the temples of Baalbek with a great view over the columns. The hotel has a history and you can feel the charm of it as if you're sleeping in a museum. However, there are some downsides when it comes to room equipments (no ac / no fridge / no tv / no landlines) and at some times there is no one at the reception desk. Breakfast is good but the coffee that is served is a bad quality instant 3 in 1 sachets....

reviews.author: Paulina Bockowska
reviews.text: Really incredible and authentic place, hence don’t expect fancy luxury. The location is perfect and the view from the hotel rooftop is spectacular. The staff is very professional and welcoming. My favourite thing was delicious Lebanese breakfast with some of my favourite local dishes enjoyed with the view over Baalbek ruins.

reviews.author: Thomas H. (Travel Consultant)
reviews.text: Very friendly owner and her team made my stay at this historic hotel with incredible views unforgettable. Very good breakfast, lovely tours to beautiful places are offered. Enjoy Lebanese hospitality! Stay at least 2 nights!

reviews.author: Hanine Abdel Rahman
reviews.text: I only had lunch there and am so eager to go back to stay at their rooms. Charming interiors that tell the history of years back where artists and many famous people stayed at the hotel that is facing the ruins of Baalback. The food is homey and the service is top

reviews.author: Youssef Yaacoub
reviews.text: I had dinner there with my family and we loved the food, the service was great and the stuff were friendly. If you’re looking for a traditional friendly old school sea food restaurant don’t hesitate to eat there. The view alone is worth visiting the place.

reviews.author: Nancy Gallou
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the food in this resto! The view is beautiful and the service was very good. Very good grilled calamari and fish. The raw fish was my least favourite. A bit pricey!

reviews.author: Juliette Mazraani
reviews.text: My experience at Chez Maguy was a profound letdown, a wound to the very soul of my culinary expectations. The promise of Lebanese warmth, the vibrant pulse of its flavors, was utterly absent. The food, ancient in its lack of vitality, spoke not of heritage but of resignation, each flavorless bite a stark contradiction to the richness it should embody. And then, the final, sharp sting: a bill that felt less like a tally and more like a cruel jest, leaving me not just unsatisfied, but utterly stripped of comfort and trust. My heart aches for the heritage unwoven by such a stark reality. Chez Maguy brought shame to the Lebanese coastal culinary culture.

reviews.author: Abdul Muqsit
reviews.text: Food was very average and overpriced, view is super good service was good too

reviews.author: Adriana V
reviews.text: Hands down the best grilled calamari EVER!! This little hidden gem is amazing. I arrived solo and had the whole outdoor terrace to myself with spectacular views. Even a piece of the Phoenician wall. Steve, the owner/server, was friendly and kind. Didn’t realize there was a downstairs access to the water until I was leaving and didn’t have enough time to jump in but soaked my feet. I am telling all my friends about this place

reviews.author: azaria chatila
reviews.text: Great experience at Colonel Brewery and Distillery! It’s pet-friendly (except on weekends), and the staff are super friendly. Prices are reasonable. The unfiltered beer and nachos were delicious, and my brother loved his fresh virgin cocktail. The seafood looked fresh, though I didn’t try it. We spent $30 for 2 beers, 1 nachos, and 1 virgin cocktail. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: jdesign leb
reviews.text: Terrible experience. Our beer came 3 hours late, the staff was rude, and no one apologized. I used to love this place, but never again.

reviews.author: daniella sakr
reviews.text: Our stay at Colonel Bed & Brew was amazing. It was one of the best places in Batroun, from the Host estephan, room cleanliness & privacy, comfort, amenities, delicious breakfast everything was perfect. A must visit in Lebanon. Will definitely come again❤ Thank U so much Estephan

reviews.author: It's Me Sarsour
reviews.text: Just perfect :) the staff, the people, the food, the beer and the whole place! Highly recommend getting the fried fish. Best two beers were the passion fruit one and the black one. Ammar is our favorite waiter 🤍

reviews.author: Georges Younes
reviews.text: Colonel Brewery uses creativity, original ideas and concepts that are hard to find elsewhere in Lebanon. Examples include a shop that rents bicycles out by the hour, access to the sea from a shallow pool for customers who want to take a dip in the Mediterranean between beers, a dog-friendly environment where dogs are allowed to roam free, an outdoor area to lounge, a brewery that makes beer, gin, vodka and arak, and food for those who want to have something with their drinks. Service is friendly and helpful. Prices are in line with those practiced elsewhere in Lebanon. The place is ideal for an afternoon or an evening. Areas of improvement have mostly to do with food. While adequate, food offerings need to be reviewed and improved by a professional chef. This will attract a wider range of clients.

reviews.author: Marc-André (M-A)
reviews.text: The place is consistently very good for years now. Located in an old building with high ceilings and a large winter garden area the place is spacious and has an inviting ambiance. Dishes are traditional for the region and tastefully spiced. Quality of meats and vegetables is impeccable. The service is highly attentive and fast. I enjoy going there a lot. So will you. Only small downside is that some people keep smoking inside. While i am usually very sensitive to this, it did not bother me due to the size of the place and the very minor olfactory annoyance.

reviews.author: Alex F
reviews.text: When we came here the vibe was odd, it wasn’t too busy and rather quiet, with football on the screens. The food did not disappoint though - all the dishes were fantastic, especially falafel and boneless chicken - those were phenomenal. Desserts worth skipping, didn’t impress or hit the spot for the end of the meal. Service overall friendly and pretty fast, so that was really nice. Can pay by card.

reviews.author: Lena Rizk
reviews.text: I frequently order delivery from Abdel Wahab Restaurant, a well-known establishment in the area. Recently, I tried their meal for one, which turned out to be a very generous portion, easily serving two people. The restaurant maintains high cleanliness standards, and I appreciated the food coming in well-presented containers. Speaking of the food, it's not only tasty but also of very good quality. However, one aspect that could be improved is the availability of options with less salt, especially for those with hypertension. This addition would cater to a wider range of dietary needs and preferences. Overall, Abdel Wahab Restaurant delivers on taste, portion size, and presentation, making it a reliable choice for a satisfying dining experience.

reviews.author: Karim Mouawad
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere sitting upstairs on the balcony! Really enjoyed the place, their Lebanese food and the service! There is also a parking service at the entrance which makes it easy just to park your car! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Yarob Badr
reviews.text: Abdel Wahab is a fantastic spot to experience Lebanese food and hospitality. They have a large menu with mezze options, fresh salads, and grilled meats. We particularly enjoyed Fattoush, Hummus, Halloumi and mixed grills. All with a quarter of famous Lebanese Brun Arak. The restaurant has a beautiful terrace that's perfect for enjoying a meal outdoors during good weather. Overall, it was a great experience - highly recommended! Tips: Make a reservation if you're going with a group, especially on weekends.

reviews.author: Ahmad Issa
reviews.text: I visited Al Ajamib2 years ago. I tried their food and it was tasty. Yesterday 25 Feb 2024 I visited again and still the same good taste. Keep it up guys. I love their Broasted Chicken. The price is 600K Lebanese Pound, Equal to US $7, affordable. Free Parking available, but sometimes crowded.

reviews.author: Anderson England
reviews.text: Good food and huge portions. The restaurant is spotless and well lit. The waiters and staff are friendly and an English menu is available. The waiter had good recommendations and the food came out quickly. The restaurant was full of locals and had a decent take away business. This was a great first meal in Baalbek. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: David Stallibrass
reviews.text: It is a basic takeaway joint, but that doesn't mean it's not great. Top quality basic dishes, friendly service. Great location.

reviews.author: Eli Had (EH)
reviews.text: Very delicious doner maybe the only in lebanon and shawarma chicken definitely recommend it

reviews.author: Djordje Andjelkovic
reviews.text: Amazing food,Friendly people. Totally remanded.

reviews.author: Wael K
reviews.text: Arrogant staff, tiny portions, average food, slow service (though we were alone) and prices were extremely exaggerated. I would not come again for my next visit to Beirut for sure!!

reviews.author: Fahim
reviews.text: We had lunch and breakfast at this place and we loved both. The owner is an elderly guy, originally from Isfahan in Iran, but can't speak Farsi. He is really kind, and he is always going around and taking care of the customers needs. He also gave us extra olives and cherries after our breakfast! Thank you for making us feel great ❤️ Wish you luck and prosperity

reviews.author: Irena Cress
reviews.text: Really overpriced, food ok, but not really special. Some of the waiters are quite arrogant if you are not part of the usual crowd of upper class people that’s frequenting the place.

reviews.author: jihad chehab
reviews.text: The food & service are great The ajami shisha is excellent but the bathrooms need some restoration. But in overall its very good. I recommend it for people taht like kabab & lebanese home made dishes.

reviews.author: Abe Hassan
reviews.text: Me and Ryan family have been going there for 20 years noif any of my friends come. Visit Lebanon I personally take them there. I think this is a place I will keep going till I have grand children food and service top of the line but one thing plz fix the way to the toilet it’s not handicapped friendly

reviews.author: Hannah B
reviews.text: Traditional Lebanese restaurant with amazing views of Raouche rock! I wouldn’t recommend going there for the food, but if you’re looking for a nice spot to relax with drinks and breathtaking views, this is the place!

reviews.author: lina bassil
reviews.text: Al Falamanki Raouche offers a vibrant and lively atmosphere with one of the best views in Beirut — a direct look at the iconic Raouche Rock. While the ambiance can get quite crowded, especially during peak hours, the breathtaking seaside view more than makes up for it. One small downside is the default use of plastic cups for water unless you specifically request a glass — something to keep in mind if you’re particular about presentation or sustainability. Overall, it’s a great spot for a meal with classic Lebanese vibes.

reviews.author: TonY NouH
reviews.text: Al Falamanki Raouche, is one of the traditional Lebanese restaurants with a breathtaking view. The food is tasty, service is good staff are helpful. Prices are average. Portion is good.

reviews.author: Louis Edmond Mouawad
reviews.text: I visited Al Falamanki Raouche mainly for the view, and in that sense, it absolutely delivered. The atmosphere was charming and unmistakably Lebanese, with a great setting overlooking the Raouche rock. We ordered Lebanese coffee and hommos, which were exactly what we expected — nothing more, nothing less. The service was good overall, but I was disappointed that we were seated at a table without the best view. They told us the prime table was reserved, yet no one showed up the entire hour and a half we were there. It felt like they were saving it for someone they assumed would spend more, which didn’t sit well with me. Still, the view and vibe are the real highlights here. Prices were fair considering the location and setting. I’d go back again for the experience, but next time I hope they seat us properly, especially if better tables are clearly available.

reviews.author: Khalil Yassine
reviews.text: GREAT ATMOSPHERE! The service is great with all staff well trained and mannered. The food is also very good and reasonably priced for the location.

reviews.author: Hannah B
reviews.text: Traditional Lebanese restaurant with amazing views of Raouche rock! I wouldn’t recommend going there for the food, but if you’re looking for a nice spot to relax with drinks and breathtaking views, this is the place!

reviews.author: Eissa Senan
reviews.text: This place is a must visit when in Beirut. Great place for authentic Lebanese plates. I’ve been a couple of times for breakfast and I was impressed, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Yasmeen Faraj
reviews.text: Elsoussi is a must-visit spot in Beirut, particularly if you're seeking an authentic Lebanese breakfast experience. While it may not boast fancy embellishments in terms of service or location, the focus here is solely on delivering the best traditional Lebanese breakfast. I highly recommend trying the fattie!

reviews.author: Caline Farah
reviews.text: Don’t go and expect a fine dining experience. Small old almost ancient shop. The same old man still makes the food himself. He is full of positivity and very welcoming. The fatteh is absolutely amazing! We ordered fatteh, beid bi awarma, hummus, fried asbeh (liver) and foul. Everything was phenomenal except for the foul, it was average.

reviews.author: Matthew Lee
reviews.text: This is another famous restaurant in Beirut which has been recommended by CNN and also visited by many celebrities. It is a no frills dining place you don't expect this place to be high end with a proper menu. Recommended to go with someone local who can help you to order the special dishes to try. Got the honour of seeing the old owner himself preparing and cooking my dishes. He is a quiet man of few words yet can see how nimble his hands are and how fast he can whip up dishes. Be in surprise for what you eat cause there might be some 'fear factor' for people who are not used to eating slightly exotic stuff. It was definitely an experience for me eating sheep's brains which I loved it a lot, and also the liver. I don't really eat a lot of liver elsewhere but here it is so well cooked and the sauce packs so much flavour to the meat. If you want to go with the safer options try the hummus, fatteh, eggs with meat or salads. Highly recommended and best to visit on weekdays morning.

reviews.author: Weronika Krydus
reviews.text: I think that was the most delicious breakfast I’ve ever eaten in Lebanon. Hummus, scrumbled egg with meat, salad, side dishes.. Everything was truthfully perfect. If you have an opportunity to visit Beirut, you have to eat here.

reviews.author: Carlo D.
reviews.text: Great place! I had grilled calamari and lebanese cold mezzes, all really delicious. Sweets are complimentaries from the house, pleanty of fresh fruits and traditional cakes. Staff polite and assertive. Reccomended.

reviews.author: Hani Siyam
reviews.text: Amazing destination. Great atmosphere. The appetizers will overwhelm you, outstanding variety. The fish is excellent. Perfect Lebanese dinning experience. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sargon
reviews.text: Love this place, sad I couldn’t go there again. Visited Lebanon recently from chicago. We tried this place and we loved it. Supper clean and nice atmosphere. Food was on point. I’d definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Lamis El Ghor
reviews.text: Heavenly!! Just love this restaurant and I keep coming back for more. Hommous was particularly tasty this time but really never disappoints anyway. And the fishes!! Goodness Small Sultans with the right crisp. The shrimps, the crabs, octopus and the list goes on...

reviews.author: Eva Demuth
reviews.text: Our second visit in this restaurant after one year and I can say it is the best sea food restaurant in the middle east. Top level personnel and nice interior of the restaurant. And sweets for free. Absolutely love it.

reviews.author: Emre ASLAN
reviews.text: It is a self service restaurant. Their sides are pretty good. We tried Tabbule, Hummus, Falafel, Salads etc. We also tried mixed kebap, it was okay.

reviews.author: ammar kachouch
reviews.text: Authentic, delicious, and full of soul! Em Nazih delivers the true taste of Lebanese home cooking in a casual and welcoming atmosphere. The self-service setup is efficient and the staff are always helpful. Prices are very reasonable, portions are generous, and the overall vibe is relaxed and genuine. A must-visit spot for anyone craving real Lebanese flavors without the fuss.

reviews.author: Mohamed Hisham
reviews.text: The food simply good specially in traditional Lebanese breakfast, atmosphere is fantastic, prices reasonable, every weekend there’s musical night. just the thing i didn’t like you have to bring order yourself and you have to pay before.

reviews.author: Albert Van den Berg
reviews.text: I highly recommend this restaurant for anyone looking to indulge in authentic Lebanese cuisine. The combination of the beautiful interior design, self-service concept, short waiting times, and the free to play backgammon boards make it a unique and enjoyable dining experience. Whether you're a fan of Lebanese food or simply looking for a new culinary adventure, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: Ziad Lel
reviews.text: I've known this restaurant for years, and I used to go there for lunch with my colleagues when my job location was in Hamra Things I love about Bayt Em Nazih: 1- The food is very good, especially the manakish in the morning ( freshly baked). 2- You feel like you are at home, and it's sef service. 3- The cheap prices they have. 4- The employees are friendly. 5- Location of the restaurant is nice and easy to find. 6- The shisha is not bad. I recommend going to Bayt em nazih if you wanna grab a quick bite or have good food at a cheap price. I usually visit this restaurant every time I visit Lebanon to have breakfast because in the morning time is not crowded.

reviews.author: Elie Aramouny
reviews.text: Beit Kanz is one of those rare places I find myself returning to over and over again—not just for the food, but for the feeling it evokes every time I walk through its doors. It’s more than a restaurant; it’s a home. A sanctuary that captures the essence of Beirut in its most beautiful, soulful form. Nestled in the iconic Tabbal building in Ashrafieh, Beit Kanz is a story of resilience and beauty. After the devastating port blast in 2020, the building was restored with such care and love that it now stands as a testament to Beirut’s ability to heal and shine again. The renovation preserved its architectural soul, and stepping inside feels like being embraced by Beirut’s rich heritage. Every visit is a journey. From the warm service to the comforting aromas of authentic Lebanese dishes, everything is crafted with intention and heart. The food is simply exceptional—flavors that remind you of home, prepared with generosity and served with genuine care. And what makes the experience even more meaningful is the spirit behind it: Beit Kanz is powered by Beit El Baraka, a foundation dedicated to supporting the community, which gives your meal a deeper sense of purpose. The staff are not only professional but deeply kind and attentive, making every guest feel like a long-lost friend. Whether you’re seated indoors, surrounded by vintage Beiruti charm, or enjoying the fresh air in the garden, you’re transported to a Beirut that feels timeless. Beit Kanz is more than a dining spot. It’s a reminder of who we are, where we come from, and how even in difficult times, beauty, tradition, and kindness continue to thrive.

reviews.author: joseph saadeh
reviews.text: Beit Kanz is a charming Lebanese restaurant nestled in the heart of Ashrafiyeh, Beirut. Housed in a beautifully preserved traditional Lebanese building, it offers a warm atmosphere filled with heritage and flavor. The architecture, with its arched windows and stone walls, takes you back in time, while the menu serves authentic Lebanese dishes made with love. A perfect spot for those seeking culture, taste, and ambiance in one unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: Reem Wahoud
reviews.text: I was really looking forward to trying this place, especially given its stunning location. Tucked away in the heart of Achrafieh, the setting is genuinely beautiful whether you’re seated inside or outside , a true hidden gem in terms of atmosphere. Unfortunately the food didn’t live up to the surroundings. We ordered a wide selection of dishes, but overall it was below average. The only standout was the chicken, which was well-prepared and flavorful. The sweets at the end also managed to leave a good impression. Thanks god It’s a shame because with such a charming spot, you’d expect the food to match. I truly hope they work on improving the menu because the potential is there.

reviews.author: Moussa Mhanna
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived at Kanz Restaurant, we were immersed in a truly exclusive oriental experience. The ambiance is a perfect blend of elegance and warmth, with both indoor and outdoor seating options that make it ideal for any occasion. The food? Absolutely delicious , every dish was rich in flavor, beautifully presented, and cooked to perfection. Whether you're a fan of traditional tastes or looking to explore something new, Kanz delivers on every level. What made the visit even more special was the friendly and attentive service. The staff, especially Zahi, went above and beyond to ensure we felt welcomed and well taken care of. Kanz isn’t just a meal, it’s a memorable dining experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Lilian Amatoury (Liliantheguide)
reviews.text: A hidden gem in the heart of Beirut! I’m so happy and proud of this beautiful Lebanese restaurant. Beit Kanz is set in a charming old house converted into a cozy, welcoming space that feels like home. The food? Epic. Honestly, it’s the best Lebanese food I’ve had lately—fresh, authentic, and full of soul. The staff are way too friendly in the best way possible, and the atmosphere is just perfect. Do not leave without trying the molasses fondant—it’s unforgettable! And make sure to check out their shop: their zaatar is hands down the best I’ve ever tasted. Beit Kanz is a true treasure—can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Elie Daou
reviews.text: Great and authentic Lebanese food, generous platters and great taste. You can eat the raw dishes without any fear of food poisoning. Keep in mind the cost though for budget conscious people.

reviews.author: Karim Sirgi
reviews.text: Used to be my FAVORITE restaurant in Lebanon; they recently underwent renovation (very nice) but it seems the quality of the food also got renovated downward ... I tried it in late January 2019 and it was a huge disappointment. I kindly informed our waiter about it and begged him to let management know and do something about it in the near future ... Best of luck for a very much needed come back to previous glory! I won't come back unless I hear great reviews again from friends and family living there

reviews.author: Elham Nakadi
reviews.text: Excellent traditionnel Lebanese Food, very good service. Family oriented, an address not to miss if your a foodie....👍😁

reviews.author: Koko Koko
reviews.text: Food is amazing but I didn't like the fish the kind was( BIZRI ) I think not well fried .the kafta nayyé and all the raw meat was excellent .

reviews.author: Samia Elzyrkassouf
reviews.text: It's a Lebanese restaurant ..mezze and grilled meat chicken sausages...very tasty and generous portions

reviews.author: Rita Tohme
reviews.text: Love it, especially for my after work escapades. It's relaxing & chilled in the afternoon, quite fun with really food music at night! The staff is super friendly and the mini burgers are my favorite 😍

reviews.author: Chadi KAI
reviews.text: A casual pub with relatively low music sound because it's located in a residential neighborhood. The good thing about the music is that u can have a clear conversation with people. Drinks tasted good, and the staff were very attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: Patrick Chemali
reviews.text: A very laid back place for drinks and a gathering. Service is friendly and courteous and the bar has a wide selection of cocktails. Their finger food is not bad and if you want a more serious meal, you can order from the adjacent Wall Street since both places are sister companies. The place tends to get crowded a lot so if you are looking to have a quiet drink try to avoid the weekend.

reviews.author: Youmna Hammoud
reviews.text: I love this place. Food is yummy. I tried crab salad, chicken tempura and international fries and wedges They were all tasty. Sauces were delicious too. Happy hour 5-8. Cheerful music!

reviews.author: Hanine Abdel Rahman
reviews.text: I love the decoration of this pub, in badaro it's always packed and the service is very good. It has similar menu as Main street. We had the smoked salmon salad that keeps the same good quality we are used on.

reviews.author: Traicy najem
reviews.text: If you are craving good bao/dumplings/burger/salad, you’re in the right place ! We went at night, the lighting and ambiance was insane! We ordered bao buns, dumplings and salad with meat, they were literally amazing ! and small tip, never order the baos without the dumplings so you can dip it in the sauce 😋 It’s a hidden gem in Hamra !

reviews.author: Wadad Lahad
reviews.text: The place is beautiful having an indoor and outdoor. The atmosphere is cool and the music is nice. The service is friendly. The quality and ingredients are good. The salad was tasty. The chicken quesadillas were tasty. Burgers are ok but used to be more tasty.

reviews.author: Gabriel K (Kazvisuals)
reviews.text: Love their food and their drinks, been there a couple of times. The drinks are unique and each has a special touch. The food is tasty, but ask the waiter to suggest the best sellers so you have the best experience. The staff and waiters are all friendly and knowledgeable and thats what makes me keep coming back!!!

reviews.author: Hala Khodary
reviews.text: It’s the kind of spot that feels like your favorite spot at home. .. part bar, part home, all heart....You show up for a drink, but stay for the warmth, the laughs, and the feeling that you’ve been coming here forever... and you will keep coming ❤️

reviews.author: Pascal LANNOO
reviews.text: Another magical classy time travel in Beirut with this trendy yet oldie cocktail bar. It is an institution in Beirut. Great drinks and staff. Don't miss the happy hour! Real experience guaranteed

reviews.author: plz
reviews.text: Trendy and safe space, feels like the Côte d‘Azur

reviews.author: George A N
reviews.text: busy street in Beirut where you can find all the nicest restaurants bars , pubs and night clubs . It is nice to walk at night. It is very safe and there are plenty of tourists across the year . Best time from sunset till late evening . You should try the experience of spending the night there and have an early breakfast at the sunrise .

reviews.author: Ghady Daou
reviews.text: A street full of life

reviews.author: seif madi
reviews.text: Amazing vibes , great food , I love the kawarma wraps The waiters are way too friendly Overall amazing concept keep on the good work suraya's team

reviews.author: Sandra Klat
reviews.text: Elegant street in Achrafieh, very well located, crowded during the day, quiet at night.

reviews.author: Pierre Wakim
reviews.text: One of the best Lahmajun in Lebanon! The meat pies are to die for. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Salah
reviews.text: Best lahmajun and subureg i ever tried!! Super tasty, friendly staff, very authentic neighborhood, very affordable. This visit was the highlight of my vacation in lebanon. Note that they don't have big seating area, only some chairs at the entrance

reviews.author: Jervenne Ong
reviews.text: Super delicious lahmacun, especially the pomegranate one. Staff and owner were really friendly. Manti was interesting and yummy too!

reviews.author: NKM
reviews.text: Food poisoning! Thank you for a wonderful Sunday experience. If I had a $ for every trip to the toilet, id be a millionaire Tfeh 3aleykon shu wiskheen la yseer feeye yalle sar

reviews.author: beto menescal
reviews.text: Great gourmet Armenian bakery experience. There's no space to sit. But it's part of the experience to eat standing up while watching them work. Buy one, eat, then eat for another to keep them nice and hot. Try them all.

reviews.author: Paola Rebeiz
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Adham Sedeeq
reviews.text: Probably worst experience I ever had on my 5 trips to Beirut. The place was completely unclean. They charged us $45 for two people on breakfast, which’s absolutely ridiculous. I went upstairs to use the toilet, I literally couldn’t use it because it was super dirty. I went there because of the reviews, that’s why I’m purified this so it couldn’t save somebody’s day or even trip. I love beirut but I hate it when people misuse you for being tourist.

reviews.author: Alaa Allam
reviews.text: A very Nice place in a central location in Hamra Opens till late hours.. very Good choice for a nice breakfast or a late light dinner.. The staff are very friendly and the place is nicely decorated, cheerful and colorful, Was good start for the day, And also a late hunger saver :D The food and juice came fresh and in good quality really liked the place and visited multiple times..

reviews.author: Salua Kamerow
reviews.text: I thought the food was good but I just tasted the quibbe (fried) and a plate of tabbouli. The service was good too—although I find a little irregular that they run by the customers with the coals burning on fire. I paid 18000 lira for 5 quibbe and tabbouli. Not bad.

reviews.author: Ruby Wu
reviews.text: I ordered a chicken breast main that costs $13USD, saying that there should be a Lebanese salad included with baked potatoes. Look what I’ve got….. plain lettuce and potatoes without cheese?!?! No sauce or anything. My takeaway food tastes worst than a street food. Guys if you want good food, don’t go there.

reviews.author: Melted Butter
reviews.text: I found this cafe to be overpriced for what offering . Chicha is quite average . I had the cheese turkey kaake it was full of veggies instead of cheese and turkey. The akkaweh kaakeh was fine served with olives and veggies on the side . We sat outside on the street . They even charge u a bottle of water without asking u if u want it or not once u arrive .

reviews.author: Zahraa Mourtada
reviews.text: the food is AMAZING. genuinely one of the best places to eat rice dishes. also btw, best grilled half chicken in lebanon

reviews.author: A. Sleiman
reviews.text: Perfect

reviews.author: Eng Mustafa
reviews.text: Excellent popular restaurant. I recommend trying the meat, labneh, and biryani rice with chicken.

reviews.author: Mahmoud Hassan (MH)
reviews.text: A restaurant that's just an advertisement, nothing more. The food portion is just rice, stale rice that has no taste. I don't recommend it to anyone, unless someone wants to eat just rice and grilled chicken.

reviews.author: مجتبى عقيل سالم طاهر
reviews.text: The food, arrangement and service are excellent. One of the best restaurants in Lebanon.

reviews.author: Pierre Wakim
reviews.text: Amazing homemade Lebanese cuisine. Reminds you of the meals you had at home with your parents. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Matthew Lee
reviews.text: A very interesting old school establishment which serves good food. It opens at 8am in the morning and we went there we were told they only serve the lighter dishes for breakfast and the rest for lunch. So with the help of my driver we ordered a few local dishes to try. I might have forgotten some of the names of the dishes but have to say it was a hearty breakfast and I loved all the dishes. I remembered the 2 fried eggs, labneh, hummus with minced meat and the stuff vine leaves in oil. The food were very well executed and felt like eating some home cooked food like you were invited to the house of a local Lebanese. A truly authentic experience to try. Food was good and the bill was reasonable. Recommended.

reviews.author: Salam Gabran
reviews.text: Brilliant experience, I was food foraging for local eateries in Beirut and I found this place. Food taste is from Heavens. I tried the okra and the cauliflower dishes, and they were splendid. The owner is friendly and took the time to describe to me the menu items. If you are looking for a portion of the spectrum of Lebanese cuisine, this place is good for you. Lebanese cuisine is very rich and diverse and it needs several restaurants to cover it.

reviews.author: S J
reviews.text: Cute little place. Nice food. Homely atmosphere. Ask for bread to be warmed if eating hummus it’s better. Great pricing too. Didn’t love the chicken dish but overall it was still a 5 star review for overall happiness.

reviews.author: Catadores Locales
reviews.text: Le chef is a local institution. Made famous by food network TV show but they maintain their simple, direct and yet delicious approach to food. Good prices are still a thing here and ratio of quality to price is excellent. Try the artichoke with garlic butter, you wont regret it. Shukran ya Chef!

reviews.author: Nicolette
reviews.text: I tasted arak for the first time at Liza’s ;) Here I found myself seated in the intimate courtyard of a historic homestead, jasmine flowering in front of me, a fountain splashing behind me and then this thrilling taste of subdued sweetness of an anise drink on a balmy spring day (1st May). Waiters in ‘Beyrouth je t’aime ’ tee shirts were graced with trays and platters bearing an array of dishes starting with a beautiful artichoke salad tossed with garden-fresh peas,coriander,spring onion :) and ending with a joyful rice and caramel pudding. In between many shared dishes with my friends,Lebanese-style hospitality,there was time to peek inside the alluring Liza mansion and buy one of those ‘je t’aime’ tee shirts to express my reaction to Beirut- a city that took me by surprise. Aside from communicating reviews,the effortless artistry and elegance at Liza’s and astounding authenticity of Lebanon at large,left me speechless.

reviews.author: Serge El-Khazen
reviews.text: Liza Beirut is a captivating blend of Lebanese heritage and contemporary elegance, nestled in a restored 19th-century palace in Achrafieh. The restaurant’s interior features themed rooms adorned with unique wallpapers—ranging from vintage banknotes to banana leaves—and traditional Levantine tiles, creating an ambiance that is both nostalgic and modern. The outside garden is very pleasant. Culinary offerings at Liza present a refined take on classic Lebanese cuisine. The menu boasts a variety of mezze, including creamy labneh, smoky moutabbal, and vibrant fattoush. Signature dishes such as the five-spice lamb confit and Armenian mante dumplings showcase the kitchen’s dedication to flavor and presentation . ￼ ￼ Service is attentive, complementing the restaurant’s warm and inviting atmosphere. Whether you’re enjoying a leisurely Sunday brunch or an intimate dinner, Liza offers an experience that delights all the senses. It’s a must-visit destination for those seeking to indulge in the rich culinary traditions of Lebanon within a setting of unparalleled beauty. The set menu is a bit pricy but delicious.

reviews.author: Nahil KAZOUN
reviews.text: Classy and traditional choice in the small roads of Achrafieh. The inside and outside architecture is beautiful. Quick service, professional staff, and nice presentation. Food taste isn't bad but might be better. However, it is difficult to find a parking on your own. The valet parking option is available. Enjoy...

reviews.author: heba rachid
reviews.text: We had the sunday brunch. I love their dessert soo much I end up going everytime I crave sweet stuff. The food is also very good. It’s a comforting and fancy place and I find myself going many times.

reviews.author: Mana
reviews.text: Nice Lebanese restaurant in the heart of achrafieh. The terrace is gorgeous. The food is also good with a nice presentation and the service too.

reviews.author: Mana
reviews.text: Nice Lebanese restaurant in the heart of achrafieh. The terrace is gorgeous. The food is also good with a nice presentation and the service too.

reviews.author: Jihan Masri
reviews.text: If you’re looking to experience traditional Lebanese cuisine done right, this place is definitely worth a visit. The ambiance is just as impressive: beautifully designed with a warm, traditional aesthetic that instantly makes you feel welcome. It's the kind of place where you want to linger a little longer. And let’s not forget the service—attentive, friendly, and professional from start to finish. Overall, a wonderful dining experience that blends taste, tradition, and top-notch hospitality. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Firas Hawat
reviews.text: A very nice place to go too Friendly and helpful staff Arabic food, great taste, great presentation, big plates and platters Fast service Affordable prices. A must try

reviews.author: Shireen ib
reviews.text: A great spot! The food is really good, with lots of tasty options to choose from. The place has a nice, cozy vibe, perfect for hanging out with family or friends. The staff are friendly. Just a heads up, though if you’re coming without a reservation, you might have to wait a bit. But it’s definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Kafa Geara
reviews.text: I was really disappointed with my visit to loris . The food was bad. Bad tabbouleh , bad homos ( I felt like I was eating homos with sugar ,most disgusting flavor ) and the batata hara ( should be made up of potatoes, chilli, garlic and lemon, not potatoes and tomato sauce). I didn't like the taste at all ,that was very strange .Additionally, our server seemed disinterested ,he is rude and acts as if he is forced to work .After tasting the appetizers and being surprised by the taste, we did not even order the main course and left. This experience really put a damper on our evening, and I'm sure I'll never be back. Please, people, not all good reviews should be believed. And the restaurant is overrated !!

reviews.author: Elena Mhanna
reviews.text: My family and I went for Iftar at Loris. The ambiance is really nice and cozy, regardless of how crowded it is. Nice Arabic music in the background, and even nicer staff! We had a variety of Lebanese and Armenian dishes; most of the food was good, but portions were a bit small, and the prices are on the higher end. However, we had a great time!

reviews.author: Joe Turk
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Jacaranda and Makan. The restaurant offers a combination of two menus: an Asian-Indian-Thai menu and an international one. We tried the lentil salad from the international menu, along with several flavorful Indian and Thai dishes from the Asian menu — everything we had was truly delicious. The ambiance was just as impressive. The place has a beautiful garden setting in the summer, surrounded by trees, creating a cozy and private atmosphere with dimmed lighting — perfect for a relaxed evening. The service was excellent too. The staff were extremely friendly and attentive, which made our visit even more enjoyable. If you're planning to go, be sure to explore dishes from both menus — they complement each other really well. I definitely recommend this spot — it’s a lovely place all around.

reviews.author: Gino Haddad
reviews.text: Makan has recently relocated to a new venue, now sharing the same space as Jacaranda, a restaurant specializing in Mediterranean cuisine. Despite the move, Makan remains a well-established name, widely known for its Indian dishes. The new location is truly beautiful, with a particularly charming outdoor area that adds to the overall experience. This is not a place for a quick meal; instead, it’s best enjoyed at a leisurely pace. The atmosphere encourages guests to relax, soak in the surroundings, and take their time. The food was decent, with portions that felt just right—not too much, not too little. Service was warm and friendly, though a bit slow, likely due to the staff being slightly overwhelmed. However, the inviting outdoor setting more than made up for it. I would definitely return just to enjoy that lovely space again.

reviews.author: Mike Aoun
reviews.text: We went for lunch and it was very good. I loved the garden space and the decor and greenery there. The food was very good, i recommend the coconut butter chicken. The staff were friendly.

reviews.author: Nizar Kassis
reviews.text: Excellent experience. Indian fusion menu, tasty, varied. Staff is very friendly & professional, and the ambiance & decoration are delightful.

reviews.author: Tony Reaidi
reviews.text: A hidden Asian food gem of a restaurant. The food is very delicious and the spices keep you asking for more and more. The naan bread is freshly made in front of you. Highly recommended any day and time.
