reviews.author: Mabelle Makary
reviews.text: Mayrig is a great choice when you’re in the mood for comfort food. The Armenian dishes are flavorful and feel homemade, with a nice variety to choose from. Warm ambiance and attentive service make it a reliable spot for a cozy meal. Highly recommended !

reviews.author: Chef Ehab Mattar
reviews.text: It was a great Experience, The hostess Maria so Friendly and Kind and she’s so Helpful and always smiley face , The Food was awesome and especially the Mante it is a must try , Keep on amazing Staff ❤️

reviews.author: Nour
reviews.text: We were craving armenian food so we decided to visit Mayrig. They were very busy, it took some time to get the menu. Youssef was very kind and really helpful. We ordered manti, the aubergine appetizer, itch and kabab kerez with a side of yogurt. The aubergine appetizer was ok, tiny portion. The rest were really delicious and generous portions. I would definitely recommend asking for a yogurt cup with the kerez dish.

reviews.author: Alex F
reviews.text: Love love love - probably my favourite restaurant in Beirut. The food was phenomenal, every dish was delicious to the last bite. Mandi was definitely the star of the show. Hummus with pastrami was also amazing. The service was great and the restaurant interior and the vibe is also lovely. All round 5 star - definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Sam Adams
reviews.text: The food is good, but some of the plates can definitely be enhanced.

reviews.author: Chirine Dannaoui
reviews.text: Great Lebanese Armenian food and wonderful service. Specifically enjoyed the Bulgur Salad (Itch), the ground beef Manti (open dumplings shaped like boats with visible stuffing), kofte yogurt soup (Madzounov), and lahmajun. The chocolate pistachio cake was good too!

reviews.author: Dany Makhoul
reviews.text: Disappointed from the food taste, onno used to serves unbelievable food !! Now days I don’t know so many dishes don’t even have taste . Don’t know maybe it’s only me that feels this way 😔but the desert was great 😊not forgetting that the prices is expensive for what they are offering 😉😉

reviews.author: Jose E. Coello
reviews.text: Everything was excellent! The food was delicious, great service and a lovely atmosphere... Will be dinning here again soon. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Michael Smith
reviews.text: A small, incredibly busy restaurant on a street with virtually no parking. Reservation is strongly recommended and seating is close quarters with smoking allowed! Yet the place is packed and the food is delicious, be it Armenian or Lebanese. Service is friendly and attentive without being pretentious. Not an easy place to find or get a table in but once all the hurdles are cleared, an enjoyable experience. The dessert selection is first-rate.

reviews.author: Abass Madhoun
reviews.text: Craving an unforgettable dining experience? Look no further than Onno Bistro in Badaro! This hidden gem will make your taste buds sing with joy. The menu is bursting with mouthwatering dishes that blend flavors like nobody's business. From the first bite to the last, you'll be in culinary heaven. The staff is friendly and always ready with a recommendation or a joke to brighten your day. Plus, the cozy atmosphere adds the perfect touch to your meal. So, gather your foodie friends and head to Onno Bistro for a food adventure you won't soon forget!

name: Souk El Tayeb Stall
address: Souk El Tayeb Stall, Beirut, Lebanon

reviews.author: heinz giering
reviews.text: A farmers market that is open every Saturday with a large selection of various home grown or made items. They do everything from honey to wine and fruits. Fresh homemade food from various vendors which can be eaten in the restaurant. They also have a menu in the restaurant which is good.

reviews.author: Catadores Locales
reviews.text: This is an example of the bougie bubble in Bei. Its not particularly bad but the experience should be taken in context of a fancy chic exclusive manicured designer farmer's market in a country with a supposed financial crisis.

reviews.author: T. GeBrim
reviews.text: A Saturday market where you can enjoy local food and culture. # Beirut # Lebanon

reviews.author: Ersin Yaynık
reviews.text: It is a nice place to taste the local flavors of Beirut. The sellers are really very attentive and friendly. If i go to Beirut again, i will visit again.

reviews.author: Naseem Ferdowsi
reviews.text: Great place to enjoy breakfast, lunch, or a glass of wine while strolling the open air market of Lebanese goods like honey, soap, bread, eggs, olives, sweets, etc., including fresh fruit and vegetables. Prices can be a little higher than the supermarket but the products are usually organic and sustainably grown. A wonderful way to support small businesses and entrepreneurs of Lebanon.

reviews.author: Rashad Khalil
reviews.text: Our one-night stay at Bab el Mina Guesthouse was truly unforgettable. Nestled near the harbor, the guesthouse offered a blend of traditional charm and modern comfort. The warm hospitality made us feel instantly at home, while the beautifully decorated rooms and serene surroundings provided the perfect escape. We savored a delicious breakfast, and the staff's local insights helped us make the most of our short stay. Bab el Mina felt like a hidden gem, where every detail is thoughtfully curated for a unique and memorable experience.

reviews.author: M C
reviews.text: Bab el Mina Guest House in Byblos is a charming place to stay with a great location and welcoming atmosphere. The rooms are clean and comfortable, and the staff are friendly and helpful. However, the bedroom dividers could use some improvement in terms of sound isolation. The current dividers seem to be more decorative than functional, and the curtains are slightly see-through, which can compromise privacy, the TV didn’t work!!. Despite this, the overall experience was pleasant and enjoyable. A great option for a stay in Byblos.

reviews.author: Dalia Balata
reviews.text: I stayed at the Hiram for three nights and it was great! The design of the house is beautiful and very cozy. The location of the house has beautiful views of the port from the terrace. The place was very clean and the staff were helpful and accommodating. Would definitely stay here if I visit Jbeil again!

reviews.author: Cybelle Khalil
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with bab el mina guesthouse! The customer service was outstanding—friendly, knowledgeable, and truly attentive to my needs. The facility was exceptionally clean and spacious, which made the experience even more comfortable and enjoyable. They went above and beyond to ensure I was satisfied, and their communication throughout the process was seamless. The staff’s professionalism and dedication to providing a positive experience really stood out. I highly recommend their services and will definitely be returning in the future!

reviews.author: Ranine Hassane
reviews.text: Better than pictures. In the middle of the city yet you have your privacy while enjoying the view and the tranquility. The kitchen is well equipped and all the rooms are clean.

reviews.author: Jason Madi
reviews.text: Babel Amchit is truly a must visit if you’re in Lebanon. The setting is chic, elegant and offers breathtaking views, perfect for a memorable outing. The service is beyond excellent, the staff is attentive, professional and made sure everything went smoothly. The food was just as impressive, delicious, refined and beautifully served. We were celebrating a birthday and everything was absolutely on point. Highly recommended for a top tier Lebanese dining experience!

reviews.author: Toni Slim
reviews.text: Went there on Sunday for lunch, original entrance and decoration, welcoming staff and helpful, comfortable seatings,breathtaking view, relaxing atmosphere, delicious food and fresh, generous in what they serve after lunch, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Yara Abboud
reviews.text: When it comes to Babel, it is always a Top Notch Experience! Always pleased to be there ! Special Thanks to Khaled ! You made our occasion excellent!

reviews.author: Alex F
reviews.text: Wow! This was an impressive lunch experience set on a beautiful rock overlooking the turquoise sea. This large restaurant offers fantastic food with a beautiful view and excellent service. We came here for lunch, and every dish we ordered was full of flavour, beautifully presented and so so delicious. Couldn’t fault one dish. Dessert was a selection of things, rather than the menu - which was also delicious. Service was excellent, even though for late lunch it was almost empty. Really enjoyed the views and the overall setting, truly beautiful. There is open terrace and also air conditioned section. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joey Fares
reviews.text: An absolute gem. From the moment we walked in, the service was warm, attentive, and flawless. The atmosphere? Breathtaking—coastal charm with a touch of elegance. And the food… every bite was unforgettable. A seafood lover’s paradise. I’ll be dreaming of this place until I return to Lebanon

reviews.author: MJ Samad
reviews.text: Beautiful spot, but the room design was off — the toilet was separated and not great. Service was okay, food didn’t live up to the setting. Could’ve been better overall. Also theres no pool to refresh .

reviews.author: Suheil Madanat
reviews.text: Superb location on sea. Clean and tidy despite a few flies at the restaurant. Delicious Lebanese and sea food. The front desk manager, Katie, was very kind and cooperative. So was the lady at the restaurant. Byblos is worth visiting again whenever we travel to Lebanon because of this hotel.

reviews.author: Isam Hussein
reviews.text: Just visited last week and all I can say is WOW. The hotel is very clean, well designed, and service/staff was excellent and friendly. Location of the hotel is perfect for visiting Byblos. Had a room by the water and view was incredible. Yes, there is a lounge located right in front of the hotel and music is a bit loud, but didn't bother us at all. Once the balcony door is closed, you could barely hear it. Hotel has a very nice summer vibe and I will definitely be staying there again. As mentioned, staff is excellent, helpful and very understanding. There were no issues with check-in or check-out (late check-out). They also provide beach towels if you need them. Lastly, the breakfast is incredible, great food, great views. Can't complain at all, we loved it!

reviews.author: sarah dergham
reviews.text: 4 stars is just because of the 24 hour generator noise, and the waiters at the breakfast weren’t very friendly. Otherwise, the reception staff were very nice and helpful. The sea view is absolutely beautiful!

reviews.author: Mike Aoun
reviews.text: I went to an engagement party held at the venue on the ground floor, the place is very nice and has an old time lebanese charm, the food was very good, they have a range of sea food related dishes, and the staff were nice and quick.

reviews.author: Youssef Yaacoub
reviews.text: I had dinner there with my family and we loved the food, the service was great and the stuff were friendly. If you’re looking for a traditional friendly old school sea food restaurant don’t hesitate to eat there. The view alone is worth visiting the place.

reviews.author: Nancy Gallou
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the food in this resto! The view is beautiful and the service was very good. Very good grilled calamari and fish. The raw fish was my least favourite. A bit pricey!

reviews.author: Juliette Mazraani
reviews.text: My experience at Chez Maguy was a profound letdown, a wound to the very soul of my culinary expectations. The promise of Lebanese warmth, the vibrant pulse of its flavors, was utterly absent. The food, ancient in its lack of vitality, spoke not of heritage but of resignation, each flavorless bite a stark contradiction to the richness it should embody. And then, the final, sharp sting: a bill that felt less like a tally and more like a cruel jest, leaving me not just unsatisfied, but utterly stripped of comfort and trust. My heart aches for the heritage unwoven by such a stark reality. Chez Maguy brought shame to the Lebanese coastal culinary culture.

reviews.text: They removed all the pools except a single shallow one behind a VIP paywall. We were not told about all these changes on entrance and the entrance fee is still the same. The beach is nice and clean, but you should inform customers of such drastic changes beforehand!!!

reviews.author: Daiana Julian
reviews.text: I’m extremely disappointed with our visit to this resort. They charged $40 per adult and $20 per child just for entrance, which would have been understandable. However, the only available area was the beach, as the swimming pool was restricted to adults only (18+). This important detail was never communicated to us (despite calling ahead and specifically asking about the facilities for children.) To make things worse, we were told towels would be provided, but when we arrived, we were asked to pay $10 per towel. At no point during our inquiry were we informed that towels were for rent or came at an extra charge. Additionally, the policy of requiring payment immediately after each order felt unwelcoming and awkward, as if we were checking out with every transaction. For such high prices, the least they could offer is transparency, proper communication, and full access to facilities. Definitely not worth the money, and we will not be returning.

reviews.author: Omar Rachid
reviews.text: Located in the heart of historic Byblos, **Feniqia** offers a dining experience with a prime view and a menu that leans into Lebanese and Mediterranean flavors. While the setting is undeniably charming—nestled in a tourist-heavy area with a lovely ambiance—our meal was a bit uneven, leaving us with mixed impressions. We started with an **assortment of appetizers**, which were mostly enjoyable. The **hummus** was smooth and well-seasoned, the **moutabbal** had a nice smoky depth, and the **fattoush** was fresh with a bright, tangy dressing. However, the **makanek (Lebanese sausages)** were disappointingly dry and lacked the usual burst of spiced flavor, while the **calamari** was overcooked, leaving it rubbery rather than tender-crisp. Service began attentively, with our waiter offering recommendations and promptly bringing drinks. But as the restaurant filled up, attention waned—dishes arrived at inconsistent intervals, and we had to flag down staff for refills. Things improved noticeably once the owner (or manager) stepped in, gently directing the team, which helped smooth out the experience. Given its location in a tourist hotspot, **Feniqia’s prices are on the higher side**, even for Lebanon’s dining scene. While the quality of some dishes justified the cost, others fell short of expectations for the price point. **The Verdict:** Feniqia has a beautiful setting and some standout dishes, but inconsistencies in food and service keep it from being a must-return spot. With a bit more attention to execution and staff coordination, it could easily elevate itself. For now, it’s a decent choice if you’re in Byblos and want a meal with a view—just order wisely.

reviews.text: One of the best Lebanese restaurants located in the heart center of the authentic Byblos. They have a wide menu options and all plates came super nice decorated and creative. The taste was very good. The staff were helpful and nice

reviews.text: The food was ok. Good fajitas, wara2 3enab & r2a2at. But the potatoes in both batata harra & the fish and chips plate was uncooked properly (still raw from the inside). Good atmosphere and good service. The bathroom needs to be taken care of, as the water was on the ground and just washing the hands was difficult to do.

reviews.author: Mohamed Hajj
reviews.text: Feniqia in Jbeil was honestly one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in a while. The atmosphere is beautiful, tucked into the old souk with a cozy and authentic feel. The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming from the moment we sat down. The food was delicious — every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The only thing is that the dishes came out one after another with a bit of time in between, so by the time the main course arrived, we were already kind of full. But to be fair, it made the whole evening feel more relaxed and enjoyable. Rating: 4.5/5 Great food, amazing setting, and truly lovely service. Would absolutely go again!

reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at the Fishing Club. Iris probably the best place to stay in Byblos. Having said that, it is eccentric at best. A rambling enterprise of harbour front restaurants and guest rooms squeezed into old buildings - it had atmosphere by the tonne but not many facilities. Dint come expecting much :). It is also incredibly difficult to find breakfast or even coffee in the mornings in Byblos - this is an evening town. Edde's Yard seems the best bet for coffee. Note - there is a lot of noise in the evenings.

Though the fish from the catch of the day was good but really pricey. (100$+ for a kg) the room are very basic, bath room wall are broken, not even a proper curtain to cover the light from the window. (And the room is not even cheap!)

reviews.text: Check in is at 1pm. If you arrive early, you must wait. Accommodation is clean with nice terrace, so u can sit on sofa outside. WiFi is little slow, so don't expect to backup your photos :) Location is just perfect.

reviews.author: Ghina M
reviews.text: We recently stayed at Bkerzay with the intention of enjoying a peaceful, relaxing retreat, but unfortunately, our experience fell short on several fronts. To begin with, the dining experience was underwhelming. At dinner, the food was average at best. The lentil salad, in particular, was disappointing – the lentils were drastically undercooked, giving the impression they hadn’t been cooked at all. The fattouch was also below expectations, made only with tomato and lettuce, lacking the essential ingredients and freshness one would expect from such a traditional Lebanese dish. Breakfast the next morning was no better. Both the hummus and the foul (beans) were also undercooked and nearly inedible. Given the emphasis Bkerzay seems to place on its culinary offerings, this was very disappointing. However, the most frustrating part of our stay came at the pool. We were shocked to find that children were everywhere, even in the 18+ adult pool, where we had expected a more serene, quiet atmosphere. There was no staff or enforcement of age restrictions to maintain the intended exclusivity of the adult pool. It felt more like a chaotic amusement park than a tranquil escape – children were screaming and running around, which completely ruined the relaxing ambiance we were hoping for. Overall, our stay did not meet expectations. Bkerzay is marketed as a luxurious and serene destination, but our experience was neither peaceful nor particularly enjoyable. Attention to detail, especially in food preparation and the enforcement of basic policies (like adult-only pool access), is crucial – and unfortunately, these aspects were severely lacking during our visit. That said, it’s important to mention that the place itself is truly beautiful. The location is breathtaking, with unmatched greenery and natural surroundings. It’s by default one of the most stunning and serene natural spots in Lebanon — the kind of setting that, with the right attention to service and guest experience, could be truly exceptional.

reviews.author: Maya Hariri
reviews.text: I have never enjoyed a staycation as much as I did in Bkerzay. It was absolutely fabulous. The view, the location, the rooms, the food, the presentation, the hike, the guides, the yoga and above all THE CUSTOMER SERVICE. They really pampered us and showed us what genuine lebanese hospitality means. Thank you so much for the amazing experience. Will definitely come back again and again!

reviews.author: Elie Rizk
reviews.text: Bkerzay is a serene eco-village in the Chouf mountains, perfect for a peaceful escape. With charming stone houses, breathtaking views, artisanal workshops, and delicious local food, it offers a unique blend of nature, culture, and relaxation. Ideal for a quiet getaway or creative retreat.

Cheap attitude and rude behavior. The two stars are for the food which was absolutely delicious and the stunning mountain view

reviews.author: Raouf Samad
reviews.text: Al Baba Sweets’ second branch in Saida, Lebanon, is a delightful haven for anyone with a sweet tooth or an appreciation for an inviting ambiance. Situated in a prime location, this branch combines the charm of delectable Lebanese sweets with a relaxing outdoor seating area, creating a truly enjoyable experience for its visitors. The outdoor setup is beautifully designed, offering a pleasant atmosphere where guests can unwind and savor their treats. The seating area is spacious and thoughtfully arranged, ensuring comfort while allowing you to soak in the vibrant surroundings of the city. Whether it’s a sunny afternoon or a breezy evening, the ambiance enhances the overall dining experience, making it perfect for families, friends, or even solo visitors looking for a peaceful break. What truly sets Al Baba Sweets apart is their wide array of traditional and contemporary Lebanese desserts. From their famed knafeh and baklava to their modern twists on classic recipes, every bite is a testament to quality and tradition. The service is prompt and friendly, further elevating the experience as the staff ensures you feel welcome and well attended to. For those in Saida, a visit to Al Baba Sweets’ second branch isn’t just about indulging in desserts—it’s about creating cherished memories in a setting that perfectly blends tradition with modern hospitality.

Just tell the waiter to get you their choice of starters and you will be delighted and satisfied with a selection of hot and cold lebanese mezzas and some of them with special twist. The design of the restaurant is very original, the prices are reasonable, and as overall experience I would say it is perfect. reviews.text: This place is one of the good spots in the city that I highly recommend, especially for people out of town. It has authentic Lebanese food and desserts. It has outdoor seating, upstairs seating and a little balcony looking area as well. The place has an amazing atmosphere and I don’t think I have ever encountered such friendly staff. The minute we walked in they recognised my friend who took us there and they were very welcoming and generous. There was a musician playing Oud and singing beautiful Arabic music. It seems welcoming for families and just friends hanging out. I also think it’s a perfect date spot for all the couples/ potential couples out there. The decor is really nice and is made to look very Lebanese. I would definitely visit again.

reviews.text: This place is an absolute gem for purchasing body oils and soaps. You can truly experience the essence of Lebanon through their delightful scents. It's an esteemed company with a rich history, and their products have reached every corner of the globe. In fact, they have even gifted their exceptional offerings to esteemed figures such as the Pope, international presidents, and ministers. I had the pleasure of selecting a gift for a friend and indulging myself with a wide variety of soaps, oils, and fragrances. The staff working there are incredibly skilled and passionate individuals who clearly love what they do.

Two ladies will catch you already at the entrance. They start talking and putting different essences on your skin. We got migraines from those heavy Parfums. Don't let them put those strong oils on your skin. You won't get rid of the smells for hours. Every step you'll do, one of the women follows you impertinently and keeps talking and insisting. They don't even give you space to breathe. It's a very unpleasant experience. Just have a look at the historic tripoli, but for buying soap, it is better to drive to their main base in ecovillage. That's worth the trip!

reviews.text: Wonderful location with access to good food and many other attractions

reviews.author: Didi HS
reviews.text: This place in Tyr is wonderful, the staff are nice, but the prices are not acceptable, they're triple the prices in other restaurants or maybe more, the food was acceptable but definitely not worth the money we paid. However, the qr code menu was not working, and we didn't know about the prices before we ordered, but we never expected it to be this much expensive. 240$ for 4 adults!!

reviews.author: D
reviews.text: The best part about this place is the outside, sea-side decking. A lovely place to enjoy the sunset or watch the waves break on a sunny day with a beer.

reviews.author: Mazen Tannous
reviews.text: Amazing place to finish your trip in Tyre, with a lovely dinner by the sea. Tasty food, a bit expensive the fish but at least it’s fished locally. The staff is super welcoming and pet friendly !!

reviews.author: Anna Bella
reviews.text: This place is over hyped if you ask me. The food is okay. The place is quite and has a nice view and has an old feeling tonight giving its charm thats it. Not very accessible because no taxis around and the host are not very accommodating. Outdoors dining ruined by cats not a problem if you like them but we are alergic so that’s a bummer. Not alot options for seafood either.

reviews.author: Haroun Othmeni
reviews.text: Ya3tik the sahha 5ouya 5idma raw3a

reviews.author: Khaled Yakoubi
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Liz Moore
reviews.text: Taxi driver recommended this. What an amazing find. We ordered sea bass and calamari and fresh orange juice. We were given free gazpacho, olives, salads and an amazing basket of bread. Afterwards we had complementary mint tea. The whole meal was less than £20 for 2 and totally delicious.

reviews.author: Wojtek Ziółkowski
reviews.text: Nice place to seat, low prices and very yummy food. Very near to fort and sea, so location is great. Restaurant doesn't look attractive, but it's definitely worth to eat there.

reviews.author: Molka Farhood
reviews.text: Very tasty and for starters. Limited outdoor seating. Annoying cats under the tables while eating. Tasty souris d’agneau. Average stuffed squid. Fries 5/5. No kids menu. Not a restaurant for kids. Super location I recommend to combine it before dinner with a sundown observation on the beach or a sea promenade walk along بحر حجر السور all along the medina of Hammamet outside at the water side.

reviews.author: William Brown
reviews.text: Very good experience. Good food, good value. Lack of vegetarian dishes even though from my view vegetarian couscous is not too complicated. Good outdoor seating though parking was not simple (not their fault).

reviews.author: Nitish Kamath
reviews.text: This is a good and okay quick food restaurant

reviews.author: Tarek Khadra
reviews.text: This is one of the best beaches in the world, you can do plenty of activities there. The beach is accessible and public for everyone, almost free. The sea shore is almost 2+ km long (the sandy side of the city) that is lovely for having a run or walk. Other water sports are available such as kayak and paddle especially during summer and spring season. Lots of restaurants are available between May and Sept serving Lebanese specialties and seafood.

reviews.author: Mohamad Ezzeddine
reviews.text: It's the beat beach among the Lebanese coast perfect golden sand enjoying the calm waves and clear water in the Tyre beach, having lu ch and exercising on the beach volleyball and beach tennis with beach beach football and the diving with the turtles in the Tyre beach is another great experience. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Peter Chanthanakone (Director)
reviews.text: Super calm and crystal clear water. Beach has sand for 150m and then huge rocks. No public bathroom but across the street from a bunch of restaurants

reviews.author: abbas samaha
reviews.text: Food and drinks are available to buy on the beach, also you can rent umbrella and table with chairs. Try to visit during weekdays , it gets really crowded on the weekends, specially in july/august. It is nice to visit in May where you can enjoy the beach alone :-)

reviews.author: Chadi Nassrallah
reviews.text: Very nice seafront and beach.

reviews.author: Salim Batlouni
reviews.text: The beach in Tyre (or Sour) is outstanding. The quality of the sand and water, and the long wide stretch of beach makes me want to spend a weekend just laying there. My favorite time in Sour is sunrise, before the crowds arrive, and while the early rises are having a morning walk. Towards the back, cross the bushes and discover the endemic plants of Tyre's coast.

reviews.author: Emilie Eddé
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and clear sea. Went there early in the weekend (end of September). There were only few runners.

reviews.author: Wissam Jawhari
reviews.text: Tyre beach is the best beach in Lebanon. Its a vast sandy beach with clean water and amazing sunset and the best part is that its free!!

reviews.author: Ali Mehdi
reviews.text: Awesome place for swimming, playing with kids, getting into a kayak and have a good Lebanese sea foods and grilled meats. Recommend to all tourists.

reviews.author: Mario Scriminaci
reviews.text: Visited in November. Beautiful beach but it’s very dirty. A lot of garbage around. However beautiful sunset.

name: Tyre Old Town Eatery
address: Tyre Old Town Eatery, Tyre, Lebanon

reviews.author: Nahil KAZOUN
reviews.text: Excellent choice for lebanese restaurant when in Zahle. From the vibes to the atmosphere to the seats beside the water, to the quality of the food, to the service, all were good. The warak inab, tawouk, fattouch with debes remmen and hommos were so tasty. Prices higher than other nearby restaurants. Recommended. Enjoy with your family, friends or beloved ones...

reviews.author: Peter Lacey
reviews.text: My Lebanese partners took me directly from the airport to this restaurant when I arrived. It's a lengthy drive from the centre of Beirut but it was well worth it. I cannot even begin to remember what we ate but absolutely everything was top class, so much so that I will return here on any trip to the wine valley

reviews.author: joseph francis
reviews.text: we arrieved at wedi el arayech in zahle we reached casino mhanna took a table above the river hoping to get some fresh air and some coolness from the river but with no luck the heat was high and no cooling fans or any other device where we were, knowing that such an issue can be easily solved. the staff were welcoming and friendly they took our order and started delivering the dishes in no time sine we arrived a little early and the place was not crowded the food was good but not as good as mhanna reputation ex fattouch was avg and the charcoal grilled meat were literrally burned we finished the lunch the service was good they presented the fruits we were 4 people they brought food for 10 people 2 or 3 dishes from a previous "table infront of us" .a big quantity of fruits but 50% of it with no taste just shape. the cherry were good and the melon also the invoice was high comparing to what we had 50 thousand lbp on each person for literraly 5 mezza dishes and 1 mixed grill dish added 2 skewers of taouk . a place like mhanna should pay more attention to details related to the comfort of the customers and to the price as well i wanted to give 4 stars but for what i had i will just give ***

reviews.author: Sam Wakim
reviews.text: For the first time visitor or the seasoned traveler to Zahle, the best place to experience Lebanese cuisine on the Berdawni is right here! Right on the river and close to everything, you'll love everything, from the ambience to the customer service, the attention to detail and the quality and quantity of delicious food. The grilled meats and arak are their specialties, as well as local wines. The fruit platters are exceedingly generous and the appetizer plates are easy to share with your friends or family. Everything is served family style and the bread is prepared fresh on the saj nearby. Reservations are not necessary, except for major holidays or large groups.

reviews.author: Kate McGill
reviews.text: Very delicious food, great service and atmosphere.

reviews.author: Nelly Skaff
reviews.text: We booked a stay at Masabki Hotel on June 1, 2025, and were assigned Room 114. That evening, around midnight, we wanted to take a shower but discovered there was no hot water. We called the reception, and the receptionist initially told us they would look into it and get back to us shortly. Later, they informed us that the water heater was not working and asked us to wait 25 minutes while they tried to fix it. After nearly 50 minutes, we checked again—still no hot water. When we called a second time, we were told that this situation was “normal” and that we could just shower the next day, as if we were at home and such things should be expected. The response was completely unprofessional. The receptionist told us to wait “two minutes” for a follow-up, but no one contacted us for another 20 minutes. We had to call back again at 1:33 AM. At that point, we were frustrated and deeply disappointed. We were then told that hot water would be available within 15 minutes—by then, it was almost 2:00 AM. In the morning, during checkout, we addressed the situation with the manager, Elie. Instead of apologizing for the inconvenience, he defended what had happened, again insisting that this kind of issue could occur in any home. That response only made the experience worse, as we had paid for services that we didn’t receive and expected a more professional approach. We chose not to continue the discussion with him, as his attitude was both unprofessional and illogical in trying to justify their failure. I'm sharing this to caution others about booking at this hotel. Based on our experience, both the service and management lacked the professionalism and accountability expected from a hospitality establishment.

reviews.author: Khaled “N3na3.t”
reviews.text: Easy to find. Great theme + u can have a walk around to relieve some stress in the natural environment but there’s no enough trash cans

reviews.author: m z
reviews.text: I believe this place is one of the most beautiful restaurants with a natural setting in Bekaa. A clean river, ducks swimming along with their baby ducks, fish, and lots of trees around that it almost looks like a forest. Although this place lacks boosting on social media, but this doesn't make its beauty any less. The food of its restaurant was tasty along with reasonable prices. The play area for kids includes swings, a slide and see-saws. Definitely a recommended place for families!

reviews.author: Rayan Mansour
reviews.text: I love the place. The hotel itself is beautiful and very cozy. My face part is the outdoor space where you get a huge garden landscape that is very peaceful to be around. The service is great, the food could be better. I definitely recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Al Kaz
reviews.text: This hotel use to have a good reputation I always wanted to go there, but when When there are they booked for a week or more than a week I was shocked that service not clean rooms are Terrible no hot water Internet, very weak. I have to buy my own battery to put it in a remote for the TV. Only thing I like the breakfast. I don’t recommend it for the price you can pay.20 more and get way nicer stay so i say nahhhh

reviews.author: Juergen Cannes
reviews.text: This Restaurant has a Terrace and you can sit inside in a perfect atmosphere as well. The prices are fair. We were sitting outside just having an Espresso and Beer. The Service was fast and friendly. The surrounding is calm. I can recommend this Restaurant.

reviews.author: Ica Ica
reviews.text: I stumbled upon BeBirgu by chance during an afternoon walk through Birgu, and I immediately fell in love with the atmosphere of the square where it’s nestled. As a solo guest, I felt genuinely welcomed from the moment I arrived. The staff were warm, attentive, and highly professional. Their thoughtful recommendations and deep knowledge of the menu made the experience even more enjoyable. The food was amazing. The octopus carpaccio was an absolute delight—elegantly plated, with a perfectly balanced harmony of textures and flavors that made each bite a pleasure. For the main course, I chose the pasta with calamari and chorizo, which pleasantly surprised me—it was light, juicy, and had just the right touch of spiciness. I’ll definitely come back next time I visit Malta. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sylwia K
reviews.text: Excellent food and staff! Traditional Rabbit - delicious !!! Pizza is also very good :) big portions so you can share

reviews.author: Alexandre Freire
reviews.text: Great restaurant. Staff hyper kind and polite. Rabbit was outstanding. I do really recommend.

reviews.author: Jeffrey C
reviews.text: A brilliant lunch! Located in a former Palazzo, we sat in the back courtyard. Excellent starter of barata with peaches and bacon and very good fish. Enjoy

reviews.author: NORMAN BROWN
reviews.text: Truly lovely experience. We had a family get together and we were given a private room which immediately made us truly comfortable as we have small children. The services aid the food was excellent. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Marjy Marjory
reviews.text: Attended a family lunch here the other day. I was really impressed by how the waiter managed such a big group and got all the orders correct. He did all this with a big smile and was so pleasant. All the staff were! We had a set menu with great choices. The food was delicious 😋. My pasta dish was full of flavour and filling. I sampled the salmon bowl and that too was amazing!! Great location and love the vibes of the place.

reviews.author: Annelies Vercruysse
reviews.text: Don Berto is highly recommended for anyone who wants to dine in peace in a beautiful setting right by the scenic harbor of the Three Cities. The location is superb—especially on the outdoor terrace, where the view is stunning. The waiters are all friendly and helpful; no request is too much. And then there’s the food: varied, generous portions, and no long waiting times. We also came here in a corporate setting—four times with a group of 50 people. Each time, we were served flawlessly and always stayed within the planned schedule. Thank you, Team Don Berto, for welcoming us with open arms!

reviews.author: Beata Ługowska-Prus
reviews.text: Very quiet, peaceful restaurant on the 1st floor (accessible via a lift) with a lovely view over the harbour from the patio. Prices are a bit higher than average, but meals were tasty and portions large (bacon risotto, seafood linguini and a pizza with potatoes). If you don't manage to eat your portion, you can ask for a takeaway box. Service was fast and polite.

reviews.author: Ryan Agius
reviews.text: Incredibly gorgeous outside dining terrace, with a good selection of cocktails and drinks. Don Berto used to be one of our favourites, but it feels like the quality of food has decreased considerably. A real shame.

reviews.author: Barry Kristians
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dinner tonight at Sotto Pinsa Romana in Valletta. A very atmospheric location, situated in a cellar. Tastefully decorated and a really fun experience. The food was amazing!! If you ask us, the pinza is much tastier than pizza! Light, crispy, and made with fresh ingredients. Absolutely top-notch! Make sure to have a dessert! We had panna cotta and tiramisu. Delicious!!! Friendly staff and clear explanations of the menu. As soon as we’re back in Valletta, we’ll definitely visit again. I later realized that in the confusion of paying cash via the machine, I forgot to leave a tip! I’ll make up for it next time!

reviews.author: Leddy Vanessa Cedeño Rodríguez
reviews.text: If you want to enjoy the best pizzas in Malta, this is the perfect place. Located in the Valletta, this bohemian and very cozy place has a variety of dishes on the menu and an exquisite wine selection. The waiters' service is 10/10. I love this place. Note: It's important to book before going.

reviews.author: Gizem Gündoğdu
reviews.text: Went to Sotto for pizza last night. The place has a very minimal and clean design, which gives it a nice atmosphere. The pizzas were tasty, with good quality ingredients and a great crust. A nice spot for a quiet and relaxed dinner.

reviews.author: Ruby Furby
reviews.text: The food was delicious and my server, Kevin, was super attentive and kind! I was sat on the ‘social’ long table as all others were reserved so I’d definitely book if you’re a larger group. Would come back here again😊

reviews.author: Gina Sorrenson
reviews.text: Just arrived in Valletta and were recommended this restaurant by our accommodation, decided to go for a walk and find...be careful it is very easy to walk past. Down the stairs and you are greeted with the wonderful smell of Italian food. It was a Thursday lunch (however a public holiday here) and the placewas full. We ordered the Fungi and Prosciutto pizza which was very yummy and enough for the two of us for lunch, washed down with a glass of the local wine. If in Valletta worth finding this one.

reviews.author: Karolina
reviews.text: We wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant — it’s a truly unforgettable experience! They serve traditional Maltese dishes, including starters, mains, and desserts, with everything clearly explained so you know exactly what you’re enjoying. The staff is incredibly kind and welcoming, and the food is absolutely delicious — beautifully seasoned and full of flavor. As vegetarians, we felt completely cared for and very satisfied with the variety offered. The personal touch from the staff, along with the stories they shared about the place, made the evening even more special. Definitely a 10 out of 10 stars experience!

reviews.author: Wellsy
reviews.text: We have been to Malta a few times and this is by far our favourite restaurant. The menu isn’t fussy, just proper food cooked well. The hospitality is outstanding in that it’s just friendly and homely. The staff will have a chat if they have time and clearly love what they do. Cannot recommend enough.

reviews.author: Doris Gomes van der Hoek
reviews.text: We came to this restaurant without reservation and we were very lucky to get a table in 15 minutes. The food was great and the wine was delicious

reviews.author: Liesbeth De Vreese
reviews.text: Restaurant Tal-Petut specializes in local dishes with a seasonal twist, where all ingredients are sourced locally (some straight from the garden of the owner). There is no set menu, and depending on the produce of the day, the chef will prepare a three-course sharing meal at a set price of €45 per person. Our dishes included a selection of vegetable antipasti, succulent pork belly, slow-cooked rabbit (a local delicacy), stuffed chicken with fresh figs and Christmas-inspired desserts. And the service was great. Definitely a highlight!

reviews.author: Fou Fassa
reviews.text: We were so extremely lucky to get a reservation for a dinner at Tal-Petut while staying in Malta. Eating here is a fantastic and unique dining experience, where you’ll be sharing a “set menu” of different slow-cooked dishes, prepared with the freshest locally homegrown organic produce and ingredients curated to absolute perfection. Tal-Petut is a dazzling experience in an atmospheric locality for fine gastronomy. Burp! #talpetut #finedining #gastronomy #birgu #malta

reviews.author: NORMAN BROWN
reviews.text: Truly lovely experience. We had a family get together and we were given a private room which immediately made us truly comfortable as we have small children. The services aid the food was excellent. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Marjy Marjory
reviews.text: Attended a family lunch here the other day. I was really impressed by how the waiter managed such a big group and got all the orders correct. He did all this with a big smile and was so pleasant. All the staff were! We had a set menu with great choices. The food was delicious 😋. My pasta dish was full of flavour and filling. I sampled the salmon bowl and that too was amazing!! Great location and love the vibes of the place.
