reviews.text: Incredibly gorgeous outside dining terrace, with a good selection of cocktails and drinks. Don Berto used to be one of our favourites, but it feels like the quality of food has decreased considerably. A real shame.

reviews.author: Hug Dealer
reviews.text: The three cities were hands down one of the best things about this country. It’s like walking through a time gone by, and it was really awesome to see where and how Maltese people live. Visted them all today.

reviews.author: Bilbo Bagsy
reviews.text: The three cities were hands down one of the best things about this country. It’s like walking through a time gone by and it was really awesome to see where and how Maltese people live. You simply must go and explore all 3. It’s easy to walk between them and it’s nothing short of impressive. The little alleys and streets leave me feeling so at peace it’s crazy. Never wanted to leave. Amazing place, amazing people, amazing country

reviews.author: Dobrica Indjic
reviews.text: A nice and clean place. Quite peaceful, with plenty of cafés, restaurants, and shops. It’s very safe, without illegal doctors or engineers like in Western Europe.

reviews.author: Cristina Beall
reviews.text: One of of the best areas in Malta,lovely walk to the Dort St Angelo with stunning view of Valleta and elegant yatchs.

reviews.author: Kamila Drozdzal
reviews.text: For me it’s the most beautiful place in Malta! ❤️

reviews.author: Olga Lypova
reviews.text: Despite the takeaway option only, the place is worth visiting! Very local, rustic, unique atmosphere, you can see how bread is baking 😍 IT WAS MY BEST QASSATAT, literally. If I hadn't tried this bun here, I would have thought that I didn't like it in general, because I didn't like it in other places. I took the one with raisins, and I haven't seen such a version anywhere else on the island or in Malta. It's perfect if you like a combination of salty and a little sweet, I recommend it ❤️

reviews.author: World In My Hands
reviews.text: Local Pizza, taste was very good but this place is only for take away. They have no option to eat there except one bench in front of the bakery, seemed very popular with locals and prices are reasonable

reviews.author: Emanuel Vicente
reviews.text: You can't miss this bakery in Gozo. Loved the traditional Ftira. All made with high quality Ingredients. I didn't try the pizza, but they looked soo good too.

reviews.author: Łukasz Szatko
reviews.text: A very small, local bakery. We’ve tried pizza and it was perfect, with local ingredients.

reviews.author: Nix Pix
reviews.text: Traditional Ftira tasted amazing! Absolutely worth a visit. One is enough for two though ;)

reviews.author: Emma Mifsud Tommasi
reviews.text: After attending two beautiful weddings with amazing food at Ta' Frenc, it was time to dine in. The experience was amazing from start to finish, nothing was rushed and all the staff were extremely attentive. The 'Prawn Pasta Flambé' was carefully cooked in front of us, using freshly made pasta. It was one of the best pasta dishes we've had in a while. Our mains were also delicious, the Sirloin was cooked to perfection with a beautiful deep red colour. The Chicken Breast was beautifully made and the chicken wing was absolutely divine. Dining out has become very rushed and Ta' Frenc was a breath of fresh air!

reviews.author: elsie chen
reviews.text: Very nice restaurant. Food are all delicious.

reviews.author: Budgie Fart (Bexx)
reviews.text: Me and my partner had a wonderful time here, we were well looked after and the food was fantastic. I particularly enjoyed the flambé crepes, I would particularly recommend that. However, the only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is that the bathroom lets it down. It doesn’t seem to fit the restaurant, being that it looks very old or hasn’t been renovated in a while and the stall locks are VERY stiff, I felt like I would be locked in at one point. Overall, we would really would love to come here again, just that their bathroom lets the experience down for me a little bit…

reviews.author: Megan Madden
reviews.text: Excellent restaurant! Very professional service and easily the biggest portions I've had at a Michelin restaurant, ever. The food was delicious, the venue is lovely, and the service team is attentive and great. I highly recommend coming here.

reviews.author: xlehrerkindx
reviews.text: We attended a wedding here and it was the best one yet! Amazing food, great service and overall friendly atmosphere. If you are looking for a place to get married at, your search is over!

reviews.author: Courtney Halverson
reviews.text: Amazing place with AMAZING food, great views and friendly staff. I’ve been thinking about the appetizer platter and their fresh cheese all week. My group each got a different kind of ravioli and shared and they were also amazing. Would recommend to anyone in Victoria for the day. Such a unique setting and really excellent food.

reviews.author: Nina Schwarz
reviews.text: I have been returning to this place every time I visited Gozo in the past 25 years as I love the atmospher, the location in the historic citadel and the Maltese Platter with local cheese, capers, onions, tomatoes and lots if fresh & crisp bread. The old building adds to the charm and the service has always been attentive and fast. It‘s miraculous that the food has kept its quality over 25 years!

reviews.author: maryam Fattahi
reviews.text: The special appetizer was simple but very tasty and healthy, the liqueur was very tasty, and the homemade dessert was amazing. The prices were also quite reasonable and good.

reviews.author: Katarína Načiniaková
reviews.text: I came to this restaurant on purpose after 8 years visiting Gozo. Why? Because I wanted to experience again the fantastic and peaceful atmosphere of historic Gozo right in the heart of Citadella and with my favourite food. After 8 years, I ordered the same thing and I recommend it to everyone - as an appetizer their homemade ricotta cheese, which goes fantastically with a glass of well chilled rosé. For the main dish I chose the spaghetti bolognese again, I love it so much and compare different chefs' creations :) The spaghetti was a little dry for me, but the taste was excellent, just the minced ragù seasoned well. I would love to come back again :) and the waiter was really really nice and kind as Well.

reviews.author: Dr Monika Gostic
reviews.text: Great place with a beautiful rooftop restaurant. The food was delicious, however we only managed to get the sharing plate with fresh cheese. When ordering anything extra, we waited too long and in the end had to leave to catch the boat. What we did manage to taste was delicious

reviews.author: Sonya Miteva
reviews.text: Very disappointed. I don't recommend it! We visited it on a weekday for lunch. They seated us right away, took our order and started waiting. We waited! And we are still waiting! 1 hour (60 min.) until they brought our order. First they made excuses that they had a large group! Then it was that the fish we ordered was cooked slowly. More than the rabbit meat?! First they brought us the side dishes - the salad wasn't fresh and had been prepared hours ago. The main dish - the rabbit meat was cold. The fish - tasty, but I would not say it was anything special. The pizza - of course, it was cold. Even the wonderful view could not compensate for our disappointment with the food.

reviews.author: Patrick Burbach
reviews.text: I am here from time to time and it is always nice being here. Our waiter today was super friendly and we felt very welcome. Sitting outside with the stunning view and having something to eat and drink is great. I really can recommend this place.

reviews.author: Serra mit h
reviews.text: A 20 minute walk from the Harbour in Gozo I found the most beautiful terrace & view (in March) with a view over green gardens, the sea and comino & Malta island. The food as well was delicious, very fresh and nicely prepared. Thanks for the friendly service!

reviews.author: Dan Bumbac
reviews.text: The view is amazing, the staff are friendly, the food is good. My girlfriend had some seafood pasta which she said was amazing, I had a burger that was decent. Probably should choose the fish dishes.

reviews.author: Nadia
reviews.text: We found this beautiful restaurant in Gozo island, we loved the atmosphere and the view of blue lagoon just in front of us was breathtaking. The service and the food were great especially the salmon and the steak! We really enjoyed this amazing experience and we will definitely come back once in Gozo. Top notch!🫶🏻

reviews.author: Alice Ferrari
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place! The food was delicious, especially the duck with fig sauce and the calamari fritto misto – both highly recommended. The view of the bay is simply stunning, with crystal-clear water and a peaceful, quiet atmosphere. The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming, making the whole experience even better. Will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Valerie Salerno
reviews.text: Delicious food and 5 star service in a beautiful and relaxed atmosphere. I highly recommend this restaurant. Mushroom linguini were superb. Vegan aubergine was to die for, and bursting with flavour. Roast potatoes and grilled vegetables were also really tasty. Attention to detail from beginning to end. Hope to be able to visit again soon. Thank you!

reviews.author: Martha Hayward
reviews.text: The best restaurant we ate at in our 10 days in Malta and Gozo. The food was beautifully cooked and fresh and the staff lovely. The terrace gives an amazing view over the harbour!

reviews.author: peter mac
reviews.text: Casually recommended as the "Best sunset view in Gozo" and was just perfect. Welcome and friendly staff, a spacious terrace with stunning views of the cove and sunset, amazing food. A special find that we just loved. Ask for a sunset table when booking and the staff will look after the rest.

reviews.author: Sylvan Bonello
reviews.text: As a local from the sister island, I can only say this is the best restaurant ever I have been to, and I have been to many restaurants both local and abroad. It’s one of those unique places where they really do provide not just food but a dining experience. From the very start, when booking over the phone, they were very nice to meet our needs as it was a special occasion. The service provided at the table is impeccable, kind, focused and not invasive in the same time. The food is just superb with the original unique flavors from the island. A family ran restaurant who have the passion for food and their clients at heart. Do not miss this place if you happen to be on the island.

reviews.author: K. R.
reviews.text: We stumbled upon this restaurant by chance and decided to visit the very next day. Despite not having a reservation, we were warmly welcomed and given a lovely table. The restaurant has a charming atmosphere, beautifully decorated with great artwork, creating a pleasant and inviting ambiance. The service was exceptional — the waitstaff were friendly, cheerful, and genuinely motivated, creating a relaxed and enjoyable vibe. It's a young, dynamic, and very courteous team. The food was absolutely fantastic, with generous portions that left us completely satisfied. We had a wonderful evening and can wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a great dining experience.

reviews.author: Krispina Around the World
reviews.text: I had an unforgettable meal at this cozy bistro in Gozo. The pork chop was absolutely incredible — tender, juicy, and aromatic. You could smell how good it was before it even hit the table. The starter featuring traditional Maltese sausage was equally impressive. Rich, spicy, and full of authentic local flavor, it set the perfect tone for the meal. If you’re in Gozo and love bold, well-crafted dishes, this spot is a must-visit!

reviews.author: Kassandra Paul
reviews.text: As part of our honeymoon, we went to this restaurant based on a recommendation from our hotelier. The food was so delicious that we went three times in four days. It was easily our favorite restaurant on the island. Everything was perfect: the service, the food, the cocktails, and the atmosphere. This restaurant is second to none.

reviews.author: Meredith Carracher
reviews.text: Enjoyed a marvellous dinner in delightful surroundings delivered by friendly, professional staff. Our meal included delicious homemade breads, handmade pastas, an innovative salad and the world’s largest pork chop! This was our final dinner after 6 weeks travel and one of the very best. Thank you to the team at Maldonado Bistro.

reviews.author: Westley Rolin
reviews.text: This restaurant is amazing, it is insane! I didn't expect to find such a gem in a town of 7,000 inhabitants. Food is delicious, service is great. The cocktails are really nice as well. The location is in an old cellar with stone walls.

reviews.author: Olga Lypova
reviews.text: Despite the takeaway option only, the place is worth visiting! Very local, rustic, unique atmosphere, you can see how bread is baking 😍 IT WAS MY BEST QASSATAT, literally. If I hadn't tried this bun here, I would have thought that I didn't like it in general, because I didn't like it in other places. I took the one with raisins, and I haven't seen such a version anywhere else on the island or in Malta. It's perfect if you like a combination of salty and a little sweet, I recommend it ❤️

reviews.author: World In My Hands
reviews.text: Local Pizza, taste was very good but this place is only for take away. They have no option to eat there except one bench in front of the bakery, seemed very popular with locals and prices are reasonable

reviews.author: Emanuel Vicente
reviews.text: You can't miss this bakery in Gozo. Loved the traditional Ftira. All made with high quality Ingredients. I didn't try the pizza, but they looked soo good too.

reviews.author: Łukasz Szatko
reviews.text: A very small, local bakery. We’ve tried pizza and it was perfect, with local ingredients.

reviews.author: Nix Pix
reviews.text: Traditional Ftira tasted amazing! Absolutely worth a visit. One is enough for two though ;)

reviews.author: Emma Mifsud Tommasi
reviews.text: After attending two beautiful weddings with amazing food at Ta' Frenc, it was time to dine in. The experience was amazing from start to finish, nothing was rushed and all the staff were extremely attentive. The 'Prawn Pasta Flambé' was carefully cooked in front of us, using freshly made pasta. It was one of the best pasta dishes we've had in a while. Our mains were also delicious, the Sirloin was cooked to perfection with a beautiful deep red colour. The Chicken Breast was beautifully made and the chicken wing was absolutely divine. Dining out has become very rushed and Ta' Frenc was a breath of fresh air!

reviews.author: elsie chen
reviews.text: Very nice restaurant. Food are all delicious.

reviews.author: Budgie Fart (Bexx)
reviews.text: Me and my partner had a wonderful time here, we were well looked after and the food was fantastic. I particularly enjoyed the flambé crepes, I would particularly recommend that. However, the only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is that the bathroom lets it down. It doesn’t seem to fit the restaurant, being that it looks very old or hasn’t been renovated in a while and the stall locks are VERY stiff, I felt like I would be locked in at one point. Overall, we would really would love to come here again, just that their bathroom lets the experience down for me a little bit…

reviews.author: Megan Madden
reviews.text: Excellent restaurant! Very professional service and easily the biggest portions I've had at a Michelin restaurant, ever. The food was delicious, the venue is lovely, and the service team is attentive and great. I highly recommend coming here.

reviews.author: xlehrerkindx
reviews.text: We attended a wedding here and it was the best one yet! Amazing food, great service and overall friendly atmosphere. If you are looking for a place to get married at, your search is over!

reviews.author: Courtney Halverson
reviews.text: Amazing place with AMAZING food, great views and friendly staff. I’ve been thinking about the appetizer platter and their fresh cheese all week. My group each got a different kind of ravioli and shared and they were also amazing. Would recommend to anyone in Victoria for the day. Such a unique setting and really excellent food.

reviews.author: Nina Schwarz
reviews.text: I have been returning to this place every time I visited Gozo in the past 25 years as I love the atmospher, the location in the historic citadel and the Maltese Platter with local cheese, capers, onions, tomatoes and lots if fresh & crisp bread. The old building adds to the charm and the service has always been attentive and fast. It‘s miraculous that the food has kept its quality over 25 years!

reviews.author: maryam Fattahi
reviews.text: The special appetizer was simple but very tasty and healthy, the liqueur was very tasty, and the homemade dessert was amazing. The prices were also quite reasonable and good.

reviews.author: Katarína Načiniaková
reviews.text: I came to this restaurant on purpose after 8 years visiting Gozo. Why? Because I wanted to experience again the fantastic and peaceful atmosphere of historic Gozo right in the heart of Citadella and with my favourite food. After 8 years, I ordered the same thing and I recommend it to everyone - as an appetizer their homemade ricotta cheese, which goes fantastically with a glass of well chilled rosé. For the main dish I chose the spaghetti bolognese again, I love it so much and compare different chefs' creations :) The spaghetti was a little dry for me, but the taste was excellent, just the minced ragù seasoned well. I would love to come back again :) and the waiter was really really nice and kind as Well.

reviews.author: Dr Monika Gostic
reviews.text: Great place with a beautiful rooftop restaurant. The food was delicious, however we only managed to get the sharing plate with fresh cheese. When ordering anything extra, we waited too long and in the end had to leave to catch the boat. What we did manage to taste was delicious

reviews.author: Viviana Briceño Torres
reviews.text: If you’re looking to try something a bit different, you should definitely check out the Ftira pizza. There’s a great variety to choose from, and the ingredients are top quality – fresh and well put together. Just keep in mind it takes around 30 minutes after placing your order, but it’s absolutely worth the wait. The texture and flavour are quite unique – somewhere between a quiche and a pizza. It’s a tasty change from the usual and well worth trying. They accept cash or Revolut, which makes paying super easy too.

reviews.author: Jack Kelly
reviews.text: Echoing many other comments. Hole in the wall, traditional. Cash only. >30 min wait time (can order by phone, but might be hard for visitor). Takeaway only (consider driving to a park to eat). A real hidden gem away from many tourists spot. Not *the* best pizza I’ve ever had but it was authentically local. Feels like the walls have stories to tell. Nice experience even if it’s a one woman operation who can be quite terse.

reviews.author: Joshua Pace
reviews.text: Nice food, very tasty. Great portion sizes. This is where the locals go so you know it’s good, worth the wait!

reviews.author: Alan Agius
reviews.text: Very small and local place, but the Ftira was exquisite. Easily shareable by 2 people. 30 minutes wait. One tip: since you cannot eat in, a good idea is to take the ftira somewhere with a good view in Gozo.

reviews.author: Guilherme Bragatte
reviews.text: Very small and local place, but the Ftira was delicious. Easily shareable by 2 people. When we arrive (Sat, around 5pm) took 30 min do finishes, but you can walk around de block while waiting. One tip: as there are no place to eat in, a good idea is take the ftira to eat somewhere with a good view in Gozo.

reviews.author: Matt McNally
reviews.text: I ate the broad bean soup and the octopus stew. Both were delicious and well presented. Service was excellent throughout and the price was very reasonable for what I received. The home-made bay leaf liqueur was a very memorable end to a lovely meal!

reviews.author: Thao Phuong Dao
reviews.text: Food was really enjoyable. I would strongly recommend their assorted carpaccio, super fresh and great flavor combination. Fish of the day was red snappers, which were very fresh and grilled just enough. Service was also very nice. A little on the slow side but overall attentive and kind

reviews.author: Rita Veríssimo
reviews.text: Truly one of our best meals ever! Food was delicious and the staff was very kind. Definitely recommend this restaurant. Everything was perfect!

reviews.author: Sam Groves
reviews.text: We were here enjoying a nice meal until my wife found a large piece of plastic (around 2 inches) in her risotto. We complained and they offered her a new dish. We had to wait a further 30mins for the new dish. When the bill arrived there was no apology or deduction, we complained and asked for a reduction given this incident and we were only offered 10% off the bill and a free limoncello, which we declined as we were driving. The food was nice however a large, sharp piece of plastic found in a dish is very concerning and that could have caused serious harm. It was very poor that the restaurant did not offer to refund the dish and were reluctant to provide any form of discount.

reviews.author: LJ M
reviews.text: Really lovely food. The service was really friendly and helpful. The atmosphere outside was great and a lovely way to enjoy the evening on the square. Really good and interesting menu,, nice drink selection and I would definitely recommend. Will be back.

reviews.author: WHYIBREATHE
reviews.text: Reasonable price and trendy style!

reviews.author: Sascha Segatz
reviews.text: Nice place with a great view.

reviews.author: Colin Rizzo
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Alec Heive
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Salma Murad
reviews.text: I have been staying in this hotel for yearsssss every time I am in Dahab . The friendly staff , the biiiiiig rooms, the rooom and the perfect location 💜

reviews.author: Nouran Reda
reviews.text: In all honesty, the location is close to everything, sea front… the staff is beyond supportive and helpful. Very reasonable prices 100% recommend

reviews.author: Ahmad Salem
reviews.text: The location is excellent in the centre of Masbat Bay. The side view is a good option looking over souvenir shops, side-seaview, and side- mountainview. Breakfast is nice, and the chef is very helpful. Staff are helpful and honest. Suitable for families. The only problem comes out off the hotel; Surrounded by the crowded area of the market, the problem lies especially with the other kitchen of the Ali Baba restaurant, which doesn't belong to the hotel, making a lot of noise with tools and yelling at each other. N.B. The dining area of the hotel on the roof offers a magnificent view 👌🏻

reviews.author: Tarek Anwar
reviews.text: Good price, great location. Old school egyptian room style. A bit unclean though. Service a tad lacking although everyone is very friendly. Highlight is the roof where you can Egyptian breakfast.

reviews.author: Hala El-atr
reviews.text: Friendly stuff🙏🏼, and Great location👌, but room’s furniture is old, dusty☹️, and they not provide minibar service inside the room😠, however when I asked for, they provided me a kettle to assure my satisfaction. My point is don’t expect lavish service, but the stuff here really are amazing 👌and will do their best to make you comfortable and happy.🥰😀😀

reviews.author: Mahmoud Al-Wreikat (JY5HL)
reviews.text: The best fish restaurant ever in Aqaba. The food is very delicious, the service is very excellent, and the service is also very fast. The owner, management and staff are excellent and very friendly. Prices are reasonable and affordable. I highly recommend going there for lunch and/or dinner.

reviews.author: Alia Barahmeh
reviews.text: Great lunch experience at Alibaba in Aqaba! Tried various seafood dishes, ribs, biryani, and appetizers - all delicious. Outdoor seating is cool, centrally located in downtown. Easy taxi access from hotels. Prices fair for quality. Staff very friendly. Loved it!

reviews.author: AL Hanadi
reviews.text: I don’t if they are good at or not, We tried grilled meet mashawi, tabbouleh and chilli potato and yalanji, it was not good at all Sour tabbouleh, very dry and hard rice inside the yalanji Chilli potato was nice Rice was nice. Staff is perfect 👌🏽 very friendly and welcoming. Atmosphere is vintage and awesome.

reviews.author: Laura Carr
reviews.text: The fish was beautiful and fresh, cooked to perfection. The service was impeccable, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Rhys Travel
reviews.text: Delicious food especially fish sayadiyah, grilled shrimps and mixed grilled meat were all great. We had to wait maybe 15-20 mins for the food as they're very busy. It's probably a touristy place and it's comfortable and clean. We also had three drinks and kunafa and baklavas. The bill came to about 55JD for three of us with service and tax included.

reviews.author: Becca Rice
reviews.text: Tucked away in a side street, this quaint spot is a true gem of a restaurant. It looks modest from the outside, but from the moment you enter it's a quality experience all the way. Everything is prepared with care and fantastic quality. The staff are attentive, friendly and ready to offer guidance with the menu. We had several small dishes to be able to try a variety of flavors and from the first savory dish down to the dessert, it was all incredible. We didn't even think to take photos because we were so absorbed in the dishes presented to us! We will definitely be back! A big thank you to this wonderful place for such a great culinary experience ❤️

reviews.author: Ale K
reviews.text: I have been going to this restaurant for years and it has consistently been excellent. It's a small and intimate restaurant, so making a reservation is highly recommended. The food is truly delicious, offering a wonderful selection of hot and cold meze. The main courses are superb, and to finish, they have delicious desserts and excellent domestic coffee.

reviews.author: Ajay Parekh
reviews.text: 5 stars well deserved! Service with a smile and attention, food was tasty and plentiful. We were a group of six on our last night in Malta. Two of us had the vegetarian mezze items, the other four had the main meat dishes also ( no vegetarian options for main course), although too full to have any dessert. Oh and the wine list is extensive and we chose well with our red.

reviews.author: Mafalda Pedro
reviews.text: AMAZING!! We found this place on google when looking for a place for dinner last minute that was close to where we were staying in Gzira, and omg we were impressed!! Between the 2 of us we got a range of plates to share and we were so impressed by everything. We really recommend the lamb, it was so tender and juicy and probably the best lamb we've ever had! Everything else was equally amazing. We had some Lebanese wine that was so good as well. We were being constantly impressed whenever everything came out. The service was amazing and the restaurant didn't disappoint.

reviews.author: David Fenech
reviews.text: We have been before but it’s been a while, so we were looking forward to enjoying some very good Mediterranean/ Middle Eastern food. The serving staff as smart and attentive as always - they deserve the best accolades as much as the cooking staff for their amazing food. We asked for our Albanian server to choose the food for us and he made some great choices. The starter hummus dips and lamb/harissa dip were so nice with the fresh bread. We felt the felafal had a very hard / burnt exterior shell, but all the meat based dishes were simply divine, including the lamb tongue. The wine is on the expensive side and the servers tried to sell more of it - doing their job. But the biggest hang up we had was the heat in the restaurant- we really couldn’t imagine eating there in summer. Having said that, I’m in love with this place - recommended

reviews.author: Jonas Bürgi
reviews.text: Some of the best food I have ever eaten in my life. There is only one dish - but this dish is perfect. There is one waiter who can speak english very well.

reviews.author: Sara Ahmed Fouad
reviews.text: The meat taste is really different. I was advised to try it, but I didn't give a big importance for the advice. Now I know, it deserves 😊

reviews.author: Safae Kherbouche
reviews.text: This place deserves 100 stars, if you ever come to Konya this place is a must try

reviews.author: Amin Memari
reviews.text: The best Turkish firing kabab you can find here, the pure taste of lamb with fresh bread takes you to the extreme of enjoyment. We ordered some Turkish sweets with tea, a great combination 👍 strongly recommend it.

reviews.author: Lennart Garritsen
reviews.text: This place is a true scam. I went here because of the reviews. They specialised in lamb with onions and bread (nothing else on offer). Food is good but fatty and service is friendly. But: very high price - 150gr plus water was 425TL… price quality is insanely bad. Other places charge way less despite owners claims. Will never return here…

reviews.author: Ica Ica
reviews.text: This was the place I returned to most often during my stay in Sliema, Malta. First of all, the atmosphere is very pleasant – warm, relaxed, and beautifully decorated. Secondly, from the very first day, everything I tried was truly excellent, and even beyond expectations. I especially want to highlight the “Eggs Royale” from the breakfast menu – so juicy and delicious that I wanted to have it every single day of my stay!😊 The coffee is also excellent, and the prices are very reasonable considering the quality. The staff is friendly, professional, and always ready to help. The place is full of high-quality products – perfect both as gifts and for immediate enjoyment. Highly recommended!🍀

reviews.author: Matthew
reviews.text: I stopped by for a late breakfast and was genuinely impressed by both the quality of the food and the warm, professional service. I ordered a sandwich with egg, a slice of cake, and a double espresso,all of which were fresh, flavourful, and beautifully presented (photos attached). The sandwich was perfectly toasted, the egg cooked just right, and the cake had a lovely texture and balanced sweetness. The espresso was rich and bold, exactly how I like it. The service was equally outstanding. The waitress who took my order was incredibly kind and professional. She clearly knew the menu very well and gave me excellent recommendations, which I appreciated as it was my first time visiting. Her friendly and confident manner made me feel welcome from the start. At the end of my visit, I went up to pay and was greeted by Sebastian at the counter, who was also exceptionally polite and courteous. He left a great final impression and added to the overall positive atmosphere of the place. It’s clear that the team at Busy Beef take pride in what they do, from food preparation to customer service. The café itself is cosy, clean, and has a relaxed vibe, perfect for a casual meal or coffee break. I’ll definitely be returning soon and have already recommended it to friends. A hidden gem in Sliema that truly deserves more recognition!

reviews.author: Vita Berdarová
reviews.text: We absolutely love this café and visit it quite often with my husband. They serve one of the best matcha lattes on the island. There’s plenty of space inside, and the atmosphere is very welcoming. The service is quick, attentive, and friendly. The food is always excellent. We especially want to highlight their croissants – they are absolutely amazing! We’ve also ordered celebration cakes here several times and were truly impressed. The café is located in the heart of Sliema, making it easily accessible. We highly recommend this wonderful place!

reviews.author: Ali Tavakol
reviews.text: Jessica was a wonderful waiter. She was kind, thoughtful, and handled our large group very well. We will definitely be back and look forward to having Jessica as our server again. The food portions are quite large - particularly the English breakfast. Busy Bee also features tasty pastries and delicious gelato. I recommend the Pistachio and White Chocolate gelato. The photos are of the hot chocolate and pancake breakfast.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: My wife and I are staying in Sliema on holiday and have been to Busy Bee four times now for breakfast. They have been around since 1933, and clearly adapting successfully over all that time. The coffee, meals and pastries are all excellent. The food prices are very affordable and great value. The service is friendly, efficient and personable. A brilliant café, Sliema residents are very lucky to have it on their doorstep. In the back there's a TV that shows a historical montage of the original store through to modern day. They clearly have master chocolatiers and bakers, and even the baristas are very skilled. The only thing is that I wish they did different sizes of coffees, one size does not fit all! We'll miss Busy Bee when we return to England, even though we have some excellent local cafés and bakeries ourselves.

reviews.author: Hector Bonnici
reviews.text: Good food, as always Good atmosphere. Love the classic british pub feel of it. After some ale, steak and ale pie a nice crepe was enjoyable. *P.S. -did not even give time to my wife to take the picture....dig in

reviews.author: R
reviews.text: Loved it. During our stay in Gzira, we came here everyday. Good for breakfast. Definitely try "Maltese Aromatico" - amazing coffee. Croissant with Nutella is top notch as well. Service was good.

reviews.author: Shirley Hibbs
reviews.text: Most unassuming Pub /Restaurant. Nothing really to say "come in", so, we did. Beautiful inside, pleasant staff. Decorated with lovely old fashioned pub mirror type pictures. Cozy litte booths to eat in. Didn't try food as no time to stay. Definitely return.

reviews.author: Allan Strydom
reviews.text: Hardly noticeable from the outside but very nice on the inside. Full English crumpet breakfast was decent and service was quick and efficient. Prices are also reasonable. Nice ambience with dimmed lighting and old swing music playing.

reviews.author: Lajos Hadnagy
reviews.text: Small, friendly, a bit British place. Tasty food, a little Maltian, but nice service. Prices are quite low. Try local food: rabbit, tuna.

reviews.author: Jay Handley
reviews.text: Simply superb, this looks and feels like an upmarket steak restaurant. The staff were friendly, helpful and informative. Talked us all through the different cuts of meat, the recommended cooking style etc. You get to stand at the counter admiring your options before choosing. Our waiter helped us pair wine to our choices, and we were not disappointed with anything. This place is heaven for a carnivore like me! Of note, the family who sat next to us had a vegan diner, who was offered various choices and she seemed to enjoy her visit too.

reviews.author: HY
reviews.text: We went to SciAcca Grill with high expectations, but the steak was somewhat underwhelming — not quite as flavorful as we had hoped. Bit fatty too. However, the mushroom dish was absolutely delicious and stood out as the highlight of the meal. The total came to around €260 for three people, which felt a bit steep given the overall experience.

reviews.author: Viesturs Kančs
reviews.text: Oh, a true pearl in Valleta for enjoying a great steak slowly. Service is outstanding and meat can be chosen on spot. A place worth visiting once again - the experience was superb. Recommend to visit for sure.

reviews.author: Juliana Londoño
reviews.text: They didn’t have my reservation saved. The terms of the meat were wrong, Rib eye was medium rare when was asked as medium. The lamb was well done, dry. When was asked as medium. The wanted to charge us 28€ from a wine we didn’t order. Staff was friendly. Relation price, quality is not worth it.

reviews.author: Miroslav Pasaric
reviews.text: The food was excellent. The staff is very helpful and friendly. We got a drink from staff. I recommend this place if you want to eat great steaks.

reviews.author: Simon Egan
reviews.text: Great lunchtime food. Really good portion sizes.

reviews.author: Jessica Gun
reviews.text: I am a private flight attendant and it’s complicated to find good products in Malta. I’m really happy I have discovered this shop. I will come back for sure ! Thank you.

reviews.author: Luiza Tanti
reviews.text: This delicacies shop is a marvel of fresh new unique products. Your shopping will definitely open your taste buds to new levels. If you want to impress people with a gift, you definitely can't go wrong here.

reviews.author: Catalin Bindiu
reviews.text: The perfect stop for a light lunch guaranteed to be served with the finest ingredients and flavors. Enjoy and shop from a lovely selection of quality foods to delight your sweet tooth or savory palate. It’s a bit pricey but the salads are a rare distinction from the poor salads normally served elsewhere on the island.

reviews.author: Ingmar Albig
reviews.text: Nice decor and the good food, however the coffee/cappuccino was up to standard for a place like that. They need a proper barista who understands their job. The sandwiches are too expensive. I understand that they are using exclusive charcuterie and cheeses but the bread was not artesanal and even if it was, over 13-15 euros for a toasted panini is too much. Also customer service was not great. If asked for help to choose from the menu the waitress should be much more helpful and orientating but was instead vague and a bit standoffish.

reviews.author: Jake Caruana
reviews.text: The food was delicious and I love the variety of choice. Some of the items such as the shakshuka was a small portion. The loaded pulled pork fried were amazing and a very big portion. The service was good and very friendly. I've also ordered take away from here a couple times and I was never disappointed. My only complaint is the ambience at the restaurant as it feels cheap. The furniture feels old and cheap, and the chairs uncomfortable. Otherwise, the food is worth it!

reviews.author: Teasy Wannabe Fruitbat
reviews.text: The atmosphere here is amazing! I love the terrace with its relaxing view! The cocktails are perfectly balanced and the food is exceptionally good! Prices aren't the best but it's money well spent! Yesterday I tried the Korean chicken tapas, chicken was firm and slightly dry like a well-roasted breast, the batter was thick and crispy and everything was coated in a finger-licking good sauce. One of the best chicken dishes I've tasted in years!!

reviews.author: Rebecca Farrugia
reviews.text: Delicious restaurant! We opted for a number of different small plates from the diverse cuisine they offer ... We orders the Pork Gao Bao, the Korean Crispy Chicken, the Artichoke dip with pita bread, zucchini patties with a mint yogurt, and finally the pulled pork loaded fries ... (Yes, we were really hungry). The dessert menu looked just as delicious, but we were stuffed full, so we're looking forward to our next visit! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Natasha Mifsud
reviews.text: Great staff, delicious food and generous portions. Cool atmosphere :)

reviews.author: Foha Leaning
reviews.text: The food was delicious, only tried the tapas. But the spicy wedges had no spice, but were crispy. Prices were on the higher end. Good funky layout, with music loud enough to drown tables next to you but not your table. The wooden chairs are not the comfiest. The pear cider was kind of disgusting. Wish they didn't use plastic straws. Will try again for mains :)

reviews.author: Godfrey Baldacchino
reviews.text: One of our long time favourite dining places, and synonymous with Marsaskala. Marc Bianco doing a fine job, maintaining the reputation of the place with wholesome food and hospitable staff. We were a party of 22 celebrating my sister-in-law's 60th birthday there yesterday. Impeccable organisation and, of course, good food all around.

reviews.author: איריס ל
reviews.text: Looks realy nice from. Outside, but inside poor decore. The tomato in the salad knew better days. The chicken was ok but too much souce. The fish was fine but the Mashed Potatoes had a wierd taste. Not cheap. Over all just fine, nothing more

reviews.author: Isabelle Borg
reviews.text: Always one of my favourite restaurants. Had my birthday dinner there. Excellent food and service.

reviews.author: Joe Borg
reviews.text: This restaurant is the best on the island for fish and sea food. Good efficient service.

reviews.author: george gatt
reviews.text: good place for fresh fish and fresh seafood and service was excellent and resealable prices. keep up .

reviews.author: Agata Kukiełka
reviews.text: Authentic Maltese food, very tasty and fresh. Staff is friendly and helpful. It’s easy to feel that it’s family run restaurant.

reviews.author: Wiktoria Klepczarek
reviews.text: Amazing local place run by a family, with no tourists, great atmosphere and we had a sweet talk with the owner, very recommended!!

reviews.author: Ellen Woffenden
reviews.text: We really loved this restaurant! The service was excellent, very friendly, and there was a really lovely family vibe. Most importantly, the food was fantastic. I had the spaghetti futti di mare and it was far and away the best I've ever had. It was a very generous portion and absolutely packed with seafood. The sauce (which was minimal but super flavoursome) was unbeatable. It was also really well priced. My partner had a tomahawk steak and we got unexpected grilled veggies and mashed potato too, which were really good. I would highly recommend this restaurant!

reviews.author: Mira Zubach
reviews.text: The most incredible restaurant experience we’ve ever had. We ordered lobster soup and mushrooms in garlic as first dish. The portions were big and tasty. As a second dish we ordered risotto with salmon and sea bass fish. Again huge portions, and for fish they also served both grilled veggies and mashed potatoes. Not to forget that they served bruschetta as a compliment starter while we were waiting for food, and in the end the owner thanked us for coming and proposed to get something from a table in the middle of the restaurant, full of nuts, fruits and sweets. Love it and definitely recommend as a very friendly welcoming restaurant with a delicious food 👍

reviews.author: Franzi
reviews.text: What shall I say? We loved it. Honesty, simplicity, hospitality and deliciousness describe the three evenings (out of nine days we spent in Malta) we spent at La Favorita enjoying the best fish dishes we ever had! Will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Dmytro Kruk
reviews.text: Very diverse menu. A wide selection of fish dishes. Maltese cuisine is well represented. Friendly staff :)

reviews.author: Connie Agius
reviews.text: I ate bebbux at this restaurant when I was on a travel scholarship and it’s as good as I remembered. The fried gbejniet is a must! The Maltese appetisers were a nice touch. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Yasmine Gialanzè
reviews.text: Tal-Familja Restaurant truly lives up to its name, offering a warm and welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh ingredients, generous portions, and beautifully presented. Every dish was cooked to perfection, bursting with flavours. The service was top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who made sure we had a great experience. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a fantastic meal in a cosy setting.

reviews.author: Yuliya Poruchnyk
reviews.text: Fantastic food, atmosphere and wine in no particular order. :) Best in Malta! Thank you!

reviews.author: Albert Macre
reviews.text: Great traditional Maltese restaurant complete with a traditional Maltese floor show. Spectacular!

reviews.author: Artem Dubowik (Area360pl - Spacery 360)
reviews.text: For my mind, La Nostra Padrona is hands down the best seafood restaurant in Malta! 🐟🍷 If you’re looking for freshly caught fish and exquisite seafood dishes, this place is a must. The cozy interior, seaside tables right by the bay, and incredibly friendly staff create the perfect dining experience. A special thank you to the owner for the spontaneous and heartfelt organization of my wife’s birthday celebration — it made the evening truly unforgettable. 💙 The food was absolutely delicious, and the grilled fish presentation was simply out of this world! Highly recommended to all seafood lovers! 🌊✨

reviews.author: Ryan
reviews.text: Excellent lunch overall—the crudi were absolutely outstanding, and the seafood pasta was generous and flavorful. I did ask whether the pasta was fresh, and while the waiter confirmed it was, it didn’t quite taste like it. That aside, it was a thoroughly enjoyable meal

reviews.author: Kateryna Karpova
reviews.text: food is delicious! The waiter from Serbia is a great guy! He also gave recommendations of food for our cravings. Loved the atmosphere inside. The view just to the marina. And the owner is super nice, opened and kind person. I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Margarita Varer
reviews.text: Very fresh and delicious seafood, generous portions, and warm hospitality from waitstaff and owner alike. Accommodating and kind people here. We had a wonderful experience here and can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Ana Kor
reviews.text: We’ve had the most amazing time and the most delicious meal at La Nostra Padrona. Good prices and wine selection, hearty portions, perfectly fried calamari, great oysters, amazing smoked cheese. They have very kind, attentive staff, too. Delicious desserts, crème brûlé is a must try!

reviews.author: Tom De Busscher
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly and helpful. We enjoyed the degustation menu which had a very fair price. I had the feeling the chef didn't reach his full potential yet and a few dishes could have some small changes or additions to reach a complete culinair orgasme. The presentation was impeccable though.

reviews.author: Peter Haigh
reviews.text: What a wonderful find I had the tasting menu and every course was wonderful. From start to finish it was a wonderful experience and I will be back The staff were brilliant and talking with the chef at the end of the evening was wonderful his passion is clearly on display with each dish and the wonderful flavours

reviews.author: Justin Davis
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant tucked away in the streets of Valletta. The service and atmosphere were impeccable. The food was amazing! We celebrated our 20th anniversary and no detail was left unattended. The staff even began our meal with Prosecco to help celebrate! Worth every penny!

reviews.author: Mark Stern
reviews.text: What a wonderful culinary experience this was, wow. The food was spectacular, amazing layering of flavors and original combinations. Our cocktails were perfectly made and tasted delicious while making you feel a bit happy inside. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Dane Ronda
reviews.text: From the moment we entered, we were greeted by a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The decor was elegant and modern, and the service was impeccable. The food was simply spectacular. Each dish was made with fresh, high quality ingredients and the passion of the chef was evident. But what really elevated our experience to another level was the selection of Spanish wines. Thanks to the expert recommendation of sommelier Sabrina, we were able to enjoy a variety of wines that paired perfectly with each dish. She guided us through the wine list, explaining the characteristics of each wine and helping us to choose the ones that best suited our tastes. All in all, our experience at Risette was exceptional. The food, the wine, the service and the ambience, everything was perfect. We will definitely return to this restaurant and recommend it to all our friends.

reviews.author: Alina G
reviews.text: One of the best meals I had during my week in Malta – seriously unforgettable. We started with the octopus carpaccio and it was absolutely incredible: fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. For the main course, I picked a red grouper straight from the fish display – they baked it in the oven and served it with vegetables and potatoes. Everything was perfectly cooked and full of The restaurant has a terrace just across the road, right on the seafront, and the view is fantastic, especially at sunset. You can make a reservation (which is a good idea), but we got lucky – they asked us to come back in 20 minutes and a table had freed up by then. Totally worth the short wait. Would 100% go back!

reviews.author: Maciej Gotkowski
reviews.text: What a joy! If you ever visit this harbor and you see those beautiful boats, you probably are going to be overwhelmed by number of restaurants. Don’t worry. Just go straight to the Roots and you will get delicious food in reasonable prices. Extraordinary wine selection and delicious pasta makes this restaurant special! Service was professional and fast.

reviews.author: Vojtěch Novotný
reviews.text: Nice restaurant in a harbor with a sea view. The octopus carpaccio was splendid, seafood pasta was okay but not in any way special, oyster was fine as it should be. Too many flies outside were spoiling the experience a bit. Overall fine

reviews.author: Bianca Dobie
reviews.text: Lovely place to enjoy your dinner. We ordered the deep fried calamari and octopus with garlic. Both amazing .

reviews.author: Karol G
reviews.text: Great fresh fish. For starter we took fried calamari and for main dish a whole sea bass and a fillet of sea bream. Everything was perfect including bread at the beginning and sides (french fries, potatoes and salad) and also a great service. Prices are quite low for what you get. I recommend this place!

reviews.author: Sponge Cake
reviews.text: We stayed in Marsaxlokk for a week, we weren't overly impressed with the standard of food that we'd been presented with at the numerous restaurants that we'd dined at, be it for lunch or dinner. Until we stumbled across this absolute gem. They are normally open just for lunch during the week, at the weekends they do extend into the evening. We were fortunate to dine there twice, once for lunch & the other for dinner. On both occasions we weren't disappointed. Fresh quality seafood, which was cooked to perfection, simple uncomplicated dishes that oozed flavour & utter joy as far as we were concerned! Service was attentive, unobtrusive & efficient. A definite must if you are in Marsaxlokk.

reviews.author: Alex Lexva
reviews.text: Average to good food for expensive prices. Scampi in seafood platter at 70 euro smelled of chlorine and were not good. Neonati fritters were average ok. Muscles and octopus were very good. Fried clamari and two local prawns were ok. Finished with a coffee which tasted burnt.

reviews.author: Nishika Goel
reviews.text: Incredible lobster pasta and sea bass! Tried oysters for the first time here and oh so worth it. However, if you go on a Sunday be prepared to wait.

reviews.author: Patricia Gallace
reviews.text: This family run fresh seafood restaurant in the small Fishing village of Marsaxlokk is amazing. Walk past all the other restaurants on the seafront - don’t stop until you get to Skuna! Look at the size of those prawns!!! Such a lovely family too! We easily shared a platter for 1! Tons of food. Thank you for a lovely meal and conversation.

reviews.author: Przemek Neyman
reviews.text: Fish was ok But the rest of the meal was huge mistake. Risotto looks like someone already eat it. Even Aperol Spritz taste like orange sparkling water

reviews.author: Emese Nagy
reviews.text: We had such a great experience at Ta’ Victor! We both went for the 5-course platter. For the main course, we tried two different kinds of fish. The soup and fish options change daily depending on what’s fresh, so the menu stays interesting and seasonal. The service was super friendly and attentive. They explained every dish – what it was, what ingredients were used, and how it was prepared – which really added to the whole experience. Everything was absolutely delicious, a solid 10/10. Highly recommend if you’re looking for something special but still relaxed and welcoming! We paid 91,4€ for the 2 menu, 1 bottle of local wine and a bottle of sparkling water.

reviews.author: Leela Senthil Nathan
reviews.text: If you want a homestyle Maltese food experience that will stuff you to the brim, this is the place. Victor cooks as if each visitor is his personal guest. It is a set menu with 4-5 courses, and every course tasted fresh and delicious. You must make a booking before you dine here, but it’s definitely worth a stop.

reviews.author: Gabrijel
reviews.text: I've been sitting here for over an hour thinking of how to put this into words, but I fail every time. The food is devine, I felt nastalgia for the cooking of a Maltisian grandmaw I never ! The standout dish was the desert, probably the best thing I ever ate, I never knew food could taist that good.

reviews.author: Oriana Seychell
reviews.text: The most authentic Maltese food experience in Malta! Victor, the owner end chef us the sweetest and great at making conversation 👏👏

reviews.author: Daniel Cassar
reviews.text: Ta' Victor is a local treasure that truly deserves to be discovered by both foreigners and locals when it comes to its incredible dining experience. Emphasis on experience, because this restaurant took us back to our nostalgic roots, something that almost no other restaurant can accomplish as well as here, especially since it compliments with the location of the restaurant. Ta' Victor is a timeless masterpiece of local cuisine that deserves its prestige and welcomes anyone looking for a true taste of Malta with open arms.

reviews.author: NFG Flame Knight
reviews.text: A Michelin experience. All the food so beautifully presented, and the taste definitely matched. Exquisite food. Top notch service. Delicious bubbly to compliment the cuisine. A must do when visiting Marsaxlokk. Well done to the team.

reviews.author: Isabelle S.
reviews.text: A Hidden Gem for Seafood Lovers Tartarus in Malta is an absolute delight for seafood enthusiasts. We had the catch of the day, which was perfectly cooked and full of fresh, delicate flavors—more than enough to share between two. The wine selection is exceptionally well-curated, featuring rare finds, including a beautifully balanced sweet wine from Chile that was a standout. The ambiance is warm and inviting, and the staff are knowledgeable and passionate about what they serve. If you’re looking for a place that values quality ingredients and expert pairings, Tartarus is a must-visit!

reviews.author: 이정호
reviews.text: the price range is a little high thoguh it tastes good. but the service wasn't satisfying. I asked the server how to eat one of the dishes I ordered, but he said use knife and fork. quite embarrassing.

reviews.author: Jane Gallagher
reviews.text: Beautifully presented snacks and starter. Excellent service and delicious dishes. Loved the seabream in buttermilk, katsu fish and prawn tortellini in bisque

reviews.author: Marianne Grima
reviews.text: A 5-Star Experience! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ From the superb food to the attentive servers, every detail was exceptional! The great duo running this gem in Marsaxlokk make the experience even more memorable. Will be back ❤️

reviews.author: Hayley Ho
reviews.text: The Maltese rabbit was delicious, but the other dishes had small portions. The serving time was quite long, but the friendly staff made up for it—they even helped me charge my phone at the bar. Overall, a good experience. Very pleasant environment.

reviews.author: Vipin Moharir
reviews.text: Location is outstanding. Sat in their secret garden, shaded under umbrellas. Service is horrible, staff is confused, untrained. Food was supposed to be great, but utterly disappointing. Waldorf salad on menu has 2 lines of description on ingredients. However, when it came on table, it was the saddest salad (see pic) I have even seen. Was replaced with greek salad (see pic - apple and sweet dressing 😱).The traditional soup was a tad bit sour (too many tomatoes in the veloute?) but passable. If only, they could be consistent with their food/service, this is would indeed be a great place to enjoy.

reviews.author: Kevin Scanlon
reviews.text: Baccus Baccus, “the God of wine and giver of ecstasy.” Baccus Restaurant in Mdina, Gozo, has been serving up just that for almost forty years. Located in the ancient capital of Gozo, it once was the gunpowder magazine for the old fortress of Mdina. The building is situated between a 1st-century Roman wall and a 10th-century Arab wall. When you walk into this marvelous restaurant, you can feel the history. We have been there several times for anniversaries, birthdays, and just when we want a special treat. The food is simply fabulous. From fresh-caught Sea Bream to succulent Filet Mignon, you will be delighted with any choice on the menu. We both have our favorite starters: traditional Caesar Salad for me and Mediterranean Aljotta soup for her (fish soup). My partner loves the short ribs—tender, juicy, and fall-off-the-bone good. I love the entire menu, so it is easy for me. The Lamb Saddle is cooked to perfection. Maltese Braised Rabbit is a dish many people shy away from; try it, and you’ll love it. You can never go wrong with a perfectly cooked filet. It's probably the best steak on the island. Baccus is the God of wine and Baccus Restaurant delivers with an astonishing wine list for the region and worldwide. They have a huge banquet room that accommodates a 1000-person reception or seats 500 people for your perfect wedding venue. Excellent service is available either in the cozy confines of the old gunpowder magazine or outside in the lovely garden area. Baccus is the perfect place for you and your special someone. It is open from 10:30 a.m. to 10:30 p.m., seven days a week.

reviews.author: otilia pasa
reviews.text: The food here is elegant and delicious, with the ravioli being the highlight—simply the best I’ve ever had. However, the portion size was disappointing, with only four ravioli on the plate. Additionally, the staff seemed overwhelmed and understaffed, which affected the service. With some improvements in these areas, this place could be outstanding

reviews.author: Nandini Venkatesh
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience here in this beautiful restaurant. Mr Durga is very friendly and welcoming, suggested some good food and drinks!

reviews.author: Viktor Lakatos
reviews.text: I have tried a lot of pastizzi in Malta, bud hands down this is far the best. I had the one with the peas and one with cheese. The peas were used some special, Middle Eastern spices, filled with a fresh, crispy pastry. Unbelievably delicious and cheap, the queue goes quickly, so it's worth the wait!

reviews.author: Ica Ica
reviews.text: Must visit if you want to try original, traditional, and tasty baked goods on Malta. Absolutely delicious! And It’s also clearly a favourite spot for locals. Highly recommended! Super cheap prices as well.

reviews.author: Krzysztof Szczepanski
reviews.text: Is-Serkin – Crystal Palace Bar offers the best pastizzi I’ve had in Malta (and I’ve tried many). It’s an absolute must if you want to experience this traditional Maltese snack at its best — perfectly crispy on the outside, moist and flavorful on the inside, and always served hot straight from the oven. This spot is beloved by both locals and tourists. It's located conveniently between Rabat and Mdina. Seating is limited, with just a few tables indoors and outdoors, and it’s often crowded — but the queue moves fast, and many people opt for takeaway to enjoy their pastries on the go. The café also has a clean restroom for customers, which is a nice bonus given the small size of the place. If you're visiting Mdina or Rabat, this is a must-stop for an authentic taste of Malta.

reviews.author: Anders Folke Westlund
reviews.text: This authentic and local maltese café is seemingly always busy from opening until closing - for a reason! Their locally made pastizzi and qassatat are on a different level, as fresh as they can be and packed with love and as many flavors as possible! Totally amazing food experience, and they’re just €0,60-1,30 each too! The venue is quite small and charming mixed with both locals and curious visitors and the workers are super efficient yet warm and friendly. This place gave us the best breakfast experience we could have wanted, great find!

reviews.author: Andrea Castañeda
reviews.text: Best Pastizzis of Malta, you see how they take it out of the oven , fresh and juicy Chicken- 0.6 € ( Must try it) Peas, Cheese - 0.5 €

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text: The de Mondion is an exceptional restaurant. We celebrated my boyfriend’s birthday at the restaurant where we had a stellar experience from start to finish. This high-class restaurant stands out for its elegance and welcoming atmosphere. The ambiance was warm, intimate and a remarkably beautiful space. The tasting menu offers a delicious selection of dishes, all prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The creativity is extremely clever, with layers of flavours to discover in each dish which all complemented each other perfectly. Each course was an explosion of flavours, beautifully presented and expertly prepared. The restaurant manages to combine Maltese culinary tradition with an innovative touch, thus offering a unique gastronomic experience. Even the sauces served with each dish deserve a special mention - rich, full of flavour and all so different. The staff were professional, attentive, friendly and knowledgable which added to our enjoyment of the evening and where we had impeccable service. We felt pampered, which made our evening even more memorable. It really could not have been any better! I highly recommend visiting The de Mondion if you are looking for an exceptional dining experience in Mdina.

reviews.author: Emil Soreng
reviews.text: Where to begin… The restaurant is set in an old “castle” where parts of Game of Thrones were filmed, offering a stunning view of Valletta and the coastline. We went for the tasting menu — which I highly recommend. Every dish was exceptional, with flavor combinations I had never experienced before. The chef’s creativity truly stood out. The staff were incredibly professional and genuinely warm. We were celebrating my girlfriend’s birthday, and they even surprised her with a handwritten card — a beautiful personal touch. Every little detail was perfect. We had our table from 19:30 until around midnight, which was ideal — arriving in daylight to enjoy the view, then transitioning into a cozy, candlelit atmosphere as night fell.

reviews.author: Agastya Asnani
reviews.text: The food was exquisite. The Chef brought an interesting twist in every dish. The balance between the acidity, bitterness and sweetness of each dish was well kept. I would recommend the foie gras and octopus for starters, followed by the beef for the main. The service was excellent and we were well looked after.

reviews.author: Mark Masiak
reviews.text: A fabulous Michelin restaurant in Mdina Malta. The chefs produce amazing menus from many local produce from their own gardens and from around Malta. Catering on-the-fly for many dietary requirements; plant based, vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, etc. Menus change frequently so regular visits are a must

reviews.author: Marcia Ardila
reviews.text: We visited De Mondion last Saturday and had an unforgettable experience. Everything was exceptional — these service was impeccable, and the food was amazing from start to finish. We chose the Taste of Malta menu and absolutely loved it, especially the suckling pig, which was a true highlight. The use of local, fresh ingredients made each dish incredibly flavourful, and the attention to detail was evident in every course. The dessert brought smiles to our faces and evoked beautiful memories — the perfect ending to a truly special meal. The waitstaff were warm, friendly, and attentive, adding to the welcoming and elegant atmosphere. Overall, it was a fantastic experience from beginning to end, and we can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Lucy Rice
reviews.text: The cakes were pretty good considering the taste, price and size. We had a raspberry and mint ice tea and they were the best things we got. We also got a hummus wrap which was pretty good. Everything was just “ok”. If I was to rate food alone I’d give it 4 stars, but the service was terrible. One waiter we had was extremely rude and didn’t even bother speaking to us when ordering, service was also really slow and disorganised. I understand it was busy but I think the general approach for service was poor and ruined the experience

reviews.author: Varist Borda
reviews.text: If you want to try some of the best desserts in Malta and enjoy the beautiful views around you should definitely visit this place. The portions are large, the prices are pleasant and the staff is wonderful. We tasted 3 wonderful chocolate cakes and an incredible strawberry milkshake here. We really liked it. The only minus is the toilet we had to stand in line. At the entrance we also had to wait for a table due to the large number of visitors.

reviews.author: Simon Adams
reviews.text: Great cafe to start your visit to Mdina! Definitely worth waiting for a seat on the upper level to get some stunning views over Malta. Oh and the coffee & cake was delicious - a must try!

reviews.author: Viktor Lakatos
reviews.text: I had high hopes for this titkok place, but probably one of the biggest disappointment in my life. The only positive I can admit, is the location and the view, but every other aspect was terrible. We spent there at least 1 hour eating 2 overpriced cakes, because just to order took them 30 minutes and we needed to run around to be able to pay. The cakes are mediocre quality, made from cheap and artificial ingredients, some of them dry as well. I wouldn't my pay higher price for a proper cake at a good location, but here the overall experience was ruined. If you really would like to visit, just order a drink, take pictures but expect to spend there a lot of time and be patient - this way you might be less frustrated.

reviews.author: Daniela Vasileva
reviews.text: A wonderful spot with a stunning view in Mdina! We waited a few minutes to be seated on the terrace, but it was absolutely worth it – the view was breathtaking. We came for coffee and cake, and both were excellent. A lovely place to relax and enjoy the moment. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Hetty Lanceley
reviews.text: Lovely lunch in a quiet little corner of Mdina. The staff were really friendly and attentive (even though they were busy!). The drinks were lovely and cold, which is just what you want in the heat! The food came quickly and was absolutely delicious. I had the calamari which was so light and crispy and my partner had the carbonara pizza which was so good, one of the best hes ever had! Bravo 🙌

reviews.author: Natt213 Natt213
reviews.text: We didn’t have to wait for a table and the staff was friendly. It all started off well – good drinks and a nice starter. Unfortunately, we were quite disappointed with the main course. My chicken was inedible – rubbery, impossible to chew, and both the sauce and the chicken itself were completely bland. The rabbit dish was slightly better, but still nothing special. Perhaps it was because we arrived about 1.5 hours before closing – it’s hard to say. I didn’t eat my portion, but the staff was very kind and understanding. We were positively surprised by their customer service – that’s definitely a big plus. Unfortunately, the overall food experience won’t encourage us to recommend or revisit this restaurant.

reviews.author: maria busuttil
reviews.text: Yesterday, we visited Trattoria AD 1530 in Mdina, and it was an exceptional experience, especially as a family with a 3 year old. From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. The atmosphere was wonderfully relaxing, and every dish was both beautifully presented and absolutely mouthwatering. The service was impeccable. The staff was not only professional but also attentive to every detail, making us feel truly at home. A special mention goes to Maria, whose eye for detail and warm approach stood out. We’re already looking forward to our next visit! A big well done to the entire team, keep up the fantastic work. We highly recommend this family friendly restaurant

reviews.author: Olia Dyankova
reviews.text: Exceptional food! We ate it before taking the photos. Service is very good. If you don’t have reservation for lunch try to be there around 12:00. If possible don’t seat on tables close to the entrance as people who are waiting to be seated will stay behind your back.

reviews.author: Dave Whitehead
reviews.text: Visited on a remembrance of a great lunch in 2007 (although the memory may have been wrong!), 1530 was a delight! I had one of the most flavourful pizzas I have ever had. Service was excellent, the décor perfect. Sure, you're going to spend more than at a burger joint, but it is *worth* it?

reviews.text: Visited on a remembrance of a great lunch in 2007 (although the memory may have been wrong!), 1530 was a delight! I had one of the most flavourful pizzas I have ever had. Service was excellent, the décor perfect. Sure, you're going to spend more than at a burger joint, but it is *worth* it?

reviews.author: Abdulhadi Salem
reviews.text: We had a really lovely evening at the Commando. The service was a top notch and the food was fascinating! It was my first time trying the duck breast and couldn’t be more pleased! the risotto was beautifully made.

reviews.author: Adrian M
reviews.text: Overall good. But please stop putting the hot tortellini on top of the raw beef tartare - it cooks the beef on the surface and beats the purpose of having a tartare. You’re using good fresh ingredients but the construction of the dish is not thought through. Work on the seasoning as most dishes were lacking it - and flavour!

reviews.author: Sloan Vereecken
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning meal! The staff are professional, knowledgeable and make you fell right at home. The food is divine! Fresh, flavourful and something for everyone. This is a must when visiting Malta.

reviews.author: Hana Ishii
reviews.text: Especially the truffle rabbit risotto was indescribably tasty. The flavor of the truffle from Northern Italy was very rich and went really well with the rabbit. Everything else we had was also very delicious and we certainly enjoyed our time at the restaurant. Definitely my fav in Malta!

reviews.author: Oleg Lukanin
reviews.text: We were quite impressed with this restaurant. A relatively small menu with great delicious dishes. The torched scallops were amazing and practically melted in your mouth. The staff were also very attentive.

reviews.author: Abdulhadi Salem
reviews.text: We had a really lovely evening at the Commando. The service was a top notch and the food was fascinating! It was my first time trying the duck breast and couldn’t be more pleased! the risotto was beautifully made.
