Everything else we had was also very delicious and we certainly enjoyed our time at the restaurant. Definitely my fav in Malta!

reviews.author: Oleg Lukanin
reviews.text: We were quite impressed with this restaurant. A relatively small menu with great delicious dishes. The torched scallops were amazing and practically melted in your mouth. The staff were also very attentive.

reviews.author: Julia Girtler
reviews.text: Delicious! Food was amazing with lots of gluten free options, one of the best gf pizzas I’ve ever had you couldn’t tell the difference. Cozy atmosphere, crumble was an 11/10, and the owner was super friendly! Overall a great experience at a really good price definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Mari Ko
reviews.text: It's a really nice place with fancy old-fashioned decoration. Waiters are nice and helpful. Food is good quality. Salads and Pizza at 7-11€. Glass of Maltese wine from 2,50€. Recommended.

reviews.author: Ryan
reviews.text: Best pizza on the island. I’ve also tried the gluten free pizza, and it tastes really good.

reviews.author: Maxwell Bonett
reviews.text: Best restaurant in Malta. Decent selection of food but all cooked to perfection. Pizzas can't be beaten & well filled with toppings. Prices are good, not exaggerated like elsewhere. Have been a regular here for a long time & will continue to be so.

reviews.author: Cassey Shapiro
reviews.text: Fantastic restaurant! Mum was happy she could get a lovely gluten free pasta, and I had a delicious porcini ravioli. Couldn’t finish my meal so I took home the leftovers and they were just as tasty the next day. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Gergana Baltaliyska
reviews.text: We visited Munchies Mellieha Bay and were very impressed! 🍽️ The food was delicious and well-prepared – especially the seafood dishes, which are definitely worth trying. The menu offers a wide variety, suitable for both lunch and dinner. The service was quick and polite – the staff was friendly and welcoming, even though the place was quite busy. The atmosphere is amazing – the view over the bay is peaceful and relaxing, making it a perfect spot to unwind and enjoy a meal by the sea. 🌊 Highly recommended for anyone looking for a nice restaurant with a beautiful view in Mellieha. We’ll definitely come back!

reviews.author: James Kimbley
reviews.text: We stopped here for lunch after Googling a good seafood restaurant. This place didn't disappoint; the waiters were friendly and polite, and the food was delicious. We had sauteed muscles for our starters and mixed seafood risotto for the mains. While our daughter has the kid's pasta 🍝, which she loved.

reviews.author: Oluwayomi Oni
reviews.text: Munchies Mellieha Bay delivered a delightful hour of entertainment paired with satisfying food. The portions were generous, perfect for enjoying alongside the restaurant's breathtaking Mediterranean views. The casual atmosphere made it easy to relax and soak in the scenery. While the food was simple, it complemented the stunning backdrop. A great spot for a quick, scenic meal and a pleasant break. Ideal for those wanting to enjoy Malta's beauty without sacrificing a tasty bite.

reviews.author: Osvaldas Vainauskas
reviews.text: We went with a group of 20 people and they easily accommodated. The food was great. While I did not get to try the Seafood Linguini it looked amazing. The portion sizes were almost overwhelming but I like a challenge. The service was great and the seaside view was spectacular.

reviews.author: eunyoung park
reviews.text: The food at this restaurant was delicious, but I have no choice but to give a low rating due to the poor service. The reason is that the glass of lemonade I ordered completely shattered the moment I picked it up. Shockingly, no one apologized or even asked if we were okay. All we kept hearing was, "It's okay," which felt dismissive rather than comforting. One of the managers even said it wasn't their fault and simply walked away. Meanwhile, we were left standing awkwardly as they cleaned the table. Despite asking to be seated at the neighboring table, we were made to wait for quite some time. Eventually, we were seated, but by then, our mood had completely plummeted. That said, I do want to acknowledge that the food itself was very tasty. What I took away from this experience is that if the staff had shown a bit more care and professionalism, they could have left travelers with a much better memory of their visit. After all, for some people, a trip to Malta may be a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

reviews.author: Mrs B
reviews.text: We’re so please we heard about this wonderful restaurant where we had their Tasting menu with the classic wine pairing. Each of the dishes were delicious and perfectly balanced, and the wine pairing for each was delightful. We’d highly recommend both the restaurant and taster menu if in area.

reviews.author: Peter Nothhelfer
reviews.text: Dear team, dear kitchen and dear restaurant owner and star chef! We thank you for the great evening and the fantastic service during our visit. The conversations with Andrew also made the evening a wonderful Christmas present for my husband. The food was unbelievably delicious and we will definitely come and visit you again. THANK YOU!

reviews.author: Pearl Swirl
reviews.text: Rebekah's restaurant is now in my top ten favorite restaurants worldwide. This experience is worth the flight alone. Don't leave Malta without trying out the five course meal!

reviews.author: William Stewart
reviews.text: With a group of four. Excellent dining experience all round. Second visit in a week. Informative staff, excellent food.

reviews.author: Emma J
reviews.text: Great experience, totally worth it, we had the tasting menu with classic wine paring❤️

reviews.author: Jean-Claude Doublet
reviews.text: Amazing maltese food prepared from the heart. Delicious rabbit and horse meat tender and slowly cooked meat. Not expensive at all and worth every cent! Service was also great and great atmosphere!

reviews.author: Carol Tong
reviews.text: Came here for the rabbit but had a full Maltese experience. While we were asking about the menu, the guy at the counter offered to provide us with a variety of Maltese dishes (in smaller portions) which we accepted. We tried the following dishes: Fenek (rabbit) - they didn't have the fried rabbit, so we opted for the stew. It was delicious! It was our favorite dish. I could eat more of this. Ziemel (horse meat) - a lean meat but the flavor was great. Bebbu (snail) - need to get your hands dirty but I appreciated that the snails didn't have the "lid" and I ate it with ease. Flavor 👍 Bragioli (minced beef) - reminded me of a meat loaf. Also delicious Qarabali (minced beef) - another minced meat dish. Was our least favorite dish. Would skip this next time. Our food came with a side of fries and roasted potatoes. All of this came out to €34.50. Value for money was great and the food was amazing. Each dish had a different flavor profile. 100% would come back again.

reviews.author: Gio Maria Zammit
reviews.text: The Real Maltese Farmers Snack Bar — the name truly says it all. It’s the perfect spot for a genuine Maltese lunch, a warm cup of tea, and the kind of atmosphere where you feel right at home. Whether you’re catching up with friends, chatting with locals, or even spotting a few familiar faces from TV, this is the place to be. I absolutely love the bragjoli and qarabali mimli — they remind me so much of what my nanna and mum used to make. Every time the plate arrives, it’s a moment of pure nostalgia and delight — always a wow. Prosit for staying true to traditional Maltese food and not turning into yet another Turkish, Indian, or Italian spot. Keep flying the flag for our culinary heritage! Gio Maria

reviews.author: Keith H. Schembri
reviews.text: One of the few remaining typical village bars that offer Genuine local food and drink at reasonable prices. No frills, no special ambience, just simple, efficient and humble service together with big portions of honest, fresh and super tasty Maltese food. Don't visit if your expectation is restaurant style food/ambience. This is a farmers bar after all, as per its original name.

reviews.author: Daniel Borg Said (Dias)
reviews.text: One of the last remaining bastion of humble, family-run, Maltese restaurants that simply serves you large portions of genuine food at very reasonable prices. There is nothing chic about it. But that's not what it's offering. Quick, effecient service. Good food, large portions, genuine ingredients. Well-deservedly it's always packed. 👍

reviews.author: Circov Andrei
reviews.text: We ordered the mixed dish (horse+quail+rabbit). Very good food and big portion (enough for two). We got free antrees and also some nuts in the end, probably because a match was ongoing on the inside TV. Nice staff. Worth a visit

reviews.author: Vladimír Urbanovič
reviews.text: Very good local food with good service. Inside it is open space and it is little bit more expensive as I expecteing.. Horse was very very good. For the rabbit. I really don't understand why somebody eat rabbit . So much bones... It like land fish. But it was ok

reviews.author: Mikadesa Sinani
reviews.text: After a long time in Malta finally we founded a great restaurant with great food and great service. The restaurant was very nice and the staff was very good. 5 stars deserves!

reviews.author: Emilija Angelovska
reviews.text: If you want to try maltese food where locals do, this is the place. They have all must try traditional dishes, and they taste amazing. We have tried the fish soup (one of the best in my life), the rabbit, the horse stew and one beef dish, and everything was super delicious. Just have on mind that the portions are huge, and they came with side dish such as potatoes or salad. It is a local restaurant, so the atmosphere is very casual.

reviews.author: Justin Hewelt
reviews.text: Great food with a Maltese Family vibe..Huge portions, in fact a little less would probably be better for everyone! Staff were very friendly and accommodating. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Larry Anastasi
reviews.text: A great ace for fried rabbit and snails, that is what I go for so I don't know what else they served. The young servers are so good and accommodating, the owner always had a big smile and hello for customers. When we visit Malta it is a must visit as much as possible for us. I would suggest making a reservation to avoid disappointment. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Daniel-Florin Apistioaei
reviews.text: The best rabbit I have ever ate. I truly recommend to check out this place. The food that they bring is definitely worth the money.

reviews.author: Thiago Rodrigues Lima
reviews.text: The rabbit here is a must have. It is the best I have ever tasted in Malta. I will definitely come back to have more.

reviews.author: David Fenech
reviews.text: One of the cluster of restaurants in the area of the Mgarr Parish Church, it is a small restaurant featuring a limited menu of mainly Maltese dishes including horse meat, snails and fried rabbit in garlic. The food is quite good but handling the Friday night crowd was challenging and we waited for a long time for the food. Other than that it was a pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Joao Pacheco
reviews.text: Small family restaurant, in clearly a non-touristic quiet town, and with very nice local (Maltese) food. Specialties are rabbit and snails. This place was really a gem, where the food is typical, freshly prepared and the portions are really generous (too big in some dishes, to be honest 😉), so he aware of that when ordering starters and mains, you may not need to order 1 dish per person. The menu is small, but that just guarantees that the food is freshly prepared. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. Prices are really affordable, even if the portions were not as big. A place definitely I'd recommend everyone to go when visiting Malta.

reviews.author: Flavius Dolca
reviews.text: This is one of the best Maltese restaurants I've been to. The food is delicious and the portions are abundant. They offer fresh beer and home-made wine. Don't skip on desert, We also received an appetiser on the house. If you want to try real Maltese food this is the perfect place.

reviews.author: Dr.Illusion
reviews.text: We had been there as a family before and although we weren’t massively impresses, we thought it was decent. This past time there were multiple things that weren’t great. I actually went there with family again and did not choose the place myself and didn’t look it up so I didn’t know it has very good reviews on google maps. Being there twice, i have to say my personal experience and their score on Google maps differ. Still a decent place though.

reviews.author: Darren Muscat
reviews.text: Great food, generous portions. Was a great group event.

reviews.author: Christina Athanasiou
reviews.text: A traditional tavern in the village of Mgarr in Malta. Excellent snails and arjoli and fried rabbit in garlic. Excellent collection of wines....you need to reserve a table, because it is always busy. The locals prefer it so, go ahead and follow them! The menu is big, but we went there for the rabbit and the snails! I don't think I ever ate so much on the island. The portions are HUGE! I was a local for 2 years, have been in many restaurants, but this tavern is awesome! A must visit!

reviews.author: David Fenech
reviews.text: What you see is what you get ! This must be Malta ‘s best restaurant for traditional rabbit dishes. I was with some friends for a meal and I cannot stop praising this place. There are no frills and no fuss. Just great food and plenty of it . And just to make it more apetising, you won’t be breaking any banks for a wholesome meal here. You MUST go once to this great place - I will be going more often though 😊

reviews.author: gillian morris
reviews.text: The owner was so passionate about his business and it showed. Our greeting made us feel special, the place was beautiful and we had a good table with comfortable seats. Menu was vast and reasonable so we're the drinks. Service was exceptional. This is a great night to visit, with the folk dancers, and then able to dance ourselves. A 10/10 for anyone. Thank you

reviews.author: David Bawiec
reviews.text: It is RARE that I come to a restaurant alone and stay for THREE and a half hours! 😍🥰 Had a MARVELOUS time!!! The atmosphere, the music, and the food were excellent. But it’s the people that made it exceptional!! 🤩 Eri, the manager, makes sure that the house runs so smooth and still found time to come over and share fascinating stories. Fun fact, he plays guitar. Who knows, maybe you’ll get him to rock out one night! 🎸 Belinda (Bella) on the other hand brings such joy and passion to the room. She thrives in this environment and makes you feel like the star. ⭐️ We had some incredibly stimulating and inspiring conversations that took us places I didn’t expect. ❤️ Both went above and beyond to make a simple dinner into a night that I will never forget! Thanks! 🥰

reviews.author: Yordan Angelov
reviews.text: One of my favourite places in Malta! Service was great, food was top quality, prices are decent, portion sizes are HUGE! I only wish I had enough space left to try the desert, but I was stuffed. Highly recommend, will be coming back again when I can

reviews.author: Igor Pecotic
reviews.text: We came on the recommendation of a friend and we didn't regret it. From the moment we entered until we left, we were guided by the extremely cheerful, friendly and kind Mrs. Belinda. The food was delicious, with an emphasis on local specialties, the house wine correct and all at a very reasonable price for generous portions. All in all 10 /10. Recommendation for a return visit.

reviews.author: Curious Wonderer
reviews.text: Ta’ Marija is a well-known Maltese restaurant that draws a lively crowd, especially for its cultural dance performance at 9:30 PM—which was entertaining and added a festive vibe to the evening. Unfortunately, the food didn’t quite match the energy of the show. We ordered the snails, stuffed squid, baked rabbit, and prawn linguine. The snails were decent and ended up being the most enjoyable of the dishes. The rabbit was quite dry, the stuffed squid lacked flavor, and the prawn linguine was watery and disappointing. That said, the service was very friendly, and the staff made us feel welcome throughout the evening.

reviews.author: O. Mifsud
reviews.text: A Meat Lover’s Dream! We visited Brass and Knuckle specifically for the meat — and it did not disappoint. We opted for the 400g Aberdeen Angus ribeye, which was seared and cooked to absolute perfection: tender, juicy, and packed with flavor. The selection of homemade starters (we chose sausages) was equally impressive, each one bursting with freshness and taste. We’ll definitely be returning for more!

reviews.author: Simi Marina
reviews.text: A very nice place with amazing food. The staff is very polite. The Aberdeen Angus Ribeye, in my opinion is delightful and the Lamb Shank is just...divine!

reviews.author: Hassene Tm
reviews.text: disappointments, I was pleasantly surprised by this place. The welcome is warm, the staff is attentive, and the manager is simply exceptional in communication and customer care. The waiters are professional and friendly, which makes all the difference. As for the food, it was absolutely amazing—delicious dishes, beautifully presented, and an overall top-notch dining experience. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: B de Paula
reviews.text: Each dish we ordered was a feast for the senses! We got their signature truffle risotto with crispy pork, short rib tacos and a rib-eye steak that was perfectly cooked. All that plus the impeccable service, we will definitely be back! Waiting time was 30-40 minutes on a Wednesday night but food was well worth the wait.

reviews.author: Bryan Vella
reviews.text: Food was tremendous. Very warm and comfortable atmosphere with a fire heater. Definitely room for improvement in terms of waiting time. But the overall experience was fantastic. Street parking nearby is available. We went on a Saturday night and we found parking straight away.

reviews.author: Randall Eckerich
reviews.text: Awesome place great bakery inside at the back. Great prices and lots of selection. Cranky lady at the cash out 😠 would not deal with her in the future. Lied to us about the pasty in the display. She said they are all cheese. Clearly the green peas we found inside is not cheese.

reviews.author: 林庭安
reviews.text: The small pastisery besides the road , all fresh bread, good for breakfast or dessert . I got a tuna bread (€1.5) & cheese bread(€0.4) crunchy ,the price was reasonable and full of ingredients inside . Tasty and local , recommend with coffee !!! Definitely come back again and try rest of flavor !

reviews.author: Me Jiban
reviews.text: I got the cake on time and it was very fresh. For 3rd Jan I Ordered birth cake from Gormina Bakery it was delicious. If you are considering ordering to for any events cake 100% recommend and I will Order again. Thanks.

reviews.author: Caine Mallia
reviews.text: Very fast service and very good bread wide variety to choose from

reviews.author: jezzaftw
reviews.text: The bread is Amazing. Shop layout slightly confusing Slight misunderstanding when i asked for sunscreen and was given After Sun cream. Not major but this could be solved by allowing customers to get a Closer look at the stock behind the cashier. Otherwise great overall

reviews.author: Ivana Rafaelisova
reviews.text: Lovely little restaurant with spirit in heart of Valeta. Amazing experience; tried tasting menu with wine pairing. Recommend as you'll try many typical dishes, well done prepared and delicious. Staff very friendly and attentive. Pasta dishes delicious, the fish as well, rabbit was also the same level. It's expensive but if you want to treat yourself, good choice.

reviews.author: David P
reviews.text: We had a wonderful welcome in this beautiful restaurant. We opted for the land and sea tasting menus, with 1 paired wine for the land. The wine was delicious. The food was nice and the outstanding dish was the root vegetable lasagne. We felt several courses were very under seasoned, and the seabass course lacked any flavour. That said, we enjoyed the evening, and Femi the waiter was excellent. The food and wine were very reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Shakey
reviews.text: Amazing experience ran by local Maltese. Great flavours , presentation and taste. The service was perfect and the food was brilliant.

reviews.author: G. M.
reviews.text: A very atmospheric and colourful bistro situated in a 17th century building, full of history and ambience. Very welcoming and friendly service. The food is traditional Maltese (but with a twist) with Italian influences. Very high quality cookery, indeed. The highlight of the dinner was the black pork pasta (fresh pasta with pork ragu and crispy lardons) which may sound simple but was simply outstanding. A good wine list too. One of those places where I would return with a great pleasure.

reviews.author: K
reviews.text: Guze is the best restaurant we tried during our 4-day trip in Malta. The dishes are adventurous compared to the other restaurants and were well executed. The flavours worked harmoniously and I must say the price was extremely reasonable. I think this restaurant has potential for one-star if the team keeps up the good work.

reviews.author: Maxzepikeno sf
reviews.text: Pizza and tira were great and I didn’t even wait more than 15 minutes, friendly staff, the only thing is they don’t have dine in option, it’s all to go

reviews.author: Victor Dragan
reviews.text: I don't usually write reviews, but here i ate 2 tasty medium size pizzas for 8-10 euros each. Keep up the good work!

reviews.author: Denise Spinoche
reviews.text: Pizzas are super delicious, we had them take away and arrived warm and crunchy, keep up the great work.

reviews.author: Bram Rijsenburg
reviews.text: We ate hear on the first day of our trip. Overall the food and service was good. But I would recommend sharing a pizza with two persons. Further more know that this is a very unhealthy dinner and don't expect any vegetables.

reviews.author: mina aghvami
reviews.text: They ready fast and delicious, price is resonable.

reviews.author: Stephanie Spiteri Said
reviews.text: Our deli counter now open form Monday till Saturday

reviews.author: Elena Bondarenko
reviews.text: good store. Good meat is always available. sometimes even an individual approach, but there is one problem: many products do not have price tags, this is not very convenient, you have to ask all the time

reviews.author: hans jürgense
reviews.text: Many articles and good selection of food. also the butcher seems to be ok. The only thing is, there is a strange smell when you enter the store

reviews.author: george attard
reviews.text: Fresh Ribeye very competitive prices grade A quality

reviews.author: karl schembri
reviews.text: Very helpful and friendly good choice of meats

reviews.author: Clabbe Bjurström
reviews.text: First time to a "fine" dining place and especially a Michelin restaurant. Food was tasty but nothing really over the top in my opinion. To place bread with butter as one course was pretty hillarious, never experienced that before. The staff was incredible and very supportive of my companion Rex who never been to a fine dining restaurant either. He enjoyed his visit.

reviews.author: Dominique Bowden
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our Grotto Tavern experience. It had been recommended by a few different people and were so glad we went! The service, food and location are all excellent. Highly recommend. We went for the 7 course taster menu and tried a local red wine. Fantastic!

reviews.author: Alexandra Coscioni
reviews.text: We had the grotto experience with the wine pairings and everything was perfect! We are foodies and love interesting combos but nothing too out there and this was the perfect mix! It is also five courses but nothing outrageous, and absolutely a perfect amount of food. The service is outstanding and the atmosphere is incredible, perfect for a special moment like an engagement, anniversary or just a splurge! I would 100% recommend and would absolutely go back!

reviews.author: Sue Dorrens
reviews.text: Incredible food, impeccable service from Jessica and Michael, and a stunning atmosphere — Grotto Tavern delivered on every front. We celebrated my 50th birthday here and I couldn't have been happier. One of the best meals I've ever had out, made even better by how reasonable the prices were. A must-visit if you’re in Malta and want an experience that feels truly special.

reviews.author: Federico
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dinner at Grotto Tavern. The highlights were the excellent service, the impressive setting in a natural cave, and the short walk after dinner through a 10-meter-long hand-carved tunnel, originally created during World War II as a bomb shelter. A big thank you to our amazing team: Michael, Greg, and Maxwell. Greg’s relaxed yet insightful way of explaining and presenting, combined with Michael’s excellent wine pairings, made for a truly memorable evening.

reviews.author: Alex Lewis
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible experience. We came last minute as a group of 7 for lunch, they sat us downstairs in the cellar. Really cool vibe and a nice reprieve from the heat outside. Kevin served us and recommended the rabbit for all of us. It was absolutely phenomenal. Other highlights were the fried goat cheese and the calamari. Very reasonably priced and one of the best meals I’ve had. 10/10 would recommend

reviews.author: Ceci D
reviews.text: We came as a highly rated recommendation from a friend and this truly surpassed our expectations. Kevin and Conrad were also super friendly! The risotto made sure that we have to find ourselves back in Malta very soon.

reviews.author: Georgia P
reviews.text: We had very high expectations of this place as everyone was recommending it and also because of being mentioned in the Michelin guide. If it wasn’t for all the hype, it would’ve probably been a 4 star meal, but in the given circumstances can only offer 3. We had a table at the lowest level and our waiter really pushed our chairs in the corner saying there’s not much room for him to walk by, totally understandable however he could’ve been more polite. Food was good but not excellent, the best part was the rabbit and the side of roasted potatoes and vegetables.

reviews.author: Piotr Daniel
reviews.text: We were hoping for a nice evening with the traditional Maltese cuisine at Rubino - basing our expectations on Michelin Bib award and good reviews all around internet. While the beginning of our experience was quite nice and the pumpkin soup was really tasteful the latter part ruined everything. We decided to go with rabbit and a lamb shack (which was dish of the day apparently). Though rabbit was overcooked it has quite okay taste. We cannot say the same for the lamb shack, it was basically tasteless, consisted of bone with a loads of lamb fat with barely any meat… it was terrible to say the least. But the best part was the bill… not only they added the 1.2€ pp to our bill for the bread and subpar humus (which as waiter told us ought to be „on house”) but we were so underwhelmed when we saw the price of lamb shack - 35€. Unacceptable. We paid, left confused and disappointed. Never coming back and would advise anyone to not visit that place.

reviews.author: Atakan
reviews.text: Dining at Rubino in Valletta was a memorable experience, offering a taste of authentic Maltese and Italian flavors in a charming, historic setting. The menu focuses on fresh, seasonal ingredients, and we were excited to try their renowned dishes. The highlight of our meal was undoubtedly the Fenek Moqli (traditional Maltese fried rabbit) and the calamari plate—both were perfectly cooked, flavorful, and truly showcased the restaurant’s expertise. The side of roasted potatoes and vegetables complemented the dishes beautifully, adding a rustic and comforting touch. The service was friendly but felt a bit rushed at times, which took away slightly from the relaxed dining experience. That said, the atmosphere at Rubino is warm and nostalgic, making it a great place for a cozy meal in Valletta. With a few small improvements in pacing and consistency, it could be a 5-star experience! Would definitely return for the rabbit and calamari.

reviews.author: Viktor Lakatos
reviews.text: I have tried a lot of pastizzi in Malta, bud hands down this is far the best. I had the one with the peas and one with cheese. The peas were used some special, Middle Eastern spices, filled with a fresh, crispy pastry. Unbelievably delicious and cheap, the queue goes quickly, so it's worth the wait!

reviews.author: Ica Ica
reviews.text: Must visit if you want to try original, traditional, and tasty baked goods on Malta. Absolutely delicious! And It’s also clearly a favourite spot for locals. Highly recommended! Super cheap prices as well.

reviews.author: Krzysztof Szczepanski
reviews.text: Is-Serkin – Crystal Palace Bar offers the best pastizzi I’ve had in Malta (and I’ve tried many). It’s an absolute must if you want to experience this traditional Maltese snack at its best — perfectly crispy on the outside, moist and flavorful on the inside, and always served hot straight from the oven. This spot is beloved by both locals and tourists. It's located conveniently between Rabat and Mdina. Seating is limited, with just a few tables indoors and outdoors, and it’s often crowded — but the queue moves fast, and many people opt for takeaway to enjoy their pastries on the go. The café also has a clean restroom for customers, which is a nice bonus given the small size of the place. If you're visiting Mdina or Rabat, this is a must-stop for an authentic taste of Malta.

reviews.author: Anders Folke Westlund
reviews.text: This authentic and local maltese café is seemingly always busy from opening until closing - for a reason! Their locally made pastizzi and qassatat are on a different level, as fresh as they can be and packed with love and as many flavors as possible! Totally amazing food experience, and they’re just €0,60-1,30 each too! The venue is quite small and charming mixed with both locals and curious visitors and the workers are super efficient yet warm and friendly. This place gave us the best breakfast experience we could have wanted, great find!

reviews.author: Andrea Castañeda
reviews.text: Best Pastizzis of Malta, you see how they take it out of the oven , fresh and juicy Chicken- 0.6 € ( Must try it) Peas, Cheese - 0.5 €

reviews.author: Courtney Halverson
reviews.text: Amazing place with AMAZING food, great views and friendly staff. I’ve been thinking about the appetizer platter and their fresh cheese all week. My group each got a different kind of ravioli and shared and they were also amazing. Would recommend to anyone in Victoria for the day. Such a unique setting and really excellent food.

reviews.author: Nina Schwarz
reviews.text: I have been returning to this place every time I visited Gozo in the past 25 years as I love the atmospher, the location in the historic citadel and the Maltese Platter with local cheese, capers, onions, tomatoes and lots if fresh & crisp bread. The old building adds to the charm and the service has always been attentive and fast. It‘s miraculous that the food has kept its quality over 25 years!

reviews.author: maryam Fattahi
reviews.text: The special appetizer was simple but very tasty and healthy, the liqueur was very tasty, and the homemade dessert was amazing. The prices were also quite reasonable and good.

reviews.author: Katarína Načiniaková
reviews.text: I came to this restaurant on purpose after 8 years visiting Gozo. Why? Because I wanted to experience again the fantastic and peaceful atmosphere of historic Gozo right in the heart of Citadella and with my favourite food. After 8 years, I ordered the same thing and I recommend it to everyone - as an appetizer their homemade ricotta cheese, which goes fantastically with a glass of well chilled rosé. For the main dish I chose the spaghetti bolognese again, I love it so much and compare different chefs' creations :) The spaghetti was a little dry for me, but the taste was excellent, just the minced ragù seasoned well. I would love to come back again :) and the waiter was really really nice and kind as Well.

reviews.author: Dr Monika Gostic
reviews.text: Great place with a beautiful rooftop restaurant. The food was delicious, however we only managed to get the sharing plate with fresh cheese. When ordering anything extra, we waited too long and in the end had to leave to catch the boat. What we did manage to taste was delicious

name: Street Stall - The Point
address: Street Stall - The Point, Sliema, Malta

reviews.author: Weaning Ping
reviews.text: Decent size mall. Great foot traffic for a Sunday. Name brands are available. Some tenant space empty. Heavily invested on LED curve screen panel with graphic signage minus advertisement. Palm tree column design. PU flooring on escalators landing and around glass railings. Malta vibes color ceramic floor tiles. Generous parking space. Wide playground with water fountain. 4 level shopping with different color coding columns like orange, sea breeze and tangerine color. No cinema. EuroSpar complete and has varieties

reviews.author: Maite Varas Ortiz
reviews.text: My fav shopping centre in Malta. Really popular, close to the promenade, cafes, bars and rocky beaches. Modern facilities and many interesting shops, restaurants, etc. ❤️🇲🇹

reviews.author: Melanie Hughes
reviews.text: Everything you could wany, and probably more. Lots of high end stores, as well as more realistic ones. Stunning setting, loved the way they have used the original facade of the building, to keep the history. Nice square outside with cafes amd restaurants.

reviews.author: SavindraSingh Shahoo
reviews.text: It is a good mall with various brands and restaurants available. However, there is one thing missing that is a movie 🎥 theatre.

reviews.author: Hug Dealer
reviews.text: Great shopping experience in Malta. Biggest mall in malta. Way better name brand shops are available under one Roof. Foods clothing trainers, shoes sunglasses electronics perfumes cosmetics. Also have interspar kiabi icare epic and more. Nike hilfiger lactose. Good cafes and restaurants here to. View are pretty cool to. Enjoying my walk around here.

reviews.author: Konstantina Karagianni
reviews.text: It was one of the most delicious dishes I’ve ever eaten! I had a filet salmon with a sauce of orange and prawn and it was so tasty. The desert was also super. The staff was top and so friendly. Everything was perfect!

reviews.author: Slaven Kramaric
reviews.text: In May 2024 we’ve visited this restaurant on a recommendation. We ate Maltese Platter and Pasta Aubergine. Both of these dishes were fantastic, in fact, Pasta Aubergine was so good we talked throughout the past 12 months about it and how we need to go one day to Sliema to enjoy it again. It was silky, creamy, aubergine was melting in our mouths, full of flavors! So, we traveled over a weekend to Malta and went to Ta’Kris once again. We ordered the same dishes + Seafood spaghetti. This time we ate one of the worst meals on Malta. Bigilla dip was so spicy we couldn’t eat it. Pasta Aubergine was the biggest disappointment, very acidic and aubergine was tough and inedible. Seafood pasta was dry, a bit overcooked and too salty. Complete and utter disappointment. I’ve complained to the three different waiters about the quality of food (they came to ask us every 10 min how was the food), we left the dishes uneaten and were still charged a full price for the meal. My opinion is that Ta’Kris has become more of a tourist trap than an authentic Maltese restaurant.

reviews.author: Alex L. (Alex)
reviews.text: We stopped by this restaurant without a reservation, and it was completely full—but what a gem of a place! Thankfully, the waitress was super helpful and managed to find us a table after just a short 10-minute wait. We tried the Maltese rabbit and beef stew, and both were delicious. The portions were generous, especially for the price, which was very reasonable. The atmosphere is warm and cozy, with charming old-fashioned Maltese decor that adds to the authentic feel. I’d definitely recommend this spot!

reviews.author: Viktor Lakatos
reviews.text: This is also a titkok famous place , recommended by many people. I have ordered the antipasti plate to try many different local dishes and I must say it tastes better than it looks. The sausage had an interesting citrus taste, the cheese was quite unique, however the tomato was a regular tomato puree from supermarket, and bread was a little dry. I might have tried some warm food as well, maybe I return later, but this experience was more mediocre.

reviews.author: Przemysław Frąk
reviews.text: We found this place thanks to a recommendation from one of the groups about Malta. The restaurant is hidden in a dead end street in a quite surprising place near the ferry port. The restaurant has two parts, inside and outside the building. The menu is quite extensive and mainly consists of local dishes from the Maltese cuisine. For me personally, a visit to this restaurant was more than just food. First of all, the tastes of Malta. I was there before we started traveling around the island. And being in every place I was looking for a taste of the dishes I tried in the restaurant. You could say that Ta'Kris became a local guide to Malta for me before I even fully discovered it. The second important reason is the staff. People from all over the world. Nice, polite, with a sense of humor. In my opinion, they are an important element of this place. Without their commitment and hard work, this place would look different. I came back here a few more times because I tried other recommended places, but they were surprisingly poor quality and with much higher prices for much worse quality. Everything I ate here was a feast for my senses. It took me to the places where the products for these dishes are made. I recommend the beef, octopus and rabbit dishes. Delicious salads with seafood and octopus and for dessert lemon cheesecake. It is worth coming back here when you feel good and leave happy. The magic ingredient of this place is the owner, who cultivates his mother's recipes, which were created dozens if not hundreds of years ago in Malta. Thanks to this, this place has become my guide to Malta. I definitely recommend both the food and the atmosphere.

reviews.author: Konstantina Karagianni
reviews.text: It was one of the most delicious dishes I’ve ever eaten! I had a filet salmon with a sauce of orange and prawn and it was so tasty. The desert was also super. The staff was top and so friendly. Everything was perfect!
