reviews.author: Sruthi Laya
reviews.text: "5/5 stars! Exceptional dining experience at this restaurant. Delicious food, impeccable service, and a warm atmosphere. All the dishes were outstanding! Friendly staff and perfect ambiance. Highly recommend. Can't wait to return and try more of their menu!"

reviews.author: Francesco Cruciani
reviews.text: We went in on the recommendation of a local shopkeeper—a server at a Valletta souvenir store who assured us we’d find well-prepared Maltese fare at fair prices. This was our first (and only) deep dive into traditional Maltese cuisine, and honestly, we were pleasantly surprised. Ambiance & Pricing The place strikes a nice balance between inviting and unpretentious. It isn’t cheap, but it isn’t overpriced either—just what we were told. The menu clearly notes that pasta can be ordered either as a starter or a main (with about a €5 premium for the latter), so keep an eye out for that when you decide portion size vs. budget. Starters (Pasta Trio) We shared three pastas as starters: • Spaghetti with octopus • Spaghetti with rabbit • Ravioli filled with sheep’s cheese All three were excellent—really fresh, perfectly al dente, and generously sauced. The octopus offered a nice briny bite, the sheep’s-cheese ravioli was creamy without being heavy, and even the rabbit pasta (often a gamble) was tender and well seasoned. Main Courses (Sharing Four-Way) For mains—again sharing among four—we chose: 1. A plate combining horse meat and fried rabbit 2. A hearty pork stew served “al forn” with a vegetable medley 3. Chicken glazed with honey The pork stew was a standout: melt-in-your-mouth pork complemented by simple roasted potatoes and seasonal veggies. The fried horse meat also surprised us—crispy exterior, tender inside, full of rich flavor. The fried rabbit, however, didn’t win everyone over; a couple of us didn’t finish our portions. The honey-glazed chicken was solid if not spectacular—my friends loved it, even if it didn’t “wow” me. Service Our servers were uniformly friendly and attentive—until the bill arrived. The man who processed our separate payments seemed noticeably put out by splitting the check (we were four and each asked to pay individually). Up until that moment he’d been perfectly cordial, so perhaps he just had a bad day. Bill Details We were a group of four and each paid €27, which felt very reasonable given the variety and quality of dishes we enjoyed. Overall Between the three pasta starters, the trio of mains, and a few sides, we left pleasantly full and satisfied. Quality and value hit the mark, with pork and horse meat dishes stealing the show. Aside from the minor hiccup at checkout and the less-than-stellar fried rabbit, this spot delivers on authentic Maltese flavors without breaking the bank. Highly recommended if you want a genuine taste of local cuisine in Valletta!

reviews.author: CD
reviews.text: We had great expectations after the strong reviews and recommendations from holiday influencers. Overall, we weren't disappointed, albeit with a blip. We ordered the Maltese platter (very good), the octopus (excellent), horse meat (good), but pan- fried rabbit dish was a letdown, with the meat rather tough. All in all, a good experience except for the rabbit. I would say that if you are less adventurous with your meats, it would be safer to stick to the Italian pizzas and pastas.

reviews.author: Despina Tzortzi
reviews.text: What a great experience! The best meal while our stay in Malta! The place was very nice and well attended. The service very good, professional, quick and with attention to detail. The food was excellent, like home cooked, the portions big and the dessert was delicious. My husband had his birthday and I asked them to surprise him with a dessert. They all showed up singing happy birthday to him!! A must try place in Valletta!!

reviews.author: Valeria Ilcheva
reviews.text: Although we didn't have a reservation, we were fortunate enough to be seated for a 1.5-hour dinner, but I’d definitely recommend making a reservation to avoid any wait. As for the food, it was fantastic! I trusted the waiter’s recommendations, and it was absolutely worth it. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. The portion sizes are perfect for one person, but if you order starters or salads, you might end up with leftovers to take home.

reviews.author: Kali Lins
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The service was just as impressive, with the staff being friendly, attentive, and professional throughout our visit. A special shout-out to the lovely waitress who spoke Portuguese — she made us feel right at home. Her warm attitude and helpful recommendations really elevated our dining experience. It's rare to find such welcoming service, and we truly appreciated it. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and outstanding hospitality!

reviews.author: Daryl
reviews.text: Staff were so friendly, managed to find us a table outside last minute and gave great advice on food recommendations - Plum Cake recommended by Marco was amazing. Views were impeccable and the food was great. For the quality of the food the prices are very reasonable, same goes for cocktails - mocktails we're also tasty, sometimes they can feel lacking but not the case at Chophouse.

reviews.author: Vita Berdarová
reviews.text: We would like to express our heartfelt thanks for the wonderful organization of our wedding, which took place on April 7, 2025. The food, service, and atmosphere were all of the highest standard. The managers were cooperative, helpful, and responded promptly throughout the entire planning and organization process. We are truly grateful and can wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant — whether for a lovely dinner or any special event.

reviews.author: Victoria Holmes
reviews.text: Just had my wedding reception at the chophouse in May. And it was SPECTACULAR!! Every aspect of the evening was 10/10. The food was incredible, every course of our bespoke menu was devine. The service was nothing I've experienced at any other wedding. They catered to every wish and hope I had for my big day to ensure it was met and I would recommend this venue to anyone thinking of a wedding in Malta. Furthermore we had several meals at the chophouse, each of which were amazing, it's the perfect restaurant for a special meal of fabulous views and food at any time! Thank you Natalia, Keith and Chef David!

reviews.author: Baert D’hauwers
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of dining at Chophouse Restaurant during a team trip to Malta, and it was one of the culinary highlights of our stay. First of all, the view is absolutely stunning – the terrace overlooks Valletta’s skyline, especially magical at sunset or when the city lights reflect on the water in the evening. A truly memorable backdrop for dinner. The menu focuses on premium cuts and grilled dishes, with high-quality ingredients and careful preparation. From starters to dessert, every plate was beautifully presented and full of flavour. Service was friendly and attentive, and the wine selection was excellent, with great pairings recommended by the staff. Chophouse combines fine dining with a relaxed atmosphere and is perfect for both professional dinners and special occasions. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Malta – and absolutely worth it for the view alone.

reviews.author: Adrian
reviews.text: I have to say, this restaurant truly impressed me. The service was outstanding — the staff were friendly, knowledgeable about the menu, and gave excellent recommendations, especially for those who were unsure what to choose. The dishes were beautifully presented and tasted absolutely delicious. Every bite felt like a real treat. I highly recommend coming here for both breakfast and dinner — it’s definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Anand Enebral
reviews.text: Amazing little place with gorgeous food. The portions are huge! We had the octopus which was delicious, super fresh and well cooked and particularly enjoyed the pumpkin sauce; and the mussels which were cooked in wine and with plenty of sauce. For a main course I had the vegan butternut risotto which was quite nice too. The hamburger was enormous and the two salads could have served one more person each. The linguine with prawns was nice but it would have been even better with the prawns already peeled.

reviews.author: Piotr Kania
reviews.text: Brought here by a local friend, was not disappointed. Service is attentive and friendly. All of us had a burger and some cocktails. Can easily recommend all. Spent here like two quality hours. All good enough to come back and test the rest of the menu.

reviews.author: Charles Brault
reviews.text: What a spot. Super chill. HH from 4-7 which is 2:1 cocktails and beer. Food was excellent. Would recommend the octopus and the sea bass for two. Our server was American and an excellent host. 11/10 would definitely return.

reviews.author: Shonnie L
reviews.text: I wandered in here for dinner as it is near where I am staying. What a lovely little gem! I had a table for one and the staff were as attentive to me as they were to the groups. They were friendly, professional and on the ball. I chose the red snapper and had a couple of cocktails too. The green hornet (kiwi) cocktail was amazing and so was the hibiscus/elderflower/gin cocktail. The fish was perfection and my plate was a piece of art. There was salt, pepper and olive oil on the table as well which is a nice touch. I received bread cooked in-house while I waited for my meal. I would recommend this place. It has a lovely vibe inside the restaurant in the evening.

reviews.author: Will Turner
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Waterbiscuit Restaurant at the InterContinental Hotel in Malta, and overall, it was a very enjoyable experience. The food was of high quality, beautifully presented, and flavorful. I highly recommend the beef cheeks—they were tender, rich, and cooked to perfection. The rib eye steak was also excellent, cooked exactly to my liking with a great char and juicy interior. One interesting aspect was the beef tartare, which was presented in a make-it-yourself style. The ingredients were served on the side, and we had to mix everything together ourselves. It was a fun and interactive way to enjoy the dish, though it might not be for everyone. The service was attentive and professional, making us feel well taken care of throughout the evening. I also tried the French Brest for dessert, but I found it to be a bit too sweet for my taste. The only minor downside was the portion sizes; I found the main courses to be slightly on the small side, especially considering the price. I was expecting a bit more heft for the cost, but the overall quality of the food and the lovely ambiance made up for it. Would definitely recommend for a special night out in Malta!

reviews.author: Videss
reviews.text: We had a fabulous group dinner! One of my friend's birthday. The Braised Veal I had was delicious, the plating was well presented! Jessa kept us entertained, she's funny and knowledgeable! She had some excellent insights about Malta. Highly recommend for group dining. I can imagine a romantic dinner will be lovely here as well. Gorgeous atmosphere right in the heart of St. Julian. Thanks so much !

reviews.author: Dianne Thorpe
reviews.text: Pretty much ate here the entire time I was in Malta. The service was great, very friendly waiters and bartenders. The food and drinks quality are awesome and consistent. The prices are reasonable and affordable for the quality. Definitely recommend and will be back if I’m in Malta. The food quality was better than some 5Star restaurants that I’ve been to. I mean you can never go wrong with French inspired restaurants

reviews.author: Rich Deerdog
reviews.text: Hotel restaurant and bar at the Intercontinental St Julian’s. Bar downstairs and restaurant upstairs. Had drinks here a few times in the bar - service is good; they sell Cisk and have a full range of spirits. Atmosphere a bit flat and quiet; probably more lively in summer. TVs on wall show football. There is also a framed golf club. Not sure why. Bar also serves food. Had burgers here late one evening. Very tasty food; freshly prepared. Full choice of mini sauces on offer. Rewarding. Restaurant upstairs offers fine dining and more casual options. The food here was first class and I’d definitely go again. Several excellent options - had beef tartare to start followed by pasta with lamb. The latter was so hearty and rich I had no room for pud 😆 Wanted to come back for the veal cheeks but couldn’t find time. 🥲 Good choice if you’re staying at the hotel; charge to your room. Outsiders also welcome though. A firm two paws up.

reviews.author: Stew Burns
reviews.text: Food was okay (served at room temp) Octopus was like leather unfortunately although when when did inform the staff the gave my wife a free cocktail that was incredible twist on a espresso martini Restaurant felt like it was situated in a reception area of a hotel or office building Felt a bit lost… Although it was quiet we waited a while for the bill and had to ask a second member of staff for it.

reviews.author: Dalton Hili
reviews.text: Food was delicious and mostly Maltese cuisine so a perfect opportunity to taste what the locals have to offer. The service was excellent and the atmosphere quite lively on the inside and a bit more romantic and quiet on the outside. I enjoyed every second here.

reviews.author: Patrick Brugger
reviews.text: Nikki was a great server. She took the time to explain menu and options. Even had us sample a wine before deciding on a bottle. Tried a variety of Maltese dishes ... all good! Price to quality ratio was great. We had rabbit pasta and a fresh local fish.

reviews.author: Катя Локанцова
reviews.text: It offers a pleasant dining experience with tasty food, a beautiful view, and a prime location. The atmosphere is charming, and the staff is generally friendly and welcoming. However, there were a couple of issues during our visit. A small mistake was made with our order, which wasn’t a big deal, but what stood out was that a staff member accidentally hit my husband on the head twice while passing by and did not apologise.

reviews.author: Tetiana Cherniavska
reviews.text: We ordered the tasting menu. The price was around 32 and it's nice actually.👌 The dishes were a lot so we could try all and feel good in the end☺️. The dessert was sooo amazing, sweet enough and warm. The fish had a high quality. I also liked the caramel onion 🤤 We will come back for sure !!!!🥰

reviews.author: Elīna Mincāne
reviews.text: Lovely place with a beautiful view on Spinola Bay, I ordered catch of the day - Red Snapper, fish was great, creamy and soft. Serviss was amazing ❤️ great place to visit!

reviews.author: Matthew
reviews.text: If you’re looking for the best burgers in St. Julian’s, look no further than Hugo’s Burger Bar! I had an amazing experience here, from the warm and friendly service to the incredible food. The moment I walked in, I was greeted with a cozy atmosphere and a welcoming vibe. The staff was super attentive, making sure everything was perfect. You can tell they genuinely care about their customers. Now, let’s talk about the food—absolutely next level! The burger I had was juicy, packed with flavor, and cooked to perfection. The bun was soft yet sturdy, holding everything together beautifully. The toppings were fresh, and the combination of ingredients was spot on. I also tried their fries, which were crispy and well-seasoned, and the homemade sauces added an extra delicious touch. The presentation of the food was fantastic, and you can see the attention to detail. I also loved the variety on the menu—there’s something for everyone, whether you like classic burgers or something more unique. Overall, Hugo’s Burger Bar is a hidden gem in St. Julian’s. Whether you’re a local or just visiting, you need to check this place out. I’ll definitely be coming back for more! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ali Elkadiki
reviews.text: During my latest visit, I found that the restaurant maintained high standards throughout the day. The service was prompt, and the employees were both friendly and professional. I enjoyed a hearty sandwich paired with a side of delicious, golden fries and a refreshing drink. Every detail—from the neat appearance of the dining area to the careful presentation of the food—made for a truly enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Elicat
reviews.text: Burgers as good as in the US. Very delicious and fresh but still served fast. Clean and stylish atmosphere, two floors. A Specialty was the pumping Station for sauce, which one could use independently. Moreover were the prices moderately, around 10-15€ per burger and 13-18 per menu. Can definitely recommend the Bacon and cheese burger. Only downside were the chicken nuggets, which are extremely overpriced with 7,5€ for 5 normal sized ones.

reviews.author: Yangsoo Kwon
reviews.text: Ordered Rocco’s burger with Coke Zero with my friends. They ordered burger set with normal coke, but they did not say which one is zero coke. But food was good and fast.

reviews.author: Dimitri
reviews.text: The burger is exactly what you would expect from a touristy place. Not bad. It's a good portion. The water being 2 euros was kinda steep.

name: Middle East Muse Lounge
address: Middle East Muse Lounge, St. Julian’s, Malta

reviews.author: Hanh Nguyen
reviews.text: Restaurant is located in the party town section. Area can get very busy and fun if you like that sort of atmosphere. Restaurant is typical of middle eastern atmosphere, with hookah lounge. Food is decent, hummus was good. Good cocktails but no red wine.

reviews.author: Gulam Mohammad
reviews.text: Food is excellent but more attention is paid to sheesha customers in some circumstances. Food is fresh and can take some time to prepare. Sheesha is also nice including the Moroccan tea.

reviews.author: András Fejes
reviews.text: We found a place for watching match and it was the best place what we could choose. The atmosphere was great. And foods and drinks were perfect. The staff are very friendly.

reviews.author: Tibor Horvath
reviews.text: Very tasty food, friendly polite staff, quick service, good prices, I much recommend this place

reviews.author: Umar Yousaf
reviews.text: Wish there was a option for 0 stars they don’t even deserve 1 star Arrived there around 1850 ask the person if there was open and they said no they open at 1900 so fair enough we waited at 1900 we went back and they said there still not open and need to clean told us to wait outside. At 1925 they called us in (should have walked away from there) but we went in and looked at the menu prices wasn’t updated on the menu (see pic) we wanted the Adaya for €20 but they said all prices have gone up to €25 I didn’t mind paying it but at least change the price on the menu. They also didn’t have blue ice and red dream. Anywho we was smoking for an hour and not once did they change the coals the place wasn’t even busy only a couple of people there. Worst experience ever they couldn’t even clean 1 area and tell us to wait inside. And for anyone out there they don’t do card payment cash only which is ridiculous because a lot of people now days use card. The toilets didn’t have locks in there how are people meant to go toilet with no locks and no light. Highly would NOT recommend.

reviews.author: Trevor Naudi
reviews.text: A great casual restaurant which is a perfect venue for any occasion! We were a group of 12 persons celebrating a family event. We had a table on the terrace which gives you an awesome view (the only downside is that it was a hot day and obviously you cannot have air-conditioning outdoors 😅. Having said that, staff is very friendly and the food is great. Downstairs they also have a chill out area with table tennis, table soccer and a couch with a big screen. Great dining experience overall

reviews.author: Justyna Pakuła
reviews.text: I had breakfast at Tuo Buoys in St. Julian’s many times and it is always absolutely fantastic! The atmosphere is laid-back and welcoming, with a beautiful view of the sea that made the whole experience even more enjoyable. The food is always fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The portion size was generous and definitely good value for money. The staff is always friendly and attentive without being intrusive, and everything came out quickly and just how I ordered it. Whether you're a local or visiting Malta, I highly recommend stopping by Tuo Buoys for breakfast—it’s a perfect way to start your day!

reviews.author: Sarah Graham
reviews.text: Popped in for a quick light lunch ! Lovely warm greeting, interesting menu, few twists on some regular meals and drinks which made a great change ! I wanted to try their gnocchi, 2 types on offer, but I was still so full from the previous day, I opted for the fish tacos & so pleased I did, more than enough. They were presented well & tasted very good. We also ordered the Caroline scrambled eggs with feta, chorizo, crispy onion and chilli on toast. Have to say, wasn't taken with the presentation, but wow did it taste good. Really nice. So much I'd like to try from this menu, sadly I'm not here long enough to work my way through. Would I return, absolutely !! Highly recommended & well done for giving us something a little different to tickle the taste buds.

reviews.author: Румина Стоянова
reviews.text: We had dinner at this lovely restaurant and felt bad we didn’t discover it earlier. The food is amazing, the portions are very generous and they even offer gluten free pasta. The waiters were really friendly and nice. So sorry we couldn’t come for brunch. Make sure to visit this place!!!

reviews.author: Maren P
reviews.text: Lovely located with views of the Spinola Bay, great service, food was freshly prepared and delivered quickly. Taste was amazing! Minir thing to note: for an Australian Place I was disappointed to find out that they did not serve Bundaberg Ginger Beer, but an Italian Brand. Especially as there are Billboards advertising Bundaberg all over the Island.... Nevertheless, I fully recommend!

name: Velvet Club Lounge
address: Velvet Club Lounge, St. Julian’s, Malta

reviews.author: Bradly Farrell
reviews.text: Great place to relax and enjoy the company of friends. The food is tasty and doesn’t take hours to come out. We went for the hookah and it didn’t disappoint! U should try the flavour that has “malta” in the name.. can’t remember the full name though 🫣 sorry. The happy hour is like 3 hours long! What more can you want!?

reviews.author: David Otten
reviews.text: We had to plan a night out for a group of 120 young students, and from the very first moment we walked in to ask for information, the organisation was super smooth. The staff was incredibly welcoming and professional, and everything fell into place effortlessly. We were able to privatise the entire basement, which came fully equipped with everything we needed: our own DJ booth, a dedicated bar with friendly barmen, private toilets, customizable lighting—the full package. It really felt like our own club for the night. Special thanks to the manager and his team, who paid close attention to every single detail and accommodated all our requests with great care and flexibility. The atmosphere was amazing from start to finish, and the whole group had an unforgettable time. A night to remember. Would highly recommend for any private party!

reviews.author: Antonio Pereira
reviews.text: Velvet Lounge Club – A Hidden Gem in St. Paul's Bay Tucked away in a residential area outside the main tourist hotspots of St. Paul’s Bay, Velvet Lounge Club is a true hidden gem. While staying in the area during our holiday in Malta, we stumbled upon this spot by chance during one of our walks – and what a great find it was! This place is both a sports bar and a shisha lounge, offering a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. The service was exceptional, with a friendly and attentive staff who went out of their way to accommodate us. We even asked if they could show a football match of our Portuguese team in the following days, and without hesitation, they assured us it would be possible. That level of customer care made us return without a doubt. A special mention goes to their Mango & Cucumber Mule, a non-alcoholic cocktail that became my wife’s absolute favorite! Refreshing and well-balanced, it was a highlight of our experience. The shisha was also excellent – smooth, flavorful, and well-prepared, making it the perfect way to unwind after a long day. In fact, it became a holiday ritual for us to visit this spot frequently. The prices are fair and in line with what you’d expect from a quality nightlife venue. Kudos to the team for the great space, excellent service, and attention to detail. Highly recommended for sports fans, shisha lovers, or anyone looking for a cozy and friendly spot away from the crowds!

reviews.author: Steve Dyke
reviews.text: Great cocktails as always. Nice to chill and people watch. Staff great very aware of all the customers. We come every year. And velvet is our evening destination. Oh food great also.

reviews.author: steve dyke
reviews.text: Been spending €60 a night all week on cocktails. And been great. Tonight (fri) had 1 an̈d no alcohol in cocktails so moved on. Not a good nite and we come twice a year and always come to velvet.

name: Gillieru Restaurant
address: Gillieru Restaurant, St. Paul’s Bay, Malta

reviews.author: kathleen
reviews.text: Stayed at Gillieru hotel May 2025 and would never stay again. I booked a single room with sea view. I was given a spacious double room. However one window curtain was hanging off its rail and my bedside light did not work, l reported this to reception but nothing was ever done. There were only sheets on the bed with no other covering which proved, with air conditioning to be cold at night. I utilised 2 blankets in wardrobe for cover.

reviews.author: Simon Smith
reviews.text: Everything was great at the hotel. The room was lovely and the maid came in every day. The room had a lovely view out into the bay. The location was excellent and I couldn't fault the breakfast each morning. You could basically have what you wanted. The staff were accommodating. If you want the same view that I got, you will need to book a room with a sea view.

reviews.author: Rebecca Smith
reviews.text: Just back from a few days staying in this beautiful hotel. Staff are absolutely lovely, friendly, helpful, welcoming and probably the best I’ve experienced. The location was perfect with fantastic views. Would stay here again without doubt.

reviews.author: Alexey Rudichev
reviews.text: An excellent accommodation in a quiet place on the seafront. Beautiful view of the harbour, from the balcony. The room was comfortable, with all amenities one would need. All the staff were incredibly nice and helpful. I enjoyed my stay very much.

reviews.author: harriet parks
reviews.text: great location, right on the water and lovely views. very friendly staff and maid. had a situation to deal with during my last minute stay, and gabriela at reception was very understanding and thoughtful. 100% recommend this hotel i would stay again.

name: Gormina Bakery
address: Gormina Bakery, St. Paul’s Bay, Malta

reviews.author: Randall Eckerich
reviews.text: Awesome place great bakery inside at the back. Great prices and lots of selection. Cranky lady at the cash out 😠 would not deal with her in the future. Lied to us about the pasty in the display. She said they are all cheese. Clearly the green peas we found inside is not cheese.

reviews.author: 林庭安
reviews.text: The small pastisery besides the road , all fresh bread, good for breakfast or dessert . I got a tuna bread (€1.5) & cheese bread(€0.4) crunchy ,the price was reasonable and full of ingredients inside . Tasty and local , recommend with coffee !!! Definitely come back again and try rest of flavor !

reviews.author: Me Jiban
reviews.text: I got the cake on time and it was very fresh. For 3rd Jan I Ordered birth cake from Gormina Bakery it was delicious. If you are considering ordering to for any events cake 100% recommend and I will Order again. Thanks.

reviews.author: Caine Mallia
reviews.text: Very fast service and very good bread wide variety to choose from

reviews.author: jezzaftw
reviews.text: The bread is Amazing. Shop layout slightly confusing Slight misunderstanding when i asked for sunscreen and was given After Sun cream. Not major but this could be solved by allowing customers to get a Closer look at the stock behind the cashier. Otherwise great overall

name: Lovage Bistro
address: Lovage Bistro, St. Paul’s Bay, Malta

reviews.author: Danielle Ondrasek
reviews.text: Really quick service and fantastic food. This was my first time having rabbit and the ravioli was an excellent first meal in Malta. The bread, olives, and olive oil are all fresh and local. The risotto was fantastic and the famous dessert imqaret (q is silent). Be warned that if you go here you will want to return multiple times!

reviews.author: Janet
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived to the moment we left the experience was simply amazing. We were looked after well by Marco, who with his exceptional knowledge of the menu and his kind nature provided a great service to me and my family members as we dined at the restaurant. I ordered the rabbit liver pasta and it was flavourful and felt like it had been homemade. Shortly after, for my main, I had a seafood orecchiette which was just divine, it was a shame that I couldn’t finish everything because the meal sizes were generous and I wanted to eat all three courses here! For desert, the strawberry tartlet crumble was the best desert I have ever had. It was light, sweet and it looked stunning. Me and my family loved the experience here and would most certainly eat here again!

reviews.author: Paula E
reviews.text: Wonderful atmosphere for a family or romantic dinner with incredible dishes and five-star service, Mediterranean food with local options and fresh seasonal items, and a large selection of wines. With options for vegans and gluten-free. The menu is not that extensive but of great quality, with affordable prices.

reviews.author: Dave Denyer
reviews.text: The environment is spacious, modern and contemporary with bossa Nova music playing gently in the background. Attentive staff promptly took us to our seat having booked the table just 20 minutes prior. However, there were plenty of spaces in this restaurant. In warmer months it looks like it would be open for outdoor dining as well. The tables were nicely spaced apart so as not to feel cramped however, there does look like there would be lots of capacity. My partner had the rabbit liver for starters, which was served on some beautifully fresh and crusty, and a basket of bread for me, served with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. The rabbit liver was perfectly cooked and rich in flavour. For the main course we had the Gnocchi Di Patata, which was beautifully creamy, and something I've not really had before until today. The portion was substantial and in fact I couldn't finish it because I was so full but it was delicious. My partner had the Sea Bass, which came with seasonal vegetables and potatoes. It was beautifully laid out on the plate and again a good portion size. For dessert, we had some ice cream and a warm chocolate fondant which was beautifully rich, perfectly cooked with a lovely crisp, outer and a liquid centre, complimented with some smooth pistachio ice cream. A restaurant. I would definitely visit again when I come to stay in Malta. I came to this restaurant purely because of the 4.8 review on Google and when navigating to the website the care it takes in mentioning the passion the chef patron has for food. If you're in Qawra, or even in Malta, I see no reason why you wouldn't come to this restaurant to try its cuisine.

reviews.author: Wilson Restrepo Tumina
reviews.text: Amazing food, big platters. The Rib eye steak was seared perfect medium rare like i asked. Pistachio risotto was something we never ate and was delicious. Staff was super nice. All in all a great place to eat!

name: Ta’ Pawla
address: Ta’ Pawla, St. Paul’s Bay, Malta

reviews.author: Jack Clement
reviews.text: We happened upon this charming restaurant while searching for an authentic Maltese dining experience—and it exceeded all expectations! From the first bite, we knew we’d made the right choice. The concise menu focused on quality, and the attentive staff took the time to walk us through each dish, offering excellent recommendations. Every dish impressed, but the star attractions were undoubtedly the Maltese specials—particularly the rich, flavorful Rabbit Stew and the sweet, crispy Imqaret for dessert. An absolute must-try for anyone craving true local flavors! Without a doubt, this spot comes highly recommended for an unforgettable taste of Malta.

reviews.author: Jacek Sokołowski
reviews.text: We had dinner there today. We were welcomed by a very friendly and engaging waitress. And then came the food – a true richness of flavors! All the Maltese specialties were absolutely delicious – the soup, the main courses (rabbit and the Bragioli), and finally the dessert. I sincerely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.

reviews.author: Rhiannon Sitton
reviews.text: This restaurant is amazing! The starters were delicious and very generous - definitely get one between two people as we couldn’t finish ours. I ordered the ta Pawla pasta but unfortunately received something different. I didn’t notice at first that it was the wrong dish so I tried to eat what I could but eventually spoke to one of the servers and they confirmed that it was the wrong dish. They offered to bring me out the correct dish but I explained that by that point I was full and couldn’t eat anymore. I asked if I could just pay half price for the dish as I had eaten some of the pasta. The staff were extremely apologetic and super lovely throughout the ordeal. When they brought out the bill they told me that they weren’t going to charge us for the pasta dish and couldn’t stress enough how sorry they were for the mistake. We were so grateful for this lovely gesture and proceeded to tip them for their generosity. I will definitely go back next time we visit Malta as the food service and restaurant itself were amazing. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Adam Todd
reviews.text: A really nice restaurant and reasonably priced. A variety of Italian and Maltese options. The set menu seems good value. The rabbit and the fresh fish were enjoyed. Big portion sizes. The pesto pasta was very oily.

reviews.author: Richard Irving
reviews.text: What a gem of a find. I've been to many fine restaurants, some even have stars from a well known guide. We spent 7 nights at St Paul's Bay and found this lovely restaurant on the second night. Excellent food that was well prepared and good value for money, topped off by prompt and attentive service. We were very impressed with the Wine list which features some excellent local examples that provided good value for money. Over the week we had dinner 4 out of 7 nights here; we highly recommend.

reviews.author: Camille Gault
reviews.text: We came as a family to try the six-course tasting menu and had a wonderful evening! The service was impeccable and highly professional. The dishes were of excellent quality, with a perfect balance of flavors and beautiful presentation. We would like to thank the entire team for the warm welcome. A special mention to Ana and Jyoti.

reviews.author: lina Thies
reviews.text: Absolutely Outstanding Dining Experience! I recently had the pleasure of dining at this incredible restaurant, and I can confidently say it was one of the best culinary experiences I’ve ever had. The atmosphere was warm, elegant, and inviting. The staff greeted us with genuine smiles and were attentive throughout the entire evening. Every dish was beautifully presented and you could taste the quality and freshness of the ingredients. We enjoyed the best seafood with the breathtaking ocean view right next to us. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply looking for an unforgettable dinner experience, this place is a must-visit when staying in Malta!

reviews.author: Khrystyna T
reviews.text: We had the 7-course tasting menu for dinner. Service started off quite slow, even though the restaurant wasn’t very busy, but it did improve as the meal went on. The food was good overall, though some dishes didn’t feel as refined as we expected for a fine dining experience. We’d suggest updating the menu—especially removing the feta cheese pastries—and working on service consistency and staff management. Very big portions though!

reviews.author: Paweł Krawczyk
reviews.text: Service is good - everyone polite and with very positive vibe. I also like the view and design. Unfortunately the food wasn't too impressive. While the fish soup was OK, the octopus I had was dry and tasteless. I would expect much better considering the prices. I think you can find many places with much better food in that area.

reviews.author: billy
reviews.text: This HAS to be the best meal in my life! I got a multi-course meal, um, perhaps seven courses. I particularly liked the salmon combined with a tiny sliver of red beet. This combination was one I had never considered. A large staff kept the meal lively through their attentive and excellent service. The meal was worth every penny and more!

reviews.author: Tomi Valny
reviews.text: Every city has its own oldest traditional café place, and this one is the Malta's one. Beautiful old-fashioned design coffee shop is a shrine for coffee and cakes lover. This café has a huge choice of local specialties, and also food, and drinks. Usually crowded, one must be lucky to find place inside. Very recommended is a honey ring of bread pudding cake with dried fruits, Maltese original.

reviews.author: Heidi T
reviews.text: Beautiful building, but it's style over substance. It looks lovely but the mango "cheesecake" was not a cheesecake and did not taste good. The waiters were very short. Make sure you have a good look at the cakes before choosing. Alternatively, go to The Cake Box - the cakes are much better there!

reviews.author: Derrick Lee
reviews.text: Really nice place we had afternoon tea which they call time for tea. Nice old cafe style with a good atmosphere, service and friendly staff. The afternoon tea was €16 per person and it was really tasty served with tea or coffee, prosecco is €4 extra per glass. Worth a visit even if you just go in for a coffee and a pastry.

reviews.author: ame momo
reviews.text: I didn't find the bread I was looking for(already sold out), but I was able to try some traditional Maltese bread. The gelato was also delicious. You can eat inside or on the terrace, but I recommend taking out. It is very pleasant to eat at a place with a nice view.

reviews.author: Marius G
reviews.text: Nestled in the heart of Valletta, Café Cordina is a charming spot that effortlessly blends history, elegance, and exceptional flavors. During our visit, we enjoyed the Greek Salad and the signature Cordina Salad—both fresh, vibrant, and expertly crafted. The crisp ingredients and balanced flavors made for a truly satisfying meal. Beyond the food, the ambiance is rich with character, set against the backdrop of beautifully adorned interiors and the lively pulse of the city. Whether you're looking for a casual lunch or a refined café experience, Café Cordina delivers on all fronts. A must-visit for those exploring Valletta!

reviews.author: Dalton Hili
reviews.text: Food was delicious and mostly Maltese cuisine so a perfect opportunity to taste what the locals have to offer. The service was excellent and the atmosphere quite lively on the inside and a bit more romantic and quiet on the outside. I enjoyed every second here.

reviews.author: Patrick Brugger
reviews.text: Nikki was a great server. She took the time to explain menu and options. Even had us sample a wine before deciding on a bottle. Tried a variety of Maltese dishes ... all good! Price to quality ratio was great. We had rabbit pasta and a fresh local fish.

reviews.author: Катя Локанцова
reviews.text: It offers a pleasant dining experience with tasty food, a beautiful view, and a prime location. The atmosphere is charming, and the staff is generally friendly and welcoming. However, there were a couple of issues during our visit. A small mistake was made with our order, which wasn’t a big deal, but what stood out was that a staff member accidentally hit my husband on the head twice while passing by and did not apologise.

reviews.author: Tetiana Cherniavska
reviews.text: We ordered the tasting menu. The price was around 32 and it's nice actually.👌 The dishes were a lot so we could try all and feel good in the end☺️. The dessert was sooo amazing, sweet enough and warm. The fish had a high quality. I also liked the caramel onion 🤤 We will come back for sure !!!!🥰

reviews.author: Elīna Mincāne
reviews.text: Lovely place with a beautiful view on Spinola Bay, I ordered catch of the day - Red Snapper, fish was great, creamy and soft. Serviss was amazing ❤️ great place to visit!

reviews.author: Vojtěch Novotný
reviews.text: The visit to this restaurant was one of the remarkable experiences! Every menu item I had was very tasty, it is hard to point something out but the tuna is the winner for me. The indoor of is very nice, service was also fine, explaining everything about the food which, as I understand, is rotating and changing frequently. I also have to mention the price - considering this restaurant is mentioned in the Micheline guide, the food is superb and the amount is in total huge, the price is very reasonable for Malta. Can surely recommend.

reviews.author: Pamela Fleming
reviews.text: I had reserved lunch for two here and looked forward to it for months prior to our cruise. We were not disappointed at all and had the best meal of our trip here. The tasting menu with the wine pairings was perfect! The lunch staff were amazing. The restaurant itself was charming and quaint and don't even get me started in the locals who sat next to us! They shared their wine with me and recommended places to check out on our way back to the ship. My son now wants to attend university in Malta, and if he does, we will be regulars here.

reviews.author: Sam Feri
reviews.text: Sadly was not blown away by our experience. The restaurant is charming, service excellent, and staff very welcoming! However the food was not really special… the textures and flavours were not on point… it was actually missing flavour. We tried hard to like the menu but nothing stood out as delicious, and the beef was dry and hard to chew, so was the traditional maltese cake at the end. All in all it was not worth it for us, humbly!

reviews.author: Conor Drummond
reviews.text: Lovely experience of traditional Milanese food. The restaurant is tucked away in the streets of valetta, and feels like you are having lunch at your grandparents house. While a more casual michelin experience, it did nothing to dampen the service or food, with each dish delicious, and very nice staff. Very reasonably priced in comparison to other restaurants/amount of food on the tasting menu

reviews.author: Eli Alves
reviews.text: The 5 course menu is really worth it. We came at lunch time, the restaurant was full, so we had to come back later on. I recommend you to you a table. The service was good and the meal was delicious. Good choice to try some local dishes. The deserts was nothing special, I don’t care much about sweets anyway, so it didn’t bother me me. Overall, the place is cozy and we definitely recommend it!!

reviews.author: Vojtěch Novotný

name: Nenu The Artisan Baker
address: Nenu The Artisan Baker, Valletta, Malta

reviews.author: Sruthi Laya
reviews.text: "5/5 stars! Exceptional dining experience at this restaurant. Delicious food, impeccable service, and a warm atmosphere. All the dishes were outstanding! Friendly staff and perfect ambiance. Highly recommend. Can't wait to return and try more of their menu!"

reviews.author: Francesco Cruciani
reviews.text: We went in on the recommendation of a local shopkeeper—a server at a Valletta souvenir store who assured us we’d find well-prepared Maltese fare at fair prices. This was our first (and only) deep dive into traditional Maltese cuisine, and honestly, we were pleasantly surprised. Ambiance & Pricing The place strikes a nice balance between inviting and unpretentious. It isn’t cheap, but it isn’t overpriced either—just what we were told. The menu clearly notes that pasta can be ordered either as a starter or a main (with about a €5 premium for the latter), so keep an eye out for that when you decide portion size vs. budget. Starters (Pasta Trio) We shared three pastas as starters: • Spaghetti with octopus • Spaghetti with rabbit • Ravioli filled with sheep’s cheese All three were excellent—really fresh, perfectly al dente, and generously sauced. The octopus offered a nice briny bite, the sheep’s-cheese ravioli was creamy without being heavy, and even the rabbit pasta (often a gamble) was tender and well seasoned. Main Courses (Sharing Four-Way) For mains—again sharing among four—we chose: 1. A plate combining horse meat and fried rabbit 2. A hearty pork stew served “al forn” with a vegetable medley 3. Chicken glazed with honey The pork stew was a standout: melt-in-your-mouth pork complemented by simple roasted potatoes and seasonal veggies. The fried horse meat also surprised us—crispy exterior, tender inside, full of rich flavor. The fried rabbit, however, didn’t win everyone over; a couple of us didn’t finish our portions. The honey-glazed chicken was solid if not spectacular—my friends loved it, even if it didn’t “wow” me. Service Our servers were uniformly friendly and attentive—until the bill arrived. The man who processed our separate payments seemed noticeably put out by splitting the check (we were four and each asked to pay individually). Up until that moment he’d been perfectly cordial, so perhaps he just had a bad day. Bill Details We were a group of four and each paid €27, which felt very reasonable given the variety and quality of dishes we enjoyed. Overall Between the three pasta starters, the trio of mains, and a few sides, we left pleasantly full and satisfied. Quality and value hit the mark, with pork and horse meat dishes stealing the show. Aside from the minor hiccup at checkout and the less-than-stellar fried rabbit, this spot delivers on authentic Maltese flavors without breaking the bank. Highly recommended if you want a genuine taste of local cuisine in Valletta!

reviews.author: CD
reviews.text: We had great expectations after the strong reviews and recommendations from holiday influencers. Overall, we weren't disappointed, albeit with a blip. We ordered the Maltese platter (very good), the octopus (excellent), horse meat (good), but pan- fried rabbit dish was a letdown, with the meat rather tough. All in all, a good experience except for the rabbit. I would say that if you are less adventurous with your meats, it would be safer to stick to the Italian pizzas and pastas.

reviews.author: Despina Tzortzi
reviews.text: What a great experience! The best meal while our stay in Malta! The place was very nice and well attended. The service very good, professional, quick and with attention to detail. The food was excellent, like home cooked, the portions big and the dessert was delicious. My husband had his birthday and I asked them to surprise him with a dessert. They all showed up singing happy birthday to him!! A must try place in Valletta!!

reviews.author: Valeria Ilcheva
reviews.text: Although we didn't have a reservation, we were fortunate enough to be seated for a 1.5-hour dinner, but I’d definitely recommend making a reservation to avoid any wait. As for the food, it was fantastic! I trusted the waiter’s recommendations, and it was absolutely worth it. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. The portion sizes are perfect for one person, but if you order starters or salads, you might end up with leftovers to take home.

name: Nenu The Artisan Baker
address: Nenu The Artisan Baker, Valletta, Malta

reviews.author: Sruthi Laya
reviews.text: "5/5 stars! Exceptional dining experience at this restaurant. Delicious food, impeccable service, and a warm atmosphere. All the dishes were outstanding! Friendly staff and perfect ambiance. Highly recommend. Can't wait to return and try more of their menu!"

Starters (Pasta Trio) We shared three pastas as starters: • Spaghetti with octopus • Spaghetti with rabbit • Ravioli filled with sheep’s cheese All three were excellent—really fresh, perfectly al dente, and generously sauced. The octopus offered a nice briny bite, the sheep’s-cheese ravioli was creamy without being heavy, and even the rabbit pasta (often a gamble) was tender and well seasoned. Main Courses (Sharing Four-Way) For mains—again sharing among four—we chose: 1. A plate combining horse meat and fried rabbit 2. A hearty pork stew served “al forn” with a vegetable medley 3. Chicken glazed with honey The pork stew was a standout: melt-in-your-mouth pork complemented by simple roasted potatoes and seasonal veggies. The fried horse meat also surprised us—crispy exterior, tender inside, full of rich flavor. The fried rabbit, however, didn’t win everyone over; a couple of us didn’t finish our portions. The honey-glazed chicken was solid if not spectacular—my friends loved it, even if it didn’t “wow” me. Service Our servers were uniformly friendly and attentive—until the bill arrived. The man who processed our separate payments seemed noticeably put out by splitting the check (we were four and each asked to pay individually). Up until that moment he’d been perfectly cordial, so perhaps he just had a bad day. Bill Details We were a group of four and each paid €27, which felt very reasonable given the variety and quality of dishes we enjoyed. Overall Between the three pasta starters, the trio of mains, and a few sides, we left pleasantly full and satisfied. Quality and value hit the mark, with pork and horse meat dishes stealing the show. Aside from the minor hiccup at checkout and the less-than-stellar fried rabbit, this spot delivers on authentic Maltese flavors without breaking the bank. Highly recommended if you want a genuine taste of local cuisine in Valletta!

reviews.author: CD
reviews.text: We had great expectations after the strong reviews and recommendations from holiday influencers. Overall, we weren't disappointed, albeit with a blip. We ordered the Maltese platter (very good), the octopus (excellent), horse meat (good), but pan- fried rabbit dish was a letdown, with the meat rather tough. All in all, a good experience except for the rabbit. I would say that if you are less adventurous with your meats, it would be safer to stick to the Italian pizzas and pastas.

reviews.author: Despina Tzortzi
reviews.text: What a great experience! The best meal while our stay in Malta! The place was very nice and well attended. The service very good, professional, quick and with attention to detail. The food was excellent, like home cooked, the portions big and the dessert was delicious. My husband had his birthday and I asked them to surprise him with a dessert. They all showed up singing happy birthday to him!! A must try place in Valletta!!

reviews.author: Valeria Ilcheva
reviews.text: Although we didn't have a reservation, we were fortunate enough to be seated for a 1.5-hour dinner, but I’d definitely recommend making a reservation to avoid any wait. As for the food, it was fantastic! I trusted the waiter’s recommendations, and it was absolutely worth it. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. The portion sizes are perfect for one person, but if you order starters or salads, you might end up with leftovers to take home.

reviews.author: Monika Bruno
reviews.text: I was lucky enough to visit this restaurant. It was one of the best decisions I've made. You feel like you're in another dimension when you taste these dishes, the play of flavors, the impressive presentation, and the excellent service. Yes, the prices aren't cheap, but it's worth it. We'll definitely come back.

reviews.author: Leah Storer
reviews.text: Tonight (16 May) we dined at Noni. My mother joined us and she has significant mobility issues. The staff was incredibly accommodating of her mobility needs and food issues. They could not have been kinder and it nearly left me in tears. On top of that the food and drinks were just fantastic and I say that having been to many Michelin starred restaurants before. This was the highlight of our wonderful trip to Malta.

reviews.author: Laura Vasankari
reviews.text: Dinner at Noni was truly a dream come true to me.

reviews.author: Dimitris Garoufis
reviews.text: A basement space of special aesthetics, the staff is impeccable and the service is perfect. As for the food, my expectations were disappointed, the presentation was excellent, but the flavors were not what you would expect considering the excessively high prices you pay compared to similar restaurants.The amuse bouche, 4 in number, the 3rd in order of consumption changed the taste, which in the first 2 was excellent, to the extent that I think it altered the taste of the 4th, the Jerusalem artichoke in different styles I would say is indifferent in taste and that it did not bridge the flavors between the first and the next dish which was shrimp with lasagna, which was an interesting dish.The last dish was a type of fish that probably doesn't exist in Greece, or if it does, we're not used to tasting it like this, which had the texture of uncooked meat accompanied by a saffron sauce, which was quite intense.Fortunately, the dessert was amazing, as were the petits fours. Also, the sommelier's suggestion was excellent and was the ideal pairing for dinner.The downside was the musty smell, as well as the fact that we were not properly informed when they asked us if we would like to start with a glass of champagne, which we considered a welcome drink, while we were charged 50 euros.Total bill including tip 350 euros. Opinions are subjective, I express mine. With this money and even less we have tasted clearly superior culinary experiences and I consider it quite far from a Michelin star.

reviews.author: Atakan
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Noni, a Michelin-starred gem nestled in the heart of Valletta. Housed in a beautifully restored 400-year-old building that once served as a bakery, Noni seamlessly blends historical charm with modern elegance. ￼ Our culinary journey commenced with the Tnaqqir starter, a delightful assortment featuring fish brawn taramasalata, pekorino with fermented tomato and dates, a mazzit tart with green apple, and Maltese olives with a surprising twist. Each bite was a testament to the chef’s ingenuity, and the accompanying sourdough ftira was the perfect vessel to savor these flavors. The Jerusalem Artichokes dish was a revelation, presenting the vegetable in various textures and forms. The combination of fratell cheese, smoked pike roe, and lemon thyme elevated the dish, creating a harmonious blend that was both comforting and sophisticated. Among the standout dishes was the innovative Lasagna, where the unexpected fusion of rossi prawns, butternut squash, seaweed, and black lime oil resulted in an explosion of flavors that danced on the palate. This creative twist on a classic left a lasting impression. The Wreck Fish was another highlight, cooked to perfection with a succulent texture that elicited an “OMG” moment. Accompanied by squid, bell pepper, and a fish bone citrus sauce, the ensemble elevated the dish to new culinary heights. For the Valentine’s Day special, my gf indulged in the Aged Dry Beef Sirloin paired with king oyster mushrooms, cooked to a flawless medium-rare. I opted for the Fenkata, and without hesitation, I can declare it the finest rabbit dish I’ve experienced in Malta. The addition of truffle to both main courses added a luxurious touch, enhancing the overall experience. A pre-dessert treat, the Ta’ Vitor Orchard Citrus, provided a refreshing interlude, though it was slightly less impactful compared to the preceding courses. We also sampled the Local Artisanal Cheeses, a delightful selection that showcased regional craftsmanship. Concluding our meal, the Single Origin Chocolate dessert was a masterstroke. Balanced with passion fruit, caramel, and coconut, it offered a harmonious and satisfying end without overwhelming the senses. In summary, our experience at Noni was exceptional. The meticulous attention to detail, innovative menu, and impeccable service make it a must-visit destination for culinary enthusiasts. We eagerly anticipate our next visit to this outstanding establishment.

reviews.author: Marco Menzhausen
reviews.text: The food was absolutely amazing! We had delicious starters, followed by mouthwatering main dishes the rabbit was exceptionally amazing along with the crab soup , and two bottles of wine — a rosé and a red, both of which were exceptional. The dessert was the perfect finish to an already perfect meal. The restaurant also has a lovely patio, ideal for enjoying a cigar to wrap up the evening. The waiters were incredibly friendly, with a great sense of humor, making the experience even more enjoyable. 10/10, highly recommend for an unforgettable dining experience.

reviews.author: Mostafa Hassan
reviews.text: The staff is very decent and nice, they are very welcoming and always smiling. The food was perfect we ordered the Salmon from the main course and lobster and crab ravioli. I gave the food 4 stars because the portion of the ravioli was relatively small other than that it was perfect. Also we had canoli and cheese cake for dessert and both were delicious and off very good quality. Highly recommended if you’re in Valletta.

reviews.author: Simon Adams
reviews.text: Set in a stunning location, this restaurant is in a great spot for a date night or special occasion! The food was good, the beef cheek and crab & lobster ravioli were nice! Worth ordering. The food and wine felt a little overpriced for what it was, but still good.

reviews.author: Dennis Galante - Mr. Manhattan
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing food and service. My wife and I had a wonderful dinner with delicious local wine and very attentive service. Thank you all so much for the 10 Star experience.

reviews.author: Janet Perrin
reviews.text: I’m covered in mosquito bites. I wish the staff asked what we were celebrating. They treated us as business as usual. But service was fast. Reservation was a must. Food was tasty. The atmosphere was lovely.
