reviews.author: Alex Lewis
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible experience. We came last minute as a group of 7 for lunch, they sat us downstairs in the cellar. Really cool vibe and a nice reprieve from the heat outside. Kevin served us and recommended the rabbit for all of us. It was absolutely phenomenal. Other highlights were the fried goat cheese and the calamari. Very reasonably priced and one of the best meals I’ve had. 10/10 would recommend

reviews.author: Ceci D
reviews.text: We came as a highly rated recommendation from a friend and this truly surpassed our expectations. Kevin and Conrad were also super friendly! The risotto made sure that we have to find ourselves back in Malta very soon.

reviews.author: Georgia P
reviews.text: We had very high expectations of this place as everyone was recommending it and also because of being mentioned in the Michelin guide. If it wasn’t for all the hype, it would’ve probably been a 4 star meal, but in the given circumstances can only offer 3. We had a table at the lowest level and our waiter really pushed our chairs in the corner saying there’s not much room for him to walk by, totally understandable however he could’ve been more polite. Food was good but not excellent, the best part was the rabbit and the side of roasted potatoes and vegetables.

reviews.author: Piotr Daniel
reviews.text: We were hoping for a nice evening with the traditional Maltese cuisine at Rubino - basing our expectations on Michelin Bib award and good reviews all around internet. While the beginning of our experience was quite nice and the pumpkin soup was really tasteful the latter part ruined everything. We decided to go with rabbit and a lamb shack (which was dish of the day apparently). Though rabbit was overcooked it has quite okay taste. We cannot say the same for the lamb shack, it was basically tasteless, consisted of bone with a loads of lamb fat with barely any meat… it was terrible to say the least. But the best part was the bill… not only they added the 1.2€ pp to our bill for the bread and subpar humus (which as waiter told us ought to be „on house”) but we were so underwhelmed when we saw the price of lamb shack - 35€. Unacceptable. We paid, left confused and disappointed. Never coming back and would advise anyone to not visit that place.

reviews.author: Atakan
reviews.text: Dining at Rubino in Valletta was a memorable experience, offering a taste of authentic Maltese and Italian flavors in a charming, historic setting. The menu focuses on fresh, seasonal ingredients, and we were excited to try their renowned dishes. The highlight of our meal was undoubtedly the Fenek Moqli (traditional Maltese fried rabbit) and the calamari plate—both were perfectly cooked, flavorful, and truly showcased the restaurant’s expertise. The side of roasted potatoes and vegetables complemented the dishes beautifully, adding a rustic and comforting touch. The service was friendly but felt a bit rushed at times, which took away slightly from the relaxed dining experience. That said, the atmosphere at Rubino is warm and nostalgic, making it a great place for a cozy meal in Valletta. With a few small improvements in pacing and consistency, it could be a 5-star experience! Would definitely return for the rabbit and calamari.

reviews.author: Nicole Xu
reviews.text: The food is amazing and it tells a story of Valletta. It is flavourful and interesting. The staff is very friendly and attentive. They take pride in the fact that everything is made fresh. At the end of the meal we were given some delicious passion fruit jelly, and when the waiter knew I love it (as I asked if they sell them as well), he brought us another two pieces. Small gestures but very memorable

reviews.author: David P
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our evening here. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, and the setting was lovely. We had 2 courses each plus, the complimentary bread and amuse bouche. All the food was nicely presented and delicious. At the end of the meal I mentioned that we would have liked to have tried the tasting menu but we had been so disappointed with the tasting menu at the 1 star Michelin the previous night, that it put us off. She then showed us some photos of their dishes, and they all looked great. The chocolate desert was 100 times better than the one we had the night before. Definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Moira-Anne S
reviews.text: Do Not Miss a Meal here! We kept our expectations low but were blown away by the outstanding meal each had. The pictures here looked great which helped us decide to choose THC. The staff were outstanding. We asked for David the chef to come say ‚hello‘ and he managed to slip out to let us praise him. Highly recommend THC.

reviews.author: Connie “Naturegirl”
reviews.text: I dined alone, on a solo holiday, at this lovely little place. They set me up at the window with a view, as requested, because it was too windy outside. It was one of the best dining experiences I have had. I was there for 2.5 hours, having the 7 course tasting menu, paied with wines for each course. Stellar! Each course came with a little description card as they were named after a street in Valletta. The card gave a little history of the street the food was named after. I was so excited for the risotto, I forgot to take a picture! Maria snuck my camera into the kitchen and took a picture of one the chef was preparing! Sorry Chef, for invading your creative space! I highly recommend this restaurant. It has a great atmosphere, great food and very friendly and helpful staff. Bravo Harbour Club! And thank you.

reviews.author: CELEVIS
reviews.text: The experience was very fun! It is not only about eating but also experiencing different flavours, they give you some free entries. The dessert was wonderful. The only thing, I expected more history in between the dishes, as it was mentioned each one represented a part of history of Malta. But I would come back again.

reviews.author: Alina G
reviews.text: One of the best meals I had during my week in Malta – seriously unforgettable. We started with the octopus carpaccio and it was absolutely incredible: fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. For the main course, I picked a red grouper straight from the fish display – they baked it in the oven and served it with vegetables and potatoes. Everything was perfectly cooked and full of The restaurant has a terrace just across the road, right on the seafront, and the view is fantastic, especially at sunset. You can make a reservation (which is a good idea), but we got lucky – they asked us to come back in 20 minutes and a table had freed up by then. Totally worth the short wait. Would 100% go back!

reviews.author: Maciej Gotkowski
reviews.text: What a joy! If you ever visit this harbor and you see those beautiful boats, you probably are going to be overwhelmed by number of restaurants. Don’t worry. Just go straight to the Roots and you will get delicious food in reasonable prices. Extraordinary wine selection and delicious pasta makes this restaurant special! Service was professional and fast.

reviews.author: Vojtěch Novotný
reviews.text: Nice restaurant in a harbor with a sea view. The octopus carpaccio was splendid, seafood pasta was okay but not in any way special, oyster was fine as it should be. Too many flies outside were spoiling the experience a bit. Overall fine

reviews.author: Bianca Dobie
reviews.text: Lovely place to enjoy your dinner. We ordered the deep fried calamari and octopus with garlic. Both amazing .

reviews.author: Karol G
reviews.text: Great fresh fish. For starter we took fried calamari and for main dish a whole sea bass and a fillet of sea bream. Everything was perfect including bread at the beginning and sides (french fries, potatoes and salad) and also a great service. Prices are quite low for what you get. I recommend this place!

reviews.author: Mark Borg
reviews.text: I was desperately searching for a property in Malta. There are few websites which provide information about few apartments in Malta. However, I found Ta Dernis is the market leader in this niche. They have listed top notch properties available in Malta. The owner is very helpful and gave me full insight of each property which were selected by me. I am very happy with their service and I will definitely recommend this company.

reviews.author: John Williams
reviews.text: I was looking for maisonette in Qawra, Malta. As I own 3 cars, I also had a requirement of a big garage space. My wife had separate requirement of open terrace, pool and wardrobe. It was kind of hard for me to find a perfect property with so many custom requirements. I saw an ad in Facebook and contacted Ta Dernis Properties. They told me that they will call back after 30 minutes. Yes, when they called back, I was very happy to know that they are currently in process of building a property which is fulfilling all my specifications. Rests of the processes were extremely smooth and hassle free. I thank Ta dernis team for excellent support and wide choice of properties.

reviews.author: Antoinette Aquilina
reviews.text: After 3 years of the promise of sale the work didn't start yet. Unbelievable

reviews.author: Joseph Chetcuti
reviews.text: Various buildings for sale

reviews.author: Rebecca Tabone
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Eren Der
reviews.text: I have been here several times 4-5 years ago. A great atmosphere where you can see football clubs' scarves around you. Whatever we ordered to drink, waiters brought us free food along with drinks. Fried chicken wings were too delicious. Thanks for good feelings.

reviews.author: Wojtek Gidzinski
reviews.text: Used to come here frequently years ago and recently returned on a short visit back to Malta. This is a great local bar with good vibes and friendly staff. They serve free random tapas/nibbles when you order drinks so it's always a nice surprise treat to get something tasty to nibble on.

reviews.author: Matteo Fontani
reviews.text: I went to the pub to watch the Fiorentina-Atalanta match today. When I got there they had the MTV channel on, but when I asked them if it was possible to watch the match they very kindly put it on for me. I ordered a beer and sat at the table. A few minutes later they served me some free nibbles which were delicious. I highly recommend this pub!

reviews.author: Lawrence Civelli
reviews.text: Best pub on the rock, with great owner Omar, amazing staff Mario, Sandra, Martha, Radieh and Chef Ali these guys are Super friiendly and free flowing apitizers all night .. been coming here for decades keep on coming and I highly recommand it to come ❤️🍺🍺🍺🍺

reviews.author: Draga Inn
reviews.text: One super pub in Malta! Originally decorated, with a couple of large TVs for watching football. The right place for socializing, but also excellent food. With drink you get a plate of snacks, and the food is also excellent. This time a cheeseburger, fresh and delicious. Super friendly staff, pub really worth visiting.

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.text: This little gem is a must! The food is great, prices are reasonable, the location is superb, and Milan (the owner) and his staff are simply some of the nicest and most accommodating people I have ever had the pleasure of meeting! Highly recommended! Peter.

reviews.author: Kira Felix
reviews.text: My husband and I ate almost everything on the menu over 6 days! Everything was fresh, flavorful and served with a smile. This is the best place to eat in Ada Bojana without a doubt! Some of our favorites were the mixed seafood grill, the fish soup, the sea bream, sea bass and the octopus salad. There’s a reason we didn’t go anywhere else for our entire holiday… the food here is simply the best you can get and the servers made us feel like friends, not just customers. Great selection of wines to pair with the food and the atmosphere was so peaceful. I highly recommend Cickova Carda.

reviews.author: Dolly J. Jackson
reviews.text: Wonderful dining experience on the banks of Ada Bojana. Server was very attentive and made excellent recommendations. We started with seafood soup which was a well-seasoned tomato base. Followed up with grilled octopus stuffed with shrimp. I would return just for this dish. The octopus was incredibly tender and came with an herb dipping sauce and lemon. Freshly made Greek salad was our side. We had a full bottle of local white wine and a bottle of sparkling water. We stayed to watch the sunset on a very uncrowded beach.

reviews.author: Hava View
reviews.text: Looking for a cool "fishing boat" - like restaurant? Well, that's the place! Many type of dishes options (fish, salads, meat and even cheese!) We had fun. Gave the place 4 out 5 stars just because of the so many mosquitoes. Make sure to wear long sleeves. I know, it's outside, but there were no repellants or any way to deal with them. If you have no problem with it, then you are going to have so much fun!

reviews.author: Bojana Simic
reviews.text: Everything was perfect! Service, food, ambience. Highly recommend fish dish that I’ve had. One of best ever I’ve had.

reviews.author: Yulia Graßhoff
reviews.text: One of my culinary highlights during the 2-week vacation in Montenegro! The restaurant is located in a beautiful part of Stari Bar just in front of the fortress, with a nice thought through interior, very friendly service and excellent food and at the same time absolutely not overpriced like in other cities of the country. I can recommend the degustation platters (both vegetarian and mixed platters were great). We had lunch and dinner there and to be honest, I could eat there every day. Thanks for the great experience! The restaurant itself does not sell alcohol, but they can get you anything from a restaurant nearby so if you fancy a wine or a beer, no problem at all.

reviews.author: Isa
reviews.text: We were drawn by the amazing rooftop terrace overlooking the stunning old town, but we ended up being mostly amazed by the quality of their food. After 2,5 weeks of eating out in Montenegro, we can say that this was by far the best one. The vegetarian platter is amazing, but so is their multi-course of meats and vegetables. We ate some things that we didn't come across anywhere else. Even though they don't serve alcoholic drinks (although they are willing to get it for you if you want), they make some delicious virgin cocktails and other highly refreshing drinks. Truly a must-eat restaurant in Stari Bar!

reviews.author: Alik
reviews.text: The establishment offers exceptional cuisine, complemented by attentive service. The menu features traditional Montenegrin dishes, expertly prepared and presented. It appears the establishment may adhere to Halal dietary guidelines, as pork and alcohol are absent from the menu. Verification of this is recommended.

reviews.author: Līga Stutāne
reviews.text: So happy with our choice from many many restaurants in the area. Tasty refreshing cocktail, pomegranate beer, and tasty light lunch with local salads and home baked bread.

reviews.author: Rafaela Perez
reviews.text: I had a very pleasant lunch at Kaldrma, both food and service were amazing. I also enjoyed their ambience, the price was fair.

reviews.author: James King
reviews.text: Proper old school restaurant. Food was delicious and the waiter was absolutely A1. Don’t come here if you want fast food - it is a place to relax, sit in the sun and enjoy life. The cats are also awesome.

reviews.author: Martin Ruzicka
reviews.text: Perfect restaurant in Bar. Food and service was No1 👌 We parked the car just one minute walk from the restaurant. The restaurant's terrace is basically located in the park. The waiter was very professional and nice. In addition to the food, we also enjoyed a very pleasant atmosphere. We definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Ekaterina Vorobets
reviews.text: The restaurant has a great location, literally in the old royal garden, which is always shady, tranquil, and green. The food and wine were delicious, though I didn't like apple charlotte (just not to my liking, it goes without ice cream by default, but you can order it additionally). The waiter was extremely polite. Now, the things I didn't like: 1. We celebrated my birthday here and asked the waiter whether they offer something with this regard (some restaurants offer a piece of cake or a discount). He said that he needed to ask the owner, but we never got any answer. 2. Some cutlery items were dirty, which is unacceptable for such a place. 3. We didn't get a wine card and a menu for non-alcoholic drinks. The waiter just proposed some options orally. We didn't know beforehand how much we had to pay. 4. The toilet was in poor condition (broken cabinet under the sink, cobweb on the chandelier, and mold on the ceiling)

reviews.author: Manu
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dinner in this beautiful location. Everything was perfect 😊

reviews.author: Trinity Lugros
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant, so much so that we came back a second time! The food was tasty and well presented. A big thank you to Stefan, who was very kind and made us feel welcome. Definitely a place we’d recommend!

reviews.author: Admir Muric
reviews.text: The best food and pizzas in one place. Always good and fresh food.

reviews.author: Balzhan Murza
reviews.text: That was bad experience, acting like a racist. But it’s a common thing for them. Bread was normal, nothing else

reviews.author: Sander Hogendoorn
reviews.text: Burek with meat was very good. With cheese little less. Was only 8 euros for an entire Burek, good price.

reviews.author: Dm. M
reviews.text: Tasty, wide choice. I like it.

reviews.author: tratz
reviews.text: Really good food and cheap

reviews.author: Eris Pejtamalli
reviews.text: The place was kinda ok. Located near the center of Bar. The service was very good. The food was not great and not bad. The atmosphere was very crowded and noisy. I don't recommend if you are looking for a quiet place.

reviews.author: Travel & Food
reviews.text: Pizza Pub Pulena is located near all famous and touristic attractions in the Bar. It is great spot not just for having pizza, it is definitely one of the best options for having a breakfast in the city. Portions are big and very delicious. Staff is very kind. I would definitely recommend this place and visit it again.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: One of the best places to eat in this area, it NEVER disappoints! We’ve been on vacation here the last 2 summers and this is our go to place every week (sometimes multiple times) The best place for pizza and beer! Amazing service every time!

reviews.author: MAR BOY
reviews.text: Pulena is a good choice for pizza and other Italian food. Not recommended for calamari at any version. My calamari portion was without taste,very poor dish.Other dishes are much better.

reviews.author: Asya Bobukh
reviews.text: Great friendly service, huge portions, delicious food! 😋😋😋 And very good prices. Just be careful with cream sauces - they put a lot in pasta 😅

reviews.author: Aditya Malik
reviews.text: Good restaurant right by the water with great views. The food on this entire boardwalk is pretty mid but at least it's all clean ingredients and healthy. It is pricey but that's a given due to the location. Our waiter was great and funny, and deboned the fish which was very nice.

reviews.author: Jasmeet Singh
reviews.text: I had a wonderful dining experience at Jadran, perfectly located right by the beach with absolutely stunning sea views. The atmosphere is relaxed, and you can enjoy your meal while watching the waves and soaking in the beautiful surroundings. The highlight of this place is definitely their seafood — everything we tried was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. From the grilled fish to the seafood platter, each dish truly showcased the quality and taste of the Adriatic. The staff was friendly, attentive, and happy to make recommendations. If you’re looking for a spot to enjoy delicious seafood with a breathtaking view, Jadran is definitely worth visiting.

reviews.author: Karolina Ristovska
reviews.text: Overall, a good experience! I really appreciated the fast service and the strong sense of national and traditional atmosphere in the restaurant. The food came out very quickly, which was a pleasant surprise. We had to wait in line to be seated, but that’s understandable considering how full the place was. The food itself was okay—not exceptional, but definitely worth the visit if you want to enjoy the local, traditional Montenegrin vibe. I’d recommend it for the experience!

reviews.author: İsidora
reviews.text: Jadran in Budva is known as the best seafood restaurant in the city, but it definitely doesn’t live up to that reputation anymore. We had a risotto with barely any seafood, and the mussels weren’t properly cooked. Nothing tasted particularly good. While it may have been good once, it’s no longer worth it. The service is good though.

reviews.author: missy temi.
reviews.text: The food was so yummy. The fish was very fresh and lightly seasoned. The fries were fried well and delicious. Would totally recommend. Great sea view too. I got the seafood platter for two people. Me and my friend couldn’t even finish the food. It was a lot. Great value for money. The platter cost about €60. We split the bill, making it €30 each.

reviews.author: Aditya Malik
reviews.text: Good restaurant right by the water with great views. The food on this entire boardwalk is pretty mid but at least it's all clean ingredients and healthy. It is pricey but that's a given due to the location. Our waiter was great and funny, and deboned the fish which was very nice.

reviews.author: Jasmeet Singh
reviews.text: I had a wonderful dining experience at Jadran, perfectly located right by the beach with absolutely stunning sea views. The atmosphere is relaxed, and you can enjoy your meal while watching the waves and soaking in the beautiful surroundings. The highlight of this place is definitely their seafood — everything we tried was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. From the grilled fish to the seafood platter, each dish truly showcased the quality and taste of the Adriatic. The staff was friendly, attentive, and happy to make recommendations. If you’re looking for a spot to enjoy delicious seafood with a breathtaking view, Jadran is definitely worth visiting.

reviews.author: Karolina Ristovska
reviews.text: Overall, a good experience! I really appreciated the fast service and the strong sense of national and traditional atmosphere in the restaurant. The food came out very quickly, which was a pleasant surprise. We had to wait in line to be seated, but that’s understandable considering how full the place was. The food itself was okay—not exceptional, but definitely worth the visit if you want to enjoy the local, traditional Montenegrin vibe. I’d recommend it for the experience!

reviews.author: İsidora
reviews.text: Jadran in Budva is known as the best seafood restaurant in the city, but it definitely doesn’t live up to that reputation anymore. We had a risotto with barely any seafood, and the mussels weren’t properly cooked. Nothing tasted particularly good. While it may have been good once, it’s no longer worth it. The service is good though.

reviews.author: missy temi.
reviews.text: The food was so yummy. The fish was very fresh and lightly seasoned. The fries were fried well and delicious. Would totally recommend. Great sea view too. I got the seafood platter for two people. Me and my friend couldn’t even finish the food. It was a lot. Great value for money. The platter cost about €60. We split the bill, making it €30 each.

reviews.author: Antti Seppälä
reviews.text: A great restaurant with cosy atmosphere, friendly staff and tasty local food. We have been there already twice during our holiday and there will definitely be more visits. It is a good idea to reserve a table during the peak hours since Konoba Bocun seems to be very popular.

reviews.author: Fıratcan Kervan
reviews.text: Konoba Bocun was a fantastic dining experience from start to finish. We ordered the ćevapi and schnitzel — both were full of flavor and cooked perfectly. The portions were just right, and everything was served hot and fresh. What really stood out to us was the service. Our waiter was incredibly kind and professional. He spoke multiple languages and took the time to explain the menu, which made everything so much easier and more enjoyable. He made us feel truly welcome and well taken care of. The restaurant itself has a cozy and friendly atmosphere, perfect for a relaxed meal. It’s clear that they put a lot of care into both the food and the overall experience. We left with full stomachs and happy hearts. Definitely a place we’d return to and recommend to others!

reviews.author: Ирина Брун
reviews.text: One of the best places I’ve been to in Montenegro. Very tasty food, I especially liked paprika (half eaten on the photo) and chicken breast. Very reasonable prices too. Food was prepared quickly. Music was very pleasant and not too loud. But my heart goes to the owners, who run this place. Mom cooks homemade baklava, son serves at the restaurant, granddad makes wine. 10/10 recommend to visit this place

reviews.author: EMILIIA G
reviews.text: Incredibly caring and helpful waiter Dejan, speaks several languages, very polite! We ate risotto with seafood, cevapi, pljeskavica, grilled vegetables - everything was very tasty! Also really liked the tea with honey and lemon. If you wish, you can order food to go.

reviews.author: Rethik
reviews.text: Really great restaurant serving Montenegrin cuisine where the locals seem to hang out. It was raining heavily and I was soaked when I entered but the owner warmly welcomed me and offered to sit me near the fireplace and hang my coat so that it can dry while I eat. Goulash was unfortunately not available at lunchtime (suggested to go early if you want goulash) so got the Plijeskavica instead. Meat was juicy and tasty but the portion is really filling for one person. There’s a restroom in the restaurant which was clean and easy to use. Overall a good experience and would definitely recommend if you’re in Budva

reviews.author: Marija Rasic
reviews.text: Great place to have a drink or very nice meal in the heart of the Old city castle and next to the sea. One of the best place to enjoy sunsets in Budva. Next to the place is local beach so kids can play while you enjoy your coffee.

reviews.author: Kath
reviews.text: Nice seafood restaurant serving Greek-inspired fare. The menu wasn’t super extensive, but you can’t go wrong with seafood and lambchops. We personally loved the cuttlefish risotto. Serving size of the food was a tad bit small though, and the prices of the drinks were just outright 😬

reviews.author: Josefiina Angerman
reviews.text: Konoba Stari Grad restaurant I had read reviews that made me want to come here to eat. We received service in fluent English. The waiter was also really friendly and nice. We ordered a fish dish for two. The waiting time didn't seem long, we received the dose in a reasonable time. The portion was large and had a suitable variety of seafood. The dish tasted really good. The only downside is that the fish was a bit too salty for me. However, overall I could recommend the fish dish and the restaurant.

reviews.author: Helen Hudymenko
reviews.text: "Stari Grad" was by far the best restaurant we have had fish and seafood at during our stay at Budvanska Rivijera. And we stayed 15 km away ;) but we came there twice ! Their fishplate -1 kg of amazing goodies like fish, shrimp, muscels, baby octopus paired with perfect risotto and Mediterranean garnish (potatoe pureè with spinage) were something to die for!!!!! Loca wine, fresh bread, amazing food, great restaurant history, cozy atmosphere , perfect service (Hvala, Dima) are something that we definitely recommend !!!! Hvala, Stari Grad 🤩👍

reviews.author: Isabella Manganelli
reviews.text: Nice restaurant on the beach. Food was pretty good. Wouldn’t suggest the calamari it was basically just batter. Everything else was delicious. Reasonable prices

reviews.author: İsidora
reviews.text: If you’re in Budva and want legit Balkan food, this place is the spot. Probably the only place open all night where you can get perfectly grilled fresh meat and warm, just-baked bread that hits the spot after partying. The BBQ here is amazing, something that’s very hard to find in Budva - juicy, packed with flavor, and always cooked just right. The service is great as well - again a rarity in Budva. You’ll usually get a little something on the house, whether it’s a starter when you sit down or a dessert at the end. Must visit for a taste of real Balkan bbq. I only have pictures of breakfast since food is too good not to immediately dig in!

reviews.author: cansu tiryaki
reviews.text: This was the first restaurant we visited during our trip to Montenegro, and we wanted to return, but unfortunately, we didn’t have the chance. Before the main course, they served complimentary cheese, salad, and delicious homemade bread. The bread was incredible. For the main course, we chose cevapi, which had large portions and was very tasty. They also offered complimentary dessert after the meal. We were very satisfied.

reviews.author: Ekaterina Kirsanova
reviews.text: Very good place for eating with good prices. Ratio of money you pay and food, service you get is fantastic. Close to the bus station. One of best pleskavica my Serbian husband had.

reviews.author: Nicholas Kalams
reviews.text: A must-visit while in Budva - authentic Balkan food at its finest. I ordered the šopska salata and the ćevapi with kajmak and both were phenomenal. I left quite full! Their house red wine is nice too.

reviews.author: Piotr Sliwka
reviews.text: Great place to eat in Budva.super professional service on the tarrace( 1 th floor)..Portions are really big, food soo tasty( nice selection of grilled food).We have been eating there nearly every day. They are open 24 h!!!!( handy for early breakfast ).Thank You Guys!Aleksandra, Piotr& Luca from Poland

reviews.author: Cobie Whitten
reviews.text: According to 2 people in our group, this was the best food they ever had ( from age 7 to 69). Started with delicious tuna pate and homemade bread. Fish platter and pasta and calamari absolutely delicious! Chocolate soufflé really really YUMMY, says the 7 year old foodie in our group. Service impeccable. We will be going again on our 4 day stay in Budva.

reviews.author: Graham Spinks
reviews.text: Another lovely restaurant in Budva. The food portions were generous and well cooked. Service friendly and efficient. We didn't order a starter but, nonetheless, we received a plate with three large scoops of fish paté, and a basket of beautiful freshly-cooked bread. We finished the paté only to be given another plate, so be warned.

reviews.author: Irene Lee
reviews.text: Unfortunately, I feel compelled to leave this review so that others are aware of what happened to us. We specifically visited Budva to dine at this restaurant, drawn by its glowing reviews. The atmosphere was lovely, the lady at the reception was very welcoming, and the food was quite decent, an overall pleasant way to spend our last evening in Montenegro. However, our experience was overshadowed by unacceptable service from our server. When the bill arrived, it was higher than expected. Upon asking for a receipt, we found that we had been charged for bread that we assumed was complimentary (it was not served to other tables), and a gratuity had been automatically added without any prior notice, either on the menu or verbally. When I raised this with the receptionist, she confirmed this was not standard practice and, shockingly, mentioned this had already happened twice that day. It was disappointing to feel taken advantage of, possibly based on assumptions about our background. As someone working in the service industry and familiar with tipping customs, I’m more than willing to tip generously when deserved—but tipping should never be forced or hidden. I’m grateful to the receptionist for her professionalism and the way she handled the situation. But I truly hope no other guest has to go through a similar experience when all they want is to enjoy a good meal.

reviews.author: jan R
reviews.text: Excellent food, freshly baked bread, fast service, beautifully decorated restaurant. I've never seen this way of serving the condiments, which was amazing as well.

reviews.author: Dave Pople
reviews.text: Four of us ate here early June 2025 The food was very good, however the service was a little bit hit and miss Had to ask for items several times before they were brought to the table The waiter did try to make a welcoming experience but it was a little bit over the top Food was the Savior. The fish we all had was exceptionally fresh Can recommend this Ripasso

reviews.author: Millen Patel
reviews.text: Very enjoyable meal. Reasonably priced drinks, food little more pricey but overall enjoyable. Our waiter was very nice, gave us good recommendations and answered any questions we had. We had the local prawns in burza sauces. Very nice

reviews.author: Donna Dooley
reviews.text: For our last meal we chose to head to Lim Restaurant along the end of the promenade. It has beautiful views, and a great selection of food. When we arrived we sat outside but up on the terrace, we were greeted by a lovely server and the owner who brought us some Rakija on the house as a welcome drink. They also offered recommendations and if you go for the fish they bring it out for you to choose or to see it which I think is very cool! We went with mussels, pork skewers, Greek salad, fries and of course a lovely apple, pastry dessert with vanilla ice cream. It was all so delicious the whole experience for us was the perfect ending to a lovely day trip on Budva. I would highly recommend everyone to take a visit here, you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Jaagup M
reviews.text: Food and service were excellent! The waiter recommended traditional Montenegron pork steak which was very tasty, it went well with the glass of house red wine as well. We also ordered a fresh salad for sharing and a chicken skewer, which I can both recommend. We even got 2 rakijas on the house! Our best restaurant experience during our trip!

reviews.author: Nattie Grande
reviews.text: Excellent place to have lunch, dinner or just to have a pleasant moment by the sea. Truly tasty and very varied dishes and very appropriate prices. Ideal to go with family or friends. But without a doubt, the best thing was Milan, the waiter, who was the one who treated us so kindly and made us feel very comfortable attending to all our requests very efficiently. I will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Bena Roberts
reviews.text: Spectacular. We had the best lunch and it was so fresh and delicious. I highly recommend! The fish says 1kg. But it goes on weight and my 400 gram Sea Bass was perfect.

name: Street Stall - Old Town
address: Street Stall - Old Town, Budva, Montenegro

reviews.author: Sarah Lazzari
reviews.text: Rhodes is such a beautiful city. Would definitely recommend visiting!

reviews.author: Isac Dos Santos Junior
reviews.text: One place everyone should have a chance to visit. Beautiful, iconic, historical.

reviews.author: terike
reviews.text: The Old Town and tip of the peninsula is where all the amazing sites and history are, incredible place.

reviews.author: taylan acar
reviews.text: The trees and cafes are amazing. Historical sites are great. The beaches are top notch. Find a ticket if Possible and visit.

reviews.author: Greg D
reviews.text: A magical and varied island, full of deep historical architecture and rich welcoming culture. The food and wine was excellent, whether we ate simple local food or went high end. I had very little idea how liveable it would feel, as the old town has everything one could need to be comfortable. A slower simpler pace of living is possible here, and we were lucky to have stayed with a wonderful warm family that shared home cooked delights with us. We also found it easy to travel around and go to other islands. The weather is perfect for me as it’s hot yet breezy so I would recommend it to those who also enjoy that kind of feel.

reviews.author: MJ Bold
reviews.text: We visited Old town bazaar clothes shop yesterday, a truly amazing shopping experience; not only did they pay for myself and my families free taxi transport to and from our hotel. The customer service was second to none. The shop has everything you would ever want, the best clothes, footwear, designer bags, and loads more. An enormous range of the latest styles and fashions, at reasonable prices. We were made to feel really welcome by all the staff, and even given free refreshing cooling drinks. Had our every need met, by Mehmet and his excellent very friendly, polite and professional team. There were so many highlights, during our shopping trip, the adorable cats, and the astonishing clothes choices. One of the best things is after we brought lots of clothes, we were able to leave them in the trusted hands of the shop and go off sightseeing, returning later, where the taxi driver Ali who was amazing, one of the most helpful and kind person we've ever met. Delivery them and us back to our hotel. Great value for money, we would definitely comeback again. The old town shop location itself is breathtaking and a stone throw away from the famous historical Roman Hadrian's Gate and the stunning marina.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: Was recommended by family, and boy they did not disappoint, went above and beyond, fantastic people, fantastic products, fantastic quality, can't recommend enough, buy with confidence

reviews.author: Adegoke Enirayetan
reviews.text: Oscar is a nice guy, he showed me good deals that makes sense. I will definitely come back with my friends for more amazing deals

reviews.author: Tracey CHAPPELL
reviews.text: Picked up by driver and taken to old bazaar. Beautiful shopping experience, staff very helpful and quality of goods superb... They even gave free transfer back to hotel after I'd had a look around other stores. great day

reviews.author: Brad Ingber
reviews.text: The service was absolutely amazing friendly, helpful, I was greated with a beverage of my choice! I was picked up from my hotel and drop back off, free of charge. The clothes were top quality. I was really impressed with how affordable everything was for such great material and style. It’s not often you find that perfect mix of price and quality. Thank you!

reviews.author: Avirup Basu
reviews.text: Good view of the valley and very nice decor. It is filled with tourists yet the servers won’t speak in English and gets very impatient while taking orders. We took a grilled fish which was okay and a grilled pork which was overcooked and very stiff. We waited nearly 30 minutes for the food to arrive and yet the pork was a bit cold as if not served right off the grill.

reviews.author: Tanmay Jadhav
reviews.text: Lovely location, outdoor seating and view. In addition the table service was amazing and we had no complaint with the food. The lamb is particularly brilliant! Definitely worth visiting when doing the lipa cave

reviews.author: Lana Pribic
reviews.text: Wow! There’s really nothing to complain about. Food? Delicious, organic, traditional. Views? Can’t be beat. Service? Warm, sweet and every need taken care of with Montenegrin charm. We ordered the salad and meze platter to start, and traditional cast iron cooked veal and lamb. From the tomatoes and cabbage salad to the bread and the mains, everything was mouthwatering, fresh and homemade. I’ve never had better meat and potatoes ever (and I’m Balkan). And of course, the plum palacinke for dessert (don’t miss this). This is a very special dining experience!

reviews.author: Liliane Correia modesto
reviews.text: What a beautiful place! The food is well served and appetizing. We were very well attended to, I recommend it.

reviews.author: snow ttk
reviews.text: We had lunch with breathtaking view. The restaurant can give fantastic food and lovely view. We ordered Belveder special for 2. The portion is so generous. We could not finish. Individual item , meat, veggies and cheese are super tasty. We recommend to visit and enjoy your meal. The parking is beside and free.

reviews.author: Miles Macdonald
reviews.text: I recommend this place 100%, I was on a day trip to Cetinje, I only wish I was staying several days so I could eat here again. Excellent Montenegran cuisine at reasonable prices. As another reviewers mentioned, you'd pay much more in the popular coastal destinations. I know I've paid more for less interesting Kotor & Budva.

reviews.author: Vladimir Kardapoltsev
reviews.text: Konoba Korzo has everything you’d expect from a traditional Montenegrin tavern. Located right on Dvorski Square, it offers a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. The prices are incredibly reasonable—on the coast, you’d easily pay twice as much for the same meal. We had two soups, a pizza, and two beers, all for under 15 euros, which is fantastic value. The hostess was very attentive, making sure we had everything we needed. The interior is a bit dated, but the great food and fair prices more than make up for it. If you're in Cetinje and looking for a good meal without breaking the bank, this is a solid choice!

reviews.author: Mary Kirpa
reviews.text: Tasty and cozy. I visited this tavern for the second time to try interesting dishes from the menu.Portions are large and generous.

reviews.author: Nessi Gileva
reviews.text: My favorite restaurant for lunch in Cetinje. I ate several times in this place! Always fresh, tasty food and huge dishes! Also very good prices 😋

reviews.author: K P
reviews.text: Very nice local breakfast with quality ingredients and world class home made bread. Absolutely fantastic service. Greatings for grandma and the rest off the stuff. 😁😃

reviews.author: Trung Lê
reviews.text: Finally a restaurant that I could truly enjoy in Montenegro. After spending new days in Budva with horribly expensive and bad food, I am glad that I found this small restaurant. The food is very delicious, super affordable and large in size. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Константин Тарасов
reviews.text: The food was very tasty, and the prices were reasonable. The staff was polite and attentive, which made the experience pleasant overall. While the restaurant itself isn’t particularly stylish or atmospheric, the quality of the food and service more than made up for it. A solid choice if you’re looking for good food without paying for fancy decor.

reviews.author: Dmitrij
reviews.text: Very nice place! Portions are big prepare for take out! Prices are good! Definitely recommend

reviews.author: Srdjan Dakic
reviews.text: Huge portions, delicious meals. Local meat dishes are great, but also see food is fantastic. No such restaurant near by.

reviews.author: Tom Holder
reviews.text: Best food we had in Cetinje. Be warned, the portions are LARGE, and the ratio of meat to side was perhaps a little too meaty. The staff were lovely, and helped us choose some dishes. The price was affordable.

reviews.author: Merve Gurkan Gmail
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars I would. We’ve stopped by this place to try a local shop on our way down to Podgorica. This was the most disgusting pekara shop I’ve ever seen in the trip, it looked like it hasn’t been cleaned in the last 10 years! There were two really unfriendly women just staring at us not entirely sure why we were there. We’ve left without sitting, the reviews here must be from their neighbours or something like that as it is entirely wrong.

reviews.author: Jakub Pawełczak
reviews.text: Not cooked food

reviews.author: Nicolas Maclot
reviews.text: We stopped there for lunch. The waitress was very understanding and made herself available to us. The owner was happy to speak French with us and recommended some places to visit. Thank you for your warm welcome.

reviews.author: Jeanne Caillaux
reviews.text: Delicious pizzas! The prices are more than reasonable, 4 euros for a huge pizza. The staff is very pleasant ;)

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.text: Very tasty burek, great prices, and card payments accepted. We'll be back! 😉

reviews.author: Palu Szek
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my meal here! The place is huge, with lots of room not just for dining but also for business meetings and private parties. The food was really tasty. Compliments to the chef, who really knows how to take care of the guests' taste buds. Plus, there’s a terrace that overlooks the bay, which means you get to enjoy fantastic food with a stunning view. What more could you ask for?

reviews.author: Lara Bozic
reviews.text: Good for a lunch and dinner, nice view, they are quite fast with bringing food and drinks, recepit aswell. Food is good, nothing special, waiter is not really dedicated to you the whole time (pouring the water for you, asking if anything is missing, etc.), most of the times he is chatting with other (5-6) waitres.

reviews.author: Aleksandar Čelebić
reviews.text: We had fish on the menu, everything was done to perfection, visually wonderful and very tasty. Gratitude to the chef and waiting staff. The place is ideal for enjoying food and drinks with a beautiful view of Herceg Novi bay.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.text: What a disaster. We opted to sit on the terrace, it was a wonderful view. Sadly many areas were neglected and in disrepair. The restaurant was huge, many tables inside and on the terrace, but the whole place needs a refurbishment, it’s very tired and dated. Not sure if it ever gets full. Service was slow and it didn’t help that the staff were preoccupied organising party balloons. Salad and drinks were served and then it started to rain. Staff were more concerned about moving furniture inside so it didn’t get wet, they ignored the few diners that were eating there. We moved ourselves to a dry covered area. Very poor service. The food was terrible, we left most of it. Prices were okay. Not recommended

reviews.author: Bobby Wen
reviews.text: We booked this place for our wedding, and they were the most amazing hosts we could have imagined. 1. The venue is the best in montenegro 2. The food was amazing, the open bar was amazing 3. Most of all, all of our guests kept telling us how brilliant the service was. The servers and hosts were attentive, on point, helpful, and beyond anything we could have imagined. They helped to make this one of the most wonderful nights beyond what we could have dreamed of If you are looking for a wedding destination, look no further!

reviews.author: Gemma B
reviews.text: Went for dinner with dinner and the food was great. The staff were quick and polite. Smoked salmon starter and bread was good size and fresh served with garlic butter and salad. The steak was cooked to request and came with vegetables and gnocchi. The spaghetti shrimp was also very tasty.

reviews.author: Inka
reviews.text: We came here for my brother's birthday dinner. The drinks were great, we had red and white wine the waiter recommended, a local beer and an aperol spritz. For starters, we shared shopska salads and a Greek salad. Shopska salad was a bit underwhelming as it only had tomato and cheese, but the Greek salad tasted very good. For main dishes, we had a seafood spaghetti, a seafood risotto, chicken with peanuts, and a beefstake in mushroom sauce. The nuts were a bit weird with the chicken, but otherwise, everything tasted amazing. The portion sizes were huge though; we wouldn't have needed the starters to feel full. Our server was wonderful and asked us about the Finnish language and coversed with us. If you have a pet allergy, I wouldn't recommend the place since the bosses dog sleeps under the tables and a cat wonders around there as well.

reviews.author: Rax Veloso
reviews.text: The best seafood in the Adriatic! We had an unforgettable dining experience here. The seafood was incredibly fresh, perfectly cooked, and bursting with flavour — truly the best we’ve had along the Adriatic coast! Special thanks to our server, Novica, who was warm, attentive, and made us feel right at home. The atmosphere was relaxed yet elegant, and every dish was a delight. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the area!

reviews.author: Emily Jundi
reviews.text: Some of the best seafood I've had in Montenegro. We ordered the fish soup, and 2 meals. The grilled octopus was delicious, great friendly service and the view by the water was perfect for our date night out. Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Stuart Wilson
reviews.text: An absolutely fantastic venue. The food was amazing. I'm 60 and I can honestly say that I have never had such a tasty beef steak in my life. It was cooked to perfection. There was no fat, only lean meat. The vegetable accompaniments were perfect. I had a cream of nettle soup which was absolutely delicious. I would highly recommend it. My wife had a salmon salad as a starter which had a beautiful lemon dressing. Her main course was an excellent gorgonzola tagliatelle. We shared a generous dandelion salad. The portions were very generous. The service was excellent. One tip, book in advance. We saw lots of disappointed people turned away.

reviews.author: Koen Grégoir
reviews.text: We had with the 5 of us 2 fantastic diners. The location on the peer is superb! The scenery cannot be improved. We were a little annoyed by the mixed music from different places. The food was very nice, so good we wanted to go back a second time. We very much appreciated the meet&greet with the owner, Alexandra, who took the time to not only find out our impressions of the restaurant , she was also interested in our story. We also very much appreciated the service by Vladimir, who 3 days after our first visit still 100% correctly remembered our meals and drinks. Impressive. A strong recommendation from the Grégoir family from Belgium!

reviews.author: Bassel zeid
reviews.text: The food was incredibly fresh and cooked very well. All the grilled seafood was not overcooked and dry. They have a good variety in the menu serving both meat and seafood options. Prices are fair, a bit on the higher side but not ridiculous.The staff are really friendly and nice. The whole atmosphere and view are incredible. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: Pedro Gonçalves
reviews.text: Delicious food. Had the best waiter service in Montenegro. As he said, quoting "I am from Yugoslavia". The location is premium and if you manage to get the tables next to the beach, the meal will be even more special (with the sunset). Price wise is expensive but given food quality, offer, service and location, some can say that it is fair.

reviews.author: Jagoda Krzciuk
reviews.text: We had the best risotto ever here! It was incredibly smooth and delicate, instantly earning the title of my ultimate comfort food. I highly recommend this place—not only for the amazing food but also for its phenomenal atmosphere. The wooden pier interior, surrounded by the sea, creates a truly unforgettable dining experience.

reviews.author: Nika
reviews.text: First time eating octopus, and it was excellent and delicious and tasty, the atmosphere was so quiet with beautiful views, the location is comfortable and view are perfect, pļjeskavicka was tasty, soft delicious. And at the end I decided to eat tiramisu, this was the best tiramisu I’ve ever eaten in my life I LOVE IT

reviews.author: Arina Vetoshkina
reviews.text: very good pastry!! and super kind staff. would be good if you add card payment 🙌🏼

reviews.author: Nemanja Mrva
reviews.text: Besf burek in whole town, and as well all other food is amazing and worth trying

reviews.author: Yakov Pyatnitskov
reviews.text: Fresh bread and a good selection of pastry. Try spinach kish and whole grain bread, it’s yummy!

reviews.author: Petar Obrenovic
reviews.text: Try mantije!!! Elderflower juice in a plastic cup brought me back to childhood.

reviews.author: Konrad Hughes
reviews.text: Delicious pastries 😋

reviews.author: Ekaterina Samarina
reviews.text: Very nice place where you want to come back! Big portions, delicious food, great service. You can speak English or Russian - you'll have a nice small talk anyway. I can recommend both: fish and meat hear. Five stars no doubt

reviews.author: Maja D
reviews.text: For sure this is a place you wanna eat at while at Herceg Novi, they have the best chef very dedicated and the freshest food made right in front of you. I’ve been customer so many years, never disappointing experience. Waiters are fun and accommodating

reviews.author: Steve Barraclough
reviews.text: Had a great meal here with my Wife. The steak I had and the sea bass my Wife had were amazing. Service was excellent. A must visit.

reviews.author: Mariia Sosnina
reviews.text: A great option for a local restaurant at the foot of the Old Town. While the prices aren’t low, the food was excellent. We ordered the kobasica and the gourmet pljeskavica. The portions were huge. Everything came out hot and fast. The kobasica was perfectly grilled and very juicy. The pljeskavica had spicy paprika, but we actually really liked it. We also had a Greek salad — fresh and tasty with large chunks of delicious cheese — and two draft beers. The total was €37 plus tip.

reviews.author: alexa
reviews.text: maybe i ordered the wrong dishes but the food here was absolute garbage. we ordered the seafood pasta and the seafood risotto - everything was overcooked! the pasta was limp and soft, the risotto rice was clumped up, and the seafood did not taste fresh at all. the cherry on top is that they were clearly understaffed so we had to wait ages to get our order taken, to get our food, and to get the cheque.

reviews.author: Princess Chua
reviews.text: One of my favorite vacation place. From receptionist to rooms to restaurant they are always kind and helpful. Perfect place to spend vacation and pampered. The pool is so nice! The jacuzzi, spa and sauna is so nice and the way on everything is very easy and will never get lost. Bianca hotel is very clean and great value. Perfect for summer and winter time.

reviews.author: Hanita Melamed
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, very kind staff. We arrived with a baby and the hotel staff did everything to make it as easy as possible for us. The pool and spa are well-equipped with a sauna and Turkish hamam. Good food. Great rooms, very net and clean. A vacation of the highest level. We thank them very much for your hospitality and highly recommend them to all those seeking a great vication.

reviews.author: Yehuda
reviews.text: A good quality hotel, clean and well-equipped rooms, but unfortunately the curtains are not wide enough and in the morning the curtains do not allow for blocking out the sunlight (another 10 centimeters on each side would have solved the problem). Breakfast and dinner are varied and of a good standard. We asked for a jug of water at dinner and were told that they did not give us water but that we had to purchase a bottle!!!!! We explained that we were only asking for a glass of water from the tap to take medication. They emphasized again that only by purchasing a bottle... shame shame shame!!!

reviews.author: Hala Madrid
reviews.text: I give these hotel a 4⭐️ review because it needs renovation but overall it was a very good hotel to spend your winter holidays because it had:jacuzzi,indoor kids swimming pool,indoor swimming pool,outdoor swimming pool,good heat air conditioning,kids playground,large outdoor playground,gym,mini outdoor gym and a large parking.

reviews.author: Miroslav Kovacevic
reviews.text: Hotel is two minutes walk to central walking street of Kolasin, we was in winter time ant it was like a fairy tail 🤩 In swimming pool was warm and pool is big and good . Sauna is separated for man and woman ( not as we like ) Room is normal size and it was warm in it. We recommend it 👌✅

reviews.author: re piola
reviews.text: Hands down the best restaurant I’ve been during my stay in Montenegro. The food was excellent in large quantity, the place was well decorated and the service was very efficient. Be aware they only accept cash.

reviews.author: Kaveh Saffari
reviews.text: This local restaurant is simply a symbol of the beautiful region & it's cousine... I believe it's a family run restaurant since I happened to see a very sweet older lady in the kitchen & later she came out to check on us & the food that was served... Very lovely people along with delicious authentic food...

reviews.author: Nadya Genova
reviews.text: The best cappuccino and fish I have tried in Montenegro. Very tasty food with affordable prices. The atmosphere is very nice. It was so good - we came back in the morning for breakfast and coffee. The priganice is a must for breakfast, but keep in mind it is a huge portion and absolutely enough for 2 people.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: All was very tasty: veal, polenta, crepes and appel strudel.

reviews.author: Fernando Rodrigues
reviews.text: Very good food! Cozy and rustic restaurant. Good service as well

reviews.author: Yakov Pyatnitskov
reviews.text: Excellent place for a quick breakfast. Three pieces of fresh pastry (pizza, pita and a sweet poppyseed roll) for 2 EUR. There are a couple of tables inside to eat. The staff is very nice and there are locals coming in in a steady line for their morning bread.

reviews.author: Fedor Beliaev
reviews.text: I didn't have enough money so they gave me the food for free. Extremely nice

reviews.author: Stevan Vulin
reviews.text: Everything was fresh and tasty, and the service was fast

reviews.author: Leanne V
reviews.text: Tasty and fresh products. Lots of locals eating there. Well priced items from as low as 20 eur cents

reviews.author: Jasmin S.
reviews.text: Delicious Pastry’s (we had the ones with pizza-/chocolate and cherry fillings) for breakfast. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Thomas K
reviews.text: charming rustic restaurant with authentic local cuisine. The Kačamak is delicious and so is the roasted veal. extremely good value for a very fair price.

reviews.author: Predrag Maletic
reviews.text: Extremely good restaurant. Nice atmosphere and vibtage look. Food is excelent, especially kacamak and teletina ispod saca. Full recommendation.

reviews.author: Mary Beth Brungardt
reviews.text: Great food and atmosphere! Rustic and pretty interior, highly recommend. We ordered the potato/cheese traditional dish and veal. 10/10

reviews.author: Travel & Food
reviews.text: The restaurant offers a taste of authentic Montenegrin cuisine, and the kačamak with homemade yogurt was very good, as well as baked veal with potatoes. However, be prepared for a bit of a wait. It took about 40 minutes for our food to arrive, also we waited to be seated 20 minutes. While the restaurant was packed, and it was a weekend, the service felt a bit too slow. Also, note that there is no parking lot, so you will need to look for street parking nearby. Overall, it is worth a visit.

reviews.author: Mihai Gabriel
reviews.text: Yes! This is a traditional place indeed! From the furniture, the plates, the decorations on the walls, the menu, everything looks old and traditional. There is a small waterfall right after the restaurant and you can hear it from upstairs. We went inside because it was quite chilly outside. But I'm glad, because I saw the decorations. Right as I remember my grand grandmother's place, a long time ago. The food tastes amazing! We had Kacamak and some chicken breast, but the portions are huuuuge! The staff is kind and friendly.

reviews.author: John Elliott
reviews.text: Lovely friendly restaurant. Stopped by for a quick drink before we climbed to see the fortress, and then came back for lunch. We had a lovely traditional sandwich and a chicken wrap, both at a great price. And always worth helping the local economy 👍

reviews.author: Dominic James Singun
reviews.text: A Must-Visit Gem in Old Town Kotor! If you’re visiting Kotor and looking for an unforgettable dining experience, Bokun Bar and Restaurant is the place to go. Nestled in the heart of the Old Town, this charming spot offers not only a perfect atmosphere but also some of the best food we’ve had in Montenegro. We ordered the fish platter, and it was absolutely phenomenal — hands down the best in town. Fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, it offered a variety of expertly grilled and prepared seafood that would satisfy any seafood lover. The selection was generous, and each bite was better than the last. Truly a highlight of our trip! The ambience at Bokun is relaxed yet vibrant, with a lovely outdoor seating area that captures the charm of Old Town perfectly. It’s a great place to unwind and enjoy a leisurely meal, whether you’re with friends, family, or enjoying a romantic evening out. Special shoutout to Alex and Honey, our wonderful waitresses — warm, welcoming, and attentive throughout. Their service was exceptional and really elevated the entire experience. And of course, a huge thanks to Okan, the chef, whose culinary skills are second to none. Every dish we tried reflected both passion and expertise. The menu also features a great variety beyond seafood, including local favorites and Mediterranean classics, all made with high-quality ingredients. All in all, Bokun Bar and Restaurant is a true standout in Kotor. Whether you’re in town for a day or staying longer, make sure this place is on your list. Highly recommended — we’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Chandra Kanth Reddy
reviews.text: There are few vegan options here for me. I tried the risotto here. Its very tasteless, few things are not cooked well, flavorless so I have to add salt and pepper. I had better ones in other restaurants. Its a step in the right direction to have vegan options, but they need to be cooked well

reviews.author: Gabriel Sosa
reviews.text: Food is great and extremely affordable for the quality/location. Dinner time is peaceful and calm to eat at the little square. They have only 1 waiter and she is keeping all tables happy and served like a champ 10/10 for her. Don’t look around and have dinner here.

reviews.author: Ling Lin
reviews.text: A pretty decent meal for the price. The salmon on the roast veg pasta was not fully cooked through when it was served and the waitress said that's how they usually serve it. I had to send it back to be cooked properly but other than that, the pasta was not bad. There were more roasted veg than I expected. Always happy to have more bang for my bucks! Although the 4 cheese pizza was slightly too salty for my taste, it had a good crust and flavour. Happy with the meal experience overall despite very mediocre service.

reviews.author: Pranjal Huse
reviews.text: Cozy and comforting place in the heart of Kotor. We had the vegetarian pizza, pasta with cheese, and hot chocolate. The food was nice and satisfying, but the hot chocolate really stood out — rich, creamy, and one of the best we’ve had on the trip.

reviews.author: Larisa Pavele
reviews.text: Great place in the heart of the Old Town of Kotor. Although we only bought coffee this time, we really liked the service, the wonderful aromatic coffee, the atmosphere of the old town! Great!

reviews.author: Tom Doherty
reviews.text: This is a cheap and cheerful kind of place and the food is of good quality. We have been twice as it fit our budget for the day. First we had fish fillet and chips and squid and chips. They came with a side salad. These meals are pretty basic but fresh and tasty. The fish was grilled and seasoned well. The second time we had a pizza and a side salad. The pizza is deep pan style. Doughy and chewy. If you like this style then come here. However they are smaller than what you would expect. The salad was seasonal and fresh. Nice olives, beef tomato, cucumber and feta style cheese. Considering it's in an amazing setting the prices are reasonable and the service is great.

reviews.author: emmy tokareva
reviews.text: Average prices, not tasty food (squids was hard, hot chocolate was just a little in the cup, fish basic and very simple). Nice music from a cafe nearby... sad, that the restaurant doesn't try to be food in such a good location (cozy square)

reviews.author: Guilherme Beltrão
reviews.text: 05-June-2025: pizza takes a long time to be served. Zero crunchiness, soggy. At least the beer is good.

reviews.author: Ayelet Schreiber Shariv
reviews.text: Don't miss out on a real gem- Fabulous fine dining restaurant. The service was impeccable and the staff were very attentive. The food was awesome and the view is beautiful and romantic when sitting by the water. (Recommend to reserve in advance) Thank you for a lovely evening 🫶🏻

reviews.author: Av OB
reviews.text: We came here for my friend’s birthday. It was absolutely amazing. The service, the food, the atmosphere - 5 stars. It was a great way to finish off our trip. Our waiter Dragomir was great. I’d definitely recommend coming here if you are in Kotor. Thank you!

reviews.author: Imelda Conheady
reviews.text: Stunning restaurant, our table overlooked the bay - amazing! Each course was fabulous, fish cooked to perfection. Also fab beetroot & goats cheese starter not to mention divine Tiramasu. Our waiter Nicolai was so attentive & guided us with our choices. He's such a great asset to this restaurant.

reviews.author: Rhys Minchin
reviews.text: An absolutely perfect experience in every way. Our host Darko was exemplary and could not have been more helpful. The food was perfect and arrived promptly. The restaurant were also fantastic catering to me with food allergies. The highlight was the breathtaking view; it felt like a slice of paradise. A must visit, the best restaurant in Kotor.

reviews.author: Ken Ruggiero
reviews.text: Outside the craziness and when no cruise ship in port, great views. The food and service was excellent and the restaurant has a very clean feel AND no cats. It is worth going here for that fact alone. The sea bass ceviche was a small but tasty serving. The pasta and prawns were excellent.

reviews.author: Ayelet Schreiber Shariv
reviews.text: Don't miss out on a real gem- Fabulous fine dining restaurant. The service was impeccable and the staff were very attentive. The food was awesome and the view is beautiful and romantic when sitting by the water. (Recommend to reserve in advance) Thank you for a lovely evening 🫶🏻

reviews.author: Jelena Zoric
reviews.text: We went there just to have one drink and enjoy atmosphere a little bit because we already have plans to eat somewhere else. I told to the host or waiter I'm not sure that we just gonna sit for a drinks and that's it. They gave us very bad table because we wanted just drinks even though they had plenty of tables empty. It wasn't even peak lunch time or anything like that it was almost five o'clock and we told them that we will stay just for like half an hour. They didn't seem to care. We were literally seated in front of the restaurant at tables that didn't even looked like they are for guests. Waiter didn't check on us at any point we were trying to call him to pay for like 15minutes. So at the end i figured out that he left our check at small table nearby and we just left money and leave. I was pretty disappointed with this experience and i didn't expect such treatment. But that aside, nature is unreal, you really need to see that. Such a peaceful place with a lot of birds enjoying in beautiful environment. Ducks are so adorable and we even saw little ducks 🙈🙈 All in all i still think you should visit this place but order food because you'll be treated much better for sure i could see how they act around people that had lunch there.

reviews.author: Aybuke Aydemir
reviews.text: The atmosphere was absolutely stunning — such a beautiful and romantic place! We only tried the dessert, which we didn’t enjoy that much, but the ambiance was so lovely that we still fell in love with the venue. Definitely a place worth coming back to, especially to try the food!

reviews.author: Natalie Binienda-Meuser
reviews.text: The place is a true oasis ! Hidden but a real gem. We had the salt baked sea bass and it was heaven! Sitting next to a little stream watching the mountain range and taking a small walk around the property while waiting for food. The service was also outstanding 🙏

reviews.author: DropAPin Traveller
reviews.text: We found this spot by chance. We just popped in for a coffee but the setting is beautiful and definitely worth visiting. I can't rate the food as we just had a coffee but the food looked delicious! The outside tables all seemed reserved so it seems you would need to book in the season.

reviews.author: james levy
reviews.text: Truly an enchanting dining experience, with the ambiance of the property and the delicious food. I had the seafood risotto, probably the best I've ever eaten - fresh, expertly prepared, beautifully presented. Also enjoyed a wonderful fresh salad, apple strudel with dessert, and delightful pasta dish. Service very attentive. Afterwards took a small tour of the property, including all the ponds and structure. Maybe a bit out of the way, and well worth the discovery. Wow! Note; My pictures may not be reflective of the food, though does describe the beautiful setting in which this restaurant sits.

reviews.author: Gabriela Dimova
reviews.text: We went there for lunch and it was so amazing that we got back for dinner as well. We have tried the Mussels with traditional red sauce and they were very delicious, pasta with shrimps and fried squads. Everything was perfect. Price compared to quality is very good. The staff were very polite and multilingual. We were lucky that in the evening there were live performers. The atmosphere is very authentic and unique.

reviews.author: Michael Curtis
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my meal here. We started with the spicy octopus and it was delicious. I had a glass of wine and the chicken in blue cheese sauce and found it to be tasty. Just like all the places in Kotor, it was quite hot inside, but overall I recommend going!

reviews.author: Martha Medina
reviews.text: If I could give this restaurant more than five stars, I absolutely would. Our experience here was incredible—truly one of the best meals I’ve ever had, both in terms of the food and the service. We visited in March, and the restaurant wasn’t too crowded at the time. We were seated indoors and received prompt attention. From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, our waiter was outstanding—he even walked us to the door to say goodbye. He thoughtfully explained each dish, and we ended up choosing a truly exquisite menu. The drinks were fabulous, and the atmosphere was warm, charming, and full of local character. We left completely enchanted and with a memorable experience. Honestly, that meal in Kotor is one of the highlights of my trip. If I ever return to Kotor, this would be one of the first places I’d go back to. Hats off to our server! He was amazing!

reviews.author: Richard Little
reviews.text: Beautiful location in a picturesque old town square. Enjoy al-fresco dining under a cosy blanket with fabulous food, wine & service. The food.... The Mushroom risotto was loaded with garlicky, buttery, umami packed mushrooms. The seafood risotto was delicate, fresh and light and paired beautifully with the local white wine. Service was perfect - discrete but attentive. The restaurant is busy so I recommend booking ahead. If you like and appreciate this review please give it a like or a thumbs up so that I know what content to include in future reviews.

reviews.author: Francis Lam
reviews.text: The food in here is absolutely amazing... Heavenly delicious. Situated inside the old town, this restaurant may look like any other restaurants inside the city wall, but it really is different in terms of tastiness. The seafood here is just so fresh, and you simply feel like tasting the sea. 😋. Please book in advance and dont wander into the adjacent restaurant if you are being turned down. We did it on the first night, and that restaurant is.....🤐. Also, do have a look at the inside. Well decorated interior as well. I know, most of you properly would like to sit outside.

reviews.text: We went there for lunch and it was so amazing that we got back for dinner as well. reviews.author: Alexandra Vintila
reviews.text: The burek here is out of this world! I’ve been getting it every day on my holiday, too good to miss out on. The service was really friendly too. Like a lot of places in Kotor they only accept cash.

reviews.author: Steve Lewis
reviews.text: The byrek is great and big. Honestly I think one is enough for two people and they are delicious. Next door is a good coffee shop and we took our byrek there and enjoyed a good coffee with them. A great breakfast/lunch option and pretty economical by Kotor standards....

reviews.author: Jolita
reviews.text: Great local bakery. Delicious Burek and hotdogs. Reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Hsu Sin
reviews.text: Came here as a tourist without cash as I thought card was accepted; only realised this after ordering and they insisted on giving it away for free. Really sweet owners and the chocolate croissant and meat pie tasted amazing! Bless you guys ❤️

reviews.author: More Luck
reviews.text: The bakery in general is very tasty, we tried different options and all were good, however it was expensive (more than expected for Montenegro prices).

reviews.author: Sarah Lambert
reviews.text: There is no denying that this is a truly stunning location. The grounds are beautiful as are the views. I have to say, there wasn’t anything wrong with the food. But at the prices they charge, I’d expect to be blown away. I wasn’t. It was average. You’re paying for the venue. Have that in mind and you won’t be disappointed. I had the seafood risotto which was a warm starter as my main.

reviews.author: Danko Vukovic
reviews.text: The ambiance here is second to none. The best time to visit is during the warmer months, when you can sit outside and enjoy the peaceful view of the river. This place is well-known for its excellent fish, but don’t miss the grilled Adriatic squid—a true delicacy that’s not to be skipped.

reviews.author: Mehveş Yamanyılmaz
reviews.text: We visited Stari Mlini with our 3 yo son and for three hours we had an amazing time both in terms of flavors and activities. The ambiance is absolutely stunning. Enjoying a peaceful conversation by the sound of the river, taking in the breathtaking views… everything was simply delightful. And a special thanks to our waiter Mr.Stefan😊 for his exceptional service and attentiveness. He was incredibly professional, friendly and welcoming. This place is a must-visit, not just for the delicious meal but also for a few truly enjoyable hours.

reviews.author: Volkan Oflaz
reviews.text: We had the chance to dine at Stari Mlini yesterday, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. This former flour mill from the 1700s has been beautifully transformed into a fairytale-like restaurant, full of character and charm. Nestled by the river with a breathtaking view of the Bay of Kotor, the setting is simply magical. The dishes were not only delicious but also thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. The staff was incredibly attentive and welcoming, making us feel genuinely special. With its rich history, stunning atmosphere, and exceptional cuisine, Stari Mlini is undoubtedly a must-visit spot in Kotor.

reviews.author: GUZEL INAN
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of dining at Stari Mlini during our visit to Montenegro, and it was an unforgettable experience. Nestled along the stunning Bay of Kotor, the restaurant offers breathtaking views that perfectly complement the authentic dining experience. The ambiance is relaxed and charming, with rustic décor that creates a cozy, inviting atmosphere. The staff was incredibly warm and attentive, ensuring that every part of the meal was flawless. We started with a selection of appetizers, including fresh seafood, and the flavors were vibrant and fresh — you could tell everything was sourced locally. For the main course, I opted for the grilled fish, which was cooked to perfection and served with a delicious array of sides. What truly stood out was the setting — dining outside by the water with the sound of gentle waves in the background made the experience truly magical. The wine list was also impressive, offering a great selection of local Montenegrin wines that paired beautifully with the meal. Though the restaurant can be a bit pricier compared to others in the area, the quality of the food, the service, and the atmosphere make it more than worth the price. If you're visiting Montenegro and looking for a memorable meal, Stari Mlini is an absolute must-visit.

reviews.author: CJ
reviews.text: The best food experience out of 4 restaurants tried in Niksic. They had a few vegan options, such as vegan pizza (they even had vegan cheeze) and pasta. Wish they had a few more vegan dishes, only because what they had on the menu was delicious and would've liked to go back and try out more. Prices were also affordable! The only restaurant where the inside did not reek of the smell of smoke. Service was friendly, attentive, knowledgable, knew English. The order was out in a decent time.

reviews.author: Harikrishanan Venugopal
reviews.text: We stopped by this really cute cafe on our way to Mostar. We had cappuccinos and fries, and everything was awesome. The inside was so pretty, but they only had a few cakes. We still had a great time though, and they even had a really clean toilet for customers.

reviews.author: bethannn ._.
reviews.text: A little far from the busy part and if you’re going at night the road looks a little daunting but the place itself was lovely. me and my partner had parmesan pizza and pulled beef burger. they have english menus, play music. the lady who served us was fast in serving us and spoke moderate english. they have two downstairs areas outside, some places inside as well as seating upstairs. they do have the pavement go straight through the restaurant so just be mindful of that. Oh and the prices are amazing! €4.90 for a 10 inch margarita pizza

reviews.author: Jiří Marvan
reviews.text: Even though the name suggests it would be a bakery, it is actually a well-furnished restaurant offering also burgers, tortillas and pancakes (both sweet and salty options) - the baked salty ones with beshamel definitely deserve a shout out but also the tortilla with pulled beef was great. Also, the prices are incredible.

reviews.author: Theresa Thierfelder
reviews.text: Great restaurant in Nikšić. We were offered several mixed platters as a group of 14 people. Really amazing. Very tasty. Nice and courteous service staff. Kind regards from CMS e. V. 🏍️

reviews.author: Vedad Imamovic
reviews.text: They didn't pay the graphic designer, they haven't answered their calls for a long time. Ordinary shameless scammers

reviews.author: Lamija Sarajlic
reviews.text: If I could, I would put a 0, considering that they have owed the graphic designer a large sum of money for a long period of time.
