reviews.author: Erna Buljubašić
reviews.text: Unprofessional behavior, you did not pay the graphic designer the agreed price!

reviews.author: Олег Марьин
reviews.text: A good bar to hang out at night without any negative consequences)

reviews.author: alexander martschewski
reviews.text: We loved this place so much we came back today for a second time, after already celebrating my fiancée’s birthday here a few days ago. The food is absolutely outstanding, the location stunning (right by the water with a view across the bay of Perast), and the service is on par with a five-star hotel. We were lucky enough to get a table right by the sea again, and it was just magical. A special shout-out to our waiter Marco, who was incredibly kind, attentive without ever being intrusive, always there at the perfect moment. We felt truly well taken care of. A heartfelt recommendation to anyone visiting the area! Благодарим от сърце и до следващият път!

reviews.author: Rajan Jariwala
reviews.text: Just had a lovely lunch at restaurant Conte in Perast. The atmosphere is amazing. The tables are right by the water, and we had a memorable experience. On top of that we were served by a gentleman called Sasha. What a legend. Welcoming, charming and recommended just right dishes. I would highly recommend visiting Perast and dining at Hotel Conte.

reviews.author: Neil Rochell
reviews.text: We came for dinner and was blown over by their service. We asked for a table on the seafront, and although we hadn't booked, we were lucky the host Andrea was able to sort something out for us. The rest of the night we were looked after by Sasa who made us feel so welcome. He had great recommendations and full of local knowledge. The food was out of this world and the views unspoilt over the fjord

reviews.author: Ankica U
reviews.text: My daughter had her wedding at Hotel Conte. We had the most wonderful day anyone could wish for. Stayed for 4 nights. The staff were exceptional. The food and location was brilliant and faultless. We will definitely be back and probably the best stay we have ever had. Thank you and see you soon. Ankica.

reviews.author: Beste Avcı
reviews.text: We arranged our stay in Perast through Restaurant Conte and were thoroughly pleased with the experience. The team was in constant communication with us even before our arrival. Since cars aren’t allowed into Perast, they showed us the free parking area and provided a shuttle to the hotel. At reception, we were warmly welcomed, and the staff was very attentive. We had our dinner at the restaurant by the sea—it was beautifully presented and absolutely delicious. As hotel guests, we also had breakfast here, which featured a rich and varied open buffet with something for every taste. Our room was tastefully decorated, modern yet in harmony with the charm of the old town. It was spotless and fully equipped. The entire staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. If I ever return to Perast, I would definitely choose this place again without hesitation.

reviews.author: Károly Sándor Pallai
reviews.text: Everything was wonderful. The 2-person fish plate is amazing, full of fresh seafood with multiple side dishes, the staff is very kind, and the athmosphere with little candles, great lights and music is so nice. Absolutely suggested to everyone who wants to spend a great moment and have some really nice food.

reviews.author: Andrew Bott
reviews.text: We really loved it here. The “lamb under the bell” was simply outstanding. My wife had the grilled fish which was super. Don’t rush this place. We waited for almost 40mins for the lamb to be ready and it was totally worth it. (The staff did tell us it would take that long.)

reviews.author: Martina Cividini
reviews.text: Fresh and high quality ingredients, attentive service. We got an appetizer and one main dish (salad of the house and tuna steak). Also when not directly on the sea you have a nice view of the bay

reviews.author: Susie Clark
reviews.text: Our dinner was more than just a meal. It was a dining experience! We chose our dinner after being shown the fresh fish of the day. We watched it being cooked by a grill master, quite the finesse! It was really fun to see how much care the fish was given! Then our server George skinned it and deboned it. Make sure to ask for George. He made the evening one of a kind. Extremely professional and entertaining. We'd return if we weren't leaving. The restaurant faces the water with a beautiful view of all kinds of activity.

reviews.author: Venetia
reviews.text: One of the best places to eat in Perast! Local dishes were delicious (and well priced) and the staff were lovely and very helpful! We tried the peppers which were delicious! We also had the fish soup and squid 🦑 mussels were nice but I’ve had better!

reviews.text: Other day I was wandering on narrow streets and saw someone gave little kittens fresh little fish. It was on the back of the restaurant. And the kind-hearted people indeed are preparing your food there. Fish is very fresh, well seasoned, with crunchy "skin". Grilled vegetables on point. Eating fish in tree shade, overlooking sea and watching people pass by on promenade.. Could improve language skills of staff to make sure what kind of fish you ordering. But they are so helpful and professional (what is not very common in this touris resort) Oh, lemonade was made of lemons and no sugar was added!! ♡

reviews.author: Oleksandr
reviews.text: Great restaurant with very tasty food! The fish platter was incredible. The service was excellent. Very satisfied!

reviews.author: Martyna _
reviews.text: The food could be much better, it came a little cold, we waited a long time and it wasn’t the best. The chicken was dry and I don’t think there were any spices, there could be a lot more fries, the calamari was rubbery and not very good. Nonetheless we were hungry enough to eat it all so it wasn’t that bad. The service was very good, nice ladies.

reviews.author: Nataša Jakša
reviews.text: We ordered some seafood, and it was absolutely delicious! The atmosphere is great, with the garden area being private enough, but also located right next to the main walkway. The service was superb! ☺️

reviews.author: Explore Eat Travel
reviews.text: This restaurant benefits from a good location and a polite, attentive waiter, which made the dining experience pleasant in terms of service. However, the food itself left much to be desired. I ordered the black cuttlefish risotto, but it was disappointing mainly because it didn’t even use proper risotto rice. The dish lacked the creamy, authentic texture and flavour you expect from a good risotto. Overall, while the service and location are solid, the quality of the food, particularly the risotto, could definitely use some improvement.

reviews.author: Hug Dealer
reviews.text: Love this Bakery. Staff friendly and helpful for the English language is not their first language. Burek was amazing and tasty. So cheap and eat every time I come to adriatic. Pastry was amazing too, not too sweet but lush.

reviews.author: Explore Eat Travel
reviews.text: This small local bakery is a hidden gem with a fantastic selection of fresh pastries and bread. Each item is clearly made with care, offering a delightful range of flavors and textures. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, adding a personal touch to the experience. However, it’s worth noting that they don’t speak English, which might be a minor challenge for non-local visitors. Despite the language barrier, the warm atmosphere and quality of the baked goods make this bakery well worth a visit!

reviews.author: Danieloncarevic
reviews.text: Not sure how this place got such high reviews but it's definitely overrated. Might be because it's the only bakery in the city. Small place, poor offer, no parking, expensive, mediocre products. The uploaded photo was supposed to be a delicious ham and cheese soft sandwich. I tried really hard but didn't find any ham or cheese. It was practically empty dough with nothing in it. If you're charging a premium for your products, at least have the decency to put something inside. If I wanted to eat just dough, I would have bought a bread. Avoid if possible and don't be deceived by the outside looks of it. We tried a few and pretty much all of them were empty and not worth the asked price.

reviews.author: Ferdinand Manalo
reviews.text: Fresh and tasty bread for a cheap price. Lovely staffs as well. Just remember to bring cash with you when you buy from here. 💶

reviews.author: Kirsty Devine
reviews.text: Great bakery with a decent choice. The bread on the top shelf is only 1€ and lasts up to three days. Nice lunch option for a low price.

reviews.author: Vojislav Brankovic
reviews.text: Through this year, my son and I were there. We have had a great vacation time. Strongly recommend that an apartment. There are a good accomodation, delicious food, the great and nice service/people. Price of accomodation and restaurant food are acceptable/not expensive. Strongly recommend. There is a good accomodation. My little son and me stay there. There is a nice, kind staff, waiters and service. The meals are delicious. Pansion, half-pansion is available. Great place, I hope visit it again.

reviews.author: Nikola 89
reviews.text: There is no better place and service in Petrovac. Friendly staff and good atmosphere. Portion are large and prices are normal compared to some other restaurants. Service is best here, especially Zoran and his colleague in afternoon shift. Pozdrav za Zorana i kolegu Nikola i Branka.

reviews.author: Damir Khayrutdinov
reviews.text: The best, service and price!

reviews.author: Ain V
reviews.text: Greetings from Estonia. We went there for breakfast. The service and food were great. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Sergey
reviews.text: Very nice restaurant. Food was very delicious and portions were big so we even ordered one portion for two people.

reviews.author: Adam Schmitt
reviews.text: This place truly stands out. The glowing reviews don’t even begin to capture how good it really is. The location is beautiful, with a wonderful view overlooking the shoreline—perfect for a relaxed meal. The atmosphere is calm and inviting, making it easy to settle in and enjoy. I had the bruschetta and the veal with potatoes and bell peppers—both were absolutely outstanding. Honestly, it was some of the best food I’ve had in a long time. You can tell there’s real talent in the kitchen. Service was excellent—friendly, attentive, and professional. Whoever is behind the food here is doing a remarkable job. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Irina Spiridonova
reviews.text: The experience was amazing, beautiful terrace with the sea view, delicious food and polite and attentive staff. Everything was seasoned well and tasted exceptionally fresh. This experience will be really hard to beat!

reviews.author: Nicole Billitz
reviews.text: There were plenty of vegetarian options, and my partner got lamb “under the bell” which he says was absolutely fantastic. We had a wonderful server, and the view is hard to beat.

reviews.author: Robert Hantzsch
reviews.text: Absolut amazing location! Tables in the garden under a fig tree with beautiful view over the ocean, the bay and of course with Mountain View. Tasty food, very good service! Excellent place to enjoy lunch or dinner!

reviews.author: Артём Петин
reviews.text: The food was very nice, the veal here is amazing With the view that you have here any food tastes better!

reviews.author: Vladimir Dasic
reviews.text: If you're expecting a true all-inclusive experience, this may look like a great deal at first glance — but unfortunately, it falls short in several key areas. First, the booking page and the hotel’s official website are outdated and misleading. Many of the amenities listed simply don’t exist or are inaccurately described. No ice cream anywhere on the property, despite it being advertised. Not a huge issue on its own, but it reflects the larger problem of misleading information. Parking fees are outdated, and even if you pay, a spot isn’t guaranteed. When we arrived, there was no one to greet us or assist with parking, one of the staff, which I later found out was some sort of manager, even turned me away, saying garage was full (it wasn't) Staff morale seemed very low. Many appeared disengaged or unhappy, which made interactions uncomfortable. Basic requests were often met with indifference or even rudeness. You could order a drink, and without any word or smile, you would be handed a drink in a plastic cup. No room service, even though it’s advertised online. There weren’t even phones in the rooms. When we tried calling the reception using numbers listed on the website, no one picked up — and at one point, our call was declined. The beach is not included in the all-inclusive package. You’ll pay an extra €14 per day for access, and surprisingly, there are no drinks or snacks offered at the beach — nor are you allowed to bring any from the hotel. Only a couple of staff members were friendly and tried to help, but they were the exception rather than the norm. All in all, the experience didn’t align with what was promised. I’m sharing this to help others set realistic expectations — or explore other options that offer better value and service.

reviews.author: Tijana Stanojević
reviews.text: Parking not available even with additional charges. Parking lot that hotel is using in lack of a proper garage is 15min walk from the hotel. Room is spacious. Shower cabin pretty clogged and leaking to the bathroom floor. No AC in restaurant and at the reception. With lot of guests it gets super hot during meals. Great bar spaces at the pool and rooftop. Kid friendly. Cleaning services should be on higher level. Beach sunbeds not included and the beach is crowded and dirty. The garden is lovely with old olive trees and friendly kittens. Location is great, next to the beach and pedestrean area. Food is great.

reviews.author: Dragan Simic
reviews.text: Just came back from one of the best family vacations in my life. Going first time to the trip with 16 months old baby was not just the vacation but the life time experience. To make it perfect all hotel stuff gave their best. So friendly, undestandable and hospitable people I have not met yet. They took care about everything to make our stay perfect. Room was always so clean and tidy, maid changed our and baby's towels on regular bases. Food was awesome, tasty and various. Nevertheless even if we needed something special from food for baby,we got it along the big smile of our waitress. So many hotel amenities as baby pools, playgrounds,park, etc. Everything is adapted for kids and babies. Beach is nearby, always clean too. This is why we can not wait for the next year to come again. Guys thank you for everything and looking forward seeing you again next year.

reviews.author: Diana Savchenko
reviews.text: The staff is friendly. The rooms are good. But the cleaners are lazy. Asked to wash the mirror, nothing has changed. The food is very tasty, and varied. Every day there was something new, and changed. The location is good. The hotel has a separately specific part of the beach

Be careful with the bill though - we have wrong price for some dishes in the bill, have to ask a waiter to correct it. And also they bring bread without asking and charge you addition money for it :) Just check the bill twice before paying )

reviews.text: We visited only restaurant, food was 5/10 not great not terrible, but service was tragedy.. the most unpleasant waiter on the Europe.. sad experience. Lake is beautiful!

reviews.author: Kuba Ska
reviews.text: They say Wi-Fi is in the rooms however it is not (or service is down). If you ask for price reduction as you paid for room with Wi-Fi, they say to leave if you do not like it (at 9pm). Rooms are basically impossible to lock, there is no bed-clothing for sheets, faucet in bathroom is leaking, you can hear every little noise or discussion over the walls. Waiter does not approach you in the restaurant after waiting more than 15min (although they see you waiting).

reviews.author: J.P. Groen
reviews.text: I just visited the restaurant. They did not want to serve me any food first, because the chef was to busy with a group of forty persons. Then, with some complaining, they offered me biftek. With French fries. Allright then. Food was okay, a bit too much (300 grams of meat), and with €18 also somewhat overpriced, where the rest of the mains (only meat, portions of 300 grams) was typically 7,50 or 8,50. I suggest they must improve service, and also improve the menu, with less meat and more other options. The views are very nice, however.

reviews.author: Anat Lev Hacohen
reviews.text: This place is insanely good! Fresh and tasty baked goods. I highly recommend tasting the meat burek. Absolutely fantastic!

reviews.author: Mrga mrga
reviews.text: the best of bread

reviews.author: Aurélien KHALKHAL
reviews.text: Very good bakery with bureks with spinach, beef, several types of bread and Montenegrin specialties at low prices. I took 2 bureks and a loaf of bread for €2.30. That's more than a meal. However, if possible, I recommend reheating the burek a little so that it is lukewarm. Top seller, we didn't understand anything so we gave her our phone with Google trad. Very smiling.

reviews.author: Mo
reviews.text: Everything highly recommended and inexpensive. The chocolate croissant was particularly good.

reviews.author: Majed
reviews.text: Delicious and fresh food. We tried the meat pie and the apple pie, they were both really good.

reviews.author: Marija Rasic
reviews.text: Great place to have a drink or very nice meal in the heart of the Old city castle and next to the sea. One of the best place to enjoy sunsets in Budva. Next to the place is local beach so kids can play while you enjoy your coffee.

reviews.author: Kath
reviews.text: Nice seafood restaurant serving Greek-inspired fare. The menu wasn’t super extensive, but you can’t go wrong with seafood and lambchops. We personally loved the cuttlefish risotto. Serving size of the food was a tad bit small though, and the prices of the drinks were just outright 😬

reviews.author: Josefiina Angerman
reviews.text: Konoba Stari Grad restaurant I had read reviews that made me want to come here to eat. We received service in fluent English. The waiter was also really friendly and nice. We ordered a fish dish for two. The waiting time didn't seem long, we received the dose in a reasonable time. The portion was large and had a suitable variety of seafood. The dish tasted really good. The only downside is that the fish was a bit too salty for me. However, overall I could recommend the fish dish and the restaurant.

reviews.author: Helen Hudymenko
reviews.text: "Stari Grad" was by far the best restaurant we have had fish and seafood at during our stay at Budvanska Rivijera. And we stayed 15 km away ;) but we came there twice ! Their fishplate -1 kg of amazing goodies like fish, shrimp, muscels, baby octopus paired with perfect risotto and Mediterranean garnish (potatoe pureè with spinage) were something to die for!!!!! Loca wine, fresh bread, amazing food, great restaurant history, cozy atmosphere , perfect service (Hvala, Dima) are something that we definitely recommend !!!! Hvala, Stari Grad 🤩👍

reviews.author: Isabella Manganelli
reviews.text: Nice restaurant on the beach. Food was pretty good. Wouldn’t suggest the calamari it was basically just batter. Everything else was delicious. Reasonable prices

reviews.author: Ashley Cooper
reviews.text: WOW 🤩 I have never before tasted a cheese dish as good as this. If you are a fan of mac n cheese or cheesey anything or are just human… TRY THE KAČAMAK! And on top of that, the restaurant is gorgeous inside and out, the service is wonderful, every dish was delicious, the beers and wines are tasty, and this is just such a beautiful gem here in Podgorica. Can’t wait to return.

reviews.author: Marina Trencheva
reviews.text: I came here for dinner and I don't regret choosing this restaurant. I can honestly say this is now my favourite restaurant in Podgorica. Every dish I ordered was so, so tasty. The restaurant has an interesting interior design. The restaurant also has a small parking lot with a few parking spaces, so if you're with a car you can try to park your car there. The waiters are absolutely amazing, very polite and friendly. I don't know the name of the waiter that served my dinner tonight (an elderly man), but he made me feel so welcomed, and I felt like I was home. Thank you for being so kind and nice to me and my partner. This man also helped me put my coat on. Such a gentleman. I really appreciate that. I cannot recommend this restaurant enough for the service and the great food. If you're visiting Podgorica, you should also visit this restaurant and try some authentic food. You won't regret it. ​ ​

reviews.author: Jocelyn
reviews.text: Came here twice during my visit. Food is absolutely delicious and service is great. The only thing I didn’t like is that we were forced to tip 10% by the waiter the second time I went there. My bill is 18.5 euro and I told the waiter I’d pay 19 euros by card and that’s when I was told tipping rate in Montenegro is 10%…so he came up with two numbers for me to choose from either one! It annoyed me when tipping should be voluntary. Such a shame this ruined my experience there

reviews.author: Konstantinos Barlas
reviews.text: Food is exceptional here! We tried traditional dishes and we didn't regret. Kacamak is absolutely amazing! The food was well prepared with care. Big portions and reasonable prices. We already reserved a table for another day! Thank you! Very nice decoration which complete a very cozy atmosphere.

reviews.author: David Dimov
reviews.text: Our waiter Marko was fabulous. Food is more than good. We had dinner two evenings and we tried many plates. No something that is not good. Everything is so fresh and well cooked. To be honest I am very precious person, but there is no bad word. Totally recommended. When weather is good, there is nice terrace which made this place perfect 👌 Great job guys

reviews.author: Cedric Roels
reviews.text: Huge portions for cheap prices. The food was literally three hands big and the prices were super affordable. All was ordered within 5 minutes and served within 15 minutes. The waiter speaks English and you can pay by card. Close to the city center and with ample shadow.

reviews.author: Jomin Neelikatt
reviews.text: Best restaurant in Podgorica! The food is incredible, I had typical cheese, goulash and homemade sausages. The goat cheese was rich in flavour while the goulash was the best I ever, delicious sauce and tender meat. Also the sausages was amazing. The staff was really kind. Big portions. Absolutely recommended if you pass by.

reviews.author: YAFEA ALYAFEI
reviews.text: An amazing traditional restaurant in the heart of Podgorica old town, the location is perfect, just across the clock tower. The place is huge. The service was quick and excellent. The food was delicious and the prices were great. I highly recommend it if you want an authentic experience.

reviews.author: Mert Yemişci
reviews.text: We noticed this restaurant, located behind the historical building, because it looked good from the outside. Main courses and soups were affordable. Only non-alcoholic beverages are a bit expensive. The portions of the meals are very good, some of them even seemed like 1.5 portions. The food was very delicious and of high quality. It's just that without exception, all the dishes are too salty, I think this is the case throughout the country. Other than that, we liked everything. I definitely recommend it. These prices are really very reasonable in a restaurant where you will receive quality service. The hot pitas served with the meal are very delicious.

reviews.author: Nikson Buzhala
reviews.text: Review: Pod Volat Pod Volat is a fantastic spot for traditional Balkan and Montenegrin cuisine. The food was one of the most delicious I’ve ever tried—rich in flavor, well-prepared, and truly authentic. From the grilled meats to the local specialties, everything was cooked to perfection. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, making it a great place to experience the true taste of the region. If you’re looking for authentic Balkan flavors, this is definitely a must-visit!

reviews.author: Jomin Neelikatt
reviews.text: Best restaurant in Podgorica! The food is incredible, I had typical cheese, goulash and homemade sausages. The goat cheese was rich in flavour while the goulash was the best I ever, delicious sauce and tender meat. Also the sausages was amazing. The staff was really kind. Big portions. Absolutely recommended if you pass by.

reviews.author: YAFEA ALYAFEI
reviews.text: An amazing traditional restaurant in the heart of Podgorica old town, the location is perfect, just across the clock tower. The place is huge. The service was quick and excellent. The food was delicious and the prices were great. I highly recommend it if you want an authentic experience.

reviews.author: Mert Yemişci
reviews.text: We noticed this restaurant, located behind the historical building, because it looked good from the outside. Main courses and soups were affordable. Only non-alcoholic beverages are a bit expensive. The portions of the meals are very good, some of them even seemed like 1.5 portions. The food was very delicious and of high quality. It's just that without exception, all the dishes are too salty, I think this is the case throughout the country. Other than that, we liked everything. I definitely recommend it. These prices are really very reasonable in a restaurant where you will receive quality service. The hot pitas served with the meal are very delicious.

reviews.author: Nikson Buzhala
reviews.text: Review: Pod Volat Pod Volat is a fantastic spot for traditional Balkan and Montenegrin cuisine. The food was one of the most delicious I’ve ever tried—rich in flavor, well-prepared, and truly authentic. From the grilled meats to the local specialties, everything was cooked to perfection. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, making it a great place to experience the true taste of the region. If you’re looking for authentic Balkan flavors, this is definitely a must-visit!

reviews.author: Anel Kulmurziyeva
reviews.text: Very friendly staff. Delicious food, pasta with shrimps was so and so tasty. Highly recommended. We didn’t like terrace because smelled of cigarettes( but food was very good. Good price.

reviews.author: Georgina Okakoso
reviews.text: Lovely restaurant with a very picturesque space. The staff were friendly and welcoming. The ambiance was really chilled and relaxed. The food was so good 😊 we all ordered different types of pasta which we all enjoyed and also ordered pizza to go. I highly recommend you pay them a visit.

reviews.author: Muffin In A Cup
reviews.text: Its spoken about by many like its some high-class restaurant yet it doesnt have much more than any other cafe around Podgorica, apart from nice desserts if that's your thing. Poorly climatised - despite there being a dozen various air-conditioners all around, none of them seem to work. Its not even august yet its hot/stuffy inside. Drinks are a bit overpriced - for instance dojc is 2.10e, pretty much everywhere else its 1.60-1.80 Decor is nice but shows its age - many of the faux leather seats are ripped/deteriorating, lamp fixtures in terrace and some inside too are visibly either falling apart or cobwebby/dusty. No complaints to servers but nothing outstanding either.

reviews.author: Zeki Yüzgüç
reviews.text: I had an amazing time at Masa’s. I had a beef pasta it was perfectly Al Dante cooked. We also had a lot of desserts. The desserts were all super fresh and tasty my favorite one was a Masa’s cake. The waiters were very attentive. Also, the owner showed great hospitality and gesture. The place was very spacious and worth my time to be there. Well done Masa.

reviews.author: Alisa Karasik
reviews.text: The restaurant upstairs has some amazing fish specialties like crudo and ceviche, downstairs cafe has basic food and some desserts

name: Street Food - Trg Republike
address: Street Food - Trg Republike, Podgorica, Montenegro

reviews.author: Amber Rawcliffe
reviews.text: Loved this place for lunch! Meat kebabs wrapped in bacon were unreal, salad was fresh.. service okay!

reviews.author: E John Inan
reviews.text: I visited Hipnos Bakery & Food during lunchtime and ordered a premium burger and a prosciutto sandwich. Honestly, my burger wasn't very tasty, but I ate it because I was so hungry. The prosciutto sandwich was overly cheesy, and I couldn't finish half of it. I believe this place has room for improvement, particularly with the menu. A smaller, more focused menu with better quality food would be an improvement.

reviews.author: Adi Yariv
reviews.text: Very nice fresh and good prices..loved the Burake

reviews.author: George Davidov
reviews.text: Waited for 5 minutes just for staff to acknowledge my presence even tho they saw me standing. Then I ordered a Pljeskavica and waited 20 minutes for it, they didn’t even ask me what i want in my Pljeskavica (sauces, tomatoes, lettuce etc.) and just gave me the white box. When i got to my accommodation I opened the box and was stunned by the “Pljeskavica” they gave me. The photo tells it all, no bread (lepinja) in which the Pljeskavica comes as standard and nothing else except a few onion bits. I paid 6€ for this! The staff is unfriendly and the place gives overall an unwelcoming vibe. Would not recommend!

reviews.author: Thomas Vermeulen
reviews.text: Bakery with burek, wrapped sandwiches & some cakes and attached to it they have a takeaway place. Salads, cevapi, burgers. I only tried the cheese & salami sandwich which was ok. For €2 that's a great cycling stop.

reviews.author: Jelena Zoric
reviews.text: We went there just to have one drink and enjoy atmosphere a little bit because we already have plans to eat somewhere else. I told to the host or waiter I'm not sure that we just gonna sit for a drinks and that's it. They gave us very bad table because we wanted just drinks even though they had plenty of tables empty. It wasn't even peak lunch time or anything like that it was almost five o'clock and we told them that we will stay just for like half an hour. They didn't seem to care. We were literally seated in front of the restaurant at tables that didn't even looked like they are for guests. Waiter didn't check on us at any point we were trying to call him to pay for like 15minutes. So at the end i figured out that he left our check at small table nearby and we just left money and leave. I was pretty disappointed with this experience and i didn't expect such treatment. But that aside, nature is unreal, you really need to see that. Such a peaceful place with a lot of birds enjoying in beautiful environment. Ducks are so adorable and we even saw little ducks 🙈🙈 All in all i still think you should visit this place but order food because you'll be treated much better for sure i could see how they act around people that had lunch there.

reviews.author: Aybuke Aydemir
reviews.text: The atmosphere was absolutely stunning — such a beautiful and romantic place! We only tried the dessert, which we didn’t enjoy that much, but the ambiance was so lovely that we still fell in love with the venue. Definitely a place worth coming back to, especially to try the food!

reviews.author: Natalie Binienda-Meuser
reviews.text: The place is a true oasis ! Hidden but a real gem. We had the salt baked sea bass and it was heaven! Sitting next to a little stream watching the mountain range and taking a small walk around the property while waiting for food. The service was also outstanding 🙏

reviews.author: DropAPin Traveller
reviews.text: We found this spot by chance. We just popped in for a coffee but the setting is beautiful and definitely worth visiting. I can't rate the food as we just had a coffee but the food looked delicious! The outside tables all seemed reserved so it seems you would need to book in the season.

reviews.author: james levy
reviews.text: Truly an enchanting dining experience, with the ambiance of the property and the delicious food. I had the seafood risotto, probably the best I've ever eaten - fresh, expertly prepared, beautifully presented. Also enjoyed a wonderful fresh salad, apple strudel with dessert, and delightful pasta dish. Service very attentive. Afterwards took a small tour of the property, including all the ponds and structure. Maybe a bit out of the way, and well worth the discovery. Wow! Note; My pictures may not be reflective of the food, though does describe the beautiful setting in which this restaurant sits.

reviews.author: Carla Myers
reviews.text: Excellent local seafood! The waiter was so helpful and attentive, and all his suggestions were fantastic. The grilled calamari was wonderful. We particularly enjoyed the mussels; they were done in a garlic marinara and it was to die for. The mixed salad however was a far too small portion, it was served on a small flat side plate with only 4 slices of tomato and cucumber (which is not typical of the area, where they usually serve lovely big salads)

reviews.author: Марина Клементьева
reviews.text: We have waited for our order during 1.5 hours. Ordered salad and tagliatelle. Chicken in tagliatelle wasn't fresh. Waiter even didn't apologize. The salad wasn't the best. You can see onion slices on the fork in the photo.

reviews.author: Danijel Milosevic
reviews.text: Great food, decent prices, lovely view. We went there a few times as a family of four, the staff was always so kind and helpful. Can't recommend enough. Comparable quality to restaurants in Kotor. 10/10

reviews.author: Sylvia Stienstra
reviews.text: Nice place to walk to from Perast relaxed terrace and kind owner/staff. Had a nice lunch here.

reviews.author: Dan Brumbea
reviews.text: It gets the five stars from me because of the view. The food is good but usually I will stop here for a coffee and a soda because I really enjoy the view.

reviews.author: alexander chernogorodov
reviews.text: Hello! The room was not as described and was not cleaned prior to our arrival. At least the floor was dirty. The air conditioner in the bedroom did not work. The specialist arrived at 7.50, which I found out about 5 minutes before his arrival, when the whole family was still resting and, having cleaned the filters, said that we had to wait, and he would continue in the evening. But he couldn’t come in the evening. We agreed with the owner that he would come in the morning after 10.00. But he came in, waking everyone up accordingly. The hostess didn’t even apologize and removed us from the booking at 7.50, as if the hotel had refused us check-in. Two days of my vacation were ruined. These are the impressions. And the nature there is gorgeous.

reviews.author: Наталія Башмакова
reviews.text: Good conditions, the room has everything you need, each room has air conditioning. The apartments are bright and beautiful. There is a shop nearby and the beach is not far away. There is private parking. There is a terrace with a view of the sea and mountains.

reviews.author: Bojana Zivanovic
reviews.text: Every recommendation. Extremely clean, unobtrusive hosts. Everything you need was in the apartment. Ironing board, iron, hairdryer, cutlery, towels. Beautiful large terrace on the ground floor with a view of the yard. The nature is incredible, as is the peace and quiet. Once again, every recommendation.

reviews.author: Sergei “boogie” B
reviews.text: Cool villa. Not far from the beach, near a shop. Peace and quiet. Excellent terrace on the first floor. The second and third have a better view, but a small balcony.

reviews.author: Marcin NN
reviews.text: I recommend ! You just have to be careful when booking the Risan villa because Google Maps shows the Risan apartment, which is closer to the sea, and the Risan villa is a bit up the hill.

reviews.author: ayhan soydan
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dining experience! Our waiter, Nikola, provided excellent service – he was attentive and made our meal even more enjoyable. We particularly loved the stunning views from the restaurant, and it's great that it's also a pet-friendly establishment. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sam Alexander Supertramp
reviews.text: The most important thing to know about this place is its amazing view. It’s definitely one of the best spots in the area to watch the sunset. As for the restaurant itself, they serve a variety of dishes. On our first visit, we tried the ćevapi, which were quite tasty and very reasonably priced. We watched the sunset and were really happy with the overall experience. On our second visit, we wanted to try something with chicken. I ordered a breaded and fried chicken roll, which is usually made with a different kind of meat, but they offered to make it with chicken instead. Unfortunately, some parts of the chicken were not fully cooked inside, which was a bit disappointing. However, the salad we ordered on the side was fresh and tasty. My girlfriend also had a chicken dish – it was good enough. Overall, we liked the place. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere was very relaxed. If you’re staying nearby, this is definitely one of the best options around. There aren’t too many restaurants in the area, so it’s worth a visit.

reviews.author: Okan Karamanlı
reviews.text: The food was delicious and the view was amazing. If you want to enjoy a nice dinner overlooking Sveti Stefan, you should definitely come here. The waiters were also very friendly and attentive.

reviews.author: Bogdan Bhall
reviews.text: Tasty food at very good prices. Fast service, nice people. Highly recommended! Best place to eat traditional in Sveti Stefan

reviews.author: Ewa Nowicka-Szlufik
reviews.text: Restoran Drago is a very nice place on the map of Sveti Stefan that you can not miss if you want to eat something tasty in a pleasant atmosphere. Large selection of dishes from the menu. Very nice service of the waiter Boban made us feel like home. Boban you are the best of the best. We hope that we will come back here again.

reviews.author: Catherine Adam
reviews.text: Delicious sunset dinner. We got here a bit before sunset and although it was a little warm it cooled down quickly and we got a lovely view of the sun as it was setting. The food was good and fresh - we focused on the seafood which did not disappoint. The staff was very friendly and helpful and our waiter particularly attentive. Would definitely recommend. (We didn’t stay at the hotel so can’t comment on the rooms.)

reviews.author: Franklin Amorim
reviews.text: Fantastic waterfront restaurant with a stunning view. We ordered a selection of cheeses and olives, a Greek salad, and a prawn risotto and everything was absolutely delicious. We also enjoyed a few glasses of lovely rosé wine. The service was excellent, and our waitress was incredibly friendly and attentive. Our total bill came to around €75, and it was well worth it. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Andrew Z.
reviews.text: Very friendly staff and a perfect location with a sea view. The waiter even brought some bread for our son to feed the fish — he found it fascinating! The tuna carpaccio was excellent, as were the grilled seafood and octopus. We also really enjoyed the sardines as a starter — highly recommended! Everything was excellent, except for two hairs we found in the dishes — but that’s a trifle compared to the outstanding taste of the food!

reviews.author: solo per te
reviews.text: Every year I come to Przno, Great Place I had high hopes for Konoba More in Pržno, but my experience was a complete letdown. This place is perpetually packed, and it seems like you need to be a local to even stand a chance at getting a table. We arrived for lunch on Sunday without a reservation—our mistake, apparently—and were told it was fully booked, with no effort to accommodate us or suggest a wait time. It is mostly by loud groups of local Montenegrins who seem to treat this place like their personal hangout. When we finally got a table, the atmosphere was unbearable. The restaurant was so noisy, with boisterous locals shouting and laughing, that we could barely hear each other. It felt more like a rowdy bar than the quaint seaside konoba we expected. The outdoor terrace, which could’ve been charming, was overcrowded, and the vibe was chaotic rather than cozy. The food didn’t redeem the experience either. The service was rushed—our waiter seemed more interested in joking with the regulars than checking on us. Prices were also steep for what we got; €55 per person for mediocre food and a headache-inducing environment is hard to justify. Konoba More might be for local crowd, but for visitors looking for a peaceful meal or decent service, it’s a miss. I won’t be back, and I’d suggest looking elsewhere in Pržno for a more enjoyable dining experience. Konoba Langust maybe when they open Visited: April 2025 | Meal Type: Luch | Would Not Recommend

reviews.author: Sara Savatovic Hathorn
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience at Konoba More restaurant. The stunning sea view and coastal decor created a relaxing atmosphere. The friendly staff provided great recommendations for local attractions. I highly recommend this place for a lovely dining experience with beautiful views!

reviews.author: Elif B
reviews.text: The staff was extremely nice and friendly, everyone speaks English. The view is amazing. We have drank only coffee, machiato was tasty. Prices are fine a bit higher than in Budva but the atmosphere worth it. When you spend up to 30€ you have a sale for parking spot and you spend more than 30€ parking spot is free. I recommend this place for sunset.

reviews.author: Oskar Mizgier
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived, the professionalism and attentiveness of our waiter truly stood out and made our dining experience exceptional. We ordered the fish plate, which was a fantastic choice—everything was incredibly fresh, perfectly prepared, and bursting with flavor. The presentation was beautiful, and each type of seafood on the plate was good. On top of the amazing food, the view from the restaurant is absolutely great. I really appreciate the job done by the waiter - comparing to other restaurants in Montenegro it really stood out.

reviews.author: Sanem Altay
reviews.text: If I could give 10 stars, I would. This was by far the best restaurant we visited in Budva and the surrounding towns. Even though we did not have a reservation for two, we were warmly welcomed and seated right away. The view was absolutely stunning. We ordered grilled vegetables, a tomato mozzarella salad, and a steak. We asked for the steak medium, and it was cooked perfectly. Highly recommend the steak—it was excellent. The staff were extremely friendly and the service was very fast. They even gave us some great information about Sveti Stefan. We’ll definitely be coming back here the next time we’re in Montenegro. Don’t think twice—just go!

reviews.author: Tom Doherty
reviews.text: Great view of the Sveti Stefan island. Fantastic service from the waiter who was very attentive and made us feel welcome. There aren't many other options around this location unless you head further up the beach towards the hotels and beach bars. This restaurant is on the expensive side. We shared a vegetarian pizza at €17 however it was very tasty and well cooked. We also had an Americano and a small draught Nik beer. The total bill was around €27. If you are willing to pay a bit extra for location and convenience in a nice setting this is for you.

reviews.author: Susanna Crementi
reviews.text: We had a magical dinner at this restaurant, enjoying the best grilled octopus we’ve ever had. The restaurant is located right in front of the sea and Sveti Stefan, offering a stunning view while you dine. The waiters were also excellent — friendly, attentive, and professional — which made the experience even more special. (Shout-out to the little cats wandering around the restaurant and stopping by to say hello while we were eating , absolutely adorable!)

reviews.author: Clint B
reviews.text: Nice little lunch stop, very casual open air in the middle of the marina. Food quality and serving size was ok for lunch. Crumbed fish was slightly over cooked but still ok. Would need to try other dishes to provide a better review at this stage. I was expecting a higher standard of food given the location and clientele in this area.

reviews.author: Asset Yergaziyev
reviews.text: Waiting time is 40 minutes. Even after the waiter said 5 min it took him 15 more to bring the food. There hot inside even they have air condition inside.

reviews.author: Ирина Малышева
reviews.text: Very atmospheric, beautiful view of the bay on the yacht, delicious pasta, served hot, with the right sauce, plenty of bacon and cheese, and a well-foamed cappuccino. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Jon Ferdinand
reviews.text: Lovely meal on the harbour appropriately priced for the area. Ourside tables a must! The pizza had a thin base with a good amount of topping. Black pasta was delicious. Service was a little slow but friendly and helpful

reviews.author: Zeynep Nazlı Ceylan
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant by the sea. The atmosphere was truly amazing. We got lunch there and tried their sandwiches,coffee and pizza. I highly recommend the beef sandwich it was amazing but we didn’t like the pizzas. Service was a bit slow. Prices were a bit higher than other places at the port. We ended up paying around 12 Euros per person without the drinks.

reviews.author: Samer Kilani
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at this restaurant. The seafood was fresh and full of flavor-easily some of the best I've had in a while. The dessert was also a highlight, perfectly balanced and a great way to end the meal. Service was very good and impressively fast, with friendly staff who made sure everything was just right. The location is perfect-right by the beach with a beautiful view that added so much to the overall atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality food in a stunning seaside setting.

reviews.author: Mikael Jalonen
reviews.text: A cozy restaurant right next to my accommodation, with stunning upstairs views across the bay. I visited three times during the week for lunch/dinner and had the sea bass fillet, soup, and pancetta-wrapped chicken. The food was reasonably priced and tasty. Service was good and efficient. Some dishes could have used a bit more seasoning, but overall everything was enjoyable. It was lovely to enjoy the food and the view from the upstairs terrace.

reviews.author: Paul Field
reviews.text: Busy casual dining that balances price and quality perfectly. Service was friendly, fast and attentive. Probably the best service we've experienced in the entire region (and it was a fairly busy service for the restaurant). Fish and Chips although visually it's a little off from traditional British fish and chips, was delicious and the portion size is great. The octopus salad and fries were amazing and plenty of fish, no skimping. Pancakes for desert were delicious as was the chocolate cake. For portion size, value and quality this is the best venue we've found in the area.

reviews.author: Kaidi O
reviews.text: The food tasted fantastic and is cheap compared to what you get, the customer service was superb. Everything in that place was simply amazing. I highly recommend this place to everyone!

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.text: We didn’t enjoy our visit to this restaurant, we had doubts before we entered and they were confirmed. There is a low class feel to the place, dirty and busy, smokers everywhere. Ground floor was uninviting so we went upstairs. A bit better, less people and cleaner air. View was really nice. Food was terrible, couldn’t eat the fish and chips. Fish was like a piece of cardboard, “chips” the same. Octopus was not fresh. At least the salad was okay. Drinks were okay too, the waiter said they make themselves including the bottle but I’m not convinced. Girlfriend had a scary experience when a man wouldn’t let her leave the bathroom, he stood in her way and insisted on talking to her, asking her personal questions. Not recommended

reviews.author: Samer Kilani
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at this restaurant. The seafood was fresh and full of flavor-easily some of the best I've had in a while.
