reviews.author: Lika Magal
reviews.text: We arrived at a beautiful restaurant in the afternoon and discovered a lunch deal for two for 65 euros. The chef's dishes were exquisite, and the desserts were delightful. There were three of us, and it was definitely enough. The portions aren’t large – that’s something to be aware of. We savored every bite. Perfect! Highly recommended. And the service was amazing – a friendly, attentive, and wonderful staff. 🙏

reviews.author: Jordan Hooper
reviews.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ From the moment we walked in, the service was absolutely outstanding — warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly. Every member of the team made us feel welcome and went above and beyond to make the experience special. The food? Easily the nicest meal we have ever had. The meals were cooked to perfection, beautifully presented, and bursting with flavour. You can tell how much care and passion goes into everything they serve. It’s rare to find a place where the atmosphere, service, and food are all equally exceptional — but this restaurant delivered on every level. A true 5-star experience all around.

reviews.author: Beth Scott
reviews.text: I don’t even know how to begin with describing how incredible our time at Murano was so I’ll split the review into two parts. We ate at Murano every morning during our honeymoon trip & stay at Regent Porto. Service was impeccable and to one of the highest levels I’ve ever witnessed. Staff were attentive and friendly & service was smooth and effortless. The view overlooking the bay is one I could have every morning. The buffet was incredible with so many options that I was overwhelmed (in a good way). There was also an option to order off a menu (highly recommend the truffled eggs and eggs Benedict with spinach). Staff were so accommodating to needs and requests off menu a truly 5 star experience. Special thanks to Jelena who went the extra mile for us on our last 3 mornings and was so lovely and funny. We also want to thank Shivangi who welcomed us every morning to breakfast, one of the most wonderful humans I’ve ever met who should be proud of the 5 star service she provides. She even made us a very special homemade card which she gifted us on our last day that I will cherish. During our stay we also had a special dinner on our first evening at Murano which was incredible from start to end. We were lucky enough to watch a stunning sunset overlooking the bay. The service from Milo’s was incredible from start to end going above and beyond to make our night special. I could eat the butter selection with the fresh bread all day long. The Buratta was the best I’ve ever had and the Seabass with potato pearls was the best dish I had during our whole time in Montenegro. We especially enjoyed the theatre of Milos deboning the fish and playing it for us. We also had the best sparkling we had during our stay a beautiful Blanc de Blanc from Italy. Murano has truly set the bar for world class service. Thank you for making our special trip perfect from start to end!

reviews.author: Milica Andrea
reviews.text: Definitely the best restaurant in Porto Montenegro! From food to service everything was exceptional. The waitress Ivana was very helpful and provided top notch service. I strongly recommend the steak and duck foie gras and for dessert the crème brûlée

reviews.author: David
reviews.text: Very bad welcoming. We were 8 people wanting to have some dinner at the terrasse, and the lady said is not possible no move 2 tables to makes us seat at the terrasse and that it HAS TO BE inside. I tried to talk with the manager, which the lady said he’s not here and she’s not gonna contact him , because I’m more than sure that a manager wouldn’t say not to such a table to people from One and Only in Montenegro What a same. She was not even trying to make us have a table.

reviews.author: Mehdi Zllanoga
reviews.text: good food not bad i really liked it i tryed the bünner it was🔥🔥

reviews.author: Ibai Cascante
reviews.text: I ordered a pizza and some pie slices. Pizza was fine. The cake of the chocolate pie was days old, it was hard. The waitress was extremely rude and unhelpful. She prevented me from making a photo of the signs to translate them to english. Absolutely to be avoided.

reviews.author: Rumeysa Gökdemir
reviews.text: It was bad experince for us. Workers were rude.

reviews.author: NURULLAH ATILGAN
reviews.text: It was bad experience for us. Workers were rude.

reviews.author: Hasan B
reviews.text: The best bakery I have been to in Montenegro, many choices and very tasty. Nice staff. They have döner and pizza too.

name: Porto Montenegro - Al Posto
address: Porto Montenegro - Al Posto, Tivat, Montenegro

reviews.author: Iryna Didkivska
reviews.text: We’ve been based in Port Montenegro for four years now, and it just keeps getting better. The infrastructure is constantly evolving in the best possible way — everything is modern, well-maintained, and thoughtfully designed. The entire marina is surrounded by lush greenery, which gives it a very relaxed and luxurious feel. The promenade is absolutely stunning, perfect for evening strolls or morning coffee with a view. There are also some truly fantastic cafés and restaurants — stylish, with great service and high-quality food. It’s a pleasure to be here year after year.

reviews.author: Aleksandar Dašić
reviews.text: Porto Montenegro is a perfect blend of luxury and comfort. From high-end boutiques and charming shops to cozy cafés and fine dining restaurants offering international cuisine, everything feels thoughtfully curated. The atmosphere manages to be both serene and lively, making it a must-visit spot whether you're there to shop, dine, or simply take in the stunning views.

reviews.author: Can Burak Bizer
reviews.text: They seem to have forgotten to build shades, somehow. It's too hot under day sun, and might be a better experience in the late afternoon for dinner - not for lunch. Honestly, to much built up (with "modern" architrcture) and feels so shopping centre touristic, yet nothing local or authenthic. Sea row is rather reserved for cafes and restaurants, and 2nd row street for shops.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: Beautiful place! Totally different vibe from the old Kotor or Budva cities. Great for having a dinner in one of the fine dining restaurants nearby or just for a walk. A lot of yachts, good looking people, places to sit down and enjoy the views. Very clean and modern place. Not that big, you can see all of it in 30 minutes. Also there are lots of luxury brand shops and delicious cafes (recommend the Kafeterija for coffee)

reviews.author: Volkan Oflaz
reviews.text: Porto Montenegro is far more than just a marina – it’s a complete lifestyle experience! As you stroll among the stunning yachts, you’re surrounded by elegance and style at every turn. From high-end boutiques to charming shops, cozy cafés to fine dining restaurants offering global cuisine, everything is thoughtfully curated. The atmosphere is both serene and vibrant, perfectly blending luxury with comfort. Whether you’re there to shop, dine, or simply enjoy the view, Porto Montenegro is an absolute must-visit while in Montenegro.

reviews.author: Greg Da Vinci
reviews.text: It is better to pass this point. The usual gas station, but very rude staff. No one speaks English. As soon as I went inside, the woman immediately began to yall at me that it prohibited to go to the toilet, that it is not public toilet. And that I have to get food first. It feels terrible

reviews.author: Dal
reviews.text: Located in a gas station near a big restaurant. They have wifi. The capuccino is basically milk with a coffee flavor.

reviews.author: Demjen Renáta
reviews.text: They didn't let us go to the bathroom, they don't speak English at all, it wasn't enough to pay 100 euros for fuel per car, they shouted at us very rudely to buy something if we wanted to use the bathroom.. Nice little hospitality. “They love tourists “😉

reviews.author: Galina Merkureva
reviews.text: The cafe at the gas station meets high service standards. Yes, of course, as everywhere at gas stations, the treats are more expensive than in a cafe in a neighboring town. But those traveling by car enjoy the smell of coffee, and the sight of fresh pastries whets their appetite. And, perhaps most importantly, a clean toilet with soap and paper pleases those who spend a lot of time behind the wheel.

reviews.author: Jonny Johnzi
reviews.text: I wanted to buy something, get gas and go to the toilet. I was rudely ordered out of the toilet. She screamed at me “Not working”. A little tip: Maybe take a piece of paper and draw a sign with “Out of Service” and stick it on the door. You rarely experience such unfriendly staff!!!

reviews.author: Jarrod Brown
reviews.text: Providing the atmosphere and experience of a modern yet relaxed pub, Montenegro’s own Blacksheep Gastropub is the first of its kind in the city of Tivat. Warm and inviting, the Blacksheep definitely stands out from the rest of the flock. The focus is on great food paired with delicious drinks to create an experience for restaurant guests. The way the pub is decorated was eye-catching and attractive to me, and really was unique from anything else in the city. I was so excited to tray the traditional style pub fare, and I can say The Blacksheep Gastropub did not disappoint! My friend and I were immediately made to feel welcome during our lunch. The servers were friendly, knowledgeable about their menu and very attentive. We never went without a single thing, and the whole time was relaxed and comfortable. We opted to start with the honey mustard chicken wings, a perfect blend of tangy and sweet with crispy fried chicken. A standard pub food kicked up to the next level. We shared an order of fried calamari, which has to be the best I ever had. Crispy, golden, and tender. I dove right in to my Rancher’s burger, topped with salty bacon and a delicately fried egg, resulting in a gooey, yet delicious, trail of yolk. My friend enjoyed a classic plate of Fish and chips, exactly what you’d want with the perfect beer to wash it all down. Of course, no meal is complete without a sweet ending, and The Blacksheep did not disappoint. The American pancakes with Nutella and chocolate syrup were amazing! The coconut shavings provided a little crunch, while the pancakes were light and fluffy. I’d go back just for these alone, though I plan on getting another burger soon. A real gem in Tivat.

reviews.author: Maya Pogosyan
reviews.text: Very nice gastropub in Tivat, one of my favorite! Super friendly & unique atmosphere, cozy terrace outside, wide selection of draft beers and very tasty food - probably one of the best price/quality places:) every Friday live music performances in the evening! Definitely recommend !

reviews.author: PHILIP BAKER
reviews.text: A nice bar doing good food & cocktails on the beautiful harbour of Tivat. It's very laid back & nobody seems to be in any hurry here, so give yourself plenty of time. People smoking inside while you're eating is a little off putting at first, but after a couple of cocktails, who cares.

reviews.author: Branimir Kojic
reviews.text: Must visit if you are beer food lover. Selection of beers is not so great in craft segment. But local brewery Fabrika from Risan have very nice beers. Favorite is Smilin' goat IPA. All burgers are excellent. First class food.

reviews.author: Dragan Ajkovic
reviews.text: Inside this place you feel like home, food is perfect (you should try burgers on montenegro way, and wraps) beer is lovely( homemade beer from podgorica) and then staff is always smilled and nice. Please try this place becouse you would be disapointed. ;-)

reviews.author: Ant Friedl
reviews.text: We had a great meal here. We'd spotted it during our week and made it our final night's dinner. I had pork with cheese inside and lightly seasoned wedges. Amazing! My girlfriend had the sea bass. Again, Amazing. The atmosphere was lovely and chilled. Cracking end to our time in Tivat. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Service

reviews.author: Katerina K
reviews.text: Quite pricey place with non working toilet, but service and food itself was great. Nice wine and beer selection, delicious olive oil, homemade bread, fancy cutlery and dishes. The quality of the food is great, try shrimps carpaccio

reviews.author: Yesim C
reviews.text: Atmosphere is very good, food is delicious, service s good and helpful. Menu has many choices. The music list inside also ee enjoyed. Prices a bit higher comparing to other average restaurants but definetly worth.

reviews.author: Nayana Talwar
reviews.text: The food is fresh and really yummy. We ordered the prawns carpaccio (yummiest ever), prawn grilled with veggies as per guest request and Lustica Bay pasta. Service was a little slow and haphazard but the food was mind blowing

reviews.author: Citlaly Manriquez
reviews.text: Uffff MY WHOLE EXPERIENCE was immaculate just impeccable from the moment I walked in to the end!! Just wow my salad was the best I’ve ever had in my entire life, I’m not big on salads but i saw the squid & octopus salad oline and wanted to give it a try as I’m staying in Porto and was craving something fresh!! My server Aleksander was incredibly polite and went above and beyond to provide me with top notch service! I highly recommend this to my friends and fellow travelers in Tivat! The creme dessert was fantastic it is almost like a flat croissant filled w bavarian cream!! I’m a fan of pastry and this made my mouth water! my Blue Lagoon drink was so fresh and perfectly balanced! Not to mention the atmosphere is so relaxing w the view of both town and water, By far my favorite restaurant here in Tivat! Xoxo 💕💕

reviews.author: Blerim Mandija
reviews.text: Nice place

reviews.author: Rafał Ozga
reviews.text: Good burqas at a good price.

reviews.author: Sylwia Pazzi
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Peter Abonyi
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Mustaf Bardhi
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Sofine Akm
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Peaceful and relaxing spot by the sea. The food was delicious and the service outstanding. Our waiter was incredibly attentive and took great care of us. A wonderful place to unwind. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Diellë Gashi
reviews.text: Visited the restaurant and had the fish and fish soup—both were super fresh and really tasty. You can tell they use good-quality ingredients. The service was also great—really friendly and attentive. Plus, the view is really pretty, which made the whole experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Tilly Tillings
reviews.text: What an incredible restaurant all around. The food was absolutely delightful- we had the muscles in tomato sauce and the meat skewer. Couldn’t recommend this restaurant anymore! Also, the staff are so lovely here and very accommodating.

reviews.author: Ruby Hargreaves-Wall
reviews.text: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 An unforgettable dining experience with a view to match We had an absolutely wonderful dinner at this beautiful restaurant overlooking the bay — easily one of the highlights of our trip to Ulcinj. The service was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming from the moment we arrived. Our server was incredibly knowledgeable and offered great recommendations, especially when it came to the fresh seafood. We went with their recommendation for the fresh fish and it was nothing short of amazing. Perfectly cooked, flaky and flavorful, with just the right touch of herbs and olive oil. Paired with a glass of local white wine, it was a perfect match.

reviews.author: András Rusznyák
reviews.text: We visited the restaurant mid-June 2025 and had a great experience. The view of the city and the bay is amazing. The lower terrace is cool and shady even in the midday heat. The fish was delicious and fulfilling for lunch. There were plenty of tables at lunchtime, I'd recommend that instead of dinner.

reviews.author: Eris Pejtamalli
reviews.text: Best place in the area. Located near Ulqin, close to the park. The atmosphere was great, very nice view makes you feel like you are floating. The service was very nice. The waiters made sure we had everything needed and helped us choose. The food was 10/10 very tasty, fresh and cooked properly. I highly recommend a visit to this place and will definitely come back again.

reviews.author: Duljo Perasevic
reviews.text: Great food. Best sevice in Ulqin. The staff is highly experienced and very tentative to every request. The design is very modern and well done. And the view is one of the best in Ulqin. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Réka Kelemen
reviews.text: Very tasty fish, BUT! We asked for a fish approximately 1 kg, they let us choose, but didn't inform that it's almost 2 kg big. (I guess regular people don't see the wait in 1 sec) And the fish we chose had the price of 35 eur/kg in the menu, while on the invoice it was 50 eur/kg. It is not about the 20 euros which we left as a tip, but the fact that they cheat on tourists I cannot accept at all. We also had some extra drinks on the bill, they let me not pay for and waited to be thankful for... Also we ordered aperol, it was my third time taking it there and it was super watery, very light and not with the good prosecco as usual.

reviews.author: BARISTAFABRIK
reviews.text: Review: Sapore di Mare in Ulcinj, Montenegro ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Five of us stayed at Sapore di Mare and it was a fantastic experience! The location of the restaurant is simply unbeatable – right by the sea with a fantastic view. There is no better setting for dinner in the area. Our bill came to €155, which was totally reasonable given the quality and quantity of the food. We shared a large sea bream that was cooked to perfection and also enjoyed fillet, striped steak and prawns with potatoes. The dishes were fresh, perfectly seasoned and lovingly prepared. We also had an excellent white and red wine as well as two bottles of water - the wine selection matched the dishes perfectly. The service is particularly noteworthy: the waiters were incredibly friendly, attentive and made sure that we didn't lack for anything. All in all, an unforgettable evening in a great seafood restaurant! We'll definitely be back. Many thanks to the Sapore di Mare team!

reviews.author: Christian Buchholz
reviews.text: Excellent location, you feel like you're sitting right in the sea. Recommendation: be there at sunset... All the waiters were super friendly, warm welcome, top service the whole time! Food outstanding, I had the veal skewers!

reviews.author: Milica Savic
reviews.text: It was really great experience with this apartment. Location is perfect, center is near and you have really great view to the sea. People who work there were really nice to us. All apartment are really clean and every day you can see this nice lady who care about apartment. You have everything in room what you need for vacation and you have kitchen that you share with everyone and you have everything in it. We had a great time there and in Ulcinj 😊

reviews.author: Daniela Červenáková
reviews.text: My husband and I are on our honeymoon and traveling from the Czech Republic to Greece. This is our 5th place where we spend the night but the most beautiful so far. Amazing quiet location surrounded by olive trees and magnificent sea views. Quality wifi signal was one of our conditions because we are working on ntb, the signal is at full level. The beach is about 3 minutes walk. We wanted to stay here longer but the rooms are already booked :(

reviews.author: K K
reviews.text: Very clean, comfortable, modern apartments with a nice balcony and sea view. The owner was very polite and helpful. Would love to come back and recommend to other guests.

reviews.author: Szabó Bence
reviews.text: Finding the place was a little difficult, but otherwise It was an amazing stay. The owner was pretty helpful as well.

reviews.author: Luka Ovsec
reviews.text: best location and accomodation ever!!!

reviews.author: Igor Fabjan
reviews.text: Delicious food - go for local delicacy - smoked carp which is fantastic! Eel and trout as well! And try priganice for a dessert

reviews.author: Rich Brilli
reviews.text: Pretty fast and attentive service for being in Europe - and a small town, too! Nice view along the waterway, pretty good English from the staff, and fair prices - they have a full food menu, but I stopped for some late evening coffee and cake and was really good, recommended!

reviews.author: 小烏魚
reviews.text: Very delicious food! Affordable prices! We’re recommended by local people here! Definitely will visit again 😀

reviews.author: Joe Russell
reviews.text: Trout was delicious, the fish chowder very good. Staff were attentive and friendly, toilets a bit dirty though. Nice decor, the view from the terrace over the river is beautiful.

reviews.author: Jakub Polczyk
reviews.text: Unique place to hava a meal. Great soup as well as fish or meat.

reviews.author: Jon Gibbins
reviews.text: Nice affordable, place with friendly staff. Stopped with the family for ice cream (just a €1) and a light lunch. The bruschetta and fries to share were just what we needed. The food served seems uncomplicated, which suited us fine, especially the kids who can be fussy. I was thankful to have a strong, iced coffee in hot weather. We sat in the outside terrace, which was good for keeping cool, watching the world go by including the occasional train nearby. Happy parents, happy kids.

reviews.author: Beccy Thompson
reviews.text: Friendly team, quick and efficient. Had a great trip out on the water (& the team went out of their way to help us with picking up drinks, restrooms etc before and after our kayak trip). Would definitely do again :)

reviews.author: Jake Motyl
reviews.text: Delicious! The steak is amazing. Everyone must come here. Excellent service, excellent coffee, excellent food. 5 stars!! Great location.

reviews.author: Darren Lische
reviews.text: The food was delicious and the service friendly. No complaints. I would eat here again. The restaurant was clean and comfortable. We ate inside and returned and ate on the terrace.

reviews.author: Cemre Ceylan
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful place. They are so friendly and welcoming! Food is delicious too. Thank you x

reviews.author: Irina Spiridonova
reviews.text: We went to this restaurant after a boat tour on the lake to try some local fish. This restaurant didn't disappoint, all the fish tasted fresh and was nicely seasoned. Smoked carp was definitely a favorite.

reviews.author: Lili
reviews.text: Great food, really good prices (we paid 20€ for 2 people without drinks or desert). Big meals that definitely fill you up, we took the leftovers home. The staff was super friendly and accommodating for our dog.

reviews.author: Rolly Sitani
reviews.text: You are literally on a boat! It feels like a pirate ship just on the lake! Tried breaded olives for the first time in my life. It was good! The homemade bread is great as well!

reviews.author: Honest Yednas
reviews.text: Don’t be fooled by the empty looking front-it’s not shut. You just have to go down the steps under the signage. The restaurant is situated on a wooden boat, good service, fresh food and nice waiter who even recommended where to get Ibuprofen. Relaxing atmosphere and good views. If you see three carp fillets on the menu, it might only come with 2☹️ but don’t you worry, it’s probably the same weight, just a heads up. If you happen to see some loud people on the phone, give them a stare and they should shut up. The waiters were extremely patient with some unpleasant customers, look out for the green polo shirts, they are nice people.

reviews.author: Tim Calderhead
reviews.text: A charming restaurant in the heart of Virpazar. We opted to have a variety of small vegetarian plates which was plenty for us, all the while enjoying the lovely sights and sounds of Virpazar. The staff were attentive, but not too much so

reviews.author: Aditya Malik
reviews.text: Nice hotel right by the parks entrance. The staff is friendly and check-in process went smoothly. The morning buffet is good, but the restaurant food is overall just ok. The spa isn't that great, but the rooms are spacious. The amenities aren't the best, but if you're just looking for a place to sleep, this is great value and quiet.

reviews.author: Moti Bar-Tal
reviews.text: The hotel is located right at the entrance to Durmitor National Park, approximately a 2 km walk to Black Lake. An excellent hotel, comfortable rooms, a superb breakfast, and a great restaurant for dinner. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Boralf Thorgul
reviews.text: We spent four wonderful days at Soa Hotel and had an amazing time! Extremely friendly end helpful service, wonderful ladies at the reception and lovely appartments. Take a hike on the red rock, the view is absolutely amazing! Also highly recommend the Jeep tour! Take also a massage, if you can!

reviews.author: alon aizik
reviews.text: Service beyond imagination at the soa hotel I have to share with you a crazy experience we had at the soa hotel! We arrived tired and exhausted in the evening, after we had a flat tire on the way. We had already imagined all the nightmares of looking for a tire shop late at night, but then something amazing happened. The reception representative, Mr. Zarko, simply went out of his way! He not only helped us find a place that would take care of the problem quickly, but even offered to meet us there to make sure we received decent service at a fair price. This is not only good service, it is service beyond all expectations. This help, care and dedication make this hotel a place that I highly recommend, and we will definitely return there. Thank you so much Zarko and Soa Hotel! Definitely recommended.

reviews.author: saar perera
reviews.text: We came to the hotel just for the restaurant. We made reservations in advance even though the restaurant wasn't full. We were there at the end of April. The food was really delicious and the waiters were polite and nice.

reviews.author: Aleksandrs Barsamovs
reviews.text: Portions were large. But one dish did stand out not in the best way. It felt like meat was cut to small pieces and just fried on a pan with some little salt. Not even a hint to be grilled. No sauces or spices whatsoever. To no surprise, it was extremely plain. Classic montenegrin "cash only," and you find that out after you have been served, not beforehand. Just wandering, what will they do if someone will come without cash and the local cash machine will not serve that particular card? Tables were sticky. The whole experience felt odd, paid down to a single cent. Giving 2 stars for not getting food poisoning.

reviews.author: Jovana R. (Jovana)
reviews.text: Prices did not get an update since Nato bombing of FR Yugoslavia. 🙂 Mixed meet (EUR 10) was served in portion which could fill two or even three hungry bellies, delicious. Service solid. Place has a mountain like tavern feel. French fries served with meal could be better and they could change playlist from popular folk songs to traditional music. 🙂

reviews.author: Lukáš Michálek
reviews.text: I had a menu option for 15 EUR. Awrage overpriced food experience stuck in 90s. I got a dirty plate and tables were sticky. The pile of bread crumbs stuck in them was suggesting that cleanness is not a priority here. Waiter was probably in training but kind and attentive. Portions generous. Roasted lamb was the best part of the menu. Soup and desert felt more like a school cafeteria memory. Overall nothing different from the rest of the Montenegrian cuisine scene. Menu option is actually a great idea, still cheaper then other restaurants but for that money I would expect a bit more effort and creativity.

reviews.author: Lotan Portal
reviews.text: Great place to eat some local dish and very good meat. We took the lamb and the veal and they were both great. The service is a bit alow but worth it. Dessert was not good... The rest was very nice.

reviews.author: Ali Al-Rufaye
reviews.text: It was delicious, we ordered the vegetable soup for 2 🍲 came in a big bowl, and was warm and tasty 😋 the trout 🐟 was very tasty as well, fried well that the skin is crispy from outside, and yet the meat was juicy, very delicious and recommended. The fries that came with the meals were a bit cold and there was a small amount in general, the fried cheese was okeish, salad came in really big cuts, but very basic, tomato slices and some cucumber cubes. The staff were very kind, friendly, smiling and welcoming, they served us very well, however we had to wait a bit to find a table, and the table next to us was very very loud, annoyingly loud that we couldn't eat peacefully, but that's nothing related to the restaurant itself 🤷‍♂️

reviews.author: Tal Porat
reviews.text: The salami sandwich was perfect for a hike and the service was good. But the pastries were not good. The meat burek was specifically bad. You can get far better and cheaper pastries in the supermarket.

reviews.author: Valeria Bronzino
reviews.text: We came with our friends to have a little breakfast before a long trip day. Decided to take Lisnato with prosciutto and one with cheese, they were absolutely cold and empty, they tasted like they made them yesterday. We also ordered 4 burek with meso, we had to wait for 25 minutes and the Pekara was completely empty, they had no one waiting for them. Burek were terrible, the meat was not properly cooked, inside 2 of my 3 friends didn’t find meat at all. The dough inside was raw and outside burnt. I don’t know what to say, I just think it’s not fair to serve something like this to people especially in the center of Zabljiak. Absolutely not recommended.

reviews.author: Dakson
reviews.text: Average bakery for people who live in Zabljak, not the fancy one for tourists which is good. They dont have much things to buy but food is average for the price.

reviews.author: Lewis Heather
reviews.text: Best bakery we found in Montenegro by far. Delicious homemade bread and pastries and a lovely family feel to the place. Wish we could get the bread sent over to England!

reviews.author: Just An Ordinary Account
reviews.text: Nice local bakery, helpful and nice staff. Delicious bureks with meat and potatoes. That was the place keeping us well fed during hiking in Durmitor.

reviews.author: Irina Spiridonova
reviews.text: We ended up going to the Durmitor restaurant for both lunch and dinner. We had pastramka with kajmak (trout with fat cream), and muchkalica (sauteed meat with vegetable sauce) for lunch, and then the lamb from under the bell (sach) with some salads. The food was amazing both times. Service was prompt and polite. The only hiccup was coffee with milk that we ordered after lunch and it arrived absolutely cold, while Turkish coffee it was brought with was hot. Not sure if that was how it's normally made, or it just got cold while the Turkish coffee was cooked. We had it anyway:) But in the end it was a really pleasant, chill place to go to, they have a small outdoor terrace overlooking a small lawn, and a litter of adorable (but spoiled) puppies who play, run around and occasionally come by to beg for food.

reviews.author: Aleksandra Nesic
reviews.text: The restaurant is located in the center of Zabljak. The food was delicious, the portions were generous. Affordable prices. The service is fast and the waiters are friendly. We sat on the closed terrace, it could be a little better arranged, but certainly everything was correct.

reviews.author: oshw _m
reviews.text: This is hands down the best restaurant I tried in Zabljak! We stayed in Zabljak for one day and ended up eating here twice.Honestly, I think everyone should try this place at least once! On our first visit, we ordered the fried meat patties and grilled meat skewers—both were delicious. The skewers were mild in flavor, and I personally preferred the taste of the patties.Also, their chicken soup is a must-try! It’s so comforting, especially with those short noodles that add a great texture to the broth..After being out in the cold, a bowl of this warm soup was exactly what we needed. The next day, we came back for more chicken soup, along with the chicken thigh dish, which was equally tasty. We also tried a tomato-based soup with meat on the owner’s recommendation, and it was excellent as well! Before coming, I’d read some reviews mentioning hidden charges, but we didn’t encounter anything like that at all. The owner was genuinely kind and transparent with us. After our meal on the second day, we were in a hurry to catch a bus. The owner noticed we were back for another meal and even surprised us with a small dessert! I have to say, everything the owner makes is fantastic, and that dessert was no exception! What really made the experience unforgettable was the owner's kindness. Not only did she make sure our food came out quickly when we were in a rush, but as we were leaving, she even offered us a ride to the bus station. Her thoughtfulness truly made me fall in love with Zabljak and its people. I wish her all the best and hope her restaurant keeps thriving!

reviews.author: Lotte
reviews.text: Really nice staff, but the food wasn’t as good as we hoped. The food portions are quite big and the chicken tasted really burned. We also lived at an Airbnb that was connected to the “hotel”. The room was okay. We had a fridge, tv and washer. Unfortunately the room didn’t have air conditioning, and we only had one duvet for 2 people in a double bed😃 The apartment is also located at a noisy place, but the host was really helpful and nice.

reviews.author: Carlos von Steinkeller
reviews.text: Good food, nice atmosphere and friendly staff. The food was tasty, the salad is always just one kind of salad, like cucumber salad is 100% cucumber slices. The Burger is not to be recommended, but the chicken breast is very delicious and the Cevapcici are a good choice too. Ajvar tastes good with the Cevapcici.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text: The best dining experience I have had in a long time. Attentive, friendly and not annoying service. The food was fresh and a delight for my taste buds. The oysters and seafood platter were amazing. I got the apple tart to go. They made it fresh onsite. It wasn't prepared and was delicious as well. The wine that was recommended was perfect. Thank you for an outstanding dining experience.

reviews.author: barry flynn
reviews.text: Absolutely outstanding! Amazing ambience, amazing staff, and the food is out of this world! Fresh ingredients cooked to perfection.Not to be missed! So good we went back and once again they did not dissapoint, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Joe Khan
reviews.text: Amazing experience at La Scala. Yusuf and all the staff were fantastic, even though it was Ramadan and the guys were breaking their fast, it was always attention to detail. Food, especially fish was out of this world, fine dining experience and so fresh and tasty. If in Agadir, please don’t miss this place, you will be so pleased.

reviews.author: DeeDee Jay
reviews.text: I don't know what to say but that this place is consistently fantastic in all areas. Ikram heads the customer service with a beautiful smile and amazing service. Ready to recommend a good dish, she's honest about size portions (and I'm a big, BIG foodie). Ikram is such a lovely server, naturally friendly. Now to the food...I am in orgamsic food heaven. The seafood salad was AMAZING as was the prawn avocado, and the prawn pil pil. Let's move to the mains sea bass and sea bream fillets for myself and my friend....DEVIOUSLY DELICIOUS!! We had the surf and turf on a different day and it was criminally delicious. Just come here and sample for yourselves ....I don't know you but I'm confident you'll be happy you came. Oh and the prices are good for what you get too...delightful. The atmosphere is wonderful, it's so relaxing, no rushing you for any reason, just gentle check ins to see if the food is to standard.

reviews.author: Elena Cassidy
reviews.text: Incredible experience at La Scala. We ate here 5 out of the 6 night we stayed here simply because of the quality of food and the service. The food was unbelievably tasty, full of flavour & each dish was nicer than the next. I would HIGHLY recommend a trip to this restaurant for an unforgettable dining experience. Youssef and his team are wonderful!

reviews.author: Mahdiyeh
reviews.text: French, Morrocanian and Mediterranean food place. Paella was delicious and tasty. The service was great. Thanks to the girl who's working there or the owner. We did not like a starter, and they changed it for us with something they offered. Music, vibes, and location were all good. I loved Crème Brûlée. The price was good and affordable.

reviews.author: Unes Chama
reviews.text: The best Restaurant 🍴 ever I had only some biers and shrimps with garlic & olive oil, so tasty and delicious 😋 I really love it I recommend it

reviews.author: Msfab
reviews.text: Fish Tagine and chicken couscous was super and portions on big side. Good value!

reviews.author: James Turner
reviews.text: Been using Le Flore for a few days, I had mentioned earlier in the week that it was my birthday, 3rd june and we would pop for a meal, turned up today, the meal was lovely, then bell's started ringing followed by happy birthday music playing, with that the waiter appeared behind me with a birthday cake with 1 candle on top, the cake was to small for 63, what a lovely gesture, thankyou so much, it made min and my wife's day (Merci beucout) Jim from Grimsby

reviews.author: Pjand Sons
reviews.text: Very good food, I'll be back tomorrow 😋

reviews.author: Tina Bevan
reviews.text: What a wonderful restaurant first class on food, service and atmosphere. You will not be disappointed and won't want to go anywhere else. The live singer was amazing, lovely voice and a good selection of songs. The staff were so friendly. Our number one recommended restaurant in Agadir. Enjoy.

reviews.author: Mr Kalach
reviews.text: The food was absolutely delicious, and the waiter was both witty and genuinely friendly. We truly enjoyed not just the meal, but also the warm and lively atmosphere. I really hope that life will bring me back here again one day!

reviews.author: Lee O'Donoghue
reviews.text: Fabulous place, food and staff! We were staying at the allegro over the road, frankly it's below average at best so do yourself a favour and visit Le Jardin d'Eau. It is knock your socks off better in every way The pastille is a definite choice. A fusion of sweet and savoury that you think you won't like but you will absolutely love We went with lamb shank and lamb tagine, both were equally great with tender meat cooked perfectly I was a bit poorly before my visit and couldn't finish much, I felt terrible about it and will head back in a couple of days for another go Edit: return visit 2 days later for lunch. Pastilla, still great! Also went for the John Dory, really great fish cookery and surprisingly generous portion. Well worth the return visit

reviews.author: Przemek Tuliszka
reviews.text: Unfortunately, I do not recommend this place if you want to eat Moroccan Salad or Caesar Salad… The mint tea was also weak. It’s worth going to a place further from the main street for better and cheaper food.

reviews.author: Gee Ellis
reviews.text: Amazing service, greeted with free bread and olives, great selection on the menu and the food was 10/10! Atmosphere was great, nice music and seating.

reviews.author: nicola greig
reviews.text: Lovely meal and great service! We had the beef carpaccio to start which just melted in our mouths! Followed by a fillet steak and the lamb shank which were both divine! The local red wine (half bottle) was also great! Just a short walk from the Sofitel where we where staying. The decor was tasteful Morocco style and the service was great! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: megatl01
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant, perfect service, food was delicious, beef tagine, lamb shank followed by crème brûlée, highly recommended Only gave a 4/5 for atmosphere as it was quiet but we did eat quite early in the evening

reviews.author: Hu Sofie
reviews.text: Beautiful place and beautiful food! We arrived at 7pm which is bit early for locals and it got busy after 10pm when the live music started. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ikram Mekraz
reviews.text: I had an incredible dining experience at this beautiful restaurant! The ambiance was absolutely stunning, with attention to every detail that made it feel both elegant and cozy. The food was delicious and beautifully presented, but what truly stood out was the service. Abdoullah was exceptional attentive, friendly, and always going above and beyond to ensure we had a perfect evening. His professionalism and warm demeanor made all the difference. Highly recommend this place, and I can’t wait to visit again

reviews.author: Sandy Wood
reviews.text: Don’t walk past - go in. Lovely environment. We were served by Hamed. So so efficient and was practically running around with our table of 9. Totally forgot what great restaurant service is like nowadays. He reminded that it can be achieved. Without hoovering over the table. Food - great Choice of food - great Portion size - huge 😝 Surrounding - fantastic

reviews.author: Tom Tom
reviews.text: ★★★★★ A dreamlike restaurant with beautiful live music! This restaurant in Hair is simply fantastic! The location right on the beach is breathtaking – a perfect place to enjoy delicious food with a stunning view. The restaurant is stylishly decorated and offers a pleasant atmosphere. What impressed me the most was the live music. Talented artists sing in different languages, creating a unique and special ambiance. The musical variety makes the evening even more memorable and provides an unforgettable experience. The food was fresh, delicious, and prepared with great care, and the service was attentive and friendly. Overall, a perfect place for a special evening! Definitely a top recommendation – I will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Cody Valnes
reviews.text: Went with a group of friends and we all enjoyed our time here with very friendly service. The food was good quality and we were quite pleased with the wine selection. A good place for large groups with lots of outdoor seating.

reviews.author: chung ying
reviews.text: Experience is good in general, great atmosphere with nice live music (just a wee bit too loud tho). Staff are friendly in general, but not too attentive, probably because it was too busy. We ordered a fish assortment dish for 1 person and a beef tagine. They are amazing. Just a bit disappointed with the dessert, we ordered a chocolate fondant, and it was served cold, probably waited a while to be served after it was done.

reviews.author: Deborah McNeice
reviews.text: Great time had here. Very busy place with great atmosphere. Staff lovely. Food great. Abdul our waiter was a joy. So professional and funny. Would go here again.

reviews.author: Andrew Menzies
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere and location with nice views across the beach. Live music not to loud as to not interrupt meal. Berber salad with extras, followed by a well flavoured Tagine Kefta. Only downside is the hawkers allowed in the restaurant.

reviews.text: Such a great place with delicious food and dessert. The waiters are friendly and funny. I ate so much and joked about being pregnant because my stomach bloated up after eating so much, and the waiter just went along with the joke. Do yourself a favour and visit this restaurant - you won't regret it!

reviews.author: Vicki Monk
reviews.text: Great food, well presented, all staff were lovely, we were served by Hassan. We went twice during our stay in Agadir and both times were extremely pleasant. Pina Colada’s were tasty too. Thumbs up from The Brits xxx

reviews.author: David Russell
reviews.text: Excellent value. My lady had the prawns provancale starter as a mains. They were meaty and more like small langoustine. 5 on the platter with a generous side of mixed veggies, not as soft as in tagine or couscous dishes, a pleasant al dente to them. I had chicken in a mild mustard sauce with rice. Delicious. The service was v friendly. Recommended.

reviews.author: claire cundall
reviews.text: We went to this restaurant for a change. I'd read the reviews and thought it may be good. How wrong was I. They brought some free small starters. A small crispy spring roll kind of thing and a shot glass size of something I wasn't sure what it was, pink liquid. I overheard someone say it was pumpkin gazpacho. Both were extremely bland. I thought 'is this the way it will continue'. Our starter came. We were sharing grilled prawns. They were OK. Not the best prawns I've ever had. Came with a bit of sauce, garlic and tomatoes but you would barely know, again very bland and not super sweet prawns you would expect from an area that has a good selection of fish. The mains came. I had sole in a shallot sauce. The fish was rolled up, it wasn't very fresh, very bland tasting. The sauce was barely there on top, again very bland. It came with boiled rice that had raisins in. Really bland rice. The vegetables were OK, well the green beans were. I had some delicious butter left over from the bread and butter and added that to my fish to try and salvage it, it didn't work. My partner had the monkfish with mango and coconut cream sauce. His had slightly more flavour owing to the mango but other than that bland again. When the waiter came to collect our plates he asked how it was. Typically English we said OK but pulled a face and wavered our hand as if to say so-so. Hassan, the main waiter dealt with the payment and offered us his card, with his name on it and asked us to provide a review on TripAdvisor. He obviously couldn't read our faces, and we'd said it was just OK when he asked. I'd left half of my fish too. The service on the whole was fine but you want good food when you're paying for it. DON'T BOTHER EATING HERE. What a waste of £62.00. Date of visit: March 2025

reviews.author: william “Billt” tranter
reviews.text: Great food, very nice staff, mid priced but the portion size is large. A very nice evening spent here

reviews.author: Jaana M
reviews.text: Go in the evening! Has warmers and a bubbly atmosphere. Plus tasty tapas. Had mini burgers and toast with goat cheese. Worth the price

reviews.author: Grant Day
reviews.text: Excellent vibe, good food and reasonable prices. Had a steak each with sides, 2 drinks and with the free nibbles as starters. Steaks were cooked perfectly and were seasoned well. £35…bargain.

reviews.author: Wandsworth Eye
reviews.text: I like this place a lot - I went there twice while I was in Agadir and on both occasions the food was tasty, the waiters friendly and helpful, and the atmosphere warm and welcoming. Nice to have draught beer available at a reasonable price, plus generous tapas. If you’re looking for a taberna/pub experience in Agadir this is the place to go.

reviews.author: Alexa Paredes
reviews.text: It’s ok, but I had to send back my burger because it had porc, so for all Muslims be careful because cross contamination is highly possible. I ended up ordering just fries for no risk.

reviews.author: Ivona Jankovskaja
reviews.text: Great food! The only bad thing was that smoking is allowed inside .

reviews.author: Kabbabi Asmae
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this restaurant in Agadir! The place was elegant, the service was great, and every dish I tried was delicious. The meat was perfectly cooked, the fish fresh and flavorful, and even the pasta was amazing. But the real highlight? The dessert — so unique and unforgettable. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Mandy & Terry Tuley
reviews.text: What a fantastic dining experience. Sat inside which is comfortable and grand. Staff were all fantastic and very attentive. The food was excellent, easy and top quality. There is even a drop off service if you request this. Go here and I'm sure you won't regret it !!

reviews.author: Luke Martin
reviews.text: Came here today for a special lunch and it was lovely. The food is really good and they bring out fresh bread and dips at the start along with a gazpacho and mango which is a really refreshing way to start a meal. We got a Moroccan beer and also a bottle of Moroccan white wine. Both of which were amazing. The starters are lovely, oysters really fresh and the goats cheese salad was great. The mains are good but didn't quite live up to the standards of the starters. We were too full to have desert.... The service is pretty good and the restaurant itself is lovely. There are a few flies if you sit out on the balcony. All told pretty ace

reviews.author: ISMAIL AITOUTALEB
reviews.text: We had a nice culinary experience at Restaurant Pure Passion in Agadir. We experimented with their fish dishes and enjoyed a refreshing mokhito — both were delicious and well-prepared. The quality of the food is undeniable. One of the highlights is the beautiful view that overlooks the sea, boats, and marina — very picturesque. However, the ambiance inside was lacking, and the atmosphere felt a bit too quiet and formal. The prices are also on the expensive side, so it’s more suitable for a special occasion. Make sure to pre-book, as it’s required to get a table. Overall, great food with a stunning view, but a few things to keep in mind.

reviews.author: Simon Hodgson
reviews.text: Great food and atmosphere. Plenty to chose from. Great menu. Fish dishes and steak was very good. Reasonably priced at around £100 per couple for 2 courses and good wine with tip.

reviews.author: Kabbabi Asmae

reviews.author: Amélie Arras
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I visited the place after reading and looking online. We chose it because of the marocain salad, the soup and the Kefta egg tagine. When we arrived we were warmly received. The menu had changed from online (different items & price), yet the waiter overheard me saying I would have loved an egg and they very kindly said it was not a problem. I personally really enjoyed my food, it was simple, tasty, and my Kefta tagine as I expected. My partner said he had tasted better Harira soup and his lemon chicken was a tad bit dry, but overall satisfied of everything. I’d recommend for a one off, to try traditional food at a very reasonable price (we paid in total 174 MAD, for olives, Harira soup, the marocain salad, our two mains, bread, a big bottle of water and mint tea).

reviews.author: Meigo Etzel
reviews.text: We went here to eat after reading the reviews but chose to believe the older ones than the recent ones so we gave it a try. But unfortunately the food was not tasty, but still we ate almost all of it since we were hungry and the portions were really small. More like for kids, see photos attached. But I must give them credit for their mint tea, it is the best one we’ve had in the 3 major Moroccan cities we’ve been to. I recommend to eat at K moon which is just 20-30 meters away from here, though this restaurant could still be given a try!

reviews.author: Vojtěch Dolejší
reviews.text: Really amazing atmosphere and great local cuisine. The food is always tasty and the service friendly. I highly recommend to come here for a meal and have a Moroccan tea. I've been here 4 times during my time in Morocco.

reviews.author: James M
reviews.text: I came here for lunch and had the sardine salad. Very tasty and tasted very fresh. Good price and friendly service :)

reviews.author: H B
reviews.text: The food is very good specially the couscous. The portion of the mixed grill was extremely small (see the picture), the soft drink cost 10 MAD on the menu but I paid 12 MAD, maybe they should update the prices on the menu.

reviews.author: Katie Ansell
reviews.text: Food is DIVINE. We had an assortment of tapas and it was some of the freshest seafood we’ve ever had - prawn carpaccio in particular is perfect. Fast and friendly service, and the atmosphere on the terrace is lovely. Drinks delicious and really reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Agnieszka Wołos
reviews.text: A restaurant that stands out among many others – both for the quality of its dishes and its service. The seafood paella tastes like the ocean – prepared with attention to flavor and presentation. The fondant was exceptionally delicate and simply melted in the mouth. The service deserves special recognition – polite, discreet, and refined, especially the senior staff who bring a sense of elegance and class to the place. An added bonus is the ocean view, which creates a truly pleasant atmosphere. Thank you.

reviews.author: Sacred_M
reviews.text: A special spot next to where the beach meets the harbour. Ideal for a morning coffee or a midday beverage. I didn't get the chance to try the food but options looked very nice. Just to sit and relax. The decor and settings were lovely and chilled, more up market than most of the other places. Staff were friendly and welcoming.

reviews.author: Nigel Hopwood
reviews.text: Great sheltered spot on the beach (especially if it’s windy) sunbeds on the beach too 100 mad for 2. Staff are friendly and service is good. Great cocktails and beers good too not cheap at £4 a pint but not too bad!) worth it for the view and relaxation.

reviews.author: miracle deniz
reviews.text: I am a Turkish sailor. I am on a world tour and I definitely recommend this place to you. The owner of this place, Mr. Ismail, is a very good person, very helpful, friendly and not at all like a boss, he works constantly and is a very gentlemanly person. All the staff are smiling.💯🫂💯🫂❤️❤️❤️❤️ Harika bir yer fiyatlar çok uygun buraya gelince benim selamımı iletin İsmail beye 💯✅ Not : And they always offer you treats here. Her zaman değişik ikramda bulunurlar ❤️💯✅

reviews.author: Christopher Cokill
reviews.text: Had a fab meal here on Friday 27th June. Had 3 courses and all were superb. Service fantastic too and great value for money compared to the UK. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Emiley Harrison
reviews.text: This is such a beautiful spot for dinner. You don't get pressured to eat here unlike other restaurants on the promenade and the staff are really attentive and friendly. We ordered the swordfish, the cordon bleu and chocolate fondant for dessert and every single dish was perfection! Also had a raspberry mojito and it tasted beautiful and had fresh mint in it. I would highly recommend you come here and give this a try as it's one of the best meals I've had in a long time and it's worth every penny. Pricing wise, all of the above cost about £44 (2 mains 2 deserts and 2 alcoholic drinks)

reviews.author: Steven Fullerton
reviews.text: Ordered fish trio and seafood paella, both excellent. The waiter was very friendly and attentive as well. Last orders for food is at 11pm. GO!

reviews.author: joao paulo cunha
reviews.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5-Star Review for Playa Restaurant and Our Incredible Waiter, Sufyan. We had the pleasure of dining at Playa multiple times for both lunch and dinner over several days, and every single experience was exceptional. The restaurant itself is beautiful—stylish, welcoming, and located in a perfect spot to relax and enjoy delicious food. But what truly made our visits unforgettable was the incredible service from our waiter, Sufyan. From day one, he went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and well taken care of. He remembered our preferences, gave spot-on recommendations, and was consistently friendly, attentive, and professional. His warm attitude and genuine hospitality made us feel like valued guests, not just customers. Every meal we had was fantastic. The quality and presentation of the food were top-notch—fresh ingredients, bold flavors, and a menu that offered great variety. Whether it was lunch or dinner, everything was consistently delicious. After several days of dining at Playa, we left with full hearts and happy memories. Thanks to Sufyan and the whole team, Playa became one of the highlights of our trip. We highly recommend it to anyone looking for great food, a relaxed atmosphere, and truly outstanding service. We’ll definitely be back

reviews.author: Mandy & Terry Tuley
reviews.text: Just had a lovely evening meal here. Every dish - starters, mains and deserts were great. Cocktails and beers were great too.

name: Street Stall - Agadir Beach
address: Street Stall - Agadir Beach, Agadir, Morocco

reviews.author: Jay Max
reviews.text: Great, nice and clean beach equipped with everything, including lifeguards. We visited it during the last week of April 2025. The weather was great, always sunny and warm at noon and the afternoon, while cloudy and chilly in the morning and late evening. The beach is huge and long, all amenities available, full of cafes, restaurants, hotels, ice-cream vendors, souvenir shops; and above all a lot of Police patrolling the area for public safety. In some areas, the soccer playing youth bother you but you can move away. You feel safe. The mountain nearby adds charm to the view.

reviews.author: Cwtch
reviews.text: Beautiful!✅️ Clean.✅️ Safe! ✅️ This "easy to access" beach is one of the most beautiful in Northern Africa! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Zaheda Begum
reviews.text: A lovely sandy beach with the famous Mountain View in morroco. Lots of food places available including mc Donald’s, kfc and Pizza Hut. There’s also lots of shops to do shopping.

reviews.author: Mr Miah
reviews.text: It’s a nice sandy beach which stretches out across for miles but… and here’s the all important information for anyone visiting. * There were NO showers (at time of visit) or even any taps with running water for visitors and nearby hotel guests to clean themselves on the beach. We walked back to the hotel covered in sand from top to toe. Not a very flattering sight. The small changing area and showers located on the beach opposite where McDonalds is, was out of use - seemed like it had been decommissioned for some time. We did come across toilet facilities couple of days later on one of our evening walks, near to the public information building which seemed to have a shower but this is at least 1/4 mile from our hotel’s designated area of the beach and not visible from our location. Unable to ascertain if this was free to use or you had to pay. Again no information on this on the promenade or anywhere within the hotel. No clear nor visible signage anywhere. TUI (our travel operator) rep didn’t mention any of this either. * Areas ‘reserved’ for specific hotels and sold as private beach space by hotels and tour operators are all run down and in need of serious upgrade! * There are people begging, along the beachfront where the restaurants are. Not an issue for most people I imagine and they usually go away when you say ‘la shukran’ which means no thank you or do the universal hand gestures to say no. * There is McDonalds, KFC and a couple of other restaurants along one stretch and a number of rundown and vacant premises at time of visit. * We visited in the last week of May and things seemed a lot quieter than anticipated. The whole beach scene wasn’t as lively as we thought it would be based on the numerous travel videos/vlogs watched prior to our visit. Things did start to get busier from 1st & 2nd June. Annual School holiday for Moroccans also begins at this time. If you’re planning to visit and prefer a busier and livelier environment, then do bear this in mind. I strongly believe with a little investment in a few key areas, this could be an amazing beach to all tourists both domestic and international.

reviews.author: Iain Mitchell
reviews.text: Huge clean sandy beach with lifeguards, cafes, shops and restaurants behind the promenade. Water is clean and can have quite big waves. Loungers and umbrellas for hire, we used the area in front of 'Jour et Nuit' cafe. The people there are super helpful and also offer food delivery. Safe place, used by locals l, families, sports teams and surfers. Surfboards for hire. Lovely sunsets. Yes there are beach vendors but they don't bother you if you say no thanks.

reviews.author: Mohammed Ali
reviews.text: Good parking, price is affordable.

reviews.author: ilhame elayati
reviews.text: Great

reviews.author: rad fug
reviews.text: Nice, large parking lot that was free (I even managed to stay overnight here with my SUV..) the only problem was as soon as you were spotted as a foreigner, people kept coming who wanted either money or food.. that's not a problem in itself, just once you've given something to someone, it doesn't stop...

reviews.author: Abdelilah Gharbaoui
reviews.text: Parking lot known during this period Some traffic, that's normal Given the time period of Year parking Satisfies the possible conditions

reviews.author: Mitch Schuddinck
reviews.text: Be careful during the day and in the evening. It has improved enormously with the big strong lights at night.

name: Street Stall - Souk El Had
address: Street Stall - Souk El Had, Agadir, Morocco

reviews.author: Brian Fernandes
reviews.text: A lovely souk to wander around in, come out of the heat. A look at the various goods on sale (be sure to haggle). Argon oil, Dates, Fridge magnets and various goods purchased. Then, some well deserved Tagines with mint tea.

reviews.author: Masih HFZ
reviews.text: A very nice shopping area with reasonable prices. You have different sections. All from food to clothes and households and fruits and veggies. One organic glass of pomegranate juice costs 1$. A burger costs from 3$. No scam and no harassing unless you are an attention seeker.

reviews.author: Gregory Fernandes
reviews.text: Very interesting experience, but great to see and explore this market. So much to see, wish I had more time there. Like most people say, you definitely have to have good bargaining skills or you'll get ripped off.

reviews.author: Steve Bloor Media
reviews.text: My wife and I have just returned from a week in Agadir, and one of the main highlights of our trip was undoubtedly our three visits to Souk El Had in central Agadir. It’s an incredible market where you can find everything—from local crafts and fresh produce to electronics and household goods. The atmosphere was lively and exciting, making it a fantastic experience. The locals were very friendly, and we had no issues at all during our visits to the souk—or in Agadir in general. However, bartering is essential. The initial asking prices are often much higher than what you’ll actually pay, so it’s always worth negotiating—you can usually get an item for a fraction of the original price. While the vendors can be quite chatty, don’t feel pressured; just enjoy the experience and take your time. In terms of taxis around the town, we found that 20 MAD (€2.00) was a fair price, and once we agreed on that rate, the drivers were generally happy to accept it. Overall, Souk El Had is a must-visit, offering a fantastic mix of culture, shopping, and local life. We’d highly recommend it to anyone visiting Agadir!

reviews.author: Jason Candy-torn
reviews.text: This is a place to go for that taste of Morocco and how the local people go about their day to day life.you will find everything you could want and need and the smells of spices and other local products is amazing. The people there are also very friendly and not pushy. BUT PLEASE DON'T ACCEPT THE FIRST PRICE HAGGLE if they are asking you for saying 100 you should be going around half of that price

reviews.text: My wife and I have just returned from a week in Agadir, and one of the main highlights of our trip was undoubtedly our three visits to Souk El Had in central Agadir. It’s an incredible market where you can find everything—from local crafts and fresh produce to electronics and household goods. The atmosphere was lively and exciting, making it a fantastic experience. The locals were very friendly, and we had no issues at all during our visits to the souk—or in Agadir in general. However, bartering is essential. The initial asking prices are often much higher than what you’ll actually pay, so it’s always worth negotiating—you can usually get an item for a fraction of the original price. While the vendors can be quite chatty, don’t feel pressured; just enjoy the experience and take your time. In terms of taxis around the town, we found that 20 MAD (€2.00) was a fair price, and once we agreed on that rate, the drivers were generally happy to accept it. Overall, Souk El Had is a must-visit, offering a fantastic mix of culture, shopping, and local life. We’d highly recommend it to anyone visiting Agadir!

reviews.author: Jason Candy-torn
reviews.text: This is a place to go for that taste of Morocco and how the local people go about their day to day life.you will find everything you could want and need and the smells of spices and other local products is amazing. The people there are also very friendly and not pushy. BUT PLEASE DON'T ACCEPT THE FIRST PRICE HAGGLE if they are asking you for saying 100 you should be going around half of that price

name: Street Stall - Souk El Had
address: Street Stall - Souk El Had, Agadir, Morocco

reviews.author: Brian Fernandes
reviews.text: A lovely souk to wander around in, come out of the heat. A look at the various goods on sale (be sure to haggle). Argon oil, Dates, Fridge magnets and various goods purchased. Then, some well deserved Tagines with mint tea.

reviews.author: Masih HFZ
reviews.text: A very nice shopping area with reasonable prices. You have different sections. All from food to clothes and households and fruits and veggies. One organic glass of pomegranate juice costs 1$. A burger costs from 3$. No scam and no harassing unless you are an attention seeker.

reviews.author: Gregory Fernandes
reviews.text: Very interesting experience, but great to see and explore this market. So much to see, wish I had more time there. Like most people say, you definitely have to have good bargaining skills or you'll get ripped off.

reviews.author: Selma B
reviews.text: Excellent food! Best tapas ever even compared to the best rated tapas restaurants in Spain. Very professional and friendly service. Of all the timed that we’ve came to Casa Garcia we have never been disappointed, it only gets better. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Nour Bid
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience. I went with my wife and our 3-year-old child, and we waited for over 20 minutes at our table—no one came to take our order. What made it worse is that people who arrived after us were served before us. I tried speaking with the manager, but all he did was say he was sorry. No action, no solution, nothing. This level of service is unacceptable, especially for a family-friendly place. Definitely not coming back.

reviews.author: e s
reviews.text: We came around lunch time and it was very crowded. I'm not from the area but I could tell that it's a popular restaurant. The service was lacking they should hire more servers since they get this busy. The food was 10/10. The anchovy in vinegar was something new to me and was soooo good and refreshing. The fish soup was well balanced. The paella was good but I've had better. I ordered some lemon to squeeze on top since it doesn't come with it. We choose a fish and they grilled it beautifully and brought it with a side of fries and roasted vegetables. Would recommend but don't come in a busy time.

reviews.author: Nawal Belkasmi
reviews.text: We came in a rush, but the food and service are top notch. The place is usually crowded I just wish tables are a bit far away from each other. We love the place tho ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.author: Iulian Chiran
reviews.text: Good place if you want fresh fish or try something other then Marrocan food. The staff was friendly and the service was good. The food was good but a bit to expensive.

reviews.author: R L
reviews.text: An absolutely stunning location for a magical setting coupled with impeccable service. The food selection is average although the taste is commendable. It makes for a wonderful dinner. However, naturally, as a tourist trap, be prepared to pay a 150-200% premium over regular restaurant prices; it’s on par with Western European prices ie. super inflated by Moroccan standards. If you’re ok with splurging on that one night, you’ll be in for a good time.

reviews.author: Nader Shamia
reviews.text: Typical local food Average taste No any costumer was there when reaching, so service was very good. Price is reasonable

reviews.author: WaHired Today
reviews.text: It has a touch of Fine dining service. The price is worth for the taste. I suggest the Lamb Tajine with Plum. It's super nice, without the after taste of lamb and even the steong smell is not present. 🤩🤩

reviews.author: fede preguntame
reviews.text: The best place I went to in Casablanca......the service is excellent, the food is very good and the atmosphere eating under the tree is a great experience.....don't expect the price to be cheap, but I think it's fair for what it offers.

reviews.author: Nas Kb
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Almounia in Casablanca. The restaurant is a hidden gem, with a small traditional door that gives no hint of the beautiful Moroccan design inside. The place is inviting, making it a perfect spot for a special meal. The food and service were both excellent, with authentic flavors and great staff. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to enjoy a true Moroccan dining experience."

reviews.author: A Horani
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! The belly dance show was very entertaining and added a lively and cultural touch to the evening. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with a nice ambiance that made the night feel special. The service was excellent – the staff were attentive, friendly, and professional. And of course, the food was absolutely delicious! Every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a great night out with good food, great service, and an enjoyable show.

reviews.author: Rachel Lyubovitzky
reviews.text: Set the standard for Moroccan cuisine that no other restaurant here ever came close to. Beautiful restaurant perfect for special events. Impeccable and responsive staff. Alcohol served, yes!! :) And now food. Generous portions, great presentation, each dish has distinct presentation and taste. Traditional Moroccan appetizer mixer recommended and very big :) Harira comes with its own soup pot big enough for 3-4 additional servings. We loved our lamb dishes, chicken and fish. Pigeon pastilla -amazing, delicwte flavor. Comparatively more expensive but well worth it. Thank you!

reviews.author: Glenn Goldman
reviews.text: Good food and very large portions. The Moroccan Salad had seven plates! Some better than others. Pastilla was excellent. It was a good place to have dinner on the last night of a two-week stay in Morocco. Prices were reasonable.

reviews.author: Roxane Heidrich
reviews.text: Top Moroccan cuisine experience in Casablanca. The restaurant is on the expensive end of the range but the prices are fully justified by the excellent choice and and quality of the food, the top standard service and the beautiful environment. Loved this place so much that I went back multiple times. The restaurant serves alcohol (wine, spirits).

reviews.author: Fadima Sylla
reviews.text: The lamb shoulder was perfect! So tender and perfectly portioned for two people. The servers were also very welcoming, making the dining experience truly enjoyable.

reviews.author: Elif Baydogan
reviews.text: The ambiance and concept of the place is nice. The staff is attentive and you feel safe. The kitchen was also very good. Everything is great.

reviews.author: H
reviews.text: The food was ok but I wouldn’t say it’s traditional. The service was amazing and I’m sure if it was any other day apart from Sunday that this place would have more of a vibe.

reviews.author: Sana McKenzie - Call Sana Real Estate Broker
reviews.text: Excellent Spanish food in Casablanca🇲🇦Recommended by our hotel🏨We ordered a handful of tapas for our table. Very tasty and filling. Quick service. Fußball themed atmosphere for people who love the sport⚽️ They also had a nightclub in the basement if you want to take your turn-up to the next level😍

reviews.author: Rhea Perez
reviews.text: Authentic Spanish Experience in the Heart of Casablanca We had a fantastic time at La Bodega in Casablanca. The ambiance is vibrant and truly Spanish, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The staff were incredibly attentive and helpful, making us feel right at home. A special thanks to Mr.Youssef for his warm welcome and excellent service! The food was absolutely delicious, full of authentic Spanish flavors, and the prices were very reasonable for the quality and experience. If you're looking for great food, a lively atmosphere, and outstanding service, La Bodega is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Indria Štarkaitė
reviews.text: Great place ! Loved the atmosphere, the live music is fantastic, the staff really care and provide actual service with attention to detail. We even got a beer on the house as they were offering a degustation. Lots of fun this place! The only downside is that they still allow people to smoke indoors, which needs better ventilation… the food was ok, not great, a bit overcooked but we didnt care too much as we had an overall great time!

reviews.author: Rusen
reviews.text: My Moroccan friend took us here, and I loved everything we ate—especially the mezes, full of different flavors. The only downside was that it was very crowded. The garden had a great atmosphere, and the bathrooms and other facilities were clean and well kept. The staff were friendly too.

reviews.author: Heavenlykid 18
reviews.text: My experience at La Sqala in Casablanca was truly extraordinary. Despite not having a reservation, we were warmly welcomed with open arms, which was especially meaningful as we were fasting and looking for iftar during Ramadan. The restaurant staff embodied the true spirit of Moroccan hospitality, making us feel genuinely cared for from the moment we arrived. A special mention must go to Yaseen, our server, whose enthusiasm and kindness were unmatched. He went above and beyond, generously offering us a variety of dishes from the buffet and ensuring that we were comfortable throughout. Yaseen’s attentiveness and warmth perfectly reflected the hospitality and generosity that Morocco is known for, especially during the holy month. His efforts left an unforgettable impression. The food was abundant and delightful, with so many options that we, unfortunately, couldn’t try everything—though that itself was part of the experience. The array of flavors and dishes truly showcased the richness of Moroccan cuisine. Overall, dining here was more than just a meal; it was an experience that highlighted the warmth and culture of Morocco during Ramadan. Yaseen, thank you for your exceptional service, and for sharing the essence of Moroccan hospitality with us. I would highly recommend to anyone visiting Casablanca, and I look forward to returning in the future. Bravo to the team for a job well done!"

reviews.author: mariame kaba
reviews.text: I had dinner here tonight. The food was amazing. The scenery was beautiful. I highly recommend this restaurant. Next time I visit Casablanca, Morocco, I will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Hydi Ng
reviews.text: Lunch only services Lunch menu, don’t get in if just for tea. Wonderful experience of Morocco cuisine. The high tea set is not something I really like but it looked nice. Many bees 🐝 some flies always come to the food. Next table smoking, 🚬. Overall the experience is superior even have a spot for photos!

reviews.author: Fatima
reviews.text: Some of the best Moroccan food i have had! The service was excellent and the ambience took me back to Marrakesh! I ordered the buffet breakfast which included a selection of breads, dips and drinks. If there’s one item I’d recommend, it’d be to try the Sfenge! Simple beautiful
