reviews.author: Sandra Viktoria Graml
reviews.text: We had a pleasant stay at this hotel. The location is excellent — just a short walk from both the harbor and the Medina, which made exploring the area very easy. The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming throughout our stay. The pool is large, with plenty of space to relax and enough loungers for everyone. The breakfast was a bit limited in variety, but still okay to start the day. All in all, a solid choice for a comfortable stay in a great location.

reviews.author: Deniz Narli
reviews.text: Very good location close to old Medina and seaside. Hotel has history and is in a beautiful Moroccan style. However you can find lots of things are dated. The swimming pool is big and quite nice. We were especially disappointed in the breakfast. You often had to scrape eggs and sausages from the pan as they were almost always empty especially if you take breakfast after 9. Not alot of choice, lacks local options. We still really enjoyed our stay. But 3 stars because there is so much room for improvement. The spa was really good, really thanks to Fatima she went out of her way to make it an unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: Molly
reviews.text: Great location, beautiful hotel but definitely outdated. I’m sure back in the day it a 5 star resort but not now. While we didn’t have a bad experience here, this definitely wasn’t on par with the other 5 star resorts we stayed out. Truthfully, our stay at 3 & 4 star accommodations in Morocco were more luxurious than this. Even something as simple as a welcome tea, like other resorts & riads do, would have really elevated the experience. Again, we did not have a bad experience here, the photos just made it seem much more updated than it was.

reviews.author: Soufiane Lahlou
reviews.text: This is the historical hotel in tangier, located at city centre. Staff is king and professional, rooms are clean and well equipped even though a bit old but it’s normal it’s consistent with the hotel style and history. The hotel has a very nice wellness centre with a big jacuzzi and fitness centre. There is also a nice pool. Our breakfast was correct very rich and diversified, we could just have expected a slightly better breakfast experience. I recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Syed Raza
reviews.text: Excellent historic hotel with lots of old history on display. A great opportunity to see down memory lane. A gallery of pictures of stars and celebrities adorn the walls of the courtyard.

reviews.author: Chehrazad C
reviews.text: I forgot to review this spot- went here last summer. The food was wonderful, and offers a modern take on traditional Moroccan cuisine. The flavours and presentation were sublime. A calming atmosphere and beautiful lighting. The service was great as well.

reviews.author: Julia Julia
reviews.text: Can highly recommend this restaurant, we got to sit in our own room, amazing staff. Super cozy and great food. We really loved this place!

reviews.author: Zarek Peris
reviews.text: The candied lamb and couscous and John Dory fish were both excellent, couscous was great, atmosphere very romantic, and service attentive but a tad slow sometimes. And a wonderful romantic time!

reviews.author: Konsuella
reviews.text: Delicious food and drinks, separate bar / lounge downstairs, and a dining room upstairs. Great service. Recommended to make reservations.

reviews.author: Mohamed Amine
reviews.text: I had a disappointing experience while visiting with my family. There was an empty table available, but the staff refused to let us sit there, claiming it was reserved—although no one showed up for over an hour. I asked if we could use the table for just 30 minutes, but they still refused, seemingly because we were not foreigners. We were a group of seven and would have ordered more than many of the foreign guests who were seated without issue. This kind of discrimination is unacceptable. I do not recommend this club.

reviews.text: My recent stay was relaxing in a luxurious kind of way. I indulged in high end accommodations while my needs were being attended to by the highly professional management team & staff! An easy recommendation to family & friends!!

reviews.author: DYOURI Amine
reviews.text: I contacted them to make a reservation for an anniversary. They informed me that reservations must be made at least 24 hours in advance, which I accepted. They even told me the price for the preparations and the anniversary cake, and they sent me examples of the flowers they offer. However, they later called me back to say that all spaces were fully booked. This wasted my time and created unnecessary disappointment. The management at The Mirage should supervise their staff more carefully, as this kind of experience can negatively impact the hotel's reputation.

reviews.author: saarah
reviews.text: We came for afternoon tea as we saw on tik tok , we came dressed and were excited to dine . We were rejected at the door and we thought it was because we did not speak French (I have been tangeir multiple times) but it was actually because we arrived in a taxi . We are not from Morocco how else are we meant to travel ??? This is pure disrespect and entitlement. The driver was a lovely man who travelled 40 mins to get us to our destination. The security had said it was also because of no reservation but we were made aware from locals that reservation was not needed . We had witnessed other people be allowed entrance . I am very displeased as we were celebrating and I am very glad we did not book to stay here for our time here in tangeir and chose idou malabata instead . No reply from this place can change our experience I do not recommend this place if you have morals .

reviews.author: Zeenat Patel
reviews.text: we travelled 30 minutes away and were denied entry. I just think it’s absolutely rude and lack of consideration. They let a family that speak french in and not tourists who are here to see the view and the city. they told us it’s “closed” … clearly? i would not recommend going here specially if you’re tourists!! being denied entry is one thing but letting someone else in after us is unfair. i was with one other person. Looking at reviews a lot of people have said the same. i think based off other reviews it’s because me and my sister came in a taxi. well wtf do you want us to come in if we are freaking tourists?? make it make sense. both mine and my sister’s outfits cost more than the food itself if that’s why we were denied entry. stupid security was so rude and not helpful in anyway. closed and lets a family in after us what a joke.

reviews.author: Glowy Explorer
reviews.text: This place is absolutely perfect for sunset, beautiful view and peaceful atmosphere. The food looks nice, but the flavors didn’t really impress me. Still, the location and the view made it worth the visit.

reviews.author: James Bruce
reviews.text: Very enjoyable ambience. Good food, fair prices. Typical mediocre moroccan wine!

reviews.author: Ruben Rivero
reviews.text: Very nice restaurant. Traditional live music. We went there with a guided tour. Service was friendly. One member of our group was sick from the ferry and they offered to make him something different to help his stomach. I am not an expert on Moroccan food, but it was ok. Chicken on the couscous was a little dry. The ambiance was great. Everything very clean and nice.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible service! The owner called us arrogant! We asked to speak to the manager after having a terrible meal simply to provide constructive criticism. The meat was chewy and the vegetables were overcooked. Instead of apologizing or offering something else from the menu, the manager claimed the meal was perfect and that we didnt know anything about Moroccan food. "Well, we have good reviews on trip advisor" he repeated. We just asked to pay our bill and leave. Then we spoke to the owner who again took no responsibility and proceeded to call us "Arrogant". No matter how wrong you think a customer is, you should NEVER insult someone like that. We didn't call them any names so I don't understand what right he has to treat us this way. This is by far the worst place I've eaten in my 16 days in Morocco. We were expecting a fantastic, fine dining experience and instead received cheap fast food. Stay far away from this tourist trap!

reviews.author: kate
reviews.text: Back in 2010, my boyfriend and I had the pleasure of dining here! We had made the mistake of not checking what time restaurants closed at night because we were so tired from our long flight. This restaurant invited us in with open arms and served us a beautiful and delicious meal. We were so thankful for their generosity!

reviews.author: Martin Henry
reviews.text: Very nice Moroccan restaurant in the heart of Tangier old town. The restaurant offers a good selection of food and drink all of a high quality. The service is efficient and friendly.

reviews.author: M.
reviews.text: Very nice and quiet atmosphere to have dinner; A combination of Vietnamese, Thai, and Cantonese cuisines. Very creative but indeed tastes very good! They have a full list of menu on Instagram where you can check the pictures of each single dish. Quick and nice service as well.

reviews.author: John Farrish
reviews.text: UPDATE: La Pagode is sadly closed. Another restaurant's sign is replacing it and the windows are covered with newspaper. Very sad. Best full service Asian food in Tanger. It is one of the nicest, quietest restaurants as well, with impeccable service. It's the classiest place I'm all of downtown.

reviews.author: Ryan Early
reviews.text: The duck (canard laqué) was amazing. It's a simple , yet flavorful main of thinly sliced duck in a delectable sauce served with rice and veggies. It was a bit of a splurge for a backpacker at 120 dh but totally worth it. Take a break from tagines and tacos Haha.

reviews.author: HiroMori Sama
reviews.text: The ambiance was nice and the staff were friendly. However the food was not authentic and the server was not very attentive. Environment is clean but definitely do not go just for the food.

reviews.author: Aboudi M.
reviews.text: Unfortunately, I was not impressed with the food at this restaurant. It did not taste authentic and was quite tasteless. I usually try to avoid writing negative reviews, but I hope that this feedback will help the owner make improvements to the menu.

reviews.author: Tim
reviews.text: Old fashioned morrocan place with blue tiles. Many levels and stiff stairs . Not for elderly suiteble I would say. Menu in Spanish or Arabic and didn't understand any from it. So only order a fresh orange juice. Prices high and the kitchen Arabic

reviews.author: Arabella Flanagan
reviews.text: We stopped by Salon Bleu for a midday break and really enjoyed it. The crepes were light and tasty. We also had fresh orange juice and fruit bowls, which were super refreshing. The view from the terrace was beautiful, looking out over the city and all the way to the Spanish mountains. A really nice, relaxing spot.

reviews.author: Abigail Smith
reviews.text: A must visit for a delicious meal! The views are like none other in the city! Tapas style but they are all delicious so you can’t go wrong when selecting! Yummy natural juices as well! Would definately come back! The restaurant is a bit of walking up stairs so just be ready for that!

reviews.author: Clara Sherwood
reviews.text: Great place to go for tea, some small bites to eat, and a view. I was amazed by the atmosphere, prices, and quality of the food. It was 380 for 2 orange juice, 1 water, 7 of "Moroccan tapas," and the couscous. It wasn't even Friday and the couscous was great! It was timely, clean, and overall delightful. You won't find anything like this! 10/10 would recommend. Tip, contrary to the Google hours, the waiter told me this place opens at 12pm.

reviews.author: Ester Tancredi
reviews.text: We had lovely time over there, the service was fast and the food delicious! Far price for the location and the general prices in Tanger. Recommended

name: Le Saveur du Poisson
address: Le Saveur du Poisson, Tangier, Morocco

reviews.author: Gary Zhu
reviews.text: By far the best meal we had in our 1 week trip to Morocco - this place is a true hidden gem and we only saw locals when we dined there. We loved all the seafood dishes which were incredibly fresh with natural flavours and the unlimited fig & grape juice! The service was also amazing especially from the manager Hisham and it felt like eating at home being served by family even though the staff do not speak much English. It is also a set menu so no need to worry about what to order. All in all highly recommend this restaurant and can’t wait to go back to visit!!

reviews.author: MT C
reviews.text: Fixed menu, good value. The fish wasn’t the most succulent I’ve had, a little dry, but boy do they fill you up. Nuts and olives, fish soup, a tajine, a grilled whole fish plus a fish kabob, fruit juice and fruit for dessert. The baqoula and seafood tajine alone is worth the price of admission. Service is far above average for Tangier, attentive and quick yet discreet. Recommended.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: Incredible food. Great place to select and enjoy fresh fish!

reviews.author: Enis GÜNAY
reviews.text: Just go inside and sit down. Price is fixed. You have only one option to order. Soup + special shrimp + fish + fruit together. Place is really traditional. Strongly recommended

reviews.text: Fixed menu, so you can't really choose what to eat. But we really liked the selections of food. For the price we had a LOT and all good qualities. So much to eat that we really couldn't finish the dessert because we were too full from the amazing fish.

reviews.author: JEFF C
reviews.text: Al Achab is a wonderful seafood restaurant in the tangier morroco Medina. We were there at 3 pm on a Sunday in February and were seated immediately. Our table overlooked the kasbah wall and marina. Service was friendly and prompt. Server did not speak a lot of English but between some English, French and google translate - it worked out. Restaurant was clean and there was a handwash station in the dining room. There are several stairs from street level to dining room. Menu is pre fixe at 180 dh per/person. Cash only. Started with olives, mixed nuts, Harrisa, Fresh bread and tea. Next course was a delicious soup with seafood in a hearty stock - perhaps Harira? Next was a very tasty mixed seafood tagine on what appeared to be a bed of greens (like spinach) that also incuded 2 skewers with grilled fish ( maybe shark) . Main was 2 meaty charcoal roasted and very Flavorful fishes. Last course was chopped nuts over a grain ( like couscous ) with honey and fresh strawberries. Only suggestion would be to provide a menu of what was to be served so guests could know what was coming, variety of fish, and cost. Very good service, great food, generous portions, wonderful view and vibe. Quality experience and Very good value. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bradley Miller
reviews.text: Easily one of the best meals I’ve had in Morocco! No lie! Price fix menu so you just sit down and let them guide the experience. I knew from the first course, a fish soup, that I was in for a treat. Hands down the best grilled fish in the area. Had a garlicky smokey taste that was absolutely exquisite. Usually not a dessert goer but the honey almonds pine nuts barley and strawberries were the perfect touch to finish the meal. This is a MUST go to if you’re in Tangier.

reviews.author: Mo Morgan
reviews.text: This is a beautiful and original Moroccan restaurant Set menu for lunch Seafood soup, shrimps cooked in a special way, grilled fish then desert So good 💙

reviews.author: Narimane Larbes
reviews.text: I love the food there one of the best seafood that i have eaten so far highly recommended it made me wonder why isn’t it a Michelin

reviews.author: ADAM SMITH

reviews.author: Hajar Hamadi
reviews.text: Clean warm friendly staff, very good service the food was delicious. Overall it was a very enjoyable evening .

reviews.author: FB62 BLF
reviews.text: Wow is very beautiful and quite 😀

reviews.author: CaramelisedGuy
reviews.text: Not bad place to stay at.

reviews.author: houda dina
reviews.text: Very nice i like it😍😍👌

reviews.author: Kenneth Tangerois3 Maroc
reviews.text: DARNA (Maison Communautaire des Femmes) is a hidden place between the Boulevard Pasteur and the Grand Socco (Place du 9 Avril 1947) that is run by women and which has a restaurant (specializing in couscous and tajines) in the ground-floor interior courtyard and also a number of shops that sell gifts. DARNA is within walking distance of the Boulevard, Place de France, Hotel El Minzah, the Medina, Kasbah, Grand Socco, Grand Hotel Villa de France and Mendoubia Gardens. All of the food at DARNA is carefully prepared every day, and there are a variety of very reasonably-priced Moroccan foods and desserts on its limited menu, and tea, cafes and Mojitos. DARNA restaurant is open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sundays and throughout the month of Ramadan, but the gift shop is open on Sundays.

reviews.author: Ultegra Majoakes
reviews.text: It wasn’t particularly clear that they served food here and we only arrived on hearing glowing reviews. Once we asked they quickly clarified the food options and promptly served us. They provided a friendly lunchtime service with a vegetarian set menu in their sunny garden. We couldn’t see a menu or prices but risked it anyway, considered asking what they will serve and the price. (90 Dirhams per person for us). We were served by a chef in training who practised his English on us, which we enjoyed.

reviews.author: Nicolas Chartier
reviews.text: Nice fixed and cheap menu (60 dirham for first and main course) on a very quiet and leafy terrace in the shade, just a stone's throw away from the bustling and loud Grand Socco. The waiting staff is clearly not trained, but makes up the lack in experience with honest, almost shy kindness. Don't skip the lemon pie dessert, it is delicious!

reviews.author: John Hokkanen
reviews.text: A local told us about this awesome place! Mostly tourists, but some of the best couscous with chicken and vegetables that we've had. Peaceful courtyard. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gian Battista Marci
reviews.text: Lovely quiet place with homecooked food. Delicious!

reviews.author: Justine I
reviews.text: Azing experience. Food and service was excellent. The dining room was beautiful. The Moroccan dancer was fantastic. Highly recommend if you visit Tanger. Unique, great experience.

reviews.author: Natalia m
reviews.text: I don’t understand the bad reviews. The place has so good food, we were delighted!. ……and a dance show on top.. amazing!

reviews.author: Fadima Sylla
reviews.text: Very good food complemented by live music and a belly dancer. It's a great morrocan restaurant!

reviews.author: Dan M
reviews.text: Food was great. Classic Moroccan cuisine. The atmosphere within the restaurant is amazing, made better by the the beautiful belly dancer and classic Moroccan live music. A real exotic taste of the Orient in every sense! The restaurant has a comfy and cosy setting. Service was excellent. A compulsory Tangier experience in my opinion.

reviews.author: Laurie Reilly
reviews.text: I made a reservation. They knew I was eating dinner here for the music and belly dancing. When we arrived, we were told there was a private party and we could eat in another dining room without the show. This is a terrible way to run a business. We ate elsewhere.

reviews.author: Tiger Zhen
reviews.text: Very friendly staff, very friendly entertainers, good atmosphere for tourist, a little over price compare to local price, which is understandable, no cards but able to take euro or even US dollar (I only had USD on me at the time). food is......will different, after all this is my first Moroccan food I had.

reviews.author: ivonne rozaz
reviews.text: It’s the first time I fell in love with a place here in Tangier, the food is amazing, the music and the atmosphere, and of course they have beer!

reviews.author: Alex Tiberiu
reviews.text: Beautiful place, live music and great atmosphere. Very friendly and helpful staff. Food was very good. Beer and wine available. They don't accept credit cards but you can mix in Euros/other currencies.

reviews.author: Andrey Dashkov
reviews.text: A gem of a place in the old Medina. The food is great, the service is friendly and efficient. Have been coming back, and never disappointed

reviews.author: Eileen Crosby
reviews.text: Food was ok, very greasy though, music was nice when they played,

reviews.author: Arabella Poxon
reviews.text: I am so sad that this place doesn’t get any recognition! It is such a gorgeous place, truly a hidden gem. There is a man sat at the door ready to walk you in (may seem like you’re in the wrong place at the beginning due to it being in a low-lit small road) The service is amazing! The waiter is so attentive and cares truly to make the service the best for you. He is by himself, therefore it may be a bit slow, however this isn’t a fast-food restaurant anyway. He made sure we were warm and comfortable the whole time. Super friendly! The food is lovely too. Great portion sizes, gorgeous bowls, great seasoning. Nothing bad to say about it! In regards to the pricing, I think it is very valid for what you get (bare in mind it is higher prices, it isn’t a place for budget meals). The ambiance is top notch. Great music, super relaxing and gorgeous!! Wouldn’t go anywhere else for dinner apart from this restaurant during my stay.

reviews.author: Radia
reviews.text: One of the best restaurants in Ouarzazate city, I highly recommend it ❤️ The atmosphere is amazing, very calm and suitable for couples, family and friends. It’s an amazing place to enjoy a calm dinner or to celebrate a special occasion… It makes my heart warm knowing that I can enjoy my meal in peace, the music playlist is worth to mention as it makes the atmosphere more pleasant ❤️ I can recommend the dishes they have to everyone I know, but I wish there will more options to choose from in the future :) I tried Pasta with chicken and mushrooms 🍄 and it was delicious, I also tried grilled meat with vegies, my opinion about it was medium but definitely not bad ❤️❤️ The cheese cake was my best part ever🤭🤭 I absolutely enjoyed every piece of it 🫠 For the service, the guys I interacted with was very professional and kind ❤️ Thank you for making me enjoy and I will definitely be back every time I’m visiting Morocco 🙏🏼🥰 See you soon,

reviews.author: Emilie Gibney
reviews.text: A hidden gem in Ouarzazate - I recommend parking on the Main Street and then walking down the small streets to get there. Will not disappoint! Brilliant local and “foreign” cuisine. The decoration and style was beautiful and service great - highly recommend to anyone stopping through the area

reviews.author: Martin Hills
reviews.text: We chose this based on some other people's reviews and photographs and were delighted with what we found. The restaurant is at the end of a very nondescript street but as you step inside you're in a beautiful setting which is done just right. The quality of the dishes we ordered were of a high standard and generous. Tables are placed well apart so you can have a discrete conversation and not be bothered by other guests. A good price for the quality of the food we were served.

reviews.author: Naphat Yothataradol
reviews.text: Best meal in Morocco so far. Good food, great service. free parking. Accept credit card.

reviews.author: Pavan Simone
reviews.text: I need to say that the restaurant view is stunning as you can look over the bay to the Spanish Coast. Food and service are great level and a special thanks to the high professional, caring and kind service of Ms. Hanna. She welcomes guests with high level approach. My favorite place to dine

reviews.author: Mohammad Ashkanani
reviews.text: One of the worst experiences ever. The food taste was not good at all and the selection on the buffet was limited. Service was bad the never cleaned my table and they didn't asked me if I need anything to drink. Even the napkin on the table was used with lipstick marks.

reviews.author: Thuraya Al Harthy
reviews.text: The atmosphere is amazing, you can see all of Tangier from the top. The Morocco food is very delicious but the international food was fine. I really recommend this place as u don't really find good places around

reviews.author: Alan Mackinnon
reviews.text: What I call the mushroom soup was excellent and then I had really fresh vegetable plate and chicken couscous and finished with a chocolate dessert

reviews.author: Ivan Rostotski
reviews.text: We were on tour and stayed at the Hilton. Dinner and breakfast were included. Dinner was a set menu that included a great salad and the main course was a very good orange chicken confet. Service very polite and the servers do speak good English and Spanish. The breakfast was a buffet and I loved that their was Morrocan dishes to try. Service again was very good

reviews.author: James Bruce
reviews.text: Very enjoyable ambience. Good food, fair prices. Typical mediocre moroccan wine!

reviews.author: Ruben Rivero
reviews.text: Very nice restaurant. Traditional live music. We went there with a guided tour. Service was friendly. One member of our group was sick from the ferry and they offered to make him something different to help his stomach. I am not an expert on Moroccan food, but it was ok. Chicken on the couscous was a little dry. The ambiance was great. Everything very clean and nice.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible service! The owner called us arrogant! We asked to speak to the manager after having a terrible meal simply to provide constructive criticism. The meat was chewy and the vegetables were overcooked. Instead of apologizing or offering something else from the menu, the manager claimed the meal was perfect and that we didnt know anything about Moroccan food. "Well, we have good reviews on trip advisor" he repeated. We just asked to pay our bill and leave. Then we spoke to the owner who again took no responsibility and proceeded to call us "Arrogant". No matter how wrong you think a customer is, you should NEVER insult someone like that. We didn't call them any names so I don't understand what right he has to treat us this way. This is by far the worst place I've eaten in my 16 days in Morocco. We were expecting a fantastic, fine dining experience and instead received cheap fast food. Stay far away from this tourist trap!

reviews.author: kate
reviews.text: Back in 2010, my boyfriend and I had the pleasure of dining here! We had made the mistake of not checking what time restaurants closed at night because we were so tired from our long flight. This restaurant invited us in with open arms and served us a beautiful and delicious meal. We were so thankful for their generosity!

reviews.author: Martin Henry
reviews.text: Very nice Moroccan restaurant in the heart of Tangier old town. The restaurant offers a good selection of food and drink all of a high quality. The service is efficient and friendly.

reviews.author: Jolene Jey
reviews.text: WORTH THE WAIT. For once in my life, I stood in line and I’m so glad I did. The food was absolutely incredible. My partner and I were starving, and we were SERVED. Big time. Huge thanks to our InDriver who rerouted us here! we were heading somewhere else, and he made sure we experienced the original spot. From now on, no trip to Tangier without stopping here. Hands down our absolute favorite restaurant in town! 💛

reviews.author: MeRy L
reviews.text: Wonderful experience, food and staff 😍 the generous set menu for 250 DH per person is well worth it. The restaurant is small and cozy, at 1 pm on Wednesday (opening hour) there was only a couple and it started to get busier around 2 pm. From start to finish, the food was exquisite 👌🏽 authentic delicious northern Moroccan cuisine 😋 we ate everything and finished all our plates! This resto is a must in Tangier!

reviews.author: Bocus Rose
reviews.text: We had dinner yesterday at this place and the food was amazing. We started with a lovely fish soup, followed by seafood hot platter and then for main we had a big grilled fish . The flavours were so good! Don't be fooled by the poor lighting and simple style inside, this is a really proper culinary experience 👌. We paid 500 dirhams for 2 and it was worth every penny. I have to add that we didn't have to wait as we arrived just on opening time and people do queue up for this place. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Arne Kittler
reviews.text: Everybody is served the same hearty fish and seafood menu. Nice flavors and more than we could eat. Recommended!

reviews.author: Jessica Bello Salguero
reviews.text: The finest food we had in Tangier. Set menu for 250 dirhams per person with fresh seafood and fish. Simply delicious. Sure, we found very satisfying meals for much less but this is a treat worth having! The service was professional. We had shark, sea bass and sole. They served us a spicy paste, 3 different types of bread (you can ask them to heat the cold ones for you in the charcoal), delicious olives and toasted nuts. They provide a special juice they make with seasonal fruits that’s unique and very tasty. For dessert we had pomegranate with red fruits and honey, and ground nuts with honey. The queue is very long if you go past 1pm and you can only pay cash. They spoke several languages

reviews.author: Rebecca Avila
reviews.text: Excellent traditional Moroccan food, great atmosphere (full of people from everywhere), and great friendly service. Definitely recommend. The grilled salmon was delicious, and we enjoyed the vegetarian couscous, and chicken tagine. We also got the lemon tart, which my family enjoyed too. Very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Khaled Hakami
reviews.text: This is one of those charming antique restaurants that truly captures the flavor of traditional Moroccan cuisine. Don’t miss the crème caramel after your meal — it’s absolutely amazing

reviews.author: Will Pirnasch
reviews.text: Nice experience, good food, friendly service. They are very generous, you get free harissa and lentils for a starter, a bottle of water, and even a tea for finish. A good place to dine.

reviews.author: Jiaxin Wan (Annie)
reviews.text: Had fish soup and chicken tagine for one person. The food was delicious so even with the free pan and dessert and tea and all the snacks I finished them all. Nice staff speaks excellent English and helped me with some coin change. I did noticed they have a slight price increase compared to the menu on Google map, but I think they deserve it. Well done.

reviews.author: Daniel Bashaw
reviews.text: This restaurant is definitely worth a visit!! Speaking honestly, they served me the best meal I had in Morocco, without a doubt. The servers are very kind and welcoming, giving tea to finish dinner. Try the Harira, it was perfect.

reviews.author: Tyler Lovatt
reviews.text: Beautiful view and place for a walk, but be prepared to get a lot of people coming upto you for taxis or selling things as there is a lot.

reviews.author: A Flou
reviews.text: The corniche is a nice place to walk in it the only thing you wont like is someone who pass by and throw some word to you…

reviews.author: Putri Ve Mohamed
reviews.text: I love Alexandria Egypt 🇪🇬

reviews.author: juzar kachwala
reviews.text: Great views

reviews.author: DT /Ahmed Adel
reviews.text: wonderful place you can relaxe

reviews.author: Abdul Hazeeb
reviews.text: I really loved this place calm and serene spend time leisurely with economic bus fares from SAPTCO at just 3.45SAR which made the commute so easy

reviews.author: NiNiShu
reviews.text: Good space to walk around. Near the bay. Crossing roads is difficult, you need to reach here with Cab. Mosque nearby Hotel Dana by Rayhaan Rotana is nearby. Starbucks nearby

reviews.author: MARYAM
reviews.text: Sunrise at Dammam Corniche is pure magic! Soft waves, golden skies, and a peaceful breeze to start your day right. It’s the perfect spot for an early morning walk, a quiet coffee by the sea, or watching the kids play as the sun comes up. Whether you’re alone or with family, sunrise here feels like a gentle reset.

reviews.author: asif Theace
reviews.text: Dammam, corniche is a place where you can spend time with family and friends. You can sit on grass in the park, plenty of area for sitting. Wide area for car parking. Local food and tea, coffee vendors are available, restaurants and al baik is also there. For kids, there are rented cars and swings to enjoy. But it needs more cleaning due to a lot of crowd and repair because the steps area which connects the sea is not clean and street lights are broken. You can find here people enjoying finish also.

reviews.author: Mohammed Omar
reviews.text: The main beach in Dammam. Perfect for weekends or just for cruising in your car on late nights. The smooth toads and what not. A HOT SPOT for real!!

reviews.author: MOHAMMED AHMED MOHAMMED
reviews.text: Wonderful view

reviews.author: mohamed alhosani
reviews.text: Nice place but more attractive

reviews.author: a m
reviews.text: This place is wonderful with nice blue beaches I hope you visit it and you will see how much this city is beautiful

reviews.author: Space Love
reviews.text: Cool place to relax and enjoy nature

reviews.author: Ehsan
reviews.text: Calm and nice with good landscape.

name: Street Stall - Grand Socco
address: Street Stall - Grand Socco, Tangier, Morocco

reviews.author: Shaik Masood
reviews.text: Such a beautiful city square full of life and colour. Easily spend hours people watching and enjoying some goo delicacies and coffee in eat-outs around.

reviews.author: Iftikhar Qaisar
reviews.text: The Grand Socco of Tangier is a vibrant local market filled with bustling bazaars. It features a large fish market and is surrounded by many historic tourist sites, along with authentic local restaurants and cafés. You’ll also find several fresh fruit and vegetable stalls offering high-quality produce. A notable highlight is the tomb of Ibn Battuta, the world-famous ancient traveler, who was buried in his beloved hometown. It was from here that he began his 29 year journey around the world—starting on a donkey! A must-visit for anyone exploring Tangier’s culture and history!

reviews.author: Douglas Langrehr
reviews.text: Old suk in the medina. Well worth the visit but selling the same tourist stuff. Good to see it as it is colourful, vibrant and a bit chaotic.

reviews.author: Amy Leese
reviews.text: Fabulous....I got amazing henna done, bought perfume, a dress, drank coffee and watched the world go by.

reviews.author: Rastko Rafael Kozlevcar
reviews.text: Lovely place well kept with marble fountain, graceful lawns with flowers, a couple of bars, an imposing mosque built in 1917 and - the legendary cinema Rif, the seat of Tangier's cinématheque.

name: Street Stall - Ibn Battuta
address: Street Stall - Ibn Battuta, Tangier, Morocco

reviews.author: hawra alnabi
reviews.text: The burial site of Ibn Batuta, a native Tangier who’s known in the Arab world for his travel and his documentation of his travels. The place is in the old town in the middle of the houses. It is very unclear how to get there with Google Maps. We had a local that showed us the way. You’ve got to enter all sorts of alleyways before you find the place. We enjoyed our visit and the bit of history shared with us by the site keeper.

reviews.author: Qing Qin
reviews.text: Ibn Baruta is the greatest traveler and explorer who should be memorized by peoples in the history. Whoever thinks he or she is a good traveler should go to checkout this meaningful historical site when he or she visits Morocco .

reviews.author: Tolga “guidetolga” Günaydın
reviews.text: In the narrow streets small tomb of Ibn Batuta, who is a important Muslim - Arabic traveler and historian in 1300s. He traveled on 3 different routes and visited India, East Africa, West Africa, Russia and the Balkans by sea and land.

reviews.author: Mohamed Alami
reviews.text: Tourists come hoping to see something interesting and they get disappointed. Is Ibn battouta remembered or forgotten here? The Tomb is closed now. It definitely needs more care and more highlights of the great adventures of this hardworking explorer. The access is difficult.

reviews.author: N Yzai
reviews.text: The greatest traveller and explorer ever, the Muslim Marco Polo. The place unfortunately is not much as its completely neglected by the authorities. They have airport and mall and streets named after him but there is no attention paid to his resting place, for example a small museum to highlight his great achievements. There are not even signs to get there or a place to sit when you do. Priorities...as they say. So if you are a traveller and coming here only to pay your respects, great! but don't expect anything else.

reviews.author: Douglas Langrehr
reviews.text: Well worth the visit. This old Kasbah has been turned into private housing but was originally the Fort which protected the entrance to the river. Take in the peaceful gardens and a mint tea at the cafe.

reviews.author: Habib
reviews.text: One of the UNESCO sites in Morocco with old houses and some magnificent huge doors. There are some good souvenirs shops and local artists paintings. Generally, there is nothing much to see and I am really disappointed as I heard a lot about it, but nice for walking at least. Unfortunately no cafés on top of the castle as it would be good for seating and beautiful scenery of the ocean.

reviews.author: Mana Salem
reviews.text: The Kasbah des Oudayas in Rabat is a place where time slows to a whisper. Tucked at the mouth of the Bou Regreg River, this 12th-century fortress feels like a secret the Atlantic Ocean has been keeping. Its walls, painted in shades of white and blue so crisp they mimic the sky, curve around narrow alleys paved with stones worn smooth by centuries of footsteps. Walking through Bab Oudaya, the main gate, is like stepping into a postcard—if postcards could carry the scent of orange blossoms from the Andalusian Gardens or the salty breeze rolling off the water. The kasbah isn’t a museum; it’s alive. Locals lean in doorways, children dart between walls draped in bougainvillea, and stray cats nap in sunlit patches. Climb to the terrace of Café Maure, where mint tea arrives sticky-sweet alongside almond pastries, and the view stretches across the river to Salé’s sand-colored skyline. Below, the river churns where fishermen haul in their catch, and surfers bob in the distance, waiting for waves. The quietest corners hide the most stories. The Museum of Moroccan Arts—a restored 17th-century house—displays faded carpets and daggers, but the real magic is outside. Wander until the sounds of the city fade, and you’ll find yourself at Plateforme du Sémaphore, where the horizon blurs between sea and sky. This isn’t just a historic site—it’s a feeling, one that lingers long after you’ve left.

reviews.author: Bonnie Kwong
reviews.text: A very relaxing place to walk around by the ocean. Be sure to take 15-20mins walk up to the top where you will have a panoramic view of the beach and the ocean.

reviews.author: Dounia Erreqassa
reviews.text: A beautiful and peaceful place full of history and charm. We really enjoyed walking through the narrow streets and taking in the stunning views.

address: Street Stall - Petit Socco, Tangier, Morocco

name: Street Stall - Place du 9 Avril
address: Street Stall - Place du 9 Avril, Tangier, Morocco

reviews.author: Hamood AlDhawi
reviews.text: A Truly Fabulous Ramadan Iftar! They serve delicious Omani cuisine with unbeatable local hospitality that makes you feel right at home. The set menu is thoughtfully curated, offering a perfect balance of traditional flavors and hearty portions. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Omani food in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. I would definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Hannalore Taal
reviews.text: This is a fine dining restaurant that offers the local Omani cuisine. Tried all the must haves as we had the tasting menu. The service was superb! Recommend for tourists wanting to experience a local meal, in a fancy setting.

reviews.author: Bad Bou
reviews.text: No matter what quality of food it is server, they had a bad attitude, and attitude is priceless. We cane today the 10th august to dine with family, which means kids as well. At the door someone stepped out and without even letting us in, refused to share the menu when we asked for it. It took several seconds before he mentioned that “kids are not accepted “!! Ok, maybe they accept pets who knows! In any way: my kids are priceless and no matter what the restaurant is, he doesn’t deserve us: the customers.

reviews.author: Stella
reviews.text: Great experience of authentic Omani food. As a foreigner it is best to ask for a sampling menu. They will let you try about 10 different dishes, which provides a great insight into Omani traditional cuisine. It wasn’t on the menu, but the waiter offered it to us as he realised we were struggling to choose from the menu.

reviews.author: Alexandra L
reviews.text: The food was amazing and the portions are huge - I would say that they are enough to make 3 hungry people happy. Also they bring the complements . I tried king fish in coconut sauce with safran rice and I really liked francensense ice-cream as a compliment - it was not sweet and it aided digestion! I Would definitely recommend this place to everyone

reviews.author: Bleslie Maldonado
reviews.text: A Delightful Start to the Day! I had an excellent breakfast that truly exceeded my expectations. The variety available was remarkable, featuring an extensive selection of fresh juices, an array of artisanal breads, and a colorful display of seasonal fruits. Each option was not only beautifully presented but also bursting with flavor, making it hard to choose just one thing! What made the experience even more enjoyable was the warm and welcoming staff. They were attentive without being intrusive, ensuring that our dining experience was seamless and pleasant. Their friendly demeanor set the perfect tone for a relaxed morning. The outdoor seating area deserves a special mention. Overlooking a stunning swimming pool surrounded by lush greenery and a serene infinity pool, it created a picturesque setting that enhanced our breakfast. It felt like a little slice of paradise, making each bite even more enjoyable. Overall, this breakfast buffet was a wonderful experience that I would highly recommend. The combination of delicious food, friendly service, and a beautiful atmosphere made it an unforgettable start to the day. If you're looking for a place to enjoy a fantastic breakfast, this is definitely a top choice!

reviews.author: Veena N
reviews.text: I visited the hotel restaurant for breakfast and dinner every day for 5 days. I was always pleasantly greeted by Dinda and Adnan who made an effort to remember my name and room number and the table I liked to sit on outside. They made my solo trip feel as if they were family welcoming me. Real management qualities. The food was amazing with stunning views. Every night it was a different cuisine with so much choice. The staff were super attentive and always smiling.

reviews.author: Amanda Koh
reviews.text: Arrived in paradise with the best seat in the house. Had a lovely morning attended to by Aaron, a jovial and well-spoken staff who shared about Oman and the beautiful property. He also brought me coffee and a fresh coconut that I enjoyed during a relaxing swim. Thank you for the breakfast service and making my stay enjoyable!

reviews.author: M. Noah
reviews.text: On the edge of excellence. It is always unfortunate when a guest finds hair in their food, and I truly believe that the hair itself is a very small fraction of the problem. How the issue is dealt with is the determining factor, and a reflection of the quality of service provided by the establishment. We got a 10% discount on our bill, so... make of it what you will I suppose. The staff themselves are a mix of friendly faces, unhappy attitudes from some, and others who were literally very confused about anything asked of them. Overall, the level of service is decent. The food itself is good. There's a wide selection of various cuisines to choose from, and everything (except for the French Fries which looked frozen) is freshly made! I do love sushi, and theirs is just great! Their desserts as well are definitely the highlight of the buffet. Cannot fault the ambiance of the place either. They have a wonderful outdoors setup, but unfortunately we opted to sit indoors mainly thanks to the humid weather (Date of Visit: 26/3/2024). Not to say that the indoors part was bad or anything like that, the restaurant is very well kept, and the furniture is very comfortable. I have been going to Al Bustan Palace, and this restaurant since my childhood. It is always good to see a place survive the test of time, and provide us with the nostalgia we need.

reviews.author: Travel Sing Fly
reviews.text: Went here for just a little lunch and refreshments on a very hot day. The hotel itself is very impressive, even though really, really ugly from outside. The lobby is breathtaking, in a good way. The restaurant has a beautiful setting, with lots of light from outside. The food, however, lacks the flaps of original Omani food. It seems like a bit evened out for foreign taste buds which is a bit sad. Very good service though (a bit too attentive maybe) - I mentioned that the food could have a bit more taste, and they wanted to reduce the bill immediately. Which in this case wasn't necessary but a nice gesture...

name: Al Seeb Street Food
address: Al Seeb Street Food, Muscat, Oman

reviews.author: jamal alnofali
reviews.text: Very good Omani traditional restaurant. The organ food of Omani

reviews.author: Harith Al Battashi
reviews.text: Good looking interior and theme, but the chairs will break your backs. The place is small but acceptable for a quick lunch. Food is great with a variety of choices, but the price is above average. Going to this place for years, but it’s going downhill. don’t look up, you’ll find spider webs all over the place.

reviews.author: Chafic El Hajj
reviews.text: The staff responsible appeared inexperienced , not at all friendly and cheerful. The food portion is good but not that tasty (very average) and all are spicy and already prepared so you can't order it without it. I would recommend you do not really visit the restaurant.

reviews.author: Ahmed Al Rawahi
reviews.text: Ali Thani restaurant is one of the best traditional Omani restaurants that serves authentic Omani cuisine in a very clean and comfortable place. The quality of the food is extremely delicious whith a wide range of choices and the prices are relatively reasonable. The staff are very friendly, polite and respectful.

reviews.author: Makhdoom
reviews.text: We have attended party there

reviews.author: Nawal Said
reviews.text: The place is warm & well designed. Our experienced was great. The food is delicious and the staff are so friendly & welcoming. Our hearts were overwhelmed to some details like, welcoming frankincense water, providing Omani coffee with dates & at the end rose water as a-sign for farewell with a good smell. Despite its high prices, it’s well worth it for its high quality in service & food as well. Not to forget the balcony view is incredible! Highly recommended✨

reviews.author: Doa M M
reviews.text: The place is warm, inviting, and beautifully designed. Although we arrived around 9 PM and had to wait about 30 minutes for a table, the atmosphere made the wait pleasant—I’d definitely recommend making a reservation in advance to avoid the delay. The food was absolutely delicious! The Shuwa and soup were not only flavorful but also generously portioned. The decor is stunning, and the terrace offers a breathtaking view that adds to the overall charm of the restaurant. What really stood out were the thoughtful little touches—the complimentary frankincense water, fresh dates, traditional Arabic coffee, and even rose water for your hands as you leave. These details truly elevate the dining experience. While it’s on the pricier side, it’s well worth it for the quality, ambiance, and exceptional service. We had an amazing time and would definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Mahdi Ghiasi
reviews.text: We visited this highly recommended restaurant with high expectations but left somewhat disappointed. The nearly two-hour wait to be seated showed its popularity but tested our patience! Once seated, the service was fast, and we appreciated the restaurant’s stylish interior design. However, the food itself was average at best.

reviews.author: Cristina d.C.
reviews.text: Excellent service and delicious food. They welcomed us with frankincense water and nice faces. They explained the dishes well. We recommend the shuwa for those who like lamb,the date bread, the grilled kingfish and the pakora. At the end they offer you Omani coffee and even wash your hands with rose water.

reviews.author: Ben Steyn
reviews.text: Bait Al Luban comes highly recommended by all the tourist sites and it’s easy to see why. The decor is beautiful and offers a traditional setting for a real Omani feast. The service was friendly and the food on offer tasty. Definitely a go to for anyone visiting.

reviews.text: The place is warm, inviting, and beautifully designed. Although we arrived around 9 PM and had to wait about 30 minutes for a table, the atmosphere made the wait pleasant—I’d definitely recommend making a reservation in advance to avoid the delay. The food was absolutely delicious! The Shuwa and soup were not only flavorful but also generously portioned. The decor is stunning, and the terrace offers a breathtaking view that adds to the overall charm of the restaurant. What really stood out were the thoughtful little touches—the complimentary frankincense water, fresh dates, traditional Arabic coffee, and even rose water for your hands as you leave. These details truly elevate the dining experience. While it’s on the pricier side, it’s well worth it for the quality, ambiance, and exceptional service. We had an amazing time and would definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Mahdi Ghiasi
reviews.text: We visited this highly recommended restaurant with high expectations but left somewhat disappointed. The nearly two-hour wait to be seated showed its popularity but tested our patience! Once seated, the service was fast, and we appreciated the restaurant’s stylish interior design. However, the food itself was average at best.

reviews.author: Cristina d.C.
reviews.text: Excellent service and delicious food. They welcomed us with frankincense water and nice faces. They explained the dishes well. We recommend the shuwa for those who like lamb,the date bread, the grilled kingfish and the pakora. At the end they offer you Omani coffee and even wash your hands with rose water.

reviews.author: Ben Steyn
reviews.text: Bait Al Luban comes highly recommended by all the tourist sites and it’s easy to see why. The decor is beautiful and offers a traditional setting for a real Omani feast. The service was friendly and the food on offer tasty. Definitely a go to for anyone visiting.

reviews.author: liju suresh
reviews.text: Extremely expensive mutton shuwa, 3.500 rial when place s with similar quality is 2.500 max. Also the ambience was bad, We chose room with table, it had a dusty smell like an old office. Altogether will not recommend this place for anyone.

reviews.author: Rashid Al-Yahyai
reviews.text: This is one of the oldest restaurants in Muscat that serves traditional Omani dishes, from camel meat to dried sardines (qashe’). I ordered Sayyadeyah, this is king fish cooked in rice that tastes so good! It comes with tomato-pepper sauce & little dish of salad. At 2.600 OR, it is reasonably priced. Service was a little slow but not more than 10 minutes. There are separate family rooms & open areas with table seating or just like I did, the Omani way of floor seating! Try it out if you are in town!

reviews.author: Sandhya Narayan
reviews.text: An amazing place for authentic Omani food. Must try the Shuwa- a traditional dish where the meat is marinated in spices & wrapped in a banana leaf which is put in a straw bag and slowly cooked over burning coal for 24 hrs. This makes the meat delicious & it beautifully come off the bone. The dish is served with flavoured rice, tomato chutney & salad. We relished & enjoyed our meal The fried fish was just ok. Staff are courteous, reasonably priced & the place is clean with private traditional dining rooms.

reviews.author: Kalim Khan
reviews.text: This is one of the oldest (22 years old as told by staff) restaurant in Muscat serving authentic Omani cuisines. The traditional lamb Shuwa is one of the most selling items. The dining area is setup in traditional way, where you can sit on the carpet and enjoy the food. Staff was very courteous and kept on checking on us for anything extra we might need. The entrance is decorated with antique items. Rooms might make you feel claustrophobic because there are no windows. Washrooms could be better.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: Went for lunch. Tried the camel meat. Service is fast and somewhat staff are welcoming. The place is dead. Not lively and unwelcoming, maybe because it’s dark inside.

reviews.author: Mohamed Ijaz
reviews.text: Amazing food and great ambience. We loved the hearty breakfast plates—with eggs, lentils, spicy fried beef, assorted dips, and fresh breads. Interior decoration is also pretty cool.

reviews.author: Kiki
reviews.text: Dukanah Café is a hidden gem with a cozy, cave-like atmosphere and a truly traditional Omani vibe. We enjoyed every dish: the flavors were authentic and comforting. The juices were delicious, the fresh bread was amazing, and the service was 🔝 notch warm, welcoming, and attentive. A perfect spot to experience real Omani hospitality and cuisine

reviews.author: Osman Rashid
reviews.text: Had a family breakfast at Dukanah cafe. Food and quantity were good. Welcoming staff. And a very nicely kept cultural themed interior. yes, the prices are at little higher side, but u pay not for food only, but also for service and overall ambience.

reviews.author: Aliyah Sumar
reviews.text: This is a lovely authentic place to visit for Omani food. If you are after Shuwa please go later in the day to avoid disappointment. Felt like ingredients here were all fresh and prices reasonable. The place itself tries to mimic an Omani fort. And the tea was absolutely delicious 😋 I will be returning just for that! We ordered breakfast for 2 and there is a variety of things including scrambled eggs, chickpeas, cucumber&olives, cheese with zatar, lentils, cream and honey served with Omani bread and tea. Worth s visit 👍🏼

reviews.author: Kaushik Bhakta
reviews.text: An antique look like interior. Service staffs are very polite and helpful. We enjoyed our meal there. If you are a tourist just step in for a rich memory of Muscat.

reviews.author: Mohammed Ali
reviews.text: lounge is clean, very good lighting, its weird that such restaurant haven't many customers.. salad was okay.. fish was too bad, juice was fine this restaurant is marketing restaurant.. not for food experience at all

reviews.author: Kristy Robinson
reviews.text: The food & service at Grand Lounge is fantastic. Beautiful Turkish food & the portions were generous. The staff were really helpful & attentive. The only shame was that we kept getting wafts of sewerage whilst sitting outside. If it wasn't for the smell I'd give it 5 stars.

reviews.author: Dilip Xavier
reviews.text: A good Turkish restaurant... meats where a little dry ... could improve Food - 3.25/5 Ambience - 3.25/5 Value for money - 3.25/5 Customer service - 3.5/5

reviews.author: Said Al Asmi
reviews.text: Tasty Turkish food, very nice ambient and spacious

reviews.author: Said Al-Asmi
reviews.text: Good food .. great treatment .. nice people .. awesome place for family, friends even for relaxation

reviews.author: Saif Al Amri
reviews.text: We ordered 4 items, one tea with milk (karak), one omani coffee and, 2 Smashed Pancakes (Julah). The total of 2.650 OMR (which is quite expensive) The quality was average, nothing remarkable. The place looked peaceful although we didn’t sit inside. Opening and closing timings shall be included and other details as well.

reviews.author: Khalid
reviews.text: I waited more than 45 minutes just for the tea ,, let alone the food that took more than an hour

reviews.author: Faiza Salim
reviews.text: The food is good... but the service is very slow... although the employees are friendly... but our order was delayed for more than 20 minutes.

reviews.author: Mahmood Alwahibi
reviews.text: 7 ******* The place, the food, the atmosphere is amazing

reviews.author: abdulrhman alabri
reviews.text: Needs to increase the number of employees

reviews.author: Semeel
reviews.text: A peaceful and unique spot in Muscat, perfect for tourists looking for an authentic Omani experience. About 45 km from the airport, easy to reach. Best time to visit is October to March. Known for local crafts, friendly people, and calm vibes. A must-visit for cultural and scenic lovers! Highly recommended for travelers who love peaceful spots and real cultural experiences.

reviews.author: Marek Tkaczuk
reviews.text: Several pleasant views as you stroll along the Corniche. You can get better views of it & some $ shots from the old fort. Doesn't compete with the Corniche in Doha but still nice.

reviews.author: Belbin
reviews.text: This place is amazing! It's perfect for relaxing with family and friends, and the scenery is gorgeous. It's even more beautiful at night! Just be prepared for some traffic.It's also great for walking around and taking nice photos.

reviews.author: Sulaiman Hojaij
reviews.text: A small ancient city/Port that reflects Omani’s ancient culture. Amazing sea/mountain setup.. Greenery and welcoming. A must visit city and Fort as well. While driving there just wait how it surprises you the moment the city appears to you Check below story😁 In Mutrah—one of the most beautiful places in Muscat—you’ll find a stunning corniche, a peaceful seaside park, and the charm of the old souk. The area has been dedicated to tourism in recent years, and only cruise ships are now allowed to dock at its port. I actually discovered Mutrah by chance. Someone had mentioned a fish market there where I might find a specific kind of fish I was looking for. It turned out to be just 2.5 kilometers from where I was staying. But I had always driven in one direction, never exploring the other—until that day. I was driving uphill when I reached a large, old-style gate—something like the entrance to an ancient city. From there, the road began to descend, and suddenly the view opened up. Below, a massive cruise ship appeared so close it seemed almost parked on land. The city, the port, the old fort—all appeared nestled between rocky cliffs that rise and fall like waves of stone. These cliffs stretch all the way into the sea, allowing even the largest ships to dock just steps from the city itself.

reviews.author: Wild Fowl
reviews.text: A Peaceful Urban Oasis Mutrah Corniche is a hidden gem in Oman! I found it to be a wonderfully peaceful spot where you can take a leisurely stroll along the waterfront and soak in the beautiful landscape. The blend of modern energy and natural beauty creates a calming atmosphere, making it the perfect escape from routine hustle and bustle. Whether you're taking in the stunning water views or simply enjoying the well-kept surroundings, Mutrah Corniche offers a refreshing break that's as scenic as it is serene. Highly recommended if you're looking for a place to relax, reflect, and enjoy the outdoors!

reviews.author: Tyler Harris
reviews.text: I've been to quite a few Souqs. This one is average. Most of the shops have very similar items and you're not gonna get a great deal. The items are way overpriced and it is difficult to negotiate the price into a reasonable range. It's fun for an hour or so but it doesn't have the great deals like in Istanbul or Cairo.

reviews.author: Charlie Melvoin
reviews.text: A worthwhile cultural experience but it’s all covered so feels a bit like an indoor strip mall and with slightly aggressive salesmen (it’s all relative depending on which other markets like this you’ve been to!). Combining it with the fort and fish market makes for a solid itinerary, just manage expectations. We bought frankincense and a holder as our souvenir.

reviews.author: Shaifa Hirji
reviews.text: visited a small souk run by a mix of Bangladeshi and Pakistani vendors, hoping to find some unique items and experience a vibrant market atmosphere. Unfortunately, my visit was far from what I had expected. While the souk had a variety of products, from textiles to trinkets, the overall experience was underwhelming. The vendors were not particularly friendly or engaging. Rather than offering any insights or recommendations about their products, they seemed more interested in rushing through transactions. This lack of customer service made the shopping experience feel impersonal and uncomfortable. The quality of the items varied significantly, with some products feeling cheaply made or overpriced for what they were. I found it hard to get a sense of authenticity or craftsmanship, which was disappointing given the reputation that such souks can have for offering unique and high-quality goods. The atmosphere also felt chaotic, with little organization, making it hard to navigate through the various stalls. Additionally, the cleanliness of the area left much to be desired. The souk felt crowded and somewhat cluttered, and there were areas that seemed neglected or in need of maintenance. The overall ambiance lacked the charm and inviting energy that I had hoped for in a traditional market setting. Ultimately, my experience was not positive. I had hoped for a vibrant, authentic market experience, but instead, I found myself quickly losing interest and leaving without purchasing anything. It’s possible others may have had a different experience, but for me, this souk did not live up to expectations.

reviews.author: Priya Agarwal
reviews.text: The market is well organised and clean with water filters as well. The place accommodates a good variety of all possible Omani products. It was a vast collection for viewing, purchasing and getting to know the Omani traditional and cultural aspects. It’s great to chill around starting from early evening.

reviews.author: mizie hussain
reviews.text: Been there in February 2025. Best place to shop traditional Omani or arab stuff. It offers a variety of Omani goods like spices, perfumes, textiles and jewelry. With its winding alleys and rich heritage, it’s great place to experience local culture and unique souvenirs

reviews.author: MLaura
reviews.text: One of the best places have been visited in Muscat. Many restaurants and bar along its promenade, where to rest and have a great time while you’re enjoying a nice view of the sea and receiving the Persian sea breeze. Sand golden shore where you can take a bath or just walk or watching guys playing football or running. Nice walk side decorated by palms and deeply in the green of vegetation . In the middle of the side walk you can find a mall with a food courtyard with many good pastries and bakery. Overall to enjoy during the sunset time

reviews.author: Panos Panagopoulos
reviews.text: Very nice place , no facilities to wash out the salt from the skin after swimming there but the environment is perfect and romantic

reviews.author: Fresh UP
reviews.text: It is a beautiful and peaceful place to relax with family and friends. I visited during sunset, and the view was absolutely stunning. The beach is clean and well-maintained, making it a great spot for a refreshing walk along the shore. There were people from different countries enjoying the serene atmosphere, adding to the vibrant yet calm vibe of the place. Highly recommend for anyone looking to unwind and enjoy nature in Muscat!

reviews.author: Shabeer Hydrod
reviews.text: Qurum Beach is a beautiful and serene destination, perfect for relaxation and outdoor activities. The golden sands stretch for miles, and the calm waves create a peaceful atmosphere. It's a great spot for families, couples, or solo travelers to enjoy a walk, a picnic, or just unwind by the sea. The nearby mangroves and stunning sunset views make it even more special. With kayaking and other water activities available, there's something for everyone to enjoy. Whether you’re looking for adventure or tranquility, Qurum Beach is a must-visit in Muscat!

reviews.author: Lars K
reviews.text: Very nice beach! Beautifully located and a great place for a swim!

reviews.author: Bianca Parisé
reviews.text: What an amazing restaurant!!! We had the pleasure to have Khalid as our waiter but really, everyone there was great to us. The food was simply delicious. They have a menu where they bring you a bunch of Omani specialties and my husband and I loved every single thing. We highly recommend. :)

reviews.author: Aylara Mammetmyradova
reviews.text: Great place if you want to try everything at once. Interior: nicely decorated and you have an option to sit on the floor, in more traditional way, or on the table. Food: They have a set menu that offers a set of local starters, main dishes and desserts. All the food was great, and portions are big, so better come on empty stomach. Service: was also great, my waiter Mohsen was very attentive, friendly, nice and we had a great chat. Whenever he brought food he explained what is what and how to eat it. Overall 10/10

reviews.author: Matthew David
reviews.text: This was definitely the best meal I had in Muscat and one of the most memorable of all time. The food was outstanding. I got the fried Omani fish over rice, cheese samosas, and a dip that was like hummus. I also got the donut hole type dessert which is one of the best things I have ever eaten. Everything was flavored and cooked perfectly. The service was very friendly and the atmosphere had a warm, authentic feel.

reviews.author: Karim El-Deriny
reviews.text: Highly recommend the tasting menu. We had so much food and it was all delicious. Excellent service with a great price

reviews.author: Olivia Fischer
reviews.text: What a restaurant! Unfortunately, we only discovered it on our last day otherwise we would have eaten here every day. We had the tasting menu which was absolutely fantastic and a very fair price. Khalid was a gem and provided the perfect feel-good atmosphere on our last evening. We will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Fatima Mohammed
reviews.text: Fell in love with Rozna. The architecture is so unique, I felt like a princess from old times, it sparked a few tales in mind. The staff were all dressed in traditional wear, there were food stations around. The menu was full of Omani cuisine wonders. The service was quite fast. They have tables and ground local seating rooms. It’s definitely a must if you visit Oman.

reviews.author: Marek Zimolag
reviews.text: It’s own and only experience - pretty busy so come for longer as the service is not super fast and they are simply busy . But the whole menu is local and you can try so many delicious things - Prices are decent and size is super satisfying . Salad was amazing same potato balls with so delicious sauce . The mains we were not lucky - I mean fish was great but somehow not our taste especially the cold one in salt - somehow we didn’t get that the main dish is served cold. The interior is unique and so magical - go and check out yourself

reviews.author: Kiki
reviews.text: Roswa is more than just a restaurant. it’s an experience wrapped in history. Set inside an old fort, the atmosphere is simply unforgettable. From the traditional Omani architecture to the candlelit corners and stone walls, every detail transports you to another time. The food? Tasty, though not exceptional. But the overall experience was absolutely one-of-a-kind. The setting, the ambiance… we loved it!

reviews.author: srinath k
reviews.text: "Discover authentic Omani cuisine in a heritage-style dining area, meticulously designed to reflect the rich culture of Oman. Every corner of the building showcases the country's traditions, and the food is simply exquisite – a must-visit for any food enthusiast!"

reviews.author: Iqbal Razaq
reviews.text: Amaaazing building, like a historic castle fort. Loads of private rooms set as traditional floor sitting dining as well as plenty of table seating. Just a fabulous place and the service from the staff is excellent. A true gem.

reviews.author: sepehr sepehrpour
reviews.text: Here, you’re mostly paying for the location rather than the taste or portion size of the food. You can enjoy the beautiful view of the sea and beach during the day or at sunset while eating, but don’t expect amazing service or exceptional food for the price you pay. The food quality was good, but for this amount of money, you can find tastier options elsewhere plus, the portions were really small.

reviews.author: Ferdi Telli
reviews.text: They have super delicious burgers with unique and creative presentations. It’s a very nice and classy place with mid-range prices. It’s definitely a place you won’t regret visiting and dining at. The only thing is that their house-made drinks are a bit pricey, but other than that, everything is great. Their fried chicken and meat dishes are also amazing — very tasty and well-prepared

reviews.author: Nala Medina
reviews.text: came back after years of not visiting and i’d say the burgers shown in the menu are deceiving for its size. we already know it’s small but it came out smaller than expected. on top of that… food was served cold. also ordered their new bulldozer drink and it tasted more like iced lemon water.. heavily sour. ambience of the place is quite romantic if you visit it at night as it had dim warm lights if you’re into that setting. my recommendation would be visiting by sunset to get the wonderful view of the beach. not as happy with the food but the staff were polite and the place is nice.

reviews.author: Ray Ameli
reviews.text: Slider Station in Muscat is a great spot for burger lovers! Their burgers are tasty, delicious, and packed with flavor, making it a must-visit for anyone craving a quality meal. The service is good, and the overall atmosphere is enjoyable. However, be prepared for a wait on weekends, as the restaurant gets quite busy—it can take up to one hour to get a free table. If you don’t mind the wait, the food is definitely worth it! Highly recommended for burger enthusiasts looking for a flavorful experience in Muscat!

reviews.author: Abdulrahman Alsultan
reviews.text: Amazing view. However the burger sizes are too small and the taste is not the best... Lack of cleaning... And the buns are simple

reviews.author: Mariam Waheed
reviews.text: Good food with tea for having breakfast (Nashta). We liked sitting area, different styles of eggs. The channy we ordered were plain, without any spicy so 2/5 on for that. Parking takes little bit time.

reviews.author: Stephie Correa
reviews.text: Great little spot to have amazing chai and grab lunch. Waiter helped us pick out what we would like. We got a platter to try many foods in small portions. Prices were very low!

reviews.author: Abdullah Al Rashdi
reviews.text: Very good option to have snacks such Omani breads and Toast. They are offering many different tasty food items with competitive price. In most of the time, is crowded. It is one of the recommended economic coffeeshop in Qurum.

reviews.author: Allan Deutsch
reviews.text: Best Karak in town. If you have your own large thermos/bottle they will fill it very cheap. The special Karak with cardamom and saffron is amazing. The Omani bread with laban and date honey is amazing! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Romail Imran
reviews.text: Food and atmosphere is very nice but the stuff is so ignorant and tired from taking orders. This is not the first time we are experiencing this. The owner should visit and see the service himself.

reviews.author: Nadiya Khan
reviews.text: I had a lovely weekend lunch by the beach, and the outdoor seating area overlooking the sea was absolutely breathtaking. Watching the seagulls and enjoying the peaceful ambiance made for a truly relaxing experience. The restaurant has a great vibe, perfect for a laid-back meal by the water. As for the food, we ordered a pasta and salad, both of which were nice. However, I feel that the menu could use a bit more variety, and the service could be improved to match the stunning setting. With a few tweaks, this place has the potential to be an even better dining destination. A great spot for a scenic meal, especially if you love dining by the sea!

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text: The Chedi hotel is beautiful to begin with. Located right in front of the beach, this restaurant has a beautiful ambiance and the food was great. Not pictured but the fish of the day was amazing.

reviews.author: Patrick Labella
reviews.text: The food is good. But that’s it. I didn’t come here to just have good food. I expected it to be great. For such a price it has to be better. One person around 50 Omr Easily. Yes the atmosphere is great next to the beach and the lighting. Service is also great. But my focus is on the food and that’s just not great. Beetroot salad with goat cheese: not much flavor and the beetroot taste like packages beetroot. Seafood pasta: 3 clams and 3 muscles and a few shrimps. Hmmmm not much seafood and the sauce is too tomaty, no additional flavors. The big shrimp also has no flavor and is dry. Overall it is not bad, because it gets the essence of the dish but a bit boring if i compare it to the price.

reviews.author: Hanaa Khalil
reviews.text: A Perfect place to spend perfect time at , enjoying perfect dinner and atmosphere. Our compliment to the chef. Thanks a lot to our hostesses Jenny and Mitanni

reviews.author: Naomi Couper
reviews.text: My friend who is visiting Oman for the first time from Germany had dinner at The Beach restaurant. Jennifer was great and friendly. She arranged me a table on the patio. Service was excellent. Food and presentation was good. My husband and I have been patronizing Chedi since 2014. This is for me is my favoruite and best hotel in Oman. Food was cooked to perfection. Beautiful decor and chic ambiance. Manager Narayan is friendly and professional as always.

name: The Chedi - The Restaurant
address: The Chedi - The Restaurant, Muscat, Oman

reviews.author: Zu A
reviews.text: The food was good, maybe not fully 5 stars. The dessert was a bit disappointing, we were expecting a bit more juicy chocolate cake. The service was very polite but a bit reserved in my opinion. Most other restaurants the service is more heartfelt especially if it is this pricey. The overall atmosphere was beautiful because it is directly on the beach and they have nice cost fires.

reviews.author: Precious Laurente
reviews.text: From UAE 🇦🇪 came to celebrate my birthday in this restaurant and i can tell that this is one of the best restaurant that we went so far here in Oman ! Thank you everyone for making my day and the atmosphere with pianist in background is the best !

reviews.author: Deena Alshwairikh
reviews.text: Had only the breakfast buffet it was actually good and full of verity of food. They do have a menu you can order from. They open from 7 am to 10 am.

reviews.author: Hasmik Mezhlumyan
reviews.text: Very overpriced! Though the place itself is very beautiful and the staff is friendly and attentive

reviews.author: Qabas Hassan
reviews.text: Had a great time at the restaurant in a cold winter afternoon. Sat outdoors and the weather was nice. The view and the ambiance was great too, as well as the service. Dish of the day was the steak and the fish! It is towards the pricey side, but expected given that it is located in a luxury hotel. Recommended!

reviews.author: Isaac Ho
reviews.text: Recommended by W Muscat, it’s a nice restaurant but touristy. I will prefer to dine at Roznan but it was fully booked. Food is nice but lacks the ambience and more like a casual dining. The favours is a bit lacking. Order a chicken, shuwa, camel and a platter for appetisers. Service is good as per Omani hospitality. Price is average.

reviews.author: Dibej Vlogs
reviews.text: The best Omani food u can even try.. very tasty .. quality top ... and the restaurant very clean, dont forget the stuff there are awsome service is one of the best

reviews.author: Naved Ali
reviews.text: Got an opportunity to dine at this restaurant recently and had a mixed experience. The staff was very courteous and welcoming and i found the restaurant interior to be a good mix of tradition and modernity. The food was good, but our order took a very long time to be served. The salad was served to us after almost half n hour and the mixed grill kept getting delayed. And we were about to finish our meal when we had to remind our server that one item from our order was yet to be served which he went into the kitchen and brought out in a couple of minutes, it seemed microwaved. I know this is not usual for this restaurant considering the good reviews and the full restaurant on a mid week night. But this was our experience which i had to write honestly so that the Ubhar team can look into to decide if anything needs to be changed. Other than the time issue, it was a good experience for us

reviews.author: Latifa Elmallouli
reviews.text: Very welcoming staff, Mohamed, Adil and the trainee guy were nice and professionnal. I strongly recommand this restaurant, especially the grilled mixed main course.

reviews.author: Fahd Batayneh فهد بطاينة
reviews.text: A fine Omani/Zanzibari restaurant in the Qurum area of Muscat very close to the Royal Opera House. They have a diverse menu of soups, salads, starters, main dishes, drinks, and desserts. They offer vegetarian, chicken, lamb, beef, and sea food dishes. They offer both traditional and fusion dishes. The atmosphere of the restaurant is really nice, and they have both outdoor and indoor seating. Staff are friendly, and service is top class. They accept both cash and card payments.

reviews.author: Isaac Ho
reviews.text: Recommended by W Muscat, it’s a nice restaurant but touristy. I will prefer to dine at Roznan but it was fully booked. Food is nice but lacks the ambience and more like a casual dining. The favours is a bit lacking. Order a chicken, shuwa, camel and a platter for appetisers. Service is good as per Omani hospitality. Price is average.
