But this was our experience which i had to write honestly so that the Ubhar team can look into to decide if anything needs to be changed. Other than the time issue, it was a good experience for us

reviews.author: Latifa Elmallouli
reviews.text: Very welcoming staff, Mohamed, Adil and the trainee guy were nice and professionnal. I strongly recommand this restaurant, especially the grilled mixed main course.

reviews.author: Fahd Batayneh فهد بطاينة
reviews.text: A fine Omani/Zanzibari restaurant in the Qurum area of Muscat very close to the Royal Opera House. They have a diverse menu of soups, salads, starters, main dishes, drinks, and desserts. They offer vegetarian, chicken, lamb, beef, and sea food dishes. They offer both traditional and fusion dishes. The atmosphere of the restaurant is really nice, and they have both outdoor and indoor seating. Staff are friendly, and service is top class. They accept both cash and card payments.

reviews.author: Almanara united LLC
reviews.text: nan

reviews.author: Mahdi Ghiasi
reviews.text: Upon being seated, we were served complimentary soup and fresh vegetables. We ordered grilled chicken, tender meat, kingfish, all accompanied by rice, and an Arabic salad. There was a mix-up in our order, and we received two chicken dishes and a fish instead. We didn’t mind the substitution, though, as the food was quite good, especially the fish, which stood out as particularly delicious. The Arabic salad was fresh and tasty, complementing our meal well!

reviews.author: Paul Biehl
reviews.text: Al Mandi serves outstanding dishes, with delicious meat, and the best bread we’ve tried on our journey through Oman so far. The meat was very soft, and literally fell off the bone. The hummus and the spicy tomato type sauce were exactly what you want, to combine with the tasty bread which looked like a pancake, and the rice. The service was really friendly, prices were great, and the ambience felt local.

reviews.author: Carolina
reviews.text: Everything we tried was delicious. Dont miss the flatbread and the pottery beans. Menu is badly translated and the staff only speaks arabic, however we managed to order and it was a good surprise.

reviews.author: Fahd Batayneh فهد بطاينة
reviews.text: A fine Yemeni restaurant next to the Nizwa Souq. They have a small menu consisting of 2 types of spicy rice, a few stews, chicken roast, lamb roast, roast fish, yoghurt and salad, and drinks. Food portions are large and tasty. Staff are friendly though service could improve. They have both indoor and outdoor seating. They also have floor seating. They accept cash and card payment.

reviews.author: Ehsan
reviews.text: Easily accessible restaurant with very delicious food and exceptionally friendly service. The meat is high-quality, perfectly grilled, and full of flavor. The salad is fresh and tastes great. There are plenty of options on the menu, and outdoor seating on the terrace adds to the experience. Given the excellent food quality, the prices are very reasonable. We enjoyed it so much that we came here twice. No complaints—highly recommended!

name: Al Mandi Al Dhahabi
address: Al Mandi Al Dhahabi, Nizwa, Oman

reviews.author: Janez Kerzan
reviews.text: We were here a year ago and the food was good. But a year later we were very disappointed. Food was not fresh prepared and it was lukewarm. It tasted bad. The final price was way above Oman average and much more than written on the menu. I really do not recommend this restaurant. Very disappointing indeed.

reviews.author: linda vasquez
reviews.text: Very bad food. Nothing had good taste. Food was not fresh prepared. Humis was awful. Even the fresh juices didnt have good taste. I really do not recommnd you this restaurant. Try to find a different option. If we knew it we would have never eaten here!

reviews.author: Martijn Kers
reviews.text: What a god awful place. The service was terrible and I ordered a kebab meal for 3.5(!!!) riyal and all i got were 2 pieces of meat and some slices of vegetable. Please do yourself a favor and don’t come here.

reviews.author: Florence C.
reviews.text: A basic restaurant. The meat was good, but the rice was very simple, no sauce, any vegetable. The service was not very nice. I woulf recommand to go to another restaurant...

reviews.author: Tomáš Laňka
reviews.text: Different prices than those listed in menu. Be careful what you order, how much you will pay and count final bill. Food was average.

reviews.author: Karen Liu
reviews.text: Came during Ramadan and we practically had the whole place to ourselves. Limited food and drinks available, just a small tea stand. Can spend hours here exploring the forts and all its rooms and passages. Rich in history, unique architecture.

reviews.author: Hassan Al-Ramadani
reviews.text: I went there on weekend, there was good vibes, local band dancing, local food and coffee and kids playing traditional games, definitely worth visiting. You can see charming views over the city from the fort

reviews.author: Helen Zhang
reviews.text: Very hot during this season at early afternoon. The fort and the castle are better known in this area. Fantastic views from roofs and corridors. There are interesting colorful workshop/shop and meeting rooms. After the exit there’s a village nearby many cute animals there and if you feed them it’s 1 OMR.

reviews.author: Salim
reviews.text: History unfolds, after your first step into the fort. You are taken into one of the oldest forts with intriguing architecture and so much history. From water cooling and heating systems, to traps and tunnel exits, so much detail. I loved how the tour is used to show the beauty of islam and its message, lots of information to take in and keep as a beautiful memory you want to visit over and over again.

reviews.author: Jürgen Laux
reviews.text: Great historic complex in the old town of Nizwa. If consisted of the fort and the castle. In the background you see the silhouette of the mosque. The buildings are in perfect shape and you can explore almost all areas. There is also a museum included that provides historical context of Oman, Nizwa and the complex.

reviews.author: Heather Williams
reviews.text: I would not say this a luxury accommodation. The location really makes this place a 4 out of 5. The rooms are quite small, but comfortable. However, if you want to have hot water, you need to turn on the hot water heater, and it will take a very long time for it to heat up. I waited an hour and still got a cold shower. You cannot get to the rooftop, which is really too bad. The view would be great up there, so I think they are missing out on adding value to the stay by not opening up that space to guests.

reviews.author: Ashly John
reviews.text: Hotel located right next to the road, which made it easy to access, The facilities were basic but sufficient for a short stay. The room was clean and comfortable, making it a decent place to rest. Overall, it's a practical choice for a quick overnight stay, but don't expect anything beyond the essentials.

reviews.author: Agathe Bertrand
reviews.text: Nice hotel in a very old building, super charming and which is very well located! The rooms are quite small but with AC and private bathroom. The breakfast was ok. The staff was very long and took care of our luggage and parked the car

reviews.author: L. NC
reviews.text: The location is good, but unfortunately I was very disappointed with my stay here. The room wasn't clean enough, especially the bathroom. There were mosquitos that bit me all night. The WIFI was poor and unstable as it kept going on and off. Not a good value for money considering the price. Not recommended.

reviews.author: Pawel Zalewski
reviews.text: It was fine. They have ac and heating. Breakfast decent, had better had worse. Great location.

reviews.author: Cynthia Tee
reviews.text: Fun experience watching goats and cattle being sold. Got here by 6 am and there was plenty of parking around the fort and souq. There are a ton of tourists - I felt like we got in the way of the shoppers and bidders. At around 7:15-30 am the bid starts and everyone leaves a ring open while sellers bring their animals around. A unique experience and I am grateful that the Omani’s were so tolerant of all the hovering cameras and tourists (there seemed like more of us than shoppers).

reviews.author: Suria Rahim
reviews.text: You can only experince this on Friday 7am to 10am. Before the Friday prayer. Animals are brought in for sale in the market. Childrens of Omani were excited to watch the animals paraded for sale. We it was intense n exciting experience. A simple circle shape shade architecture. Practical for the purpose, with low wall seating area to watch. Truly amazing experience.

reviews.author: Jason Dennis
reviews.text: When in Oman, right!? Yes, check out this weekly event to get a truly energetic and fun experience. It starts early, and if you're driving, parking can be a nightmare, but the livestock auction in Nizwa is one of only a couple places in the world where tourists are allowed to be part this regional custom. Enjoy an early sunrise, see all the animals, chat with locals, and watch all the excitement.

reviews.author: Julius Zeise
reviews.text: It was such a cool experience to witness something like this. Very traditional and incredibly interesting. Of course, it also makes you think about the well-being of the animals. It’s a bit sad to see how the animals are treated just like products. But in the end, it is a goat market. I think everyone has to decide for themselves whether they want to give attention to something like this or not.

reviews.author: K L
reviews.text: What an amazing animals market. Please come early at around 7am in the morning, every Friday. Must visit if you are in Nizwa.

reviews.author: Usama Sherifdeen
reviews.text: Traditional Atmosphere: “A charming blend of tradition and culture—feels like stepping back in time.” Variety of Goods: “From fresh dates and spices to silver jewelry and pottery, the variety here is amazing.” Local Interaction: “Friendly local vendors happy to share stories and offer samples.” Craftsmanship: “Beautiful handmade items, especially the khanjars and traditional crafts.” Accessibility: “Well-organized and easy to explore, located right next to Nizwa Fort.” Suggestions: • “Best visited in the morning for fresh produce and less crowd.” • “Prices are reasonable, but a little bargaining adds to the fun.” • “Perfect place to buy authentic Omani souvenirs.”

reviews.author: Firas Q
reviews.text: Great for a Seasonal Visit, but Pricey and Crowded This is a lovely place to visit in winter or after 4 PM during autumn and spring. It offers plenty of traditional items, though they tend to be quite expensive. The area is also great for photography, especially if you enjoy capturing old buildings. However, parking can be a hassle due to poor organization, making it difficult to park or exit. On public holidays, the place gets very crowded. If you’re already visiting Nizwa Fort or passing through on your way to Salalah, it’s worth stopping by—perhaps for a quick cup of coffee or Karak tea.

reviews.author: Ph. Al Hakmani
reviews.text: Al aqr village at Nizwa central souq . Such a amazing attractive place. Well organized & you find lots of cafes, Restaurants, accommodation/ hotel to stay on. Very clean place. Highly recommend to visit.

reviews.author: Helen Zhang
reviews.text: 1PM-4PM the souq will be closed. Mainly 3 sections: Handcrafts, meat, sweets. There are nice cafes on the second floor of Handcraft section, and vegetable and honey markets at Sweets section, meat sections are not fully opened when we entered there close to 1PM, there are many available fresh chicken and lamb and beef. On the Sweets section there is also a second floor inside the hall, there were some antique furniture and other artistic pieces. Generally it’s a small souq. Owners of the shops are quite nice.

reviews.author: Mohamed Ramadan
reviews.text: The best time to visit is Friday at 6:30 am, specifically if you have kids. On Friday, they have a weekly market and sell fresh fruits, vegetables, goats, cows, and cars. The people are too friendly and let you browse without getting offended. Must wear modest clothes and respect the country culture. It is difficult to find parking, but with some time, you will be able to park. The market is complete about 11:30 am. for the Friday prayer.

reviews.author: Shiju varghese
reviews.text: Has a good, hardworking team and coordinates all the work in Safely Manner.. Excellent team to manage civil and MEP jobs.

reviews.author: hp creator
reviews.text: Good team with technician and quality work.

reviews.author: AL BUSTAN MAINTENANCE
reviews.text: since 1998

name: Al Baleed Resort Cafe
address: Al Baleed Resort Cafe, Salalah, Oman

reviews.author: Bikram Ranjitkar
reviews.text: We had great time at Sakalan Restaurant. Wide range of varieties. Amazing ambiance and seating area arranged veey well. Food was tasty, service was outstanding. They have very attractive theme nights, where food lovers can enjoy authentic flavour and great hospitality. I definitely recommend.

reviews.author: saed ali
reviews.text: Everything was perfect starting from by 'Marhabh' by Cheivi, She was very nice with us till our table. Buffet was amazing and everything tasty. Asad, Made and Mani were very helpful to make us happy. Nice weather, place, people and atmosphere what more we need to make our morning perfect. Thank you Sakalan team for everything. For sure we welcome back Insha'Allah.

reviews.author: Nayyar Khan
reviews.text: I came with my friends to enjoy the sea food night in Sakalan Restaurant, I am so satisfied by the Service provided by the professional team. I don’t have words to explain, highly recommended for those who want to enjoy the best food in Oman.

reviews.author: Fathi Nawar
reviews.text: it's a wonderful restaurant. amazing views of-of the beach and swimming pool.excellent foods.. staff are very helpful.. but the price is expensive.

reviews.author: Ucman S
reviews.text: Great selection in the breakfast buffet with good Omani and international options. I loved the Semia and also the variety of juices they have. The views are also great and the restaurant is very stylish.

reviews.author: Sz Gergo
reviews.text: The size of the place is impressive. If you are in the area, have a look but getting there just for this isn’t worth it. There is not much to see aside from walls and gates.

reviews.author: GHOSH A.H
reviews.text: Very nice atmosphere at out side of palace

reviews.author: Kai Winter
reviews.text: Not realy something to see

reviews.author: abnTFWL علي مصبح أبو سحيم
reviews.text: A very excellent place, it is called the Sultan's Palace, the fort, and next to it is an old popular market called the Haffa

reviews.author: Muhammad Rizwan
reviews.text: Hmm delicious

reviews.author: Martin Mengele
reviews.text: Best Lebanese food in town. Try the Baba Ganoush, it's marvelous! Super friendly people here! Not the cheapest though, but reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Rajneesh Armugham
reviews.text: Labanese restaurant at Salalah. Clean and good place, tasty food.

reviews.author: Nayyar Khan
reviews.text: There is no best chicken shawarma in salalah other than this, one of the best shawarma in town

reviews.author: Sulaiman Al Kharusi
reviews.text: Lebanese food are served here. Different types and good food can be found here

reviews.author: Fadi Nassar
reviews.text: Good option for sandwiches specially falafel and meet shawarma wich i like most but you can try another as you like nice place good service nice staff normal prices

reviews.author: Fatima Aldawood
reviews.text: I had a wonderful dining experience with my family at this restaurant. From the moment we arrived, the service was excellent — welcoming, attentive, and very professional. The food was absolutely delicious, with every dish cooked to perfection and beautifully presented. A special thank you to Nina. She was friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for great food and even better service. We’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Arnisa Burapachaisri
reviews.text: Amazing view and service! Food was overpriced but good quality, probably the best in Salalah. Coconut tempura prawns and caesar salad were the highlights. Pizza was very mediocre. Taimae and Sandeep were exceptional waiters - very helpful, thoughtful, efficient and professional.

reviews.author: SAMI S.
reviews.text: Excellent food, drinks were properly done. The location and venue are top notch. Amazing service delivered by Geetha.

reviews.author: Ibrahim Al Faraj
reviews.text: Excellent food, drinks were properly done. The location and venue are very good. Absolutely amazing service the best in Salalah I feel. ((waiters)) very helpful, thoughtful, efficient and professional.

reviews.author: Jiří Krupička
reviews.text: Absolutely perfect resort! The breakfasts here are absolutely amazing, the Al Mina restaurant cooks delicious meals, the shisha and fresh drinks are also awesome. And the staff are the best! Everyone is helpful and puts a smile on your face every time. Thank you so much for the perfect service and for your friendliness!

reviews.text: very nice restaurant. wonderful place... too many kinds of food. I had celebrated there for my birthday 🎉.. the staff are very kind.. excellent view and Good Times.

reviews.author: Piercarlo Graffino
reviews.text: Restaurant located within the Crown Plaza resort, at breakfast there is everything, sweet and savoury, the staff is very attentive and the fruit is excellent. A special mention goes to Miss Rowena, who is very friendly and extremely friendly and kind.

reviews.author: luca faccin
reviews.text: Delicious lunch with pool and sea view. I really enjoyed the selection of fresh salad. Service was also excellent, a special thanks to Miraj for making our stay unforgettable!

reviews.author: Nadeem Akhtar
reviews.text: An authentic Turkish restaurant with delicious Mix Platters, Mouth watering kebabs, Fantastic meat and chicken pastries. Dedicated, well behaved staff, value for money .......

reviews.author: Courtny Stewart
reviews.text: At breakfast, the customer service was amazing. Mr. Rahman was very responsive, kind, and has a good memory. Can't wait for my next breakfast!

reviews.author: Ahsan's Window (Ahsan Khan)
reviews.text: Explore the vibrant Haffa market, where you'll discover an array of local treasures, including fragrant frankincense, traditional skull caps, and unique souvenirs, all at affordable prices. Don't miss the stunning Haffa beach nearby – a perfect addition to your visit!

reviews.author: Eva Ali
reviews.text: Small and charming market with a delightful variety of oud, frankincense, bukhoor, and burners. The quality of items is impressive, but be prepared to bargain for the best deals. A must-visit spot for authentic Omani products and souvenirs!"

reviews.author: Agnieszka Melania Przemyslak
reviews.text: 2-3 lanes with stalls. You can buy souvenirs: scarves, perfume, frankincense oils, magnets, clothes. Huge parking. Close to the beach,

reviews.author: Ahmed Siddiqui
reviews.text: Haffa Souq is a traditional market where visitors can shop for frankincense, perfumes, textiles, and handicrafts. The aroma of spices and incense fills the air, creating an authentic shopping experience. It’s an excellent place to purchase souvenirs and immerse oneself in local culture.

reviews.author: Nim Narayanan
reviews.text: I went for the iftar buffet. The food tasted good and the service and ambience is what we expect from a star hotel . However, there were very few options available. There was only one biryani or mandi i dont know (mutton), plain white rice, one seafood dish, one beef liver dish, two veg dishes, and one Egyptian dish that I couldn't identify, 2 other Chicken items, 2 type of soups. The juices were average, and there were no fresh options available. The live counter for pizza was a unique touch, in the live counter when I asked for fish fry, I was initially told it was finished, even though there was fish available. The time was only 8 pm, not midnight, so it was disappointing. The dessert selection was plentiful and tasty, but there were only three flavors of ice cream with no toppings, and only watermelon for cut fruits. Overall, it's a mixed experience. Considering the ambience and service, I'd give it 3 stars. However, the price for two adults, 30 OMR, seems a bit too high for what was offered.

reviews.author: Senthil Kumar Paramasivam
reviews.text: Al Zafaran Restaurant is located in the Radisson Blu 🏨 hotel. Indoor & outdoor seating available. Outdoor view is amazing. One side sea 🌊 view & other side swimming 🏊‍♀️ pool. reviews.author: Vaibhav Lathiya
reviews.text: Sohar Beach is a picturesque stretch of coastline in the northern region of Oman, offering a serene retreat for locals and tourists alike. This pristine beach is known for its golden sands, clear turquoise waters, and a tranquil atmosphere that invites relaxation. The beach provides a perfect setting for leisurely strolls along the shoreline, with the sound of waves gently crashing against the shore creating a soothing ambiance. Visitors can enjoy the breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea and the distant horizon, making it an ideal spot to unwind and appreciate the natural beauty of the Omani coast. Sohar Beach is also a popular destination for water enthusiasts, offering opportunities for swimming and water sports. The calm and inviting waters make it suitable for both experienced swimmers and those looking to enjoy a refreshing dip. With well-maintained facilities, including picnic areas and shaded spots, Sohar Beach is an excellent location for family outings and gatherings. The beach comes alive during the evening, as the sunset paints the sky in vibrant hues, providing a stunning backdrop for those looking to capture memorable moments. Whether you seek a peaceful escape or an active day by the sea, Sohar Beach offers a versatile and inviting environment, showcasing Oman's natural beauty and providing a welcome respite from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

reviews.author: Nim Narayanan
reviews.text: A Must-Visit for Adventure Lovers! If you enjoy outdoor activities and hiking, Wadi Shab is an absolute gem. It’s one of the most scenic spots in Oman, offering a mix of rugged beauty, crystal-clear water, and an unforgettable sense of adventure. The hike through the wadi is stunning — with towering cliffs, lush greenery, and serene pools along the way. But this isn’t just a walk in the park. Be prepared! ✅ Tips Before You Go: • Carry water shoes – The rocks are extremely slippery. • Wear a life jacket – Especially if you plan to swim into the famous cave. • Helmet (optional but smart) – Some parts are rocky and can be risky. • Bring your own water and food – You won’t find any shops or services inside. • Be prepared for self-rescue – There are no lifeguards or safety staff; you’re completely on your own. This place is pure adventure — thrilling and beautiful — but not for the unprepared. The effort is 100% worth it if you go ready and cautious.

reviews.author: Hamza Abdul Qadoos
reviews.text: Excellent place for fun. Long walk 50 minutes. Best time to visit early morning 5:30 start from origin. Difficult to take toddler but if you're strong enough you can manage. Amazing place to visit and swimming experience also nice. 10/10 recommended.. 👌🏻💐

reviews.author: Priya Agarwal
reviews.text: Indeed an adventurous experience! Something unforgettable…starting with renting shoes and life jackets, the hike throughout was a bit tiring but the views all along the route was extremely beautiful. The canyons and turquoise waters inculcates a spirit of curiosity for completing the hike. Reaching the water way, it is so soothing to swim, that is when all the hike in the heat pays off. Taking the water route, it is a beautiful experience to reach the famous narrow cave where you squeeze yourself out carefully to enjoy the waterfall there. A great haven for adventure seekers!

reviews.author: Honesty
reviews.text: A lifetime experience. Wadi in Oman is such a natural gem that everybody needs to try/ see at least once ! I had the chance to go and swim there with a guide that was also amazing! Don’t go alone please it’s pretty dangerous ! Specially girls always with a guide a local one of course. The water is so amazing refreshing and clean ! People are welcoming and it’s such actually a healing and peaceful place. Enjoy, but please be safe.

reviews.text: I tried their special ribs mandi haneeth, and it was superb—tasted great! The chicken mandi was also nice. For the rice, we chose a mix of kabsa and mandi, and both were flavorful and delicious. The staff were friendly, but the service was a bit disappointing due to a delay in arranging seating. Maybe it was because I visited during a holiday and a crowded time, but it felt like it could have been managed better. Parking is limited. The ambiance was lovely, with Arabic Majlis-style seating. Located in Al Khor city, away from Doha, it’s worth the drive. I also tried the areeka and Nutella kunafa. The Nutella kunafa was nice, but the areeka was just okay—it could use more cheese and honey. Recommended!

reviews.author: Hamza Khan
reviews.text: This is the perfect restaurant if you want to enjoy fresh specialty fish. Although they serve chicken and other BBQ stuff too, I would recommend this place only for Fish BBQ. This place easily has one of the best and the most delicious fishes. Every fish item comes with the most delicious, flavorful and fluffy, freshly made rice. It comes with two kinds of chutneys, their garlic-mint chutney and their spicy chutney. These go perfectly with their fish and rice. Their price is also affordable. This place is always busy and chaotic. You will always have trouble finding a place to sit and they’ll ask you to leave as soon as you’re done eating to make space for more customers. The staff are not the friendliest people. However, the food is so good, I would definitely return to this place again. Great food and a great atmosphere.

reviews.text: I recently visited Al A’dhamiyah Iraqi Restaurant in Doha, and my experience was mixed. The service was excellent, with a friendly and attentive staff. The grilled ribs were very disappointing—the meat was tough and had an unpleasant taste. As for the biryani rice, it was quite bland and unimpressive. Overall, the restaurant offers great service and fair prices, but it needs significant improvement in food quality to meet expectations.

The ambience and the interior design of the place is truly interesting and much thought has been put into it.

reviews.author: Bosondos Bedoo
reviews.text: 5 stars – A Memorable Dining Experience at Al Hubara, Sheraton Doha!** I recently visited **Al Hubara** at Sheraton Doha with my family, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The buffet offered an amazing variety of dishes that truly impressed us all! There was a wide selection of **fresh salads**, **cold and hot appetizers** like **tabbouleh, hummus, and kibbeh**, all full of authentic flavors. The **main courses** were a highlight — from juicy **grills**, tender **ribeye steaks**, and succulent **lamb ribs**, to delicious **shish tawook**, **kofta sticks**, and a range of **seafood** and **oriental dishes**. The **live pasta and noodle station** was a fun touch that added to the overall experience. To top it off, the **dessert section** was phenomenal, especially their famous **Um Ali** — absolutely delicious! The atmosphere was welcoming, and the **staff were professional, friendly, and attentive** throughout our visit. I **highly recommend Al Hubara** for anyone looking to enjoy a rich variety of high-quality food in a warm, elegant setting. Perfect for family outings or special occasions. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Michael Dalida
reviews.text: Our recent dinner buffet experience at Al Hubara Restaurant inside Sheraton Hotel was absolutely fantastic. From the moment we entered, the ambiance captivated us with its surreal and luxurious feel, setting the perfect tone for a memorable evening. The highlight of the evening was undoubtedly the wide selection of Asian, Arabic, and international cuisines offered. The buffet spread was extensive and meticulously prepared, catering to every palate with flavors from around the world. Whether indulging in freshly made sushi, savoring aromatic Arabic dishes, or exploring the diverse international offerings, each dish was crafted with attention to detail and quality. The service was impeccable, with attentive staff ensuring our dining experience was nothing short of exceptional. The elegant surroundings and soothing ambiance further enhanced our enjoyment, creating a perfect atmosphere for a special dinner. Overall, Al Hubara Restaurant surpassed our expectations with its delicious food, inviting ambiance, and top-notch service. It's a definite must-visit for anyone looking to indulge in a culinary journey amidst luxury and comfort.

reviews.text: The food is almost the same as major 5 star chains. Personally I find all of them as a little bland. But the ambiance/atmosphere and the service is top notch.

reviews.text: We had our company lunch today in this restaurant. The service was wonderful. One of the ladies who served us was very sweet (sorry, I forgot her name). She was professional and went beyond in terms of customer service. I love the option of getting ice cream for ourselves. The food variety for me was enough as I easily get stuffed. Overall, the experience was lovely. Thank you.

reviews.author: Nourhan Tarrad
reviews.text: Sheraton Al Hubara Ramadan Tent I tried it for the first time this year, and it was an amazing experience! The food was delicious with a great selection, and the atmosphere was very cozy. The staff was attentive, and everything was well-organized. I’ll definitely be coming back next year.

reviews.author: Bosondos Bedoo
reviews.text: 5 stars – A Memorable Dining Experience at Al Hubara, Sheraton Doha!** I recently visited **Al Hubara** at Sheraton Doha with my family, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The buffet offered an amazing variety of dishes that truly impressed us all! There was a wide selection of **fresh salads**, **cold and hot appetizers** like **tabbouleh, hummus, and kibbeh**, all full of authentic flavors. The **main courses** were a highlight — from juicy **grills**, tender **ribeye steaks**, and succulent **lamb ribs**, to delicious **shish tawook**, **kofta sticks**, and a range of **seafood** and **oriental dishes**. The **live pasta and noodle station** was a fun touch that added to the overall experience. To top it off, the **dessert section** was phenomenal, especially their famous **Um Ali** — absolutely delicious! The atmosphere was welcoming, and the **staff were professional, friendly, and attentive** throughout our visit. I **highly recommend Al Hubara** for anyone looking to enjoy a rich variety of high-quality food in a warm, elegant setting. Perfect for family outings or special occasions. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Michael Dalida
reviews.text: Our recent dinner buffet experience at Al Hubara Restaurant inside Sheraton Hotel was absolutely fantastic. From the moment we entered, the ambiance captivated us with its surreal and luxurious feel, setting the perfect tone for a memorable evening. The highlight of the evening was undoubtedly the wide selection of Asian, Arabic, and international cuisines offered. The buffet spread was extensive and meticulously prepared, catering to every palate with flavors from around the world. Whether indulging in freshly made sushi, savoring aromatic Arabic dishes, or exploring the diverse international offerings, each dish was crafted with attention to detail and quality. The service was impeccable, with attentive staff ensuring our dining experience was nothing short of exceptional. The elegant surroundings and soothing ambiance further enhanced our enjoyment, creating a perfect atmosphere for a special dinner. Overall, Al Hubara Restaurant surpassed our expectations with its delicious food, inviting ambiance, and top-notch service. It's a definite must-visit for anyone looking to indulge in a culinary journey amidst luxury and comfort.

reviews.text: The food is almost the same as major 5 star chains. Personally I find all of them as a little bland. But the ambiance/atmosphere and the service is top notch.

We ordered the date and arugula salad, beetroot hummus, and creamy chicken pasta(I asked to remove the chicken and they did it for us) . I really liked all the dishes, and I think I’ll go back to try new dishes.

reviews.author: Dina Shakhatreh
reviews.text: The food was delicious, and the service was quick and efficient. The quality and experience were top-notch.

reviews.author: Alex Mishin
reviews.text: It’s a really cozy casual place with traditional dishes. Very friendly and fast service. And what is a most important it is I guess only place that works during Ramadan in Souq Waqif area! It is on the 3d floor of Arumail Boutique Hotel.

reviews.author: Christian Bernardi
reviews.text: In the hearth of the famous Souq Waqif in Doha, State of Qatar, a very unique Indian style restaurant with all the most traditional dishes from the "Incredible India". Menù starts with "Street Food of India" where you can find delicious very traditional Pani Poori, Charcoal fish Amritsari or Jaipuri paneer fingers, to continue with the "Appetizers from Tandoor" and the Curries, vegetarians, Rice dishes and breads.. just like a walk in down town Bombay.. Mango lassie is a must to accompany a delicious dessert like Kulfi or Moong Dal. Prices are very reasonable and ambience is, as just said, unique and very relaxing...but the best part for us was the kindness and the welcoming atmosphere created by the manager, Mr. Walid and the chef..so professional and always ready to answer all our curiosity about Indian specialties!

reviews.author: Ralf Khayal
reviews.text: I've met some friends , during which we played a board game. We had an intensive mint tea while others smoked shisha. No food was eaten. Maybe next time.

reviews.author: Omar Alsabbah
reviews.text: Nice food, very good service and cosy place.

reviews.author: Kye
reviews.text: One of the best lounges I’ve experienced. During long layovers, the comfortable sleeping area makes it easy to get some rest. Multiple beverage and dining zones help manage crowds effectively during peak hours. The main dining area on the upper floor offers a decent food selection, and the shower rooms are clean and well-maintained. Over the past several years, this lounge has consistently delivered outstanding service every time I’ve passed through.

reviews.author: Rafiq
reviews.text: Al Mourjan Business Lounge at Doha Airport is nothing short of exceptional. From the moment you step in, the luxurious ambiance and impeccable service set the tone for an unparalleled experience. The lounge is spacious, beautifully designed, and offers a sense of exclusivity that makes every visit feel special. The dining options are truly impressive, with a wide selection of gourmet dishes and refreshing beverages that cater to every taste. Whether you're indulging in a full meal or simply unwinding with a drink, the quality and presentation are outstanding. The relaxation areas are thoughtfully designed, providing a peaceful escape from the airport hustle, while the elegant seating and breathtaking views enhance the overall experience. The staff is incredibly courteous and attentive, ensuring that every guest is comfortable and well taken care of. Whether you're catching up on work, freshening up in the shower suites, or simply enjoying a moment of tranquility, Al Mourjan Business Lounge delivers excellence in every detail. It’s easily one of the finest airport lounges, making layovers and travel far more enjoyable. Looking forward to my next visit!

reviews.author: Sunil Chandy
reviews.text: Al Mourjan Business Lounge is rated as one of the best lounges in the world. It's on two levels, the lower floor has coffee Tea machines everywhere along with snacks. There is also a deli type restaurant here with various snacks sandwiches and drinks, including champagne. Go upstairs and there is a buffet as well as A la Carte. Needless to say the food is superb. Depending on your ticket you can enter this lounge as many times as you want. The staff are extremely friendly and helpful. If I am honest I have to say the lounge experience was better than the flight experience. As always this was my experience and YMMV.

reviews.author: Patrick Xu
reviews.text: Very spacious and upscale lounge, among the best lounges in the world. Food options were very good, a la carte menu was available. The environment was excellent, everywhere was spotless. services were very friendly and attentive. Because this lounge is a little bit away from the gates, it was not crowded. We had a 9 hours layover in the airport, so we booked a sleeping room, but were not staying there very long because a guy was snoring so loudly and the receptionist was constantly knocking the floor with high heels. We moved to the Al Mourjan Business - The Garden, and it was relatively busy there.

reviews.author: Steph
reviews.text: The lounge is huge and quite spread out. The main restaurant is upstairs with a plethora of food choices and bar area. Another dining area on the far left from the entrance and quite nice for those who would like to catch up with work and quick bite as they have proper high table setup with charging port. In that dining area is the shower rooms for male and female. You have to register and wait if the line is long. The downside is that there's no way the staff could notify it's your turn. The shower room however is a bit stuffy and warm. There's no hair dryer in each shower rooms too, so you have ti request from the cleaning staff. I quite enjoy sitting at the area facing the aeroplanes as there are also light food and beverages station nearby.

reviews.text: Hot here late, in transit, just need a quick beer and a bite, before embarking on another 14 hour flight. The food was amazing, and the service by Susil was fantastic and so kind. Thanks

reviews.author: Fulldistance Going
reviews.text: Lovely setting giving a sense of being a garden and water. The service is friendly but I found that certain other guests were being more preference than us. The Muhamarra was excellent but I almost broke my Tooth as a walnut shell was in the dish. The moutabel was delicious as well. The Kunaffa was okay… more of the vermicelli would have been nice. Over all a nice spot to kick back.

reviews.author: Am-Oz Quest
reviews.text: Amazing across the board! The ambiance is wonderful; lively, but not overly so, making it a great place to unwind. Sumon was a wonderful host and made great recommendations. Portions are HUGE - way bigger than expected, so we were stuffed by the time our main arrived! We had the beetroot & halloumi salad, hummus, and lamb & seafood mixed grill. Everything was exceptional. We've got plenty of leftovers for tomorrow, and dreams of outstanding flavors to bring us back!

reviews.author: Abigail Mendoza
reviews.text: Al Nafourah Garden at the Hyatt Regency in Doha is a wonderful spot, especially if you're looking for a relaxing dining experience. The outdoor patio is absolutely beautiful, offering a perfect setting to enjoy a meal while soaking in the pleasant atmosphere. The food and drinks were impressive— we tried the lamb flatbread and the shawarma wrap with fries, both of which were flavorful and satisfying. The service was exceptional, with the staff being attentive and friendly, which made the experience even more enjoyable. It was also incredibly convenient to have such a great restaurant right within the hotel, making it an ideal choice during our stay. Whether you're staying at the Hyatt or just passing through, Al Nafourah Garden is definitely a must-visit while in Doha.

reviews.author: Laura Mesa Abad
reviews.text: 10/10 Me and my friend had dinner for 10JOD total. The food was delicious - we had the kofta with tomato, baba ganoush, garlic yogurt and the Arabian salad. The service was impeccable - the waiter was very kind and offered us tea and sweets for dessert (for free!🥹). This is a lovely restaurant I would really recommend eating at if you’re ever in Aqaba!

reviews.author: Mohga Tawfik
reviews.text: I saw good reviews on this place so suggested it to my friends to try it. We were fasting so we had our iftar. I wanted to try the traditional food (mansaf) but the chicken version. The milky soup that comes with the dish is being served separately which is very useful in case you didn’t like it so you can manage whether to add it to the dish or not. It wasn’t light and salty, this is not my preference when it comes to food so I ate the rice with the chicken only 😁 but they tasted very nice. Portion was very good. Prices were good too. It was crowded Masha2allah. I’d eat there again.

reviews.author: Um Suleiman
reviews.text: Service was excellent food was amazing will visit again the kabab was tasty juicy well spiced but the shrimp I’ve never had shrimp like this my entire life yousif was amazingly friendly and pleasant I’ll definitely recommend it to family and friends

reviews.author: Lavinia Wang
reviews.text: I was recommended this restaurant by a local friend. The place was small but really clean. I ordered hummus with meat and lamb with rice. Both were super tasty. The portion sizes were huge! Yusef was very friendly, making the experience even better. Thank you Yusef, I’ll see you next time!

reviews.author: Lucile Ané
reviews.text: Delicious restaurant, best meal we had in Jordan ! Service is exceptional. We especially recommend trying the lemon mint drink and the Berouti hummus.

reviews.author: syruk
reviews.text: I visited Al Bait Al Shami today for the third time in three years, and I’m happy to say that the quality of the service, hospitality, and food has remained consistently excellent. The place has a charming atmosphere, with beautifully decorated interiors that reflect the authentic Syrian spirit. The food is delicious, with true Syrian flavours, presented in an appealing way. Portions are generous and reasonably priced. The drinks are tasty, and the overall ambience is cosy and enjoyable. The staff are polite, welcoming, and attentive. They’re more than happy to accommodate special requests or modify dishes to suit your taste. The restrooms are clean and well-maintained, which is always a plus. We also enjoyed the shisha, which was quite pleasant. As a lovely gesture, the restaurant offered us complimentary traditional Middle Eastern sweets. There are separate seating areas for smokers and those who prefer fresh air, but note that children are not allowed in the smoking section — something to keep in mind when visiting with family. I’ll definitely be coming back here on my next trip to Doha!

reviews.author: Wajdy Shalghin
reviews.text: Syrian cuisine, the food is good, we had mixed grill the chicken tawook, meat cubes, lamb chops and kebab are good, tender and tasty. We had also meat with tomato which was also good. In addition to cheese burek which was amazing, hummus, mutabal, fatoush and rocca salad. The sweet was OK. The service was good and the staff were nice. I recommend

reviews.author: Ajeet Keshari
reviews.text: Very Disappointing I tried the Umm Ali at Al-Shami Home Restaurant last night, and unfortunately, it was a huge letdown. As someone who truly enjoys this classic dessert, I was shocked at how poorly it was made. It felt like the chef either had no idea how Umm Ali is supposed to taste or simply didn’t put any care into preparing it. The texture was off, the flavor was bland, and overall, it was a far cry from what Umm Ali should be. Honestly, it was so bad that I genuinely believe they should reconsider offering it on their menu until they learn how to make it properly. If you're craving Umm Ali, this is definitely not the place for it.

reviews.author: Parth Soni
reviews.text: Me along with my friends went to have Umm ali late in the evening but little did we knew about the disappointment we were going to face. Certainly, Chef don't know how its made. We barely had 2-3 spoon out of guilt towards paying for it. I'd highly advise to revisit the recipe as it's a famous dessert. ------- To be considered as constructive feedback and not otherwise, A disappointed Visitor.

reviews.author: Samer Kharsa
reviews.text: If you miss homemade-style meals, Al-Shami Home Restaurant is the place to go. Their food is consistently flavorful, with standout dishes like the thinly sliced rocca with beetroot salad and the boneless chicken breast platter (my favorites); in addition to their standard daily meals. The service is fast and friendly, making each visit enjoyable. Plus, the reasonable prices make it a great value. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: Lovely restaurant with an amazing view of the skyline and cultural center. We had a lovely dinner outside on the balcony, but we could smell the camels and ponies a little bit from the Souq (I don't blame the restaurant, though). The service was excellent, and the desserts were out of this world!!

reviews.author: Alaa :3
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived, the hospitality was incredible. It was warm, friendly, and attentive making us feel truly welcome. The food was so amazing! Portions were generous, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. And the view is just stunning! Overlooking the Doha skyline and the Fanar which made the whole experience even better. Everything was perfect from start to finish. If you’re looking for great food, hospitality and service, with a beautiful view, this is the place to be. Thank you Hsu Myat for your amazing hospitality and great service.

reviews.author: Aroosa Raja (Rooseeey)
reviews.text: My first evening dinner when visiting Qatar. Food was delicious and fresh, so fulfilling. Service is 100%, Hsu was friendly and lovely to meet. Hope to come back again one day. Balava dessert was recommend and Hsu was right, it's so good!

reviews.author: Wella
reviews.text: A hidden gem at souq Waqif. It has a beautiful view on the terrace. You have to go through the lounge first to go to the top floor. Definitely have a seat outside as you will enjoy it a lot. The peaceful atmosphere and the food was delicious.

reviews.author: Rayan Negm
reviews.text: Food was excellent I loved the cookies and the service was super nice the staff called hsw myat and koshitha was very nice definitely recommend nice prices nice food nice everything

reviews.author: eman alissa
reviews.text: Unfortunately I didn’t had a chance to try the seafront branch because they closed earlier than usual, although it is the Eid break!! The hostess was unfriendly and rude when I called to ask about the restaurant gate! It was like a maze route, with no information signs!! Instead of apologizing for closing early or not calling me or misinforming me about the time of the kitchen last order at 1am, She kept saying that we missed our reservation and she was annoyed because I called!! Thank you il gabbiano for hiring professional staff!!

reviews.author: Ali Moharrag
reviews.text: Wonderful experience at the new branch, with the added benefit of better decor. Service was exceptional by Mr Mustafa, who was very attentive and helpful. Food was excellent as always. We will of course return.

reviews.author: Lara Bukhari
reviews.text: I had a great meal at the restaurant. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with soft lighting and calming music. The food was delicious, made with fresh ingredients, and the flavors were just right. The service was friendly and helpful, It was a lovely experience with tasty food and excellent service. I highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Ali Alkhateeb
reviews.text: Nice & calm restaurant with amazing & professional staff. Food is regular nothing grab my attention but with good portion. Prices is considered above average. Opening time 14:00 Additional star for the ambiance & the staff

reviews.author: Yasir Mansouri
reviews.text: Nice restaurant we had business Iftar in Ramadan, the location is good with plenty of parking space, have a beautiful interior design with great seating areas, also they have special dining rooms, for private parties, the staff were very nice and friendly, the waiters were professional in serving food, the food was good with various varieties, we had a great time.

reviews.author: Lucy Clays
reviews.text: We had a brilliant time enjoying lunch at Al Sufra. Our server, Walid, was very friendly and attentive. The food was yummy and would especially recommend the sea bass. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jav EBRAHIMPOUR
reviews.text: It's a nice spot for dining and personnel are very nice and welcoming. Food and drinks are good as well. I wasn't happy with their system not accepting digital business ID when other restaurants in the same hotel accept and apply % offer, there was no reason to be different. I reckon to the management they can be more friendly as part of customer satisfaction otherwise people will not comeback after a single try! Maybe that's why it was too quiet!

reviews.author: Vimbai Mbanje
reviews.text: Al Sufra is an amazing restaurant with great decor. The service is 10/10, everyone is so friendly, it really made the dining experience a pleasure. The food prepared at Al Sufra was absolutely beautiful. Chef Muath who prepared our wonderful dishes also took the time to come and greet us at our table which was lovely. I’d definitely recommend

reviews.author: Margo M.
reviews.text: Incredible experience - from magical ambiance and stunning interior, Al Sufra is a restaurant to experience! The food was truly scrumptious, the service warm and welcoming. The dessert - super delicious! All in all - compliments to the chef and the team who operates this wonderful venue 😊 !

reviews.author: Animation Airlines
reviews.text: Thank you, Ms. Nour, for your excellent service on our 4-month anniversary. The food was delicious, and the service was amazing. Everything went better than i expected. Can't wait to return! Wish you all the very best.

reviews.author: Zoheir Saidi (Zopuscule)
reviews.text: Very nice food between Turkish and Lebanon !! Meet, fish on the grill with fresh vegetables... what else you want ;)

reviews.text: The place is now called "The village"

reviews.text: v.good

reviews.author: Daniele Di Stefano
reviews.text: It has changed its name and is now called VILLAGE

reviews.author: uthman
reviews.text: The restaurant has been closed for approximately one year, August 27, 2016

reviews.author: Mariem Maknine
reviews.text: The food tasted good especially the chicken and the service was great Kamrull was friendly

reviews.author: Pawel Nawrocki
reviews.text: Delicious middle east dishes. Easy to get from the subway and airport.

reviews.author: Sofia Rashid
reviews.text: 6 stars…actually 7 tbh Delicious and fresh food. Lamb majboos shank was melting in our mouth. Lamb chops were worth finger licking. Pita bread was perfectly crisp and salad tasted like it was fresh out of the farm. 2 extra stars are for our server who saw me shivering in cold and brought blanket and covered me. Kinda 🥰

reviews.author: Hana Garbo
reviews.text: We try the food here because in the reviews that it is good food so we expecting that it will be good. But sadly to say we didn’t enjoy the food a lot of portion for the lentil soup but need to make improvement on the taste . The serving is only for 1 person can’t be share for two. And also the preparation is not the same as we saw on the reviews. The price is high for this food but no problem if the food is good and and the portion was enough to share. Now i can say that i can’t recommend this to any one you will waste your money sorry. I think the restaurant need to improve something for the taste and the portion of their food.

reviews.author: Hisham Sawi
reviews.text: It is located in Yousef Ahmed Al-Gamal Square in Souq Waqif in Doha. It is one of the best cafes for meeting friends and family. It has a noticeable atmosphere of intimacy, the items are excellent and the service is beyond excellent.

reviews.author: Samista Ellis
reviews.text: It was so amazing the first time, I returned before I left Doha. I had my first experience eating on the floor. It was unexpected because I never knew that this was an actual "thing". I was pleasantly surprised and it is the highlight of my trip as it relates to dining. The place was bustling but super fast and excellent service . Very clean establishment as well. Shout out to my waiter - Abdullah, whose suggestions were on point and he recognized that we had never eaten on the floor before. He made the experience most memorable. He also remembered us on our second visit and did an excellent job, once again. Be mindful- IT IS A LOT OF FOOD!! The rice was the most delicious I have ever had , ever 😋 😍!!

reviews.author: Dominika Anna Bauer
reviews.text: First time trying Yemen food and I loved it. I blindly ordered a meat dish and a dessert and enjoyed both with plenty of leftovers. Service was fast and the food arrived fast as well. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Vignesh Gv
reviews.text: The food was definitely not for my palate. Gave this place a go to try an authentic Yemeni food. The mandi rice with lamb was just too bland and had raw flavours. Rice was quite grainy and was not boiled well. Lamb felt like it was cooked just in plain water with no flavour whatsoever. It was tender though. Got nauseated midway and had to waste half of it. The locals dining in though were devouring the food which meant it was to their liking and proximity to souk tells the story. Service was pathetic. It was too crowded. Ambience was dated and crammed for space.

reviews.author: PH Ong
reviews.text: Happy to have a meal here any day. Food may not like the most exciting, but taste like someone's mom made dinner for you. We had Hanid meat and beef with Yemeni species - both dishes were well marinated and seasoned, cooked till fall of the bone tender. And you can request a small bowl of complimentary soup. The one we had tasted of a hint of lamb, pepper and potatoes.

reviews.author: Krista M
reviews.text: First time having Yemeni food and it was delicious! We got the buried meat and chicken stew which came with bread. Loved it! The restaurant gets very busy at night so plan accordingly. The prices are reasonable too.

reviews.author: So_oP
reviews.text: The food was pretty amazing. The majboos was delicious. The rice was light, fluffy, and fragrant. The lamb was perfectly seasoned, tender and moist. The apple salad was good too, nicely balanced of tart and sweet. Valet parking was available.

reviews.author: Abdulla Janahi
reviews.text: One of the best dishes I had in Doha was the Harees Soup at this restaurant — an absolute must-try. The Machboos Hamour was also excellent: flavorful, well-cooked, and not heavy on oil. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Rahmah Ramli
reviews.text: One of the best place to taste the local Qatari cuisine. The ambience and deco of the restaurant is serene and beautiful. Restaurant is clean, staffs are attentive and helpful. However parking can be quite a hassle, because of parking limited lots. The next option is valet parking. Despite that, we had a great time having our dinner here. Alhamdulillah.

reviews.author: Baraak alsaeed
reviews.text: Belhambar offers **true Qatari flavors**—their **machboos** and **balaleet** are must-tries! Generous portions, cozy atmosphere, and friendly service. Perfect for a cultural dining experience. **Don’t miss the karak chai!**

reviews.author: Ahmad Alshaikh
reviews.text: Great food, amazing flavors. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with top-notch presentation and generous hospitality. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.text: Having returned here for a second time, I sampled the Peach Iced Tea, and it was absolutely delightful. The Chapati Halloumi Pesto and Shrimp Pasta is also highly recommended. One must also try their Iced Chai Halib!

reviews.author: Lamiya
reviews.text: I’ve been to the Souq Waqif countless times but this was my first time visiting this place. The moment I walked in, I was blown away by the huge display of teapots. It was really impressive! The sofas were super comfortable and it felt so cozy like being at home. I could easily stay for hours. Mr. Joseph, one of the staff greeted me with a warm smile and made me feel really welcome. And the Arabic music playing inside was just perfect.

reviews.author: Antar Ak
reviews.text: I had an amazing dining experience at From the moment I walked in, the ambiance was warm and inviting, and the staff was incredibly welcoming. The food was absolutely delicious each dish was prepared with great attention to detail, bursting with flavor, and beautifully presented. A special shout-out to Amina, who made the experience even more memorable! Her friendly attitude, professionalism, and attentive service truly stood out. She went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. It’s rare to find such exceptional hospitality, and Amina is a true asset to the restaurant.

reviews.author: Melissa Dsouza
reviews.text: The staff were amazing sweet, attentive, and went the extra mile. Huge thanks to Valentina for making it memorable! Enjoyed the Sakura shisha. The fries and luqaimat with cheese & zaatar were decent, but the service truly stood out.

reviews.author: Usama Siddiqui
reviews.text: Their prices are on the higher end as compared to the other restaurants in the same vicinity. The portion size doesn't justify the price. Nonetheless, full marks for their service and atmosphere.

reviews.author: Rima
reviews.text: Love this restaurant! The food is delicious and our server Oliphar was super helpful, kind and friendly. The ambience is perfect, extremely clean and food is done to perfection. Def recommend trying it out!

reviews.author: A. O.
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our time here. Highly recommend if you’re checking out Katara village. They have breakfast before 12pm and lunch after. We had both a breakfast set and some lunch dishes. Their food portion looks bigger than the pictures and is very generous. The dishes are quite unique from other more common middle eastern ones (such as Lebanese) and we were excited to try Qatari food. The saffron cake is really good. The lamb is also really well done. If you’re here for breakfast, the set is very nice as well. Don’t forget to order Arabic coffee - they make it very well here. The manager and our waiters are all very welcoming and helpful. They truly showed Qatari hospitality!

reviews.author: L N
reviews.text: The chicken machbous is very tasty and the chicken is very succulent. Thanks to Asgar who recommended this dish and warned me of the huge portion so that I can estimate how much to order. The portion is meant for sharing for two or more persons. The hibiscus tea is sour but unique. It seems this place is very popular with locals and I can see why. Thumbs up for local Qatari food.

reviews.author: HASIM BIN UMMER Hasim
reviews.text: "Authentic Flavors and a Memorable Dining Experience!" Feeh Al'Aafia is a must-visit restaurant in Katara for anyone who loves authentic and flavorful cuisine. The menu offers a wide variety of dishes that truly capture the essence of Arabic and Qatari culinary traditions. The ambiance is warm and inviting, with a perfect blend of modern elegance and traditional touches. Located in the heart of Katara Cultural Village, the restaurant provides a relaxing atmosphere with stunning views of the surroundings. The service is exceptional, with friendly staff ensuring a delightful dining experience. Whether you’re looking for a hearty meal or just a place to unwind with friends, Feeh Al'Aafia is a fantastic choice. Highly recommended for locals and visitors alike!

reviews.author: Suliman H
reviews.text: The place is empty and they let us wait a long time outside. I guess they are understaffed. Food was good we loved the shrimps and Samosa.

reviews.author: Princess
reviews.text: If i could give them 10 stars I would, I am very impressed by the delicious taste of their food. I ordered clams and seabream I was enjoying every bit. The lemon butter sauce is exceptional yummy yummy. If you're seafood lover you must go there and thank me later! I would definitely go again and again any time I visit Bahrain. Thank you for the warm welcome by the staff and lovely hosts who served me ☺️🙌

reviews.author: Alexei Moiseyev
reviews.text: It's an absolutely delightful experience. The service is exceptional. The views from the terrace that envelopes the restaurant are splendid. The menu and the wine list are perfectly designed. Fresh seafood can be selected from the ice-lined display to be prepared in various ways. I've gone for a butterfly hamour simply grilled. ...an absolute delight!

reviews.author: Saud Al-Subaie
reviews.text: At the fish market resturant, you choose your seafood fish, shrimps, crabs, and seashell and how you want them to be cooked. Variety of recipes available with extra appetisers of your choice. The views around by the sea are beautiful. The service is good. But this resturant is unbelievably overpriced!

reviews.author: Zaid Al-Asa'd
reviews.text: The Fish Market restaurant offers an unforgettable dining experience that I highly recommend. From the moment you step in, the ambiance is charming, with an open and fresh design that enhances the experience. The highlight, of course, is the seafood, which is not only fresh but prepared with incredible skill. Every dish I tried was bursting with flavor, from the perfectly grilled shrimp to the deliciously fresh sea mussels. The variety on the menu caters to all preferences, ensuring that everyone finds something they love. What really sets the Fish Market apart is its exceptional service. The staff is attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable, making excellent recommendations without being overbearing. You can tell they take pride in what they do, which makes the meal that much more enjoyable. And then there’s the view – simply breathtaking. The restaurant overlooks a serene waterfront, making it the perfect spot for a romantic evening or a relaxing lunch. Whether you're a seafood lover or just looking for a unique dining experience, the Fish Market delivers on all fronts. It’s a place I can’t wait to visit again.

reviews.author: Karim Mouawad
reviews.text: We really enjoyed having lunch there. The food was delicious. Great to be able to enjoy their food as we usually enjoyed at their original branch in Al Bander Resort. It gave us the opportunity to enjoy it in downtown Bahrain Bay. Had the salad, shrimps, crab, silous and sea bream which were all delissssssh!! Thank you! ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Lilith
reviews.text: The ambience and view were beautiful. The decoration has been tastefully done, and there is a nice view of the city, sea and Fort. Unfortunately, though I was not very impressed with the food. The seafood was not seasoned, and the rice was extremely plain.

reviews.author: Ara Jherielle
reviews.text: This is a must-visit restaurant. Amazing place. You can enjoy the variety of seafood within your budget. 👍🏻 And a relaxing view of the sea. 🌊

reviews.author: DMK
reviews.text: Popular waterfront eatery at which you could either take your time and choose your catch on display to be prepared for you, or rely on expert chefs to deliver house specials at a quicker turnaround. We like seafood so we really enjoyed this place. This restaurant is frequented equally by both international tourists and local clientele who value the quality offerings of this unique venue.

reviews.author: sky Forhad
reviews.text: It's a seafood Fish Market Marina in Alexander The fish soup was different from what we're used to, as it had shrimp in it. It was a delicious soup with plenty of ingredients. Afterwards, we ordered grilled fish. It came with fried calamari and rice, but the fish was undercooked. At first, I thought this might be how Egyptians prepare fish, but then I realized it was just mine that was like that. When I asked for it to be changed, they sent a new plate. The taste was quite good. There were 4-5 different kinds of mezes, and the ones with garlic and eggplant were my favorites. Warm mini pitas were also served with the dishes. The staff were served at a normal pace. The place was large but noisy. However, the view was amazing. You could watch the calm waters of the Mediterranean from anywhere in the restaurant.

reviews.author: Eda Nur Camur
reviews.text: The fish soup was different from what we're used to, as it had shrimp in it. It was a delicious soup with plenty of ingredients. Afterwards, we ordered grilled fish. It came with fried calamari and rice, but the fish was undercooked. At first, I thought this might be how Egyptians prepare fish, but then I realized it was just mine that was like that. You could watch the calm waters of the Mediterranean from anywhere in the restaurant.

reviews.author: I. Morgan
reviews.text: The Mina District Fish Market is unlike any fish market you’ve ever seen — it’s more like stepping into the luxury food halls at Harrods. The building itself is a work of art, with intricate mosaics, clean marble interiors, and beautiful ironwork that gives the whole space a sense of calm elegance. Even if you’re not here to buy, it’s absolutely worth a visit just to admire the design and experience the atmosphere. The selection of seafood is vast, fresh, and beautifully displayed — from local catches to more exotic varieties. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, it’s the perfect stop if you’re exploring the Mina District or Old Doha Port. Stylish, spotless, and full of character — a must-see spot in the city!

reviews.author: Muna Hawwa
reviews.text: offers a unique blend of culinary excellence and architectural beauty 🩷🩷🩷 Many visitors highlight the quality of the seafood and the unique dining experience. Some patrons have noted longer waiting times during peak hours and suggest arriving early to avoid delays. Despite its upscale ambiance, the market offers competitive pricing, often more affordable than high end seafood restaurants in Doha.

reviews.author: Isuru Dissanayake
reviews.text: This is one of the iconic fish market in Mina District, Doha. This fish market is located in a building that doesn't really look like a fish market. Fish market interior is like an art gallery. The ceiling is doctorated with colorful glass panels and it looks amazing. Also they maintain the fish market with a pleasant vibe. Highly recommended to visit and have a look.

reviews.author: Света Косенко
reviews.text: Thank you for a good experience and tasty food in your restaurant. And thank you for an amazing hospitality from Khalid. Everything was 5 star, my biggest recommendation!

reviews.author: Isidre Marco Tuset
reviews.text: This is a new area on the old city harbour with nice restorants & cafeterías. The fish market is young stile and you can bay the fish that they cook for you.

reviews.author: Kristyna Zavadilova
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at this restaurant! From the moment I walked in, the warm and authentic atmosphere set the tone for a wonderful meal. The decoration is beautiful and truly reflects the charm of traditional Arabic design, every detail feels intentional and inviting. A huge shoutout to the incredible servers, Montassar and Mark, who went above and beyond to make our visit special. They were attentive, friendly, and made sure my Arabic coffee cup was never empty! Speaking of which, the biscuits served with the Arabic coffee were just perfect, crisp, buttery, and full of flavor. Breakfast was a delight, everything was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. The hummus was incredibly flavourful and smooth, and the fresh mint in the tea added such a refreshing touch. Every bite and sip felt like a little celebration. Even the outdoor seating was impressive, the AC outside works perfectly, keeping us cool and comfortable throughout the meal. Can’t wait to come back again soon. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ruth Lovelyn
reviews.text: I visited the place Gahwetna and ate the recommended best seller of Mashkool which deserves a 5 star. very tasty and presented well with an affordable price. The place was clean and maintained. The waiter was so kind and nice and accommodating, gave even a complimentary sweet which is very nice as well, its like a coffee cream tiramisu on a jar.w

reviews.author: Kaylea Willis
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful selection of food! We shared a breakfast for 4 and each dish was incredible! Lovely outside seating with air conditioning and the service from staff was very accommodating and welcoming! Thank you so much

reviews.author: Maryam H
reviews.text: Very poor service. First we waited about 10 minutes for someone to come to us to place an order. We received tea after we had finished eating, even though we asked for it right away. The woman serving was very rude. The food was ok, nothing special. I will not come back to this place.

reviews.author: Fahad almohawes
reviews.text: I had my breakfast today and I do attached my selection👍 worthy for trial during Qatar stay👌 Highly recommended

reviews.author: Aya Shika
reviews.text: Staff were warm welcoming from the moment I stepped in. The service was outstanding, delivered with true professionalism. The starters and main course were full of flavour with the beautiful presentations. Thank you for the unforgettable dining experience!

reviews.author: Hossai G
reviews.text: Absolutely adored the Experience menu here. All the meals and mocktails were so cool and the service was impeccable. Special shoutout to the Venison 👌 Just an overall great experience, our favourite restaurant in Doha and well deserving of the Michelin star!

reviews.author: Mirah Marhaendra
reviews.text: Every visit to IDAM by Alain Ducasse feels like a love letter to gastronomy. The artistry of Chef @fabricerosso is woven into every dish—each bite telling a story of passion, precision, and creativity. With their new menu, there’s even more to discover and savor. And now, with a well-deserved One Michelin Star, it’s a testament to their dedication to pushing culinary boundaries. Beyond the exquisite dishes, the mocktail pairing experience by @ratan_robi_ is just as remarkable—thoughtfully crafted to complement every flavor, earning its own recognition in the Michelin Guide. A true symphony of taste in every sip and bite.

reviews.author: Libby Lies
reviews.text: Superb service and delicious (and ingenious) food made this a Michelin star experience. What a treat. I will have daydreams about the venison dish for a very long time. Thank you for the amazing evening, Idam. 🖤

reviews.author: Rose
reviews.text: We had a wonderful eight course dinner yesterday at Idam. We also had a non-alcoholic drink package, which was great and inventive. We were especially impressed by the waiter’s professionalism, really good food and a genuine, caring atmosphere. We were also introduced to the restaurant's terrace where we could see Doha in the evening light and we had a pleasant chat with idam employee (Maître d'?). The evening was a perfect start to this year. Thank you very much for this unique experience.

address: IDAM by Alain Ducasse, Doha, Qatar

reviews.author: W B
reviews.text: Kamachi — My Official Top Pick for Breakfast in Doha! This spot has secured its place as my go-to breakfast destination in Katara. The menu is refreshingly simple, featuring just a handful of Qatari traditional breakfast dishes.. each one outstanding in its own right. Honestly, it’s hard to describe just how delicious everything is… this place is a must-try for every Doha visitor. parking available. Dine-in option, but note: it’s always busy and lively, so expect a short wait for a table. The food is fresh, authentic, and consistently mouthwatering. Prices are very reasonable given the food quality, service standards, and prime Katara location. ✅ 5 stars — easily earned. If you’re after a genuine taste of local breakfast culture.. simple, hearty, and absolutely delicious.. Kamachi should be at the top of your list.

reviews.author: Abu Firas
reviews.text: A wonderful traditional restaurant in Katara. Lovely location, great service and tasty food. We tried many dishes like liver, keema, foul, hummus, keimar with honey, Shakshouka and eggs. The bread is so fresh and hot. Luckily we found a table for 14 people. Don’t miss Karak tea.

reviews.author: Taimur Bin A. Salaam
reviews.text: Kamachi truly surprised me in the best way possible. From the moment I walked in, the traditional design and warm, cozy ambience instantly made me feel at home. It's the kind of place where you want to sit back, relax, and enjoy a slow, comforting meal. I ordered their foul and shakshuka with bread, and it was an absolute classic. The flavors were rich and authentic, and the bread was perfectly soft and fresh — ideal for dipping and scooping. It felt like a home-cooked breakfast with a touch of finesse. But the highlight for me was definitely their karak — smooth, strong, and perfectly balanced. If I were living in Qatar, Kamachi would easily be my daily go-to for a great cup of karak and a solid, soulful meal. The combination of delicious food, authentic vibe, and amazing tea makes it a must-visit spot in my book.

reviews.author: Waleed Bayyari
reviews.text: Great place to enjoy authentic arabic - qatari with a twist of indian in between! For breakfast - lunch - dinner anytime of the day. Situated in Katara (parking sometimes is not easy) Their platters are all served on same size plates, the variety of eats are on point! The kamachi bread is made inhouse - crispy & light - Perfect for dipping!! what we have ordered below are all recommended Keema - Kamachi Kabda (liver) - Meat Nashef - egg & tomatoes - lentil bowl - indian rajma/foul - Service was great, no delays in food & server was very helpful Great work & keep up the great food & service

reviews.author: Mai Aljondob
reviews.text: What’s nice about this restaurant is that it’s quick in preparation and service, and the food is served in a traditional style that suits the place and its vibe. They also serve the food really hot. However, the waitress gave us the spoons and forks to set up ourselves — she didn’t arrange them on the table, and she wasn’t very organized in how she placed the food

reviews.author: Osama A
reviews.text: Good place to enjoy the Egyptian cuisine and special vibes as well There's a good selection of traditional dishes, but the taste is fairly average. Shisha is available. Prices are little high

reviews.author: Hana Garbo
reviews.text: I will tell you my honest review And this is not SPONSORED GUYS! This is our first time to dine in here. We expect too much for the food to be good but sad to say didn’t reach our expectations and also the price is little bit expensive for the portion of the food. But for us no problem for the price unless we enjoy the food but sad to say we didn’t. I think they need to improve more for the taste of the food and also the strawberry juice is very sweet even my son didn’t like to drink it. And we order enough for us but we paid almost 500qr wow😱 There is area separated who like shisha and there is a family area There is someone who can sing for you i don’t if by request or they make random for the people. The restaurant is huge you can bring your family and friends with you. The staff are friendly too! The one we like a lot is the fresh egytian bread made by the old lady there from the oven and she is friendly too. My rate for every food : Molokia - 8/10 a little bit salty Mixed stuff vegetables or mashy- 7/10 a little bit of salty also Bamia -8/10 good but little bit of salty Mashy chrome (cabbage leaves ) and wara anab(grape leaves) 8/10 it’s ok Rose shaaria(rice with vermicelli) 9/10 good Mixed grill is 6/10 expensive not tasty at all the portion is too little Bechamel macaroni- 8/10 good but the problem is the meat that they is use is sheep i thinks cause i can’t eat if the meat is so smelly so i know that this one is not pure beef so I didn’t eat this one at all. The sweet we take it home The karkadeh juice (hibiscus) is 10/10 even my son like it too! I Don’t know if i can recommend this restaurant to you guys but maybe you like try We did order delivery for them also after tamiya (falapel beans) 9/10 was good even it’s 4pcs only and little expensive but the taste is good The foul ( fava beans ) 9/10 is good also With the fresh Egyptian bread , I hope my comments here can help you guys Once again this is my honest review Thank you

reviews.author: ahmed nagy
reviews.text: The Iftar buffet was excellent, with a great variety of authentic Egyptian dishes. What truly stood out was the exceptional hospitality – the staff were incredibly welcoming and made the experience feel special. The Ramadan vibes were beautifully present, creating a warm and memorable atmosphere. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Mahmoud Elsadany
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The food was exceptional, offering a wide variety of delicious dishes to choose from. The seating arrangement and the Ramadan atmosphere were truly special, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making the whole dining experience even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this place

reviews.author: Mohammed Al-Tamimi
reviews.text: The real Egyptian taste away from home Amazing delicious food and atmosphere

reviews.author: Farhan Riaz
reviews.text: Beautiful location with views of visiting cruise ships. Food was delicious and fresh at reasonable prices. Amin took care of us, a super friendly and helpful individual ! (thanks for charging my dieing mobile :D

reviews.author: Winter Sea
reviews.text: I came in this place to have shisha in front of the sea with friends, it was really nice experience special thanks to Moroccan guy Hicham and Lebanese guys Ala and Muhammad, they are stars in service they took care of us

reviews.author: Khaoula Ch
reviews.text: I order cappuccino and some sweet, the service is excellent, the moment we come everyone was very kind, special thanks to Tunisian server Amin he was very kind My friend took chicha it was very nice I really recommend The view is fantastic

reviews.author: MacX
reviews.text: Came for a Shisha and drank a Karak Chai. View is amazing and Shisha was very good. Of course the place is not cheap, but I expected this in such a location. The staff was very friendly and joked around.

reviews.author: Meredith M
reviews.text: Nice setting and comfy chairs. Food was good. They could do with a baby changing table somewhere!
