reviews.author: Meredith M
reviews.text: Nice setting and comfy chairs. Food was good. They could do with a baby changing table somewhere!

reviews.author: bashar mraish
reviews.text: Nobu Doha is truly an experience worth having at least once. The restaurant’s decor is absolutely stunning — from the impressive architecture to the elegant interior design, every detail feels luxurious and sophisticated. The food is delicious and beautifully presented, staying true to Nobu’s world-class reputation. Each dish bursts with flavor and creativity, although the portions are on the smaller side, so don’t expect to leave overly full. Be prepared for a hefty bill — around per person is typical — but the exceptional quality, ambiance, and service make it worthwhile for a special night out. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to treat themselves to a unique dining experience in Doha.

reviews.author: Muhammad Ahmad Abbas
reviews.text: Had one of the finest lunches at Nobu Doha — a symphony of flavor, elegance, and understated opulence. From the first bite to the final moment, everything spoke of refined taste and timeless luxury. A truly majestic dining experience that blends art, culture, and culinary brilliance in every detail.

reviews.author: Ella Cioaca
reviews.text: Nobu’s exquisite location and their sharp staff are always a pleasure! The vivid atmosphere and their open kitchen are always attraction us.The gin selection and all their dishes suited us pretty well. We shall be looking out for other Nobu location while travelling!

reviews.author: Tracy C
reviews.text: First time dining at a Nobu buffet/brunch in Doha and it did not disappoint. Do not expect to pay less than 200 QR as that is around the starting price (was able to avail a friend’s discount as well). This is probably one of the best brunches I’ve been too. I ordered two different cocktails which were excellent! Sushi and seafood items were fresh. Variety of dessert and fruit also available in “buffet style” area. In the brunch package, you can choose a main and a dessert. Appetizers were brought to the table to share. The view and ambiance of the dining area was spectacular as you get views of the water and skyline as well. Random note - there was a nice view of the Pearl in the restrooms as well.

reviews.author: juls O
reviews.text: Nobu is on another level! The location alone, right by the sea, screams luxury. The vibe is super classy with a chill soundtrack that lets you actually chat at the table. The staff? So accommodating and friendly! Now, let’s talk food. Wow! Every dish was on point, and the quality totally justifies the price. We started with the zensai edamame, then the king crab tacos, followed by the tuna maki and tempura. And don’t skip dessert—it's exquisite! Overall, a five-star experience that’s worth every penny!

reviews.author: Jonna Harish
reviews.text: A best experience of visiting this one and more yummy varieties and tasty food. Simply awesome.

reviews.author: Rocky Green
reviews.text: I had a delicious breakfast here today as well as my first ever Shisha experience. I sat on a delightful terrace overlooking the ocean. My waiter Amir was excellent. I forgot to tip, I am so sorry. Next time I visit Qatar I will certainly visit here again.

reviews.author: Sloppy Panda
reviews.text: Orient Pearl and Salata Park is our newest favorite place in Qatar! My kids loved the park. They really enjoyed playing there. We had fun as it was not crowded. Then we had our dinner snack at the Orient Pearl. The place is exquisitely well structured and cozy. Looks expensive but worth the stay. We ordered Kunafa, Syrian Ice Cream, Shishtawok sandwich and a mango pineapple juice were amazing! The indoor area looks first class. Their comfort room is extremely 7 star! Smells like you’re in a hotel. Finally, the service is genuinely extraordinarily lovely. I’m sure we’ll come back for more. Thank you for the great customer experience!

reviews.author: Martina Mattar
reviews.text: The baba ganoush was really good but the rest didn't impress us. That said, we only ordered small plates and none of the main courses. The vibe was "businessmen in lunch break", which is usually a good sign for food.

reviews.author: mahi
reviews.text: It’s a bit on the pricey side, but the food makes it up for that.Ambiance is nice the only issue was Sheesha smoke, if you are with kids its just not somewhere I would go as the smoke is everywhere. Staff is courteous and quick to respond.

reviews.author: Saira J. Barlas
reviews.text: I’ve never been a fan of Iranian food but the food here was absolutely delicious and succulent. Really changed my viewpoint. The service was exceptional and what we ordered was flavourful. Wouldn’t say the food here was of high quality but the vibe and the setting made it enjoyable! Definitely recommended for newcomers to Doha!

reviews.author: Andreea Daniela Dinulescu
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful restaurant I’ve been in. The decor is so breathtaking. I was very impressed. We received from the house some traditional yoghurt with warm bread. Was very good. To eat I took the fried eggplant and a side of friends. They have the dish at appetizers but honestly is so big I was full. My husband had grilled beef on skewers and was very tender and tasty. I also tried some lamb from a friend’s dish, very good too. The portions are very big, we were so full we couldn’t eat anymore. The fresh juices are amazing. They were out of pomerganate, but I took mango instead and was a revelation 😂 so good and refreshing. The staff is very attentive and pleasant. If I come to Doha again I will return to this restaurant.

reviews.author: Philip
reviews.text: I've been to Parisa a few times now, and everyone I've brought has said it's been their best restaurant experience in Doha. The interior is absolutely stunning, the staff is friendly, and the food is outright delicious. Make sure to book a reservation as it can get quite full, especially on weekends. A must-try if you're in the souq area.

reviews.author: Dina Shakhatreh
reviews.text: This restaurant was a great find! The food was full of flavor and the portion sizes were more than satisfying. Everything tasted fresh and well-prepared.

reviews.author: Ernesto Méndez
reviews.text: Our visit to Parisa in Souq Waqif was absolutely memorable. It was my first time trying this type of cuisine, and I was genuinely impressed. The food was delicious—full of rich flavors and beautifully presented. The atmosphere of the restaurant is simply stunning. The warm, inviting décor made us feel like we were dining inside a piece of art. It was so beautiful that we couldn’t resist taking a few photos to remember the moment. Special thanks to Mr. Danish, who provided outstanding service. He was kind, attentive, and truly made sure we had everything we needed without ever being intrusive. His care made the experience even more enjoyable. This won’t be our last visit—I’m already looking forward to coming back!

reviews.author: Tanya Ribeiro
reviews.text: This a small place with their usual great snack menu, when you just want a bite to grab. Tried the tender coconut refresher drink which was nice.

reviews.author: Blue Flame
reviews.text: Its a nice minimal restaurant with good quality food.

reviews.author: Ashok Philip Jacob
reviews.text: Try the Chips Bag tasty , superb.

reviews.author: Dean Leung
reviews.text: Ordered sandwiches that were "Grab and Go". 40 minutes later, I am still told that my order is being prepared and that no refunds will be made if we cancel. Understaffed and unprepared. Don't name something "Grab and Go" if you have to prepare to order.

reviews.author: Ahmed Adel
reviews.text: The food and the service was excellent. Chapatii was great. And the staff were good and smiles all time. The only bad thing was the air conditioning.

reviews.author: W B
reviews.text: I heard a lot about this place, so I was really excited to try it for breakfast. When I got there, I was a bit disappointed.. the place felt empty and not alive, only one table was taken. I sat down and ordered the American breakfast. The food came warm, not hot. The eggs were overcooked and dry. The beef wasn’t juicy and was hard to cut, with too much fat. The potato was okay. The biscuit with gravy was nice but nothing special. The coffee also tastes cheap. Overall, the place looks like a classic American diner, but the food didn’t impress me. There are better options in Doha for this kind of breakfast. *Will repeat the visit? No.

reviews.author: Ms D
reviews.text: I'd heard quite a bit about Ric's, and was really craving biscuits and gravy, so I ordered up a late Friday breakfast today: biscuits, white gravy, sausage and home fries. The food was okay. Definitely edible and arrived in pretty good condition for delivery. But, I'm an American cook. A good American cook. And there's some things that Ric's could be doing so much better... Sausage patties were the consistency of a burger patty and overcooked. If you are going to do a beef sausage, the ground needs to be finer. The sage came through, which is the only reason it could pass as sausage-like. Biscuits were crumbly and dry. They lacked any kind of tenderness and were overbaked at the bottom. The gravy saved them... kind of... The home fries had zero seasoning. The onion was nice but too sweet. Decent consistency though. The gravy was nice, but needed both salt and, more importantly, black pepper.

reviews.author: Aya Shika
reviews.text: The staff were kind and professional. The portions and the taste of the food were good. The ambience is cozy and the restaurant was hygienic.

reviews.author: JaX
reviews.text: We went to the Tornado Tower branch. We had combo nachos/burritos, waffles, French toast, omellete with cups of Americano (refillable). The beef sausage was dry. The food was filling but unfortunately, tasteless and dry.... needs improvement. I didn't really enjoy the meal. The ambience was very good for nice conversation. Service by the male waiter (he was alone most of the whole morning) was efficient but long. He did great even if he was alone. The old menu and food at the former branch was better and more hearty.

reviews.author: Julie Solivar (Julie)
reviews.text: The food was good, but not great. I ordered the Rigs which come with egg, turkey sausage, and French toast. (Turkey sausage is too tough, and the French toast is too soggy). Biscuits and gravy are okay, but the bread is hard and not like the original American biscuit. The staff is friendly and the ambiance is pleasant!

reviews.author: N T
reviews.text: My always destination for breakfast in Doha. In love with places location, delicious food, and great service. Highly recommended for breakfast.

reviews.author: Maria Khan
reviews.text: Came here because of the Qatar Airlines series on the chef and really enjoyed the food! It’s authentic Qatari breakfast, good serving sizes, great prices, and a nice diverse menu. The service from the waiters is…interesting. They weren’t rude though. We enjoyed our food a lot though! Definitely recommend coming here.

reviews.author: Sharifa A Rahman
reviews.text: The food here is exceptional. The place was very busy due to its popularity. The honey and cheese regag was perfect in taste! Karak tea of course was 10/10 This is a real Qatari gem. It being owned by a love Qatari lady is also amazing to see.

reviews.author: Nurşah Atsu
reviews.text: Egg was good. I had more expectation from Saj. Saj pizza was not good…Staff is amazing. The prices should be less. Local place.

reviews.author: Ela Yudhanira
reviews.text: A nice local restaurant if you want to eat like a local. My friend recommended this place and seems like many famous people has been here. They serve different varieties of ragag and teas. I ordered ragag honey cheese and it was tasty. I also ordered a saffron tea and it was perfect. The price is also reasonable, the staffs are helpful and friendly.

name: Souq Al Wakra Restaurant
address: Souq Al Wakra Restaurant, Doha, Qatar

reviews.author: Paul Ciprian
reviews.text: A traditional but clean market with all the amenities of the modern world. Cobblestone streets, buildings with traditional architecture, restaurants, cafes and dozens of shops selling souvenirs, traditional clothes, spices, handicrafts, perfumes. In the market, small producers selling sweets, food and homemade juices. A special section is the bird market, where there are dozens of types of colorful birds. An interesting place, a must-visit! Crowded, in the evening.

reviews.author: Tomas Rehorek
reviews.text: You can find anything here. The beginning of the east side is where most of the souvenirs are to be found. Usually fair prices. There are some nice regional restaurants as well. Photos are only from the outside of the souk. Inside, there are typical narrow passages with plenty of shops offering regional spices, cashmere, gold, toys, etc.

reviews.author: THE WANDERING COACH.
reviews.text: Indian Mango Festival also known as Indian Hamba is a real treat for mango lovers like me ,Quality fruit ,great variety Variety:multiple stalls, with different types of mangoes offering rich selection Common Frustration!! Cornered audience, Bring a female companion or visit as a family To avoid entry restrictions—security strictly enforces “families only. Crowded condition:Since it’s free and well‑publicized, opening hours—especially right at 4 PM—see heavy foot traffic, making it bustling and sometimes a bit overwhelming ,

reviews.author: Maheema Kavindya
reviews.text: Every tourist must visit this place. Food was ao nice and the prices also low. Surrounding was so friendly. You can easily reached by Metro. Evening time and night is recommended.

reviews.author: Queenie 18
reviews.text: One of the best place in Doha that I can come every day. Great Architecture, atmosphere, decoration, with plenty of restaurants choices. Can walk alone here all day long just to capture all beautiful corners there.

reviews.author: Deborah Mboya - DAM (777Debz)
reviews.text: So, I finally got around to trying Zuma at Al Maha Island after hearing a lot of hype. It’s one of those places that seems to promise a high-end dining experience with a lively atmosphere. Unfortunately, for me, the whole experience was just… okay. Let’s start with the sushi — it was fine. Not bad, but definitely not great either. For a restaurant with Zuma’s reputation and price point, I expected something a bit more memorable. The flavors were kind of flat, and nothing really stood out. It didn’t feel like a place that was putting much creativity or freshness into what they were serving that day. The service was also just okay. The staff weren’t rude, but they weren’t particularly friendly or attentive either. We had to wait longer than expected to get someone’s attention a few times, and it felt like we were just another table they had to get through. Not the kind of vibe you want when you're out for a nice dinner. Now, the space itself is modern and stylish, which I appreciated — but the tables are super close together. Like, awkwardly close. If you're planning on having a relaxed conversation or catching up with someone, forget it. You can hear every word from the tables around you, and they can hear you too. It felt more like a crowded lounge than a restaurant. One weird thing I didn’t expect: they don’t allow hats. I showed up wearing a clean, casual cap and was politely asked to take it off. I get it if that’s their policy, but it felt a bit unnecessary given the overall casual feel of the place — especially considering how trendy and relaxed the crowd looked. On the plus side, the manager was actually decent. He came by to check in and was polite and professional. He seemed open to feedback, which I appreciated. That definitely helped soften the overall impression. All in all, Zuma at Al Maha Island was a decent night out, but nothing that left me excited to return. With so many great dining options around, I’d probably try somewhere else next time.

reviews.author: Baraak alsaeed
reviews.text: Zuma Doha is a truly exceptional dining experience! From the moment we arrived on Al Maha Island, everything felt luxurious and well-curated. The ambiance is elegant yet vibrant — especially on the terrace with breathtaking views of the sea. The food? Absolutely divine. Every dish we tried was a masterpiece, from the miso-marinated black cod to the wagyu beef skewers and the signature spicy tuna maki. The service was top-notch — attentive, professional, and friendly. We also enjoyed the Sunset Menu — a perfect way to unwind with delicious bites and a stunning skyline view. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy high-end Japanese cuisine in Doha. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Haya Alkuwari
reviews.text: Had a great dining experience at Zuma Doha yesterday for lunch. The service was excellent everyone was friendly and welcoming, which made for a pleasant atmosphere. The food was delicious, with well-balanced flavors in every dish. The grilled wagyu was tender and perfectly cooked, the lettuce salad was fresh and light, and the raw fish was very fresh. For dessert, the sweet potato cake was really good. The vanilla tea was a nice, comforting way to end the meal. Overall, a great experience, and I’d definitely go back!

reviews.author: Aya Shika
reviews.text: Staff were warm welcoming by mentioning "Irasshaimase" in Japanese (traditional way to welcome at restaurant. The foods were tasty and fresh. The outdoor seating option was great with a nice view. Thank you for the great dining experience!

reviews.author: Ella Cioaca
reviews.text: Zuma, Doha (Lusail Island) – A Must-Visit Culinary Experience Zuma in Doha, located on the stunning Lusail Island, offers an unforgettable dining experience. The setting is spectacular, right by the water, adding to the restaurant’s already vibrant and energetic atmosphere. From the moment you step inside, you’re welcomed with warm smiles—from the waitstaff to the chefs—which immediately sets the tone for an exceptional evening. The service is top-notch, with an attentive and professional team ensuring everything runs smoothly. The music is another highlight. We visited at the end of December and had a DJ that night, creating an electrifying yet sophisticated ambiance that perfectly complemented the experience. Now, the food—simply outstanding. Every dish, from starters to main courses to desserts, was flawless. The sushi was fresh and expertly prepared, the fish dishes were cooked to perfection, and the flavors were on point throughout the meal. One standout dessert featured sweet potato ice cream with caramel and pecan nuts—an absolute must-try. Zuma Doha is not just a restaurant; it’s an experience. The combination of impeccable service, vibrant energy, and exquisite cuisine makes it a place you won’t regret visiting. If you’re in Doha, especially on Lusail Island, make sure this spot is on your list.

reviews.author: Din Saint
reviews.text: This place serves one of the best lamb biryani I have tasted. It rivals that of Michelin star biryani place without a doubt. The biryani rice used basmati grains, moist, not oily, and the lamb tender as heck. The portion is huge! The condiment sauce paired great with the dish. A simple yet satisfying meal at only 16 QAR. Aside from the biryani, other notable dishes would be the lamb and chicken Kadai. Look past the excessive oil used in the dish, the gravy is rich and savoury. It is not too watery and holds well when dipped with Naan bread. The naan is made fresh to order and served steaming hot from the oven. The atmosphere here is hot, literally. Especially during summer, the heat from the kitchen and the naan oven, escapes into the dining place. The AC isn't the strongest making the enclosed place somewhat a huge sauna, not too hot but it makes it quite uncomfortable during your meal. That said, this place is a gem tucked away in Messaid. For a hearty meal, it's well worth the travel

reviews.author: Saghar Abbas
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the food at this restaurant. The Mutton Kadiye and Chicken Haleem were very tasty and full of flavor. The staff were very kind and helpful, especially Mr. Moshin. He took great care of us and made us feel welcome. I will definitely come back again. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sana Rizwan
reviews.text: Love the food . Pure dhaba style pakistani khana . The taste is very authentic and the spice level can be adjustible . the service is awesome they will try to accommodate you in the best possible manner . Over all there is a lot of variety and you can get the pakistani food fresh as this restaurant has quite a lot customers and the menu covers majorly all basic items with awesome prices . Sitting area for families is upstairs but if someone can't go up or take stairs they can arrange downstairs as well .

reviews.author: Ajwad Rathore
reviews.text: My group has some picky eaters but even still, everyone loved their dishes. We had chicken biryani, daal maash, kebab curry, chicken kebab, mix grill and karela. Quality Pakistani food. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Nafeesa Banu
reviews.text: Best restaurant in the world service waiter is the best u can find verryyyyyyyy fasssttttt serviccceee. Must eat from here soooooo goood za best in za Qatar

name: Afghan Brothers Restaurant
address: Afghan Brothers Restaurant, Umm Salal, Qatar

reviews.author: Sonia Rehmani
reviews.text: This is your go-to place for desi food. Must try. Mutton soup is complimentary and amazing. The bar b.q and fish is also perfect. Must visit. There's a separate family room for kids to eat in harmony and let others eat too.

reviews.author: Rafah
reviews.text: I wasn’t thrilled by the food, and was surprised to know that this is the most well know Afghani restaurant in Doha, since the food didn’t seem like it. First, they serve a spicy soup, which I liked. We ordered Foul, Moutabel (an eggplant dip), and Boukhari Rice. The Moutabel was delicious, zero mistakes. However, the rice and Foul didn’t meet my expectations. They lacked the punch of flavor. For dessert, we got these deep fried balls dipped in a sugar syrup. It tasted unfresh, I highly don’t recommend them. Aside from that, the staff are nice and respond very quickly, and the food is severed quite fast. The atmosphere is so classic for an Afghani restaurant.

reviews.author: abu ebaad
reviews.text: Good ambiance with floored seating and retro feel is quite great. Complimentary soup was just wow. We ordered Mutton mandi and barbecue chicken with bukhari rice. Mixplatter and appetisers . Platter was good but there are better options available. And main course felt a bit heavy later on. Overall its good, i will try other branches of afghan brothers for comparison.

reviews.author: Souma Souma
reviews.text: Very nice experience, reasonable prices and good quality food

reviews.author: Waleed Bayyari
reviews.text: Traditional restaurant if you fancy the traditional on the floor seating arrangement with one of the best traditional Rice dishes in town! To me its one of my favorite spots! Their Mandi is always on point! - Their Goat Mandi 👌🏼 - Chicken Mandi 👌🏼 - they have the Soup they serve before anythi g & its a nice warm up before the feast! - their Daqoos mix (tomato parsley & other ingreients salsa mix for the roce) is really good with the rice This place never disappoints & always recommended 👌🏼👌🏼

reviews.text: This place has always been seen as closed, I don't know what is there that is always kept closed, although it would be great if it was opened to the general public.It looks beautiful from a distance but up close it seems like a secret place.

reviews.author: Asmaa mrose
reviews.text: Amazing stunning view in the magrib on sunset time. The air is so clean .There is a restaurant and coffee tea shop open also the place is great to organize a wedding party , the view and location is perfect for family and friends. They close early in the night but the place is well worth it. Highly recommended it.

reviews.author: Ali Mujalli
reviews.text: Amazing views day and night . We visited this place several times whenever we come to Abha. It has restaurants, toy shop, perfumes shop. It also has an elevator that takes you to upper floors. You can enjoy a cup of coffee in the beautiful weather and cool breeze at this time of the year

reviews.author: Hibha Moosa
reviews.text: One of the nearest uphill scenic view from Abha town. It only opens at 2 in the noon, the top floor consists of some amazing view. One can surely enjoy the climate from here, carry a jacket if you are planning to stay long. Th green mountain has an entrance ticket of 20 riyal which could be redeemed at any restaurants. The top cabin is also rented, 20/- riyal per hour, but the waitor was kind enough to extend our period as there were no other customers waiting in line. Its lovely to have some hot drinks from there but make sure to drink quickly as it will get cold. It also has 🚡 cable car service, we walked down the hill to exit and it was another cool experience.

reviews.author: Yong-khiam Cheng
reviews.text: NOZOMI Khobar offers an exceptional dining experience. The quiet, charming ambiance immediately sets a sophisticated tone, perfect for a relaxed evening. Overlooking the serene sea, the restaurant provides a beautiful view that enhances the overall atmosphere. Beyond the delightful setting, the food truly shines. Each dish is meticulously prepared, offering a fusion of Japanese cuisine with modern flair that is both delicious and visually appealing.

reviews.author: Mehmood Chaboi
reviews.text: Exceptional Japanese Fine Dining at Nozomi I had an incredible dining experience here, truly one of the finest spots for Japanese cuisine in the region. The ambiance is cozy and elegant, creating the perfect setting for a relaxing evening. The staff were attentive, courteous, and made sure every detail was taken care of. What really stood out was the live cooking section, which added a dynamic and interactive element to the experience. Watching the chefs prepare dishes with precision and artistry made it all the more enjoyable. The food was absolutely top-tier beautifully presented, rich in flavor, and authentic. From starters to the desserts, everything was crafted with care and finesse. Hats off to the chef. Highly recommend Nozomi for anyone looking to enjoy a sophisticated and memorable Japanese dining experience in Al Khobar.

reviews.author: Sana Esam
reviews.text: If you are looking for a fine dining experience with an amazing view this place is for you!! The food is exceptional however when comparing the price to the quantity of makis, you kind of question it. The only reason why I gave it a 4 star is because of the their pricing as I personally value quantity over view etc. Otherwise, customer service, the location and the view all are amazing. Thank you Nozomi for the experience!

reviews.author: Arshad Nusra
reviews.text: Authentic Japanese Cuisine with a Stunning Ambience! 🍣✨ I had a wonderful dining experience at NOZOMi ! The sushi was incredibly fresh, expertly prepared, and full of flavor. The ambience was truly amazing—elegant, peaceful, and perfect for a relaxing meal. The attention to detail in both the food and decor made the experience even more special. However, it is on the expensive side, so be prepared for a premium dining experience. That said, the quality of the food and service makes it worth it for a special occasion or a treat-yourself moment. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommended if you’re looking for authentic Japanese flavors in a beautiful setting!

reviews.author: Abdul Rehman Zaheer
reviews.text: “Your wallet might cry, but your taste buds will thank you.” When the menu claims “authentic Japanese.” More often than not, I find myself quietly folding a napkin in disappointment. But Nozomi.... it surprised me. Recently visited Nozomi with friends, and let me just say.... this place doesn't whisper sophistication, it shouts it in perfectly tuned harmony. The ambience? As precise as a sashimi slice. Thoughtfully curated, softly lit, and immaculately clean. No unnecessary theatrics. Just subtle elegance that whispers, “you’re in good hands.” It feels less like a restaurant and more like a calm retreat… the kind where even your chopsticks know to behave. Nozomi delivers authentic Japanese cuisine in an atmosphere so chic, you start wondering if you accidentally walked onto the set of a high-budget culinary film. The décor is an experience in itself... tasteful, minimal, with just enough drama to make you lean in and take it all in. Easily one of the most well-curated spaces I’ve seen locally. Now to the food: and yes, it lives up to the setting. Chan San” Maki rolls... beautifully plated, balanced, and bursting with delicate flavor. The tempura shrimp was light, crisp, and guiltlessly addictive. The braised beefsteak? Fall-apart tender and rich with depth, like it had a philosophy degree. Service? Efficient, polite, and beautifully invisible.... as it should be. Yes, it’s on the expensive side, so don’t walk in expecting a casual lunch. But for a special occasion, a business dinner, or a “treat yourself because you deserve it” moment: Nozomi is an excellent choice. Think of it less as a meal and more as an experience. But quality and craftsmanship are not for discount aisles. Nozomi isn’t where you go to casually chew! it’s where you go to reflect, savor, and remember what proper Japanese cuisine can taste like when done with discipline. Final Verdict: Worth every riyal when the moment calls for something exceptional.

reviews.author: Syed Ali Anwer Kazmi
reviews.text: Amazing lunch experience! The set menu had an incredible variety - delicious main course, 3 types of fresh salads, 2 delicious soups, and drinks. But the highlight was the refill option - loved that I could go back for more! And the cherry on top was the Chocolate Lava Cake - WOW! It was hands down the best I've ever had. Rich, gooey, and utterly divine. The service was great, too. Highly recommend this place for lunch!"

reviews.author: Osama Mohsen
reviews.text: We had our Eid dine-in at Outback and it was amazing experience. The staff are helpful and friendly. The place is warm and welcoming. Lighting in the patio needs some improvement tho. The food is great although portion sizes are a bit smaller than expected. The prices are on the high range but very comparable with similar restaurants. I would recommend the Pepper Brisket, but not the Sirloin.

reviews.author: Aliw Carter Elamparo
reviews.text: Went during Saudi Founding Day 2025 with the promotion. Loved the place, spacious with 2nd floor and Elevator. Perfect ambiance for family and friends. Good food and drinks. Can ask additional bread appetizer which is soft and tasty. Worth the price. Plenty of parking slots.

reviews.author: Mariam
reviews.text: It was a very nice experience and I will repeat it again. I give this restaurant 10/10. The service was very wonderful, especially with the employee Nano. The food dishes were big, worth their price, and very delicious. I was not disappointed. Thank you and I will definitely come again. 👍🏻👍🏻 ❤️Al-Khobar

reviews.author: Seham Altayeb
reviews.text: My dining experience was truly exceptional, thanks to the outstanding service by waiter *Mathun Paswan*. He was highly professional, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect. The restaurant itself offers a refined atmosphere and delicious food of top quality. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Hamzazu N
reviews.text: Excellent food selections in addition to good service. Prices are on the high side but definitely worth it. Highly recommended. One problem, only one toilet per gender, even though the restaurant is very large and gets crowded some times.

reviews.author: Froilan Antonio Bacungan
reviews.text: Lunch menu is a great deal but highlight was brother Siraj who was very proactive and accommodating, truly served with heart. Thanks for the experience, we’ll be back for sure.

reviews.author: Farha Mohammad Rabbanne
reviews.text: Piatto Soup & Salad Bar – Totally Worth It! So I finally tried the soup and salad bar at Piatto, and honestly? Loved it. Super fresh, tons of variety, and everything tasted homemade in the best way. The salad options were way more than just lettuce and tomatoes, they had roasted veggies, pasta salads, cheeses, olives, all the good stuff. You can definitely build a solid, satisfying plate. The soups? Next level. I tried the creamy tomato and the mushroom one both were warm, cozy, and full of flavor. Like, I’d go back just for those. If you’re trying to eat a little lighter or just want a chill starter before your main, the soup and salad bar at Piatto totally delivers. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.author: Raphael Pallaud
reviews.text: Nice, welcoming, spacious, well-lit, super-clean, well maintained. Food is plentiful (salad bar) and varied. Prices are gentle to the wallet. Service is great. Our amazing waiter was Mr John from Kenya, who took great care of us. We look forward to meeting him again. On the slightly negative side, we found the gelato portions diminishing in size and some of the gelato types being unlabelled (something incidental I hope). Overall, a great experience. Update: we came back! Food is still great! Piatto is really consistent in terms of quality... Our amazing waiter was Mr Kelvin, great service!

reviews.author: Karim Omar
reviews.text: ⚠️⚠️⚠️ I’m a loyal Piatto customer and love their diverse menu, but for the second time at the Al Khobar branch, I encountered a food issue, this time with the kids’ Mini Cheese Burger (beef). Due to the seriousness of the matter, I’ve escalated the issue with photos to the Ministry of Commerce. I hope the restaurant takes this seriously, especially as it concerns children’s meals.

reviews.text: We visited on October 31st - clearly the entire city was quiet and most places were closed. This one was open - so we took a chance. But it surprised us by the fresh food, excellently done, and with authentic local taste. The roti was awesome!!

reviews.author: WY M
reviews.text: Best restaurant in Al Ula. You want local cuisine authenticity then dine here. Plus this is where they take tour groups so you know it got to be good.

reviews.author: Robyn Huang
reviews.text: We had a great breakfast here - several large dishes with bread at 55 SAR. We sat in the family section which has closed off rooms and it’s own bathroom. Manager on-site is Sudanese and speaks a bit of English. He helped us to order fava bean stew, a date pancake, banana honey mash and a few scrambles with bread. Everything tasted absolutely delicious and flavourful. It was a wonderful meal.

reviews.text: Poor service (unless you go and find the guy by yourself none will appear) Quite fine but dry food (looks better then it is) Cleanness of the place definitely has to be improved. You don't feel comfortable as well, bad furniture and seems very old and cheap Small choice if food Stuff is not speaking english Mistakes in the order were done even if you point in the menu what you want

reviews.author: Cláudio Cardoso
reviews.text: The place is ok. Some food highlights, with a mix of local and Lebanese, but missing the comfort and a proper layout that is easy to seat and enjoy a meal. Service is ok, but needs to be more attentive and logical when serving in quieter periods. One of the slightly above average spots in town.

reviews.author: Khalid Chaudary
reviews.text: Great food and fantastic service! Restaurant folks speak good English. Ordered local foods off the menu which included Hummus, Chicken kebabs, and a dish whose name escapes me right now. Also, ordered Arabic tea with the food. Everything was delicious!!! Food arrived fresh, hot full of flavor. Since we were in a hurry - the management made a priority to get our food out on time. Definitely check out this place.

reviews.author: Claire Johnson
reviews.text: We dined here for lunch after an Old Town tour. Not a lot was open but they opened at 1P. There is a lot of outdoor seating but we were fortunate to sit inside in the majilis sitting from which is very limited seating. The service was very friendly and attentive. We ordered the Muntakhab Salad, Mutabbaq with Meat and Mixed Grill. Everything was nice and fresh and spiced perfectly. I’d definitely return to dine there in the evening in their extensive and beautiful patio seating.

reviews.author: John Paul Tuquib
reviews.text: This restaurant found inside the Old Town Clean, tidy and well organized restaurant. The ambiance is cool and cozy. The pricey is a little bit expensive The food is delicious and yummy Staff's are much accommodating and helpful.

reviews.author: Healani Norman
reviews.text: As this is one of the restaurants that is open year around, we actually visit relatively frequently so I'm surprised I haven't reviewed it before. We love the lamb the most but they also have a very lovely mixed plate that is delicious! Each plate comes with thick cut fries. Unfortunately, we usually go with friends and they order most of the food so I don't know the name of the cheesy bread we specifically like, especially because last time we went, I pantomimed what it was to the gent who was helping us, and he understood. You can see them making it at the very back of the outside part of the kitchen, throwing it against the heated stone and then peeling it off. I really wish I had a video of it! Otherwise every drink we've had here has been exceptionally fresh, I always order the pomegranate juice. I'm also not usually a fan of falafel, but I do enjoy it here. They also have your general starters of hummus, moutabal, etc. I have never sat in the indoor dining, although they look very cute but the seating outside is absolutely gorgeous. You're also able to order Shisha for the table, although we haven't done it yet. Great place for large parties as the tables are huge and the seating is perfect.

name: Chef Jason Atherton’s at Maraya
address: Chef Jason Atherton’s at Maraya, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Ian Hastings
reviews.text: If you visit Al Ula you should visit Maraya. As with most things in Al Ula you will need to book online. It costs SAR 275 per person, but that includes entry and comes off your food bill. When you turn off the main road to access Maraya you will Come to a security barrier they will check your QR code (get from booking). You will then travel about 4-5 kms along a very good and wide tarmac road. Views are spectacular as you drive along. As you come over the ridge, you will see Maraya - an impressive building. The car part is down the hill on your right (opposite the building). Park up and walk across the road. We went at sunset and the views and colours were spectacular. When you enter the building they will check your QR code again then you will go in a lift to the 3rd floor to the restaurant. You will have a choice of dining in or outside. You can also access the roof top for sunset which offers amazing views. The food is delicious and not that expensive. I would say that the table service is inadequate for the establishment. Amazing building and food but poor table service. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Frank Sanders
reviews.text: It boggles my mind, trying to understand how a building this impressive is built. Sure, you could chalk it up to just being a bunch of mirrors in the desert but when you first see it, your mind doesn’t quite comprehend what you’re looking at. When my car crossed the hill, I didn’t even Realize it was right in front of me. The building is insanely beautiful. I recommend going between 11 AM and 1 PM so the sun is nearly directly on top to minimize the amount of shadow at the base of the building. Also a tip on buying tickets, if there was a Guided tour (which the tickets say there are) I didn’t see any Guide or any group, which I didn’t want anyways. I simply wanted to walk around the building. Also, you have an option for (DMC) tickets or regular. There doesn’t appear to be a difference whatsoever, including the price so I just went with the regular. A guy at the entrance to the complex just looked at my ticket and let me in. Don’t overthink it.

reviews.author: Vizmary Montes
reviews.text: Maraya is a truly stunning venue — the mirrored building in the middle of the desert is breathtaking and absolutely worth seeing. However, the overall experience could be better. There is almost no customer service on site, the internet connection is very poor (which is frustrating if you need to work or share your visit), and the prices are quite high for what is provided. The concept and architecture are impressive, but the visitor experience does not match the potential of the place.

reviews.author: Chris Cafuir
reviews.text: The place was incredible but the staff were not accommodating. They did not greet us and entertain us immediately. Our tour guide was friendly and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Syed Tariq Anwar
reviews.text: Visited the iconic Maraya Concert Hall in AlUla — the world’s largest mirrored building — and it was absolutely breathtaking. The way it reflects the desert landscape and sandstone mountains is surreal. A masterpiece of design, right in the heart of ancient beauty. Modern, magical, and unforgettable.

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.text: Friendly and helpful manager, speaks English. If you want to try a local experience with great value, try this. I would eat here again. The chicken is very juicy and flavourful.

reviews.author: Haitham Eltawiel
reviews.text: In the middle of Alaziziyah area in Alula Traditional restaurant with very basic appearance Staff are very good and kind I visited 2 times Actually, it’s very basic and don’t expect something high Maklouba is under the standard in most of restaurants Cleanliness is very bad I think enough for me to visit 2 times and the review was after the second time

reviews.author: Juan Carlos
reviews.text: Excellent choice for a “local” meal in AlUla! A modest restaurant with a very friendly owner and staff and very, very delicious food!!! Prices are super low. We tried the grilled chicken and it was fantastic!!!

reviews.author: Davood sait
reviews.text: Since 2008, when I joined the Al-Ula Airport project, I have always visited this restaurant. Whether the management has changed or stayed the same, I’m not sure. After a long time, I recently visited again, and I could taste the authentic Arabian food here, which brought back nostalgic memories of the old days in Al-Ula. Al-Ula has developed, but this restaurant is still there, maintaining its benchmark.

reviews.author: Lizy
reviews.text: Great restaurant in Alula Souq. Delicious chicken, friendly and helpful staff(the guy who cleans and brings the order is fantastic), and excellent prices. If you want a local experience away from the fuzz of the Old Town, that’s the place to be! A note for foreign guests who will find themselves in front of a closed door but see people inside, it might be due to prayer time. A common thing in Saudi is encountering shops and restaurants close for 20 minutes or so during this time.

name: Entrecôte Café de Paris
address: Entrecôte Café de Paris, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: KeepTheYellow
reviews.text: I had an Amazing experience here, the food was spectacular esp the melted butter sauce which they serve with the steak. Gerald my waiter was brilliant.! I hope to come back in the near future

reviews.author: Ahmed Al-Akki
reviews.text: An amazing restaurant if you like meat. I had lunch here with my daughter and her husband. The food and service were superb. The restaurant is a little bit on the expensive side, but it’s worth a try.

reviews.author: Ali Alkhateeb
reviews.text: Despite the high price of the fine stake, it is worth to try!. Very juicy & tender entrecote stakes. Great vibe & service. Not recommended for family with kids

reviews.author: Marc Ajami
reviews.text: Amazing experience. A little fast-paced due to the nature of the food but enjoyed it overall. From the refreshing salad, to the fresh bread, to the amazing steak and fries, to finish it off with their crème brûlée. A little on the higher side in terms of prices but for the meat quality you’re getting, it’s worth it. We had one black angus and one Australian tenderloin. The first was better as expected.

reviews.author: Beyouty LA.arabia
reviews.text: All staff friendly their desert so tasty, enjoyed dinner with amazing view...

name: Fresh House
address: Fresh House, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Marc mjp
reviews.text: Delicious food, amazing service and reasonable price. The best food experience I've had in Al Ula by far!!

reviews.author: Haitham Eltawiel
reviews.text: Good location in Alula old town Wonderful decoration reflecting the old traditional Saudi style Service and staff are amazing and helpful They explained how to make a good order as per your preferences Food is amazing and delicious Cost is very affordable We will visit again during our stay in Alula for sure

reviews.author: Alia Kalkattawi
reviews.text: Amazing food, Sajad was very nice and helpful, would visit again for sure.

reviews.author: Manpreet Kandola
reviews.text: Nice to have some healthy clean food. Lots of great quick options. Gluten-free options were plentiful. The bowls were very good and the gluten-free desserts were amazing.

reviews.author: Ghdeer
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive and The food was absolutely delicious and healthy I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a healthy, tasty meal with a gorgeous view

name: Harrat at Banyan Tree
address: Harrat at Banyan Tree, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Jean-Hugues Weber
reviews.text: Really really good. A place to book again! Stayed in a villa with pool , very comfortable, modern, clean. Spa is very qualitative. Infinity pool between the rocks is the place to enjoy... The surroundings are magnificent, even if you're in the middle of nowhere and 15km from the old town. Restaurants are fine, Quality of food is good. Service at the restaurants is good but not perfect (butter melts totally within 3 minutes outside, because served with no ice).

reviews.author: chiung ti feng
reviews.text: The room was absolutely stunning! The rock pool was amazing and breakfast was incredibly delicious. Every single staff member we met was exceptional – friendly, professional, and welcoming. We also tried the spa and it was incredibly relaxing. Special thanks to Nanni at the spa – she did an amazing job! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Abdulrahman Moh
reviews.text: One of the best holiday destinations I've ever experienced. From the exceptional service to the breathtaking views and the refreshing, healthy atmosphere, this place offers the perfect environment for relaxation and peace of mind. Every detail reflects quality and care. Highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind in a beautiful and serene setting!

reviews.author: 선우승연
reviews.text: We stayed at Ashar resort,. The resort was really one of the most beautiful desert resort with surrounded its amazing rocks and brilliant golden sands. Amazing nature with giant rocks!!! I also passed by Maraya Concert Hall every day, which was like a mirage in the desert. we extended our stay for another day (total 5 days). Especially, the breakfast was so delicious and made us happy every morning. We greeted and talked with Chef Mostafa, and it seemed like he cooked with love. The noodles on the last day were his grateful gift and we were very touched. Mostafa.!!! Thank you. You made us happy. We have a reason to come back to Ashar. Thank you again. ♡♡♡

reviews.author: Mariateresa Licata
reviews.text: We had a truly wonderful stay and felt incredibly well taken care of throughout. Everything was perfect — from the villa to the service — and our time in AlUla will remain a cherished memory. Both restaurants serve excellent food - the Saffron with Thai food and the Harrat, with Arabic food. We also could experience the SPA and the fully equipped gym. Our stying in the two best villa with the private pool was amazing: very relaxing and luxury staying. We hope to return one day and will certainly recommend Banyan Tree AlUla to our friends and family. The entire team at Banyan Tree AlUla is very professional, expecially we had been supported from Francesca, at Giest relations and Dhaher, at Concierge, who had been great in supporting us planning the trip in every detail and then making every happen has it was planned :)

name: Heart of the Oasis
address: Heart of the Oasis, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Paolo
reviews.text: The food is good, as it is the service. The menu is practically based on Italian dishes, though all of them are slightly customised. The location and the atmosphere are particularly nice, as the entire restaurant is situated in an old area next to an oasis. The small houses around it are extremely characteristic. Just be aware that during winter in the evening it is slightly cold (even though there are heaters).

reviews.author: Cláudio Cardoso
reviews.text: The place is stunning, in a really beautiful setting. Food is ok, just the amount of flies are so horrible that ruins the experience. There are cleanliness details missing, but the beauty of the place makes it up for everything else. They need to resolve the flies problem.

reviews.author: Chris Van Cammeren
reviews.text: We are visiting Saudi for the first time ! What a great experience! Staying for a few days in Al’Ula we scouted the internet for nice restaurants! This lead us to have diner in Heart of Oasis. This is a wonderful location with a great atmosphere! The service is superb. The restaurant has an Italian flair which is one of our favorite cuisines! Unfortunately the food is not in par with the location! Quality of the products is good but it really misses that right Italian twist…

reviews.author: Marc Ajami
reviews.text: Flawless experience. From the reception and service, the new concept and vibes, to the speciality dishes and items. The deboned chicken was possibly the best chicken I’ve ever had. Their homemade dough made the Bombe (Bresaola and Parmesan) taste so good. Beef carpaccio was on point. Pumpkin truffle ravioli, make no mistake. Finish it up with their fresh Tiramisu. 5/5.

reviews.author: Mary М
reviews.text: Hello! It is a very cozy place, strongly recommend to visit it. Food is delicious, we ordered crazy salad, beef tenderloin, and mashed potatoes. Everything was very tasty. We were surprised by combination of ingredients in crazy salad, it was harmonic and has its interesting sense. The service is quick, restaurant team is very polite and friendly. Relatively remote location, authentic ambience and pleasant music make atmosphere relaxing, romantic and cozy - it is just pleasant to stay there and have a nice discussion with companion(s). Price is reasonable. Overall, definitely worth a visit, you will enjoy that experience. Thank you and have a great time in Al’Ula :)

name: Joontos at Dar Tantora
address: Joontos at Dar Tantora, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Josh .E
reviews.text: One of the top dinner experiences my wife and I have had. The food was amazing, every bite was climactic, really enjoyed the beef sambusa specifically, the ambience and vibe was top notch. The service was outstanding, the two Nigerian waiters made our night! Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Gilda Di giacomo
reviews.text: An Unforgettable Culinary Experience in AlUla The food here is nothing short of exceptional. From the very first bite, every dish impressed — especially the Mozzarella with cherry tomatoes and the homemade bread with butter, which was simply delightful. The Batata Harra stood out with its bold flavors, and the chickpea salad paired perfectly with the tender, flavorful tenderloin — both are absolute must-tries. What truly elevated the experience was the warm hospitality. The service was attentive and welcoming, and having the chef personally visit our table to check on the meal and share the story behind the food and the hotel’s concept was a rare and thoughtful touch. His explanation of the use of locally sourced ingredients added depth to the experience.

reviews.author: Amal Aldrees
reviews.text: This breakfast spot is a must-visit for anyone craving a flavorful start to the day. The menu features a delightful mix of sweet and salty options. The cozy atmosphere and friendly service only add to the overall charm, making it an ideal place to enjoy a delicious, satisfying breakfast.

reviews.author: Maurizio Muratore
reviews.text: Tucked within the atmospheric setting of the Old Town of AlUla, Joontos offers a dining experience that beautifully bridges heritage and innovation. The ambiance is both intimate and elegant, with the restaurant blending traditional Najdi architecture and modern touches. Candlelight and earthy textures enhance the charm, creating a serene and memorable setting, especially in the evening. The menu is a tribute to local ingredients and flavors. Expect reimagined Saudi cuisine, where each dish pays homage to tradition while embracing creativity. Delicious! Service is warm, knowledgeable, and attentive without being intrusive. Rating: 5/5

reviews.author: Ahmed Al-Akki
reviews.text: My wife and I had dinner at this restaurant. We didn’t like the taste of the fusion style food that much. In addition, the temperature of the main courses wasn’t hot enough. We didn’t like the atmosphere that much either as all around us there were staff doing all sorts of cleaning. The restaurant is also cramped. For the price we paid to eat there, we would expect something much better.

name: Local Oasis Café
address: Local Oasis Café, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

name: Maraya Social
address: Maraya Social, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: KiKi Navarro
reviews.text: Truly Exceptional Dining Experience! I had a fantastic experience at Maraya Social! From the moment i walk in, the atmosphere was warm, inviting, and beautifully designed! The service was top- notch ; the staff were attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was just right throughout the evening! The food was absolutely delicious - each dish was full of flavor, beautifully presented, and cleary made with high quality ingredients. You can tell the chefs take pride in what they do. Whether you're coming for a special occasion or just a great meal out, this place hits all the marks! Highly recommended- I'll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Bishal Basnet
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience. I recommend you to visit, little experience but worth it. You need to have a reservation and will cost 275 SAR/PP but that goes towards your bill and it is non refundable so you have to order food of that worth or more. Hospitality service was very poor. There was no one to welcome you to the restaurant. The waiter missed our drink order. Food were coming in random order, i mean mains followed by starters some have not got their drinks half way through main course. Absolutely terrible service for a 5 star restaurant. Even there was no one at the end to thank you and say goodbye. Terrible customer service.

reviews.author: Julia K.
reviews.text: Come dine here when you’re visiting Maraya! Located at the top of the building, the restaurant has a beautiful interior and exterior design, creating a cool atmosphere. The food was delicious and beautifully presented. The service was great. Everyone was very kind and attentive (shout out to Mr. Sabbir and team).

reviews.author: karlos sevilla
reviews.text: Maraya Social in AlUla is one of the most unique and breathtaking dining experiences I’ve ever had. From the panoramic views on top of the mirrored concert hall to the exceptional dishes, everything was flawless. The roasted seabass with spinach veloute and cauliflower risotto were incredible, and the service was world-class. A must-visit if you’re in AlUla!

reviews.author: Cheryl Chambers.
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived, we were treated like VIPs. Great attention to detail, with waiters over hearing conversations that lead to utensils, drinks and kind gestures being made without asking. Food was flavoursome, the drinks were refreshing. The staff can’t help enough. As for the view from the top of the Maraya, it is phenomenal. Thank you.

name: Oasis Grill
address: Oasis Grill, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

name: Pink Camel Pastry Boutique
address: Pink Camel Pastry Boutique, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: waleed kh
reviews.text: The place is beautiful, located in one of the old houses overlooking a farm. I think it would be wonderful during the winter and spring seasons. The menu is simple and the food is great. I believe if the breakfast options were more varied, it would be amazing.

reviews.author: Mark Teitelbaum
reviews.text: An outstanding breakfast and lunch location in Al Ula, located steps away from the Oasis running through the Old City. I visited several times with a travel friend and we consistently tried, and enjoyed, the range of items on the menu. The restaurant offers a separate coffee bar and seating both by the oasis trail and upstairs. Every meal we had was outstanding. In particular, try the Shakshuka and the roast carrots

reviews.author: Ahmed Al-Akki
reviews.text: We had breakfast at this amazing place. We sat in the garden seating area at the back of the restaurant. This area has a great view of the oasis. The food and service were excellent. It is a little bit on the expensive side, but the taste and quality of the food is outstanding.

reviews.author: Ahmed Hozayen
reviews.text: We had a breakfast in this amazing place with a beautiful view 😍 the food is tasty and delicious 😋 the vibes and staff are very helpful 👌

reviews.author: Chloe Brentnall
reviews.text: My favourite place to dine for lunch in AlUla. The food is absolutely gorgeous, service is excellent and the location is stunning. I would highly recommend this place for breakfast, lunch and dinner!

reviews.author: Essam Althobaiti
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Somewhere! The food was out of this world — every bite was a burst of flavor and beautifully presented! Delicious doesn’t even begin to describe it! The staff were incredibly polite, warm, and professional, making the whole experience even more pleasant. What truly took things to the next level was the outside dining area — the view is simply wonderful, and the gardening upgrade transformed the atmosphere into something exotic and serene. It’s like dining in a hidden paradise — peaceful, green, and full of charm. Highly recommended! Will definitely come back again! 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great food, great people, and a magical setting! Thumbs up to the management for elevating this place! Keep it up! 👍🏼🌿🍽️

reviews.author: mano0o1989 “Eman alshammari”
reviews.text: Samoir Restaurant is one of the most important restaurants that must be visited. The place is wonderful to the extreme and overlooks a farm that is relaxing for the soul. We enjoyed walking in it and wandering around it. The vibes of the place are amazing and relaxing for the soul. The sound of the water, trees and plants around you, the cleanliness of the place, the hospitality of the hosts and the deliciousness of the food. Everything was exceptional and wonderful. Samoir is a destination that must be visited in the old town.

reviews.author: Julia K.
reviews.text: This restaurant is truly a gem and a must-visit in Al Ula! Locals highly recommended it as the best in town, and I can see why. The highlight for me was the stunning design and decor. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated, from the elegant pillows and sofas to the charming umbrellas, pool, and beautifully arranged outdoor seating. Additionally, the service was outstanding. The staff were extremely kind and attentive, and were very careful with my allergy. The food was delicious and impressively quick to arrive. I highly recommend visiting during daylight hours to fully appreciate the gorgeous setting.

reviews.author: Ahmed Abdullah
reviews.text: Somewhere is the kind of restaurant that effortlessly captures the essence of a truly exceptional dining experience. From the moment you step inside, you’re welcomed by an atmosphere that feels both chic and relaxed, with elegant decor and thoughtful touches that make it the perfect setting for any occasion. The ambiance strikes the perfect balance—modern yet cozy, refined yet unpretentious. The staff at Somewhere are an absolute highlight. Their service is impeccable: attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable without being intrusive. Whether it’s helping you choose the perfect wine pairing or offering a suggestion from the menu, they go out of their way to make you feel special and well taken care of. As for the food, it’s nothing short of extraordinary. Every dish is a testament to the chef’s skill and passion for creating flavorful, beautifully presented plates. From the delicate appetizers to the rich main courses, each bite feels like a celebration of fresh, high-quality ingredients. The flavors are bold yet balanced, with inventive twists on classic dishes that surprise and delight. The desserts, of course, are just as impressive—decadent yet light, leaving you with a lasting impression of the entire meal. What truly sets Somewhere apart is how effortlessly it blends all these elements together—outstanding food, top-notch service, and a stunning ambiance—into a seamless, unforgettable experience. It’s a place where every detail is carefully considered, and it shows in the perfect harmony of the meal and atmosphere. If you're looking for a restaurant that feels special, Somewhere is the perfect destination for an exceptional dining experience. It’s not just a meal; it’s an experience you’ll cherish and remember

reviews.author: Jonathan Urmeneta
reviews.text: Our experience at Somewhere Al Ula was a mix of highs and lows. From the start, the hostess made us feel very welcome, setting a positive tone for the evening. The ambiance is undoubtedly one of the restaurant’s strong points—beautiful design, well-thought-out decor, and a stunning pool area that seamlessly blends with the surroundings. However, when it came to the food, we were left a bit underwhelmed. The menu felt somewhat limited, and while we tried different dishes, they lacked depth in flavor. The portions were also quite small considering the premium pricing. Service was another aspect that didn’t quite meet expectations. While some staff members were attentive (offering us blankets, for example), the overall service felt robotic and impersonal, missing the warmth that can elevate a dining experience. Overall, Somewhere has a great setting and potential, but the food and service need refinement to truly match the ambiance.

name: Street Shawarma Stall
address: Street Shawarma Stall, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

name: Suhail Restaurant
address: Suhail Restaurant, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Camillo D.
reviews.text: Mashallah! This is the first time I had the chance to eat Saudi Fine dining, and the experience was amazing. The taste of the food was unique, the sauce added a tasty flavor to the shrimp and chicken dishes. The prices are steep, but it is definitely worth it.

reviews.author: Dorette Roos // Electric Cello
reviews.text: Our BEST food experience in AlUla!! The food was really beautifully presented and delicious. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable. The dessert was incredible. Lovely authentic feel! I definitely recommend it!

reviews.author: Dal al
reviews.text: If you want to try a real authentic local food this is the best place. Although it a bit pricey, but each dish is enough for 2 persons to share. We try the chicken saleeq, hail tumman (main dish)and hail kubaiba (appetizer). The outdoor seating and atmosphere is perfect.

reviews.author: Sai
reviews.text: Lovely place in the heart of Old Town. Could add a bit more flavor to the chicken but the meat (لحم) was amazingly tender. Good view if you sit on the first floor

reviews.author: Noufachian
reviews.text: The view was amazing,They’ve a very delicious traditional food menu, overpriced beside the size of the dishes, Service was perfect. Highly recommended

name: Tetra Pizza
address: Tetra Pizza, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Hashim AbdulLateef
reviews.text: Recently dined at Tetra Pizza, and it was a delightful experience. The pizza was delicious, with a perfect balance of crispy crust and flavorful toppings. The menu offers a great variety, catering to different tastes and preferences. I ordered for the BBQ option. The ambiance of the restaurant is cozy and inviting, making it a pleasant place to enjoy a meal with friends or family. The staff were friendly and attentive, ensuring a great dining experience. Overall, Tetra Pizza is a fantastic spot for pizza lovers and I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Ohod Baninassr
reviews.text: I ordered three pizzas from this restaurant, and unfortunately, all of them arrived with undercooked dough. The pizzas were inedible and had to be thrown away. Not recommended at all!

reviews.author: Amdjed Islam DALI
reviews.text: Tetra Pizza recently changed locations, but the quality remains top-notch! I've enjoyed their pizza across different branches, and it's always been delicious. Highly recommend for anyone looking for great pizza with consistent taste and friendly service.

reviews.author: Mohammed Alhusayni
reviews.text: The best pizza in alula , they have half and half pizza but it is not in the menu , and they have thick and thin pizza if you order big or small size of pizza , also it is not in the menu , you can eat inside, the restaurant is clean also the bathrooms, the orders don’t be late as past

reviews.author: Henry
reviews.text: Now, I am very qurious about rank score here.. How come 4/5.. I didn't satisfy everything. My favorite was just coke.. wish you fix it

reviews.author: Patrick Angehrn
reviews.text: The restaurant has a lovely atmosphere and the staff were friendly and welcoming. The food was okay – I’ve had much better Chicken Kabsa elsewhere, but it was still decent. Overall, the price-performance ratio was fair, though not exceptional. A pleasant experience, but there’s room for improvement when it comes to the food.

reviews.author: Edgardo Marrero
reviews.text: We had the the most beautiful and delicious Iftar dinner outdoors. The service and the attention to detail was impeccable. The staff was very accommodating and explained every dish that was served. So happy we came during Ramadan to take advantage of this unique experience! Congratulations to all the staff for a job well done. Mr. Edgardo Marrero

reviews.author: Julia K.
reviews.text: Several locals recommended this restaurant for dinner, and it absolutely lived up to the hype! In the heart of the old town, Tofriyah offers stunning views of historic buildings and surrounding mountains, creating a charming and picturesque atmosphere. The music added to the cozy ambiance, and the service was great. They paid attention to every detail, including the calligraphy on the cutlery. Everything was delicious, and there were many vegetarian options. The prices were incredibly reasonable.

reviews.author: tcp03
reviews.text: This is the best place in the old town by far. The food and atmosphere cannot be beat. You should def consider the orange rice with chicken. It was amazing. Also Mohammad Ghazy was outstanding. His professionalism and ability to interact with guests and make them feel home is unmatched. He truly made the visit wonderful. I cannot wait to come back. I give this place and Mohammad’s service my highest possible recommendation.

reviews.author: Kri K
reviews.text: Good prices and lovely food. We had the Red Jareesh which was to die for! (My boyfriend initially said he doesn't like Jareesh, but even he LOVED it here). Mohammad, who works there, was super friendly and full of smiles which made the place even better. We wish him all the best in Saudi. Kind regards Kristine from Denmark

name: Villa Fayrouz
address: Villa Fayrouz, Al Ula, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Dr. Muhammad Hassaan Amjad
reviews.text: It's a good Lebanese restaurant with the most outstanding feature being its location. The food is average, typical Lebanese taste with a very okay-ish presentation. We tried their meat fatteh, chicken and sauteed potatoes. All of which were just average. Staff is good but they don't really help you out with the menu especially with the serving size. We were served by Saabir who was courteous and pointed out their highlights but skipped the portion size and we ended up ordering so much extra food. Otherwise the ambiance is very enjoyable especially in good weather with a great view particularly if there's a full moon.

reviews.author: Gokul S
reviews.text: Don’t understand the low rating- this resto was great! food was delicious. Mohsin who waited on us was delightful and kind. Recommend!

reviews.author: Ahmed Al-Akki
reviews.text: Lunch was very delicious, our waiter was amazing and the atmosphere was great. There is a small section in the restaurant that used to be a Quran teaching room. You can see many inscriptions on the room’s walls.

reviews.author: Simon Shaw
reviews.text: Great food and service… it was quiet but the staff were attentive and the food delicious… Mohsin was a star waiter…

reviews.author: Esther Ekart
reviews.text: Tasty , high quality food, lots of options, also veggie options, good prices, cozy atmosphere. The mezze is a must try!!

reviews.author: Dominika Kostolníková

reviews.author: syruk
reviews.text: I visited Al Bait Al Shami today for the third time in three years, and I’m happy to say that the quality of the service, hospitality, and food has remained consistently excellent. The place has a charming atmosphere, with beautifully decorated interiors that reflect the authentic Syrian spirit. The food is delicious, with true Syrian flavours, presented in an appealing way. Portions are generous and reasonably priced. The drinks are tasty, and the overall ambience is cosy and enjoyable. The staff are polite, welcoming, and attentive. They’re more than happy to accommodate special requests or modify dishes to suit your taste. The restrooms are clean and well-maintained, which is always a plus. We also enjoyed the shisha, which was quite pleasant. As a lovely gesture, the restaurant offered us complimentary traditional Middle Eastern sweets. There are separate seating areas for smokers and those who prefer fresh air, but note that children are not allowed in the smoking section — something to keep in mind when visiting with family. I’ll definitely be coming back here on my next trip to Doha!

reviews.author: Wajdy Shalghin
reviews.text: Syrian cuisine, the food is good, we had mixed grill the chicken tawook, meat cubes, lamb chops and kebab are good, tender and tasty. We had also meat with tomato which was also good. In addition to cheese burek which was amazing, hummus, mutabal, fatoush and rocca salad. The sweet was OK. The service was good and the staff were nice. I recommend

reviews.author: Ajeet Keshari
reviews.text: Very Disappointing I tried the Umm Ali at Al-Shami Home Restaurant last night, and unfortunately, it was a huge letdown. As someone who truly enjoys this classic dessert, I was shocked at how poorly it was made. It felt like the chef either had no idea how Umm Ali is supposed to taste or simply didn’t put any care into preparing it. The texture was off, the flavor was bland, and overall, it was a far cry from what Umm Ali should be. Honestly, it was so bad that I genuinely believe they should reconsider offering it on their menu until they learn how to make it properly. If you're craving Umm Ali, this is definitely not the place for it.

reviews.author: Parth Soni
reviews.text: Me along with my friends went to have Umm ali late in the evening but little did we knew about the disappointment we were going to face. Certainly, Chef don't know how its made. We barely had 2-3 spoon out of guilt towards paying for it. I'd highly advise to revisit the recipe as it's a famous dessert. ------- To be considered as constructive feedback and not otherwise, A disappointed Visitor.

reviews.author: Samer Kharsa
reviews.text: If you miss homemade-style meals, Al-Shami Home Restaurant is the place to go. Their food is consistently flavorful, with standout dishes like the thinly sliced rocca with beetroot salad and the boneless chicken breast platter (my favorites); in addition to their standard daily meals. The service is fast and friendly, making each visit enjoyable. Plus, the reasonable prices make it a great value. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Dr. Shah Hussain
reviews.text: I recently visited Marjan Island in Dammam during the evening, and unfortunately, the current condition of the spot is quite disappointing. The area seemed neglected, with a noticeable lack of cleanliness—trash was scattered around, and the usual vibrant atmosphere was missing. Unlike before, there wasn’t much foot traffic, giving the place a deserted feel. It seemed like the island might be partially closed or undergoing some sort of renovation, although no official signs confirmed this. Facilities that were once a highlight, like the monument tower and rest areas, appeared poorly maintained. If anyone is planning to visit Marjan Island soon, I’d suggest reconsidering or at least going during the day and being prepared for limited amenities. It’s best to bring your own food, water, and essentials, as the on-site options are minimal. While the location still offers a nice sea breeze and scenic views, the current state doesn’t reflect the vibrant destination it once was.

reviews.author: Sheraz Ahmed (Your Sir Jee)
reviews.text: “Marjan Island, Dammam – A Nostalgic Visit with Future Excitement” During our visit to Marjan Island, Dammam, after more than 28 years, we were delighted to relive the cherished memories we made here between 1990 and 2000. This island has always been a special place for us, where our kids enjoyed countless visits, and we once celebrated Pakistan Day with our close family, making it an unforgettable memory. While the island still holds its natural charm, we noticed that some planning and development work is underway, promising to bring more attractions for visitors in the future. As of now, the island remains a simple yet lively picnic spot, where most visitors were enjoying their time by the roadside, fishing, or relaxing with family. The main food options were from food stalls, which added to the casual, outdoor experience. One striking sight was the long stretch of cars parked beside the sea, showing how popular this place remains among locals and visitors alike. It was refreshing to see people gathering, enjoying the cool breeze, and making the most of the island’s peaceful atmosphere. We look forward to seeing how the planned developments will enhance the experience while keeping the island’s serene and nostalgic essence intact.

reviews.text: Nice place with a semi good view of the Haram mosque. Service is good, expensive buffet ($78) per adult and kids eat for free. The buffet variety is not much, only one live station for pasta. Salads was not bad, nice selection of breads and dessert has a middle eastern part and western one. In general service was nice, my only take is the quality of the food, flavors and taste wasn’t as much as you expect with such a price tag and yeah with this price you’d expect their juice glasses to be actually bigger than the usual one they use for breakfast!

reviews.author: Algérie Algerino
reviews.text: During our visit to Makkah, my family and I had planned to dine at the Raffles Hotel. We decided to sample different hotels each night to gauge both quality and pricing. When I inquired about the cost, the staff informed me it was 160 SAR per person. Considering we were a family of four – my wife, two children, and myself – I asked if we could pay only for myself and my wife. Upon returning later, I found a same staff member at the counter. I attempted to pay and requested payment for only two people, as other hotels had accommodated. Initially, the staff member refused and called the manager. Despite my insistence, the manager declined. Undeterred, I requested to speak directly with the manager. After a conversation with the manager, they finally agreed to accept payment for two people. However, to my surprise, the price had escalated to 590 SAR for just two individuals. This unexpected increase left me in a difficult situation, especially considering my children's presence and their inquiries about the escalating cost. Even though the hotel is great and fabulous, I dream to have an opportunity to spend 10 days there all-inclusive, Inchallah, experiencing every luxury and amenity it has to offer.

reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here during last year hajj and apologies for the late review as I’ve totally forgotten to give. Honestly it was the best services and food I ever had in Mecca. Was always serviced by Mr Anshad as well as Mr Hamdan and honestly they are the definition of an excellent service. Forever helpful and friendly. Honestly is a 5 star service for me. I need to apologise for this as I’ve forgotten the name of the chef but he was the chef that was always at the lamb and arab rice section and serving me. The food here tasted amazing as well and the chef was extremely friendly as well. Everyone whom attended for the lunch buffet needs to try their pasta as their carbonara as well as the neopolitan spaghetti are the best dish I ever had, especially when the specific chef cooked for me. I hope someone could let me know what’s the name of the chef as I honestly forgotten. I apologised for giving such a late review as I promised them to give a review back then but totally forgotten. Nevertheless, the whole experience I had here was a perfect 10/10 and I would definitely be dining here when I’m back in the holy land.

reviews.text: I recently visited Makkah Restaurant in Sharafiya and tried both the mutton and chicken kadai. The mutton kadai was exceptional, with a fantastic taste that has kept me coming back for more—I've visited four times already. The butter rotti was also quite good. However, the meat mix keema didn't live up to the same standard. Overall, Makkah Restaurant is one of the best places for mutton kadai in Jeddah, offering reasonable prices and generous meat portions. The restaurant is often busy, which can make it feel a bit congested, and it might be time to update the chairs to improve comfort. Despite these minor issues, the quality of the food makes it a standout choice.

reviews.author: Lafoi Elelei

reviews.author: N H

reviews.author: Javier Patarroyo
reviews.text: Tasty traditional Indonesian food. Quality ingredients. Freshly prepared mango juice Clean place (tables toilets kitchen). A deep cleaning of the walls and / or painting them will make place better looking.
