reviews.text: Indonesian food which have the same authentic taste as in Indonesia. If you're indonesian and boring with the daily food in hotel in Makkah you can try this one. The place is not too big, but still comfortable. There are many fan but not all area covered. Usually tour leader will bring us here when we're about to leave Makkah

reviews.author: Senorita Marsella
reviews.text: My favorite Indonesian restaurant in Jeddah. Good quality food, hygiene, friendly staff, strategic location, cozy restaurant atmosphere, yummy - big portion 😁 and reasonable price.

reviews.author: Seyyid Bilal
reviews.text: First time I have been here with my friends food is nice and traditional Asian. Just inside need some renovation. Service could be better... Icetea was out of my expectation 😅 but I am happy that they serve natural iced tea..

reviews.text: A very spacious and big wall. I definitely recommended it as a venue though parking might be an issue!!

reviews.author: Mahmoud Saeid
reviews.text: I have tried all the restaurants and buffets in the Clock Tower and this one is the best one hands down. The quality of the food and selection is unbelievable. Everything is prepared by professional chefs. They also have the biggest selection of desserts and breads I have even seen.

reviews.author: Drmobaid Obaid
reviews.text: The BEST in Makkah Raflles. The best food and the BEST staff members specifically Faisal Kafando and Rialis who are the best of the best and their supervisor Nouf Assekhairy. Thanks to ALL for making our stay more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Y k
reviews.text: Nice place with a semi good view of the Haram mosque. Service is good, expensive buffet ($78) per adult and kids eat for free. The buffet variety is not much, only one live station for pasta. Salads was not bad, nice selection of breads and dessert has a middle eastern part and western one. In general service was nice, my only take is the quality of the food, flavors and taste wasn’t as much as you expect with such a price tag and yeah with this price you’d expect their juice glasses to be actually bigger than the usual one they use for breakfast!

reviews.author: Algérie Algerino
reviews.text: During our visit to Makkah, my family and I had planned to dine at the Raffles Hotel. We decided to sample different hotels each night to gauge both quality and pricing. When I inquired about the cost, the staff informed me it was 160 SAR per person. Considering we were a family of four – my wife, two children, and myself – I asked if we could pay only for myself and my wife. Upon returning later, I found a same staff member at the counter. I attempted to pay and requested payment for only two people, as other hotels had accommodated. Initially, the staff member refused and called the manager. Despite my insistence, the manager declined. Undeterred, I requested to speak directly with the manager. After a conversation with the manager, they finally agreed to accept payment for two people. However, to my surprise, the price had escalated to 590 SAR for just two individuals. This unexpected increase left me in a difficult situation, especially considering my children's presence and their inquiries about the escalating cost. Even though the hotel is great and fabulous, I dream to have an opportunity to spend 10 days there all-inclusive, Inchallah, experiencing every luxury and amenity it has to offer.

reviews.author: Mohd Fadzrul
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here during last year hajj and apologies for the late review as I’ve totally forgotten to give. Honestly it was the best services and food I ever had in Mecca. Was always serviced by Mr Anshad as well as Mr Hamdan and honestly they are the definition of an excellent service. Forever helpful and friendly. Honestly is a 5 star service for me. I need to apologise for this as I’ve forgotten the name of the chef but he was the chef that was always at the lamb and arab rice section and serving me. The food here tasted amazing as well and the chef was extremely friendly as well. Everyone whom attended for the lunch buffet needs to try their pasta as their carbonara as well as the neopolitan spaghetti are the best dish I ever had, especially when the specific chef cooked for me. I hope someone could let me know what’s the name of the chef as I honestly forgotten. I apologised for giving such a late review as I promised them to give a review back then but totally forgotten. Nevertheless, the whole experience I had here was a perfect 10/10 and I would definitely be dining here when I’m back in the holy land.

reviews.text: Alhamdulillah food was excellent and fairly priced. A large variety of delicacies was served for guests. The Manager Abu Saif was friendly and open to positive feedbacks. We even requested staff to make special kadak chai for us, and they obliged. And the chai was awesome. Highly recommended place to come especially for those far away from their homeland.

reviews.author: John Thunderdk
reviews.text: Al Shurfa restaurant is located in P3 of Zamzam tower... Which offer Breakfast, Lunch,Dinner.. They offer variety of Arabian foods which not spicy at all.. Disappointed on Mindhi as spices didnt breakthrough the meat.. Lamb, Kebabs were good, Rice is ok..Salads were different.. Specially recommend Coleslaw which was very good... As for fish Salmon was top notch on taste... Totally disappointed on dessert... There's a wide way for upgrading sweets and cakes which lacks alot... Lastly its a cozy environment place as its very close to Haram Sharif... Enjoy food with family and friends..

reviews.author: Samia Hassan (Samia Top Tips)
reviews.text: We had the open buffet breakfast several times in this place. It’s very convenient near the Haram, offers a family friendly atmosphere and a good selection of food for a good price.

reviews.author: Anthony A
reviews.text: Not bad at 75 SAR per person wabba rice with huge pieces of meat god knows what it is camel or goat but it’s tasty . Chicken a bit dry but try the kedgeree rice with fish that’s very tasty Arabic food in the clock tower in Mecca 🕋 who’d a thought it

reviews.author: Abdelrahman Kadry (Said)
reviews.text: For every Algerian Umrah pilgrim or Hajj, the only restaurant that tastes delicious traditional Algerian food with sweets. Also, Al-Taybat Restaurant in Mecca. Brother Muhammad is very polite and very sophisticated in his treatment of the dishes, as in the menu. They have most of the Algerian food, even the harissa, which they bring from Algeria. They have special daily dishes. Inside the restaurant sessions are meliha. ❤️🇸🇦🇩🇿 What is special is that the entire staff is Algerian, and this guarantees you Algerian food from the origin of the country 👍 If anyone wants to eat Algerian food, I recommend it Good luck, may God bless you and grant you success 👏💛

reviews.author: Syaffana S
reviews.text: Leaving this review on behalf of my mum: Had v gd meal here cause buffet spread is so delicious n offers wide spread of continental cuisine.. Special shoutout to restaurant manager Mohamed Abdul Monem for giving excellent service 👍🏽 He made me ginger n honey drink when he noticed that i was having cough n flu..i am touched by his kind gesture..will definitely be back here again

reviews.author: S Siddiqui
reviews.text: Maybe I chose their bad day - ( Wednesday, May 17th) but I only got an array of insipid, dry, tasteless, cold and ridiculous mix of cuisine and dishes (Daal? Chawal?, Paella (with over cooked seafood) Pizza and some weird selection of food. For the price it was utterly disappointing. Even their bread (khoobz)was stale! 2 stars is for their attentive staff, but insisted on profiling me :), and interestingly brought me the bill before I finished my dinner, either thinking I can’t pay or wanted to cut me off :), wide selection of their salads and desserts, and decent presentation. Save your money - do not recommend it!

reviews.author: vina aditya
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay at Hilton! The hotel is clean, comfortable, and perfectly located. A special thanks to Muhammad Al Kholy from the staff — he was incredibly helpful, professional, and welcoming throughout our stay. He made sure everything was smooth and went out of his way to assist us. Great service like his really makes a difference. Highly recommend this hotel and would love to come back again!

reviews.author: Ibrahim Al-Sairafi
reviews.text: I’m very pleased with the overall experience. The service has been excellent from the moment I arrived. The staff are warm, welcoming, and highly professional. I’d like to especially recognize Mohamed AlKohli at the hotel restaurant for his outstanding service his professionalism and attention to detail truly stood out. The hotel’s location is also very convenient, close to the main areas of the city, which made getting around easy and comfortable. Thank you to the Hilton team for a great stay I look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Desatmi Mitra
reviews.text: There is also chili sauce available, especially for Indonesians, they will definitely like this. My first experience of Umrah in 2023 and while in Medina I stayed at Hilton. Honestly, this was a very amazing worship experience for me. Being invited by Allah was already very happy, plus being special guest with the best facilities and the best trip, Masyaa Allah Tabarakallah. The hotel's distance is very close to the Nabawi mosque, which is very pleasant. The luxurious and comfortable hotel facilities are very helpful and can be a strong booster in improving the quality of worship. The food provided is also varied. The hotel menu adjusts to most of the guests staying at that time. And especially for Indonesians, the availability of chili sauce is one of the plus points. Very tasty. Hopefully I can stay at this hotel again during my next Umrah with my family.

reviews.author: Alshaimaa Mohamed
reviews.text: The location of the hotel to the Prophet mosque and cleanliness were noticeable. I am delighted by Hanna's hospitality in the restaurant at breakfast during her morning shift.She really is skillful, hospitable and added to my spiritual trip intensly by her kindness and caring.

reviews.author: Nabila Shehu
reviews.text: The hospitality was great and the staff were quick to help out any way they could. Excellent service from Mr muhammed al kholy at the restaurant, very helpful and kind to my friends and family. Service was timely and proximity to the mosque made everything so much easier. Highly recommend. Shaon was particularly helpful and always cheerful.

reviews.author: M A MALIK
reviews.text: Jannatul Baqi, also known as Baqi al-Gharqad, is a significant Islamic cemetery in Medina, Saudi Arabia. It's considered one of the holiest cemeteries in Islam, along with the graveyard of Masjid-i-Nabawi in Medina, as it is the final resting place for Prophet Muhammad's family members, wives, and many of his companions. The cemetery is the location of the graves of four Shia Imams, making it particularly important for Shia Muslims.

reviews.author: Sajjad Haider
reviews.text: Jannat ul Baqi review The authorities decide where you can go, where you can stand, what you can see and where you can pray. The time slots are also severely limited. Just allowed to walk on one short path and then exit. In my experience, they made us use an alternate entrance despite there being no crowds or rush. They did not even allow us to stop and say a prayer. Behaved rudely as per Saudi tradition. The place is very close to the heart of hundreds of millions of people. It has the graves of the family of Prophet Muhammad Peace Be Upon Him.

reviews.author: Arsman Ahmad
reviews.text: Al-Baqi Cemetery in Medina is a profoundly spiritual and historically significant site, revered by Muslims around the world. It is the final resting place of numerous companions, family members, and close associates of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), including his beloved daughters, wives, and other prominent figures from early Islamic history. This sacred ground serves as a poignant reminder of the simplicity of life and the inevitability of death, as emphasized in Islamic teachings. The cemetery is meticulously maintained, exuding an atmosphere of tranquility and solemnity. Walking through its grounds offers visitors a deeply humbling and reflective experience, encouraging them to contemplate the lives of those buried here and their contributions to the faith. Given the sanctity of Al-Baqi, visitors are encouraged to approach with the utmost respect and reverence, adhering to Islamic etiquettes. It is a place of prayer, remembrance, and connection to Islamic heritage, making it an essential destination for Muslims visiting Medina.

reviews.author: Bilal Ahmed Khan (DrBill)
reviews.text: Timings are after Fajr prayer for a longer time and then after Asr prayers for maybe half an hour. Females are not allowed inside. Jannat al-Baqi is a historic and significant cemetery located in Medina, Saudi Arabia, adjacent to the Prophet's Mosque (Al-Masjid an-Nabawi). It is one of the most revered burial sites in Islam due to its association with several important figures from early Islamic history. Many of the Prophet Muhammad's family members, companions (Sahabah), and prominent figures of early Islam are buried in Jannat al-Baqi. Among those buried there are: 1. Umm al-Mu’minin (the Mother of the Believers) Aisha – The Prophet's wife. 2. Uthman ibn Affan – The third caliph of Islam. 3. Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin) – The son of Husayn ibn Ali and a great-grandson of the Prophet. 4. Abu Hurairah – A renowned companion of the Prophet who narrated many hadiths. 5. Fatimah bint Asad – The mother of Ali ibn Abi Talib.

A must-visit for Muslims coming to Medina.

reviews.text: Amazing! Really impressed. Had a wonderful visit to this mall. It has a wide variety of a lot of brands under one roof. Food court is too good! Very well maintained.

reviews.author: Bilal Ahmed Khan (DrBill)
reviews.text: I recently visited Al Rashid Mega Mall, and I was truly impressed! The mall is spacious and beautifully designed, making it a pleasure to walk around. There’s a fantastic variety of shops, from international brands to local boutiques, so there's something for everyone. The food court is a highlight, offering a diverse range of dining options, from fast food to traditional cuisine. I enjoyed trying some local dishes, and the atmosphere was vibrant and welcoming. The mall also hosts various entertainment options, including a cinema and fun activities for kids, which makes it a great place for families. The staff were friendly and helpful, adding to the overall positive experience. Whether you’re looking to shop, eat, or just enjoy a day out, Al Rashid Mega Mall is definitely worth a visit when in Madina!

reviews.text: The Central Market one of the most famous urban markets in Morocco with historical and cultural significance. It is located on Muhammad V Boulevard, among the colonial architecture of the 20th century. Crammed with locals, the daily market is a fascinating place for tourists to get a taste of local culture, while picking up bargains on everything from food to flowers and traditional clothing.

reviews.author: Tas A
reviews.text: The historical significance this mountain has on islamic history is undeniable. It is hard to believe it in today’s world but I would request everyone to put your shoes back during Prophet (SW) days and imagine the war zone during that time.

reviews.author: Sameer ibn Azhar
reviews.text: Mount Uhud, located in the north of Medina, holds significant importance in Islam due to its association with the Battle of Uhud, a key event in early Islamic history. The battle, which took place in 625 CE, was the second major conflict between the Muslims of Medina, led by Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), and the Quraysh tribe of Mecca. The Battle of Uhud is remembered for its lessons in faith, perseverance, and obedience. Despite initial success, the Muslim forces faced a setback due to a group of archers abandoning their posts, contrary to the Prophet's instructions. This shift allowed the Meccan forces to regroup and launch a counterattack, resulting in heavy casualties for the Muslims. Among the martyrs was Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib, the beloved uncle of the Prophet. Mount Uhud symbolizes the trials and tribulations faced by the early Muslim community and serves as a reminder of the importance of steadfastness and unity. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) frequently visited the site to pay respects to the fallen companions, emphasizing the significance of their sacrifice. Today, Mount Uhud is a pilgrimage site for Muslims worldwide. Visitors come to reflect on the historical events, seek spiritual inspiration, and honor the memory of the martyrs. The lessons learned from the Battle of Uhud continue to resonate with believers, reminding them of the importance of following divine guidance and remaining resolute in the face of adversity. The mountain stands as a testament to the enduring legacy of faith and courage in Islam.

reviews.author: Aghnia Hauna
reviews.text: You can climb to the hill, so you need to use proper shoes. Next to the hill, you can visit the graveyards area.

reviews.author: Zia
reviews.text: Alhamdulillah, visited the place. May Allah give every one the chance to cone here.

reviews.author: Md Jahirul Islam
reviews.text: For anyone visiting Medina, a trip to Mount Uhud is essential. It’s not just a hike; it’s a journey into the heart of Islamic history, filled with moments of reflection and inspiration. I left with a deeper appreciation for the sacrifices made by the early Muslims and a renewed sense of connection to my faith. Highly recommended for anyone seeking to understand the rich tapestry of Islamic heritage.

reviews.author: Jordim22
reviews.text: Seafood night at Al Orjouan was a fantastic experience! Located inside the luxurious Ritz-Carlton in Riyadh, Al Orjouan is a stunning restaurant with opulent decor and a truly upscale ambiance. It may feel like an exclusive place, but it's definitely worth a visit — especially on Wednesdays, when they host their famous seafood buffet. The variety was incredible: fresh oysters, octopus, shrimps, prawns, sushi, and countless other options. Everything was fresh, well-prepared, and beautifully presented. To top it off, the dessert selection was just as impressive. Considering the location and the quality of food, the price (around 400 SAR) is very reasonable for Saudi Arabia. If you're a seafood lover and looking for a special dining experience in Riyadh, I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Say Tere
reviews.text: The buffet tables and bars were attractively arranged. With the best bites, we left satisfied and definitely full. Random: Japanese food: Desserts: Steak: Salad: The ones we liked most were: Sushi and desserts 🌸🌸🌸 It was a great dinner for us. 10/10 💥💥💥

reviews.author: ahmed Hafez
reviews.text: We visited the restaurant and had a mixed experience. On the positive side, the service provided by Hadi and Yazid was excellent — they were very respectful, polite, and professional. However, unfortunately, our order was not completed even after waiting for more than an hour and a half, with no clear explanation. In addition, there seemed to be intentional mistreatment or discomfort caused by some of the other staff members. This is not the first time we’ve encountered this issue. We truly hope the management will address this and improve the overall organization and communication within the restaurant, as it has great potential but the overall experience was affected negatively

reviews.author: Master Vigilante (AJ)
reviews.text: I gotta say, I’m surprised with all the fuss and the good reviews. I honestly say it’s overrated. I have been here in a seafood night (that’s thursday) and I rarely have any expectations when I visit somewhere new. But as a reputation as Ritz-Carlton, this restaurant has not reached to a “hotel” restaurant expectation. To be fair, I am not big fan of buffets. However; it did not have a lot of varieties. My soup was not hot. The service was decent, and their drinks are amazing. Try their Radiant Rose drink. One of the main reason that I did not like this place, is the type of guests around here. You could expect that this place will be visited by high class visitors, but it was the contrary. Many children are running around, and people are talking in high voices, and there are a lot of native minority people with bad dressing and slippers, I could advise that they should put on a dress code. I am not saying this restaurant is bad, but it is not outstanding.

reviews.author: Buki Okoro
reviews.text: We all had an amazing lunch time here. Staff were nice and friendly, we got a lovely window side table with a view. And the food was just lovely. Very wide selection of intercontinental dishes and loads of desert. Momen was amazing he too great care of us and ensured everyone in our party had great fun. Hospitality was top notch. Definitely worth a visit if you are in Riyadh

reviews.author: Sara’s Food Story
reviews.text: The best place in town to enjoy a weekend brunch . love their hospitality, very friendly and professional staff. The ambience was great with live music . Tried caviar for the first time and loved it 👌🏻 Their sushi was scrumptious and so was the dim sum and bao 🤩 Also loved their live ramen and grill counter.M, loved how they served the mocktail at the table with a performance.( flairtending ) The kids play area had so many games , a clown, face painting, bouncy castle and a separate buffet for the kids.

reviews.author: JJ LEE
reviews.text: I have eaten many buffet in a 5 stars hotel and this one was quite dissappointing. The varieties are acceptable but quality is not so good. Sashimi doesn't taste fresh. No oyster no lobster no hokkaido crabs nothing really expensive here. The grill is more ok compare to the rest. Desserts are quite interesting too. But no exciting fruits. Juice and drinks are not included. Overall nothing special for the relatively expensive price tag of the buffett.

reviews.author: Michelle Repuya
reviews.text: Located inside Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh. Buffet is now open & offers wide variety of dishes as you like... from seafood to meat and sweets selections. Anything you can possibly crave is here. Price is reasonable for the food plus the elegant ambiance. Sad not be able to share the videos. Google only accepts photos😉

reviews.author: noha alghunaim
reviews.text: Elements is an excellent choice if you want to try different food and open to all choices.. But you have to check which cuisine they serve for each day before making a reservation.(Indian , seafood, international and so on..) The food quality was great we went on an international day cuisine for dinner. Loved the pumpkin soup and the salad selection . The hot plates was good specially the steak section. My partner loved the sushi bar they have over there.. They say reservations needed but I guess you can walk in .but it’s little bit pricey for the the selection they sever 270 per person VAT excluded. We also tried elements for breakfast I actually enjoyed the breakfast selection more the dinner.. everything is fresh and neatly presented . Starting from the bread and pastry section, cheese bar, and to the live cooking section.The breakfast was 180 per person VAT excluded.

reviews.author: engish tutor
reviews.text: Generally good. Sushi was very good and appetisers had a good selection. Sea food options were very good and impressive. We then had Beef wellington, which tasted like the pastry had come out of a wellington boot. Beef was good though. Desserts were nice with a good selection. Worth a visit.

reviews.text: Great place to try out Saudi food for the first time! The decor here is top notch, you can tell they took a lot of care to make sure the decor aligned with the traditional vibes here. I tried a variety of dishes (wish I remembered the names but I was jetlagged). I tried some hummus, dessert, meat dishes, salad and more. Definitely come in a group if you can because it is quite a bit of food.

reviews.author: Mohammed Amro Hadi
reviews.text: We visited Najd Village on Takassusi Street last night and while the food was enjoyable — with dishes like Hamees, Matazeez, Naimi Meat Kabsa, Maqluba, Steamed Naimi Meat, Sambosas, and fresh salads — what truly stood out the most was the ambiance. More than the food itself, the setting stole the show. Dining felt like stepping back in time, with interiors resembling a traditional Saudi home, complete with old-style decor and classic cutlery. It created a warm, nostalgic experience that made the visit special. The Tatlee Custard and Crème Caramel desserts were a sweet finish.

reviews.author: Shirley Supangan
reviews.text: My authentic, very lovely Arabian cuisine experience at Najd Village was made so much better by wonderful staff members Anna and Annie. Their recommendation, lamb dishes paired with refreshing laban mix drink, is an excellent combination. Thank you so much, Anna and Annie!

reviews.author: Hani Bugshan
reviews.text: A restaurant that serves traditional food from the Najd region... allowing you to experience the old traditional atmosphere.

reviews.author: Mohamed Azarudeen Yunoos
reviews.text: A Wonderful Dining Experience at Najd Village Restaurant Our recent dinner at Najd Village Restaurant was a truly memorable experience. The ambiance was absolutely amazing, with its beautiful old heritage style that transported us back in time. The restaurant offers delicious Arabic food, and everything we tried was flavorful and authentic. We were warmly greeted and served traditional gawa coffee and dates upon arrival, a lovely touch that set the tone for the evening. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure we had everything we needed. Even with our large group of 40 people, the food was served quickly and efficiently, which was impressive. I highly recommend Najd Village Restaurant for anyone looking for a delicious meal in a unique and charming setting.

reviews.author: Amin Hassan
reviews.text: Dining at The Globe Restaurant was an unforgettable experience! Perched high in the Al Faisaliah Tower, the panoramic view of Riyadh was nothing short of spectacular. The atmosphere was elegant and serene, creating the perfect setting for a special evening. The food was phenomenal, offering a delightful fusion of modern European cuisine with a unique twist. Every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavors. The tasting menu was a journey of culinary excellence, and the dessert was the cherry on top. The service was impeccable from start to finish. The staff was attentive, knowledgeable, and made us feel welcome throughout our visit. Special dietary needs were well accommodated, which was much appreciated. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply looking for an exceptional dining experience, The Globe Restaurant is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Gordon Nisbet
reviews.text: A great afternoon for high tea. Staff very attentive and friendly. Well worth a visit and the vista is awesome. You can see the changes in Riyadh.

reviews.author: Deborah Okeme
reviews.text: My husband and I recently celebrated my birthday dinner here, and it was an unforgettable experience! The ambiance was cozy and inviting, perfect for a special occasion, and the staff went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and cared for. Every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor, truly elevating the evening. It’s clear that great care and attention to detail are priorities here. Thank you for making our celebration so special.

reviews.author: Nimra Seher
reviews.text: We had an amazing time for our anniversary dinner. Reaching the location was good, specially getting valet parking was really convenient as we were running late. Food was good, we were also able to venture out to THE EXPERIENCE and enjoy the amazing night views of Riyadh's down town.

reviews.author: Nora M

reviews.author: Nimra Seher
reviews.text: We had an amazing time for our anniversary dinner. Reaching the location was good, specially getting valet parking was really convenient as we were running late. Food was good, we were also able to venture out to THE EXPERIENCE and enjoy the amazing night views of Riyadh's down town.

reviews.author: Nora M
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful place, just gorgeous! The food however was really basic, feels like old school French cuisine, looks and sounds amazing but tastes mediocre. Wouldn’t recommend if you want actual good food but if you’re looking for an amazing view, this is the place!

name: The Ritz-Carlton - Azure
address: The Ritz-Carlton - Azure, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Archon Qiqi (七七)
reviews.text: This Eid I decided to spend it by staying at the Ritz Carlton Hotel. 🏨🌟 I am pleased to have done so; they’ve offered a great experience in terms of space, well-maintained rooms, great service, excellent hotel staff, exquisite restaurants with delectable food, and much more. On our first day we stayed, it was quite empty due to all the celebrations, so our room had been upgraded to a Club Executive One-Bedroom Suite, which was very spacious. Soon after being in our room, we were greeted with a honey cake with fruit slices on the side, along with complimentary sweets, which were beautifully assorted inside a small golden box. To mention, we were considerately offered more throughout our stay. The hotel staff were very friendly, polite, and patient, offering us anything we needed and doing so generously, especially one housekeeper that went by the name (( Mohammed Alauddin )). He was very kind and wished us a happy Eid with a big welcoming smile. When coming, definitely check out the pool, as the view is absolutely stunning from the poolside. Beside it, you’ll find an Italian restaurant by the name Azzuro, and on the level above, a Chinese restaurant called Hong. The restaurant located inside of the Ritz Carlton specifically (🇮🇹) Azzuro, had absolutely delicious food, and I would highly recommend it to anyone planning to have a stay here. ⚠️ On the downside, I’d like to mention that the all-day menu was quite underwhelming, at least in terms of what we had ordered. We got the Ritz Carlton Cake, which was very dry and lacked in flavor. In addition, we had the assorted cold mezze; however, we did request to switch the Fattoush with Batata Harra, which had an excessive amount of sauce, and most of the dishes looked and tasted like canned food. Besides that, my overall experience staying here was very positive and I would definitely choose to come again. ✅

reviews.author: S. Hakeem
reviews.text: A truly luxurious experience at The Ritz-Carlton. The lobby is elegant and welcoming, setting the tone from the moment you arrive. A special thanks to Ahmed Alghamdi at the reception for the generous upgrade and his warm, professional service — it made a real difference. Also grateful to the butler team led by Ayman for their excellent organization and thoughtful support throughout the stay. The breakfast buffet offers a great variety and is definitely worth visiting again, even on its own. We tried the Italian restaurant by the pool — the view is lovely and relaxing, though the food itself was average (I’d rate it 6/10). Still, it’s a nice spot if you’re looking for a scenic and casual evening. Earlier during our stay, we visited the bowling alley, which was a fun and well-maintained facility — a great addition for some light entertainment. A memorable stay that combines hospitality, comfort, and attention to detail.

reviews.author: SAB
reviews.text: Our three-night stay at this hotel was nothing short of exceptional👌🏼 The room itself was spacious and well-appointed, offering a blend of comfort and luxury. The breakfast buffet was diverse, catering to all tastes with an impressive variety of dishes, ensuring a delightful start to each day.✨ The staff deserves a special mention for their professionalism and warmth. They were incredibly friendly, well-trained, and fluent in both English and Arabic, ensuring seamless communication and top-notch service.♥️♥️♥️ Overall, this hotel provides an unforgettable experience, combining breathtakin views, comfortable accommodations, delicious meals, and impeccable service. It’s the perfect destination for anyone seeking a peaceful and luxurious escape. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and look forward to returning in the future.

reviews.author: Tayef Khan
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived, The Ritz-Carlton delivered an experience that exceeded every expectation. The staff was incredibly welcoming and attentive, always going the extra mile to ensure comfort and satisfaction. The room was elegant, spotless, and perfectly appointed with luxurious details that made it feel like a true escape. The location was ideal, and the amenities—from the spa to the dining—were absolutely world-class. Every interaction felt personalized, and the overall ambiance was calm, refined, and relaxing. This is more than just a hotel—it’s a full experience in hospitality excellence. I can’t recommend it highly enough and will definitely return. By Nahid – his very existence is a personification of elegance and appreciation for quality❤️❤️

reviews.author: Hady
reviews.text: The Perfect Spot for Meetings and Gatherings! I’ve attended several events at the Ritz-Carlton Hotel in Riyadh, and I can’t recommend it enough! The ambiance is stunning, making it a fantastic choice for business meetings or catching up with friends. The staff is incredibly attentive, ensuring everything runs flawlessly, and the food is always a treat! Even when I have online meetings, I love being in this beautiful space—it just lifts my spirits. If you're looking for a place that feels welcoming and luxurious, this is it. I can’t wait to visit again!

reviews.author: James Kress, PhD
reviews.text: We had a nice experience at this location. There is a vast array of products on sale. Ranging from perfume, cologne, home sprays, lotion, and more. Some things are decently priced something seem far too expensive. However I will say that the Taif Rose is extremely fragrant. Much different than some of the other roses I have smelled before. So maybe the prices are worth it given the amount of work and time that goes into the production of these materials and the products themselves. Definitely a fun place to look around.

reviews.text: One of the oldest dam in KSA. It's inside a National Park. Nice place to hang out with friends & family. Make sure you carry food, snacks with you. There are no shops nearby.

reviews.author: Muhammad Mansoor
reviews.text: It is also called Saysad Dam and is situated north of Taif. It was built in Umayyad era and built by Moawya Bin Aby Sofian. Great architectural marvel of his time. Shows advancement beside other nations of his time.

reviews.text: Best climate.feel happy it is cool area , Dam not like big dam ; Some people’s swimming .clamping mountain for adventure Always breezing wind

Make sure you carry food, snacks with you. There are no shops nearby.

name: Street Stall - Shubra
address: Street Stall - Shubra, Taif, Saudi Arabia

reviews.author: Claudia Mihu
reviews.text: I had an amazing t-bone steak with potatoes and pimientos pardon . Everything was cooked so perfectly I thought I will pay a kidney, but the price was quite decent. Both the meat and potatoes were so soft , woth a small discrete touch of cooked onion. I will return for sure. The view is spectacular too

reviews.author: S Chowdhury
reviews.text: Sitting outside is very beautiful! Stunning views and very nicely decorated interior. Fried Calamari was gluten free as it was fried in chickpea flour, but it was not crunchy, if they used cornflour maybe this would solve the texture. The cuttle fish was okay, not something we would get again. Overall food was okay, but the views were the best part.

reviews.author: S E
reviews.text: Despite our very large group they served a decent several course lunch. Will visit here the next time I come to Alicante.

reviews.author: Mida Hardo
reviews.text: The place is big. The view from the restaurant is nuce as it is located by the sea. The nicest area is at the teraza. We were not impressed by the first staff who welcome us. Not friendly and assign us on the table that was not ready (no dining plates ready). We were declined by her when we asked for another table that is ready (given we made a reservation before). The food is average and the coffee con leche was terrible. The staffs who served the food were nice. They had live music when we had dinner on Saturday night.

reviews.author: Sebastian Tamayo
reviews.text: This place has amazing views, great spot by the marina. I ordered the octopus leg, and it was the highlight of the dinner. Later i order a meat and sausage rice which was pretty decent, but it was a little salty and had a strong taste of tomatoes. They have a very good wine selection and a good amount of options on the menu. The menu OS though was terrible, tabs after tabs that you have to click to navigate it. Definitely something I wish they would change to make it friendlier for the customer. All in all it was a good experience with decent food but amazing views. The service was okay at best, even though it's somewhat understandable since the festival was going on during my stay here. I would like to visit this place again whenever there's not a festival overpopulating the whole city and every restaurant, hopefully for a better experience.

reviews.author: Paul Bobo
reviews.text: Just blown away by my visit here. Arrived just as they were opening for lunch and was lucky to get a space at the counter. Food, service and atmosphere were all faultless, couldn't have asked for better. Food wise I loved the Gilda so much I ordered a second one, the topped breads were delicious as was the Jamón. Excellent red wine too. Definitely worth visiting here as a treat.

reviews.author: Arthur Van Dam
reviews.text: Great experience! We only had seafood and it was splendid—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. Nice selection of wines too, which paired beautifully with the dishes.

reviews.author: Dan Catalin Costache
reviews.text: Amazing culinary experience and top notch service. We had some sea food tapas and they were out of this world. I also totally recommend the roasted peppers.

reviews.author: Geoffrey Berg
reviews.text: Effortlessly classy and cool, you can see why Nou Manolín has attracted lots of Spanish celebs. Our meal was outstanding, the fried prawns in the shells with broken eggs and rice with pigs trotters were both unusual and delicious. I wouldn't call the cousine experimental, just very well executed, much like the service and decor. A great place to take someone you love.

reviews.author: Scafify
reviews.text: The most amazing restaurant- one of the best we have ever eaten in, not just the food but experience. Queue just before 8pm to get a seat at the bar and see the seafood on display. Fast and furious service but you can relax and take you time if you wish, the place is buzzy with atmosphere and the food is super fresh and perfect to prepared and presented. I guarantee you will not be disappointed. Enjoy !

reviews.author: Scott Thompson
reviews.text: We were lucky enough to score 2 nights at Bar de Pla in a week’s trip to Barcelona. We tried to eat the menu and everything was delicious. Service was fast and furious. Reasonably priced and certainly some authentic Spanish Tapas offered. Quality was great both nights.

reviews.author: Jason Covert
reviews.text: A tough table to get with a group, but always delivers. Bar Del Pla is located within the maze-like alleys of El Gotic, and simply oozes with history and ambiance. The food is very good, and you know it’s fresh as they often run out of dishes later in the evenings. The service was impeccable during our visit and we never felt out of sorts despite bringing children to a 10:00pm sit down. Spain is special that way. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Pia
reviews.text: Absolutely unforgettable. I’ve truly never eaten better in my life — every bite was perfection. The flavors, the quality, the care in each dish… just wow. A culinary experience I’ll be dreaming about for a long time.❤️❤️

reviews.author: Carla Vila
reviews.text: Super nice experience. We came based on a recommendation - absolutely worth it. Friendly, kind staff, competent and quick service, personalised recommendations when asking about dishes - all great. Food wise, every plate was tasteful and wholesome, complementing flavours and creative ingredients - definitely elevated cuisine. Talking details, everything was tasty, as said, but we specifically enjoyed the zucchini flowers with pickled onion - great combo -, the tomato salmorejo plate, that was very refreshing and an unconventional approach to a classic plate, but the highlight for us was the mushroom carpaccio with wasabi emulsion / sauce. It was a real explosion of flavours, umami 2.0 and nicely presented. This foodie place is definitely up to par with the top tapas bars in town without being pretentious and cocky. Must try! Thank you :-)

reviews.author: Marco Loffredo
reviews.text: A Cozy Gem in Barcelona Tucked away near the Picasso Museum, Bar del Pla is a true hidden gem in Barcelona’s El Born district. This cozy restaurant perfectly captures the essence of a traditional Spanish tapas bar, with its warm ambiance, friendly staff, and a lively yet intimate atmosphere. One of the standout dishes here is their artichokes, beautifully crispy on the outside and tender inside, seasoned with a delicious red sauce that adds just the right amount of tangy richness. It’s the kind of dish that keeps you coming back for more. Beyond the artichokes, Bar del Pla offers a fantastic selection of tapas, from fresh seafood to melt-in-your-mouth Iberian ham, all paired with a great wine and vermouth list. The quality of the ingredients and the care put into each dish make every bite a delight. Whether you’re looking for a casual bite after exploring the Picasso Museum or a full-on tapas feast, Bar del Pla is the perfect spot. It’s a place where locals and visitors come together over great food in an authentic setting, making it a must-visit in Barcelona.

reviews.author: Veronica Derevyanko
reviews.text: Super cozy tapas place. Enjoyed it a lot. It’s either you book the restaurnt area with proper seating or walk in. If you do walk in be prepared to stand in queue. The food is great. And the point here is that you give them your budget and tell them your preferences and they choose for you. There is no so called menu. Very nice place. But be prepared for a lot of oil😂

reviews.author: Anne Ngammaharat
reviews.text: Long queue but excellent tapas. Should try to arrive before 7 pm for dinner for walk-ins or book ahead for larger party. All dishes we ordered were well executed. Recommend ordering pan to mob up the broth from the clam and iberico ham dish — delish!

reviews.author: Steve Ginther
reviews.text: Fantastic meal, staff was so wonderful and accommodating which made the great food all the better. Dining room was rustic and authentic. One of the best meals I've had in Spain in my entire life.

reviews.author: Andre Lucas Ribeiro
reviews.text: Extremely good tapa place in Barcelona, for me, one of the best in the city. There are not many sits available, so I suggest getting there very early or making a reservation online. The prices are not cheap, but they are worth it. The service is very fast.

reviews.author: Kelli Inglis
reviews.text: Best food we had in Barcelona. The food was AMAZING! Get there early as it gets busy. We arrived about 8.30, waited 5-10 mins for seats. Everyone sits at the bar and you get to watch the food being made. They ask what your preference is, so we chose fish and seafood. We were not disappointed! It's definitely on the pricier side, at nearly €100 for 2, but worth every penny!!

reviews.author: Dennis Bauszus
reviews.text: A super efficient tapas bar dealing well with the Primavera crowd. We stopped there for some tapas and cava on our way to the festival. The waiters are very friendly and we enjoyed our food and drink. Despite the bar being full we had to wait very little.

reviews.author: Diane
reviews.text: Went solo. It was super crowded. The staff told me waiting time could be from 20-30mins. i ended queuing for 10mins coz the group ahead of me could not wait any longer and left. ☝️So dont be disheartened about the queue. Noisy atmosphère. I was being bumped from all directions and the girl beside me was flipping her hair every minute and i wonder how much dandruff went into m'y drink. A semi drink girl banged the door while im inside the toilet looking for her phone which je found in her jacket. ☝️For first timers, before ordering, ask for a number (in a wooden cube) first then that's the time to tell them what you like to have.. Nothing special about the burger with bacon with cheese and pepper. They ran out of longanissa so i ordered xistorra without having any idea what it is. I got tiny slices of well done hot dogs. Bit salty but liked it. Food not so expensive considering the success. Toilets are super small and needs to be checked regularly. It was horrible!. Hence 3 ⭐.

reviews.author: Joseph F
reviews.text: Went over the weekend, was a classical tapas bar although really overcrowded for parts which slightly pulls down my score on atmosphere. However my biggest issue was the very poor and outright rude staff when ordering; when ordering a bottle I was told a minimum of 2 plates needed to be ordered despite me already asking to place an order for 5 or so plates as eating with a friend. The barman was also annoyed that we did not have one of the blocks with a number on to order? I still didn’t know what that actually was because it was never actually told to us nor given by the person showing us our spot? Whilst ordering the barman continued to walk off often for a minute or two and seemed to do other work before finally brining back the plate I had ordered. I was therefore standing around like an idiot at the bar for a prolonged and unnecessary time. When I finally ordered the final plates and paid for all that I ordered the same barman stood around and looked at me like I was an idiot when I asked him where was my croquettes… I had to show him that the receipt, which I paid for just a second prior, had them on the tab he then reluctantly went to go fetch them. To top things off when he returned with them I then repeated to have the two glasses for my bottle which he still hadn’t gave me, he more or less threw them towards me with the croquettes in doing so making me drop half of them and almost smashing one of the glasses onto a near by customer and their food. Needless to say I felt disgusted by his behaviour and felt quite embarrassed by the whole ideal. It was a shame as his actions seriously hurt my experience of this place, which could have been a very different review.

reviews.author: ceren özaltun
reviews.text: You should definitely try their rosé cavas! The burgers were a bit too salty for my taste. If I come back here, I’ll absolutely go for the cavas again!

reviews.author: Ali Temel Keceli
reviews.text: This is the one of the best local adres for the eat on stand. Food is very good taste. Price is very low for the quality. Just visit enjoy your food witj caja

reviews.author: Peter Khalil
reviews.text: Excellent place for tapas. We came here around 10:00 PM and had to wait 20 minutes to find a table. So I can only guess it will take much longer if you come at regular dinner times. The kitchen stops serving food after 11, and they stop serving rice or pasta options after 9:30, which is a little disappointing. We tried multiple tapa options and all were amazing, 10/10 for the quality. We tried fried garlic shrimp, red shrimp, tomato bread, and mixed fried fish. The fried garlic shrimp is by far the highlight of this place. We ended up ordering it 3 more times as it is irresistible!! We also got sangria for a drink and cream caramel for dessert, and both were good

reviews.author: Linh Quan
reviews.text: Visiting Barcelona for the first time. My friend recommended this place. It’s walking distance from our hotel. We stayed at Renaissance Barcelona I think it’s about 10 min walk. We went for dinner. There was a line we put in our name at the host desk and waited about 15 min to get seated. We ordered a bunch of tapas to try. The food came out so fast everything was delicious. Some were so good we reordered a 2nd round. We ordered another order of the lobster rice, grilled razor clams and the codfish with honey aioli. The menu is quite bit I don’t mind going back to eat again so I can try out other food we didn’t eat to try. I definitely want to try the suckling pig 🤭

reviews.author: r m
reviews.text: This is a tapas restaurant. It doesn't seem to take reservations, so we walked in. The restaurant was spacious and crowded with many customers. The staff were friendly and worked efficiently, which we liked. We ordered the dishes in the photos, and were impressed by how delicious they were. And they were all reasonably priced! The beef and foie gras dishes were especially delicious. If we had been hungrier, we would have liked to have tried more dishes. It was a really nice restaurant. We definitely recommend going there if you're staying in Barcelona.

reviews.author: Connie Wan
reviews.text: the restaurant is very big, but also very busy, the atmosphere is good. I came here 2 times just for the Foie gras. Despite they are so packed, the service is good and fast. The Foie is exceptional, I tried langostinos, bacalao, pulpo, which are OK, but nothing special. As I am single, I don't have to wait but for bigger groups???

reviews.author: Nadine Claes
reviews.text: The food here was delicious! One of the best tapas we had in Barcelona. Came here for lunch, they said we had to wait 15 minutes to be seated (we were 2 people), but after 5 minutes they already said there was room for us! Sat at the bar, cool place, nice staff, you could really feel the atmosphere. Definitely recommend coming here!

reviews.author: Mauyeeyee
reviews.text: Had a quick bite here to experience the Tapas Culture inside the famous Mercat de la Boqueia. 🙂 Ordered two best sellers, Fried Eggs with Baby Squid and Patatas Bravas and they did not disappoint. 🙂 A little pricey for the squid dish but it was something different from other tapas bars’ menu. Glad I’ve tried that. 😌 Service was fast and friendly. My first tapas meal in Barcelona was a good start. 😊

reviews.author: Jane Liang
reviews.text: Had brunch at El Quim’s twice during my stay, there was so much to select from, I feel like I can eat here for another week. Everything was delicious & worth the money. I had the shrimp, mushroom with foie Gras & egg, Iberia ribs, peppers, Peruvian dessert & Mamma’s chocolate cake. Alberto provided excellent, efficient service with smile.

reviews.author: Rudolf H
reviews.text: Went for breakfast. They opened at 9 sharp. Ordered eggs with baby squid. They gave bread as sides for free. The fried potatoes were nicely done too. Overall a great experience.

reviews.author: Ala Al-Mubarak
reviews.text: One of the best restaurants in La Boqueria. It is always packed but the service is friendly and fast. Definitely try their patats bravas and the baby squid with fried eggs. Recommended 👍🏼

reviews.author: Mike773 U
reviews.text: 10/03/25: Barça Birthday Trip. El Quim featured on YouTube which is where we saw it. Great food, great beer and great service. Managed to find 2 seats quickly in 2 consecutive days for a bite to eat. Well worth a visit the black pudding & onions were exceptional, as was the Spanish omelette!

name: El Quim de la Boqueria
address: El Quim de la Boqueria, Barcelona, Spain

reviews.author: Mauyeeyee
reviews.text: Had a quick bite here to experience the Tapas Culture inside the famous Mercat de la Boqueia. 🙂 Ordered two best sellers, Fried Eggs with Baby Squid and Patatas Bravas and they did not disappoint. 🙂 A little pricey for the squid dish but it was something different from other tapas bars’ menu. Glad I’ve tried that. 😌 Service was fast and friendly. My first tapas meal in Barcelona was a good start. 😊

reviews.author: Jane Liang
reviews.text: Had brunch at El Quim’s twice during my stay, there was so much to select from, I feel like I can eat here for another week. Everything was delicious & worth the money. I had the shrimp, mushroom with foie Gras & egg, Iberia ribs, peppers, Peruvian dessert & Mamma’s chocolate cake. Alberto provided excellent, efficient service with smile.

reviews.author: Rudolf H
reviews.text: Went for breakfast. They opened at 9 sharp. Ordered eggs with baby squid. They gave bread as sides for free. The fried potatoes were nicely done too. Overall a great experience.

reviews.author: Ala Al-Mubarak
reviews.text: One of the best restaurants in La Boqueria. It is always packed but the service is friendly and fast. Definitely try their patats bravas and the baby squid with fried eggs. Recommended 👍🏼

reviews.author: Mike773 U
reviews.text: 10/03/25: Barça Birthday Trip. El Quim featured on YouTube which is where we saw it. Great food, great beer and great service. Managed to find 2 seats quickly in 2 consecutive days for a bite to eat. Well worth a visit the black pudding & onions were exceptional, as was the Spanish omelette!

reviews.author: Geneieve Sarah Teo
reviews.text: SO GOOD, we came here twice during our stay in Barcelona. Waited at least 40mins but worth it! If you don’t mind standing, you might get a table faster :) Recommend: - the squid (must!) - octopus - pork and peppers (must!) - potato egg cheese thing - chocolate truffle with olive oil (must!)

reviews.author: Tuğba Gürson
reviews.text: That was the best tapas experience in Barcelona We came here 2 times in 4 days. You should definitely try calamari, mussels, beef or pork/ peppers and cava Elia remembered us. Even if he is really busy! We felt so amazing there. Good food, good people. Thank you all the team

reviews.author: Aicha Kh
reviews.text: What a lovely experience💕The food was full of authentic Spanish flavors delicious, well prepared, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere felt warm and traditional, just like being in Spain. A special thank you to Lhei, who took such great care of us throughout the meal. His kindness, attention to detail, and welcoming attitude made our visit even more special 🍀🍀🍀

reviews.author: Sevde Avci
reviews.text: I had the best tapas I've had in Barcelona. The place is small and traditional. They don't accept reservations. You may have to wait in line for a long time for dinner. I've been here twice for lunch. The first time I was able to enter without waiting in line, the second time I waited in line for 15-20 minutes. Although it was very crowded, the waiters were polite, cheerful and fast. All of the tapas were delicious. Even the olive plate I had as a starter was very good. I won't praise the tapas one by one because all the tapas I tried were great. I am attaching photos of all of them.

reviews.author: Eugene Low
reviews.text: Food and atmosphere here is fantastic. Snagged a standing table by the bar and was served by the daughter of the owner (i presume), her English is fantastic and kept checking in with our meal. We ordered bread, blistered peppers (WOW), octopus w potato (beautiful), baked potato and jamon. All very delicious l. Special highlight goes to the house smoked anchovies. Excellent! Will def be back again. Be prepared to queue a little but it moved relatively quickly. Don't forget to get a glass or two or five (or a bottle) of cava and vermut

name: Street Stall - El Raval
address: Street Stall - El Raval, Barcelona, Spain

name: Street Stall - Gothic Quarter
address: Street Stall - Gothic Quarter, Barcelona, Spain

name: Street Stall - La Boqueria
address: Street Stall - La Boqueria, Barcelona, Spain

reviews.author: Francesca Angeles
reviews.text: Lots of food and drinks to choose from! I visited in the afternoon so most of the fried food I bought weren’t crunchy anymore, but the taste was still quite nice. I recommend trying the cold cuts. Not sure if I’m going back again because there are too many people, but I recommend for those visiting for the first time.

reviews.author: Ani Hovhannisyan
reviews.text: Walking through this market is definitely a must, but here’s what to expect if you plan to eat there: There are no common seating areas — only a few spots around the food stalls where they prepare meals right in front of you, and those are usually full. You also can’t sit there with food from a different stall. We bought some fruit from the stands near the entrance to take home, but unfortunately, not everything turned out to be fresh. So make sure to take a closer look at what they give you, and if possible, choose the items yourself — everything looks super fresh at first glance, but that’s not always the case.

reviews.author: Poonam Saini
reviews.text: The market was super colorful with all kinds of fruits, fresh juices, chocolates, and Spanish snacks everywhere. I tried a couple of things, and they were alright. The burrito was pretty good, but the juice? It was basically just water with barely any fruit flavor. If you’re getting juice there, make sure you pick the right stall!

reviews.author: Danielle Hollenshade
reviews.text: Beautiful to look at, but a bit overwhelming for me. The colorful fruits and wide variety of fresh seafood, meats, candies, chips, and more are impressive. There is no shortage of options. It was very crowded and I’m not a fan of food being out in the open air. Worth a quick visit, but not really my style for shopping or eating.

reviews.author: Timo K
reviews.text: It's the same store like 8 times there. 5 stores times 8 fills up the place. Places don't let you sit if you just want a drink. That was a bummer. Ham was delicious!! Not sure if any locals ever buy here. Full of tourists. Nice views though.

name: Street Stall - La Boqueria
address: Street Stall - La Boqueria, Barcelona, Spain

name: Street Stall - Poble Sec
address: Street Stall - Poble Sec, Barcelona, Spain

reviews.author: Andrea M
reviews.text: Amazing restaurants, stores, and history! The food we tried was amazing. You can spend all day here.

reviews.author: RichRich
reviews.text: Busiest street of Barcelona, despite of some renovations being done along the way we had fun. Wasn’t so bad traffic wise and all amenities made it interesting.

reviews.author: Eyitoyosi Onadipe
reviews.text: Must visit. So many things to see, eat and do on one street but be careful as this can also be a tourist trap where prices are hiked. Don’t settle for the 1st thing you see, try another.

reviews.author: Nicole Velez (Mysticfoodie)
reviews.text: Pure tourist trap. The interesting things are off the beaten path. A good starting point to venture around the city.

reviews.author: JOE THOMAS
reviews.text: Cool street vibes over here! Lots of tables and chairs to eat food and drink coffee and just watch people walking around, cool shops and shopping district as well!!

name: Street Stall - Sant Antoni
address: Street Stall - Sant Antoni, Barcelona, Spain

reviews.author: Steve T
reviews.text: Amazing meal! Definitely did not disappoint.... the famous Olive was yummy. The meal was a mixture of delights and wonderful surprises. It’s such a fun and relaxing place. The best part was their separate dessert room! It was like Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory. The desserts were all very light despite looking heavy. All were delicious and i was super stuffed after everything.... worth it!

reviews.author: Jason Yu
reviews.text: As a foreigner, process of getting a reservation online was ridiculous, but certainly try because this was one of the best restaurants we went to in Barcelona. There was a choice of tasting menu where they keep serving you dishes until you say stop, or ordering a la carte. We opted for a la carte, but it seemed most other tables didn't. Every dish was presented beautifully and tasted refined and delicious. Tapas were approximately 5 euros per portion. For two people you would need 2 portions. There were also some main dishes that were around 15-20 euros. In total we ordered approximately 9 tapas double portion, and a starter to share. We are small eaters. For dessert they give you a surprise. I won't give it away here but suffice to say dessert was also good. Although variety was less than for main courses and portions I felt were also smaller. It seems the dining experience is designed to get you to order the most number of dishes. But that's understandable, and given how good everything was, just accept and enjoy the food and experience.

reviews.author: Shane Tews
reviews.text: A fantastic wine and culinary pairing of local delicacies. It was a great experience for a group. The sommelier was as delighted to serve us her native grapes as we were to savor them with each delicious plate brought forward from the open kitchen.

reviews.author: Steven Hansen
reviews.text: YES it is expensive! But you are in for a rare treat. What a fantastic afternoon with the surprise menu for lunch and a tour at the the dessert room afterwards. Everything was planned to the smallest detail including the servings, the waiters, the show. Once in a while, spend the huge amount of money and go treat yourself with an experience at Tickets. It is well worth it!

reviews.author: Martin Saposnick
reviews.text: The food was creative and well prepared. The service was part of the “in the style of a old ice cream parlor look & feel” Not a comfortable atmosphere.There was too much running around with the servers for a relaxing feeling. We specified that we did not want spicy, but it was ignored. The wine service was clear and well executed.

reviews.author: Jon Eide
reviews.text: Great food great service - eat and drink like a local. Mushrooms and chorizo were excellent

reviews.author: Jie Ying
reviews.text: Delicious bites and friendly staffs, fuss free bistro that serves great food and drinks. Had a great time here

reviews.author: Rob Holmes
reviews.text: Friendly and fun pinxtos bar in Bilbao old town. High quality pinxtos. Good outside seating area that catches the sun.

reviews.author: Andy Edney
reviews.text: Great little bar tucked away but well worth seeking out. The setas al purgatorio were garlicky and delicious and the chorizo al inferno were lovely and smokey. They also seem to do their own wine Señorío de Bacaicoa which was very good. Overall a very high standard of pintxos.

reviews.author: MADDOGLEP
reviews.text: Popped inside as the warm weather started to fade and the wind began to blow. Sat inside as glasses blew off the outside tables. Locals do not seem bothered. Older locals crowd...more grey hairs than on a Lipizzaner horse..so I blend in well. Traditional town bar with pintxos on the counter. Paulicarus asked for the firey chorizo. All good value.

reviews.author: Demba Ba
reviews.text: I had breakfast at this amazing neighborhood joint! It's run by a lovely couple. I had the "French toast" and a spicy tortilla...maaannn. The husband made me two great coffees! He also gave me an itinerary for a day trip, called to make a reservation at the joint I went to next. Mil gracias, mil gracias por la hospitalidad y el cariño. Y pues, lo del chocolate 🫕🍫...😂🙏🏿🔥

reviews.author: Craig
reviews.text: Awesome home cooked (actually in bar kitchen) tortillas and torrijas in back road. Bring cash no card.

reviews.author: Alex T
reviews.text: great food, good price too, highly recommend

reviews.author: T. Hoan Tran
reviews.text: The best tortilla in Bilbao :) plain or sweet chili tortilla. Miguel at the bar is super friendly, he shows us his city with photos :)

reviews.author: Andreia 2201
reviews.text: The best bar in town!! If you want to taste the best tortillas, this is it! The torrijas are to die for, they're so good. The service is great and the staff is friendly.

reviews.author: Sergio B
reviews.text: A bit of a disappointment as all 3 of the pintxos I had were pretty unremarkable. The fried baby squid was the best but, still, nothing special. The broiled bacalao pintxos was creamy and pretty tasteless. Service was fine, but there's no inside seating and the place is just not pleasant in general (the terrace does seem nice).

reviews.author: Leddy Vanessa Cedeño Rodríguez
reviews.text: If you want to try the famous “pintxos” you can find them here. They have a variety and are exquisitely delicious. You can pair them with an Aguila beer. The service is good. Inside, there are no chairs to sit on, just bar-style tables, but the atmosphere is pleasant. I recommend visiting this place.

reviews.author: RJ K
reviews.text: They offer a variety of pintxos with inventive flavor combinations. I highly recommend the vaca madura con trufa and chipirón gratinado. There is plenty of room for eating inside the restaurant; you can choose to stand at the bar or eat at bistro tables.

reviews.author: Fair Rater
reviews.text: Recommended by our Abnb host, we visited and got hooked! There’s an incredible variety of pintxos and each one we tried (8 types) were delicious. A good selection of wine and desert pintxos rounds out a great culinary experience. Returning today with the goal of eventually trying every pintxo they have.

reviews.author: Mister Morelight
reviews.text: You heard about El Globo and it’s true: a great pintxos experience in the heart of Bilbao. We have tried many other pintxos bars but this one stood out as one of the better ones. Fast and efficient service, the pintxos are heated and served, you eat and drink at the counter. While the space seems small, the rotation is quick and El Globo is a great stop on a pintxos bar hoping tour. Highly recommended P.S.: if this review was helpful, please leave a quick ❤️ and thank you for it 🙏

reviews.author: Kristen Swanson
reviews.text: Best cheesecake!

reviews.author: Ana s (Anukya)
reviews.text: Great atmosphere, great music 🎶. The baby squid are delicious ❤️

reviews.author: MARTA CORONADO VALDERREY
reviews.text: A nice place for a coffee, a pot of tea, or a long drink, depending on the time... I recommend it ;-)

reviews.author: Lo Compartimos
reviews.text: 10/10 service. The pintxos are equally excellent, with the cod being a highlight. The squid rings are good, and the portions of snouts are excellent.

reviews.author: maria alejandra Castets
reviews.text: Excellent pintxos and very good price. Everything super homemade. The people who serve are very friendly and attentive. Many of the clients are people from the neighborhood which makes the atmosphere very familiar.

reviews.author: Grace Conrad
reviews.text: Incredible flavours in a lovely setting. We went for lunch and had 3 courses for €30. The highlights were: the aubergine and goats cheese starter - very intense flavour The cod with pil pil sauce - the creamy sauce was cut through with a puttanesca type sauce with the cod in. The asparagus starter was nice but the flavours were a bit simple for my liking. Brilliant service, lovely bread and coffee service.

reviews.author: Loïc D
reviews.text: Just amazing! Food , wine , service, everything perfect. Friendly and knowledgeable staff , fresh and ingredients and very good taste exploration in the food. As some said: the french toast is amazing, definitely try it.

reviews.author: Dennis Galante - Mr. Manhattan
reviews.text: We had an amazing lunch that was beyond my expectations. The flavors and freshness of everything is outstanding. Fantastic wine selection and the service was excellent. Thank you all 🌹

reviews.author: andyyy
reviews.text: this place was okay. i had the burger and my grandma had a couple pintxos. food was cold and Sangria was way way to strong. the burger was okay but weird secret sauce that nobody told you about and mustard. the mustard was okay but i don’t like mustard so it threw me off. the sparkling lemonade was refreshing and the service was great. it did take a while for the waiter to come back for our check but that’s okay. we sat outdoors and the weather was exceptional! beautiful view of the river and sculptures.

reviews.author: Kana S
reviews.text: Guggenheim Bistro is on the 2nd floor of the museum; you’ll be able to enjoy fine basque dishes for lunch. Guests select each one from starters, main and dessert. Baguette and water are included. I ordered fish soup for starters, cod balls for main, and baked apple for dessert, adding a glass of homemade orange sweet liqueur (3€). The soup contained a lot of local seafood and was packed with flavour. Cod balls are served with fried cod skin and basque traditional sauce. Baked apple was a recommendation of a restaurant staff and rather nice with thyme ice cream. I highly suggest that you try a glass of orange liqueur with the dessert. I suppose 29.50€ is reasonable and satisfying to taste this lunch in the museum.

reviews.author: Mister Morelight
reviews.text: Avoid at all costs, you will be disappointed. To make this restaurant work, you would need to fire all the staff that work there. Rude, unwelcoming, unpleasant, irritating, they basically hate their jobs and they will make you feel it. Absence of any welcome, confusion on seating area for no valid reason (ultra rigid reasoning), rushed ordering, unhelpful, impatient, we hated every minute spent in this restaurant which is surprising for such a beautiful dining room. The fish had no taste, no seasoning, the red peppers were awkward, they did not add anything to the dish. Lazy dish by a lazy chef. The steak was not better. Poor quality, very chewy, again the lazy red peppers just to throw a punch of red on the plate and cheap tasteless fried potatoes. Lazy chef. For 200€ for 4, we could have had much better in Bilbao. Don’t make our mistake, avoid. P.S.: if this review was useful to you, please leave a quick 👍, thank you 🙏

reviews.author: Lighthouse Tai Chi
reviews.text: We managed to get a cosy table for lunch and the menu del dia. There is no à la carte at lunch, but that's fine. The service is very welcoming and professional and the atmosphere busy, touristy and pleasant. People had recommended here for the decor, which is more interesting in the bar than the restaurant but very art nouveau inspired by the East. The food was a bit disappointing and average. The best dish was lentils. Perhaps the pintxos at the bar are more exciting. We enjoyed our visit and would love to try the more refined evening menu next time. This is a pricy menu del dia but the venue is unique and the service excellent

reviews.author: Paul Biehl
reviews.text: Café Iruña was my absolute culinary highlight in Bilbao! The service was great, the atmosphere and especially the place itself was fantastic, and the Pintxos simply sensational! Especially the Pintxos Moruno, and the Pintxo with Jamon and Cheese were delicious!

reviews.author: Jo Aigner
reviews.text: Lovely place with great interior features from the epoch it was built. The food was delicious and the service very nice. Happy to go back any time.

reviews.author: Jožko
reviews.text: The Soup and the Desert was good, but the steak was horrible - as a rubber, very fatty. We ordered 28 pieces (!!). Personal was nervous. Iconic restaurant, last time visiting...
