Even i found a hair in my plate I called someone to bring the senior he took the plate and run ! I didn't ask him to take it ! Im informing any tourist want to visit there that's not the real tunisian taste they making a different food with a cheap price to make look wow good price and fish more client , a place only for taking pictures .couscous with chakchouka lol

reviews.author: Darrow Carson
reviews.text: What a huge mistake. We should have known better. We do know better but we arrived around 3pm and because everyone recommended it, we figured we would just stay. If you find yourself in the same position, leave. It’s a tourist restaurant, it’s all tourists and no locals. The food is substandard. We had the “chicken ravioli” dish which was a really dry piece of chicken and small pieces of square pasta with almost no sauce. We had chicken at a roadside stand the day before which was so much better. The service was terrible. We were told to wait in a side room. They forgot about us until I went to remind them we were still there. We were finally seated and shown the fixed menu which included dessert. When it was time to order dessert, they were all out. They then wanted to charge us full prices for the appetizers and main dishes instead of the cheaper fixed menu price because we didn’t get dessert. This place is a factory. I’d much rather eat in a place where locals eat with good food.

reviews.author: Saladin Elkadiki
reviews.text: Great Restaurant in Tunis with great sea and beach view. Food and wine selection good for Tunis but there is room to improve. Steak was average, perhaps could be better. The seafood main dishes were a bit dull and not as fresh as we hoped. The calamari was too oily and too much bread batter causing it to be soggy not crisp. Should consider Italian or Greek style of Calamari. The Octopus Carpaccio was tasty and well presented but the Dorade Carpaccio was not fresh tasting and had a bit of bitter taste and the Boutarga was low grade. Some dishes were not available unfortunate but service is great and dessert selection is excellent.

reviews.author: Mahmoud Zaghloul
reviews.text: Le Pirate Monastir is a must-visit dining experience! From the moment we walked in, the staff welcomed us warmly, making us feel right at home. The unique pirate-themed decor truly sets the restaurant apart – it’s like stepping into a ship, with incredible attention to detail that adds so much charm and character to the ambiance. As for the food, the set menu is truly a feast. We started with famous Tunisian harissa, yogurt and olive dishes with bread. Then we were served a legendary seafood soup. Afterwards, an assortment of fresh seafood appetizers, each more flavorful than the last. The shrimp was perfectly cooked, the mussel dish was lightly seasoned and fresh. The octopus was crafted in a mind blowing seasoned tomato sauce.Along side 3 different Tunisian salad dishes. For the main course, the grilled fish was the standout – juicy, flaky, and served with an array of delicious side dishes that complemented it beautifully. The portions were generous, and it was clear that only high-quality ingredients were used. Dessert was the perfect ending to a fantastic meal, with a beautifully presented fruit platter and lemon sorbet that left us completely satisfied. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared and added to the overall experience. If you appreciate fresh, flavorful Mediterranean cuisine in a one-of-a-kind setting, Le Pirate Monastir is a must-try. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Bedoui Jassem
reviews.text: The restaurant is perfectly located within the Monastir port. The food quality is excellent, and the portions are generous. The dessert was wonderful, complemented by live music from a nearby singer. The staff are friendly and empathetic, making the experience even more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: I would give this place a solid 3.5/5 stars. Wish they had an a la carte menu because the quality of dishes of the set menu was all over the place - 2-3 stars for the bread, fish soup, and various appetizers, and 4 stars for the grilled fish and dessert. If I could, I would skip the appetizers and just get the grilled fish, but it all comes together for 55TND. It’s also a lot of food for one person so I feel like I created a lot of food waste. Fish soup - mostly salty, not sure if there was even any fish in it (unless it’s just supposed to have fish flavor, not fish chunks) Appetizers - most of these were unexceptional and tasted like they had been sitting out for a while Grilled fish - this was actually fresh and tasted delicious Dessert - the fruit was so perfectly ripe and juicy. Also enjoyed the citron sorbet. I was stuffed at this point and didn’t get to the plate of cookies that they served alongside mint tea All in all, the food was decent, but the restaurant could definitely use improvements.

reviews.text: The food is excellent! I got to this place expecting a menu but I directly got some fish soup and I didn't mind, then I figured out they have the same service for everyone. It was a nice experience, which I only can recommend. I will go back gladly :)

reviews.author: Ross Daniels
reviews.text: Lovely place large & nice setting. Staff were courteous & friendly. Food was ok. I think our experience was let down by the very long wait for food. That was a pity because the setting is very pleasant.

reviews.author: Diane Ha
reviews.text: It was nice and quiet during lunchtime on a Monday. Decent sized building with ample seating with different feel; sunny outdoor, partial open roof, indoor casual cafeteria feel, indoor cave wall-like romantic feel. The staff were friendly, helpful and spoke some English. The food was delicious and ingredients were fresh. I got a perfectly grilled sea bream - meat was tender and skin slightly charred, with just a hint of spices where its guts were cleared out from. The fresh salad and grilled vegetables were the perfect amount, variety and balance of flavors. The generous side dish of chickpeas, fresh fennel, olives and bread left me satiated at the end. Looking forward to going back!

reviews.author: Ayesha Seedat
reviews.text: The food was outstanding and the service was impeccable. We had the Citron line fish which was the best meal we had in Tunis !!!!!!

reviews.author: Nayeem Chowdhury
reviews.text: Food was not too great. Ordered their mix of seafood and mixed meat platters and everything on each platter was poor except the tempura prawns. The lamb chops they gave were so small it can be finished after a single bite. The meatballs and merguez tasted like paper mâche and there were no flavour to it. The calimari was hard and too rubbery, it was overcooked. The simplest item to make was the chips and they messed that up too. They were soggy as if they were microwaved. After telling the chef this, they made a fresh batch which also looked microwaved and were just hot and soggy. Don't recommend. Poor place to eat and expensive.

reviews.author: Piotr Kalkowski
reviews.text: As food presentes good, the quality of it lacks. Our meal came cold and... partially raw (!) which is not only outrageous but dangerous - we've ordered sea fruits. Service takes very long and it's focused on bigger groups.

reviews.author: A Abbous
reviews.text: This restaurant has been my favorite for about ten years. While it hasn't changed much, I’ve noticed that the prices have increased compared to other places, and the portions can sometimes be smaller. However, they still serve the best burger in Tunis. I have noticed that the quality may drop slightly during peak hours.

reviews.author: NnD
reviews.text: I just ate there, I'm a tourist and I ordered the Classic Burger. it was very delicious! Perfectly cooked. The service was fast and friendly. I highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Mina
reviews.text: My comfort food ! Hands down best burger in town . I really recommend trying it out :)

reviews.author: Corazon Camarines
reviews.text: We enjoyed the food- but we did not appreciate that the male staff (manager I think?) decided to spray (green) insect spray inside the dining area while we were there eating. Good thing we were half way eating the pasta when he did that. But not sure about the 2 take out burgers that other staff were preparing - near the sprayed area. Please note that this was an enclosed space. We informed the female staff who was gracious enough to acknowledge the feedback. Food was tasty and filling. Good for sharing. We liked the burger - meaty and juicy. Truffle pasta was great - creamy and tangy. Burrata salad was almost good - burrata exterior was rubbery and was a bit hard to chew on. Maybe they gave us an old one. Which was unfortunate because we liked the other components of the salad.

reviews.text: Great burgers, salads, and pastas! Can someatimes be really busy on weekends and you may have to sit on a long shared table, so get there earlier if you’re looking for a private table. They have lots of additions you can add to your burgers, including pork bacon. Prices range from 20-35 dinar usually per person.

reviews.text: don't be fooled by the impressive hall, the rooms are nothing like it. The room we stayed in had a bed frame that was hanging by a thread. It's a miracle it didn't break completely during the night. Cleaning is superficial at best clearly noone has cleaned under the beds for a looooong time. The whole room STANK of old stale cigarette smoke. Only reason we spend the night is that we had travelled all day and it was 2am in the morning. Everyone including kids were exhausted. Needless to say we stayed the ONE night only and will NEVER EVER stay there again! Only good point of this disgusting hotel is the location.

reviews.author: Harley van Swaay
reviews.text: This is the kind of hotel that makes you think that you have landed in some sort of a remake of The Shinning. 3/4 of the floors are abandoned with doors unhooked and cigarette buds all over the place. The windows of the rooms don't close properly which makes a creepy sound when the wind hits the building. No one seems to clean the rooms, we found dirty sheets, towels, bathroom floor etc. while the balcony was full once again of cigarette buds. To be fair, the staff is nice but that is probably due to the fact that Tunisians in general are really hospitable

reviews.author: Evangelos Balanis
reviews.text: Wi-Fi didn't work for whole 10 days that I stayed in the hotel. Everyday they would find an excuse. The staff in general was very polite apart from the lady that was one day in the reception that she was quite rude. Air condition doesn't work. The TV has only 3 very foggy arabic channels. Other than that, what you pay is what you get. 3 star hotel for Tunisian standards. In other places would barely be 2 stars

reviews.text: Dirty rooms and staff doesn't speak English. All in bathroom broken, broken lights and floor in the corner look like never was clean. Escalators shaking and its fear to use them. In breakfast area milk for coffee not fresh, kitchen trolley very dirty look like never been clean. Avoid this place there near much better hotels.

Ground floor Caffe is meeting place for half of town. It's great location, great view from hotel, quite reasonable price. I like it here.

reviews.text: "We recently visited Dar Restaurant in Tunisia, where the staff welcomed us warmly, especially Chef Nacer, who provided excellent hospitality. We were served a variety of delicious dishes, including spring rolls and fried shrimp, but the star of the show was the couscous with meat, dates, and nuts, which was incredibly tasty. The restaurant is an excellent choice for those seeking an authentic Tunisian dining experience."

reviews.text: Place would be totally empty dead in the middle of the beach and the employee won’t let a guest have dinner with nice long shorts after a day at the beach. Be aware since it is not written in their Google page about it.

reviews.text: You will ask me why I didn't give it a full 5 stares for one reason they keep rising prices it s so unreasonable but to be really is the best shawarma i ever tried in my life however you can have your food done in 5 min [shawarma sandwich] and if the were free you can have even down then 5 min before when they were the best quality _ prices in Tunisia I used to goes there weekly but now monthly

reviews.text: Cosy family-friendly place. Food is very well cooked and the quantities are generous. Highly recommend getting fried/crispy chicken. The prices are very reasonable. All in all, you get the best bang for your buck here

reviews.text: The total quality for a first time visitor extremely poor 😅.

reviews.author: Sal Mi
reviews.text: Food was great wine was good. The waiter somehow was rude and I don’t know what was wrong with him, but he was like gazing at me and giving me like side eyes for no reason and I didn’t appreciate it. It’s a good place overall but the bathroom is pretty small. There is no area for like the pictures no mirrors nothing it’s not very open spot like every other lounge or club lagls spot for taking group pictures in like mirrors or something

reviews.author: Aicha Kh
reviews.text: I'm absolutely loving this place! Everything here is so good, from the food to the cozy atmosphere 🌸

reviews.author: Sana Kaffel
reviews.text: Avoid this place, the service is horrible the guy charged us three beers instead of 2. He was so rude and even told my husband that he is not aware of how many beers he got. He gave us the money back in a very rude way and turned his back on us. I was told that the manager will come and see us until I went to see him by myself. If you want this place to remain open hire professional waiters or you will be bankrupt soon. Forget to mention that Aymen the other waiter was excellent. Please don’t spend your money on this horrible place.

reviews.author: Mina
reviews.text: The place was nice , the music was good and the decor is fancy .But the service was a bit slow , maybe because it was on a weekend , other than that it’s a nice place for a night out with friends !

reviews.author: Daniel Atherton
reviews.text: CHECK YOUR BILL!! Every time we have been here the waiter ALWAYS adds extra drinks to the bill, then we have to go through the song and dance to get them removed It’s a great vibe with good food and drinks, but come on why are you scamming people??? Management please deal with this

reviews.author: Andyjamesnelson
reviews.text: Really impressed with both the food and the hospitality. They helped me order. Then brought me extra salad. Then once I’d finished my main, they offered to bring me more for free! Amazing. The food has a real homemade authentic feels and is full of flavour. They bring you a free soup, bread and side salad to start. It’s a very popular place but everything is served quickly. It’s only open till 4pm! It’s upstairs! Cash only! I’ll definitely be back to try more. Thanks!

reviews.author: Welly Lee
reviews.text: We had a great experience at El Mida! We ordered the mechouia salad, brik, and grilled fish. The salad was flavorful, and the fish was perfectly grilled—both were absolutely delicious. The brik was made fresh, but the egg inside was a bit more raw than we prefer. What really stood out was the exceptional service. The waiters were incredibly attentive, always making sure we had enough bread and checking in on us. The meal came with complimentary bread, soup, a side dish, dessert, and mint tea, and they even offered refills on these without extra charges. Overall, a fantastic dining experience with great food and top-notch hospitality. Would definitely return!

reviews.author: openwaterraver
reviews.text: How good is this place? Let me answer this way.. we stayed nearby here for 5 days and we ate at this restaurant every day for lunch. That’s how much we enjoyed this restaurant. They have daily specials every day (except Monday when they’re closed). Food was always super fresh and delicious. Prices were very reasonable. The staff and owner were so friendly we felt like family! Places and people like this make our trip to Tunisia simply amazing!

reviews.author: Eliane Amend
reviews.text: Fantastic restaurant - best in La Marsa. We loved it so much we went again! Lovely staff, great service and the flavour is amazing! Soup starter, tea and desert included in the price. Come here early - they sell out fast!

They do dish of the day which is nice .

reviews.text: An old school kebab restaurant in Adana with a relaxed and nostalgic ambiance. Complimentary appetizer plates are a standard offering, much like in many kebab places. The minced Adana kebab is a popular choice. The service here is both quick and welcoming.

reviews.author: Zeki Akbas
reviews.text: We had an excellent Adana mince meat kebab that was simply delicious. Mr Hakim personally greeted us and showed the photos of famous people who visited this establishment during its 100 years. Service was fast and efficient. Recommended

reviews.text: Highly overrated! Has famous people on the wall visiting the place but that shouldn’t mean anything. The adana kebap is below average. It was too fatty with a dense fat taste on it. Wouldn’t be my stop next time.

reviews.text: Very popular in Adana. Food was freshly cooked. Waiters speak Arabic language.

reviews.text: although I was spectacle at first the menu was good. The taste of the meat was excellent. and most beautiful Ayran I have ever tried. Service was good but they are hurrying you up a bit. So that’s all. prices are acceptable because the meat they are given is huge

reviews.text: There are many of Adana Kebap restaurants but that is special one. Everything was good and delicious . Staff is so friendly and smiley. Price iş not cheap but it deserves. If you go at the weekend or at rush hour need to wait to be seated. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Miss O
reviews.text: Onbaşılar Kebap Restoran Şubesi in Adana is a place that left a lasting impression. Even though it’s been about three years since I visited, I still remember the incredible meal and warm atmosphere. The kaburga kebabı (lamb ribs) and patlıcan kebabı (eggplant kebab) were perfectly grilled and served on a bed of fluffy, homemade pide bread. The smoky, charred vegetables—grilled peppers and tomatoes—balanced the rich flavors of the meat beautifully. The presentation, with everything arranged on a long platter, was equally memorable. The mezze selection was fantastic. The ezme (spicy tomato salad) was fresh and tangy, the haydari (yogurt with herbs and garlic) creamy and refreshing, and the çiğ köfte (spiced raw meatballs) flavorful and tender. The turşu (pickled vegetables) and turp dilimleri (sliced radishes) added a fresh, crisp contrast. Each mezze complemented the main dishes perfectly. The homemade pide, topped with sesame seeds, was soft and warm—perfect for scooping up the mezze or kebab juices. The lively and authentic atmosphere completed the experience. If you’re in Adana, Onbaşılar Kebap is a must-visit for its outstanding food and hospitality.

reviews.author: Sevim Tuna
reviews.text: Delicious mezes and adana kebap went down a gulp. Top it off with dövme baklava stuffed with walnuts!

reviews.author: Pouya
reviews.text: It has a nice view of the lake and a beautiful small museum inside. Their Adana kebap was good.

reviews.author: Hysen Rebello
reviews.text: The food was absolutely brilliant, especially the kebabs. Just the right level of spice. The location is great too. Try to get a table close to the window. The cats are a bit of a bother. They are not afraid to grab food off the table.

reviews.author: Maria Talley
reviews.text: This is one of the local go-to spots in Famagusta. A family-style restaurant that won't leave you hungry. For $65 my mom and I shared an awesome 3 course dinner with desserts and even took a bunch of meet home with us for the next day. One thing to know is that there isn't a menu to choose from, only prix fixe, so come hungry!

reviews.author: Kirill Yerofeyev
reviews.text: Delicious and diverse food, convenient location in the heart of Famagusta, very invested and attentive staff. Who seems to be the restaurant manager was constantly checking up on us to ensure we had a great experience. Next time I’m in Cyprus I’ll make sure to visit again. We had meze and meats platter (never tasted chicken this soft), and came here for drinks the week before. Everything was top-notch

reviews.author: ABGAR GARIS
reviews.text: We went there with friends, two families midday and it was really busy but the waiters and waitresses were quick and helpful. The menu was great and the prices were reasonable. The food quality and price was great. The restaurant is by the sea and has great atmosphere. We didn't have to wait long for the food and the side dishes were also satisfying.

reviews.author: gl umz
reviews.text: We have been coming to Apsava for many years. The food and service is excellent. We couldn't finish the meat and had to take them home. The meat portion for 2 people is huge after all that meze as well. Forgot to take photos of the desserts snd fruits. The restaurant has a very cosy interior and well decorated with trees lining one side of the restaurant.

reviews.author: Jean-Marc Nginn
reviews.text: Nice place, nice restaurant located in the old town. the staff is welcoming, helpful and smiling. There are lots of tables and apparently they serve at all hours. The dishes ordered were excellent and in quantity. Fortunately, it is possible to take leftovers from your meal in doggybags. it was a nice surprise and I will definitely come back.

reviews.author: bahar dehghani
reviews.text: We ordered the Pide and the Kebab with eggplant, and both were really delicious! The portions were generous —just one of those dishes were perfect for two people. They also offered free and unlimited appetisers like salad, two types of French fries, and some super tasty Çiğ köfte. When we were finished they charged them again 😅 The staff were really friendly, even though we spoke English. Mohamad, the Arab guy, was especially kind and welcoming. After we finished our meal, they surprised us with a free tea service, which included tea, ice cream, and Knafeh. It was the perfect sweet ending after such a heavy meal! Overall, I totally recommend this place if you're looking for good food and a great experience.

reviews.author: Faleh Alrammah
reviews.text: Certainly! How about this succinct yet enticing review: --- Visited here and was utterly charmed by the authentic Turkish ambiance. The complimentary dish served upon arrival was a delightful teaser of the flavors to come. Ordered the Eskender, and it was a revelation—perfectly cooked, with flavors that transported me straight to Turkey. A must-visit for anyone craving genuine Turkish cuisine. 5 stars

reviews.author: Dr. Murat Çinici
reviews.text: I had a meal at Aspava in Kızılay. The place is clean and has a pleasant atmosphere. I ordered the “PTT” menu, which includes 4 pieces of lavash-wrapped döner, salad, fries, çiğ köfte, ezme, tea, and two desserts. The taste was average, but the portions were generous. The price was 540 TL — not cheap, not expensive, just reasonable for what you get. There were plenty of complimentary side dishes, and when I asked for an extra plate of fries, they brought it quickly, which was nice. However, the service could be better. The waiter gave off a bit of a “eat quickly and leave” vibe. Maybe it’s because I was dining alone, but a more welcoming and professional attitude would have improved the experience. Overall, it’s a decent spot with rich offerings. Would I go again? Yes. But there’s room for improvement when it comes to customer service.

reviews.author: Angus Wong
reviews.text: Even though the staff did not speak English, we could communicate with what little Turkish words I have learnt and the help of Google Translate. We ordered two mains and two drinks, but we ended up with a big feast. The starters literally filled our four seat table, and the manager was offering free refills while we were waiting for our mains. The serving size of the şiş kebap was huge, we got 5 kebaps for that one dish alone. As we finished our mains, we were served two more courses of dessert and a pot of çay. This all ended up only costing us 1045TL which is around $30 USD at the time. This is the best value meal we have ever had! Throughout our meal the wait staff and manager were friendly and helpful, and didn't rush us even though they were quite busy and had almost full capacity. Despite the language barrier, we felt welcomed.

reviews.author: Siarinho 28
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly and accommodating. There is a lot of space in the restaurant. Besides the food, many different side dishes are served. But the main course was unfortunately just average. The meat was tough and not well done. It was heavy in the stomach. Prices for the food were moderate.

reviews.author: Paulina Sobiepańska
reviews.text: Very nice place! Great live music, awesome food quality and perfect service. There is wine, beer and coctails available. Steaks, pastas, seafood and chicken, huge choice of desserts and salads also. While visit restaurant was full but it was still calm and not noisy - good, romantic atmosphere for date of friends/family meeting. Highly recommended (on weekends reservation seems to be required).

reviews.author: PAROOR HARISH MOHAN
reviews.text: Superb.. Delicious Turkish food being served. Lovely ambience and the service is also really nice.

reviews.author: Amir Mot
reviews.text: Food was above average. Service was not good! Thanks to the guy in glasses who had a clue what customer service is about, but the younger kids that served our table need to learn the business. Served cold tea, forgot my drink, never came back to check on us, but managed to give us a good share of attitude. Get better guys!! Interior is so cool, though, making it a good spot for dates and such.

reviews.author: Matt Thompson
reviews.text: Great spot for Turkish breakfast! Nice patio, excellent service, and really good food.

reviews.author: Rob Rector
reviews.text: I've eaten here four times now. I wish there was a 2.5 star rating. While the food is a 4 star - very good, clean tastes, good product - the last times I was there the live music was a complete turn off and warranted a 2 star. I don't mind music but the staff insisted on turning the volume up on the live band to the point you couldn't have a conversation with the person across the table. Normally when the live band is so loud they are substituting volume for talent but here it wasn't the case. The group was good but just way too loud. I went out to eat with my wife and friends, not with the band. Unfortunate because I probably won't go there again with Luigi's much more convenient with just as good of food, great cocktails and excellent view.

reviews.author: Páll Marvin Jónsson
reviews.text: Nice restaurant, open and spacious. Food was good, group of 30 and they did very well in serving everyone quickly and almost no hickups. Recommended for groups in need for good lunch.

reviews.author: Zeynep Kayhan
reviews.text: The place is big, stylish, new. First we tried take-away and were not happy with the food. We thought being take-away was responsible for the not so tasty pide, lahmacun and Adana kebap. So we gave a second chance as sitting in. Service was slow, orders being mixed up, personnel mimicking behind the guests. Good things about the establishment were brand new place and relatively reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Deniz TURNA
reviews.text: Our acquaintance with Necatibey continued with Tunalı. Now we were very happy to see the Çayyolu branch. Again, a stylish place was built. Large spacious areas were built. There are also garden sections. Again, the portions are filling and delicious. The service was very fast and attentive. The only problem was that we wanted döner wrap and it came as Adana. The prices are reasonable compared to Çayyolu. I recommend you try it.

reviews.author: İrfan Yüksel
reviews.text: It's literally a disgrace, it's an upstart business approach, we made a reservation, we go hours before, there's no one to greet you at the door, then you catch someone forcefully, you ask, he looks at the list in his hand, he says you don't have your name, you have a place upstairs, he makes up things, you go upstairs, the person upstairs says your reservation hasn't been taken, sit there, they show a dirty table, five of us are trying to squeeze into a table for four people, as if that wasn't enough, you wait too long in the kitchen, there's already a long queue for food, and he turns around and turns around. It's such a fiasco, it's such a terrible business, I'm surprised if anyone leaves it. As I was leaving, I looked at the tables and there were people huffing and puffing waiting for their food. This is entirely up to the boss. Unfortunately, the inadequate staff could not coordinate the unqualified staff. In the photo above, you can see the table they wanted us to sit at and the general state of the place. This is exactly what happens when money comes into the hands of people who have no experience of being a tradesman. Go and visit a museum.

reviews.author: Jig Saw
reviews.text: A complete fiasco! I didn't expect this at all. I went for iftar during Ramadan, I thought it might be because of the crowd, but this time the place was very quiet. We ate meat doner, iskender and minced meat pita, but if we hadn't. The worst of the doner that came was that we would have eaten better even at an anonymous aspava. I'm not exaggerating, the meat was cut as thick as a fruit pulp and was tasteless. The Iskender was the same thickness and unusually, it was prepared with butter spilled in the kitchen. It's here. It can't be that much. If people trust the name Kebap 49, you have to make it properly. In other words, either don't make that döner at all, and if you do, make it in a way worthy of its name. I don't think I will go there again. The prices are normal, but it is never possible to say the same for the taste...

reviews.text: Not too bussy, there is an open market every Thursday and Monday in the park near the staion.

reviews.text: That was fantastic evening with some friends with beautiful environment. But the plenty items of delicious food that was little bit exception in tasted. We ordered only fish and chips, chocolate cakes,Naan grilled but with a great desserts our evening grew very special and all the food was perfect shape in size that was extra comfort. Their table services were enough disciplined. 😘🎈🎁

reviews.author: Juan Luis Rousselot
reviews.text: If you're in Ankara and looking for a restaurant that offers not just a meal, but a complete cultural experience, Koray’s establishment is a must-visit. The service is impeccable, the staff is incredibly welcoming, and the opportunity to explore traditional Turkish flavors is one you won't want to miss. An experience very worth trying!

reviews.author: Atia Tasnim
reviews.text: The restaurant was clean and refined. As a seasoned traveler, I have never encountered a restaurant of this caliber. Their extensive menu showcases a traditional Turkish fish cuisine elevated to a fine-dining experience. We enjoyed the food and it also looks appetising.

reviews.author: Sofija Dzadzeva Aksakal
reviews.text: Impeccably clean and refined. As a seasoned traveler, I have never encountered a restaurant of this caliber. Their extensive menu showcases a traditional Turkish fish cuisine elevated to a fine-dining experience. Our exceptional service was provided by Taner, whose impeccable table manners significantly enhanced our dining experience.

reviews.author: Johannes P.
reviews.text: Awesome and delicious food. I recommend the crab and the starters. Also the staff is very friendly and well trained. Location is also super nicely decorated. There are two areas. One is close to the entrance which is really nice. We were in the backside which was not that nice but still ok. I highly recommend to go here for seafood. But it's price is more premium, but at the same time also the quality.

reviews.author: Heather Horner
reviews.text: Honestly, I am so disappointed in this place. I made a special reservation here as it was my last night in Turkey and had researched what I thought would be a fabulous dining experience with a spectacular view. Alas, I was woefully disappointed. While the restaurant itself boasts decent views, they are clouded by a perpetual cloud of smoke from everyone smoking and contaminating your food. Service was poor. The hostess had an attitude from the second we arrived and when we asked to be reseated, mere moments after first sitting, because the smoke was so intoxicating it was causing me to cough, she increased her attitude ten fold. It took us over 15 minutes to finally be served - and while the server did bring us our food, he never checked on us or asked us if we needed anything else. I wish I could say the food was good, but it was mediocre at best with nothing being seasoned. My salad still had massive, bitter stalks on the greens making it too tough and bitter to eat. If you’re looking for a nice view, you could perhaps consider this location for a sunset drink but I would highly discourage dinner or spending any meaningful amount of time here.

reviews.author: Sherry Maserati
reviews.text: Dining at 7 Mehmet was a truly unforgettable experience. From the moment we arrived, we were captivated by the incredible sea views—whether you're seated inside, upstairs, on the open or covered terrace, the scenery is absolutely stunning. The ambiance is elegant yet relaxed, spread across two stories with thoughtfully designed spaces that enhance the overall experience. The service was top-notch: attentive, efficient, and warm without being overbearing. They even offered blankets once the evening breeze picked up—a small but thoughtful touch that really stood out. The bathrooms were spotless, reflecting the same care and attention shown throughout the restaurant. Now, the food is absolutely phenomenal. This is authentic Turkish cuisine at its finest, and I couldn’t stop ordering. Every single dish was a hit: from the lofte, lamb, and chicken to the tenderloin, and that fava bean appetizer with fried onions—each plate was beautifully prepared and packed with flavor. And the desserts? A dream. The goat milk pistachio ice cream, baked rice pudding, and pumpkin dessert were the perfect finish. They were also very accommodating of gluten-free allergies, which made the experience even more enjoyable and stress-free. Yes, it's popular for a reason, so I’d highly recommend making a reservation. From ambiance and food to service and views, everything was flawless. I’m already looking forward to going back—this is a must-visit spot for anyone looking for a 5-star Turkish dining experience in Antalya.

reviews.author: Timon Lau
reviews.text: Nice to dine at one of the oldest restaurants in the city. Impressed that they have so many items on the menu can still execute them well. We especially enjoyed the köfte in the tomato sauce and the rice with bergamot and pineapple. It can be quite busy, and it seems like all the servers are always rushing off somewhere, so it can seem a bit frantic. The view outside is nice though especially during the evening. Glad we came!

reviews.author: Shaylin Osterloh
reviews.text: The location is beautiful and the food was good. We ordered the lamb chops & lamb shish & the pumpkin dessert to share. We were told the lamb shish would come with mashed potatoes and rice but when it arrived, we got fries and rice, which isn't a big deal but we weren't informed of the change. Our newly opened water bottle was dropped and smashed by our waiter but we were still charged for the full bottle. We were sat outside on the deck but there isn't a dedicated smoking section, so as a non-smoker this was a bit disappointing as the tables are quite close together and there were quite a lot of smokers around. The service was very chaotic, which is generally understandable for a busy restaurant but considering this is an upmarket restaurant, I expected more organisation from the staff and better service overall. There was no ambience considering the price. Overall this place is over hyped and I feel like your hard earned money could be spent elsewhere.

reviews.author: O S
reviews.text: I went to 7 Mehmet in Antalya and had high expectations. The view was absolutely beautiful, and the restaurant itself looked very fancy. The setting suggested a fine dining experience. Unfortunately, the food was a major letdown. The presentation was plain and uninspired, which really clashed with the upscale atmosphere. It felt like very little thought was put into how the dishes were served. For a restaurant that looks this refined, the food should reflect the same level of care and detail. Overall, it was style over substance. Great location, but the food did not come close to justifying the prices or the reputation. I left disappointed and would not return.

reviews.author: Katya Bukovneva
reviews.text: Well, taking into account that it is a touristic center full of cafes with fake reviews, it is a good place to choose. It is a stylish and cozy place with good music. There is a terrace with quite atmospheric surroundings. We had mussels and a burger. Be aware that the first burger in the menu, it is a beef cutlet with burger bread. The meat is high quality. Mussels were good as well. The staff was friendly and kind. It was quite expensive for Turkey. But maybe due to recent economic issues there, it is a new reality :(

reviews.author: Massimo Mengali
reviews.text: Best ceviche I’ve had in a long time! The margarita was perfectly balanced, and the whole menu reflects quality and care. Great vibe in the heart of Antalya’s old town. It's definitely worth a visit!

reviews.author: tugba SareS
reviews.text: The serving size was pretty small, we’d ordered quesadilla con pollo and nachos con salsa , the nachos wasn’t fresh or something it was bought from the supermarket. It was very disappointing for me as I had tried the same cuisine in the USA and Spain so I was expecting to get at least similar taste not a packaged nachos. After we ate I was still hungry. The price and the portion doesn’t really worth it. It was very expensive. The plates were already served on the table which could be a good thing for some of you guys but for me I don’t find it hygienic. There was no napkins on the table we had to ask for it. Staffs were just fine.

reviews.author: Vik
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the overall experience we had here. We booked dinner in advance one of the last nights staying in Antalya back in August. It’s a tapas kind of restaurant where you share plates between people. It was the weekend and just a couple of tables besides our were full and it was around 7pm. We ordered different kind of dishes and some were better than the other. I personally didn’t like the smoked duck meat as it had a peppery aftertaste from the wood smoke. I wasn’t a fan of the vegetable chips as Ive eaten it before and it just doesn’t sit with me whenever I try it. Everything else was delicious and we even ordered the marinated duck rolls twice. We were sitting outside and all in all the atmosphere was nice and the waiter was attentive. A pleasant experience with good food! The restaurant is on the expensive side but it’s worth it for a special night out.

reviews.author: Myriam K
reviews.text: It is such a nice place to have dinner! The food was amazing, service was great. The portion sizes are big for the main dishes and the flavour is perfect. Definitely worth the price!! We really enjoyed our food and the staff was super nice so if you’re ever strolling around the Old Town and don’t know where to have dinner (with a good vibe!) go to this place!

reviews.author: Frank Iverson
reviews.text: ⸻ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Seraser is truly something special. The interior and terrace are absolutely stunning – the most romantic and ambient setting you could imagine. The decor is elegant and inviting, perfect for a memorable night out. What made it even more magical were the cats and their kittens gently roaming around, being cared for and fed by the staff. You can tell the people here are kind and genuine. We had an unforgettable dinner, made even more special by a proposal to my fiancée. The staff treated us with so much kindness and made the evening feel truly celebratory. The food was delicious – top-tier in every way. Yes, there’s a 10% service fee added (little weird to not mention) , but it’s well-deserved. We would have tipped more regardless. Can’t recommend this place enough – perfect for a romantic night or any special occasion.

reviews.author: Andrea Attanasio
reviews.text: A Flower in the Desert! There is goodness, then...there is Excellence! 5 star solution! Extraordinary location, impeccable staff, but everything is not "beautiful if it doesn't dance"! Extraordinary dishes and for an Italian accustomed to excellence this is truly unique. Cellar First-rate wines, mellow music. They say it's a bit expensive...but remember, Excellence is right to pay for! Highly recommended! Well done.

reviews.author: Rezz
reviews.text: Excellent food and atmosphere in the heart of old town. We were greeted politely and taken to our seats. The food was extremely good, the place was clean. We had the octopus and steak.

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: Very good food and friendly Service! We loved the athmosphere and had an amazing evening. We highly recommend the moussels

reviews.author: Enrico Sereno
reviews.text: Simply the better place you can eat in Turkey if you like fine cuisine! All was just perfect.

reviews.author: Mahmoud Sabbah
reviews.text: A suitable place for hiking is beautiful and wonderful. There are several different places. There is an old mosque. You can take pictures there. When you get to a place, you will start to take pictures of the place Then you will start to take personal and memorial photos A nice and beautiful place that is useful for families or friends If you visit Antalya, I advise you to go to it

reviews.author: Assaad Chamoun
reviews.text: Republic Square (Cumhuriyet Meydanı) is a central and historically significant public space in Antalya, Turkey. Situated near the old town district of Kaleiçi, the square serves as a vibrant gathering place for both locals and tourists. At the heart of Republic Square stands the National Ascension Monument (Ulusal Yükseliş Anıtı), a prominent bronze statue unveiled in 1964. Created by sculptor Hüseyin Gezer, the monument features Mustafa Kemal Atatürk on horseback, accompanied by a boy and a girl symbolizing the nation's youth. The base of the monument includes inscriptions of key dates from Turkey's War of Independence, highlighting Atatürk's leadership in the founding of the Republic. Republic Square is more than a historical site; it's a lively cultural hub. The square frequently hosts public events, national celebrations, and cultural festivals, reflecting the city's dynamic spirit. Surrounded by cafes, restaurants, and shops, it offers visitors a chance to experience local cuisine and engage in people-watching amidst a bustling atmosphere. 📍 Accessibility and Nearby Attractions Located in the city center, Republic Square is easily accessible via public transportation and is within walking distance of several key attractions: * **Kaleiçi (Old Town):** A historic district known for its narrow streets, Ottoman-era houses, and ancient city walls. * **Antalya Marina:** Offers picturesque views of the Mediterranean Sea and is a short stroll from the square. * **Atatürk Avenue:** A bustling street lined with shops and eateries, perfect for shopping and dining.  ### 🎟️ Visitor Information * **Admission:** Free * **Opening Hours:** Open 24/7 * **Best Time to Visit:** Evenings are particularly lively, with illuminated monuments and a vibrant crowd. Republic Square stands as a testament to Antalya's rich history and contemporary culture, making it a must-visit destination for anyone exploring the city.

reviews.author: E. K. M.
reviews.text: An important square in the city center with a statue in the middle. Sometimes there are events such as concerts and fairs.

reviews.author: Reginald Jones
reviews.text: Beautiful part of town, just ip from the marina, and I mean up. If you go down to the marina, get your O2 out to get back to the top. You can walk around a number of ways from the furthest to straight up the stairs. Do not be fooled by the lift. It was closed. Keep to the cafes more than the restaurant as you will pay large prices, but for us who like a cold beer. There is a great cafe off by the side of the monument who seems to have a happy hour all day long and charges you 100tl for a large beer. With good price for food.

reviews.author: Kaisar Travels
reviews.text: A beautiful square with amazing views over the old town and harbour!

reviews.author: Oyinkan Sade Sanni
reviews.text: If you are in the area, worth viewing. I wouldn’t recommend driving a long distance to go view. These photos are all there is to see in my opinion. Too many modern architecture surrounding it. Old meets new.

reviews.author: Alex Escher
reviews.text: The gates are worth a look. Everything is free and there are restaurants all around. It's a combination of new-model columns and old stones in fringes. Particularly noteworthy is the rut about 15 centimeters deep from carts with goods in the stones under the gate, hundreds of years of trade.

reviews.author: Hyunjun Lee
reviews.text: Passing Through the Gateway to the Middle Ages It felt like stepping through a gateway into the Middle Ages. The Old Town was filled with a timeless charm, preserving the essence of a bygone era. Inside, there were shops, souvenir stalls, and restaurants lining the streets, yet the place exuded more than just a touristy atmosphere. It was a peaceful, nostalgic space infused with the spirit of the medieval past. The stone-paved alleys, low stone walls, and wooden window frames added to its enchanting character. During my month-long stay in the Old Town, I had visited this place about three times. Each visit had its own unique charm, but today felt particularly special, thanks to the beautiful weather. The warm sunlight gently illuminated the narrow streets, and the sky stretched endlessly in a brilliant shade of blue. As I wandered through the alleys, the soft melodies of street musicians and the inviting aroma of coffee filled the air, making the walk even more pleasant. As I strolled slowly, it felt as if time had slowed down. In this historic quarter, where traces of the past still linger, even a simple walk became a memorable experience. Today, the scenery, the streets, and even my own footsteps felt lighter and more joyful than ever.

reviews.author: Nabin Nazeer
reviews.text: Hadrian’s Gate is a fascinating historical landmark and a must-see when visiting Antalya. Built in honor of the Roman Emperor Hadrian’s visit in 130 AD, it’s a beautifully preserved structure that offers a glimpse into the city’s rich past. The architecture is stunning, especially the marble columns and intricate carvings. Walking through the gate feels like stepping back in time. It's located at the entrance to the old town (Kaleiçi), making it a great starting point for exploring the cobbled streets, local shops, and cafes. The area around the gate is clean and well-maintained, with plenty of photo opportunities, especially during golden hour. There are also information boards nearby that give a brief history, which is helpful for visitors who aren’t on a guided tour. Why 4 stars? While the gate itself is impressive, the surroundings can get quite crowded with tourists, and the modern city buzz just beyond it can take away from the historical atmosphere a bit. Also, some vendors nearby can be a little persistent. Overall, Hadrian’s Gate is a great stop — rich in history, easily accessible, and worth a visit when in Antalya.

reviews.author: Posh Bergie
reviews.text: Some rich history engulfed by the modern shops around it. Located in the old city, very close to Old Bazaar and right next to a car park for added convenience. Great to see this Roman monument in person

reviews.author: Sarah Lazzari
reviews.text: Rhodes is such a beautiful city. Would definitely recommend visiting!

reviews.author: Isac Dos Santos Junior
reviews.text: One place everyone should have a chance to visit. Beautiful, iconic, historical.

reviews.author: terike
reviews.text: The Old Town and tip of the peninsula is where all the amazing sites and history are, incredible place.

reviews.author: taylan acar
reviews.text: The trees and cafes are amazing. Historical sites are great. The beaches are top notch. Find a ticket if Possible and visit.

reviews.author: Greg D
reviews.text: A magical and varied island, full of deep historical architecture and rich welcoming culture. The food and wine was excellent, whether we ate simple local food or went high end. I had very little idea how liveable it would feel, as the old town has everything one could need to be comfortable. A slower simpler pace of living is possible here, and we were lucky to have stayed with a wonderful warm family that shared home cooked delights with us. We also found it easy to travel around and go to other islands. The weather is perfect for me as it’s hot yet breezy so I would recommend it to those who also enjoy that kind of feel.

reviews.author: MJ Bold
reviews.text: We visited Old town bazaar clothes shop yesterday, a truly amazing shopping experience; not only did they pay for myself and my families free taxi transport to and from our hotel. The customer service was second to none. The shop has everything you would ever want, the best clothes, footwear, designer bags, and loads more. An enormous range of the latest styles and fashions, at reasonable prices. We were made to feel really welcome by all the staff, and even given free refreshing cooling drinks. Had our every need met, by Mehmet and his excellent very friendly, polite and professional team. There were so many highlights, during our shopping trip, the adorable cats, and the astonishing clothes choices. One of the best things is after we brought lots of clothes, we were able to leave them in the trusted hands of the shop and go off sightseeing, returning later, where the taxi driver Ali who was amazing, one of the most helpful and kind person we've ever met. Delivery them and us back to our hotel. Great value for money, we would definitely comeback again. The old town shop location itself is breathtaking and a stone throw away from the famous historical Roman Hadrian's Gate and the stunning marina.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: Was recommended by family, and boy they did not disappoint, went above and beyond, fantastic people, fantastic products, fantastic quality, can't recommend enough, buy with confidence

reviews.author: Adegoke Enirayetan
reviews.text: Oscar is a nice guy, he showed me good deals that makes sense. I will definitely come back with my friends for more amazing deals

reviews.author: Tracey CHAPPELL
reviews.text: Picked up by driver and taken to old bazaar. Beautiful shopping experience, staff very helpful and quality of goods superb... They even gave free transfer back to hotel after I'd had a look around other stores. great day

reviews.author: Brad Ingber
reviews.text: The service was absolutely amazing friendly, helpful, I was greated with a beverage of my choice! I was picked up from my hotel and drop back off, free of charge. The clothes were top quality. I was really impressed with how affordable everything was for such great material and style. It’s not often you find that perfect mix of price and quality. Thank you!

reviews.text: Hidden Gem! I tried tomato soup, rica and eggplant sauté all of them was so delicious They also have Michelin Star which is another surprise

reviews.text: Who ever wants to taste local foods with simple but quality place. Remind that owner operate resturant until 16:00 just for lunch. Their policy. Glass buffet select traditional turkish and local foods instead of grill. Also restroom are quite clean.

reviews.author: Aslı Özcivelek
reviews.text: Great local restaurant. Everything we had was very tasty. They have buffet style cold and warm food options. You can make your own plate and mix multiple meze’s. Local place with a very casual setting. Service was good. Its good for a quick lunch.

reviews.author: Nikolas Voutselas
reviews.text: Amazing local food cooked fresh every day! Probably one of the best meals i had in Bodrum - nothing pretentious, just true tasty food at super affordable prices! Worth getting out of your way to try

reviews.author: C S
reviews.text: My review below is from over a year ago, things have changed here drastically, since this establishment has joined the Michelin gourmand list. I have vowed to never step a foot in here again, as prices went absolutely through the roof! Bodrum is expensive and I am willing to pay for quality, though here, after so many years, I felt ripped off badly. In December 2025 I paid 945 TL for 1 plate of green beans (no meat), 1 plate bulgur pilav, 1 plate with 5 greens and 1 water. Never again. This is the nth time I had lunch here and every single time I thought this was the very best eatery in its class in all of Bodrum. These people have been able to hold up highest standards consistently over the years. I wish there were more places like this and am grateful for it!

reviews.author: Beth Walkemeyer
reviews.text: Really stunning restaurant with a beautiful view. The service was amazing and very friendly staff. I did the tasting menu, which definitely got me out of my comfort zone. The oysters were delicious, so were the scallops and all of the seafood is very fresh. For me personally, I don’t have such a wide range when it comes to seafood and so I did find some of the dishes too much. I think for someone that loves all seafood this restaurant is perfect as there so many unique dishes and types of seafood to try. The house made wine pairing I also highly recommend. They matched perfectly with the food.

reviews.author: Burak Kayabaşı
reviews.text: Michelin-Recommended Seafood Restaurant – In the City Center, Near Zeki Müren Museum Located in the heart of the city, just a short walk from the Zeki Müren Museum, this restaurant offers a delightful dining experience with a beautiful view. Highlights: Michelin-recommended venue Primarily offers a tasting menu, but a few à la carte options are also available A seafood-focused menu, featuring daily fresh catches Dishes include mussels, oysters, shrimp, tuna, and more, all served in small, refined portions. Extensive wine list with plenty of pairing options Everything I tasted was absolutely excellent—there’s nothing negative I can say about this place. Things to Note: Reservation is required No private parking area Approximate cost: $75 per person for the tasting menu (wine not included) Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Roy Ghanem
reviews.text: Excellent food Perfect ambiance Friendly staff Specifically the owner he is in the top of the service

reviews.author: Brian Le
reviews.text: While it’s not directly on the water, the views are still awesome and a bit more quiet and away from the flashy lights and loud music. Service is outstanding. Staff are so nice and attentive but not in your face which is great. We got the tasting menu. The food is phenomenal.

reviews.author: Lava Fataka
reviews.text: Best food I have eaten in a while. Best restaurant I will likely eat in Bodrum. The salad in one of the pictures is made 100% like how my mum or grandma makes it and they’re Ottoman Turkish Iraqi’s. The view is incredible, you sit and smell jasmine flowers. The atmosphere is very chilled and beautiful, you hear birds chirping. The service is excellent and staff are super friendly. We had vegetarian a la carte which was a safe option for my mother who is not very adventurous with sea food. The vegetables were soaked in the craziest dressing ever. The olive oil they use - omg. They have a clementine drink which leaves a floral aftermath taste. We asked about few dishes and it was all local produce and you can identify from the taste and quality. The portion size was perfect as it is a la carte, we left and felt full to a healthy level. The price for what we ate is average for a Michelin awarded restaurant. Your trip to Bodrum does not count if you do not go to this restaurant.

reviews.author: Levent IŞIKLILAR
reviews.text: As a person who spent his childhood in Bursa and lives abroad, it is definitely a place I visit when I go to Bursa. The owner and chef Mr Nail continues his father's profession with success. If you go on Friday, you will also have the chance to eat halva. My favourite is 1,5 portion and shira (kind of grape juice).

reviews.author: Melisa Konak
reviews.text: Really good place. Food was amazing. Also the service was good, the people are very nice

reviews.author: Aydın Cemil Aykac
reviews.text: The right address for meatballs with pita. If you come on a Friday like us, milk halva and tea are also offered. When you enter the street where the place is located, the staff of other shops stop you and call you to the place. The fact that Yeni Hacıbey does not need such a method shows its quality.

reviews.author: Hamza
reviews.text: On 18.05.2025, after a 40-minute wait, a dish that was claimed to be meatballs with pita was put in front of us. The presentation was incomplete. The business that ran out of milk halva and roasted peppers is still stubbornly trying to turn away customers from the street and serve. The business that caused me and my guests to have stomach aches with bad oil is a complete gastronomy killer. I don't know where you will end up, but I am writing this so that you don't end up here. While they serve incompletely, their prices are not worth it for this small plate. They are very sensitive about their prices, even though they bring 300 TL less orders, you should not make the mistake of sitting in front of them. In short, especially do not introduce your guests from out of town to the famous "meatballs with pita" of Bursa here.

reviews.text: A very nice place but too much noise and there are no garbage disposals there. It is clean anyhow. Seats are available and the view is just nice. The tram can put you in front of it in addition to many bus lines. I loved it. Also there is no nearby restaurants or any place to buy food or water from.

reviews.author: amibala1
reviews.text: Good place for a visit. Could be time of year but was good to be out of the hustle and bustle of Istanbul. Got places to visit like the Han, bazaars and shrines. Plenty of mosques with great architecture. Great panaramic views from Osmans shrine. A with all the tourist hotpots, loads of places to eat. Can't really go wrong. Not 5 star because transportation was a headache as I came from Istanbul via ferry. No clear signs. Figured it out in the end but would have been helpful to have access to this info beforehand.

This statue is particularly famous among natives with the question "How many feet has the horse lifted?". The answer is, surprisingly, 0.

reviews.author: Zara Zailan
reviews.text: Visited on Friday so during Friday prayers shops will close temporarily and resume immediately after. Many cafes and textile shops. Also there is a fruit, nuts and fish market. A lot of gold and Jewelry and tasbih shops. Locals are friendly and indeed it may not be cheap but DEFINITELY cheaper than Istanbul grand bazaar (up to 50% even!). Surprisingly spent atleast 3 hours walking, eating, exploring with my young children.

reviews.author: Syeda Taslima Yesmin
reviews.text: After Istanbul, the Bursa Grand Bazaar is the second-largest bazaar. This bazaar is open almost every day, except for Sundays and Eid holidays. There are thousands of different shops and restaurants at this bazaar. This bazaar sells everything from abayas for women to hijabs, colorful cushions, prayer mats, tajbihs, carpets, and fragrances. The prayer mats, carpets, and clothing all reflect Turkish culture. Compared to the Grand Bazaar in Istanbul, I noticed that this bazaar offers significantly lower prices. However The vendors will ask you a lot of money if they discover you are a tourist, so you will need to bargain. When visiting this bazaar, make sure not to skip up the chance to try Bursa's well-known Iskandar kabab, also known as Bursa Kabab.

address: Street Stall - Koza Han, Bursa, Turkey

reviews.author: Mothusi
reviews.text: It might be a historical place. But it is occupied by cafes. And everyone smokes here. You can feel vibe of smoking heaven. If there are not many cafes here like now, it would be much beautiful and great place than now.

reviews.author: Maha Mansour
reviews.text: Visiting friends in Bursa for the Adha holiday, I was invited, among other places, to experience the special atmosphere of this charming place, the Koza Han, where people flock from various places in Turkey and around the city. It’s a huge courtyard where cafés and other shops abound, each offering their unique coffee flavor, sweets or food. We settled in one corner overlooking the yard, and waited patiently for what proved to be the best Turkish coffee I’ve tasted to date: Gözde kahve (favorite coffee). What makes it unique is the way it’s prepared slowly over coal, the way one would barbecue. The server brought the trays carrying the empty cups (each of a different color), as well as water and loukoum, a local tradition, which I find endearing. Later, when the coffee was ready, he brought each separately in a copper coffee pot, made differently to meet each of our tastes (sweet, black, half sugar). Just sitting there and observing the crowd around gives one a sense of serenity and calm, something we needed at the end of a very busy and tiring day. People sitting and chatting, others mulling around, the smell of coffee brewing hanging in the air, it’s all a pleasure one has to experience. I would definitely recommend for everyone who gets the chance to enjoy 😊 this treat.

reviews.author: baran avci
reviews.text: A very cute inn with a tiny mosque in the middle, inside there are shops selling mostly textile products, and there are also small cafes where you can drink tea and coffee.

reviews.author: Hana Seui
reviews.text: Beautiful building. Courtyard offered a serene place for a cup of tea. Bazaar style shopping to be had around the outside of building. Inside had lil shops with silk scarves and delicates. Fresh fruits and veggies galore a lil further down. Enjoyed this explorer day alot!

reviews.author: Pamuk
reviews.text: The Turkish coffee was very tasty, but honestly a bit overpriced – I paid 180 TL in total, which is over 3 euros. Still, overall a great experience!

reviews.text: Very beautiful place to hang out and spend free time

reviews.text: This is a hidden gem of Bursa. Found it way to go down near the restaurant MEHFIL Lounge. Amazing view must visit. Don’t leave Bursa if you haven’t visited it.

reviews.author: Psylenoz
reviews.text: Nice little bridge and views from around. Cafes also have nice views

reviews.author: Tuna Esmer
reviews.text: This bridge gives you the long-gone reflections of Yeşil (Green) Bursa. Apart from being a spectacular viewing spot, it also hosts the City Library. Only a few minutes away from Heykel on foot. Just be careful with finding the right underpass. Bursa has a lot of them!

reviews.author: Saleh
reviews.text: Nice place has some gift stores and cafe, but nothi g much to see.

reviews.text: Totally worth it! If not for the historical monuments then at least just for the fantastic view of old town Bursa with its beautiful old mosques and bazaars, and the gorgeous mountainside.

reviews.author: Reza Sattarzadeh Nowbari
reviews.text: The clock tower of Bursa is probably one of the most iconic buildings of the city. This tower has symbolic values now and is a very popular spot for visitors to the city.

reviews.author: Maher Baloch
reviews.text: Tophane Clock Tower is a beautiful historical landmark in Bursa with a peaceful atmosphere and breathtaking views of the city. Located near the tombs of Osman Gazi and Orhan Gazi, it’s a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the scenic surroundings after exploring the rich Ottoman history. The tower itself is well-preserved and stands tall as a symbol of the city’s heritage. The area around it is clean, well-maintained, and often filled with both locals and tourists appreciating the peaceful ambiance. Whether you’re into photography, history, or just looking for a quiet place with great views, Tophane is definitely worth a visit. A perfect blend of culture, history, and nature in one spot.

Also the restaurant itself is an authentic old beautiful building with lots of history 🤍 And they have the BEST homemade baklava!

reviews.text: We went to the restaurant. Though the food was good, it was not as good as when we first went two years ago. The atmosphere was amazing. I definitely recommend onion dolma and pottery kebab. The staff was really good, as always.

reviews.text: One of the best places where I ate real Turkish food. Exquisite flavors, vegetarian variety, excellent service. I didn't stay here, I was just passing through. 100% recommended.

reviews.author: tom lee
reviews.text: The village Mustafa Pasha may not be most famous place in Kapadocia, but it provided me the most valuable memories in the whole trip. It was actually a quiet and peaceful village, and the OLD GREEK HOUSE COULD REALLY BE A LANDMARK of the town, the host is hospitable, kind and gentle, and the architecture of his house is really AMAZING, honestly, made me astonished, also, the food and drinks r also excellent, we really had a great time there. ABOVE ALL, when I was leaving to the view point my car trapped in the snow, then the owner helped me save my car and drove me down hills, I didn’t know how to show my thankfulness, just wrote this to always remember this extraordinary day in my mind, thank you!!

reviews.author: Servet Can Özel
reviews.text: Tepsi Kebap is magnificent. The restaurant makes us feel warm in coldest winter of Capadocia. Musics are really traditional. You can feel the Turkish culture here. Waiters are too polite, I suggest kocabağ Kapadokya white wine it’s local and very tasty.

reviews.author: o gorkaya
reviews.text: That's really amazing place with cozy vibes, amazing food and astonishing view for the valley. We've tried cold and hot appetizers, meet, vegetarian main dish and dessert. Everything was amazing. Highly recommend to visit, but book in advance, it's always full. And it's deserve that 🍷

reviews.author: Beatriz Diniz
reviews.text: View: A very special moment with an impressive view of the castle! Food: The food was delicious, and the atmosphere was lovely. Service: Ottamann gave us exceptional service — he was incredibly polite and very helpful when we couldn't decide on our dishes. Price: 2 starters, 2 main dishes, 1 dessert, 2 waters, glass of wine ~ 145€ - it worth every penny!

reviews.author: Julie Scheler
reviews.text: Very good service. Our server timed all of our food perfectly. He made great recommendations. The wine the sommelier recommended was excellent.

reviews.author: Alper Öner
reviews.text: First of all, it is necessary to state that the view is very good, you can see the Pigeon Valley and the castle from a magnificent perspective, the lighting creates a great ambiance, the food includes examples from world cuisines, the food is very good, the Turkish cuisine is also a fusion of world cuisine, the taste is very good, the meat is very high quality, they offer their own wine, I especially liked their desserts, the creme brulee was one of the best creme brulee I have ever eaten, it is definitely one of the best restaurants I have ever been to, if I go to Cappadocia again, it is the first place I will go, I made a reservation two weeks in advance.

reviews.text: All was perfect, the food was tasty, the view amazing and the service accurate, polite and careful to customer needs. Our waiter, Osman, has been really good with us
