We got the mezze starter which looked fab, wasn't exactly to our palettes but it's all about trying new things. I got the meat platter which was well seasoned perhaps aside from the chicken. Overall this was really delicious Turkish cuisine

reviews.author: Jess Ma
reviews.text: We had just arrived from Istanbul where we had amazing food and we found the kebab here to be the best! It was so juicy, tender, flavorful, and large portions. We also had the meze platter, which was delicious with bread. Great value, friendly service, and delicious food. Lovely vibe and decor as well, and tucked away from the hectic and louder touristy areas.

reviews.author: Pooja Sharma-Jones
reviews.text: We read good reviews so came along for dinner. They’ve just re-opened for the season in April . Loved the vibrant decor, lovely and colourful. Hummus to start which was delicious. They kindly catered for my husbands gluten free diet too. For mains we had the chicken thigh shish and BBQ chicken wings. Both presented beautifully and was delicious. Service was excellent too. Don’t be put off my the food images on the menu, the food was very good

reviews.author: john duncan
reviews.text: Oh wow, what a meal! One of the best Turkish restaurants in Fethiye. Food was unbelievably good, so flavourful and a large portion. They make their own soft drinks which were absolutely lovely. Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Michael Hadjion
reviews.text: This restaurant has a charming courtyard setting amongst trees and lanterns. The service was attentive and quick, and the food was some of the best Turkish cuisine we have had during our holiday. We tried the Tavuk Guvec (chicken casserole) and Kuzu İncik Tandir (lamb shank). It was comfort food at its best; hearty and flavourful.

reviews.author: Han
reviews.text: Pide is a tradition here. We ordered meat with pide, and it was generously topped with flavorful meat and served on delicious, freshly baked pide bread. The service was very friendly and helpful, provided by members of the owner’s family. I definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Kris Dandachi
reviews.text: We went out to supper pretty late, but it was a quiet night at the restaurant. They took our order, and everything came out on time. We all ordered something different. The prices were decent, 220 liras to 280. The bathrooms are nice and clean. That's the first time I've seen a pretty decent bathroom. Food took about 15 to 20 minutes it flew by quickly

reviews.author: Mark Potter
reviews.text: We found this place through reading reviews and certainly was not disappointed. Good and quick service. We choose 2 different Pide and a side of seasoned home made chips and 2 soft drinks all of which were excellent and were surprised at how little the bill came too. Good food and value for money in a lovely setting. Would recommend

reviews.author: Mana
reviews.text: The nice thing about it was the one man show from the bar facing it!! When we came we wanted to eat döner and iskander but they were out of them. So had to get the lamb ( not good at all) the pizza like with meat ( we asked not to have green peppers and it was full of them) so we couldn’t eat them. The kofte was ok. Very touristic place. We knew it but didn’t find a place in the restaurant we wanted.

reviews.author: Aaron “Far Away Now”
reviews.text: Nefis Pide is always busy and for good reason. The Pide are delicious and the everyone is really friendly and welcoming. The price is also excellent and they have a large shaded outdoor seating area.

reviews.author: Seval Akgurel
reviews.text: Try Yuvalama(It’s like soup) , Antep dolma and Icli kofte. They are the best! 2 small Yuvalama was 24 TL , 2 icli kofte: 16 TL and Antep dolma: 18 TL.

reviews.author: Senol Camur
reviews.text: Very good guidance and food recommendations. Tomorrow we go there once again before we leave Gazi Antep.

reviews.author: Ian Hawkins
reviews.text: One of the nicest meals I've ever had. Very tasty and I enjoyed every mouthful. Seriously delicious. The staff were friendly and when they realised we couldn't speak Turkish they went to get someone who could speak English (I think he was the owner). Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jairus Onsafari
reviews.text: Great local eats in Antep

reviews.author: Abdulrahman Hasanato
reviews.text: One of the most know restaurants in Gaziantep. Delicious food with great service. If you visit Gaziantep you must go here.

reviews.author: Selma Ozhan
reviews.text: An amazing place! Totally felt the unique culture! Wonderful food, very friendly service (special thanks to Mr. Resit) and delightful live music by Mr. Yılmaz! A must must must place to visit!!!!

reviews.author: Hortoglu Ailesi
reviews.text: Our engagement at Bayazhan was absolutely unforgettable. I’m so glad I chose this beautiful venue. The staff was incredibly attentive, and the food oh, the food! It was so delicious, I couldn’t hold back my tears while eating. It truly moved me. The atmosphere was filled with joy and warmth as we danced and joined in the halay. Even though the space was a bit cozy, it only added to the sense of togetherness. Everyone felt so connected, and it made the evening even more special. A heartfelt thank you to Bayazhan and especially to Celal Bey and Mediha hanım, for making our special day so memorable. We couldn’t have asked for more!

reviews.author: mahmoud kamal
reviews.text: Food is good. Seating is nice. Toilet dirty flooded and toilet doors not maintaned

reviews.author: Lucian Rajah
reviews.text: We thought that this would be the classic tourist trap; high prices with poor service and average food but we were pleasantly surprised. The venue is great, I'm sure it has a great atmosphere in the evenings but as we were there for lunch it was very quiet. The service was great and the food was good. The chicken thighs were cooked perfectly. A good lunch/dinner spot that shouldn't be overlooked.

reviews.author: Marichka Makovetska
reviews.text: Great place, nice food, great service! Special thanks to Ibrahim for hospitality))

reviews.author: Ari Zingillioglu
reviews.text: Expect short waiting to be seated on the weekends. Great ambiance, fast service, friendly personnel. Prices are reasonable for quality food. We liked the Alinazik very much and the Simit Kebap. Lahmacun was worth trying but not the best in town. Overall score 4.2/5 for a Kebab Restaurant

reviews.author: Naushin Sarfraz
reviews.text: We were concerned due to some recent reviews but we did not encounter any such thing. Though we don't know turkish, we had nonproblem ordering, we were seated immediately, staff helped us and recommended excellent kebabs for us, the food lived up to its reputation, salad was amazing with pomegranate dressing, bread was fresh from the oven and the kebabs!!! I cant even begin to describe the taste. Pictures don't do justice as we were too keen to eat and didn't want to wate time taking pics:) Staff was very kind. Thank you and hope to come to gaziantep again to eat here. By the way they do help you park outside the restaurant. Just ask them at the door.

reviews.author: B.H. Al-Rawi
reviews.text: As usual in Gaziantep, the food was very good and one dish in specific was extremely tasty with new taste signature, think they called it Ali Nazek Kebab. The freshly baked local bread was delicious. The service was excellent with English speaking staff. The price is high but you are going to pay for the experience and the quality of food and for the name since it is one of the most well known places in all of Gaziantep. One point is that if you are like me a big dude the portions are small.

reviews.author: Toygar Acinci
reviews.text: Great service with good recommendations to try seasonal kebabs and best crispy lahmacun to try on your visit to Gaziantep. Thanks to Mr. Cevher for his hospitality and his honest service! Will be back there and will keep ordering their baklava to Switzerland.

reviews.author: Ekrem Erhan Gucel
reviews.text: Locals see this place as “too touristy”, even though I came here to this city as a tourist, I concur with this claim. I think the food was fantastic and the interior design matches the feel of the city. The staff was helpful and very positive. Every local folk has their own views on where to eat the best food, regardless of what people say, visit here once and decide yourself!

reviews.author: Ahmad Merhi
reviews.text: The food tasted really good. Salad and lahmacun are on the house which is a very nice touch. We came for Küşleme which this restaurant is very famous for. It was as good as we heard. Service is very friendly and price seems reasonable considering we had a lot of meat on the table. One of the biggest downsides is the location of the restaurant. The neighbourhood left little to be desired. That being said the atmosphere inside the restaurant is decent enough.

reviews.author: Toygar Acinci
reviews.text: I visited Kebapci Halil Usta again after nearly 15 years. It used to be one of my absolute favorites in Gaziantep, and while it’s still a nice place to visit, I noticed some differences this time. The meat was a bit harder and saltier compared to what I remember, which slightly affected the overall experience. That said, the salad was fresh and delicious as always, and their ayran was still as tasty and refreshing as ever. It’s clear that the place has become a bit more touristic over the years, which might have influenced the change in taste and atmosphere. Halil’in Yeri is still worth a visit, especially for those exploring Gaziantep’s food scene for the first time, but I might consider other local options next time for a more traditional experience.

reviews.author: Alina
reviews.text: I don't have words to describe how much we love this place. The food is spectacular!! The most delicious spicy gaziantep salad ever and the kebabs are incredible. I usually don't like eating liver but I loved it here, so fresh and tasty. Really really you must come here and try it!! The family who owns the place is so great too, so kind and welcoming. They made us feel at home. Really a must!!

reviews.author: Elaine Huang
reviews.text: The food is so good! All staff are so nice and friendly. It’s a must go restaurant in Gaziantep 😍

reviews.author: Haval Sadiq
reviews.text: The best meat skew that I ever had in addition to the salad was stunning, thay they brought. The baklava was also very delicious. However, it was slightly overpriced because we didn't look at the menu, and the waiter brought for us 1.5 portion, which was too much, and some of my friend couldn't finish it. The price for one portion is around 14$/p and 1.5 portion 21$/p.

reviews.author: Chandan Kumar
reviews.text: I had been to the hotel with my team for team lunch we all had enjoyed the food there and their restaurant team was very proactive and they had left us with the best dining experience.

reviews.author: Subash Thangavel
reviews.text: Delicious food

reviews.author: Sema Deniz
reviews.text: Good place

reviews.author: Derya Ulutaş Çokgüngör
reviews.text: They advise you to order it that way, saying that we are making the classic katmer, that is, we add too much pistachio and cream, and as a result, they sell one katmer for 460 TL. In other words, they also explain that they are putting twice as much material. You learn at the checkout that the price will double. Never go unless you really want to be deceived and want to eat a layer of katmer for the price of a kilo of baklava. You should choose fair places where you can eat better katmer at a much more affordable price.

reviews.author: Anıl Saat
reviews.text: Tradesmen's restaurant, family business. You can access local home-cooked dishes of Antep. It's delicious.

name: Street Stall - Bakırcılar Çarşısı
address: Street Stall - Bakırcılar Çarşısı, Gaziantep, Turkey

reviews.author: Аsiya
reviews.text: Very authentic place! Highly recommended to visit! You won’t leave without getting some new copper items for your kitchen. However, be mindful—there are both factory-made and handcrafted pieces, so prices and quality vary. Also, don’t forget to buy the famous Antep pepper! 🌶️

reviews.author: Wizard of oz
reviews.text: Was a different experience. Bit pricy but its a tourist place same as everywhere. Whatchout for bikes and motorcycles they run through the baazar recklessly

reviews.author: Fisildar
reviews.text: Shopkeepers are humble and tolerant towards tourists. Their native language is generally Turkish, but there are also some who speak Arabic. If you do not know these languages, it would be better if you go with a tour guide who speaks English and Turkish. Sellers are usually open to negotiation and will offer you tea or Turkish coffee if they understand that you are a serious customer. In this market, there are various decorated and hand-embroidered copper products that require labor to produce. There are tens of thousands of beautiful products, but you can cook very nice Turkish coffee with copper coffee pots. The pink-orange colored ones are plain copper, but the gray colored ones are tinned. These coffee pots do not take up space in your suitcase and are very light. In addition to copper, souvenir furniture and mother-of-pearl craftsmanship products can also be found in this market.

reviews.author: deep heat
reviews.text: Very nice and historical area og Gaziantep.

reviews.author: Charaine Poutasi
reviews.text: Great market with great shopping opportunities.

name: Street Stall - Elmacı Pazarı
address: Street Stall - Elmacı Pazarı, Gaziantep, Turkey

reviews.author: Simon Proudman
reviews.text: Great Turkish coffee

reviews.author: Ghazi Khozai
reviews.text: Great

reviews.author: ALGFİLO RENT A CAR
reviews.text: The last stop of the arduous journey of spices... This is the stop of those who know their taste... The harmony and magnificent harmony attracts people. It's as if one's appetite is whetted here. Everything looks so beautiful that sometimes you buy what you can't buy. The conversation is sweet. Tasting treats are pleasing. Even though the shopkeepers' persistent shouts of "here you go" are annoying, people still find it normal. Even if you don't buy one, this place offers free museum tours. Its location opposite the Coppersmiths' Bazaar adds color and continuity to your trip. It can't be explained, it can only be experienced...!

reviews.author: Mehmet Yıldırım
reviews.text: It is one of the important places to visit and visit. It should be remembered that Gaziantep is close to the coppersmiths' bazaar and a few places should definitely be visited while you are there...

reviews.author: T
reviews.text: I can recommend Saçıbeyaz to buy pistachio. There is actually an Albino brother with white hair inside. The peanuts we bought are quite fresh and I cannot say that the price is cheap compared to other places, but it is quite reasonable for that quality peanuts that you cannot find everywhere.

name: Street Stall - Gazi Muhtar
address: Street Stall - Gazi Muhtar, Gaziantep, Turkey

name: Street Stall - Gaziler Caddesi
address: Street Stall - Gaziler Caddesi, Gaziantep, Turkey

reviews.author: E G
reviews.text: I decided to eat here as it was featured in one of my cookbooks, everything we ordered was delicious! Felt like hearty home cooked meals. Staff friendly and the 90s feel to the interior was cozy and comfortable. I also found it reasonably priced for a place with such hype.

reviews.author: Elissa McQuaid
reviews.text: Had lunch here yesterday and had the pleasure to try a number of different dishes. - eggplant casserole - tasted more of green peppers than eggplant but seems fresh and tasty - eggplant and lamb casserole - delicious but had very few small pieces of lamb - zucchini fritters - really delicious - kidney beans - firm beans with yummy seasoning, not in any kind of sauce, so dry but good still - baklava - crispy and fresh All were enjoyable and the service was excellent. It was fun to look inside to see all the food in the making.

reviews.author: Devan Patel
reviews.text: Went because of the hype the Netflix show Chefs Table caused and I had a great experience. The food was very savory. It was unique flavors I had never tasted before and was not what I was expecting. The baklava was the best I have ever tasted. It was very flaky and melted in my mouth. Our host was very hospitable and kind and explained this entire menu to us. I will eat there again when I visit Istanbul.

reviews.author: Jennifer Ji
reviews.text: We had to try it due to the hype. It was confusing at first as we were told it's sold by kilo but this is just for the salad. Due to the great selections, we asked a waiter for 3 recommendations. He suggested the artichoke, chicken and beef dishes plus rice wrapped in pastry which is more than enough. When the bill came, we realised the two dishes recommended are LT700 which is on the higher side compared to most other dishes on the menu. See invoices attached for the dishes we had. The food was delicious though but you can have it for much cheaper if you select other dishes. The baklava was also really buttery and lovely. In the end when the bill came, the waiter mentioned the bill excluded tip, implying we should tip on top which was cheeky. We spent a total of LT2,600 for the meal, plus additional for the tip.

reviews.author: D K
reviews.text: I went with my daughter (who’s especially into traditional dishes) and one of her friends. Everything we ate was absolutely delicious, the dessert was amazing, and the service was genuinely great. But there’s one thing I don’t get: how can a place this good, fresh, and high-quality still get such ridiculous negative reviews? What stood out to me even more is that most of the negative comments seem to come from people from Turkey. In my opinion, this restaurant fully deserves 5 stars — I’d give more if I could. Thank you, ÇİYA🫶🏻

reviews.author: Francesca
reviews.text: This place should have better ratings. The view from here is absolutely stunning, especially at sunset. The food is good. I got the lamb, and it was well-cooked. Service was attentive and friendly, and they spoke English, which is already rare in Istanbul. The entrance of this restaurant is in the Hotel with a fancy lobby and a separate elevator to the top. It is a versatile space great for a romantic dinner or a business meal.

reviews.author: Habib Al Mulla
reviews.text: Hamdi resturant, this is the branch in Pera. Charming view and attentive service but that’s it. Food is average at best.

reviews.author: Ricco Tomassini
reviews.text: Very tasty food with reasonable prices considering the location and quality. Amazing view. Try to book a table just next to the windows for best experience.

reviews.author: Steve Chappell
reviews.text: Very nice terrace restaurant on top of the Radisson. Wasn't so busy on the night we went which meant we could question the helpful and polite staff about a cuisine of which we had limited awareness. Delightful results, lamb chops were wonderful... and the view... simply stunning.

reviews.author: Mohammad Heidari
reviews.text: Beautiful panoramic view. Delicious food. I tried the pistachio kabob and it was really good and unique. They bake their own bread and it was fresh and yummy. Quick tip: try to go there close to sunset time to see the town both bright and dark.

reviews.author: Francesca

It is a versatile space great for a romantic dinner or a business meal.

reviews.author: Yutong Dong
reviews.text: We were expecting a quick bite before the dessert next door , it was quick light and easy. Very flavorful, very healthy and delightful. We love the atmosphere, the veggie selections and the seafood, just to be clear we are not looking for a formal dinner, it was an easy drop in without reservations, no long waiting, perfect. If you’re looking for a proper dinner or meal , put your expectations low, it’s definitely not the place for bow tie and gown. But a fresh easy urban kitchen for people with delicate pallet

reviews.author: Farid Hamka
reviews.text: Lovely mezzes (especially the yoghurt and the tabbouleh), which is a great indicaation of the quality of an eatery in Turkey. The roast lamb chops are so delicious, almost melt in the mouth.

reviews.author: Tingting Lin
reviews.text: would not recommend.. overall quite bad experience 1. worst octopus ever - we ordered the octopus hot starter but it was so dry and difficult to even cut.. 2. bad service - waiters refused to add hot water in our herbal tea cups and they just ordered another round for us?! We were so confused as it was just tea bags, but they trapped us into paying double the price

reviews.author: Rovik Robert
reviews.text: Was quite disappointed by my experience here - figured they tucked me away because I was post-surgery but they forgot all about me most of my meal and I had to keep trying to get attention to place my order and check on my meal. Food is decent but nothing worth shouting about in my opinion. Would pass on this.

reviews.author: Mariam B (mariamtea)
reviews.text: I walked in without a reservation at 5pm and there were plenty of tables available. The food was basic but well made. I would definitely come again. The mezze is fresh and they have carious options hot and cold.

reviews.author: Yutong Dong
reviews.text: We were expecting a quick bite before the dessert next door , it was quick light and easy. Very flavorful, very healthy and delightful. reviews.text: I walked in without a reservation at 5pm and there were plenty of tables available. The food was basic but well made. I would definitely come again. The mezze is fresh and they have carious options hot and cold.

reviews.author: Alexis Pulido
reviews.text: I recently had the tasting menu at the restaurant and was thoroughly impressed. The Slow Cooked Beef Short Rib was particularly delectable, with its tender and melt-in-your-mouth texture. The Bolet Mushroom was also flavorful and creamy. The service was exceptional, and the city views were breathtaking. I highly recommend the tasting menu to anyone seeking a memorable dining experience.

reviews.author: celine parris
reviews.text: My husband and I just had dinner at Mikla and had the best fine-dining experience on our entire 10-day visit to Istanbul. The food was absolutely beautiful and the portions were surprisingly generous, but even more so, the service was next-level. It is clear that everyone who works here is exceptionally well-trained in fine-dining service and they all made us feel so very welcomed. It was truly an unforgettable dinner service and we will surely be back on our next trip to this city of delicious food and beautiful restaurants.

reviews.author: Julia Jyde
reviews.text: starry!!!!! firstly, this is the most welcomed i’ve felt in a restaurant. the service is so well-mannered and kind and attentive. truly deserving of the michelin star. the dirty martini was well made, and the white wine we had was fantastic, really light and fruity. the complementary crudités and bread were unbelievable. particularly the little sardine crisp! and i’m telling you, i really dont like olive oil, but this Turkish olive oil with the bread, i fell in love with. i could drink it pure. for a starter, the lamb’s heart was spectacular. soft and tender and the purée was sweet and nutty, reminiscent of all things good. the dry aged beef as a main was crazy. so much juicy meat, spectacularly flavourful just by good cooking. i did miss some flaky salt on it but the well-seasoned sides compensated. i think the kale was so good and crispy and i’m a sucker for layered crispy potatoes. for dessert i highly recommend the bitter chocolate! like a nice elongated dark praline with a tangy cherry-berry sorbet. yum. overall, great date night spot, and terribly delicious. the cocktail list is so long and its worth going just for that and some amazing Istanbul views. but also stay for a show-stopping meal!

reviews.author: Adam Borden
reviews.text: Service was excellent, and the food delicious. Make sure to ask for a table on the outside terrace to take in the full city views! The interior dining room is lovely but does not have quite the same ambience.

reviews.author: WeiRong Kang
reviews.text: A nice fine dining restaurant with very nice views. They had enough service staffs to attend to you even when the restaurant is crowded. Being michelin starred, we came here to try on one night. Since we are just short time travellers, we did not exactly dress very well for it but luckily the staff were still nice. Had the tasting menu and a bottle of red (which were recommended by them) and it was good. The tasting menu was a little pricey but it had all the proteins you want from fish to duck to lamb. We were overfed that night! And we thought that the menu could be adjusted a little to ensure that diners still have the appetite to continue. We were already full halfway through the 7-8 course meal and probably did not really enjoy the dishes fully at the end. The dishes were actually nice, but could be better if they can play around with the ingredients a little more by cutting the quantity but add more flavors. It would be a 5 star if they could do that. Comparing to other similar restaurants we tried, I think they could do a little more given the price. I would recommend that you only choose the tasting menu if you have a big appetite or really hungry. If not, suggest to choose other options which could be actually better.

reviews.author: Catalin Vasilescu
reviews.text: The best restaurant I’ve been to in Istanbul so far! The beef was incredibly tender and juicy - absolutely delicious. The waiters were very professional and friendly, which made the experience even better.

reviews.author: Hus Bico
reviews.text: Best Istanbul experience u can get for your money, the food was 10/10 maybe the best sushi i tried in a long time. The cocktails were classic and tasty and the bartender was the show, good humor and and polite. Do your a favor and try this place if your are in Istanbul and go all in.

reviews.author: meizar jamhour
reviews.text: This place, the staff, the food/meat deserve 5 stars. I just wish they work a little bit on the reservation, I mean I shouldn’t wait for an hour when I already made a reservation few hours ahead!! Because everyone is limited on time especially when you are on vacation.

reviews.author: Vanessa Leite
reviews.text: Great experience and food. Food was delicious and waiter was very attentive. Its more on the pricy side but u go for the experience. Waiter does stay around you the whole time. We enjoyed very much our experience and would be back at our next visit. The sirloin we had was delicious cooked in butter just wow. And u must try the dessert even if ur full have 1 the backlava with ice cream was soo good. And the show they do with meat cutting and salt even for dessert is great.

reviews.author: Daryoush Ramazani
reviews.text: Just close your eyes and choose whatever you want,itll blow your mind,carpaccio is better than italy,steak is better than states,and dont forget to get tour baklawa,it was so good i took picture a bit too late😂.

reviews.author: Олександр Калашник
reviews.text: Good service, not so expensive)

reviews.author: Bülent Yıldız
reviews.text: They have very delicious menus. Both fish, grilled and appetizers are wonderful. Cretan girls used to make the best appetizers. We also had the chance... The service and friendliness are great. I recommend...

reviews.author: Erkan Zeybek
reviews.text: Very nice, reasonable prices. Live music. At the end of the promenade but worth it.

reviews.author: BEYZADEM MEKAN DETEKTİFİ İnternational
reviews.text: Fish and its services are suitable for those who want to stay in the city, not the sea.

reviews.author: ümit tomar
reviews.text: Grilled menus, conversation and food in a nice, comfortable and pleasant environment

reviews.author: issilay
reviews.text: Surprisingly there was no queue at the entrance as there was some protests going on in the city. The view is so nice. If you are not going to sit at the cafe/restaurant 10 minutes is enough to take photos and see around.

reviews.author: Dejan Antonijevikj
reviews.text: Great view, build 1907 by Jewish Philanthropist offers great view on city Seaside. Upstairs 2 nice Restaurants

reviews.author: Deniz Yıldırım
reviews.text: A must if you are here for touristic purposes. You shouldn't expect much from the elevator itself since it is basically an elevator and nothing else, but the scenery on top is spectacular. The cafeteria/restaurant on top doesn't offer much, I guess sometimes you have to accept that it is the view but not the actual quality that you pay for. Nevertheless, it is an experience worth trying.

reviews.author: Mohamed Elgendy
reviews.text: Nice spot to oversee the city of İzmir. Must visit, don't ignore. Spend some time upthere and don't rush.

reviews.author: Laura Iancu
reviews.text: Best view of Izmir and a really good place to take a few good pictures of the city.Definetely would recommend it

reviews.author: KiraCherry38
reviews.text: I was sitting there, scanning the QR Code and waiting to order the items of my choice. 10 minutes 20 minutes 30 minutes The waitress was asking everyone around me, if they had already ordered and if everything was fine(except me). So I opened Google Maps and checked the reviews: There seems to be a pattern with ignoring customers and the cafe owner even replies very rudely under the reviews. Enjoy the view and the elevator, but don't spend your money on this cafe!

reviews.author: melinda patricia
reviews.text: İt's another attraction in İzmir . The location is arround nostalgic area, many cute Cafes surrounding. Asansör means the elevator in turkish. On the top there is a cafe run by municipality , the food is ok. You can see nice views from up there . they served any beverages, breakfast, and others snackies 😁.

reviews.author: ivy jorelle
reviews.text: Waiters are helpful and welcoming. The qr code was not working on my phone and the nice bar lady handed out the menu on her phone. I ordered an Aperol spritz but was on on the drink list but they offered another drink which was good as well. The views of the place is great.

reviews.author: Charlotte
reviews.text: Thank you so much a very classy evening, the meal was lovely 3 courses with the amazing views and friendly service . I highly recommend this restaurant and will visit again everything was perfect and I enjoyed my take away dessert today the fruit is lovely and fresh and delicious. Much appreciated

reviews.author: Brian Watson
reviews.text: Great views and very friendly staff. Would recommend to anyone visiting Izmir :)

reviews.author: Tanya Hasanniazi
reviews.text: Went there because of their reviews, worth it, especially their calamari was very fresh, their meze was fresh too. The only issue was their bread, would expect a newly baked bread. The staff are very attentive and the atmosphere is nice for an hour or two.

reviews.author: Douglas Shin
reviews.text: İzmir Sea View Restaurant / If you're looking for a seafood restaurant with a stunning view, İzmir Deniz Restaurant stands out as one of the most beautifully located spots along the İzmir coastline. Especially at sunset, the sea glows in golden hues, creating a perfect setting for a romantic meal or a peaceful dinner with friends. The restaurant offers a refined ambiance and is popular among locals—always a good sign of authenticity. The service was attentive, and the environment was calm and sophisticated. While the sunset view is truly unforgettable and the setting feels upscale, there were some aspects that felt slightly underwhelming considering the price point. #IzmirSeaView #DenizRestaurant #SunsetDinner

reviews.author: Pouya Safa
reviews.text: I saw this place from a famous YouTuber video, as a tourist in Izmir I wanted to get a taste of Ege cuisine and Im glad I came to this restaurant the food quality and options were great and thanks to everyone in kitchen, however there are some things that really piss me off, first thing was Service, it was slow and highly biased, there were hidden charges which Are Illegal in Turkey like servis fee and charging 200+(7$)for just bringing water and plain bread, overall; the place the food and the atmosphere were great but at this price point and with all these added costs I recommend another place.

reviews.author: Zee B.
reviews.text: I have searched for the best fish restaurants in Izmir and this restaurant kept showing on top list so i gave it a try. To be honest the food in Izmir is more expensive than Istanbul we paid almost 150$ for 2 adults 2 kids and we left hungry. They only had 3-4 types of fish to choose from for a fish restaurant. Many varieties on the menu we asked for they said they did not have. A common thing among restaurants in Izmir is that they charge for couvre ( which is basically the use of utensils and plates) such a weird concept in my opinion and never seen it before. Would not recommend it for sure.

reviews.author: Mehmet
reviews.text: I got the fiery atom dip, a refreshing arugula tomato mix, and a pair of crisply fried red mullets. The atom was a delightful kick of spice balanced with rich yogurt. The salad had a fresh snap to it. Those mullets? Fresh and crispy. Service? Top-notch. One of the standout dining experiences I've had. A must-visit!

reviews.author: Tanya Hasanniazi
reviews.text: Went there because of their reviews, worth it, especially their calamari was very fresh, their meze was fresh too. The only issue was their bread, would expect a newly baked bread. The staff are very attentive and the atmosphere is nice for an hour or two.

reviews.author: Myeongjin Son
reviews.text: Good fresh fish and good service.

reviews.author: Liliya Ivanilova
reviews.text: The best place in whole İzmir to eat calamari!!! However, normally, such places supposed to be on the seashore, this one in the middle of stone jungles 😂 but if your goal is to get the most tasty fish or calamari it's definitely this one!!! I cannot say the same for shrimps, but it's matter of preferences😅 everything was amazing: food, service, care of customer... unfortunately, I didn't click any photo, because the taste made me lost my mind))) thanks a lot to the cooker.

reviews.author: Jingkun Zeng
reviews.text: We came here twice for dinner. Delicious salad, calamari and grilled fish. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Meir Niv
reviews.text: The best fish restaurant in izmir. I visit friends and they take me. Fresh fish and food very very tasty. Amazing service.

reviews.author: Yakob T.
reviews.text: Amazing fish! Good for meetings. Been there at 13:30 o’clock. Service was very friendly and they serve standard liquor as well.

reviews.author: Kev
reviews.text: This place is huge. One can find anything from printing service to suits and souvenirs. Of course there are a lot of restaurants and cafes. There is no need to visit every corner of it. Maybe just casually stroll and see where one is lead to.

reviews.author: Gabrielle Trebus
reviews.text: Really nice bazaar with everything from food to house utilities and party supplies. I had a lot of fun just walking and exploring

reviews.author: Kagalek T
reviews.text: I visited that bazaar. So beautiful, large. People so kind. But some of shop scammed me. He charged price for me. Anyway. They have problems with toilet. Only 1 toilet and it cost 15 tl. Stuff is not cheap. The same price as the other local shops. On the pic it’s restaurant. I went to their toilet for a while and waiter just took all my orders before i finished. Although I warned them not to touch it, that I would be back.

reviews.author: Asma Alfa
reviews.text: The place where you can find anything (affordable prices) It’s almost the heart of İzmir also an old shopping place Mixed between modern and antique,be careful sometimes it fells like a maze. Weekends and holidays might be so crowded than usual. There are Cafe,restaurant,shop,office, even bridal markets and many

reviews.author: Michael Lambert
reviews.text: Unlike Istanbul’s bustling bazaars, Izmir stands out with a broader selection of fresh fish and seafood, reflecting its coastal charm. The markets here also offer high-quality imitation products that are impressively crafted. The overall atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, making the shopping experience not just about the goods, but also the positive, laid-back vibe.

reviews.author: Sena Kaur
reviews.text: Based on the amount of good reviews we wandered in. They service is nice but unfortunately we both got sick after eating here. We had the mushroom pasta and şiş tavuk (grilled chicken). We really wanted to like this unfortunately there were too many flies inside to enjoy, i am sure everyone works very hard here but we did not have a good experience

reviews.author: Mohamed Al-Kooheji
reviews.text: The Goat soup was great, the tomato one not so much. The lamb chops were great and so were the pickled beetroot and labneh dish (spicy).

reviews.author: Hozefa Koita
reviews.text: Great service. Nice food and busy restaurant near to Izmir Marriott and other hotels nearby. Staff friendly and helpful. Adana Kebab, Tavuk Sote, Chicken with Basil sauce, Kunafa and Cay.

reviews.author: Payam Shirazi
reviews.text: Inside is very clean and smells fresh. Surprisingly, no cigarette odor is present inside. A/C is working fine. Staff are friendly and courteous.

reviews.author: Cosmin Gabriel Paunescu
reviews.text: I have been to this restaurant several times, which is often one of the best in Izmir. The food is good, on the other hand, the only thing that I noticed in a more unpleasant way is the prices that exploded. You can't give 500 TL on Iskender, when you get less than 300g of meat. There are restaurants that still have reasonable prices of 300 TL for meat products.

reviews.author: lee freeman
reviews.text: Begrudgingly given sample of Pistachio. It tasted of BAD freezer burn. I requested to taste the melon in order to make a purchase and was refused by the employee. "Only ONE taste! " Insulting and poor business. I walked away.

reviews.author: Esin Çelebi Bowyer
reviews.text: Open air or indoors you can have options to sit an relax for a moment with a cuppa and nice selection of cakes and pastries. Other than that, it is an amazing place to get your self design birthday cakes. I was looking for a place to get a special birthday cake for my husbands. I described what I wanted with a photo. They made an amazing job. I must admit it isreasonably priced too.thanks to Ali Osman bey, my surprise birthday cake. It is beyond my expectations.

reviews.author: Bert (neverstopbert)
reviews.text: Delicious Baklava, they had a good amount of options when we went to order for take-out. Try it for yourself.

reviews.author: Alina
reviews.text: good pistachio ice cream, but overprice sorry not sorry

reviews.author: Dina Astayeva
reviews.text: Accidentally found this place while looking for baklava take away. really nice baklava, good service. So today we came back here again & sit inside, ordered baklava & desserts.

reviews.author: Salma Murad
reviews.text: I have been staying in this hotel for yearsssss every time I am in Dahab . The friendly staff , the biiiiiig rooms, the rooom and the perfect location 💜

reviews.author: Nouran Reda
reviews.text: In all honesty, the location is close to everything, sea front… the staff is beyond supportive and helpful. Very reasonable prices 100% recommend

reviews.author: Ahmad Salem
reviews.text: The location is excellent in the centre of Masbat Bay. The side view is a good option looking over souvenir shops, side-seaview, and side- mountainview. Breakfast is nice, and the chef is very helpful. Staff are helpful and honest. Suitable for families. The only problem comes out off the hotel; Surrounded by the crowded area of the market, the problem lies especially with the other kitchen of the Ali Baba restaurant, which doesn't belong to the hotel, making a lot of noise with tools and yelling at each other. N.B. The dining area of the hotel on the roof offers a magnificent view 👌🏻

reviews.author: Tarek Anwar
reviews.text: Good price, great location. Old school egyptian room style. A bit unclean though. Service a tad lacking although everyone is very friendly. Highlight is the roof where you can Egyptian breakfast.

reviews.author: Hala El-atr
reviews.text: Friendly stuff🙏🏼, and Great location👌, but room’s furniture is old, dusty☹️, and they not provide minibar service inside the room😠, however when I asked for, they provided me a kettle to assure my satisfaction. My point is don’t expect lavish service, but the stuff here really are amazing 👌and will do their best to make you comfortable and happy.🥰😀😀

reviews.author: Mahmoud Al-Wreikat (JY5HL)
reviews.text: The best fish restaurant ever in Aqaba. The food is very delicious, the service is very excellent, and the service is also very fast. The owner, management and staff are excellent and very friendly. Prices are reasonable and affordable. I highly recommend going there for lunch and/or dinner.

reviews.author: Alia Barahmeh
reviews.text: Great lunch experience at Alibaba in Aqaba! Tried various seafood dishes, ribs, biryani, and appetizers - all delicious. Outdoor seating is cool, centrally located in downtown. Easy taxi access from hotels. Prices fair for quality. Staff very friendly. Loved it!

reviews.author: AL Hanadi
reviews.text: I don’t if they are good at or not, We tried grilled meet mashawi, tabbouleh and chilli potato and yalanji, it was not good at all Sour tabbouleh, very dry and hard rice inside the yalanji Chilli potato was nice Rice was nice. Staff is perfect 👌🏽 very friendly and welcoming. Atmosphere is vintage and awesome.

reviews.author: Laura Carr
reviews.text: The fish was beautiful and fresh, cooked to perfection. The service was impeccable, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Rhys Travel
reviews.text: Delicious food especially fish sayadiyah, grilled shrimps and mixed grilled meat were all great. We had to wait maybe 15-20 mins for the food as they're very busy. It's probably a touristy place and it's comfortable and clean. We also had three drinks and kunafa and baklavas. The bill came to about 55JD for three of us with service and tax included.

reviews.author: Becca Rice
reviews.text: Tucked away in a side street, this quaint spot is a true gem of a restaurant. It looks modest from the outside, but from the moment you enter it's a quality experience all the way. Everything is prepared with care and fantastic quality. The staff are attentive, friendly and ready to offer guidance with the menu. We had several small dishes to be able to try a variety of flavors and from the first savory dish down to the dessert, it was all incredible. We didn't even think to take photos because we were so absorbed in the dishes presented to us! We will definitely be back! A big thank you to this wonderful place for such a great culinary experience ❤️

reviews.author: Ale K
reviews.text: I have been going to this restaurant for years and it has consistently been excellent. It's a small and intimate restaurant, so making a reservation is highly recommended. The food is truly delicious, offering a wonderful selection of hot and cold meze. The main courses are superb, and to finish, they have delicious desserts and excellent domestic coffee.

reviews.author: Ajay Parekh
reviews.text: 5 stars well deserved! Service with a smile and attention, food was tasty and plentiful. We were a group of six on our last night in Malta. Two of us had the vegetarian mezze items, the other four had the main meat dishes also ( no vegetarian options for main course), although too full to have any dessert. Oh and the wine list is extensive and we chose well with our red.

reviews.author: Mafalda Pedro
reviews.text: AMAZING!! We found this place on google when looking for a place for dinner last minute that was close to where we were staying in Gzira, and omg we were impressed!! Between the 2 of us we got a range of plates to share and we were so impressed by everything. We really recommend the lamb, it was so tender and juicy and probably the best lamb we've ever had! Everything else was equally amazing. We had some Lebanese wine that was so good as well. We were being constantly impressed whenever everything came out. The service was amazing and the restaurant didn't disappoint.

reviews.author: David Fenech
reviews.text: We have been before but it’s been a while, so we were looking forward to enjoying some very good Mediterranean/ Middle Eastern food. The serving staff as smart and attentive as always - they deserve the best accolades as much as the cooking staff for their amazing food. We asked for our Albanian server to choose the food for us and he made some great choices. The starter hummus dips and lamb/harissa dip were so nice with the fresh bread. We felt the felafal had a very hard / burnt exterior shell, but all the meat based dishes were simply divine, including the lamb tongue. The wine is on the expensive side and the servers tried to sell more of it - doing their job. But the biggest hang up we had was the heat in the restaurant- we really couldn’t imagine eating there in summer. Having said that, I’m in love with this place - recommended

reviews.author: Jonas Bürgi
reviews.text: Some of the best food I have ever eaten in my life. There is only one dish - but this dish is perfect. There is one waiter who can speak english very well.

reviews.author: Sara Ahmed Fouad
reviews.text: The meat taste is really different. I was advised to try it, but I didn't give a big importance for the advice. Now I know, it deserves 😊

reviews.author: Safae Kherbouche
reviews.text: This place deserves 100 stars, if you ever come to Konya this place is a must try

reviews.author: Amin Memari
reviews.text: The best Turkish firing kabab you can find here, the pure taste of lamb with fresh bread takes you to the extreme of enjoyment. We ordered some Turkish sweets with tea, a great combination 👍 strongly recommend it.

reviews.author: Lennart Garritsen
reviews.text: This place is a true scam. I went here because of the reviews. They specialised in lamb with onions and bread (nothing else on offer). Food is good but fatty and service is friendly. But: very high price - 150gr plus water was 425TL… price quality is insanely bad. Other places charge way less despite owners claims. Will never return here…

reviews.author: dev naz Animal Rescue
reviews.text: I have to say this place is absolutely amazing! We were not expecting to have such a great time here, we randomly stumbled upon this place while we were walking on the main strip. We asked for a menu but they said leave it to us. From soil to your plate this place is an award winner In gastronomy. We enjoyed every plate they sent out to us, roughly takes an hour to complete the whole meal. Every meal that came they gave us information about each plate, then the chef came out to ask if we were happy with the meals. We went at a time where it was completely empty because we came in the afternoon. Its a woman’s business so its another reason to support them.

reviews.author: Mehmet Yildirim
reviews.text: Food is right but they have to learn Bring water at first or ask it Make taste vine and not pour it directly to glass One type of bier worst in turkey Efes Came to table with can Unbelievable for a pretending restaurant

reviews.author: hans nijhuis
reviews.text: Location is perfect. Views amazing and service perfect. We came in for lunch and i guess they are not really into this. Food was good, but not special. But views and service made up for it. We paid 650 tl for lunch and soda so for us it was oke. Thanks again for serving lunch while i guess you were not expecting it.

reviews.author: Ilias Pantos
reviews.text: Definitely worth visiting and tasting . The whole ritual of eating and dinning is excellent. The different tastes are very balanced especially for the starters and the dip plate ! Service is great and even though no one speaks English it never seems to be a problem. This is because the whole atmosphere and setting is so good !

reviews.author: Munira Saleh
reviews.text: The place is pretty with intricate decor. The decoration pieces are beautiful and were chosen well. The food reflects tha Mardin cuisine with a stylish presentation. The taste of the food is ok but I think is overrated.all of this is what would you expect when reviewing a restuarant. But what is a bit of a shock is the attitude of the staff. Most of them in general. I tried not to be biased and just review the place, but it was overwhelming.

reviews.author: Zekeriya sen
reviews.text: Very local and cosy. Don't go for any fancy expectation. The kebab is basis fresh Mardin Kebap. Not a wow but quite decent. Will go every time I come to Mardin.

reviews.author: mustafa hastak
reviews.text: MK

reviews.author: UFUK BATUM
reviews.text: classical 👍

reviews.author: Emrah Ozan UTKU
reviews.text: Approximately 13 years later, I came to this place to find the old taste again, but I could not find the old taste, service or atmosphere. They don't even have any tea to serve, and the taste and quality of the food has dropped significantly. We came to reminisce about the old days, but we dreamed of silence. Again??? NEVER.

reviews.author: Burak Yildirim
reviews.text: It's a very expensive place, two portions of kebab are 800 TL, meat is expensive, etc., but can you buy 150 TL for 3 open ayran in a business? It's a shame, it's a sin, people have no conscience, mercy anymore. We drank the same open ayran for 75 lira at Xale Meheme in Diyarbakır. I hope you read this review before you go and decide accordingly.

reviews.author: lee lee
reviews.text: This restaurant is truly exceptional — not only is the food absolutely delicious, but the atmosphere is also warm and inviting. The owner is incredibly kind and welcoming, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. One of the standout features is the generous portion sizes — you’re not only getting quantity but also outstanding quality, with every dish prepared with great care and attention to detail. What I especially appreciate is the restaurant’s honesty and integrity. Unlike some other places that may try to take advantage of tourists by inflating prices, this restaurant is fair and transparent in its pricing, which builds a great deal of trust. Normally, I don’t write reviews, but I felt compelled to share my experience because I truly want this place to thrive. I highly recommend visiting — it’s an experience you won’t regret. Just one important note: be sure to make a reservation in advance

reviews.author: Joey Chan
reviews.text: Had a great dinner here. The lovely couple put lots of effort in the little details in the dining experience they provide for diners. When I ordered a glass of white wine, the owner let me taste four types of white wine before settling on my favourite one. And for our food, they provided dozens of sauces for our choosing to pair with our salad and fries along with our mains. The portions were huge by the way! At the end we were gifted coffee and/or tea, also a cute magnet and some water and chocolates to go because they knew we were flying the next day! Their hospitality was top-notch and heartwarming. Thanks again for the lovely meal!

reviews.author: hee
reviews.text: If I could give 6 stars i would! The service is impeccable! The owner puts so much of care into the presentation and dining experience. The chicken wing, tenderloin and mushroom with cheese that we had was delicious! The highlight was all the sauces available and the homemade pomegranate sauce that they have for the salad! Would highly recommend if you are in the area! Remember to make a reservation!

reviews.author: 방민진
reviews.text: I am Korean, but I want this restaurant to be known to people all over the world, so I am writing a review in English! As soon as I entered, they poured me water. This was the first time I have ever seen a restaurant that served water for free. It was not just about the price, but it felt like a warm heart that they were giving to a hungry traveler who was exhausted from the heat. The food was also very, very delicious. I was so hungry that I tried to eat two dishes, but they told me, “It’ll be a lot. Eat one and if it’s not enough, order another.” After I finished eating, they wrapped up the chocolate that they had served me along with the water and tea that they had opened and poured for me. The female owner is Korean, and she said that she had been married for a short time and that all of this service has been provided for a long time! I was satisfied with both the taste and the service, so if I come to Pamukkale, I definitely want to come back. I hope the owner prospers 🩷 한국인이라면 무조건 가세요 무조건입니다 예약하고 무조건 !!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Michal Korinek
reviews.text: We visited Hiera Restaurant Coffee & Tea House based on reviews and I must admit that I have never experienced such a high level of service and customer care in my life. The owner of the restaurant lives for the restaurant and puts his heart and soul into every detail. The restaurant has a very beautiful decoration, the tables are beautiful and the chairs are comfortable. The food was delicious and the pickled vegetables were the best I have ever eaten in my life. If I could give only one place 6 stars in my life, it would be this place for 100% !!!, because it deserves it beyond all doubt. I have to bow down to the owner and thank him for an amazing experience. This is was once-in-a-lifetime experience.

reviews.author: Qassim Alshaikh
reviews.text: The food is normal The meat Döner taste nothing. No salt or spices. Thr prices are over. We order 100 gram meat 2 plate. With 2 ayran. Total more than 600 lira. Will not repeat the trial

reviews.author: Mamoun Ibrahim

reviews.text: In Trabzon this time from Dubai, yesterday we experienced the authentic local flavors from the Black Sea, enjoying incredible food and warm hospitality straight from the fishermen to our plates!

reviews.author: Dora Baba
reviews.text: Great fish! It was quite far away from everything but definitely worth it. Amazing appetizers and ikram (free, little things they share at the beginning). Loved every moment of our experience. Amazing staff, really friendlg atmosphere.

reviews.author: Dr. Nalan Kalyon
reviews.text: A must visit when being in Trabzon and experiencing a good seafood restaurant. The food was delicious and the interior authentic. We had the fish soup, sea bass, a salad and milk rice as desert. The service and staff were nice. The fish soup and fish was delicious and either the salad and milk pudding. What I didn’t like was that the order was taken at the front desk, we were not able to have seat and have a look into the menu as well as the servings of fish course were little - we just had a couple of small fish pieces on our plates.

reviews.author: Mais Qadri
reviews.text: Definitely worth the hype! Excellent service, food, and cozy vibes! Highly recommended I visited with my mother, we tried the şiş salmon & shrimp tempura along with the special salad & seafood soup! Authentic taste!! Thank you

reviews.author: Salah Al Humaid
reviews.text: I had a delightful dining experience at this seafood restaurant! The grilled Salmon skewers were perfectly cooked, tender, and full of flavor. The Salmon kofta was a unique and delicious twist on traditional kofta, and the sea bass in tomato sauce had a rich, savory taste that was simply mouthwatering. The fried fish was crispy and golden, and it satisfied my seafood cravings. The overall meal was a fantastic seafood feast, and I can't wait to return for more!

reviews.author: I C Solutions
reviews.text: What a lovely experience. I wish we have something similar in North America. The Meydan is an open street market that has any and everything you can think of. From furniture to electronics to appliances to jewelry to wearables to souvenirs to restaurants of all kinds to cafes to amusements, etc. You can spend the whole day everyday with your family and not get bored. It is close to some scenic sites and all within walking distance. You definitely get to experience the full Turkish culture at one place. A definite place to visit.

reviews.author: Alla Edine
reviews.text: Meydan is a gathering place and a wonderful market that shows the heritage of the region and the simplicity of the people. A clean place and all services are available, I really recommend it if you are in trabzon.

reviews.author: MAHA AlZubeidy
reviews.text: The busiest area in Trapzon where you can find, see, buy, and eat everything you like.

reviews.author: Fahmey Eusoff
reviews.text: The staff is efficient and helpful. There's a parking garage nearby, The road may be narrow to maneveur a big SUV or minivan, and get help from staff. The apartment is clean and spacious for 6 persons. There's an elevator. Location, right in the heart of Trabzon downtown, walkable.

reviews.author: Mahmoud Rababah
reviews.text: Meydan Parkı, is the central hub of Trabzon, serving as a lively meeting point for locals and tourists alike. Surrounded by shops, cafes, and restaurants, it offers a vibrant atmosphere that reflects the spirit of the city. The park itself is well-maintained, with beautiful fountains, flower beds, and plenty of benches where people can sit and relax. It's an ideal spot for a leisurely walk or a quick break while exploring Trabzon's historic sites and nearby attractions. Despite its charm, Trabzon Meydan can get quite crowded, especially during peak hours and weekends, which may affect the peaceful ambiance some visitors seek. However, its central location makes it a convenient starting point for exploring the city, and the surrounding cafes provide a great opportunity to experience traditional Turkish tea or coffee. Overall, Meydan Parkı is a must-visit for anyone coming to Trabzon, offering a blend of urban energy and a relaxing green space in the heart of the city.

name: Al Dhafra Restaurant
address: Al Dhafra Restaurant, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Jyotsna Rebeiro
reviews.text: Such a good all round experience. So refreshing to have staff that don't hover and yet available when you need them. Food was exceptional. The seafood bar allows you to choose your fish and have it cooked how you want it. Was doubtful but completely floored when it arrived- well plated and so yummy! We didn't go for the buffet asked which looked slaying displayed on a boat like table. But opted for jumbo prawns and grilled salmon from the seafood bar. Also indulged in a mixed grill. Free round of welcome drinks and after meal tea. The ambience is warm and adorned with heritage elements and vintage photos from Sheikh Zayeds time reflecting on the early Abu Dhabi days. Really, we loved it all. Thank you, we are coming back with friends.

reviews.author: Chelsia Gonçalves
reviews.text: I spent a week on vacation exploring both Dubai and Abu Dhabi, and this restaurant was by far the best dining experience of my entire trip. Everything was flawless — from the incredibly attentive and kind staff to the mouthwatering food and heavenly desserts. We ordered the premium seafood mix, which was absolutely divine. Every bite was packed with flavor, and the freshness of the fish was outstanding — genuinely some of the best I’ve ever had. The dish also came with access to a buffet of salads and desserts, all of which were beautifully presented and delicious. As a final touch, we were offered tea or coffee on the house, which made the experience feel even more thoughtful and refined. The ambiance, service, and quality of the food were all exceptional. I can’t recommend this place enough — it’s an absolute must-visit if you’re in the area!

reviews.author: Rotche Pascual
reviews.text: They have the best grilled garlic and lemon butter sea bream and sea bass. Cravings satisfied. Also, the staffs are very accommodating and welcoming. Specially, Lorie and Joan who gave an amazing service. Definitely will come back again. Keep up the good quality of services and food. Thank you!

reviews.author: Shadow
reviews.text: Good atmosphere,very nice service...thank you for your service special mention to Jo Ann and Brenda .. I highly recommend this restaurant!!!

reviews.author: Lima Kayello (KayelloFit)
reviews.text: Al Dhafra Restaurant offers an authentic Emirati dining experience with exceptional service. Floor managers Annie and waitress Jo Anne ensured a memorable visit with their warm hospitality. They also helped us pay our parking. The rustic ambiance, soup-salad buffet and open-concept seafood selection create a unique dining experience, allowing guests to choose fresh seafood cooked to perfection. For great food, top service, and a true taste of Emirati culture, Al Dhafra is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

name: Al Fanar Restaurant
address: Al Fanar Restaurant, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Noor Rabia
reviews.text: We've been there for Iftar in Ramadan. The service is great. Authentic atmosphere. But the food is average for traditional Ramadan dishes. I liked their Pakora. Their luqaimat is not that good I would never order it again.

reviews.author: Ibrahim Youssef Ibrahim Abdullah
reviews.text: The authentic setting is very nice, the service is excellent, the food was mostly good, I liked the lentil soup, and the biryani more than the baked potatoes appetizer. The machboos was full of spices and flavors. Also, the waiter Typhen was very helpful.

reviews.author: Sun-You Park
reviews.text: Typhen was an amazing server. He gave us great recommendation on food choices and an amazing service. The food was exquisite. I loved trying the local Emirati cuisine. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Karl Piper
reviews.text: Debrata was an amazing waiter he made sure we had the best experience, great food and a lot of it! this place is not shy on portions. Most dishes you can share for 2 I would say.

reviews.author: Nathalie Hughes
reviews.text: Saurav was very kind and attentive. The food was amazing and the service was excellent. They have so many vegetarian options.

name: Al Mrzab
address: Al Mrzab, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Tamer Marshoud
reviews.text: If you are searching for an authentic Emirati restaurant in Abu Dhabi then definitely you must try Al Mrzab Traditional Restaurant. The menu has a variety of Emirati and Gulf dishes. The Saffron welcoming drink is very tasty and refreshing. The food presentation is amazing and the taste is very delicious (No wonder the restaurant won 3 Michelin awards for 3 years on a row). The service was really nice. The staff were welcoming, smiling all the time and very professional. I highly recommend this restaurants if you are looking for an authentic Emirati taste.

reviews.author: Rabiyat Heydarli
reviews.text: From the first step this restaurant impressed me so much with autentic traditional atmosphere and design. Food was soooo good. We have tried hummus, machboos and biryani and loved them all❣️ Highly recommend this place 😍

reviews.author: M C
reviews.text: Al Mrzab Traditional Restaurant is a hidden gem for authentic Emirati cuisine! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with a beautiful traditional setup that makes you feel right at home. The food is absolutely delicious—every dish is rich in flavor and cooked to perfection. The Majboos, Harees, and Luqaimat were standout dishes, capturing the true essence of local flavors. Service was top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who made sure everything was perfect. Prices are reasonable for the quality and portion sizes. If you’re looking for a true taste of the UAE, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Xelcius
reviews.text: The meal started with a fresh Fattoush salad, a mix of crisp vegetables, pomegranate seeds, and crunchy pita chips, lightly dressed with a zesty vinaigrette. Alongside it, the hummus was rich and creamy, pairing perfectly with the soft, warm flatbread. The highlight of the meal was the Machboos, a fragrant rice dish topped with tender, flavorful chicken and lamb, slow-cooked with aromatic spices and lentils. The portion was generous, making it perfect for sharing. The addition of boiled eggs added a nice touch of richness to the dish. Service was efficient, and the overall experience felt like a step into the heart of traditional Emirati cuisine. Whether you're a local or a visitor looking for a taste of authentic Gulf flavors, Al Mrzab is definitely a must-try. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Hande Harmanci
reviews.text: A traditional restaurant for Emirati food. It was a nice surprise that an ethnic Uzbek Afghan waiter greeted us in Turkish and helped us with the menu. It’s a bit challenging to choose from the menu since there were only a few photos. We ordered a shrimp dish with tomato sauce and a lamb dish. Both came with rice. Lamb was really delicious. Shrimp was meh. The complimentary saffron drinks and dates were nice. The arugula salad was refreshing. Service was quick and efficient.

reviews.author: Lizzz G
reviews.text: Honestly, the taste of food is just right as standard grilled seafood. service was not so bad, however till we finished half of the dish, we found the paper tag on one of the prawns which was a bit disappointing as even is going to be expired.

reviews.author: farah ishtay
reviews.text: I recently visited by tafish and had a fantastic experience! The seafood was fresh and flavorful, with a variety of options to choose from. The staff was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was pleasant . I highly recommend the grilled shrimp A great spot for seafood lovers.

reviews.author: Aisha Alyaarobi
reviews.text: I visited Bu Tafish for the first time and had an incredible dining experience. The seafood was absolutely delicious and fresh, with every dish exceeding expectations. For dessert, the kunafa and watermelon were the perfect sweet finish to the meal. On top of the great food, the service was exceptional—attentive and friendly, making the entire experience even more enjoyable. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone craving fresh seafood and excellent service!

reviews.author: Mirna Amoy
reviews.text: We had lunch with my Husband and his family in this Restaurant, and we had a Great experience. the food was Great. the staff name John was helping us a lot. He is Nice and the service was Great. the atmosphère is relaxing.we will come back here again.

reviews.author: Lester Ivan Cabatit
reviews.text: I visited Bu TAfisha and had the most amazing dining experience in Abu Dhabi! The food was absolutely incredible, especially the grilled shrimp and the fried lady fish. They were cooked to perfection and were so flavorful. I also loved the nautical ambiance of the restaurant. It was so relaxing and inviting. I highly recommend Bu Tafish to anyone looking for a delicious and unique dining experience.
