reviews.author: Alejandro L.
reviews.text: Went here in December 2021. Great food and service. The outdoor dining area is great and it is located in the gigantic, gloriously tacky Emirates Palace. Make sure to arrive early as you will probably get lost in the fancy hallways of the building. Not to busy when we went, but the experience would have been better without the people eating near us smoking. But overall a great restaurant that is worth visiting.

reviews.author: Adam Elboim
reviews.text: Food was tasty and high quality. Combination of lots of different middle eastern dishes, including from Iran, Lebanon, Turkey. We had the lamb with cherry sauce and then the lobster and seafood platter, all very yummy. The only reason that we did not rate a 5 is because they did not give any time for us to finish the mezze before the main courses arrived, and there was a discrepancy in the bill (which I did not realize until we left). I would definitely go back here.

reviews.author: Liudmyla Ресурсное настроение
reviews.text: Amazing restaurant with super delicious food and service at Emirates palace hotel. Warm welcoming hostess, arabic atmosphere interior. Personally I love their hummus with freshly baked bread and shish tawuk (teste like my father cooks)

reviews.author: Ertra Natey
reviews.text: This Middle Eastern restaurant is located in the extravagant Emirates Palace hotel and serves Emirati food. The interior is minimalist design contrasting the Gold and flashy entrance of the hotel. I ordered camel tongue and it was delicious. Must try.

reviews.author: Delovaya Kolbasa
reviews.text: Great place with superb service! Nice and relaxing atmosphere! Scallops and wine recommended by Emad were absolutely amazing!

name: Freej Swaileh
address: Freej Swaileh, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Vijoy Venu
reviews.text: Famous for their Kuwaiti traditional cuisine we decided to try this as tourists. The meat was tender and juicy. The soups were served in carved out bread and was an experience. Their rice is slightly sweet however I felt it very oily for me. Good portion size and usually crowded place. They have seating outdoor and upstairS too.

reviews.author: Qaasim Illi
reviews.text: They offer traditional Kuwaiti cuisine, but I’m not into meat. I opted for salads and vegetarian entrees with Tannour bread. The taste was good across the board. The ambiance is warm and inviting, with Arabic coffee served alongside the recitation of a poem. Nice.

reviews.author: Azin Safa
reviews.text: My friends and I went here for breakfast. The place had a nice and pleasant atmosphere, and the service was relatively good. The food was very delicious but came in small portions—except for the liver dish, which had a sufficient serving size. After the meal, we were served Arabic coffee and dates, but the portions were quite small, and there weren’t even enough dates for everyone at the table.

reviews.author: Tasneem Alothman (Taz)
reviews.text: I’ve been to Fareej Swaileh (فريج صويلح) twice now in Kuwait, and both times the experience has been consistently great which says a lot. The food is tasty and hits the spot, but what really stood out was how fast everything came out; I honestly don’t think we waited more than five minutes. It’s perfect when you’re hungry and don’t feel like waiting forever. Another thing I love is the لقيمات (sweet dumplings) they serve for free before and after the meal. It’s such a thoughtful touch that makes the whole experience feel warm and welcoming. Definitely a spot I’ll keep coming back to.

reviews.author: Sally Chung
reviews.text: I found this place on Google while looking for local cuisine, and it didn’t disappoint! During the Gulf Cup, it was super crowded, even at 4 PM, but the 20-minute wait was totally worth it. The chicken was tender, the rice perfectly cooked and seasoned. Despite the crowd, the service was excellent and English-friendly. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to try authentic Kuwaiti cuisine!

reviews.author: Doct0r B
reviews.text: I went to them many times in different timing and occupations. Their set of menu is good to go and the test is amazing. The breakfast, launch and dinner each have unique flavors. Usually they serve the soup in a bread but you can ask them to be served in a regular bowel. I recommend the chicken soup. For the breakfast they have separate dishes or as a packages ( Freej Swaileh BK and Emirati BK - as I attached) For lunch and dinner, they have variety from rice to stew, I prefers beef stew (Saloonat Latham) with whit rice. For salads try Chefs special which is Arabic slaw with cheese served in a nice crispy bread and sour sauce. For dessert you can try different types, but I recommend LUQAIMAT with cheese (fried dough with cheese) and Karak tea (TEA with MILK). They have inside sitting and in the winter they do a lovey decoration outside, so you can have great time with your family and enjoying the nice weather too.

reviews.author: Oofy X
reviews.text: One of my favorite places to have traditional food in, I always ordered for delivery but this time decided to dine in. Unfortunately the atmosphere of the place is dead, it doesn’t give the same vibes as the branch in Kuwait at all, and there’s barely any atmosphere in the place. The food was great as always and the staff were so friendly!

reviews.author: Shaikh Annie
reviews.text: Love the restaurant with beautiful ambiance and the lovely staff. Even love the way they welcome people. 💗 I couldn’t add more pictures but love their welcome saffron drink and last lebanese tea and all food was really tasty fresh and MOUTHWATERIN. Must try these all items . You gonna love it! 🤩😍

reviews.author: Doyle Lee
reviews.text: A splendid Kuwaiti restauran super friendly staff! We had great food such as hummus, mumawash prawn rice and delicious leguimat. Their samosa is so worthy for a mention too. Don't miss the supermarket opposite for your hotel needs. Highly recommended for a complete enjoyable outing!

reviews.author: adnan ahmad
reviews.text: The ambiance was so cozy and welcoming. The soft lighting made it perfect for a relaxed iftar with family.Every dish was hit in the buffet. The elegant decor and peaceful vibe made our iftar even more memorable.

name: Hakkasan Abu Dhabi
address: Hakkasan Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Alain Duscher
reviews.text: Hakkasan, located within the prestigious Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental in Abu Dhabi, is a true benchmark for refined Chinese gastronomy. Awarded a Michelin star, this restaurant offers an exceptional culinary experience where every detail is meticulously crafted to elevate the meal. From the moment you step in, the welcome is worthy of the finest establishments. The staff is attentive and professional, creating a warm and exclusive atmosphere. Before sitting at the table, it is highly recommended to start the evening with an aperitif at the restaurant’s bar, renowned as the longest in the city. The cocktails prepared by the bartender are true works of art, blending subtle flavors with elegant presentation. The cuisine exceeds all expectations. Every dish strikes a perfect balance between tradition and innovation, with flawless execution and top-quality ingredients. The flavors are delicate, the seasonings precise, and the aesthetics of each plate reflect the meticulous care in preparation. This Michelin star is truly deserved. The restaurant’s ambiance is enhanced by a modern and sophisticated design, combining soft lighting with noble materials. The terrace offers an even more exceptional experience, featuring a magnificent view that completes this unique moment. Despite the luxurious setting and outstanding service quality, the prices remain reasonable for an establishment of this caliber. Hakkasan is unquestionably a must-visit destination for lovers of fine Chinese cuisine, where elegance and excellence merge in perfect harmony.

reviews.author: Varn V
reviews.text: A flawless dining experience at Hakkasan Abu Dhabi. An extensive menu with incredible variety – every dish we chose was perfection, from the dim sum starters to the chicken, fish, and wagyu beef fried rice. The wine pairing was spot-on, and the presentation throughout was refined and elegant. A special shout-out to Nilima, our server, who was warm, attentive, and knowledgeable. The entire team delivered impeccable service. Post-dinner, the outdoor bar served a great pisco sour by Paola with the top Ukrainian DJ spinning effortlessly cool tracks – perfect ambiance. Hakkasan continues to impress, with the same consistent excellence I’ve experienced at their London and Miami branches. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Érika Juliana
reviews.text: • Unforgettable experience, loved it! I went with family and everyone enjoyed everything, the food, the service, the view (from the gorgeous Etihad Towers!), and the overall ambiance. The restaurant is located inside the Emirates Palace Hotel and is definitely worth a visit. It has one Michelin 🌟 and it truly deserves it. • The service was really good, and Elena did a remarkable job serving us, telling us about the menu options, and introducing important details about it, all in a very relaxed and friendly manner. • We chose the Dragon and Qilin Signature Menus (498 AED and 698 AED, respectively), what a wonderful choice! The entire menu is exceptionally well-crafted, with outstanding quality in taste, presentation, portion size, and texture. Highly recommended!! (Prices April/2025) • Can’t wait to go back and definitely a premium Chinese restaurant I’d recommend :) If you found this info useful, leave a ❤️ to let me know. Thanks!

reviews.author: Marios Taramides
reviews.text: Great restaurant with a great service and great tastes. The whole experience was really stunning. I would definitely propose the Dim Sum, the soft shell crab, the crispy duck salad, the Chilean Seabass and for sure the A5 wangu tartar. If the weather permits it I would sit outside. Inside is a bit too dark and the music too loud to my taste. It's not a cheap place but it deserves every single penny.

reviews.author: Jenny Najjar
reviews.text: This was our first Michelin star restaurant experience so we had very high expectations and Hakkasan exceeded our expectations. From the decor to the service to the food, every bit was amazing! As soon as you walk in, your breath is taken by how beautiful the restaurant is, specifically the outdoor section. The service from start to finish was exceptional and did not miss a beat. As soon as the food service began, we felt transformed into a beautiful story by our waiter. The food was fantastic and the presentation was even better. This restaurant definitely deserves their star and their reputation! well done

name: Li Beirut
address: Li Beirut, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Sandra O
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived, the staff went above and beyond, demonstrating exceptional care and attention. They thoughtfully prepared a delicious meal tailored precisely to my special dietary requirements. Throughout the entire dinner service, they were attentive and proactive, ensuring every need was met with genuine warmth. The food itself was truly outstanding. Each dish was expertly crafted and bursting with flavour, a testament to the remarkable talent and skill of the chefs. They deserve immense praise for such a memorable culinary experience. Best kunafa I have ever had.

reviews.author: Katja B.
reviews.text: We had great family dinner in Li Beirut. The food was delicious. Service was great by Ebrahim. Very nice atmosphere with soft music and dimmed lights. Can definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Rossitza Doshkova
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of dining at Li Beirut, a Michelin-rated Lebanese restaurant that is proudly featured in the Michelin 2025 Guide for Abu Dhabi. Located in the luxurious Hilton Conrad at the Etihad Towers, this gem combines world-class dining with an unforgettable atmosphere. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm hospitality and a cozy, inviting ambiance. The soft lighting, the decor, and the soft music created a perfect backdrop for an authentic dining experience. A special shout-out to Ibrahim, who took care of us throughout the evening. His service was impeccable—attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly. He made great recommendations from the menu, ensuring we got the best of what the restaurant had to offer. His attention to detail and commitment to making our experience enjoyable did not go unnoticed. The food itself was outstanding. From the creamy hummus to the perfectly grilled kebabs and fresh tabbouleh, every dish was bursting with flavor. The portions were generous, and the flavors transported me straight to Lebanon. Overall, I highly recommend this Michelin-rated restaurant for anyone craving delicious Lebanese cuisine and exceptional service. Ibrahim's hospitality truly made the evening memorable, and the overall atmosphere was just the cherry on top. With its stunning location and Michelin distinction, it’s a place you won’t want to miss. I can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Mounir El Fassi
reviews.text: Li Beirut is a success story. Mr. Rawad, the operation manager is doing a great job, giving the place an authentic Lebanese atmosphere. Ghita, the assistant manager, is a real maestro in this wonderful restaurant. Akram and Ibrahim are simply great. To everyone willing to visit Li Beirut, try the Lebanese tea: it is so tasty.

reviews.author: sope jeon
reviews.text: Abu Dhabi’s Li Beirut was truly the best restaurant I’ve ever experienced. With a Michelin One Star, I expected the taste to be guaranteed, but the layers of deep flavors and the excellent textures really elevated the dishes. What impressed me even more was their kindness and service. My dedicated manager, Angel, was truly an angel in every sense. She provided exceptional service and kindly guided us on how to enjoy the meal, all while showing a genuine affection for Korea and making us feel welcome. Additionally, when I mentioned we were on our honeymoon, they organized a very touching event for us. I was truly moved. Once again, I can say it was the best meal to celebrate our last night of the honeymoon. I will definitely come back to see you, Angel (and this time, I promise to leave a tip… I felt so bad for not having cash!).

name: Meylas
address: Meylas, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Honest Reviews
reviews.text: We went several of times here, the food is good. We preferred the breakfast over the other meals. The only thing is that whenever we go there, we go in a time if brunch and the staff always get pissed when we order breakfast (not sure why). The other day we went and ordered breakfast, it didn’t seem to be freshly made, the eggs were dry.. and the fave bean were not as good as always.. the bread seemed to be soggy. The staff are polite but not as much friendly and it seems like they like to serve certain people and ignore others. Anyhow it’s a bit expensive.. but the atmosphere is really nice. It is a really really good emirati restaurant but it needs to be taken care of.

reviews.author: Alya 7
reviews.text: Authentic emarati restaurant with beautiful interior design and atmosphere. The service was excellent and food tasty. Prices are reasonable.

reviews.author: ASMA (Om Hameed)
reviews.text: 08/11/2024 Amazing place, definitely recommend. You finally feel like you are in a more traditional environment. We got there for a very early lunch around 12 pm so it wasn't crowded yet. All the food was delicious, especially the traditional salounat lamb dish. Will be one of my favorite memories of visiting Abu Dhabi.

reviews.author: Shekhar “Shekhoooo”
reviews.text: Food was great however missed the authentic Emirati flavor. Surprised few Emirati food was missing from the menu. Location is awesome to enjoy a coffee and chill out with freinds or colleagues.

reviews.author: Vignesvaran “Vig” Swaminathar
reviews.text: Food was nice and staff very friendly. Located within a residential complex and not too far from where we were staying on Yas Island. Our first time trying Emirati cuisine and it was nice. Chicken and lamb was tender and rice was flavourful. Liked the setting of the place with an open concept kitchen and decorated with a retro feel mix with tradition.

name: Mezlai

The only reason that we did not rate a 5 is because they did not give any time for us to finish the mezze before the main courses arrived, and there was a discrepancy in the bill (which I did not realize until we left). I would definitely go back here.

name: Saudi Kitchen
address: Saudi Kitchen, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Andy Wijaya
reviews.text: Saudi Kitchen in Abu Dhabi offers a delightful and authentic experience of traditional Saudi Arabian cuisine. The restaurant features a welcoming atmosphere with a simple yet elegant design that reflects Saudi cultural elements. The menu is rich with classic dishes such as kabsa, mandi, grilled meats, and a variety of flavorful rice options. Portions are generous, and the flavors are authentic, capturing the essence of home-style Saudi cooking. Signature dishes like the lamb kabsa and chicken mandi are especially popular for their tenderness and aromatic spices. The service is friendly and attentive, and the staff are knowledgeable about the menu, ready to recommend dishes based on your preferences. Prices are reasonable, considering the quality and portion size. Saudi Kitchen is a great choice whether you’re looking for a casual meal with family or wanting to introduce friends to authentic Saudi flavors. It’s a spot where comfort food and culture come together beautifully in the heart of Abu Dhabi.

reviews.author: Carolyn Pierpont
reviews.text: FANTASTIC! Authentic food and atmosphere! Very reasonably priced! A bit unsure to why people have negative comments on here as our experience was fantastic as soon as we walked in! Food was full of flavours! Highly recommend the camel!!! We had chicken Hamish and Camel and Lamb Mandi! Portion sizes was enough for a family but there was only 2 of us! Highly recommend this place good wholesome authentic food!

reviews.author: Tarek El-Gammal
reviews.text: The Saudi kitchen presents an exceptional Saudi/gulf dining experience in a stylish, welcoming atmosphere. From the moment you step in, the staff's professionalism and warmth set the tone for a memorable visit. The menu features a selection of traditional dishes. The Zurbian was perfectly cooked and delicately seasoned, delivered deep, aromatic flavors. Appetizers and desserts were equally impressive, with the konafa cream standing out for its rich cream and soft texture and subtle sweetness. Service was prompt and knowledgeable, enhancing the overall experience without being overbearing. While the prices are on the higher side, the quality and attention to detail make it worthwhile. Scoring Breakdown: Food Quality: 9/10 Service: 8/10 Ambiance: 7/10 Value for Money: 7/10 Overall Experience: 8.8/10 Finaly: A saudi taste that delivers on flavor, standard service. Recommended for special occasions or refined casual dining.

reviews.author: aisha A
reviews.text: Tried Saudi Kitchen and it was a solid experience. The mandi was cooked well, meat was tender and the rice had great flavor. The kunafa was crispy on the outside and perfectly sweet and cheesy inside. The sauces were a nice touch and added some good variety. The ambience was clean and comfortable, nothing over the top but it worked. Definitely worth checking out if you’re craving some good Middle Eastern food.

reviews.author: Nik M
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my visit to this place! The food was absolutely delicious, and the prices are reasonable. The space itself is large, beautifully designed, and feels very authentic. The interior is full of charming details. Great spot with a warm atmosphere — definitely worth visiting.

reviews.text: We've always loved the food at Sofra at the Shangri-La Qariyat Al Beri, Abu Dhabi and now we can add that's they definitely have gotten even better than before. A business meeting became a lunch and the lunch went on for two hours so you can imagine how good the food, ambiance and most importantly, the company was. Thanks for the hospitality. The biryani was simply out of this world and the Thai Red curry was killer.

reviews.author: Maricar H
reviews.text: I celebrated my birthday at Sofra BLD in Shangri-La, and it was an unforgettable experience! From the stunning lobby to the beautifully designed interior, the ambiance was truly captivating. The valet parking service added a touch of luxury. The spacious chairs and attentive staff made our dining experience even more enjoyable. The international buffet was a highlight, offering a diverse range of flavors. But the real showstopper was the rotating ice cream station, featuring an array of delicious flavors. It was the perfect sweet treat to end the meal. Overall, Sofra BLD exceeded my expectations, and I'd highly recommend it to anyone looking for a pleasant dining experience. Can't wait to come back!"

reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Sofra’s brunch buffet! The variety of dishes was impressive, with everything from fresh pastries to perfectly cooked meats, seafood and delicious desserts. What made the experience even better was the exceptional service from Mildred, Ruwan, Abdullah, Mon and Yan. They were attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed. Highly recommend this place for a delicious and memorable brunch!

reviews.author: rima odeh
reviews.text: Extremely disappointing experience at Shangri-La buffet. I had high expectations, but the reality was shocking. Most of the food was tasteless, poorly cooked, and many dishes were empty for long periods. The overall quality was far below what you’d expect from a 5-star hotel. We barely ate anything because the food was simply not edible or appealing. It’s unacceptable to charge this amount for such low standards. Nothing felt fresh or well-prepared, and the service did not make up for it. Honestly, this buffet is not worth the price, and I left feeling frustrated and disappointed. I will definitely not return, and I do not recommend it to anyone expecting quality food or a decent dining experience.

name: Talea

reviews.author: emma haider
reviews.text: from the moment we stepped into Talea we knew we were in for something very special. It happened to be our first night in Abu Dhabi and also our first marriage anniversary, and this restaurant made it truly unforgettable. the breathtaking atmosphere and decorations set the perfect mood for a romantic evening. regarding the food, I have never tasted anything as delicious in my life! i highly recommend Talea if you are looking for something romantic and unique.

reviews.author: Walid Kotaich
reviews.text: Walking into Talea was like walking into a Tuscan dream. With regional classics executed to literal perfection, Talea stands out for its authenticity, depth of flavor and the kind of service that makes you feel like you’re back at home. The food, I have no absolute words. Every bite was like a recipe from Nona’s cookbook coming to life. Each bite of this incredible, divine food, didn’t just melt in my mouth, it told me a story of love and then disappeared with grace. We ordered: Tartare Di Spigola, Gnocchi Di Zucca, Fettuccine, Rombo, Burratta and Tiramisu. Every dish was a dance of art and story of a Tuscan paradise and it left me speechless. The sourdough of the Tartufo pizza was lighter than air itself and it made me crave more. It wasn’t cooking but a painting, expect the paint was made from truffle, Italian olive oil and delicious cheese. The gnocchi was so so unique and mouthwatering that it’ll make you crave for more. I am personally a huge fan of tartar and this place, no doubt, makes the best tartar ever that it took me back to the early days of my childhood. The tiramisu is to die for and they even made it right in front of us. No one can do tiramisu better than this beautiful Italian restaurant. I’d fight someone for that last bite of tiramisu and I’d lose with honor. Some meals feed your tummy, this one fed nostalgia. All the flavors fit so well that I felt they were singing in harmony. It was like having a little dance in a plate or a piece of home. Don’t even get me started on how amazing the atmosphere was. The place is beautiful and there was even a live singer. Our lovely servers, Roshan and Davide , made us feel like we were being welcomed into a family; warm, familiar and eager to feed you until you surrender! The service and food were served with a soul and not just a smile because they don’t serve guests but memories that made me feel like I was right back home. The staff was so professional that it anticipated needs that I didn’t know I had until they gave them. The whole thing experience was just an edible escape to Italy, no passport required. I do recommend this place and I think this is THE Italy restaurant of the UAE. Want authentic Italian food? This is the right place to go! Thank you to all the lovely people here and my generous compliments to the chef because he definitely has magic hands to create such amazing, tasty, loving food filled with life and soul in each bite. Thank you again ! 🫶🏻

reviews.author: Sumaia A.
reviews.text: Several reviews weren't that great, so I was concerned about having my iftar at this restaurant. However, it turned out to be good. The staff were very friendly, and the food was fine. Usually, I don't like white pasta because it's often heavy, but this one was light. The tomato soup was also fine. The cost is reasonable for a fine dining restaurant

I wonder what they have served the Michelin tester. The wine list is ok, but slightly minimalistic. I guess, if the were not 1 Michelin star, I would have given 4 stars here.

name: Vasco’s
address: Vasco’s, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Reda Hashem
reviews.text: Located opposite the Abu Dhabi Hilton hotel on the waterfront, Vasco's remains a favourite restaurant with many. The restaurant has a very pleasant outdoor terrace seating area overlooking the beach, and is the place to be weather permitting of course. The menu has changed since my last visit, but there are some items that are permanent residents, such as the spiced grouper with mashed potatoes, and the Dal makhani... There is a small bar area where you can enjoy a refreshing drink whilst waiting for your friends. Inside the restaurant the atmosphere is cosy, there is a large bottle cooler refrigerator, a live tank with live lobsters, and a salad bar faces the open plan kitchen with a wood burning pizza oven. Service is efficient and friendly and the food still up to standard. Parking is usually available just in front and access for wheelchais not a problem. If you're looking to entertain, or simply enjoy a family meal out, Vasco's will not disappoint.

reviews.author: Nihara Hareesh
reviews.text: Situated in the exclusive Hilton Beach Club, the restaurant is named after the world famous Vasco Da Gama and the menu is completely inspired from his exploration route. With the marvelous view of the beach Vasco's serves cuisines from all over the world and they have manged to win some prestigious awards. I chose to dine inside and my favorite from the entire meal was definitely their selection of fine wine and mushroom risotto. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Cody Satterlee
reviews.text: This is a high end place at a medium-high end price. Seafood seems to be their go-to, although steaks are available. I had a Portuguese grouper which was saltier than I would prefer. Heaters are available on patio for cool evenings.

reviews.author: Carl
reviews.text: A mere image of its former self. Disappointing. Not sure what happened to the place, on previous visits to abu dhabi we were very impressed by the place leading us to visiting them again. Disappointing in many aspects, the service was not to standard, the food was not better that something that can be thrown together at home and the manager was rude and entitled. For the service, our waiter was kind on the rare occasions that he'd appear. The manager seemed as if he was well aware and content with the fact that his business would succeed on the business from tourists who don't plan on returning anyways. For the food, it was the biggest disappointment as previously we loved the meals that we were served. For me I had the corn-fed chicken which was bitter and served with some expired onion and mash which was spiked with flour for some reason. We shared the fried squid and calamari for a started and it was overcooked and not enjoyable. My family wasn't too happy either with their seafood dishes. I'll probably not go back there which is sad since we had good memories there.

reviews.author: Will Bailey
reviews.text: I visited this beachside restaurant in the early evening and had a very enjoyable meal. I ordered Punjabi style daal makhani for starters followed by a tandoori grilled red snapper, which was a catch of the day that I could choose before it was cooked. Special thank you for Kamrul who looked after me and provided excellent and attentive service. I would recommend highly.

reviews.author: Constantin S.
reviews.text: nice place for waking and drinks. The ambiance is inviting, with cozy seating and soft lighting that makes it perfect for both casual meet-ups and intimate gatherings. The menu features a variety of refreshing beverages, from artisanal coffees to vibrant smoothies, catering to all tastes. As you stroll around, you can enjoy the greenery and perhaps even catch a glimpse of local art displayed on the walls. It's a spot where friends can relax and unwind, making it an ideal destination for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The soothing background music adds to the overall charm, creating an atmosphere that encourages conversation and connection. Whether you’re starting your day with a cup of coffee or winding down with a drink in the evening, this place is sure to leave a lasting impression.

reviews.author: Ghida Braish
reviews.text: This was one of the most terrifying experiences I’ve ever had at a theme park. While visiting Yas Waterworld with my friends, I was electrocuted after touching the bricks near one of the rides — and I’m not exaggerating. I immediately reported it to the staff, expecting urgent action to protect others. Instead, I was ignored and dismissed. Moments later, a child was also shocked and collapsed. It was horrifying. Even after that, the staff continued to underestimate the danger. I begged them not to make me walk across the wet floor that was clearly live with electricity — but they insisted, putting my life at risk again. One security guard even got shocked when trying to help. Only then did they bring me shoes so I could get out safely. This wasn't just negligence — it was a complete failure to protect guests. What happened could’ve ended tragically. Yas Waterworld needs to take full responsibility, investigate what happened, and make sure this NEVER happens again. People go to waterparks for fun — not to leave traumatized.

reviews.author: Syed Muhammad Nasir Uddin
reviews.text: Ajman beach is a lovely waterfront promenade that offers a peaceful escape with beautiful views of the Arabian Gulf. The area is perfect for a leisurely walk along the coastline, with palm trees lining the pathway and a serene atmosphere that’s ideal for relaxation. It’s less crowded compared to other more popular beaches in the UAE, making it a great spot for those who want to enjoy a quieter beach experience. The Corniche itself is well-maintained, with clean pathways, benches, and shaded areas, providing ample space for a comfortable stroll or a picnic. There are also some cafés and restaurants nearby where you can grab a drink or bite while enjoying the view. The area is family-friendly, with spaces for kids to play and plenty of green areas for a relaxed outing. For those who enjoy watching boats or the occasional dhow sailing by, the Corniche offers nice views of the water. The sunset views are particularly stunning and a highlight for many visitors. Overall, Ajman beach is a laid-back, scenic location perfect for a quiet day out by the water. It offers a nice balance of relaxation and recreation, without the hustle and bustle of more crowded tourist destinations.

name: Bukhari Restaurant
address: Bukhari Restaurant, Ajman, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Saadiya Ahmad
reviews.text: We recently had the pleasure of dining at Bukhara, a beautifully recreated Northern Indian restaurant that provides an authentic and immersive experience similar to the famous location in New Delhi. The restaurant’s ambiance is truly impressive, featuring handmade carpets, warm mood lighting, and stone floors that create a cozy yet elegant atmosphere perfect for a memorable meal. We began our dining experience with a variety of starters, including crunchy poppadums paired with flavorful chutneys. The Papadi Chaat was a standout—crispy and topped with potato, pomegranate, tamarind, and whipped curd, offering a delightful mix of textures and flavors. We also enjoyed Amritsari Jhinga—batter-fried tiger prawns that were perfectly crispy—and Chicken Pakora infused with ginger and green chilies, fried to golden perfection. For our main course, we chose the Murgh Dum Biryani, which was aromatic and richly spiced, with tender pieces of chicken and fragrant basmati rice. The naan bread was buttery and infused with garlic, complementing the thick, flavorful onion and tomato gravy of the Paneer Tikka Masala. The Murgh Malai Kababs were incredibly tender and creamy, melting in your mouth. The highlight of the meal, however, was the Gosht Ki Nalli—succulent lamb shanks slow-cooked in a rich gravy flavored with onion, yoghurt, cardamom, and saffron. It was served with rice and naan, and the complexity of flavors was truly unforgettable. To finish, we enjoyed traditional Indian desserts such as Rasmalai—soft, spongy cottage cheese dumplings soaked in saffron-infused milk—and Gulab Jamun soaked in fragrant cardamom syrup. Both were the perfect sweet ending to our meal. Overall, Bukhara offers an exceptional Indian dining experience with authentic flavors, elegant presentation, and a warm atmosphere. We highly recommend it for anyone looking to indulge in rich Northern Indian cuisine, whether for a special occasion or just a flavorful night out.

reviews.author: Nadia Aziz
reviews.text: Had An Wonderful dining experience with my family at Bukhara restaurant at Ajman hotel one of the best hotels in Ajman and best Indian restaurant love the food staff was so nice Sumi & Avay they are so helpful and friendly Had an wonderful evening

reviews.author: Ritika Khilwani
reviews.text: Disappointing First Visit Despite Excellent Food We were really looking forward to our first visit to Bukhara, especially since we were celebrating a special occasion—my parents’ anniversary. Unfortunately, while the food did exceed our expectations, the overall experience was quite disappointing due to the service. I had informed the staff in advance that we were celebrating an anniversary and asked if a small gesture could be arranged to make the evening a bit more special. Instead of being accommodating, the staff seemed dismissive and uninterested—there were no greetings or even a simple acknowledgment of the occasion. Throughout the dinner, despite our bill crossing 2000+, the service felt rushed and impersonal. Staff members kept approaching our table to tell us it was the "last order for drinks" in a rather curt manner, which made us feel quite unwelcome. What truly soured the evening was what happened at the end. After paying the bill and leaving a generous tip, we took a moment to click a few pictures to capture the evening. Shockingly, the staff turned off the lights on us while we were still taking photos. When we asked why, the lady attending to us said she wanted to leave to catch her bus, implying we should wrap up and go. We had barely stayed 5 minutes beyond finishing our meal. Having worked in the service industry myself, I understand the pressures of the job—but there’s a basic level of courtesy and hospitality that was clearly missing here. It was especially disheartening on what was meant to be a joyful celebration for my family. To be fair, the food was excellent, and we truly enjoyed the flavors. But the overall experience was ruined by the lack of warmth and hospitality, which is just as important in creating a memorable evening. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and works on improving the guest experience, especially for those celebrating special moments.

reviews.text: If you wish to to taste the real and distingueshed Indian foods so this place is one of the most unique ones i can highly recommend to you. Good for individuals and groups. Prices quite high for being Ajman, more in line with Dubai, but I can tell the quality was high and we massively enjoyed the food.

reviews.author: Ehab Ibrahim
reviews.text: An incredible experience that truly captures the essence of Emirati culture and cuisine. The traditional décor, warm ambiance, and authentic flavors made it feel like a journey back in time. Every dish was bursting with flavor — rich, comforting, and beautifully presented. Special thanks to our waiter Abdul Rahim, who was exceptionally attentive and welcoming. He explained the dishes with passion and made sure we had everything we needed. A great guy who made our visit even more memorable! Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy real local food in a charming, heritage-inspired setting.

reviews.author: Wael Mishlawi
reviews.text: I recently visited Al Fanar Restaurant & Cafe — a truly authentic Emirati dining experience. The ambiance was charming and took me back to the UAE’s heritage, the food was absolutely delicious, and the service was warm and attentive. Highly recommend it if you’re looking to try traditional Emirati cuisine in a cozy, nostalgic setting!

reviews.author: Ahmad Shairany Zahar
reviews.text: Very nice atmosphere setting. The restaurant has a very cultural indoor decor (slight hint of Malay heritage 😅) but also a very scenic outdoor seating where we could view the water-show at the waterfront. The food was very good although the portions are uncharacteristically small for arabic cuisine 😄. Service staff is very good and helpful especially our Nepalese server Chandramanny. Would definitely come again and recommend to friends.

reviews.author: Jeremy Meacham
reviews.text: Excellent and welcoming to foreigners. Staff spoke English, amazing service from our waiter Osama!!!! Osama gave us a welcoming smile and service he even tried explaining the foods to us which were new for us. The food was excellent! The flavors and dishes taste like an excellent home cooked meal. The ambiance and decor is also a wonderful setting.

reviews.author: Natalie S
reviews.text: I was craving some freshly grilled fish so I came to Al Fanar and it didn’t disappoint! The food was so fresh, full of flavor and fantastic. Abdul Rahim was the server and is so kind. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality.

name: Al Hadheerah
address: Al Hadheerah, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Sarmad Khemmoro
reviews.text: An amazing desert experience for an amazing food. From the beginning to the end it was all great. Some minor things should not be affecting my review such as the guy cooking the lamb and other meat fell behind and the queue became long and he had to under cook some meat. Also the server forgot many time our orders for drinks and had to remind them few times, but they never got the drinks. I did not really care as everything else was great. The show was nice, the hawk, camel and horse shows were enjoyable. The buffet was huge with many selected options. Good place to visit while in Dubai.

reviews.author: Maria Guzman
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience, we came to celebrate mom’s birthday and since we got here the staff was attentive to make this a memorable celebration. The food was amazing, our hostesses Subash was on top of everything. Yasser the team were very cautious with every detail to make it simply espectacular. The staff is super friendly and the service superb. Definitely recommend, the show was a great compliment to the experience and making a lasting memory.

reviews.author: Hessa Alrowahi
reviews.text: I had Iftar at Alhadeerah Restaurant during Ramadan, and it was an unforgettable experience! The food was absolutely delicious, with a wide variety of traditional dishes that satisfied every taste. What really made the evening special was the live entertainment – the horse show was incredible and truly added to the magic of the evening. The atmosphere was lively, and the staff was attentive and friendly. Highly recommend Alhadeerah for anyone looking for a unique and enjoyable Iftar experience with great food and exciting shows!

reviews.author: pooja arora
reviews.text: Highly recommended for those looking to unwind over good food while soaking in a sophisticated yet earthy atmosphere. The setup not only adds character to the space but also highlights the cultural significance of traditional elements.The open-air seating seamlessly blends traditional decor with a modern touch, creating an inviting and authentic ambiance. There was seating to accommodate 150 people in the restaurant. There was live entertainment, from 7 pm to 11pm.. couple of dances , ara Ian singers.. some music throughout.

reviews.author: Omi Narayan
reviews.text: Located inside Bab al shams, near qudra. A truly magnificent Arabian desert experience. Food, ambience and entertainment is just awesome. Plenty of vegetarian options. Definitely recommended if you want an extravagant luxury desert experience.

name: Al Mallah
address: Al Mallah, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Billy Hu
reviews.text: It’s not easy to find a good restaurant opening 24 hours, but Al Mallah is. The first time I came here was only to drink juice. The big glass has been already given me a deep impression. The second time we ordered the grilled platter. The taste was not bad. If lamb chop can be more tender, that will be better. But the whole experience is nice. Service and atmosphere were also acceptable. One suggestion is the menu. If you can point out which dishes can be recommended. This will be more understandable for the people who are not often eating Arabic food.😊

reviews.author: Randy Wan
reviews.text: Popped into Al Mallah on a whim and walked out pleasantly full and mildly pickled (thanks to the endless sides). We had the hummous, fattoush, and a mixed grill that came with their pickles and fluffy kuboos. Was it mind-blowing? Nah. But was it tasty? Absolutely. Everything was solid, well-seasoned, and arrived quicker than my willpower disappears near shawarma. For the price, it's an absolute steal in Dubai terms — proper value for money. Great spot if you're after a no-fuss feed that won't bankrupt you.

reviews.author: Roberto CR
reviews.text: One of the best Shawarma I have ever tried!!! Chicken was really good! From the bread, to the sauce, chicken and fillings. Also on the affordable side. Lamb was not my favorite, but just a preference. Drinks look appetizing. Pelé tasted fresh. The Shawarma "logs" (?) are visible. Everything looks clean.

reviews.author: Gloria Chaponda
reviews.text: The outdoor eating space was great. The staff were very helpful in guiding on the menu options. They even offered different pickles for starters. Great choice of drinks as well. If you happen to book a hotel with bed and breakfast along Al Mina Street this is definitely one of the places you can easily walk to and enjoy a meal and later do some shopping in the surrounding shops

reviews.author: Ghazaleh Hosseini
reviews.text: I ordered the beef and chicken shawarma sandwiches — the beef was flavorful, but the chicken was just average. I also tried the chicken shawarma pizza, made with shawarma chicken pieces, olives, and cheese. Unfortunately, it had a strange sweet taste and was one of the worst pizzas I’ve had in Dubai. I had ordered the food online, and by the time it arrived, it was completely cold, which made the whole experience even more disappointing.

reviews.text: Super 👍 All dishes were up to our expectations and beyond. Outdoor seating area is well organized and furnished. A must during good weather. Lamb Machboos was delightful. Chicken madhroba is a must for spicy lovers. A place to visit again for sure. Well recommended.

name: Al Muntaha
address: Al Muntaha, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Amy Khan
reviews.text: 🌟 Al Muntaha Restaurant – A Dining Experience Above the Clouds 🌟 Located on the 27th floor of the iconic Burj Al Arab, Al Muntaha (meaning The Ultimate or The Top) truly lives up to its name. From the moment you step into the elevator to the second you’re seated by the glass windows overlooking the Arabian Gulf, everything feels luxurious and unforgettable. ✨ Ambiance: The interior is sleek and elegant with panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline and ocean. Perfect for romantic dinners, anniversaries, or treating yourself to a fine dining experience. 🍽️ Cuisine: Al Muntaha specializes in modern French and European cuisine with Arabic influences. The presentation is artistic, and each dish is a flavor journey. 🥂 Signature Dishes to Try: 1. Wagyu Beef Rossini – AED 780 (Grilled wagyu beef with foie gras and truffle jus – absolutely melts in your mouth.) 2. Brittany Lobster Tail – AED 600 (Fresh lobster served with saffron risotto and bisque foam.) 3. Caviar Selection – AED 1,100 (Perfect for special occasions – served with classic condiments.) 4. Duck Foie Gras Terrine – AED 490 (Served with figs and brioche – smooth, rich, and luxurious.) 5. Caramelized Pineapple Tart – AED 180 (Dessert lovers, don’t skip this! Served with coconut ice cream.) 💸 Price Range: Expect to spend between AED 800 – AED 1,500 per person, depending on your choice of dishes and drinks. There is also a 7-course tasting menu priced around AED 1,250 per person. --- 📸 My Verdict: Dining at Al Muntaha isn’t just about the food – it’s an experience. From the view to the service, everything is designed to impress. If you’re looking to celebrate something truly special in Dubai, this is one place that should be on your list.

reviews.author: Ciaociao k
reviews.text: We had group set menu, I did not expect full service because of we were big number group. View from table was amazing, restaurant was not busy. We were so relax. They use beautiful linen table cloth, also Ercuis tableware. All polished, I love it. Service was so fast, BUT each meal NO EXPLANATION. This restaurant has awarded Michelin？star? NO Presentation. I asked ‘ How do we eat ?” Server answered very simple, but never continue explain after meals. I thought He would explain foods( because I asked first dish)but never happened. So, I asked again next dish, then answered. Interesting. This fancy restaurant is not explain when they serve. Our tour guide gave as menu in the bus,even though they have to, even ONE word! I felt ‘You are group customers, you do not understand English or?” Someone looks like not speak English or Arabic, but do not judge. I understand 3 languages. They have to be Professional, does not matter group or individual. If they give this kind of service, why don’t they stop accept group? Very disappointed.

reviews.author: Robert Scarborough
reviews.text: Al Muntaha Restaurant Burj Al Arab. 1 Michelin Star. Friday 18th April 2025 The aperitif’s were excellent. Especially the mushrooms. I will remember the combination taste for a long time. The consume was amazing Asparagus so yummy. Crisp clean on the palate. deep green flavour Yellow tail probably king. Yoghurt sauce. Lemon little bit a muscle juice white Italian Caviar * This is simply a stunning dish. The raw fish blends so well with this amazing sauce. It’s amazing. Even the tiny disks of radish serve a purpose balance everything. Yes I’m in heaven again. Words will not do this dish justice. It’s just that good The white burgundy could be the best white wine I’ve ever had. Pumpkin ravioli domes Just 100% pumpkin. The filling is superb soft delicious nutty roasted pumpkin. The sauce is unbelievable skin sauce then 3 weeks aged pumpkin skin vinegar. Amazing. It’s just pumpkin but prepared to a degree of pure genius and deliciousness. This is why I do this. That just messed with my mind. Perfect. Bread butter * Crunchy delicious the seed that makes the bread is grown locally and unbelievably good. Butter milk is from cow who has just had a new born spiced with leaves of national tree of UAE Chaf. It’s a dish on its own. Aniseed Meat milk flavours are just growing with each bite. There is so much going on the nutty bread has a deep flavour the butter is au. It’s happened again I’m am tasting the actual animal through the perfectly clean natural butter. Amazing Talbut fish. * Turbot fish is cooked perfectly glistening in the light juicy delicious. Stunning white asparagus the combination is perfect. Clean crispy asparagus with sweet delicious fish. Beautiful dish. Sauce from the bones is stunning. No Canette (Duck) as it didn’t arrive they only cook it fresh. So chicken is the replacement with Chicory salad. * Roasted chicken that is elevated to its highest order. Roasted on the crown carved at the table. * The bread is family recipe he brought with him. It’s excellent chewy nutty delicious bread. But it has been brought out too late so can’t eat too much. * This is when you realise you are in the company of genius. The chicken is so bloody good. Sweet roast flavour with so much packed in. Sorbet * Ah no. Lemon sorbet, lemon from his local garden. Light lemon mousse with a bit of orange. Lemon Skins blackened in the oven turned into crisps nuggets What the They are amazing. Crunchy nuggets of sweet and bitter deliciousness. * It’s bitter (Blackened skin) sweet divine heaven. This a pure chef’s dish. Complex Mix sweet with mind spinning bitter that makes you think twice on what you’re eating. Amazing wonderful dish to intrigue me. Chocolate * What can I say the picture says it all. Beautiful chocolate with truffles ice cream. Nice fantastic way to finish. This restaurant is sensational. It’s not that it has a Michelin Star it’s the food. The amazing chef comes out with most dishes explaining them. He is gracious with his time. The staff are so attentive. The menu is exactly what I want. It’s not what you read. It messes with my mind confusing me with each bite. The outstanding dishes are the: Sorbet that’s is more and the Bread and Butter that confuses and brings out different flavours each bite. It’s a food journey that is a fantastic ride. Not forget the moustache bread

reviews.author: Yasmina Monzer
reviews.text: What an experience - and yes that was an experience not a restaurant visit. The food was completely sensational. Every dish was most minimalist in their ingredients but yet more flavorful and more elegantly presented than the other. My favorite was the salmon tartar. The service was top notch and the views are the cherry on top.

reviews.author: Selim Jahjah
reviews.text: Upscale your experience as it crosses any other restaurant with an elegant environment, it’s not about food more than a nice experience for a special occasion… everything was perfectly presented and served…. In such place don’t ask for a limits in your budget

address: Al Ustad Special Kabab, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Erlyn Gordola
reviews.text: We ordered kebab and rice, good for 4 person😀.It's worth to wait. Good customer service with the owner. The kebab was juicy, perfectly seasoned, and so satisfying. Fresh ingredients and amazing flavours in every bite. Truly one of the best kebabs we've ever had. Highly recommend for a memorable meal!

reviews.author: Saravanan R
reviews.text: After so much social media hype, I tried this restaurant along with my family. I'm really frustrated after eating. the taste is nothing specific. the price twice even we can say thrice for the quantity and quality. There are a lot of good restaurants, comparatively good taste and quality. Reviewing from the heart restaurant owner must think about the price. I hope what we paid is going in turns of good salary towards the workers who are working there. Not recommended for spicy lovers. May be we don't like because of no spicy or flavour.

reviews.author: RN Nañoz
reviews.text: We recently discovered this restaurant through a food blog, and we're so happy we tried it out immediately! The kebabs were exquisite; each bite was delightful and improved our mood. The restaurant had a welcoming and homey atmosphere, the staff were prompt and attentive, and the friendly owner was actively involved. It's no wonder they've been in business for 72 years. We highly recommend this restaurant and plan to return.

reviews.author: Itchy Feet Foodies
reviews.text: This is a famous spot for famous people to visit as you’ll see all over the walls when you enter. The service is great with lively, funny waiters and a good buzz. We had the mixed grill and it was very tasty, even the sour chicken. Recommended for somewhere off the beaten track in Dubai.

reviews.author: JJ W
reviews.text: Amazing experience. We have resided in Dubai for a year now and this is our first experience of Arabian Tea House. All I can say is …. Don’t leave it as long as we did! The staff are fantastic especially with children. The food is amazing. Don’t think there was an empty seat in the Tea House which is a fantastic sign. Will definitely be back again

reviews.author: Carl
reviews.text: The service here is top-notch, warm, attentive, and very respectful. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with genuine hospitality. The staff are knowledgeable about the menu and quick to make suggestions if you’re unsure what to order. Dishes are served promptly, and everything comes out fresh, hot, and beautifully plated. Whether you’re just having tea or a full Emirati meal, they make sure you’re well taken care of without being intrusive.

reviews.author: ABDULRAHMAN AL SHIHHI
reviews.text: This is our first visit to this particular branch, and we have already tried other branches of the restaurant. The service is excellent, the food is delicious, and the prices are reasonable. We ordered a DH 78 Egyptian breakfast tray for two or three people, but it does not include Karak, which is served in Gorri for DH 30, and free bread. The place is suitable for families. We also recommend that, if your first visit, download the restaurant app to take advantage of a free dish, as well as reward points for subsequent visits.

reviews.author: Lulwah Altourah
reviews.text: We had a great time at Arabia Tea house as always! The atmosphere is great, the food is authentic and delicious and the service is great! The staff is so friendly and our waitresses Bridget made the experience more special! We will always come back❤️

reviews.text: I have been to other ATH outlets but this one, in Mercato is my favourite! The service is top notch.. prompt and knowledgeable about the menu. My personal favourite things to try here: liver breakfast tray, hummus, samsa, falafel and their hibiscus tea. If you like Arabic food, you must visit this place.

reviews.author: Estelle Bara
reviews.text: I was looking for a typical restaurant to taste authentic oriental cuisine and I wasn't disappointed! What's more, the place is in the old part of Dubai, which enhanced that authentic feeling! I started with the Labneh and cheese rolls (with local Akawi cheese). It was really good! For the main course, I chose the sea bream, which was the fish of the day, and finished with a mint tea. You won't go home hungry, as the portions are generous. Finally, I'd like to highlight the quality and friendliness of the service! Go there with eyes closed! ❤️

reviews.author: L Bambu
reviews.text: First off Ahmed Raza is the best person you can have as a waiter. We consider ourselves lucky to have found this place years back (can’t believe I didn’t review earlier) and every time we’re in Abu Dhabi or Dubai we make sure to visit Ahmed. The food is amazing as well as the history of the restaurant itself. I would make some recommendations but rest assured whatever Ahmed Raza recommends, never disappoints. If you have time take a walk thru the restaurant and go thru its long history which brings you to the present which has great views, food, staff, and atmosphere. Hope everyone enjoys as much as we have over the years.

reviews.author: Waleed AlRayes
reviews.text: We chose from the seafood menu, and it was delicious. The staff and service were excellent. I recommend this restaurant in the area.

reviews.author: Ed Hoskin
reviews.text: I've been there three times over the last 17 years and the quality remains superb with a great position on the river, delicious juices, and just amazing meats. Not the easiest place to find, but worth hunting out.

reviews.author: Jim Leung
reviews.text: Great heritage restaurant built in 1935. Cuisine is modern Lebanese. The food is delicious and the ambience is good just next to the Creek waterway. Thanks to Raza and the rest of the service team for the warm hospitality.

reviews.text: This place was so exciting. The vendors are pushy but not forceful. Get your saffron here for super cheap. Make sure to get a refreshing Cane or mint lemonade juice. They were so refreshing.

reviews.author: Ziauddin Zia
reviews.text: A must-visit spot for anyone exploring old Dubai! Grand Souk Bur Dubai is full of character, history, and charm. The narrow alleys are lined with shops offering everything from spices, perfumes, and textiles to souvenirs, traditional clothes, and handicrafts. The sellers are friendly and open to bargaining, so don’t be shy to negotiate prices. It’s a great place to experience the local culture and pick up some authentic gifts. The atmosphere is lively, especially in the evenings. It’s right next to the Dubai Creek, so you can also hop on an abra (traditional boat) to Deira Souk, which adds to the experience. Be prepared for a bit of hustle, but that’s part of the charm. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in Dubai!

reviews.author: Jihan Dabbour
reviews.text: Grand Souk Bur Dubai is a hidden gem. The place feels vintage and real, not commercial or rushed. Streets are narrow, shops are packed with old charm spices, fabrics, souvenirs, antiques. It’s calm compared to other markets. You can walk, explore, and shop without pressure. Perfect spot to find unique gifts or local items. The sellers are friendly and open to bargaining. Great for quiet shopping, taking photos, or just soaking in the old Dubai feel. If you like culture and calm, this is your place.🤍

reviews.author: Nalin Hemantha
reviews.text: A vibrant gem in old Dubai! Grand Souk Bur Dubai offers colorful textiles, aromatic spices, and friendly vendors. Perfect for bargain hunters and culture lovers near the scenic Dubai Creek.

reviews.author: ManU Mohan
reviews.text: We visited Grand Souk Bur Dubai during our Dubai trip from Kerala and it was a beautiful experience. The souk has a traditional charm, with shops selling everything from perfumes and dry fruits to abayas and Arabic lamps. People were friendly and polite — some even spoke a few Malayalam words, which made us feel at home! Prices were reasonable after a little bargaining. A must-visit for families looking to explore local culture.💚

address: Dubai Marina Cafe, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

name: Gaia Dubai
address: Gaia Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Sandeep Samtani
reviews.text: Straight from the Airport for a super duper Greek meal. Started off with the delicious Prawns Saganaki cooked in a lovely tomato sauce. Next was the meatballs which were so tender and had a great taste. The third starter was the grilled octopus. Enjoyed all the three starters. Dessert was their classic cheesecake which was definitely the highlight Great way to start the trip.

reviews.author: Rei
reviews.text: We went for dinner after hearing a friend recommend it. The restaurant was bright, clean and tasteful. As we were ordering, the restaurant quickly filled up and we realized it was a popular place. The meal was well-balanced and tasty, and the staff were friendly and attentive. The desserts, which I had heard were popular, were also delicious. I'll try ordering something different next time.

reviews.author: M G
reviews.text: Gaia delivers a top-tier dining experience with well-executed dishes and attentive service. Menu showcases fresh ingredients and bold flavors, making every bite enjoyable. The ambiance adds to the charm, creating a refined yet lively atmosphere. Service is professional and engaging, enhancing the overall experience. That said, prices are quite high, so it’s not an everyday spot—but for a special occasion or a splurge, it’s well worth it.

reviews.author: Ekaterina Kelman
reviews.text: The food is amazing! Really recommend to try the goat meat. It’s perfectly cooked, so it tastes very smooth and comes with delicious sauce, vegetables and rice. As a starter, get baked feta cheese with honey. You won’t regret it! The frozen yoghurt dessert was one of the best desserts in my life! This restaurant is located in a nice area. You can take a walk after dining there and enjoy the views of the skyscrapers and Museum of the Future.

reviews.author: Umm Yahya
reviews.text: We went to this restaurant as a family and had a great time with our kids. It’s hard to find the kind of dishes served at Gaia anywhere else. We loved everything about it.

name: Jumeirah Beach Stall
address: Jumeirah Beach Stall, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: RAJESH SANAPALA
reviews.text: One of the favorite beach. Running & Cycling tracks available. Best place to spend time with your family and loved ones.

reviews.author: Tomy k Wilson
reviews.text: Nice beach in Dubai. Many restaurants for walking. Washrooms and changing rooms are available. It is easily accessible through tram. Many international hotels nearby that you can enjoy nice views of the beach. Walking trials are there for those who are interested in walking. Overall, nice experience .

reviews.author: dodie lukman
reviews.text: The beach was clean and nice to look and visit and sorounding by hotel facility around there. However beach is the beach and not suitable for the poeople who only visit but not sun bathing. Next time i will bring the swimsuit to get the real sun heat..

reviews.author: Milaaj Kk
reviews.text: Visiting Jumeirah Beach was an unforgettable experience! It’s one of Dubai’s most iconic public beaches, offering beautiful views, soft white sand, and crystal clear waters. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by how clean and well-organized everything was. The beach is wide and spacious, allowing everyone to enjoy without feeling overcrowded, even on weekends. The facilities here are excellent there are plenty of showers, changing rooms, and clean restrooms. Lifeguards are always present, making it a very safe place for families with children. There’s also a long jogging and walking track along the beach, which is great for anyone who wants to stay active while enjoying the ocean breeze. The view of the Burj Al Arab in the background adds a luxurious touch to the entire experience. It’s a perfect spot for photography, especially around sunset when the colors in the sky are absolutely breathtaking. There are many cafés and food stalls nearby, offering refreshing juices, snacks, and meals. I grabbed a coffee from a beachside café and simply relaxed while listening to the sound of the waves it was the perfect break from the busy city life. Parking is available but can be a bit crowded during peak times, so arriving early is a good idea. There are also options for renting sun loungers and umbrellas if you plan to stay for a few hours. Overall, Jumeirah Beach offers the perfect mix of relaxation, fun, and natural beauty. Whether you want to swim, exercise, picnic, or just unwind, this beach has something for everyone. Definitely a must-visit when you’re in Dubai!🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩😍😍😍

reviews.author: Deepa Dindoyal
reviews.text: The beach offers a good overall experience. The water is warm, although it can sometimes be a bit rough. It’s worth noting that the water isn’t as clear blue as often advertised. While the setting is pleasant, there’s room for improvement with more shops, food options, and activities to enhance the overall vibe. Still, it’s an enjoyable spot for a relaxing day by the sea.

name: Juns Dubai
address: Juns Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Azzam
reviews.text: It’s recommended in the Michelin Guide, and now I see why. The food was incredible; every single dish we ordered was packed with flavor, beautifully presented, and honestly hard to fault. They also have a pre-theatre menu on weekends, which is an amazing deal considering the quality of food and the location. It’s a great option if you want a high-end dining experience without going overboard on price. The vibe is also worth mentioning is quiet and relaxed, which can be rare to find in Downtown. It’s perfect for a laid-back lunch or dinner where you actually want to enjoy conversation.

reviews.author: Shams Dgh
reviews.text: A very fun and memorable experience! I went with my husband and we tried the eleven-course tasting menu along with the zero-proof drinks. It was exciting to try so many creative dishes that kept coming one after another. What made it even more special was how the staff took the time to explain each dish and share how the chef came up with it. It felt personal and unique. Totally recommend it for a date night!

reviews.author: Talsia
reviews.text: a warm, inviting ambiance and a team of staff who go above and beyond to ensure a memorable experience. The service is excellent — attentive yet unobtrusive — with a clear focus on detail and genuine hospitality. Each staff member was friendly, helpful and clearly passionate about what they do, making the entire evening feel thoughtfully curated. The food itself matched the quality of the service. The Wagyu Short Ribs Claypot was the standout dish — tender, rich, and packed with flavor. To finish, the Coconut Pie was a beautiful balance of lightness and indulgence. Smooth in texture with just the right sweetness, it was the perfect way to end the meal.

reviews.author: H Clayton
reviews.text: I went to Jun’s for the first time today, after hearing about it for the past few years. We decided to order off the regular menu, though we had originally come for Dubai Restaurant Week. For the starters, we had the rainbow heirloom carrots and prawn toast. Both dishes were delicious, offering different enjoyable textures. But those carrots I’d been hearing about them for a while…I heard they were a must. They did not disappoint. My only disappointment was that I had to share. The mains we ordered included the Dan Dan noodles and Seabass. Both cooked to perfection, though I could have done with a bit more heat on the noodles. For dessert, we had the mango panna cotta—it was light and refreshing; and we ended with the frozen yogurt, served tableside with the components of honey, walnuts, a gojuchang cookie, and chili oil. Wow! It was the perfect ending to the meal!

reviews.author: Sarah Jane de Jesus
reviews.text: We have high expectations for this restaurant. With all the rave reviews and our Asian background, we were excited about the flavors that would remind us of home. For appetizers, we ordered the salmon carpaccio and wagyu beef potstickers, and we loved both! The main courses were good, but they didn't quite meet our expectations. We tried the wagyu steak frites and miso sea bass claypot rice. The portions were generous, making them suitable for sharing. Lastly, the coconut ube pie dessert brought back wonderful memories from our childhood. It was truly nostalgic. ❤️

name: Palm Jumeirah Grill
address: Palm Jumeirah Grill, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Rahul Raveendran
reviews.text: Waugh!! Truly a wonder of architecture! Visited this beautiful man-made island in Dubai one evening, amazing views.

reviews.author: Sayandip Pal
reviews.text: Palm Jumeirah is a truly iconic man-made island shaped like a palm tree—one of Dubai’s most impressive engineering marvels. It offers luxury at every turn, from 5-star hotels like Atlantis The Palm to fine dining, beach clubs, and high-end residences. The views are stunning—both of the Dubai Marina skyline and the Arabian Gulf. You can relax on private beaches, dine at rooftop restaurants, or take a monorail ride to explore the island. Great for both tourists and residents looking for a blend of relaxation, entertainment, and exclusivity. A must-see in Dubai!

reviews.author: vaibhav mungase
reviews.text: Palm Jumeirah is a beautiful place to explore. The experience was not bad, and the views are stunning. I recommend visiting in the evening for the best photos and sunset views.

reviews.author: Xiao Xiao Chen
reviews.text: After you take the tram, you’ll have to walk through a car park for about 5 minutes to the monorail area. To buy a day pass it’s 35 Dirham. If you’re not doing any water sports I don’t think there’s much so you can skip going to the end stop, and if you’re not going to spend to go up to the view point (I think it’s over 100 dirham) then don’t bother coming here.

reviews.author: Paris Norriss
reviews.text: The crescent of the palm is a great running spot. The circumference is 12km so I managed to run a marathon by doing 3.5 times. The sights are nice as some of the hotels are quite epic looking but mainly looking out to see is so nice while you run. There’s not a lot of places to stop for water though as it’s all big hotels.

reviews.author: Kevin Van Bogaert
reviews.text: Pierchic offers a truly unique dining experience, with its stunning location over the water and breathtaking views of the Burj Al Arab. We visited for dinner, which was a memorable experience, especially thanks to the romantic setting and peaceful ambiance. The cuisine is refined yet honest – classic Italian dishes, beautifully presented and full of flavor. Everything we tasted was prepared with care and elegance. Compliments to the chef for delivering a menu that balances sophistication with authentic simplicity. That said, the pacing of the meal could use some improvement. Our aperitif had only just arrived when the starters were already being served, followed by the wine tasting moments later – all within a few short minutes. It felt rushed, and for a Michelin-recognized venue, more attention to timing and flow would be expected. Still, we thoroughly enjoyed our evening. For those seeking the best views, a lunch reservation might be an excellent alternative, as the daylight would make the beautiful surroundings even more striking. Overall, Pierchic remains a highly recommended spot – with just a bit more focus on timing, it has the potential to offer a truly flawless fine dining experience

reviews.author: Smilja Zeba
reviews.text: I am a loyal guest of Pierchic since 2020 and they never failed to impress me. From food, to kindness, atmosphere just everything. Food is very simple, yet very authentinc in taste, italian dishes. Great choice of coctails, moctails and other drinks. I always come gladly to this place, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Lachica
reviews.text: I've celebrated my birthday today, and it was amazing. Thanks to Erik who assisted us all the way, he even prepared birthday suprise which we really appreciates the most. He's very professional on his job and so attentive. The food was delicious especially the seabass and buratta. We will definitely come back. 🥰

reviews.author: 828cab
reviews.text: In Dubai from the States for a wedding anniversary and after an American Express recommendation, we booked a reservation for the Long Table Dinner. We were made to feel special from the moment we arrived at the pier, and the hostess verified our reservation. We were escorted to a bar on the pier and offered champagne. The table setting for dozens of people and the surrounding area were nothing less than breathtaking. Live music (very good band) and a service team that exceeded expectations during the orchestrated delivery of each course. Every single detail during the evening was attended to in a razor-sharp manner. We were even given a recognition gift for our anniversary and met the amazing chef. Having dined in many places, I don't think any dining experience I have had met the moment like this one did. Every course was very good and so were the people we met that evening.

reviews.author: Cerys Isaac
reviews.text: nice location but we weren’t treated very well by the staff (some other people had favourable treatment and it was obvious) they tried to make up for it with free tea/coffee at the end so that was something positive i guess. also very small portion sizes for the price and the food wasn’t outstanding

reviews.author: Sewan Rai
reviews.text: Food Doesn’t Need Borders – Just Taste Buds Being from India, I never imagined my first Pakistani food experience would feel this warm and familiar. I visited Ravi Restaurant in Satwa and tried Nihari, mutton curry, and their freshly baked bread — and honestly, it was unforgettable. The flavors were bold, comforting, and full of love. The meat was cooked to perfection, the gravy was rich, and the bread was the perfect companion. I could taste the tradition in every bite. Despite the differences our countries may have, food reminds us that we’re more connected than we think. In the end, it’s not about flags or politics — it’s about sharing a meal and a moment. Ravi made me feel that connection. I’ll definitely be back again.

reviews.author: Nithin Mukundan
reviews.text: Ravi’s in Satwa is a legendary spot for authentic Pakistani food, and it absolutely lived up to the hype. The place itself looks like it hasn’t changed in decades—completely old-school and almost from another era. But don’t let the appearance fool you—the food here is next level. It blows your mind and your taste buds. We tried the Chicken Achari and Mutton Peshawari, and both were phenomenal. The Chicken Achari had that distinct achar (pickle) flavor, but it was surprisingly subtle and well-balanced. The spice was just enough to add a kick without overpowering the dish. The Mutton Peshawari was the highlight—so tender and rich in flavor that it felt like it had been slow-cooked for hours. Truly delicious. All of this was enjoyed with their signature Pakistani roti—soft, hot, and perfect for scooping up every last bit of gravy. And we wrapped up the meal with a strong, comforting cup of chai. Ravi’s isn’t fancy or modern, but it delivers some of the best, most soulful Pakistani food you’ll find in Dubai. If you’re looking for bold flavors and a truly satisfying meal, this is the place. It was easily one of our food highlights of the trip.

reviews.author: Krystine Le
reviews.text: It was our first time at Ravi. Located in a humble neighborhood so the prices are pretty good for the amazing food. We ordered their popular Mutton Peshawari( recommended by a really friendly and warm waiter ) it was so flavorful and the meat was just cooked perfectly tender. We love it so much we have to ordered for second. The Naan both plain and with butter was great. Warm hospitality from all the staff. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Matthew Lee
reviews.text: Wow to be honest, I didn't expect myself to be giving this rating to Ravi. I thought it would just be a normal place for breakfast but the food really blew me away. Been thinking whether to visit this place cause as a tourist its not a good and accessible location so far from the metro station. Its best to come here by bus instead but I took a long walk from the metro station. I was actually thinking of eating the briyani and I was disappointed that I was too early for briyani as they only start selling briyani after 11am. I was already thinking of leaving the place but then one of the guys stopped me and asked me to try some breakfast food like some beef curry. I just said okay I'll try a small portion. I was a bit worried cause I didn't get to see the menu properly and was wondering if they would rip me off. The guy actually told me its not expensive and I had to trust him. He then served a plate of curry stew like dish and the moment I tried it, my eyes lighted up and I was like how delicious is that! The beef was so soft it just become flat as I pressed it with the spoon, and when I placed into the mouth it felt like it would melt in the mouth. I really cannot describe the curry but it was so smooth and not too spicy and so strange there was ginger strips on it. The guy then asked me if I would like to have paratha to go along and dip the sauce. I wondered how much it would cost again but I didn't ask so I nodded and he went to bring some freshly made paratha which was hot to even use the hands. I waited for a while for it to cool and I tried the original taste and wow it was so thin and crispy it tasted like paper! And the flavours was so good! And of course the combination with the curry was just the ultimate. I wished I could eat more, but he served 2 parathas and I only had room for one, and also just to be on the cautious side in case I get ripped off. It was so comforting and satisfying I was kinda just at a loss for words but just enjoying it throughout and saying wow wow wow in my mind. They also offered this dessert to try I just tried a spoonful and I guess I didn't try more I didn't want the sweetness to overwhelm the food I just had. When I went to pay for it I didn't realized that the price was so reasonable that my jaws almost dropped. This is one place that I will visit whenever I come back Dubai, not for their Adidas but this again! Also hope to be back to try the briyani at a later time. Its such a memorable meal.

reviews.author: purnendu sinha
reviews.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Ravi Restaurant is a go-to spot for hearty, flavorful Pakistani breakfast. The halwa puri is a classic favorite, and the Haleem and mutton gravy are rich and delicious. Their daal is comforting and well-spiced — great for a budget-friendly, satisfying meal. However, cleanliness and hygiene leave a lot to be desired. The place could really use some attention in terms of maintenance and tidiness, which takes away from the overall experience. If you’re here just for the food, especially breakfast, it’s worth a try — just manage your expectations on the ambiance

reviews.author: Manfred Vogel
reviews.text: Excellent coffee and sweets
